Taoka is a good coach, but has made mistakes in judging his players and the opposition. He still has an eye for talent though, as he recognized Uozomi's potential and gave him encouragement when Uozomi's skills were weak and he was thinking of quitting. Taoka also realized that when Sendoh and Fukuda joined the team that they would become key players. However, he thought that he could encourage Fukuda by criticizing him while at the same time praising Sendoh. Fukuda's personality turned out to be more sensitive, and after a year of criticism, he snapped, attacking Taoka during a practice match. This resulted in his suspension from the team, which is why Fukuda did not play during the practice match with Shohoku. Having learned from his mistake, Taoka uses Fukuda to great effect during the match with Kainan. During the league round match with Shohoku, Taoka underestimates how much Sakuragi's abilities have grown in the short time since Shohoku first played Ryonan. He also underestimates Kogure's abilities. Both of these underestimations cost Ryonan a shot at the national championships, and Taoka acknowledges them after the game.   (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Tatsuhiko Aota
description: The captain of the Shohoku judo team, Tatsuhiko Aota is a childhood friend of the Akagi siblings, having argued with Takenori over which sport was better, judo or basketball, since their youth. This grudge continued until their present age, where their feud is over which team will be National Champion first. He once tried to make Sakuragi join the judo team because he considered his fighting skills exceptional, and to achieve this, "bribed" him with some photos of Haruko when she was younger. Still, Sakuragi refused, saying simply, "because I'm a basketball player" (actually because he knew he would actually be closer to Haruko if he stayed with the basketball team). But Tatsuhiko does not give up on trying once in a while. He is rather loyal to Takenori when the need arises, cheering him on when he is outplayed and hard-pressed during the second Ryonan match.   Despite his inability to physically coerce Sakuragi into joining the judo team, Tatsuhiko has proven that he is skilled, as he is the sole member of the judo team to qualify for the National Championships in judo. It is also worth noting that Tatsuhiko has had a crush on Haruko since they were young. She calls him "Ta-chan" instead of by his last name, which irritates Sakuragi immensely.   (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Levi
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3")

Squad Captain of the Special Operations Squad (known as Squad Levi) within the Survey Corps. He is known as humanity's strongest soldier. 

Levi is abrasive, blunt, and has a strong respect for structure and discipline. He is a clean-freak, demanding spotless cleanliness of himself, his equipment, and his environment. Rumors say he was involved in underground crime in his life before coming a soldier. Despite his emotionless and unfriendly demeanor, Levi cares deeply for his squad and greatly values human life.

name: Eren Yeager
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7") - 183 cm (6'0")
__Affiliation:__ 104th Trainees Squad, Survey Corps. 

Eren was born to [Carla](https://anilist.co/character/62475/Yeager-Carla) and [Grisha Yeager](https://anilist.co/character/62477/Yeager-Grisha) in Shiganshina District within the southern region of Wall Maria. He grew up in the town with his parents and foster sister [Mikasa](https://anilist.co/character/40881/Ackerman-Mikasa), who moved in with the Yeagers as a child. Eren spent most of his time with Mikasa and their mutual best friend [Armin Arlert](https://anilist.co/character/46494/Arlert-Armin), whom the pair often defended from neighborhood bullies.  

Eren is a passionate, determined, hardheaded, and impulsive young man. When they were children, Armin showed him a book depicting the wonders of the outside world. Eren grew to share Armin's curiosity of the world beyond the Walls and resolved to see it for himself. This dream inspired his admiration of the Survey Corps and his desire to join their ranks as soon as he became eligible for enrollment. 

When the Titans suddenly broke through Wall Maria into Shiganshina, Eren was forced to watch on as his mother became trapped under the rubble of their house and eaten by a titan. Forever changed from this event, Eren vows to kill every last titan.

name: Mikasa Ackerman
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7") - 176 cm (5'9½")
__Position:__ 104th Training Corps, Survey Corps
__Relatives:__ [Birth Mother](https://anilist.co/character/84341/Mikasa-no-Haha) (Deceased), [Birth Father](https://anilist.co/character/84339/Mikasa-no-Chichi) (Deceased), [Grisha Yaeger](https://anilist.co/character/62477/Grisha-Yeager) (Foster Father), [Carla Yaeger](https://anilist.co/character/62475/Carla-Yeager) (Foster Mother, Deceased), [Eren Yeager](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Eren-Yeager) (Foster Brother)

Mikasa is Eren Yaeger's foster sister and mutual childhood friend of [Armin Arlert](https://anilist.co/character/46494), living with the two of them in Shiganshina District within the southern region of Wall Maria. 

When she was young, her parents were killed by human traffickers, and she was kidnapped. Eren discovered this and helped her escape her captors. Later, Eren gave her his scarf, which she constantly wears and shares an emotional attachment to. She was adopted by the Yaeger family soon after. Because of these past events, Mikasa shares an unbreakable bond with Eren and lives to protect him, constantly worrying for Eren's well-being. After the Titans broke through Wall Maria and killed her and Eren's mother, she chose to follow Eren into the military to try and keep him safe from danger. 

Even as a child, Mikasa possessed impressive fighting skill and strength, and that skill was only honed further during her training.  Mikasa is considered a genius among all the army trainees and is incredibly skilled at combat and agility, to the point that she was known as the greatest soldier among the 104th Training Corps and graduated in first place. Though being among the best of the best, she remains humble and refrains from displaying arrogance. Ultimately, Mikasa's loyalty remains with Eren no matter the circumstance, with her only true desire being to live a peaceful life with him.

name: Armin Arlert
description:
__Height:__ 163 cm (5'4")
__Position:__ 104th Trainees Squad, Survey Corps
__Relatives:__ [Grandfather](https://anilist.co/character/84313/Armin-no-Ojiisan)

Armin is a young boy who was born and raised in the Shiganshina District within the walls, being childhood friends with both [Eren Yeager](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Eren-Yeager) and [Mikasa Ackerman](https://anilist.co/character/40881). After Wall Maria was breached, he chose to join Mikasa and Eren in joining the military, both to try to make a good and meaningful impact on the world, and to fulfill his dream of seeing the outside world.

Even when he was young, the naturally curious Armin has always had a deep fascination with the world beyond the Walls. As a child, he found and studied an illegal book about the outside world that was owned by his grandfather. He often shared the book and information contained in it with Eren Yeager, his best friend, and his dreams of seeing the world outside the walls. Armin was branded a heretic by other children for his unusual interest in the outside world and was thus frequently picked on. Too timid to defend himself, Armin would often rely on his friends Eren and Mikasa Ackerman to protect him from local bullies. This, coupled with his frail physique, was a deep shame for Armin, leading him to have poor self-esteem and to believe that he is a burden to others. Because of this, Armin has always been very eager to prove his worth, especially towards his close friends. 

Armin is known to be exceptionally loyal and selfless. He constantly worries for the safety of his friends, and he is always prepared to throw himself into dangerous situations to save them. Alongside his kindhearted nature and emotionally intelligence, Armin is a very analytical person. He likes to think deeply about situations and solve problems using his mind. These personality traits, in conjunction with his intelligence, good judgment, level headedness, ability to plan ahead, come up with creative ideas and to think outside the box, are what make him a great tactician. Although he may appear among the physically weakest of the 104th Training Corps, his incredible intelligence and strategic genius makes him an invaluable asset to any team.

name: Hange Zoe
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7")
__Affiliation:__ Survey Corps; Section Commander, Squad Leader.

Leader of the Survey Corps' Fourth Squad, Hange is also in charge of conducting research on Titans, and pursues this knowledge so passionately that they have become obsessed with Titans as a result. After originally holding a deep hatred for the creatures, Hange decided to take on a new outside-the-box approach to their research by letting go of their resentment towards Titans and approaching the test subjects with compassion. 

Hange is an energetic, freethinking and quirky scientist, with a unique way of conducting both themselves and their work. Hange is a genius outside of just Titan research too, using their brain to create weapons, tactical plans, and inventions for the benefit of humanity. As a leader, Hange is thoughtful of their comrades, and can easily figure out complex problems in order to create plans for their teammates to carry out.

name: Erwin Smith
description:
**Height:** 188 cm
**Position:** 13th Commander, Survey Corps

Discerning, intelligent, and widely respected, Erwin is the unshakable and calculated 13th commander of the Survey Corps. While he cares deeply for his men, he does not hesitate to sacrifice them for the good and prosperity of mankind, and his men have proven more than willing to stake their lives at his order. Erwin developed the Long-Distance Enemy Scouting Formation.

name: Sasha Blouse
description:
__Initial Height:__ 168cm
__Affiliations__: 104th Cadet Corps, Survey Corps; Soldier
__Relatives__: [Artur Blouse](https://anilist.co/character/131281/Artur-Blouse) (Father), [Lisa Blouse](https://anilist.co/character/134952/Lisa-Blouse) (Mother)

Originally from Dauper, a remote and scarcely populated village of hunters located in a mountain forest in the southern area of Wall Rose, Sasha joined the military as a cadet of the 104th Training Corps, where she ranked 9th upon graduation. After graduating, she'd choose to enlist in the Scouting Regiment. 

Sasha is a friendly and fun-loving girl. She speaks with a local accent from her home village, but initially hid it out of embarrassment by using overly formal and polite speech. She is a constant food hoarder and is known to have an incredible appetite; eating provided her with considerable gratification and relief, especially during times of great stress, and food was often the only thing on her mind when at ease. Raised as an animal hunter, Sasha specializes in archery, horseback riding, and tracking, although her eccentricity and unconventional methods tend to make her a poor fit for group operations.

~!She later saves a child named [Kaya](https://anilist.co/character/132738/Kaya) from a titan attack, who her family ends up adopting.!~

name: Reiner Braun
description:
__Height__: 185 cm (6'1")

Member of the Survey Corps and former cadet of the 104th Training Corps. Reiner is a passionate and strong-willed young man with a strong sense of duty. He ranked 2nd in his training class upon graduation, finishing behind only [Mikasa](https://anilist.co/character/40881). His comrades have great trust in him, and he is stated to be the "big brother" of the 104th cadets.

name: Jean Kirstein
description:
__Height__: 175 cm (5'8")
__Relatives__: [Mother](https://anilist.co/character/131444/Jean-no-Haha)

Jean Kirschtein is a graduate of the 104th Cadet Corps, among whom he ranked 6th for his skills with ODM gear and ability to look at things through a more tactical lense. Jean hails from Wall Rose's Trost District, and joined the military with hopes of living a peaceful life within the walls as part of the Military Police. However, he would later find himself joining the Survey Corps after being convinced both by his close friend [Marco Bott's](https://anilist.co/character/62479/Marco-Bott) words, and after witnessing the death of several of his comrades.

Jean has a blunt personality. He holds no restraint when it comes to speaking his mind, even when he knows it would not be wise to do so or when it could spark conflict. Jean is also pragmatic: he has a strong aversion to exposing himself to dangerous situations. During his time as a cadet, Jean was extremely hot-headed, easily becoming frustrated and quick to resort to violence when pushed. Jean was also very cynical about defeating the Titans, believing that humanity has no chance against them and openly mocking more idealistic individuals like [Eren Yeager](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Eren-Yeager), and saw resisting the Titans as a hopeless cause. However, despite these things, and although he presents himself as self-centered, Jean places high value on the lives of his comrades, and is willing to risk his life to prevent countless more deaths from his comrades. Even with his shortcomings, Jean has shown himself to be a natural leader, being able to understand others and assess situations well because of his flaws, and proves capable of leading his fellow soldiers when they are left confused and without a plan.

name: Annie Leonhart
description:
__Height__: 153 cm (5")  

A member of the 104th Southern Division in the Cadet Corps. After graduating from the 104th, ranked 4th place in the top 10, she ends up joining the Military Police. She is roommates with [Hitch Dreyse](https://anilist.co/character/86017).

A stoic girl, Annie is considered to be an isolated, solitary type, being rarely seen smiling or socializing and often having an emotionless expression. She is apathetic and somnolent, with little desire to put in any effort into meaningless disciplines or activities. Nonetheless, what drives Annie more than anything is her desire for a normal life.

name: Krista Lenz
description:
__Height__: 145 cm (4'8")
__Affiliations__: 104th Trainees Squad, Survey Corps

Ranked tenth in the trainee class, Krista is a very shy and kind, caring person, often being described as a "goddess" or "angel" by her peers. She is good friends with [Ymir](https://anilist.co/character/71479/Ymir).

name: Zeke
description:
__Height__: 183 cm

Zeke is the current inheritor of the Beast Titan, and is considered by [Reiner Braun](https://anilist.co/character/46484/Reiner-Braun) to be the strongest Warrior, contrasting [Levi's](https://anilist.co/character/45627/Levi) title of "humanity's strongest soldier".

name: Ymir
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm (5'7")
__Affiliations:__ 104th Trainees Squad, Scouting Legion

Member of the Scouting Legion. She seems selfish, cynical, bossy, sly, uncooperative, exploitative, and confrontational, but she can apparently be kind, especially to [Krista](https://anilist.co/character/62481/Krista-Lenz).

name: Connie Springer
description:
__Height__: 158 cm (5'2")  
__Relatives:__ [Mother](https://anilist.co/character/137287/Conny-no-Haha), Martin Springer (Brother), Sunny Springer (Sister)

Connie Springer is a graduate of the 104th Training Corps, having ranked 8th in class. He is known to be one of the quickest soldiers while using ODM gear and is skilled at making very sharp turns. He hails from the rural Ragako Village within Wall Rose, his greatest ambition being to make his family and village proud of him. Upon graduation, he chose to join the Survey Corps. 

Upbeat and naive, Connie is rather unfocused outside of combat, and enjoys goofing around and messing with his friends, but can also be a bit dense at times, as he can have some difficulty comprehending new developments as they appear. Connie always tries to remain optimistic, consistently caring for the well-being of his friends, family and village, and being willing to help in any way he can. However, this soft spot and the struggles he goes through as a member of the Survey Corps takes a toll on him, as he often responds to grief and loss with anger, irritation and hatred, causing him to at times make rash, impulsive decisions. He will do anything to protect his family, whether it be his biological family or his closest friends.

name: Narrator
description:
This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. 

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

name: Floch Forster
description:
Floch is a new recruit in the Survey Corps. He joined the Survey Corps during the two months between the attack at Orvud District and the return to Shiganshina District.

~!After the rest of the Yeagerists are killed during the port battle, Floch hides on the ship to Marley. After shooting holes in the fuel tank of the flying boat, Floch is ultimately killed by Mikasa.!~

name: Bertolt Hoover
description:
__Height__: 192 cm (6'3")  
__Affiliation__: Survey Corps

Member of the Survey Corps and former cadet of the 104th Training Corps. Bertoldt ranked 3rd in his training class upon graduation, finishing behind only [Mikasa](https://anilist.co/character/40881) and his hometown friend [Reiner](https://anilist.co/character/46484). He is a quiet young man who identifies himself as someone with a weak will that follows popular opinion. Despite ranking 3rd in his class, his training commandant noted him to be a person with great potential, but an utter lack of initiative. Bertoldt originally he enlisted in the military with aspirations of joining the Military Police and living in the safety of the inner wall, but after the Battle of Trost he instead decided to join the Survey Corps.

name: Kenny Ackerman
description:
__Affiliation:__ Military Police; Captain of Anti-Personnel Control Squad.
__Relatives:__ [Kuchel Ackerman](https://anilist.co/character/127940/Kuchel-Ackerman) (Sister), [Unnamed Grandfather](https://anilist.co/character/128589/Kenny-no-Ojiisan), 

Kenny Ackerman is a member of the Military Police Brigade's First Interior Squad and also the Anti-Personnel Control Squad. Decades prior, however, Kenny was known as an infamous serial killer that stalked victims in the capitol. 

Despite his dark field of work, Kenny appears to be rather jovial and takes pleasure in taunting his adversaries during battle. When fighting, he becomes animated and lively, often making a scene or otherwise throwing insults and witticisms. However, he also fought with control and was able to effortlessly sneak up on his targets when they least expected him. His preferred method of killing during his time as a serial killer was to slit the throats of his victims which earned him his infamous handle "Kenny the Ripper", and it was rumored that he murdered over 100 members of the Military Police Brigade. However, decades later his killings ceased and the terror that he once inspired dwindled into an Urban Legend. He eventually was found working under the Royal Government, the reasoning for his sudden shift in behavior being a mystery. Kenny is ultimately, despite his comical personality, very cold and calculated, sparing little emotional attachment or loyalty to anyone, with only a few exceptions.

~!ㅤ
He notably shares the same bloodline as both [Levi](https://anilist.co/character/45627/Levi) and [Mikasa Ackerman](https://anilist.co/character/40881/Mikasa-Ackerman).!~

name: Dot Pixis
description: The highest-ranked Administrator of the Southern Region. Head of the Garrison's Southern Territories, Pixis is a cunning leader with astute insights. However, he is also an alcoholic who is constantly watched over by his aid, [Anka](https://anilist.co/character/84331/Anka-Rheinberger), who constantly scolds him for sleeping and drinking during critical moments.

name: Grisha Yeager
description:
Father of [Eren Yaeger](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Eren-Yeager) and caretaker of [Mikasa Ackerman](https://anilist.co/character/40881/Mikasa-Ackerman). He is a renowned doctor who was well respected in the District of Shiganshina after he saved the village from a mysterious viral epidemic by developing vaccines. He also provides a medical house call service to the people of Shiganshina and to various towns in addition to having a network of contacts within the Corps of the Shiganshina District. He is married to [Carla Yaeger](https://anilist.co/character/62475).

~!In the basement of the Yeager family house, he hides a secret which he refers to as the "truth". Upon finding Eren after the fall of Wall Maria, he injects him with a series of chemicals and amnesiacs and entrusts him with the key to the "truth", before mysteriously disappearing. This strange serum resulted in Eren gaining the ability to transform into a titan.!~

name: Hitch Dreyse
description:
**Height:** 168 cm
__Affiliations:__ 104th Cadet Corps.

Recruit of the Military Police stationed in Stohess District. She was roommates with [Annie Leonhart](https://anilist.co/character/46490/Annie-Leonhart).

Hitch acts immature in certain ways, she has a sarcastic, easygoing personality and seems to mischievously enjoy teasing and needling her fellow officers, especially [Marlo Freudenberg](https://anilist.co/character/71457/Marlo-Freudenberg). She claims she chose to join the Military Police out of laziness, as it is well known that the senior staff are incredibly corrupt and she wanted to benefit from the system herself; however, she did not take into account that, as a new recruit, her superiors would dump all their work on her. Though she may act a bit air-headed at times, Hitch is not selfish and cares about those around her, especially her fellow comrades.

name: Marco Bott
description:
__Height__: 178 cm (5'9")
__Affiliations__: 104th Training Corps

Originally from Jinae District. Marco ranked 7th in the 104th Training Corps and is widely respected by other cadets of the 104th. Marco is a very kind, calm, and idealistic person, valuing the good of the group above his own interests, as well as understanding and coping with his own shortcomings and limitations. He is seen as a natural leader, and desires to join the Military Police to serve near the King. 

*Note: Marco Bott is the official English translation by Kodansha.*

name: Carla Yeager
description: Eren's mother.   ~!She's eaten alive in the second chapter.!~ Note: Carla Yeager is the official English translation by Kodansha.

name: Marlo Freudenberg
description:
__Affiliations:__ Military Police, 104th Cadet Corps.

Recruit of the Military Police stationed in Stohess District.

While most who join the Military Police Regiment do so because they want a safe position far from the danger of the Titans, Marlo did so because he claims to want "to uphold justice and do what's right.", much to the amusement of his fellow officer, [Hitch Dreyse](https://anilist.co/character/86017/Hitch-Dreyse), whom he often clashes with due to them being near complete opposites. His goal is to rise to the top of the organization so he can stop the pilfering of taxes and misappropriation of land. Though steadfast in his idealism, he could make moral compromises to achieve his goal, confessing a willingness to act like "scum" in order to move up in rank. Due to his passion towards his ideals, he had often been compared to [Eren Yeager](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Eren-Yeager) by people who know both of them.

name: Moblit Berner
description:
__Height:__ 176 cm (5'9")
__Affiliation:__ Survey Corps; Executive Officer, Fourth Squad.

A veteran member of the Survey Corps and [Hange Zoe](https://anilist.co/character/71121/Hange-Zoe)'s second-in-command within the Survey Corps' Fourth Squad. He also serves as Hanji's assistant and messenger.

He comes across as an intelligent and responsible person, which may be the reason he was tasked to keep his overzealous and eccentric superior out of trouble. Much of the time, this leaves him in a state of near-panic, having to constantly remind Hange to be more careful or yanking them to safety. That he remains at Hange's side constantly suggests he is a loyal person, and that he cares deeply for his superior's safety, regardless of the stress involved with being under their command. He is also able to show signs of a serious nature when it comes to missions, going out of his way to investigate problems and put himself in danger before others.

name: Phosphophyllite
description:
**Hardness**: 3.5 ~!(legs: 7; head: 5)!~

The main protagonist and the youngest gem when the story began. They're weak, brittle - not suited for battle - and their clumsiness makes them difficult to maintain any roles, even though they've always wanted to be useful. Phos' initial job was to make a natural history encyclopedia which they progressed very little on. They promised to help [Cinnabar](https://anilist.co/character/123384/Cinnabar) find a job suited for them as well.

Phos is a young, overconfident, clumsy, and naive gem, who is the only one capable of getting away with talking back to [Kongou](https://anilist.co/character/123394/Kongou). Many gems describe them as lazy and useless due to their fragility and incompetence, although Phos does display a drive to help Sensei and the others, often held back by their low hardness. There is an underlying way of how Phos acts and speaks about themselves that hints at them taking the “useless” and “lazy” comments to heart, and impacting their self-esteem. These facts indicate that Phos may have something of an inferiority complex. They settle with what they can do and constantly state that they will try better next time. Phos displays a change of personality over the course of the series, mainly due to maturing, trauma, and outside influences. This is mainly due to the fact that the gems are not equipped to deal with trauma.

Phosphophyllite wears a standard winter uniform and black shoes without socks, occasionally accompanied by long black gloves. Phos has mint-green features known by the gems and the Admirabilis as the Lunarians' favorite color. Their hair is short, originally just beneath the ears, but cut shorter in later chapters to imitate [Antarcticite](https://anilist.co/character/124307/Antarcticite)'s hairstyle.

name: Shinsha
description:
**Hardness**: 2

The only gem who goes on night patrol. Due to their body producing Mercury (which is harmful to gems and living things), they are isolated and insecure. They hate fighting and hate to be seen.

According to [Rutile](https://anilist.co/character/123399/Rutile), Cinnabar has an extraordinary amount of talent and combat ability, but is too much to handle due to their uncontrollable poison. Cinnabar's silver poison gathers faint light at night, which keeps them awake and aware while night patrolling. According to [Kongou](https://anilist.co/character/123394/Kongou), the night patrol is something Cinnabar came up with themselves. They used to spend their time during the day in Hollow Cape, waiting for the Lunarians to take them since they thought they may at least be of use to them. They are knowledgeable about things other gems don't know about.

[Phosphophyllite](https://anilist.co/character/123385/Phosphophyllite) was recommended by the gems to see Cinnabar for the encyclopedia. After accidentally hearing their secret and wish, Phos promises to help Cinnabar find a job more suited to them than night patrol, saying, "a fun job only you can do." When encountering Phos each time, Cinnabar seems doubtful of their words, but they are the only gem they regularly speak to. Although they try not to show it, they have a tiny sliver of hope that Phos will be able to fulfill their promise.

Cinnabar is able to pull out an abundant amount of mercury. They're able to manipulate it in the air, from a distance, and around them. They seem to not be in full control over it and sometimes release it without wanting to.

name: Diamond
description:
**Hardness**: 10

One of the gems who mainly does patrol duty. They're partners with [Bort](https://anilist.co/character/123389/Bort). Despite Diamond's high offensive power, their toughness is second-rate and easily broken. The other gems consider them lovely and a top fashion model.

Diamond is friendly, kind, and gentle. They appear to be relatively calm during battle, even when their situation isn't good. However, they are actually insecure and frustrated with their current body which, though being the hardest, shatters easily. They dislike being compared to Bort, although they admire their younger sibling a lot. They are perceptive regarding gems' inner feelings and relationships, though [Cinnabar](https://anilist.co/character/123384/Cinnabar) accuses them of seeing everything as some kind of romance. Despite Diamond's more gentle nature, they're very stubborn and tend to fight until they shatter. From Bort's point of view, Diamond is extremely reckless.

~!Diamond is one of the gems who accompanies [Phos](https://anilist.co/character/123385/Phosphophyllite) to the moon. They tell Phos that they "want to go somewhere without Bort".!~

name: Antarcticite
description:
__Hardness:__ 3

Antarcticite is the gem assigned to winter duty while the others hibernate. Due to their crystal composition, Antarc "sleeps" in liquid form when it is above room-temperatures, and re-crystallizes when the temperature drops. The colder the temperature, the harder they become.

Antarc is a perfectionist who acts like a soldier, marching and speaking with extreme formality. They are used to working alone, as all the other gems hibernate during the winter. Despite their usual cold attitude, Antarc has a soft side, and they love [Kongou](https://anilist.co/character/123394/Kongou) more than anything, often breaking their usual icy demeanor around him. They do not like to openly show this softer side though, becoming extremely embarrassed when [Phos](https://anilist.co/character/123385/Phosphophyllite) sees them like that.

name: Padparadscha
description:
__Hardness:__ 9

One of the elder gems who mainly does patrol duty, but is currently inactive. Padparadscha was born with an incomplete torso, which affects their consciousness. They're partners with [Rutile](https://anilist.co/character/123399/Rutile), who also maintains their health.

Padpa is easygoing, but knows a lot more than what they let on. They want the other gems to stop worrying about them, and would like to sleep in order not to burden anyone.

name: Bort
description:
__Hardness:__ 10

One of the gems who mainly does patrol duty. They're partners with [Diamond](https://anilist.co/character/123390/Diamond). Bort is a diamond-class gem whose hardness and toughness are top level. They are a calm yet ruthless warrior who excel at battles and are obsessed with combat. The other gems call them a "battle maniac".

Bort is an efficient and analytic fighter, often pointing out the flaws in the other gems' tactics in a blunt and straightforward manner. This causes them to be seen as cold and scary to the others, but also to be respected, looked up to, and seen as reliable. Despite their harsh personality, they do have a softer side.

name: Lapis Lazuli
description:
__Hardness:__ 5

A gem that was taken to the moon before the beginning of the story, leaving only their head behind on Earth. Lapis was in charge of the library, a position now taken up by their former partner [Ghost Quartz](https://anilist.co/character/128723/Ghost-Quartz).

Lapis was clever, confident, and charming, with keen observation and great deductive thinking skills. [Euclase](https://anilist.co/character/123391/Euclase) remarks that although Lapis was extremely smart and pleasant to talk to, they would rather use their skills to satisfy their own intellectual curiosity rather than for the benefit of others. This meant they could be quite manipulative at times. [Cairngorm](https://anilist.co/character/124600/Cairngorm) describes Lapis as "surprisingly deceiving" and excellent at keeping secrets.

~!After [Phos](https://anilist.co/character/123385/Phosphophyllite) loses their head in a battle against the Lunarians, Cairngorm asks [Kongou](https://anilist.co/character/123394/Kongou) for permission to use Lapis's head as a substitute. He agrees, and their head is attached to Phos's body. This new head influences their personality; most notably, Phos inherits Lapis's deductive and strategic abilities, and becomes more attentive to details. Lapis’s personality also adds a more secretive and manipulative nature to Phos.

Not long after the head is first attached, Lapis appears in Phos's dream, explaining that they left a "message" in their inclusions just in case another gem used their head. They tell Phos that they also wanted to understand the Lunarians, but they were distracted by trying to rationalize the Lunarians' illogical actions during a battle, resulting in them being shot by arrows and taken to the moon.!~

name: Kongou
description:
**Hardness:** Unknown

Kongou is the teacher of the lustrous. He has a vast amount of knowledge and has the power to drive away the Lunarians with a single attack.

Normally, Kongou is quiet and stoic. When he speaks, he is straightforward and concise. He only rarely displays emotions, but this is rumored to be because he is deliberately hiding them and that his face would be very easy to read otherwise. On the rare occasions where he shows humor, he is still as deadpan as ever. Kongou cares for the Gems considerably and blames himself when they are injured or taken away by the Lunarians.

~!He is actually a prayer machine built by [Dr. Ayumu](https://anilist.co/character/285150/Ayumu), who Kongou sees as his mother.!~

name: Rutile
description:
**Hardness**: 6

A gem who works as a doctor. They repair cracked or broken gems and handle the management of herbs, pastes, powders, and other medical remedies. They are partners with the unstable [Padparadscha](https://anilist.co/character/124485/Padparadscha), whose body is actively being maintained. Besides repairs, Rutile is responsible for carrying out regular physical checkups and applying powder and saltwater resin to the gems' bodies.

Rutile is a workaholic takes their job very seriously. They are known to stay up all night if needed to put a gem back together. As a result, they are often tired and will take naps during the day. They are also a bit eccentric and sarcastic, and to take great pride in their job and research. They don't take well to having their medical authority questioned. Even so, they become easily embarrassed when pestered about things like love.

They are very close to Padparadscha. Hundreds of thousands of failed operations to fix them have not made them lose hope. They believe they cannot be called a doctor if they cannot solve Padparadscha's condition. They are extremely dedicated, bordering on obsessed with this task.

~!Rutile's mental state is broken after [Phos](https://anilist.co/character/123385/Phosphophyllite) takes Padparadscha to the moon without telling anyone. They have become more impulsive and feral in nature, and have abandoned their job as a doctor.!~

name: Yellow Diamond
description:
__Hardness:__ 10

The oldest gem, who mostly does patrol duty. They're partners with [Zircon](https://anilist.co/character/123401/Zircon). Yellow Diamond is cheerful yet mature, and feels responsible for all of their siblings.

Throughout their life, Yellow has had several partners—[Green Diamond](https://anilist.co/character/393651/Green-Diamond), [Ruby](https://anilist.co/character/393652/Ruby), [Sapphire](https://anilist.co/character/393650/Sapphire), and [Pink Topaz](https://anilist.co/character/393648/Pink-Topaz)—but they were all taken to the moon. Yellow struggles with low self-esteem and possible self-loathing for constantly letting their partners be taken by the Lunarians, and also questions why they bother fighting anymore.

~!They are one of the gems who accompanies [Phos](https://anilist.co/character/123385/Phosphophyllite) to the moon.!~

~!During their time on the moon, Yellow gradually becomes more and more mentally unstable, and eventually even begins to suffer from delusions, thinking of themselves as a Lunarian and becoming distressed whenever they realize they're really a gem.!~

name: Cairngorm
description:
__Hardness:__ 7

Cairngorm is the inner crystal of [Ghost Quartz](https://anilist.co/character/128723/Ghost-Quartz), who has a multilayered structure. "Cairngorm", the name given to them by [Kongou-sensei](https://anilist.co/character/123394/Kongou), is a variety of smoky quartz.

~!In a battle with the Lunarians, the outer layer of Ghost Quartz is stripped off and taken to the moon, leaving the inner Cairngorm behind. Afterwards, they take up Ghost's duties in their stead.

Ghost Quartz described Cairngorm as "rude, violent, and selfish", and said they would only listen to their old partner, [Lapis Lazuli](https://anilist.co/character/130062/Lapis-Lazuli). But although Cairngorm was initially infuriated with [Phos](https://anilist.co/character/123385/Phosphophyllite) for "letting" Ghost get taken, they begin to act much kinder, and even become quite protective of them. The two gems become partners and are both assigned to winter duty.!~

~!However, Phos and Cairngorm are never able to go on winter duty together, because Phos gets attacked and their head gets taken to the moon. Afterwards, Cairngorm pleads with [Kongou-sensei](https://anilist.co/character/123394/Kongou) to use Lapis Lazuli's head to repair them. In fact, they are so desperate to repair Phos that they even offer up their own head as an option. During Phos's 102 year rest, Cairngorm tackles winter duty alone, and frequently visits the comatose Phos.!~

~!Later in the manga, Cairngorm reluctantly goes to the moon with Phos. Not long after, [Prince Aechmea](https://anilist.co/character/133785/Aechmea) questions Cairngorm's extreme dedication to Phos and, upon examining the gem closely, discovers that their eyes still contain traces of Ghost Quartz which are affecting Cairngorm's behavior. After removing those traces, Cairngorm's behavior changes drastically: they remove their powder, begin dressing in feminine clothing, no longer seem to feel attachment towards Phos or Lapis Lazuli, and most notably, become extremely close with Aechmea. They have a very lovey-dovey relationship with eachother and soon get married, making Cairngorm the "princess" of the Lunarians.!~

name: Ghost Quartz
description:
__Hardness:__ 7

A gem in charge of the library and convalescent center, though they sometimes do patrol duty as well. Ghost Quartz has a body made of more than one crystal, meaning they have a second gem inside of them: a dark-colored crystal later named [Cairngorm](https://anilist.co/character/124600/Cairngorm), who has their own personality and is capable of communicating with Ghost. Their weapon of choice is a sickle.

Ghost Quartz is quiet, calm, and insecure about themselves. They seem to be rather isolated from the other gems. They used to be partnered with [Lapis Lazuli](https://anilist.co/character/130062/Lapis-Lazuli), who was the one in charge of the library until they were taken to the moon by the Lunarians, leaving only their head behind; Ghost was placed in charge of the library afterwards. They speak of Lapis in high regards. Although Ghost describes their inner crystal, Cairngorm, as "violent and brash", they both equally respected and followed Lapis.

~!Ghost temporarily teamed up with [Phos](https://anilist.co/character/123385/Phosphophyllite), but during their first battle, the outer Ghost Quartz was chipped off of the underlying Cairngorm by the Lunarians and was taken to the moon, leaving only Cairngorm behind. In Ghost's final moments, it's given a clearer picture of Ghost's attitude towards Cairngorm, calling them rude, violent, selfish, and annoying. However, Ghost then entrusts Cairngorm to protect Phos after they're gone.!~

name: Alexandrite
description:
__Hardness:__ 8.5

A gem who works as an expert on the Lunarians. They are studious and passionate about this work, being referred to as a "Lunarian research maniac" by the other gems. They even draw original Lunarian designs sometimes. However, despite being a Lunarian researcher, Alexandrite is forbidden from looking at or engaging with them. This is because they have a condition where, when they look at Lunarians, they have a chance of turning into "Red Alex". In this mode, their color changes from blue to red, and they go berserk, becoming obsessed with just cutting down anything in their way until they eventually pass out.

Alex originally started researching Lunarians for two reasons: one, to overcome their condition, and two, in order to retain the "fresh feeling of hatred" they have for the Lunarians as a result of their former partner, [Chrysoberyl](https://anilist.co/character/393647/Chrysoberyl), being taken by them.

When referred to with honorifics, Alexandrite hates being called Alex-san, preferring the cuter Alex-chan. This is changed to Alexi and Lexi in the official English translation.

~!They are one of the gems who accompanies [Phos](https://anilist.co/character/123385/Phosphophyllite) to the moon.!~

name: Aechmea
description: ~! Aechmea is the leader of the Lunarians. !~

name: Euclase
description:
__Hardness:__ 7.5

A kindly and knowledgeable elder gem who does patrol duty, secretary work, strategy planning, and other odd jobs. They seem to be partners with [Jade](https://anilist.co/character/123393/Jade). Euclase is kind, intellectual, and extremely perceptive. They're also good at math, and can recite any gem's age to the day on command. They have a strong sense of responsibility and often worry over the others.

name: Jade
description:
__Hardness:__ 7

A very serious gem who mainly works as [Sensei](https://anilist.co/character/123394/Kongou)'s spokesperson. They seem to be partners with [Euclase](https://anilist.co/character/123391/Euclase). Jade is responsible, hardworking, and takes things too seriously.

name: Amethyst 84
description:
__Hardness:__ 7

A gem who mainly does patrol duty. They are partners with their identical twin, [Amethyst 33](https://anilist.co/character/209228).

The twins work in tandem for most things, often talking at the same time or finishing each other's sentences. No one really cares which is which anymore, including themselves. Because twin gems won't break by touching each other, the Amethysts have a habit of clanging their heads together, much to the chagrin of the other gems.

~!Later, Eighty-Four switches their hairstyle to deceive [Phos](https://anilist.co/character/123385/Phosphophyllite) in order to go to the moon in Thirty-Three's place. On the moon, Eighty-Four has become their own individual and serves as an assistant scientist there. They seem to be highly interested in more of the psychological aspects in the science field.!~

name: Ventricosus
description: Ruler of the Admirabilis.

name: Obsidian
description:
__Hardness:__ 5

A gem in charge of weapon production. Energetic and bubbly, Obsidian is very dedicated to their job and will make others weapons without hesitation if requested to.

name: Red Beryl
description:
__Hardness:__ 7.5

A passionate and dedicated gem in charge of clothing. Red Beryl a workaholic who lives for their job as the fashion stylist and tailor for the other gems. Their style is very frilly, cute, and feminine, and they have a different hairstyle every day.

Red Beryl used to be partnered with Aquamarine, who was taken to the moon before the beginning of the story.

name: Aculeatus
description: Brother to [Ventricosus](https://anilist.co/character/124216/Ventricosus), ruler of the Admirabilis.

name: Benitoite
description:
__Hardness:__ 6.5

A gem who mainly does patrol duty. They're partners with [Neptunite](https://anilist.co/character/123396/Neptunite). Benitoite is a sensible, earnest, and somewhat timid gem who has a hard time saying "no." They're insecure about their lack of individuality.

~!Benito is one of the gems who accompanies [Phos](https://anilist.co/character/123385/Phosphophyllite) to the moon. They reveal that the reason they wanted to go is to become special, as they see themselves as too ordinary and plain.!~

name: Zircon
description:
__Hardness:__ 7.5

One of the gems who mainly does patrol duty. They're partners with [Yellow Diamond](https://anilist.co/character/123400/Yellow-Diamond), and they're the second youngest after [Phos](https://anilist.co/character/123385/Phosphophyllite).

Zircon is very hardworking, diligent, and responsible, but is also anxious, always worrying over something.

name: Ishikoro
description: ~!Pebble is a new type of rock-based lifeform that was born some time after [Phosphophyllite](https://anilist.co/character/123385/Phosphophyllite) prayed the Lunarians away into nothingness. Since meeting Phos, the two have become kindred spirits.!~

name: Morganite
description:
__Hardness:__ 7.5

A gem who mainly does patrol duty. They're partners with [Goshenite](https://anilist.co/character/123392). Morganite is overconfident, reckless, and loves to tease [Phos](https://anilist.co/character/123385/Phosphophyllite).

~!Both Morganite and Goshenite are taken to the moon shortly after Phos loses their head and begins their 102-year rest.!~

name: Luffy Monkey
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm
__Affiliations:__ ~!Straw Hat Pirates (Captain); Four Emperors!~ 
__Devil Fruit:__ Gomu Gomu no Mi (Rubber-Rubber Fruit) 
__Devil Fruit Type:__ Paramecia
~!__True Devil Fruit:__ Hito Hito no Mi Model: Nika (Human-Human Fruit)
__True Devil Fruit Type:__ Mythical Zoan!~
__Bounty:__ ~!3,000,000,000 (previously: 1,500,000,000, 500,000,000, 400,000,000, 300,000,000, 100,000,000 and 30,000,000)!~

Luffy is the captain of the Straw Hat Pirates and is best friends with all of them and values them over all else. At first glance, Luffy does not appear to be very intelligent, often seeing things in childish manner and can easily be amazed by the simplest things. However, because he views the world in a straightforward and simple manner, he is occasionally the only person who can see past the events and see what should be done.  

Luffy seems to have an unstoppable appetite, a characteristic that is common to the Japanese archetype of the (at times simple-minded) young adventurer with a heart of gold; perhaps the hunger more so in Luffy's case due to having an elastic stomach. Luffy is also another one of the several characters given the middle initial "D".  

Although Luffy is fairly lightheaded and a funny character, he has an unstoppable sense of determination, optimism and commitment and will do anything to stand up for his friends and comrades. Along with that, he has great courage to back it up as well as unbelievable strength. Ever since consuming the devil fruit he was shown to be not worried about his inability to swim, much like his brother. Much of these traits are common among D's. His only display of true fear is towards his grandfather, to the point that he does not fight back and is intimidated at the mere mention of him.  

Luffy never kills any of the villains, no matter how cold-hearted they are; instead, he frequently sends the villain flying, knocking them out or until the point that they are almost near death, which results in some of the villains searching for revenge, such as [Buggy the Clown](https://anilist.co/character/725) and [Alvida](https://anilist.co/character/4899). Author [Eiichiro Oda](https://anilist.co/staff/96881) explains that it's not a question of morality so much as a matter of punishing the villains for their crimes - he feels that killing the villains lets them off too lightly, whereas he considers letting them live to see their dreams be ruined a far more fitting punishment.  

Luffy has a dream, and to even have a chance at achieving this dream, he says that he must find the One Piece and become King of the Pirates. He knows that to achieve his goal, he will have to defeat many strong opponents, including the World Government and his childhood hero [Shanks](https://anilist.co/character/727).

name: Zoro Roronoa
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm (5'10")
__Affiliation:__ ~!Straw Hat Pirates (current); Kuraigane Island (former, temporary); Shimotsuki Village (former)!~
__Bounty:__  ~!1,111,000,000 (previously: 60,000,000, 120,000,000 and 320,000,000)!~

Zoro was the first crew member to be recruited by [Luffy](https://anilist.co/character/40/Luffy-Monkey). 

Zoro is a skilled swordsman who fights with his own unique sword style known as santoryu (three katana fighting style). This is achieved by using one katana in each hand, and another in his mouth. He is also seen fighting with only one or two swords. When in a serious fight he ties his normally, tied on the arm bandana, on his head. Though not a samurai, he appears to maintain a certain degree of bushido, and is frequently mistaken for one. Unlike Luffy and most of the other Straw Hat pirates, Zoro has been known to kill his opponents if he has to, though never in cold blood. 

Zoro has a stern, serious and distanced personality, however he often reacts in a goofy and exaggerated comic style due to his gruff, impatient attitude. On the ship, he normally either trains with weights or sleeps. The only work he is seen doing regularly is hoisting the anchor using his great strength. He also likes sake, almost to the degree that Luffy likes meat, but like [Nami](https://anilist.co/character/723/Nami), he never gets drunk due to his inhumanly-high endurance and tolerance for alcohol. Another notable trait is his lack of orientation, as Zoro often gets lost, even in small, familiar spaces or when being led by someone. Despite this, he is often the first to sense an enemy or danger, and the first to react. He is often displayed being well aware of dangerous situations and people around him.  

Zoro often reminds others of the harsh facts, which often shocks some of the other crew members, although they usually decide he is right. Zoro has also stated that he is an atheist, and has never believed in anything except himself. He often comes across as arrogant and overconfident, but only because he knows he's a strong man with great fighting ability. Even so, Zoro knows that he still has a lot of untapped potential, and is constantly seen training and trying to improve his fighting skills. He adheres to a strict sword master's code of honor, and never falsely brags or lies about his abilities, sometimes outright admitting a weakness, even to an enemy. He also never tries to escape from a fight or use trickery to win, believing that doing so is cowardly and scorning anyone who uses such tactics. Zoro is very vigorous, strong-willed, and determined.

name: Sanji
description:
__Height:__ 177 cm (5'9")
__Affiliation:__ ~!Straw Hat Pirates (current); Momoiro Island (former, temporary); Baratie (former); Germa Kingdom (former)!~
__Bounty:__ ~!1,032,000,000 (previously; 77,000,000, 177,000,000 (Only Alive) and 330,000,000)!~

Sanji is the chain-smoking chef of the Straw Hat Pirate Crew. He has superb fighting skills that only make use of his legs, in an effort to minimize damage to his hands which would impair his cooking skills. Sanji uses an array of powerful and varied kicking moves when he fights. His cooking skills are world class, and he was mentored in both cooking and fighting by Chef "Red Leg" Zeff of the Baratie. He was born in the North Blue, but grew up in the East Blue. Sanji is trash-talking and serious, and usually gruff and impatient, especially around men. This is contrasted by his "love-cook" side, as he is very amorous around women. Sanji is completely devoted to any beautiful woman, usually losing all common sense and composure in front of them, then attempting to comically swoon them. He has sworn to never let insult or injury happen to any woman while he can still stand, even if that woman is trying to kill him. This is often problematic in his fighting as he can't attack female opponents, and would rather die than hurt them. All this is apparently the result of a "strict upbringing".

His goal in life is to find the All Blue, a legendary ocean, which contains all the fish in the world. As such, it would be paradise for any cook with as much love for his work as Sanji, who holds great respect for the tools, ingredients, and art of cooking. So great is his devotion to his calling, that Sanji will not let any person or creature starve, regardless of them being friend or foe.  Being the crew's chef, he looks out for the health of his crew mates. Sanji respects [Luffy](https://anilist.co/character/40) as a captain, but often gets angry at him for eating too much, showing disrespect for the aesthetics of cooking, and generally being daft and irresponsible. He is constantly in petty fights with [Zoro](https://anilist.co/character/62) (sometimes calling him Marimo) over each others' traits and they have developed a rivalry, but have managed to make a devastating team together. He is very protective of the female crew members and [Nami](https://anilist.co/character/723) likes to take advantage of him, exploiting his extreme servility. Sanji originally wanted to cook [Chopper](https://anilist.co/character/309), but has come to respect him as a crew member and friend. He's also good friends with [Usopp](https://anilist.co/character/724); they team up and interact often, and Sanji understands him quite well.

name: Robin Nico
description:
__Height:__ 188 cm (6'2")
__Affiliation:__ ~!Straw Hat Pirates (Current); Baltigo (Revolutionaries, Former, Temporary); Alabasta (Baroque Works, Former); Ohara (Former)!~
__Position:__ Archaeologist
__Devil Fruit:__  ~!Hana Hana no Mi (Flower Flower Fruit)!~
__Devil Fruit Type:__ ~!Paramecia!~
__Bounty:__ ~!930,000,000 (previously; 79,000,000, 80,000,000 and 130,000,000)!~

Robin is the seventh member of Straw Hat's Crew. She had a bounty of 79 million beri since she was eight years old, during an incident in which she supposedly destroyed six Buster Call ships through the use of the powers she gained by eating the Hana Hana no Mi (Flower Flower or Blooming Blooming Fruit). The fruit's power enables her to conjure up multiple replicas of her body parts (most often her arms) upon any surface she is able to see making her very powerful and dexterous as a result. Robin joined the Straw Hat Pirates after [Luffy](https://anilist.co/character/40) saved her life, or (how she states it) Luffy forced her to live when she wanted to die. To atone for his crime, Robin demands that Luffy allow her to join his crew, to which he complies leaving every other crew member except [Sanji](https://anilist.co/character/305) in shock. Although feared at first, she is quickly accepted and viewed as a comrade by the crew.

Robin is actually an archaeologist of talent and despises anyone who thoughtlessly damages any piece of history. The World Government fears her because she can decipher Poneglyphs (stones marked with glyphs from an ancient language), which contain details capable of reviving ancient weapons that have the power to destroy the world. In reality, Robin has stated that she does not care about ancient weapons and that her dream is to find the True History written on the Rio Poneglyph.

Robin is a mysterious and serious person who appears quiet and reclusive, and the wisest in the Straw Hat's Crew. She was thought by those around her to be cold and mean, but it was proven that she is actually a kind person who always thinks before she acts. She often only speaks when something interesting or important has happened. She loves to study history, and the comfort and freedom to study and read. She is also quick to point out gross or realistically morbid facts, often creeping out [Nami](https://anilist.co/character/723) or [Usopp](https://anilist.co/character/724). Robin is the wisest and most sensible member of the crew. She has a vast knowledge of the seas and the world and usually keeps her head during surprising situations, allowing her to logically analyze the situation without losing her cool. This trait makes her different from the other Straw Hats, who often comically react melodramatically to unexpected happenings and hold irrational ideas and conclusions. Despite her attempts to keep herself distant, Robin has fallen for her new friends and has taken the role of the distant den mother.

name: Nami
description:
__Height:__ 169 cm (5'6½”)
__Affiliation:__ Straw Hat Pirates
__Position:__  Navigator
__Bounty:__  ~!366,000,000 (previously; 16,000,000 and 66,000,000)!~

Nami is the third person to align herself with Straw Hat Pirates, and the fifth to actually join as an official member. Possibly one of the best navigators currently sailing the Grand Line, she has the ability to recognize and analyze even the slightest changes in the weather through sheer intuition, thus saving the ship and the crew from the very unstable Grand Line weather on multiple occasions.

name: Ace Portgas
description:
__Height:__ 185 cm (6'1")
__Devil Fruit:__ Mera Mera no Mi (Flame Flame Fruit)
__Devil Fruit Type:__ Logia
__Bounty:__ 550,000,000

One of the most obvious features on Ace is his tattoos. Ace's back tattoo is left intact in the English version of the dub despite 4Kids' previous edits to crosses. At the same time Ace also promotes his tattoo to [Luffy](https://anilist.co/character/40/Monkey-D-Luffy), something which is truly considered odd by 4Kids standards. Ace has a tattoo on his back of the Whitebeard symbol; a skull with a white mustache and a manji behind it. To avoid confusion between the two symbols and avoid slander for being a nazi, this was changed to crossbones in the shape of a "cross" in the anime, as well as in the most recent chapter of the manga.  Ace has another tattoo on his left arm by the shoulder: it reads "ASCE" with the "S" crossed out. ~!It serves as a symbol of his other deceased sworn brother Sabo.!~ In the English version of the anime, Ace's shoulder tattoo signifying his name is edited out, as he is referred to there as "Portgaz D. Trace." He appears in One Piece Grand Adventure, once again without the tattoo on his arm.  Ace travels around the Grand Line on his boat which is constructed so his Mera Mera no Mi fuels the engine on the rear end allowing it to move.  Currently, Ace is one of the two known pirates to ever escape arrest by the Marine captain [Smoker](https://anilist.co/character/2753/Smoker), the other escapee being Ace's younger brother Luffy. Ace and Smoker fought to a standstill in Alabasta.  He left Fuusha Village three years before Luffy, and he is a loyal crewman and commands the Second Division of [Whitebeard](https://anilist.co/character/2751/Edward-Newgate), his captain.  In appearance, the two brothers are obviously related, despite the fact that Ace is more muscular than the rather lanky Luffy. He also sports rather childish freckles. He is apparently narcoleptic (a trait common amongst Ace's family) and therefore falls asleep on random occasions, making people wonder if he has dropped dead. As far as personality goes, Ace is much more intelligent, polite, and generally more bearable than his younger brother, which prompts the Straw Hat crew to question whether he is truly related to their bumbling captain. However, the brothers themselves are very close, Ace portraying typical good-big-brother behaviors such as asking the crew to keep an eye on his little brother.

name: Chopper Tony Tony
description:
__Height:__ 90 cm (2'11¼")
__Affiliation:__ Straw Hat Pirates
__Position:__  Doctor
__Devil Fruit:__ Hito Hito no Mi (Human Human Fruit)
__Devil Fruit Type:__ Zoan
__Bounty:__ ~!1,000 (previously; 50 and 100)!~

Chopper is the 6th member to join the Straw Hat Pirates, acting as their general physician, despite being a reindeer. 

After a set of unusual circumstances, he ate the Hito Hito no Mi (Human Human Fruit), which permitted him the ability to speak, think, and (to a limited extent) change into a human. Chopper often acts like a child, but he is an upright friend and companion who will try anything to overcome a task given by his team. He also still has distrust in humankind because of events his youth, where he was treated as a brutal monster. He will often outright insult a human who compliments him while smiling, dancing, and being obviously pleased. He also shows a certain interest in books, but mostly medicine related ones. Chopper is more or less on a journey to define himself, seeing almost anybody on his crew as a role model. This, combined with his naiveness, often causes him to imitate the other Straw Hats' actions, no matter how obviously silly. Because of this, he often gets involved in the crazy antics of [Luffy](https://anilist.co/character/40/Luffy-Monkey) and [Usopp](https://anilist.co/character/724/Usopp), wholeheartedly believing that what they are doing is sensible and fun. 

Chopper is one of the most innocent Straw Hat Pirates, and is also very naive, resulting in a tendency to believe anything told to him, even the outrageously fictitious and exaggerated lies of Usopp. [Sanji](https://anilist.co/character/305/Sanji) originally wanted to cook Chopper and continues to refer to him as "the emergency food supply" to tease him but considers him a friend. Although he is the crew's doctor, he wasn't originally hired by Luffy for that purpose, but rather, in Luffy's words, for being  "a cool reindeer that can transform".

name: Usopp
description:
__Height:__ 174 cm (5'8½")
__Affiliation:__ Straw Hat Pirates (previously Usopp Pirates)  
__Position:__ Sniper  
__Bounty:__  ~!500,000,000 (previously 30,000,000 as Sogeking, 200,000,000 as God Usopp)!~  
 
Usopp is a liar and likes to play pranks on his crew members or just goof off with [Luffy](https://anilist.co/character/40/Luffy-Monkey) and [Chopper](https://anilist.co/character/309). He loves to tell tall tales to Chopper (who believes him blindly) or anyone who's listening. The other aspect of Usopp besides his lying is his cowardice; he is a very timid person, or so he thinks. In extremely stressful situations, Usopp has proven to be far more courageous than he believes himself to be. He shows great resolve when his friends are threatened or mocked by outsiders. Even though he is a complete coward in battle, he is a useful part to the Straw Hat Pirates. He is extremely handy and can fix almost anything. He sometimes sees a role model in [Zoro](https://anilist.co/character/62/Zoro-Roronoa) who never seems afraid but always proud. Usopp lacks a bit of self esteem and is often taken advantage of by [Nami](https://anilist.co/character/723) to make her weapons or repair and improve them - something he is very adept at, having constructed the ingenious weapon "Clima Tact." 

Usopp will also stand up and fight for not only the well-being of people, but also for their ideals - and the ideals of a pirate, which he holds very high. In battle he normally tries to trick his enemy by telling tales or mischievous lies to deceive them. Despite his lack of physical strength compared to other members of the crew, Usopp seems to be just as resilient as his comrades and this ability to bear loads and loads of damage, is one of his best traits, in addition to his cunning and intelligence, which has saved the Straw Hats on many occasions. Usopp also has outstanding marksmanship abilities with his slingshot and is on his way to becoming one of the best snipers in the One Piece world, although his goal in life is to become a proud and strong pirate like his father [Yasopp](https://anilist.co/character/9562/Yasopp) of the Red Haired Pirate Crew.

name: Brook
description:
__Height:__ 266 cm (8'8½")
__Affiliation:__ Straw Hat Pirates (previously; Rumbar Pirates)
__Position:__ Musician, Swordsman
__Devil Fruit:__ Yomi Yomi no Mi (Revive Revive Fruit)
__Devil Fruit Type:__ Paramecia
__Bounty:__  ~!383,000,000 (previously; 33,000,000 and 83,000,000)!~

Brook known as the "Gentleman Skeleton", is a pirate inhabiting the Florian Triangle region of the Grand Line. Although he claims to be a gentleman, and talks in the dialect of one, Brook's etiquette has severely degenerated over the course of his isolation. He has awful table manners: he shouts for food while waiting to be served, asks to swap plates with people who have larger servings than he does and eating so messily his entire face is stained. He is also extremely flatulent after meals, but says "excuse me" so as to be "gentlemanly." He also loves to tell odd, bone-themed jokes, as well as melodramatic tales, and is very perverted, asking to see [Nami](https://anilist.co/character/723/Nami) and [Robin](https://anilist.co/character/61/Nico-Robin)'s underwear upon meeting them.

He's a skilled musician (something [Luffy](https://anilist.co/character/40/Monkey-D-Luffy) has always wanted in his crew since the beginning), fond of playing the violin. Due to his light weight he can not only jump to incredible heights but can run on water by moving his legs furiously. He uses a shikomizue as his main weapon; with it, he is able to make swift iaidō attacks that the enemy cannot notice.

name: Hancock Boa
description:
__Height:__ 191 cm (6'3")  
__Affiliation:__ ~!Kuja; Kuja Pirates; Shichibukai (former)!~ __Occupation:__ ~!Pirate Captain; Empress of Amazon Lily; Shichibukai (former)!~__Devil Fruit:__ Mero Mero no Mi (Love-Love Fruit) 
__Type:__ Paramecia 
__Bounty:__ ~!1,659,000,000 (Formerly 80,000,000)!~

She is one of the Shichibukai and captain of the Kuja Pirates. She is the Empress of the Amazon Tribe on the Isle of Woman. She detests the World Government, but wants to keep her Shichibukai title. Her immense beauty belies her cruel personality, as shown when she kicks a kitten in her way.       

~!As children, Boa with her sisters were captured and sold as slave for World Nobles. There she was branded with "Dragon Foot" - a sign that proves your misery and status as a slave. To hide this fact, she has spread a rumor among her people that upon battling a Gorgon, she and her sisters were cursed, and now have Gorgon eyes on their backs that will turn anyone around into stone if it is exposed.

She has an immense crush on [Luffy](https://anilist.co/character/40/Monkey-D-Luffy), so much so that if she stays away from him, she is stricken with "Love Sickness" and will eventually die.

She ate "mero-mero" fruit when she was a slave and gained the ability to turn anyone who thinks she is beautiful into stone. She is also one of the few characters who possesses "Haoshoku Haki (or King's Disposition/Will)." Some of the others being [Rayleigh](https://anilist.co/character/17142/Silvers-Rayleigh), [Whitebeard](https://anilist.co/character/2751/Edward-Newgate), Luffy and [Shanks](https://anilist.co/character/727/Shanks).!~

name: Doflamingo Donquixote
description:
__Height:__ 305cm (10'0")
__Affiliation:__ Shichibukai, Human Auction House, Bellamy pirates 
__Position:__ Shichibukai (Warlord of the Sea) 
__Devil Fruit:__ ~!Ito Ito no Mi (String String Fruit)!~
__Devil Fruit Type:__ ~!Paramecia!~
__Bounty:__ 340.000.000 Beli (former) 

Doflamingo is a larger than normal blond haired man who generally dresses in flamboyant clothes. In reference to his animal theme, the flamingo, his clothes are brightly colored with his feathered coat being distinctively pink. He also has an odd way of walking, a bow-legged waddle (but does not always do this), which is also a reference to his animal theme. Twenty-two years ago, his hair was longer than currently, had two earrings in his left ear, and he sported a pair of goggles that he wore on his forehead, in addition to his sunglasses that he wears to this day. 

Doflamingo is one of the most carefree characters in One Piece. He seems to have a penchant for dramatic phrasing, as well as a habit of exaggerated posing when giving declarations. He also appears to fear nothing and no one, as he openly taunts Fleet Admiral Sengoku, sits on the table during the Shichibukai meeting and shows only gleeful interest at the thought of warring with [Whitebeard](https://anilist.co/character/2751/Edward-Newgate). During the Battle of Marineford, all of Doflamingo's interactions have all been for the sake of personal amusement, hinting a sadistic side. He also has an odd habit of sitting in odd positions, like on the back of chairs, on tables, barrels and, even a pile of bodies in the middle of a war zone.

name: Newgate Edward
description:
__Height:__ 666 cm (21'10")
__Affiliation:__ ~!Whitebeard Pirates (former/deceased); Sphinx (former); Rocks Pirates (former)!~
__Position:__ ~!Captain (Whitebeard Pirates); Yonko (one of the 4 emperors of the New World)!~
__Devil Fruit:__ ~!Gura Gura no Mi (Tremor-Tremor Fruit)!~
__Devil Fruit Type:__ ~!Paramecia!~
__Bounty:__ ~!5,046,000,000!~

Edward Newgate, also known as Whitebeard, is the captain of the Whitebeard Pirates.

~!He is part of the Yonko, the 4 emperors of the New World, alongside [Big Mom](https://anilist.co/character/54495/Charlotte-Linlin), [Blackbeard](https://anilist.co/character/3331/Marshall-D-Teach), [Kaidou](https://anilist.co/character/46109/Kaidou) and [Red-Haired Shanks](https://anilist.co/character/727/Shanks). The Yonko are part of the San Dai Seiryoku, the Three Great Powers. The other two great powers are the Marine Headquarters and the Shichibukai, the seven warlords of the sea.

Whitebeard is said to be the strongest man in the world and the pirate closest to obtaining the legendary treasure, One Piece. It is said that Whitebeard used to have numerous battles with the late Pirate King, [Gol D. Roger](https://anilist.co/character/4883/Gold-Roger), and was marked as his equal in the past.

Whitebeard appears to have some health problems, possibly stemming from his advanced age or from his ferocious encounters with other great pirates during his earlier days. He is always surrounded by nurses and is hooked up to intravenous tubes. But despite this, he still drinks rum by (and directly from) the barrel. Even with his health issues, he is still considered the world's strongest pirate, which raises the question of how powerful he must have been in his prime.

He was a cheerful and carefree person during his younger years, prior to commanding his own ship and becoming known as Whitebeard. Due to being an orphan who grew up in poverty, Newgate has a strong desire for a family. In adulthood, unlike his comrades who loved treasure and riches, he only desired a family and saw that as the greatest treasure.!~

name: Franky
description:
__Height:__ 225 cm (7'4½")
__Affiliation:__ Straw Hat Pirates (previously; Franky Family, Tom's Workers)
__Position:__ Shipwright
__Devil Fruit:__ None
__Bounty:__  ~!394,000,000 (previously; 44,000,000 and 94,000,000)!~

Franky is a cyborg who is the shipwright of the Straw Hat Pirates. He first appeared in the Water 7 arc. Franky is one of "Tom's Workers".

Franky's dream is to build a ship that would travel to the end of the Grand Line. This is the ship that the Straw Hats are currently riding, but his dream is not yet achieved until they make it to the end.

Franky usually acts tough and is quickly angered, but he is also very emotional when it comes to sad tales and often bursts into large tears, or on some occasions, plays a song. His most distinguishable personality trait is his flamboyant attitude. He frequently shouts the word 'SUPER' when he's in a positive mood, or adds it into his speech. He also has a signature pose which he uses very often.

Franky is quick to defend other people (eg. Franky Family, [Nico Robin](https://anilist.co/character/61/Nico-Robin)) and take action if his friends are harmed. He is also quick in making friends, allies, and comrades with even the most unlikely of individuals. Because of this, he is seen as a 'big brother' figure. [Monkey D. Luffy](https://anilist.co/character/40/Monkey-D-Luffy) bears similar qualities (with the exception of engaging in unnecessary fights) and because of this, despite the disputes the two had in the past, both grew to respect each other during the events of the Enies Lobby Arc.

name: Jinbe
description:
__Height:__ 301 cm (9'10½")
__Affiliation:__ ~!Straw Hat Pirates (current); Sun Pirates (former); Ally of the Big Mom Pirates (former); Shichibukai (former); Ryugu Kingdom (resigned); Impel Down (former)]!~
__Position:__ ~!Captain (Sun Pirates), Helmsman (Straw Hat Pirates)!~
__Devil Fruit:__ None
__Bounty:__ ~!1,100,000,000 (previously; 250,000,000, 76,000,000 and 438,000,000)!~

Jinbe is a whale shark fishman who was the second captain of the Sunny Pirates after Fisher Tiger, and who became a Shichibukai eight years ago. Jinbe's name comes from jinbei-zame (甚平鮫), which means "whale shark" in Japanese. His epithet, Kaikyou would normally translate into "Strait" or "Channel". However since the kanji for it is written as (海侠の) and not (海峡の), the kyou part (侠) of it comes from (任侠), a honorific used when addressing a high ranking yakuza member, thus making his epithet a Japanese pun.

name: Dracule Mihawk
description:
__Height:__ 198 cm (6'6")
__Devil Fruit:__ None
__Bounty:__ ~!3,590,000,000!~

Mihawk is said to be the strongest swordsman in the One Piece world, and he is commented as being a monster superior to monsters. Because of his status and power, defeating him is Roronoa Zoro's ultimate goal. Mihawk is so strong, in fact, he is accused by some characters (And fans) of having the power of a Devil Fruit; however, nothing has stated anything but that his abilities simply come from pure skill and power.  He wields the Black Sword (Grosses messer), the strongest sword in the world. It's an ornately decorated, man-sized (6 feet) sword shaped like a cross with a shiny black blade, curved at the end. It also seems to generate otherworldly purple streaks as it slices, as seen when he cut down Zoro and when he split Don Krieg's ship in half. He can tear pirate ships apart with a single, unseen slash of his sword, blocking bullets with a simple turn of his sword, and he can easily defend against even legendary swords with a small, inch-long knife concealed in the cross he wears around his neck.  In appearance, Mihawk wears very decorative, ornate, black-and-red clothing. His most identifiable clothing would be his wide-rimmed hat adorned with a large piece of fluff, a long, black cloak, and his cross necklace and sword. He is easily compared to the real-life pirate Bartholomew Roberts, AKA Black Bart, who also donned a crimson overcoat, a wide brimmed hat with a red feather, and a diamond cross attached to a gold chain around his neck. Mihawk travels around in a coffin-shaped raft with two green-flamed candles, a single black sail, and a single seat. The fact that he can traverse across the unforgiving oceans, as well as the Grand Line itself, in such a meager craft is yet another testament to his abilities.   

~!After the events of the Levely, the Navy dismissed all of the Shichibukai, including Mihawk, and who is now a wanted pirate.!~

name: Perona
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3")
__Affiliations:__ Thriller Bark Pirates (Mysterious Four)
__Devil Fruit:__ Horo Horo no Mi (Hollow-Hollow Fruit)
__Devil Fruit Type:__ Paramecia

Nicknamed the "Ghost Princess", Perona is a girl dressed in Gothic Lolita style and a commander in the army of [Gecko Moria](https://anilist.co/character/7454/Gecko-Moria) on his island-ship of Thriller Bark. She is also the commander of Perona Wonder Garden, where an army of animal zombies live and protect her. She looted the Thousand Sunny with some zombies and later took on guard duty while [Absalom](https://anilist.co/character/9655/Absalom) was away attempting to marry [Nami](https://anilist.co/character/723/Nami). She cannot stand anything that she feels is not cute, such as insects.  Perona has eaten the Horo Horo no mi (Ghost Ghost fruit) which allows her to create several ghostly apparitions. The ghosts can pass through someone to cause them to go into a sort of induced depression.

name: Narrator
description:
This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. 

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

name: Buggy
description:
__Height:__ 192 cm (6'3½")
__Affiliations:__ ~!Cross Guild; Buggy's Delivery (dissolved into Cross Guild); Buggy Pirates; Buggy and Alvida Alliance; Four Emperors; Seven Warlords of the Sea (disbanded); Roger Pirates (disbanded); Impel Down (former)!~ 
__Origin:__ Grand Line
__Residence:__ Karai Bari Island; Orange Town (former) 
__Devil Fruit:__ Bara Bara no Mi (Chop Chop Fruit)
__Devil Fruit Type:__ Paramecia
__Bounty:__ ~!3,189,000,000 (previously;15,000,000)!~

Buggy accidentally consumed the Bara Bara no Mi, (Chop Chop fruit) a Devil Fruit, which allows him to separate his body parts and control them independent of each other, but robbed him of the ability to swim. The abilities gained from this fruit also make Buggy immune to attacks from knives or swords; any such attack just separates him into his component parts.  In addition, most of his body is capable of flying through the air, fast enough to propel a man through a wall - with the crucial exception of his feet. However, even though the parts are separate, Buggy can still feel what the part feels (for example, when [Luffy](https://anilist.co/character/40/Monkey-D-Luffy) attacked Buggy, he separated his torso from his waist, only to find that Luffy was aiming for the crotch. Needless to say this left him with a rather painful result. Also when Buggy launched his hand out to pin down [Zoro](https://anilist.co/character/62/Roronoa-Zoro) for [Cabaji's](https://anilist.co/character/4897/Cabaji) Sting of the Unicycle Technique, Luffy stomped on it, inflicting tremendous pain). He also seems to require either a fixed distance from his detachments, or keep them within his line of vision, in order to manipulate them separately.  Besides his Devil fruit abilities he usually fights with three knives between his fingers. During the flashbacks of his youth he already used these three knives. He also has a blade hidden in his shoe and in Logue Town used a sword in his failed attempt to execute Luffy.

name: Crocodile
description:
__Height:__ 253 cm (8'3½")
__Affiliations:__ ~!Cross Guild; Shichibukai (former); Baroque Works (former); Impel Down (former)!~
__Devil Fruit:__ Suna Suna no Mi (Sand Sand Fruit)
__Devil Fruit Type:__ Logia
__Bounty:__ ~!1,965,000,000 (previously; 81,000,000)!~

Crocodile is the leader of Baroque Works, a secret organization of assassins and spies, and a member of the Shichibukai. Utilizing Baroque Works, he incites rebellion in the kingdom of Alabasta in order to gain access to the Poneglyph hidden beneath the palace. He believes it will reveal the location of the weapon Pluton, which Crocodile wishes to gain control of in order to establish his military power. He is defeated by [Monkey D. Luffy](https://anilist.co/character/40/Monkey-D-Luffy) and stripped of his Shichibukai status by the World Government, after which he is imprisoned.
