Fleadom allows Ikalgo to turn two of his tentacles into an air rifle. When residing inside a corpse, Ikalgo can use a special kind of giant fleas as rounds for the gun; they have a vertical leap of 200 meters (approx. 656 ft 2 in), and their saliva contains anticoagulant properties so potent that not even Killua was immune to it. The flea bullets boast impressive range and muzzle velocity and are powerful enough to knock an unaware individual back a few meters. Furthermore, their trajectory did not appear to change in the slightest when Ikalgo was targeting Killua. However, they do not appear to be capable of killing the target directly, managing to draw blood but not proving lethal even when hitting a critical area such as the neck. This would be in line with Ikalgo's reluctance to kill. The fleas can be conjured only if Ikalgo is puppeteering a corpse; if he is not, he can conjure regular bullets. The air gun needs to be recharged after every shot. By pulling the trigger with an empty chamber, Ikalgo can utilize the stored air to propel himself backwards at high speed.

__Living Dead Dolls__ (死体と遊ぶな子供たちリビングデッドドールズ)
_Type:  Manipulation_
Ikalgo is capable of inhabiting and taking control of a corpse, manipulating its movements, and utilizing its voice and Nen abilities. When he does so, he seems to reside in the head of the host, but can apparently leave its body from other points. Although Ikalgo can manipulate a corpse, he is powerless to stop its decomposition.!~

name: Morel Mackernasey
description:
__Nen Type:__ Manipulation

Morel is a Hunter who uses a giant smoking pipe and smoke as weapons, and who has a great sense of compassion. As his role progresses during the chimera ant arc, Morel shows himself as an experienced and resourceful fighter, which is shown in his fight against Leol wherein he uses his pipe as a snorkel so that he could allow himself to breathe underwater, and in doing so suffocates his opponent with the Carbon Dioxide he had emitted. The smoke that he uses are for his nen ability, able to take on various shapes and could act independently to him once commands are issued.

##  __Morel's Abilities:__

~! __Deep Purple__ (紫煙機兵隊ディープパープル Purple Haze Soldiers)
_Type: Emission, Manipulation, and Transmutation_
This ability allows Morel to transmute his aura into smoke and to manipulate it in any way he sees fit. With the aid of his giant pipe, he produces great amounts of smoke which he can then shape in countless constructs, such as ropes, grass, hoses, rafts, rabbits, dolls, and even replicas of individuals fully capable of speech and with remarkable strength and speed, although physical contact with them will expose the trick. Smoke constructs can also be told apart from living beings with En, although not with general aura sensing. Morel can change the color of the smoke to make the created objects seem more realistic, even using them to blend into his surroundings, as well as modify their durability to the point they can become virtually indestructible. The versatility of Deep Purple is such that Morel boasted he had yet to meet a Nen user with a more flexible ability.

His most complex creations are the Smoke Troopers. Morel can emit cores wherein he puts simple Manipulation commands, such as to attack defensively and retreat when encountered by an enemy, before covering the cores with smoke and mold them into his Troopers, which then start acting automatically. It is possible that the cores are not always required, as Morel was able to create Troopers directly from his exhaled smoke. In this case they seem to operate by taking direct orders from Morel rather than relying on preset commands. Alternatively, it is possible that Morel can form the cores remotely, at the same time as he shapes the smoke into constructs. Morel can create a maximum of 216 dolls. By sacrificing quantity to gain quality, he can compress that amount to 50. These dolls then become more complex than his regular dolls, and Neferpitou admitted their quality was superior to the one they controlled. Deep Purple caps Morel's aura output. Dispelling the constructs enables Morel to retrieve the aura he poured into them and utilize it again.

__Smoky Jail__ (監獄ロックスモーキージェイル)
_Type: Manipulation and Transmutation_
Morel encases himself and the opponent in an impenetrable barrier made out of smoke. The barrier appears to be unbreakable both from the inside and the outside, as Menthuthuyoupi was unable to damage it with his regular attacks as well as his explosions. Only particle-sized bodies can cross it. Since the smoky aura is detached from his body, Emission might also be involved in the ability.!~

name: Shalnark Ryuseih
description:
From his appearance, Shalnark seems to be a guileless and normal boy. However, see him in action with the rest of the Phantom Troupe and that thought is dispelled.

Shalnark is one of the most intelligent and quick-thinking members in the group —being adept at using technology for information gathering, providing the brains behind the brawn. Shalnark is also a Hunter, so he has the ability to gain access to certain information that could be potentially useful for the Phantom Troupe He is member number 9 of the Troupe. 

__Nen Abilities:__  
Black Voice - Mobile Fate Detector: Shalnark is able to control the physical movements of any person he has targeted, as long as he has a special antenna on them and that person is not already being controlled. This is done via a cellphone interface in which he remotely controls other people from a distance while pointing the antenna at the person he's controlling.
Auto Mode: When Shalnark places an antenna on himself, he temporarily gains immense strength. However, he can only control himself through giving himself instructions and cannot withdraw from Auto Mode until he has accomplished the task. After going out of Auto Mode, Shalnark cannot move for two days. He also doesn't retain any memory from what happened in that state.

name: Canary
description:
__Height:__ 164 cm (5′4.5)

A servant to the Zoldyck family. She believes their difference in status means they will never be close. Unbeknownst to her, Killua regards her as a dear friend.

She is initially introduced as a ruthless guardian who does not hesitate to attack trespassers, but, as noted by Gon, she is not as heartless as she pretends to be, and just for a fraction of a second, her eyes convey gentleness or concern, although she tries to suppress it.

name: Chika Kudou
description:
**Height:** 178 cm (5'10")

The first member to join Kurata in the club. Kudou brings with him a reputation for fighting and delinquency, which initially makes others distrustful of him. However, underneath his rough exterior is a kind heart who wants to honor his deceased grandfather by playing the koto.

~!Prior to the start of the series, Chika was neglected by his father and was caused to live with his grandfather, [Gen Kudo](https://anilist.co/character/134571/Kudou-Gen), instead. During these days, Chika would always get into fights and is infamous because of this. Despite this, [Tetsuki Takaoka](https://anilist.co/character/134572/Takaoka-Tetsuki) was close to him and would often come to Gen's house to check up on Chika. Through his grandfather's attempts, and also Tetsuki's reaching outs, Kudo starts to become mellow. Unfortunately, the bad crowd he was hanging out with disliked this and set Chika up by ransacking his grandfather's house where he crafts kotos that he is blamed for this by the neighbors and the police. Not long after this incident, Gen passed away due to a heart disease and it is revealed that Chika now lives with his paternal aunt, [Isaki Kudo](https://anilist.co/character/134563/Kudou-Isaki), after Gen's passing.!~

name: Satowa Houzuki
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm (5'2")

Satowa is a first year student and the daughter of a famous koto family, Houzuki. She has been learning to play koto since she was little and has won many contests. Although she is a koto prodigy, Satowa was debarred from Houzukikai. She claims that she joined the koto music club because she wants to become known as "young virtuoso koto player that led a no-name school club to become number 1 in nation" when she makes professional debut. She loves koto.

name: Hiro Kurusu
description: She is Takezou's classmate and joins the koto music club after hearing their first performance. She has knowledge of koto due to the influence of her grandmother. She becomes the koto music club's vice-president.

name: Takezou Kurata
description: President of koto music club. He's shy and weak in difficult situations. After his failure at the exam, depressed, Takezou saw his senpai's performance, where she was giving her all even though no one listened and koto's string had been broken. He was deeply moved by her performance, so he joined the club. After senpai's graduation, he became an only member of koto music club and had to find strength to protect it.

name: Suzuka Takinami
description:
A math teacher at Tokise High and the Koto Club's advisor.

~!Initially he feigned ignorance of his musical background, though it's later revealed that his parents are world renowned musicians. As a child, he had no interest in playing music whatsoever other than listening to it. When he was seven, his father discovered his talent for writing musical scores and quickly took upon him to brand his son as a child prodigy. Because of this, Suzuka began to disdain music but his interest is later revitalized after becoming the advisor for the Koto club. He often writes pieces for the club as well as gives practice advice, while leaving the actual koto teaching to [Akira](https://anilist.co/character/134569/Doujima-Akira).!~

name: Tetsuki Takaoka
description: Tetsuki has been classmates with Chika since middle school. He's worried about his friend, because he knows Chika's circumstances. He seems to be a quiet person, but in reality he shows his true colors when fighting. He comes from wealthy family, his father is the director of a large hospital.

name: Natsu Momoya
description:
__Height:__ 177cm

Natsu Momoya is a 1st year student at Tokise High School and a member of the Tokise High School Koto Club. In his free time, he goes drumming or dates girls.

~!Momoya came from the same junior high school as Kudo, and as such knew of his violent history.!~

name: Akira Doujima
description: One of Chiharu Houtsuki's apprentice. She becomes the koto club's instructor.

name: Kouta Mizuhara
description: Kota Mizuhara is a second year student at Tokise High School and a member of the Tokise High School Koto Club.

name: Saneyasu Adachi
description: Saneyasu is a second-year student at Tokise High School and a member of the Tokise High School Koto Club.

name: Isaki Kudou
description:
__Height:__ 164 cm
__Relatives:__ [Gen Kudou](https://anilist.co/character/134571/) (Father, Deceased), [Chika Kudou](https://anilist.co/character/126137/) (Nephew)

Is the aunt of Chika Kudo who provides a place for him to live after his grandfather passes away.

name: Michitaka Sakai
description: Michitaka Sakai is a second year student at Tokise High School and a member of the Tokise High School Koto Club.

name: Mio Kanzaki
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm
__Affiliation:__ Hakuto High School
__Occupation:__ Student

Mio Kanzaki is a 2nd year student at Hakuto High School and a member of its koto club.

name: Atsumu Yoshinaga
description:
__Height:__ 159 cm

Atsumu Yoshinaga is a 1st year student at Tokise High School and a member of the Tokise High School Koto Club. He is a quiet, awkward and timid boy and hasn't dealt with people all that much in his life, so he doesn't quite understand personal space. He clings to people he likes and is shown to be a crybaby.

~!He was very close to his grandfather when he was a little boy and was bullied by other boys because of him playing koto.!~

name: Kiriyuu Ousuke
description:
Ousuke Kiryu is a 2nd year student at Meiryo High School.
Due to neglect by his peers at an early age because of his heart condition, Ousuke grew up to be better than average at reading people in order to compensate for his lack of physical ability.

name: Gen Kudou
description:
__Affiliation:__ Tokise High School (Formerly)
__Occupation:__ Koto maker
__Relatives:__ [Isaki Kudo](https://anilist.co/character/134563/Isaki-Kudou) (Daughter), [Chika Kudou](https://anilist.co/character/126137/Chika-Kudou) (Grandson)

Was a koto maker, the father of Isaki Kudo and the grandfather of Chika Kudo who died a year before the events of the story.

name: Sei Uzuki
description: __Height__: 174cm

name: Takeru Kurata
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm
__Relatives:__ [Takezo Kurata](https://anilist.co/character/134561/Takezou-Kurata) (Older brother)
__Status:__ Active
__Affiliation:__ Meiryou High School
__Occupation:__ Student

The younger brother of Takezo Kurata and a student at Meiryou High School.

name: Keishi Doujima
description: Akira's older brother.

name: Miran Saotome
description:
__Height__: 154cm (5'05")

A student at Ichiei High School. She has an older sister. Although she lives in a student dorm, she keeps regular contact with her family. Her sister sends her cute clothes and accessories, but she's too shy to wear them, so she keeps them safely stored away.

name: Chiharu Houzuki
description: Satowa's mother.

name: Sentarou Miya
description: Sentarou Miya is a 2nd year student at Eidai High School and a member of its koto club

name: Luka Chevalier
description:
__Height__: 179cm (5'9")

Luka likes his mother's home-cooked meals and Japanese food. He dislikes natto however. He likes to go to places he has never been to before and explore, visit art galleries and museums, read, and play video games. He loves manga and anime.

name: Marcille Donato
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3")

Marcille is a mage who is part of [Laios'](https://anilist.co/character/126818/Thorden-Laios) party. She is an elf from the Northern Continent.

~!She is actually half-elf and half tall-man. Her mother is an elf, and father was a tall-man who passed away when Marcille was young.!~

Marcille is kind, intelligent, principled, and loyal to her friends. However, she can also be very high-strung and has a difficult time dealing with things far outside her comfort zone (such as eating monsters). She has a lot of confidence in her magic ability due to her background, and can feel lonely when she's unable to help the party. She was one of the best students at the Magic Academy, where she joined the research program specializing in dungeon-making; this is where she met [Falin](https://anilist.co/character/130508/Thorden-Falin), and is still her closest friend to this day. Marcille can also be a bit naive at times, believing that friendships alone can keep a party together.

name: Laios Thorden
description:
__Height:__ 185 cm (6'1")

Laios is the leader of his party and Falin's older brother. He is a tall-man from the Northern Continent.

Laios is a monster fanatic and a strong fighter. His deep knowledge and passion for monsters helps him to excel in combat and dungeon exploration. However, social skills are where he often falters; he struggles to pick up social cues, resulting in a lack of awareness and tact. This has caused him a lot of trouble throughout his life, a shortcoming that he is painfully aware of and insecure about. Despite this, Laios is extremely kindhearted, accepting, and friendly.

name: Senshi
description:
__Height:__ 140 cm (4'7")

Senshi is a member of [Laios](https://anilist.co/character/126818/Thorden-Laios)' party. He is a dwarf from the Eastern Continent.

Having spent 10 years studying monster cuisine and living a self-sufficient life inside the dungeon, Senshi loves cooking and is more than happy to share his knowledge and skills. He is dependable and strong, but can also be rather stubborn and set in his ways. He helps maintain the natural environment and ecology of the dungeon, and considers  himself part of it. He dislikes magic and treats it with a great deal of gravity and caution.

name: Falin Thorden
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7")

Falin is [Laios](https://anilist.co/character/126818/Thorden-Laios)'s younger sister and a mage specializing in support spells. She is a tall-man from the Northern Continent.

Falin is a very kind, caring, and considerate person who doesn't want to hurt others. She extends this kindness even to the restless dead, who she has been attuned to since childhood. She can also be self-sacrificing and reckless; if the lives of her loved ones are in danger, she would not hesitate to take the blow in their stead. Like her brother, Falin has also had a fanatic interest in biology from a young age.

name: Izutsumi
description:
__Height:__ 150 cm (4'11")

Izutsumi is a former member of Shuro's party and currently a part of Laios' party. She is a tall-man (beast-man) from the Eastern Archipelago.

Izutsumi is rather stand-offish, but is not a distant person; she's fairly self-centered, but is in the process of learning the value of working with others. She is primarily fueled by a determination to find someone to lift her curse. She has terrible table manners and is a picky eater.

~!Izutsumi was born to humans, but the nature of her first curse, the curse placed over her which fused her body with that of an animal's is unknown. In her youth, Izutsumi was paraded as a circus freak. Eventually, Izutsumi was bought by Shuro's father to be raised as a retainer. After being bought, a second curse was placed over Izutsumi by one of the other retainers, which involved a knife-wielding spirit attacking Izutsumi unless the brand of the curse was regularly touched by the person who set the curse on the victim.!~

name: Chilchuck Tims
description:
__Height:__ 110 cm (3'7")

Chilchuck is a member of [Laios](https://anilist.co/character/126818/Thorden-Laios)' party. He is a half-foot from the Eastern Continent.

Chilchuck is shrewd, practical, and sharp-tongued. He refuses to take jobs unless he is paid in advance. His specialties are lockpicking and identifying and disarming traps. He's more open to eating monsters than [Marcille](https://anilist.co/character/127292/Donato-Marcille) is, but like her, draws a hard line at humanoids. He generally goes along with whatever the party does, but will speak frankly when they do something that can get them killed. His job as the party rogue puts him on edge, as failure to undo or avoid traps can lead his companions to immediate mortal danger. When his party members ignore his warnings, he quickly becomes agitated. He prefers to keep his private life separate from his work, so he doesn't tell his party a lot about himself.

~!He has a wife and 3 daughters, but hasn't seen them in years.!~

name: Mithrun
description:
__Height:__ 155 cm

Mithrun is the captain of the Canaries, an Elf group sent to investigate the dungeon. He was born to a noble family, the House of Kerensil, and has one older brother.

He is a male elf who is the head of the group. He has pale hair cut in a short bob. The tips of both his ears have been cut off. Only one of his eyes works. He typically wears a long-sleeved shirt with stripes along the arm, a sleeveless top, a skirt, trousers and knee high boots. Like a number of the other Canaries, he wears a high neck collar. He uses teleportation magic, most often using it to replace the space occupied by foes to restrict their ability to attack.

Mithrun has a very poor sense of direction. ~!He is calm and collected at all times, but is also unaware of his own needs because the demon he made a pact with during his time as a Dungeon Lord devoured all of his desires, except for his desire for revenge.!~ He is very blunt when speaking.

name: Kabru
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7")

Kabru is the leader of his party, exploring the dungeon together with [Rinsha](https://anilist.co/character/135289/Rinsha), [Mickbell](https://anilist.co/character/239690/Tomas-Mickbell), [Kuro](https://anilist.co/character/239687/Kuro), [Daia](https://anilist.co/character/239691/Diamond-of-Sadena), and [Holm](https://anilist.co/character/239686/Kranom-Holm). He is a tall-man from Utaya, part of the Western Continent.

Kabru typically appears rather laid-back, but he is an extremely socially intelligent, analytical, and calculating man with a strong sense of justice. His hobby is observing and analyzing people and their relationships; he remembers every tiny detail about everyone that he comes across. He can be ruthless when he needs to be. Kabru's main goal is to prevent the dungeon from expanding and destroying the nearest villages, which happened to his home village of Utaya and led to his mother's death when he was a child.

name: Thistle
description: __Height:__ 130 cm Thistle is the mage responsible for the creation of the dungeon on The Island and a jester who served in the court of King Delgal during the Golden Age. His actions make him the primary antagonist of the manga Delicious in Dungeon. As the lord of the dungeon, the Lunatic Magician has a great amount of power over both the structure of the dungeon and the monsters that inhabit it. His lifespan has also been extended by the dungeon's power. He is incredibly loyal and protective of the king, and is willing to destroy anything he perceives as a threat to his throne or kingdom. The elf was present in the king's life since his birth and for major events such as his wedding and coronation. ~!During King Delgal's reign, he suggested that Thistle study magic, which is where the elf flourished. However, among the elven and dwarven relics that Thistle studied was something of the dark arts. Thistle became obsessed with power and began his descent into madness, culminating in the elf casting a curse of immortality over the country and creating the dungeon.!~ ~!The Lunatic Magician also imprisoned the guardian of the Golden Country, the Winged Lion, in the depths of the dungeon.!~ (Source: Dungeon Meshi Wiki)

name: Inutade
description:
__Height:__ 195 cm (6'5")

Inutade is a member of Shuro's party, serving him as one of his retainers. She is an ogre from the Eastern Archipelago.

Compared to her comrades in Shuro's group, Tade is carefree, friendly, rather simple-minded, and gets hungry easily. Her real name is Hijouhi (ヒジョウヒ). She seems to have been close with Izutsumi.

name: Namari
description:
__Height:__ 130 cm (4'3")

Namari is a former member of [Laios](https://anilist.co/character/126818/Thorden-Laios)' party and a current member of [Tansu](https://anilist.co/character/239685/Floke-Tansu)'s party. She is a dwarf from the Eastern Continent.

Namari is very knowledgeable about weapons and blacksmithing. Even though she has a strict personality when it comes to work and isn't on the best terms with her former party, she still worries about them and treats them like friends. It is rumored that she often argues with her employers over payment, and that her father is a well-known weapon dealer who scammed the government and later disappeared.

name: Yuuyoku no Shishi
description:
Winged Lion is the unnamed entity that is the guardian spirit of the Golden Country trapped by the Lunatic Magician in the depths of the dungeon on the Island.

As its epithet describes, it looks much like a lion with large, eagle-like wings sprouting from either side of its ribs.

The Winged Lion appears as a motif throughout the dungeon, such as the statues in the castle town, the water fountains, and on the hilt of Laios' sword.

name: Rinsha
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm

She's a young wizard from the Eastern countries and a member of Kabru's party. It is hinted that she might have romantic feelings towards Kabru as she seems extremely jealous over him. 

Not much is known about her, except the fact that she's most likely from a country other than Shuro's homeland and she can use lightning with her magic. She's rather wary of people she doesn't know, and most of the time she looks like she's annoyed.

name: Toshirou Nakamoto
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm (5'11")

Shuro is a former member of the Thorden siblings' party. His real name is Toshiro Nakamoto.

He is an Eastern man with long black hair tied back in a ponytail, fair skin, and black eyes. He is shorter than Laios but taller than Marcille. When he appears again in the story, he appears more gaunt with sunken eyes and an unshaven face.

Ordinarily, Shuro is a reserved man who doesn't often make demands of others. He has trouble expressing his true opinions to other people, instead relying on subtle social cues to imply what he feels. If the other party doesn't understand it, he tends to go along with what they say instead of push the issue. He seems to be impulsive under pressure, making snap decisions such as rescuing Falin by himself.

~!His family is apparently of some noble lineage, as he has five retainers at his call. One of them, Maizuru, looked after him since he was a child. She noted that he was always reserved and never ate much, but ate plenty of whatever she made for him. Shuro arrived to The Island in order to train as a warrior. He was largely uninterested in monetary rewards or danger because of this.

Sometime after joining the Thorden siblings' party, Shuro fell in love with Falin when he woke one night and saw her enthralled instead of disgusted by a caterpillar on her finger, after which he proposed to her. She told him she needed time to think about it however, and unfortunately was eaten by the dragon before she could give an answer. Once they returned to the surface, Shuro left the party so he could rescue Falin with his retainers. He spent almost no time eating or resting during their descent through the dungeon.!~

(Source: Dungeon Meshi Wiki)

name: Cithis
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm

Member of the Canaries, an Elf group sent to investigate the dungeon. She appears to be second in command to Misurn. Her magic specialty is unknown, but she offers to 'burn' an enemy at one point, and seems to use a tool that looks like a branch of lily of the valley flowers.

She was convicted for the use of ancient magic, incitement to murder, documents forgery and fraud. Sentenced for life.

Cithis' priority appears to be keeping Mithrun alive, due to his inability to remember to do so for himself after his desires were removed by a demon. She is seen often at his side, helping to point him in the right direction when he wanders off track as well as keeping track of his meal times.

name: Fleki
description:
__Height__: 140cm
__Likes__: Anything spicy
__Dislikes__: Carrots

Fleki has wavy, shoulder-length hair and messy bangs, as well as notches in both of her ears like the other Canaries indicating conviction of having used black magic. She typically wears a short tunic with a belt and ankle boots, and the same high collar as the others, as well as a falconry glove.

Fleki's magic appears to revolve around commanding a number of different bird-like familiars, including a shadowy black bird with a curly tail, three small round white birds, and three larger white crow-like birds.

name: Lycion
description:
__Height__: 170 cm (5'7")

Lycion is a member of Mithrun's squad of Canaries. He is an aloof, laid-back elf. Like many of the other Canaries, he has notches cut into his ears, a mark of being convicted of using black magic.

~!Lycion is able to turn into a canine beast and is comfortable even in partial transformation. He has extreme body dysmorphia and hates how his original elven body looked. Conversely, he loves and praises his beast-man form, and joined in illegal fighting tournaments in order to show it off. He views his monster body purely as a cosmetic change, and doesn't have any real interest in monsters or their natural habits.!~

name: Kensuke
description: A Living Armor mollusk monster who lives in the handle of Laios's sword. The only visible parts of Kensuke appear to be antenna-like eyes, which poke out of the hilt of the sword it inhabits.

name: Kuro
description:
__Height:__ 145 cm

A kobold who joined Kabru's party alongside Mickbell. This loyal kobold never wavers in his dedication to his master.

(Source: Dungeon Meshi World Guide: Boukensha Bible)

name: Pattadol
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm
__Likes:__ Tomato
__Dislikes:__ Liver

Member of the Canaries, an Elf group sent to investigate the dungeon. She is the second child of a noble family, the House of Vari, and was appointed by her parents to join the Canaries.

She appears to have a long-haired faerie as a familiar who acts primarily as a communicator between her and the other elves. She can transform her familiar into a magic staff to cast spells, including one that generates a physical barrier. While she seems to panic fairly easily, she seems to be the most proper of the team, stopping the other elves from laughing at Mithrun's mistake and reminding Sishys to keep her mind on the battle. She is also quite observant, noting Shuro and Namari's response when the chimerized Falin appears on the first floor.

(Source: Delicious in Dungeon Wiki)

name: Maizuru
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm (5'5")

Maizuru is a member of Shuro's party, serving him as one of his retainers. She is a tall-man from the Eastern Archipelago. Her real name is Iyo (イヨ).

Having known him his whole life, Maizuru is a brilliant yet overprotective teacher to Shuro. She is also a powerful mage who is able to perform a wide range of spells. Her magic seems to revolve around paper.

name: Fionil
description:
__Height:__ 150 cm (4'11")

Fionil is a novice adventurer currently exploring the dungeon with Doni. She is a half-elf from the Northern Central Continent.

Fionil was originally hired by the western elves to report any changes that occurred on the island due to the dungeon. However, she was so moved by Doni's story that she decided to leave her job and join him as an adventurer.

name: Leed
description: Younger sister of Chief [Zon](https://anilist.co/character/324941/Zon)

name: Kiki Floke
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm (5'11")

Kiki is of the twins in Tansu's party. She is a tall-man.

Kiki and her twin brother Kaka were born into a nomadic clan, but one day they were left behind at a tavern as children, and were sleeping in a stable when Mr. and Mrs. Tansu found and adopted them. They grew up surrounded by gnomes.

name: Benichidori
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3")

Benichidori is a member of Shuro's party, serving him as one of his retainers, and is a member of the ninja squad who serves the Nakamoto clan. She is a tall-man from the Eastern Archipelago. Her real name is Matsu (マツ).

Benichidori is quiet, observant, cautious, and a skilled fighter. She has facial dysmorphia, meaning she is extremely insecure about the way her face looks, so she always wears heavy makeup.

name: Johan Liebert
description:
Johan Liebert is the older twin son of the Lieberts, whose father Michael was an East German trade advisor who defected to the West. He is the titular "monster" and the main antagonist of the series. The mystery of his past is the focus of the plot. He is called a monster, the next Adolf Hitler and the devil himself.

Johan was shot in the head as a child when his parents were killed in their home, but saved from death by [Dr. Tenma](https://anilist.co/character/718). Because of this, he regards Dr. Tenma almost as though he was his father. He claims to love his twin sister [Anna](https://anilist.co/character/720), and has some loyalty to her. Johan has spent parts of his life in different places under different names. He possesses charisma and intelligence but is also cunning, manipulative and deceitful; while he is seemingly kind, compassionate and loving to children, he is actually cold, cruel and fundamentally incapable of empathy. He uses his talents to manipulate and corrupt others, often with no apparent end than to cause suffering and destruction.

His goal, as he stated when he was young, is to kill everyone that knows of his existence, and be the last one standing at the end of the world. He identifies with other killers, discovering their secrets. One of the themes of Monster is how individuals are capable of transforming into monsters; Johan often acts as both a direct and indirect catalyst for this transformation.
~! During his "perfect suicide" he was shot in the head by a bystander and seemingly died, but was later saved by Kenzo Tenma. !~

name: Kenzou Tenma
description: Doctor Kenzo Tenma is a Japanese neurosurgeon working at the Eisler Memorial Hospital in Düsseldorf. At the beginning of Monster he is favored by the department director for his prodigious surgical skill. After a crisis of conscience, he chooses to save the life of a young boy instead of the city's mayor, and is unjustly demoted as a result; he then becomes suspect for murder when the department director and several prominent doctors are killed weeks later. It is only after nine years that Dr. Tenma learns the perpetrator of the hospital murders is none other than the boy he saved years before, [Johan Liebert](https://anilist.co/character/719). Plagued by guilt, he resolves to find Johan and end the life of this "monster" he feels responsible for creating. Despite his mission, Dr. Tenma is a humanitarian who genuinely cares about the lives of others. These acts of kindness make him very influential with the people he meets.

name: Wolfgang Grimmer
description:
A freelance journalist who is researching Kinderheim 511; he is also soon drawn into the search for [Johan](https://anilist.co/character/719), as he decides to help [Tenma](https://anilist.co/character/718).

~!As a former subject in 511 Kinderheim, he had developed another personality: an aggressive fighter that comes out and protects him whenever he is under dire stress, inspired by his childhood adoration for an Incredible Hulk-type TV character whom he refers to as the Magnificent Steiner. He also received training as a spy after his time in Kinderheim 511.!~

name: Heinrich Runge
description: Inspector Runge is a dedicated detective belonging to the BKA, which is like the FBI of Germany. When [Dr. Tenma](https://anilist.co/character/718/Tenma-Kenzou) is accused of murder in Düsseldorf, Inspector Runge is assigned to Tenma's case. Runge moves his hand to "store" information from his cases. He has such a successful track record for solving his cases that he believes that he can't be wrong.

name: Anna Liebert
description:
[Johan](https://anilist.co/character/719/Liebert-Johan)'s twin sister and the only unharmed survivor of the night when both her parents and her brother were shot in what appeared to be a botched burglary. At first she showed signs of amnesia due to the psychological trauma of the incident. After she and her brother disappeared, she was adopted by the Fortner family from Heidelberg, who were unaware of her previous identity as Anna Liebert. 

As Nina Fortner, she was a hardworking law student at an unnamed university (likely the University of Heidelberg), as well as an adept practitioner of Aikido. She lived her life in peace until Johan made contact with her on her twentieth birthday. She comes to pursue Johan, albeit by different methods and for a different reason than [Tenma](https://anilist.co/character/718/Tenma-Kenzou).

name: Eva Heinemann
description:
Eva Heinemann is [Doctor Tenma](https://anilist.co/character/718/Tenma-Kenzou)'s fiancée and the daughter of the Director of Eisler Memorial Hospital. She leaves Doctor Tenma after he is demoted by the Director for disobeying his orders. After Director Heinemann is murdered by [Johan](https://anilist.co/character/719/Liebert-Johan), she tries to return to Tenma, then recently promoted Chief of Surgery due to holes created in the staff by the murder. After being rejected by Doctor Tenma, she later becomes an extremely embittered alcoholic, a three time divorcee who uses the money from divorce settlements to finance her lavish lifestyle. After burning her house down in a drunken rage, she wanders throughout Germany and is also caught up in the investigation of the Monster.

Although she does not personally suspect Dr. Tenma as having caused her father's death, one of the things she lives for is to see him suffer in prison in retribution for his rejection of her, as she had previously turned over evidence incriminating Dr. Tenma to [Inspector Runge](https://anilist.co/character/721/Runge-Heinrich). Her relationship with Tenma can be characterized as obsessive.

During the series, she becomes a main target of [Roberto](https://anilist.co/character/8611/Roberto).

name: Dieter
description:
Dieter is a young boy when found by [Tenma](https://anilist.co/character/718/Tenma-Kenzou) to be under the care of a man named [Hartmann](https://anilist.co/character/166955/Hartmann). Upon meeting Dieter, Tenma notices that the young boy is covered in bruises. It turns out that Hartmann was trying to make Dieter into another [Johan](https://anilist.co/character/719/Liebert-Johan), a kind of leader that had not been produced from 511 Kinderheim before.

Dieter later becomes more optimistic after being saved by Doctor Tenma from Hartmann's physical and mental abuse. He follows Doctor Tenma in his search for Johan, partially to prevent Tenma from becoming a murderer, but also because he is fond of Tenma.

He later teams up with [Nina](https://anilist.co/character/720/Liebert-Anna), to give her moral support whenever her traumatic memories resurface as he was also subjected to similar abuse.

name: Martin Reest
description:
Martin Reest works for Baby and has worked for him for three years. He says he'll do any job as long as it doesn't involve women. He went to prison for eight years, charged for killing his girlfriend and her lover.

Peter Čapek calls Martin up for a job; to look after and protect Eva Heinemann as her bodyguard after she was being targeted by Roberto.

Very reluctantly Martin accepts the job and spends time looking after Eva, during which he becomes closer to her.

~!When ordered to kill her, he refuses and escapes with her.!~

name: Julius Reichwein
description: A psychologist who deals in counseling as well as assisting recovering alcoholics. He is caught up in the mystery surrounding the Monster after one of his patients, Richard Braun, supposedly dies in a drunken accident while investigating Johan Liebert. Later on, he becomes guardian to Dieter and aids Tenma in any way he can while defending Tenma's character. He also provides psychological care to Nina, Eva, and others. The Character of Dr. Reichwein bears a physical resemblance to the American Actor Wilford Brimley and Shunsaku Ban from Astroboy. Naoki Urasawa has also used the physical appearance of Brimley in the Pluto manga as well. First seen in Chapter 49.

name: Franz Bonaparta
description:
~!Relatives: Johan Liebert (Half nephew), Anna Liebert (Half Niece), Viera Černá (Sister in law)!~

Franz Bonaparta is considered to be the one responsible for the eugenics experiment that led to the birth of the Liebert twins and is also attributed as the author of the storybooks used to indoctrinate the children of Rose Mansion. Most notable of them was The Nameless Monster, from which Johan took both is name and his mode of operation. Other famous books of his included The Big Eyed Man and the Big Mouthed Man, The God of Peace, and The Quiet Village. His storybooks deal very heavily in metaphor and symbolism, often with monsters as important characters in them. Most also deal with the idea that human nature contains the ability to become good or evil, though his works tend to denounce humanity rather than uplift it. ~!He repents for all his actions after witnessing the death of Grimmer, he confronts Johan with the intention of killing him but he is in turn killed by Roberto before he can go through with it. !~ ~!While his real name is Klaus Poppe, other names that he has used include Emil Scherbe and Jakov Vyrobek.!~ 

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Richard Braun
description: A private investigator hired by Hans Georg Schubert to investigate the supposed suicide of Edmund Farren. His alcoholism after shooting a criminal resulted in his wife and daughter leaving him. Since then, he was trying everything to piece his life back together and reconcile with his family.    ~!When it came to encountering Johan Liebert after finding his tombstone, Johan lured him to the roof of a building about his role of killing a criminal in his last case. Johan manipulates Richard into a state of deep regret after which he offers Richard a bottle of whiskey. It's unknown if he took the bottle or not. Richard is later found dead after falling from the building, presumably an accident. However it is hinted that Johan may have murdered him and made it appear as if he had fallen. One clue to support that Johan murdered him is that he offered and left a broken bottle of whiskey when Dr. Reichwein knew very well that Richard only drank scotch. Both his wife and daughter are seen at his funeral mourning him.!~

name: Rudy-Ulrich Gillen
description: A criminologist, and one of Tenma's former classmates; he helped Tenma by saving him from arrest and also acquiring information about Johan from all the criminals that Johan had met. He also helped Nina to recall her past, to the point of endangering his life. Rudy is able to get into some insight about Johan and how he works but despite all that he knows, he is still baffled by Johan's actions. Dr. Gillen is also a former student of Dr. Reichwein. First seen in Chapter 33.    *Wikipedia

name: Roberto
description:
A big, burly man and one of the many people from the orphanage 511 Kinderheim that [Johan](https://anilist.co/character/719/Liebert-Johan) controls. He admires Johan very much, and often acts as Johan's bodyguard and henchman. He is also a professional hitman with substantial proficiency.

~!His true name, already forgotten by himself, is Adolf Reinhart. [Wolfgang Grimmer](https://anilist.co/character/3096/Grimmer-Wolfgang) is the only person who remembered him and also considered him as a friend in the their childhood at the orphanage. He was shot by Tenma in chapter 73 and seemed to fall into a sea of flames, but he comes back in chapter 108 as an attorney for Tenma under the name of 'Baul', still faithful to Johan. He appears the most out of any of Johan's henchmen in the series and is a recurring enemy. He later appears in the final gunfight in the series as second-in-command of the operation. He enters a fight with Lunge and is shot in the gut, he escapes and kills Franz Bonaparte and dies of his earlier wound. First seen in Chapter 37.!~

name: Jan Suk
description: A detective with the Prague police, he tries to find the mystery involving the death of his superior, Filip Zeman. Zeman was investigating the death of a former headmaster of 511 Kinderheim with Grimmer as a possible suspect, when Suk discovered that Zeman was working with the former Czechoslovakian secret police. When three more officers are murdered, he too is cast under suspicion, and when police attempt to monitor Suk's movements, two more are killed. Suk manages to obtain a tape made by the former headmaster of 511 Kinderheim, but is badly wounded by those seeking the tape. While all this is happening, he confides to someone who he believes is Anna Liebert, a beautiful blonde woman he meets at a bar.    *Wikipedia

name: Otto Heckel
description:
A common thief who runs into Tenma in Chapter 17 when he breaks into a murder victim's house where Tenma is investigating. Heckel is not interested in solving the mystery surrounding the monster, he is more preoccupied in making quick cash by any means necessary. Nonetheless, both Tenma and Heckel must rely on each other in order to survive.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Lotte Frank
description: A female college student also at the University of Munich who is trying to go after Karl Neumann's heart and thus aids his investigation into his father and late mother. When Karl rejects her by getting a proxy to go on a date with her, she is immensely crushed and is comforted by Nina. Given that moment, Nina and Lotte become fast friends. She too wants to know about the mysteries behind Johan Liebert as well as the death of the student who worked with them for Schuwald. First seen in Chapter 47. (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Fritz Vardemann
description: A lawyer hired by residents in Dusseldorf after Tenma was arrested in Prague at one point. Vardemann has made a name for himself proving the innocence of his clients, including his father, who died in prison before being exonerated. He is married and during the series his wife gives birth to a daughter. He enjoys listening to Over the Rainbow from The Wizard of Oz. However, it is revealed later on that Vardemann found notes written by his father which may indicate that he was guilty in the first place. He then teams up with Suk in order to find out the truth regarding an author named Franz Bonaparta in the hopes of discovering the truth about his father's past as well.    *Wikipedia

name: Karl Neumann
description: A male college student at the University of Munich, who is the son of Schuwald and Langer. He is trying to get close to his father without actually letting him know that he is his son. At the same time, he is also caught up in the mystery of a dead student, and the disappearance of Johan Liebert after his father's book collection is burned in a massive inferno during a ceremony at the University Library. After he reconciles with his father, he stays on as Schuwald's personal assistant.

name: Hans Georg Schuwald
description: Known as the "Bayern Vampire", Schuwald is a recluse. He is also a successful businessman, and his success allows him to donate his book collection to the University of Munich. He also has several students from the university in his employ, reading him Latin. However, he does have a past, namely, he fathered a son with a prostitute named Margot Langer. Incidentally, Margot Langer had a friend in Prague who mothered twins. While his book dedication ceremony was targeted by Johan in a scheme to unleash terror and pandemonium, authorities believe that Schuwald is the real target and that Dr. Tenma is indeed responsible. Schuwald is first seen in Chapter 47.    *Wikipedia

name: Rosso
description: Mr. Rosso is well-known and Nina Fortner's chief in his restaurant. ~!He's a former hitman.!~He employed Nina as a waitress there, and Anna's radiance and beauty gathered many customers who flocked to his restaurant. He always puts five sugars in his coffee and he loves movies and regrets not having enough free time to watch them when he was younger.

name: Milan Kolacsh
description: Milan is a dentist who saved Tenma from being caught by the police in the Turkish Quarter in Frankfurt. He took Tenma to his place after Tenma was hit by a van while trying to escape.  ~!Milan was a childhood friend with [[Peter Čapek]] and his main purpose was to kill Čapek which resulted in his death.!~

name: Helenka Novakova
description: A prostitute who gave birth to Hans Georg Schuwald's child, Karl Neumann. After successfully leaving Prague, she worked as a high price call girl who eventually became Schuwald's lover.    (source: wikipedia)

name: Viera Černá
description:
Viera Černá is the mother of Johan Liebert and Nina Fortner. After the Eugenics Experiment spearheaded by Franz Bonaparta, she is given a new name: Anna. 

~!At the end of the series, she is found in Southern France.!~

name: Akanbou
description:
First mentioned in Chapter 25, the "Baby" is a short, elderly man, and an infamous Neo-Nazi leader. He worships Johan as an ideal Aryan leader who would be able to become the next Hitler to lead Germany into prominence. He also works for the four individuals who would gladly welcome Johan as a political leader. To this end, he hoped to use Nina as bait to coerce Johan, but also as a precautionary measure to protect him (and the other group members) from Johan. ~! This fails as Johan kills one of the first of four members in the organization.
In the second half of the series he grows depressed and confides in a prostitute, he is later killed by this prostitute in a scheme engineered by Johann.!~ The characteristics of the "Baby" is heavily influenced by the character "[The Man from Another Place](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Man_from_Another_Place)" from [Twin Peaks](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Twin_Peaks). His first appearance, in Chapter 26/Episode 15, is also nearly identical, appearing to Nina Fortner from behind a red curtain (akin to the Black Lodge's waiting room) while dancing to the tune "Be My Baby". (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Kenji Endou
description: Endo Kenji grew up in late-1960s/early-1970s Japan, at a time when American phenomena, notably the space race and the era of Woodstock, were resounding around the world.  An avid reader of manga who often saw apocalyptic scenarios playing out, he always responded with the cry of "I would fight".  During this time, he and his friends made up a scenario for world conquest in order to play heroes.  Flash forward to 1997, when Kenji has taken charge of his family liquor shop, and turned it into a convenience store.  He is now raising the daughter of his sister, [Kiriko](https://anilist.co/character/29789/Endou-Kiriko) (who disappeared immediately after leaving her daughter to Kenji), and living a fairly ordinary life.  However, after events from the prophecy he made up earlier begin to come true, he learns of an evil organization, led by a masked man called "Friend", which is using his plans to conquer the world.  As the organization's hold on the government strengthens, he becomes a wanted man and lives on the streets, continuing to (covertly) oppose Friend on the streets, partially through terrorism and partially through a protest song he wrote (named "Bob Lennon").

name: Tomodachi
description:
The main antagonist of the series. An enigmatic cult leader who, in 1997, began using the symbol [Kenji](https://anilist.co/character/3442/Endou-Kenji) and his friends put together in the 1970s. His followers have filled venues such as the Budokan.One of his goals is to take over the world. His face is hidden in shadow throughout the series; he even confronts Kenji by wearing a mask. His true identity is one of the driving mysteries of the series. As of 2000, the Friendship Democratic Party (FDP) is established as a political group with government representatives such as Manjome Inshu.   

~!Over the course of the series, two people assume the identity of Friend: Fukubei, who is one of Kenji's schoolmates, initially appears to be one of Kenji's allies, and Katsumata, another of Kenji's schoolmates, the latter of whom possesses special powers.!~

name: Kanna Endou
description:
[Kenji](https://anilist.co/character/3442/Endou-Kenji)'s niece, she serves as the protagonist for the events in the aftermath of the "Bloody New Year's Eve". She is shown to have ESP at an advanced level, and is capable of predicting the future (To a small extent), bend spoons with her mind, and even once strangled a woman without touching her (in a fit of emotional rage). She loves rock&roll, due to Kenji's obsession with it. She idolizes Kenji despite what the rest of the world thinks of him, and is also quite skilled at the guitar. She lives by herself in a low-rent apartment and works part-time at a small noodle shop in the middle of Thai/ Chinese Mafia territorium.

~!She is daughter of [Kiriko Endou](https://anilist.co/character/29789/Kiriko-Endo) and "Friend" [(Fukubei Hattori)](https://anilist.co/character/21461/Fukubei-Hattori).!~

name: Chouji Ochiai
description: A childhood friend of Kenji's who created the "Friend" symbol and became a salaryman. Later traveled to Tibet and Thailand after his son died, at which point he gets involved in the dealings of the "Friend" group.  長治 is sometimes misread as "Nagaharu" but his first name is Chouji.

name: Kiyoshi Sada
description: Kenji's classmate who wasn't part of the original gang. As a child, he often wears a mask, but was bullied a lot in school and eventually left after a semester, thus his face remains unknown to most of the gang.    ~!However, Fukubei meets with him and Sadakiyo asks if he can be his friend. He later joins the Friends and is the caretaker of Friend's replica childhood home. He becomes the English teacher of Kyoko Koizumi and takes her to the Friend's home, where he begins to realize that maybe he wasn't doing the right thing after all, and ends up burning the home, and taking Kyoko to meet his old teacher at the senior center. He supposedly dies in a fiery car crash while Kyoko and the gang escape, but appears in 3FE with his mask on as he tries to hold off Friend. !~

name: Kyoko Koizumi
description:
Kyoko is a high school girl that attends the same school as Kanna. For a history assignment, she impulsively picks Bloody New Year's Eve, but when she starts doing some research, she meets [Kamisama](https://anilist.co/character/8116/Kyuutarou-Kaminaga)'s and learns the truth of what happened that night.

~!She is suddenly recruited to participate in Tomodachi Land where she must abide by the Friend's cult activities or risk being sent to Tomodachi Land. She struggles with her survival until she meets [Yoshitsune](https://anilist.co/character/20072), who helps her get through the exam in exchange for uncovering more information on the identity of Friend. In 3 FE, Kyoko discovers that she has a talent for bowling and is heavily recruited by Kamisama.!~

name: Yukiji Setoguchi
description:
The only female member of [Kenji](https://anilist.co/character/3442/Endou-Kenji)'s original group of friends, and also the strongest physically.

Yukiji currently (at the beginning of the story) serves as a drug dog handler for Narita Airport.  Takes care of [Kanna](https://anilist.co/character/9730/Endou-Kanna) in the year 2014.

name: Yoshitsune Minamoto
description:
Yoshitsune is a childhood friend of [Kenji Endou](https://anilist.co/character/3442/Kenji-Endou). He was part of Kenji's Youth Group and later Kenji's Group.

As a child, Yoshitsune was very shy and often forgot about by his friends. During adulthood, for his job, he made the mistake of ordering 1000 printer cartridges when he only needed four, and while wondering what he was supposed to do, he received a text from Kenji asking him to come fight against Friend.

~!He managed to survive the Bloody New Year's Eve and from there lived as a custodian at Tomodachi Land, trying to learn more about it and eventually coming to help [Kyoko Koizumi](https://anilist.co/character/38517/Kyoko-Koizumi) escape where he again gets himself involved with his former colleagues.!~

name: Kyuutarou Kaminaga
description: Kamisama is the nickname of a homeless old man who is bent on the return of ten-pin bowling as a major sport in Japan. Kamisama has the power of foresight and can see what will happen before it comes to pass.

name: Shouhei Chouno
description: Chono is the grand-son of the "legendary" Inspector Cho. The latter was murdered by his colleague, Yama, in 1997, because he had discovered the identity of his friend and projects.

name: Hattori
description: Fukubei is one of Kenji's childhood friends, but he barely remembers him at the class reunion. He lives with his three children and wife, who happens to be the member of the "Friend's" cult. Later, he decides to join Kenji to save the world    ~! It is revealed that Fukubei was the first "Friend."!~

name: Maruo
description: Childhood friend of Kenji's, stays bests friends with him even as an adult. As a child he was part of the founding members of the secret base group. As an adult he is married with a son and manages "The Fancy Shop" a store for high school girls.  Source: 1st chapter of 20th century boys

name: Saburou Kido
description: In 1997, Donkey became a teacher in a technical school. Married and father of a boy, he lost almost all contact with his old friends. It investigates a little too close to Friend, and sends letters to Kenji about it and it will lead to his assassination by Masao and another henchman of Friend. His death is the starting point for the investigation of Kenji, equally shocked and saddened his friends Donkey's death.

name: Katsumata Tadanobu
description: A friend of [Fukubei](https://anilist.co/character/21461/Fukubei-Hattori)'s who often wore a double of the same mask [Sadakiyo](https://anilist.co/character/27225/Sada-Kiyoshi) wore.

name: Kiriko Endou
description:
Kiriko is Kenji's older sister and Kanna's mother. For the vast majority of the manga, Kiriko is only seen in flashbacks, where she is shown to have a strong sense of justice and an interest in biology. She was also an important mother figure for Kenji during his youth, often taking him places or getting him presents and helping him out (like when he was hospitalized due to a motorcycle accident or when she got him an electric guitar).   

~!Fukubei researched Kiriko's romance with Moroboshi and after he had him killed, began courting Kiriko in the same way as Moroboshi (i.e. using his words). His goal appeared to be to encourage her to fulfill her dream of studying microbiology and use her expertise to create the deadly virus. When Kiriko realized that Fukubei was creating a cult around himself, she gave the police everything she knew about him and left her child, Kanna with Kenji and their mother. Unfortunately, the detective she gave it to was Yama and he had already defected to friend at the time, so her evidence was destroyed. Kiriko then went to see Yamane and convinced him about Fukubei's true intentions. Upon realizing how deadly the new virus that Yamane made was, she decided to spend all her time and effort making a vaccine.  Kiriko feels extremely guilty over her involvement in the creation of the virus, as such she has spend most of her time trying to out-maneuver Friend and create a vaccine that would be distributed to everyone. As a last gamble in Friend year 3, Kiriko exposes herself to the next generation of the virus to test out her own vaccine. Fortunately the vaccine works and Kiriko survives.!~

~!In 21st Century Boys, Kiriko seems to be working in some African country as a volunteer doctor. Kanna and Chouno come to see her, and daughter and mother finally reunite.!~

name: Keitarou Fukuda
description: [Kenji](https://anilist.co/character/3442/Kenji-Endou)'s childhood friend nicknamed Froggy. He has been hiding out in America when he discovers that Kanna's mother has gone there to try to manufacture the vaccine for the outbreak of 2015.

name: Masaaki Shimon
description:
Masaaki Shimon, also known as Mon-chan was part of [Kenji](https://anilist.co/character/3442/Kenji-Endou)'s circle of friends during his childhood. In 1969, he and his friends built their own secret base. They built this on a large field.

He moved to Germany and became a rugby player before retiring to take care of his ailing mother. After her passing, he started his own business with a partner.

~!He returns to Japan to attend [Donkey](https://anilist.co/character/82557/Sabur-Kido)'s funeral, and later answers Kenji's call to arms on Bloody New Year's Eve. Mon-chan survives the event, but prior to this, he was diagnosed with a terminal illness. He is later seen hospitalized in 2002 due to his disease.!~

~!In 2002, Mon-chan was already seriously ill and in the hospital. He was visited by [Yukiji](https://anilist.co/character/7271/Yukiji-Setoguchi), to whom he showed the information he has collected while investigating the Friend. Shortly after, Mon-chan suddenly leaves the hospital with no warning and disappears, which is later revealed to have been to contact [Sadakiyo](https://anilist.co/character/27225/Sada-Kiyoshi) in an attempt to investigate further, not knowing Sadakiyo's involvement with Friend. Sadakiyo kills him on behalf of the Friend, taking the information he has gathered.!~

name: Sanae
description: A strong mind young woman of the age of Friend Era. Sanae's skeptical about "friend" and the whole conspiracy. She along with her brother saved Otcho.     Source: Classic Manga

name: Haru Namio
description: A singer who became the best known national artist of Japan after composing the massive hit song «Hello- Hello». He is famous for endorsing Friend's figure and political party with the messages​ of his music. Could there be anything else to his lyrics, hidden beneath their cheerful surface?

name: Yuuichi Konno
description: Childhood friend of Kenji and his band, Konchi is a character who is very present in the flashbacks of the 70s, but which is secondary because we never see adulthood. We know he was part of the band child and he was close to Kenji and others. However, he moved in his last year at primary school and went to live in Hokkaido, that is what explains why one sees so little.  In 2000, he received a letter of Kenji who asked for his help but Konchi does not meet his childhood friend ... and it seems to regret in the year 3 Ami. It is indeed this year we (re) discover this character, which broadcasts the song Kenji loop on the radio from his position of Hokkaido.   ~!It appears to us under the identity of a mysterious DJ, and we discover in Volume 21 his real identity. He lives alone since 2015 and let go of the second virus is obviously look reminiscent of the 1970s and the peace and love movement. We know that Kenji met during this trip through Japan. It is also at this meeting that he heard the song and decided to spread. But he did not recognize Kenji this time, which is understandable since they had not seen since childhood ...!~

name: The Assassin
description:
The Assassin (real name unrevealed) is one of Friend's assistants.

~!He is the one who pushed Moroboshi, [Kiriko](https://anilist.co/character/29789/Kiriko-Endo)'s beloved one, in front of a train and caused his death to let the "Friend" [(Fukubei Hattori)](https://anilist.co/character/21461/Fukubei-Hattori) be with her. He also lured [Dr. Shikishima](https://anilist.co/character/82577/Shikishima)'s daughter, [Lena Shikishima](https://anilist.co/character/82575/Lena-Shikishima), into being his girlfriend and to be under Friend's command, so that Dr. Shikishima would create the first Robot for him.!~

name: Masao Tamura
description:
In 1997, Masao was a passionate member of Friend's cult since its early days. He was first shown dancing in his underpants, performing his "morning healing aerobics" while listening to Friend's "healing CD"; his room was also seen with various Friend posters, and he owns Friend t-shirts. Later on, he "purified" Pierre Ichimonji, a leader of a rival cult, once again showing his fanaticism and obsession towards Friend.

~!It is discovered later that Masao was an alumni of Musashiyama Technical School, the institution [Donkey](https://anilist.co/character/82557/Sabur-Kido) teached at. He was also shown to be an accomplice in Donkey's murder.!~

~!In 2014, Masao was incarcerated for an unknown reason in Umihotaru Prison, the same place that held [Otcho](https://anilist.co/character/6004/Chouji-Ochiai), under the registration number "13". He acted as a preacher in the prison. Later he was released and became Friend's top hitman.!~

name: Mitsuyo Takasu
description: Takasu is the authoritarian leader of the Dream Navigators from Tomodachi Land.

name: Myne
description:
__Family structure__ ~!　Father: [Gunther](https://anilist.co/character/126528) 　 Mother: [Effa](https://anilist.co/character/126527) 　 Older sister: [Tuuli](https://anilist.co/character/126526) 　 Younger brother: [Kamil](https://anilist.co/character/157140)!~ __Status__ 　 Class: commoner 　 Occupation: soldier's child
Youngest daughter of a poor commoner family. She has navy blue hair and golden eyes. She has a feeble body which gets a high fever if she forces it too much, it is also smaller than the average for her age. Urano Motosu died at the age of 22 and reincarnated into Myne's body by the time Myne was 5 years old.
____ _Spoiler from [Part 3](https://anilist.co/manga/110801)_ # ~!__Rozemyne__ (ローゼマイン)!~ ~!
__Family structure__ 　 Father: [Karstedt](https://anilist.co/character/156108) 　 Mother: [Elvira](https://anilist.co/character/157149) (Karstedt's first wife, mother of baptism) 　 Older brother: [Eckhart](https://anilist.co/character/201318) 　 Older brother: [Lamprecht](https://anilist.co/character/201319) 　　　 Nephew: Siegrecht 　 Older brother: [Cornelius](https://anilist.co/character/201320) 　 Younger half-brother: [Nikolaus](https://anilist.co/character/201317) (son of Karstedt's second wife) 　 Mother: [Rozemary](https://anilist.co/character/157151) (Karstedt's third wife, mother setting) 　 Adoptive father: [Sylvester](https://anilist.co/character/157135) 　 Adoptive mother: [Florencia](https://anilist.co/character/201321) 　 Older brother: [Wilfried](https://anilist.co/character/201564) 　 Younger sister: [Charlotte](https://anilist.co/character/201565) 　 Younger brother: [Melchior](https://anilist.co/character/201566) 　 Paternal relatives 　 Great-grandfather: [Aub Ehrenfest](https://anilist.co/character/201635) (fifth generation) 　 Great-grandfather: [former Giebe Leisegang](https://anilist.co/character/262016) (Bonifatius's first wife's father) 　 Grandfather: [Bonifatius](https://anilist.co/character/201624) 　 Half-uncle: son of Bonifatius's second wife 　　　 Cousin: [Traugott](https://anilist.co/character/201627) __Status__ 　 Class: archnoble → archducal family member 　 Occupation: apprentice blue shrine maiden, orphan director and studio manager → archduke candidate, high bishop, orphan director and studio manager __Age related__ 　 Age difference with Myne: -1 　 Birth season: summer
Rozemyne is an archnoble girl. Her flowing midnight-blue hair is well kept, silkier than even the hair of most archnoble girls, and her moon-like golden-yellow eyes are like windows into her emotional heart. She has a pretty face as well, and would no doubt grow up to be a true beauty. She has pale white skin largely untouched by the sun, and soft hands that weren't at all worn down by labor. Rozemyne ​​has a massive amount of mana inside her. Her mana is so great that Karstedt determined that it was necessary to hide his own daughter and raise her in secret, away from any danger. [The former High Bishop](https://anilist.co/character/126545) misunderstood her presence in the temple, and not discerning her true identity, he began to groan and complain that a commoner shrine maiden disturbed the peace. Rozemyne ​​was raised humbly, unaware of her parents or their status, but still, her compassionate heart ached for the suffering of those who lived in worse circumstances than her. She felt sorry for the children who lived in the orphanage, and did what no one else would by giving them food and work, due to that, Rozemyne is worshiped and honored by the orphans as a Saint. [The Archduke](https://anilist.co/character/157135) determined that the work Rozemyne gave to the orphans could become a new industry for his duchy. Just when he was considering spending the next twenty or more years spreading it around the duchy, Rozemyne ​​was targeted by [a noble from another duchy](https://anilist.co/character/157148). In order to secure Rozemyne's position in the nobility, and to protect her mana wealth for the sake of Ehrenfest, the Archduke adopted her.!~

name: Ferdinand
description:
__Family structure__ ~!　Father: [Adelbert](https://anilist.co/character/201316) (deceased) 　 Mother: [Seradina](https://anilist.co/character/198761) 　 Older half-sister: [Georgine](https://anilist.co/character/201312) 　　　 Niece: Alstede 　　　 Nephew: Wolfram (deceased) 　　　 Niece: [Detlinde](https://anilist.co/character/225797) 　 Older half-sister: [Constanze](https://anilist.co/character/201617) 　　　 Nephew: [Rudiger](https://anilist.co/character/225798) 　 Older half-brother: [Sylvester](https://anilist.co/character/157135) 　　　 Nephew: [Wilfried](https://anilist.co/character/201564) 　　　 Niece: [Charlotte](https://anilist.co/character/201565) 　　　 Nephew: [Melchior](https://anilist.co/character/201566) 　　　 Niece: fourth child 　 Paternal relatives 　 Uncle: [Bonifatius](https://anilist.co/character/201624) 　　　 Cousin: [Karstedt](https://anilist.co/character/156108) 　　　 Cousin: Karstedt's half-brother 　 Half-aunt: Irmhilde!~ __Age related__ ~!　Age difference with [Myne](https://anilist.co/character/126156): +13 (summer) 　 Birth season: presumed to be spring or summer!~
He is a blue priest who serves as the High Priest of the temple of the city of Ehrenfest. He is tall and slender, he has light blue hair that reaches down towards his shoulders and pale golden eyes. People frequently mistake him by being older than he really is. ~!He was the son of a concubine in noble society. Regardless of [his father’s true wife](https://anilist.co/character/194299), his relationship with his older half-brother was not at all bad. After his father's death, his half-brother recommended him to join the temple. Before he became the High Priest, with the help of his half-brother he built a library inside the temple, one that even nobles with unfortunate economic circumstances would be able to use. Despite the fact that it had not been terribly long since he joined the temple and that he was still very young, he became the High Priest due to all of the people who were primarily in charge of managing the temple’s affairs had been called away to noble society, leaving him to take on every single aspect of running the temple.!~

name: Benno
description:

name: Punpun Onodera
description:
Punpun is a socially awkward young boy whose age of innocence ends with his parents' divorce. As he continues to mature and interact with people around him as the average boy would, such as dealing with crushes and getting into mischief with his classmates, he begins to learn how crushing and harsh reality can be and struggles to find his purpose in the world.

~!As Punpun grows older, his appearance changes drastically based on how he views himself.
!~

name: Aiko Tanaka
description:
An eccentric girl who is the main love interest of Onodera Punpun throughout the manga.

~!After many years without meeting up with Punpun, they meet at a driving school and start seeing each other more often. Little by little, they open up to each other to eventually reveal different truths about each of their realities. She tells Punpun how she's fed up with the poor lifestyle of hers because of her crippled and cult-obsessed mother. In a rush to leave her house along with Punpun, they decide they should at least let her mother know. While in her house, Aiko's mother becomes enraged with the news and attacks Aiko with a knife several times, the biggest wound being around her abdomen. Filled with anger, Punpun assaults Aiko's mother and strangles her to death.!~ ~! While Aiko and Punpun are running away, she reveals to him that after he strangled her mother until apparent death, she was still alive and that it was her that gave the final blow by stabbing her stomach to death with a knife.!~
 ~!They later run off to several places with the intention of starting things over. Through a series of events and dialogues, both Aiko and Punpun start to lose their composure and right thinking, trying to kill each other several times. One morning, Aiko wakes up to leave a sleeping Punpun alone and hangs herself with a rope.!~

name: Sachi Nanjou
description: Sachi is a young woman pursuing a career as a manga artist. She befriends [Onodera Punpun](https://anilist.co/character/17706/Onodera-Punpun) and serves an important role in his life. She has realistic views on things and isn't afraid to speak out, but most people think she is just a rude person.

name: Masumi Seki
description:
A runaway child who misunderstood freedom. 

Masumi Seki is one of [Punpun](https://anilist.co/character/17706/Onodera-Punpun)'s childhood friends and is best friends with [Shimizu](https://anilist.co/character/22653/Shimizu-Kou). He has a rough personality and usually has a cool, indifferent expression even when upset. There is a permanent scar above the tip of his nose that is covered by a bandaid for most of elementary school. His family owns Seki Lunches, which used to do business with the now-abandoned miso factory.

~!Seki begins smoking cigarettes in elementary school. After he and his friends explore the old miso factory, his dropped cigarette causes an explosion while Shimizu is still inside. This instance traumatizes Seki, causing a deep phobia of fire. He faces his fear of fire when Shimizu again is caught in an exploding building with the Pegasus Ensemble, and Seki breaks inside to rescue him. In the epilogue, he is even shown smoking a cigarette.!~

name: Yuuichi Onodera
description:
Punpun's uncle (Punpun's mom's brother) who is a 30-something freeter. He was previously a ceramics teacher, but he quit his job due to a certain incident. He looks after Punpun after Punpun's parents divorce.

Women of all ages find him very attractive. He is bad at resisting the charms of beautiful women which leads him to several serious troubles in his life. Because of that, he finds humans to be ugly and detestable creatures and prefers to keep contact with other people to the minimum.

~!After living with Punpun's grandparents, he moves in with Punpun, meets a girl named Midori, gets married, has a child.  He repeatedly cheats on his partners, and tries to kill himself!~

name: Kamisama
description:
Appears after Punpun says a special chant his uncle taught him. He helps Punpun with his problems.    ~!His "help" is frequently an incitement to violence.!~ 
~!As the manga keeps going, it's revealed that "God" is really the manifestation of Punpun's darker thoughts.!~

description:
A weird friend of [Punpun](https://anilist.co/character/17706/Onodera-Punpun). Best friends with [Seki](https://anilist.co/character/58561/Seki-Masumi). He's not so independent and has a wild imagination. His nose seems to be running all the time.

~!The cause of his wild imagination and inability to be independent came from the trauma of losing his mother in a traffic accident while he was still in elementary school.!~

name: Toshiki Hoshikawa
description:
Leader of the ''Good Vibrations'' cult. He is a younger son of a wealthy religious fanatic. His father is the founder of the Cosmos Health Center.

He is a self-claimed prophet, although his predictions always came true. He says that everything that has happened and will happen in the universe had been engraved as musical scales onto the surface of a giant cylinder called "Akashic records," a music box of infinite proportions which is the shape of our universe. But this box is singing an unstable tune and on July 7, the violent dissonance will cause the destruction of this world, the so-called "Promised Despair." He is assembling a group of twelve people who would help him to sing a tune of a song "Tsubasa wo Kudasai" in order to harmonize that instability and save the world.

name: Shuntarou Harumi
description:
A childhood friend of Punpun, who moved away as a child.
~!He comes back as an adult at the series finale, detached from the entire drama that had been going on in everyone's lives.!~

name: Takao Yaguchi
description: After Punpun breaks up with Aiko, Aiko asks Yaguchi to be her boyfriend; however, their relationship appears as quite uncomfortable. Yaguchi plays for his school's badminton team, but an injury prevents him from reaching his full potential.

name: Heiroku  Shishido
description:
The owner of Shishido Heights Real estate. He is too kind and can easily trust complete strangers, much to the irritation of his daughter. He becomes friends with Punpun and offers him a job opportunity at a real estate business. He also likes to collect manekineko dolls.

Coincidentally, the flat that he asks Seki and Shimizu to clean is the one that Punpun later rents to live in.

name: Punyama Punpun Mama
description:
Punpun's Mom.

~!Throughout the series, she is constantly shown acting very coldly toward Punpun, and it is later revealed that she blames Punpun for all of the hardships in her life. After being hospitalized for Pneumothorax, she is determined to be a better mother, but can't stop her usual habit of speaking harshly toward her son. In chapter 67, it is revealed that she has cancer and very little time to live; her final words to Punpun is her apology for being a terrible mother, and the admittance that she truly loved him.!~

name: Midori Okuma
description:
Midori is a hard-working 25-year-old girl. She is a nurse that took care of Punpun's mother. She dreams of opening a cafe.

~!She later starts dating Punpun's uncle, Yuuichi, and becomes part of the family.!~

~!When Yuuichi runs away because of his infidelity and adultery, Midori rapes Punpun in her distress, scarring him deeply.!~

name: Punyama Punpun Papa
description:
Punpun's dad. He turns down a work transfer due to family reasons but gets fired from work as a result. He is unable to find a job since then.

After the divorce, he goes to his hometown Kagoshima and starts working as night guard at a hydro plant. He sends letters to Punpun every month.

~!The one who was actually writing the letters was Punpun's mother. After the death of Punpun's mother, he offers Punpun the opportunity to start everything from scratch, but Punpun decides to live on his own.!~

name: Setsuyuki Mimura
description:
Punpun's friend from high school. They work at the same part-time jobs after going to university. He often acts like a fool and likes to brag about his muscles. Because of that, he is unpopular among girls. When he introduces Hebitsuka Gesumi as his girlfriend, his friends don't believe him.

He decides to pursue a teacher's career because both of his parents are teachers.

name: Gesumi Hebitsuka
description: Girlfriend of Mimura. They work together at their university's goods store. She is a nice, energetic, and hardworking girl but can be clumsy at times.

name: Wada Akinori
description:
A mathematics teacher that works at the same cram school as Nanjou Sachi. He tries to hit on Sachi up to the point of stalking her.

He is one of the early members of the "Good Vibrations" cult. He had known Pegasus since his collage days. He is the most influential person in the group.

~!He wants people to realize the greatness of Pegasus' prophecies, yet at the same time he doesn't want him to make any inaccurate predictions. In order to fulfill his plan, he needs someone to do "push the button" work, for which he pays greatly. That someone turns out to be Seki Masumi.!~

~!The plan is a mass suicide of "Good Vibrations" cult members for the sake of the world's safety. The "pushing a button" job turns out to be turning on the TV for his senile mother, and indirectly, taking care of her.!~

name: Weekly Big Comic Spirits
description: The twelfth follower of Pegasus in the "Good Vibrations" cult.

name: Azusa Kanie
description: She was one of Punpun's love interests during his high school days.

name: Komatsu
description: Punpun's friend from elementary and middle school. He has a natural talent for badminton.

name: Having-one-battery-left-is-troublesome
description: A member of the "Good Vibrations" cult. He works in web design and publishes indie magazines on the side. He likes to discuss out-of-place artifacts (OOPArts) and mysterious giant organisms.

name: Miyuki Kanie
