description: The older sister of Azusa and friend of Nanjou Sachi. She likes to wear fancy hats depicting animals or insects. Although she quarrels with Sachi a lot, they care about each other as much.

name: Yugami
description:
A lawyer and friend of Onodera Yuuichi. He helps handle a divorce business. 
~!He takes a shine to Ookuma Midori, but when Yuuichi takes her away, they get on bad terms with each other.!~

name: Tanaka Mitsuko
description:
Aiko's mother. She is a part of the Cosmo Health Center organization. She is very strict with her daughter and keeps her on total control, often beating her up when she refuses to obey. After Hoshikawa Piroshiki's death, she cripples her leg, further enforcing Aiko to stay with her.

~!
The crippling of her leg is actually a lie, as is revealed when Punpun and Aiko confront her that Aiko is leaving together with Punpun. Enraged with the news, she attacks Aiko with a knife several times, the biggest wound being around her abdomen. Filled with anger, Punpun assaults Mitsuko and strangles her to death.!~

name: Saotome
description: The ex-husband of Sachi. He works in the TV industry. He worked hard to achieve his goals in life, and because of that, he despises all losers who do nothing but whine all the time.

name: Tomoya Okazaki
description:
__Height:__ 173cm
__Class:__ 3-D

Tomoya Okazaki is the protagonist of Clannad. Due to his habit of always arriving late to school, skipping classes during the day, and staying out all night, he has been labeled as a delinquent.

name: Nagisa Furukawa
description:
__Height:__ 155 cm

Nagisa is the daughter of [Akio](https://anilist.co/character/7095/Furukawa-Akio) and [Sanae Furukawa](https://anilist.co/character/6831/Furukawa-Sanae). Though she is in her senior year, Nagisa is one year older than her classmates; she had to repeat her third year again after an illness that lasted nine months. Nagisa meets [Tomoya](https://anilist.co/character/4606/Okazaki-Tomoya) on the first day of this year.  Nagisa is very timid, and has a habit of saying the names of food that she wants to eat as a way of motivating herself. She wants to reestablish the suspended Theater Club, but does not have enough self-confidence to do so.

name: Tomoyo Sakagami
description:
__Height:__ 161 cm

Tomoyo transferred to [Tomoya](https://anilist.co/character/4606/Okazaki-Tomoya)'s school as a second year student during spring. Although Tomoya is older than her, Tomoyo does not show him his due respect as a senior student. She has a younger brother named [Takafumi](https://anilist.co/character/9301/Sakagami-Takafumi).

She is rumored to be violent and to have a misconduct record for fighting. These rumors are later confirmed, when she beats up several delinquents from her previous school at a day during school hours. [Youhei](https://anilist.co/character/4610/Sunohara-Youhei) challenges Tomoyo, unable to believe what he saw. After several meetings with Tomoyo, Tomoya learns from Tomoyo that she wants to be a student council president, and later, her reason of wanting to be one.

name: Fuuko Ibuki
description:
__Height:__ 150 cm

Fuko is a first year student at Tomoya's school (Technically, her age is same as Tomoya's), but she is always alone by herself, making wood carvings of starfish with a small knife to give to others as presents for her sister's upcoming wedding. Whenever Fuko sees something she thinks is incredibly cute she completely loses awareness of her surroundings, which Tomoya takes advantage of by playing a variety of pranks on her.

name: Kyou Fujibayashi
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm

Kyou is a bad-mouthed and aggressive girl well known as a good cook. She was in Tomoya's class in their second year, and has maintained a steady friendship with Tomoya even though they are put in different classes on their third year. She is currently the class representative of her class. She has a pet baby boar named Botan. She owns a scooter and she throws various types of dictionaries towards anyone she gets furious with, especially Youhei.

name: Akio Furukawa
description:
**Height:** 175 cm (5' 9")

Akio is Nagisa's father. 

Although he often talks and plays rough, he is kind and sympathetic. His childish side makes it easy for people to befriend him. He runs the Furukawa Bakery with his wife [Sanae](https://anilist.co/character/6831/Sanae-Furukawa). In his spare time, Akio plays baseball with children in the small park next to the bakery, and indulges in the Gundam fandom. He is often the victim of Sanae's bread, having to eat her bread in front of her while claiming that he loves it.

~! 
During the School Life arc, Akio reveals that he was an actor in a theatrical company, but has to quit his job due to Nagisa's health. Akio replaces Youhei's role as the comic relief during the After Story arc, however, he can be serious when needed, as he often gives advice to Tomoya on what it is like to become a man. He tells the story about how Nagisa almost died due to their unintended negligence, and how her life is connected to the city after getting saved from her fever. 
!~

name: Kotomi Ichinose
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3'')

Kotomi is another schoolmate of [Tomoya](https://anilist.co/character/4606/Okazaki-Tomoya)'s in the same year, but, like [Kyou](https://anilist.co/character/4605/Fujibayashi-Kyou), is in a separate class from Tomoya. The "Koto" in Kotomi is derived from the Japanese musical stringed instrument of the same name. She is in the top ten for every subject throughout the whole country in standardized exam results—she always goes to library to read extra materials, especially books in foreign languages. Kotomi is a very quiet girl and it is quite difficult to communicate with her. In her spare time, she plays the violin, although she is very poor at it to the point of causing pain to those who hear her play.

name: Ushio Okazaki
description:
Ushio is [Tomoya](https://anilist.co/character/4606) and [Nagisa](https://anilist.co/character/4604)'s daughter. She is a well-behaved, well-loved girl who is very curious about the world around her. Tomoya notes that she does not act like other girls her age. For example, most girls would want to have dolls; however, when Tomoya goes on a trip with her, he buys her a robot with which she is fascinated. Tomoya, finding it strange that she would prefer this type of toy, learns that Ushio has some interest in robots; thus he also calls her "boyish". Ushio also appears to like baseball. Ushio's interest has been influenced by her grandfather who teaches her to imitate famous baseball players. She refers to [Akio](https://anilist.co/character/7095) as "Akii" and calls her grandmother by her given name "Sanae".

In the few earlier episodes of the stories, Ushio stays with [Sanae](https://anilist.co/character/6831) and Akio. During her time with her grandparents, she learns to be a baseball addict like Akio, Ushio also learns strict disciplines from Sanae not to cry unless it is in the restroom.

~!As the story progresses on with Tomoya's recovery, she starts to live with her father. As she lives with her father, she later becomes friends with [Fuuko](https://anilist.co/character/4601), the sister of her mother's old teacher, [Kouko](https://anilist.co/character/6971). Due to the lack of time Tomoya can spend with Ushio, she sneaks out of her father's house to view a hospital she refers as "pleasant." This is the place that Akio once took Nagisa to beg for her life.!~ 

~!One day, Ushio falls dangerously ill, and the doctor's conclude that she has contracted the same mysterious illness that Nagisa once had. To support his daughter, Tomoya quits his job and chooses to stay with Ushio as she unsuccessfully fights for her life. Ushio asks Tomoya to take her on a trip like the last one they went to, but he refuses, saying she needs to heal first. Tomoya finally gives in the second time she asks. As they walk towards the train station in the snow, Ushio collapses, whispers "I love you" to her father, before dying in his arms. 

In the extra ending of Clannad: After Story, Nagisa and Ushio do not die and live happily with Tomoya.!~

~!At the edge of death after failing to get away from the world, it is revealed that she is actually the Girl in the Illusionary World who had lost her memory after dying in the real world.!~

name: Youhei Sunohara
description:
__Height:__ 167 cm (5'4")
__Occupation:__ Student

Youhei is Tomoya's friend and also a delinquent. He entered the school on an athletic recommendation in football (soccer), but was kicked out of the soccer club after being involved in a fight. After this incident, he became lazy, becoming the only student with a higher absence rate than Tomoya. He and Tomoya are known as the "Dirty Pair" in school. Youhei plays a major role in some character paths. Youhei plays the most role in Sunohara siblings' arc, which centers around his relationship with his sister Mei, who tries to bring back her brother's former self.  In After Story arc,  ~!he attends Nagisa's fake graduating ceremony after being begged by Tomoya, and visits Nagisa when she is sick and pregnant. According to the scriptwriters, he has the most appearance in the School Life arc.!~  In the movie, Youhei is depicted less as a comic relief character and is more serious about life, such as when he gets a part-time job due to his family's financial situations. He also gets along with Tomoyo and the two even worked together to ease Tomoya's depression.

name: Sanae Furukawa
description:
**Height:** 158 cm (5' 2")

Sanae is Nagisa's mother. Normally she's very childish and a cry-baby, but when needed she can be very strong-willed and dependable. She runs the Furukawa Bakery with her husband Akio. She often tries out strange concepts to make breads that are anything but edible and never get sold. Outside of the bakery, she tutors children. She's quite proud of the way people often mistake her for Nagisa's older sister because of her youthful appearance.    ~!Sanae plays a larger role in After Story, often comes to Tomoya's aid when Nagisa is sick and needs to be accompanied, especially during Nagisa's pregnancy. Before being a baker at the Furukawa Bakery, she was a junior-high teacher, and had to quit her job due to Nagisa's health. Sanae is the mastermind behind Tomoya and Ushio's trip to the flower cape, in hope for them to reconcile. She knows Shino, Tomoya's grandmother in his father's side, although it is never revealed how they met. !~

name: Ryou Fujibayashi
description:
__Height:__ 159 cm

Ryou is Tomoya's classmate and class representative. She is the younger of the Fujibayashi twins. Unlike her older sister, she is timid and doesn’t cook well, though she is good with other household chores. Ryou is very keen about fortune telling, but her predictions, while incredibly specific, always manage to be either somewhat skewed or extremely wrong. She aspires to become a nurse.

name: Misae Sagara
description: Misae Sagara is the resident manager at Youhei's dorm. Misae is 23 years old at the time the story takes place; this is only mentioned in the visual novel. She was Hikarisaka's first female student council president when she was in high school. She achieved a full week of perfect attendance for the whole student body and she was loved by the students. Misae is friendly with the dorm students but strict when it comes to the dorm rules. She is also well-liked by the rugby members. Depending on decisions, Tomoya can change her to a violent dorm lady through his lecture, which is her original personality, who uses brute force to convince the dorm students to do their cleaning duty.      ~!Misae is waiting for her lover to return, which is actually her cat—Katsuki Shima. When Tomoya tries to pursue Misae, the cat gives Tomoya a dream about Misae's past. When Misae was still in high school, she met a boy named Katsuki Shima who insisted in granting her wish as a payment for encouraging him to recover. Misae's reluctance on having her wish granted and Katsuki's persistency eventually have their feelings for each other develop further, which also made her elected as the student council president due to her rumors with Katsuki. However, Katsuki realizes that his true identity is not Katsuki but his cat, who gave him the duty of granting Misae a wish before dying. Being conflicted with his duty and his love for Misae, he insisted her on having her wish granted. After announcing her wish on having Katsuki forever loving Misae, Katsuki obliged. Katsuki returned to his cat form, and waited for Misae like usual. Noticing the cat's fondness on her, Misae takes the cat as her pet, without knowing the cat's identity as her lover. At the town's festival, Tomoya tells Misae about her cat's true identity. !~

name: Yusuke Yoshino
description: Yusuke is an electrician who once attended Tomoya's high school and lived as a rock musician. He is admired by Mei for his infrequent rock play. Tomoya first met Yusuke during a street light accident involving a person's car, and assists Yusuke in his work. Through Yusuke, he realizes the pain of working in society. Yusuke is engaged to Kouko, and is also one of the reasons why Fuko exists in the school.   Clannad After-Story:  ~! He plays a more prominent role in After Story, giving Tomoya a job as an assistant electrician in his company, and sometimes gives him advice. Due to Tomoya's interest in him, Yusuke tells him of his past - how he became a rock musician, rose in fame, and ended due to his loss of his original motivation, along with stress and drugs. After being rehabilitated, no one wanted him anymore, except for Kouko, who had encouraged him to become a rock musician during his high school days. Throwing away his past, he now works as an electrician. Realizing that there are people who still love his music through Tomoya, Yusuke decides to create another music CD that sings his love for the city.  !~

name: Yukine Miyazawa
description:
Yukine is a second year student who hangs around in the library's reference room during lunchtime. She takes care of many newcomers from other schools who also happen to be delinquents - in particular, people who knew her brother. She's very kind, and avails [Tomoya](https://anilist.co/character/4606) and [Youhei](https://anilist.co/character/4610) an instruction book for magical spells for them to try.

~!Yukine is actually involved deeply with the story relating to the delinquents. Her brother is well known for being a delinquent, and this sometimes gets her into different situations involving the delinquents of the town. It is later revealed, in After Story, that her brother died and nobody knew that other than the group of people that reside on her brother's side. Yukine later helps reunite the members of opposite gangs, and they all end up being friends.!~

name: Mei Sunohara
description: Mei is Youhei's younger sister who loves Youhei as a brother and lives in the countryside. Mei is a smart girl and likes to see new things. She is a fan of Yusuke Yoshino, an older male graduate from Tomoya's school, who is a member of a band. Worried about her brother's situation, she calls Youhei, but instead of her brother, Tomoya disguised as Youhei tells her to come.  Mei's personality is a direct opposite of that of her brother, Youhei. She can be very nosy about things, like trying to further Tomoya's relationship with Nagisa by becoming their cupid angel or learning Youhei's current situation.

name: Botan
description:
Botan is Kyou's pet boar. Despite loving her owner, Botan hates and fears her twin sister Ryou, since she once tried to get her into the bath with her, which she mistook for an attempt of cooking her alive. Botan is well known for her catchphrase "Puhi-Puhi", the sounds that she makes.

(Source: Fandom)

name: Katsuki Shima
description: Katsuki is a boy Misae Sagara met many years ago. She encourages Shima to recover when he is still in his wheelchair. Their meeting leads to the event in Misae's path.  ~!It turns out that he is a cat kept by the real Shima, who asked the cat to grant Misae a wish before dying.!~     Several years ago when he was still in a wheelchair he met Misae in a hospital and was encouraged by her to recover. Eventually he finds her again and wants to thank her by granting her wish.

name: Nazo no Shoujo
description: The only human in the illusionary world, a world Tomoya dreams of. She creates a body out of garbage for an unnamed entity only referred to as, "Me," so that she will not be alone in the illusionary world. She is not created by CGI, everything she does is hand-drawn. (Source: Wikipedia) After Story ~!It is revealed that the girl is [Ushio](https://anilist.co/character/10342/Ushio-Okazaki), Tomoya's daughter in a world with her father after she dies in the real world. !~

name: Garakuta no Ningyou
description:
He has no name and but narrates the situation in the illusionary world seen through Tomoya's dream while referring to himself only as "Me". He has his body created by the girl out of garbage so that he can be with her. The body is about half the girl's height. He can't talk as he is created without a mouth, so relies on body language to communicate with the girl. Unlike most characters in the series, he is created via CGI. (Source: Wikipedia)

~! In After Story, It is revealed that the Garbage Doll is Tomoya in a world after Ushio's death, as well as [the girl](https://anilist.co/character/9193/Girl-from-the-Illusionary-World) being his daughter,  [Ushio](https://anilist.co/character/10342/Ushio-Okazaki). The last we get to see of the Garbage Doll and the girl is when the Imaginary World is supposedly destroyed. !~

name: Naoyuki Okazaki
description: Naoyuki is Tomoya's father. Tomoya's mother Atsuko Okazaki died when Tomoya was young, thus leaving only himself to raise Tomoya. After the accident, Naoyuki turns to alcohol and smoking, and held frequent fights with his son. One day while arguing with his son on trivial things, he slammed Tomoya against the wall, dislocating Tomoya's right shoulder. Immediately after that, Tomoya refused to come out of his room, and by the time he finally went to the hospital, it was declared to be untreatable. Ever since then, his father has treated Tomoya more kindly, but like a stranger rather than family. This only hurt Tomoya even more, so he becomes a delinquent, as he is unable to participate in basketball activities any longer, and he avoided returning to his home early enough to be confronted with his father. Tomoya has the intention of running away from his home, as revealed from Kotomi's path.

name: Kouko Ibuki
description:
Kouko is Fuko's older sister. She used to be an art teacher at Tomoya's school, and she treats everyone kindly. Kouko is one of the familiar faces in the Furukawa Bakery, and Nagisa admires her very much, being her former art teacher. Currently she is engaged with Yusuke Yoshino.  

~!and is the major reason why Fuko still exists in the school, despite still sleeping in the hospital.!~  

In the movie, Kouko was a drama teacher instead of an art teacher. She, along with Youhei and Tomoya helped supervise and revive the drama club for Nagisa.

name: Toshio Koumura
description: Toshio Koumura is a language teacher at Tomoya's school and Tomoya's home room teacher during his first year. His age conceals his once vigorous past marked by his enthusiasm in teaching. He was friends with Kouko Ibuki three years ago.  Five years ago, he was a strict teacher in an engineering school being well known for delinquents. He changed a lot of delinquents in the engineering school for the better, but at Tomoya's school, his skill is not needed due to the prestigious image of the school. He finds Tomoya and Youhei to be odd ones and decides to change them for the better; he is the one who arranged Tomoya and Youhei to meet.  He retires one year later, prior to the end of the school segment of the story. In After Story, he returns and organizes the fake graduating ceremony intended for Nagisa, arranged by Tomoya.

name: Rie Nishina
description: Nishina Rie has played the violin since she was young, she entered a lot of concerts, and had won many competitions. Rie was set to go study overseas, but she was then involved in an accident that weakened her grip and prevented her from playing the violin as well as she used to. Rie was lonely when she entered this school, she almost gave up her life when Koumura confronts her and teaches her chorus. Thus, Rie regained her meaning of her life, and wants to create the choir club.    In Kotomi's path, she lends Kotomi a violin, after Kotomi hears the violin from her. In the After Story, Rie works as a waitress in the same family restaurant as Nagisa.

name: Sugisaka
description: Sugisaka is a member of the chorus club. She tries to force Nagisa to give up on establishing theatre club by threatening her, but later confronts Nagisa directly, telling Rie's past, hoping she will not bother Rie's dream. Youhei does not trust Sugisaka due to her usage of threat letter, and her attempt on messing up Nagisa's shoe cabinet. In the After Story anime, Sugisaka works as a waitress in the same family restaurant as Nagisa.

name: Harada
description:
**Height:** 158cm

Harada appears in the anime as a cameo in The Girl Genius' Challenge. She was with the other members of the Choir Club when [Kotomi](https://anilist.co/character/4602/Kotomi-Ichinose) came in and saw the violin in [Rie](https://anilist.co/character/14833/Rie-Nishina)'s hands. Like everyone else, [Sugisaka](https://anilist.co/character/21507/Sugisaka) covered her ears when [Kotomi](https://anilist.co/character/4602/Kotomi-Ichinose) played and dropped down when she stopped.

(Source: Clannad Wiki)

name: Hitagi Senjougahara
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm

Hitagi, the main female character, is a weak-looking girl with an "incurable disease". She is in the same class as [Koyomi Araragi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi), but he has almost never heard her speak. When she was in the first year of high school, she encountered a mysterious crab, after which she became weightless. Ever since, she has avoided contact with everyone else, threatening everyone who discovers her secret. She called herself a tsundere and always speaks in an abusive style.

~!At the end of Mayoi Snail, she admits that she loves Koyomi, and subsequently enters into a relationship with him.!~

~!After the events in Tsukihi Phoenix, she overcame all of her trauma, and became a rather cheerful and normal girl. She starts calling Araragi with a cute nickname, chuckling at small things and sending e-mails full of Emojis, although her sharp tongue is still there, but toned down.!~

~!Hitagi has told [Hanekawa](https://anilist.co/character/22055/Hanekawa-Tsubasa) that she suffers from an Electra Complex (when a girl has intense sexual attraction towards her father). Whether this was a joke or a sincere admission has remained unrevealed!~

name: Shinobu Oshino
description:
A girl who lives with [Oshino Meme](https://anilist.co/character/22552/Meme-Oshino) in an abandoned building. She loves donuts from the Mister Donut chain. At the beginning of Hitagi Crab, she was renamed "Shinobu" by Meme, who suggested that the name Shinobu (忍), comprised of a heart (心) under a blade (刃), matched her original persona.

~!She appears to be an eight year old girl, but was originally a beautiful vampire who had lived for more than 500 years. After the events of Koyomi Vamp, she was left in a weakened condition with no powers or traces of her original personality, and therefore had to abandon her "Kiss-Shot Acerola-Orion Heart-Under-Blade" name. Prior to being a vampire, she was a princess of unparalleled beauty. She was referred to as "Princess Beauty" or "Acerola" during this time, the latter being her original name. Eventually, she was turned into a vampire by Deathtopia Virtuoso Suicide-Master to save her from the curse of beauty.!~

name: Koyomi Araragi
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm   

A third year high school student who is close to failing every class except math. He is a laid-back person whose only real friend at school is [Tsubasa Hanekawa](https://anilist.co/character/22055/Tsubasa-Hanekawa). Due to events prior to Kizumonogatari and Bakemonogatari, Koyomi avoided having friends and seemed to have lost faith and trust in people and himself.

~!During spring break, he gave [Kiss-Shot](https://anilist.co/character/23602/Shinobu-Oshino) his blood and became a vampire. Although [Meme Oshino](https://anilist.co/character/22552/Meme-Oshino) helped him become human again, there are a few lingering side effects; he can see in the dark and far distances, and he heals faster than the average human. He is still scared of morning sunlight even though it no longer has any effect on him.!~

name: Tsubasa Hanekawa
description:
__Height__: 158 cm

She styles her hair into two braids and ties them with a hair ribbon that has a cat design. She is always seen dressed in the uniform of Naoetsu Private High School, even outside of school days, and is rarely seen on any other type of clothing, except for a set of sleepwear which she wore during Tsubasa Cat Arc.  Hanekawa Tsubasa is [Araragi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi)'s classmate and the class president. Araragi describes her as "the class president of all class presidents". Her catchphrase is "I don’t know everything, I just know what I know". Hanekawa currently lives with her stepfather and stepmother.

Hanekawa Family's Past:  ~!Her biological mother was 17 years old when she got pregnant, the biological father is unknown because she apparently had many lovers. Before she gave birth to Tsubasa, she married another man who was a "workaholic". Right after giving birth, Tsubasa's biological mother commited suicide. The workaholic stepfather, unable to raise a child, remarried again to a woman who is Tsubasa's current mother. The workaholic father soon died from overwork and the current mother married another man who is now Tsubasa's current father. !~  Hanekawa Story's overview in Nekomonogatari/Bakemonogatari:  

~!Prior to the beginning of Bakemonogatari, Hanekawa was possessed by the mischievous spirit of a dead cat during Golden Week due to stress over her family. The matter was eventually resolved with the help of Shinobu at the cost of some of Hanekawa's memories, but the problem emerged again right before the school festival because of different stress. Araragi was told by Hanekawa's bakeneko form that she has feelings for him.  In 'Tsubasa Tiger' (Nekomonogatari: Shiro), on her way to school, she met a tiger spirit which spoke to her. Soon buildings important to Hanekawa began to mysteriously burn down and 'Black Hanekawa' (her bakeneko form) began to take over her body every time she slept. The inevitable showdown was afoot and led to some surprising events.  'Tsubasa Tiger' is written from the perspective of Hanekawa rather than Araragi.!~

name: Deishuu Kaiki
description: The white swindler who once deceived [Hitagi](https://anilist.co/character/22037/Hitagi-Senjougahara) and the cause of [Nadeko](https://anilist.co/character/22050/Nadeko-Sengoku)'s curse. Kaiki is a capable conman, able to deceive multiple people to get the results he wants, usually being money. On one occassion, he has used the alias 'Suzuki'. Though he appears to be a deceitful man, Kaiki has tried to help others occasionally. In Nisemonogatari, ~!it is revealed that he was a university student alongside [Yozuru](https://anilist.co/character/57501) and [Meme](https://anilist.co/character/22552). Back in his college days, he had a crush on [Tooe Gaen](https://anilist.co/character/137496/Tooe-Gaen), so he now watches over her daughter [Kanbaru](https://anilist.co/character/22054/Suruga-Kanbaru) out of respect.!~ He is the narrator of Koimonogatari.

name: Nadeko Sengoku
description:
__Height:__ 153 cm 

Nadeko, the main character of Nadeko Snake, is [Tsukihi](https://anilist.co/character/24195/Tsukihi-Araragi)’s friend back in elementary school. She always wears a waist pouch, always casts her eyes downward, has her bangs covering her eyes, has a shy personality, and can be easily amused. [Koyomi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi) played with her a lot whenever she visited his house after being invited by his sisters. She refers to Koyomi as Koyomi onii-chan and appears to have feelings for him.   ~!She was cursed two times by a classmate who liked the boy she rejected, and the rejected boy. While the first one is banished, Koyomi is forced to battle the second to keep it from killing Nadeko.!~ She's quite protective of her hair (particularly her forelocks) thinking that it's her place to guard more than her panties. When she finally combed her forelocks aside in Nisemonogatari, Koyomi commented that she has a glare just like a serpent, probably foreshadowing the story of Nadeko Medusa.

In Nademonogatari, ~!Nadeko gains a power to draw, create, and then materialize shikigami, making her useful in the eyes of [Izuko Gaen](https://anilist.co/character/87115/Izuko-Gaen) and gets offered a job, thanks to [Yotsugi Ononoki](https://anilist.co/character/57499/Yotsugi-Ononoki)!~

name: Mayoi Hachikuji
description: Mayoi is a fifth-grade elementary school girl. She always carries a big backpack, wears a hairband, and sports ponytails.    ~!Ten years ago she was involved in a traffic accident and died because of it. After that she became a ghost and considers herself a "lost snail". She will unwillingly cause the people around her to become lost and unable to find their way home. The only people who can see her are people who don't want to go home in the first place. However, after [Araragi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi) and [Senjougahara](https://anilist.co/character/22037/Hitagi-Senjougahara) help her find the home she was looking for, she changed from an "earthbound spirit" to a "wandering spirit", a fact that she considers to be a bonus, as well as granting her to be free to wander wherever she desires. At the end of Nisemonogatari, she said goodbye to Koyomi, implying that she will not be seeing him again, which will be the basis of the next story, Mayoi Jiangshi. Her family name before her parents got divorced was Tsunade.!~

name: Ougi Oshino
description:
Ougi appears to be a girl with short black hair, black pupils, and pale white skin. She is a junior of [Koyomi Araragi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi) at Naoetsu Private High School. Ougi often talks to Koyomi about oddities, and helping him remember what he knows. Her catchphrase is, "I don't know anything, Araragi-senpai. It's you who knows."

Ougi is mysterious and can come off as spooky/creepy. She also speaks in a condescending tone towards Koyomi and [Hanekawa](https://anilist.co/character/22055/Tsubasa-Hanekawa). Furthermore, Ougi is capable of pulling off many things, despite what she says about what she knows.

~!As of Hanamonogatari and afterwards, chronologically, Ougi refers to himself as a boy. Others will question Ougi's identity when they first meet him as they knew him as a girl before, but they all shrug it off and seem to doubt themselves as to whether he was a girl before. An example being when [Suruga](https://anilist.co/character/22054/Suruga-Kanbaru) asks about it and was told that he has always been a boy since he was born. [Nadeko](https://anilist.co/character/22050/Nadeko-Sengoku) and Koyomi have also have a similar experience. Suruga herself refers to him as 'Ougi-kun', 'he', 'this guy', and 'the boy'. As of Musubi, Ougi seems to be a girl once again, now remaining in the classroom seen in Ougi Formula.!~ ~!The reasons for this seems to be due to Ougi connecting to Suruga after Koyomi graduates, therefore becoming her other side. Thus, Ougi becomes a boy and seems to pretend its the first time he meets everyone afterwards. After Suruga herself graduates, it's likely that Ougi no longer has anyone to connect to and becomes a girl that guides others in the odd classroom.!~

name: Suruga Kanbaru
description:
Suruga, the main character of Suruga Monkey, is [Koyomi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi)'s underclassman, ace of the school's basketball team and one of [Hitagi](https://anilist.co/character/22037/Hitagi-Senjougahara)'s acquaintances from back in junior high school. Immediately after she entered senior high school, she became aware of Hitagi's secret and was threatened by her, just like Koyomi was. She's an admitted lesbian, fujoshi, lolicon and masochist. 

~!Back in elementary school, she inherited what she thought was a Monkey's Paw but was actually a Rainy Devil from her mother. She started stalking Koyomi after she discovered he was dating Hitagi. She becomes friends with Koyomi and Hitagi after Koyomi rids her of the Rainy Devil.!~ She also has been growing her hair longer since. Her next story was revealed to be Suruga Devil.

name: Yotsugi Ononoki
description:
**Occupation:** Oddity Specialist

Yotsugi Ononoki is an expressionless human corpse tsukumogami and the shikigami familiar of [Yozuru Kagenui](https://anilist.co/character/57501/).

Despite appearing almost entirely stoic, she still has hinted at feeling genuine emotion. She's mentioned how she considers [Koyomi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/) her friend on multiple occasions, such as when giving him advice "as a friend" as opposed to as an oddity specialist. She's also expressed how she wouldn't want to have to harm him despite needing to follow orders as a shikigami.

She has an ability called Unlimited Rulebook which allows her finger to shape-shift and cause explosions. She also seems to have a type of super strength, being able to to carry Kagenui and others using only one finger.

She also has an appreciation for muscles.

(Source: Monogatari Fandom)

name: Meme Oshino
description: Meme is a middle-aged man who lives in an abandoned building. Being an expert in apparitions field, he solves [Koyomi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi) and others' problems. Although he sometimes expects compensation, he does not require it always and seems to help those in need from good nature. Due to his vast knowledge of supernatural studies and general oddities, he serves as Araragi's informant during his stay in the city. Meme is a graduate of Shinto studies in college, although he never pursued the career of being a Shinto priest. Despite that, he is perfectly capable to accomplish spiritual works of a Shinto priest, such as exorcising entities and solving paranormal mysteries. He occasionally wears a Priest's outfit, as seen with the session with [Senjougahara](https://anilist.co/character/22037/Hitagi-Senjougahara) and the heavy crab. Meme's other notable accessories include an earring on his right ear and a necklace, both consisting of an inverted cross.

name: Karen Araragi
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm 
 
Karen, the main character of Karen Bee, is one of [Koyomi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi)'s sisters. She is older than [Tsukihi](https://anilist.co/character/24195/Tsukihi-Araragi) and always doing outdoor activities. Despite being younger, Karen is taller than Koyomi, much to Koyomi's dismay.    

~!In Karen Bee, her hot-headed personality and her habit of acting before thinking lead her to be stung by a bee which leads to being poisoned with a terrible fever that lasted for 3 days. Like [Hitagi](https://anilist.co/character/22037/Hitagi-Senjougahara), she refused any help from anyone which eventually leads to her and Koyomi fighting each other. Later it was revealed that it was set up by [Kaiki](https://anilist.co/character/53641/Deishuu-Kaiki). Karen and Tsukihi are nicknamed Tsuga no Ki Nichū no Fire Sisters (栂の木二中のファイヤーシスターズ, lit. Fire Sisters of Tsuga no Ki 2nd Junior High). It was revealed that the reason she and Tsukihi found boyfriends was so that Koyomi would become jealous. They found boyfriends in Koyomi's image with Karen's boyfriend being shorter than her. She and Tsukihi also thought that Koyomi's girlfriend was [Tsubasa](https://anilist.co/character/22055/Tsubasa-Hanekawa). Koyomi, Karen and Tsukihi's parents were revealed to be police officers. !~

name: Tsukihi Araragi
description:
__Height:__ 156 cm   

Tsukihi, the main character of Tsukihi Phoenix, is one of [Koyomi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi)'s sisters. She's the youngest of Araragi family. Unlike her sister, [Karen](https://anilist.co/character/24194/Karen-Araragi), she is always doing indoor activities. Contrary to her personality, she constantly changes her hair style and is short-tempered to the point that Koyomi describes her as having hysteria.    ~!She is actually the reincarnation of a phoenix and has been since before she was even born. The phoenix entered the baby's body when it was still in the womb and by now both beings' minds have become one. She is immortal and the only thing that end her life is a natural death from old age. It was hinted that [Kaiki](https://anilist.co/character/53641/Deishuu-Kaiki) was the one who sent [Kagenui](https://anilist.co/character/57501/Yozuru-Kagenui) and [Ononoki](https://anilist.co/character/57499/Yotsugi-Ononoki) to go after Tsukihi. Tsukihi and Karen are nicknamed Tsuga no Ki Nichū no Fire Sisters (栂の木二中のファイヤーシスターズ). It was revealed that the reason she and Karen found boyfriends was so that Koyomi would become jealous. They found boyfriends in Koyomi's image with Tsukihi's boyfriend being taller than her. She and Karen also thought that Koyomi's girlfriend was [Tsubasa](https://anilist.co/character/22055/Tsubasa-Hanekawa). Koyomi, Karen and Tsukihi's parents were revealed to be police officers. !~

name: Izuko Gaen
description:
She is a young-looking woman who wears clothes that are too large for her. Izuko often boasts about her knowledge, coming off as somewhat arrogant. She claims to know everything, to the degree where she can predict the future; as a result, she likes to brag about this with her catchphrase, "There is nothing I don't know, I know everything." Izuko is also the younger sister of [Tooe Gaen](https://anilist.co/character/137496/Gaen-Tooe).

When others get help from her, she wishes for something in return; usually ending up with them doing her a favour.

~!She was the senpai of [Oshino](https://anilist.co/character/22552/Oshino-Meme), [Kaiki](https://anilist.co/character/53641/Kaiki-Deishuu) and [Yozuru](https://anilist.co/character/57501/Kagenui-Yozuru) in their university years.!~

~!It is implied that, while creating [Yotsugi](https://anilist.co/character/57499/Ononoki-Yotsugi), Izuko was cursed with knowledge.!~

name: Yozuru Kagenui
description: Yozuru was first introduced in Tsukihi Phoenix. She is an onmyouji and one of [Meme](https://anilist.co/character/22552/Meme-Oshino)'s clubmates at the university. As a rule she imposed on herself, she's not allowed to step on the ground. Between the three kouhai during university she was the only one who graduated. She fights by using her fists and is powerful enough to punch through multiple floors at once.

name: Episode
description:
A young vampire hunter who wields a giant cross as a weapon. He stole [Kiss-Shot](https://anilist.co/character/23602/Oshino-Shinobu)'s left leg. Despite his physical appearance, he's only 6 years old. Episode often says, "Gotta love it," or, "That's hilarious," as a catchphrase. He has an aggressive and arrogant personality, and has a tendency to get carried away when fighting.

~!Episode is a half-vampire, he doesn't belong to humans or vampires; due to this, he is spiteful towards both sides.!~

name: Senjougahara no Chichi
description: The father of [Hitagi Senjougahara](https://anilist.co/character/22037/Senjougahara-Hitagi). He is often working due to being in debt after he and Hitagi's mother split. Upon noticing that Hitagi is more cheerful after being with [Koyomi Araragi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Araragi-Koyomi), he is happy that she is able to enjoy herself once again and thankful for Koyomi.

name: Kuchinawa
description: The giant apparition snake whose voice Nadeko hears.

name: Araragi no Haha
description: The mother of Koyomi, Karen, and Tsukihi. She, along with her husband, have been cops for many years.

name: Kako
description: One of the many tiger aberrations, though like no other. The Kako will burn buildings down, and only wishes for things to burn. The tiger even has a catchphrase, "I don't know everything, but everything burns." ~!The Kako was created by Hanekawa unconsciously and is the manifestation of her envy. She later absorbs it and accepts her envy.!~

name: Sunshi Sajou
description: A boy inflicted by the Jagirinawa via a reverse curse. It is implied that he is the boy that loved Sengoku Nadeko and originally inflicted her with one of the two Jagirinawa that binded her. After Nadeko was saved, one Jagirinawa escaped which found its way back to the boy. ~!The boy is told about Deishuu Kaiki's presence in town by Oshino Ougi. Once learning where Kaiki is going to be, he brutally attacks Kaiki with a metal rod or pipe as revenge for purchasing the curse from him in a prior scams.!~

name: Untenshu
description: A cab driver who transports Deishuu Kaiki out of town and asks what he thinks of the city in episode 23.

name: Mayoi no Chichi
description: The father of Hachikuji Mayoi. After he and Hachikuji's mother got divorced, he would not let Hachikuji see her. After Mayoi ran away to see her mother, he searches for her. ~!In Kabuki, when he finds Koyomi Araragi and Shinobu Oshino outside of his house, he asks if they've seen Hachikuji. It's assumed that Hachikuji is allowed to see her mother after running away in Route X.!~

name: Nadeko no Haha
description: The mother of Sengoku Nadeko. Not much is known about her, though Deishuu Kaiki states that she doesn't know much about her daughter. On top of that, she likely forces expectations on Sengoku, such as being cute.

name: Tsunade
description:
The mother of Hachikuji Mayoi. Initially, she and Hachikuji's father had true love for each other, though it later died out when they got married, resulting in a short lived marriage. They remained other the same roof for a year until she left, but had to agree to never seeing Hachikuji again. 

Later, Hachikuji runs away on Mothers Day to see her mother once again, but unfortunately fails after the tragic accident. After the accident, her mother moves away, resulting in an empty plot of land where her residence was. ~!In Kabuki, Hachikuji does meet her mother again and the two have a heartfelt reunion.!~

name: Shouko Nishimiya
description: A young, deaf transfer student with an amazingly positive outlook on life. Despite being a victim of continuous bullying, she always keeps a smile on her face.

name: Shouya Ishida
description:
__Height:__ 183 cm

The main character and narrator. Ishida bullied [Nishimiya Shouko](https://anilist.co/character/80243) in elementary school and when she transferred away, he was ostracized and bullied by his former friends. He started to ignore those around him (imagining them with a large X across their face) and was driven to the point of suicide. He changed his mind after he apologized to Nishimiya and began to spend time with her. He learned sign language specifically so he could apologize to her and is shown to be very talented in it. He feels like he hasn't been punished enough for bullying Nishimiya and often wishes he could kill his younger self. He seems resigned to the fact that he will never be able to have friends again.

name: Naoka Ueno
description: A girl from [Ishida](https://anilist.co/character/80491/Ishida-Shouya) and [Nishimiya](https://anilist.co/character/80243/Nishimiya-Shouko)'s elementary school and the girl that Ishida was closest to at school. Ishida remembers her bossing him about and also being his main helper in bullying Nishimiya. After having separated from him since middle school graduation, Ueno runs into Ishida years later, herself now working in a cat café.

name: Yuzuru Nishimiya
description: [Shouko](https://anilist.co/character/80243/Nishimiya-Shouko)'s younger sister who is currently a middle school student. She cut her hair short so their [mother](https://anilist.co/character/124037/Nishimiya-Yaeko) would not cut Shouko's and has kept it that way ever since; due to this, she is often mistaken for a boy, with [Ishida](https://anilist.co/character/80491/Ishida-Shouya) even thinking that she is Shouko's boyfriend at first.

name: Tomohiro Nagatsuka
description: A short, fat, and lonely boy who is a habitual liar. When someone tries to steal Nagatsuka's bike, Ishida offers his to be taken instead. Nagatsuka sees this act of kindness as an unbreakable act of friendship and swiftly becomes Ishida's self-proclaimed best friend and starts to idolize Ishida. He is shown to be quite obsessive and protective of Ishida and often dislikes him befriending other people. However, Nagatsuka is also supportive of Ishida and often offers advice. He has plans to become a millionaire, so is willing to hand out money to friends and is keen to become a film director—entering himself and Ishida into a film competition. It is shown both Ueno and Kawai find Nagatsuka repulsive, while Ishida is uncomfortable that Nagatsuka is so willing to take his side when he knows so little about him. Though his film proves to be a failure, this only made Nagatsuka resolved to take up film studies as his college subject.

name: Miyako Ishida
description:
A kind and loving single mother of Shouya and his older sister who owns a hair salon. She cares for her granddaughter Maria as well as Ishida and often lets Yuzuru stay around the house. She became disappointed upon learning that Ishida bullied Nishimiya and had to pay 1.7 million yen for all the hearing aids Ishida broke.

~!When Ishida pays her back with the intention of killing himself afterwards, she reveals that she had been aware of his plans and threatens to burn the money if he tries to kill himself again—leaving her with nothing. Unfortunately, she accidentally burns the money anyway.

After Ishida ends up in a coma, she becomes awkward around Nishimiya, despite trying to remain polite.!~

name: Maria Ishida
description:
[Ishida](https://anilist.co/character/80491/Ishida-Shouya)'s young niece who lives with Ishida and his family. Maria is half-Japanese from her mother's side and half-Brazilian from her father's side.

~!She gains a constant wonder about the difference between things that are dead and alive after Ishida's fall and fearing he might be dead, Yuzuru takes it upon herself to teach her the difference—being an expert on the matter.!~

name: Miyoko Sahara
description:
A kind girl from Ishida and Nishimiya's elementary school. She was the only person willing to make an effort to learn sign language and befriend Nishimiya.

~!Sadly, this singled her out for bullying too, and started to take all her classes in the nurse's office. Ishida finds Sahara several years later so she can reconnect with Nishimiya, and she becomes her friend again. She was always and is still bullied by Ueno for her unorthodox sense of fashion, however, the two remain close even after they separated and Sahara boldly claims they are now best friends. Sahara has grown very tall during the time-skip and due to her high heel boots appears even taller. After Ishida, Sahara spends the most time with the Nishimiya family; however, their relationship is briefly strained when Ishida decides to cut off all ties with his friends by insulting them, claiming that Sahara is always the first to run away from a problem. Sahara later texts Ishida asking how he could prove that he has grown up; this motivates him to risk his life-saving Nishimiya during her attempted suicide. Fed up with Ueno always blaming Nishimiya for everything, she chooses to take Nishimiya's side and defends her from being attacked by Ueno during Ishida's hospitalization. After graduating from high school, Sahara goes to Tokyo to become a runway model, bringing an unwilling Ueno with her.!~

name: Yaeko Nishimiya
description:
A cold woman, who after catching a virus from her husband during pregnancy, left Shouko deaf. Yaeko's husband's family quickly filed for a divorce. When her husband left, she was pregnant with Yuzuru and her mother helped her raise both her daughters. 
~!Eventually, she left her mother to care for the children permanently while she works—causing problems in her relationship with Yuzuru—not helped by the fact Yuzuru frequently skips school to take photos of dead animals. She made Shouko stay at the elementary school where she was bullied for so long in the hopes it would toughen her up and prepare her for how people would treat her. She planned to cut Shouko's hair like a boy to make her look tougher, but Yuzuru cut her own hair instead in protest. She hates Shouya and feels he can never atone for the happy school years he stole from her daughter. Upon seeing him again years after he left school, she slaps him; however, after her mother's death, she begins to warm up to Ishida and thanks him for being Yuzuru's friend.!~

name: Takeuchi
description:
Takeuchi-sensei was the homeroom teacher of Shouya, Shouko, Naoka, Shimada, Hirose, Miki, and Miyoko during their 6th-grade year.

~!While he was disappointed in Ishida for bullying Nishimiya, he still laughed at the jokes made about her, and once Nishimiya left, he prompted the class to turn Ishida into a scapegoat for all their bullying. He refused to believe Ishida when he claimed he was being bullied too. Years later, Ishida runs into Takeuchi again when looking for locations for the film. Takeuchi says that Ishida has grown into a fine young man and all the bad things in his past have changed Ishida for the better. Mashiba dislikes how Takeuchi talks about Nishimiya and throws his drink into Takeuchi's face, costing them the chance to film at the school, though with Ishida's later hospitalization and Mashiba's apology to him, Takeuchi allows them to shoot anyway.!~

name: Satoshi Mashiba
description:
A boy who becomes interested in and joins Ishida's group of friends upon learning they are making a movie. He is eager to be the leading actor and is considered handsome and talented enough to do so. Mashiba was lonely as a child and the other children took him for granted and bullied him, now he is completely intolerant of bullies in any form, and while generally calm and level-headed, he reacts violently to any random act of bullying he sees.

~!He is oblivious to Kawai's crush on him until Ishida points it out. It is later revealed that Mashiba befriends Ishida because of his social awkwardness and never being able to fit in at school despite trying to; by hanging out with Ishida—believing him to be even stranger than he is—he would appear normal. However, this only makes him feel that he should be the least important in the group. Thus, when Ishida asks Mashiba to hit him after the former reveals his bullying records, he calmly does so. Mashiba is the first to reconcile with Ishida upon his release from the hospital and later studies to become a teacher after graduation.!~

name: Kazuki Shimada
description:
Ishida's best friend in elementary school. He helped him bully Nishimiya.

~!When Nishimiya moved away, Shimada placed all the blame on Ishida and soon became the ringleader of the people bullying Ishida: frequently stealing his shoes, beating him up, and writing threats and cruel things on his desk in chalk every morning. Ueno wants Ishida and Shimada to be friends again and gets Ishida to the amusement park where Shimada is now working, but Ishida storms away, deciding he does not care about Shimada and does not want to be his friend again. It is revealed that when Ishida falls while saving Nishimiya, Shimada sees him and saves him from the river; however, Ishida never learns this because he is unconscious at that time and Shimada asks Nishimiya, who witnesses the event, not to tell him about it.!~

name: Ito Nishimiya
description:
Shouko and Yuzuru's maternal grandmother. A caring, wise woman, she cared for Nishimiya and Yuzuru when their father left and their mother was at work. She bought Yuzuru her first camera and tries to convince Yuzuru that her mother means well for both her and her sister.

~!Ito dies of old age and leaves a letter that Yuzuru asks Ishida to read at the funeral. The letter tries one last time to convince Yuzuru to forgive her mother, but she grows angry and does not hear the end of it.!~

name: Miki Kawai
description:
Nicknamed "Kawaiichi," Kawai was the school representative at Ishida's elementary school. She is popular and normally takes charge of situations and is shown to be kind to everyone; however, all her actions seem to have her academic reputation in mind. Kawai is also a narcissist who believes that everyone should love her, as well as wants to be the victim in every problem she faces.

~!Though she never actually insulted Nishimiya, Kawai did nothing to intervene and even laughed alongside her friends, making her also responsible for Nishimiya's transfer. Kawai's accusation of Ishida being a bully is a catalyst to his isolation among his classmates. Kawai becomes Ishida's classmate again in high school and takes part in Nagatsuka's film shooting, bringing Mashiba, whom she has a crush on, in tow. It is revealed that Kawai has always been scared of Ishida and accuses him of not wanting to face the truth, again a catalyst to his falling out with his film crew. Later, when she tells the class that they will make paper cranes as a wish of recovery for Ishida, who is hospitalized after saving Nishimiya, her classmates are disgusted and secretly bully her. Having to experience the feeling of getting bullied for the first time, Kawai resolves to become more empathetic with others. At the end of the series, Kawai presents Ishida with the paper cranes made by their classmates and follows Mashiba to study to become a teacher.!~

name: Pedro
description: Maria's Brazilian father.

name: Ishida no Ane
description: Ishida's older sister. She is significantly older than him as she already graduated from college when he was still in elementary school. Curiously, she is the only character with lines whose face is never seen. According to Shouya, his sister had dated numerous men, one of whom has a younger brother who was bullied by Shouya. Later, she dated a Brazilian man named Pedro; this time, her relationship stuck, and she had a daughter, Maria, with him.

name: Keisuke Hirose
description:
Keisuke was Shouya Ishida's friend in elementary school. Although he did bully Shouko Nishimiya, he wasn't a huge participant and usually seemed uncomfortable picking on her. However, he was more than happy bullying Shouya later on.

~!Keisuke stayed close with Kazuki after graduation and along with him brings Shouya from the river after he falls down after saving Shouko.!~

name: Kita
description: Ishida's music teacher in elementary school. As Sahara was among the students, Kita was the only one among the teachers who was willing to get along with Nishimiya despite her deafness. She attempted to make the class learn sign language for Nishimiya's sake, but her proposal was rejected because she herself did not know about it. Later, Kita also included Nishimiya to take part in the school choir, but despite trying hard to teach her, Nishimiya ended up ruining the song and made the school lose the choir competition.

name: Inori Yuitsuka
description: A 5th grade elementary student who loves figure skating so much she used to practice it in secret. Though she greatly lacks academic skill, when she's in the rink she's like a different person.

name: Tsukasa Akeuraji
description: He is a former ice dancer and now the coach of [Inori Yuitsuka](https://anilist.co/character/197151/Inori-Yuitsuka).

name: Hikaru Kamisaki
description: An orphan who was picked up by [Jun Yodaka](https://anilist.co/character/197164/Jun-Yodaka) and currently lives with [Rioh Sonidori](https://anilist.co/character/197158/Riou-Sonidori) and his mother. She is [Inori's](https://anilist.co/character/197151/Inori-Yuitsuka) rival who she promised with that they would compete against each other in the All-Japans.

name: Iruka Okazaki
description:
__Height:__ 161 cm

Iruka Okazaki is a figure skating athlete who accompanied [Riina Kojou](https://anilist.co/character/382022/Kojou-Riina) who helped host the opening ceremony of the Chuubu Block Tournament. She is also an A Class Star Skater who goes to Kankyou University High School.

~!Iruka acts coldly towards [Inori](https://anilist.co/character/197151/Yuitsuka-Inori), but secretly has quite a soft spot for her.!~

name: Jun Yodaka
description: The coach of [Hikaru Kamisaki](https://anilist.co/character/197152/Kamisaki-Hikaru). He took Hikaru in as his skating disciple from a far away snowy land, but left the task of caring for her other needs to the Sonidori family.

name: Ryouka Miketa
description: One of [Inori's](https://anilist.co/character/197151/Inori-Yuitsuka) rivals. She is a 3rd grade girl in the Preliminary skating category with Inori. She looks up to "girlish" things and believes cats are the cutest things in the universe.

name: Riou Sonidori
description: Riou is a 5th grade elementary school student and member of Meikou Wind FSC. Son of Olympic silver medalist [Shinichirou Sonidori.](https://anilist.co/character/197159/Shinichirou-Sonidori)

name: Ema Yamato
description: Ema is a 4th grade elementary school student affiliated with Rengecha FSC. She was born in Kyoto and is long time friends with [Suzu.](https://anilist.co/character/209212/Suzu-Kamoto) Her cheeks are always red, and she is well behaved but not afraid to say what's on her mind. She is a hard worker who believes in actions over words. She is an only child and her tall height for her age makes her a motherly figure among her classmates. She doesn't dislike it, but she also likes Suzu treating her like a little sister.

name: Suzu Kamoto
description: Suzu is an elementary school student affiliated with Rengecha FSC. She won the silver medal in the All-Japan Novice B competition. She is the youngest of 4 sisters who have doted on her like a doll since a young age, causing her obsession with cuteness. She has an anti-aging plan for remaining cute, and constantly thinks about the philosophy of cuteness. If someone doesn't call her cute she will massage their face into a "Suzu face" and talk about the philosophy of cuteness for hours on end. She's hard on people who are hard on themselves and has cast-iron mental strength.

name: You Kago
description: You is the daughter of the Kago family who supported [Tsukasa's](https://anilist.co/character/197163/Tsukasa-Akeuraji) skating career.

name: Yuudai Jakuzure
description: [Ema Yamato](https://anilist.co/character/209214/Ema-Yamato)'s coach. He is a former mens' singles who was strong enough to participate in the free skate in several national events before his retirement. He was born in Osaka and in his junior years, he won several tournaments in the Kansai block. He is a free-wheeling man, when he encounters a problem, he prefers to take it slow and formulate a plan instead of using guts and attitude to tackle it. As a coach, he attempts to dress as close to an elementary school teacher as possible around his students.

name: Mamoru Sekoma
description: Receptionist at a local skating rink.

name: Hitomi Takamine
description: [Tsukasa's](https://anilist.co/character/197163/Tsukasa-Akeuraji) former Ice dance partner and a current skating coach at Lux Toyama FSC.

name: Yuuna Yagi
description: Yuuna is the 3rd best skater at Meikoh Wind FSC and is [Shinichirou Sonidori's](https://anilist.co/character/197159/Shinichirou-Sonidori) primary student. She joined the club after seeing his Olympic performance and has a secret crush on him. Before events, she mentally builds herself up while sitting alone with a puppet.

name: Mario Nachi
description: [Ryouka Miketa](https://anilist.co/character/197157/Ryouka-Miketa)'s coach. She's lively with lots of piercings, with her bold personality fading into bashfulness around people she doesn't know. She was formerly ranked in Japan's top 12 skaters for her high jumps, but she currently only has one student as a coach.

name: Shinichirou Sonidori
description: Head coach at Meikou Wind FSC and father of [Riou Sonidori](https://anilist.co/character/197158/Riou-Sonidori).

name: Mika Yuitsuka
description: [Inori's](https://anilist.co/character/197151/Inori-Yuitsuka) older sister. She used to be a figure skater but quit due to an injury.

name: Ritsuki Koguma
description: Ritsuka is a skater from Okayama who competed in a Level 1 meet against [Inori.](https://anilist.co/character/197151/Inori-Yuitsuka)

name: Kakeru Uobuchi
description: Kakeru is a jump obsessed maniac since his days as a professional athlete, he taught himself a quadruple lutz with no outside instruction. He is like a "cheat code" as a coach, helping skaters pull off any jump they request, but he goes around to all the clubs so will also power up skaters' rivals. He loves helping skaters pull off jumps for him in person and is a great fan of [Shinichirou Sonidori's](https://anilist.co/character/197159/Shinichirou-Sonidori) jumping.

name: Riley Fox
description:
__Height:__ 163 cm

A former Team USA skater and Olympic gold medalist, she is now the head coach of her own club Starfox FSC.

name: Maomao
description:
Maomao works as an apothecary in the red light district, helping her mentor and father [Luomen](https://anilist.co/character/261968) in caring for its residents, with special attention given to the Verdigris Hall brothel, where she was born and was initially raised.

One day, while gathering herbs, she gets kidnapped and sold to be a common servant in the inner court of the imperial palace, where only the Emperor's consorts and their servants reside. Not allowed to leave, her curious personality and skills begin to rope her into mysterious problems that can affect the whole country.

~! It was later revealed that Loumen was actually her adoptive father. Her biological father is [Lakan](https://anilist.co/character/232926), the tactician in the Li military. Loumen is actually Maomao's biological great-uncle. Her biological mother is [Fengxian](https://anilist.co/character/274191), who was a high ranking courtesan at the Verdigris House. !~

name: Jinshi
description: Jinshi is the eunuch in charge of the affairs of the inner palace. He is described as having a face capable even of outshining the consorts in beauty, amazing women and men alike. He is constantly accompanied by his attendant [Gaoshun](https://anilist.co/character/244317/Gaoshun) and has taken an interest to [Maomao](https://anilist.co/character/126824/Maomao)'s intelligence and active demeanor.

name: Narrator
description:
This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. 

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

name: Rouran
description: The (new) Pure consort, residing in the Garnet Palace within the inner court. She makes a big show of her exorbitant and ever changing clothing, jewellery and make up. Despite that, she doesn't talk any more than she needs to, keeping her distance.

name: Gyokuyou
description:
The Noble consort, residing in the Jade Palace within the inner court. Her red hair and green eyes distinguish her from the other consorts, that being part of the reasons she became the Emperor's favoured consort, having already given birth to a girl of his. Despite these circumstances, she is very careful of whom she keeps around so she has the smallest retinue of all the high consorts.

~! Later on, she gives birth to a boy, the new heir to the crown, thus becoming the Empress. !~

name: Gaoshun
description: Gaoshun is [Jinshi](https://anilist.co/character/127278/Jinshi)'s attendant. He's shown to be extremely dependable. A stern believer in deference to authority and proper etiquette, his disapproval is often splattered in his transparent facial expressions, even if he says nothing.

name: Rifa
description: The Able consort, residing in the Crystal Palace within the inner court. The second most favoured consort of the Emperor, said to be so in big part due to her voluptuous chest. She gave birth to a boy who succumbed for unknown reasons and she herself is in grave health condition at the start of the story.

name: Lakan
description:
Lakan is a renowned strategist known for his nonchalant disregard of proper manners. His plotting ability causes fear even in the Emperor himself. He sees people's faces as a piece of shogi representing their worth, with a few exceptions like the woman he loved and his daughter. Currently heads the La clan.

~!He is [Maomao](https://anilist.co/character/126824/Maomao)'s biological father and the nephew of [Luomen](https://anilist.co/character/261968/Ruomen)!~

name: Aaduo
description:
The Pure consort, residing in the Garner Palace within the inner court. She was the current Emperor's milk sibling and childhood crush, being just a year older than him. She became the previous Emperor's consort and gave birth to his child at 18, who was stillborn. The ordeal made her infertile, but circumstances between her and the royal family allowed her to keep her position as a High Consort.

She is very spartan on the outside yet has a motherly side to her.

~!She is Jinshi's real mother!~

name: Xiaolan
description: Xiaolan is a servant in the inner court of the palace. Carefree and easy to please, she looks at her sale to the inner palace as a good thing, since at least she now has proper bedding and meals. She loves gossiping and constantly serves as a source of possibilities for Maomao to brainstorm over.

name: Lihaku
description: Lihaku is a military officer, residing in the outer court of the palace. He's strong and honest, but not exactly brilliant.

name: Pairin
description: Pairin is the oldest of the Three Princesses of Verdigris Hall. She loves men's bodies and dreams of being taken away by a muscular prince.

name: Riishu
description: The Virtuous consort, residing in the Diamond Palace within the inner court. She was sent to be a high consort on the inner court as a young child because her prominent family was aware of the previous Emperor's pedophilic tendencies. When he died, she was allowed to leave as she was never visited by him, but her family arranged for her to return to her high consort position. Due to how young she is, she doesn't get any interest from the current Emperor, commands no respect, nor does she have any influence. She's very naive and gets bullied even by her own attendants.

name: Meimei
description: Meimei is one of the Three Princesses of Verdigris Hall. She started as Fenshen's apprentice and, being somewhat cunning herself, inherited Fenshen's taste for strategy board games. She is the most attached to the brothel and the people within.

name: Ruomen
description: Ruomen is a physician of the Inner Court, a physician in the red-light district, and Maomao's father.

name: Suirei
description: Suirei is a court lady, doing menial tasks in the outer court.

name: Joka
description: Joka is the youngest of the Three Princesses of Verdigris Hall and one of Maomao's adopted sisters.

name: Fenshen
description:
Fenshen used to be a high ranking courtesan in Verdigris Hall. With a flinty and hard personality, she was unmatched at strategy board games. She fell in love with a man who could challenge her at those, but was later abandoned after bedding him.

~!Her mental condition degraded heavily and she mistreated her baby to the point the other courtesans took Maomao to raise her themselves. Ultimately she contracted syphilis and got bedridden in a backroom of Verdigris.!~

name: Hongniang
description: Lady Gyokuyou's head lady-in-waiting.

name: Yarite Baba
description: Once a high ranking courtesan herself, the Madam is now the runner of the Vergidris Hall.

name: Fuyou
description: A mid-rank consort, princess of a distant land. She became the Emperor's middle consort against her will.

name: Koutei
description: The current Emperor fulfills the role expected of him. He is hated by his mother, the Empress dowager, for being the product of her rape. His most trustworthy relationship is with his brother, who manages small things behind the scenes for him.

name: Lingli
description: Lingli is the baby of high consort Gyokuyou. She's the first child of the current Emperor to survive. She's nicknamed Xiaoling by her mother, meaning Little Bell.

name: Luffy Monkey
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm
__Affiliations:__ ~!Straw Hat Pirates (Captain); Four Emperors!~ 
__Devil Fruit:__ Gomu Gomu no Mi (Rubber-Rubber Fruit) 
__Devil Fruit Type:__ Paramecia
~!__True Devil Fruit:__ Hito Hito no Mi Model: Nika (Human-Human Fruit)
__True Devil Fruit Type:__ Mythical Zoan!~
__Bounty:__ ~!3,000,000,000 (previously: 1,500,000,000, 500,000,000, 400,000,000, 300,000,000, 100,000,000 and 30,000,000)!~

Luffy is the captain of the Straw Hat Pirates and is best friends with all of them and values them over all else. At first glance, Luffy does not appear to be very intelligent, often seeing things in childish manner and can easily be amazed by the simplest things. However, because he views the world in a straightforward and simple manner, he is occasionally the only person who can see past the events and see what should be done.  

Luffy seems to have an unstoppable appetite, a characteristic that is common to the Japanese archetype of the (at times simple-minded) young adventurer with a heart of gold; perhaps the hunger more so in Luffy's case due to having an elastic stomach. Luffy is also another one of the several characters given the middle initial "D".  

Although Luffy is fairly lightheaded and a funny character, he has an unstoppable sense of determination, optimism and commitment and will do anything to stand up for his friends and comrades. Along with that, he has great courage to back it up as well as unbelievable strength. Ever since consuming the devil fruit he was shown to be not worried about his inability to swim, much like his brother. Much of these traits are common among D's. His only display of true fear is towards his grandfather, to the point that he does not fight back and is intimidated at the mere mention of him.  

Luffy never kills any of the villains, no matter how cold-hearted they are; instead, he frequently sends the villain flying, knocking them out or until the point that they are almost near death, which results in some of the villains searching for revenge, such as [Buggy the Clown](https://anilist.co/character/725) and [Alvida](https://anilist.co/character/4899). Author [Eiichiro Oda](https://anilist.co/staff/96881) explains that it's not a question of morality so much as a matter of punishing the villains for their crimes - he feels that killing the villains lets them off too lightly, whereas he considers letting them live to see their dreams be ruined a far more fitting punishment.  

Luffy has a dream, and to even have a chance at achieving this dream, he says that he must find the One Piece and become King of the Pirates. He knows that to achieve his goal, he will have to defeat many strong opponents, including the World Government and his childhood hero [Shanks](https://anilist.co/character/727).

name: Zoro Roronoa
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm (5'10")
__Affiliation:__ ~!Straw Hat Pirates (current); Kuraigane Island (former, temporary); Shimotsuki Village (former)!~
__Bounty:__  ~!1,111,000,000 (previously: 60,000,000, 120,000,000 and 320,000,000)!~

Zoro was the first crew member to be recruited by [Luffy](https://anilist.co/character/40/Luffy-Monkey). 

Zoro is a skilled swordsman who fights with his own unique sword style known as santoryu (three katana fighting style). This is achieved by using one katana in each hand, and another in his mouth. He is also seen fighting with only one or two swords. When in a serious fight he ties his normally, tied on the arm bandana, on his head. Though not a samurai, he appears to maintain a certain degree of bushido, and is frequently mistaken for one. Unlike Luffy and most of the other Straw Hat pirates, Zoro has been known to kill his opponents if he has to, though never in cold blood. 

Zoro has a stern, serious and distanced personality, however he often reacts in a goofy and exaggerated comic style due to his gruff, impatient attitude. On the ship, he normally either trains with weights or sleeps. The only work he is seen doing regularly is hoisting the anchor using his great strength. He also likes sake, almost to the degree that Luffy likes meat, but like [Nami](https://anilist.co/character/723/Nami), he never gets drunk due to his inhumanly-high endurance and tolerance for alcohol. Another notable trait is his lack of orientation, as Zoro often gets lost, even in small, familiar spaces or when being led by someone. Despite this, he is often the first to sense an enemy or danger, and the first to react. He is often displayed being well aware of dangerous situations and people around him.  

Zoro often reminds others of the harsh facts, which often shocks some of the other crew members, although they usually decide he is right. Zoro has also stated that he is an atheist, and has never believed in anything except himself. He often comes across as arrogant and overconfident, but only because he knows he's a strong man with great fighting ability. Even so, Zoro knows that he still has a lot of untapped potential, and is constantly seen training and trying to improve his fighting skills. He adheres to a strict sword master's code of honor, and never falsely brags or lies about his abilities, sometimes outright admitting a weakness, even to an enemy. He also never tries to escape from a fight or use trickery to win, believing that doing so is cowardly and scorning anyone who uses such tactics. Zoro is very vigorous, strong-willed, and determined.

name: Sanji
description:
__Height:__ 177 cm (5'9")
__Affiliation:__ ~!Straw Hat Pirates (current); Momoiro Island (former, temporary); Baratie (former); Germa Kingdom (former)!~
__Bounty:__ ~!1,032,000,000 (previously; 77,000,000, 177,000,000 (Only Alive) and 330,000,000)!~

Sanji is the chain-smoking chef of the Straw Hat Pirate Crew. He has superb fighting skills that only make use of his legs, in an effort to minimize damage to his hands which would impair his cooking skills. Sanji uses an array of powerful and varied kicking moves when he fights. His cooking skills are world class, and he was mentored in both cooking and fighting by Chef "Red Leg" Zeff of the Baratie. He was born in the North Blue, but grew up in the East Blue. Sanji is trash-talking and serious, and usually gruff and impatient, especially around men. This is contrasted by his "love-cook" side, as he is very amorous around women. Sanji is completely devoted to any beautiful woman, usually losing all common sense and composure in front of them, then attempting to comically swoon them. He has sworn to never let insult or injury happen to any woman while he can still stand, even if that woman is trying to kill him. This is often problematic in his fighting as he can't attack female opponents, and would rather die than hurt them. All this is apparently the result of a "strict upbringing".

His goal in life is to find the All Blue, a legendary ocean, which contains all the fish in the world. As such, it would be paradise for any cook with as much love for his work as Sanji, who holds great respect for the tools, ingredients, and art of cooking. So great is his devotion to his calling, that Sanji will not let any person or creature starve, regardless of them being friend or foe.  Being the crew's chef, he looks out for the health of his crew mates. Sanji respects [Luffy](https://anilist.co/character/40) as a captain, but often gets angry at him for eating too much, showing disrespect for the aesthetics of cooking, and generally being daft and irresponsible. He is constantly in petty fights with [Zoro](https://anilist.co/character/62) (sometimes calling him Marimo) over each others' traits and they have developed a rivalry, but have managed to make a devastating team together. He is very protective of the female crew members and [Nami](https://anilist.co/character/723) likes to take advantage of him, exploiting his extreme servility. Sanji originally wanted to cook [Chopper](https://anilist.co/character/309), but has come to respect him as a crew member and friend. He's also good friends with [Usopp](https://anilist.co/character/724); they team up and interact often, and Sanji understands him quite well.

name: Robin Nico
description:
__Height:__ 188 cm (6'2")
__Affiliation:__ ~!Straw Hat Pirates (Current); Baltigo (Revolutionaries, Former, Temporary); Alabasta (Baroque Works, Former); Ohara (Former)!~
__Position:__ Archaeologist
__Devil Fruit:__  ~!Hana Hana no Mi (Flower Flower Fruit)!~
__Devil Fruit Type:__ ~!Paramecia!~
__Bounty:__ ~!930,000,000 (previously; 79,000,000, 80,000,000 and 130,000,000)!~

Robin is the seventh member of Straw Hat's Crew. She had a bounty of 79 million beri since she was eight years old, during an incident in which she supposedly destroyed six Buster Call ships through the use of the powers she gained by eating the Hana Hana no Mi (Flower Flower or Blooming Blooming Fruit). The fruit's power enables her to conjure up multiple replicas of her body parts (most often her arms) upon any surface she is able to see making her very powerful and dexterous as a result. Robin joined the Straw Hat Pirates after [Luffy](https://anilist.co/character/40) saved her life, or (how she states it) Luffy forced her to live when she wanted to die. To atone for his crime, Robin demands that Luffy allow her to join his crew, to which he complies leaving every other crew member except [Sanji](https://anilist.co/character/305) in shock. Although feared at first, she is quickly accepted and viewed as a comrade by the crew.

Robin is actually an archaeologist of talent and despises anyone who thoughtlessly damages any piece of history. The World Government fears her because she can decipher Poneglyphs (stones marked with glyphs from an ancient language), which contain details capable of reviving ancient weapons that have the power to destroy the world. In reality, Robin has stated that she does not care about ancient weapons and that her dream is to find the True History written on the Rio Poneglyph.

Robin is a mysterious and serious person who appears quiet and reclusive, and the wisest in the Straw Hat's Crew. She was thought by those around her to be cold and mean, but it was proven that she is actually a kind person who always thinks before she acts. She often only speaks when something interesting or important has happened. She loves to study history, and the comfort and freedom to study and read. She is also quick to point out gross or realistically morbid facts, often creeping out [Nami](https://anilist.co/character/723) or [Usopp](https://anilist.co/character/724). Robin is the wisest and most sensible member of the crew.
