He makes ugly and crude machines, and his belief is that 'The machines of men are armour, cannons and caterpillars'.  Gengai has a bad habit of modifying everything he has at hand, forgetting to tell the items' users important instructions on how to utilize them until it's too late. This usually results in the items' users getting into trouble.   Hiraga Gengai was first introduced in Episode 17. Seemingly as a normal mechanic, the Yorozuya later found out that his only son, Hiraga Saburou had lost his life in the Joui wars. His only son's death left him with a deep emotional scar and Takasugi Shinsuke took advantage of that and used him to attack a festival in which the Shogun would be attending. However, with the help of the Yorozuya and the Shinsengumi, the attack was stopped and Gengai persuaded that revenge against the Bakufu was not the right course of action.   Presently, he is the owner-proprietor of Machine Hall, a machine-repair workshop and inventor's office, and he frequently has to repair Gintoki's scooter. Even so, he is still a fugitive from the law, as seen from his wanted poster at the end of Episode 17, and as stated by Gintoki in the beginning of Episode 67.  In the Lotus Chapter he helped repair Tama by re-using No.305's body.   In the Tama's Virus Infection Chapter, he helped analyze the problem of Tama's pixelated look, sending the Yorozuya into her body to fight the viruses.   In the Kabuki-cho arc, he appeared to help in the battle against the men of Doromizu Jirochou.  In chapter 318 he repaired Sa-chan's glasses, and in chapter 321, it was discovered that he actually turned the glasses into some kind of mass destruction weapon.

name: Catherine
description: An amanto who resembles a cat. At first, she seems to be a diligent worker at Otose's snack shop who is trying to support her family, but soon reveals herself to be a thief. Despite this, Otose hired her again after she was released from prison. She used to work as a thief with three others vaguely resembling Arsène Lupin, Goemon Ishikawa, and Daisuke Jigen. She speaks Japanese with an accent, represented by katakana characters in the place of hiragana; she is the only member of her former crew to speak this way.

name: Ayumu Toujou
description: Tojou is Kyubei's servant, who is extremely dedicated, if not obsessive, in his concern for his young master. He generally speaks in a very polite manner, using -masu and -desu instead of the short dictionary forms usually employed in a normal male-speech.   He addresses Kyubei as waka, which means young master and has for years kept a diary recording Kyubei's activities. Kyubei is usually indifferent to Tojou's excessive attention, although she did kick him when he commented that gothic lolita clothes would suit her. Tojou's eyes are normally closed unless he is surprised or under emotional distress. If his eyes do open, the whites of his eyes are actually black, and his pupils either glow with an unearthly green, blue or red. He has an obsession with beating a raw, unbroken egg yolk on his rice for meals (as shown when the egg yolk broke, and him going into a berserk rage quite uncharacteristic with his usual demeanor).  His name is based on Aya Tojou of the manga Strawberry 100%.

name: Buntarou Mori
description: A transfer student, who after being talked into climbing the school building, discovered a sense of fulfillment upon reaching the top. After which he became interested in rock-climbing. He is a loner who says he doesn't need friends, and seems to have gone through something in the past. He would rather climb a mountain alone than with a partner.

name: Masao Oonishi
description: [Mori's](https://anilist.co/character/35510/Buntarou-Mori) teacher at school.

name: Hajime Miyamoto
description: A classmate of [Mori](https://anilist.co/character/35510/Buntarou-Mori) who also is fond of climbing mountains.

name: Yumi Shirai
description: Yumi is [Mori](https://anilist.co/character/35510/Buntarou-Mori)'s classmate in his new high school.

name: Keito Hara
description: Keito Hara is a solitary climber. ~!After dying from hypothermia on K2, his body was later found on the mountain by [Buntarou Mori](https://anilist.co/character/35510/Buntarou-Mori).!~

name: Rokka
description: ~!Rokka is the daughter of [Buntarou Mori](https://anilist.co/character/35510/Buntarou-Mori) and [Hana Katou](https://anilist.co/character/67539/Hana-Katou).!~

name: Ishida
description: [Mori's](https://anilist.co/character/35510/) homeroom teacher.

name: Mizuki
description: Mizuki is [Mori's](https://anilist.co/character/35510/) classmate from his former school. His attempted suicide after jumping from the school rooftop deeply affects Mori and becomes the main reason why Mori closes off his heart and changes his personality.

name: Momo
description: Momo is [Taku's](https://anilist.co/character/67545/Taku-Niimi) girlfriend.

name: Hitagi Senjougahara
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm

Hitagi, the main female character, is a weak-looking girl with an "incurable disease". She is in the same class as [Koyomi Araragi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi), but he has almost never heard her speak. When she was in the first year of high school, she encountered a mysterious crab, after which she became weightless. Ever since, she has avoided contact with everyone else, threatening everyone who discovers her secret. She called herself a tsundere and always speaks in an abusive style.

~!At the end of Mayoi Snail, she admits that she loves Koyomi, and subsequently enters into a relationship with him.!~

~!After the events in Tsukihi Phoenix, she overcame all of her trauma, and became a rather cheerful and normal girl. She starts calling Araragi with a cute nickname, chuckling at small things and sending e-mails full of Emojis, although her sharp tongue is still there, but toned down.!~

~!Hitagi has told [Hanekawa](https://anilist.co/character/22055/Hanekawa-Tsubasa) that she suffers from an Electra Complex (when a girl has intense sexual attraction towards her father). Whether this was a joke or a sincere admission has remained unrevealed!~

name: Shinobu Oshino
description:
A girl who lives with [Oshino Meme](https://anilist.co/character/22552/Meme-Oshino) in an abandoned building. She loves donuts from the Mister Donut chain. At the beginning of Hitagi Crab, she was renamed "Shinobu" by Meme, who suggested that the name Shinobu (忍), comprised of a heart (心) under a blade (刃), matched her original persona.

~!She appears to be an eight year old girl, but was originally a beautiful vampire who had lived for more than 500 years. After the events of Koyomi Vamp, she was left in a weakened condition with no powers or traces of her original personality, and therefore had to abandon her "Kiss-Shot Acerola-Orion Heart-Under-Blade" name. Prior to being a vampire, she was a princess of unparalleled beauty. She was referred to as "Princess Beauty" or "Acerola" during this time, the latter being her original name. Eventually, she was turned into a vampire by Deathtopia Virtuoso Suicide-Master to save her from the curse of beauty.!~

name: Koyomi Araragi
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm   

A third year high school student who is close to failing every class except math. He is a laid-back person whose only real friend at school is [Tsubasa Hanekawa](https://anilist.co/character/22055/Tsubasa-Hanekawa). Due to events prior to Kizumonogatari and Bakemonogatari, Koyomi avoided having friends and seemed to have lost faith and trust in people and himself.

~!During spring break, he gave [Kiss-Shot](https://anilist.co/character/23602/Shinobu-Oshino) his blood and became a vampire. Although [Meme Oshino](https://anilist.co/character/22552/Meme-Oshino) helped him become human again, there are a few lingering side effects; he can see in the dark and far distances, and he heals faster than the average human. He is still scared of morning sunlight even though it no longer has any effect on him.!~

name: Tsubasa Hanekawa
description:
__Height__: 158 cm

She styles her hair into two braids and ties them with a hair ribbon that has a cat design. She is always seen dressed in the uniform of Naoetsu Private High School, even outside of school days, and is rarely seen on any other type of clothing, except for a set of sleepwear which she wore during Tsubasa Cat Arc.  Hanekawa Tsubasa is [Araragi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi)'s classmate and the class president. Araragi describes her as "the class president of all class presidents". Her catchphrase is "I don’t know everything, I just know what I know". Hanekawa currently lives with her stepfather and stepmother.

Hanekawa Family's Past:  ~!Her biological mother was 17 years old when she got pregnant, the biological father is unknown because she apparently had many lovers. Before she gave birth to Tsubasa, she married another man who was a "workaholic". Right after giving birth, Tsubasa's biological mother commited suicide. The workaholic stepfather, unable to raise a child, remarried again to a woman who is Tsubasa's current mother. The workaholic father soon died from overwork and the current mother married another man who is now Tsubasa's current father. !~  Hanekawa Story's overview in Nekomonogatari/Bakemonogatari:  

~!Prior to the beginning of Bakemonogatari, Hanekawa was possessed by the mischievous spirit of a dead cat during Golden Week due to stress over her family. The matter was eventually resolved with the help of Shinobu at the cost of some of Hanekawa's memories, but the problem emerged again right before the school festival because of different stress. Araragi was told by Hanekawa's bakeneko form that she has feelings for him.  In 'Tsubasa Tiger' (Nekomonogatari: Shiro), on her way to school, she met a tiger spirit which spoke to her. Soon buildings important to Hanekawa began to mysteriously burn down and 'Black Hanekawa' (her bakeneko form) began to take over her body every time she slept. The inevitable showdown was afoot and led to some surprising events.  'Tsubasa Tiger' is written from the perspective of Hanekawa rather than Araragi.!~

name: Nadeko Sengoku
description:
__Height:__ 153 cm 

Nadeko, the main character of Nadeko Snake, is [Tsukihi](https://anilist.co/character/24195/Tsukihi-Araragi)’s friend back in elementary school. She always wears a waist pouch, always casts her eyes downward, has her bangs covering her eyes, has a shy personality, and can be easily amused. [Koyomi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi) played with her a lot whenever she visited his house after being invited by his sisters. She refers to Koyomi as Koyomi onii-chan and appears to have feelings for him.   ~!She was cursed two times by a classmate who liked the boy she rejected, and the rejected boy. While the first one is banished, Koyomi is forced to battle the second to keep it from killing Nadeko.!~ She's quite protective of her hair (particularly her forelocks) thinking that it's her place to guard more than her panties. When she finally combed her forelocks aside in Nisemonogatari, Koyomi commented that she has a glare just like a serpent, probably foreshadowing the story of Nadeko Medusa.

In Nademonogatari, ~!Nadeko gains a power to draw, create, and then materialize shikigami, making her useful in the eyes of [Izuko Gaen](https://anilist.co/character/87115/Izuko-Gaen) and gets offered a job, thanks to [Yotsugi Ononoki](https://anilist.co/character/57499/Yotsugi-Ononoki)!~

name: Mayoi Hachikuji
description: Mayoi is a fifth-grade elementary school girl. She always carries a big backpack, wears a hairband, and sports ponytails.    ~!Ten years ago she was involved in a traffic accident and died because of it. After that she became a ghost and considers herself a "lost snail". She will unwillingly cause the people around her to become lost and unable to find their way home. The only people who can see her are people who don't want to go home in the first place. However, after [Araragi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi) and [Senjougahara](https://anilist.co/character/22037/Hitagi-Senjougahara) help her find the home she was looking for, she changed from an "earthbound spirit" to a "wandering spirit", a fact that she considers to be a bonus, as well as granting her to be free to wander wherever she desires. At the end of Nisemonogatari, she said goodbye to Koyomi, implying that she will not be seeing him again, which will be the basis of the next story, Mayoi Jiangshi. Her family name before her parents got divorced was Tsunade.!~

name: Suruga Kanbaru
description:
Suruga, the main character of Suruga Monkey, is [Koyomi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi)'s underclassman, ace of the school's basketball team and one of [Hitagi](https://anilist.co/character/22037/Hitagi-Senjougahara)'s acquaintances from back in junior high school. Immediately after she entered senior high school, she became aware of Hitagi's secret and was threatened by her, just like Koyomi was. She's an admitted lesbian, fujoshi, lolicon and masochist. 

~!Back in elementary school, she inherited what she thought was a Monkey's Paw but was actually a Rainy Devil from her mother. She started stalking Koyomi after she discovered he was dating Hitagi. She becomes friends with Koyomi and Hitagi after Koyomi rids her of the Rainy Devil.!~ She also has been growing her hair longer since. Her next story was revealed to be Suruga Devil.

name: Meme Oshino
description: Meme is a middle-aged man who lives in an abandoned building. Being an expert in apparitions field, he solves [Koyomi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi) and others' problems. Although he sometimes expects compensation, he does not require it always and seems to help those in need from good nature. Due to his vast knowledge of supernatural studies and general oddities, he serves as Araragi's informant during his stay in the city. Meme is a graduate of Shinto studies in college, although he never pursued the career of being a Shinto priest. Despite that, he is perfectly capable to accomplish spiritual works of a Shinto priest, such as exorcising entities and solving paranormal mysteries. He occasionally wears a Priest's outfit, as seen with the session with [Senjougahara](https://anilist.co/character/22037/Hitagi-Senjougahara) and the heavy crab. Meme's other notable accessories include an earring on his right ear and a necklace, both consisting of an inverted cross.

name: Karen Araragi
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm 
 
Karen, the main character of Karen Bee, is one of [Koyomi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi)'s sisters. She is older than [Tsukihi](https://anilist.co/character/24195/Tsukihi-Araragi) and always doing outdoor activities. Despite being younger, Karen is taller than Koyomi, much to Koyomi's dismay.    

~!In Karen Bee, her hot-headed personality and her habit of acting before thinking lead her to be stung by a bee which leads to being poisoned with a terrible fever that lasted for 3 days. Like [Hitagi](https://anilist.co/character/22037/Hitagi-Senjougahara), she refused any help from anyone which eventually leads to her and Koyomi fighting each other. Later it was revealed that it was set up by [Kaiki](https://anilist.co/character/53641/Deishuu-Kaiki). Karen and Tsukihi are nicknamed Tsuga no Ki Nichū no Fire Sisters (栂の木二中のファイヤーシスターズ, lit. Fire Sisters of Tsuga no Ki 2nd Junior High). It was revealed that the reason she and Tsukihi found boyfriends was so that Koyomi would become jealous. They found boyfriends in Koyomi's image with Karen's boyfriend being shorter than her. She and Tsukihi also thought that Koyomi's girlfriend was [Tsubasa](https://anilist.co/character/22055/Tsubasa-Hanekawa). Koyomi, Karen and Tsukihi's parents were revealed to be police officers. !~

name: Tsukihi Araragi
description:
__Height:__ 156 cm   

Tsukihi, the main character of Tsukihi Phoenix, is one of [Koyomi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi)'s sisters. She's the youngest of Araragi family. Unlike her sister, [Karen](https://anilist.co/character/24194/Karen-Araragi), she is always doing indoor activities. Contrary to her personality, she constantly changes her hair style and is short-tempered to the point that Koyomi describes her as having hysteria.    ~!She is actually the reincarnation of a phoenix and has been since before she was even born. The phoenix entered the baby's body when it was still in the womb and by now both beings' minds have become one. She is immortal and the only thing that end her life is a natural death from old age. It was hinted that [Kaiki](https://anilist.co/character/53641/Deishuu-Kaiki) was the one who sent [Kagenui](https://anilist.co/character/57501/Yozuru-Kagenui) and [Ononoki](https://anilist.co/character/57499/Yotsugi-Ononoki) to go after Tsukihi. Tsukihi and Karen are nicknamed Tsuga no Ki Nichū no Fire Sisters (栂の木二中のファイヤーシスターズ). It was revealed that the reason she and Karen found boyfriends was so that Koyomi would become jealous. They found boyfriends in Koyomi's image with Tsukihi's boyfriend being taller than her. She and Karen also thought that Koyomi's girlfriend was [Tsubasa](https://anilist.co/character/22055/Tsubasa-Hanekawa). Koyomi, Karen and Tsukihi's parents were revealed to be police officers. !~

name: Hak Son
description:
**Height:** 188 cm

He is the former chief and general of the Wind Tribe. He is famously known as Thunder Beast for his fighting skills that were said to be unrivalled by anyone, earning him the title of "strongest soldier in the kingdom".

~!He is in love with [Yona](https://anilist.co/character/43814/Yona). Even when Yona was unaware of his feelings, every now and then, Hak couldn't help but display his affection towards her.!~

name: Yona
description:
__Height:__ 157 cm
__Race:__ Human

The spoiled princess of the Kouka kingdom, who has a crush on her cousin and childhood friend [Soo-won](https://anilist.co/character/88670). Soo-won comforted her when she lost her mother in young age. She hates her crimson red hair. Her bodyguard is the other childhood friend, the general [Son Hak](https://anilist.co/character/43815) who she finds really annoying.

As the princess and the only heir of the Kouka Kingdom, Yona was raised with extreme care and gets whatever she wants, for example, beautiful accessories and clothing. This lead her to being a spoilt princess. After some life-changing events, Yona developed into a strong young lady who lives for the people of Kouka Kingdom, while also paying back the friends who helped her survive.

~!After Soo-won kills her father in front of her eyes in order to become the new king, she has to run from the castle with Son Hak. !~

~!She is the reincarnation of the red dragon.!~

~!She later confesses her love to Son Hak.!~

name: Shin-Ah
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm
__Race:__ Dragon

He is the blue dragon and has dragon eyes that allows him to see great distances. Shin-Ah's dragon eyes are also capable of disrupting the nerves of anyone he glares at until it kills them.

~!Later in the story, his power was explained in more detail. His victims are subject to fatal hallucinations. In extreme cases he can cause their entire bodies to stop functioning, including their hearts. However, he does not have full control over this power and will lose himself to the blue dragon's murderous willpower. When he finishes using that ability, he himself becomes paralyzed as a result, making the power a double-edged sword.!~

~!He almost lost complete control when [Yona](https://anilist.co/character/43814/Yona) was captured by some bandits (they were in the fire tribe and Shinah was assigned to protect Yona), causing them to have hallucinations after his mask was knocked off by a bandit. However, she wasn’t afraid of his power and saved him from losing to his power (though it wasn’t easy because he lost himself and didn’t recognize her). He was scared that he wouldn’t be able to stay by Yona’s side anymore and she would hate him because of this. But she reassured his importance to her and to continue to stay with the group.!~

He is also voiced by Sanae Kobayashi.

name: Jae-Ha
description:
__Height:__ 188 cm
__Race:__ Dragon

He is the descendant of the Green Dragon and possesses the power of a dragon in his right leg. His power allows him to jump high and long distances that almost make it look like he can fly. It also makes his leg incredibly strong and lethal when used to kick. He's a big flirt, he doesn't care whether it's a man or a girl.

~!Twenty-five years ago, Jae-ha was born in the Village of Ryokuryuu and Garou, the previous Ryokuryuu, took care of him. During his childhood, he was confined in chains within his room to prevent him from escaping the village and also from repeating the tragedy that happened eighty-five years ago. On his every attempt to flee, he was always stopped by Garou and he was beat up as punishment.!~

name: Zeno
description:
__Height:__ 166 cm
__Race:__ Dragon

He is the yellow dragon and has a really strong body.

~!He joins the group immediately after the Awa arc. Later on it's revealed that he was watching Yona ever since she was chased out of Hiryuu castle to see if she was fit to use the power of the four dragons. After the events in Awa he decided that he wanted to follow her, so he showed up at the campfire.!~

~!In chapter 100, it is revealed that he is immortal, and that he is the original dragon warrior who received the blood of the Yellow Dragon. His power worked by having certain areas of his body being seriously injured before having that part regenerating back quickly. This was why when he appeared to be a normal human when Hak tried to test whether his body was indestructible (he was not seriously injured). While his body is regenerating, scales appear on the places where his wounds were, making his body as hard as steel. According to Zeno himself, during regeneration his physical power is no less than Kija's dragon arm or Jae-Ha's dragon leg.!~

~!He was married in the past to a sickly girl named Kaya.!~

name: Ki-Ja
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm
__Race:__ Dragon

He is the white dragon of the group. He has dragon claws on his right hand, which is said to have ten times the strength of a normal human's.

~!In a side chapter focused on Kija, he (when he was a child) had secretly went to see his father (who was on deathbed). However his father was too weak to realise who it was and thought it was the granny. He had asked if it was okay for him to touch that child (Kija) now that his right hand was back to being a normal human hand. Kija, upon hearing this leapt onto the bed and hugged his father. His father died shortly after saying "Kija" when he realised it was him.!~

name: Yun
description: __Height:__ 162 cm Race: Human In Princess Yona's group, he is the healer and genius. He is an outstanding curious intellectual. He can say mean things, but he's a caring pretty boy. He was born in a poor village of the Fire Tribe.

name: Soo-Won
description:
__Height:__ 185cm
Race: Human

He is the son of the deceased General Yu-Hon, the older cousin of Yona, as well as her and Hak Son's childhood friend, the three were best friends. He kills Yona's father and becomes the 11th King of Kouka and wants to unite the Kingdom to restore its original power after King Il's reign.

~!He later meets Yona once again in Awa after Kumji's death and hides Yona from General Ju-do and the others, and states that he still has something to do when Yona wanted to kill Su-won.!~

Nozomi Yamamoto voices him as a child.

name: Ao
description:
Ao is Shin-Ah's squirrel companion and friend, who is named after the previous Seiryuu by Shin-Ah.

Ao is a goofy and mischievous yet adorable squirrel, often playing around and making poses that match the person she is riding on. She likes to eat a lot which makes her bite on random things, like Yona's earrings or Shin-Ah's finger. She tries to make people (specifically Shin-Ah or Yona) cheer up if they are feeling down or sad by rubbing their face or acting cute.

name: Lili An
description: She is the daughter of the Water Tribe General An Jun-gi. Though she appears to be a confident and brave girl on the outside, she is actually a shy, caring person, who tries to hide her personality by acting and talking big to others. As a general’s daughter, Lili doesn't like to show her weaknesses to others, and once she does, she considers it as a disgraceful behaviour​.

name: Geun-Tae Lee
description: Lee Geun-Tae is the general of the Earth Tribe and he is the husband of Yun-Ho. He serves under Soo-Won after acknowledging his strength during the Battle Game Festival held in Chi'Shin. Geun-Tae is a bearded, dark-skinned man who is almost never seen without a proud snarl on his face. He has brown almond eyes (yellow in the anime) and long untidy dark brown hair that he ties in a ponytail using a rope-like ornament with tassels on both ends. His fringes cover most of his forehead and some of its strands hang to the sides of his face. Whenever he goes to the castle, he wears an outfit chosen by his wife: a brown leather overcoat with animal-prints atop a white robe with yellow-patterned hemlines, a two-layered purple beaded necklace, and a pair of black boots. While at home, he dons a simple robe where his scars can be visibly seen. Like the people in the Wind Tribe, he likes to take everything easy. He never considers the hierarchy on his tribe and he lets his people talk to him as if he is just an ordinary citizen. He also likes picking fights, especially against Han Joo-Doh, who he never shares a stable relationship with. However, as a general who fought on Emperor Joo-Nam’s era, he believes that he belongs to the battlefield and has been eager to use his skills and fight on the frontlines again. Ever since the banning of war under Emperor Il’s reign, he grew rusty and has been looking for a capable king who he can lend his strength to. Because of this, he will threaten a king of rebellion if he sees him not fit for the position.

name: Mun-Deok Son
description: Son Hak's adoptive father. Form General of the Wind tribe.

name: Tae-Jun Kan
description:
Kan Tae-Jun is the second son of the Fire Tribe General Kan Soo-Jin. He is in love with Yona and has been determined to make her his wife so he could inherit the throne of the Kouka Kingdom.

Tae-Jun is a happy, cowardly, and arrogant man who is obsessed with Yona. He is a pampered person that gets anything he wants and will grow resentful and childish if someone stops him for claiming it. At times, he can also be sneaky and will go against even his father's orders if he thinks it'll be for the better. He has a high regard for himself and will boast his position to anyone, especially to those who offended him while he demand them to give him an apology. Despite his high position in the Fire Tribe, he has no idea of the real situation of the villages outside the capital and thinks that the people are merely slacking off. 

However, After experiencing all the citizen’s hardships, his eyes open to the bad state of his tribe and realizes that with how their current system, there won’t be any future for their tribe. Along with this, he grows to respect Yona and promises her that he will protect the Fire Tribe for her sake.

name: Tae-Yeon
description: Hak's adoptive brother.

name: Min-Soo
description: A servant inside the Hiryuu Castle who attends to the needs of Princess Yona and Emperor Il.

name: Kouren
description: The first princess of the Xing Kingdom and the legitimate successor to the throne.

name: Algira
description: Algira is the servant of the Princess Tao and friend of Vold. He is a supporter of Tao's faction which opposes Princess Kouren's faction.

name: Mei Nyan
description: She is the chief mistress of Cha-Gol.

name: Hiryuu
description: King Hiryuu is the first King of Kouka. He was the red dragon god who descended from the heavens and took on human form to rule a kingdom on Earth.

name: Yuno
description: Gung-tae I's wife.

name: Vold
description: Vold is working with Algira to help Princess Tao fight against her sister's rule. He is revealed to be one of the Five Stars, which consists of the strongest fighters in Xing.

name: Abi
description: Abi is the first person to bear the Seiryuu's power. He is one of the four Dragon Warriors who was entrusted to protect King Hiryuu and to never betray him.

name: Qifrey
description:
Qifrey is a witch and [Coco's](https://anilist.co/character/129840/Coco) teacher. He runs an atelier and currently has four disciples.

He is a caring teacher who patiently teaches his students magic. This is especially true for Coco, who has no special abilities as a witch at first but he continues to encourage her until she can draw magic skillfully. He is protective of all his disciples, as seen from how he protects them from being taken by Esheath from the Magic Security Council. However, Qifrey is overly obsessed with his goal to locate the Brimmed Hats, with his gentle attitude oftentimes replaced by a buried hatred he has always hidden. It appears he had a personal agenda against the Brimmed Hats, as well.

~!The reason Qifrey has a grudge towards the Brimmed Hats is that they are responsible for taking away his memories and right eye as a child. He was later locked in a coffin, buried under a tree, and left there to die as it slowly filled with water. Thankfully, people from the Magic Security Council and Sage Beldarut found him and rescued him from his miserable condition, which later on he would become the pupil of Sage Beldarut. Qifrey also went to the Tower of Books in order to find an answer on how to solve the problem of his missing memories and right eye, but for that, he must use forbidden magic, and as such his issue remains unsolved.!~

name: Coco
description:
She is a young girl who becomes an apprentice witch under the witch [Qifrey](https://anilist.co/character/129841/) after her initial accidental use of forbidden magic turned her mother to crystal. She hopes to search the Tower of Books for the book containing the magic, in order to reverse its effects on her mother.

She is quite a dork for magic, with a child-like (even for her age) widen eyed look whenever she sees things that are common for every other witch. The very magic that inspired her was simple magic made by Qifrey's watcher that caused glowstone path to light up.

name: Agott Arkrome
description:
Agott is a witch in training and [Qifrey's](https://anilist.co/character/129841/) student. She belongs to the famous Arkrome house, who have served as librarians at the Tower of Books for generations.

She has a tendency to focus on how much more she still needs to accomplish, leading her to express dissatisfaction with her current progress. Agott suffers from self-esteem issues over being considered merely average and she takes that out on others who she doesn't think either deserves magic or have the talent to do so, which is usually [Coco](https://anilist.co/character/129840/Coco).

name: Richeh
description:
Richeh is a young witch in training and a disciple of [Qifrey](https://anilist.co/character/129841/Qifrey). She wants to keep her magic essentially "pure" and unchanged and resents having to do what others tell her to do. 

Richeh specializes in crystal magic, particularly in creating transparent crystal ribbons. She also excels at drawing small, intricate glyphs, and has been shown to be adept at connecting these together to form magical portal holes. She has a seemingly emotionless and childish personality. She avoids showing much emotion, though others can still notice emotions on her. She is particularly prone to showing that she's angry at people.

name: Olruggio
description:
He is a witch and serves as the Watchful Eye for [Qifrey's](https://anilist.co/character/129841/Qifrey) atelier. He has a gruff way of speaking but his magic is often described as "warm". He has created a lot of magical items, such as the Glowstone Path, the Snugstone and the Searneedle Wand. His specialty is fire-based magic.

He is very caring to the apprentices and gives them things that might be helpful, as well as rushing to Qifrey's aid, but every time someone points out he's acting very nicely, he tries to brush it off as something anyone would do or to his work as watchful eye.

name: Tetia
description:
Tetia is a young witch in training at [Qifrey's](https://anilist.co/character/129841/) Atelier. She loves clouds and dreams of creating the perfect cloud magic.

She's perpetually energetic and has a habit of thanking people for thanking her. Tetia is an extremely upbeat, loving girl that tries to help everyone she knows and keep the mood high. She is also the one who often gets everyone grounded and keeps the mood up by being loving to her friends.

name: Fudemushi
description:
A member of a species called the brushbuddy. A small creature with fur resembling a paintbrush. It possesses a natural instinct to gather wherever it catches the scent of Magic Ink.

Friendly and affectionate, it has grown quite attached to [Coco](https://anilist.co/character/129840/Coco) and the members of the Atelier.

name: Custas
description: He is a young boy with dark skin, dark eyes, and long dark hair. He is occasionally drawn with sharp and noticeable canines. After an incident that left his legs unusable, he also uses a sealchair.

name: Tartah
description: Nolnoa's young assistant in the shop. He suffers from argentosis, a rare sight condition which makes him effectively colorblind and thus initially unable to use magic because certain effects rely on inks differentiated by their color. He becomes a dear friend to [Coco](https://anilist.co/character/129840/Coco), who helps him by teaching him magic with which to circumvent his disability.

name: Euini
description:
He is a nervous apprentice witch studying under Kukrow.

Euini is a very anxious witch who worries about his own abilities and is very aware of his own faults; he confesses that he is most comfortable practicing magic when there isn't an audience watching him. Euini tends to think lowly of himself and that causes him to under-perform in any given situation.

name: Luluci
description: Member of the Knight Moralis.

name: Beldaruit
description: One of the Three Wise, he is responsible for overseeing the education of new witches. He was also Qifrey's professor.

name: Iguin
description: Iguin is the Brimmed Hat Witch who sold a book of forbidden magic to [Coco](https://anilist.co/character/129840/Coco). Their motivation is somewhat unknown, but it has something to do with Coco. They appear to be incredibly powerful, possessing magic that is beyond the scope of normal witches. Iguin also has incredible agility, being able to jump while casting magic. They rarely appear except to interfere with Coco from the sidelines.

name: Alaira
description: Alaira is a senior witch who lives at the Witch Auditorium. She is friends with [Qifrey](https://anilist.co/character/129841/).

name: Easthies
description:
A member of the Knights Moralis and the leader of a squad of five.

A strict and serious individual, he is pretty stern and does not care about trivial things such as his birthday. Work is his top priority, he is dedicated to his job of enforcing the law and has no interest for his appearance or personal care. He shows himself to be ruthless, ignoring the pleas of others and does not hesitate to take action as a Knight.

name: Ininia
description:
Ininia is an apprentice witch currently serving under a mysterious witch named Restis.

She is very lawful to her master, Lord Restis. Ininia talks in third person and is very aloof, barely showing any emotion. She also has a very simple view on friendship, viewing those as friends as ones that will be spared from her more harmful magic.

name: Dagda
description: Dagda is a traveling minstrel. He appears alongside the boy Coustas who is like a son to him.

name: Riliphin
description:
[Richeh's](https://anilist.co/character/129838/) older brother and an apprentice witch.

Riliphin is a reserved and quiet young man. He has a strong aversion to areas with a large number of people, and prefers quiet places.

name: Jujy
description: Jujy is an apprentice learning under the witch [Hieheart](https://anilist.co/character/331281/Hieheart).

name: Utowin
description: Member of the Knights Moralis. He works directly under Easthies.

name: Nolnoa
description: Nolnoa is an old witch who runs a magic shop called The Starry Sword with his grandson Tartah in the town of Kalhn.

name: Atwert
description: Atwert is a Pointed Hat Witch that is introduced as Galga's lover.

name: Deanreldy Ezrest
description: The king of Ezrest and ruler of the Six Monarchs of Zozah Peninsula, and the father of Eolio Ezrest, Ezrest's prince.

name: Hieheart
description: Hieheart is a witch and [Jujy's](https://anilist.co/character/331278/Jujy) professor.

name: Sinocia
description: Sinocia is an Unknowing doctor working at the Healing Spire.

name: Maomao
description:
Maomao works as an apothecary in the red light district, helping her mentor and father [Luomen](https://anilist.co/character/261968) in caring for its residents, with special attention given to the Verdigris Hall brothel, where she was born and was initially raised.

One day, while gathering herbs, she gets kidnapped and sold to be a common servant in the inner court of the imperial palace, where only the Emperor's consorts and their servants reside. Not allowed to leave, her curious personality and skills begin to rope her into mysterious problems that can affect the whole country.

~! It was later revealed that Loumen was actually her adoptive father. Her biological father is [Lakan](https://anilist.co/character/232926), the tactician in the Li military. Loumen is actually Maomao's biological great-uncle. Her biological mother is [Fengxian](https://anilist.co/character/274191), who was a high ranking courtesan at the Verdigris House. !~

name: Jinshi
description: Jinshi is the eunuch in charge of the affairs of the inner palace. He is described as having a face capable even of outshining the consorts in beauty, amazing women and men alike. He is constantly accompanied by his attendant [Gaoshun](https://anilist.co/character/244317/Gaoshun) and has taken an interest to [Maomao](https://anilist.co/character/126824/Maomao)'s intelligence and active demeanor.

name: Rouran
description: The (new) Pure consort, residing in the Garnet Palace within the inner court. She makes a big show of her exorbitant and ever changing clothing, jewellery and make up. Despite that, she doesn't talk any more than she needs to, keeping her distance.

name: Gyokuyou
description:
The Noble consort, residing in the Jade Palace within the inner court. Her red hair and green eyes distinguish her from the other consorts, that being part of the reasons she became the Emperor's favoured consort, having already given birth to a girl of his. Despite these circumstances, she is very careful of whom she keeps around so she has the smallest retinue of all the high consorts.

~! Later on, she gives birth to a boy, the new heir to the crown, thus becoming the Empress. !~

name: Gaoshun
description: Gaoshun is [Jinshi](https://anilist.co/character/127278/Jinshi)'s attendant. He's shown to be extremely dependable. A stern believer in deference to authority and proper etiquette, his disapproval is often splattered in his transparent facial expressions, even if he says nothing.

name: Rifa
description: The Able consort, residing in the Crystal Palace within the inner court. The second most favoured consort of the Emperor, said to be so in big part due to her voluptuous chest. She gave birth to a boy who succumbed for unknown reasons and she herself is in grave health condition at the start of the story.

name: Lakan
description:
Lakan is a renowned strategist known for his nonchalant disregard of proper manners. His plotting ability causes fear even in the Emperor himself. He sees people's faces as a piece of shogi representing their worth, with a few exceptions like the woman he loved and his daughter. Currently heads the La clan.

~!He is [Maomao](https://anilist.co/character/126824/Maomao)'s biological father and the nephew of [Luomen](https://anilist.co/character/261968/Ruomen)!~

name: Aaduo
description:
The Pure consort, residing in the Garner Palace within the inner court. She was the current Emperor's milk sibling and childhood crush, being just a year older than him. She became the previous Emperor's consort and gave birth to his child at 18, who was stillborn. The ordeal made her infertile, but circumstances between her and the royal family allowed her to keep her position as a High Consort.

She is very spartan on the outside yet has a motherly side to her.

~!She is Jinshi's real mother!~

name: Xiaolan
description: Xiaolan is a servant in the inner court of the palace. Carefree and easy to please, she looks at her sale to the inner palace as a good thing, since at least she now has proper bedding and meals. She loves gossiping and constantly serves as a source of possibilities for Maomao to brainstorm over.

name: Lihaku
description: Lihaku is a military officer, residing in the outer court of the palace. He's strong and honest, but not exactly brilliant.

name: Pairin
description: Pairin is the oldest of the Three Princesses of Verdigris Hall. She loves men's bodies and dreams of being taken away by a muscular prince.

name: Riishu
description: The Virtuous consort, residing in the Diamond Palace within the inner court. She was sent to be a high consort on the inner court as a young child because her prominent family was aware of the previous Emperor's pedophilic tendencies. When he died, she was allowed to leave as she was never visited by him, but her family arranged for her to return to her high consort position. Due to how young she is, she doesn't get any interest from the current Emperor, commands no respect, nor does she have any influence. She's very naive and gets bullied even by her own attendants.

name: Meimei
description: Meimei is one of the Three Princesses of Verdigris Hall. She started as Fenshen's apprentice and, being somewhat cunning herself, inherited Fenshen's taste for strategy board games. She is the most attached to the brothel and the people within.

name: Ruomen
description: Ruomen is a physician of the Inner Court, a physician in the red-light district, and Maomao's father.

name: Suirei
description: Suirei is a court lady, doing menial tasks in the outer court.

name: Joka
description: Joka is the youngest of the Three Princesses of Verdigris Hall and one of Maomao's adopted sisters.

name: Lahan
description: Lahan is the adopted son of [Lakan](https://anilist.co/character/232926/Lakan) and a number loving eccentric.

name: Fenshen
description:
Fenshen used to be a high ranking courtesan in Verdigris Hall. With a flinty and hard personality, she was unmatched at strategy board games. She fell in love with a man who could challenge her at those, but was later abandoned after bedding him.

~!Her mental condition degraded heavily and she mistreated her baby to the point the other courtesans took Maomao to raise her themselves. Ultimately she contracted syphilis and got bedridden in a backroom of Verdigris.!~

name: Hongniang
description: Lady Gyokuyou's head lady-in-waiting.

name: Yarite Baba
description: Once a high ranking courtesan herself, the Madam is now the runner of the Vergidris Hall.

name: Fuyou
description: A mid-rank consort, princess of a distant land. She became the Emperor's middle consort against her will.

name: Koutei
description: The current Emperor fulfills the role expected of him. He is hated by his mother, the Empress dowager, for being the product of her rape. His most trustworthy relationship is with his brother, who manages small things behind the scenes for him.

name: Lingli
description: Lingli is the baby of high consort Gyokuyou. She's the first child of the current Emperor to survive. She's nicknamed Xiaoling by her mother, meaning Little Bell.

name: Guen
description: Guen is the current physician of the inner court. The requirement of being castrated to be allowed to work inside the inner court does not attract many physicians to choose from. Guen, not a very good one, accepted such employment terms to prevent his sister being forced to become a court lady.

name: Makio Koudai
description: A 35-year-old novelist who lives alone. She is deeply introverted, and has not communicated with her relatives for a long time due to arguments with her [mother](https://anilist.co/character/387235) and [sister](https://anilist.co/character/363293). Took in her sister's orphaned daughter, [Asa](https://anilist.co/character/189957).

name: Asa Takumi
description: After the passing away of her parents, she was adopted by her [Aunt Makio](https://anilist.co/character/171138). She now faces the hardship of adapting to a new environment, while sorting the emotions within herself.

name: Shingo Kasamachi
description: [Makio's](https://anilist.co/character/171138) friend and ex-boyfriend.

name: Emiri Nara
description: [Asa's](https://anilist.co/character/189957/Asa-Takumi) classmate and best friend. ~!Asa eventually learns that Emiri is a lesbian and that Emiri is dating [a girl](https://anilist.co/character/393115) who attends the same preparatory classes.!~

name: Nana Daigo
description: [Makio's](https://anilist.co/character/171138/Koudai-Makio) friend from her days at school.

name: Kazunari Touno
description: [Asa's](https://anilist.co/character/189957/Asa-Takumi) guardianship supervisor.

name: Minori Koudai
description: [Asa's](https://anilist.co/character/189957/) deceased mother. [Makio's](https://anilist.co/character/171138/) older sister.

name: Chiyo Morimoto
description: A first-year student acquainted with both [Asa](https://anilist.co/character/189957) and [Emiri](https://anilist.co/character/363290), who aspires to be a doctor. ~!She discovers a scandal involving the medical school she was applying to, and reacts angrily.!~

name: Michiko Nara
description: [Emiri's](https://anilist.co/character/363290/) mother.

name: Kotoko
description: Makio's friend from her days at school.

name: Motsu
description: Makio's friend from her days at school.

name: Shouko
description: ~![Emiri's](https://anilist.co/character/363290/) girlfriend.!~

name: Kyouko Koudai
description: Minori and Makio's mother. Asa's grandmother.

name: Ii
description:
The Nonsense User, a boy that drastically plays down his abilities, yet inevitably solves any mystery he encounters. Ii is an abnormal person. A "defective product." Unable to express much emotion, he is often seen with a neutral expression; however, Ii is able to express some emotion in some circumstances. At the beginning of his second year in junior high, he joined the ER3 System and went to Houston in America for 5 years and later returns to Japan at the age of 19. Upon return, he begins to attend Rokumeikan University in Kyoto. Ii is "friends" with [Tomo Kunagisa](https://anilist.co/character/29594/Kunagisa-Tomo), though he refuses to admit he has any and instead calls them acquaintances. Also known as the "mirror image" of [Hitoshiki Zerozaki](https://anilist.co/character/34293/Zerozaki-Hitoshiki), he is believed to be what Ii would be like if he didn't hold back. 

Tomo is helped out by Ii at times, having a friendly relationship overall. The two are similar, being unable to fully express emotions, though Tomo can only truly express happiness. Despite this, she and Ii had an incident a few years back that she never wishes to happen again. The incident is believed to be Ii leaving Tomo for 5 years. ~!After the beheadings occurred on Wet Crow's Feather Island, the culprit pointed a gun at Tomo, forcing Ii to admit his love for her, causing the culprit to give up as they were able to get Ii to say something he wouldn't.!~

As the mirror image of Hitoshiki Zerozaki, the two are unable to harm each other as they can both predict the other's moves. Their relationship is a strange one, as both of them are vastly different yet so similar to one another.

Many people call Ii some cutesy nickname like, "Ii-chan," and the like, though very few people know his actual name. 
~!In a conversation with Shiogi, Ii is asked questions to hint towards his name. After figuring it out, he requests that she not use his name, as anyone else has died. The people that have died being Tomo (emotionally), Magokoro Omokage (in a fire), and his forgotten younger sister Harukana Ii (in a plane crash)!~

name: Jun Aikawa
description:
The fierce Desert Eagle coated in scarlet. The unstoppable Laughing Red Tigress. Humanity's Strongest: Jun Aikawa. Renowned for her prowess in anything and everything, Jun is the most powerful person in the world. Her occupation is that of a contractor and will take any job, no matter how trivial or illegal it may be, so long as money is involved. Those that call her by her last name are considered her enemies, thus she insists friends to refer to her as Jun. Her abilities are practically limitless as a Multidisciplinary Master. [Ii](https://anilist.co/character/29593/Ii) and Jun initially meet by pure chance and their fates become intertwined.

With a strong sense of justice and a wild personality, Jun can be a lot to handle for the average person and especially Ii. He is particularly bothered by Jun's hatred for leaving things half-assed. On top of that, Jun is a rather arrogant individual. Despite this, she does value her friends and trusts them greatly. A majority of the people that hear her name fear it, as many over-the-top stories exist about her feats. Though some of the said feats may be completely wrong, Jun is a very intelligent woman and is considered to be a genius among geniuses. 

As Jun is known both for her abilities and her mind that is like no other, she is said to be Humanity's Strongest. Being the Multidisciplinary Master,  she is a master of disguise, sound imitating, lock picking and mind-reading. Not only that, but Jun also has amazing fighting capabilities, which are nearly impossible to overcome.

~!When [Hitoshiki Zerozaki](https://anilist.co/character/34293/Zerozaki-Hitoshiki) and Jun fought, she admitted that he was a bit tough even for her and that his skill with knives was second to none. Hitoshiki managed to get away without a scratch, though it wasn't easy.!~

~!The origin of Jun isn't pretty, as she is the product of incest. Initially, [Takashi Saitou](https://anilist.co/character/173351/Saitou-Takashi), her biological father, wished to create the strongest human. He, along with Akira Kajou and Junya Aikawa, created Jun, with one of Jun Saitou twins as her mother. Jun was later abandoned as she was deemed a failure by Takashi. Of her three fathers, Junya Aikawa was the only one she could consider as a father.!~

name: Tomo Kunagisa
description:
The technological genius Blue Savant and heiress of the Kunagisa household. Tomo is a young girl who is well versed in computer engineering, capable of crafting computers that are much more powerful that anything on the market. Most known for being the leader of Team, a collection of genius hackers. Due to Tomo's renowned computer genius, she is invited to Wet Crow's Feather Island by Iria Akagami. Tomo brings Ii with her, to help her get around. 

Tomo stands out like no other, having blue hair and eyes due to recessive genes. Her hair may get even darker if she refuses to wash it, becoming ultramarine, which can happen often as she hates taking baths. Due to this, Ii usually just throws her into a bathtub. Ii also tied up her hair in many ways, from braids to quadtails. Tomo herself enjoys fun, though she is not the best at being sociable, as she rarely listens to others besides the task at hand. Unlike most people, Tomo thinks somewhat backwards. Ii describes her thinking as instead of building a sand castle with what's needed, Tomo simply has a whole pile of sand and removes what isn't needed. Additionally, she is nearly incapable of expressing anything other than happiness, besides a tad of minor annoyance.

As the leader of Team, Tomo bears the title of "Walking Wrath." She manages all of Team, and will get assistance from the other members for whichever goal she has in mind. Team itself is a cyber-terrorist organization that preforms many illegal actions to either get information or money. They rarely get caught, though there is one close call and they end up disbanding, all of which happens while Ii is in Houston. ~!It's later revealed that Tomo is worshipped as a god among the cyber-terrorist team. Tomo appears to treat them equally, but there are questionable times where she may think of them as slaves.!~
~!At the end of the series, Tomo's hair becomes nearly black and she begins to grow again. Prior to this, she had the same appearance ever since Ii left for Houston.!~

name: Hitoshiki Zerozaki
description:
The No Longer Human serial killer of Kyoto and member of the Zerozaki clan: Hitoshiki Zerozaki. Notoriously known as the Prowler during the Kyoto serial murder case. Hitoshiki is a man with a small stature that kills for the sake of killing. Soushiki Zerozaki and Hitoshiki have a somewhat brotherly relationship, though they've grown distant. In general, he doesn't have many friends as a serial killer, though Iori Mutou could be considered one, as well as Ii. Another killer, Izumu Niounomiya, is a friend and rival of Hitoshiki. 

Hitoshiki himself is eccentric, though he generally has a casual personality and way of speaking. He considers himself a brat and believes everyone else was once a brat. When he and Ii meet, he calls Ii a doppelganger as they are essentially identical, yet so different. Hitoshiki is later described as the mirror image of Ii, and what Ii would be like if he didn't hold back. As a Zerozaki, Hitoshiki has a desire to kill anyone he meets without remorse, though he is capable of holding himself back. Like Ii, Hitoshiki has a catchphrase where he often says, "What a riot," which contrasts against Ii's "Nonsense."

As both a Zerozaki and a serial killer, Hitoshiki has a couple abilities and tools at his disposal. In the vest he wears, there are many knives placed all throughout it, which complements his mastery at using knives. To go along with his knife expertise, Hitoshiki is also able to utilize string, making a nearly undetectable trap. Unfortunately, with all his prowess in killing, he cannot do much against Ii, as they can counter each other and will just end up in a stalemate. ~!Hitoshiki's knife finesse has made him able to hold his own against Jun Aikawa. Despite this, he cannot defeat her, thus he escapes. The two later come to an agreement where Hitoshiki vows to stop killing to continue living and tells Jun Ii's solution to his own problem during the time.!~ ~!When Hitoshiki was born, his parents both died. His parents were Hataori Zerozaki as his mother and Zeroshiki Zerozaki as the father. As they died after Hitoshiki's birth, Soushiki began to raise him.!~

name: Mikoko Aoii
description:
A peppy college student that is very outgoing and able to express emotions without fault. Mikoko attends Rokumeikan Private University, along with her fellow friends. She hangs out with Tomoe, Akiharu, Muimi, and later on, Ii. Muimi and Mikoko have been friends since elementary school, while the others met later on in high school and college. 

Mikoko owns a vintage model Vespa, referring to it as, "scoot," much to Ii's dismay.  When drunk, Mikoko has a tendency to strip her clothes. 

As Mikoko is able to express emotions without holding anything back, others are a bit jealous that they can't be like her. ~!Soon after meeting Ii, she develops a crush on him and falls in love, only her love becomes an obsession. Due to this, she is willing to kill any obstacles that stand in her way.!~ ~!Mikoko later strangles Tomoe out of jealousy and ends up killing herself with the same murder weapon after Ii rejects her sickening, corrupted love.!~

name: Miiko Asano
description:
The close friend of Neon and resident of the Antique Apartment, Miiko is a freeter and master of Kendo and Kenjutsu. She rarely expresses her feelings, though is known for showing off her temper while fighting. In order to show what she's feeling, Miiko wears a jinbei with kanji representing her emotions on the back. She has a habit of helping the weak all she can, one being in a relationship with 4 different people because of it.

Ii gets helped out by Miiko often, such as borrowing her Fiat 500. The two shop together for antiques, with Miiko buying things she will never use, and later reselling them. Due to her need to help others, she is quite concerned about Ii's personality and nature.

name: Tomoe Emoto
description:
A college student that is friends with Mikoko. Tomoe attends Rokumeikan Private University with her friends. Similar to Ii, Tomoe has an inferiority complex and wishes to become someone like Mikoko. Furthermore, she considers herself a "Defective Product," making Ii interested in learning more about her. 

Tomoe respects the boundaries of others, not pushing or pulling those boundaries. She will not open up to anyone, nor will she let others open up much to her. Contrary to this, Tomoe opens up more with Ii because they are similar in nature. She also was held back a year after being in a hospital for a long duration back in middle school. ~!On her 20th birthday, she was strangled to death after a birthday party was held with her friends and Ii. Mikoko ended up strangling her out of jealousy as Tomoe connected with Ii.!~

name: Neon Suzunashi
description: A part-timer at Enryaky Temple and close friend of Miiko, Neon is a calm and relatively casual woman. She has a great amount of life experience despite not having an education. Ii is uncomfortable around Neon, as she lectures him whenever they meet. Neon is also known to be a powerful fighter, and generally strong.

name: Sasaki Sasa
description:
A detective in the Kyoto Police Force and old friend of Jun Aikawa, Sasaki is a serious and business centered woman. When she needs information out of someone, she will get it through trickery if she must. Despite this, she does have empathy towards other during rough situations. Sasaki also has a partner to help her with detective work, the partner being Kazuhito Ikaruga.

As an old friend of Jun, she knows many tales about just how strong Humanity's Strongest is. The two talk from time to time, though usually they help each other out with their work. Sasaki ocassionally receives, often illegal, help from Jun with some cases.

name: Akiharu Usami
description:
A student of Rokumeikan Private University, Akiharu is a relatively carefree guy. He's been friends with Mikoko since highschool, and later becomes friends with Tomoe and Muimi. Muimi threatens him often, as he has a habit of forcing his opinions onto others. Ii forgets who Akiharu is, as Ii doesn't think he's memorable. Ii describes him as looking like a relatively normal-looking guy that wears urban fashion.

~!After the second strangulation, Akiharu conversed with Ii and figured he'd likely be next. The next day, he was found strangled to death. Ii believes that Akiharu may have figured out the mystery and accepted his friends despite their flaws.!~

Though he never gets a design in the main series, he gets one in 240 gakuen, a crossover manga featuring characters from Nisio's novel series.

name: Muimi Atemiya
description: Best friend of Mikoko and college student at Rokumeikan Private University. Muimi is a "bad girl" that appears rough and radiates a delinquent aura. She has smoked since elementary school, but has made a point to not smoke when non-smokers are around. Muimi also scolds Akiharu out of rage when he says something stupid, which is often. Muri Atemiya is her younger sister. ~!Muimi is very close to Mikoko, so much so that she is willing to kill for her sake. After Mikoko dies, Muimi takes it in to her hands to murder Ii, but she fails when Ii's knight in shining armor, Hitoshiki Zerozaki, saves him. After the failed murder, she kills Akiharu because it was all over. Ii later confronts Muimi, and ends up warping her mind into how wrong she really is, leading to her being suicidal and borderline insane.!~

name: Kazuhito Ikaruga
description: A detective of the Kyoto Police Force and partner of Sasaki. Kazuhito is described by Ii as being a strange man wearing a suit. He is likely shrewd and clever, as he was able to trick Ii to get information out of him.

name: Lelouch Lamperouge
description:
__Nationality:__ Britannian __Height:__ 178 - 183 cm __Relatives:__ Nunnally Lamperouge __Allegiance:__ Order of the Black Knights __Position:__ Order of the Black Knights Leader __Knightmare Frame:__ Burai, Gawain, Shinkiro, Sutherland
Lelouch is a student of Ashford Academy high school, where he is a member of its student council. A brilliant thinker who is quite talented at chess, he lives with his younger sister, Nunnally, with their maid, [Sayoko Shinozaki](https://anilist.co/character/1807), at a house situated within the compounds of Ashford Academy, where they are looked after by the Ashford family. Lelouch is soon swept into the conflict between the Britannia Empire and the pockets of resistance which oppose it when he accidentally boards a truck being used by Japanese resistance operatives. Within the truck is a capsule holding [C.C.](https://anilist.co/character/1111), who sacrifices herself to save him from the military forces trying to recapture her. When it seems as if her sacrifice was pointless, C.C. suddenly touches his hand and offers him the "Power of the King", the mythical power of Geass. The Geass manifests itself in him as the power of absolute obedience, which allows him to make people obey his orders without question. With his new power, Lelouch begins his rebellion against the Empire, forming the Order of the Black Knights and takes up the identity of Zero to lead them, becoming a revolutionary and gaining popular support amongst the people. ~!Lelouch is the son of the Emperor of Britannia, Charles zi Britannia, and the late Imperial Consort Marianne vi Britannia, making Lelouch the eleventh prince of the Britannian Imperial Family.!~

name: C.C.
description:
**Height:** 167 cm
**Allegiance:** The Black Knights

C.C. is apparently immortal, healing from any wound (implied to include beheading) with enough time. She also doesn't age. Apart from her immortality, C.C. can bestow people with the power of Geass, which manifests differently in each person but generally carries the ability to affect the minds of those it is used on in some way. The Geass sigil glows on her forehead whenever she manifests this power, and she has a similar scar on her left breast. It is hinted that many more like her exist, as shown in her memories of many children with similar sigils, and she suggests that the power has precipitated bloody conflicts in the past. Her powers caught the interest of Britannia, who imprisoned her for experimentation purposes.

name: Shirley Fenette
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5'9")

Shirley Fenette is a typical, all-around nice girl who is exceptionally friendly and loves her friends. She is a member of the swimming club. She admits to being infatuated with [Lelouch](https://anilist.co/character/417/Lamperouge-Lelouch) since his enrollment on campus, but finds it extremely hard to get his attention. She has a habit of jumping to conclusions before people can explain things to her, particularly when Lelouch is concerned.

name: Kallen Stadtfeld
description:
__Height:__ 173 cm (5'8")  

A Britannian-Eleven girl, who believes herself to be a Japanese person at heart.

Before the Britannia Empire conquered Area 11, Kallen's original name was Karen Kouzuki. She comes from a prestigious family and attends the Ashford Academy where she receives outstanding grades while serving as a member of its Student Council. When away from the Academy, she fights as an anti-Britannian operative. Also, Kallen helped organize the Black Knights.

Her brother, [Naoto Kouzuki](https://anilist.co/character/1123/Kouzuki-Naoto), with whom she had a deep connection, was a former leader of her resistance cell before his death.  Both Kallen's stepmother, a Britannian, and biological mother live with her in the same house, but her biological mother is employed as a maid and is often mistreated by both her stepmother and Kallen herself. After her biological mother is arrested for using Refrain (a fictional drug which lets people think they're reliving the past), Kallen changes her views and decides to fight against the Britannian Empire not only for her brother, but to fulfill her new wish for a world in which she can live happily with her biological mother.

Frail and meek, this aspect of Kallen's character was used as a public front to mask her true nature as well as hide her involvement in the resistance.  Kallen leads a double life as a normal Britannian student and as a member of a guerrilla resistance group against Britannia, which is later reformed into the Order of the Black Knights by [Lelouch Lamperouge](https://anilist.co/character/417/Lamperouge-Lelouch). In school, she portrays herself as a weak-bodied high school student who obeys all of the formalities, and goes by her Britannian name of Stadtfeld. However, her personality changes in to a very strong-willed and forceful one when she acts as a resistance fighter.

As a running gag, Kallen ends up nude or immodestly dressed in front of other people on numerous occasions: Lelouch sees her naked after she pulls back a shower curtain in surprise in the third episode, [Suzaku](https://anilist.co/character/559/Kururugi-Suzaku) sees her bathing under a waterfall when they are stranded on Kaminejima, she is forced to dress in an immodest bunny costume at the start of the second season (to plant a tracking device on Lelouch), and she walks in on a meeting between [C.C.](https://anilist.co/character/1111/CC) and the Chinese ambassadors wearing only a towel when intending to complain about the previous situation to C.C. (claiming that the operation would've gone faster if C.C. was wearing the outfit).

name: Suzaku Kururugi
description:
__Height:__ 176 cm (5'9")         
__Nationality:__ Japanese         
__Known Relatives:__ Genbu Kururugi (father, deceased), Kaguya Sumeragi (cousin)
__Knightmare Frame:__ Lancelot and Lancelot Albion

Lelouch's childhood friend and son of Japan's last prime minister. After Britannia's takeover of Japan, Suzaku joins the Britannia Army and becomes an Honorary Britannian. He agrees with Zero (Lelouch in disguise, unknown to Suzaku) with his assertion that the Britannia Empire is not worth serving, but nevertheless wishes to implement changes and improvements from within the empire, all the while trying not to lose sight of his goals lest his father's death have been in vain. He has a strong sense of justice and is the only one known to be able to pilot the elite Britannian Knightmare Frame, Lancelot. He always keeps with him a broken pocket watch, a memento of his deceased father.

name: Jeremiah Gottwald
description: An elite Knightmare Frame pilot and a Purist, who is deeply concerned with the Purists' supremacy - enough to use Suzaku as a scapegoat for both avenging Clovis' death and reinforcing the Purists' superiority in Area 11. Initially, he held the rank of Margrave in Area 11's military hierarchy. After Clovis' murder, Jeremiah takes upon the role of Area 11's Acting-Consul, but upon the Zero fiasco, Jeremiah falls into disgrace (due to his incomprehensible actions caused by Lelouch's geass), is targeted for termination by his fellow Purist officers, demoted to the rank of a mere Knightmare Frame pilot and referred mockingly as Orange or Orange-Kun by both his superiors and his fellow knightmare pilots.    ~!In the second season he came back as a machine-like man having the ability to use Geass Canceller. At the end of episode 13 it is seen that he joins Zero's side after revealing that on the day Empress Marianne was killed, he attempted to rescue her but failed. He came back as a member of the Knightmare Frame pilot to atone for his inability to rescue her. !~

name: Cornelia li Britannia
description:
Cornelia is the second princess of the Britannia Imperial Family and, as such, [Lelouch](https://anilist.co/character/417/Lamperouge-Lelouch)'s half-sister. She is extremely skilled in Knightmare Frame combat and completed the establishment of Area 18 shortly before arriving in Area 11. Cornelia is the Chief General of the Imperial Army. ​She pilots a customized Gloucester Knightmare Frame and has her own circle of devoted officers.

As a child, she appeared to have doted upon her younger sister [Euphemia](https://anilist.co/character/1114/li-Britannia-Euphemia); as a result, Euphemia is Cornelia's only known weak spot.

name: Lloyd Asplund
description: Lloyd Asplund is an earl of the Britannian nobility and the developer of the elite Knightmare Frame Lancelot. To keep from being reminded of the fragility of human lives and friendship, Lloyd immerses himself in science and has come to view people as nothing more than tools — he regards Suzaku, for example, as a mere component of the machine that he pilots. He has a tendency to mock others and is often rebuked for this behavior by Cécile Croomy, his assistant. Prior to joining the military, he attended the Imperial Colchester Institute. Lloyd's research organization, Camelot is an irregular division of the Britannian Military and has been granted permission by Prince Schneizel to operate outside the command structure and regulations of the regular Britannian armed forces.  Rakshata refers to Lloyd as the Earl of Pudding, as pudding is his favorite food. ~! He is engaged to wed Milly Ashford in the first season, having agreed to the union mostly in hope that he might obtain the designs of the Knightmare Frame Ganymede. As such, he is forced into doing nice things for her by Suzaku, though Milly breaks off the engagement after she graduates.!~

name: Nunnally Lamperouge
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3") - 164 cm (5'4")

She is [Lelouch](https://anilist.co/character/417/Lamperouge-Lelouch)'s younger sister who is wheelchair-bound due to old bullet wounds on her legs, and blind due to psychological trauma. Lelouch believes that she may be able to see again someday. They live in Kururugi Residence where she first met [Suzaku Kururugi](https://anilist.co/character/559/Kururugi-Suzaku).

~!After Britannia invades Japan, Lelouch hides their identity in fear of their safety and changes their surname to Lamperouge. They then seek help from [Marianne](https://anilist.co/character/1129/vi-Britannia-Marianne)'s old allies, the Ashford family, who kept their identity a secret and allows the two siblings to live in a building on campus to accommodate her disabilities. Nunnally attends Ashford Academy's middle school and is friends with Lelouch's classmates, particularly with [Shirley](https://anilist.co/character/1120/Fenette-Shirley). She is very kindhearted and calls the Elevens "Japanese people".!~

name: Villetta Nu
description:
An elite Knightmare Frame pilot and a Purist, who appears to be more collected than [Jeremiah](https://anilist.co/character/1113/Gottwald-Jeremiah) in battle. She was one of the first to have been under the power of Geass' influence and is one of the few still loyal to Jeremiah even after his fall in disgrace.

~!When [Lelouch](https://anilist.co/character/417/Lamperouge-Lelouch) leaves to attack the Geass Order, Villetta goes to the Chinese Federation to confront [Ohgi](https://anilist.co/character/1115/Oogi-Kaname), intending to kill him to eliminate her links to the Elevens. She hesitates when Ohgi admits his love for her. She is captured after an altercation with [Sayoko](https://anilist.co/character/1807/Shinozaki-Sayoko), but is eventually released and leads Ougi to believe Zero cannot be trusted. She remains with the Black Knights following this. It is revealed that she is pregnant with Ohgi's child and she remains on Horai Island when the Black Knights depart to battle Lelouch. At the end of the series Villetta marries Ohgi.!~

name: Rolo Lamperouge
description:
Rolo is introduced in the second season as [Lelouch](https://anilist.co/character/417/Lamperouge-Lelouch)'s younger brother, ~!but is actually an assassin placed there by the Britannian Emperor under orders to kill him should he ever recover any memories of being Zero.!~  

Rolo is unsociable and reserved, unlike his older brother, a trait which does not gain him many friends at school. ~!While working with the Britannian Secret Intelligence Service, he is aloof and doesn't seem very interested. While Rolo puts up a front of being withdrawn, this exterior hides a ruthless and detached killer who will do whatever it takes to complete his mission.  Despite his attitude towards the mission, Rolo is devoted to Lelouch.!~ He often stays in the background and simply listens and isn't afraid to be very blunt about their faults.  Lelouch's year without memories show him and Rolo quite happy, particularly when Lelouch gives him a heart-shaped musical locket as a birthday present, which he keeps attached to his cellphone. His attachment to the locket is such that he refuses to return it even when Lelouch tries to reclaim it.

~!It is also clear that he has also been heavily affected by his time with Lelouch. Because of this, he is easily manipulated into believing that Lelouch cares for him and thus follows his orders without question.!~

name: Milly Ashford
description:
Milly Ashford is the granddaughter of the school superintendent, Ruben K. Ashford, and president of the Student Council. 

Milly enjoys teasing [Shirley](https://anilist.co/character/1120/Fenette-Shirley) and is eager to discover [Lelouch's](https://anilist.co/character/417/Lamperouge-Lelouch) weaknesses — enough so to rally the entire school into chasing after [Arthur](https://anilist.co/character/48473/Arthur) when she suspects the cat to hold something precious to him.

~!Milly is aware of Lelouch's identity as a former prince of Britannia, her family having supported [Empress Marianne](https://anilist.co/character/1129/vi-Britannia-Marianne). In the second picture drama special included on the DVD release, her grandfather and [Nina](https://anilist.co/character/1124/Einstein-Nina)'s grandfather are said to have worked on the Io and Ganymede Knightmare Frames together. Marianne's assassination led to the family's nobility status being stripped. The Ashfords arrange for Milly to marry [Earl Lloyd Asplund](https://anilist.co/character/1130/Asplund-Lloyd) to restore it. After the events of the first season, Milly remains a student on campus because she failed her examinations, although it is noted that she did so on purpose to remain on campus with her friends. She eventually earns enough credits to graduate and becomes a weather forecaster on the local TV news. She also breaks off her engagement with Lloyd. !~

name: Rakshata Chawla
description:
**Height:** 182 cm (6'0")

Rakshata Chawla is an Indian scientist and the head of the Black Knights' research and development team. She has extensive experience in medical cybernetics, and appears to have been an academy acquaintance of Lloyd Asplund and Cécile Croomy. Rakshata is not fond of speaking of the past, but it is known that she studied at the Imperial Colchester Institute. She is fairly laid back in most situations, usually seeing laying on a couch when not actively working (one is even installed on the bridge of the Black Knights' flagship, the Ikaruga), and is never seen without her tobacco pipe. She affectionately refers to her technological creations as her "children" and treats them as such. She is visibly enraged, a contrast to her normal demeanor, upon learning that Lloyd and Cécile modified her Knightmare without her consent (they are kind enough to credit her for the design, though). Upon the formation of the UFN and the reorganization of the Black Knights as its military force, Rakshata is designated as the Chief of Science, similar to her previous position within the Black Knights.  Rakshata is the creator of the Guren Mk-II and its radiant wave surger weapon. She also developed the Gefjun Disturber, a force field generator that disables all sakuradite-powered technology within its area of effect. This includes Knightmares, though by the second season newer models have countermeasures added to negate the Disturber's effect; only fifth-generation or older Knightmares remain vulnerable. In addition, the field blocks the motion of hadrons, radio waves, and microwaves. This renders anything within the field invisible to radar, and can aid in the blooming of hadron-based beam weaponry. It is named after the Norse goddess of chastity Gefjun.

name: Schneizel el Britannia
description:
**Height:** 200 cm (6'7")

Schneizel el Britannia is the Second Prince of the Britannian Imperial Family and the Prime Minister of the Holy Britannian Empire.

name: Kaguya Sumeragi
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm (5'5")

Kaguya Sumeragi is the young head mistress of the Kyōto House, and a supporter of the Black Knights. She is the representative of Sumeragi Concern, a large conglomerate founded by the Sumeragi House.   Despite her age and physique, she possesses a strong will and is highly influential amongst the Houses. Kaguya has admired Zero since his debut, and wishes to have his hand in marriage. Nothing anyone says contrary to this desire seems to faze her, including the suggestion that Zero might be sleeping with other women, to which she responds "A true hero enjoys physical pleasures," and proceeds to suggest that she, Kallen, and C.C. are Zero's harem.   Kaguya met Lelouch and Nunnally during their childhood at the Kururugi Shrine, and is Suzaku's cousin. She is the only living member of the Kyōto House following the Black Rebellion, having managed to escape to the Chinese Federation until Zero's return one year later. With the execution of Kirihara and the other members of Kyōto House, Kaguya states that she and Suzaku are the only remaining members left of the six clans of Kyōto.   With the formation of the United Federation of Nations, she is made the Supreme Council Chairwoman and the representative of the United State of Japan.   She is named after Kaguya, the main character of what is considered to be the oldest Japanese folktale.

name: Xingke Li
description: Li briefly appeared in episode 23 of season one and made his full debut in the first episode of R2. Li is a member of the Chinese Federation. He possesses a sword, which he always carries with him. He is also fiercely loyal to the Empress, a trait not shared by any of his superiors. It seems that part of his goal is to reestablish the throne of China as the clear authority, as the current Empress is the head of a puppet government, with eunuchs holding actual power in the country.  Li was formerly a bodyguard for the influential eunuch Gaohai, and accompanied him when he was sent by the Federation as a consul to the Britannian colony Area 11. They arrive right as the Order of the Black Knight's operation to recover Zero began. The Black Knights succeed in their mission and Zero orders the Knights to head to the Chinese Embassy for protection.
