description: An elven mage who is said to possess knowledge about nearly every magic that exists. She was Flamme's master. She founded the Continental Magic Association around 20 years before Himmel's death. First-class mages get the privilege of meeting her and can ask for any magic they desire.

name: Denken
description: Denken is an imperial mage of the second-class. In his youth he belonged to an army but became an imperial mage after winning a power struggle. Often calm and calculating, however he still has a fire burning within despite his old age. He saw [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754/Frieren) as his motivation to become a mage. ~!Becomes a first-class mage after the examination.!~

name: Methode
description: A mage that can use restraint and mental manipulation magic. Good at detecting mana and can use simple recovery magic.

name: Sense
description: First-class mage that is proctoring the Second Exam of the First Class Mage Examination. She is a solemn person who rarely speaks.

name: Wirbel
description: Second-class mage and the leader of the eighth party during the first stage of the First Class Mage Exam. He is the captain of the Northern Magic Corps and is thus a very experienced mage. Specializes in magic that restrains the opponent when their body is in full-view.

name: Macht
description:
Macht is a demon and a member of the Seven Sages of Destruction that directly serve the Demon King. He wishes to understand human emotions and find a solution for humans and demons to coexist.

He strives for this goal by utilizing inhumane methods.

name: Lawine
description: Lawine is a third-class mage in the Second Party of the First Class Mage Examinations. She specializes in manipulating ice.

name: Aura
description:
Aura is one of the Seven Sages of Destruction directly serving the Demon King. 

~!She later was killed by [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754/Frieren) after being commanded to kill herself using her own Auserlese.!~

name: Land
description: Second-class mage in the Fourth Party of the First Class Mage Examination. He specializes in illusion magic.

name: Kanne
description: Kanne is a third-class mage who graduated from the Academy of Magic. She is childhood friends and classmates with [Lawine](https://anilist.co/character/293727), and the two entered the first-class mage exam together. In the first stage of the exam, she was paired with Lawine and [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754).

name: Laufen
description: A third-class mage. Specializes in magic that makes her move at high speed. Treats [Denken](https://anilist.co/character/246058/Denken) as her grandfather.

name: Kraft
description: He is an elf that Frieren's group meets in a cabin in the mountains. He's a monk and believed to be the last elf alive until meeting Frieren.

name: Genau
description: First-class mage who was a proctor for the first examination.

name: Linie
description: Linie is a Demon working under [Aura](https://anilist.co/character/219110/Aura). Under Aura's instruction, she was sent to assist [Lügner](https://anilist.co/character/316985/Lgner) alongside [Draht](https://anilist.co/character/316987/Draht) to perform negotiations with [Graf Granat](https://anilist.co/character/318147/Granat-Hakushaku).

name: Minami no Yuusha
description: The Hero of the South is a Hero who fought on the front lines against the demons for mankind before Himmel met Frieren. He was said to be mankind's strongest.

name: Stoltz
description: Stark's older brother, referred to as the strongest warrior in the village.

name: Makio Koudai
description: A 35-year-old novelist who lives alone. She is deeply introverted, and has not communicated with her relatives for a long time due to arguments with her [mother](https://anilist.co/character/387235) and [sister](https://anilist.co/character/363293). Took in her sister's orphaned daughter, [Asa](https://anilist.co/character/189957).

name: Asa Takumi
description: After the passing away of her parents, she was adopted by her [Aunt Makio](https://anilist.co/character/171138). She now faces the hardship of adapting to a new environment, while sorting the emotions within herself.

name: Shingo Kasamachi
description: [Makio's](https://anilist.co/character/171138) friend and ex-boyfriend.

name: Emiri Nara
description: [Asa's](https://anilist.co/character/189957/Asa-Takumi) classmate and best friend. ~!Asa eventually learns that Emiri is a lesbian and that Emiri is dating [a girl](https://anilist.co/character/393115) who attends the same preparatory classes.!~

name: Nana Daigo
description: [Makio's](https://anilist.co/character/171138/Koudai-Makio) friend from her days at school.

name: Kazunari Touno
description: [Asa's](https://anilist.co/character/189957/Asa-Takumi) guardianship supervisor.

name: Minori Koudai
description: [Asa's](https://anilist.co/character/189957/) deceased mother. [Makio's](https://anilist.co/character/171138/) older sister.

name: Chiyo Morimoto
description: A first-year student acquainted with both [Asa](https://anilist.co/character/189957) and [Emiri](https://anilist.co/character/363290), who aspires to be a doctor. ~!She discovers a scandal involving the medical school she was applying to, and reacts angrily.!~

name: Michiko Nara
description: [Emiri's](https://anilist.co/character/363290/) mother.

name: Kotoko
description: Makio's friend from her days at school.

name: Motsu
description: Makio's friend from her days at school.

name: Shouko
description: ~![Emiri's](https://anilist.co/character/363290/) girlfriend.!~

name: Kyouko Koudai
description: Minori and Makio's mother. Asa's grandmother.

name: Violet Evergarden
description:
__Height:__ 161 cm

Violet is described as a very beautiful young woman, being almost doll-like in appearance, with light-blue eyes, a fair complexion, and a slender frame. She is noted for her womanly semblance. She has waist-length golden hair with locks that frame her face. She either has her hair untied, in a low ponytail, or, after becoming a Doll, pulled up into two braided buns with two red ribbons. Due to losing her arms in the war, Violet received maneuverable prosthetic arms made of adamant silver. After the end of the war and on normal occasions, Violet is often seen wearing a white blouse, a green skirt and a pair of heeled brown boots.

~!Growing up as an orphaned child soldier in the army who was treated as a mere tool, Violet was not educated like a regular human being and did not understand human feelings well. She was raised and grew up as a person who had feelings, but couldn't perceive or express them. For this reason, she could be mistaken as emotionless, or apathetic. Even before she was found and taken into the army, she couldn't speak or understand speech, only understanding orders to kill. She did not possess any sense of right or wrong from the start; she didn't understand what could be considered righteous or erroneous. She merely chased after the adults who gave her orders. She followed the idea of "kill or be killed," thus she could kill countless people without feeling guilt or remorse. She did anything that was asked of her and always followed orders, which was a trait from her life as a soldier. Even after the war ended and she was discharged from the military, Violet had a habit of using words back from her life as a soldier; saluting, disliking being defenseless, and doing tasks without taking any breaks. She also continued to think of herself as a "tool" and believed that it would be appropriate to discard her if she can no longer be used as a weapon.!~ 

Violet is also aloof, expressionless and is said to have the attitude and the presence of a doll. Her expressions are mostly deadpan, so it is hard to tell her mood changes. This is why she sometimes has trouble expressing her own feelings and comes off as expressionless, which makes it difficult to get through her, but she will give a smile from time to time. Through her work as a Doll where she helps people write heartfelt letters, she slowly learns about human emotions, leading her to become more skilled at writing letters and conveying her clients' feelings, as well as becoming understanding of others. She is proven to be a good listener and someone who always thinks about other people's happiness.

name: Gilbert Bougainvillea
description:
Gilbert Bougainvillea is a character in the Violet Evergarden series. He is a major in the Leidenschaftlich army who values Violet more than anything, seeing her as a human being rather than a tool.

~!Violet was "given" to Gilbert as a gift to commemorate his promotion, having being promoted to a major in light of his wartime achievements and expectations from his bloodline. Dietfried, not wanting to take care of Violet, pushed this task to his younger brother. Gilbert then decided to enlist her on a militant unit that he had been appointed to take overall command of in his promotion to major. He later received permission to conduct private experiments at the training grounds as to whether Violet could be officially classified as a "weapon."!~

name: Benedict Blue
description: Benedict Blue (ベネディクト・ブルー, Benedikuto Burū?) is a character in the Violet Evergarden series. He is a postman working at the CH Postal Company. He has known Hodgins since before the company's establishment and has had a brusque attitude towards him since he started working there.

name: Cattleya Baudelaire
description: Cattleya Baudelaire is a character in the Violet Evergarden series. Being a figurehead Auto Memories Doll who works for the CH Postal Company, Cattleya never stops being requested and often takes on clients with love troubles. She works alongside [Violet](https://anilist.co/character/90169/Evergarden-Violet) and has been close with [Hodgins](https://anilist.co/character/124799/Hodgins-Claudia) since before the company was established, joining as one of its initial employees.

name: Claudia Hodgins
description:
A former army commander. He founded the CH postal company and serves as president.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Iris Cannary
description:
Iris Cannary is a character in the Violet Evergarden series. A rookie Auto Memories Doll with an unyielding spirit who works at CH Postal Company, Iris admires young working women and is enthusiastic about quickly making a name for herself in the industry.

~!As a child, she became friends with a boy named Emonn Snow and the two were very close. Iris was in love with him, and she had also supposedly convinced herself that her feelings were reciprocated. Because of that, she confessed to him before they graduated school, but he rejected her confession. The emotional pain caused by Emonn's rejection was what caused her to leave her hometown to become an Auto Memories Doll.!~

name: Dietfried Bougainvillea
description:
Dietfried Bougainvillea is a naval captain in the navy and [Gilbert](https://anilist.co/character/124790/)'s older brother. He was the one who found [Violet](https://anilist.co/character/90169/) and made her into Gilbert's "weapon" on his promotion to a major in the army.

(Source: Violet Evergarden wiki)

name: Erica Brown
description:
Erica Brown is a character in the Violet Evergarden series. She is an Auto Memories Doll who has been working at the CH Postal Company for a while. She is not good at communicating and isn't confident in her work.

~!Erica is an anime-original character.!~

name: Ann Magnolia
description: Ann Magnolia is a character in the Violet Evergarden series and the protagonist of the second chapter of the first volume of the light novel. She is a young girl who lives with her terminally ill [mother](https://anilist.co/character/223026/Clara-Magnolia).

name: Yuris
description: A boy who asked Violet to write a letter." I'm frustrated that I can't be honest with my family and my best friend Lucas."

name: Clara Magnolia
description: She is the mother of [Ann](https://anilist.co/character/213148/Ann-Magnolia), who had a terminal illness and predicted that her fate was close.

name: Lucas
description: Julis' best friend. They used to play together a lot.

name: Daisy Magnolia
description: The granddaughter of [Ann Magnolia](https://anilist.co/character/213148/Ann-Magnolia), whom Violet met when she was asked to write letters to by her [mother](https://anilist.co/character/223026/Clara-Magnolia). After Ann's death, she finds an old letter that has been kept in a safe place and traces the achievements of the automatic memoir doll, [Violet Evergarden](https://anilist.co/character/90169/Violet-Evergarden).

name: Shion
description: [Yuris’](https://anilist.co/character/209728) little brother.

name: Shichou
description: The Mayor of Leiden.

name: Ashito  Aoi
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm
__Year:__ 1st Year
__ Jersey Number:__ 33
__Position:__ FW ~!DF!~

Ashito is a brash and naïve kid from a remote prefecture called Ehime who has dreams of becoming the world's greatest forward. He currently lives in Tokyo as a first year high school student and member of Tokyo City Esperion FC.

name: Hana Ichijou
description:
__Height:__ 157 cm

Hana Ichijou is the younger step-sister of [Tatsuya Fukuda](https://anilist.co/character/133817), the coach of Tokyo City Esperion FC Youth. She has been a football fan since she was very young. She was especially a fan of Fukuda, even before their parents married. Hana has a deep knowledge of nutrition as she aspires to become a sports surgeon. She uses that knowledge to make meal plans for the players, notably [Ashito](https://anilist.co/character/133818/Ashito--Aoi) and [Kuribayashi](https://anilist.co/character/162034/Haruhisa-Kuribayashi).

name: Nagisa Akutsu
description:
__Height:__183cm
__Year:__ 2nd Year
__Jersey Number:__ 4
__Position:__ DF

He is the only player from the class one year above [Ashito](https://anilist.co/character/133818/Aoi-Ashito) to have passed the tryouts. A defender with the skill to earn a starting spot on the first team as early as his freshman year, he is stoic and hot-tempered, often clashing with his teammates. He took a dislike to Ashito after facing him during the tryouts, and even after joining the team, he picks fights with him at every opportunity, trying to take him down.

name: Tatsuya Fukuda
description:
__Height:__ 176 cm

Director of Tokyo City Esperion FC Youth, and Head Coach of the A Team. He was born in Ehime, Japan but moved to Tokyo to attend high school. He joined Tokyo City Esperion FC of the J-League (Japan's top professional football league) at the age of 18 and became a regular at 20. At 23 he was signed by the Spanish club Sabadell FC who had been recently promoted to Spain's top division, La Liga. A while later, his mother married [Hana Ichijou](https://anilist.co/character/162035/Hana-Ichijou)'s father and he became her step-brother. Fukuda happens to meet [Ashito](https://anilist.co/character/133818/Ashito--Aoi) in Ehime, discovers his talent, and invites him to try out for Esperion Youth.

name: Yuuma Motoki
description:
__Height:__ 174 cm
__Year:__ 1st Year
__Jersey Number:__ 29
__Position:__ FW

A first-year high school student and member of Tokyo City Esperion FC. He was promoted from the Esperion Junior Youth team. He plays the forward position, and even though he is a first-year, he has the ability to be a first team regular. He has known [Anri](https://anilist.co/character/272621/Anri-Kaido), the daughter of the president of Kaido Denki, Esperion's main sponsor, since childhood, but it seems that she hates him.

name: Eisaku Otomo
description:
__Height:__ 163 cm
__Year:__ 1st Year
__Jersey Number:__ 30
__Position:__ MF

A first year student and midfielder playing for Tokyo City Esperion FC's Youth Team. He’s the team’s mood-maker, always looking out for everyone. He gets incredibly nervous before matches, but once the game starts, he’s a midfielder who controls the team with cool, level-headed judgment.

 In everyday life, he’s a bit of a joker who tries desperately to impress girls, but his efforts fall flat (despite his best efforts).

name: Haruhisa Kuribayashi
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm
__ Year:__ 2nd Year
__Jersey Number:__ 10
__Position:__ MF

Kuribayashi is considered a football genius, making his professional debut at age 16 for Tokyo City Esperion FC of the J-1 League. He also plays for Japan's Under-20 National Team.

name: Keiji Togashi
description:
__Height:__ 187 cm
__Year:__ 1st Year
__Jersey Number:__ 31
__Position:__ DF

Togashi is a first year high school student and member of Tokyo City Esperion FC Youth. He is a hot-headed and passionate kid who came to Esperion after leaving his motorcycle gang behind. His dark black hair is regularly styled in a classic biker-yankee pompadour.

name: Noriko Aoi
description: The mother of [Ashito](https://anilist.co/character/133818/Ashito--Aoi) and [Shun](https://anilist.co/character/239920/Shun-Aoi), and the owner of the family's store. She currently resides in Ehime with Shun while Ashito is away in Tokyo.

name: Jun Asari-Marchs
description:
**Height:** 174 cm
__Year:__ 1st Year
__Jersey Number:__ 25
__Positon:__ SB

Jun is a cool, blond, beautiful boy with an English father and Japanese mother. He is a side back who is good at attacking.

name: Anri Kaido
description: She's the daughter of one of Tokyo City Esperion's sponsors' CEO, Denji Kaido and an aspiring football coach.

name: Souichirou Tachibana
description:
__Height:__ 173 cm
__Year:__ 1st Year
__Jersey Number:__ 28
__Position:__ FW

A first year student playing as forward for Tokyo City Esperion FC.

name: Kenta Yoshitsune
description:
__Height:__ 181 cm
__Year:__ 3rd Year
__Jersey Number:__11
__Position:__ Forward

Captain of the Tokyo City Esperion FC Youth A team. He is a forward and last year's top scorer in the U-18 Premier League. His soccer skills are overwhelming, but he has an elusive personality, speaking in a peculiar tone of voice and losing the end of words.

name: Nozomi Date
description:
**Height:** 178 cm

Head Coach of Tokyo City Esperion FC Youth B Team. He has been a close friend of [Fukuda](https://anilist.co/character/133817/Tatsuya-Fukuda) since their days as J-League players.

name: Ren Kitano
description:
__Height__: 170 cm
__Uniform Number:__ 10 (Aomori); 7 (National Team)

Starting midfielder and main playmaker of both Aomori Seiran High School and Japan's Under-18 National Team. Although just a first-year high schooler, he has signed a preliminary professional contract with FC Kashima of the J-1 League, planning to join the team after high school.

name: Shun Aoi
description:
__Height:__ 180cm

Shun is a supporting character in [Ao Ashi](https://anilist.co/manga/107279/Aoashi/) and the main protagonist in its spin-off, [Ao Ashi: Brother Foot](https://anilist.co/manga/136600/Aoashi-Brotherfoot/). He is the oldest child of [Noriko](https://anilist.co/character/239921/Noriko-Aoi) and the older brother of [Ashito](https://anilist.co/character/133818/Ashito--Aoi), and he currently works a part-time job. Shun has recently been scouted and accepted to play soccer for the J-League team in their family's home prefecture, AC Ehime.

name: Ryuuichi Takeshima
description:
__Height:__ 171 cm
__Year:__ 1st Year
__Jersey Number:__ 27
__Position:__ DF

A promotee from the junior youth team. A rarity in the ultra-attacking Esperion team, a defender specialized in defense. He shares a conflict with [Togashi](https://anilist.co/character/253950/Togashi-Keiji), who has a different philosophy on soccer, alongside [Kuroda](https://anilist.co/character/253947/Kuroda-Kanpei).

name: Trepone Rufin
description:
__Uniform Number:__ 10

Starting forward for both Funabashi Academy and Japan's Under-18 National Team. He is this year's leading goalscorer in the U-18 Premier League. Tripone and his younger brother [Sammy](https://anilist.co/character/292938) are half-black, and they have faced many instances of bullying and discrimination due to their skin color. Fortunately, Tripone was welcomed by [Coach Natsume](https://anilist.co/character/284709) and his teammates at Funabashi. Finally in a supportive environment, Tripone was able to grow his talents and become one of his generation's best players.

name: Taira Nakamura
description:
**Height:** 176 cm
__Year:__ 2nd Year
__Jersey Number:__ 22
__Position:__  MF

He is one year older than Ashito and was promoted from the junior youth team. He is a midfielder who belongs to the second team. He has a caring personality and often gives advice to Ashito, who is less skilled, as a senior from the youth team. He is also well-liked by his teammates.

name: Kanpei Kuroda
description:
__Height:__ 161 cm
__Year:__ 1st Year
__Jersey Number:__ 26
__Position:__ MF

Promoted from Junior Youth. He usually has a laid-back, gentle, and approachable vibe, but he's a realist who prioritizes becoming a pro above all else.

name: Akitaka Shiba
description: Veteran player who has spent his entire 20-year professional career with Tokyo City Esperion FC. He has also appeared in two World Cups for Japan.

name: Demian Cant
description:
__Uniform Number:__ 10

Originally from Argentina, Demian is a Forward for FC Barcelona's U-18 team. He is being promoted to the Senior Team after the Al-Kass U-18 International Youth Cup. He is known as the future of FC Barcelona.

name: Youichi Kiriki
description:
**Height:** 168 cm
__Year:__ 2nd Year
__Jersey Number:__ 18
__Position:__ MF

He is one year older than Ashito and was promoted from the junior youth team. He is a midfielder with outstanding technique. He is a talented player who has been selected for the Japanese national team at various age levels, but he is not happy that he has always been seen as Kuribayashi's second-best player at Esperion since his junior youth days.

name: Aki Tsukishima
description: One of the youth team coaches at Tokyo City Esperion FC. He played for Esperion Youth as a teenager, eventually moving on to play for Oumiya Alanciano in the J1 League.

name: Enshin Akiyama
description:
__Height:__  185cm
__Year:__ 2nd Year
__Jersey Number:__ 16
__Position:__ GK


Starting goalkeeper for Tokyo City Esperion FC Youth A Team. Despite being a goalkeeper, he has the technique of a field player. Second-year high schooler.

name: Cheng Hua
description:
__Height:__ 190 cm - 185 cm (San Lang)

Hua Cheng is the deuteragonist and main love interest in Heaven Official's Blessing.

One of the Four Great Calamities, Hua Cheng is the most famed of the three Devastation-class Demons in the Ghost World, thus he is entitled the Ghost King. When he first emerged, he challenged 33 gods and won, making his name as the scourge of the Heavenly Officials overnight.

~!His most famous moniker, Crimson Rain Sought Flower, was attained during his early days as a supreme. After he annihilated [Qi Rong](https://anilist.co/character/261438/Qi-Rong)'s lair and causing blood rain to fall, he found a lone white flower struggling under the heavy rainfall. Until the downpour ceased, Hua Cheng stood by this flower and shielded it from the rain with his red umbrella.!~

~!Just like any other ghost, Hua Cheng's only weakness is his ashes. Hua Cheng's ashes were modelled into a diamond ring that he entrusted to [Xie Lian](https://anilist.co/character/149589/Xie-Lian). When asked if his ashes were sufficiently protected, he stated that if the hiding place of his ashes were to be destroyed, then he would no longer have any reason to exist and might as well disappear.!~

name: Lian Xie
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm
__Weapons:__ Ruoye, Fang Xin

Xie Lian is the main protagonist of the Chinese web novel _Heaven Official's Blessing_.

He was widely known throughout the Xian Le nation as the beloved yet strange prince. Never showing interest in what was considered normal for a prince, he simply declared, "I want to save the common people!" Through practice, hard work, and insight beyond his years, he perfected his cultivation and ascended to the Heavens at the age of 17. He owns a special silk band called Ruoye.

After multiple unfortunate events, he was twice banished from the Heavens. 800 years later, he returns for the third time with an immense crash.

name: Qingxuan Shi
description:
He is one of the Five Elemental Masters in the Heavenly Court. Since he is often worshiped as a female version of himself and often transforms into a woman, he was given the nickname.

He is the younger brother of the Shi Wudu and one of the Four Famous Tales - "The Young Lord Who Pours Wine" (少君倾酒).

name: Qing Mu
description:
Mu Qing is a supporting character in Heaven Official's Blessing.

Mu Qing is a Martial God who oversees the southwest. Eight hundred years ago, he was the personal attendant of Xie Lian. He abandoned the Prince to take care of his mother when Xie Lian descended from Heaven for the first time.

name: Xin Feng
description:
Feng Xin is a supporting character in Heaven Official's Blessing. 

Feng Xin is a Martial God who oversees the southeast. Eight hundred years ago, he was the imperial bodyguard of Xie Lian and later, the first general of the Crown Prince's Palace Hall.

name: Wen Ling
description: Lingwen is the foremost Civil Goddess in the Heavenly Court and one of the notorious Three Tumors.

name: Xuan He
description:
__Height:__ 189 cm

He Xuan is a ghost of Supreme rank and one of the Four Great Calamities. He bears the title Black Water Submerging Boats and his domain is the Black Water Demon Lair.

name: Yi Ming
description: Yi Ming is one of the Five Elemental Masters in the Heavenly Court.

name: Rong Qi
description:
Qi Rong is a Savage level ghost who is close to becoming a Supreme. Despite not being a ghost of the highest rank, he is still regarded as one of the Four Great Calamities, known as the Night-Touring Green Lantern.

He is the maternal cousin of Xie Lian and bore the title Prince Xiao Jing during his years as Xianle royalty.

(Source: Fandom Wiki)

name: Ming Pei
description: Pei Ming, titled as General Ming Guang, is the Martial God of the North with nine thousand temples dedicated to his palace. He is one of the Four Famous Tales: "The General Who Broke His Sword", as well as a member of The Three Tumors.

name: Banyue
description:
She was the Imperial Preceptor of the fallen Banyue kingdom. She was claimed a traitor by its people after allowing the invading army into the city.
~!She had first met Xie Lian over 200 years ago. He took care of her as she was an orphan as a child!~

name: Yao Fu
description: A Heavenly Official of the Middle Court and subordinate of Mu Qing. He often accompanied Xie Lian on his missions in the mortal realm alongside Nan Feng.

name: Yin Yu
description: Yin Yu is the former Martial God of the West ~!who was later banished from the Heavens and now works for Hua Cheng as a servant and assistant.!~ He also used to be the guardian of Quan Yizhen.

name: Feng Nan
description: A Heavenly Official of the Middle Court and subordinate of Feng Xin. He often accompanied Xie Lian on his missions in the mortal realm alongside Fu Yao.

name: Xiu Pei
description:
Xiu Pei is a Heavenly Official of the Middle Court and subordinate of Ming Pei. He appears in the first arc of the story.
He is a proud and composed young man. He takes his tasks as a Martial God seriously and isn't shown to be very emotional.
He holds deep respect and admiration for Ming Pei and is friendly toward Banyue and Lian Xie.
~!For 150 years before the start of the novel, he lured people into the Banyue Kingdom to be fed to the ghosts of the soldiers as a way to calm their resentment. As a Heavenly Official, with his every move watched, he could not directly kill the remaining ghosts of the soldiers in the Sinner's Pit. Instead, he descended as a traveling guide called A-Zhao and worked to cover up the massacre!~

name: Qianqiu Lang
description:
Lang Qianqiu is a god of the East and the last one alive of Yong'an Kingdom direct royal bloodline.

Former Xie Lian's student (who at the time took the position of Yong'an Guoshi) who wrongly, but for good reasons, accused him of massacre of his family and as revenge sticked down into three-lid coffing without knowledge he was immortal as a result of which Xie Lian spend there whole century. After more than 700 years it came out that the one responsible for whole event was An Le, Lang Qianqiu's best friend who betrayed him in the name of his native kingdom, Xian Le. The only one other known conspirator was Qi Rong, Xie Lian's own cousin.

(Source: Fandom Wiki)

name: Wu Jun
description:
Jun Wu is the Heavenly Emperor who presides over the Heavenly realm, as well as the oldest and most powerful Martial God.

~!It's later revealed that he is actually the ghost White No-Face, titled the White-Clothed Calamity, the eldest and most powerful of the Four Great Calamities. Centuries ago, he had great influence in the fall of the Xianle kingdom.!~

name: Yushi Huang
description:
__Height:__ 178cm

Yushi Huang, also known as Lord Rain Master, is one of the Elemental Masters in charge of rain and agriculture. She is also known as one of the Four Famous Tales, "The Princess Who Slit Her Throat".

_Source: Wiki_

name: Ji Xuan
description: A powerful female ghost of Savage rank and a former lover of Pei Ming.

name: Bai Wu Xiang
description: White No-Face, titled as the White-Clothed Calamity, is the eldest and most powerful of the Four Great Calamities. Centuries ago, he had great influence in the fall of the Xianle kingdom.

name: Lan Jian
description:
Former citizen of Xian Le Kingdom and member of a wealthy family, currently working as a prostitute in Ghost City.

~!After Xie Lian's first banishment for some time was Feng Xin's lover. Died pregnant with his child a few months before Xie Lian got banned from heaven for the second time. She and her unborn son existed as ghosts for at least the next eight centuries.!~

name: Zhu Tufu
description: Butcher Zhu is a boar butcher that resides in Ghost City and sells human meat at the market.

name: Levi
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3")

Squad Captain of the Special Operations Squad (known as Squad Levi) within the Survey Corps. He is known as humanity's strongest soldier. 

Levi is abrasive, blunt, and has a strong respect for structure and discipline. He is a clean-freak, demanding spotless cleanliness of himself, his equipment, and his environment. Rumors say he was involved in underground crime in his life before coming a soldier. Despite his emotionless and unfriendly demeanor, Levi cares deeply for his squad and greatly values human life.

name: Eren Yeager
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7") - 183 cm (6'0")
__Affiliation:__ 104th Trainees Squad, Survey Corps. 

Eren was born to [Carla](https://anilist.co/character/62475/Yeager-Carla) and [Grisha Yeager](https://anilist.co/character/62477/Yeager-Grisha) in Shiganshina District within the southern region of Wall Maria. He grew up in the town with his parents and foster sister [Mikasa](https://anilist.co/character/40881/Ackerman-Mikasa), who moved in with the Yeagers as a child. Eren spent most of his time with Mikasa and their mutual best friend [Armin Arlert](https://anilist.co/character/46494/Arlert-Armin), whom the pair often defended from neighborhood bullies.  

Eren is a passionate, determined, hardheaded, and impulsive young man. When they were children, Armin showed him a book depicting the wonders of the outside world. Eren grew to share Armin's curiosity of the world beyond the Walls and resolved to see it for himself. This dream inspired his admiration of the Survey Corps and his desire to join their ranks as soon as he became eligible for enrollment. 

When the Titans suddenly broke through Wall Maria into Shiganshina, Eren was forced to watch on as his mother became trapped under the rubble of their house and eaten by a titan. Forever changed from this event, Eren vows to kill every last titan.

name: Mikasa Ackerman
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7") - 176 cm (5'9½")
__Position:__ 104th Training Corps, Survey Corps
__Relatives:__ [Birth Mother](https://anilist.co/character/84341/Mikasa-no-Haha) (Deceased), [Birth Father](https://anilist.co/character/84339/Mikasa-no-Chichi) (Deceased), [Grisha Yaeger](https://anilist.co/character/62477/Grisha-Yeager) (Foster Father), [Carla Yaeger](https://anilist.co/character/62475/Carla-Yeager) (Foster Mother, Deceased), [Eren Yeager](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Eren-Yeager) (Foster Brother)

Mikasa is Eren Yaeger's foster sister and mutual childhood friend of [Armin Arlert](https://anilist.co/character/46494), living with the two of them in Shiganshina District within the southern region of Wall Maria. 

When she was young, her parents were killed by human traffickers, and she was kidnapped. Eren discovered this and helped her escape her captors. Later, Eren gave her his scarf, which she constantly wears and shares an emotional attachment to. She was adopted by the Yaeger family soon after. Because of these past events, Mikasa shares an unbreakable bond with Eren and lives to protect him, constantly worrying for Eren's well-being. After the Titans broke through Wall Maria and killed her and Eren's mother, she chose to follow Eren into the military to try and keep him safe from danger. 

Even as a child, Mikasa possessed impressive fighting skill and strength, and that skill was only honed further during her training.  Mikasa is considered a genius among all the army trainees and is incredibly skilled at combat and agility, to the point that she was known as the greatest soldier among the 104th Training Corps and graduated in first place. Though being among the best of the best, she remains humble and refrains from displaying arrogance. Ultimately, Mikasa's loyalty remains with Eren no matter the circumstance, with her only true desire being to live a peaceful life with him.

name: Armin Arlert
description:
__Height:__ 163 cm (5'4")
__Position:__ 104th Trainees Squad, Survey Corps
__Relatives:__ [Grandfather](https://anilist.co/character/84313/Armin-no-Ojiisan)

Armin is a young boy who was born and raised in the Shiganshina District within the walls, being childhood friends with both [Eren Yeager](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Eren-Yeager) and [Mikasa Ackerman](https://anilist.co/character/40881). After Wall Maria was breached, he chose to join Mikasa and Eren in joining the military, both to try to make a good and meaningful impact on the world, and to fulfill his dream of seeing the outside world.

Even when he was young, the naturally curious Armin has always had a deep fascination with the world beyond the Walls. As a child, he found and studied an illegal book about the outside world that was owned by his grandfather. He often shared the book and information contained in it with Eren Yeager, his best friend, and his dreams of seeing the world outside the walls. Armin was branded a heretic by other children for his unusual interest in the outside world and was thus frequently picked on. Too timid to defend himself, Armin would often rely on his friends Eren and Mikasa Ackerman to protect him from local bullies. This, coupled with his frail physique, was a deep shame for Armin, leading him to have poor self-esteem and to believe that he is a burden to others. Because of this, Armin has always been very eager to prove his worth, especially towards his close friends. 

Armin is known to be exceptionally loyal and selfless. He constantly worries for the safety of his friends, and he is always prepared to throw himself into dangerous situations to save them. Alongside his kindhearted nature and emotionally intelligence, Armin is a very analytical person. He likes to think deeply about situations and solve problems using his mind. These personality traits, in conjunction with his intelligence, good judgment, level headedness, ability to plan ahead, come up with creative ideas and to think outside the box, are what make him a great tactician. Although he may appear among the physically weakest of the 104th Training Corps, his incredible intelligence and strategic genius makes him an invaluable asset to any team.

name: Hange Zoe
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7")
__Affiliation:__ Survey Corps; Section Commander, Squad Leader.

Leader of the Survey Corps' Fourth Squad, Hange is also in charge of conducting research on Titans, and pursues this knowledge so passionately that they have become obsessed with Titans as a result. After originally holding a deep hatred for the creatures, Hange decided to take on a new outside-the-box approach to their research by letting go of their resentment towards Titans and approaching the test subjects with compassion. 

Hange is an energetic, freethinking and quirky scientist, with a unique way of conducting both themselves and their work. Hange is a genius outside of just Titan research too, using their brain to create weapons, tactical plans, and inventions for the benefit of humanity. As a leader, Hange is thoughtful of their comrades, and can easily figure out complex problems in order to create plans for their teammates to carry out.

name: Gabi Braun
description:
__Height__: 138 cm

Gabi Braun is an Eldian living in the Liberio internment zone and the cousin of [Reiner Braun](https://anilist.co/character/46484/Reiner-Braun). She is friends with her fellow warrior candidates [Udo](https://anilist.co/character/125663), [Zofia](https://anilist.co/character/125664/Zofia), and [Falco Grice](https://anilist.co/character/125660). 

Gabi is very passionate and head-strong, expressing her emotions and opinions without inhibition. She is also brave, possessing boundless determination, and willing to put her life on the line to complete a goal for a perceived greater good. However, these attributes can also make her somewhat overbearing and domineering. This causes her to be tactless at times, forcing her opinions on others and taking charge regardless of whether it was asked for or not. She mostly shows this side around her fellow Warrior candidates, considering herself their de facto leader to an extent, and even threatening to 'punish' them when they disagree with her. Nonetheless, she is friendly enough that they have no issue with spending their leisure time with her. Aside from her resolve and determination, Gabi is care-free even on the battlefield, making remarks about her cuteness and claiming her commander loves her too much to sacrifice her.

~!She is a Warrior candidate that is likely to inherit the Armored Titan.!~

name: Sasha Blouse
description:
__Initial Height:__ 168cm
__Affiliations__: 104th Cadet Corps, Survey Corps; Soldier
__Relatives__: [Artur Blouse](https://anilist.co/character/131281/Artur-Blouse) (Father), [Lisa Blouse](https://anilist.co/character/134952/Lisa-Blouse) (Mother)

Originally from Dauper, a remote and scarcely populated village of hunters located in a mountain forest in the southern area of Wall Rose, Sasha joined the military as a cadet of the 104th Training Corps, where she ranked 9th upon graduation. After graduating, she'd choose to enlist in the Scouting Regiment. 

Sasha is a friendly and fun-loving girl. She speaks with a local accent from her home village, but initially hid it out of embarrassment by using overly formal and polite speech. She is a constant food hoarder and is known to have an incredible appetite; eating provided her with considerable gratification and relief, especially during times of great stress, and food was often the only thing on her mind when at ease. Raised as an animal hunter, Sasha specializes in archery, horseback riding, and tracking, although her eccentricity and unconventional methods tend to make her a poor fit for group operations.

~!She later saves a child named [Kaya](https://anilist.co/character/132738/Kaya) from a titan attack, who her family ends up adopting.!~

name: Reiner Braun
description:
__Height__: 185 cm (6'1")

Member of the Survey Corps and former cadet of the 104th Training Corps. Reiner is a passionate and strong-willed young man with a strong sense of duty. He ranked 2nd in his training class upon graduation, finishing behind only [Mikasa](https://anilist.co/character/40881). His comrades have great trust in him, and he is stated to be the "big brother" of the 104th cadets.

name: Jean Kirstein
description:
__Height__: 175 cm (5'8")
__Relatives__: [Mother](https://anilist.co/character/131444/Jean-no-Haha)

Jean Kirschtein is a graduate of the 104th Cadet Corps, among whom he ranked 6th for his skills with ODM gear and ability to look at things through a more tactical lense. Jean hails from Wall Rose's Trost District, and joined the military with hopes of living a peaceful life within the walls as part of the Military Police. However, he would later find himself joining the Survey Corps after being convinced both by his close friend [Marco Bott's](https://anilist.co/character/62479/Marco-Bott) words, and after witnessing the death of several of his comrades.

Jean has a blunt personality. He holds no restraint when it comes to speaking his mind, even when he knows it would not be wise to do so or when it could spark conflict. Jean is also pragmatic: he has a strong aversion to exposing himself to dangerous situations. During his time as a cadet, Jean was extremely hot-headed, easily becoming frustrated and quick to resort to violence when pushed. Jean was also very cynical about defeating the Titans, believing that humanity has no chance against them and openly mocking more idealistic individuals like [Eren Yeager](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Eren-Yeager), and saw resisting the Titans as a hopeless cause. However, despite these things, and although he presents himself as self-centered, Jean places high value on the lives of his comrades, and is willing to risk his life to prevent countless more deaths from his comrades. Even with his shortcomings, Jean has shown himself to be a natural leader, being able to understand others and assess situations well because of his flaws, and proves capable of leading his fellow soldiers when they are left confused and without a plan.

name: Annie Leonhart
description:
__Height__: 153 cm (5")  

A member of the 104th Southern Division in the Cadet Corps. After graduating from the 104th, ranked 4th place in the top 10, she ends up joining the Military Police. She is roommates with [Hitch Dreyse](https://anilist.co/character/86017).

A stoic girl, Annie is considered to be an isolated, solitary type, being rarely seen smiling or socializing and often having an emotionless expression. She is apathetic and somnolent, with little desire to put in any effort into meaningless disciplines or activities. Nonetheless, what drives Annie more than anything is her desire for a normal life.

name: Krista Lenz
description:
__Height__: 145 cm (4'8")
__Affiliations__: 104th Trainees Squad, Survey Corps

Ranked tenth in the trainee class, Krista is a very shy and kind, caring person, often being described as a "goddess" or "angel" by her peers. She is good friends with [Ymir](https://anilist.co/character/71479/Ymir).

name: Zeke
description:
__Height__: 183 cm

Zeke is the current inheritor of the Beast Titan, and is considered by [Reiner Braun](https://anilist.co/character/46484/Reiner-Braun) to be the strongest Warrior, contrasting [Levi's](https://anilist.co/character/45627/Levi) title of "humanity's strongest soldier".

name: Pieck Finger
description:
__Height__: 155 cm

Pieck is an Eldian who serves as one of Marley's Warriors. She is shown to be somewhat sweet and kind, consistently shown to care about her fellow Warriors and the Warrior candidates. ~!She is the current inheritor of the Cart Titan.!~

name: Ymir
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm (5'7")
__Affiliations:__ 104th Trainees Squad, Scouting Legion

Member of the Scouting Legion. She seems selfish, cynical, bossy, sly, uncooperative, exploitative, and confrontational, but she can apparently be kind, especially to [Krista](https://anilist.co/character/62481/Krista-Lenz).

name: Connie Springer
description:
__Height__: 158 cm (5'2")  
__Relatives:__ [Mother](https://anilist.co/character/137287/Conny-no-Haha), Martin Springer (Brother), Sunny Springer (Sister)

Connie Springer is a graduate of the 104th Training Corps, having ranked 8th in class. He is known to be one of the quickest soldiers while using ODM gear and is skilled at making very sharp turns. He hails from the rural Ragako Village within Wall Rose, his greatest ambition being to make his family and village proud of him. Upon graduation, he chose to join the Survey Corps. 

Upbeat and naive, Connie is rather unfocused outside of combat, and enjoys goofing around and messing with his friends, but can also be a bit dense at times, as he can have some difficulty comprehending new developments as they appear. Connie always tries to remain optimistic, consistently caring for the well-being of his friends, family and village, and being willing to help in any way he can. However, this soft spot and the struggles he goes through as a member of the Survey Corps takes a toll on him, as he often responds to grief and loss with anger, irritation and hatred, causing him to at times make rash, impulsive decisions. He will do anything to protect his family, whether it be his biological family or his closest friends.

name: Narrator
description:
This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. 

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

name: Falco Grice
description:
__Height__: 140 cm
__Position__: Warrior Candidate

Falco Grice is an Eldian Warrior candidate working for the Marley government and is the younger brother of [Colt Grice](https://anilist.co/character/125665/Colt-Grice). Falco is close friends with his fellow warrior candidates; [Udo](https://anilist.co/character/125663/Udo), [Zofia](https://anilist.co/character/125664/Zofia), and [Gabi](https://anilist.co/character/125659/Gabi-Braun).

While not as physically strong as his fellow soldiers, he makes up for it with his quick wit and improvisation. He is a very merciful and compassionate person, going out of his way to protect and save other people lives, even enemy soldiers. He is also very polite and respectful towards others, and is an empathetic person, being willing to hear people out and properly understand things from their points of view.

~!He is a candidate to inherit the power of the Armored Titan. He has the desire to become the Armored Titan in order to prevent Gabi Braun from inheriting it, as he has a crush on her and wants them to live a long life.!~

name: Yelena
description:
Yelena is the leader of the Anti-Marleyan Volunteers working under [Zeke Yeager](https://anilist.co/character/125661/Zeke). She was one of the Marleyan soldiers on board the first survey fleet to Paradis Island after Marley's failed attack operation. She is a very tall woman with her blonde hair styled in a short bob with straight bangs. She has large dark eyes and somewhat androgynous features due to her build and style.

Yelena is a fervent follower of Zeke Yeager, holding great admiration and respect for him. She is usually calm and collected, her demeanour remaining unchanged even when [Jean Kirstein](https://anilist.co/character/46498/Kirstein-Jean) yelled at her for failing to see her job through. Nonetheless, she is willing to take responsibility and apologizes should she fail in her task. Yelena appears to maintain a very relaxed demeanour while having dry, humorous undertones to much of her actions.

~!It is later revealed that Yelena was born into an unassuming family in Marley, and eventually became disillusioned with her own country. After meeting Zeke Yeager, Yelena concocted a plan to solidify herself in history by helping Zeke save the world. As part of her narrative, Yelena created a false background for herself, claiming that her homeland was invaded and conquered by Marley. She was forcibly drafted as a soldier to fight in the Marleyan military, where she met similar-minded soldiers and organized them into the Anti-Marleyan Volunteers to fight against Marley.!~

name: Floch Forster
description:
Floch is a new recruit in the Survey Corps. He joined the Survey Corps during the two months between the attack at Orvud District and the return to Shiganshina District.

~!After the rest of the Yeagerists are killed during the port battle, Floch hides on the ship to Marley. After shooting holes in the fuel tank of the flying boat, Floch is ultimately killed by Mikasa.!~

name: Bertolt Hoover
description:
__Height__: 192 cm (6'3")  
__Affiliation__: Survey Corps

Member of the Survey Corps and former cadet of the 104th Training Corps. Bertoldt ranked 3rd in his training class upon graduation, finishing behind only [Mikasa](https://anilist.co/character/40881) and his hometown friend [Reiner](https://anilist.co/character/46484). He is a quiet young man who identifies himself as someone with a weak will that follows popular opinion. Despite ranking 3rd in his class, his training commandant noted him to be a person with great potential, but an utter lack of initiative. Bertoldt originally he enlisted in the military with aspirations of joining the Military Police and living in the safety of the inner wall, but after the Battle of Trost he instead decided to join the Survey Corps.

name: Kenny Ackerman
description:
__Affiliation:__ Military Police; Captain of Anti-Personnel Control Squad.
__Relatives:__ [Kuchel Ackerman](https://anilist.co/character/127940/Kuchel-Ackerman) (Sister), [Unnamed Grandfather](https://anilist.co/character/128589/Kenny-no-Ojiisan), 

Kenny Ackerman is a member of the Military Police Brigade's First Interior Squad and also the Anti-Personnel Control Squad. Decades prior, however, Kenny was known as an infamous serial killer that stalked victims in the capitol. 

Despite his dark field of work, Kenny appears to be rather jovial and takes pleasure in taunting his adversaries during battle. When fighting, he becomes animated and lively, often making a scene or otherwise throwing insults and witticisms. However, he also fought with control and was able to effortlessly sneak up on his targets when they least expected him. His preferred method of killing during his time as a serial killer was to slit the throats of his victims which earned him his infamous handle "Kenny the Ripper", and it was rumored that he murdered over 100 members of the Military Police Brigade. However, decades later his killings ceased and the terror that he once inspired dwindled into an Urban Legend. He eventually was found working under the Royal Government, the reasoning for his sudden shift in behavior being a mystery. Kenny is ultimately, despite his comical personality, very cold and calculated, sparing little emotional attachment or loyalty to anyone, with only a few exceptions.

~!ㅤ
He notably shares the same bloodline as both [Levi](https://anilist.co/character/45627/Levi) and [Mikasa Ackerman](https://anilist.co/character/40881/Mikasa-Ackerman).!~

name: Dot Pixis
description: The highest-ranked Administrator of the Southern Region. Head of the Garrison's Southern Territories, Pixis is a cunning leader with astute insights. However, he is also an alcoholic who is constantly watched over by his aid, [Anka](https://anilist.co/character/84331/Anka-Rheinberger), who constantly scolds him for sleeping and drinking during critical moments.

name: Grisha Yeager
description:
Father of [Eren Yaeger](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Eren-Yeager) and caretaker of [Mikasa Ackerman](https://anilist.co/character/40881/Mikasa-Ackerman). He is a renowned doctor who was well respected in the District of Shiganshina after he saved the village from a mysterious viral epidemic by developing vaccines. He also provides a medical house call service to the people of Shiganshina and to various towns in addition to having a network of contacts within the Corps of the Shiganshina District. He is married to [Carla Yaeger](https://anilist.co/character/62475).

~!In the basement of the Yeager family house, he hides a secret which he refers to as the "truth". Upon finding Eren after the fall of Wall Maria, he injects him with a series of chemicals and amnesiacs and entrusts him with the key to the "truth", before mysteriously disappearing. This strange serum resulted in Eren gaining the ability to transform into a titan.!~

name: Hitch Dreyse
description:
**Height:** 168 cm
__Affiliations:__ 104th Cadet Corps.

Recruit of the Military Police stationed in Stohess District. She was roommates with [Annie Leonhart](https://anilist.co/character/46490/Annie-Leonhart).

Hitch acts immature in certain ways, she has a sarcastic, easygoing personality and seems to mischievously enjoy teasing and needling her fellow officers, especially [Marlo Freudenberg](https://anilist.co/character/71457/Marlo-Freudenberg). She claims she chose to join the Military Police out of laziness, as it is well known that the senior staff are incredibly corrupt and she wanted to benefit from the system herself; however, she did not take into account that, as a new recruit, her superiors would dump all their work on her. Though she may act a bit air-headed at times, Hitch is not selfish and cares about those around her, especially her fellow comrades.

name: Marco Bott
description:
__Height__: 178 cm (5'9")
__Affiliations__: 104th Training Corps

Originally from Jinae District. Marco ranked 7th in the 104th Training Corps and is widely respected by other cadets of the 104th. Marco is a very kind, calm, and idealistic person, valuing the good of the group above his own interests, as well as understanding and coping with his own shortcomings and limitations. He is seen as a natural leader, and desires to join the Military Police to serve near the King. 

*Note: Marco Bott is the official English translation by Kodansha.*

name: Eun-Yeong Baek
description:
A first-year high school student who lives in the supposedly-haunted old dorm house. He's constantly butting heads with [Hae-Jun](https://anilist.co/character/273310/Go-Hae-Jun), his new dormmate, due to his selfish behaviour and messy nature. He's always surrounded by friends, to whom he seems bright and fun, but to Hae-Jun he's cold and snarky. 

Although the two get on each others' nerves, they realise that they both have nowhere else to go, and must live together in the run-down old dorm.

name: Hae-Jun Go
description:
A second-year high school student who can see ghosts. He recently transferred to a new school, and due to his mother's obsession with the supernatural, he's desperate to leave home and stay in the school dorms. After a tragic accident, he finally gets his wish, but ends up in a run-down old house which is supposedly haunted. 

Hae-Jun's new life isn't as easy as he'd hoped, as he's constantly fighting with his dormmate, silently enduring his classmates' bullying, and pretending not to notice the ghosts, all while struggling with his recent trauma.

name: Marie Kim
description:
A second-year high school student and president of the journalism club. Her parents divorced when she was young, and her mother left and started a new family. Even though she was just a child, Marie was burdened with the housework, cooking and cleaning for her father and older brother. Although she was happy to help when she was young, all the responsibility is too much for her, and she dreams of moving into the school dorms. 

As well as taking care of the home, Marie has to put up with her older brother's temper. They often have fun and play games together, but if he gets angry, he often hits her. Their father knows about this, but doesn't think it's a big deal. Marie's aunt argues with him, saying that history will repeat itself if he doesn't do something. Marie's father often hit her aunt when they were young, which led to her cutting ties with most of her family. She warns him that once Marie realises how much she was burdened with, and how no one would protect her from her brother's violence, she'll leave and never come back. 

Having her aunt fight for her gives Marie the push she needs. In order to show how serious she is about the journalism club in the hope of persuading her father to give her permission to move to the dorms, she writes a scoop about Hae-Jun bullying a classmate and stealing his money. Soon she realises she got it all wrong, but the article has already turned the school against Hae-Jun, and Marie realises how difficult it is to prove what really happened.

name: Ju-Wan Park
description:
A second-year high school student at Hansol High, who is desperate to move into dorms. He has kept diaries since he was young, which his mother would read then laugh about with her friends. Exhausted with his lack of privacy, he eventually moves in with Hae-Jun and Eun-Yeong in the old dorm building. 

Unfortunately, his troubles seem to have followed him to his new home. His talkative nature rubs his dormmates the wrong way, unintentionally offending them, and his personal belonging start to go missing, leading him to accuse Eun-Yeong of stealing.

Although his dorm life gets off to a rocky start, he is a very kind person, and a loyal friend.

name: Kaguya Shinomiya
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm

The vice president of the student council of Shuchiin Academy, member of the wealthy Shinomiya family, she is a multi-talented genius who can do anything if she sets her mind to it. Due to the way she was raised, she instinctively looks down on others and thinks of ways to use them for her own benefit. Kaguya rarely interacted with other people before she joined the student council, but that has begun to change. She is an incredibly sheltered girl, resulting in her lacking in several pieces of what might be considered common sense. She still doesn’t understand love very well, and her main objective is to make [Miyuki Shirogane](https://anilist.co/character/121101) fall in love and confess to her.

Later in the series: ~!She confesses her love to Miyuki Shirogane and they start dating.!~

~!In a [Oshi no Ko special chapter](https://anilist.co/manga/153520), it was revealed that she married Miyuki and changed her surname to Kaguya Shirogane!~

name: Chika Fujiwara
description:
The secretary of the Shuchiin Academy student council. She could not be predicted, her thoughts could not be read. A natural disaster who unconsciously threw everything into chaos simply by being present, also known as __Subject F__.

~!In chapter 222 of the manga, Chika reveals that she played piano because she wanted to be perfect, and she becomes a prodigy at the piano. The expectations of her family and her fans rose, forcing her to practice more. She quit piano after [Kaguya](https://anilist.co/character/120649/Shinomiya-Kaguya) told her to just quit if she didn't like the piano. Soon after Chika challenged Kaguya to a game battle and if she won, she would get to become Kaguya's friend. In the end, she becomes Kaguya's first friend.!~

name: Miko Iino
description:
__Height:__ 147 cm (4'7")

She is a freshman at Shuchiin Private Academy and the Auditor of the Student Council. Miko has a strong sense of justice and will correct others on what's right and wrong. Unfortunately, this led to her being bullied, though she still continues to uphold her idea of "right". She idolizes [Chika Fujiwara](https://anilist.co/character/121103), listening to anything she says, even if it's for Chika's enjoyment.

name: Yuu Ishigami
description:
The treasurer of the student council of the Shuchiin Academy. He's extremely valued by [Miyuki](https://anilist.co/character/121101), given that he single-handedly manages all the school's funds. He's also terrified of [Kaguya](https://anilist.co/character/120649), though no one else is sure why that is. Yuu keeps to himself and rarely speaks up, often getting into trouble when he does. He has a depressed outlook on life while having an inferiority complex. In contrast to his attitude, he is willing to help those in need and will sacrifice his pride if need be. Unlike his high school self, he had a much different outlook and demeanor during middle school.

Later in the series: 
~!Ishigami develops a crush on Tsubame that he inadvertently confesses his feelings for her at the school's cultural festival. Ishigami does not realize that his actions were perceived as a confession by the rest of the student body and is therefore oblivious to the implications of having given Tsubame a heart-shaped gift (considered akin to a confession in Shuchiin tradition). After some convincing by Kaguya, Tsubame decides to seriously consider Ishigami's confession, with her original intention being to let him down as gently as possible. It isn't until Ishigami watches Tsubame's performance of the traditional play that gave rise to the aforementioned tradition that he realizes his actions had unintended meaning. Even then, Ishigami's thickheaded nature prevented him from recognizing the full meaning of his actions: a straight confession!~

~!On the day of the third years' graduation ceremony, Tsubame finally has an answer for Ishigami's proposal. Despite Ishigami doing his best to convince Tsubame to accept him, Tsubame ultimately rejects Ishigami. Tsubame promises Ishigami that the two of them will remain friends and Ishigami sees her off with a smile and a gift of flowers. Afterwards, Ishigami breaks into tears, finally learning what heartbreak is like.!~

name: Ai Hayasaka
description:
Ai Hayasaka is a second-year student at Shuchiin Academy and a valet of the Shinomiya family. She is a member of the Hayasaka family, who have served the Shinomiya family for generations, gaining their trust.

Having been personally assigned to enter Shuchiin Academy with her, Ai supports [Kaguya Shinomiya](https://anilist.co/character/120649) in her high school life and has been a part of Kaguya's life for ten years. Because of their close relationship, Ai is one of the few people around to which Kaguya's amiability is not an act.

Even if she demonstrates maturity as a valet, Ai still has the concerns of a young girl, such as caring to be in fashion and going out with friends, even if she does not have much time for herself due to work.

Ai helps Kaguya with the struggles about her feelings for [Shirogane](https://anilist.co/character/121101).

~!She later leaves her job as a maid to Kaguya but still continues her friendship.!~

~!In the Doujin-ban universe, she starts dating and later gets engaged to Shirogane!~

name: Miyuki Shirogane
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm

He is a second year student at Shuchi'in Academy and the president of the student council.

Miyuki is a handsome young man with blond hair and blue eyes. Due to his constant sleep deprivation and nearsightedness, his eyes appear to glare. He usually wears the regular Shuchi'in Academy black male uniform adorned with the Aiguilette, the golden chain-like accessory around his neck. The Aiguilette symbolizes his authority as student council president.

Shirogane is a diligent student who, despite his underprivileged background, climbed his way to the top of his class through hard work and determination. Shirogane holds himself in high regard, consistently working to maintain his perfect image. He is textbook workaholic, enjoying his part-time job and often putting his own health at risk for the sake of his work. Due to his poor background, Shirogane values money greatly and goes to great lengths to not be wasteful, and generally dislikes expensive gifts.

~!Miyuki's mother left his family when he was a child. Miyuki's father's factory was shut down and currently has no stable employment. They live in an apartment that costs ￥50,000 (Approx $450) a month. Due to this grisly past, he has been led to a lifestyle of part time jobs and hard work. He passed the Level 2 Kanji Kentei exam and has passed Grade Pre 1 on Eiken. He has also got second place on the National mock exam.!~

~!Miyuki transferred into Shuchi'in Academy during his first year of high school on a scholarship. His first week was a disappointment in that a great majority of his peers were condescending to him because of transferring in. Miyuki was being recruited to serve as the new student council general affairs officer by the Previous Student Council President and helped clean up a swamp. There, he saw Kaguya Shinomiya saving a girl from drowning. It was at that moment where he was truly charmed by Kaguya. At the advice of fellow student council member [Momo Ryuuju](https://anilist.co/character/212390/Ryuuju-Momo), he adopted the confident genius personality he is shown to have at the story's beginning in order to attract her.!~

Even though he is obviously in love with [Kaguya Shinomiya](https://anilist.co/character/120649/Shinomiya-Kaguya), her wealth and talents greatly intimidates him, leaving him utterly terrified at the idea of confessing to her. He fears that all of his actions will lead Kaguya to look down him, causing him to overthink in many situations. Shirogane has never had a girlfriend and thus is actually quite clueless when it comes to romance, though his dignified demeanor leaves most of the students to think otherwise. Although he excels at studying, Shirogane has proven to be painfully talentless in a variety of other activities, such as sports, singing, dancing and more.

Despite this, Shirogane is unwaveringly kind and virtuous, never putting any of his goals above the well-being of others. He is extremely supportive and generous, willing to help any students with their problems, and will put aside his quest to get Kaguya to confess if it even has a chance of hurting someone else.

name: Narrator
description:
This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. 

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

name: Kei Shirogane
description:
Kei Shirogane is [Miyuki Shirogane's](https://anilist.co/character/121101) little sister. She attends Shuchiin middle school and is the treasurer for the middle school student council.

She is a hard worker just like her brother and can be very prideful at times. She also inherited his sense of righteousness and hates it when someone doesn't do the right thing in a given situation. Like her brother, she likes helping out those who are in trouble even if it means going out of her way to do it. Since she grew up in a family that places emphasis on saving money, she normally carries coupons and works hard for the things she wants to buy. 

She developed a prickly attitude towards her brother due to his over protectiveness. She's also entered a rebellious phase and due to her pride and she cannot get herself to have a lighthearted conversation with Miyuki, leading into the similar mind games that Miyuki and [Kaguya](https://anilist.co/character/120649) play against each other, but her objective is to talk to Miyuki without making it look like she has a brother complex. She rarely speaks and most of the time it is only when she exchanges formalities at school or when she hurls abuses at her brother.

name: Maki Shijo
description: Maki is a classmate and friend of [Nagisa](https://anilist.co/character/134330). She has short hair styled in short pigtails. She is friends with Nagisa and is secretly jealous of Nagisa's relationship with her boyfriend, as she too liked Kashiwagi's Boyfriend, but could not confess before. As a branch member of the Shinomiya clan, she is [Kaguya](https://anilist.co/character/120649)'s second cousin twice removed so she sometimes refers to Kaguya as "Auntie". [Miyuki](https://anilist.co/character/121101) and [Yuu](https://anilist.co/character/121102/Yuu-Ishigami) observe she acts very tsundere (cold on the outside but wanting to be affectionate), and similar to Kaguya in personality. She declares Yuu and Miyuki as her friends, due to their support in helping her process her failed romance, much to Kaguya's horror

name: Shirogane no Chichi
description:
Father of [Miyuki](https://anilist.co/character/121101) and [Kei Shirogane](https://anilist.co/character/126144).

~!His wife left him and their factory shut down leaving him to not have any stable employment.!~

~!He later becomes a youtuber.!~

name: Tsubame Koyasu
description: Tsubame is a third-year student who is vice-captain of the cheer squad and a rhythmic gymnast. She is very popular. She encourages [Yuu](https://anilist.co/character/121102) in the cheering activities.

name: Nagisa Kashiwagi
description: Nagisa is a classmate who occasionally asks [Kaguya](https://anilist.co/character/120649) about what to do in her relationships. [Tsubasa](https://anilist.co/character/134327)'s girlfriend.

name: Kobachi Osaragi
description:
Kobachi is [Miko](https://anilist.co/character/125886)'s classmate with the glasses and a member of the disciplinary committee. She has been looking after Miko for over 10 years.

~!Though she doesn't love him in a romantic way, she has liked Yu Ishigami since middle school. She believes that Tsubame Koyasu is a kind person and is therefore supportive of Ishigami's feelings for Tsubame, despite her friend Miko being in love with Ishigami as well.!~

name: Moeha Fujiwara
description: Moeha is [Chika](https://anilist.co/character/121103)'s little sister who is in junior high. She is the student council vice-president at the junior high. She admires [Miyuki](https://anilist.co/character/121101) as well and hopes to confess someday. She has a habit of voicing dark ideas, which unnerve [Kaguya](https://anilist.co/character/120649) a great deal.

name: Rei Onodera
description: She is a supporting character in the series. She was a member of Shuchi'in's Red Cheer Team and is a classmate of Yu Ishigami and Miko Iino. She is a fairly calm girl under normal circumstances and is fairly open-minded, but when involved with the Cheer Team or the culture festival committee, she becomes far more energetic.

name: Karen Kino
description: She is a member of the mass media club at Shuchi'in Academy.

name: Erika Kose
description: She is a member of the mass media club at Shuchi'in Academy.

name: Momo Ryuuju
description:
Momo Ryuuju is a supporting character in the series. She is the president of the Astronomy Club and one of The Impossible Girls.
As a member of a yakuza family, she places little value on the school rules, as seen by her wearing a hat and playing games on her cellphone while on school grounds. She also has a short temper, and others view her as being threatening.

name: Tsubasa Tanuma
description: He is a student in Shuchi'in highschool and always asks [Miyuki Shirogane](https://anilist.co/character/121101) for advice about love. [Kashiwagi](https://anilist.co/character/134330)'s boyfriend.

name: Zen Seito Kaichou
description:
The Previous Student Council President (real name unknown) is a supporting character in the series. He is a third-year high school student at Shuchi'in Academy and the president of the 66th Student Council.

He is a third year student at Shuchi'in Academy and was the president of the School Council when Miyuki Shirogane was in his first year.

name: J Suzuki
description: A taxi driver and one of the Four Ramen Emperors of Tokyo.

name: Pes
description: Pes is the beloved pet dog of [Chika Fujiwara](https://anilist.co/character/121103/Chika-Fujiwara). He is quite a large dog, with golden fur and floppy ears. He has piercing eyes like [the president](https://anilist.co/character/121101/Miyuki-Shirogane)

name: Mikado Shijo
description:
Mikado is the twin brother of [Maki](https://anilist.co/character/134328). He is among the story's smartest characters, as he placed first in the national mock exam during freshman year, to [Miyuki](https://anilist.co/character/121101)'s second place. As such, Miyuki has had an obsession with beating him in a rematch. However, Mikado chose to attend a nearby public school in order to play soccer with his friends.

~!After leading his team to the national championship, Mikado transfers to Shuchiin, where he becomes a member of Class 3-A, along with all of the story's notable third years, including Kaguya, Miyuki, Maki, [Chika](https://anilist.co/character/121103/) and [Ai](https://anilist.co/character/121104/).!~

~!Mikado is revealed to be very much a normal teenager, albeit a genius, as he has normal worries like being able to make friends at a new school. He also readily defers to his sister, despite finding her crazy and incomprehensible. Interestingly, Mikado is very similar to Miyuki, and the two quickly go from misunderstood rivals to close friends.!~

name: Shouzou Tanuma
description:
Shouzou Tanuma is a world famous heart surgeon and the physician of the Shinomiya family.
He is also Tsubasa's grandfather

name: Ippo Makunouchi
description:
__Nationality:__ Japanese 
__Boxing style:__ Infighter, Peek-a-Boo 
__Height:__ 5'5" (164.0 cm)  
__Reach:__ 65" (165.0 cm) 
__Weight Class:__ Featherweight 
__Specialty:__ Liver Blow, Gazelle Punch, Dempsey Roll  

Ippo Makunouchi is the main protagonist of the series. He lives with his mother, [Hiroko Makunouchi](https://anilist.co/character/36881/Makunouchi-Hiroko), and helps with the family charter boat fishing business. Ippo is a classic power in-boxer and is well known for his Peek-a-Boo style of boxing and hard punches which include three signature punches: a rib-cracking liver blow, Gazelle punch (an uppercut variant), and the Dempsey roll technique. His signature punches appear to be modeled after Mike Tyson, Floyd Patterson and Jack Dempsey respectively.

Ippo is bullied throughout most of his school life. After being rescued by [Takamura](https://anilist.co/character/845/Takamura-Mamoru), he ends up being brought to Kamogawa Gym, where he displays an explosive punching power. After seeing a video of Mike Tyson, he becomes inspired to take up boxing to feel reborn with strength. He soon proves himself to Takamura and [Kamogawa](https://anilist.co/character/10156/Kamogawa-Genji), and starts on the path to being a pro boxer.

name: Mamoru Takamura
description:
__Height:__ 185 cm (6'1")

Takamura is very hearty, rude and often behaves vulgarly. He is a loud arrogant boaster who tends to refer to himself as Ore-sama (a Japanese name suffix intended for people of great importance) and he rarely ever shows a shred of consideration towards other fighters after a loss.  Takamura was discovered on the streets by Coach Kamogawa Genji, and his speed, power, and technique are all high-level to the point that he is capable of handling both In Fighters and Out Boxers without too much trouble. Unlike most characters in Hajime no Ippo, he has no special finishing blow, but every punch he has possesses killer destructive power. With the wild power to always force out any situation he claims will happen, he is a man who does everything he says he will.  As the one who got Ippo, Aoki and Kimura into boxing, he is well respected at the Kamogawa Gym. Even though he constantly looks down on and ridicules their achievements, his unrivalled strength and the few moments his true kindness leaks out prevent them from losing their respect for him. Takamura loves to pick on his fellow gym mates, with Aoki usually the first on his list. Although he tends to get more serious when hearing about or training for his next match, he still finds the time to play pranks on everyone and goof around.  The character for Taka (鷹) in his name means hawk, and as a result he is sometimes nicknamed The Japanese Hawk by announcers and spectators (most notably during his matches against Brian Hawk and David Eagle). He lives alone at the Ohta Inn apartment complex, and his room is littered with junk, old food, pornography, and even his boxing belts. His pompadour hairstyle is his trademark.

name: Takeshi Sendo
description:
Sendo is an In Fighter with arm strength on par with [Ippo Makunouchi](https://anilist.co/character/15/Makunouchi-Ippo). To date, he is the only boxer to face Ippo more than once in the pro ring and is his chief rival. Sendo is a featherweight and his most well known move is his powerful smash. 

He greatly admires boxer Rocky Marciano, to the extent that he will personally point out that he is not the same "Rocky" from the film of the same name. He is also a fan of [Mamoru Takamura](https://anilist.co/character/845/Takamura-Mamoru). Sendo is modeled after the real-life "Naniwa Rocky", boxer turned actor Akai Hidekazu.

name: Alexander Volg Zangief
description: The World Amateur Champion is a handsome boxer from Russia who excels at outboxing and taking points, but adopts a vicious infighting style when he moves to Japan (Ippo notices how depressed he looks after this happens). Raised by a single mother in a small town near to St. Petersburg, Volg originally takes up boxing in order to provide medical assistance for his seriously ill mom (who coincidentally looks a lot like Hiroko Makunouchi, but with longer and reddish hair), but after consecutive losses to both Ippo and Sendou, he is forced to leave the Otawa Gym and return to Russia, staying by his mother's side until her death. Besides his incredible outboxing technique, Volg's greatest weapon is a vertical combination called "White Fang" (a short, quick left uppercut, followed by an incredibly fast and powerful chopping right). Volg later returns to Japan to get his old boxing gloves from Ippo before he goes to America, and ends up helping Ippo train for his upcoming match against Sawamura Ryuhei. Currently Volg is in America fighting at the world stage and, under the training of Dankichi Hama, is the 4th ranked IBF Jr. Lightweight fighter. His personality is very humble and polite, though he's a very good boxer, Volg admits that he doesn't really like boxing as it hurts other people but only does it so he can help his ill mother back home but finally comes to realize he has passion for boxing. There was also a running gag at the beginning, related to his rusty Japanese. When Ippo met Volg when he couldn't read kanji in the subway, and few minutes after their first conversation he got in trouble with other native Japanese people for the very same reason.

name: Ichirou Miyata
description:
Ever since he was little, Miyata has always wanted to be like his dad. His dad, Suzuki Miyata, used to be a boxer, until a career-ending jaw bone injury forced him to retire. Miyata takes  his training dead seriously, and has always believed in his father's old beliefs, that skill can beat strength. You hardly ever see the guy smile because he thinks  that he doesn't have the privilege to smile unless he wins a boxing match. 
~!He had worked his way up to almost the top of the feather weight championship, until Ryo Mashiba beat him in a match. Miyata ended up in the hospital with a broken foot, as well as some other injuries.!~

name: Genji Kamogawa
description:
Head coach and founder of the Kamogawa gym. He fought as a prizefighter in Japan shortly after the end of World War II. Along with his friends, [Ginpachi Nekota](https://anilist.co/character/34715/Nekota-Ginpachi) and [Dankichi Hama](https://anilist.co/character/83533/Hama-Dankichi), Kamogawa developed a style of fighting that both presumably became the forerunner of boxing in Japan and emphasized scientific theory in its techniques.
