description: The highest-ranked Administrator of the Southern Region. Head of the Garrison's Southern Territories, Pixis is a cunning leader with astute insights. However, he is also an alcoholic who is constantly watched over by his aid, [Anka](https://anilist.co/character/84331/Anka-Rheinberger), who constantly scolds him for sleeping and drinking during critical moments.

name: Petra Ral
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm (5'2")
__Affiliation:__ Survey Corps; Soldier, Special Operations Squad.
__Relatives:__ [Father](https://anilist.co/character/131987/Petra-no-Chichi)

Petra Ral is a soldier of the Survey Corps hand-picked by [Captain Levi](https://anilist.co/character/45627/Levi) to join the Special Operations Squad.

Petra is a very kind and caring woman, going out of her way to look after and guiding [Eren Yaeger](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Eren-Yeager) when he was first admitted to the squad. She seemed to have the most attachment to Eren among Levi Squad, as she was often the only one shown to actually worry about him and his wellbeing, at least at first. Although all of Levi's squad wished for Eren's unconditional trust, it was ultimately Petra who convinced him to do so. 

Despite her kind nature, Petra was a conditioned soldier with a quick reaction time against perceived danger. She displays extreme loyalty to her leaders, superiors and their orders, and cares deeply for her team, although she tends to be at odds with [Oluo Bozad](https://anilist.co/character/71687/Oluo-Bozard) due to his irritating tendency to try and imitate Levi. She greatly looks up to Levi as her superior and is deeply devoted to him, willing to completely dedicate her life to his cause. It is implied that she may harbor romantic feelings for her captain.

name: Grisha Yeager
description:
Father of [Eren Yaeger](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Eren-Yeager) and caretaker of [Mikasa Ackerman](https://anilist.co/character/40881/Mikasa-Ackerman). He is a renowned doctor who was well respected in the District of Shiganshina after he saved the village from a mysterious viral epidemic by developing vaccines. He also provides a medical house call service to the people of Shiganshina and to various towns in addition to having a network of contacts within the Corps of the Shiganshina District. He is married to [Carla Yaeger](https://anilist.co/character/62475).

~!In the basement of the Yeager family house, he hides a secret which he refers to as the "truth". Upon finding Eren after the fall of Wall Maria, he injects him with a series of chemicals and amnesiacs and entrusts him with the key to the "truth", before mysteriously disappearing. This strange serum resulted in Eren gaining the ability to transform into a titan.!~

name: Hitch Dreyse
description:
**Height:** 168 cm
__Affiliations:__ 104th Cadet Corps.

Recruit of the Military Police stationed in Stohess District. She was roommates with [Annie Leonhart](https://anilist.co/character/46490/Annie-Leonhart).

Hitch acts immature in certain ways, she has a sarcastic, easygoing personality and seems to mischievously enjoy teasing and needling her fellow officers, especially [Marlo Freudenberg](https://anilist.co/character/71457/Marlo-Freudenberg). She claims she chose to join the Military Police out of laziness, as it is well known that the senior staff are incredibly corrupt and she wanted to benefit from the system herself; however, she did not take into account that, as a new recruit, her superiors would dump all their work on her. Though she may act a bit air-headed at times, Hitch is not selfish and cares about those around her, especially her fellow comrades.

name: Marco Bott
description:
__Height__: 178 cm (5'9")
__Affiliations__: 104th Training Corps

Originally from Jinae District. Marco ranked 7th in the 104th Training Corps and is widely respected by other cadets of the 104th. Marco is a very kind, calm, and idealistic person, valuing the good of the group above his own interests, as well as understanding and coping with his own shortcomings and limitations. He is seen as a natural leader, and desires to join the Military Police to serve near the King. 

*Note: Marco Bott is the official English translation by Kodansha.*

name: Ii
description:
The Nonsense User, a boy that drastically plays down his abilities, yet inevitably solves any mystery he encounters. Ii is an abnormal person. A "defective product." Unable to express much emotion, he is often seen with a neutral expression; however, Ii is able to express some emotion in some circumstances. At the beginning of his second year in junior high, he joined the ER3 System and went to Houston in America for 5 years and later returns to Japan at the age of 19. Upon return, he begins to attend Rokumeikan University in Kyoto. Ii is "friends" with [Tomo Kunagisa](https://anilist.co/character/29594/Kunagisa-Tomo), though he refuses to admit he has any and instead calls them acquaintances. Also known as the "mirror image" of [Hitoshiki Zerozaki](https://anilist.co/character/34293/Zerozaki-Hitoshiki), he is believed to be what Ii would be like if he didn't hold back. 

Tomo is helped out by Ii at times, having a friendly relationship overall. The two are similar, being unable to fully express emotions, though Tomo can only truly express happiness. Despite this, she and Ii had an incident a few years back that she never wishes to happen again. The incident is believed to be Ii leaving Tomo for 5 years. ~!After the beheadings occurred on Wet Crow's Feather Island, the culprit pointed a gun at Tomo, forcing Ii to admit his love for her, causing the culprit to give up as they were able to get Ii to say something he wouldn't.!~

As the mirror image of Hitoshiki Zerozaki, the two are unable to harm each other as they can both predict the other's moves. Their relationship is a strange one, as both of them are vastly different yet so similar to one another.

Many people call Ii some cutesy nickname like, "Ii-chan," and the like, though very few people know his actual name. 
~!In a conversation with Shiogi, Ii is asked questions to hint towards his name. After figuring it out, he requests that she not use his name, as anyone else has died. The people that have died being Tomo (emotionally), Magokoro Omokage (in a fire), and his forgotten younger sister Harukana Ii (in a plane crash)!~

name: Jun Aikawa
description:
The fierce Desert Eagle coated in scarlet. The unstoppable Laughing Red Tigress. Humanity's Strongest: Jun Aikawa. Renowned for her prowess in anything and everything, Jun is the most powerful person in the world. Her occupation is that of a contractor and will take any job, no matter how trivial or illegal it may be, so long as money is involved. Those that call her by her last name are considered her enemies, thus she insists friends to refer to her as Jun. Her abilities are practically limitless as a Multidisciplinary Master. [Ii](https://anilist.co/character/29593/Ii) and Jun initially meet by pure chance and their fates become intertwined.

With a strong sense of justice and a wild personality, Jun can be a lot to handle for the average person and especially Ii. He is particularly bothered by Jun's hatred for leaving things half-assed. On top of that, Jun is a rather arrogant individual. Despite this, she does value her friends and trusts them greatly. A majority of the people that hear her name fear it, as many over-the-top stories exist about her feats. Though some of the said feats may be completely wrong, Jun is a very intelligent woman and is considered to be a genius among geniuses. 

As Jun is known both for her abilities and her mind that is like no other, she is said to be Humanity's Strongest. Being the Multidisciplinary Master,  she is a master of disguise, sound imitating, lock picking and mind-reading. Not only that, but Jun also has amazing fighting capabilities, which are nearly impossible to overcome.

~!When [Hitoshiki Zerozaki](https://anilist.co/character/34293/Zerozaki-Hitoshiki) and Jun fought, she admitted that he was a bit tough even for her and that his skill with knives was second to none. Hitoshiki managed to get away without a scratch, though it wasn't easy.!~

~!The origin of Jun isn't pretty, as she is the product of incest. Initially, [Takashi Saitou](https://anilist.co/character/173351/Saitou-Takashi), her biological father, wished to create the strongest human. He, along with Akira Kajou and Junya Aikawa, created Jun, with one of Jun Saitou twins as her mother. Jun was later abandoned as she was deemed a failure by Takashi. Of her three fathers, Junya Aikawa was the only one she could consider as a father.!~

name: Tomo Kunagisa
description:
The technological genius Blue Savant and heiress of the Kunagisa household. Tomo is a young girl who is well versed in computer engineering, capable of crafting computers that are much more powerful that anything on the market. Most known for being the leader of Team, a collection of genius hackers. Due to Tomo's renowned computer genius, she is invited to Wet Crow's Feather Island by Iria Akagami. Tomo brings Ii with her, to help her get around. 

Tomo stands out like no other, having blue hair and eyes due to recessive genes. Her hair may get even darker if she refuses to wash it, becoming ultramarine, which can happen often as she hates taking baths. Due to this, Ii usually just throws her into a bathtub. Ii also tied up her hair in many ways, from braids to quadtails. Tomo herself enjoys fun, though she is not the best at being sociable, as she rarely listens to others besides the task at hand. Unlike most people, Tomo thinks somewhat backwards. Ii describes her thinking as instead of building a sand castle with what's needed, Tomo simply has a whole pile of sand and removes what isn't needed. Additionally, she is nearly incapable of expressing anything other than happiness, besides a tad of minor annoyance.

As the leader of Team, Tomo bears the title of "Walking Wrath." She manages all of Team, and will get assistance from the other members for whichever goal she has in mind. Team itself is a cyber-terrorist organization that preforms many illegal actions to either get information or money. They rarely get caught, though there is one close call and they end up disbanding, all of which happens while Ii is in Houston. ~!It's later revealed that Tomo is worshipped as a god among the cyber-terrorist team. Tomo appears to treat them equally, but there are questionable times where she may think of them as slaves.!~
~!At the end of the series, Tomo's hair becomes nearly black and she begins to grow again. Prior to this, she had the same appearance ever since Ii left for Houston.!~

name: Hitoshiki Zerozaki
description:
The No Longer Human serial killer of Kyoto and member of the Zerozaki clan: Hitoshiki Zerozaki. Notoriously known as the Prowler during the Kyoto serial murder case. Hitoshiki is a man with a small stature that kills for the sake of killing. Soushiki Zerozaki and Hitoshiki have a somewhat brotherly relationship, though they've grown distant. In general, he doesn't have many friends as a serial killer, though Iori Mutou could be considered one, as well as Ii. Another killer, Izumu Niounomiya, is a friend and rival of Hitoshiki. 

Hitoshiki himself is eccentric, though he generally has a casual personality and way of speaking. He considers himself a brat and believes everyone else was once a brat. When he and Ii meet, he calls Ii a doppelganger as they are essentially identical, yet so different. Hitoshiki is later described as the mirror image of Ii, and what Ii would be like if he didn't hold back. As a Zerozaki, Hitoshiki has a desire to kill anyone he meets without remorse, though he is capable of holding himself back. Like Ii, Hitoshiki has a catchphrase where he often says, "What a riot," which contrasts against Ii's "Nonsense."

As both a Zerozaki and a serial killer, Hitoshiki has a couple abilities and tools at his disposal. In the vest he wears, there are many knives placed all throughout it, which complements his mastery at using knives. To go along with his knife expertise, Hitoshiki is also able to utilize string, making a nearly undetectable trap. Unfortunately, with all his prowess in killing, he cannot do much against Ii, as they can counter each other and will just end up in a stalemate. ~!Hitoshiki's knife finesse has made him able to hold his own against Jun Aikawa. Despite this, he cannot defeat her, thus he escapes. The two later come to an agreement where Hitoshiki vows to stop killing to continue living and tells Jun Ii's solution to his own problem during the time.!~ ~!When Hitoshiki was born, his parents both died. His parents were Hataori Zerozaki as his mother and Zeroshiki Zerozaki as the father. As they died after Hitoshiki's birth, Soushiki began to raise him.!~

name: Takashi Saitou
description:
A peculiar man in a traditional Japanese garb and a fox mask who felt a "karmic connection" to Ii.

Catchphrase: *"We'll meet again, if we have a connection."*

~!His main philosophy is that no matter what humans may try, they can't escape fate, and that every decision that's available to them are ultimately meaningless with every divergence being corrected according to destiny. Two concepts form the core of his philosophy:

Back Nozzle: The belief that events important to the "story" would happen in some form or another since the "story" can't be changed. He states that Ii, Rizumu and himself would have a similar conversation even if the time and place are different.

Jail Alternative: The concept that events that were intended to happen will happen anyway, regardless of the people involved. He explains that the meaning and result would remain the same, but the people involved can easily be substituted, even himself and Rizumu.!~

~!During his first conversation with Ii, he states that he's standing outside the story; he's been exiled from karma; he's been expelled from causality. He also calls himself "half-assed and vague" as a result of past events and his current place outside of the story. Because of this, he has to use other people (mainly the Thirteen Stairs) to act in his place.!~

~!On his second conversation with Ii, he remarks that the "soul" within Ii is reminiscent of his own as *Humanity's Worst*, and his goal is to witness the Dying Epilogue, which is the idea that all events that has occurred will eventually lead to one point regardless of how related or unrelated the events, coincidences and meetings are when leading up to that point.!~

~!Before leaving the clinic, he claims Ii as his enemy and states that Jun Aikawa is his daughter!~

Prior to his first appearance,

~!Ii makes a remark when speaking with his old teacher, Miyoshi Kokoromi, about how he heard through the grapevine that a Japanese person with a strange name was a candidate for the Seven Fools. Tomo Kunagisa also remarks about a "genius machinist who brought electronic darkness onto the entire world with a mere 16 byte program." He is "One that far surpasses Cluster that once existed, the existence called Desert Fox-"!~

name: Izumu Niounomiya
description:
The strongest hitman of the Niounomiya Troupe. He is the split personality and older brother of Rizumu Niounomiya. Though he identifies as a male, his actual body is that of a female due to him being a split personality.

~!In reality, Izumu is his very own person, rather than a split personality. He is typically near his younger sister, Rizumu Niounomiya, though he stays out of sight, only coming out when necessary. Like other Niounomiya, he is the product of a lab experiment to make the strongest killer. Izumu is pure strength without weakness, contrasting Rizumu's pure weakness without strength.!~

name: Mikoko Aoii
description:
A peppy college student that is very outgoing and able to express emotions without fault. Mikoko attends Rokumeikan Private University, along with her fellow friends. She hangs out with Tomoe, Akiharu, Muimi, and later on, Ii. Muimi and Mikoko have been friends since elementary school, while the others met later on in high school and college. 

Mikoko owns a vintage model Vespa, referring to it as, "scoot," much to Ii's dismay.  When drunk, Mikoko has a tendency to strip her clothes. 

As Mikoko is able to express emotions without holding anything back, others are a bit jealous that they can't be like her. ~!Soon after meeting Ii, she develops a crush on him and falls in love, only her love becomes an obsession. Due to this, she is willing to kill any obstacles that stand in her way.!~ ~!Mikoko later strangles Tomoe out of jealousy and ends up killing herself with the same murder weapon after Ii rejects her sickening, corrupted love.!~

name: Ichihime Yukariki
description:
A small frail girl with a bizarre way of speaking, Ichihime Yukariki. Once being saved by Jun Aikawa and Yuma Shisei when she was twelve years old, Ichihime grew to become friends of her saviours. Later, at seventeen years old, she enlists the help of Jun to help her get out of Sumiyuri Private Academy, which is coined as "Hangin' High" by the students. At Hangin' High, Ichihime is a target and other students wish to capture her for unknown reasons. Ii refers to her as "Hime-chan" as a nickname.

Ichihime herself is a tad strange, from looking nearly the exact same as she did at twelve years old to speaking Japanese poorly. She states that she was raised in America, which would explain her near broken Japanese. Beyond those anomalies, Ichihime is also rather ditzy and childish. Ii says that she likely enjoys hand movements, as she uses them quite extensively. Not only that, but she refers to Ii as "Master" nearly instantly, though Ii feels like it lacks any respect. ~!Though Ichihime seems like a ditzy girl, she is very much the opposite. She is a monster. Trusting no one but herself, Ichihime believes everyone else will betray each other in the end and aren't genuine in their actions. Despite this, there is a vast amount of respect for Jun, as she was able to trust others after being betrayed herself. Ichihime herself also has a resilient mind, as she was able to mercilessly kill others without remorse.!~ ~!The true reason for Ichihime's broken Japanese is due to her suffering an injury on her frontal lobe when she was saved by Jun. She hears it right in her head, even if it is not when spoken.!~

Among the students at Hangin' High, Ichihime has a somewhat unique ability where string is used. One such use would be winding up string, making it into a rope, and using it to climb out a window. It is used as support for the most part. Besides that, there isn't much else Ichihime can do due to her small stature, though she does fancy a recorder for fun.
~!The string she uses is more often used with wicked intent, as seen when she slices Shiogi into pieces, along with the director, Tamamo, and the other 37 faculty. She inherits the nickname ZigZag due to her string ability. As she doesn't trust a single person, she chose to slaughter any that get in her way, even Ii and Jun. In the end, she fails and has her recent memory essentially wiped when Jun tazzes her with an extremely high amount of power which knocks her out as well. It's revealed that Yuma taught Ichihime how to be a string user after saving her, and she vowed to never use it with bad intent, though Hangin' High would not allow that. After being saved, she is brought in by Jun and lives a mostly normal life.!~

name: Miiko Asano
description:
The close friend of Neon and resident of the Antique Apartment, Miiko is a freeter and master of Kendo and Kenjutsu. She rarely expresses her feelings, though is known for showing off her temper while fighting. In order to show what she's feeling, Miiko wears a jinbei with kanji representing her emotions on the back. She has a habit of helping the weak all she can, one being in a relationship with 4 different people because of it.

Ii gets helped out by Miiko often, such as borrowing her Fiat 500. The two shop together for antiques, with Miiko buying things she will never use, and later reselling them. Due to her need to help others, she is quite concerned about Ii's personality and nature.

name: Rizumu Niounomiya
description: A great detective and member of the Niounomiya Troupe. Has a split personality and is the "younger sister" of Izumu Niounomiya.

name: Shiogi Hagihara
description:
A masterful tactician that utilizes whatever she can to get the job done: Shiogi Hagihara. Carrying out any order given to her without question, she is a fearsome individual. She is an excellent marksman as well, who was able to handle a sniper rifle at 11 years old and take out targets who were over a kilometer away. At Sumiyuri Private Academy, she is one of the top students.

As a trained assassin, Shiogi is quite formidable with her job, even at a young age. Being intelligent, a master of martial arts, and proficient with her role, she is quite the strong assassin. Ii and Shiogi have a somewhat similar personality, though she has no trouble with living by simply following orders. Though she is often serious and radiating a bewitching aura as the edge of a katana, there are moments where she can get flustered, such as Ii complimenting her breast size. ~!Shiogi is the daughter of Noa Origami, which Ii learns after she figures out that her mother was killed through backwards thinking. Upon learning her mother is dead, she freaks out and loses an arm to Ichihime's string. She then charges Ichihime and is subsequently sliced into pieces.!~ ~!Shiogi has had a number of jobs, including assassinating the Zerozaki, protecting Iria Akagami from the Zerozaki clan, and finding Ichihime.!~

name: Kasuga Kasugai
description: A scientist at Kyouichirou Shadou's Laboratory.

name: Houko Yamiguchi
description:
Houko Yamiguchi is a runaway kid living in the Antique Apartments, and the half-sister of Moeta Ishinagi.

~!She is a former assassin of the Yamiguchi family, the second most powerful Killing Name.!~

name: Moeta Ishinagi
description: Moeta Ishinagi is a runaway kid living in the Antique Apartments, and the half-brother of Houko Yamiguchi.

name: Rabumi Katanashi
description: A flirtatious nurse at Ii's "favorite hospital" in Kyoto. Reads mystery novels.

name: Oguri Cap
description:
__Height:__ 167 cm

A coolheaded dreamer from the countryside.

Originally hailing from the countryside, she enrolled in Tracen Academy after dominating the racing scene back home. She works to make her hometown proud, but try as she might, her clumsy side always comes out. At the academy, she's known as a fearsome gourmand, able to empty an entire pot of rice in the blink of an eye.

name: Agnes Tachyon
description:
__Height:__ 159 cm

A super genius horse girl who’s one of the smartest horse girls of her time. Because of her great intellect, she’s never had to reveal her maximum ability. Thus her true skills are still unknown. Her personality is logical, intelligent, and eccentric. She’s not at all malicious, and in fact has a jovial, playful disposition. She has an Ultimate Super Ultra Sweet Tooth. She’s constantly eating sugar to keep her grey matter full of energy.

name: Rice Shower
description:
__Height:__ 145 cm

Bringer of misfortune? This racer pursues her dreams despite her dreary outlook.

A timid Umamusume, she is under the impression that any misfortune befalling those around her is entirely her fault, when really, it's just bad timing. Nevertheless, she is determined to eradicate this supposed jinx of hers. She loves reading picture books in her spare time, especially "The Blue Rose of Good Fortune."

name: T.M. Opera O
description:
__Height:__ 156 cm

The pompous star of the stage. Her laugh fills the room!

Opera O's behavior is always over-exaggerated, sometimes loudly, and you will often hear her proclaiming her greatness in some way or other. She seriously believes that those who do not know their own beauty and strength are unhappy, and she works tirelessly every day to enlighten them. She's friends with and admired by [Meisho Doto ](https://anilist.co/character/211557/Meishou-Dotou).

A member of Team Rigil as well as rival to [Narita Top Road ](https://anilist.co/character/273332/Narita-Top-Road) and [Admire Vega ](https://anilist.co/character/273331/Admire-Vega).

name: Silence Suzuka
description:
__Height:__ 161 cm

The silent runner aiming to break the sound barrier.

An Umamusume seen as a prodigy who's always ahead of the pack, both figuratively and literally. She gets so absorbed with running that she comes off as aloof, but most know that she is dedicated. She is roommates with Special Week and many find themselves attracted to her authentic personality.

name: Kitasan Black
description:
__Height:__ 140 cm (Season 2) / 162 cm (Season 3)
__Team:__ Spica

Her smile brightens the room. A festival-loving bucket of sunshine.

Ever bright and cheerful, she loves festivals more than anyone else. Her innate altruism makes her unable to ignore a person in need, and she's always ready to lend an ear. Her bottomless kindness has earned her the admiration of those around her, but when she gets too excited, her words take on a certain festival flair. With a smile as bright as the sun, she continues to run towards the dazzling horizon, hoping that she will discover her true dream along the way.

name: Special Week
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm

Rar'n to go! A pure-hearted girl focused on her dream.

Born in Hokkaido, Special Week is a bright and cheery, hardworking Umamusume. After losing her birth mother, Special Week was raised by her mother's friend. Now, she hopes to make both her moms proud by fulfilling her promise of becoming Japan's top racer. Though she may falter along the way, her indomitable spirit ensures that she runs ever forward.

name: Manhattan Cafe
description:
Always chasing shadows... Quite the mysterious Umamusume.

A mysterious girl who blends in with the shadows... and speaks with them. She can often be found sticking close to the walls, tracing odd patterns with her fingertips. According to her, however, she's always with her "friend." She enjoys sipping a nice cup of coffee, as gulping it down too quickly hurts her stomach.

name: King Halo
description:
Extremely haughty. Her pride extends to the heavens!

An Umamusume with an unbreakable spirit, King Halo is ready to overcome any challenge in order to be recognized by all as a first-class lady. Despite their strained relationship, she hopes to one day be recognized by her mother—a first-rate Umamusume and designer—and prove herself as a daughter. Yet to her gaggle of admirers at the academy, there's no doubt in their minds that she's already worthy of the title of "King," and they do not hesitate to regularly hail her as such.

name: Jungle Pocket
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm

Jungle Pocket is a bold and charismatic girl who is known for her wild energy, loud voice, and rough personality. She used to be the leader of a group of ruffians in the world of freestyle racing, but was so awestruck by [Fuji Kiseki](https://anilist.co/character/140847/Fuji-Kiseki)'s running that decided she wanted to race officially. With Fuji as her senior and [Agnes Tachyon](https://anilist.co/character/235974/Agnes-Tachyon) as her rival, she aims to be the strongest horse girl of the new era. ~!After losing against Agnes Tachyon in the Satsuki Sho she developed an imposter syndrome where she kept having doubts about herself and how she never beat Agnes Tachyon, concluding she was a fraud. Later on, Fuji Kiseki notices all of her doubts and challenges her to run against her. With this race that she proclaimed having lost, she remembers once again why she wanted to run in the first place. With this new determination inherited from Fuij Kiseki, she finally found the courage to beat her own fears, claiming victory agains T.M. Opera O in the Japan Cup.!~

name: Haru Urara
description:
__Height:__ 140 cm

No matter how many times she falls, this girl always picks herself back up!

She's on a losing streak... but she never gives up! While she may not be the most skilled, she experienced the excitement of racing back in Kochi and wanted more. While she completely flunked Tracen's entrance exam, her admissions officer was nonetheless impressed when they spoke by her boundless possibility—which she spreads to all the Umamusume around her. 

She is based on the internationally-famed racehorse of the same name with a record of 0 wins and 113 losses.

name: Daiwa Scarlet
description:
__Height:__ 163 cm

Beyond arrogant! This hothead hates to lose.

Unyielding, strong-willed, and cheeky, she wants to be number one at everything she does. She usually plays the role of the perfect, mild-mannered honor student, but the truth is that she hates losing more than anything else. If it'll help her be number one, she'll go through any training—no matter how grueling. She sees her rather showy roommate Vodka as both her motivation and her rival.

name: Meishou Dotou
description:
__Height:__ 164 cm

In order to change her outlook and herself, this pessimist gives it her all.

Her self-esteem droops as low as her ears. Things never seem to go quite right for this clumsy girl. Even so, she's determined to change herself for the better and doesn't want to ever give up, all for the chance at securing a brighter future. She admires [T.M. Opera O](https://anilist.co/character/140845/TM-Opera-O)'s grandiose self-confidence.

name: Satono Diamond
description:
__Height:__ 135 cm (Season 2) / 158 cm (Season 3)
__Team:__ Capella

Possesses a will harder than diamonds! She can handle any jinx!

Born to an affluent house, she was showered with love and affection growing up. This sheltered upbringing has made her somewhat naive, but her gentle, honest demeanor hides a diamond-hard resolve. She trudges on resolutely, determined to break the Satono family's jinx and bring honor to her family.

name: Admire Vega
description:
__Height:__ 157 cm

The lone star that shines brightest. She carries the weight of her immense resolve.

A somewhat gloomy Umamusume who tends to avoid company. A certain tragedy that took place early in her life affects her deeply, even making her racing activities seem like an attempt to atone. Though she doesn't intend it, her stoic pessimism garners the interest and concern of those around her, and she often gets caught up in the antics of T.M. Opera O, one of her racing peers. 

~!Admire Vega reveals that she was to be born with a twin sister, but that only one of them could survive until birth (presumably due to complications). Therefore she finds herself guilty of taking away her sister's right to run.!~

name: Narita Top Road
description:
__Height:__ 166 cm

An energetic honor student! ...But also kind of a supporting character?

A spirited competitor practically overflowing with positive energy. She wants nothing more than to meet the expectations of her fans and is determined to surmount any challenge to do so. Her willingness to acknowledge and compliment her competitors' strengths has earned her the popularity and respect of her peers. Though she has the makings of a star, she often seems to find herself in more of a supporting role.

name: Daitaku Helios
description:
__Height:__ 156cm

Good vibes only! For real, for real! No cap! ☆ Who's ready to party? This racer!

"I'm so loud?! Well, DUH, if you're gonna do something, you gotta make it FUN! And if you wanna call that cringe, I'll just crank it up even louder! ♪" That's the mindset of this bright, chatty runner. Get ready for smilemaxxing and par-tays, 'cause she's in it to enjoy it. Helios is never one to turn down an invitation, and has a way of making every occasion a blast.

name: Cheval Grand
description:
**Height**: 160cm

Ambitious with a timid heart. Aiming to become a great Umamusume.

She's introverted, withdrawn, and has an inferiority complex about her talented older and younger sisters. She spends her time working hard to hopefully surpass them both one day, and have her own abilities acknowledged. She's not on bad terms with either of her siblings... but they both have a glamorous temperament, which makes her a bit out of place when they're together.

name: Fuji Kiseki
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm

Always at your service. The classiest racer around.

A dashing performer who never hesitates to take another runner gently by the hand. You won't catch her flirting, however. Instead, she helps her dear ponies in her capacity as leader of Ritto Dormitory. As a runner, she hopes to captivate audiences just like her mother, a stage actress. Her ultimate stage: the Triple Crown.

In Seasons 1-3, she is affiliated with Team Rigil.

In The Beginning of the New Era, she trusts [Tanabe](https://anilist.co/character/330959/Tanabe-Trainer)'s skills as a trainer more than anyone else.

name: Agnes Digital
description:
**Height:** 143 cm

I love Umamusume! A super versatile otaku.

A veritable Umamusume otaku. She came to Tracen Academy to be close to all of her favorite runners. She does respect boundaries, however, and tries to stay out of trouble. She's eager to get up close and personal with as many Umamusume as possible, and to that end she has revealed surprising ability on both dirt and turf.

name: Dantsu Flame
description:
__Height:__ 163 cm

Dantsu Flame is a good-natured Umamusume who often goes along with the whims of others. Although not extremely confident in herself, she works very hard in the hopes that she can run in races forever. Because she can be easily swayed, she is usually pushed around by her unique peers. She is good friends with [Jungle Pocket](https://anilist.co/character/322150/Jungle-Pocket).

name: Curren Chan
description:
__Height:__ 155 cm

A shining star of pure cuteness! I need lots of love and attention, okay?

When you think of "cute," you think of Curren Chan, and when you think of Curren Chan, you think of the selfie goddess boasting over 3 million followers on Umastagram. Realizing just how adorable she was from the moment she was born, she's used her natural charm to bend her parents and seniors alike to her whims. Thanks to that, she is able to climb the social ladder of life with ease. To show everyone just how cute she is, she now aims for the top of the Twinkle Series.

name: Narita Brian
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3")

Actions speak louder than words! A tough and stubborn lone wolf.

A member of team Rigil. A lone wolf of few words and ample strength, Narita Brian is feared throughout the academy due to both her personality and her performance on the turf. She has little interest in anything besides running, which she does only to quench her own endless thirst. Off the racecourse, she is [Biwa Hayahide's](https://anilist.co/character/174851/Biwa-Hayahide) little sister and, for some reason, a student council vice president.

name: Aston Machan
description:
__Height:__ 152 cm

Aiming to be a mascot. An ephemeral eccentric girl.

She carries a Machan doll, and will approach any camera she sees. A particularly strange Umamusume, one of her hobbies is recording voice memos. Her dream is to become a mascot that spans the whole world. Behind her cloud-like fluffy words, it seems there may be a certain desire...?

name: Biwa Hayahide
description:
__Height:__ 171 cm

A fiery intellectual. Logic is her weapon!

A theorist through and through, she breaks down any problem systemically. Theory-driven as she is, she values practical application, so her methods never end up as just talk. She has honed her ability to compete with the overwhelming talent of her sister, Narita Brian. She is good friends with schoolmates Narita Taishin and Winning Ticket.

name: Yami Sukehiro
description:
__Height:__ 183 cm

Yami Sukehiro is a foreigner from the Land of the Sun and the first captain of the Clover Kingdom's Black Bulls squad of the Magic Knights. ~!He is also a former member of the Grey Deer squad.!~

name: Asta
description:
__Height:__ 155 cm (5'1")

An orphan who was left under the care of a church in the village of Hage. He dreams of becoming ​the Wizard King but is unable to use magic, so he trains to build up his physical strength. He is the wielder of a five-leaf clover anti-magic grimoire and is a 3rd Class Junior Magic Knight of the Clover Kingdom's Black Bull and Royal Knights squads.

name: Noelle Silva
description:
__Height:__ 161 cm (5'3")

Noelle Silva is a member of the Black Bulls and was inducted into the squad around the same time as [Asta](https://anilist.co/character/123285). She is the second daughter of one of the Clover Kingdom's royal families, House Silva, and the younger sister of the captain of the Silver Eagles, [Nozel Silva](https://anilist.co/character/124442). She likes sweets.

~!Her family disowned her due to her lack of control on her magic and having [their mother](https://anilist.co/character/124972) die while giving birth to her.!~

name: Yuno
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm (5'7")

Yuno was left, along with [Asta](https://anilist.co/character/123285/Asta), in front of a church in a village called Hage when he was an infant. He grew up at the church and spends most of his day with Asta. Sometime later, a thug tries to take his necklace away from him and sell it for money. Fortunately, Asta steps in and tries to take it back. In the end, the thug decided to leave without the necklace after Asta keeps charging at him. Since then, Yuno stopped crying and decides to take Asta's dream to be the Wizard King as his own as well.

name: Mereoleona Vermillion
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm

She is a noblewoman and the first daughter of the Clover Kingdom's House Vermillion, one of its royal families. She is also the captain of the Crimson Lion squad and the Royal Knights squad.

name: Julius Novachrono
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm

The Wizard King of Clover Kingdom's Order of the Magic Knights.
Fascinated by magic in all its forms, he eagerly seeks out and observes unusual magical abilities whenever possible. Those close to him know him for his boundless enthusiasm, excitement, and curiosity toward magic.

__Chapter 333 spoiler:__
~!It is revealed that Julius was born in a body with two souls, with the other being [Lucius Zogratis](https://anilist.co/character/319876)!~

name: Narrator
description:
This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. 

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

name: Charlotte Roselei
description:
__Height:__ 171 cm

Charlotte is a noblewoman of House Roselei and the captain of Clover Kingdom's Blue Rose squad of the Magic Knights.

She appears as a quiet, cold, and indifferent woman who keeps her emotions controlled and well hidden. She is constantly shown to appear as a rather stern woman, despite inwardly having an inward monologue that constantly appears to say calm down, especially around [Yami Sukehiro](https://anilist.co/character/124440/Sukehiro-Yami). She often does not respond to situations that go out of hand, preferring to appear indifferent and let things play out. She does respond well to emergencies and pressing concerns, performing her duties and moving swiftly to take care of any problems that come up. However, she still is capable of losing her composure and becoming annoyed, which almost always involves Yami teasing of her. She is also a lightweight when it comes to alcohol, barely able to finish a pint before becoming drunk.

Charlotte considers her duty to the kingdom to be her foremost responsibility, with little interest in the social aspects of life. Her beauty is quite noticeable when she chooses to show it, but she is more comfortable in plate mail than silk dresses and cares little for the opinions of most others. She also has a hard time being open with most people and expressing herself on occasion. That said, she often quips back at her fellow captains when they make rash decisions or do something she considers stupid, particularly Yami. However, she also has admiration for those who are competent and work hard, though she rarely ever shows it. Outwardly, she displays little interest in finding a husband and becomes angry when the subject is brought up, for which Yami repeatedly teases her and calls her "Spiny Prickly Queen."

name: Nacht Faust
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm

Nacht is a devil host and a former nobleman of House Faust. He spent several years working as a spy within the Spade Kingdom.

~!He is the vice-captain of the Clover Kingdom's Black Bulls squad.!~

name: Liebe
description: ~!Liebe is the devil who resides within Licht's former grimoire, which is currently Asta's grimoire. He is the source behind Asta's Anti Magic.!~

name: Fuegoleon Vermillion
description:
__Height:__ 188 cm

He is a nobleman and the first son of the Clover Kingdom's House Vermillion, one of its royal families. He is also the former captain of the Crimson Lion squad of the Magic Knights.

name: Nozel Silva
description:
__Height:__ 177 cm

Nozel is a nobleman and the oldest son of the Clover Kingdom's ruling family, House Silva. He is also the captain of the Silver Eagle squad of the Magic Knights. ~!He is also the son of Acier Silva, the older brother of Nebra Silva, Solid Silva and Noelle Silva, and the cousin of Kirsch Vermilion and Mimosa Vermilion.!~

name: Dorothy Unsworth
description: Dorothy is the captain of Clover Kingdom's Coral Peacock squad of the Magic Knights. She sleeps most of the time, but when she is awake she can bring enemies into a dream world where she controls everything.

name: Rill Boismortier
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm

Rill is the captain of Clover Kingdom's Azure Deer squad of the Magic Knights and a member of the Royal Knights squad.

name: Zenon Zogratis
description:
Zenon is a member of Spade Kingdom's Dark Triad
He is a tall man with black, messy hair. His most notable feature is a cross-shaped mark on the left side of his forehead and it extends down across his left eye. 
His magic Attribute is Bone Magic, and his Demon's magic gives him Spatial Magic

name: Jack the Ripper
description:
__Height:__ 197 cm

Jack is the captain of Clover Kingdom's Green Mantis squad of the Magic Knights.

name: Vanica Zogratis
description: Member of the Spade Kingdom's Dark Triad, and the host for the devil Megicula. She's a psychopath and she enjoys fightings against tough enemies. Her native magic is Blood Magic, whilst Megicula's magic is Curse Warding Magic.

name: Sally
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3")

She is a rogue mage and a member of the White Night Eye.

name: Dante Zogratis
description:
Dante is a member of the Spade Kingdom's Dark Triad and the host of the devil Lucifero.

Dante seems to be a calm and easy going individual. Even in the face of a surprising turn of events, he does not lose his cool.

He believes that evil is the true nature of humanity and the world is too dull because of it. Therefore, he considers being called evil a compliment, and encourages other people to embrace their malice, as it is a supreme emotion only humans have. He often looks down on who he considers weaker than him. His native magic is Flesh Magic, and his Demon's, Lucifero, is Gravity Magic.

name: Sekke Bronzazza
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm

Sekke is a member of Clover Kingdom's Green Mantis squad.

A magic knight who fought and lost to Asta during their entrance exam. He befriended Asta in order to use him as a stepping stone to show off his powers which he believed to be superior, as Asta appeared to be an incompetent magician.

As a magic knight, he complains about how tough he has it in his squad and that he's always tasked with monotonous chores. He meets Asta's group while gambling with an elderly woman on the black market. He tries to impress the women Asta is with, but ends up getting stabbed in the foot by a paralysis inducing knife while chasing a burglar. Believing his life to be over, he tries to pass on his unfulfilled life's ambition to Asta before realizing his injury is far from fatal.

name: Langris Vaude
description: He is a nobleman of House Vaude and the vice-captain of Clover Kingdom's Golden Dawn squad of the Magic Knights. He is from Tota, a village within the Clover Kingdom.

name: Sylph
description: Sylph is the spirit of wind and serves Yuno.

name: Gimodelo
description:
Gimodelo 「ギモデロ Gimodero」 is a devil who serves Nacht, the vice-captain of the Clover Kingdom's Black Bull squad of the Magic Knights.

(Source: Black Clover wiki)

name: Rades Spirito
description:
__Height:__ 174 cm

Rades is a rogue mage who is a member of the White Night Eye. He was a member of Clover Kingdom's Violet Orca squad of the Magic Knights.

name: Megicula
description: Megicula 「メギキュラ Megikyura」 is a high-ranking devil who serves Vanica, a member of the Spade Kingdom's Dark Triad.

name: Holo
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'2)

Holo is a wolf harvest deity originally from a land in the north known as Yoitsu. She made a promise with men from a town called Pasloe where she would ensure the town would have good wheat harvests year after year. However, as time went on, the townspeople slowly started to forsake Holo and did not rely on her as they once did. As such, Holo escapes from town in [Lawrence's](https://anilist.co/character/7374/) wagon and started traveling with him to see how much the world has changed since she has been in Pasloe. Holo has chosen the form of a girl younger than Lawrence, though she still retains her large wolf tail and ears. Her true form is that of a very large wolf which many people revered and feared.  

She refers to herself as the "Wise Wolf of Yoitsu" (ヨイツの賢狼). She is typically very haughty and self-sufficient, though due to her isolation for hundreds of years in Pasloe, she gradually feels very lonely, and sometimes shows a more fragile side of herself towards Lawrence, whom she relies on for company. Holo fears this loneliness, along with the difference in lifespans that she and Lawrence have, but hides it the best she can with jokes. She has a peculiar way of speaking, modeled after that of the oiran high-class courtesans. She is fond of delicious food and alcohol, but especially loves apples. She takes pride in her tail and takes special care of it, constantly combing and maintaining it.

name: Kraft Lawrence
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm (5'10'') 

Kraft Lawrence is a twenty-five-year-old traveling peddler who goes from town to town buying and selling various things in order to make a living. When he was twelve, he became an apprentice to a merchant relative, and set out on his own at eighteen. His goal in life is to gather enough money to start his own shop, and he has already been traveling for seven years while gaining experience in the trade. He meets Holo one night and eventually agrees to her traveling with him. She helps him by providing her wisdom which helps to increase his profits and get him out of jams. Lawrence usually goes by his surname, only some who have known him for a long time, like Jakob Tarantino, the master of his guild, call him by his first name Kraft in the novel.

name: Elsa Schtingheim
description: The church deaconess of the the village of Tereo, successor of the late father Franz.

name: Nora Arendt
description: She is a skilled shepherdess from a church-town named Lubinheigen. Her companion in this profession is a well-trained sheep dog named Enekk.

name: Myuri
description: ~!Lawrence and Holo's daughter!~

name: Dian Rubens
description:
Dian is an alchemist who is in the process of chronicling pagan tales and beliefs so as to print them in books.

 ~!She is actually an immortal bird deity, similar to how Holo is a wolf deity.!~

name: Fleur Boland
description: A merchant staying at the same inn in Renos as Lawrence and Holo.

name: Helena
description: Helena is a waitress working at the Tails of Beasts and Fishes restaurant in the town of Renose.

name: Col Tote
description: A boy saved by Lawrence at the river checkpoint. A naive but clever lad. He strives to become a priest to save his village.

name: Evan Gyoam
description: A young miller who's romantically involved with Elsa.

name: Fermi Amarty
description:
He is a young man who works as a fish broker. 

~!Amarty is in love with Holo. He wants Lawrence to sign a contract in order to buy Holo.!~

name: Zheren
description: A mysterious merchant that Lawrence and Holo meet on their journey when they visit a monastery. He suggests a "get rich quick" scheme to Lawrence involving reminted coins.

name: Ted Reynolds
description: The master of the Jean Company on the north bank of Kerube.

name: Lud Kiemann
description: The chief of the Kerube branch of the Rowen Trade Guild.

name: Louis Schtinghilt
description: Louis Lana Schtinghilt, better known as Father Franz, was the abbot of Diendran Abbey in Tereo and, secretly, a mythologist and collector of pagan tales.

name: Marten Liebert
description: He is a business worker for Hans Lemerio.

name: Yergin
description: Amalie's servant.

name: Kalm
description: Myuri's childhood friend, a boy who likes mischief. He also likes Myuri. Hearing that Muri has left the house with Col, he comes to tell Lawrence that he wants to propose to Myuri when she's back.

name: Amalie Draustem-Hadish
description: She's the seventh lord of Hadish village.

name: Horad
description: A shepherd. The couple encounters him on their way from Svernel back to Nyohhira in Volume 19 of the Light Novel.

name: Selim
description: Aram's younger sister, she came to the north with Aram to start a bathhouse. She's a girl who looks more serious and melancholy as Aram does, and she looks like a nun. Her hair and complexion are light, giving her the impression of being wealthy. She looks a little older than Holo when she looks like a human. Her true identity is a female wolf with a beautiful silver coat. Contrary to her human appearance, it seems that she's actually much younger than Holo. Her true form is still twice as small as Holo, yet still larger than a regular person. After many twists and turns, she decided to live and work at the "Spice and Wolf" bathhouse, which had been short of manpower due to the lack of Col and Myuri.

name: Hanna
description: A woman introduced by Hilde, who first appears in Volume 17. A hard worker who takes over the kitchen of Lawrence's bathhouse "Spice and Wolf" and works for three people alone.Her identity is not as expected, and Lawrence hasn't heard the details yet, but it seems to be an incarnation of a bird.

name: Hans Remelio
description: Hans Remelio is the head of his Remelio Trading Company that was heading towards bankruptcy when first met by Lawrence and Holo.

name: Chihaya Ayase
description:
__Height:__ 167 cm (5'6")

A determined schoolgirl who "possesses a remarkable hearing ability". She believes that by persevering in karuta, she will meet [Arata](https://anilist.co/character/47165/Wataya-Arata) again, and begins a karuta club at her high school with [Mashima](https://anilist.co/character/47167/Mashima-Taichi). While she is beautiful, she is considered too weird; her classmates refer to her as a "waste of a beauty". She has been described as a "tomboy trapped in a supermodel's body".

name: Taichi Mashima
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm (5'7") 

Taichi is from a wealthy family (His father & Grandfather are both doctors). [Chihaya's](https://anilist.co/character/47163/Ayase-Chihaya) childhood friend is quite the golden boy. Smart, good looking, and mature, he excells at nearly everything he does which makes him the voice of reason in the Misusawa Karuta Club. While he sees himself as keeper of Chihaya and the less experienced members, he demands a lot of himself both in games and as a leader and can overthink even the most simple situations. Taichi's karuta leverages his incredible memory to give him a sense of which cards might be called next and the ability to out-think opponents. He also has a crush on Chihaya but is hesitant to do anything as he thinks that she only has eyes for [Arata](https://anilist.co/character/47165/Wataya-Arata).

name: Shinobu Wakamiya
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm
__Favourite Song:__ Poem #40 Though I would hide it, In my face it still appears-- My fond, secret love. And now he questions me: "Is something bothering you?"

Shinobu Wakamiya is the current Queen of Karuta, she is also the youngest Queen in history. She is left-handed. Shinobu has been described as someone who is cute, but having the fashion sense of a rock. She often feels as if her opponents are vigorous and active at the beginning of match, but when on verge of losing, it feels as if she was back to playing karuta alone again. Arata and Shinobu know each other very well, she has never beat him in a karuta match. Shinobu started playing karuta when she and her divorced mother moved to her Grandma's house and found the box of karuta cards, which she fell in love with. Shinobu became a Class A karuta player when she was in fourth grade.

name: Arata Wataya
description:
__Height:__ 173cm (5'8") 
__School:__ Fukui Prefecture East Hitsufujioka High School 
__Karuta Society:__ Fukui Nagumo Society - A Class

Arata Wataya was a transfer student from Fukui that went to Chihaya's elementary school. The grandchild of a master karuta player, Arata inspires Chihaya to take up karuta by telling her that he thinks she has a talent for it. He had difficulty fitting in at Chihaya's elementary school because of his Fukui dialect and his family's poverty. His passion for karuta is inspired by his grandfather, a Meijin (master). After their first game at Arata's house, Chihaya befriends him. His dream is to become a Karuta Meijin. After graduating from elementary school, he returned to Fukui to care for his sick grandfather. He stops playing karuta because his grandfather died while Arata was competing in a karuta tournament to rise to A-rank. However, after Chihaya and Taichi visit him in Fukui, he regains his resolve to play competitive karuta again.

name: Kanade Ooe
description:
__Height:__ 150 cm
__School:__ Municipal Mizusawa High School - Year 2 Class 5 - Karuta Club accountant
__Karuta Society:__ Shirohoku Society - C Class

A girl with a taste for the classics, Kanade is a quiet girl who works in a kimono store and loves all kinds of traditional clothing. She is quite knowledgeable about the true meanings behind the One Hundred Poems and joins the karuta club on the condition that they start wearing hakama. 

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Hisashi Suou
description:
__School:__ 8th Year University student 
__Karuta Society:__ No society - Super A Class 
__Height:__ 180 cm 
__Hobby:__ Karuta 
__Favourite Song:__ Poem #2 The spring has passed And the summer come again

The reigning Master. He possesses the most intuition out of all the current karuta players, and has 28 one-syllable cards.  [Wikipedia] ; For the silk-white robes, So they say, are spread to dry On the "Mount of Heaven's Perfume."  Suoh started Karuta during university, and became Meijin within 3 years, and has held the title for 4 consecutive years. Everyone acknowledges his god-like abilities, but he is on constant lookout for someone stronger than himself. He is a solitary genius who always suffers from hunger, and is hard to become excited. It is his 4th time repeating a year at university.  Personality: The current Meijin is a weirdo? At first glance he may look like a typical university student, but in reality he is tall, has a questionable beard, an extremely quiet voice, and loves Japanese confectionery. His personal favourite idol is “Kyokotan” (Yamashiro Kyouko) who is a professional Karuta reader. He once asked her for a recording of her reading the poems, after offering her a gift of confectionaries. He is a man who wants to only fight strong people, and so he rarely makes an appearance at tournaments. In an interview, he has started that he wants to quickly be Meijin 5 years in a row, become an eternal-Meijin, then retire.

name: Hideo Harada
description:
__Level:__ Class A, 6. Dan
__Group:__ Shiranami Karuta Society

Hideo Harada is the head of the Shiranami Society for karuta that Chihaya and Taichi are part of. He used to teach Arata as well, while Arata was in primary school with Chihaya and Taichi. He taught Chihaya throughout Junior High School and is currently mentor to both Chihaya and Taichi. He is also a medical doctor and married.

Harada Hideo is portrayed as a kind man with a deep and insightful knowledge of the game of karuta. He states that he teaches his students offensive karuta, which aims to take cards from the opponent's side. He is extremely competitive, whether on behalf of his students or as a competitor himself, or even as a figurehead, representing his karuta society, and is his students' staunchest supporter.

name: Tsutomu Komano
description:
__Height:__ 157 cm
__School:__ Municipal Mizusawa High School - Year 2 Class 1 - Karuta Club secretary and recorder of matches
__Karuta Society:__ Shirohoku Society - B Class

An intelligent boy in Chihaya's class who is second only to Taichi in test scores. Often tied to his desk and anti-social, he feels that nothing is worth doing unless it makes you smarter. However, Chihaya and Taichi help to convince him that karuta involves a lot of strategies and he joins the club. He is also left-handed.

name: Akito Sudou
description: Akito Sudo is another Class A karuta player. Together with his teammates from Hokuō Academy Karuta Club he was playing against the Mizusawa Karuta Club. After his team loses to them, he gains respect for them and supports Chihaya. It has been noted that Sudo has incredible potential that is stifled by his tendency towards sadism.

name: Sumire Hanano
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm 
__Karuta Society:__ Shiranami Society - No Class
__Favourite Song:__ Poem #9 Colour of the flower Has already faded away, While in idle thoughts My life passes vainly by, As I watch the long rains fall.

A first-year who's just been dumped by her boyfriend. She’s part of the twenty-strong recruiting class of prospective members the Karuta Club manages to attract, but she's not remotely interested in the Hundred Poets. She has a love interest in [Taichi Mashima](https://anilist.co/character/47167/Mashima-Taichi).

name: Haruka Inokuma
description:
Inokuma has short, blonde hair and round eyes. She wears rectangular glasses and her Karuta Level is Class A (Dan 7) while she's also won four consecutive Queen titles. She's also a mother of 3 children.

Like Ayase Chihaya and Wakamiya Shinobu, she posses good hearing and a strong game sense for karuta.

name: Midori Sakurazawa
description: Coach of the Fujisaki High School Karuta team.  She maintains an intense stamina program for all the members.

name: Yuusei Nishida
description:
__Height:__ 176 cm
__School:__ Municipal Mizusawa High School - Year 2 Class 9 - Karuta Club member
__Karuta Society:__ Suihoku Society - A Class

A rather tubby boy who is reluctantly often called 'Porky' by Chihaya. Once a top karuta player who had previously played against Chihaya, Arata and Taichi in an elementary school tournament, Yusei quit karuta after suffering a defeat against Arata and took up tennis as a refuge. However, Chihaya manages to remind him how he used to play for fun and he ends up joining the karuta club.

name: Rion Yamashiro
description: Member of the Fujisaki High School karuta team. She is also the granddaughter of Kyoko Yamashiro.

name: Hiro Kinashi
description: An eccentric member of the Hokuou Academy Karuta Club. His rank is Class B.

name: Akihiro Tsukuba
description:
__Height:__ 167 cm

A boy who joins the Karuta Club at the start of Chihaya's second year. He is originally from Hokkaido and is a master at playing second verse karuta using two hands. He joins the club to learn how to play first verse karuta.
Tsukuba played the Hokkaido-style Karuta until his last year in middle school, therefore he came to the Karuta club very confident. Even though the rules are different than what he’s used to, he has a drive to become strong and becomes a Karuta club member.

name: Taeko Miyauchi
description: The adviser for the tennis club, badminton club, chemistry department, and karuta club. Although against karuta at first, she eventually warms up to the game after witnessing Chihaya and the others play. From then on she started actively cooperating with the team.

name: Chitose Ayase
description:
__Height__: 159cm  

Chihaya's older sister. She's a model and the complete opposite of Chihaya's tomboyish personality.

name: Yuu Ashino
description: Arata's neighbor.

name: Hajime Wataya
description: Arata's grandfather, a karuta master.

name: Chieko Ayase
description: Chihaya's mother.

name: Rieko Ooe
description: Kanade's mother. She runs a kimono store, which provides hakama for the Mizusawa Karuta Club.

name: Shiho Wakamiya
description: The mother of Shinobu Wakamiya, the current Queen.

name: Kyouko Yamashiro
description: She's a professional karuta reader, often reading for championships or higher level events. She has a granddaughter, Rion Yamashiro.

name: Kaiji Itou
description: The main character of the story. Kaiji is poor, downtrodden and lazy - he lives by himself in a slum and is constantly in debt. He bides his time by playing cheap gambling games with neighbors, though he always loses. In spite of this, when his life is in danger, he displays a remarkable hidden capacity for gambling, which allows him to endure the hardships he faces. He is shouldered with a 3,850,000 yen debt at the beginning of the story by a coworker who convinced him into consigning a loan, leaving Kaiji with the full weight of the debt compounded over a year. Though he started off as somewhat of a naive man, he quickly develops into a clever and thoughtful gambler after his first experience on the Espoir.

name: Kazuya Hyoudou
description:
The second son of Kazutaka Hyoudou, a spoiled child who loves gambling as much as his father. Having only been treated falsely throughout his entire life, by people who only wanted to use him for his money or pleased him to avoid retribution, Kazuya does not understand human bonds and believes that friendship and love are simply lies that will fall away at the last moment. He also seeks to become an acclaimed author, believing that, this way, he will get true acceptance and praise, not merely humored by people who hate him for his father's sake.

After Kaiji disagrees with his outlook on life, he sets up a "Salvation Game" to put their contradictory worldviews to the test and see which is true, and which is false.

~! After Kaiji defeats him in One Poker, he falls from the great height of the building as the condition of the loser, but Kaiji, Chang, and Mario manage to save him from the fall as an act of mercy. He is shown to be unconscious after they leave him to escape with the money he bet. Enraged with his son's condition and the loss of 2.4 billions Yen, Kazutaka commands the blacksuits and Endo to capture Kaiji, Chang, and Mario to get the money back. !~

name: Bowen Chang
description:
Chang Bowen is one of the three friends who participate in Kazuya's Salvation Game. Like Mario, he came to Japan in order to seek money to get out of poverty.

He was originally from a poor rural village in China and the second son to a poor family. Because of China's single child policy, he was sent into a life of hard manual labor at a very young age.

Chang did his best trying to learn Japanese with the materials he bought from what little money he had, aiming to purchase a family register and migrate to Japan to feed his family.

name: Mario Garcia
description:
Mario is one of the three friends who participated in Kazuya's Salvation Game. Like Chang, he came to Japan in order to seek money to get out of poverty.

He and his family lived in poverty in the Philippines in an massive landfill called the Smokey Mountain.

name: Kaoruko Waguri
description:
__Height:__ 148 cm

An ace student at Kikyo Private Academy. Kaoruko is incredibly intelligent and kind, but often acts airheaded as well. She greatly enjoys eating sweets, meeting [Rintaro](https://anilist.co/character/268677/Rintarou-Tsumugi) in his family's cake shop and quickly befriending him. Despite later learning that he attends Chidori High—a school at bitter odds with her own—she continues to be close with him.

name: Rintarou Tsumugi
description:
__Height:__ 190 cm

A student at Chidori High. Rintarou is a very kind and calm person, but his blonde hair and piercings—adopted due to struggles with self-expression in his childhood—have led to many writing him off as a delinquent. The exceptions to this are his close friends at Chidori High, as well as [Kaoruko](https://anilist.co/character/268676), a girl from an opposing school known as Kikyo Private Academy. After first meeting Kaoruko in his family's cake shop, Rintarou gradually begins to spend more time with her.

~!Later, Rintarou falls for Kaoruko and confesses his feelings to her. While this causes some awkwardness between the two at first, she eventually returns his feelings and they begin dating.!~

name: Subaru Hoshina
description:
[Kaoruko](https://anilist.co/character/268676/Kaoruko-Waguri)'s closest friend since middle school. Subaru is noted to be exceptionally pretty by her peers but has a somewhat withdrawn personality, particularly having trouble whilst talking to boys. She's also very protective of Kaoruko, initially disapproving of her relationship with [Rintaro](https://anilist.co/character/268677/Rintarou-Tsumugi) and the others before discovering how kindhearted the boys are.

~!Despite becoming friendly with the Chidori High boys, Subaru feels as though she doesn't fit in with the group despite wanting to be close with them. However, with Kaoruko and the boys' help she reaffirms her friendship with them, even becoming comfortable enough to casually tease [Saku](https://anilist.co/character/272241/Saku-Natsusawa) and bring him presents for his birthday.!~

name: Saku Natsusawa
description:
A student at Chidori High and a close friend of [Rintarou's](https://anilist.co/character/268677/Rintarou-Tsumugi), alongside [Shouhei](https://anilist.co/character/272240/Shohei-Usami) and [Ayato](https://anilist.co/character/272243/Ayato-Yorita).

Despite his attractive features he always appears gloomy, making him appear hard to talk to. But while he is more withdrawn than his friends he cares deeply about them and is naturally kind despite his cynical exterior. He is also incredibly intelligent, being the smartest student at Chidori High and even outdoing Kikyo's students, as noted by [Subaru](https://anilist.co/character/270095/Subaru-Hoshina) who begins to study with him.

~!Due to his standing as a genius he became isolated from his peers in middle school, resulting in his current introverted personality.!~

name: Shohei Usami
description: A student at Chidori High and a close friend of [Rintaro](https://anilist.co/character/268677/Rintarou-Tsumugi)'s, alongside [Ayato](https://anilist.co/character/272243/Ayato-Yorita) and [Saku](https://anilist.co/character/272241/Saku-Natsusawa). Shohei is extremely outgoing, being the most talkative member of Rintaro's friend group. He also holds no hostility towards Kikyo's students despite the opposing school's vitriol towards each other.

name: Ayato Yorita
description: A student at Chidori High and a close friend of [Rintarou's](https://anilist.co/character/268677/Rintarou-Tsumugi), along with [Saku](https://anilist.co/character/272241/Saku-Natsusawa) and [Shohei](https://anilist.co/character/272240/Shohei-Usami). Ayato is rather friendly, and while he prefers to avoid situations involving violence, he is highly capable of defending himself and will readily fight should his friends be threatened.

name: Kyouko Tsumugi
description: [Rintaro](https://anilist.co/character/268677/Rintarou-Tsumugi)'s mother. She runs the Tsumugi Family Bakery alongside her husband [Keichiro](https://anilist.co/character/299398/Keichiro-Tsumugi).

name: Madoka Yuzuhara
description: A good friend of [Kaoruko](https://anilist.co/character/268676/Kaoruko-Waguri)'s that attends Kikyo Private Academy. Extremely friendly and outgoing, and unlike her fellow classmates at Kikyo, harbors no animosity or negative feelings towards the students at Chidori High.

name: Keichiro Tsumugi
description: [Rintaro](https://anilist.co/character/268677/Rintarou-Tsumugi)'s father. He runs the Tsumugi Family Bakery alongside his wife [Kyouko](https://anilist.co/character/286245/Kyouko-Tsumugi). He is dedicated to his work as a baker, spending nearly every day in the kitchen perfecting his technique.

name: Makoto Tsukada
description: The homeroom teacher for Rintaro and his friends at Chidori High.

name: Ayumi Sawatari
description:
A good friend and classmate of [Kaoruko](https://anilist.co/character/268676/Kaoruko-Waguri)'s, and a student at Kikyo Private Academy. Raised in a strict and accomplished family, she grew to rely on the negative rumors about the students at Chidori Public High School to protect her self-esteem.

~!Later, with Kaoruko's help, she overcomes her self esteem issues and becomes friends with the Chidori High boys, letting go of her previous preconceptions of them.!~

name: Soutarou Tsumugi
description: [Rintarou](https://anilist.co/character/268677/Rintarou-Tsumugi)'s older brother. He moved out of his family's house and works as a beautician.

name: Mio Natsusawa
description: [Saku](https://anilist.co/character/272241/Saku-Natsusawa)'s younger sister.

name: Kousuke Waguri
description: [Kaoruko](https://anilist.co/character/268676/Kaoruko-Waguri)'s brother.

name: Fuuko Waguri
description: [Kaoruko](https://anilist.co/character/268676/Kaoruko-Waguri)'s mother.

name: Suzuka Asakura
description: A friend of [Kaoruko](https://anilist.co/character/268676/Kaoruko-Waguri)'s, and a student at Kikyo Private Academy.

name: Chisa Minamoto
description: [Kaoruko's](https://anilist.co/character/268676/Kaoruko-Waguri) friend and classmate at Kikyo Private Academy.

name: Ayame Toki
description: Teacher & student guidance counselor at Kikyo Private Academy. Homeroom teacher for [Kaoruko](https://anilist.co/character/268676/Kaoruko-Waguri)’s class; extremely strict and holds bias against Chidori students.

name: Satsuki Nabata
description: Classmate of [Tsumugi Rintaro](https://anilist.co/character/268677/Rintarou-Tsumugi) from middle school. She was initially scared of him but gradually learnt about his gentle nature. She dyes her hair blonde after being inspired by Tsumugi to change.

name: Reo Hidaka
description: Reo was a friend and study partner to [Saku Natsusawa](https://anilist.co/character/272241/Saku-Natsusawa), before they got into a disagreement and parted ways.

name: Tang Fang
description:
An aloof, lazy, patient and tolerant Head of the memory recycling station.

She is calm and composed, detached, with little emotional fluctuation. When speechless, she simply remains silent. She does her job as required, but occasionally she will get a little angry because of Bai Zhong's low-level mistakes.

name: Gintoki Sakata
description:
__Height:__ 177 cm  

A samurai living in an era where a samurai is no longer needed. To add to his troubles, oppressive aliens have moved in to invade. Gintoki lives with [Kagura](https://anilist.co/character/674) and [Shinpachi](https://anilist.co/character/673), taking on odd jobs to make the world a better place...and to pay their rent. In the Joi war, he was known as the "White Devil" (Shiroyasha) due to his silver hair and white coat he wore in battle, which, combined with his impressive capabilities as a swordsman, made him famous among his comrades and struck fear into Amanto.

Gintoki has naturally permed silver hair, which he blames for his lacking love-life. He has a big crush on the TV's news weather girl, [Ketsuno](https://anilist.co/character/6225). In fact, to date, the only time he is seen to have blushed is when he tries to make use of [Sadaharu](https://anilist.co/character/2651) and Ketsuno's dog to get a chance to talk to her. Though several female characters have shown an interest in Gintoki, he usually does not show any response back and merely puts up with them as annoyances.

Gin has two major obsessions in life. He is obsessed with sweet foods such as parfait, ice cream, and cake. His second obsession is reading the manga anthology magazine Weekly Shōnen Jump. (Which, not coincidentally, is where Gintama is published in). His favorite type of milk is strawberry milk. Gin will go to great lengths to get the latest Jump issue, to the point of reckless behavior. His Jump obsession makes him easily dream of being like other Jump heroes, including wishing that he had a "Bankai" similar to the hero characters of Bleach.

Despite his appearance and initial behavior, Gintoki has a great amount of pride for the old Bushido code. He takes it upon himself to rescue or avenge not only his comrades and friends but also people he barely got acquainted too, be it a pit-fighter who was taking care of abandoned orphans or an Amanto who resembles a kappa.

Despite being a fearsome fighter with nearly unmatched skills, he avoids needless bloodshed after suffering the loss of most of his friends and allies during the Joi war.

name: Kagura
description:
__Height:__ 155 cm

Although she appears to be a normal, cute, human girl in Chinese-style clothing, she actually belongs to the Yato Clan, one of the strongest and most bloodthirsty of the Amanto races. The Yato is said to have "transparent" skin that is highly sensitive to sunlight, so Kagura carries a purple parasol at all times. The parasol is also the Yato clan's weapon of choice; Kagura's is bulletproof and fires bullets from its tip. Because of her Yato blood, she is super-strong and can stop a speeding motor-scooter with one hand. Although stronger than most humans, she cannot control her strength perfectly. Her super-human strength makes her extremely bad with pets. Most of her pets, with the exception of [Sadaharu](https://anilist.co/character/2651/Sadaharu), have met with an untimely demise at her hands.

She is also extremely flexible and fast; capable of catching multiple speeding bullets between her teeth and fingers. During a battle, she's often seen flipping through the air and performing various acrobatic feats. Due to her Yato blood, she is capable of rapid regeneration. During the Benizakura arc, she is seen healing from a gunshot wound almost overnight.

Kagura also has an unusually strong appetite. She is able to consume large quantities of food within a matter of seconds. Nevertheless, her tastes are endearingly plain. Sukonbu, rice, and eggs are among her favorite foods.

Her immediate family consists of her father, [Umibouzu](https://anilist.co/character/9876/Umibouzu), a widely recognized alien hunter, her mother, who is deceased, and her older brother [Kamui](https://anilist.co/character/12946/Kamui), once presumed missing who is now involved with the space pirates Harusame.

She came to Earth to earn money for her family. She found work fighting for a gang, but when they ordered her to kill her target, she ran away. Not long afterward, she met [Gintoki](https://anilist.co/character/672/Sakata-Gintoki) and [Shinpachi](https://anilist.co/character/673/Shimura-Shinpachi) when Gintoki accidentally ran her down with his scooter. After they helped her to make a clean break from the gang, she intimidated Gintoki into hiring her. She now lives at the Yorozuya and sleeps in Gintoki's closet, like [Doraemon](https://anilist.co/character/4304/Doraemon).

Kagura and Gintoki share an odd father-daughter-like relationship. Together with Shinpachi, the three of them make for a strange, dysfunctional, yet tightly knit family. Kagura is very protective of Gintoki. Although, she herself has gotten into many fights with him, rarely does she let anyone else pick on him. She seems to trust wholeheartedly in Gintoki's ability and strength. Even in sticky situations, she has no doubt that Gin-chan would come to save her. She has a tendency to imitate Gintoki's bad habits, and would often quote the bad advice he gives her. Some of her lines start with "Gin-chan says..." or "Gin-chan told me..."

Kagura is also somewhat of a tomboy. She is often seen partaking in games with various neighborhood boys. Although her candid manner of speech often causes them to shun her, she doesn't seem to mind. In fact, she has no problem at all with forcing her way into their game. In battle, she has proven to be bull-headed and a sore loser. Like Gintoki, and probably because of his influence, she is not above resorting to petty tricks and manipulation to get the better of her adversary. Unlike many conventional manga heroines, she doesn't display the same consciousness toward decorum, table manners, ​and physical appearance. Puking, cussing, picking her nose, spitting, fighting, and scratching herself is common behavior for Kagura.

She regards [Okita](https://anilist.co/character/2282/Okita-Sougo), captain of the Shinsengumi, as a rival. She detests him, and appeared to be disgusted when she previously mentioned (about Okita), that "he definitely likes me", but as that hasn't been brought up since, it is uncertain if it should be considered canon, that he apparently likes her.

According to the OVA, Kagura is the first and only Weekly Shonen Jump girl to vomit on-screen. To date, she has induced herself to vomit on several occasions. She also has an uncanny knack for seeming calm or detached during high-tension situations; in episode 5, she slept through a car-chase. Her appetite knows no bounds, and she is especially fond of sukonbu.

In Japanese, Kagura speaks in a stereotypical dialect that is associated with Chinese immigrants. In the English-translated manga, she punctuates her sentences with yup, uh-huh, nope, and the like.

~!In the Yoshiwara in Flames arc, Kagura meets her older brother, Kamui who abandoned her because she was weak in his eyes.!~ In the last Gintama character popularity poll, she came in 6th place.

name: Kotarou Katsura
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5'8")

Katsura is [Gintoki](https://anilist.co/character/672)'s former comrade during the Joi war. Even after the Amanto take-over of Japan, Katsura continues to resist the Amanto, and has amassed a band of followers.

He is a wanted man due to his involvement in terrorist activities against the Bakufu, and is constantly on the run from the Shinsengumi. Although his initial methods were originally more violent in nature (for instance, sending a bomb to an Amanto embassy), Katsura has gradually grown to believe that there are people important to him in Edo, and decides that he no longer wants to destroy the country, but believes there should be a way to change it without causing sacrifices.  Katsura seems to be highly respected by his followers, and has even been called the "Daybreak of the Joui Faction" by some. When people believed that Katsura had died during the Benizakura arc, even other terrorist groups tried to avenge his death. Since he is a wanted man, Katsura is often seen wearing disguises, although his identity is often still easily found out. 

Katsura seems to possess a rather outdated sense of humour, and sometimes refers to things from a past era, such as when he tried to buy a Famicon when people were queuing up to buy the OwEe (a parody of the Wii).
