Despite her lackadaisical image, she can be extremely serious when needed. She's shown to be somewhat maternal, especially with Orihime and Momo.

name: Soi Fon
description:
__Race:__ Shinigami
__Height:__ 150 cm (4'11")
__Rank:__ Captain of the 2nd Division, Commander-in-Chief of the Onmitsukidō, Corps Commander of the Executive Militia Corp, 9th Head of the Fēng Family
__Previous Position:__ Bodyguard of [Yoruichi Shihouin](https://anilist.co/character/908/Yoruichi-Shihouin) Executive Militia member

Soi Fon is staunchly loyal, firm, and unbending in her beliefs. She is a hard worker and takes a strong moral stand — she particularly believes in following orders. She is generally reserved and not arrogant like her lieutenant. She will not hesitate in the slightest to strike down even her subordinates if they stand in her way. Soi Fon, like most female shinigami, is a member of the Shinigami Women's Association.

Underneath her standard shinigami captain uniform, Soi Fon wears the special forces leader's uniform, which has no sleeves or covering for the back. The reason the shoulders and the back are exposed is because of Soi Fon's ability to use shunkō (flash cry), an advanced technique that combines hand to hand combat and kidō and causes high spiritual pressure to accumulate at the shoulders and back, blasting away the fabric at the shoulders and back. Her hair is worn short with two long braids covered in cloth.

Long ago, she had a close friendship with Yoruichi Shihouin that went beyond the typical leader/subordinate relationship. When Youruichi left the soul society with no explanation, Soi Fon took it as a personal betrayal of her feelings, with gives rise to her intense hatred of anyone who disobeys orders or disturbs the harmony of the soul society. She finally comes to terms with her feelings toward Yoruichi during the "Rukia Rescue" arc, and the two becomes friends again soon after. Soi Fon has borderline romantic feelings toward Yoruichi which becomes evident on several occasions such as when she buys some photos of Yoroichi eating voraciously in skimpy clothing.

Soi Fon also has a personal dislike for [Kisuke Urahara](https://anilist.co/character/210/Urahara-Kisuke) because of his close relationship with Yuruichi. Another person she dislikes is her own lieutenant, [Oomaeda](https://anilist.co/character/5728/Oomaeda-Marechiyo), whom she punches quite frequently for his stupidity and cowardice.

The correct romanization of her name, as confirmed by [Kubo Tite](https://anilist.co/staff/96880/Kubo-Tite), is Suì-Fēng.

name: Yasutora Sado
description:
__Height:__ 197 cm (6'5")  

Yasutora Sado, or as his friends call him, Chad, is a teenager of Mexican descent who is close friends with [Ichigo Kurosaki](https://anilist.co/character/5/Ichigo-Kurosaki). He is extremely tall and appears to be much older than he actually is.

Chad is a quiet person and is sometimes the subject of jokes or bullies because he never fights back, against ordinary humans, or often hollows and Soul Reapers until necessary. Nonetheless, he is treated equally within his group of friends in Karakura (Ichigo, [Keigo](https://anilist.co/character/4227/Asano-Keigo) and [Mizuiro](https://anilist.co/character/9060/Kojima-Mizuiro)). Chad also has a weakness for cute things, like small animals and [Kon](https://anilist.co/character/1089/Kon), and is one of the few characters that actually treats Kon with any dignity but for the most part ignores him. To match his extraordinary size, Chad possesses extraordinary superhuman durability, even before activating his spiritual powers, being able to survive the impact of a falling steel girder on his back and a head-on motorcycle collision, and is strong enough to break telephone poles and wield them as giant clubs, even when already injured. Besides his physical strength, Chad has also shown to be very intelligent; he ranked 10th out of 322 in school, while Ichigo ranked 23rd.

name: Mayuri Kurotsuchi
description:
__Height:__ 174 cm (5'8") 
__Shikai:__ Ashisogi Jizou
__Bankai:__ Konjiki Ashisogi Jizou

Mayuri Kurotsuchi is Captain of the 12th Division in the Gotei 13 and the 2nd president of the Shinigami Research Institute. He gained his position after Kisuke Urahara, the former captain and president, was exiled by the Soul Society. His lieutenant is Nemu Kurotsuchi, his artificially created "daughter."

name: Shuuhei Hisagi
description:
__Height:__ 181 cm (5'11")
__Rank:__ Co-Lieutenant of the 9th Division
__Zanpakutou:__ Kazeshini (Death Wind)
__Shikai Command:__ Kare, Kazeshini (Reap, Kazeshini)  

Shuuhei is an extremely mature and calm individual, a state that is slightly at odds with his somewhat punk-like appearance. He usually takes responsibility, and tends to avoid violence when possible. He seems to be virtuous, much like his Captain's image; until later, when it was revealed his Captain was a traitor. He is often seen in the company of [Renji](https://anilist.co/character/906/Abarai-Renji) and [Kira](https://anilist.co/character/1093/Kira-Izuru). Along with [Hinamori](https://anilist.co/character/1092/Hinamori-Momo), Renji and Kira followed Shuuhei as their senpai during their academy days. Omake chapters also show that he is quite perverted.

name: Ikkaku Madarame
description:
__Height:__ 182cm (6'0") 

Ikkaku Madarame is the 3rd Seat of the 11th Division in the Gotei 13. His captain is Kenpachi Zaraki.  In terms of his attitude, Ikkaku is a stereotypical 11th Division member — violent, fight-loving, and rude. This has been noted by Tetsuzaemon Iba, among others. He loves fighting so much that he is unwilling to travel anywhere without a sword, resorting to carrying a wooden one when posing as a student at Ichigo Kurosaki's school. However, Ikkaku does have a sense of loyalty and responsibility unlike many of the lower-ranked 11th Division members, and is fiercely loyal to his captain, under whose command he wishes to die.  Ikkaku shares many personality traits with his division's captain, Kenpachi Zaraki, which explains why they seem to have so much respect for each other.

name: Yachiru Kusajishi
description:
__Race:__ Shinigami
__Height:__ 109 cm (3'7")
__Rank:__ Lieutenant of the 11th Division
__Relatives:__ [Kenpachi Zaraki](https://anilist.co/character/909) (adoptive father)

Yachiru is the shortest member of the Gotei 13. She became a shinigami without having taken the standard exams. She is the current Vice-Captain of the 11th division but her strength and powers thus far are unknown. She is also the president of the Shinigami's Women Society. 

She first met Kenpachi as a baby after he had just killed a group of people. She instantly became drawn to him as she later said that it was as though Kenpachi had used blood to wash away the dark, hopeless, unforgiving world she lived in.

name: Kon
description: Kon primarily serves as a comedic foil in the series; when not inhabiting Ichigo's body, his normal plushie body is treated with little respect and much disdain. The humorously cruel treatment he is always subjected to provides the comic relief in Bleach. One of the only people who gives him any respect is Chad; however, Chad ignores him most of the time. His plushie body is a knock-off of the main character of the popular TV show Carnivore Kingdom, named "Ponkichi", which happens to be Chad's favorite show. It was a prize from the shooting game in the Karakura Town Festival.

name: Nemu Kurotsuchi
description:
Nemu is the lieutenant of the 12th Division in the Gotei 13, under captain [Mayuri Kurotsuchi](https://anilist.co/character/1168/Kurotsuchi-Mayuri).

Nemu is the artificially created daughter of Mayuri Kurotsuchi, a combination of his research in artificial bodie  and artificial souls. This past has driven her to become rather introverted and melancholic, preferring to stay silent in her captain's presence. Their relationship is far from the average father-daughter one, as Mayuri doesn't seem to care much for Nemu's well-being (using her as bait in combat). The most that can be said in his favor is that he has occasionally implied concern over her life as a point of personal pride in his own skill as her creator. Despite being abused and mistreated in every possible way by her captain and father, Nemu still shows great loyalty to him, and has openly expressed worry at the prospect of his death, likely due to her implied gratitude that Kurotsuchi brought her into the world. Unlike her father, however, she seems to have compassion for others, saving [Uryū Ishida](https://anilist.co/character/564/Ishida-Uryuu)'s life as a thank you for not killing Mayuri. Based on the 13 squad episode endings and the Bount arc, Nemu's fighting style seems to be a combination of capoeira-like martial arts, and kidō attacks.

Nemu's body was designed to withstand fatal injury, though still suffers the pain brought on by her injuries. This extends to being able to survive impregnation by [Szayel Aporro Granz](https://anilist.co/character/3211/Grantz-Szayel-Aporro), a process meant to bring him back to life while leaving his host as an empty husk. Mayuri can repair Nemu very quickly in these situations, allowing her to continue doing her father's bidding. Nemu is also immune to Mayuri's many poisons. Despite this, she carries around a variety of antidotes to be used as she sees fit. She also holds various poisons and potions derived from Mayuri's research in her own body, making her highly dangerous to those that attack her internally. Nemu does not normally carry a zanpakutō, but she is revealed to have one in an illustration in the artbook "All Colour but the Black." Her zanpakutō takes the form of what appears to be a thin katana.

name: Yhwach
description:
__Affiliation:__ Wandenreich 
__Occupation:__ Emperor of the Wandenreich 

The current leader of the Vandenreich, the military organization of the Quincies. About 1000 years ago Yamamoto Genryuusai failed to kill him, although the circumstances remain unknown.  During Ichigo Kurosaki's guaranteed absense, Yhwach mobilizes the elite of his army, the Stern Ritter, and invades Soul Society. He gave them the order to kill all the death gods.  As the invasion proceeds Yhwach encounters Kenpachi Zaraki and the fight between those two begins. Yhwach easily wins over Kenpachi, commenting how weak he was. Before he manages to finish him off, he is interrupted by enraged Yamamoto.

name: Juushirou Ukitake
description:
__Height:__ 6'1" (187 cm)
__Rank:__ Captain of 13th Division
__Zanpakutou:__ [Sougyo no Kotowari](https://anilist.co/character/31391/Sougyo-no-Kotowari)

Ukitake is the captain of the 13 Division in the Gotei 13. Ukitake Juushirou is respected by many, especially by his subordinates, for his honesty, loyalty, and personal sense of justice. He is afflicted with an unknown illness.

He has been close friends with 8th Division Squad Captain [Kyouraku Shunsui](https://anilist.co/character/1088/Jirou-Souzousa-Shunsui-Kyouraku) since his youth, about 2000 years or more ago. The two frequently work together.  It is implied that, since he has achieved the rank of captain, Ukitake must be a powerful fighter. He is considered to be one of the strongest captains besides [Yamamoto](https://anilist.co/character/5726/Yamamoto-Shigekuni-Genryuusai), Kyouraku, [Unohana](https://anilist.co/character/3845/Unohana-Retsu), and [Aizen](https://anilist.co/character/1086/Aizen-Sousuke). However, he is limited by his illness to fighting only for short periods of time; excessive action triggers fits of bloody coughing.

name: Bambietta Basterbine
description:
__Race:__ Quincy
__Affiliation:__ Vandenreich
__Occupation:__ Stern Ritter "E"
__Team:__ Vandenreich
__Base of Operations:__ Vandenreich Base

Bambietta Basterbine is a Quincy and a member of the Vandenreich's Stern Ritter, with the designation "E".

name: Jugram Haschwalth
description: Haschwalth is a Quincy affiliated with the Wandenreich. He's a member of the Stern Ritter and the right hand of Yhwach.

name: Anna Yamada
description:
__Height:__ 171 cm (5'8")
__Occupation:__ Middle School Student (Second Year)

Yamada Anna is the main heroine of the story and is the classmate and love interest of [Ichikawa Kyoutarou](https://anilist.co/character/174191/Kyoutarou-Ichikawa). She is also an airhead who is pretty and very immature besides her looks.

She is a magazine model and actress. She is very popular with both boys and girls but has a clumsy side to her. Anna frequently snacks in the library, much to Kyoutarou's dismay. She is also shown to be very jealous to the point of obsession whenever Kyoutarou interacts with other girls.

name: Kyoutarou Ichikawa
description:
__Height:__ 156.5 cm (5'2")
__Occupation:__ Middle School Student (Second Year)
__Twitter:__ https://twitter.com/thanatos_moros

Ichikawa is the protagonist of the story Boku no Kokoro no Yabai Yatsu and a classmate of  [Yamada Anna](https://anilist.co/character/174190/Anna-Yamada). He at the beginning of the manga is a gloomy, antisocial, sadistic boy and eager to kill his classmates, but in reality he is a kind boy with an incredibly low self-esteem, reaching the point where he believes that the people feel disgusted with the simple fact of being by his side, but the only person who does not think that of him is Yamada.

~!He later becomes the love interest of Anna Yamada.!~

name: Kana Ichikawa
description: [Kyoutarou](https://anilist.co/character/174191/)'s older sister.

name: Moeko Sekine
description: Another of Anna's close friends. The loudest and most energetic of Anna's circle.

name: Yuuki Yamada
description: Yuki Yamada is a secondary character in Boku no Kokoro no Yabai Yatsu. He is the husband of [Sanae Yamada](https://anilist.co/character/306752) and the father of secondary protagonist [Anna Yamada](https://anilist.co/character/174190/Anna-Yamada) who is a quiet but somewhat doting father that enjoys cooking and video games.

name: Chihiro Kobayashi
description: Anna's best friend.

name: Sanae Yamada
description: Sanae Yamada is a secondary character in Boku no Kokoro no Yabai Yatsu. She is the wife of [Yuki Yamada](https://anilist.co/character/306773/Yamada-Yuuki) and the mother of [Anna Yamada](https://anilist.co/character/174190/Anna-Yamada).

name: Yurine Hanzawa
description: Yurine is a laid-back and quiet young woman. She becomes [Ichikawa](https://anilist.co/character/174191/Kyoutarou-Ichikawa) and [Yamada](https://anilist.co/character/174190/Anna-Yamada)'s classmate in their third year, in Class 3-1.

name: Lucifer Nigorikawa
description:
Lucifer Nigorikawa is a figment of [Ichikawa](https://anilist.co/character/174191/Kyoutarou-Ichikawa)'s imagination in Boku no Kokoro no Yabai Yatsu.

Not quite a real "character" per se, Nigorikawa is an imaginary figure that Ichikawa conjures up to help himself deal with his emotional shortcomings. He is largely based off of Nigorikawa-kun, the male lead of [Yamada](https://anilist.co/character/174190/Anna-Yamada)'s favorite shoujo manga, Your Color's Octave. The "Lucifer" moniker and the associated black wings he sometimes sprouts are additions from Ichikawa's chuunibyou delusions.

name: Kanna Andou
description: Kanna is notable for her obsession with other peoples' relationships. She becomes [Ichikawa](https://anilist.co/character/174191/Kyoutarou-Ichikawa) and [Yamada](https://anilist.co/character/174190/Anna-Yamada)'s classmate in their third year, in Class 3-1.

name: Nico Kouda
description:
~!__Twitter:__ https://twitter.com/pig_man1209!~

She is a fellow model in [Anna Yamada](https://anilist.co/character/174190/Anna-Yamada)'s agency.
~!She has an obsession with Yamada, bordering on stalking.!~

name: Mamiya
description: Childhood friend of Nanjou. Wants to advance their relationship, but never seems able to catch his eye.

name: Haruya Nanjou
description:
Haruya Nanjou is a secondary character in Boku no Kokoro no Yabai Yatsu.
A suave, but shallow playboy, Nanjou takes an interest in [Anna Yamada](https://anilist.co/character/174190/Anna-Yamada) for her looks and social status. He acts as a recurring antagonist and love rival for [Kyoutarou Ichikawa](https://anilist.co/character/174191/Kyoutarou-Ichikawa).

name: Ichikawa Haha
description: She is the mother of [Kana](https://anilist.co/character/193218/Kana-Ichikawa) and [Kyoutarou Ichikawa](https://anilist.co/character/174191/Kyoutarou-Ichikawa). She appears to be a fairly normal housewife, and does cooking and cleaning around their home, though she has some kind of part-time job.

name: Moriya-sensei
description: The teacher of Class 3-1. An energetic and high-spirited teacher that likes to move around a lot.

name: Maeda-sensei
description: The teacher of Class 2-3, a large, muscular man who seems to take an interest in bettering [Ichikawa](https://anilist.co/character/174191/Kyoutarou-Ichikawa) after he notices his interactions with [Yamada](https://anilist.co/character/174190/Anna-Yamada) begin to bring him out of his shell. He convinces him to do the end-of-year speech for his class.

name: Yuuki Suwa
description: Suwa is [Yamada](https://anilist.co/character/174190/Anna-Yamada)'s modeling manager.

name: Nao Kugenuma
description: A strong classmate of Ichikawa and Yamada.

name: Ichikawa no Chichi
description: He is the father of [Kana](https://anilist.co/character/193218/Kana-Ichikawa) and [Kyoutarou Ichikawa](https://anilist.co/character/174191/Kyoutarou-Ichikawa). A college instructor.

name: Kana Arima
description:
__Height:__ 150 cm (4'11")

An actress who was called a prodigy child. She has a rather stubborn personality yet an empathic side to her. She easily succumbs to pressure and while she does put up a front to others, she has very self-deprecating thoughts when it comes to her abilities. She's an honest and earnest person, who is very diligent and persistent even in the roughest of times. Also, she tends to place all responsibility on herself when it comes to others as she is the one who has the most experience in the show business world. She also hates bell peppers.
  
~!After the events of the Sweet Today Drama adaptation, she secretly develops a crush for [Aquamarine](https://anilist.co/character/183885/Hoshino-Aquamarine).!~

~!She longs for someone to look at her for who she is now and praise her efforts, someone to say that its okay for her to be here. And after the new B-Komachi's first concert, that person becomes Aquamarine after he waves her respected colored glow stick. Only reinforcing Kana's resolve to make Aquamarine fall for her.!~

name: Ai Hoshino
description:
__Height__: 151 cm (4'11")

She's an idol and lead of B-Komachi, an idol group affiliated with Strawberry Productions. Her life took a turn when through an undetermined amount of time, she became pregnant with twins. Not wanting to squander her reputation, she and her team decide to hide this fact; having to play the role of idol and mother.

name: Akane Kurokawa
description:
__Height:__ 163 cm (5'4")

Akane Kurokawa is a rising star actress from the Lalalie Theatrical Company. Although a shy and quiet person, she is very serious when it comes to creating a good performance. She does a deep examination of each role she is given, allowing her to perfectly portray the character's personality and motivations. Akane is introduced to [Aqua](https://anilist.co/character/183885) as a fellow cast member on the set of the reality dating show *The Beginning of My Love With An Idol*.

name: Aquamarine Hoshino
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm (5'7")

[Ai Hoshino's](https://anilist.co/character/172759/Ai-Hoshino) son. He is the twin big brother of [Ruby Hoshino](https://anilist.co/character/183884/Ruby-Hoshino).

~!He was previously a doctor named Goro, who became a fan of Ai through his patient named Sarina.!~ 

~!After reincarnating as Aquamarine and witnessing Ai's murder, he is intent on plotting revenge to the person who schemed Ai's death.!~

name: Ruby Hoshino
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm (5'2")

[Ai Hoshino's](https://anilist.co/character/172759/Ai-Hoshino) daughter, and the younger twin sister of [Aquamarine Hoshino](https://anilist.co/character/183885). 

~!She was previously a patient named Sarina under Goro's care. Due to her illness, she was wheelchair-bound. After discovering B-Komachi, she had always aspired to be an idol although her condition kept her from achieving her dream. Since being reincarnated as Ruby, she is now working towards her dream of being an idol like Ai. To do so she's currently working with Strawberry Productions to revive B-Komachi along with Arima Kana and Memcho.!~

name: MEM-cho
description:
__Height:__ 155 cm (5'1")

A girl who strived to become an idol at a young age, but due to her family situation, made sacrifices that ultimately ended with her becoming too old to become one. She is a YouTuber. 

~!Mem-cho's real age is 25, and she is later recruited as the third member of the re-formed B-Komachi idol group.!~

name: Miyako Saitou
description:
Miyako is married to [the president](https://anilist.co/character/245521) of Ichigo Productions and is [Ai's](https://anilist.co/character/172759) manager. She is a shallow woman who appears to have only married her husband due to the prospect of working with hot guys. She is also a babysitter to the twins.

~!After Ai's death, she becomes the twin's adoptive parent. As the twins blossom into adolescence, she becomes more mature, both as a caretaker and as a manager. She is also the manager of the new B-Komachi.!~

name: Abiko Samejima
description: Author of "Tokyo Blade".

name: Taishi Gotanda
description: Taishi Gotanda is a movie director, and the "mentor" of [Aquamarine Hoshino](https://anilist.co/character/183885/Aquamarine-Hoshino). He still lives with his [mother](https://anilist.co/character/302910).

name: Pieyon
description: A famous physical training YouTuber affiliated with Strawberry Productions, where he is the agency's top earner. On request from company president Miyako Saitou, he promotes the new B-Komachi by collaborating with Ruby Hoshino and Kana Arima in a physical training video on his channel.

name: Frill Shiranui
description:
Frill Shiranui is a student in Ruby Hoshino's class. She is a multi-talented performer who can sing, dance, and act. At first, Ruby is in awe of her, yet they eventually become friends. 

 ~!She is the younger sister of [Koromo Shiranui](https://anilist.co/character/212391/Koromo-Shiranui) from [Kaguya-sama wa Kokurasetai: Tensaitachi no Renai Zunousen](https://anilist.co/manga/86635/Kaguyasama-wa-Kokurasetai-Tensaitachi-no-Renai-Zunousen/).!~

name: Minami Kotobuki
description: She's a classmate and friend of Ruby Hoshino. Minami is a Gravure model who uses a fake accent.

name: Hikaru Kamiki
description:
~!He is the father of Aqua and Ruby.!~

~!He is later revealed to also be Taiki Himekawa's biological father, having been molested by Airi Himekawa when he was a child before allegedly having her murdered as well by telling her husband about the affair.!~

name: Karasu Shoujo
description: She is a seemingly supernatural being apparently aware of everything that transpires within the story.

name: Mimi Yoshizumi
description: Cosplayer and VTuber under the name Komimi Suzune. [Shun](https://anilist.co/character/280874/Shun-Yoshizumi)'s sister.

name: Ichigo Saitou
description: Ichigo Saitou is the director of the agency Ichigo Production. He is the one who scouted [Ai](https://anilist.co/character/172759/Ai-Hoshino) and made her a star.

name: Shun Yoshizumi
description: Former Assistant Director on the online variety show "Dig Deep! One Chance!" Currently works as [Ruby](https://anilist.co/character/183884/Ruby-Hoshino)'s manager.

name: Yura Katayose
description: Top actress in Japan. Represented by SA Entertainment.

name: Masaya Kaburagi
description: Masaya Kaburagi is a TV and Web-TV producer.

name: Toshirou Kindaichi
description: Leader of the Lala Lai Theatrical Company, and one of its founding members. He is the Director of the 2.5D Stage Play *Tokyo Blade*.

name: Akane no Haha
description: Mother of [Akane Kurokawa](https://anilist.co/character/203384).

name: Fuyuko Niino
description: A member and founder of the original incarnation of B-Komachi, she can be identified by the panda hairpin.~!She was later revealed to have orchestrated the murder of Ai Hoshino with [Hikaru Kamiki](https://anilist.co/character/299249/Hikaru-Kamiki).!~~!She tried to stab Ruby on the day of her appearance in the Tokyo Dome, but Ruby was actually Akane in disguise.!~

name: Meiya
description: Cosplayer who uses the stage name Meiya. She was invited by Ruby for a cosplay segment on _Dig Deep! One Chance!_.

name: Meimei
description: A member of the original incarnation of B-Komachi, she can be identified by the cat hairpin.

name: Kanon Oikawa
description: She was diagnosed with Sensorineural hearing loss when she was five years old. She isn't entirely deaf; if she has a hearing aid, the room is quiet, and she can see the other person's lips, she can hold on a conversation.

name: Saki Kindaichi
description: She accidentally runs into Kanon on her way to a piano lesson, and they eventually meet again as classmates.

name: Kyomoto
description: Kyomoto is a truant student in fourth grade. Because she doesn't show up to school, she practices drawing at home relentlessly. One day, her art gets published alongside [Fujino](https://anilist.co/character/286677)'s in the elementary school's newspaper, which began a one-sided rivalry.

name: Ayumu Fujino
description: Fujino is a fourth grader who draws 4-panel manga strips for the elementary school's newspaper. Her talent as well as her funny stories are praised by her classmates. But one day, she is challenged by the skilled drawings of a truant student from next-door class, and becomes determined to improve her art.

name: Oguri Cap
description:
__Height:__ 167 cm

A coolheaded dreamer from the countryside.

Originally hailing from the countryside, she enrolled in Tracen Academy after dominating the racing scene back home. She works to make her hometown proud, but try as she might, her clumsy side always comes out. At the academy, she's known as a fearsome gourmand, able to empty an entire pot of rice in the blink of an eye.

name: Tamamo Cross
description:
__Height:__ 140 cm

Her comebacks are lightning fast. Showin' 'em what Naniwa girls are made of!

A small girl with an unmistakable Kansai dialect. Despite her size, she's a bundle of energy and is always ready for action, be it in a race or in everyday life. She grew up in a less fortunate environment, but her power comes from her persistent spirit—you won't find much getting her down. She and the effortlessly funny [Oguri Cap](https://anilist.co/character/96114/Oguri-Cap) make for a good comedic duo.

name: Belno Light
description:
__Height:__ 146 cm 

Belno Light is a teammate of [Oguri Cap.](https://anilist.co/character/96114/Oguri-Cap) She is skilled at studying, which allows her to excel at providing insight and analysis. Her family runs a major company specializing in sports goods for Uma Musume, which gives her deep knowledge about racing equipment.

name: Super Creek
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm

Motherly and kind, her presence is soothing.

No matter how bad you were, this racer will forgive and comfort you before spoiling you rotten. Her tendency towards leniency sometimes extends to herself. She values the growth of others over even her own personal gains. She is rivals with both Oguri Cap and Tamamo Cross.

name: Obey Your Master
description: An Uma Musume representing America. She is lively and cheerful, with a lighthearted vibe but also an air of mystery around her. She has no notable race record and no G1 victories.

name: Fujimasa March
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm 

Fujimasa March is a scholarship student at the Kasamatsu Training Academy. She was considered the best in her class and set her sights on winning the Tokai Derby. [Oguri Cap](https://anilist.co/character/96114/Oguri-Cap) is the first person she would consider as a rival.

name: Dicta Striker
description: Dicta Striker is the self proclaimed ace of her grade at Tracen Academy and classmate of [Oguri Cap](https://anilist.co/character/96114/Oguri-Cap). She appears rough and violent at first glance, but she is actually caring and good-natured. She is the type who wants to compete with everything she has in order to win.

name: Norn Ace
description: Norn Ace is a well known Uma Musume in her hometown, and roommates with [Oguri Cap](https://anilist.co/character/96114/Oguri-Cap) in Kasamatsu. Norn and her friends initially bully Oguri for standing out in class, but eventually become strong supporters.

name: Jou Kitahara
description: [Oguri Cap's](https://anilist.co/character/96114/Oguri-Cap) trainer in Kasamatsu. His dream is to train a racer who can win the Tokai Derby.

name: Gold City
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm

A blunt racer and the gold standard in racing and beauty.

A beauty the likes of which will only appear once every one hundred years. She's been a model for as long as she can remember, and has always acted the part. She realized one day, however, that running is her true heart's desire. Since then, she has raced ever forward so that she may be recognized not for her looks, but for her talent. She's understood most by her good friend Tosen Jordan.

name: Sakura Chiyono O
description:
**Height:** 156cm

Follow your dreams! This Umamusume is honest and hardworking.

A pure-hearted, honest Umamusume. She admires [Maruzensky](https://anilist.co/character/140842/Maruzensky), and aims to be her equal in every way. She makes a habit out of filling her "Chiyonotes" with proverbs relevant to her daily experiences—though few but her are able to parse them.

name: Mr. C.B.
description:
__Height:__ 166 cm

Bound by nothing! A cheerful and flawless Umamusume.

A Umamusume who loves the free world of racing. The unbounded ambiance she exudes gives her a mysterious charm. At first glance, she appears to be free-spirited, but it's because she's stubborn and refuses to do anything she doesn't agree with. Surprisingly, she may be a bit clumsier than most other Umamusume.

name: Yaeno Muteki
description:
**Height:** 159cm

She runs with the dignity of a warrior. This Umamusume is rough and rugged.

With fists that pierce the wind and kicks that shake the earth, this martial artist trains not to harm others but to succeed on the track. Though she strives to maintain discipline and decorum, her hotheaded side sometimes seeps to the surface. She loves her grandparents very much, and seeks to do them proud by spreading their school of martial arts far and wide.

name: Mejiro Ardan
description:
**Height:** 162 cm

She wants to shine bright, no matter how briefly! This well-to-do girl has legs of glass.

A sheltered young lady—ephemeral, gentle, and thoughtful. Despite her fragile, "glass" legs putting her at a disadvantage when running, she refuses to let cynicism keep her down. As a child, her frail body kept her from most recreation and social activities, so she finds community life at the academy to be quite the novel experience.

name: Inari One
description:
__Height:__ 139 cm

A plucky umamusume who is a true child of Edo though she actually comes from the countryside. She’s small, but possesses infinite power and stamina. Her strength was unmatched in her local series, and she was known as the “Downtown Superstar.” She’s the kind of person who gets into haggling fights over a buying or selling price, and isn’t afraid to show off her strength during a race. Oguri Cap and Super Creek are her classmates, and they each mutually respect each others’ abilities.

name: Ginjirou Musaka
description: [Jou Kitahara](https://anilist.co/character/352505/Jou-Kitahara)'s uncle and ~![Oguri Cap's](https://anilist.co/character/96114/Oguri-Cap) trainer.!~

name: Fumino Nase
description: She is the trainer of [Super Creek](https://anilist.co/character/211565/Super-Creek)

name: Michelle My Baby
description: An Uma Musume representing American who is known as the American Giant. Her signature racing style uses her formidable physique which has allowed her to win major races in America. She has a cheerful and friendly personality.

name: Rudy Lemono
description: One of [Norn](https://anilist.co/character/363003/Norn-Ace)'s close friends. She has a rough exterior but is actually the most sensible among the group. She is often dragged into the schemes of [Mini the Lady](https://anilist.co/character/363000/Mini-The-Lady).

name: Mini The Lady
description: One of [Norn](https://anilist.co/character/363003/Norn-Ace)'s friends. She has a cunning and mischievous personality but tends to go overboard. She actually excels academically and is ranked 2nd in her grade.

name: Misato Akasaka
description: A live broadcast announcer for races in the Twinkle Series.

name: Ellerslie Pride
description: An Uma Musume representing New Zealand who is also known as the "Steelheart Maiden." She is a superstar in her home country, with her final spurt and beauty both considered world class. Oceania has long dreamed of winning the Japan Cup, and she passionately desires to become that champion.

name: Moonlight Lunacy
description: An Uma Musume representing England who is called The Noblewoman of Great Britain. She has refined features and a dignified aura which commands a presence worthy of a lady. After losing the previous Japan Cup, she is seeking a revenge match.

name: Toni Bianca
description: An uma musume representing Italy who is called the European Monarch. After conquering the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, she is considered the strongest racer in the world and is the favorite among the overseas contenders for the Japan Cup. She is approaching the Japan Cup with the resolve to make it the culmination of her racing career.

name: Masami Komiyama
description: She is the trainer of [Tamamo Cross](https://anilist.co/character/211567/Tamamo-Cross).

name: Yukio Tanaka
description: The main character, the series follows his rapid development from living an average life to becoming an outstanding guitarist. Being a weak individual lacking an authoritative presence , he cannot help but let others push him around, a possible metaphoric stereotype on the very proper and manner conscious Japanese society. Recruited as the last member of BECK, he serves as the second guitarist and vocalist, and has a very beautiful voice that is mostly used for Beck's slower songs. He owns a Fender Telecaster.

name: Maho Minami
description: Ryusuke's sister who is a talented singer with a strange relationship with Koyuki. At times she seems attracted to him, at others she brushes him off with little regard to his often ignored feelings.

name: Ryuusuke Minami
description: A Japanese character with a long history in America, he speaks fluent English, and frequently uses both Japanese and English in his conversations. He lives alone in a shack by the fishing pond. His skills and taste in music inspire Koyuki to take up the guitar. The band's creator, Ryusuke is BECK's lead guitarist. A once-younger Ryusuke and Eddie Lee stole the Lucille from the trunk of Syke's vehicle.

name: Tsunemi Chiba
description: Main vocalist for BECK, he is the key member that [Ryusuke](https://anilist.co/character/4170/Minami-Ryuusuke) needed to bring [Taira](https://anilist.co/character/308/Taira-Yoshiyuki) into the band. His attitude, style, and appearance was based on Zack De La Rocha from Rage Against The Machine and compared to [Koyuki](https://anilist.co/character/676/Tanaka-Yukio), his voice is more punk and rock oriented, like the majority of the band's songs. He also named the band Beck after staring at [Ryusuke's dog](https://anilist.co/character/141894/Beck) for a few moments. He also tends to pick his nose.

name: Yoshiyuki Taira
description: The first recruited member of BECK, Taira is the bassist, and the most talented band member next to [Ryusuke](https://anilist.co/character/4170/Minami-Ryuusuke). He plays Music Man StingRay bass. His attitude may sometimes come off as uncaring. He has been seen working as a traffic officer. As the story progresses, we learn that his father was a jazz musician that left him and his mother when he was young.

name: Yuuji Sakurai
description: The fourth member to join, he was also Koyuki's first good friend, sticking with him even when the school bully and his gang beat him up for breaking the silent treatment on Koyuki. He is the drummer, inspired by his brother, and replaces the original drummer of BECK who followed Ryûsuke from his original band, Serial Mama.

name: Kenichi Saitou
description: Koyuki's guitar and swimming teacher, Saitou once swam in the Olympics but was unable to achieve his dream of winning so has turned his life to teaching others how to swim better. Saitou is loud and demanding in public, and especially strict when it comes to swimming. But when he is out of the water he is much more open, even turning to Koyuki for advice on his attractions to Momo. Saitou is a fan of British rock and his favorite band in the anime is the fictional Rocket Boys

name: Beck
description: Beck is a dog and the symbol of the band "Beck".

name: Eddie Lee
description: Lead guitarist of Dying Breed, he was Ryusuke's close (and only) friend. It is while they are growing up (and carjacking) that Eddie helped him find Beck (the seemingly patchwork dog) and Lucille. He seems to resemble Kurt Cobain from Nirvana, he can be also based on Eddie Vedder of Pearl Jam or Geddy Lee of Rush.     ~!Just before he died, he entrusted Koyuki with part of his new song "Devil's Way", later Beck completed the song to perform it live in honor of Eddie!~

name: Matt Reed
description: Lead singer for Beck's American band "Dying Breed". Known as rock's craziest guy.    After letting Koyuki sing with them at the stage he became a fan of him and tries to push Koyuki to the top.

name: Izumi Ishiguro
description: Koyuki's childhood friend, he eventually was left to choose between her and Maho, though by the time he reached his decision, the two girls also reached one of their own, luckily a similar conclusion.

name: Momoko Ogasawara
description: Koyuki's music teacher at school, she gets to know Saitou through Koyuki and they start to develop a relationship through the series.

name: Kazuo Satou
description: The lady who first gets Beck into Greatful Sound (chapter 23, page 10) (with some "help" from Leon Sykes" (chapter 24)) she is also the woman who gets the band into contact with their first label, the indie label "Lust For Life" (Beck: Mongolian chop Squad chapter 43, page 40-45).

name: Hiromi Masuoka
description: Hiromi Masuoka is a student at the Ichieda Gakuen Private High School attended by Koyuki, Saku, and Chiba. She also worked for a period in a doughnut shop next to Koyuki's, the Seiryuu restaurant. She is a friend of Koyuki and Saku.

name: Rikiya Kitazawa
description: Rikiya Kitawaza is a thug attending Koyuki's middle school and a childhood friend of Hyodo.

name: Tanabe
description: Tanabe is a school friend of Koyuki. His hobbies include photography.

name: Masaru Hyodou
description: Masaru Hyodo is the chief instigator in a group who bully Koyuki during his middle school days. Hyodo is also a "technically" accomplished guitarist, but as Ryûsuke points out, doesn't have any real feeling or passion behind his playing. Hyodo's father is a famous musician, but his parents are divorced (Hyodo is his mother's maiden name).

name: Yoshito Morozumi
description: Yoshito Morozumi is a school friend of Maho and a budding actor and model. He competes with Koyuki for Maho's affections, often subjecting him to ridicule. He later joins Belle Ame on stage at Greatful Sound.

name: Eiji Kimura
description: Originally in Ryusuke's first band, Serial Mama, he turned into his rival, and his new band, Belle Ame, formed as BECK's competition was mainly succeeding through appeal for the band member's looks and not sound. Getting all the big breaks, Belle Ame seemed destined for greatness, until BECK destroyed their ride to fame, at the cost of being blacklisted in the music industry.

name: Manabu Miyazawa
description: Manabu Miyazawa is the vocalist for Eiji's group Belle Ame. Before joining Belle Ame, he was in a band called Cloud.

name: Mikoto Misaka
description: __Height:__ 161 cm (5'3") __Classification:__ Esper __School:__ Tokiwadai Middle School __Esper Power:__ Electromaster __Power Level:__ 5 One of the main heroines in the Toaru Majutsu no Index series and the protagonist of her side story, Toaru Kagaku no Railgun. An Esper of Academy City, her powers are ranked Level 5, the highest rank for the most powerful Espers. She ranks as third-strongest out of the seven people who hold this rank in Academy City.

name: Accelerator
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm 
__Classification:__ Esper 
__Esper Power:__ Accelerator
__Power Level:__ 5

Accelerator is the most powerful Esper in Academy City. Their real name is unknown, though Accelerator recalls their surname was composed of two characters and their given name consisted of three characters. 

A sadistic person about the same age as [Touma](https://anilist.co/character/13700/Kamijou-Touma), Accelerator has the esper power "Accelerator", an ability unique to them. The ability includes "Vector Change", a form of telekinesis that allows Accelerator to change the vector values of anything they touch, due in part to having a thin coat of AIM fields surrounding their body.

name: Touma Kamijou
description: __Height:__ 168 cm __Classification:__ Esper (technically) __Esper Power:__ Imagine Breaker __Power Level:__ 0 (technically) The main protagonist of Toaru Majutsu no Index and a supporting character in Toaru Kagaku no Railgun. He has the lowest psychic rank possible at Level 0—largely because the people testing psychic abilities cannot detect or classify his abilities. His power is Imagine Breaker, a power which negates all magic, psychic, or divine powers but also his own good luck. Due to the nature of his power, the founder of Academy City considers him neither a Psychic nor a Magician but rather a normal person with a unique ability. He tends to stay away from trouble but possesses a strong sense of justice, albeit somewhat shallow and dogmatic. He is a smart student and knowledgeable about certain subjects yet is a failure in his esper studies. While he is an idealist for the hopes of other people, ironically he is cynical about himself possibly because of his powers.

name: Ruiko Saten
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm
__Classification:__ Esper
__School:__ Sakugawa Middle School
__Esper Power:__ Aero Hand
__Power Level:__ 0

A Level 0, classmate and friend of [Uiharu](https://anilist.co/character/20622) who is known for wearing a flower on the left side of her hair. She is a little shameless as she sometimes flips Uiharu's skirt in public.  She first appears in the Toaru Kagaku no Railgun manga and its anime series and makes a cameo appearance in the Toaru Majutsu no Index light novel series and the opening of the anime.   ~!When rumors of a special tool that increases psychic powers called the "Level Upper" spread, she considers obtaining it out of envy as she does not have any apparent powers. When she uses it, Ruiko consequently winds up in a coma and gradually recovers thanks to the help of the creator of the 'Level Upper.'!~

name: Kuroko Shirai
description:
__Height:__ 152 cm (5'0")
__Classification:__ Esper
__School:__ Tokiwadai Middle School
__Affiliation:__ Judgment
__Esper Power:__ Teleport
__Power Level:__ 4

Kuroko is [Mikoto](/character/13701/)'s kouhai in Tokiwadai Middle School and a protagonist in <cite>Toaru Kagaku no Railgun</cite>, as well as a supporting character in <cite>Toaru Majutsu no Index</cite>. A Level 4 Esper, she is a member of Judgment, a special public committee group whose duty is to maintain peace and order in Academy City. She has an unhealthy obsession with Mikoto, whom she calls "Onee-sama" (big sister), and is on the constant lookout for a chance to get physically intimate with her (and getting called a pervert in the process). 

Her power is instant teleportation, which allows her to teleport herself and anything she touches as long it weighs under around 130-137 kilograms to anywhere in a radius of around 81-85 meters.

name: Misaki Shokuhou
description:
__Height:__ 169 cm 
__Classification:__ Esper 
__Esper Power:__ Mental Out
__Power Level:__ 5

Misaki is a Level 5 student who attends Tokiwadai Middle School. She goes under the alias "The Queen" which refers to her having the largest faction within Tokiwadai Middle School. She appears as an elegant beauty of Tokiwadai Middle School, sporting long straight hair of golden color. She wears a pair of white gloves and stockings, both adorned with lace. She is also seen holding a shoulder bag with a star adorned on the middle.

As one of the two Level 5s of Tokiwadai, she and her followers have a rivalry with [Mikoto Misaka](https://anilist.co/character/13701/Misaka-Mikoto) and her fans. She never shows herself in public, instead using her followers or mind-controlling people to act as her representatives when talking with individuals. It is hinted that she has a strong dislike for public appearances, and this is why whenever the school needs a "face" to promote certain public events, she and her faction will simply stand aside and let Mikoto hog all of the attention and responsibilities.

name: Kaori Kanzaki
description:
__Height:__ 175cm 
__Classification:__ Magician
__Affiliation:__ Necessarius, Amakusa-Style Remix of Church (Priestess)  

A  sorceress from Necessarius. Unlike her partner Stiyl, she uses magic to magically strengthen her body. Her sorcery name is Salvere000. She uses a 2 meter long katana (which actually is a Nodachi) called "Seven Heavens Seven Swords" as her weapon. She has a special attack called Nanasen (七閃, Nanasen? "Seven Flash") that uses her katana and some wires. She used to be a kind woman who treated Index like a sister, but when Index's memories were deleted by Necessarius, Kaori changed into a cold and silent woman as Index no longer remembered her and consequentially did not trust her. 

After Touma saves Index's life and her current memories, she decides to stay in Academy City to be with Index and protect her.  Later in the novels, more of her past is revealed. Not only is Kaori a skilled swordswoman, but she is a Catholic Saint possessing the "Stigma" — the ability to call upon God's power — and the former leader of the Amakusa Catholics. However, Kaori left the group as she resented that she had been fated since birth to become its leader, which led her to despise the concept of luck and fortune. Though she is Catholic, she joined Necessarius in hopes of changing her fate and befriended Index, developing a sisterly relationship with her. The repeated failed attempts to make Index remember her after each memory erasure resulted in her cold personality as Kaori began to accept that no matter how much a person tries, no one can change their destiny. She begins to show a kinder side to herself after Touma saves Index (thus giving her hope that anyone can defy their destiny) and gradually falls in love with him after he helps her face her past with the Amakusa Catholics, becoming more prone to showing emotion and sometimes showing a little embarrassment if she is with him. She is the protagonist of her own spin-off mini light novel bundled with the Toaru Kagaku no Railgun DVDs.

name: Index Librorum Prohibitorum
description:
__Height:__ 148 cm (4'10")
__Classification:__ Magician
__Affiliation:__ Anglican Church
__Ability:__ Spell Intercept

Index, also known by her full name Index Librorum Prohibitorum, is one of the main heroines and the titular character of the series. She is a young nun from Necessarius, a branch of the Church of England. 

Index is small in stature and has a petite build. About 14 or 15 years old, she has thigh-length, silvery-blue hair with very white skin and large green eyes. She also wears a white robe with golden embroidery sewed onto every edge of it, the Walking Church.

name: Last Order
description:
Misaka clone No. 20001, she is the administrator of the Misaka Network and the fail-safe mechanism in case the Sisters got out of control. She is not designed to function independently and survive for long outside a culture container, and appears to be only about ten years old.

Unlike her previous clone sisters, she is capable of showing emotions and has a close relationship with [Mikoto](https://anilist.co/character/13701/Misaka-Mikoto), [Misaka Imouto](https://anilist.co/character/17729/MISAKA-10032) and [Accelerator](https://anilist.co/character/13917/Accelerator).

name: MISAKA 10032
description: Misaka is the 10032nd clone of Misaka Mikoto, a Sister, that was first introduced in Toaru Majutsu no Index and plays a relatively small role in Toaru Kagaku no Railgun. Originally supposed to be killed in the 10032 experiment against Accelerator as part of the Level 6 Shift Project, she is one of the few Sisters that remained in Academy City for readjustments. She becomes the most prominent clone in the series after being rescued by Kamijou Touma, and is referred to as Misaka Imouto (御坂妹 Misaka Imōto?, lit. "Misaka's little sister") whenever they meet.

name: Kazari Uiharu
description:
__Height:__ 153 cm
__Classification:__ Esper
__School:__ Sakugawa Middle School
__Affiliation:__ Judgment
__Esper Power:__ Thermal Hand
__Power Level:__ 1

Shirai's friend and colleague in Judgment and another protagonist in Toaru Kagaku no Railgun. Shy and humble, she goes to Sakugawa Junior High, different from Shirai's, and is known for wearing a headband made of flowers on her head, and sometimes a surgical mask as she constantly suffers the flu. She has a sweet tooth but is often called for Judgment duties before she can enjoy her sweets. She displays various skills with the use of the computer, such as repelling hackers and information gathering.   She makes a cameo appearance in the opening of the Index anime and appears as a supporting character in the second season. She has small parts in the novels, larger ones in the Railgun SS novels.   ~!Her power is the ability to maintain the temperature of objects although she can really only maintain them at temperatures she herself tolerates.!~

name: Othinus
description: She is referred to as One-Eyed Othinus and, similarly to the Othinus of legend, she wears an eyepatch over her right eye which she has presumably lost in order for her to drink from the Well of Wisdom, though this may just be a ritualistic and aesthetic choice, as Othinus is maybe invoking Idol Theory to match that of Odin of Norse mythology. Her remaining eye is glittery green and with slit-like iris. She's seen dressed in a fur coat and a black leather outfit. She also wears a wide brimmed hat with a pointed tip, one which would have been worn by a witch.

name: Frenda Seivelun
description:
__Height:__ 155 cm
__Classification:__ Esper
__Affiliation:__ ITEM (Defected)
__Power Level:__ 0

Frenda Seivelun is a member of team ITEM. She is one of the main combatants of the team, and though not having any apparent esper ability of her own, she makes up for it with her incredible prowess in close combat, as well as expertise in traps and concealed weaponry. It is revealed that she has a little sister by the name of [Fremea Seivelun](https://anilist.co/character/41373/Seivelun-Fremea). 

She and ITEM's leader [Shizuri Mugino](https://anilist.co/character/30041/Mugino-Shizuri) have a sort of master-servant relationship.

 ~!In volume 15 of the novel, Frenda betrayed ITEM and Mugino goes on a solitary manhunt for her. Mugino later finds and executes Frenda, cutting her in half by the waist with her Meltdowner ability.!~

name: Mitsuko Kongou
description:
__Height:__ 163 cm
__Classification:__ Esper
__School:__ Tokiwadai Middle School
__Esper Power:__ Aero Hand
__Power Level:__ 4

Mitsuko Kongou is a transfer student and heiress to Kongou Airlines. She is a Level 4 esper with an ability called "Aero Hand" which allows her to create a powerful gust of wind to propel any objects she touches like a missile. Mitsuko shows pride in herself despite being a new student in the school but shows ignorance of common routines such as finding directions and kitchen-related work. She is usually seen carrying a fan that she usually uses for her ability and has a pet boa constrictor named Ekaterina.

name: Shiage Hamazura
description: Level 0 and former Skill-Out with his best friends [Komaba Ritoku](/character/40145) and [Hattori Hanzou](/character/39988). A former lackey, grunt, chauffeur, and informant of ITEM, he delved into Academy City's darkness and turned into an anomaly that disrupts Aleister Crowley's plans and calculations time and time again.

name: Motoharu Tsuchimikado
description:
__Height:__ 176cm (5'9")
__Classification:__ ~! Magician-Esper hybrid !~ 
__Affiliation:__ ~! Necessarius, GROUP (Leader) !~  

A blond teenager who is always seen with sunglasses and wearing an Aloha shirt. He is a friend and classmate of Tōma who just happens to be his next-door neighbor at the dormitory they're staying at. While he seem like a normal, average teenager, there's more to him than meets the eye.   ~!Secretly, Tsuchimikado is actually a former agent of Necessarius who became a freelance spy for Necessarius, Academy City, and other unknown organizations; the leaders of both Necessarius and Academy City are both aware of this but have decided to let him be for the time being. His sorcery name is Fallere825, 'the back-stabber'.!~   ~!He was formerly a skilled Onmyōji as his family are descendants of Abe no Seimei but gave up his abilities when he went under the ESP development curriculum. He has a younger step-sister named Maika, whom he is also in love with, and for this he is known as the Shisukon Gunsō (シスコン軍曹, "Sis-com Sergeant"?). He is also a member of one of Academy City's secret organizations, the "GROUP". His ESP ability is the Level 0 Auto Regeneration (肉体再生, Nikutai Saisei?, lit. "Body Regeneration"). Due to this power, he can still use magic as he can repair the damage done to his body, making him the only successful psychic/magician hybrid. Despite these advantages, he avoids using magic except in the most desperate situations as he cannot avoid the extreme pain caused by using it.!~ (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Stiyl Magnus
description:
__Height:__ 200cm (6.56 ft)
__Classification:__ Magician, Priest
__Affiliation:__ Anglican Church (Necessarius)

A sorcerer from Necessarius. His sorcery name is Fortis931. He is an extremely heavy smoker; he claims a world without nicotine would be hell. He specializes in using flames and is able to use a flame sword or summon a 3000 degree Celsius fire called Innocentius ("King of Witch Hunters") to battle his enemies. Despite his looks, he is actually fourteen-years-old and ironically is physically weak. He mostly has a bad temper but is actually kind, as he cares about Index very much and his failure to save her life without losing her memories was his greatest regret. When he learns the Church lied to him and Kaori about Index's condition, he decides to disobey orders to capture Index and let her live her life.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Itsuwa
description: An Amakusa Catholic girl. She seems to have romantic feelings towards Tōma bordering on actual love but due to her shyness, she was not able to act on them and convey them to him. She has accompanied Tōma and friends on more than one occasion, going to, Italy, France, and then England with him. In the events of the 16th novel she becomes his caretaker. When Acqua first attacks, she fails to protect Touma, trying unsuccessfully to heal him with magic several times due to his Imagine Breaker. After Touma is sent to the hospital she is seen despairing because of her failure. She is rebuked by Tatemiya Saiji, who tells her to stop feeling sad and look to the future, when Acqua will come and attack again, and that she should focus on proving to Touma that it was worth his time protecting her from Acqua. During the Amakusa Catholics' rematch against Aqua after Tōma was nearly killed, she displayed a sudden change of personality, becoming full of tranquil fury that even the way she spoke changed. She performed a "Saint Destroyer" in that battle, harming Acqua causing him to lose the "Divine Mother's Mercy". Her weapon is a Friulian Spear which by adding layers of reinforcement, it turns the spear to a symbol of a 'Thousand Years Tree', which symbolizes the growth of plants and makes certain magic spells to be more potent over time and she also can perform Nanasen (七閃?, "Seven Flash") by manipulating her spear and steel wires just like Kanzaki Kaori.

name: Aleister Crowley
description:
Based on the late Aleister Crowley. He was once the greatest magician in modern magic history, where more than half of all modern magicians are affected by this man's established theories, and two-fifths of them are direct followers of his ways. Aleister stretched the boundaries of sorcery farther than the advances made in the last few millennia alone and wrote many top-class spell books like The Book of the Law.

 His death in 1947 shocked many but it was not the last the world had heard of him. In reality, he faked his death to stop the obsessing fanatics following him and secretly went to Japan where he meet a doctor who he would later call Heaven Canceler. Years later, Aleister, Heaven Canceler, and several powerful individuals combined their resources and influences to create one of the most technologically advanced cities on Earth in western Tokyo, Academy City. By this time, rumors of Aleister still being alive led some mages to discover the truth. At first, they were happy to see that he was alive but were immediately shocked as that not only Aleister abandoned using magic but was more interested in the study and development of espers. 

To this day, only a few magicians know Aleister is still alive who are mostly the leaders of powerful magical organizations and their trusted followers, and those that do know him to view him with skepticism, curiosity on what he's doing, or outraged for abandoning magic and supporting science especially esper studies. Not making things any better is the fact Aleister was responsible for the creation of the truce between Science and Magic where neither side is allowed to interfere in each other affairs which have irked both sides. As the 13th Board of Director and General Director of Academy City, Aleister has the final say of the city affairs but usually leaves the city's welfare to the other members of the board. He resides within a tall, gray building called The Windowless building, known for not having any exterior windows where access to the building is a secret to a few. In there, Aleister's body which has now become younger lies inside a giant glass tube, supported by machines made by Heaven Canceler that extended his lifespan where he plots his mysterious plans.

name: Gunha Sogiita
description: He is the 7th Level 5 Academy City student thus making him one of the most powerful espers in the city. Despite being a level 5, his ability is unknown. His rank as the 7th level 5 may not be reflective of his true capabilities since no one understands his power. He is nicknamed Attack Crash after his signature attack.  His personality is not unlike Kamijou Touma, though he is considered hot-blooded and dives into problems headfirst without considering the consequences as shown through the encounter between Gunha and Ollerus, where he misunderstood Ollerus' intentions.   ~!He is also somewhat dense in certain situations, as shown in the Toaru Jihanki no Sonzai Shoumei light novel the first thing after being shot by Mikoto's railgun is commenting that gaming tokens aren't supposed to be taken outside arcades, and that he'll go back with her to return it and apologize.  He also appears to have a habit of giving completely impossible explanations for the nature of his abilities. For example, his explanation for what he does when he executes Attack Crash is that he creates an unstable field of psychokinesis in front of him and destroys it by providing a stimulus from his fist, thus causing an explosive aftereffect for some distance, something which a nearby student in the Power Development Curriculum for telekinesis says is impossible. Also, he explains his Aurora Guard as him lifting Earth's electromagnetic field and using it to defend against Electricity-based attacks, another impossible phenomenon.  In the SS2 of Toaru Majutsu no Index Light Novels, it was revealed that he is a "Gemstone"- espers who gained their powers without going through the Ability Developement Program of Academy City. Thus its unknown to all what his real ability is.!~

name: Aisa Himegami
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm
__Classification:__ Esper (Gemstone) 

 A quiet young girl with a rather blunt personality who wears Miko attire.   ~!While she may seem normal, she is also known as "Deep Blood" and has the ability to kill vampires when they approach her, as her blood's smell attracts them. However, it made her miserable because it killed her family and friends that were turned into vampires. This prompts her to go to Academy City, hoping to find a way to get rid of her powers, until she meets the alchemist Aureolus Izzard. She cooperates with him because he told her that her blood can be used to save the life of a person he cared for (Index) in return for helping her get rid of her powers.!~  ~!When Aureolus learns Index's life was already saved by Tōma and tries to kill him, Aisa attempts to defend Tōma, which prompts Aureolus to use his alchemy to try to kill her as she was now useless to him. Her life was saved by Tōma who dispelled the spell on her with his right hand. When she asks Tōma about why he saved her, he told her that he did not have a reason to rescue her. After the incident, she lives with Tōma and Index but later moves to Komoe's apartment and wears a magical power-blocking cross, which enables her to live what she had always wanted: a normal life. She was formerly a student at Kirigaoka Academy for Girls, one of the five elite schools of Academy City, but was transfer to Tōma's school when her sponsor, Aureolus Izzard mysteriously disappear thus ending her enrollment at Kirigaoka Academy. Ever since Tōma saved her life, Aisa started to have feelings for him, which is ironic as she once joked that Tōma's life was like a dating sim. !~

name: Komoe Tsukuyomi
description:
__Height:__ 135 cm

Despite her childish and very short appearance, she is actually an adult and one of [Touma Kamijou](https://anilist.co/character/13700/Kamijou-Touma)'s teachers. This is proven by her apartment being littered with beer cans and cigarettes. She also contradicts her age by acting childish to her students, having a child-like crush on Touma, and ending her sentences with desu, something a child usually does. This irony means that she is often regarded as one of the seven great mysteries of Academy City.

She has major interest in studying pyrokinesis and performs magic once, when [Index](https://anilist.co/character/13699/Librorum-Prohibitorum-Index) requires her to participate in a magical ritual to heal her wounds. The fact that she is able to do so indicates she has no esper abilities of her own.

name: Shizuri Mugino
description:
__Height:__ 163 cm
__Classification:__ Esper 
__Esper Power:__ Meltdowner
__Power Level:__ 5

Mugino is one of Academy City's Level 5 espers. She is ranked #4th and has the ability "Meltdowner". She can retain "pure" form of electrons (fix them in an ambiguous state which is neither a particle or a wave), and manipulate them into a beam which can melt down pretty much anything. She is also the leader of ITEM, the underground peace-making organization.

Mugino's appearance may suggest she's gentle and kind, but in reality she's a sadistic, battle-hungry fighter who looks down on all she deems weaker. She shows a compassionate face towards her teammates, although she would dispose of them if they got in her way.

~!She encounters [Teitoku Kakine](https://anilist.co/character/39953/Kakine-Teitoku), leader of SCHOOL in the war of Acadmey City's underground organizations, but was defeated. Shortly after she kills her subordinate in ITEM, [Frenda](https://anilist.co/character/30040/Seivelun-Frenda) for betraying the organisation. And around the end of the war, she makes a decision regarding [Rikou Takitsubo](https://anilist.co/character/30042/Takitsubo-Rikou), which led to her fighting against [Shiage Hamazura](https://anilist.co/character/39705/Hamazura-Shiage), a level 0 who was an underling of ITEM. Surprisingly Hamazura wins the fight with a combination of luck and brains. Mugino was severly damaged in the fight, losing an eye and an arm, which led Hamazura into believing her to be dead.

But later she reappears in Russia, having acquires a replacement arm and a monocle that snugly fits in her right eye socket. After losing her arm every encounter that she had with Hamazura left Mugino more and more imbalanced, she developed a huge obsession with getting rid of Hamazura. She becomes obesessed to the point of abusing Body Crystal to defeat Shiage.

By the end of volume 22 she finally decides to make peace with herself and with Shiage, finally returned to being the "old Mugino" who trusted her teammates and friends.!~

__In To Aru Majutsu no Index: New Testament:__ ~!Mugino has had her eye replaced with a mechanical one and covers up the rest of her injuries with makeup and has gotten a prosthetic arm that she is able to use as well as a real one. These replacement body parts make it look almost exactly the same as how she used to look before she fought Hamazura. She has also rekindled relations with the rest of ITEM and is shown to regret having killed Frenda. Also Mugino's personality is shown to have changed greatly in New Testament. She is far kinder than she was in the first series and shows far less bloodlust and obsession than the times during the conflicts between underground organizations. She is also shown to think more of lower level espers and no longer look down on them as much as she used to.!~

name: Saiai Kinuhata
description:
She is a member of ITEM, led by [Shizuri Mugino](https://anilist.co/character/30041/Mugino-Shizuri). ~!She later becomes its leader in Volume 19, after Shizuri's defeat in Volume 15 at the hands of Shiage Hamazura.!~

Despite being a powerful Psychic, Saiai is one of the most mellowed-out characters in the group; she isn't a screw-up like [Frenda](https://anilist.co/character/30040/Seivelun-Frenda), nor is she as frightful as her leader, Mugino. She enjoys bad movies and likes to tease others, [Shiage](https://anilist.co/character/39705/Hamazura-Shiage) in particular because of his reaction to anything sexually suggestive. She also likes to add "super" (chou) to her remarks.

Her ability is the Level 4 Offense Armor (Chisso Soukou, "Nitrogen Armor"), which she uses to control the nitrogen in the atmosphere to create a few centimeters of solidified nitrogen to act as a barrier. She can use this to attack and defend. Like Accelerator's AIM vector shield, the primary function of her ability is to create an armor of super-compressed nitrogen around her, she fights a sniper in volume 15 and Academy city's special sniper rifle is shown to have no effect on her other than to knock her backwards a little. Because of her ability, she carries around a small amount of nitrogen for use at all times.

~!According to [Teitoku Kakine](https://anilist.co/character/39953/Kakine-Teitoku), Saiai is a leftover from 'Project Mayday of Darkness' (usually referred to as the "Dark May Project") whose aim was to create a personal version of Accelerator's ability by using a similar pattern of ability operation. This was done by referencing the cognitive patterns of Accelerator himself in order to optimize the personal realities of certain espers taking part in the experiment. Though the details are not mentioned, Saiai only succeeded in creating an automatic self-defense capability that activates if she is attacked.!~

name: Misaka Worst
description: She is the newest lineup of Misaka Clones introduced in Toaru Majutsu no Index.    Little information is available for these new clones, but it is certain that they are created for a different purpose than their predecessors. This series of clones are made from the "Third Production Plan", which began after Last Order was taken by Accelerator. They are at Level 4, stronger than the normal Level 2 Sisters and the Level 3 Last Order. These clones can fire railguns, though their railgun can only just go past the speed of sound, unlike Mikoto who can make it go past three times the speed of sound. The colour of their lightning is purple, unlike Mikoto's which is blue.     One of them is to replace Last Order as the administrator of the Misaka Network, to bring it into a stage above what they are now in order to further Aleister's plan.    Compared to the first 20,001 clones of Misaka Mikoto (all clones except Full-Tuning), Misaka Worst's physical form is a high school student version of the Level 5 Electromaster; it is also pointed out that they are 2-3 centimeters taller than the original.    Their physical features also differ to the first batch of Sisters; they have dark circles around their eyes and has orange pupils, compared to the gray pupils of the 20000 Misaka Clones and to the original's brown pupils. They no longer wear a similar hairpin as the first batch, and they do not wear Tokiwadai Middle School's uniform; instead, they wear a full-body suit. To prevent this series of clones being controlled by Last Order, all of the clones are cut up and have many metal parts embedded in them, which according to the Misaka Worst clone that fought Accelerator was painful beyond belief.     As for their personality, though they have the same appearance as Mikoto, their personality was programmed to be similar to Mugino's.

name: Mitsumi Iwakura
description: First-year high school student who moved to Tokyo from the outskirts of Ishikawa Prefecture near Suzu. Raised a child prodigy, she entered high school at the top of her class; however, she has no athletic ability. Her pure personality unintentionally influences the people around her. She has a younger sister and brother.

name: Sousuke Shima
description: [Mitsumi's](https://anilist.co/character/138851/Iwakura-Mitsumi) classmate who is popular with girls. He is known for sabotaging the entrance ceremony and skipping classes. Though he planned to skip the entrance ceremony, he meets Mitsumi and they run to school together.

name: Yuzuki Murashige
description: [Mitsumi](https://anilist.co/character/138851/Iwakura-Mitsumi)'s classmate and her first friend in Tokyo. Her popularity among boys made her develop a complex about being shunned by other girls. She studied abroad in her childhood and has blonde hair, so people assume she is good at English, but according to herself she is not that good at it.

name: Nao
description: [Mitsumi](https://anilist.co/character/138851/Iwakura-Mitsumi)'s paternal aunt. She is a transgender woman and works as a stylist. Mitsumi's guardian since she moved to Tokyo.

name: Mika Egashira
description: Mitsumi's classmate who approached her after Mitsumi became friends with Sousuke. Mitsumi's pure nature inspired her to face her complexes. She develops a caring relationship with Mitsumi.

name: Makoto Kurume
description: Mitsumi's classmate. She is introverted and worries about becoming isolated; she meets Mitsumi when she joined the student council to join some kind of community. Despite not liking flirtatious people, she meets Yuzuki through Mitsumi and they become close friends.

name: Narumi Kanechika
description:
Second-year classmate of [Mitsumi Iwakura](https://anilist.co/character/138851/Mitsumi-Iwakura) and a member of the Drama Club.

He's very strong-willed and passionate about his interests, especially acting. He has shown to be very willing to put in lots of time and work into what he loves, and doesn't hesitate to drag others into it. His love for acting, and his will to share it with everyone does somewhat blind him from seeing other's emotions on the other hand. Despite being somewhat oblivious to emotions at times, he always helps others and cares about their wellbeing.

Narumi dreams of becoming a playwright in the future.

name: Fumino Toyama
description: Fumino is Mitsumi's childhood friend. She remains in Ishikawa while Mitski attends high school in Tokyo. Despite the distance, the two remain best friends, frequently catching up over video calls, and confiding in each other.

name: Tokiko Takamine
description: Second-year student council member. An extreme perfectionist who voluntarily follows a strict daily schedule. She had a stoic personality but became kinder upon meeting Mitsumi.

name: Tsukasa Mukai
description: Mitsumi's classmate and Sousuke's friend since middle school. He is quiet and kindhearted.

name: Kento Yamada
description: Mitsumi's classmate and Sousuke's friend. He is the class clown who is loved, teased, and harmless to humans and animals; however, he is surprisingly diligent, making cookies for everyone in the class and supporting his classmates quietly.

name: Chris Fukunaga
description: One of [Shima's](https://anilist.co/character/138850/Sousuke-Shima) friends.

name: Chieri Yasaka
description: In the same class as Mitsumi in the second year of high school. Has trouble making friends with other girls.

name: Kiyohiko Ujiie
description: In the same class as Mitsumi in their second year of high school and a member of the student council with her. An unpopular guy with who speaks with little tact.

name: Xiaoshi Cheng
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm
__Skills:__ Basketball, Photography

Manager of Time Photography Studio. Rough around the edges, but good at heart. Often acts impulsively. In order to save his studio from going out of business, he works together with [Lu Guang](https://anilist.co/character/218267/Lu-Guang), using their powers to enter photos and fulfill client requests.

He can enter the world inside a photo and possess the photographer's body, temporarily controlling their words and actions.

name: Guang Lu
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm
__Skills:__ Intelligence, Strategizing 
__Dislikes:__ Things being messed up after he's tidied them up, Plans being messed up
__Likes:__ Gourmet Food, Basketball, Reading, Sleeping, Sunbathing

Partner at Time Photography Studio. Calm and rational. Works together with [Cheng Xiaoshi](https://anilist.co/character/218266/Cheng-Xiaoshi) to fulfill client requests by acting as his guide and directing his actions.

He can foresee everything that happens inside a photo within 12 hours of it being taken; can share the consciousness of the person going into the photo through a high five and use this to direct their actions.

name: Ling Qiao
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm

Current landlord of Time Photography Studio. Grew up with Cheng Xiaoshi. Acts as the middleman and picks up commissions for Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang.

name: Emma
description: Emma is a client in the first photo that Lu Guang and Cheng Xiaoshi are shown entering.

name: Li Xiao
description: A policeman.

name: Bin Chen
description: Works with Xiao Li

name: Min Liu
description: ~!Min Liu is one of the antagonists of Link Click.!~

name: Meng Liu
description: [Hongbin Lu's](https://anilist.co/character/218590/Hongbin-Lu) half-sister.

name: Xie Zhu
description: The CFO of Vicky Game and [Emma's](https://anilist.co/character/218589/EMMA) boss.

name: Hitagi Senjougahara
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm

Hitagi, the main female character, is a weak-looking girl with an "incurable disease". She is in the same class as [Koyomi Araragi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi), but he has almost never heard her speak. When she was in the first year of high school, she encountered a mysterious crab, after which she became weightless. Ever since, she has avoided contact with everyone else, threatening everyone who discovers her secret. She called herself a tsundere and always speaks in an abusive style.

~!At the end of Mayoi Snail, she admits that she loves Koyomi, and subsequently enters into a relationship with him.!~

~!After the events in Tsukihi Phoenix, she overcame all of her trauma, and became a rather cheerful and normal girl. She starts calling Araragi with a cute nickname, chuckling at small things and sending e-mails full of Emojis, although her sharp tongue is still there, but toned down.!~

~!Hitagi has told [Hanekawa](https://anilist.co/character/22055/Hanekawa-Tsubasa) that she suffers from an Electra Complex (when a girl has intense sexual attraction towards her father). Whether this was a joke or a sincere admission has remained unrevealed!~

name: Shinobu Oshino
description:
A girl who lives with [Oshino Meme](https://anilist.co/character/22552/Meme-Oshino) in an abandoned building. She loves donuts from the Mister Donut chain. At the beginning of Hitagi Crab, she was renamed "Shinobu" by Meme, who suggested that the name Shinobu (忍), comprised of a heart (心) under a blade (刃), matched her original persona.

~!She appears to be an eight year old girl, but was originally a beautiful vampire who had lived for more than 500 years. After the events of Koyomi Vamp, she was left in a weakened condition with no powers or traces of her original personality, and therefore had to abandon her "Kiss-Shot Acerola-Orion Heart-Under-Blade" name. Prior to being a vampire, she was a princess of unparalleled beauty. She was referred to as "Princess Beauty" or "Acerola" during this time, the latter being her original name. Eventually, she was turned into a vampire by Deathtopia Virtuoso Suicide-Master to save her from the curse of beauty.!~

name: Koyomi Araragi
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm   

A third year high school student who is close to failing every class except math. He is a laid-back person whose only real friend at school is [Tsubasa Hanekawa](https://anilist.co/character/22055/Tsubasa-Hanekawa). Due to events prior to Kizumonogatari and Bakemonogatari, Koyomi avoided having friends and seemed to have lost faith and trust in people and himself.

~!During spring break, he gave [Kiss-Shot](https://anilist.co/character/23602/Shinobu-Oshino) his blood and became a vampire. Although [Meme Oshino](https://anilist.co/character/22552/Meme-Oshino) helped him become human again, there are a few lingering side effects; he can see in the dark and far distances, and he heals faster than the average human. He is still scared of morning sunlight even though it no longer has any effect on him.!~

name: Nadeko Sengoku
description:
__Height:__ 153 cm 

Nadeko, the main character of Nadeko Snake, is [Tsukihi](https://anilist.co/character/24195/Tsukihi-Araragi)’s friend back in elementary school. She always wears a waist pouch, always casts her eyes downward, has her bangs covering her eyes, has a shy personality, and can be easily amused. [Koyomi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi) played with her a lot whenever she visited his house after being invited by his sisters. She refers to Koyomi as Koyomi onii-chan and appears to have feelings for him.   ~!She was cursed two times by a classmate who liked the boy she rejected, and the rejected boy.
