description: He is a twenty-something man with nothing much left and he can barely pay for his rent or food.

name: Himeno
description: She is [Kusunoki](https://anilist.co/character/132152/Kusunoki)'s only childhood friend.

name: Satoru Gojou
description:
__Height:__ 190 cm (6'3")
__Occupation:__ Jujutsu Sorcerer, Teacher
__Affiliation:__ Tokyo Metropolitan Curse Technical College, Gojou Family
__Grade:__ Special Grade Sorcerer
__Cursed Technique:__ Six Eyes, Limitless

Satoru Gojou is one of the main protagonists of the Jujutsu Kaisen series. He is a special-grade jujutsu sorcerer and is widely recognized as the strongest in the world. Satoru is the pride of the Gojou Family, the first person to inherit both the Limitless and the Six Eyes in four hundred years. He works as a teacher at the Tokyo Jujutsu High and uses his influence to protect and train strong young allies

name: Yuuji Itadori
description:
**Species:** Human
**Height:** 173 cm (5'8")
**Occupation:** Sorcerer, Student, Vessel
**Affiliation:** Jujutsu High

Yuuji is a fair person who cares greatly for not only his comrades but anyone he views as people with their own wills, despite how deep or shallow his connection to them is. He cares greatly for the "value of a life" and to this end, he will ensure that others receive a "proper death." He is easy to anger in the face of pure cruelty and unfair judgment of other people.
He doesn't have the born talent required to use cursed techniques, but he has incredible athletic abilities and he is considered very strong for his age, as shown by when he easily beat a coach in Steel Ball Throw.

name: Megumi Fushiguro
description:
__Species:__ Human
__Height:__ 175 cm (5'9")
__Occupation:__ Sorcerer, Student
__Affiliation:__ Jujutsu High
__Grade:__ Grade 2 Sorcerer
__Cursed Technique:__ 10 Shadows

Megumi is the deuteragonist of the Jujutsu Kaisen series. He is a first-year student at Jujutsu High and also a descendant of the Zenin Family.

While outwardly stoic and calculating, Megumi wishes to help protect people he sees as good or kind. He believes that the world is unfair and that a Sorcerer is a tool to ensure kind people are given more chances to live. Claiming it to be his selfish and irrational desire, he does not see himself as a hero for doing this.

name: Kento Nanami
description:
__Height:__ 184 cm (6'0½")
__Occupation:__ Sorcerer
__Affiliation:__ Jujutsu High
__Grade:__ Grade 1 Sorcerer
__Cursed Technique:__ Ratio

He is a Grade 1 Jujutsu Sorcerer and a Tokyo Jujutsu High alumni. 

Nanami is a very intelligent and reserved man who at first appears to be someone who is just very serious about his work. He knows how to separate sentimentalism from service and claims he's only a Jujutsu Sorcerer because it's slightly less idiotic than regular careers. As one of [Yuji's](https://anilist.co/character/127212/Yuji-Itadori) mentors, Nanami is a complete contrast to [Gojo](https://anilist.co/character/127691/Satoru-Gojou), who is far more outspoken and easy-going.

name: Nobara Kugisaki
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3")
__Occupation:__ Jujutsu Sorcerer, Student
__Affiliation:__ Tokyo Jujutsu High
__Grade:__ Grade 3 Sorcerer

She is a first-year student and grade 3 jujutsu sorcerer at Tokyo Jujutsu High studying under [Satoru Gojo](https://anilist.co/character/127691) alongside [Yuji](https://anilist.co/character/127212) and [Megumi](https://anilist.co/character/126635).
 
Nobara is a confident and brash young woman with an unshakable character. More than anything, Nobara is determined to stay true to herself no matter what. She takes great pride in being both a pretty girl and a strong fighter, refusing to let anyone influence her.

Initially, Nobara can appear to be a very obnoxious and arrogant person. She first introduced herself to Yuji and Megumi by expressing how inferior they were. She also argued with Yuji for the greater part of their first mission together. Despite her abrasive attitude, Nobara is actually an incredibly caring and dutiful person, but would never let most people see that side of her. After fighting alongside each other in several missions, Yuji and Megumi grow to become Nobara's closest allies.

name: Maki Zenin
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7")

Maki Zenin is the older twin sister of [Mai Zenin](https://anilist.co/character/134168/Mai-Zenin). Maki is a grade 4 sorcerer and a second-year at Tokyo Metropolitan Jujutsu Technical High School. She is from the main branch of the Zenin clan, one of the "Prominent Three Families" of the Jujutsu world.

She left the Zenin family in order to prove herself capable of being a Sorcerer after being deemed uncapable, since she lacks Cursed Energy.

~!Because Mai and Maki are monozygotic twins, their strength is considerably limited to one another. Monozygotic twins are considered as a single individual in the Jujutsu world and are a sign of bad omen.!~

~!After the death of her twin sister Mai, Maki has lost all of her cursed energy and gained a Heavenly Restriction. This causes her skills and human capabilities to be on par with [Toji Fushiguro's](https://anilist.co/character/162722/Touji-Fushiguro).!~

name: Sukuna
description:
__Species:__ Human, Reincarnated Sorcerer

According to the legend, Sukuna was a demon with four arms and two faces who lived in the golden era of sorcery 1000 years ago. Sorcerers of the era gave their all to defeat him, but to no avail. Without ever being defeated, his body was split into 20 separate indestructible cursed objects, which allowed him to live on and traverse the ages to come. In 2018, [Yuuji Itadori](https://anilist.co/character/127212/Itadori-Yuuji) consumed one of the aforementioned cursed objects, and Sukuna was reincarnated. 

~!In reality, Sukuna was not a demon, but rather a deformed human sorcerer. His body was able to be split up into 20 cursed objects because he received assistance from [Kenjaku](https://anilist.co/character/289584).!~

Sukuna is hedonistic and has no regard for the suffering of others, believing that suffering is natural for the weak. He is selfish, and always wants to stay in control of the situation without caring about the consequences.

name: Yuuta Okkotsu
description:
__Species:__ Human
__Occupation:__ Sorcerer, Student
__Affiliation:__ Jujutsu High
__Grade:__ Special Grade Sorcerer

The main protagonist of Jujutsu Kaisen prequel series [Tokyo Metropolitan Curse Technical School](https://anilist.co/manga/105469/Tokyo-Toritsu-Jujutsu-Kodo-Senmon-Gakko). He was initially a Special Grade Cursed Victim haunted by his late childhood friend, [Rika Orimoto](https://anilist.co/character/208533/Orimoto-Rika). [Satoru Gojou](https://anilist.co/character/127691/Satoru-Gojou) mentored Yuuta and enrolled him at Tokyo Jujutsu High.

name: Touji Fushiguro
description: Touji Fushiguro, born Touji Zenin, is the father of [Megumi Fushiguro](https://anilist.co/character/126635/). He took a job from the Star Religious Group to assassinate the Star Plasma Vessel.

name: Aoi Toudou
description:
__Species:__ Human
__Height:__ 190 cm
__Occupation:__ Sorcerer, Student
__Affiliation:__ Kyoto Jujutsu Technical High School
__Grade:__ Grade 1 Sorcerer

Toudou is a third-year student at Kyoto Jujutsu Technical High School who possesses inhuman physical strength, durability, and speed. 

~!He is able to use a technique called Boogie Woogie, in which he can switch the position of two things that posses a certain amount of curse energy within his range.!~

name: Chousou
description:
Chousou is half human and half cursed spirit and the first of the Death Painting Wombs with a Special Grade rank. He and his two brothers, [Kechizu](https://anilist.co/character/210832/Kechizu) and [Eso](https://anilist.co/character/210831/Esou) are Cursed Womb: Death Paintings who have sided with [Mahito](https://anilist.co/character/133702/Mahito)'s group.

Chousou bears strong attachments to his brothers and is very overprotective of them. ~!However, after receiving a vision during his battle with Itadori, Chousou was eventually convinced that Sukuna's vessel was actually one of his younger brothers. He then became furious at Mahito and the other cursed spirits for manipulating him into harming Itadori.!~

~!Chousou is one of nine death painting wombs that came from a woman capable of giving birth to cursed spirit children. At some point, Chousou and his brothers were stored at the Jujutsu High, along with some of Sukuna's fingers.

As stated by Chousou himself, Noritoshi Kamo, the man who experimented on his mother is in fact his third "parent" due to him having mixed in his own blood into Chousou when his mother was pregnant with him. Although seemingly not remembering much about his own past, it is evident that Chousou himself remembers Noritoshi and holds a grudge against him for toying with his mother and siblings' lives.!~

name: Panda
description:
__Species:__ Cursed Corpse (varies among 3 personalities)
__Occupation:__ Jujutsu Sorcerer, Student
__Affiliation:__ Jujutsu High
__Grade:__ 2

He is a second-year at Tokyo Prefectural Jujutsu High. As a Metamorphosed Cursed Corpse, he is the best creation of Principal [Masamichi Yaga](https://anilist.co/character/189237/Masamichi-Yaga). He is sentient and has three cores inside the doll body: the youngest brother "Panda", the eldest brother "Gorilla" and a sister.

name: Narrator
description:
This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. 

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

name: Hiromi Higuruma
description: A defense lawyer who deems the Japanese justice system as unfair. After losing another case, he realizes his client was going to be ruled guilty from the beginning. With these negative emotions, he awakened his cursed power in the courtroom demanding a retrial. He is currently the top player of the Culling Game.

name: Shouko Ieiri
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm
__Ability:__ Reverse Healing Cursed Technique

Alumnus of Tokyo Jujutsu High, having been classmates with [Satoru Gojo](https://anilist.co/character/127691) and [Suguru Geto](https://anilist.co/character/133699). After graduating into a full-fledged jujutsu sorcerer, Shoko became the school's primary doctor.

name: Kinji Hakari
description: Kinji Hakari is a character in the Jujutsu Kaisen series. He is a third-year student at Tokyo Jujutsu High who is currently suspended for clashing with authority. While away from the school, Kinji is running a fight club between sorcerers for money.

name: Yuki Tsukumo
description: One of the four Special Grade Sorcerers.

name: Mai Zenin
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7")

Mai Zenin is the younger twin sister of [Maki Zenin](https://anilist.co/character/134167/Maki-Zenin). Mai is a grade 3 sorcerer and a second-year at Kyoto Jujutsu Technical High School. As a child, Mai always relied on Maki since she was afraid of Cursed Spirits. 

~!Because Mai and Maki are monozygotic twins, their strength is considerably limited to one another. Monozygotic twins are considered as a single individual in the Jujutsu world and are a sign of bad omen.!~

~!In chapter 149, Mai decides to sacrifice herself in order to make Maki stronger.!~

name: Kirara Hoshi
description: A third-year student at Tokyo Jujutsu High who is currently suspended for clashing with authority. While away from the school, Kirara has partnered with [Kinji](https://anilist.co/character/197584) while running his fight club. Their cursed technique is Interstellar Flight (Love Rendezvous), a complex technique whose motif is based on the Southern Cross constellation.

name: Hajime Kashimo
description: Hajime Kashimo is a sorcerer from 400 years ago, currently inhabiting the body of someone Kenjaku prepared as a vessel, and has served as a player in the Culling Game, seeking to find and consequently battle Sukuna

name: Fumihiko Takaba
description:
__Species:__ Human
__Occupation:__ Comedian

He is a failing comedian who was turned into a sorcerer by [Kenjaku](https://anilist.co/character/289584/Kenjaku) in order to participate in the Culling Game.

Fumihiko is an exceptionally goofy individual whose jokes aren't funny, but he still lives to entertain above all else. He found himself failing as a comedian and was down on his luck. A co-worker encouraged him to keep going because there's always a demand for comedians who think they're funny. Takaba acts on those words and has a very energetic attitude. He's very outspoken and comedy-focused in everything he does.

name: Naoya Zenin
description: Naoya Zenin is one of the sons of [Naobito Zenin](https://anilist.co/character/188432/Zenin-Naobito) and believes himself to be the true heir of the Zenin Family.

name: Kenjaku
description:
__Species:__ Human
__Height:__ 183 cm
__Occupation:__ Curse User
__Cursed Technique:__ Cursed Spirit Manipulation

Kenjaku is one of the primary antagonists of the Jujutsu Kaisen series. He is an ancient sorcerer who pursues the goal of "evolving" humanity via cursed energy, thereby ushering in a new golden age of jujutsu sorcery paralleling the Heian Era.

~!Using his cursed technique that allows him to transplant his brain into different bodies to possess them, he has inhabited different people throughout the centuries, assuming different identities.!~

name: Rika Orimoto
description: Rika Orimoto is the childhood friend of Yuta Okkotsu who tragically died when she was hit by a car. Her spirit was cursed, transforming her into a powerful Special Grade Vengeful Cursed Spirit worthy of the moniker "Queen of Curses".

name: Takuma Ino
description:
__Species:__ Human
__Occupation:__ Sorcerer
__Affiliation:__ Jujutsu High
__Grade:__ Grade 2 Sorcerer

Takuma Ino is a grade 2 jujutsu sorcerer and a close associate of Kento Nanami who operates out of Tokyo Jujutsu High.

Takuma Ino is a genuine and cheerful person with a more positive outlook on things than most jujutsu sorcerers. He doesn't believe he's the smartest person around and has a lot of respect for Nanami. Whenever Ino finds himself in a tough situation, he asks himself what would Nanami do.

name: Haruhi Suzumiya
description:
**Height:** 158 cm (5'2") 
**Occupation:** Student (grade 10-11), Ultra Director, Ultra Detective, Brigade Chief and Founder

Haruhi Suzumiya is the founding member of the SOS Brigade with the purpose of finding aliens, time travelers and espers. She is incredibly eccentric and usually anti-social, with no interest in "ordinary" humans.

name: Yuki Nagato
description:
**Height:** 154 cm (5'0") 
**Occupation:** Student (grade 11), ~!Integrated Data Sentient Entity Humanoid Interface!~

Yuki Nagato is a quiet high school freshman that is the only member of the SOS Brigade that was not "voluntarily arrested," or coerced into joining, by [Haruhi Suzumiya](https://anilist.co/character/251/Haruhi-Suzumiya). She lives alone in the same apartment complex as [Ryouko Asakura](https://anilist.co/character/255/Ryouko-Asakura). Yuki has a very stoic and introverted personality, preferring simple body language rather than speaking. When prompted to speak, she does so in a very concise manner, always speaking in a monotone and displaying a dispassionate complexion. 

~!‎‎As it turns out, Yuki is a "humanoid interface," or artificial human, created by the "Integrated Data Entity" three years prior for the purposes of interacting with and observing events on Earth. Specifically, she is assigned to observe Haruhi Suzumiya, who was supposedly the cause of an explosion of data that occurred and significantly altered the world.!~

name: Kyon
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7") 
__Occupation:__ Student (grade 10-11)  

Kyon is a first-year high school student enrolled in North High, and his real name is unknown; instead being referred to by everyone by the nickname "Kyon". This nickname was created for him by his aunt and then spread by his [little sister](https://anilist.co/character/912/Kyon-no-Imouto). He is quite cynical and doesn't believe in anything interesting like aliens, time travelers, or espers. But his curiosity gets the better of him when he tries to talk to a new student, [Haruhi Suzumiya](https://anilist.co/character/251/Haruhi-Suzumiya). She ends up forming the SOS Brigade and drags Kyon into it, where he tries his best to stop Haruhi from causing too much trouble. Kyon is the second person to join the SOS Brigade, and is the "fourth seat" of the group. 

~!He is the only member of the group who is "normal", having no special abilities at all.!~

name: Mikuru Asahina
description:
**Height:** 152 cm (5 ft)
**Occupation:** Student (grade 11-12), SOS Deputy Vice Commander, ~!Time Traveler!~

Mikuru Asahina, a shy and timid girl with a childish naïveté, is the only character other than [Kyon](https://anilist.co/character/252/Kyon) to be brought into the SOS Brigade against her will. Considered one of the most beautiful girls in high school, Mikuru is as kind, caring and thoughtful as she is beautiful. She easily gets scared or flustered, and is apparently prone to daydreaming as she can also be rather clumsy at times. Nevertheless, she can be surprisingly resilient and is capable of recovering from even the most discomforting of situations. However, because of her gentle nature she seems rather helpless most of the time. Kyon sees it as his duty to always watch over and protect her, although, when it comes to [Haruhi](https://anilist.co/character/251/Haruhi-Suzumiya), there is no rescue. 

~!She is in fact a time traveller from the future with the purpose of observing Haruhi during the course of the story line. Mikuru often has trouble talking to Kyon because many of the things he asks about revolving around her powers are "classified". Mikuru's future self occassionally shows up as well, in order to properly guide the timeline to the correct path, and is notably more mature and knowledgeable than her past self. In order to differentiate between the older and younger versions, whenever the older self is present in the same time span, Kyon refers to her older self as Asahina-san (Big) and to the younger Asahina as Asahina-san (Small).

Mikuru is the designated "mascot" of the SOS Brigade, serving as a way to attract interest and members by using her attractive physical qualities- her cute face, trim figure, and noticeably sizeable bust. She was "voluntarily arrested" by Haruhi, who deemed it necessary to have an alluring "Moe" type in the club. Her sex appeal and innocence is often exploited by Haruhi to procure resources. Mikuru is on a regular occasion forced to wear any outfits that Haruhi buys for her. Haruhi also sees it fit that Mikuru is unable to dress and undress by herself most times and often does it for her, much to Mikuru's considerable - and vocal - distress.!~

name: Itsuki Koizumi
description:
**Height:** 178 cm (5'10")
**Occupation:** Student (grade 11), Vice Commander, ~!Esper!~

Itsuki is the last member to have joined the SOS Brigade, having been recruited by [Haruhi Suzumiya](https://anilist.co/character/251/Haruhi-Suzumiya) as a "mysterious transfer student". Itsuki is constantly smiling and always speaks in a formal and polite manner. He is also prone to giving long and detailed explanations, usually illustrated by exaggerated hand gestures. Itsuki's fondness for speculation often causes him to produce explanations for situations involving the SOS Brigade, its members and related events. Itsuki only tends to share these explanations and theories with [Kyon](https://anilist.co/character/252/Kyon), and also enthusiastically plays different kinds of board games with him to pass the time, despite losing all the time, although Kyon suspects that he may be doing so on purpose. 

~!Itsuki is an Esper, and was sent to observe and keep Haruhi emotionally stable by a mysterious group known as "The Agency", in order to protect the rest of humanity. Although he is an esper, which is exactly one of the sorts of people Haruhi desires to meet, Itsuki never reveals himself as such, at least, not to her. Despite the theory he advances in which Haruhi is the equivalent of God, Itsuki says that there are many differing lines of speculation about Haruhi within "The Agency." Itsuki himself does not believe in a singular God, nor does he regard Haruhi as such, although he reveals that he has colleagues that do. Apparently, most of the questions that he raises about Haruhi's true nature are philosophical in nature and do not necessarily represent his personal beliefs. Itsuki also reveals that the majority of "The Agency" advocates observing Haruhi instead of doing anything that might provoke her.   

Out of the three Brigade members, Kyon is the least fond of Itsuki. He often finds himself annoyed with Itsuki's plastic smile, his willingness to acquiesce to Haruhi's outrageous schemes, playful teasing and his various forays into his psychological and philosophical theories. He is also distrustful of Itsuki's intentions, comparing him to [Yuki Nagato](https://anilist.co/character/249/Yuki-Nagato) when it comes to deciphering his expressions.!~

name: Ryouko Asakura
description:
At first, Ryouko appears to be a compassionate and hard-working high school girl. One of Kyon's friends, Taniguchi, places her in the top three first-year girls in the school with a grade of AA+: indicative of her pleasant personality, beauty, and athleticism. Her enormous popularity made her the unanimous choice for class president of Kyon's homeroom class. She also showed particular concern about how Haruhi had distanced herself from the rest of the class.   

~!However, it turns out that she is Yuki's backup, and as such, is also another "humanoid interface".!~

name: Tsuruya
description: Tsuruya is the hyperactive friend of [Mikuru](https://anilist.co/character/253/Mikuru-Asahina), notable for her loud voice, ankle-length hair, and prominent tooth. She possesses a cheerful and friendly disposition. She is also prone to long fits of unrestrained and intense laughter at things she considers even the slightest bit humorous.  Her fang-like tooth gives her an idiosyncratic speech pattern, causing her to misspeak words by leaving out syllables. Her speech pattern is often accompanied with a lisp and her catch phrases "megas" and "nyoro". Her knowledge of the SOS Brigade comes almost exclusively from Mikuru. She is also the heir of the Tsuruya family, which purportedly collaborates with [Itsuki](https://anilist.co/character/254/Itsuki-Koizumi)'s Agency. It is also unknown if Tsuruya has a secret identity or agenda. Though she is not a brigade member, Tsuruya is still often used as an extra body for some of the Brigade's activities.

name: Kyon no Imouto
description: Not much is revealed about Kyon's fifth-grade sister; not even her real name is given. Other characters simply refer to the eleven-year-old as Kyon's (Younger) Sister or Little Sis. She has relatively few speaking lines, though she does appear in The Adventures of Mikuru Asahina - Episode 00, Episode 6, and Episode 14, fulfilling the duties of an irrepressible younger sister. She has even fewer lines and appearances in the original novel version than the anime's rendition. Usually, her presence is made apparent whenever Kyon is at home.    She is carefree, happy and playful and is also the force behind the use of the nickname "Kyon"; after she heard their aunt call her older brother such, she started using the nickname as well in front of his school friends. From there, the name spread and eventually stuck. She seems to get along well with all of the SOS Brigade, especially with Mikuru, sharing a sister-like relationship with her.

name: Shamisen
description: Shamisen is a stray cat selected by Haruhi to play the role of Yuki's familiar for their film "The Adventures of Mikuru Asahina", Shamisen is unusual in the sense that he is a male calico cat. During the filming of the movie, Haruhi's reality-altering powers temporarily give Shamisen the ability to speak. He is adopted by Kyon after the completion of the movie, and is given the nickname "Shami" by his sister.

name: Taniguchi
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7")
__Occupation:__ Student (grade 10-11)

Taniguchi is a loud high school student enrolled at North High who is good friends with both [Kunikida](https://anilist.co/character/258/Kunikida) and [Kyon](https://anilist.co/character/252/Kyon).

Taniguchi is comically lascivious; giving a "score" of attractiveness to each first-year girl based upon his tastes and preferences. He remembers the full names of everyone receiving an 'A' rank, with Nagato receiving an A-. As for Mikuru, her mere presence elicits an altered state of adoration for Taniguchi and Kunikida, especially when she was in her soba-serving costume. He also knew Haruhi from back in junior high, and was Kyon's original source of information on Haruhi before he started conversing with her. It is hinted that he may have been the person that dated Haruhi for the shortest amount of time.

name: Kunikida
description:
__Height:__ 166 cm (5'5")
__Occupation:__ Student (grade 10-11)

Kunikida is a quiet high school student enrolled at North High who is good friends with both [Taniguchi](https://anilist.co/character/257/Taniguchi) and [Kyon](https://anilist.co/character/252/Kyon).

Kunikida is much quieter than Taniguchi with the latter doing most of the talking when the two are hanging out. He and Kyon went to the same junior high school, and may know more about Kyon. He once stated that "Kyon likes weird girls," as evidence to support the idea that Kyon is romantically interested in [Haruhi Suzumiya](https://anilist.co/character/251/Haruhi-Suzumiya). It is believed that Kunikida himself has a crush on [Tsuruya](https://anilist.co/character/256/Tsuruya).

name: Ginko
description:
Ginko employs himself as a Mushi master (mushi-shi), traveling from place to place to research Mushi and aid people suffering from problems caused by them. Ginko's unusual white hair and green eye color is the result of an incident involving a mushi that occurred when he was a child.

While designing the character, Mushishi-writer and -artist [Urushibara](https://anilist.co/staff/97394/Urushibara-Yuki) actually planned to have the story take place in a contemporary setting. Ginko's rather modern clothes, which do not seem to match the time period reflected by all other characters, still reflect this.

Ginko is a rare person who attracts mushi. This inspires his peripatetic lifestyle; staying in one place too long will gather a potentially dangerous amount of mushi. He also smokes constantly in order to keep mushi away.  In terms of personality, Ginko is rather laid back, but can be very serious when it comes to protecting people from mushi. He also often stresses that the mushi are not evil, but they merely exist as a part of the nature and try to survive like every other living being.

~!When [Nui](https://anilist.co/character/5167/Nui) found him, he was unconscious in the woods, wounded and abandoned. As he had no place to go, Nui decided to care for him instead of making him leave. He went by the name "Yoki" until Nui was consumed by the Ginko mushi, thus changing his name to "Ginko."!~ ~!He lost his other eye and hair color when he tried to save Nui from the Ginko mushi that lived in the pond near where they lived. Nui protected Ginko by telling him to offer them as a sacrifice so the Ginko would let him be. He never saw Nui again and after nearly being consumed by the mushi he adopted the name Ginko to save himself.!~

name: Narrator
description:
This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. 

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

name: Adashino
description:
Adashino is the doctor of a seaside village whom [Ginko](https://anilist.co/character/425/Ginko) occasionally visits to sell Mushi-related items to. His hobby is collecting such items and keeps them in a shed behind his home.

(Source: Mushishi Wiki, edited)

name: Toki
description: After his younger sister died in the lake, Toki seemed to have snow following him around...

name: Isaza
description: Isaza is a member of the traveling Watari, always staying near the "river of light".

name: Masumi
description: A young woman, who seems to fall in love easily. After experiencing heartbreak she becomes very passive and withdrawn.

name: Ibuki
description: A young sailor who has developed a connection to a flock of bird-type mushi able to create wind.

name: Tama Minai
description:
Tama Minai is a Mushishi who is committed to protecting the Scribe of the Karibusa family.

Tama's ancestor sealed The Forbidden Mushi into the Karibusa Family. The Mushi has since then been passed on to each member of the family in the form of a birthmark. The members with the birthmark contain the Forbidden Mushi sealed in them and are called Scribes. The current Scribe of the fourth generation is [Tanyuu Karibusa](https://anilist.co/character/13714).

(Source: Mushishi Wiki)

name: Rokusuke
description:
A brewery master who wishes to replicate his father's golden sake.

~!He eventually does this, however, it turns out he unknowingly used a Mushi, which replicates the use of yeast, hence the golden appearance of his sake.!~

name: Saho
description: A woman with striking beauty that lacks all five senses.

name: Masaki
description: A gardener who makes medicine which seems to heal any illness.

name: Amimoto
description: The village elder, who is for some reason hated by Sakichi.

name: Musume
description: A young girl who meets Ginko, while trying to buy medicine for her ill mother.

name: Usuke
description: Tatsu's little brother

name: Sakichi
description: Sakichi and his daughter, Mina, appear in Episode 2, "The Warbling Sea Shell." They live by the sea, but suspiciously not in the nearby seaside village.

name: Houchi's Father
description: He seems to be hiding a secret.

name: Mina
description: A young, simple girl who lives near a fishing village by the sea. She and her father, Sakichi, appear in Episode 2, "The Warbling Sea Shell." Mina appears to be a friendly child, but without anyone to talk to. It is found out later that her father forbade her from speaking to anyone in the nearby village.

name: Houichi
description: A man of seemingly boundless energy who helps Ginko when he falls unconscious on a snowy mountain.

name: Mansaku no Musuko
description: Mansaku's grandson.

name: Yutaka Hoshino
description:
Peco is a member of the Katase High table tennis club, along with his best friend [Smile](https://anilist.co/character/20325/Tsukimoto-Makoto). Unlike his friend, Peco is very charismatic and has a real passion towards Ping Pong. Peco dreams of becoming the Ping Pong world champion, and claims that he'll move to Europe to start playing professionally after he graduates.

~! In the epilogue, it is revealed that Peco loves playing ping pong again and competes in competitions regularly.!~

name: Makoto Tsukimoto
description:
Smile is a member of the Katase High table tennis club, along with his best friend [Peco](https://anilist.co/character/20326/Hoshino-Yutaka). Unlike the other members of the club, Smile thinks of the sport as a job or a way to pass time. He does not try to enjoy it for fun and often lets less able players beat him out of consideration for their feelings. The other members of the club nicknamed him Smile because he never does.

~!In the epilogue, he becomes a ping pong coach for kids and new players.!~

name: Wenge Kong
description: Wenge Kong (nicknamed China by everyone else) is an extremely skilled table tennis player who travelled to Japan to start anew after he was kicked out of his home team in China. Originally his intention was to beat the local hero 'Dragon', but he finds new worthy opponents after meeting Peco and Smile.

name: Ryuichi Kazama
description:
Kazama is captain of the powerful table tennis club of the Kaiou Gakuen academy. He has also won the Inter-High for the second consecutive year. He has a stoic personality and devotes everything to table tennis.

~! Throughout the series Dragon believes Ping Pong is about hard work and dedication, so much to the point that you feel nothing but pain playing the sport. He believes there are no such things as Heroes and believes people cannot fly. This is all changed in the championship finals of the series when he matches against Peco (The Hero) and with this, Peco teaches Dragon how to stop slowly climbing up a cliff but instead how to jump off and take flight straight to the stars. !~

name: Manabu Sakuma
description: Demon is a childhood friend of Peco's and a member of the Kaio Academy table tennis club. Despite being Peco's friend, Demon is also his rival.

name: Jou Koizumi
description: Mr. Koizumi is the Katase High School Table Tennis club advisor. He recognizes Smile's gift and ability towards the sport and so vows to train him. When Mr. Koizumi was younger he was considered to be the best table tennis player in Japan, and was nicknamed 'Butterfly Joe' because of his extraordinary skills. Mr. Koizumi states that Smile reminds him of his younger self. He is also an English teacher.

name: Obaba
description: Obaba is an old chainsmoking woman who acts as Peco's mentor. She also owns the local table tennis dojo Tamura of which Peco and Smile are frequent visitors. She is close friends with Jou Kozoimi since her youth, when both were renowned table tennis players.

name: Kong no Coach
description: Kong Wenge's coach. He is fluent in both Japanese and Chinese, and also acts as a friend and an interpreter to Kong.

name: Yurie Kazama
description: Kazama's cousin and implied girlfriend.

name: Ota
description: Team captain of Katase, known for his unusual hairstyle. He helps run the family appliance store and is often occupied with odd jobs after school.

name: Kong no Haha
description: Kong Wenge's mother.

name: Michio Tamura
description: Obaba's son.

name: Masayuki Sanada
description:
The vice-captain of Kaio High School, and the second-best player on the team, he is shown to possess qualities befitting a captain.

~!He harbours a one-sided crush on Yurie Kazama, he is shown to be jealous of the affection she harbours for Ryuichi Kazama, however, he gives up on her later!~

name: Shouyou Hinata
description:
__Teams:__ Yukigaoka Junior High (Former); Karasuno High (Current)
__Number:__ 1 (Junior High 3rd Year); 10 (High School 1st year); 5 (High School 3rd year)
__Position:__ Captain (Junior High); Outside Hitter (Junior High); Middle Blocker (High School)

Hinata has an unusually high ability to jump. Since he was young, Hinata trained his legs to compensate for his lack of height. He joins the Karusuno High School Volleyball team and amazes the team with his natural affinity as a spiker. Although he is a complete beginner and never had any experience playing in a volleyball team, he grows rapidly through each match.

~!After graduating from high school, Hinata traveled to Brazil to gain experience by playing beach volleyball. This is when he got the name, Ninja Shoyo. Upon returning to Japan, he became a member of the MSBY Black Jackals, a Division 1 team in the V-League. He became a member of the Japan Men’s National Volleyball Team during the 2021 Olympics. Currently, that is the year 2022, he is a member of Asas São Paulo, a professional team in the Brazil Super League.!~

name: Tobio Kageyama
description:
__Team:__ Karasuno High, Kitagawa Daiichi Junior High (former) 
__Height:__ 180.6 cm 
__Year:__ 1st Year, class 3 
__Number:__ 9 
__Position:__ Setter 

A famous setter in his middle school who joins the Karusuno High Volleyball team. He was known as the "King of the Court" in his middle school because of his arrogant demeanor and the way he would order around his teammates. Although he still carries an overbearing attitude, he begins to change when he starts to play with [Hinata Shouyou](https://anilist.co/character/64769) who views him as a rival.

name: Yuu Nishinoya
description:
__Team:__ Karasuno High, Chidoriyama Junior High (former) 
__Height:__ 159.3 cm (5'2")
__Year:__ 2nd year, Class 3 
__Number:__ 4 
__Position:__ Libero

Yuu is a very energetic and temperamental person. His boisterous nature and crazy shenanigans can attract unwanted attention quite easily, which often bodes ill for him. Although he hardly ever worries about the consequences of his actions (and may even revert to violence in order to vent out his anger on certain occasions), he is surprisingly considerate of his friends' feelings and insecurities.

Yuu can be extremely impatient, excitable and impulsive. As [Ryuunosuke Tanaka](https://anilist.co/character/67325) puts it, "he simply gets too fired up for his own good." He doesn't bother to filter his words, and is therefore prone to blurting out whatever he's thinking in a loud and tactless manner. In-game, however, his attitude changes drastically: he becomes incredibly focused and serious, remaining calm and doing everything in his power to provide the support his team needs until the very end. For this reason, everyone in the volleyball club respects him greatly.

name: Kenma Kozume
description:
__Height:__ 169.2 cm

The setter of the Nekoma High School volleyball club. Kenma is [Kuroo](https://anilist.co/character/71269)'s childhood friend and keeps playing volleyball because of him. He has a very calm personality and is usually doing things at his own pace. Often seen playing video games and being introverted. Nekoma's backbone, brain and heart.

name: Tooru Oikawa
description:
__Height:__ 184 cm 

The setter and captain of the Aoba Josai High School volleyball club. He was [Kageyama](https://anilist.co/character/64771/Tobio-Kageyama)'s senpai when they were attending Kitagawa Daiichi. According to Kageyama, he is a very talented setter and volleyball player with a ​complex personality. 

His favourite food is milk bread.

name: Kei Tsukishima
description:
**Height:** 188 cm 
**Team:** Karasuno High
**Year:** 1st year, class 4 
**Number:** 11 
**Position:** Middle Blocker  

A member of the Karasuno High volleyball club. Tsukishima is very blunt and will sometimes rile his teammates up due to his antagonistic nature (most notably being [Hinata](https://anilist.co/character/64769/Hinata-Shouyou), [Kageyama](https://anilist.co/character/64771/Kageyama-Tobio), [Nishinoya](https://anilist.co/character/67327/Nishinoya-Yuu), and [Tanaka](https://anilist.co/character/67325/Tanaka-Ryuunosuke)) and sometimes other teams because of his casual smug attitude, taking pride in and relishing when his opponents see him as a nuisance as seen with [Tendou](https://anilist.co/character/126073/Tendou-Satori) and [Shirabu](https://anilist.co/character/137537/Shirabu-Kenjirou). Tsukishima is standoffish and has an arrogant and condescending personality, but he has low self-esteem and thinks of himself as inferior. Although he is only outwardly close with [Yamaguchi](https://anilist.co/character/71609/Yamaguchi-Tadashi), he can be seen occasionally caring about his other club members.

name: Koutarou Bokuto
description:
__Height:__ 185.3 cm

Bokuto is a third year student at Fukurodani Academy and is its volleyball team's captain and wing spiker. His spikes pack a powerful punch that others can struggle to receive. Despite this, Bokuto has a tendency to not doing well in the middle of games when getting shut out. Luckily, [Akaashi](https://anilist.co/character/88938) has a whole list of things Bokuto does and tries his best to bring Bokuto back up to his usual self. Besides Akaashi, Bokuto is friends with a few other rival team's players, such as [Kuroo](https://anilist.co/character/71269) and sorta friends with [Tsukishima](https://anilist.co/character/67329).

name: Tetsurou Kuroo
description:
__Team:__ Nekoma High School 
__Height:__ 187.7 cm
__Year:__ 3rd Year, class 5 
__Number:__ 1 
__Position:__ Middle Blocker  

The captain of the Nekoma High School volleyball club. Kuroo has a somehow manipulative and cunning personality, but cares about his friends and teammates very deeply. As Nekoma's captain he has a sense of responsibility and confidence. Even though Kuroo's a middle blocker, he often uses offensive plays too.

name: Koushi Sugawara
description:
__Height:__ 174 cm 

Being the vice captain, Sugawara has a soothing personality for his teammates and acts as a pillar of support for them. Even though he isn't Karasuno's official setter anymore, he doesn't dream of giving up on playing in general. As such, he encourages himself and all of his teammates not to give up, no matter how rough the situation might be.

Sugawara's dedication to volleyball is clear when he decides to continue club activities even when most third years choose to retire to focus on their futures. In a meeting, his teacher asked Sugawara why he's so determined to continue playing even though he's not a starting member, and Sugawara replied that he doesn't want to have regrets in the future.

He is also quite perceptive as he noticed how [Tanaka](https://anilist.co/character/67325/Tanaka-Ryuunosuke) asked for the key to the gym (back during the first years' 3-on-3 match) even though he always comes in late, so Sugawara knew that something was up. He is also intelligent as he can come up with helpful tactics during the game. An example of this is when he came up with the idea of saying "bring it" and "send it to me" for [Kageyama](https://anilist.co/character/64771/Kageyama-Tobio) and [Hinata](https://anilist.co/character/64769/Hinata-Shouyou)'s combo.

name: Ryuunosuke Tanaka
description:
__Height:__ 177.2 cm 
__Team:__ Karasuno High 
__Number:__ 5 
__Position:__ Wing Spiker

name: Keiji Akaashi
description:
__Height:__ 182.3 cm

A second year at Fukurodani Academy, and its volleyball team's vice-captain and setter. Akaashi is often calm and collected, though he does have times where he begins to get worried about things. More often than not, he has to handle Bokuto and all of his antics during the game. When such happens, Akaashi usually thinks of some way to bring Bokuto into peak condition again, though there are times where he struggles with doing so.

name: Tadashi Yamaguchi
description:
__Team:__ Karasuno High 
__Height:__ 179.5 - 180 cm 
__Year:__ 1st year, class 4 
__Number:__ 12 
__Position:__ Middle Blocker  

Yamaguchi always hangs out with [Tsukishima](https://anilist.co/character/67329/Tsukishima-Kei) and is very protective of him. He has trained himself hard to use a jump float serve. He is also a substitute ace server of the Karasuno Volleyball team.

name: Kiyoko Shimizu
description:
__Team:__ Karasuno High
__Height:__ 166.2 cm
__Year:__ 3rd Year, class 2 

The manager of the Karasuno High volleyball club.

name: Asahi Azumane
description:
__Team:__ Karasuno High 
__Height:__ 184.7 cm 
__Year:__ 3rd year, class 3 
__Number:__ 3 
__Position:__ Wing Spiker

In contrast to his appearance, he is rather quiet and gentle and has his difficulties realizing that he is Karasuno's ace as he initially doesn't feel that way. He shows to be weak-willed at the beginning when he leaves the team before the first years come, feeling that he let down his entire team when they lost against Date Tech High even though they counted on him. After coming back to Karasuno, he realizes that his will to play volleyball is much stronger than he thought and with the help of his teammates, he acknowledges his position as Karasuno's ace (even though he is still mocked sometimes by Daichi for not having any "ace-like presence") and gains self-confidence.

name: Daichi Sawamura
description:
__Team:__ Karasuno High 
__Height:__ 176.8 cm 
__Year:__ 3rd year, class 4 
__Number:__ 1 
__Position:__ Wing Spiker 

The captain of the Karasuno High volleyball club.

name: Keishin Ukai
description:
**Height:** 178.2 cm 
**Team:** Karasuno High 

Karasuno High School volleyball club's alumnus, currently coaching volleyball club and helping out his mother at the shop.

name: Wakatoshi Ushijima
description:
__Height:__ 189.5 cm (6' 2.6")
__Team:__ Shiratorizawa Academy
__Number:__ 1
__Position:__ Wing Spiker

Wakatoshi Ushijima is a third year at Shiratorizawa Academy and the captain and ace of the school's boys' volleyball team. Currently, he is the number one ace in Miyagi Prefecture and one of the country's top three aces, along with [Sakusa](https://anilist.co/character/139475/Sakusa-Kiyoomi) and [Kiryuu](https://anilist.co/character/139506/Kiryuu-Wakatsu). Left handed. His favourite food is hayashi rice.

name: Hitoka Yachi
description:
__Team:__ Karasuno High 
__Position:__ Manager
__Occupation:__ High School Student (1st Year, Class 5)

A 1st year who was recruited by [Shimizu](https://anilist.co/character/67689/Shimizu-Kiyoko) as a manager trainee. She appears to be very nervous, but easily befriends [Hinata](https://anilist.co/character/64769/Hinata-Shouyou).

She's paranoid (which causes her to be intimidated easily), very curious, and is organized with her notes, including the ones that she takes from class; this is largely due to her mother being a graphic designer.

name: Hajime Iwaizumi
description:
__Height:__ 179.3 cm 
__Team:__ Aobajousai High School 
__Year:__ 3rd Year, class 5 
__Number:__ 4 
__Position:__ Wing Spiker 
__Ability Parameters (out of 5):__ Power = 5; jump = 4; stamina = 4; intellect = 3; technique = 3; speed = 4  

Is a third-year student from Aoba Johsai High; he is the volleyball team's ace, vice-captain and a wing spiker. He is also [Tōru Oikawa](https://anilist.co/character/71611/Oikawa-Tooru)'s childhood friend and "pillar". Iwaizumi often gets irritated by Oikawa's behavior and tells him that guys who have girls going kyaa kyaa over them irritates him the most.

name: Lev Haiba
description:
__Team:__ Nekoma High School
__Height:__ 194 cm
__Weight:__ 79,7 kg
__Year:__ 1st Year
__Position:__ Middle Blocker

Lev is a half Russian, half Japanese. However he says he doesn't speak Russian because he was born and raised in Japan. His name in Russian means lion. Lev wasn't around when Karasuno and Nekoma had their first match together. He started playing volleyball in high school, that's why he was still a novice and spent whole time on bench at that time so he didn't come. Lev is blessed with natural physical ability, intuition and height. He declares that he's an ace even though he's a middle blocker. Kenma states that Lev is a good and honest guy.

Lev is quite childish and cheerful, shown when he was making fun of Hinata's height. Lev's appearance, as well as his piercing eyes, causes people to believe he is much more intimidating and serious than he actually is. Though he can be blunt, he never seems to mean any harm and adopts a playful attitude towards most things.
He is also shown to be enthusiastic about spiking as he gets excited about it very easily, and can be competitive with people he is interested in.

name: Saeko Tanaka
description:
Saeko Tanaka is a former student of Karasuno High and the older sister of Ryuunosuke Tanaka. She was also a classmate of the Small Giant during her high school years.

The second years of the volleyball team views her as a cool older sister, especially Nishinoya, but Tanaka thinks of her as a nuisance whenever she bothers his study sessions. Like her brother, she's loud and outspoken.

Her driving has been described by her brother as dangerous as he had once stated to Hinata and Kageyama that he can't guarantee their safety in her car.

name: Yuuji Terushima
description:
**Team:** Johzenji
**Height:** 177 cm
**Number:** 1
**Position:** Wing Spiker
**Role:** Captain

The recently instated captain of the Johzenji volleyball team. Values spirit and fun over all else, contrary to the teams original motto "valor and simplicity." His ways of practice are often very hectic, and include mostly 2 vs 2.

name: Ittetsu Takeda
description:
__Team:__ Karasuno High 
__Height:__ 166.5 cm 

Volleyball club faculty advisor of the Karasuno High School.  Takeda is inexperienced in volleyball, but still became an advisor for Karasuno. He often doesn't understand rules and that's why he takes notes about every new thing he learns. Takeda has an enthusiastic and brave personality.

name: Morisuke Yaku
description:
__Team:__ Nekoma High School 
__Height:__ 165.2 cm 
__Year:__ 3rd Year, class 5 
__Number:__ 3 
__Position:__ Libero  

Currently playing libero of the Nekoma High School volleyball club.

name: Takanobu Aone
description:
__Team:__ Datekougyou High School 
__Height:__ 191.8 cm 
__Year:__ 2nd Year, class A 
__Number:__ 7 
__Position:__ Middle Blocker 

Main pillar of Datekou. Even though Aone never smiles and seems serious and scary, he actually has a very kind heart. [Futakuchi](https://anilist.co/character/77415/Futakuchi-Kenji) said that Aone has a habit of "locking on" to you if he knows his opponent is an ace.

name: Levi
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3")

Squad Captain of the Special Operations Squad (known as Squad Levi) within the Survey Corps. He is known as humanity's strongest soldier. 

Levi is abrasive, blunt, and has a strong respect for structure and discipline. He is a clean-freak, demanding spotless cleanliness of himself, his equipment, and his environment. Rumors say he was involved in underground crime in his life before coming a soldier. Despite his emotionless and unfriendly demeanor, Levi cares deeply for his squad and greatly values human life.

name: Eren Yeager
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7") - 183 cm (6'0")
__Affiliation:__ 104th Trainees Squad, Survey Corps. 

Eren was born to [Carla](https://anilist.co/character/62475/Yeager-Carla) and [Grisha Yeager](https://anilist.co/character/62477/Yeager-Grisha) in Shiganshina District within the southern region of Wall Maria. He grew up in the town with his parents and foster sister [Mikasa](https://anilist.co/character/40881/Ackerman-Mikasa), who moved in with the Yeagers as a child. Eren spent most of his time with Mikasa and their mutual best friend [Armin Arlert](https://anilist.co/character/46494/Arlert-Armin), whom the pair often defended from neighborhood bullies.  

Eren is a passionate, determined, hardheaded, and impulsive young man. When they were children, Armin showed him a book depicting the wonders of the outside world. Eren grew to share Armin's curiosity of the world beyond the Walls and resolved to see it for himself. This dream inspired his admiration of the Survey Corps and his desire to join their ranks as soon as he became eligible for enrollment. 

When the Titans suddenly broke through Wall Maria into Shiganshina, Eren was forced to watch on as his mother became trapped under the rubble of their house and eaten by a titan. Forever changed from this event, Eren vows to kill every last titan.

name: Mikasa Ackerman
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7") - 176 cm (5'9½")
__Position:__ 104th Training Corps, Survey Corps
__Relatives:__ [Birth Mother](https://anilist.co/character/84341/Mikasa-no-Haha) (Deceased), [Birth Father](https://anilist.co/character/84339/Mikasa-no-Chichi) (Deceased), [Grisha Yaeger](https://anilist.co/character/62477/Grisha-Yeager) (Foster Father), [Carla Yaeger](https://anilist.co/character/62475/Carla-Yeager) (Foster Mother, Deceased), [Eren Yeager](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Eren-Yeager) (Foster Brother)

Mikasa is Eren Yaeger's foster sister and mutual childhood friend of [Armin Arlert](https://anilist.co/character/46494), living with the two of them in Shiganshina District within the southern region of Wall Maria. 

When she was young, her parents were killed by human traffickers, and she was kidnapped. Eren discovered this and helped her escape her captors. Later, Eren gave her his scarf, which she constantly wears and shares an emotional attachment to. She was adopted by the Yaeger family soon after. Because of these past events, Mikasa shares an unbreakable bond with Eren and lives to protect him, constantly worrying for Eren's well-being. After the Titans broke through Wall Maria and killed her and Eren's mother, she chose to follow Eren into the military to try and keep him safe from danger. 

Even as a child, Mikasa possessed impressive fighting skill and strength, and that skill was only honed further during her training.  Mikasa is considered a genius among all the army trainees and is incredibly skilled at combat and agility, to the point that she was known as the greatest soldier among the 104th Training Corps and graduated in first place. Though being among the best of the best, she remains humble and refrains from displaying arrogance. Ultimately, Mikasa's loyalty remains with Eren no matter the circumstance, with her only true desire being to live a peaceful life with him.

name: Armin Arlert
description:
__Height:__ 163 cm (5'4")
__Position:__ 104th Trainees Squad, Survey Corps
__Relatives:__ [Grandfather](https://anilist.co/character/84313/Armin-no-Ojiisan)

Armin is a young boy who was born and raised in the Shiganshina District within the walls, being childhood friends with both [Eren Yeager](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Eren-Yeager) and [Mikasa Ackerman](https://anilist.co/character/40881). After Wall Maria was breached, he chose to join Mikasa and Eren in joining the military, both to try to make a good and meaningful impact on the world, and to fulfill his dream of seeing the outside world.

Even when he was young, the naturally curious Armin has always had a deep fascination with the world beyond the Walls. As a child, he found and studied an illegal book about the outside world that was owned by his grandfather. He often shared the book and information contained in it with Eren Yeager, his best friend, and his dreams of seeing the world outside the walls. Armin was branded a heretic by other children for his unusual interest in the outside world and was thus frequently picked on. Too timid to defend himself, Armin would often rely on his friends Eren and Mikasa Ackerman to protect him from local bullies. This, coupled with his frail physique, was a deep shame for Armin, leading him to have poor self-esteem and to believe that he is a burden to others. Because of this, Armin has always been very eager to prove his worth, especially towards his close friends. 

Armin is known to be exceptionally loyal and selfless. He constantly worries for the safety of his friends, and he is always prepared to throw himself into dangerous situations to save them. Alongside his kindhearted nature and emotionally intelligence, Armin is a very analytical person. He likes to think deeply about situations and solve problems using his mind. These personality traits, in conjunction with his intelligence, good judgment, level headedness, ability to plan ahead, come up with creative ideas and to think outside the box, are what make him a great tactician. Although he may appear among the physically weakest of the 104th Training Corps, his incredible intelligence and strategic genius makes him an invaluable asset to any team.

name: Hange Zoe
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7")
__Affiliation:__ Survey Corps; Section Commander, Squad Leader.

Leader of the Survey Corps' Fourth Squad, Hange is also in charge of conducting research on Titans, and pursues this knowledge so passionately that they have become obsessed with Titans as a result. After originally holding a deep hatred for the creatures, Hange decided to take on a new outside-the-box approach to their research by letting go of their resentment towards Titans and approaching the test subjects with compassion. 

Hange is an energetic, freethinking and quirky scientist, with a unique way of conducting both themselves and their work. Hange is a genius outside of just Titan research too, using their brain to create weapons, tactical plans, and inventions for the benefit of humanity. As a leader, Hange is thoughtful of their comrades, and can easily figure out complex problems in order to create plans for their teammates to carry out.

name: Erwin Smith
description:
**Height:** 188 cm
**Position:** 13th Commander, Survey Corps

Discerning, intelligent, and widely respected, Erwin is the unshakable and calculated 13th commander of the Survey Corps. While he cares deeply for his men, he does not hesitate to sacrifice them for the good and prosperity of mankind, and his men have proven more than willing to stake their lives at his order. Erwin developed the Long-Distance Enemy Scouting Formation.

name: Sasha Blouse
description:
__Initial Height:__ 168cm
__Affiliations__: 104th Cadet Corps, Survey Corps; Soldier
__Relatives__: [Artur Blouse](https://anilist.co/character/131281/Artur-Blouse) (Father), [Lisa Blouse](https://anilist.co/character/134952/Lisa-Blouse) (Mother)

Originally from Dauper, a remote and scarcely populated village of hunters located in a mountain forest in the southern area of Wall Rose, Sasha joined the military as a cadet of the 104th Training Corps, where she ranked 9th upon graduation. After graduating, she'd choose to enlist in the Scouting Regiment. 

Sasha is a friendly and fun-loving girl. She speaks with a local accent from her home village, but initially hid it out of embarrassment by using overly formal and polite speech. She is a constant food hoarder and is known to have an incredible appetite; eating provided her with considerable gratification and relief, especially during times of great stress, and food was often the only thing on her mind when at ease. Raised as an animal hunter, Sasha specializes in archery, horseback riding, and tracking, although her eccentricity and unconventional methods tend to make her a poor fit for group operations.

~!She later saves a child named [Kaya](https://anilist.co/character/132738/Kaya) from a titan attack, who her family ends up adopting.!~

name: Reiner Braun
description:
__Height__: 185 cm (6'1")

Member of the Survey Corps and former cadet of the 104th Training Corps. Reiner is a passionate and strong-willed young man with a strong sense of duty. He ranked 2nd in his training class upon graduation, finishing behind only [Mikasa](https://anilist.co/character/40881). His comrades have great trust in him, and he is stated to be the "big brother" of the 104th cadets.

name: Jean Kirstein
description:
__Height__: 175 cm (5'8")
__Relatives__: [Mother](https://anilist.co/character/131444/Jean-no-Haha)

Jean Kirschtein is a graduate of the 104th Cadet Corps, among whom he ranked 6th for his skills with ODM gear and ability to look at things through a more tactical lense. Jean hails from Wall Rose's Trost District, and joined the military with hopes of living a peaceful life within the walls as part of the Military Police. However, he would later find himself joining the Survey Corps after being convinced both by his close friend [Marco Bott's](https://anilist.co/character/62479/Marco-Bott) words, and after witnessing the death of several of his comrades.

Jean has a blunt personality. He holds no restraint when it comes to speaking his mind, even when he knows it would not be wise to do so or when it could spark conflict. Jean is also pragmatic: he has a strong aversion to exposing himself to dangerous situations. During his time as a cadet, Jean was extremely hot-headed, easily becoming frustrated and quick to resort to violence when pushed. Jean was also very cynical about defeating the Titans, believing that humanity has no chance against them and openly mocking more idealistic individuals like [Eren Yeager](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Eren-Yeager), and saw resisting the Titans as a hopeless cause. However, despite these things, and although he presents himself as self-centered, Jean places high value on the lives of his comrades, and is willing to risk his life to prevent countless more deaths from his comrades. Even with his shortcomings, Jean has shown himself to be a natural leader, being able to understand others and assess situations well because of his flaws, and proves capable of leading his fellow soldiers when they are left confused and without a plan.

name: Krista Lenz
description:
__Height__: 145 cm (4'8")
__Affiliations__: 104th Trainees Squad, Survey Corps

Ranked tenth in the trainee class, Krista is a very shy and kind, caring person, often being described as a "goddess" or "angel" by her peers. She is good friends with [Ymir](https://anilist.co/character/71479/Ymir).

name: Zeke
description:
__Height__: 183 cm

Zeke is the current inheritor of the Beast Titan, and is considered by [Reiner Braun](https://anilist.co/character/46484/Reiner-Braun) to be the strongest Warrior, contrasting [Levi's](https://anilist.co/character/45627/Levi) title of "humanity's strongest soldier".

name: Ymir
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm (5'7")
__Affiliations:__ 104th Trainees Squad, Scouting Legion

Member of the Scouting Legion. She seems selfish, cynical, bossy, sly, uncooperative, exploitative, and confrontational, but she can apparently be kind, especially to [Krista](https://anilist.co/character/62481/Krista-Lenz).

name: Connie Springer
description:
__Height__: 158 cm (5'2")  
__Relatives:__ [Mother](https://anilist.co/character/137287/Conny-no-Haha), Martin Springer (Brother), Sunny Springer (Sister)

Connie Springer is a graduate of the 104th Training Corps, having ranked 8th in class. He is known to be one of the quickest soldiers while using ODM gear and is skilled at making very sharp turns. He hails from the rural Ragako Village within Wall Rose, his greatest ambition being to make his family and village proud of him. Upon graduation, he chose to join the Survey Corps. 

Upbeat and naive, Connie is rather unfocused outside of combat, and enjoys goofing around and messing with his friends, but can also be a bit dense at times, as he can have some difficulty comprehending new developments as they appear. Connie always tries to remain optimistic, consistently caring for the well-being of his friends, family and village, and being willing to help in any way he can. However, this soft spot and the struggles he goes through as a member of the Survey Corps takes a toll on him, as he often responds to grief and loss with anger, irritation and hatred, causing him to at times make rash, impulsive decisions. He will do anything to protect his family, whether it be his biological family or his closest friends.

name: Narrator
description:
This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. 

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

name: Floch Forster
description:
Floch is a new recruit in the Survey Corps. He joined the Survey Corps during the two months between the attack at Orvud District and the return to Shiganshina District.

~!After the rest of the Yeagerists are killed during the port battle, Floch hides on the ship to Marley. After shooting holes in the fuel tank of the flying boat, Floch is ultimately killed by Mikasa.!~

name: Bertolt Hoover
description:
__Height__: 192 cm (6'3")  
__Affiliation__: Survey Corps

Member of the Survey Corps and former cadet of the 104th Training Corps. Bertoldt ranked 3rd in his training class upon graduation, finishing behind only [Mikasa](https://anilist.co/character/40881) and his hometown friend [Reiner](https://anilist.co/character/46484). He is a quiet young man who identifies himself as someone with a weak will that follows popular opinion. Despite ranking 3rd in his class, his training commandant noted him to be a person with great potential, but an utter lack of initiative. Bertoldt originally he enlisted in the military with aspirations of joining the Military Police and living in the safety of the inner wall, but after the Battle of Trost he instead decided to join the Survey Corps.

name: Kenny Ackerman
description:
__Affiliation:__ Military Police; Captain of Anti-Personnel Control Squad.
__Relatives:__ [Kuchel Ackerman](https://anilist.co/character/127940/Kuchel-Ackerman) (Sister), [Unnamed Grandfather](https://anilist.co/character/128589/Kenny-no-Ojiisan), 

Kenny Ackerman is a member of the Military Police Brigade's First Interior Squad and also the Anti-Personnel Control Squad. Decades prior, however, Kenny was known as an infamous serial killer that stalked victims in the capitol. 

Despite his dark field of work, Kenny appears to be rather jovial and takes pleasure in taunting his adversaries during battle. When fighting, he becomes animated and lively, often making a scene or otherwise throwing insults and witticisms. However, he also fought with control and was able to effortlessly sneak up on his targets when they least expected him. His preferred method of killing during his time as a serial killer was to slit the throats of his victims which earned him his infamous handle "Kenny the Ripper", and it was rumored that he murdered over 100 members of the Military Police Brigade. However, decades later his killings ceased and the terror that he once inspired dwindled into an Urban Legend. He eventually was found working under the Royal Government, the reasoning for his sudden shift in behavior being a mystery. Kenny is ultimately, despite his comical personality, very cold and calculated, sparing little emotional attachment or loyalty to anyone, with only a few exceptions.

~!ㅤ
He notably shares the same bloodline as both [Levi](https://anilist.co/character/45627/Levi) and [Mikasa Ackerman](https://anilist.co/character/40881/Mikasa-Ackerman).!~

name: Dot Pixis
description: The highest-ranked Administrator of the Southern Region. Head of the Garrison's Southern Territories, Pixis is a cunning leader with astute insights. However, he is also an alcoholic who is constantly watched over by his aid, [Anka](https://anilist.co/character/84331/Anka-Rheinberger), who constantly scolds him for sleeping and drinking during critical moments.

name: Grisha Yeager
description:
Father of [Eren Yaeger](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Eren-Yeager) and caretaker of [Mikasa Ackerman](https://anilist.co/character/40881/Mikasa-Ackerman). He is a renowned doctor who was well respected in the District of Shiganshina after he saved the village from a mysterious viral epidemic by developing vaccines. He also provides a medical house call service to the people of Shiganshina and to various towns in addition to having a network of contacts within the Corps of the Shiganshina District. He is married to [Carla Yaeger](https://anilist.co/character/62475).

~!In the basement of the Yeager family house, he hides a secret which he refers to as the "truth". Upon finding Eren after the fall of Wall Maria, he injects him with a series of chemicals and amnesiacs and entrusts him with the key to the "truth", before mysteriously disappearing. This strange serum resulted in Eren gaining the ability to transform into a titan.!~

name: Hitch Dreyse
description:
**Height:** 168 cm
__Affiliations:__ 104th Cadet Corps.

Recruit of the Military Police stationed in Stohess District. She was roommates with [Annie Leonhart](https://anilist.co/character/46490/Annie-Leonhart).

Hitch acts immature in certain ways, she has a sarcastic, easygoing personality and seems to mischievously enjoy teasing and needling her fellow officers, especially [Marlo Freudenberg](https://anilist.co/character/71457/Marlo-Freudenberg). She claims she chose to join the Military Police out of laziness, as it is well known that the senior staff are incredibly corrupt and she wanted to benefit from the system herself; however, she did not take into account that, as a new recruit, her superiors would dump all their work on her. Though she may act a bit air-headed at times, Hitch is not selfish and cares about those around her, especially her fellow comrades.

name: Hannes
description: A soldier who saves Eren and Mikasa during the prologue. He owes a debt to the Yeager family.

name: Carla Yeager
description: Eren's mother.   ~!She's eaten alive in the second chapter.!~ Note: Carla Yeager is the official English translation by Kodansha.

name: Keith Shadis
description: Keith Shadis was the head instructor of the 104th Trainees Squad. He seemed to be a friend or have some sort of relationship with [Dr. Grisha](https://anilist.co/character/62477/Yeager-Grisha), as he knew [Eren](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Yeager-Eren) is the son of the doctor and praised Eren for his effort.

name: Marlo Freudenberg
description:
__Affiliations:__ Military Police, 104th Cadet Corps.

Recruit of the Military Police stationed in Stohess District.

While most who join the Military Police Regiment do so because they want a safe position far from the danger of the Titans, Marlo did so because he claims to want "to uphold justice and do what's right.", much to the amusement of his fellow officer, [Hitch Dreyse](https://anilist.co/character/86017/Hitch-Dreyse), whom he often clashes with due to them being near complete opposites. His goal is to rise to the top of the organization so he can stop the pilfering of taxes and misappropriation of land. Though steadfast in his idealism, he could make moral compromises to achieve his goal, confessing a willingness to act like "scum" in order to move up in rank. Due to his passion towards his ideals, he had often been compared to [Eren Yeager](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Eren-Yeager) by people who know both of them.

name: Moblit Berner
description:
__Height:__ 176 cm (5'9")
__Affiliation:__ Survey Corps; Executive Officer, Fourth Squad.

A veteran member of the Survey Corps and [Hange Zoe](https://anilist.co/character/71121/Hange-Zoe)'s second-in-command within the Survey Corps' Fourth Squad. He also serves as Hanji's assistant and messenger.

He comes across as an intelligent and responsible person, which may be the reason he was tasked to keep his overzealous and eccentric superior out of trouble. Much of the time, this leaves him in a state of near-panic, having to constantly remind Hange to be more careful or yanking them to safety. That he remains at Hange's side constantly suggests he is a loyal person, and that he cares deeply for his superior's safety, regardless of the stress involved with being under their command. He is also able to show signs of a serious nature when it comes to missions, going out of his way to investigate problems and put himself in danger before others.

name: Myne
description:
__Family structure__ ~!　Father: [Gunther](https://anilist.co/character/126528) 　 Mother: [Effa](https://anilist.co/character/126527) 　 Older sister: [Tuuli](https://anilist.co/character/126526) 　 Younger brother: [Kamil](https://anilist.co/character/157140)!~ __Status__ 　 Class: commoner 　 Occupation: soldier's child
Youngest daughter of a poor commoner family. She has navy blue hair and golden eyes. She has a feeble body which gets a high fever if she forces it too much, it is also smaller than the average for her age. Urano Motosu died at the age of 22 and reincarnated into Myne's body by the time Myne was 5 years old.
____ _Spoiler from [Part 3](https://anilist.co/manga/110801)_ # ~!__Rozemyne__ (ローゼマイン)!~ ~!
__Family structure__ 　 Father: [Karstedt](https://anilist.co/character/156108) 　 Mother: [Elvira](https://anilist.co/character/157149) (Karstedt's first wife, mother of baptism) 　 Older brother: [Eckhart](https://anilist.co/character/201318) 　 Older brother: [Lamprecht](https://anilist.co/character/201319) 　　　 Nephew: Siegrecht 　 Older brother: [Cornelius](https://anilist.co/character/201320) 　 Younger half-brother: [Nikolaus](https://anilist.co/character/201317) (son of Karstedt's second wife) 　 Mother: [Rozemary](https://anilist.co/character/157151) (Karstedt's third wife, mother setting) 　 Adoptive father: [Sylvester](https://anilist.co/character/157135) 　 Adoptive mother: [Florencia](https://anilist.co/character/201321) 　 Older brother: [Wilfried](https://anilist.co/character/201564) 　 Younger sister: [Charlotte](https://anilist.co/character/201565) 　 Younger brother: [Melchior](https://anilist.co/character/201566) 　 Paternal relatives 　 Great-grandfather: [Aub Ehrenfest](https://anilist.co/character/201635) (fifth generation) 　 Great-grandfather: [former Giebe Leisegang](https://anilist.co/character/262016) (Bonifatius's first wife's father) 　 Grandfather: [Bonifatius](https://anilist.co/character/201624) 　 Half-uncle: son of Bonifatius's second wife 　　　 Cousin: [Traugott](https://anilist.co/character/201627) __Status__ 　 Class: archnoble → archducal family member 　 Occupation: apprentice blue shrine maiden, orphan director and studio manager → archduke candidate, high bishop, orphan director and studio manager __Age related__ 　 Age difference with Myne: -1 　 Birth season: summer
Rozemyne is an archnoble girl. Her flowing midnight-blue hair is well kept, silkier than even the hair of most archnoble girls, and her moon-like golden-yellow eyes are like windows into her emotional heart. She has a pretty face as well, and would no doubt grow up to be a true beauty. She has pale white skin largely untouched by the sun, and soft hands that weren't at all worn down by labor. Rozemyne ​​has a massive amount of mana inside her. Her mana is so great that Karstedt determined that it was necessary to hide his own daughter and raise her in secret, away from any danger. [The former High Bishop](https://anilist.co/character/126545) misunderstood her presence in the temple, and not discerning her true identity, he began to groan and complain that a commoner shrine maiden disturbed the peace. Rozemyne ​​was raised humbly, unaware of her parents or their status, but still, her compassionate heart ached for the suffering of those who lived in worse circumstances than her. She felt sorry for the children who lived in the orphanage, and did what no one else would by giving them food and work, due to that, Rozemyne is worshiped and honored by the orphans as a Saint. [The Archduke](https://anilist.co/character/157135) determined that the work Rozemyne gave to the orphans could become a new industry for his duchy. Just when he was considering spending the next twenty or more years spreading it around the duchy, Rozemyne ​​was targeted by [a noble from another duchy](https://anilist.co/character/157148). In order to secure Rozemyne's position in the nobility, and to protect her mana wealth for the sake of Ehrenfest, the Archduke adopted her.!~

name: Ferdinand
description:
__Family structure__ ~!　Father: [Adelbert](https://anilist.co/character/201316) (deceased) 　 Mother: [Seradina](https://anilist.co/character/198761) 　 Older half-sister: [Georgine](https://anilist.co/character/201312) 　　　 Niece: Alstede 　　　 Nephew: Wolfram (deceased) 　　　 Niece: [Detlinde](https://anilist.co/character/225797) 　 Older half-sister: [Constanze](https://anilist.co/character/201617) 　　　 Nephew: [Rudiger](https://anilist.co/character/225798) 　 Older half-brother: [Sylvester](https://anilist.co/character/157135) 　　　 Nephew: [Wilfried](https://anilist.co/character/201564) 　　　 Niece: [Charlotte](https://anilist.co/character/201565) 　　　 Nephew: [Melchior](https://anilist.co/character/201566) 　　　 Niece: fourth child 　 Paternal relatives 　 Uncle: [Bonifatius](https://anilist.co/character/201624) 　　　 Cousin: [Karstedt](https://anilist.co/character/156108) 　　　 Cousin: Karstedt's half-brother 　 Half-aunt: Irmhilde!~ __Age related__ ~!　Age difference with [Myne](https://anilist.co/character/126156): +13 (summer) 　 Birth season: presumed to be spring or summer!~
He is a blue priest who serves as the High Priest of the temple of the city of Ehrenfest. He is tall and slender, he has light blue hair that reaches down towards his shoulders and pale golden eyes. People frequently mistake him by being older than he really is. ~!He was the son of a concubine in noble society. Regardless of [his father’s true wife](https://anilist.co/character/194299), his relationship with his older half-brother was not at all bad. After his father's death, his half-brother recommended him to join the temple. Before he became the High Priest, with the help of his half-brother he built a library inside the temple, one that even nobles with unfortunate economic circumstances would be able to use. Despite the fact that it had not been terribly long since he joined the temple and that he was still very young, he became the High Priest due to all of the people who were primarily in charge of managing the temple’s affairs had been called away to noble society, leaving him to take on every single aspect of running the temple.!~

name: Benno
description:
__Family structure__ ~!　Father: father (deceased) 　 Mother: mother (after the death of her husband, she was approached by [Gustav](https://anilist.co/character/126540) and she refused him) 　 Fiancé: [Liz](https://anilist.co/character/156117) (deceased) 　 Older brother: brother (doing business in another town) 　 Older sister: Milda (to avoid marriage with [Gustav](https://anilist.co/character/126540)'s son, she got married in another town) 　 Younger sister: [Corinna](https://anilist.co/character/126538) 　　　 Niece: [Renate](https://anilist.co/character/157141) 　　　 Nephew: Knut 　 Great-grandmother: [Gilberta](https://anilist.co/character/156116) (deceased) 　 Uncle: [Emile](https://anilist.co/character/156115)!~ __Status__ ~!　Class: commoner 　 Occupation: gilberta company's master 　 Title: gutenberg!~ __Age related__ ~!　Age difference with [Myne](https://anilist.co/character/126156): +22 (summer) / +23 (winter) 　 Birth season: autumn or winter!~
He's introduced as [Otto](https://anilist.co/character/126534)'s acquaintance from when Otto was a trader. ~!Later is revealed that he and Otto are brothers-in-law.!~ He's the proprietor of the Gilberta Company, a major shop that its main business is in clothing and accessories. He and the [guildmaster](https://anilist.co/character/126540) don't get along well. He has pale color like milk tea hair and reddish brown eyes.

name: Lutz
description:
__Family structure__ ~!　Father: [Deid](https://anilist.co/character/140074) 　 Mother: [Karla](https://anilist.co/character/126535) 　 Older brother: [Zasha](https://anilist.co/character/126533) 　 Older brother: [Sieg](https://anilist.co/character/126532) 　 Older brother: [Ralph](https://anilist.co/character/126530) 　 Cousin: [Fey](https://anilist.co/character/126531)!~ __Status__ ~!　Class: commoner 　 Occupation: merchant apprentice 　 Title: gutenberg!~ __Age related__ ~!　Birth season: summer 　 Winter age difference with [Myne](https://anilist.co/character/126156): 0!~
Myne's neighbor. He has golden hair and jade eyes. He is the fourth and youngest son in his family. His father is a carpenter. His mother gets along well with [Myne's mother](https://anilist.co/character/126527). He thinks of Myne like a younger sister even though they are the same age.

name: Tuuli
description:
__Family structure__ ~!　Father: [Gunther](https://anilist.co/character/126528) 　 Mother: [Effa](https://anilist.co/character/126527) 　 Younger sister: [Myne](https://anilist.co/character/126156) 　 Younger brother: [Kamil](https://anilist.co/character/157140)!~ __Age related__ ~!　Winter age difference with Myne: +1 　 Birth season: summer!~
Myne's older sister. She has blue-green hair and blue eyes. ~!After her baptism ceremony, she becomes an apprentice seamstress.!~
