Form names include Dust Whirlwind Cutter, Claws-Purifying Wind, Clean Storm Wind Tree, Rising Dust Storm, Cold Mountain Wind, Black Wind Mountain Mist, Gale - Sudden Gusts, Primary Gale Slash, and Idaten Typhoon.

name: Muzan Kibutsuji
description:
__Height:__ 179 cm (5'10")

He is the Demon King, the first of his kind, and the progenitor of all other demons in existence. Muzan is also the leader of the Twelve Kizuki, an organization of the twelve strongest demons in existence that serve directly under him.

~!A millennium ago, during the Heian Era, Muzan was turned into a demon during an experimental treatment trying to cure his terminal illness, and his goal since then was to live without the fear of death and become truly eternal. He believes that Sun Breathing users are his only threat. He has a grand total of seven hearts and five brains.!~

name: Gyoumei Himejima
description:
__Height:__ 220 cm (7'2½")

He is a Demon Slayer and the Stone Hashira of the Demon Slayer Corps. Gyomei also serves as the mentor of [Genya Shinazugawa](https://anilist.co/character/137776/Shinazugawa-Genya).

name: Yoriichi Tsugikuni
description:
__Combat Style:__ Sun Breathing

Yoriichi Tsugikuni is a major supporting character of Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba. He was a legendary Demon Slayer of the Demon Slayer Corps during the Sengoku Era.

~!Yoriichi is the younger twin brother of Michikatsu Tsugikuni, who later became a Demon and joined the Twelve Kizuki, holding the position of Upper Rank 1.!~

~!Yoriichi is also the progenitor of Breathing Styles as a whole and was an immensely gifted individual who was fated and meant to defeat Muzan Kibutsuji, but failed.!~

name: Douma
description:
__Height:__ 187 cm (6'1½")

He is Upper Moon Two, making him the third-strongest demon after Muzan and Upper Moon One. He has a very friendly attitude, and fights with a pair of metal fans. He is the founder of a cult known as the "Eternal Paradise Cult," and eats his followers, allegedly in order to release them from the pain of living.

~!He is the demon who killed Shinobu Kochou's older sister and Shinobu, as well as Inosuke's mother.!~

name: Hotaru Haganezuka
description: Hotaru Haganezuka is a swordsmith affiliated with the Demon Killing Corps.

name: Daki
description: Daki, known as Warabihime in her oiran guise, is a member of the Twelve Demon Moons, holding the position of Upper Moon Six.

name: Gyuutarou
description: ~!Gyuutarou is a member of the Twelve Demon Moons, holding the position of Upper Moon Six, which he shares with his younger sister Daki.!~

name: Kagaya Ubuyashiki
description: He is the head of the Ubuyashiki Family and 97th leader of the Demon Slayer Corps known mainly as "Oyakata-sama" ("Master") by his subordinates and peers.

name: Suma
description: Suma is a kunoichi and one of Tengen Uzui's wives.

name: Makio
description:
Makio is a kunoichi and one of Tengen Uzui's wives.
~!
According to the second official fanbook, Makio is actually a distant cousin of Tengen's.!~

name: Hinatsuru
description: Hinatsuru is a kunoichi and one of Tengen Uzui's wives.

name: Ai Hoshino
description:
__Height__: 151 cm (4'11")

She's an idol and lead of B-Komachi, an idol group affiliated with Strawberry Productions. Her life took a turn when through an undetermined amount of time, she became pregnant with twins. Not wanting to squander her reputation, she and her team decide to hide this fact; having to play the role of idol and mother.

name: Aquamarine Hoshino
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm (5'7")

[Ai Hoshino's](https://anilist.co/character/172759/Ai-Hoshino) son. He is the twin big brother of [Ruby Hoshino](https://anilist.co/character/183884/Ruby-Hoshino).

~!He was previously a doctor named Goro, who became a fan of Ai through his patient named Sarina.!~ 

~!After reincarnating as Aquamarine and witnessing Ai's murder, he is intent on plotting revenge to the person who schemed Ai's death.!~

name: Ruby Hoshino
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm (5'2")

[Ai Hoshino's](https://anilist.co/character/172759/Ai-Hoshino) daughter, and the younger twin sister of [Aquamarine Hoshino](https://anilist.co/character/183885). 

~!She was previously a patient named Sarina under Goro's care. Due to her illness, she was wheelchair-bound. After discovering B-Komachi, she had always aspired to be an idol although her condition kept her from achieving her dream. Since being reincarnated as Ruby, she is now working towards her dream of being an idol like Ai. To do so she's currently working with Strawberry Productions to revive B-Komachi along with Arima Kana and Memcho.!~

name: Xiaohei Luo
description: Xiaohei is a cat spirit who lived in a forest for years before humans cut it down. He was angry with humans at first, but eventually grew to like them.

name: Shizuku Hoshikawa
description:
__Height:__ 167 cm

Shy girl who avoids speaking with others, she's constantly haunted by her past of having bullied a friend. In secret, she wrote a novel expressing her innermost feelings she has never shared with anyone. Although she had planned to erase herself along with her novel when she finished writing, it didn't work out that way because her classmate [Kaori](https://anilist.co/character/204142) borrowed her novel after noticing it by chance. Having read it, Kaori asks when her next novel will be. Everything changes from then on, as they agree to go out until summer ends.

name: Kaori Asaka
description:
__Height:__ 149cm

Cheery and energetic, she accidentally stumbled upon her classmate Shizuku's novel when she approached her. After borrowing the novel in order to read it, she has started take an admiration towards Shizuku and asks when her next novel will be. Distraught to know she wasn't planning to write another one, Kaori asks to go out together so she can be inspired to write a new story. Unbeknown to Shizuku, she knew her from elementary school. There's also something she's hiding from her...

name: Ruri Ichinose
description: Ruri Ichinose was Shizuku Hoshikawa's classmate in fifth grade of elementary school. She is currently attending a different high school.

name: Shiori Asaka
description: Kaori's little sister.

name: Seri Ichihara
description: She is friends with [Ruri](https://anilist.co/character/308867/Ichinose-Ruri).

name: Gyro Zeppeli
description:
Gyro has a cocky and flamboyant personality, appearing to have a high opinion of himself. However, he can be driven by emotions for other people and become realistic and serious when a problem presents itself.

Like most Manga archetypes, Gyro is incredibly intelligent when he needs to be. His most distinguishable body features are his long hair, western hat and his gold teeth which have "GO! GO! ZEPPELI" displayed on them, revealed whenever he smiles at someone. His signature laugh/chuckle is "Nyo ho ho ho~".

~!Note that the "Caesar" in his name is pronounced in the traditional Greek way, more akin to the German "Kaiser". This is distinct from [Caesar Anthonio Zeppeli](https://anilist.co/character/21959/Zeppeli-Anthonio-Caesar) from [JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Part 2](https://anilist.co/manga/31630/-/), whose name is pronounced in the modern English way.!~

name: Johnny Joestar
description:
Johnny Joestar is an American former jockey turned paraplegic, and is the main protagonist of Part 7. He is a depressive man with a bleak outlook on life, but he is also very stubborn and capable of extreme, unwavering determination to the point of disregarding any risks or consequences, putting his goal above all else. He joins the Steel Ball Run race to find out the secret behind [Gyro Zeppeli's](https://anilist.co/character/11772) steel balls, as Johnny believes they're capable of healing his legs.

Johnny was once a horse racing prodigy. However, when waiting in line for a play, the girl he was with convinced him to cut to the front of the line and bribe the bouncers to throw out the youth in the front of the line, who had been waiting there all night. Furious, the youth shot Johnny in the back, paralyzing him from the waist down.

~!Johnny earns a Stand named "Tusk" when they venture into the Devil's Palm as a result of their fight with [Dio](https://anilist.co/character/20148/Brando-Diego) and [Dr. Ferdinand](https://anilist.co/character/130205/Ferdinand-Hakase). Tusk is able to fire Johnny's spinning fingernails similar to a revolver, with the nails having to take a few seconds to regrow. This long range attack becomes his primary means of defense. His Stand is small in size and has the same star-pattern over it as on Johnny's clothing, it appears to reside inside of him and only comes out to offer advice. It cannot speak, only make animal-like noises.

Later in the series, Johnny masters Gyro's "Spin" technique and uses it with his Stand's fingernail bullets; at one time, even being able to use it on himself. His Stand also evolves although remaining similar in appearance, now able to fire from the toenails on Johnny's paralyzed feet. !~

name: Funny Valentine
description:
Funny Valentine is the 23rd President of the United States, and the main antagonist of Steel Ball Run. He is the true mastermind behind the Steel Ball Run race. He watches the competition from behind the curtains and hopes to gather the Saint's Corpse to use the Holy Relic to further the United States of America's interests and power, and explains that his way to do that is by "taking the first napkin".

Valentine has a lot of importance for patriotism and seems to care about his country. Most of his bad deeds are not selfishly centered, but instead are done in order to achieve what he thinks is power for America, and to follow his goal of making America the most dominant country.

~!Valentine is a Stand User.
Valentine's Stand, Dirty Deeds Done Dirt Cheap (D4C), enables him access at any time to any number of alternate worlds/universes/dimensions; where if desired he may swap bodies with his counterparts, granting him pseudo-immortality. However, to activate said effect, Valentine must get caught between two objects (for example, a flag and the ground or a sofa and the wall). This limits D4C's ability but not by much since he has gotten caught between water and the bottom of the ocean as a method of using his ability before.

Valentine mostly uses an American Flag as his signature, and to active D4C's ability. He also has scars on his back resembling the old American Flag, as a result from him being tortured as a soldier.!~

name: Diego Brando
description:
Diego Brando (usually called "Dio" for short) is a famous professional jockey from England. He is one of the participants in the Steel Ball Run race. Although unrelated to his [__Dio__](https://anilist.co/character/4004/Brando-Dio) counterpart directly (parts 1-6 and 7-9 take place in two distinct, separate universes), he appears to be very similar to the original Dio in both looks and personality. 

~!He was raised among a group of homeless people after his mother saved him from drowning in a river when he was still a baby. He was later adopted into nobility when his talent as a jockey was discovered. Although he was raised with much love, he acts cold-hearted and will do virtually anything to win.!~

name: Lucy Steel
description:
Lucy Steel is the wife of [Steven Steel](https://anilist.co/character/23652/Steel-Steven), the organizer of the Steel Ball Run race. Lucy is a kind, intelligent, and gentle girl who is extremely loyal to her husband. Although she appears nervous and meek, Lucy is incredibly courageous, resourceful, and determined.

~!Lucy's involvement with the story truly begins when [Funny Valentine](https://anilist.co/character/20147/Valentine-Funny) is introduced. Lucy finds out that Funny Valentine plans to gather the bones of "The Saint" for his own needs and also kill Steven Steel. Lucy goes to great lengths to prevent this from happening.!~

~!Later on, Lucy teams up with [Hot Pants](https://anilist.co/character/23650/Hot-Pants) to steal back the heart of Jesus's corpse from the president. Lucy disguises herself as the president's wife, but she is captured by Valentine, and is chosen by the corpse to be its user. This turns Lucy into an artificial Stand user that allows her to use its "holy field" ability that Valentine plans to use to become the leader of the world.!~

name: Hot Pants
description:
Hot Pants is a participant in the Steel Ball Run race. Her stand is Cream Starter.

~!She is later revealed to be a nun who was sent to the race in disguise by the Kingdom of Naples and the Vatican in order to collect the saint corpse parts.!~

name: Sandman
description:
Sandman is a participant in the Steel Ball Run race from a Native American tribe. Despite being ostracized, he hopes that winning the race will earn him the money to buy back his ancestor's land, and he quickly becomes one of the fiercest competitors in the race thanks to his running technique.

~!Sandman is a Stand User who wields In a Silent Way in battle, which can store sounds in objects or even people.!~

name: Pocoloco
description: A young man who participates in the Steel Ball Run race,  known for his incredible luck due to his stand's power.

name: Mountain Tim
description:
Working as a cowboy and bounty hunter, Mountain Tim is announced as a leading competitor in the Steel Ball Run. During the first stages of the race, Tim becomes one of Johnny and Gyro's allies. ~!He is also a Stand User and shifts through his lasso thanks to his stand, Oh! Lonesome Me.!~

Mountain Tim is a man of average to above-average height and average build. Handsome and light-haired, he later acquires a scar crossing his face.
He wears a stereotypical range of cowboy attire; his hat has a zebra print, while the clothing on his upper torso, his belt gun holster, and his scarf have a leopard print. He wears a sheriff's badge in the shape of a five-pointed star on his left side.

~!Oh! Lonesome Me enables Mountain Tim to separate segments of his or others' bodies and freely slide them along a rope. It also grants him superhuman control over the rope, freely and precisely manipulating it to grab small objects from afar for instance.
This ability to separate himself into little pieces as far as the rope goes grants Mountain Tim greater agility and flexibility. Launching himself along it, Tim may shoot enemies from odd angles; and through the process of splitting and joining himself and others back together, he may travel and escape through small spaces.!~

Possessing a mysterious mastery of equestrianism, horses tend to bow their heads in his presence.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

name: Steven Steel
description:
The organizer of the Steel Ball Run race, and [Lucy](https://anilist.co/character/23651/Lucy-Steel)'s husband.

~!It's revealed later in the series that Funny Valentine uses Steven's Steel Ball Run race to get the bones of "The Saint" against Steven's will.!~

name: Oyecomova
description:
Oyecomova is a Neapolitan terrorist who participates in the Steel Ball Run. Having heard of Gyro Zeppeli's participation, he seeks revenge on him and attacks Gyro alongside Mountain Tim and Johnny Joestar in the Rocky Mountains.
He stand Boku no Rhythm wo Kiitekure allows Oyecomova to create and attach special time bombs to anything he touches, be it solid objects or even water and smoke. This make his very deadly to approach.

name: Mrs.  Robinson
description: Mrs. Robinson is a minor character in Jojo's Bizarre Adventure: Steel Ball Run. He is a racer in the Steel Ball Run race.

name: L. A. Boom Boom
description: L.A. Boom Boom is a minor antagonist in Steel Ball Run and the youngest member of the Boom Boom Family along with his father [Benjamin](https://anilist.co/character/172184/Boom-Boom-Benjamin) and his older brother [Andre](https://anilist.co/character/172166/Boom-Boom-Andre).

name: Andre Boom Boom
description:
Andre Boom Boom is a minor antagonist from Part VII: Steel Ball Run and part of the Boom Boom Family.

Andre appears as a boy in his early twenties and his most peculiar physical character are the freckles that cover his face. He has the odd abilities to make his nostrils flat and put his whole ear in his ear hole.

Just like the other members of the family, Andre does not seem completely sane, but he shows a little more intelligence than his younger brother.

name: Benjamin  Boom Boom
description: Benjamin Boom Boom is a minor antagonist from Part VII: Steel Ball Run and the leader of the Boomboom Family and father of [L. A.](https://anilist.co/character/172175/Boom-Boom-L-A) and [Andre](https://anilist.co/character/172166/Boom-Boom-Andre). He is one of the racers of the Steel Ball Run and one of the first Stand Users to be featured in Part VII.

name: Maomao
description:
Maomao works as an apothecary in the red light district, helping her mentor and father [Luomen](https://anilist.co/character/261968) in caring for its residents, with special attention given to the Verdigris Hall brothel, where she was born and was initially raised.

One day, while gathering herbs, she gets kidnapped and sold to be a common servant in the inner court of the imperial palace, where only the Emperor's consorts and their servants reside. Not allowed to leave, her curious personality and skills begin to rope her into mysterious problems that can affect the whole country.

~! It was later revealed that Loumen was actually her adoptive father. Her biological father is [Lakan](https://anilist.co/character/232926), the tactician in the Li military. Loumen is actually Maomao's biological great-uncle. Her biological mother is [Fengxian](https://anilist.co/character/274191), who was a high ranking courtesan at the Verdigris House. !~

name: Jinshi
description: Jinshi is the eunuch in charge of the affairs of the inner palace. He is described as having a face capable even of outshining the consorts in beauty, amazing women and men alike. He is constantly accompanied by his attendant [Gaoshun](https://anilist.co/character/244317/Gaoshun) and has taken an interest to [Maomao](https://anilist.co/character/126824/Maomao)'s intelligence and active demeanor.

name: Rouran
description: The (new) Pure consort, residing in the Garnet Palace within the inner court. She makes a big show of her exorbitant and ever changing clothing, jewellery and make up. Despite that, she doesn't talk any more than she needs to, keeping her distance.

name: Gyokuyou
description:
The Noble consort, residing in the Jade Palace within the inner court. Her red hair and green eyes distinguish her from the other consorts, that being part of the reasons she became the Emperor's favoured consort, having already given birth to a girl of his. Despite these circumstances, she is very careful of whom she keeps around so she has the smallest retinue of all the high consorts.

~! Later on, she gives birth to a boy, the new heir to the crown, thus becoming the Empress. !~

name: Gaoshun
description: Gaoshun is [Jinshi](https://anilist.co/character/127278/Jinshi)'s attendant. He's shown to be extremely dependable. A stern believer in deference to authority and proper etiquette, his disapproval is often splattered in his transparent facial expressions, even if he says nothing.

name: Rifa
description: The Able consort, residing in the Crystal Palace within the inner court. The second most favoured consort of the Emperor, said to be so in big part due to her voluptuous chest. She gave birth to a boy who succumbed for unknown reasons and she herself is in grave health condition at the start of the story.

name: Lakan
description:
Lakan is a renowned strategist known for his nonchalant disregard of proper manners. His plotting ability causes fear even in the Emperor himself. He sees people's faces as a piece of shogi representing their worth, with a few exceptions like the woman he loved and his daughter. Currently heads the La clan.

~!He is [Maomao](https://anilist.co/character/126824/Maomao)'s biological father and the nephew of [Luomen](https://anilist.co/character/261968/Ruomen)!~

name: Aaduo
description:
The Pure consort, residing in the Garner Palace within the inner court. She was the current Emperor's milk sibling and childhood crush, being just a year older than him. She became the previous Emperor's consort and gave birth to his child at 18, who was stillborn. The ordeal made her infertile, but circumstances between her and the royal family allowed her to keep her position as a High Consort.

She is very spartan on the outside yet has a motherly side to her.

~!She is Jinshi's real mother!~

name: Xiaolan
description: Xiaolan is a servant in the inner court of the palace. Carefree and easy to please, she looks at her sale to the inner palace as a good thing, since at least she now has proper bedding and meals. She loves gossiping and constantly serves as a source of possibilities for Maomao to brainstorm over.

name: Lihaku
description: Lihaku is a military officer, residing in the outer court of the palace. He's strong and honest, but not exactly brilliant.

name: Pairin
description: Pairin is the oldest of the Three Princesses of Verdigris Hall. She loves men's bodies and dreams of being taken away by a muscular prince.

name: Riishu
description: The Virtuous consort, residing in the Diamond Palace within the inner court. She was sent to be a high consort on the inner court as a young child because her prominent family was aware of the previous Emperor's pedophilic tendencies. When he died, she was allowed to leave as she was never visited by him, but her family arranged for her to return to her high consort position. Due to how young she is, she doesn't get any interest from the current Emperor, commands no respect, nor does she have any influence. She's very naive and gets bullied even by her own attendants.

name: Meimei
description: Meimei is one of the Three Princesses of Verdigris Hall. She started as Fenshen's apprentice and, being somewhat cunning herself, inherited Fenshen's taste for strategy board games. She is the most attached to the brothel and the people within.

name: Ruomen
description: Ruomen is a physician of the Inner Court, a physician in the red-light district, and Maomao's father.

name: Suirei
description: Suirei is a court lady, doing menial tasks in the outer court.

name: Joka
description: Joka is the youngest of the Three Princesses of Verdigris Hall and one of Maomao's adopted sisters.

name: Lahan
description: Lahan is the adopted son of [Lakan](https://anilist.co/character/232926/Lakan) and a number loving eccentric.

name: Fenshen
description:
Fenshen used to be a high ranking courtesan in Verdigris Hall. With a flinty and hard personality, she was unmatched at strategy board games. She fell in love with a man who could challenge her at those, but was later abandoned after bedding him.

~!Her mental condition degraded heavily and she mistreated her baby to the point the other courtesans took Maomao to raise her themselves. Ultimately she contracted syphilis and got bedridden in a backroom of Verdigris.!~

name: Hongniang
description: Lady Gyokuyou's head lady-in-waiting.

name: Yarite Baba
description: Once a high ranking courtesan herself, the Madam is now the runner of the Vergidris Hall.

name: Fuyou
description: A mid-rank consort, princess of a distant land. She became the Emperor's middle consort against her will.

name: Koutei
description: The current Emperor fulfills the role expected of him. He is hated by his mother, the Empress dowager, for being the product of her rape. His most trustworthy relationship is with his brother, who manages small things behind the scenes for him.

name: Lingli
description: Lingli is the baby of high consort Gyokuyou. She's the first child of the current Emperor to survive. She's nicknamed Xiaoling by her mother, meaning Little Bell.

name: Mu-Won Jin
description: The last descendant of the 4th generation leader of the Northern Heavenly Sect, Kwan-Ho Jin. With his supposed death 10 years ago, he reappears as the 5th generation leader of the Northern Heavenly Sect and given the title "The Northern Blade".

name: Ha-Seol Eun
description: Eun Ha-Seol is a mysterious girl who came across Jin Mu-Won after being attacked by a unknown assailant. After recuperating from her injuries, she gradually began to open to Mu-Won while rebuilding her strength and took it upon herself to defend him when the Northern Heavenly Sect was under attack before being rescued by her master, the Witch of the White Night Seo Geum-Hyang.

name: Mu-Sang Seo
description: Seo Mu-Sang is introduced as a member of the Third Mercenary Group dispatched by the Central Heavenly Alliance to keep guard over Jin Mu-Won and served as its Vice Captain and Second in command. He was also the chief strategist of the group.

name: Soo-Cheon Dam
description: Dam Soo-Cheon, commonly known by his epithet Lone Star of the Cerulean Sky, is a martial master and the current family head of the Valley of No Return and a member of the Seven Lesser Heavens. He is the third son of Dam Jeok-Shim, a member of the Nine Skies. He, along with Seo-Moon Hye Ryung and Shim Won-Lee, created the Cerulean Dragon Society in order to allow young martial artists a great voice within the affairs of Murim.

name: Kwan-Ho Jin
description: Known as the 4th generation leader of the Northern Heavenly Sect, Jin Kwan-Ho was unrivaled under the heavens and known by the title "North Wall". After decades of successfully defending the mainlands from the Silent Night, he was ultimately betrayed by his most trusted comrades and The Nine Skies. After giving up his own life with the request to spare his son, Jin Kwan-Ho unknowingly paved a horrible and treacherous path for his son.

name: Hwang-Cheol
description:
Hwang-Cheol is a former warrior of the Northern Heavenly Sect. Self defense is the extent of his martial arts, and as such, he was the weakest warrior in the sect. However, he is unmatched in his devotion and loyalty towards the sect. Even after the dissolution of the sect, he remained loyal to the sect, and by extension, loyal to Jin Mu-Won. After the dissolution of the Northern Heavenly Sect, he worked as a wandering merchant and would do his best to bring supplies for Jin during Jin's adolescent years in the ruined Northern Heavenly Sect, and also helped Jin with supplies during Jin's time, training in the Jeokam mountains.. 

~!Post timeskip, he is seen working as a merchant and bodyguard with the White Dragon Merchant Troupe.!~

name: Dan-Yeop Geum
description: Geum Dan-Yeop is a member of The Silent Night who was orphaned after the destruction of his home, alongside his sister Eun Ha-Seol. His aim is to resurrect the sleeping Silent Night and awaken it to rise up against the Central Heavenly Alliance by kidnapping merchants in the province of Unnam and force Jo Cheon-Woo and his Broken Fist Sect to attack in retaliation.

name: Mu-Seong Yong
description: Leader of the Iron Brigade.

name: Cheon-Woo Jo
description: Former member of the legendary Great Four Of The Northern Heavens and known as Demon Fist. After he colluded with the Nine Skies and betrayed the Northern Heavenly Sect he established the Broken Fist Sect in the Province of Unnam.

name: Jin-Hu Buk
description: Buk Jin-Hu was the 1st Generation Leader of the Northern Heavenly Sect as well the creator of it's legendary martial arts, the Gathering of Ten Thousand Shadows. He was a prominent martial master of his time. He was elected by the Central Heavenly Alliance as the leader of the Northern Heavenly Sect.

name: Bul-Yeong
description: Bul-Yeong is a member of the Shaolin Temple and is a member of the Nine Skies, a group of powerful and untouchable martial masters who ruled over the world of murim.

name: Sa-Won Bi

description: Dam Jeok-Shim also known by his epithet, Awakened Nirvana is a martial master and member of the Nine Skies. He has three sons with three wives. Dam Jeok-Shim is a hedonist and doesn't really care for his sons. His son and successor despises him.

description:
**Height:** 163 cm

She lives in a small town called Itomori. She is a part of her family's shrine and participates in old traditions as a shrine maiden with her younger sister [Yotsuha](https://anilist.co/character/121518/Yotsuha-Miyamizu).

name: Taki Tachibana
description:
~!**Age after timeskip:** 22-23!~

He lives in Tokyo, juggling between his part-time job at an Italian restaurant, his relation with his friends, and his dreams to eventually become an architect.

name: Yukari Yukino
description: The mysterious woman [Takao](https://anilist.co/character/79463/Akizuki-Takao) met one rainy day in the garden. She spends her days with chocolate in one hand and a beer in the other. Their rainy morning meetings begin after she responds to Takao's greeting in classic verse.

name: Miki Okudera
description: A university student, one of Taki's friends and his co-worker at the Italian restaurant "Il Giardino delle Parole". She is a beautiful and fashionable college girl who is popular with the male waiters. She develops closer feelings for Taki when Mitsuha inhabits his body. She is a smoker, which Tsukasa discovers when they spend a night together while accompanying Taki on his search for Mitsuha. .~!At the end of Your Name, Okudera is shown to be wearing a wedding ring although it is never stated who she marries in the film. In an interview, however, Makoto Shinkai revealed that she was engaged with Tsukasa Fujii, as he was also shown with a wedding ring prior to Taki and Okudera's exchange at the end of the film!~

name: Takao Akizuki
description: A 15-year-old in his first year of high school. He hopes to become a shoemaker and practices on the side while he works his part-time job. His family circumstances have given him maturity beyond his years. He skips the first half of school on rainy days to think up new shoe designs in the garden.  (Source: official site)

name: Yotsuha Miyamizu
description: [Mitsuha](https://anilist.co/character/121514/Miyamizu-Mitsuha)'s younger sister, who lives with her and their [grandmother](https://anilist.co/character/121520/Miyamizu-Hitoha). She thinks her sister is somewhat crazy but loves her despite the situation. She participates in creating both kumihimo and kuchikamizake.

name: Hitoha Miyamizu
description: The head of the Miyamizu family and the maternal grandmother of [Mitsuha](https://anilist.co/character/121514/Miyamizu-Mitsuha) and [Yotsuha](https://anilist.co/character/121518/Miyamizu-Yotsuha). Hitoha is a calm and composed woman with a strong love for her family, especially her granddaughters. However, she isn't particularly fond of her [son-in-law](https://anilist.co/character/150755/Miyamizu-Toshiki) since he rejected the Miyamizu shrine and its traditions to pursue a career in politics, calling him "that stupid son".

name: Tsukasa Fujii
description:
A side character in Kimi no Na wa. He is one of Taki Tachibana's closests friends and is often concerned about him whenever Mitsuha Miyamizu embodies him. Despite teasing Taki, he tries to support him as much as he can. 

~!At the end of the movie, he is married to Miki Okudera.!~

name: Violet Evergarden
description:
__Height:__ 161 cm

Violet is described as a very beautiful young woman, being almost doll-like in appearance, with light-blue eyes, a fair complexion, and a slender frame. She is noted for her womanly semblance. She has waist-length golden hair with locks that frame her face. She either has her hair untied, in a low ponytail, or, after becoming a Doll, pulled up into two braided buns with two red ribbons. Due to losing her arms in the war, Violet received maneuverable prosthetic arms made of adamant silver. After the end of the war and on normal occasions, Violet is often seen wearing a white blouse, a green skirt and a pair of heeled brown boots.

~!Growing up as an orphaned child soldier in the army who was treated as a mere tool, Violet was not educated like a regular human being and did not understand human feelings well. She was raised and grew up as a person who had feelings, but couldn't perceive or express them. For this reason, she could be mistaken as emotionless, or apathetic. Even before she was found and taken into the army, she couldn't speak or understand speech, only understanding orders to kill. She did not possess any sense of right or wrong from the start; she didn't understand what could be considered righteous or erroneous. She merely chased after the adults who gave her orders. She followed the idea of "kill or be killed," thus she could kill countless people without feeling guilt or remorse. She did anything that was asked of her and always followed orders, which was a trait from her life as a soldier. Even after the war ended and she was discharged from the military, Violet had a habit of using words back from her life as a soldier; saluting, disliking being defenseless, and doing tasks without taking any breaks. She also continued to think of herself as a "tool" and believed that it would be appropriate to discard her if she can no longer be used as a weapon.!~ 

Violet is also aloof, expressionless and is said to have the attitude and the presence of a doll. Her expressions are mostly deadpan, so it is hard to tell her mood changes. This is why she sometimes has trouble expressing her own feelings and comes off as expressionless, which makes it difficult to get through her, but she will give a smile from time to time. Through her work as a Doll where she helps people write heartfelt letters, she slowly learns about human emotions, leading her to become more skilled at writing letters and conveying her clients' feelings, as well as becoming understanding of others. She is proven to be a good listener and someone who always thinks about other people's happiness.

name: Gilbert Bougainvillea
description:
Gilbert Bougainvillea is a character in the Violet Evergarden series. He is a major in the Leidenschaftlich army who values Violet more than anything, seeing her as a human being rather than a tool.

~!Violet was "given" to Gilbert as a gift to commemorate his promotion, having being promoted to a major in light of his wartime achievements and expectations from his bloodline. Dietfried, not wanting to take care of Violet, pushed this task to his younger brother. Gilbert then decided to enlist her on a militant unit that he had been appointed to take overall command of in his promotion to major. He later received permission to conduct private experiments at the training grounds as to whether Violet could be officially classified as a "weapon."!~

name: Benedict Blue
description: Benedict Blue (ベネディクト・ブルー, Benedikuto Burū?) is a character in the Violet Evergarden series. He is a postman working at the CH Postal Company. He has known Hodgins since before the company's establishment and has had a brusque attitude towards him since he started working there.

name: Cattleya Baudelaire
description: Cattleya Baudelaire is a character in the Violet Evergarden series. Being a figurehead Auto Memories Doll who works for the CH Postal Company, Cattleya never stops being requested and often takes on clients with love troubles. She works alongside [Violet](https://anilist.co/character/90169/Evergarden-Violet) and has been close with [Hodgins](https://anilist.co/character/124799/Hodgins-Claudia) since before the company was established, joining as one of its initial employees.

name: Claudia Hodgins
description:
A former army commander. He founded the CH postal company and serves as president.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Iris Cannary
description:
Iris Cannary is a character in the Violet Evergarden series. A rookie Auto Memories Doll with an unyielding spirit who works at CH Postal Company, Iris admires young working women and is enthusiastic about quickly making a name for herself in the industry.

~!As a child, she became friends with a boy named Emonn Snow and the two were very close. Iris was in love with him, and she had also supposedly convinced herself that her feelings were reciprocated. Because of that, she confessed to him before they graduated school, but he rejected her confession. The emotional pain caused by Emonn's rejection was what caused her to leave her hometown to become an Auto Memories Doll.!~

name: Dietfried Bougainvillea
description:
Dietfried Bougainvillea is a naval captain in the navy and [Gilbert](https://anilist.co/character/124790/)'s older brother. He was the one who found [Violet](https://anilist.co/character/90169/) and made her into Gilbert's "weapon" on his promotion to a major in the army.

(Source: Violet Evergarden wiki)

name: Luculia Marlborough
description:
Luculia is a graduate of the Auto Memories Doll Training School and a novice Auto Memories Doll. Luculia and Violet became friends as fellow classmates at the training school, and she is the one who helped Violet graduate and earn her licence.

She is shown to be a kind and considerate person who is willing to go out of her way to assist others, such as her offering Violet some of her food the first day they met as well as attempting to help her write a letter to Gilbert. Despite a tragic backstory, she is shown to carry a positive attitude and cheerful demeanor when around other people, but tends to be more quiet and solemn when alone. She is expressive and sociable, but she struggles to communicate her own feelings, particularly regarding her brother.

name: Erica Brown
description:
Erica Brown is a character in the Violet Evergarden series. She is an Auto Memories Doll who has been working at the CH Postal Company for a while. She is not good at communicating and isn't confident in her work.

~!Erica is an anime-original character.!~

name: Kaguya Shinomiya
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm

The vice president of the student council of Shuchiin Academy, member of the wealthy Shinomiya family, she is a multi-talented genius who can do anything if she sets her mind to it. Due to the way she was raised, she instinctively looks down on others and thinks of ways to use them for her own benefit. Kaguya rarely interacted with other people before she joined the student council, but that has begun to change. She is an incredibly sheltered girl, resulting in her lacking in several pieces of what might be considered common sense. She still doesn’t understand love very well, and her main objective is to make [Miyuki Shirogane](https://anilist.co/character/121101) fall in love and confess to her.

Later in the series: ~!She confesses her love to Miyuki Shirogane and they start dating.!~

~!In a [Oshi no Ko special chapter](https://anilist.co/manga/153520), it was revealed that she married Miyuki and changed her surname to Kaguya Shirogane!~

name: Chika Fujiwara
description:
The secretary of the Shuchiin Academy student council. She could not be predicted, her thoughts could not be read. A natural disaster who unconsciously threw everything into chaos simply by being present, also known as __Subject F__.

~!In chapter 222 of the manga, Chika reveals that she played piano because she wanted to be perfect, and she becomes a prodigy at the piano. The expectations of her family and her fans rose, forcing her to practice more. She quit piano after [Kaguya](https://anilist.co/character/120649/Shinomiya-Kaguya) told her to just quit if she didn't like the piano. Soon after Chika challenged Kaguya to a game battle and if she won, she would get to become Kaguya's friend. In the end, she becomes Kaguya's first friend.!~

name: Miko Iino
description:
__Height:__ 147 cm (4'7")

She is a freshman at Shuchiin Private Academy and the Auditor of the Student Council. Miko has a strong sense of justice and will correct others on what's right and wrong. Unfortunately, this led to her being bullied, though she still continues to uphold her idea of "right". She idolizes [Chika Fujiwara](https://anilist.co/character/121103), listening to anything she says, even if it's for Chika's enjoyment.

name: Yuu Ishigami
description:
The treasurer of the student council of the Shuchiin Academy. He's extremely valued by [Miyuki](https://anilist.co/character/121101), given that he single-handedly manages all the school's funds. He's also terrified of [Kaguya](https://anilist.co/character/120649), though no one else is sure why that is. Yuu keeps to himself and rarely speaks up, often getting into trouble when he does. He has a depressed outlook on life while having an inferiority complex. In contrast to his attitude, he is willing to help those in need and will sacrifice his pride if need be. Unlike his high school self, he had a much different outlook and demeanor during middle school.

Later in the series: 
~!Ishigami develops a crush on Tsubame that he inadvertently confesses his feelings for her at the school's cultural festival. Ishigami does not realize that his actions were perceived as a confession by the rest of the student body and is therefore oblivious to the implications of having given Tsubame a heart-shaped gift (considered akin to a confession in Shuchiin tradition). After some convincing by Kaguya, Tsubame decides to seriously consider Ishigami's confession, with her original intention being to let him down as gently as possible. It isn't until Ishigami watches Tsubame's performance of the traditional play that gave rise to the aforementioned tradition that he realizes his actions had unintended meaning. Even then, Ishigami's thickheaded nature prevented him from recognizing the full meaning of his actions: a straight confession!~

~!On the day of the third years' graduation ceremony, Tsubame finally has an answer for Ishigami's proposal. Despite Ishigami doing his best to convince Tsubame to accept him, Tsubame ultimately rejects Ishigami. Tsubame promises Ishigami that the two of them will remain friends and Ishigami sees her off with a smile and a gift of flowers. Afterwards, Ishigami breaks into tears, finally learning what heartbreak is like.!~

name: Ai Hayasaka
description:
Ai Hayasaka is a second-year student at Shuchiin Academy and a valet of the Shinomiya family. She is a member of the Hayasaka family, who have served the Shinomiya family for generations, gaining their trust.

Having been personally assigned to enter Shuchiin Academy with her, Ai supports [Kaguya Shinomiya](https://anilist.co/character/120649) in her high school life and has been a part of Kaguya's life for ten years. Because of their close relationship, Ai is one of the few people around to which Kaguya's amiability is not an act.

Even if she demonstrates maturity as a valet, Ai still has the concerns of a young girl, such as caring to be in fashion and going out with friends, even if she does not have much time for herself due to work.

Ai helps Kaguya with the struggles about her feelings for [Shirogane](https://anilist.co/character/121101).

~!She later leaves her job as a maid to Kaguya but still continues her friendship.!~

~!In the Doujin-ban universe, she starts dating and later gets engaged to Shirogane!~

name: Miyuki Shirogane
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm

He is a second year student at Shuchi'in Academy and the president of the student council.

Miyuki is a handsome young man with blond hair and blue eyes. Due to his constant sleep deprivation and nearsightedness, his eyes appear to glare. He usually wears the regular Shuchi'in Academy black male uniform adorned with the Aiguilette, the golden chain-like accessory around his neck. The Aiguilette symbolizes his authority as student council president.

Shirogane is a diligent student who, despite his underprivileged background, climbed his way to the top of his class through hard work and determination. Shirogane holds himself in high regard, consistently working to maintain his perfect image. He is textbook workaholic, enjoying his part-time job and often putting his own health at risk for the sake of his work. Due to his poor background, Shirogane values money greatly and goes to great lengths to not be wasteful, and generally dislikes expensive gifts.

~!Miyuki's mother left his family when he was a child. Miyuki's father's factory was shut down and currently has no stable employment. They live in an apartment that costs ￥50,000 (Approx $450) a month. Due to this grisly past, he has been led to a lifestyle of part time jobs and hard work. He passed the Level 2 Kanji Kentei exam and has passed Grade Pre 1 on Eiken. He has also got second place on the National mock exam.!~

~!Miyuki transferred into Shuchi'in Academy during his first year of high school on a scholarship. His first week was a disappointment in that a great majority of his peers were condescending to him because of transferring in. Miyuki was being recruited to serve as the new student council general affairs officer by the Previous Student Council President and helped clean up a swamp. There, he saw Kaguya Shinomiya saving a girl from drowning. It was at that moment where he was truly charmed by Kaguya. At the advice of fellow student council member [Momo Ryuuju](https://anilist.co/character/212390/Ryuuju-Momo), he adopted the confident genius personality he is shown to have at the story's beginning in order to attract her.!~

Even though he is obviously in love with [Kaguya Shinomiya](https://anilist.co/character/120649/Shinomiya-Kaguya), her wealth and talents greatly intimidates him, leaving him utterly terrified at the idea of confessing to her. He fears that all of his actions will lead Kaguya to look down him, causing him to overthink in many situations. Shirogane has never had a girlfriend and thus is actually quite clueless when it comes to romance, though his dignified demeanor leaves most of the students to think otherwise. Although he excels at studying, Shirogane has proven to be painfully talentless in a variety of other activities, such as sports, singing, dancing and more.

Despite this, Shirogane is unwaveringly kind and virtuous, never putting any of his goals above the well-being of others. He is extremely supportive and generous, willing to help any students with their problems, and will put aside his quest to get Kaguya to confess if it even has a chance of hurting someone else.

description:

name: Kei Shirogane
description:
Kei Shirogane is [Miyuki Shirogane's](https://anilist.co/character/121101) little sister. She attends Shuchiin middle school and is the treasurer for the middle school student council.

She is a hard worker just like her brother and can be very prideful at times. She also inherited his sense of righteousness and hates it when someone doesn't do the right thing in a given situation. Like her brother, she likes helping out those who are in trouble even if it means going out of her way to do it. Since she grew up in a family that places emphasis on saving money, she normally carries coupons and works hard for the things she wants to buy. 

She developed a prickly attitude towards her brother due to his over protectiveness. She's also entered a rebellious phase and due to her pride and she cannot get herself to have a lighthearted conversation with Miyuki, leading into the similar mind games that Miyuki and [Kaguya](https://anilist.co/character/120649) play against each other, but her objective is to talk to Miyuki without making it look like she has a brother complex. She rarely speaks and most of the time it is only when she exchanges formalities at school or when she hurls abuses at her brother.

name: Maki Shijo
description: Maki is a classmate and friend of [Nagisa](https://anilist.co/character/134330). She has short hair styled in short pigtails. She is friends with Nagisa and is secretly jealous of Nagisa's relationship with her boyfriend, as she too liked Kashiwagi's Boyfriend, but could not confess before. As a branch member of the Shinomiya clan, she is [Kaguya](https://anilist.co/character/120649)'s second cousin twice removed so she sometimes refers to Kaguya as "Auntie". [Miyuki](https://anilist.co/character/121101) and [Yuu](https://anilist.co/character/121102/Yuu-Ishigami) observe she acts very tsundere (cold on the outside but wanting to be affectionate), and similar to Kaguya in personality. She declares Yuu and Miyuki as her friends, due to their support in helping her process her failed romance, much to Kaguya's horror

description:
Father of [Miyuki](https://anilist.co/character/121101) and [Kei Shirogane](https://anilist.co/character/126144).

~!His wife left him and their factory shut down leaving him to not have any stable employment.!~

~!He later becomes a youtuber.!~

name: Tsubame Koyasu
description: Tsubame is a third-year student who is vice-captain of the cheer squad and a rhythmic gymnast. She is very popular. She encourages [Yuu](https://anilist.co/character/121102) in the cheering activities.

name: Nagisa Kashiwagi
description: Nagisa is a classmate who occasionally asks [Kaguya](https://anilist.co/character/120649) about what to do in her relationships. [Tsubasa](https://anilist.co/character/134327)'s girlfriend.

name: Kobachi Osaragi
description:
Kobachi is [Miko](https://anilist.co/character/125886)'s classmate with the glasses and a member of the disciplinary committee. She has been looking after Miko for over 10 years.

~!Though she doesn't love him in a romantic way, she has liked Yu Ishigami since middle school. She believes that Tsubame Koyasu is a kind person and is therefore supportive of Ishigami's feelings for Tsubame, despite her friend Miko being in love with Ishigami as well.!~

name: Moeha Fujiwara
description: Moeha is [Chika](https://anilist.co/character/121103)'s little sister who is in junior high. She is the student council vice-president at the junior high. She admires [Miyuki](https://anilist.co/character/121101) as well and hopes to confess someday. She has a habit of voicing dark ideas, which unnerve [Kaguya](https://anilist.co/character/120649) a great deal.

name: Rei Onodera
description: She is a supporting character in the series. She was a member of Shuchi'in's Red Cheer Team and is a classmate of Yu Ishigami and Miko Iino. She is a fairly calm girl under normal circumstances and is fairly open-minded, but when involved with the Cheer Team or the culture festival committee, she becomes far more energetic.

name: Adolphe Pescarolo
description:
The Principal of Shuchi'in Academy
He's strict regarding school regulations, but knows how to garner the favor of students nonetheless. He helped Yu Ishigami get enrolled to Shuchi'in despite not finishing his task of making an apology letter. Despite being an authority figure within the school, he has shown comical disregard for school rules and discipline when it comes to his own actions, having been openly caught playing Pokemon Go on more than one occasion on school grounds while chastising nearby students for doing the same.

name: Tsubasa Tanuma
description: He is a student in Shuchi'in highschool and always asks [Miyuki Shirogane](https://anilist.co/character/121101) for advice about love. [Kashiwagi](https://anilist.co/character/134330)'s boyfriend.

name: Kozue Makihara
description: Makkii-senhai is a first-year high school student at Shuchi'in Academy and the president of the Tabletop Gaming Club, As the president of the Tabletop Gaming Club, Kozue loves games. She also has a somewhat sadistic sense of humor, as shown by her cheerfully torturing Miko while gathering audio for their class' event during the culture festival. She is shown to be very intelligent, regularly ranking among the top ten students in the freshman class during the end of semester exams.

name: Pes
description: Pes is the beloved pet dog of [Chika Fujiwara](https://anilist.co/character/121103/Chika-Fujiwara). He is quite a large dog, with golden fur and floppy ears. He has piercing eyes like [the president](https://anilist.co/character/121101/Miyuki-Shirogane)

name: Kazeno
description:
Kazeno is a third year high school student at Shuchi'in Academy and was the captain of the Cheer Club during the Sports Festival.
He is a very energetic and caring person,cheering on his team and giving support to Yu Ishigami.

name: Terashima
description: She's a third-year high school student at Shuchi'in Academy and a member of the Tabletop Gaming Club which Chika Fujiwara is also a part of. Terashima, being demoted from Terako to Gigako, is a pun on metric prefixes

name: Kyoko Ootomo
description: She was [Ishigami](https://anilist.co/character/121102/)'s classmate in their last middle school year. She dated Kou Ogino, who cheated on her without her knowledge.

name: Shouzou Tanuma
description:
Shouzou Tanuma is a world famous heart surgeon and the physician of the Shinomiya family.
He is also Tsubasa's grandfather

name: Lucy
description:
Lucy is a mysterious netrunner from Night City. She is quite introverted and doesn't like to talk much about her past. Although she looks innocent, she won't hesitate to kill a person in a heartbeat if they tick her off. Lucy also considers Night City a prison and dreams of one day leaving it for the moon.

Lucy is a part of [Maine](https://anilist.co/character/284159)'s crew of edgerunners. One of its members, a netrunner named [Kiwi](https://anilist.co/character/284161), is her mentor. She also becomes acquainted with [David](https://anilist.co/character/284158) and takes him on a tour through Night City's criminal underworld, leading the two of them to become partners in Maine's crew.

~!She is Half Polish and Half Japanese!~

name: Rebecca
description: Rebecca is an edgerunner of Night City, and is described as a short, spunky, trigger-happy solo who is always fighting with her brother [Pilar](https://anilist.co/character/284162/Pilar). The two siblings often team up with [Maine](https://anilist.co/character/284159/Maine) and his crew to conduct mercenary jobs.

name: David Martinez
description:
David is a street kid from Arroyo, Santo Domingo in Night City, who is enrolled into Arasaka's educational system at Arasaka Academy. He lives with his mother Gloria in an apartment of Megabuilding H4.

After experiencing a personal tragedy, David has the powerful Sandevistan speedware installed in his body and becomes one of Night City's edgerunners. He also becomes acquainted with [Lucy](https://anilist.co/character/284157/Lucy), who leads him into the city's criminal underworld, and chooses to join the gang of edgerunners she is a part of, led by [Maine](https://anilist.co/character/284159/Maine).

name: Maine
description: Maine used to be a military soldier before he became a mercenary. Now a veteran edgerunner in Night City, Maine dreams of "making it big", although he values his friendships with his crew more than his own glory.

name: Kiwi
description: A member of Maine's crew of mercenaries, Kiwi is an enigmatic and snarky netrunner with a detachable cybernetic jaw. She also acts as a mentor to Lucy.

name: Falco
description: Falco is a Nomad wheelman, and part of Maine's edgerunner crew.

name: Gloria Martinez
description: Both Gloria and her son David live in an apartment of Megabuilding H4 in Santo Domingo, Night City. She is an emergency medical technician (EMT).

name: Dorio
description: Dorio is a veteran edgerunner and Maine's right-hand. She's jacked and strong, but despite her tough exterior, Dorio has a soft side that she only shows to the people she trusts.

name: Pilar
description: Pilar is an edgerunner of Night City, known to be a comical and crude techie who loves to show off. He and his sister, [Rebecca](https://anilist.co/character/284163/Rebecca), often team up with [Maine](https://anilist.co/character/284159/Maine) and his crew to conduct mercenary jobs.

name: Faraday
description: Faraday is a ruthless fixer with ties to Militech and a distinctive optic cyberware that gives him four eyes. He is based in Santo Domingo and often employs Maine to conduct jobs.

name: Maxim Kuznetzov
description: Maxim Kuznetsov is a Solo working as a driver for the Arasaka Corporation

name: Koyuki Hikawa
description:
__Height:__ 152cm (4’11)

Haunted by past relationships, bullying, hostility, family issues, and the weight of her own expectations, she often erects emotional walls—rejecting others before giving them a chance to truly understand her

name: Akine Atagawa
description: [Manatsu Atagawa's](https://anilist.co/character/396044/Manatsu-Atagawa) younger sister. She went to middle school with [Yuki Azumi](https://anilist.co/character/394746/Yuki-Azumi).

name: Yuki Azumi
description: [Miki's](https://anilist.co/character/354442/Miki-Azumi) younger brother.

name: Tsubasa Igarashi
description: [Koyuki's](https://anilist.co/character/354440/Koyuki-Hikawa) ex-boyfriend from middle school, who she is on bad terms with.

name: Manatsu Atagawa
description: One of [Miki](https://anilist.co/character/354442/Miki-Azumi) and [Koyuki's](https://anilist.co/character/354440/Koyuki-Hikawa) teammates from the basketball team in middle school.

name: Noriko-sensei
description: The school nurse.

name: Nagisa Amamiya
description: [Minato's](https://anilist.co/character/354441/Minato-Amamiya) sister.

name: Miharu
description: One of Koyuki and Miki's friends from middle school.

name: Mari
description: One of [Miki's](https://anilist.co/character/354442/Miki-Azumi) classmates and friends from high school.

name: Muko
description: One of [Miki's](https://anilist.co/character/354442/Miki-Azumi) classmates and friends from high school.

name: Mei
description: One of [Miki's](https://anilist.co/character/354442/Miki-Azumi) classmates and friends from high school.

name: Tatsu
description: A boy who would tease Koyuki in middle school.

name: Asuka Langley Souryuu
description:
__Height:__ 155 cm (5'1")

Asuka is the Second Child ('Second Children' in the Japanese versions of NGE), who pilots Evangelion Unit 02. She is from Germany, but her nationality is American. She has an American father and a half-German, half-Japanese mother. In the Rebuild of Evangelion series of movies, her name is changed to Asuka Langley Shikinami. 

~!Her mother, Kyoko Zeppelin Souryuu, went insane after an Eva-related experiment and began to believe that a doll that resembled Asuka was, in fact, her daughter, to the point that she refused to acknowledge the real Asuka. Kyoko Zeppelin Souryuu committed suicide on the very day that Asuka was chosen to become an Eva pilot. On that day, Asuka promised herself that she would never cry again. This event gives her an innate hatred of dolls and all things that she perceives to be doll-like, especially Rei. Despite those feelings, Asuka shows no hesitation when required to cooperate with Rei when necessary, proving her to be committed and professional regarding her duties as an Eva pilot.!~

~!Asuka's father later remarried a woman for whom Asuka feels no affection. Asuka feels the need to verbally and sometimes physically lash out at everyone around her, except to her unrequited crush, Kaji, who is Misato's ex-boyfriend and more than twice Asuka's age. On her better days, however, she can be quite cheerful and friendly.!~

~!Like Shinji, Asuka also has difficulty being close to people, except unlike Shinji, who shells himself, Asuka's coping mechanism is over-aggressiveness and so she unintentionally hurts people she likes, pushing them away and thus sinking further into loneliness and self resentment. This issue is referred to as the "hedgehog's dilemma" and is a recurring motif in the story.!~

name: Rei Ayanami
description:
**Height:** 149 cm (4'11")
~!Source of genetic material: Yui Ikari and Lilith, the Second Angel.!~  

Ayanami is the First Child and the pilot of Evangelion Unit 00. She is shown to be socially withdrawn and hardly interacts with anyone. Rei's cool, silent and emotionally-stunted personality has garnered the scorn of her schoolmates; [Asuka](https://anilist.co/character/94/Souryuu-Asuka-Langley) calls her a "doll" or "puppet".

Although she once only associated with [Gendou](https://anilist.co/character/1257/Ikari-Gendou), she and [Shinji](https://anilist.co/character/89/Ikari-Shinji) break the ice after the battle against Ramiel and grow progressively closer for a while. In the manga version, Rei grows a lot closer to Shinji than in the anime.  

~!Clones of her, which lack souls, are kept hidden under the NERV building to be the supposed "cores" of the Dummy Plugs. !~ 

~!It is hinted that Rei died twice; in the series, this stems from the fact that Rei herself says "I think I'm the third one," shortly after her death when Unit 00 self-destructed, an event that she could not remember. The first Rei is shown to have died as a small girl at the hands of Dr. Naoko Akagi for revealing carelessly (or perhaps in an intentional set-up by Gendo Ikari) to Naoko that Gendo called her a "useless old hag." The explanation is that her soul and most of her memories are transferred to one of the clones every time she dies, which then takes the preceding Rei's place as if she had not died at all. !~

name: Shinji Ikari
description:
__Height:__ 155 cm (5'1")

Shinji Ikari is the Third Child ('Third Children' in Japanese), who pilots Unit 01. He is the son of [Gendo](https://anilist.co/character/1257) and the late [Yui Ikari](https://anilist.co/character/1258). Abandoned by his father, Gendo, when he was a toddler, Shinji often ran away from difficult situations. As a pilot, he panics easily and reacts very poorly to unexpected events. 

~!Over time and with encouragement from Misato, he learns to be less cowardly, more outspoken, and more confident, but his progress is all undone when he is forced to kill the only person who ever openly expressed love toward him. His only friends are Toji and Kensuke, but he apparently cares about Rei more than even he realizes.!~

name: Misato Katsuragi
description:
__Height:__ 163 cm (5'4)

Misato Katsuragi is the chief operations officer at NERV, initially holding the rank of Captain (with a later promotion to Major). She is the field commander for the Eva pilots, issuing orders and giving battle strategies. She also acts as [Shinji](https://anilist.co/character/89) and [Asuka's](https://anilist.co/character/94) guardian, letting them live in her apartment rather than have them living alone. While she is professional and diligent in her duties, she is a slob and a drunkard while off-duty. 

~!She is the only survivor of the Katsuragi Expedition, the scientific study led by her father which triggered the Second Impact; the cross pendant she wears was given to her by her father just before his death.  She and [Ryouji Kaji](https://anilist.co/character/1260) were lovers during college, and slowly rekindle their romance over the course of the series. She was also friends with [Ritsuko Akagi](https://anilist.co/character/1251) in college, but their relationship unravels as she learns more about the ultimate goals of NERV and SEELE.!~

name: Kaworu Nagisa
description: ~!Kaworu Nagisa is both the 17th Angel and the Fifth Child. Although classified as an Angel, Kaworu is similar to Rei Ayanami in being a Seed of Life that inhabits a human body. Despite his human form, Kaworu does not consider himself to be human, since he refers to humans as "the Lilin".!~

name: Pen Pen
description: Pen Pen is a hot-spring penguin who lives with [Misato Katsuragi](https://anilist.co/character/1259/Katsuragi-Misato) as her pet. He lives in a refrigerator and is a source of company and comfort to Misato, who has problems of her own.

name: Mari Makinami Illustrious
description:
Mari Makinami Illustrious is an Evangelion pilot introduced into the franchise during the second installment of the four part theatrical remake series, Rebuild of Evangelion. 

Little is known about her as of yet except that she is the pilot of the Provisional Evangelion Unit-05 which differs from previous incarnations drastically featuring four mechanical "legs" that end in wheels and a lack of hands which have been replaced with a jousting lance and "claw". Because of it's unique design, Mari pilots her Eva wearing a helmet-like contraption and her plugsuit is equipped with several attachments that connect to tubing that apparently help her in moving the Evangelion. 

Mari is probably the most content with being an Eva pilot. She is also shown to be more informed than the other pilots, knowing various backdoors into both Nerv and the Eva operational programs and access Eva abilities known to only the higher-up staff of Nerv. Mari also revels in piloting Eva, usually singing over the comm-radio before excitedly engaging an Angel in combat.

name: Ryouji Kaji
description:
Kaji, while only being a special inspector, secretly works for SEELE investigating NERV's true intentions. During college, he had a serious relationship with [Misato](https://anilist.co/character/1259/Katsuragi-Misato), but after having long broken up, they see each other again on the UN fleet ferrying Unit 02 and its pilot, [Asuka Langley Soryu](https://anilist.co/character/94/Souryuu-Asuka-Langley), to Japan. 

~!After he returns to NERV headquarters, Kaji and Misato rekindle their romance following a period of teasing and insults, when Misato confesses that she broke up with him because she realized that Kaji reminded her of her father. He is eventually shot by an unnamed assailant, described as "a third party working either for SEELE or for NERV's Intelligence Division" in the episode Film-book. In the manga, it is Commander Ikari who personally kills Kaji.!~

name: Ritsuko Akagi
description:
Ritsuko Akagi is NERV's head scientist and is heavily involved in the repairs and maintenance of Tokyo-3's defenses against the Angels, particularly the Evas.  She is the daughter of [Naoko Akagi](https://anilist.co/character/19207/Akagi-Naoko), the developer of the MAGI supercomputer system which controls Nerv. In many ways, Ritsuko is living in the shadow of her mother, whom she both admires and despises. Naoko was the head scientist working on the Evangelion project before her death, and Ritsuko is continuing the work her mother began with the Evas, as well as continuing the development of the Magi supercomputer system. Flashbacks to a teenaged Ritsuko reveal that she is a natural brunette, just like her mother.

Ritsuko is extremely intelligent, with a strong dedication to her work and a stoic, detached attitude which is frequently contrasted against [Misato Katsuragi](https://anilist.co/character/1259/Katsuragi-Misato)'s hot-headness, especially during Eva combat. Her occasional jibes at Misato are a source of comic relief in the series. She has a great affinity for cats, and Misato chides her at one point for substituting her cats for human affection. She also is a heavy smoker, as evidenced by an ashtray on her desk filled with cigarette butts stained by her lipstick.

name: Gendou Ikari
description:
Gendou Ikari is the commander of NERV. He is responsible for the research done on the Evas, [Rei Ayanami](https://anilist.co/character/86), and the Human Instrumentality Project. He is the father of the Third Children, [Shinji Ikari](https://anilist.co/character/89), and the guardian of Rei. His original surname was Rokubungi, but he changed it to Ikari following his marriage to [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/1258). At the start of the series, he is the only person having an effective connection to Rei. As the series progresses, his unscrupulous past is revealed, as is the intensity with which he loved Yui.

~!In the original series, his maiden name is Rokubungi.!~

name: Kensuke Aida
description:
Kensuke Aida is an otaku, a military buff, Toji's best friend, and one of the "Other Children," Eva pilot candidates in the same class as Shinji, Toji, Rei, Asuka, and Hikari. His hobbies include camping in the mountains surrounding Tokyo-3 and playing at simulated war reenacting - by himself. Kensuke solidifies his friendship with Shinji after Shinji saves him and Toji during the fight against the fourth Angel, Shamshel. Kensuke dreams of becoming an Eva pilot and ceaselessly begs Shinji to pull strings in NERV so he can be selected as a pilot, despite Shinji telling him that he has no say in the matter. He also seems oblivious to the intense physical and psychological duress endured by Eva pilots. Nevertheless, Kensuke enjoys the privileges of being the friend of an Eva pilot; he and Toji accompany Shinji on the excursion to the UN combined naval fleet during the transportation of Unit 02. Like presumably every one of Shinji's classmates, Kensuke's mother is deceased. Like Toji, Kensuke has a crush on Misato Katsuragi. He is rarely seen without his camcorder at hand.

_Kensuke is named after a main character in the novel The Fascism of Love and Fantasies (Ai to Gensou no Fascism) by Ryu Murakami. He is also similar in appearance to the character Jean, from Hideaki Anno's earlier anime Nadia: The Secret of Blue Water._

name: Touji Suzuhara
description:
Toji is a tough boy, the stereotypical "jock," and is in constant conflict with Asuka. His younger sister was injured in the battle between the third Angel, Sachiel, and Unit 01, and he beats Shinji up soon after for being indirectly responsible. However, after witnessing firsthand the suffering Shinji experiences piloting Unit 01 in the battle against Shamshel, Toji comes to respect Shinji and the two eventually become friends.

~!Toji Suzuhara is the Fourth Child.!~

~!Toji's Eva, Unit 03, is taken over by the thirteenth Angel, Bardiel, and is eventually destroyed by Unit 01, which was under the control of the Dummy Plug system. He is severely injured when his Entry Plug is crushed; in the manga, he is killed.!~

In 3.0+1.0 of the rebuild series, ~!he is a doctor residing in Village 3 and is married to [Hikari Horaki](https://anilist.co/character/1254/), with a daughter.!~

_Toji is named after one of the main characters in the novel The Fascism of Love and Fantasy (Ai to Gensou no Fascism) by Ryu Murakami._

name: Maya Ibuki
description:
Maya Ibuki is a First Lieutenant at NERV and a computer technician who works primarily with [Ritsuko Akagi](https://anilist.co/character/1251/Akagi-Ritsuko). Her main role during the fights with the Angels is to constantly monitor the Eva pilots’ synchronization ratios and send various emergency commands to the Evangelions as ordered by [Misato](https://anilist.co/character/1259/Katsuragi-Misato) or [Gendo](https://anilist.co/character/1257/Ikari-Gendou).

In spite of her profession, Maya despises violence of any sort, and is frequently shown becoming nauseous and averting her eyes during battles with the Angels. Notably, in The End of Evangelion, Maya is the only NERV officer who is shown refusing to fight back against the JSSDF invaders. She rejects the gun Shigeru hands her to defend herself saying "I can't shoot this thing", not because she is unskilled, but because she has never shot it at a human being.

name: Kohzou Fuyutsuki
description: Kozo Fuyutsuki is second-in-command of NERV HQ and Gendo Ikari's right hand man. As Deputy Commander of NERV, Fuyutsuki frequently takes command of situations at the base whenever Gendo is away on business. Gendo also tends to unload the more mundane work, such as town council meetings, paperwork, and the like, onto Fuyutsuki.

name: Hikari Horaki
description:
Hikari Horaki is the class representative of the class that Shinji and the other Eva pilots attend. Like all of her classmates, she is an unknowing Eva pilot candidate. She has a by-the-book demeanor and takes her responsibilities as "class rep" seriously. Although she frequently bickers with Toji, she reveals to Asuka that she has an enormous crush on Toji but is unable to openly express her feelings to him. She also appears to be Asuka's only friend. After the battle with Arael, Asuka seeks out Hikari and stays with her for an unspecified time. During a late evening she reveals her inner insecurities to Hikari, a testament to their friendship; however, Hikari appears saddened by the hateful words Asuka uses.

Hikari is an accomplished cook who appears to take care of her two sisters, [Nozomi](https://anilist.co/character/244735/) and [Kodama](https://anilist.co/character/244734/). Like presumably every one of Shinji's classmates, Hikari's mother is deceased.

In 3.0+1.0 of the rebuild series, ~!she resides in Village 3 and is married to [Touji Suzuhara](https://anilist.co/character/1262), with [a baby daughter](https://anilist.co/character/245144/). [Her father](https://anilist.co/character/245145/) lives with them.!~

_Hikari is named after a character in the novel The Fascism of Love and Fantasies (Ai to Gensou no Fascism) by Ryu Murakami. Her name, and that of her unseen younger sister, Nozomi, and elder sister, Kodama, is also in reference to the names of the trains of the Tokaido Shinkansen line._

name: Shigeru Aoba
description: Shigeru Aoba is First Lieutenant at NERV and a computer technician. At times a stereotypical metal head, he is a nihilist and plays guitar (he can also sometimes be seen strumming an air guitar).  ~!In his implementation sequence, Lilith forces her way through his AT Field by bombarding him with a wall of Reis in which he screams in fear. She supposedly takes this tactic with his implementation because there is no one he loves or trusts enough to let his guard down, suggesting a possible layer of solitude and bitterness behind his cynical persona.!~ Again, his character is not explored in depth within the series.  (Source: afufu.net)

name: Makoto Hyuuga
description: Makoto Hyuga is First Lieutenant at NERV and a computer technician. He is something of a nerd, reading manga while on his break time, but is a hard worker, nonetheless. He also appears to harbor a deep crush for Misato, as Lilith approaches him during his implementation in the form of Misato.

name: Sakura Suzuhara
description: The younger sister of Touji Suzuhara.

name: Midori Kitakami
description: She is a member of the WILLE organization.

name: R. Kaji
description: ~! Misato and Ryouji's child. He has the same name as his father. He doesn't know anything about his parents.!~

name: Sonohokasei
description: This character page is set to represent and list credits for voice roles without a specific character name/role attributed. Character roles named specifically should be added separately.

name: Matsukata
description: A pregnant resident of Village 3.

name: Tsubame
description: ~!Daughter of [Touji Suzuhara](https://anilist.co/character/1262/) and [Hikari Horaki](https://anilist.co/character/1254/).!~

name: Hachiman Hikigaya
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5'9")

Hachiman is an isolated, friendless boy who is pragmatic to a fault. His most prominent feature is his set of "dead fish-eyes." He firmly believes that "youth" is simply an illusion created by hypocrites, for hypocrites, born from the ashes of past failures. In this state of apparent corruption, he is coerced into joining the Service Club by his futures advisor in the hopes that exposing him to the world will change his personality, and ultimately make him a "better person." He is called "Hikki" affectionately by [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/67069).

name: Yukino Yukinoshita
description:
Yukino is the leader of the Service Club, of which she is the sole member until [Hachiman](https://anilist.co/character/67065) joins her. She is smart, beautiful, and is nicknamed the "Ice-cold Beauty" for her icy demeanor. She has a twisted sense of "noblesse oblige", and believes that it is the duty of the exceptional (in other words, herself) to help the "lost lambs" of the world. Her personality often leads her to be disgusted at the naivete of others, particularly [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/67069)'s, and she does not hesitate to show it. Despite this, Yui still affectionally calls her "Yukinon." She is a student of Class 2J (The academic standards of Class J are 2 to 3 points higher than the regular classes on the bell curve.)

~!It was later revealed that her father is a member of the National Diet (a legislator in Japan's parliament). Yukino was in the car that hit [Hachiman](https://anilist.co/character/67065).!~  

~!She later confesses to [Hachiman](https://anilist.co/character/67065) and becomes his girlfriend.!~

name: Yui Yuigahama
description:
Yui is a cheerful, outgoing girl who becomes the Service Club's first "customer", asking them to help her bake cookies for "a certain someone". Her problems lie not with her personality, but with her inability to deal with issues by herself. She believes that talent is inborn, and often aspired to be like others until [Yukino](https://anilist.co/character/67067) changed her way of thinking. Following her experience with the Service Club, Yui begins to attend Service Club sessions after school as well, despite Yukino's objections early on.

~!She is the owner of the dog that led to [Hachiman](https://anilist.co/character/67065)'s accident.!~

~!She has feelings for [Hachiman](https://anilist.co/character/67065) which she admits to the members of the Service Club in the final episode of the series.!~

name: Iroha Isshiki
description:
Iroha is a 1st-year student of class 1-C in Sobu High school, introduced in Volume 7.5. Hachiman sees her as a “not cute [Komachi](https://anilist.co/character/67075/Komachi-Hikigaya)” or a “better version of [Sagami](https://anilist.co/character/85283/Minami-Sagami).”

She acts in front of anyone to maintain her “cute appearance” with the image of an innocent girl in order to keep her image well with others, but she is a sly and crafty girl underneath. She shows her true color to [Hachiman](https://anilist.co/character/67065/Hachiman-Hikigaya) and [Tobe](https://anilist.co/character/82543/Kakeru-Tobe), which irritates the former while the latter is unaware of it.

name: Shizuka Hiratsuka
description: Shizuka is [Hachiman](https://anilist.co/character/67065)'s teacher, a language teacher who serves as his futures advisor/counselor. She is aware of Hachiman's supposed "problems", and takes steps to ensure he is freed from them, her first move being to force him into joining the Service Club. However, she appears to have some quirks of her own: she is a young smoker, she is very sensitive about her age, and she is often prone to quoting or copying scenes from popular shounen manga. She also never remembers to knock before entering the Service Club's classroom, much to [Yukino](https://anilist.co/character/67067)'s chagrin.

name: Saika Totsuka
description: Saika is a member of the tennis club who has a feminine appearance, but prefers others to not mistake his gender. He is called "The Prince" by his female classmates. On their first meeting, Saika asks help from [Hachiman](https://anilist.co/character/67065) to join the tennis club, which was brushed off by [Yukino](https://anilist.co/character/67067). Saika then asked the service club to help him improve his tennis skills. He eventually became one of the few people in class 2F who would talk to Hachiman, and often hangs out with Hachiman.

name: Komachi Hikigaya
description: [Hachiman](https://anilist.co/character/67065)'s younger sister who is very different than her brother. She's cheerful and lively and is part of her school's student council.

name: Saki Kawasaki
description: [Hachiman Hikigaya's](https://anilist.co/character/67065/Hikigaya-Hachiman) classmate who seems like a delinquent, but wants to make friends. She cares deeply for her brother as she hid her name and age to work in night-shift part-time jobs in order to pay school fees and reduce her family's load.
