name: Xin Li
description: The hero of the story. A war orphan who aims to become the "World's Greatest General". He later meets Zheng Ying, the future first king that would rule all of China.

name: Lei Qiang
description: A member of a legendary assassin clan called "Chi You" that is exceptional in combat and uses the notorious Dance of Death. She fights with a sword named "Lu Seui".

name: Yi Huan
description:
Yi Huan is a Vice General who serves in Great General Ao Meng's army. In the past, he was a bandit leader with the moniker Yi Huan the Beheader.

His personality is said to be extremely brutal as he has no qualms in killing surrendered soldiers and personally beheaded every person in any city or village he conquered. This is shown in how he sends Wei soldiers, who have been severely tortured, along with bags of eyeballs back to their camp to decrease morale and incite fear.

He always has an arrogant smirk on his face and talks in a crude manner at times. He shows no respect for his foes as he calls Feng Xuan "an old fart" and "trash" before killing him. He is exhibits a sense of humor and sarcasm as in the case when a fellow crew member asked him why he made an unskilled man named Ogiko as 1000-man commander of The Yi Huan army, he replied "Gyahaha cause it's funny obviously."

He also has a cool demeanor and almost never displays any shock no matter how bad the situation is. Yi Huan also shows a very dark side as he toys with Xi Bai Gui by dangling the idea of escape from death if he begged for his life then stabbed him several times after he refused to grovel.

He does exhibits a sense of loyalty exclusive to Ao Meng by holding the rank of Vice General in his army and coming when summoned as demonstrated when Tang Zhang used Ao Meng's name, as he knew that Yi Huan would simply ignore an request for a conversation with him.

name: Zheng Ying
description: The young king of Qin who bears a striking resemblance to Piao. Later becomes Qin Shi Huang.

name: Mu Li
description:
One of the 3 great heavens generals of Zhao.

~!He marries [Yin Hai](https://anilist.co/character/132035/Hai-Yin) later on in the series.!~

name: Liao Diao He
description: He Liao Diao is the last known descendent of the Kyuumei Mountain Tribe, which was destroyed in the war with Yang Duanhe, king of the Qin mountains. As a result of this, she moved to Kokuhi village, a place of outlaws in which she eventually encounters and befriends Ying Zheng and Li Xin. She becomes an expert in blowing poisonous needles using a hollow bamboo stem acquired following the defeat of the assassin Muta by Xin. It is initially assumed by Xin, Zheng and Bi that Diao is a boy, however it is revealed early on that she is a girl after she is wounded in a skirmish with their pursuers. She remains with Xin after they part ways with Zheng and she cares for their home during some of Xin's early campaigns before heading to strategy academy, where she is taught by Shou Hei Kun. Her expertise result in her eventual appointment as lead strategist of the Hi Shin Unit ~!and later the Hi Shin Army!~. One of the most notable displays of her strategic prowess was during the battle of Koku You Hill.

name: Jian Wang
description: General of Qin and the leader of Wang Jian Army. He is also the current head of the Wang Family

name: Tian Meng
description: The son of Meng Wu and a Qin General leading the Gaku Ka army.

name: Teng
description: Teng is Wang Qi's aide and seems to be an army man himself. He is the only one who actually has any idea what Wang Qi's plans are.

name: Chang Ping Jun
description: Chang Ping is one of the Four Pillars of Ryo and the Chancellor of the Right in the Qin court. He is a strategic genius and the Head of Military Affairs under King Zheng Ying of Qin. In the strategist academy, he instructed Mou Ten, Mou Ki, ​and Ten in the ways of strategic warfare.

name: Buwei Lü
description: A merchant who ranked up as Qin's Right Chancellor.   ~!Shortly after he is introduced, it is revealed that he is planning to keep his army in Wei until Zheng Ying dies, then storm Qin's capital of Xianyang, denouncing Jiao Cheng as a tyrant and taking the throne for himself. !~

name: Wu Meng
description: One of the "Four Pillars" of Buwei Lü. Father of Meng Tian and Meng Yi.

name: Ben Wang
description: Ou Hon is a General of Qin and the leader of the Gyoku Hou Army. The heir to the Ou Family's main branch, he is the son of Great General Ou Sen and a relative to the late Great General Ou Ki.

name: Jiao Cheng
description: The half-brother of Zheng Ying.

name: Lin Wa
description: Lin Wa is the current Prime Minister and the leading martial figure of the state of Chu.

name: Chang Wen Jun
description: Chang Wen is the official who later worked his way up to Chancellor of the Left in the Qin state, and is extremely loyal to the king, Zheng Ying. He used to be a warrior of great fame and was skilled with the spear. In the past, he fought alongside Qi Wang and Hyou in the military.

name: Meng Ao
description:
__Status__ :
~!Deceased!~
Marital Status:	Widower
Hair: White
__Relatives__ : 
Mou Bu (Son)
Mou Aki (Daughter)
Mou Ten (Grandson)
Mou Ki (Grandson)
__State__ : Qi (Originated), Qin

Mou Gou "Haku Rou", a Great General and leader of the Mou Gou Army of the State of Qin, was the father of Great General Mou Bu and the grandfather of Mou Ten and Mou Ki.

__Appearance__ :
He was an old man with a large body frame, who had a long beard. 
~!He later lost his left arm to Ren Pa.!~

__Personality__ :
~!He had a relaxed, almost lax personality, as he kept telling his men to take it slow and easy. Mou Gou always had a calm look on his face but was troubled by the insurmountable wall in his life that was the Zhao great general Ren Pa. He was abnormally strict when it comes to his own family. When under pressure, Mou Gou used to dress as a normal foot soldier and find a quiet place somewhere nearby to clear his head.!~

__STATS__
Strength	85 (but strong enough to push back Ren Pa)
Leadership	90
Intelligence	91
Experience	S

(Source: Kingdom wiki)

name: Taihou
description:
The Queen Mother is an extremely beautiful, mature woman who still retains her youthful appearance. She has a mesmerizing look in her eyes and a unique air of sexual sensuality.

In her youth, Bi Ki possessed an innocent and almost naive outlook on her life but after going through the horrible hardships she endured during her days as a hostage in Zhao, she became cold and cruel and since becoming the Queen Mother of the State of Qin she has turned into a vain and conceited person, unable to have feelings of love and compassion. Blaming the birth of her son, Ei Sei, for her misery she bares a deep hatred for him and attempted to kill him by choking the boy to death when he was a child.

name: Bo Zi
description:
Shi Haku is a Great General from the state of Wei. He is a part of the Seven Fire Dragons of Wei who are Great Generals who's abilities are on par of those of the Zhao Three Great Heavens and Qin Six Great Generals. However internal fights occured, and three generals including Shi Haku killed 3 of the other generals, while Go Kei stayed neutral. As a punishment, Shi Haku and the two other generals were in an underground prison for 14 years.

Shi Haku is said to be Wei's best spear wielder. His mastery with the spear is said to be so skilled that he is able to deal grievous blows to the point his enemies are incapable of noticing that they've been struck. It is also said that his skills didn't go rusty but rather he surpassed his form over the last decade despite being incarcerated for 14 years.

(Source: Kingdom Wikia)

name: She Qing
description: Kei Sha was an Instinctual General and Ri Boku's vassal. During king Tou Jou's reign he was considered one of the most important commanders of the Zhao Military. He was known under the moniker "The Silent Hunter".

name: Kai Meng
description:
Gai Mou is an easy going laid-back General who only goes on the battlefield if he finds someone interesting to duel. He is very boastful to the point of even saying lies about his strength.

He also appears to be rather dense often having his lieutenant Jun Sou chiding him on his incompetence. An example of this is shown when he misinterprets Jun Sou's explanation about Shin going as far to assume Shin killed Ou Ki and Kyou. Another example of his simple-minded attitude is when he yelled his name and rank at the Hi Shin Unit in hopes of having a one on one duel with Shin at the risk of giving away his location to everyone (which was ultimately successful). 

Gai Mou is also rather lecherous as seen when he is indulging himself with four girls (claiming to be making up for 14 years of being imprisoned) before clashing with the Hi Shin Unit. He is later seen with them again when he questions Ka Ryo Ten after having some action with his concubines.

Philosophically, he sees Ren Pa and Ou Ki's opinion of war as a struggle of dreams and sentiments as a delusion meant to disguise the slaughter for what it really is. Thus he concludes that war is just a practice where the strong slaughter the weak. With this, Ou Ki and Ren Pa never took his challenges to duel him seriously and would withdraw as he didn't have a reason to fight that was worthy enough for them to consider.

(Source: Kingdom wiki)

name: Yi Liu
description: A palace girl of the state of Qin and Sei Kyou's first wife.

name: Ling Huang
description:
Rei Ou was a part of the Seven Fire Dragons of Wei, whose abilities are on par with those of the Zhao Three Great Heavens and the Six Great Generals of Qin.

At some point, Rei Ou along with Gai Mou sided with Earl Shi in his conflict against Tai Ro Ji, Ben Tou and Shou Sen, the other three Fire Dragons, with Tai Ro Ji being personally responsible for the death of Earl Shi's younger sister. This resulted in the deaths of the opposing Fire Dragons.

As a punishment, Rei Ou and the two other generals were incarcerated in an underground prison for 14 years.

name: Ai Lao
description: Rou Ai was brought to the Royal Harem by [Ryo Fui](https://anilist.co/character/66705/Buwei-L) as a eunuch, but his real role was ~!to be the [Queen Mother](https://anilist.co/character/188824/Bi--Ki)'s pleasure partner.!~ He went on to become king of the state of Ai. He is said to have a penis stiff enough to hold even the wheel of a cart.

name: Qifrey
description:
Qifrey is a witch and [Coco's](https://anilist.co/character/129840/Coco) teacher. He runs an atelier and currently has four disciples.

He is a caring teacher who patiently teaches his students magic. This is especially true for Coco, who has no special abilities as a witch at first but he continues to encourage her until she can draw magic skillfully. He is protective of all his disciples, as seen from how he protects them from being taken by Esheath from the Magic Security Council. However, Qifrey is overly obsessed with his goal to locate the Brimmed Hats, with his gentle attitude oftentimes replaced by a buried hatred he has always hidden. It appears he had a personal agenda against the Brimmed Hats, as well.

~!The reason Qifrey has a grudge towards the Brimmed Hats is that they are responsible for taking away his memories and right eye as a child. He was later locked in a coffin, buried under a tree, and left there to die as it slowly filled with water. Thankfully, people from the Magic Security Council and Sage Beldarut found him and rescued him from his miserable condition, which later on he would become the pupil of Sage Beldarut. Qifrey also went to the Tower of Books in order to find an answer on how to solve the problem of his missing memories and right eye, but for that, he must use forbidden magic, and as such his issue remains unsolved.!~

name: Coco
description:
She is a young girl who becomes an apprentice witch under the witch [Qifrey](https://anilist.co/character/129841/) after her initial accidental use of forbidden magic turned her mother to crystal. She hopes to search the Tower of Books for the book containing the magic, in order to reverse its effects on her mother.

She is quite a dork for magic, with a child-like (even for her age) widen eyed look whenever she sees things that are common for every other witch. The very magic that inspired her was simple magic made by Qifrey's watcher that caused glowstone path to light up.

name: Agott Arkrome
description:
Agott is a witch in training and [Qifrey's](https://anilist.co/character/129841/) student. She belongs to the famous Arkrome house, who have served as librarians at the Tower of Books for generations.

She has a tendency to focus on how much more she still needs to accomplish, leading her to express dissatisfaction with her current progress. Agott suffers from self-esteem issues over being considered merely average and she takes that out on others who she doesn't think either deserves magic or have the talent to do so, which is usually [Coco](https://anilist.co/character/129840/Coco).

name: Richeh
description:
Richeh is a young witch in training and a disciple of [Qifrey](https://anilist.co/character/129841/Qifrey). She wants to keep her magic essentially "pure" and unchanged and resents having to do what others tell her to do. 

Richeh specializes in crystal magic, particularly in creating transparent crystal ribbons. She also excels at drawing small, intricate glyphs, and has been shown to be adept at connecting these together to form magical portal holes. She has a seemingly emotionless and childish personality. She avoids showing much emotion, though others can still notice emotions on her. She is particularly prone to showing that she's angry at people.

name: Olruggio
description:
He is a witch and serves as the Watchful Eye for [Qifrey's](https://anilist.co/character/129841/Qifrey) atelier. He has a gruff way of speaking but his magic is often described as "warm". He has created a lot of magical items, such as the Glowstone Path, the Snugstone and the Searneedle Wand. His specialty is fire-based magic.

He is very caring to the apprentices and gives them things that might be helpful, as well as rushing to Qifrey's aid, but every time someone points out he's acting very nicely, he tries to brush it off as something anyone would do or to his work as watchful eye.

name: Tetia
description:
Tetia is a young witch in training at [Qifrey's](https://anilist.co/character/129841/) Atelier. She loves clouds and dreams of creating the perfect cloud magic.

She's perpetually energetic and has a habit of thanking people for thanking her. Tetia is an extremely upbeat, loving girl that tries to help everyone she knows and keep the mood high. She is also the one who often gets everyone grounded and keeps the mood up by being loving to her friends.

name: Fudemushi
description:
A member of a species called the brushbuddy. A small creature with fur resembling a paintbrush. It possesses a natural instinct to gather wherever it catches the scent of Magic Ink.

Friendly and affectionate, it has grown quite attached to [Coco](https://anilist.co/character/129840/Coco) and the members of the Atelier.

name: Custas
description: He is a young boy with dark skin, dark eyes, and long dark hair. He is occasionally drawn with sharp and noticeable canines. After an incident that left his legs unusable, he also uses a sealchair.

name: Tartah
description: Nolnoa's young assistant in the shop. He suffers from argentosis, a rare sight condition which makes him effectively colorblind and thus initially unable to use magic because certain effects rely on inks differentiated by their color. He becomes a dear friend to [Coco](https://anilist.co/character/129840/Coco), who helps him by teaching him magic with which to circumvent his disability.

name: Euini
description:
He is a nervous apprentice witch studying under Kukrow.

Euini is a very anxious witch who worries about his own abilities and is very aware of his own faults; he confesses that he is most comfortable practicing magic when there isn't an audience watching him. Euini tends to think lowly of himself and that causes him to under-perform in any given situation.

name: Luluci
description: Member of the Knight Moralis.

name: Iguin
description: Iguin is the Brimmed Hat Witch who sold a book of forbidden magic to [Coco](https://anilist.co/character/129840/Coco). Their motivation is somewhat unknown, but it has something to do with Coco. They appear to be incredibly powerful, possessing magic that is beyond the scope of normal witches. Iguin also has incredible agility, being able to jump while casting magic. They rarely appear except to interfere with Coco from the sidelines.

name: Alaira
description: Alaira is a senior witch who lives at the Witch Auditorium. She is friends with [Qifrey](https://anilist.co/character/129841/).

name: Easthies
description:
A member of the Knights Moralis and the leader of a squad of five.

A strict and serious individual, he is pretty stern and does not care about trivial things such as his birthday. Work is his top priority, he is dedicated to his job of enforcing the law and has no interest for his appearance or personal care. He shows himself to be ruthless, ignoring the pleas of others and does not hesitate to take action as a Knight.

name: Dagda
description: Dagda is a traveling minstrel. He appears alongside the boy Coustas who is like a son to him.

name: Riliphin
description:
[Richeh's](https://anilist.co/character/129838/) older brother and an apprentice witch.

Riliphin is a reserved and quiet young man. He has a strong aversion to areas with a large number of people, and prefers quiet places.

name: Utowin
description: Member of the Knights Moralis. He works directly under Easthies.

name: Nolnoa
description: Nolnoa is an old witch who runs a magic shop called The Starry Sword with his grandson Tartah in the town of Kalhn.

name: Galga
description: Galga is a member of the Knights Moralis.

name: Sasaran
description: Sasaran, also known as the "Empty Cloak Witch" and the "very embodiment of forbidden magic" is a mysterious member of the Brimmed Cap Group.

name: Coco no Haha
description: [Coco](https://anilist.co/character/129840/Coco)'s mother is a middle-aged woman who owns her own tailoring shop. She raised Coco by herself after her husband died.

name: Kukrow
description: He is the disparaging teacher of Euini.
