The pinnacle of female heroes, Queen is superior in many ways. She hopes to win the tournament to bring order to the world.

(Source: Official Site)

name: Xingyun Qing
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm

A singer-songwriter blessed with exceptional luck and a natural voice. Lucky Cyan is overwhelmingly popular both as a hero and as a musician.

(Source: Official Site)

name: Mo Sha
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm

A cool-headed hero who completes his mission without uttering a single word. He is loved by his many fans for the silence with which he completes his work and for the chiseled, handsome face behind the mask.

(Source: Official Site)

name: Ling Lin
description:
__Height:__ 180cm

Former employee at an advertising agency in charge of producing commercials for [Nice](https://anilist.co/character/362412) and [Moon](https://anilist.co/character/361972). After being fired from his job, he witnesses Nice's apparent suicide and is found at the scene by [Juan](https://anilist.co/character/361976). She and her men take Ling Lin and begin the process of turning him into the hero Nice.

name: Nice
description: A manifestation of the perfect hero as imagined by the people.

name: Luo Li
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm

A girl in a battle suit jam-packed with all kinds of tricky gadgets. She confronts all her opponents with engineering talent and a strong sense of justice.

(Source: Official Site)

name: Xiaoqiang
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm

Half of a hero duo that's become famous for their mascot-like charm. Once Big Johnny goes berserk, only Little Johnny can stop him.

(Source: Official Site)

name: Cheng Yang
description:
A university student who works part-time as an actor playing E-Soul in a Children's Theater. He dreams of being reunited with E-Soul, who saved his life as a young child.

(Source: Official Site)

name: Yueqing Xiao
description: A Hero belonging to the Treeman Group and Nice's girlfriend.

name: Ahu
description:
__Height:__ 30 cm (35 cm with hat)

An empathic, loyal hero dog that made it into the Top 10 at record speed, Ahu turns gratitude into superpowers.

(Source: Official Site)

name: Nuonuo Wang
description:
A researcher working at the Dim Light Laboratory. Respects Professor Luo Tong. Loli's friend.

~!Daughter of [Mo Sha](https://anilist.co/character/349528).!~

name: Liang Long
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm

An unruly lone wolf known for his superhuman resilience, he eagerly awaits his opportunity to take the title of X with his indomitable fighting spirit.

(Source: Official Site)

name: Pohuai Wang
description: Nice's nemesis. He stands in Nice's way at every opportunity.

name: Juan
description: Nice's manager. She will use any means necessary to gain Trust.

name: Qi Shi
description: 249th ranked Hero. He is plotting to expose Nice's secret.

name: Gulang
description: A villain who relentlessly pursues Firm Man. She scatters homemade picture books in an attempt to lower Firm Man's trust.

name: Qing Xia
description: University classmate of Cheng Yang. She is a kind and cheerful person who is concerned that her younger brother has no friends.

name: Hun Dian
description: A legendary hero who once saved the world from a great disaster. Despite his 34-year career, he has never revealed his true face behind the mask.

name: Chao Shang
description: Son of De Shang and classmate of Cheng Yang. He inherited his father's business acumen and aims to start his own hero business.

name: Budao
description: An indomitable hero who never falls. His trademark is his red scarf.

name: Youzi Xiao
description: Younger brother of Qing Xia. He enjoys going to see E-Soul Hero Shows, but his reviews are harsh.

name: Yan Shu
description: Representative of Mighty Glory (MG). He puts the achievement of his own goals first, and will not hesitate to commit inhumane acts to achieve them.

name: Hazuki Sendai
description:
**Height:** 163 cm (5'4")

A bright, worldly high school girl. She is at the bottom of the highest school caste and stands out in class since she is popular. On the other hand, she is compared to her brilliant sister and doesn't have a place at home. Looks irresponsible but is actually serious.

name: Shiori Miyagi
description:
**Height:** 157 cm (5'2")

The type of high school girl who doesn't talk about herself much and only interacts with her few friends. She isn't at the bottom of the school caste system, but she is at the bottom of the second rank. Is the only child in a father-child household. Her father prioritizes work and doesn't come home often. She doesn't call people over to her house often, usually only Sendai. Truth be told, she's lonely.

name: Osamu Dazai
description:
**Height:** 181 cm (5'11")
**Ability:** No Longer Human

A member of the Armed Detective Agency. He's a suicide enthusiast who searches for a place to die. However, he doesn't like pain, and would prefer a lovers' suicide with a beautiful woman. He's aimless, elusive, nonchalant, and jokes around normally, but, when he is serious, it is clear that he is an insightful and intelligent individual. He loves to annoy his fellow Agency member, [Kunikida](https://anilist.co/character/89200).

~!He was a former Executive of the city's worst underworld organization, the Port Mafia.!~

name: Ranpo Edogawa
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm (5'6")

The great detective of the Armed Detective Agency. He possesses sharp observation skills that are acknowledged by his coworkers, and he settles difficult cases at the request of the police. Because of his self-confidence, his speech is brazen and child-like. His motto is "If you'll have me, everything will be ok!" He likes logical thinking and fantastic tales.

name: Chuuya Nakahara
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3")

Chuuya is a Port Mafia member who detests [Osamu Dazai](https://anilist.co/character/89198) for betraying the mafia and joining the Armed Detective Agency. He's also constantly teased by Dazai what makes him hate Dazai even more. Chuuya is short but he's quick and uses powerful martial arts. 

His ability, "For The Tainted Sorrow," revolves around gravity manipulation, allowing him to manipulate and alter the gravity of anything he touches, keeping it that way until a certain period of time.

name: Ryuunosuke Akutagawa
description:
__Height:__ 172cm (5'8")
__Likes:__ Curios and antiques, tea, figs
__Dislikes:__ Bonsai trees, dogs, baths

"The weak will die. Die, and make way for others."
A member of the notorious "Port Mafia" that operates by the harbor. Akutagawa has a black and white "survival of the fittest" view of the world, claiming that weak people should die and give way to the stronger ones. His ability is called "Rashōmon" (羅生門).

He is not afraid of pain and defeat, if only to hear a word from a "certain person". His ruthless, vicious nature makes him one of the Port Mafia's most dangerous members, feared by both ally and foe. Much of the obedience he receives from subordinates of Black Lizard , and the Mafia in general, largely stems from fear of his short temper and general intolerance of incompetence. 

In chapter 87,
~!it is revealed that Akutagawa doesn't have much time left to live, as he is suffering from a vital lung disease.!~

In chapter 88 of the manga,
~!Akutagawa turns undead, being bitten by Bram Stoker after a fatal blow which results in his death.!~

(Source: Bungou Stray Doys Wiki, Anime News Network)

name: Atsushi Nakajima
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7")
__Ability:__ Beast Beneath the Moonlight

He came to Yokohama after being driven out of a poor orphanage that was attacked by a man-eating tiger. On the verge of starvation, he meets [Dazai](https://anilist.co/character/89198/Dazai-Osamu) and gets a job helping at the detective agency. Because he's never had friends or family and was labeled as "useless," he lacks self-confidence.

name: Lucy Montgomery
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm (5'5")

A member of Ability User Society "Fellowship of The Guild." 

Her ability is known as "Anne of Abyssal Red".

~!She helped [Atsushi](https://anilist.co/character/89197/Nakajima-Atsushi) escape the Guild because they bonded over their past trauma and loneliness.!~

name: Akiko Yosano
description:
__Height:__ 166 cm (5'5")
__Ability:__ Thou Shalt Not Die

A modern woman with a bob cut who's a member of the Armed Detective Agency. Although she's an excellent doctor who is indispensable to the Agency, all members of the the Agency are scared to be placed into her care. It's recommended that you don't use outdated misogynistic expressions in front of her.

name: Fyodor Dostoyevsky
description:
__Ability:__ Crime and Punishment

Head of the underground organization "Rats in the House of the Dead" and part of the terrorist organization "Decay of Angels". He maintains a calm, confident, and arrogant yet polite personality towards others and has shown to be extremely intelligent, cunning, and sinister. He is highly religious and speaks often of the sin of man, especially ability users. According to him, he is anemic.

name: Kyouka Izumi
description:
__Height:__ 148cm (4'10")

A docile young lady who dresses in a kimono, but also a member of Port Mafia. As she holds a killing ability, she was found by the organization and raised as an assassin.

~!She later joins the Armed Detective Agency.!~

name: Doppo Kunikida
description:
__Height:__ 189 cm (6'2")
__Ability:__ The Matchless Poet

A member of the Armed Detective Agency. He carries a notepad with the word "Ideal" written on the cover, and what is written inside are guides for life. He has a straight-laced personality and hates nothing more than schedules going awry. As a partner to the free-spirited [Dazai](https://anilist.co/character/89198/Dazai-Osamu), his troubles never end.

name: Edgar Poe
description:
__Height:__ 182 cm (6'0")
__Ability:__ Black Cat in the Rue Morgue

A member of The Guild who is rarely seen without his pet raccoon, Karl. Poe's ability, Black Cat in the Rue Morgue, can transport someone into a story they're reading.
Poe is portrayed as shy but determined. He spent six years on a plot to defeat Ranpo, showing that he will work hard at something he cares about. He often talks too quietly for others to hear. ~!After the Guild War, he forms a rivalrous friendship with Ranpo, and frequently brings him his works to read after Ranpo said he wants to see them.!~

name: Nikolai Gogol
description:
__Height:__ 184 cm (6’0)
__Ability:__ The Overcoat

Nikolai Gogol is a member of the Decay of Angels. He's a sadist who enjoys putting on a show with his words. He is freakish, vigorous, unrepentant, and quite enigmatic. However, Gogol suggests that his quirky image could or might not be real. The side of him that has no remorse for murdering others is just as genuine as the one who has guilt and is well aware of the unjust and cruel nature of his acts. He joined the Decay of Angels in order to experience what he had always desired: freedom against gravity.

The Overcoat, Gogol's ability, allows him to use his coat to manipulate spaces and what emerges from it. It functions essentially as a portal, capable of relocating and moving anything. He may use this to materialize a pillar or to manifest his hand and pistol in a location unrelated to him. The ability is also applicable to living beings.

name: Yukichi Fukuzawa
description:
__Height:__ 186 cm (6'1")
__Ability:__ All Men Are Equal

The president of the Armed Detective Agency, who manages the hooligans. Although he doesn't often come out, at a critical moment, he triumphantly takes command. Because Yukichi is a man of dignity and status, it seems even the frivolous Ranpo will actually work if he orders it.

name: Kenji Miyazawa
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm (5'2")
__Ability:__ Undefeated by the Rain

A member of the Armed Detective Agency. Before he was scouted, he lived in a rural area without electricity. He knows no suspicion, and will be understanding and considerate no matter who he is talking to. He has a lot of friends who call him "Ken-chan." He likes music, tempura soba, and Mitsuya cider.

name: Sigma
description:
Sigma is a member of the terrorist organization, "Decay of Angels", and owner of the Sky Casino.

His ability is unknown, but stated by Fyodor to be the weakest of the Angels. It may be more support-oriented than combat-oriented because of this.

He is shown to be very kind to his customers and to have a sense of pride and ownership over his casino.

name: Junichirou Tanizaki
description:
__Height:__ 174 cm (5'8.5")
__Ability:__ Light Snow

He is a member of the Armed Detective Agency and the older brother of [Naomi](https://anilist.co/character/89209/Tanizaki-Naomi).

name: Ougai Mori
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm
__Ability:__ Vita Sexualis

Ougai Mori is the boss of the Port Mafia. Ougai is analytical and tactical. He often puts on overdramatic acts but rarely breaks his composure internally. 

He has been shown to be somewhat ruthless and unfaltering when it comes to violence. He hasn't, however, shown any particular enjoyment from killing. His ruthlessness comes from his pragmaticism.

Although he can be intimidating at times and emit a scary formal aura, he is often polite to the point of seeming approachable. He is polite to allies and enemies alike.

name: Tecchou Suehiro
description:
__Ability:__ Plum Blossoms in Snow

Tecchou Suehiro is a Hunting Dogs special unit member with the ability Plum Blossoms in Snow. Tecchou has a considerably more serious demeanor than his companions, yet he still qualifies as an oddball for his strange preferences in food. He takes his duty as a Hunting Dog earnestly and has a deep sense of justice. He despises the notion of torture and is a highly compassionate person.

Tecchou's ability, Plum Blossoms in Snow, lets him enhance the size, shape, and reach of his blade. It is unknown whether he can demonstrate his ability on other weapons. He is said to have the strongest ability in the Hunting Dogs.

name: Michizou Tachihara
description:
__Height:__ 176 cm
__Ability:__ Midwinter Memento

A commander of the Black Lizards, the Port Mafia's squad of hitmen. Though he puts up a tough and violent front, he cares deeply for his friends. Very skilled gunner, especially when dual wielding.

name: Saigiku Jouno
description: Saigiku Jouno is a member of the Hunting Dogs. He possesses the ability "Priceless Tears".

name: Ango Sakaguchi
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm
__Ability:__ Discourse on Decadence 

Port Mafia's former exclusive informant. Works as an assistant counselor at the Special Ability Department at the Ministry of Internal Affairs.

For the most part, Ango is a composed, calm young man, showing more restraint than [Osamu Dazai](https://anilist.co/character/89198/Dazai-Osamu) and more discipline than [Oda Sakunosuke](https://anilist.co/character/120625/Oda-Sakunosuke). Although he values both as genuine friends, he strongly believes that Dazai needs someone to keep him from acting out as much as he does.

name: Bram Stoker
description:
Bram is a vital member of the Decay of Angels.

~!Bram's unnamed ability allows him to convert people into undead Vampires, even if they are on the brink of death.!~

name: Oochi Fukuchi
description:
Oochi Fukuchi is the commander of the Hunting Dogs special units and has the ability Mirror Lion. 

~!However, in reality, he is the leader of the terrorist organization, the Decay of Angels, acting under the alias of Kamui.!~

name: Teruko Ookura
description:
Teruko is vice-commander of the Hunting Dogs special units and has the ability "Gasp of the Soul".
~!Teruko's ability allows her to manipulate the age of anyone she touches.!~

name: Ryuurou Hirotsu
description:
__Height:__ 178cm
__Ability:__ Falling Camellia

Member of Port Mafia, "Black Lizards" Assault Unit Captain. His ability, Falling Camellia, cause things that he touches to fly backward with immense force.

name: Xiaoshi Cheng
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm
__Skills:__ Basketball, Photography

Manager of Time Photography Studio. Rough around the edges, but good at heart. Often acts impulsively. In order to save his studio from going out of business, he works together with [Lu Guang](https://anilist.co/character/218267/Lu-Guang), using their powers to enter photos and fulfill client requests.

He can enter the world inside a photo and possess the photographer's body, temporarily controlling their words and actions.

name: Guang Lu
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm
__Skills:__ Intelligence, Strategizing 
__Dislikes:__ Things being messed up after he's tidied them up, Plans being messed up
__Likes:__ Gourmet Food, Basketball, Reading, Sleeping, Sunbathing

Partner at Time Photography Studio. Calm and rational. Works together with [Cheng Xiaoshi](https://anilist.co/character/218266/Cheng-Xiaoshi) to fulfill client requests by acting as his guide and directing his actions.

He can foresee everything that happens inside a photo within 12 hours of it being taken; can share the consciousness of the person going into the photo through a high five and use this to direct their actions.

name: Ling Qiao
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm

Current landlord of Time Photography Studio. Grew up with Cheng Xiaoshi. Acts as the middleman and picks up commissions for Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang.

name: Fei Xia
description:
__Height:__ 185 cm

A college student studying Applied Physics in Bridon who became a part-time model and quickly became famous.

name: Vein
description:
__Height:__ 187 cm

The head of the Yingdu Chinese Chamber of Commerce. He oversees countless businesses and a talent agency, holding extensive connections and intelligence. Beneath his unrestrained exterior lies a sense of strong principle.

name: Xiao Liu
description:
__Height:__ 183 cm

Liu Xiao is the younger brother of Liu Min and the second son in the Liu family.

He met Li Tianchen by chance when they were both children. Later on, he left to study abroad and finished his studies, returning to China a few months after the events of Liu Min's passing and the Li Tianchen incident. Soon after, he met with Li Tianchen again and stated his plan to "bring more parallel lines together"

name: Tianchen Li
description: Li Tianxi's twin brother

name: Jin Qian
description: Lawyer for Liu Jing and former police officer.

name: Li Xiao
description: A policeman.

name: Qing Wang
description: **Height:** 173 cm

name: Jae Lee
description: Jae Lee claims to be a police officer from Bridon, and came to Guidu to investigate an incident, though he appears to have other motives.

name: Levi
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3")

Squad Captain of the Special Operations Squad (known as Squad Levi) within the Survey Corps. He is known as humanity's strongest soldier. 

Levi is abrasive, blunt, and has a strong respect for structure and discipline. He is a clean-freak, demanding spotless cleanliness of himself, his equipment, and his environment. Rumors say he was involved in underground crime in his life before coming a soldier. Despite his emotionless and unfriendly demeanor, Levi cares deeply for his squad and greatly values human life.

name: Eren Yeager
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7") - 183 cm (6'0")
__Affiliation:__ 104th Trainees Squad, Survey Corps. 

Eren was born to [Carla](https://anilist.co/character/62475/Yeager-Carla) and [Grisha Yeager](https://anilist.co/character/62477/Yeager-Grisha) in Shiganshina District within the southern region of Wall Maria. He grew up in the town with his parents and foster sister [Mikasa](https://anilist.co/character/40881/Ackerman-Mikasa), who moved in with the Yeagers as a child. Eren spent most of his time with Mikasa and their mutual best friend [Armin Arlert](https://anilist.co/character/46494/Arlert-Armin), whom the pair often defended from neighborhood bullies.  

Eren is a passionate, determined, hardheaded, and impulsive young man. When they were children, Armin showed him a book depicting the wonders of the outside world. Eren grew to share Armin's curiosity of the world beyond the Walls and resolved to see it for himself. This dream inspired his admiration of the Survey Corps and his desire to join their ranks as soon as he became eligible for enrollment. 

When the Titans suddenly broke through Wall Maria into Shiganshina, Eren was forced to watch on as his mother became trapped under the rubble of their house and eaten by a titan. Forever changed from this event, Eren vows to kill every last titan.

name: Mikasa Ackerman
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7") - 176 cm (5'9½")
__Position:__ 104th Training Corps, Survey Corps
__Relatives:__ [Birth Mother](https://anilist.co/character/84341/Mikasa-no-Haha) (Deceased), [Birth Father](https://anilist.co/character/84339/Mikasa-no-Chichi) (Deceased), [Grisha Yaeger](https://anilist.co/character/62477/Grisha-Yeager) (Foster Father), [Carla Yaeger](https://anilist.co/character/62475/Carla-Yeager) (Foster Mother, Deceased), [Eren Yeager](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Eren-Yeager) (Foster Brother)

Mikasa is Eren Yaeger's foster sister and mutual childhood friend of [Armin Arlert](https://anilist.co/character/46494), living with the two of them in Shiganshina District within the southern region of Wall Maria. 

When she was young, her parents were killed by human traffickers, and she was kidnapped. Eren discovered this and helped her escape her captors. Later, Eren gave her his scarf, which she constantly wears and shares an emotional attachment to. She was adopted by the Yaeger family soon after. Because of these past events, Mikasa shares an unbreakable bond with Eren and lives to protect him, constantly worrying for Eren's well-being. After the Titans broke through Wall Maria and killed her and Eren's mother, she chose to follow Eren into the military to try and keep him safe from danger. 

Even as a child, Mikasa possessed impressive fighting skill and strength, and that skill was only honed further during her training.  Mikasa is considered a genius among all the army trainees and is incredibly skilled at combat and agility, to the point that she was known as the greatest soldier among the 104th Training Corps and graduated in first place. Though being among the best of the best, she remains humble and refrains from displaying arrogance. Ultimately, Mikasa's loyalty remains with Eren no matter the circumstance, with her only true desire being to live a peaceful life with him.

name: Armin Arlert
description:
__Height:__ 163 cm (5'4")
__Position:__ 104th Trainees Squad, Survey Corps
__Relatives:__ [Grandfather](https://anilist.co/character/84313/Armin-no-Ojiisan)

Armin is a young boy who was born and raised in the Shiganshina District within the walls, being childhood friends with both [Eren Yeager](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Eren-Yeager) and [Mikasa Ackerman](https://anilist.co/character/40881). After Wall Maria was breached, he chose to join Mikasa and Eren in joining the military, both to try to make a good and meaningful impact on the world, and to fulfill his dream of seeing the outside world.

Even when he was young, the naturally curious Armin has always had a deep fascination with the world beyond the Walls. As a child, he found and studied an illegal book about the outside world that was owned by his grandfather. He often shared the book and information contained in it with Eren Yeager, his best friend, and his dreams of seeing the world outside the walls. Armin was branded a heretic by other children for his unusual interest in the outside world and was thus frequently picked on. Too timid to defend himself, Armin would often rely on his friends Eren and Mikasa Ackerman to protect him from local bullies. This, coupled with his frail physique, was a deep shame for Armin, leading him to have poor self-esteem and to believe that he is a burden to others. Because of this, Armin has always been very eager to prove his worth, especially towards his close friends. 

Armin is known to be exceptionally loyal and selfless. He constantly worries for the safety of his friends, and he is always prepared to throw himself into dangerous situations to save them. Alongside his kindhearted nature and emotionally intelligence, Armin is a very analytical person. He likes to think deeply about situations and solve problems using his mind. These personality traits, in conjunction with his intelligence, good judgment, level headedness, ability to plan ahead, come up with creative ideas and to think outside the box, are what make him a great tactician. Although he may appear among the physically weakest of the 104th Training Corps, his incredible intelligence and strategic genius makes him an invaluable asset to any team.

name: Hange Zoe
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7")
__Affiliation:__ Survey Corps; Section Commander, Squad Leader.

Leader of the Survey Corps' Fourth Squad, Hange is also in charge of conducting research on Titans, and pursues this knowledge so passionately that they have become obsessed with Titans as a result. After originally holding a deep hatred for the creatures, Hange decided to take on a new outside-the-box approach to their research by letting go of their resentment towards Titans and approaching the test subjects with compassion. 

Hange is an energetic, freethinking and quirky scientist, with a unique way of conducting both themselves and their work. Hange is a genius outside of just Titan research too, using their brain to create weapons, tactical plans, and inventions for the benefit of humanity. As a leader, Hange is thoughtful of their comrades, and can easily figure out complex problems in order to create plans for their teammates to carry out.

name: Erwin Smith
description:
**Height:** 188 cm
**Position:** 13th Commander, Survey Corps

Discerning, intelligent, and widely respected, Erwin is the unshakable and calculated 13th commander of the Survey Corps. While he cares deeply for his men, he does not hesitate to sacrifice them for the good and prosperity of mankind, and his men have proven more than willing to stake their lives at his order. Erwin developed the Long-Distance Enemy Scouting Formation.

name: Sasha Blouse
description:
__Initial Height:__ 168cm
__Affiliations__: 104th Cadet Corps, Survey Corps; Soldier
__Relatives__: [Artur Blouse](https://anilist.co/character/131281/Artur-Blouse) (Father), [Lisa Blouse](https://anilist.co/character/134952/Lisa-Blouse) (Mother)

Originally from Dauper, a remote and scarcely populated village of hunters located in a mountain forest in the southern area of Wall Rose, Sasha joined the military as a cadet of the 104th Training Corps, where she ranked 9th upon graduation. After graduating, she'd choose to enlist in the Scouting Regiment. 

Sasha is a friendly and fun-loving girl. She speaks with a local accent from her home village, but initially hid it out of embarrassment by using overly formal and polite speech. She is a constant food hoarder and is known to have an incredible appetite; eating provided her with considerable gratification and relief, especially during times of great stress, and food was often the only thing on her mind when at ease. Raised as an animal hunter, Sasha specializes in archery, horseback riding, and tracking, although her eccentricity and unconventional methods tend to make her a poor fit for group operations.

~!She later saves a child named [Kaya](https://anilist.co/character/132738/Kaya) from a titan attack, who her family ends up adopting.!~

name: Reiner Braun
description:
__Height__: 185 cm (6'1")

Member of the Survey Corps and former cadet of the 104th Training Corps. Reiner is a passionate and strong-willed young man with a strong sense of duty. He ranked 2nd in his training class upon graduation, finishing behind only [Mikasa](https://anilist.co/character/40881). His comrades have great trust in him, and he is stated to be the "big brother" of the 104th cadets.

name: Jean Kirstein
description:
__Height__: 175 cm (5'8")
__Relatives__: [Mother](https://anilist.co/character/131444/Jean-no-Haha)

Jean Kirschtein is a graduate of the 104th Cadet Corps, among whom he ranked 6th for his skills with ODM gear and ability to look at things through a more tactical lense. Jean hails from Wall Rose's Trost District, and joined the military with hopes of living a peaceful life within the walls as part of the Military Police. However, he would later find himself joining the Survey Corps after being convinced both by his close friend [Marco Bott's](https://anilist.co/character/62479/Marco-Bott) words, and after witnessing the death of several of his comrades.

Jean has a blunt personality. He holds no restraint when it comes to speaking his mind, even when he knows it would not be wise to do so or when it could spark conflict. Jean is also pragmatic: he has a strong aversion to exposing himself to dangerous situations. During his time as a cadet, Jean was extremely hot-headed, easily becoming frustrated and quick to resort to violence when pushed. Jean was also very cynical about defeating the Titans, believing that humanity has no chance against them and openly mocking more idealistic individuals like [Eren Yeager](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Eren-Yeager), and saw resisting the Titans as a hopeless cause. However, despite these things, and although he presents himself as self-centered, Jean places high value on the lives of his comrades, and is willing to risk his life to prevent countless more deaths from his comrades. Even with his shortcomings, Jean has shown himself to be a natural leader, being able to understand others and assess situations well because of his flaws, and proves capable of leading his fellow soldiers when they are left confused and without a plan.

name: Annie Leonhart
description:
__Height__: 153 cm (5")  

A member of the 104th Southern Division in the Cadet Corps. After graduating from the 104th, ranked 4th place in the top 10, she ends up joining the Military Police. She is roommates with [Hitch Dreyse](https://anilist.co/character/86017).

A stoic girl, Annie is considered to be an isolated, solitary type, being rarely seen smiling or socializing and often having an emotionless expression. She is apathetic and somnolent, with little desire to put in any effort into meaningless disciplines or activities. Nonetheless, what drives Annie more than anything is her desire for a normal life.

name: Krista Lenz
description:
__Height__: 145 cm (4'8")
__Affiliations__: 104th Trainees Squad, Survey Corps

Ranked tenth in the trainee class, Krista is a very shy and kind, caring person, often being described as a "goddess" or "angel" by her peers. She is good friends with [Ymir](https://anilist.co/character/71479/Ymir).

name: Zeke
description:
__Height__: 183 cm

Zeke is the current inheritor of the Beast Titan, and is considered by [Reiner Braun](https://anilist.co/character/46484/Reiner-Braun) to be the strongest Warrior, contrasting [Levi's](https://anilist.co/character/45627/Levi) title of "humanity's strongest soldier".

name: Ymir
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm (5'7")
__Affiliations:__ 104th Trainees Squad, Scouting Legion

Member of the Scouting Legion. She seems selfish, cynical, bossy, sly, uncooperative, exploitative, and confrontational, but she can apparently be kind, especially to [Krista](https://anilist.co/character/62481/Krista-Lenz).

name: Connie Springer
description:
__Height__: 158 cm (5'2")  
__Relatives:__ [Mother](https://anilist.co/character/137287/Conny-no-Haha), Martin Springer (Brother), Sunny Springer (Sister)

Connie Springer is a graduate of the 104th Training Corps, having ranked 8th in class. He is known to be one of the quickest soldiers while using ODM gear and is skilled at making very sharp turns. He hails from the rural Ragako Village within Wall Rose, his greatest ambition being to make his family and village proud of him. Upon graduation, he chose to join the Survey Corps. 

Upbeat and naive, Connie is rather unfocused outside of combat, and enjoys goofing around and messing with his friends, but can also be a bit dense at times, as he can have some difficulty comprehending new developments as they appear. Connie always tries to remain optimistic, consistently caring for the well-being of his friends, family and village, and being willing to help in any way he can. However, this soft spot and the struggles he goes through as a member of the Survey Corps takes a toll on him, as he often responds to grief and loss with anger, irritation and hatred, causing him to at times make rash, impulsive decisions. He will do anything to protect his family, whether it be his biological family or his closest friends.

name: Narrator
description:
This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. 

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

name: Bertolt Hoover
description:
__Height__: 192 cm (6'3")  
__Affiliation__: Survey Corps

Member of the Survey Corps and former cadet of the 104th Training Corps. Bertoldt ranked 3rd in his training class upon graduation, finishing behind only [Mikasa](https://anilist.co/character/40881) and his hometown friend [Reiner](https://anilist.co/character/46484). He is a quiet young man who identifies himself as someone with a weak will that follows popular opinion. Despite ranking 3rd in his class, his training commandant noted him to be a person with great potential, but an utter lack of initiative. Bertoldt originally he enlisted in the military with aspirations of joining the Military Police and living in the safety of the inner wall, but after the Battle of Trost he instead decided to join the Survey Corps.

name: Dot Pixis
description: The highest-ranked Administrator of the Southern Region. Head of the Garrison's Southern Territories, Pixis is a cunning leader with astute insights. However, he is also an alcoholic who is constantly watched over by his aid, [Anka](https://anilist.co/character/84331/Anka-Rheinberger), who constantly scolds him for sleeping and drinking during critical moments.

name: Hitch Dreyse
description:
**Height:** 168 cm
__Affiliations:__ 104th Cadet Corps.

Recruit of the Military Police stationed in Stohess District. She was roommates with [Annie Leonhart](https://anilist.co/character/46490/Annie-Leonhart).

Hitch acts immature in certain ways, she has a sarcastic, easygoing personality and seems to mischievously enjoy teasing and needling her fellow officers, especially [Marlo Freudenberg](https://anilist.co/character/71457/Marlo-Freudenberg). She claims she chose to join the Military Police out of laziness, as it is well known that the senior staff are incredibly corrupt and she wanted to benefit from the system herself; however, she did not take into account that, as a new recruit, her superiors would dump all their work on her. Though she may act a bit air-headed at times, Hitch is not selfish and cares about those around her, especially her fellow comrades.

name: Marco Bott
description:
__Height__: 178 cm (5'9")
__Affiliations__: 104th Training Corps

Originally from Jinae District. Marco ranked 7th in the 104th Training Corps and is widely respected by other cadets of the 104th. Marco is a very kind, calm, and idealistic person, valuing the good of the group above his own interests, as well as understanding and coping with his own shortcomings and limitations. He is seen as a natural leader, and desires to join the Military Police to serve near the King. 

*Note: Marco Bott is the official English translation by Kodansha.*

name: Hannes
description: A soldier who saves Eren and Mikasa during the prologue. He owes a debt to the Yeager family.

name: Carla Yeager
description: Eren's mother.   ~!She's eaten alive in the second chapter.!~ Note: Carla Yeager is the official English translation by Kodansha.

name: Mike Zacharias
description:
Squad Captain of his own squad, Squad Mike, a major division within the Survey Corps. He has been described by others as "humanity's second strongest soldier", being only behind [Levi](https://anilist.co/character/45627/Levi).

Mike is an extremely strong and durable soldier and an acknowledged leader with a brave heart and a tactical mind. He also has a remarkably good sense of smell, which allows him to detect Titans from great distances. During times of ease, Mike is shown to be a quiet and reserved man, rarely speaking unless it concerned a more serious matter. He also has a bizarre habit of "sniffing" people when he meets them.

name: Rico Brzenska
description: The Squad Leader of the 1st Division Elite Force of the Stationary Guard.    ~!She is the sole survivor of the elite squads assigned to protect Eren during the liberation of Trost District. She does not trust Eren and still views him as a traitor.!~

name: Nanaba
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm
__Affiliation:__ Scouting Legion Survey Corps

name: Marlo Freudenberg
description:
__Affiliations:__ Military Police, 104th Cadet Corps.

Recruit of the Military Police stationed in Stohess District.

While most who join the Military Police Regiment do so because they want a safe position far from the danger of the Titans, Marlo did so because he claims to want "to uphold justice and do what's right.", much to the amusement of his fellow officer, [Hitch Dreyse](https://anilist.co/character/86017/Hitch-Dreyse), whom he often clashes with due to them being near complete opposites. His goal is to rise to the top of the organization so he can stop the pilfering of taxes and misappropriation of land. Though steadfast in his idealism, he could make moral compromises to achieve his goal, confessing a willingness to act like "scum" in order to move up in rank. Due to his passion towards his ideals, he had often been compared to [Eren Yeager](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Eren-Yeager) by people who know both of them.

name: Gesicht
description:
He attempts to capture a powerful killer in Germany who is attacking both humans and robots with no apparent motives.

In the original manga, Gesicht's name was Gerhart, and in the 1980's anime his name was Zeron. In Pluto, he along with his wife and the other robots in the story are given a human appearance - contradictory to his prior robot appearances in both the manga and 1980 series.

name: Epsilon
description: Photon-powered advanced robot who dislikes fighting and cares for homeless children. Created for war along with the other advanced ones, but refused to go there because of his pacifistic beliefs.  Arguably the strongest out of the war series, Epsilon uses the Sun itself as his power source, capable of launching various heat and light based attacks, as well as creating photon-shields and manipulating photons. Epsilon is also capable of willingly detaching his own hands and controlling them remotely.

name: Atom
description: Loosely based off of Osamu Tezuka's classic character, "Astro Boy," Atom of the "Pluto" series is a highly developed robot. He is constantly classified as one of the worlds top seven robotic technological advances in science, to the point that even Gesicht's sensors have trouble distinguishing him as a robot or human.  He works with Gesicht in order to help discover the truth behind the recent chain of murders. He has a sister, Uran.

name: North 2-gou
description: A Scottish robot with six mechanical armed arms, formerly one of the most powerful fighting robots during the 39th Central Asian War. He prefers not to fight, choosing instead to work as the butler of a blind renowned composer.

name: Brau-1589
description: Brau-1589 is the first robot to ever kill a human, taking place 8 years before the events of Pluto.

name: Umatarou Tenma
description: Dr. Tenma (which means "Pegasus" or literally "Heaven-horse" in Japanese) was a renowned roboticist and the Japanese Minister of Science. When his nine-year-old son Tobio died in a car accident, he decided to recreate him as the invincible robot "Atom".

name: Pluto
description:
~!Pluto is actually Sahad, a peaceful, quaint, robot with a strong affinity towards nature and who wished to fill his desolated country of Persia full of flowers. He was created by the Persian Minister of Science, Dr. Abullah.

(Source: Astro Boy Wiki)!~

name: Uran
description:
Astro's cybernetic sister in the manga and anime series Astro Boy, as well as its many adaptions. She is a superhuman android with a naive, tomboyish personality.

She is the third robot addition to Astro's family, the first two being his parents. Uran is an extremely mischievous little girl who constantly lands her older brother in trouble. While lacking Astro's weaponry and propulsion systems, she is extremely powerful.

Like Astro, she is fully capable of experiencing human emotions (although she is somewhat immature), by being naughty or disobedient, even annoying.   

__2003 Series:__

Uran reappears in the 2003 series with the name Zoran, with a slightly altered look, including a more appropiate dress in order to appeal to more western audiences. She still retains her tomboyish personality and cheekiness, however is shown to be more adventurous (which instead often puts her in trouble). She is given the ability to communicate with animals and befriends a bird which she names Houdini, however is often jealous of her brother's powers (such as the ability to fly, as well as his popularity).

name: Paul Duncan
description: A Bohemian composer who hired [North No. 2](https://anilist.co/character/141755/North-2gou). He was on the verge of death due to a childhood illness, but he was saved by a surgery performed by [a Japanese doctor](https://anilist.co/character/1344/Kuroo-Hazama). As a result, his vision deteriorated and he became blind. Due to believing that he was abandoned by his mother in the past, he has a stubborn personality and even refers to North No. 2 as a weapon.

name: Ochanomizu Hakase
description: Dr. Ochanomizu, a recurring character in many of Osamu Tezuka's manga, including Astro Boy, can be seen "lecturing" at Narita International Airport, outside of Tokyo, on HIV and safe sex.  Dr. Ochanomizu was most famously seen as the mentor to Astro Boy and the creator of Astro's sister and parents.

name: Dr. Roosevelt
description: A.I created to aid the president of the United States of Thracia.

name: Adolph Haas
description: A simple man who lives with his family in Düsseldorf.~!A member of RK, an anti-robot extremist group.!~~!Vows to kill Gesicht after learning his involvement in his brothers death!~

name: Tawashi
description:
Police Inspector Tawashi (a.k.a. Inspector Gumshoe) is a law enforcer and recurring character in the Tetsuwan Atom mythos. Known for his surly demeanor, Inspector Tawashi is a dedicated officer. And he hates robots.

He is similar to Inspector Geta in that both always appear as police investigators, and both are known for their dedication to their job. However, while Geta is known for his honesty and uprightness, Tawashi is most known for his suspicion of people. He is suspicious not only of Tezuka villains such as Ham Egg and Lamp, or of ambiguous characters such as Rock Holmes, but is even critical and untrusting of such figures as Astro Boy. The series which contains most of his appearances is Astro Boy, but he also has notable appearances in such series as The Amazing Three, Black Jack, Lion Books, Unico, and Rainbow Parakeet.

name: Ash Lynx
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm (5'11")
__Nationality:__ American-Irish

Ash has the personality, charisma, and skill to gather large groups of individuals together under his influence. Not only is he excellent in combat and an incredible marksman, but he's also highly intelligent with an IQ of 200. His intelligence lends itself well to solving the mystery of 'Banana Fish' and he has also been stated to be quite well-read, knowing his way around the newspaper's daily columns and political novels - unusual for someone who did not finish middle school.

Along with his remarkable intelligence, Ash's good looks and charisma allow him to sway the will of people to his benefit in dire situations, and he's well aware of it. Despite the influence he holds over others, however, Ash is mistrustful and holds most people at arms-length except for a few select friends in his inner circle, the most notable being [Eiji Okumura](https://anilist.co/character/21928). He is not afraid of death not because of courage, as he calls himself a coward, but because of his disillusionment with his own life.

name: Eiji Okumura
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm
__Nationality:__ Japanese
__Languages:__ Japanese, English
__Background:__ Eiji was a talented athlete and pole vaulter in Japan, until a injury left him unable to compete. Completely discouraged, faced with losing his sports scholarship, and ridiculed by his former competitors and coaches, Eiji fell into a depressed slump. Then [Ibe](https://anilist.co/character/127039/Ibe-Shunichi) took him in as his assistant, and the two traveled to New York City, to do a report on youth in street gangs. In New York, Eiji met [Ash Lynx](https://anilist.co/character/13580/Lynx-Ash).  

__Best 80's Fashion Statement:__ Hawaiin shirt over a tank top, tied in the front, falling off one shoulder.  

__Inspiration:__ In an interview, author [Akimi Yoshida](https://anilist.co/staff/97082/Yoshida-Akimi) said that the character design for Eiji was inspired by Japanese actor Nomura Hironobu.

name: Shorter Wong
description:
Shorter is the "boss" of Chinatown, a loyal friend to Ash, and a criminal with a heart of gold. Like [Ash](https://anilist.co/character/13580/Lynx-Ash), Shorter is an unusual "thug" with a deep sense of honor, and a drive to always do the right thing. He'll go to any lengths to protect his loved ones... even when the interests of those closest to him come into irreconcilable conflict.

Shorter is clever, resourceful, and as tough as steel. He's equally skilled at brawling, shooting, and sneaking around like a shadowy thief. Shorter can disguise himself as a completely different person, and fool even [Eiji](https://anilist.co/character/21928/Okumura-Eiji) into thinking that he is a dotty old Chinese man.

Shorter has an irrepressible sense of humor and can wear a lopsided, devilish grin even during the grimmest of circumstances. Like Ash, he is a charismatic leader who can easily unite the other kids on the street under his rule.

At the beginning of the series, Shorter has a mohawk hairdo. But by volume two he has shaved off all of his hair and is completely bald. Shorter's trademark fashion statement is his ever-present sunglasses. He even wears them while sneaking around a cornfield in the middle of the night! In an interview, [Akimi Yoshida](https://anilist.co/staff/97082/Yoshida-Akimi) said that Shorter's character design was inspired by Sanburaza Nakano.

name: Sing Soo-Ling
description:
**Height:** 165 cm, 191 cm (Garden of Light)
**Nationality:** Chinese-American

Sing Soo-Ling is the current leader of the Chinatown mafia, the younger half-brother of Lao Yen Tai.

name: Yue-Lung Lee
description:
__Height__:172 cm

He is one of the main antagonists of the series and the youngest son of the Lee family, the largest crime family in China.

(Source: BANANA FISH Wiki)

name: Blanca
description:
__Height:__ 196 cm (6'5")
__Hair Color:__ Brown

A retired assassin and the man who trained [Ash Lynx](https://anilist.co/character/13580/Ash-Lynx) to become heir to [Dino Golzine](https://anilist.co/character/132705/Dino-Francis-Golzine). Even though he cares for Ash, Blanca is a highly effective killer who dutifully carries out any contract he is hired for, such as when he is hired by [Yut-Lung](https://anilist.co/character/29576/YueLung-Lee) to murder [Eiji Okumura](https://anilist.co/character/21928/Eiji-Okumura). Ultimately declining to, Blanca instead defects to Ash's gang. He is shown to have excellent hand to hand combat skills, and insanely talented at long-range sniping.

name: Skip
description: An African-American boy, and member of Ash's gang.

name: Max Lobo
description: __May contain spoilers:__  "Max Lobo" is the pen name of Max Glenreed, a good-natured Vietnam veteran, former cop, journalist, novelist, and jailbird. As a journalist, Max wrote a regular column for the Village Tribune. He also wrote a novel about the Vietnam war called Seven Hundred and Thirty Days in Saigon. When we first meet Max in the manga, he is jailed for punching a cop. However, considering his cozy relationship with Charlie, Antonio, and even the prison guards, there is a strong suggestion that Max is keeping himself in jail as long as he wants. He practically brags that he could get out at any time; however, staying locked up seems to be serving the purpose of good old-fashioned investigative journalism.    Ever since the Vietnam war, Max has been hot on the trail of "Banana Fish," and has secretly been collecting notes and research for years. In Vietnam, his close friend Griffin Callenreese took some illicit drugs and went on bad trip, going on a shooting rampage and killing fellow members of his unit; it was Max, ultimately, who shot Griff's legs out from underneath him and stopped the carnage. Max had to abandon Griffin to the "nut house" in Saigon, although after the end of the war, he spent years searching for Griffin's whereabouts. To this day, Max is haunted by the memory of Griffin. Later on in the story, this guilt drives him to protect Ash from danger, despite the antagonistic relationship that Ash initially forces him into.    Max provides a lot of comic relief in the story. He sometimes acts as a fool, sometimes as an idiot savant. He loves his son and his ex-wife, Jessica, even though he is deathly afraid of Jessica's temper.    In an interview, Akimi Yoshida said that Max's character design was based on actor Harrison Ford.    (Source: boukenshin.net & HotaruKara)

name: Jessica Randy
description: She is a journalist, as well as the ex-wife of Max and mother of Michael.

name: Cain Blood
description:
__Height__: 192 cm

The Boss of African-American youth gang Black Sabbath. Referees Ash's fight with Arthur and later supports Ash and his gang in the war against the Corsican mafia.

name: Shunichi Ibe
description: A Japanese photojournalist who comes to New York City to do a report on street gangs.

name: Michael Glenreed
description: Michael Glenreed is the son of Max and Jessica.

name: Alex
description: Alex is the second-in-command in Ash's Gang.

name: Nadia Wong
description: Shorter's sister. She works at Chang Dai restaurant in Chinatown.

name: Frederick Arthur
description:
__Height__: 182 cm

A vindictive and cruel ex-member of Ash's street gang, who allies himself with Golzine in order to usurp Ash.

name: Dino Golzine
description:
__Height__: 178 cm

A major mafia boss in New York City, and the adoptive guardian of Ash Lynx. He has a taste for young boys.

name: Charlie Dickinson
description: Charlie Dickinson is a homicide detective as well as a friend of Max, when the two later met in a police academy.

name: Jennifer
description: Lives with Jim Callenreese. She's the stepmom of Ash and Griffin.

name: Jim Callenreese
description: Jim Callenreese is Ash and Griffin's dad.

name: The Fly
description: He is a supplier of black-market goods.

name: Dr. Meredith
description: Dr. Meredith is a back alley doctor. He helps Ash both with looking after Griffin, and finding out what a white powdery substance is that's not heroin.

name: George Scott
description: He acts as Ash Lynx's lawyer to set Ash free from jail through his connection with Max Lobo.

name: Willard Evanstine
description: Evanstine is a member of the New York City police.

name: Alexis Dawson
description: Alexis Dawson is a pathologist at the University of California.

name: Eduardo L. Fox
description:
**Height:** 190 cm

He is the leader of a mercenary group and former regimental leader of the French Foreign Legion.

name: Chizuru Hishiro
description:
A prodigy who has the best grades among the girls in her class. She's extremely bad at communication. She has a habit of immediately looking up anything she doesn't understand on the internet.

~!Hishiro was in fact Test Subject No. 001 of the Kantou Branch of ReLIFE Laboratory. Her inter-personal issues had made her not able to keep any job for long, and the list of short-term employments on her resume eventually made her unemployable. Her first year of ReLIFE experiment was a failure, but she was given a second chance, and she made the effort to make friends the second year. With the help of [Kaizaki](https://anilist.co/character/89425/Kaizaki-Arata) and her friends, she was able to overcome her past issues and restore her feelings that were damaged in the past.

After her ReLIFE experiment ended, she joined the ReLIFE Laboratory in the Research and Development Division.!~

name: Arata Kaizaki
description:
A 27-year old man who seems to fail at every job interview he partakes in. He accepts an offer to be part of the ReLIFE experiment in order to receive a recommendation to a company.

~!In Chapter 221, he learns that [Chizuru](https://anilist.co/character/89426/Hishiro-Chizuru) was a subject of ReLIFE and was shocked to discover she is older than him. After she briefly becomes sad at his possible disappointment, he assures her that he is happy with the revelation and hugs her which surprises but delights her. He then confesses his feelings for her that he is truly in love with her and wishes to be with her forever, and asks her to go out on a date with him. She is very touched by this declaration and states if he is okay with her she'll go out with him on a date, as they smile at each other and share their first kiss.!~

name: An Onoya
description:
__Height:__ 153 cm (5'0")

A third year in [Arata Kaizaki](https://anilist.co/character/89425/Kaizaki-Arata)'s class. She may be positive about everything she thinks about, but then she may not be thinking about anything.

~!However, she is in fact an employee of the ReLIFE Support Division and [Ryo Yoake](https://anilist.co/character/89427/Yoake-Ryou)'s junior supervisor in the ReLIFE experiment. She was actually going to be the support of Kaizaki, though this was changed. Her real age is 26-27!~

name: Rena Kariu
description: A stoic tsundere who has good grades, sports prowess, and a competitive personality. However, she's never satisfied and is always aiming higher.

name: Ryou Yoake
description: A member of the ReLife research team, and the person in charge of Arata's experiment. He's always cheerful, but has a cunning personality. He takes the form of a high schooler and supports Arata as a classmate.

name: Kazuomi Ooga
description:
__Height:__ 171 cm (5'7")

Kazuomi Ooga looks like a flashy student, but he has the best grades among the boys in his class. He has a pure side and is not interested in romance. He is not athletic.

~!Kazuomi greatly respects his older brother, who had previously shouldered the responsibilities of providing for the family. Even after Takaomi became a NEET, Kazuomi simply felt it is now his old turn to be responsible and let his brother time to rest. The piercing Kazuomi got from his brother was one of his greatest treasures, as a remembrance for when Takaomi was cheerfully working hard.!~

name: Honoka Tamarai
description: Honoka Tamarai is the captain of the volleyball team. She has a spacey personality and is easy-going, but is extremely skilled at sports and has monster strength. She's the childhood friend of [Inukai](https://anilist.co/character/89839/Inukai-Akira) and [Asaji](https://anilist.co/character/89840/Asaji-Nobunaga), and they call her "Tama (-chan)."

name: Akira Inukai
description: A young man with an unfriendly, blunt, but also honest personality. He's the kind of person to act before speaking. [Tamarai](https://anilist.co/character/89838/Tamarai-Honoka) and [Asaji](https://anilist.co/character/89840/Asaji-Nobunaga) call him "Aki (-chan)."

name: Kokoro Amatsu
description: The teacher of Year 3 Class 3. She specializes in physical education. She is also in charge of the girls' volleyball club.

name: Nobunaga Asaji
description: A kind and friendly young man. He is very skilled in athletics. [Tamarai](https://anilist.co/character/89838) and [Inukai](https://anilist.co/character/89839) call him "Nobu (-chan)."

name: Saiki Michiru
description:
Michiru was Arata Kaizaki's superior from his former company.

~!She commits suicide after getting severely rebuked by her coworkers.!~

name: Rumi Naomi
description: An employee who joined Arata's company after he was fired.

name: Sumire Inukai
description: She's Aoba High School's nurse.

name: Koushi Usa
description: He is a teacher at Aoba High School. He's in charge of 3rd year, class 4. He's also the supervisor of the boys volleyball club.

name: Kento Amagase
description: An employee of the ReLIFE institute in the field of research, within the laboratory of the company. He takes care of providing the pills to transform subjects from adults to adolescents and vice versa.

name: Zen Kamioka
description:
A new employee of the former company of Arata Kaizaki. 

~!After meeting Arata at the cemetery, he tells him that his actions inspired some people at the company.!~

name: Mari Shikido
description: A colleague working at the same convenience store as Ooga.

name: Hana Nishiyashiki
description: She's a student of Class 3-3 often seen together with Rinko Yanagigaura.

name: Rinko Yanagigaura
description: She is a student of homeroom 3-3 who is usually seen together with Hana Nishiyashiki and she often tries to get Hana to calm down

name: Takaomi Ooga
description:
He is Kazuomi Ooga's older brother. Takaomi graduated from Aoba High School and Aoba University with top grades, found a job with a large and prestigious company. Soon after became a NEET after long-term harassment from his co-workers. 
~!When Arata starts working at the ReLife company Takaomi is his first subject!~

name: Myne
description:
__Family structure__ ~!　Father: [Gunther](https://anilist.co/character/126528) 　 Mother: [Effa](https://anilist.co/character/126527) 　 Older sister: [Tuuli](https://anilist.co/character/126526) 　 Younger brother: [Kamil](https://anilist.co/character/157140)!~ __Status__ 　 Class: commoner 　 Occupation: soldier's child
Youngest daughter of a poor commoner family. She has navy blue hair and golden eyes. She has a feeble body which gets a high fever if she forces it too much, it is also smaller than the average for her age. Urano Motosu died at the age of 22 and reincarnated into Myne's body by the time Myne was 5 years old.
____ _Spoiler from [Part 3](https://anilist.co/manga/110801)_ # ~!__Rozemyne__ (ローゼマイン)!~ ~!
__Family structure__ 　 Father: [Karstedt](https://anilist.co/character/156108) 　 Mother: [Elvira](https://anilist.co/character/157149) (Karstedt's first wife, mother of baptism) 　 Older brother: [Eckhart](https://anilist.co/character/201318) 　 Older brother: [Lamprecht](https://anilist.co/character/201319) 　　　 Nephew: Siegrecht 　 Older brother: [Cornelius](https://anilist.co/character/201320) 　 Younger half-brother: [Nikolaus](https://anilist.co/character/201317) (son of Karstedt's second wife) 　 Mother: [Rozemary](https://anilist.co/character/157151) (Karstedt's third wife, mother setting) 　 Adoptive father: [Sylvester](https://anilist.co/character/157135) 　 Adoptive mother: [Florencia](https://anilist.co/character/201321) 　 Older brother: [Wilfried](https://anilist.co/character/201564) 　 Younger sister: [Charlotte](https://anilist.co/character/201565) 　 Younger brother: [Melchior](https://anilist.co/character/201566) 　 Paternal relatives 　 Great-grandfather: [Aub Ehrenfest](https://anilist.co/character/201635) (fifth generation) 　 Great-grandfather: [former Giebe Leisegang](https://anilist.co/character/262016) (Bonifatius's first wife's father) 　 Grandfather: [Bonifatius](https://anilist.co/character/201624) 　 Half-uncle: son of Bonifatius's second wife 　　　 Cousin: [Traugott](https://anilist.co/character/201627) __Status__ 　 Class: archnoble → archducal family member 　 Occupation: apprentice blue shrine maiden, orphan director and studio manager → archduke candidate, high bishop, orphan director and studio manager __Age related__ 　 Age difference with Myne: -1 　 Birth season: summer
Rozemyne is an archnoble girl. Her flowing midnight-blue hair is well kept, silkier than even the hair of most archnoble girls, and her moon-like golden-yellow eyes are like windows into her emotional heart. She has a pretty face as well, and would no doubt grow up to be a true beauty. She has pale white skin largely untouched by the sun, and soft hands that weren't at all worn down by labor. Rozemyne ​​has a massive amount of mana inside her. Her mana is so great that Karstedt determined that it was necessary to hide his own daughter and raise her in secret, away from any danger. [The former High Bishop](https://anilist.co/character/126545) misunderstood her presence in the temple, and not discerning her true identity, he began to groan and complain that a commoner shrine maiden disturbed the peace. Rozemyne ​​was raised humbly, unaware of her parents or their status, but still, her compassionate heart ached for the suffering of those who lived in worse circumstances than her. She felt sorry for the children who lived in the orphanage, and did what no one else would by giving them food and work, due to that, Rozemyne is worshiped and honored by the orphans as a Saint. [The Archduke](https://anilist.co/character/157135) determined that the work Rozemyne gave to the orphans could become a new industry for his duchy. Just when he was considering spending the next twenty or more years spreading it around the duchy, Rozemyne ​​was targeted by [a noble from another duchy](https://anilist.co/character/157148). In order to secure Rozemyne's position in the nobility, and to protect her mana wealth for the sake of Ehrenfest, the Archduke adopted her.!~

name: Takashi Natsume
description:
__Height:__ 167 cm (5'6")

Natsume Takashi is the main protagonist of the series who, like his deceased grandmother [Natsume Reiko](https://anilist.co/character/13886/Natsume-Reiko), has the ability to see ayakashi (spirits). He inherited the Book of Friends from her, a book of contracts binding ayakashi to servitude when they were defeated by Reiko. Due to Natsume's strong resemblance to his grandmother, he is often mistaken for her and is pursued by ayakashi who hate Reiko but yearn for the Book of Friends. To rid himself of these troubles, Natsume resolved to end the book by returning all the contracted names to their former owners. He is accompanied by the youkai [Madara](https://anilist.co/character/13784/Madara), nicknamed "Nyanko-sensei" (or simply "sensei"), promising him possession of the book once he dies. In return, the creature must serve as his bodyguard until then.  

Orphaned at an early age, Natsume was passed on from relative to relative. His ability to see and communicate with ayakashi isolated him from both family and friends throughout his childhood. He was labeled as a 'liar' and 'attention seeker' for trying to tell others about the ayakashi, and his attempts to run away from the youkai had them calling him insane. Natsume then became reclusive in order to try to lead a relatively “normal” life with people. Eventually, he was passed on to the Fujiwaras, a middle-aged couple from his father's side of the family. In contrast to the relatives before, they genuinely care for Natsume, and he loves them in return. He does not want to cause them any trouble, so the ayakashi problem remains secret.  

Natsume's incredibly strong spiritual power allows him to actually hit and hurt youkai. He develops friendships with youkai and exorcists alike, though the interest of many is to use him to their advantage. In the anime, Natsume is more cheery and good-natured, while in the manga, he is slightly more dismal and short-tempered, especially toward Nyanko-sensei.   To return the names inscribed in the Book of Friends, Natsume must first picture the said ayakashi in his mind to learn of its name. The book then flips open to the page where the name is written, which he takes out and places in his mouth while breathing out. The spell which originally enslaved the spirits used Reiko's saliva and breath; as Reiko's grandson and one who bears a strong resemblance to Reiko, Natsume is able to use the spell as well. The cost of releasing each name, however, is that his energy is almost completely drained in the process.

name: Madara
description:
A mysterious feline spirit. 

Madara was sealed in a shrine until he was accidentally released by Natsume. Because Madara was trapped in a material form for so long, Madara ordinary takes on the shape of a maneki neko (lucky cat), leading Natsume to nickname him Nyanko-sensei. In this form, other people can see him, leading for Natsume having to ask his guardians if he could keep him as a pet.   

Madara is a powerful spirit, who protects Natsume from others and teaches him spells on occasion, in return for Natsume's promise to give him the Book of Friends when he dies. They often fight each other, which leads to Natsume punching Madara on the face and knocking him out. Despite his protests of not being a cat, he likes to play with cat toys. Nyanko's design is based on a lucky cat statue Midorikawa was given as a child. 

In the anime, Natsume is more respectful to Madara.

name: Reiko Natsume
description:
__Family:__ Takashi Natsume (grandson), Takashi's Mother (daughter)

Reiko Natsume is the maternal grandmother of [Takashi Natsume](https://anilist.co/character/13783/Takashi-Natsume), and the person whom Takashi inherited his strong spiritual power from.

She was despised by both humans and youkai. She was a bully towards humans and youkai alike, resulting in her being socially isolated. She defeated many Youkai and made them write out their names in the Yuujinchou (translated into Book of Friends), making them "servants" to her. However, there are times she is kind to humans but they don't return the gesture. For instance, she had taken a doll from a pot youkai, Kayatsubo to return to a human child but they told her that she could keep it, believing she stole it.

 ~!She died young with no human willing to remember her with many youkai mistaking her grandson for her.!~ Some of the youkai she "enslaved" or made plans with grew to despise her, while some youkai (like Santou) continued to wait for her return.

name: Shuuichi Natori
description:
__Height:__ 175cm 

A man who is also able to see spirits. He is a famous actor and exorcist and has a lizard birthmark that moves around on his body. He has the ability to manipulate paper dolls and has three youkai under his command. Natsume tends to disapprove of his forceful exorcism methods.

name: Kaname Tanuma
description:
__Height:__ 171 cm

Another student who had recently moved into the area. He is sickly and quite susceptible to illnesses. Like [Takashi Natsume](https://anilist.co/character/13783/Natsume-Takashi), he is able to detect spirits, but to a lesser degree limited to seeing merely shadows and sensing slight presence of spirits. He wants to help Natsume in anyway he can, but is afraid that he will just be a burden because of his weak ability.

name: Tooru Taki
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm 

Tohru Taki is a female student at Natsume's school. She was first "discovered" by one of Natsume's friends, Nishimura who had heard rumors of her beauty and became entranced, he still maintains an obvious crush on her even though Natsume holds most of her attention.  Taki is introduced into the story as a shy, silent girl. Later, the reason for this is because she was cursed by a yokai; the last 13 names said by her will be eaten by him at the end of a one year period. The yokai also throws her into an impossible gamble for her life which he does not honor even when she wins.  Taki is generally a happy, extroverted and optimistic girl. She is shown to have a peculiar taste in cuteness, as is shown when she hugs Nyanko-sensei, calling him cute. Like Tanuma, she tries to help Natsume in any way she can, but is usually prevented from doing so because Natsume worries about their involvement with yokai.   Even though Taki herself has too little spirit energy to see yokai, she does have the knowledge of drawing yokai circles, discovered by her grandfather. The circle, once drawn, gives any human the ability to see yokai who step within the radius of the circle. The circle does not require any spirit energy to create and activate, so anyone could possible draw it if they know how to. But due to it being complicated in looks, Taki is presummably the only one able to draw it without the need of a guide.

name: Touko Fujiwara
description: The wife of Shigeru Fujiwara. In the past, she has offered Natsume Takashi to live with her and her husband. She said that she does not have any children. Touko is a very kind and loving housewife who treats Natsume as her own child, since she cares about him a lot.

name: Hinoe
description: Hinoe means third in rank, third sign of the Chinese calendar. A powerful youkai whose form is a human woman. She is madly in love with Natsume Reiko. Being knowledgeable, she often acts as Natsume Takashi's mentor. Hinoe enjoys teasing Natsume and Madara.

name: Misuzu
description: A huge powerful bull youkai with many followers. He acknowledges that Natsume Takashi is a worthy holder of the Book of Friends and offers himself as Natsume's bodyguard in place of the "useless" Madara.

name: Shigeru Fujiwara
description: The husband of Touko Fujiwara. Along with Touko,Shigeru took Natsume over and he and his wife raise him as their own child. He is a quiet and considering man. When he was young, he met Natsume's grandmother, Reiko. When Shigeru was a young boy,he met Reiko and they became friends.

name: Hiiragi
description: Hiiragi is a Yokai that has been forcibly tied to an old storehouse once owned by a prominent family. She was tied there with a rope she could not break and forced to curse anyone who tried opening it.  As it turned out, Natori once met her while he was a child, putting bandage on her wounded arm. Natori would later return with the intent of exorcising her, having forgotten who she was. But, thanks to interference by Natsume, her life was saved, and she took on the new position as Natori's newest familiar after everything was cleared up.

name: Atsushi Kitamoto
description: Natsume's friend from class. He is a sensible and rational person.

name: Jun Sasada
description:
The class president of Takashi's class. 

Sasada believes that Takashi can see spirits, and constantly asks him questions about it, to which he replies that he doesn't have such an ability. Much to Takashi's chagrin, she wants to come along with him when he's visiting spirits.   

The story in the manga differs slightly, as Sasada moves away after the encounter with Shigure.

name: Satoru Nishimura
description: Natsume's friend from class. He is funny and easy-going, with a slightly perverted side. He has a crush on Taki Tooru, but thinks that she and Natsume are going out, and ran off comically crying.

name: Aoi
description:
A bird-yokai who takes human form. Natsume fails to realize this upon their first meeting.

[Source: MAL]

name: Kappa
description: A kappa Natsume found lying dry on the ground. He helps the kappa by throwing water on him.

name: Chobi-hige
description: Youkai that first appears at episode 6 and 7 of Zoku Natsume Yuujinchou.

name: Urihime
description: Urihime is one of the three faithful youkai under the command of Natori Shuuichi. She first appears with Sasago. In recent times, she is often seen appearing with Hiiragi under the command of Natori-san. All three of them have pledged their faithfulness to Natori-san.

name: Maomao
description:
Maomao works as an apothecary in the red light district, helping her mentor and father [Luomen](https://anilist.co/character/261968) in caring for its residents, with special attention given to the Verdigris Hall brothel, where she was born and was initially raised.

One day, while gathering herbs, she gets kidnapped and sold to be a common servant in the inner court of the imperial palace, where only the Emperor's consorts and their servants reside. Not allowed to leave, her curious personality and skills begin to rope her into mysterious problems that can affect the whole country.

~! It was later revealed that Loumen was actually her adoptive father. Her biological father is [Lakan](https://anilist.co/character/232926), the tactician in the Li military. Loumen is actually Maomao's biological great-uncle. Her biological mother is [Fengxian](https://anilist.co/character/274191), who was a high ranking courtesan at the Verdigris House. !~

name: Jinshi
description: Jinshi is the eunuch in charge of the affairs of the inner palace. He is described as having a face capable even of outshining the consorts in beauty, amazing women and men alike. He is constantly accompanied by his attendant [Gaoshun](https://anilist.co/character/244317/Gaoshun) and has taken an interest to [Maomao](https://anilist.co/character/126824/Maomao)'s intelligence and active demeanor.

name: Gaoshun
description: Gaoshun is [Jinshi](https://anilist.co/character/127278/Jinshi)'s attendant. He's shown to be extremely dependable. A stern believer in deference to authority and proper etiquette, his disapproval is often splattered in his transparent facial expressions, even if he says nothing.

name: Lakan
description:
Lakan is a renowned strategist known for his nonchalant disregard of proper manners. His plotting ability causes fear even in the Emperor himself. He sees people's faces as a piece of shogi representing their worth, with a few exceptions like the woman he loved and his daughter. Currently heads the La clan.

~!He is [Maomao](https://anilist.co/character/126824/Maomao)'s biological father and the nephew of [Luomen](https://anilist.co/character/261968/Ruomen)!~

name: Pairin
description: Pairin is the oldest of the Three Princesses of Verdigris Hall. She loves men's bodies and dreams of being taken away by a muscular prince.

name: Meimei
description: Meimei is one of the Three Princesses of Verdigris Hall. She started as Fenshen's apprentice and, being somewhat cunning herself, inherited Fenshen's taste for strategy board games. She is the most attached to the brothel and the people within.

name: Joka
description: Joka is the youngest of the Three Princesses of Verdigris Hall and one of Maomao's adopted sisters.

name: Lahan
description: Lahan is the adopted son of [Lakan](https://anilist.co/character/232926/Lakan) and a number loving eccentric.

name: Yarite Baba
description: Once a high ranking courtesan herself, the Madam is now the runner of the Vergidris Hall.

name: Rikuson
description: Subordinate of [Rakan](https://anilist.co/character/232926). A very capable official, he is gentle, diligent, and quick-witted.

name: Bai Niangniang
description: A mysterious fairy with translucent white skin, white hair, and red eyes who has been causing a stir. Rumor has it that she can read people’s minds and use magical powers to create gold.

name: San
description:
**Relatives:** [Moro](https://anilist.co/character/9174/Moro) (adoptive mother)

San is the princess of the Wolf Gods. She acts, behaves, and resembles a wolf since she was raised by wolves. She is fundamentally defined by her appreciation of nature and hatred towards humans.

San is a young woman of average build who wears ragged clothing and a cape made of a wolf's fur and has what appears to be amaranth red war paint on her face. She wears a head necklace with a single small gem on her front. She also bears short, straight, earthy brown hair and has dark blue eyes with bangs slightly parted in the middle. She has a medium necklace with three fangs tied across her neck. She wears long, dangling, oval-shaped earrings during the whole film. She is also very agile, fast, fairly strong, and appears to be really good at using daggers and spears. She wears a mask which is her iconic feature. The mask is red with ears and white wavy lines and three sunshine yellow holes for a mouth and eyes. 

San is depicted as stubborn, short-tempered, courageous, and protective - her primary concern is to protect the forest and animals she lives with. At first, she rejects her own humanity and is seen as misanthropic, thinking of herself only as a wolf. She initially only exhibits compassion towards the inhabitants of the forest but is able to accept and develop an admiration for others.

name: Ashitaka
description: A prince of the Emishi tribe, Ashitaka is cursed in combat with a demonic boar. His only hope for a cure is to return to the forested land from which the boar-god originally came and discover what rage infected it. Leaving his people behind forever, he makes that journey and discovers the gods of the forest at war with the humans in a iron-mining town. Ashitaka vows to help the two sides reach a compromise, to cure them of the very anger that now eats away at him. The key to compromise appears to lie with a mysterious human girl who lives amongst the gods.

name: Moro no Kimi
description: Years ago, Moro found two adults chopping down the animal's forest. Moro was furious, and she was about to attack them when they threw their baby at her feet as they fled. That baby was then named San, and raised by her.    As the years went by, Moro taught San the wolf life, how to run like one, and even act like one. When "The Iron Works" was established, Moro had a tendency to tell San to attack the villagers, since they were defiling the forest. One rainy day, Moro attacked the villagers, while Eboshi was there. Eboshi then used her iron gun, and shot Moro, making Moro lose her immortality.

name: Eboshi Gozen
description: Lady Eboshi  is the founder and leader of Tatara Ba (Iron Town).      ~!Calm and collected, she is a proper lady at all times, as well as being an accomplished swordswoman and having a sound business mind. She is well loved and respected by the townspeople, especially the women, as Eboshi is considered something of a hero in their eyes. She buys women originally sold to brothels in order to bring them to work for her, and even hires on lepers to make new kinds of ishibiya (hand canons introduced to Japan from China, though the new ones look more like rifles than canons). As such, Tatara Ba is basically considered to be a refuge for those who have nowhere else to go.!~

name: Yakkul
description: [Ashitaka](https://anilist.co/character/2802/Ashitaka)'s loyal red elk.

name: Kodama
description: Tree spirits, whose appearance is a sign of a healthy forest. They are portrayed as small, white humanoids with large, rattling heads and mask-like features.  They appear to protect the forest, but also lead Ashitaka out of the forest of the Forest Spirit with two wounded Irontown workers. They are said to bring good luck.

name: Shishigami
description: Shishigami is the ancient spirit of the forest. During the day, Shishigami resembles a great stag with many antlers, bird-like feet, and the face of a baboon. At sunset, Shishigami becomes Daidarabocchi , a huge god in a humanoid form that appears to be made out of stars with a long pointed face and tentacle-like spikes on the back.
