Though he might appear constantly happy and joyous on the outside, Manabe actually at times looks down on himself, and can often get serious if he sees the need to.    

Manabe is always fascinated by the Sohma family's beauty, as he is occasionally seen asking different Sohma family members their secret to their handsomeness.    

~!Manabe is also the half-brother of Machi Kuragi, the quiet and pensive treasurer. He is very protective of her and can often be seen ordering her around, though rather out of love than sibling superiority. They share the same father, but have different mothers. According to Kakeru, he is the illegitimate son of their father, but because he was older than Machi and the only son, their mothers got into a heated dispute as to who was to be their father's heir. Machi's mother was particularly hard on Machi, forcing her to be as perfect as possible, so that as the legitimate child of her father, she would become the family's heir over Kakeru. The matter was settled when Machi's younger brother was born and Machi was brushed aside. As a result, Kakeru feels he needs to take care of his younger sister given that he feels she has been treated unfairly and she has become unloved. Manabe tells Yuki at one point that he himself noticed how stupid the inheritance dispute was and told his mother that he would not take part in it. He'd go on a rampage and shout the words, "I'm not gonna play your stupid game anymore!." Which soon made his mother realize that he was right. He told Yuki that this made him "officially free." He also said "maybe that means Machi hasn't gained her freedom yet."

Although Machi and her mother still need to work things out, Kakeru and his mother seem to get along fine, though they argue regularly about trivial matters very loudly, which results in complaint from the landlord. Kakeru's mother seems to have decided that she doesn't care about the inheritance anymore.    Due to his vice presidential status he is also very acquainted to Yuki Sohma, the student council president. Together the two, although their differences are quite obvious and their personalities at times clash with one another, have developed a rather bonded relationship and the two are now finally seen smiling together in some parts of the manga, rather than Manabe just teasing Yuki, or falling asleep while Yuki is talking. !~

name: Kazuma Souma
description:
When he was a child, Kazuma was mean to [his grandfather](https://anilist.co/character/233304), who was then the member of the Soma family possessed by the cat of the Chinese Zodiac, during their first and only meeting simply because his grandfather was cursed by the cat. 

Hoping to make amends for how he had treated his grandfather, he decided to take care of the young [Kyo Soma](https://anilist.co/character/209) ~!after Kyo's mother had committed suicide.!~ He is Kyo's martial arts teacher, but is also an adoptive father to him. Kazuma thinks well of [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/207) and hopes that her love for Kyo is sincere and that her relationship with Kyo will not mirror that of his grandfather and grandmother. Kyo calls him "Shishou" which means "master". Kazuma has taught many of the other Somas martial arts, including [Kagura](https://anilist.co/character/366), [Yuki](https://anilist.co/character/208) and [Haru](https://anilist.co/character/369).

name: Kureno Souma
description:
__Zodiac Animal:__ Rooster

Kureno is a quiet, obedient man. ~!He falls in love with [Arisa Uotani](https://anilist.co/character/375).!~

name: Kagura Souma
description:
__Zodiac Animal:__ Boar

She has been in love with [Kyo](https://anilist.co/character/209) since they were young, although she doesn't know that Kyo is in love with her friend, [Tohru Honda](https://anilist.co/character/207). Because of her "pity" of him as a child, when he was all alone because he carried the curse of the cat, she played with and took care of him. Eventually, it developed into a near-obsessive love for him. She is convinced she will marry him, mainly because she threatened him into proposing to her (at age 7 with knives in the manga, or a boulder in the anime to a 5-year old Kyo), and partly because she thinks that they belong together because they can hug each other without transforming into their zodiac form. 

Despite this love, she often loses her head and beats him senseless when he does something to anger her or make her anxious. As one of the only three female members of the zodiac, she is able to hug any of the male members and neither she nor they transform.

She lives with her mother, who is perfectly okay with Kagura's double-edged personality, and [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/3892). Kagura seemingly is the only female member of the zodiac that has not been personally hurt by [Akito](https://anilist.co/character/374).

name: Hiro Souma
description:
__Zodiac Animal:__ Sheep

Hiro is a very intelligent but verbally aggressive and smart-mouthed sophist. He is in love with [Kisa](https://anilist.co/character/371), and resents [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/207) because she unwittingly monopolizes Kisa's time and attention. He starts out hostile to Tohru, but eventually eases his initial attitude through a combination of grudging admiration for Tohru and Kisa telling him to let up. He is sarcastic and pessimistic.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Ritsu Souma
description:
__Zodiac Animal:__ Monkey

As far back as he could remember, his parents always had to apologize for everything he did, so he is very unsure of himself. He feels that every day, he is robbing the world of its air by breathing.

He found that it always made him feel more comfortable to dress like a girl, but that only gave his parents even more to apologize for. Since he looks so much like a girl, that's what [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/207) thought when she first saw him, until he accidently transformed. Somehow, Tohru convinced him that he does have a reason to live, he just hasn't found it yet. Shigure likes to play with Ritsu's insecurities and gullibility, much as he does his editor, [Mitsuru](https://anilist.co/character/9759).

~!When the two meet, they realize they have this in common. In the final chapter of the manga, Ritsu tells Kagura, while giving her one of his women's kimonos, that he has asked Mitsuru on a date, and in a bonus story in the first fan-book, he and Mitsuru are a couple.!~  

Natsuki Takaya derived his name from the eighth month, odakaritsuki or "rice harvest month," which is the month of the monkey, of the traditional Japanese calendar. In an author's note, Takaya said that she regretted how little role Ritsu played in the main story.

(Source: AbsoluteAnime.com)

name: Megumi Hanajima
description:
Megumi and Saki are extremely close. Megumi has always been there for Saki, and when he learned of his sister's powers, he, not wanting his sister to be the only "weird one" in the family, studied the art of curses until he finally mastered it. He and Saki both enjoy wearing black, because they feel "calm" in that color. He joined Saki in her predicament so that she would not be alone in her sufferings. Megumi's name is a small joke, for the name "Megumi" means "blessing", while Megumi himself studies how to put curses on people.    

Megumi has never actually been seen using his power to curse anyone. When the Prince Yuki Fan Club attempted to weaken Tohru's defenses by finding and using Saki's weakness, Megumi joined his sister in scaring them away. His dark demeanor and his ability to "guess" the girl's names frightened them from the house. The next day, Saki mentioned that the girls would all be cursed in three days' time. While it seems possible for Megumi to do this, since he claimed that all he would need were the girls' names, the manga never shows what happens, so Saki could have been bluffing.    

Like his sister, he is also highly mature for his age, not only in intelligence and behaviour but as well as in sexual maturity, as Arisa states when he makes a comment how he came to her restaurant only to see her in a miniskirt: "You know, you really don't act like a middle schooler; more like a lecherous old man." (This only happens in the manga.) Megumi, for his part, has been called the trio's "bodyguard" and seems to consider himself as such as he goes through a good deal of trouble to aid Arisa and his sister in their guarding of Tohru. Megumi seems to admire her very much and will do anything to help her.    

(Thanks to Absolute Anime for Character Description)

name: Katsuya Honda
description:
He is Tohru's late father and used to be a student teacher when he met Kyoko Honda (who he helped leave her previous lifestyle). He later left student teaching and married Kyoko, despite the eight-year age gap (when he and Kyoko met, she was 13 and he was 21). Katsuya, who had apparently had a rebellious childhood, admitted that he had fallen in love with Kyoko because she had been able to cry and confess to being lonely, which he wasn't able to do. When Kyoko told him she was pregnant and had doubts as to whether she could properly raise a child, he assures her that they will take care of the baby together, as a real family.

~!A short time later, when Tohru was three years old, he died of pneumonia. The sudden death caused Kyoko to almost kill herself.!~

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Mayuko Shiraki
description: Mayuko Shiraki (白木 繭子, Shiraki Mayuko) is Tohru, Kyo, Yuki, Saki, and Arisa's homeroom teacher; what subject she teaches is never given, though in an author's note, Natsuki Takaya said she thinks Shiraki fits the image of a literature teacher. Shiraki is depicted as generally good-humored but sometimes aggressive—when Kyo attempts to leave class on Valentine's Day, she stops him at the door with a folder in his face and threatens to dye his hair black instead of orange, and once breaks up a fight between Hatsuharu and Kyo by dumping a bucket of water over them;she once demanded as a joke that, after some students familiarly addressed her "Mayu-chan-sensei," that they call her "Great Teacher Mayuko." Her parents, who worry about Shiraki being unmarried, run a bookstore where she sometimes helps out. Takaya said in an author's note that Shiraki is "possibly sad" that she is a woman and "secretly insecure of how tall she is," but since Hatori Sohma is tall too, they "might look pretty good together."  Shiraki is best friends with Kana, Hatori's former fiancee, and through she met Hatori, Shigure, and Ayame two years before the series begins. While Shiraki was attracted to Hatori, she was glad that Kana and Hatori were happy together. She dated Shigure for a month before breaking up, partly because Shigure was distant and partly because she was only dating him to alleviate her loneliness. She was at a loss when Kana and Hatori broke up, because Hatori had erased Kana's memory of the engagement. Shiraki still has feelings for Hatori, but resents Shigure's continuing interference in her life, even when it brings her closer to Hatori.In the final chapter, Shiraki and Hatori are shown as a couple, with Hatori inviting her on an Okinawa vacation.

name: Mine Kuramae
description:
Mine Kuramae works at Ayame Sohma's clothing store as a designer and seamstress, and lives with him in an apartment above the store. She is passionate, cheerful, and determined to do anything for Ayame; she takes care of details he neglects in his enthusiasm, such as getting permission to visit Yuki's class. According to Natsuki Takaya, "she is an amazing person" for being able to keep up with Ayame. She is depicted as especially enthusiastic about dressing girls up in her outfits, sparkling at the thought of doing so, and she herself is always shown wearing a frilly maid's uniform. According to Ayame, Mine is someone he "can confide in."  ~!When Ayame is freed from the curse, the first thing he does is embrace her.!~

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Yutaka Hoshino
description:
Peco is a member of the Katase High table tennis club, along with his best friend [Smile](https://anilist.co/character/20325/Tsukimoto-Makoto). Unlike his friend, Peco is very charismatic and has a real passion towards Ping Pong. Peco dreams of becoming the Ping Pong world champion, and claims that he'll move to Europe to start playing professionally after he graduates.

~! In the epilogue, it is revealed that Peco loves playing ping pong again and competes in competitions regularly.!~

name: Makoto Tsukimoto
description:
Smile is a member of the Katase High table tennis club, along with his best friend [Peco](https://anilist.co/character/20326/Hoshino-Yutaka). Unlike the other members of the club, Smile thinks of the sport as a job or a way to pass time. He does not try to enjoy it for fun and often lets less able players beat him out of consideration for their feelings. The other members of the club nicknamed him Smile because he never does.

~!In the epilogue, he becomes a ping pong coach for kids and new players.!~

name: Wenge Kong
description: Wenge Kong (nicknamed China by everyone else) is an extremely skilled table tennis player who travelled to Japan to start anew after he was kicked out of his home team in China. Originally his intention was to beat the local hero 'Dragon', but he finds new worthy opponents after meeting Peco and Smile.

name: Ryuichi Kazama
description:
Kazama is captain of the powerful table tennis club of the Kaiou Gakuen academy. He has also won the Inter-High for the second consecutive year. He has a stoic personality and devotes everything to table tennis.

~! Throughout the series Dragon believes Ping Pong is about hard work and dedication, so much to the point that you feel nothing but pain playing the sport. He believes there are no such things as Heroes and believes people cannot fly. This is all changed in the championship finals of the series when he matches against Peco (The Hero) and with this, Peco teaches Dragon how to stop slowly climbing up a cliff but instead how to jump off and take flight straight to the stars. !~

name: Manabu Sakuma
description: Demon is a childhood friend of Peco's and a member of the Kaio Academy table tennis club. Despite being Peco's friend, Demon is also his rival.

name: Jou Koizumi
description: Mr. Koizumi is the Katase High School Table Tennis club advisor. He recognizes Smile's gift and ability towards the sport and so vows to train him. When Mr. Koizumi was younger he was considered to be the best table tennis player in Japan, and was nicknamed 'Butterfly Joe' because of his extraordinary skills. Mr. Koizumi states that Smile reminds him of his younger self. He is also an English teacher.

name: Obaba
description: Obaba is an old chainsmoking woman who acts as Peco's mentor. She also owns the local table tennis dojo Tamura of which Peco and Smile are frequent visitors. She is close friends with Jou Kozoimi since her youth, when both were renowned table tennis players.

name: Kong no Coach
description: Kong Wenge's coach. He is fluent in both Japanese and Chinese, and also acts as a friend and an interpreter to Kong.

name: Ota
description: Team captain of Katase, known for his unusual hairstyle. He helps run the family appliance store and is often occupied with odd jobs after school.

name: Kong no Haha
description: Kong Wenge's mother.

name: Michio Tamura
description: Obaba's son.

name: Amir Halgal
description: Amir comes to be the bride for Karluk. She is very capable of hunting and managing house chores. She is nice and calm person, and overprotective to Karluk

name: Pariya Togonosh
description: An outspoken girl who befriends Amir. Her father has a hard time finding suitors for her since she is easily riled up.

name: Azel Halgal
description: [Amir's](https://anilist.co/character/26120/) older brother.

name: Henry Smith
description: An English traveler and researcher living with the Eihon family. He has been researching the customs, language, and culture of the tribes and peoples. He left the Eihon family to return to England after being warned of rising tensions in the region with the Russians. It is hinted that he might be an English intelligence officer sent to Central Asia as a part of the Great Game. After leaving the Eihon family, he was captured by the Russian military under suspicion of spying, but was later released with the help of Amira and Karluk.

name: Talas
description:
A young nomadic woman living with her mother-in-law. Introduced in chapter 12. Married into her current family at age sixteen, but in a few years became a widow of all its five sons as per tradition, which dictates that a widow with no children marries one of her husband's brothers. Since her father-in-law also died, she helps and keeps company to her mother-in-law instead of going back to her own family. She becomes romantically involved with Mr. Smith.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Karluk Eihon
description: He is a calm person with lots of patience - doing what his wife Amira asks him to so as not to make her worry. He adores her very much.

name: Ali
description: Smith's guide to Ankara and is associated with the local military. He is unabashedly greedy and resourceful, taking advantage of a situation as he sees fit. He is not married, but expresses interest in finding a wife when he feels he has obtained sufficient financial stability.

name: Anis
description:
The young wife of a wealthy and kindhearted man living in Persia. She is the mother of a young son, Hasan. Smith and Ali are briefly guests in the home of Anis' husband, though Smith never sees Anis herself. Though Anis has everything she could have, she is isolated and lonely until her maid Maarfe encourages her to join her at the public baths. Anis forms an immediate connection with Shirin, with whom she hopes to form a bond of sisterhood with.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Laila
description:
One of the twin sisters Mr. Henry Smith encounters in the village on the banks of the Aral Sea. She is virtually indistinguishable from her sister Laili and is rarely see apart from her. She often neglects household chores, instead spending her time with her sister devising plans to land a rich husband.

Laila debuts in the manga during chapter 19.

name: Laili
description: One of the twin sisters Mr. Henry Smith encounters in the village on the banks of the Aral Sea. She is virtually indistinguishable from her twin sister Laila whom she is rarely separated from. Like her sister, she has a tendency to neglect her household chores, instead spending time devising plans to land a rich husband. Her cheeky attitude and blunt way of speaking often lands her in trouble with her father.

name: Joruk Halgal
description: Amir's cousin.

name: Sherine
description: Sherine (シーリーン Shiiriin) is Anis's avowed sister.

name: Umar
description:
Pariya's potential husband.

He is from a family of shepherds. He knows how to read and how to use the abacus.

name: Rostem
description: Karluk's youngest nephew.

name: Baimat Halgal
description: Amir's middle brother.

name: Yusuf
description: Seleke's husband. He lives in Eihons' household together with his wife and children.

name: Tileke
description: Daughter of Yusuf and Sanira. She's the oldest sibling.

name: Seleke
description: Karluk's older sister. She lives in her parent's house together with her husband and children. Seleke sems to be on very good terms with her mother and Amira.

name: Sanira
description: Karluk's mother

name: Camora
description: Camora is from Rahim's family. According to Pariya, she is always sunny and cheerful, and nice to everyone. She's perfect at sewing and other chores, and can even sing and dance like a star. She has the makings of a perfect bride, and her father meets with prospects almost every day.

name: Saahman
description: Older brother of Farsami, and childhood friends with the twins (Laila and Laili) in the village on the banks of the Aral Sea.

name: Akunbek Eihon
description: The head of Eihon Family.

name: Farsahmi
description: Younger brother of Saahman, and childhood friends with the twins (Lailia and Leili) in the village on the banks of the Aral Sea.

name: Gyro Zeppeli
description:
Gyro has a cocky and flamboyant personality, appearing to have a high opinion of himself. However, he can be driven by emotions for other people and become realistic and serious when a problem presents itself.

Like most Manga archetypes, Gyro is incredibly intelligent when he needs to be. His most distinguishable body features are his long hair, western hat and his gold teeth which have "GO! GO! ZEPPELI" displayed on them, revealed whenever he smiles at someone. His signature laugh/chuckle is "Nyo ho ho ho~".

~!Note that the "Caesar" in his name is pronounced in the traditional Greek way, more akin to the German "Kaiser". This is distinct from [Caesar Anthonio Zeppeli](https://anilist.co/character/21959/Zeppeli-Anthonio-Caesar) from [JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Part 2](https://anilist.co/manga/31630/-/), whose name is pronounced in the modern English way.!~

name: Dio Brando
description:
__Height:__ 195 cm (6'5")
__Race:__ Human (formerly), Vampire (onwards)
__Nationality:__ British

Dio is an immortal vampire and the arch rival of the Joestar clan.
 
__Series 1: Phantom Blood__ 
~!Dio is the son of [Dario Brando](https://anilist.co/character/74099/Brando-Dario), an alcoholic and abusive father. Back when Dio was just a boy, he was brought into the household of [George Joestar](https://anilist.co/character/21956/Joestar-I-George) after the mysterious death of his father, so as to repay the debt he owed Dio's father for saving his life. But soon Dio's personality caused trouble for George's young son, [Jonathan Joestar](https://anilist.co/character/8087/Joestar-Jonathan). Even more of a sociopath than his father, Dio was resolute to shatter Jonathan's spirit and take his place as the favored son, even going so far as to arrange for Jonathan's dog [Danny](https://anilist.co/character/222601/Danny) to be burned to death. Initially, Dio is able earn the trust of the patriarch of the Joestar family through deceit (and at Jonathan's expense). However, his plans of taking over the Joestar household were discovered by Jonathan when he discovered that not only had Dio poisoned his biological father to death, he was doing the same to his adoptive father, all to take the Joestar estate for his own.

Determined not to be stopped, and understanding the potential to enjoy power over all things instead of just the Joestar estate, Dio wears and activates the Stone Mask, becoming a nearly unstoppable vampire. His gains supernatural abilities such as being able to walk on walls, and regenerating his body faster than fire can consume it. He is able to create two fluid jets from his eyes powerful enough to slice stone and kill living things. He is also able to vaporize his body fluid rapidly enough to freeze anything he touches. However, this is at the expense of having his body be sustained by sheer willpower alone, rather than vital energy. A sufficiently powerful vital force--specifically, sunlight or the Hamon force--will negate the sustaining force's presence and disintegrate the long-unliving body. Like all Jojo vampires, Dio sucks blood through tentacles in his fingers and has been seen at least once drinking blood from an unnamed girl.!~

name: Johnny Joestar
description:
Johnny Joestar is an American former jockey turned paraplegic, and is the main protagonist of Part 7. He is a depressive man with a bleak outlook on life, but he is also very stubborn and capable of extreme, unwavering determination to the point of disregarding any risks or consequences, putting his goal above all else. He joins the Steel Ball Run race to find out the secret behind [Gyro Zeppeli's](https://anilist.co/character/11772) steel balls, as Johnny believes they're capable of healing his legs.

Johnny was once a horse racing prodigy. However, when waiting in line for a play, the girl he was with convinced him to cut to the front of the line and bribe the bouncers to throw out the youth in the front of the line, who had been waiting there all night. Furious, the youth shot Johnny in the back, paralyzing him from the waist down.

~!Johnny earns a Stand named "Tusk" when they venture into the Devil's Palm as a result of their fight with [Dio](https://anilist.co/character/20148/Brando-Diego) and [Dr. Ferdinand](https://anilist.co/character/130205/Ferdinand-Hakase). Tusk is able to fire Johnny's spinning fingernails similar to a revolver, with the nails having to take a few seconds to regrow. This long range attack becomes his primary means of defense. His Stand is small in size and has the same star-pattern over it as on Johnny's clothing, it appears to reside inside of him and only comes out to offer advice. It cannot speak, only make animal-like noises.

Later in the series, Johnny masters Gyro's "Spin" technique and uses it with his Stand's fingernail bullets; at one time, even being able to use it on himself. His Stand also evolves although remaining similar in appearance, now able to fire from the toenails on Johnny's paralyzed feet. !~

name: Jousuke Higashikata
description:
Seemingly a sailor who is amnesiac about all details of his personal life.  For some reason, he has 4 testicles.

The real identity of this character is unknown. The second chapter stated that the Jojolion protagonist's name ~!could be Yoshikage Kira, however, it is later revealed that he is merely a doppelganger for the real [Kira](https://anilist.co/character/54055/Kira-Yoshikage).!~ He was later given the name Jousuke by the Higashikata family, who took him in. ~!However, DNA testing implies that they are nearly the same person.!~

name: Yasuho Hirose
description:
__Height__: 166 cm (5'5")
__Occupation__: University Student
__Stand__: Paisley Park

A young girl who lives in the town of Morioh in the new timeline of JoJo's Bizarre Adventure. After the events of the March 11th earthquake she finds a mysterious naked man lying under rubble and decides to save him.

name: Hermes Costello
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm
__Prisoner 
Number:__ FE40533
__Stand:__ Kiss

Hermes is a woman voluntarily imprisoned in Green Dolphin Street Prison in order to seek revenge for her sister Gloria Costello's killer, Sports Maxx, and soon allies herself with Jolyne Cujoh in the hostile environment that the jail is. Thanks to a certain pendant, Ermes acquires her own Stand, Kiss, which has the ability of duplication stickers.

name: Joubin Higashikata
description:
__Nationality__: Japanese

Jobin Higashikata is an antagonist featured in the eighth part of JoJo's Bizarre Adventure, JoJolion. 

Jobin is the eccentric eldest son of the Higashikata Family. He is married with Mitsuba Higashikata and has a son, Tsurugi. Beyond his job at the Higashikata Fruit Company, Jobin was formerly one of the members of the Rock Humans' Locacaca Organization. 

In his room, he keeps a large shelving unit full of display cases for exotic beetles. It is hinted that his fondness for beetles is the way they symbolize strength. He breeds beetles to make them fight and considers them to be gladiators when on the arena.

Jobin desires the power of the Locacaca, wishing to obtain it to rid his family of the Higashikata curse. This desire leads to him valuing the Locacaca and elimination of any in his way above everything else, even being unconcerned if Morioh itself were to be destroyed in the process.

Jobin is a Stand User and wields the mysterious Speed King. Little is known about Speed King's abilities other than its primary ability to store heat and temperature within a short localized point. This power can be weaponized and used to heat people's blood vessels, boiling the blood inside to render them unconscious or even kill them- when applied to the temples the heat can become so damaging the victim's eyes burst. Speed King is shown to be physically able enough to rapidly pummel enemies. The Stand also has other hidden abilities that Jobin keeps undisclosed, even to his own family.

~!He is later killed after seeing the Wonder of U user, Tooru staring at him. He was struck with a calamity by being shot to death by the dip tube of a spray that pierced his chest and instantly suffered from extreme blood loss.!~

name: Lucy Steel
description:
Lucy Steel is the wife of [Steven Steel](https://anilist.co/character/23652/Steel-Steven), the organizer of the Steel Ball Run race. Lucy is a kind, intelligent, and gentle girl who is extremely loyal to her husband. Although she appears nervous and meek, Lucy is incredibly courageous, resourceful, and determined.

~!Lucy's involvement with the story truly begins when [Funny Valentine](https://anilist.co/character/20147/Valentine-Funny) is introduced. Lucy finds out that Funny Valentine plans to gather the bones of "The Saint" for his own needs and also kill Steven Steel. Lucy goes to great lengths to prevent this from happening.!~

~!Later on, Lucy teams up with [Hot Pants](https://anilist.co/character/23650/Hot-Pants) to steal back the heart of Jesus's corpse from the president. Lucy disguises herself as the president's wife, but she is captured by Valentine, and is chosen by the corpse to be its user. This turns Lucy into an artificial Stand user that allows her to use its "holy field" ability that Valentine plans to use to become the leader of the world.!~

name: Tooru
description:
Tooru is a citizen of Morioh. During his high school years, he dated Yasuho and the two seem to have been very close. One year before the events of JoJolion, he broke up with her. He then became a part-time worker at TG University Hospital at an undisclosed date.

~!Tooru is later revealed to be the main antagonist of Part 8. He is a rock human and the mastermind of the Locacaca Organization. 

Tooru's stand, Wonder of U, is able to create illusions that can be sent after a specific target. It can disguise itself and take on the appearance of a human, allowing it to interact with non-stand users. It can also create projections of itself, which can travel quickly between locations by phasing into and appearing on transparent surfaces, such as windows or picture frames. Wonder of U's ability is automatic and can be activated on any person who has looked at its back in either an attempt to pursue it or otherwise moves toward it. While Wonder of U's ability is active, targets will experience various instances of conflict which seemingly play out in the most devastating way imaginable. These calamities often involve an affected person repeatedly colliding with objects in their environment, resulting in far greater injury than is possible under normal circumstances.!~

(Source: JoJoWiki)

name: Rai Mamezuku
description:
Rai Mamezuku is a reclusive plant appraiser secretly employed by the Higashikata Fruit Company. Rai is an eccentric, blunt, quick-witted, and analytical man who often comes across as cold-hearted. He is extremely antisocial, going to great lengths in order to stay isolated. His stand, Doggy Style, allows him to unravel his body into band-like cords.

~!He is struck by calamity after trying to attack Wonder of U, and as a result, is killed by Josuke's bubbles.!~

name: Yoshikage Kira
description:
Yoshikage Kira is a marine surgeon. He mostly acts cold and apathetic towards others, although he is not as heartless as he seems.

~!Yoshikage is Holy Joestar-Kira's son and Kei Nijimura's older brother. He underwent an equivalent exchange with Josefumi Kujo, fusing together to become Josuke Higashikata. He is also a stand user who wields Killer Queen.!~

name: Sandman
description:
Sandman is a participant in the Steel Ball Run race from a Native American tribe. Despite being ostracized, he hopes that winning the race will earn him the money to buy back his ancestor's land, and he quickly becomes one of the fiercest competitors in the race thanks to his running technique.

~!Sandman is a Stand User who wields In a Silent Way in battle, which can store sounds in objects or even people.!~

name: Norisuke Higashikata IV
description:
The current head of the Higashikata household and owner of the Higashikata Fruit Company. He is the father of Jobin, Hato, Joshuu, and Daiya Higashikata. 

~!His stand, King Nothing, can track specific smells.!~

name: Joushuu Higashikata
description: Joshu is the spoiled third of Norisuke Higashikata IV's four children and eventually rubs shoulders with Josuke Higashikata without truly becoming a friend. He has an unrequited crush on Yasuho Hirose. Joshu eventually awakens a Stand, Nut King Call.

name: Josefumi Kuujou
description:
~!__Stand__: Soft & Wet!~
__Nationality__: Japanese

Josefumi is a man of slim to medium build and seemingly average height. He is similar to Part 4's Josuke Higashikata in appearance, wearing metallic peace sign and heart pins on his clothes and styling his hair into a pompadour with the sides bleached. Josefumi wears a checker-patterned sweater over a loose-collared shirt with dark slacks.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

name: Daiya Higashikata
description:
Daiya is Norisuke Higashikata's youngest daughter. She is near-blind, and is an avid fan of progressive rock (in particular, Yes). She is extremely possessive of Josuke, and appears to be jealous of Yasuho for getting close to him.

~!When she was a child, she fell into a fault near the wall-eyes and gained a stand, California King Bed, which can steal people's memories and turn them into chess pieces. A memory can be stolen when a person lies to Daiya or tries to fool her. However, stolen memories return if she steps on that person's shadow.!~

name: Kei Nijimura
description:
Kei Nijimura is the Higashikata family's housekeeper. 

~!She is eventually revealed to be the daughter of Holy Joestar-Kira, making her Yoshikage Kira's younger sister. Kei is also a stand user who wields Born This Way, an automatic stand that produces freezing wind which activates when her target opens something.!~

name: Tsurugi Higashikata
description: Tsurugi Higashikata, the youngest member of the Higashikata family, is the son of Jobin and Mitsuba Higashikata. Tsurugi's stand, Paper Moon King, allows him to transform objects into origami and create illusions.

name: Kaato  Higashikata
description:
Kaato Higashikata is Norisuke Higashikata IV's ex-wife and the mother of Jobin, Hato, Joshu, and Daiya Higashikata. After being condemned to 15 years in jail for the murder of a child, Kaato is released and determined to be duly compensated for her time spent in prison.

~!Her stand, Space Trucking, allows her to store things in her deck of cards.!~

name: Satoru Akefu
description:
Satoru is the head doctor of TG University Hospital and presumed mastermind of the Locacaca Organization. Supposedly 89 years old, he is an elusive figure with almost no public presence despite being in charge of a major institution of medicine.

~!In reality, Satoru is a retired doctor of TG University Hospital who Tooru is impersonating with his stand. He supposedly recedes in a nursing home in the Ibaraki Prefecture, though it is implied he might have been killed.!~

(Source: Jojowiki)

name: Mitsuba Higashikata
description:
Mitsuba is the wife of Jobin Higashikata and the mother of Tsurugi Higashikata.

~!Her stand, Awaking III Leaves, allows her to to use arrows to change the directions of energy and objects.!~

name: Yotsuyu Yagiyama
description:
Yagiyama is a man of slim build and average to above-average height, claiming to be 28 years old. He has shoulder-length, straight black hair with short bangs. His eyes are black with small triangular highlights.

He wears a headpiece of leaves and a collar with a pin bearing the letter H. His arms, stomach, and legs are clad in a dark, leathery material studded with small metallic spikes. Over this, he wears a crop top and a pair of floral-printed bloomers. Attached to his belt is a small pouch.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

name: Tamaki Damo
description:
Tamaki Damo claims he is 23, though he appears much older, seeing as his hair is styled into a comb-over to hide his bald spot. His facial hair is styled into a goatee and horseshoe mustache. He is introduced wearing aviator sunglasses and a dark-colored tracksuit with spiked sleeves and an image of a saxophone on the left breast. He is much shorter than Hato and is considerably overweight.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

name: Hato Higashikata
description:
Hato is Norisuke Higashikata's eldest daughter. She's a model of some renown, and is quite proud of it. She gets into fights with Joshuu regularly.

~!Her stand, Walking Heart, allows her to lengthen her heels, turning them into deadly weapons.!~

name: Karera Sakunami
description:
Karera Sakunami is an agriculture student in love with Josefumi Kujo. She usually acts laid-back and carefree, but is also temperamental, crude, and unpredictable. Her stand, Love Love Deluxe, allows her to grow and manipulate hair.

Karera is a serial con artist who uses her ability to commit petty crimes and scams for her own benefit. She also has a characteristic wobbly staggering gait, always looking as if she is going to fall sideways when she walks.

name: Kiyotaka Ayanokouji
description:
__Height:__ 176 cm (5'9")

Ayanokouji is an inconspicuous and unobtrusive student. He is shown to be extremely intelligent and possesses a profound insight to study the emotions of people around him. Almost everything about his life prior to the entrance exams is unknown. He is shown to be extremely calculating and possessing superhuman intellect, perception, and strength. He's skilled at fighting and is able to easily manipulate the people around him. He is quite fond of his friends and protects those that he can without standing out. He has little regard for others' feelings and will coldly let them suffer to succeed, occasionally even his friends.

name: Suzune Horikita
description:
__Height:__ 156 cm (5'1")

A beautiful girl who sits next to [Ayanokouji](https://anilist.co/character/123212/Ayanokouji-Kiyotaka). She is the opposite of Ayanokouji when it comes to friendship; she disregards it and thinks of making friends unnecessary, thus she does not communicate much with her classmates. She is not convinced that she was placed in the D class, therefore she aims to get promoted to the A class.

name: Kei Karuizawa
description:
__Height:__ 154 cm (5'0")

She is a girl with a bad attitude who is located at the top of the D class hierarchy. She fights with [Kushida](https://anilist.co/character/123214/Kushida-Kikyou) for their class' top 2 places. Even though she gives off the impression of someone who is careless, arrogant, and messy, Kei's true self is very logical and astute with a sharp mind. She has remarkable ability to read the environment and the people around her, and makes the correct decision often.

name: Honami Ichinose
description:
__Height:__ 159 cm (5'2")

If there was one sentence to describe Honami, it would be that she is genuinely kind-hearted, benevolent, and a pacifist to the core who is against using underhanded means and violence. 

One of her main traits is her unselfish and supportive personality, combined with her excellent social skills and her being naturally people-oriented. Honami is also a charismatic and energetic person, and extends her sweet and benign character even to those of the lower classes, unlike many other upper-class students.

name: Arisu Sakayanagi
description:
__Height:__ 150 cm (4'11")

Arisu Sakayanagi is one of the class representatives of class 1-A along with [Kohei Katsuragi](https://anilist.co/character/207026). She suffers from congenital heart disease which limits her physical ability. 

She appears to possess a "go with the flow" attitude as she accepts most situations with no protest though she voices her dislike of boring situations after Katsuragi noted of the class scores. Unlike Kohei Katsuragi, who has a conservative stance, Arisu possesses an innovative attitude. Together, the pair effectively lead class A through the school years.

She enjoys situations she finds interesting as shown when she smiled at [Kakeru Ryuen](https://anilist.co/character/159627)'s declaration to rule the school or when she listened to the speech of [Suzune Horikita](https://anilist.co/character/123213) and found it amusing. In the light novels, Arisu enjoys toying with people as seen when she cryptically hinted to [Kiyotaka Ayanokoji](https://anilist.co/character/123212) of knowing him while he had voiced he never saw her before. Later on, while being together with [Honami Ichinose](https://anilist.co/character/123216), she also had the chance to show her confidence and complacency after [Teruhiko Yukimura](https://anilist.co/character/173450) of Ayanokoji Group boldly claimed that D-Class has the plan to overtake A-Class soon.

Additionally, although she has an easygoing personality, it was shown in the later part of the series that she's easily provoked when being described based on her petite appearance (e.g. "Little Girl") as she believes that it doesn't give her justice due to her domineering quality.

name: Airi Sakura
description:
__Height:__ 153 cm (5'0")

A girl who is into photography. She hates standing out and likes to take modeling pictures.

name: Kakeru Ryuuen
description:
__Height:__ 173 cm (5'8")

Kakeru Ryuuen is the class representative of class 1-C and is known for being an infamous delinquent. He does not lead his class by trust, but rather by fear. He has a group of henchmen who do his dirty work, which contributes to his fearsome reputation.

name: Sae Chabashira
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm

The homeroom teacher of the protagonist's class (D). She is originally indifferent to her class, doing almost nothing to help them in the battle between classes, and remains unmotivated for the most part.

name: Hiyori Shiina
description:
Hiyori Shiina is one of the students of Class 1-C who is a loner.

She's a quiet girl, though sometimes she is seen occasionally smiling. She always carries books with her in her bag in case she meets someone who shares the same interest in literature as her. Since nobody in class 1-C is into literature, she doesn't have anyone to talk to. She always speaks politely. She dislikes how the classes are competing with each other, wanting everyone to be friends.

~! She encounters Kiyotaka in the library, and they find themselves having the same taste in books. As she always wanted a friend who has similar interests as her, their friendship gradually blossoms and she refers to him as her "reading buddy". She slowly starts developing romantic feelings for Kiyotaka.!~

name: Kikyou Kushida
description:
__Height:__ 155 cm

She boasts tremendous popularity among men and women as the D class' idol. She aims to be friends with everyone not just in D class. She wants to get along well with her classmate, [Horikita](https://anilist.co/character/123213/Horikita-Suzune).

name: Rokusuke Kouenji
description:
Rokusuke Kouenji is one of the students of class 1-D. He came from a well-known family of scholars. However, he ended up in D-Class for his egotistical behavior.

~!In Year 1, Volume 11, he watches a scuffle between [Hirata](https://anilist.co/character/123218/Hirata-Yousuke) and [Mii-Chan](https://anilist.co/character/136233/Wang-MeiYu), which ended with Hirata pushing a desperate Mii-Chan, who was trying to help him, on the ground. Kouenji then intervenes and states his annoyance at Hirata "for treating a girl wrong" referring him as "like a fly, very irritating". His friendship with Mii-Chan is then showed to progress in Year 2, Volume 5, when they are seen walking together often, and Mii-chan referring to him as "someone easy to talk to" when asked about their relationship by [Satou](https://anilist.co/character/163519/Satou-Maya) and [Matsushita](https://anilist.co/character/191401/Matsushita-Chiaki).!~

~!During the Second Year Uninhabited Island Special Exam, he strikes an agreement with [Suzune Horikita](https://anilist.co/character/123213/Horikita-Suzune), in which he would try for a first-place finish and Suzune would reward him with complete protection from class vote expulsion until graduation and exempt him from being forced to co-operate with the rest of the class, which he wins.!~

name: Manabu Horikita
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm (5'10")

He is the leader of the school council and is [Horikita Suzune](https://anilist.co/character/123213/Horikita-Suzune)'s elder brother.

name: Maya Satou
description:
She is a student of class 1-D. 

~!In Volume 7.5, Maya asks for [Kei Karuizawa](https://anilist.co/character/141122/Karuizawa-Kei)'s help to plan her "date" with [Kiyotaka Ayanokouji](https://anilist.co/character/123212/Ayanokouji-Kiyotaka). Kei was surprised and suggested other boys to her, but she refused, and said that she only liked Kiyotaka. She told her plan to Kei and made some changes according to her suggestions. She then later asked Kei if they could make it a "double-date", by including her and [Yousuke Hirata](https://anilist.co/character/123218/Hirata-Yousuke) in the plan. Eventually, Kei agreed and decided to schedule the double date on December 25.

She confessed to Kiyotaka after the double date during Christmas, but was rejected and ran away crying. They promised each other that they will hang out again in the future and wants to see each other again but Maya couldn’t hold her feelings and excused herself first as she didn’t want him to see her in a pathetic state. She was hinted to have cried an innumerable amount of times behind closed doors after being rejected as the next time we saw her, she was able to frankly tell her friends she was rejected without being choked up. Her friends summarised that this could only had happened if she had come to terms with the rejection showing an immense amount of willpower to move on. That said, she still harbours feelings for Kiyotaka and has admitted that she finds him way cooler and hotter than Hirata not holding against Kei for liking the same person. She still feels conflicted that her best friend was in a relationship with her crush but decided to uphold their secret and support them in whatever way she can.!~

~!Maya has below average academic abilities as was apparent during the Paper Shuffle special exam. Her physical abilities are of the lower echelon as well. However, she is one of more popular girls in her class. Although not to the tier of Kei, many observers were astonished to see someone like her talk to and publicly flirt with the 'uninteresting' Kiyotaka. She is also out-going and not afraid to take risks such as confessing to Kiyotaka on their first date.!~

name: Haruka Hasebe
description:
Haruka is a pretty normal person, but she is not very open to other people as shown when she didn't participate in the class's swimming session where she tends to prefer keeping to herself and not bothering people, simply to avoid trouble. She is considered to have good looks and is often viewed lustfully by boys, thus wanting to seclude herself. She is mostly seen wearing the school's uniform, with the difference that she has the upper button of her shirt undone and her tie relatively loosened. She prefers giving people nicknames the moment she meets them, which is said by Kushida to be a method for her "to appear closer to the people she isn't close to". 

~! In Year 2, Volume 5, Haruka is told off by Kushida when she tries to help the latter. She is then seen aggressively opposing the motion by Ayanokoji to expel Airi Sakura, being her closest friend, to no avail. She is one of the 4 remaining members and the sole remaining girl of the Ayanokoji Group.!~

name: Mio Ibuki
description: Mio Ibuki is a student of class 1-C. Not only does she possess excellent academic qualities, but her physical ability is also not to be underestimated. She is skilled in combat, having the knowledge of several martial skills that can rival those of many martial artists.

name: Yousuke Hirata
description:
__Height:__ 174 cm (5'8")

The social leader of the D class. He has excellent academic and athletic ability, and is considered extremely handsome by his classmates, he is shown to be extremely compassionate and puts others before himself, considering everybody equal. He is considered a perfect male student and his placement in the D-class is originally considered a mystery.

name: Chiaki Matsushita
description:
Matsushita is one of the students of class 2-D. She has a quiet older sister type of personality. She is generally kind to all the boys and girls alike, but she does not actively go out to make friends.

~!Chiaki had believed from early on in the first year that Class D had no hopes of ever reaching Class A and thus resigned herself to a carefree school life, never putting in any real effort into her academics. She considers herself to be a major underachiever, believing that she could easily score in the top 10% of her class if she truly tried to, but believed it to be pointless as long as she was in Class D. Later on in the light novels, she starts seeing improvements in the class and becomes willing to start contributing to the class. She is also known to be skilled at mental arithmetic and can calculate quickly. She even held her own against Kouhei Katsuragi from Class A in the Mental Arithmetic event in the Event Selection Exam.!~

~!Later, in her monologue, she states that she had started to pay close attention to Kiyotaka after the end of year special exam, but she was not romantically interested in him. According to her, she was probably among the top 10% of students in their year, but had not revealed her abilities since she did not want people to be jealous of her. She had thought that even if she tried her best, the chance of Class-D being able to rank up the classes was minimal. However, after closely observing Kiyotaka, she had arrived at the conclusion that Class-D might be able to reach the higher classes if both she and Kiyotaka tried and used their complete abilities. By observing Kei's behavior in class, she was able to deduce that she was attracted to Kiyotaka, and the only logical solution to this change of liking from Hirata to Kiyotaka would be that Kiyotaka was actually very gifted.!~

name: Ken Sudou
description:
__Height:__ 183 cm (6'0")

Ken is apart of Class 1-D and is apart of the Basketball Club. Due to his poor academic ability, he is referred to as one of the 3 Idiots of D-Class. Regardless of this, his athletic ability is without a doubt one of the best among the school. He has a crush on Suzune after receiving help from her. Under the constant supervision of Suzune, he gradually matures and begins to improve academically rising out of the bottom ladder of class and earning her trust.

name: Albert Yamada
description: Albert Yamada is one of the students of Class 1-C.

name: Akane Tachibana
description: Akane Tachibana is a former student of Advanced Nurturing High School who has graduated from Class 3-A and the former secretary of the Student Council.

name: Chie Hoshinomiya
description: Chie Hoshinomiya is the homeroom teacher of class 1-B. She has a cheerful, flirty personality and is referred to as "never having grown from her high school days" by Ayanokoji. She shows glimpses of a more serious side of hers upon matters relating to reaching Class-A. She was a classmate of her colleague Sae Chabashira during their time in the Advanced Nurturing High School.

name: Mei-Yu Wang
description: Mei-Yu is of Chinese descent and is shown to be one of the academically gifted students. She has a visible crush on Hirata Yosuke.

name: Nazuna Asahina
description:
Nazuna Asahina is a student of Class 3-A at the Advanced Nurturing High School. 
 
Nazuna has rough mannerisms, but she is very well liked and influential within the 2nd years who is laid-back and playful, but she is also dutiful and never forgets to repay a debt made to her. She has a habit of judging people too quickly as seen with Kiyotaka Ayanokōji when she assumed him to be a pitiable flirt, when really he was a good person who retrieved her most precious belonging. She is ashamed and embarrassed with herself for thinking that.
 
She possesses an amulet to which she cares for very much. She believes it to be an object of good luck, and it give her great mental strength when she has it on her. She claims it be a harbinger of destiny that not only watches over romance, but brings people together in a fated encounter.
 
She is close to Miyabi Nagumo, but unlike her fellow second years, she does not idolize him despite being in the same class

name: Masumi Kamuro
description: Masumi Kamuro is a student of Class 2-A and a member of the Art Club. She is one of the members of the inner circle of Sakayanagi faction but is shown to be only interested in doing so as Sakayanagi has some information about her criminal history.

name: Miyabi Nagumo
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm (5'10")

Miyabi Nagumo is a student of Class 3-A at Advanced Nurturing High School
~!Succeeds Manabu Horikita as the Student Council President.!~

name: Geu Sonyeon
description: The boy who lost their parents live with one hope: that he can walk with the [girl](https://anilist.co/character/197692/Geu-Sonyeo) forever...until they come across adults who are trying to take that hope away.

name: Geu Sonyeo
description:
The girl who lost her father due to an infectious disease, contracted from someone on the bus who they ventured with.
Meets the boy unexpectedly on the bus, and together they walk on the path for as long as they can.

name: Jeongjangeul Ibeun Namja
description:
He used to be a doctor. He has excellent marksmanship skills and knowledge of weaponry, picking off one by one the soldiers who kidnap the children, and setting explosive traps within the city. He provides the children with shelter and food and treats their wounds, asking for help with finding and exterminating trespassers in exchange. He believes that every person carrying a gun does so with the intent to kill, and must be eliminated.
~!The meat he and the children eat comes from the bodies of those he has killed.!~

name: Sonyeoui Abeoji
description: After the war, him and his daughter are the only surviving members of their family. They manage to get on a bus with several other people, traveling from place to place in search of safety. He is a kind man who tries to take his daughter's mind off the gloom of their new lives. ~!He also succumbs to the infectious disease contracted from one of the passengers.!~

name: Unjeonsa
description: He drives the bus used by a group of people who managed to escape the war. A former soldier who saw his friends die in battle, he is a pragmatic but compassionate man of few words. He looks after the girl after her father leaves the bus.

name: Haebyeonga Yeoja
description:
A woman who lives along the seaside with her partner.
~!The Boy meets the couple as an old man and is reminded of the two children he met in the forest long ago. Though initially reluctant, he eventually becomes friends with this couple and their child.!~

name: Supsogui Sonyeo
description: She travels with a boy who seems to be around her age; both speak the same language, which the Boy and Girl don't understand.

name: Eolini
description:
The child of the seaside couple.
~!She considers The Boy (now an old man) to be her grandfather.!~

name: Soseolga
description: He is among the few who managed to escape the war, using a bus to travel from place to place in search of safety. He correctly diagnoses an old man as suffering from an incurable infectious disease, and succumbs to it himself shortly after the old man. In a wedding photo, his parents are shown to be of Indian descent.

name: Haebyeonga Namja
description:

~!The Boy meets the couple as an old man and is reminded of the two children he met in the forest long ago. Though initially reluctant, he eventually becomes friends with this couple and their child.!~

name: Isanghan Namja
description: A man whom the boy and the girl meet on their journey. The girl takes pity and lets him follow them, while the boy feels uneasy about his presence and suggests they try to shake him off. He behaves in a manner resembling a chimpanzee (only makes high-pitched noises, snatches the children's supplies, eats raw meat, and doesn't seem to understand or respond in human language). ~!His only spoken words are cries of pain as he lay dying after accidentally stepping on a hidden landmine while chasing after the children.!~

name: Supsogui Sonyeon
description:
He travels with a girl who seems to be around his age; speak the same language, which the Boy and Girl don't understand. ~!When the two pairs meet for the first time, the boys hold each other at gunpoint, unsure of the others' intentions, but the girls defuse the situation.!~
~!However, when a missile explodes in the vicinity, the boys are startled into firing their weapons. He is killed and his partner immediately commits suicide after witnessing his death.!~

name: Angyeongeul Sseun Yeoja
description: She is among the few who managed to escape the war, using a bus to travel from place to place in search of safety. She usually sits by herself in silence. ~!When the novelist discovers that he is infected with the same disease that had taken another passenger's life, and voluntarily leaves the bus, she falls into a deep depression and refuses to eat. She ends up committing suicide shortly after.!~

name: Noin
description: He is among the few who managed to escape the war, using a bus to travel from place to place in search of safety. ~!He suffers from an unnamed infectious disease which proves to be terminal and highly contagious, first manifesting through a persistent cough and eventually through necrotic tissue. He is the first to leave the bus once the second stage manifests, though by that point it's already too late for the others.!~

__Height__: 167 cm

name: Roxy Migurdia
description:
Roxy Migurdia is a talented mage from the Migurd race, and a former magic tutor. Because she can't use telepathy, she left her village due to feeling isolated from her peers. Unable to make a stable living as an adventurer, she became a travelling tutor and eventually becomes [Rudeus'](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat) teacher.

~!She is Rudeus' second wife and gives birth to their daughter [Lara](https://anilist.co/character/273376/Greyrat-Lara) & [Lily](https://anilist.co/character/321620/Greyrat-Lily). She is one of the three goddesses Rudeus worships in his religion. Her panties that serves as a relic for the Goddess of Wisdom is enshrined in the basement.!~

name: Rudeus Greyrat
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5'9")

Rudeus is a tall, well-built, and cool-looking man. However, before his reincarnation, he was originally an overweight 34-year-old Japanese NEET who became a recluse following his high-school persecution. Because of his former life, he is careful not to get carried away and become arrogant. As a result, he is extremely self-aware and humble because he does not want to revert to his old self. He is a kind person, helping his friends and protecting his family whenever needed. Due to being capable in many fields, people have high expectations of him. His body possesses a high affinity for magic. Rudeus is very polite to others, often to the point of making them uncomfortable.

Rudeus is one of the few people capable of using voiceless magic, and even rarer as someone who can use voiceless incantation with melded magics. He cannot use voiceless incantation for healing magic due to his lack of understanding in regards to how mana is manipulated to heal. A normal Magician takes at least five seconds for a simple spell, while for higher-level spells it's thirty to sixty seconds. Rudeus can do it almost instantly no matter what the difficulty of the spell, with the exception of healing magic.

name: Eris Boreas Greyrat
description:
Eris Boreas Greyrat is a noble girl and distant relative of [Rudeus](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat). She is a tsundere with a short temper but has potential in the Sword-God style.

~!She is Rudeus' third wife and gives birth to their son [Ars](https://anilist.co/character/273378/Greyrat-Ars) and daughter [Christina](https://anilist.co/character/278862/Greyrat-Christina). She is one of the three goddesses Rudeus worships in his religion. A wooden sword that serves as a relic for the Goddess of War is enshrined in the basement.!~

name: Sylphiette
description:
Sylphiette is [Rudeus'](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat) childhood friend who is part human, elf, and beast race.

~!Following the teleportation incident, during which her hair turned white from mana exhaustion, she became Princess Ariel's personal bodyguard under the alias Fitz.!~

~!She is Rudeus' first wife and gives birth to their daughter [Lucy](https://anilist.co/character/188846/Greyrat-Lucy) and son [Sieghardt](https://anilist.co/character/273377/Greyrat-Saladin-Sieghardt). She is one of the three goddesses Rudeus worships in his religion. A cloth stained with her virgin blood that serves as a relic for the Goddess of Love is enshrined in the basement.!~

name: Ruijerd Superdia
description:
Ruijerd Superdia is the former leader of the Superd's Warrior group whom once served under Laplace with unwavering loyalty. He was accompanying [Rudeus](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat) and [Eris](https://anilist.co/character/88349/Eris-Boreas-Greyrat).

~!Laplace betrayed his group by giving them each a devil spear which made them ecstatic from killing, even their own family. After giving his son a fatal wound, his son managed to destroy the devil spear and Ruijerd finally wakes up from the brainwash. He considered committing suicide but decided not to and everyone of that warrior group swore revenged on Laplace.

He finally got his revenge after several years of hiding. He interfered in the battle between Laplace and the three heroes. But even if Laplace was defeated, there was no way to change the things that had already transpired.

After exacting his revenge, he now has a goal of removing the infamy the Superd race has.!~

name: Ghislaine Dedoldia
description: __Ghislaine Dedoldia__ is the daughter of Gustav the former Doldia village chief, and the mentor of [Eris](https://anilist.co/character/88349/Eris-Boreas-Greyrat) and she is also the student of [Rudeus Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat) in magic and other subjects. She is one of the few people who have become a Sword King.

name: Paul Greyrat
description: Paul Greyrat is the father of [Rudeus Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat), [Norn Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/145458/Greyrat-Norn) and [Aisha Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/145459/Greyrat-Aisha). He is both a talented man that became advanced in all three sword arts at a young age and a lustful man that attracts and sleeps with many women before [Zenith](https://anilist.co/character/179855/Zenith-Greyrat) chained him down.

name: Orsted
description:
Orsted is the current Dragon God, 2nd-ranked of the 7 World Powers, and the sworn enemy of [Hitogami](https://anilist.co/character/211165/Hitogami). Similar to other Dragon Race people such as [Perugius](https://anilist.co/character/209572/Perugius-Dola), he has silver hair and golden sanpaku eyes with an overpowering look. He carries no visible equipment and wears a white coat adorned with fur.

Orsted has a curse that makes every living being feel an overwhelming fear just from being within his presence. Strangely enough, this curse does not affect [Rudeus](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat) or [Nanahoshi](https://anilist.co/character/137816/Nanahoshi-Shizuka).

name: Aisha Greyrat
description: Aisha Greyrat is the daughter of [Lilia](https://anilist.co/character/179854/Lilia) and [Paul Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/88347/Paul-Greyrat) and is the younger half-sister of [Rudeus Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat) and [Norn Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/145458/Norn-Greyrat).

name: Zenith Greyrat
description:
Zenith Greyrat is the wife of [Paul Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/88347) and the mother of [Rudeus Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/88348) and [Norn Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/145458/Norn-Greyrat).

~!Zenith was born in the Holy Country of Milis, as the second daughter of an earl of Milis. She grew up following the Milis Church religion, never breaking the rules, getting good grade in school, and had nickname Milis young lady standard. But, when Zenith reached the age of 15, she rebelled against her parents and ran away from home.

While trying to find a job as a Healer, she was a solo adventurer for a time. However she was frequently conned out of a large amount of money due to the little knowledge she had on how expensive healer's are, but was saved by Paul Greyrat. She then join Paul's party, the Fangs of the Black Wolf, as a healer. She spent a long time in the party as a healer and gradually began to fall in love with Paul and wanted to marry him. However Paul was a womanizer who frequently slept with multiple women and she didn't want to be with someone like that so she told him if he promised to be faithful to her then she would sleep with him, to which he agreed.
Shortly after, she became pregnant with Rudeus and as a result both her and Paul retired from adventuring and settled down in the countryside.!~


__Light Novel Volume 13 Spoiler__
~!After being freed from the Teleport Labyrinth, she does not express emotions actively since she sees the world around her as if she were in a trance or dream. Occasionally she will display actions that show her emotions, such as when she smiled at Norn or hit Rudeus when he said he was going to add Eris to his family as a wife, which shows signs of her personality basically unchanged but hidden and suppressed by her dream state caused by her Miko Powers.!~

name: Elinalise Dragonroad
description: Elinalise is a former member of Paul's party. She has an erotic nature due to her curse. She is a warrior that is good at managing monster aggro but isn't a great fighter.

name: Shizuka Nanahoshi
description:
__Light Novel Volume 9 spoiler__

~! Nanahoshi Shizuka is a Japanese girl that was saved by [Rudeus](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat) in his past life, but instead of reincarnating like Rudeus, she was teleported to Asura Kingdom and was saved by [Orsted](https://anilist.co/character/187382/Orsted). !~

name: Lilia
description:
Lilia is a maid of the Greyrat household. She was [Paul](https://anilist.co/character/88347/Paul-Greyrat)'s classmate in a swordsman dojo. A crippling injury forces her to leave her position as a princess guard, and she becomes a maid to Paul and [Zenith](https://anilist.co/character/179855/Zenith-Greyrat).

~!After working through the revelation with the family, she is taken in as Paul's second wife and becomes closer friends with Zenith. Lillia gets pregnant with Paul's daughter and becomes the mother of [Aisha Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/145459/Aisha-Greyrat)!~

name: Norn Greyrat
description: Norn Greyrat is the daughter of [Zenith Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/179855/Zenith-Greyrat) and [Paul Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/88347/Paul-Greyrat) and is the younger sister of [Rudeus Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/88348) and older half-sister of [Aisha Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/145459/Aisha-Greyrat).

name: Zanoba  Shirone
description: Zanoba Shirone is a doll loving prince of Shirone. When he was three years old, he killed his brother, the Fourth prince, as if his brother was a doll. When he was 15 years old, he killed his wife, as if she was a doll.

name: Kishirika Kishirisu
description:
Kishirika Kishirisu is The Great Empress of the Demon Realm. She is the demon empress known for her demon eyes' powers and the ability to bestow others with demon eyes. She is engaged to [Badigadi](https://anilist.co/character/262620/Badigadi), the demon lord of immortality.

__Light Novel Volume 4 Spoiler__
~!Kishirika Kishirisu is the person that is responsible for giving [Rudeus](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat) his demon eye, among other favors!~

name: Ariel Asura
description: Second Princess of the Asura Kingdom. She is hardly ever seen without her two bodyguards, [Luke](https://anilist.co/character/226703) and "[Silent Fitz](https://anilist.co/character/88346)". After surviving many assassination attempts, she and her bodyguards flee to The Magic City of Sharia and enroll at  the Ranoa Magic Academy.

name: Geese Nukadia
description:
Geese is of the Magic Race, the last surviving tribe member, heritage and is introduced into the series when his and Rudeus's paths collide in a shared jail cell located in the Great Forest. Rudeus address Geese by the nickname of "Newbie" during their time together. He is a Jack of all Trades that can do almost everything, except fighting for the most part.

~!He's a former member of the adventurer party "Fang of the Black Wolf", a party in which Paul and Zenith were former members of. Geese vowed to never teach another woman cooking again after he taught Zenith, which lead to the eventual demise of the party. The connection being that Zenith wanted to impress Paul and after succeeding they left the party which lead to the dissolution.!~

name: Hitogami
description:
Hitogami is the Man God, having the power to see into the future, and the sworn enemy of [Orsted](https://anilist.co/character/187382). He has a blank white face coupled with a grin that eludes memory, which gives off the feeling that his face is covered in a mosaic. He helps [Rudeus](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat) throughout key points in his journey.

~!Hitogami later becomes the overarching antagonist of the series following the revelation that he actually sought to prevent the birth of Rudeus' children, who are prophesied to kill him one day.!~

~!Hitogami's exact origins are unknown, however it is known that after the Creator God's death, unbeknownst to anyone, he was born within the Void World. At some point in the distant past, the being who would come to be known as Hitogami killed or otherwise usurped the original Man God and took his form. He then began manipulating the Dragon God and his five Dragon Generals into destroying the other four worlds and then proceeded to help the survivors of those ruined world to flee into the human world.!~

name: Rokari Migurdia
description: [Roxy](https://anilist.co/character/88350)'s mother and [Rowin](https://anilist.co/character/211181)'s wife.

name: Perugius Dola
description: Perugius Dola is one of the heroes who banished Demon God Laplace.

name: Sauros Boreas Greyrat
description:
__Sauros Boreas Greyrat__ was the Landlord of the Fittoa Region, Asura Kingdom and the grandfather of [Eris](https://anilist.co/character/88349/Eris-Boreas-Greyrat).

~!After the Teleport Incident, he was blamed for the loss of the Fittoa Region and was executed.!~

(Source: Mushoku Tensei Wiki)

name: Luke Notos Greyrat
description:
Luke Notos Greyrat is the second prince of the Asura kingdom Ariel Anemoi Asura's personal guardian and also holds the status of Knight. 
He's also the cousin of Rudeus Greyrat, but from another of the four different branch families in the Greyrat genus, namely the Notos family.

name: Minitona Dedoldia
description: Daughter of the tribe warrior chief [Gyes Dedoldia](https://anilist.co/character/251607).

name: Osamu Dazai
description:
**Height:** 181 cm (5'11")
**Ability:** No Longer Human

A member of the Armed Detective Agency. He's a suicide enthusiast who searches for a place to die. However, he doesn't like pain, and would prefer a lovers' suicide with a beautiful woman. He's aimless, elusive, nonchalant, and jokes around normally, but, when he is serious, it is clear that he is an insightful and intelligent individual. He loves to annoy his fellow Agency member, [Kunikida](https://anilist.co/character/89200).

~!He was a former Executive of the city's worst underworld organization, the Port Mafia.!~

name: Chuuya Nakahara
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3")

Chuuya is a Port Mafia member who detests [Osamu Dazai](https://anilist.co/character/89198) for betraying the mafia and joining the Armed Detective Agency. He's also constantly teased by Dazai what makes him hate Dazai even more. Chuuya is short but he's quick and uses powerful martial arts. 

His ability, "For The Tainted Sorrow," revolves around gravity manipulation, allowing him to manipulate and alter the gravity of anything he touches, keeping it that way until a certain period of time.

name: Paul Verlaine
description: Paul Verlaine is the antagonist in the light novel STORM BRINGER.

name: Adam Frankenstein
description: Adam Frankenstein or simply by his code name, Adam is a humanoid computer whose goal is to arrest Paul Verlaine. He wears a blue suit and carries a black badge which contains information about himself. He is a detective from Europole (Europe Detective Police Organization) and is made by an ability technician named Dr. Wollstonecraft. He was sent in Japan to carry out his mission in arresting Paul Verlaine and protecting Chūya Nakahara.

name: Hiroto Ikuta
description: A freeter. He works part-time at a fishing place. He has no girlfriend, but old ladies seem to really like him.

name: Natsumi Kobayashi
description: An art student at a university in Tokyo. She lives with her cousin [Hiroto](https://anilist.co/character/253838/).

name: Yomogi Tachibana
description: She works in real estate and is annoyed by [Hiroto](https://anilist.co/character/253838/)'s carefree attitude.

name: Akari Yokoyama
description: [Natsumi](https://anilist.co/character/253841/)'s friend and a student at the same department as her. She was born in Fukuoka, and just like Natsumi, she was unable to make any friends after entering university.

name: Hanae Wada
description: An eccentric but kind old woman with gray hair and glasses. She met [Hiroto](https://anilist.co/character/253838/) by chance and started having dinner together every Monday and Thursday. After her death, she gave Hiroto the house she had been living in.

name: Hideki Noguchi
description: A friend of [Hiroto](https://anilist.co/character/253838/)'s since high school who runs a furniture store. He has been married for one year and is about to become a father.

name: Eri
description:
She is the girl that [Yuuta](https://anilist.co/character/270546/Itou-Yuuta) meets on the hospital roof where he was about to commit suicide.

She likes movies and chooses to exploit her passion to help Yuuta create a movie himself.

name: Yuuta Itou
description: A boy tasked to film his mother's disease battle.

name: Yuuta no Haha
description: She is suffering from an unspecified terminal illness and asks her son to record her final months.

name: Yuuta no Tomodachi
description: She is friends with Yuuta and Eri. After Dead Mother Explosion is aired at the school festival, she criticizes the ending but expresses understanding about the rest, as her own mother had passed a year before.

name: Tauchi
description: A nurse who is close to Yuuta's mother and presumably treats her. Yuuta mispronounces her name as "Taguchi".

name: Kana Arima
description:
__Height:__ 150 cm (4'11")

An actress who was called a prodigy child. She has a rather stubborn personality yet an empathic side to her. She easily succumbs to pressure and while she does put up a front to others, she has very self-deprecating thoughts when it comes to her abilities. She's an honest and earnest person, who is very diligent and persistent even in the roughest of times. Also, she tends to place all responsibility on herself when it comes to others as she is the one who has the most experience in the show business world. She also hates bell peppers.
  
~!After the events of the Sweet Today Drama adaptation, she secretly develops a crush for [Aquamarine](https://anilist.co/character/183885/Hoshino-Aquamarine).!~

~!She longs for someone to look at her for who she is now and praise her efforts, someone to say that its okay for her to be here. And after the new B-Komachi's first concert, that person becomes Aquamarine after he waves her respected colored glow stick. Only reinforcing Kana's resolve to make Aquamarine fall for her.!~

name: Ai Hoshino
description:
__Height__: 151 cm (4'11")

She's an idol and lead of B-Komachi, an idol group affiliated with Strawberry Productions. Her life took a turn when through an undetermined amount of time, she became pregnant with twins. Not wanting to squander her reputation, she and her team decide to hide this fact; having to play the role of idol and mother.

name: Akane Kurokawa
description:
__Height:__ 163 cm (5'4")

Akane Kurokawa is a rising star actress from the Lalalie Theatrical Company. Although a shy and quiet person, she is very serious when it comes to creating a good performance. She does a deep examination of each role she is given, allowing her to perfectly portray the character's personality and motivations. Akane is introduced to [Aqua](https://anilist.co/character/183885) as a fellow cast member on the set of the reality dating show *The Beginning of My Love With An Idol*.

name: Aquamarine Hoshino
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm (5'7")

[Ai Hoshino's](https://anilist.co/character/172759/Ai-Hoshino) son. He is the twin big brother of [Ruby Hoshino](https://anilist.co/character/183884/Ruby-Hoshino).

~!He was previously a doctor named Goro, who became a fan of Ai through his patient named Sarina.!~ 

~!After reincarnating as Aquamarine and witnessing Ai's murder, he is intent on plotting revenge to the person who schemed Ai's death.!~

name: Ruby Hoshino
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm (5'2")

[Ai Hoshino's](https://anilist.co/character/172759/Ai-Hoshino) daughter, and the younger twin sister of [Aquamarine Hoshino](https://anilist.co/character/183885). 

~!She was previously a patient named Sarina under Goro's care. Due to her illness, she was wheelchair-bound. After discovering B-Komachi, she had always aspired to be an idol although her condition kept her from achieving her dream. Since being reincarnated as Ruby, she is now working towards her dream of being an idol like Ai. To do so she's currently working with Strawberry Productions to revive B-Komachi along with Arima Kana and Memcho.!~

name: MEM-cho
description:
__Height:__ 155 cm (5'1")

A girl who strived to become an idol at a young age, but due to her family situation, made sacrifices that ultimately ended with her becoming too old to become one. She is a YouTuber. 

~!Mem-cho's real age is 25, and she is later recruited as the third member of the re-formed B-Komachi idol group.!~

name: Miyako Saitou
description:
Miyako is married to [the president](https://anilist.co/character/245521) of Ichigo Productions and is [Ai's](https://anilist.co/character/172759) manager. She is a shallow woman who appears to have only married her husband due to the prospect of working with hot guys. She is also a babysitter to the twins.

~!After Ai's death, she becomes the twin's adoptive parent. As the twins blossom into adolescence, she becomes more mature, both as a caretaker and as a manager. She is also the manager of the new B-Komachi.!~

name: Abiko Samejima
description: Author of "Tokyo Blade".

name: Taishi Gotanda
