name: Yotsugi Ononoki
description:
**Occupation:** Oddity Specialist

Yotsugi Ononoki is an expressionless human corpse tsukumogami and the shikigami familiar of [Yozuru Kagenui](https://anilist.co/character/57501/).

Despite appearing almost entirely stoic, she still has hinted at feeling genuine emotion. She's mentioned how she considers [Koyomi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/) her friend on multiple occasions, such as when giving him advice "as a friend" as opposed to as an oddity specialist. She's also expressed how she wouldn't want to have to harm him despite needing to follow orders as a shikigami.

She has an ability called Unlimited Rulebook which allows her finger to shape-shift and cause explosions. She also seems to have a type of super strength, being able to to carry Kagenui and others using only one finger.

She also has an appreciation for muscles.

(Source: Monogatari Fandom)

name: Sodachi Oikura
description:
[Koyomi Araragi's](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Araragi-Koyomi) childhood friend. She is a student with a strong sense of competitiveness which led to her popular nickname, much to her chagrin.

Sodachi was the president of a first-year class where both [Hitagi](https://anilist.co/character/22037/Senjougahara-Hitagi) and Koyomi also belonged to. At school, she wanted to be called as "Euler", but ends up getting the nickname "How Much", a pun on her surname and a reference to her personality.

~!When she tried to figure out the culprit who stole the answers for the mathematics test, everyone voted Oikura as the culprit. She stopped going to school after the incident.

In her first year of middle school, she taught Araragi mathematics during summer break, with her being the reason for Araragi being good at math. But she had her motives for doing so. She wished Araragi would notice the domestic violence occurring in her household and for him to report this to his parents, who are cops.

Oikura and Araragi had even met when they were in sixth grade when his parents brought her over to stay with them. She ran away from his household shortly after.

She later transferred away from Naoetsu High School, having to reintegrate herself with a new school, which turned out to be very difficult for her.!~

name: Tsukihi Araragi
description:
__Height:__ 156 cm   

Tsukihi, the main character of Tsukihi Phoenix, is one of [Koyomi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi)'s sisters. She's the youngest of Araragi family. Unlike her sister, [Karen](https://anilist.co/character/24194/Karen-Araragi), she is always doing indoor activities. Contrary to her personality, she constantly changes her hair style and is short-tempered to the point that Koyomi describes her as having hysteria.    ~!She is actually the reincarnation of a phoenix and has been since before she was even born. The phoenix entered the baby's body when it was still in the womb and by now both beings' minds have become one. She is immortal and the only thing that end her life is a natural death from old age. It was hinted that [Kaiki](https://anilist.co/character/53641/Deishuu-Kaiki) was the one who sent [Kagenui](https://anilist.co/character/57501/Yozuru-Kagenui) and [Ononoki](https://anilist.co/character/57499/Yotsugi-Ononoki) to go after Tsukihi. Tsukihi and Karen are nicknamed Tsuga no Ki Nichū no Fire Sisters (栂の木二中のファイヤーシスターズ). It was revealed that the reason she and Karen found boyfriends was so that Koyomi would become jealous. They found boyfriends in Koyomi's image with Tsukihi's boyfriend being taller than her. She and Karen also thought that Koyomi's girlfriend was [Tsubasa](https://anilist.co/character/22055/Tsubasa-Hanekawa). Koyomi, Karen and Tsukihi's parents were revealed to be police officers. !~

name: Mai Sakurajima
description:
__Height:__ 162 cm (5'4")

A 3rd-year student at Minegahara High School. She is serious and polite, but has a strong will.

Well known, famous actress, who is currently on hiatus. Because her life had always revolved around her work in entertainment, she remains isolated at school.

(Source: Aniplex USA)

name: Sakuta Azusagawa
description:
__Height:__  172 cm (5'7")

A strange 2nd year student in high school, who doesn't have a cellphone in this day and age. He is currently an outcast at school due to rumors of a violent past... but doesn't seem to care.
~!Sakuta eventually starts dating [Mai Sakurajima](https://anilist.co/character/127222)!~
(Source: Aniplex USA)

name: Rio Futaba
description:
__Height:__ 155 cm (5'1")
__Talent:__ Explaining any strange phenomenon with science

She is [Sakuta](https://anilist.co/character/127221/Azusagawa-Sakuta)'s classmate, who is always cool and calm, always willing to give various advice on puberty syndrome. She is also the sole member of the Science Club, and known as an eccentric person at the school. 

(Source: Aniplex USA)

name: Kaede Azusagawa
description:
__Height:__ 5'4" (162 cm)

She is the younger sister of Sakuta Azusagawa. 

~!Suffered amnesia and gained a different personality after her ordeal with Adolescence Syndrome stemming from online bullying. Since then, she has lived with Sakuta and has not attended school.!~

name: Tomoe Koga
description:
__Height:__ 150 cm (4'11")

A typical 1st year high-school student at Minegahara High School who can take hints, but is slightly scatterbrained. Being overly concerned about how people look at her, she hides her Hakata accent, which comes out when she panics or is relaxed.

(Source: Aniplex USA, edited)

name: Shouko Makinohara
description:
__Height:__ 150 cm (4'11")
__Talent:__ Early to bed, early to rise

A girl who has the same first and last name as [Sakuta](https://anilist.co/character/127221/Azusagawa-Sakuta)'s first crush. She is a shy middle school girl, but reliable and kind.

She bumps into Sakuta, while holding an umbrella over an abandoned cat in the rain.

~!It is later revealed that the older Shouko that Sakuta encounters is from the future, and is able to return to the past due to her puberty syndrome.!~

name: Nodoka Toyohama
description:
__Height:__ 158cm (5'2")
__Talent:__ Changing clothes quickly

Mai's half-sister, related through her father. A member of the idol group "Sweet Bullet" and designated as the most fashionable within the group. Despite her flashy looks, she attends an elite all girls' high school. She is confident and can be competitive.

(Source: Aniplex USA)

name: Yuuma Kunimi
description: A good friend of [Sakuta Azusagawa](https://anilist.co/character/127221/Sakuta-Azusagawa) and [Rio Futaba](https://anilist.co/character/127633/Rio-Futaba), as well as the boyfriend of [Saki Kamisato](https://anilist.co/character/130304). He is a member of Minegahara High's basketball team, being quite athletic and popular within the school.

name: Saki Kamisato
description:
[Yuuma](https://anilist.co/character/130307/Yuuma-Kunimi)'s girlfriend. Popular within the school and can be a standoffish person, but she shows great affection towards Yuuma. She is quite protective of him and often clashes with [Sakuta](https://anilist.co/character/127221/Sakuta-Azusagawa) as a result.

~!It is revealed that Saki has an older sister whom her parents often compare her to, causing her to develop low self-esteem. Sakuta believes this to be the reason why she is so protective of Yuuma's image and her own, as in her eyes she already has a fragile self-image.!~


~!After graduating she attends the same college as Sakuta and goes into health studies, in the hopes of becoming a nurse in order to help Yuuma whenever she can due to his decision to partake in firefighter training.!~

name: Yousuke Maesawa
description: A member of the school basketball team. He has an attractive and charming demeanor, but he is ultimately not above slandering other students. Maezawa has bad-mouthed all of his past girlfriends.

name: Marcille Donato
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3")

Marcille is a mage who is part of [Laios'](https://anilist.co/character/126818/Thorden-Laios) party. She is an elf from the Northern Continent.

~!She is actually half-elf and half tall-man. Her mother is an elf, and father was a tall-man who passed away when Marcille was young.!~

Marcille is kind, intelligent, principled, and loyal to her friends. However, she can also be very high-strung and has a difficult time dealing with things far outside her comfort zone (such as eating monsters). She has a lot of confidence in her magic ability due to her background, and can feel lonely when she's unable to help the party. She was one of the best students at the Magic Academy, where she joined the research program specializing in dungeon-making; this is where she met [Falin](https://anilist.co/character/130508/Thorden-Falin), and is still her closest friend to this day. Marcille can also be a bit naive at times, believing that friendships alone can keep a party together.

name: Laios Thorden
description:
__Height:__ 185 cm (6'1")

Laios is the leader of his party and Falin's older brother. He is a tall-man from the Northern Continent.

Laios is a monster fanatic and a strong fighter. His deep knowledge and passion for monsters helps him to excel in combat and dungeon exploration. However, social skills are where he often falters; he struggles to pick up social cues, resulting in a lack of awareness and tact. This has caused him a lot of trouble throughout his life, a shortcoming that he is painfully aware of and insecure about. Despite this, Laios is extremely kindhearted, accepting, and friendly.

name: Senshi
description:
__Height:__ 140 cm (4'7")

Senshi is a member of [Laios](https://anilist.co/character/126818/Thorden-Laios)' party. He is a dwarf from the Eastern Continent.

Having spent 10 years studying monster cuisine and living a self-sufficient life inside the dungeon, Senshi loves cooking and is more than happy to share his knowledge and skills. He is dependable and strong, but can also be rather stubborn and set in his ways. He helps maintain the natural environment and ecology of the dungeon, and considers  himself part of it. He dislikes magic and treats it with a great deal of gravity and caution.

name: Narrator
description:
This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. 

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

name: Falin Thorden
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7")

Falin is [Laios](https://anilist.co/character/126818/Thorden-Laios)'s younger sister and a mage specializing in support spells. She is a tall-man from the Northern Continent.

Falin is a very kind, caring, and considerate person who doesn't want to hurt others. She extends this kindness even to the restless dead, who she has been attuned to since childhood. She can also be self-sacrificing and reckless; if the lives of her loved ones are in danger, she would not hesitate to take the blow in their stead. Like her brother, Falin has also had a fanatic interest in biology from a young age.

name: Izutsumi
description:
__Height:__ 150 cm (4'11")

Izutsumi is a former member of Shuro's party and currently a part of Laios' party. She is a tall-man (beast-man) from the Eastern Archipelago.

Izutsumi is rather stand-offish, but is not a distant person; she's fairly self-centered, but is in the process of learning the value of working with others. She is primarily fueled by a determination to find someone to lift her curse. She has terrible table manners and is a picky eater.

~!Izutsumi was born to humans, but the nature of her first curse, the curse placed over her which fused her body with that of an animal's is unknown. In her youth, Izutsumi was paraded as a circus freak. Eventually, Izutsumi was bought by Shuro's father to be raised as a retainer. After being bought, a second curse was placed over Izutsumi by one of the other retainers, which involved a knife-wielding spirit attacking Izutsumi unless the brand of the curse was regularly touched by the person who set the curse on the victim.!~

name: Chilchuck Tims
description:
__Height:__ 110 cm (3'7")

Chilchuck is a member of [Laios](https://anilist.co/character/126818/Thorden-Laios)' party. He is a half-foot from the Eastern Continent.

Chilchuck is shrewd, practical, and sharp-tongued. He refuses to take jobs unless he is paid in advance. His specialties are lockpicking and identifying and disarming traps. He's more open to eating monsters than [Marcille](https://anilist.co/character/127292/Donato-Marcille) is, but like her, draws a hard line at humanoids. He generally goes along with whatever the party does, but will speak frankly when they do something that can get them killed. His job as the party rogue puts him on edge, as failure to undo or avoid traps can lead his companions to immediate mortal danger. When his party members ignore his warnings, he quickly becomes agitated. He prefers to keep his private life separate from his work, so he doesn't tell his party a lot about himself.

~!He has a wife and 3 daughters, but hasn't seen them in years.!~

name: Mithrun
description:
__Height:__ 155 cm

Mithrun is the captain of the Canaries, an Elf group sent to investigate the dungeon. He was born to a noble family, the House of Kerensil, and has one older brother.

He is a male elf who is the head of the group. He has pale hair cut in a short bob. The tips of both his ears have been cut off. Only one of his eyes works. He typically wears a long-sleeved shirt with stripes along the arm, a sleeveless top, a skirt, trousers and knee high boots. Like a number of the other Canaries, he wears a high neck collar. He uses teleportation magic, most often using it to replace the space occupied by foes to restrict their ability to attack.

Mithrun has a very poor sense of direction. ~!He is calm and collected at all times, but is also unaware of his own needs because the demon he made a pact with during his time as a Dungeon Lord devoured all of his desires, except for his desire for revenge.!~ He is very blunt when speaking.

name: Kabru
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7")

Kabru is the leader of his party, exploring the dungeon together with [Rinsha](https://anilist.co/character/135289/Rinsha), [Mickbell](https://anilist.co/character/239690/Tomas-Mickbell), [Kuro](https://anilist.co/character/239687/Kuro), [Daia](https://anilist.co/character/239691/Diamond-of-Sadena), and [Holm](https://anilist.co/character/239686/Kranom-Holm). He is a tall-man from Utaya, part of the Western Continent.

Kabru typically appears rather laid-back, but he is an extremely socially intelligent, analytical, and calculating man with a strong sense of justice. His hobby is observing and analyzing people and their relationships; he remembers every tiny detail about everyone that he comes across. He can be ruthless when he needs to be. Kabru's main goal is to prevent the dungeon from expanding and destroying the nearest villages, which happened to his home village of Utaya and led to his mother's death when he was a child.

name: Thistle
description: __Height:__ 130 cm Thistle is the mage responsible for the creation of the dungeon on The Island and a jester who served in the court of King Delgal during the Golden Age. His actions make him the primary antagonist of the manga Delicious in Dungeon. As the lord of the dungeon, the Lunatic Magician has a great amount of power over both the structure of the dungeon and the monsters that inhabit it. His lifespan has also been extended by the dungeon's power. He is incredibly loyal and protective of the king, and is willing to destroy anything he perceives as a threat to his throne or kingdom. The elf was present in the king's life since his birth and for major events such as his wedding and coronation. ~!During King Delgal's reign, he suggested that Thistle study magic, which is where the elf flourished. However, among the elven and dwarven relics that Thistle studied was something of the dark arts. Thistle became obsessed with power and began his descent into madness, culminating in the elf casting a curse of immortality over the country and creating the dungeon.!~ ~!The Lunatic Magician also imprisoned the guardian of the Golden Country, the Winged Lion, in the depths of the dungeon.!~ (Source: Dungeon Meshi Wiki)

name: Inutade
description:
__Height:__ 195 cm (6'5")

Inutade is a member of Shuro's party, serving him as one of his retainers. She is an ogre from the Eastern Archipelago.

Compared to her comrades in Shuro's group, Tade is carefree, friendly, rather simple-minded, and gets hungry easily. Her real name is Hijouhi (ヒジョウヒ). She seems to have been close with Izutsumi.

name: Namari
description:
__Height:__ 130 cm (4'3")

Namari is a former member of [Laios](https://anilist.co/character/126818/Thorden-Laios)' party and a current member of [Tansu](https://anilist.co/character/239685/Floke-Tansu)'s party. She is a dwarf from the Eastern Continent.

Namari is very knowledgeable about weapons and blacksmithing. Even though she has a strict personality when it comes to work and isn't on the best terms with her former party, she still worries about them and treats them like friends. It is rumored that she often argues with her employers over payment, and that her father is a well-known weapon dealer who scammed the government and later disappeared.

name: Rinsha
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm

She's a young wizard from the Eastern countries and a member of Kabru's party. It is hinted that she might have romantic feelings towards Kabru as she seems extremely jealous over him. 

Not much is known about her, except the fact that she's most likely from a country other than Shuro's homeland and she can use lightning with her magic. She's rather wary of people she doesn't know, and most of the time she looks like she's annoyed.

name: Toshirou Nakamoto
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm (5'11")

Shuro is a former member of the Thorden siblings' party. His real name is Toshiro Nakamoto.

He is an Eastern man with long black hair tied back in a ponytail, fair skin, and black eyes. He is shorter than Laios but taller than Marcille. When he appears again in the story, he appears more gaunt with sunken eyes and an unshaven face.

Ordinarily, Shuro is a reserved man who doesn't often make demands of others. He has trouble expressing his true opinions to other people, instead relying on subtle social cues to imply what he feels. If the other party doesn't understand it, he tends to go along with what they say instead of push the issue. He seems to be impulsive under pressure, making snap decisions such as rescuing Falin by himself.

~!His family is apparently of some noble lineage, as he has five retainers at his call. One of them, Maizuru, looked after him since he was a child. She noted that he was always reserved and never ate much, but ate plenty of whatever she made for him. Shuro arrived to The Island in order to train as a warrior. He was largely uninterested in monetary rewards or danger because of this.

Sometime after joining the Thorden siblings' party, Shuro fell in love with Falin when he woke one night and saw her enthralled instead of disgusted by a caterpillar on her finger, after which he proposed to her. She told him she needed time to think about it however, and unfortunately was eaten by the dragon before she could give an answer. Once they returned to the surface, Shuro left the party so he could rescue Falin with his retainers. He spent almost no time eating or resting during their descent through the dungeon.!~

(Source: Dungeon Meshi Wiki)

name: Cithis
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm

Member of the Canaries, an Elf group sent to investigate the dungeon. She appears to be second in command to Misurn. Her magic specialty is unknown, but she offers to 'burn' an enemy at one point, and seems to use a tool that looks like a branch of lily of the valley flowers.

She was convicted for the use of ancient magic, incitement to murder, documents forgery and fraud. Sentenced for life.

Cithis' priority appears to be keeping Mithrun alive, due to his inability to remember to do so for himself after his desires were removed by a demon. She is seen often at his side, helping to point him in the right direction when he wanders off track as well as keeping track of his meal times.

name: Fleki
description:
__Height__: 140cm
__Likes__: Anything spicy
__Dislikes__: Carrots

Fleki has wavy, shoulder-length hair and messy bangs, as well as notches in both of her ears like the other Canaries indicating conviction of having used black magic. She typically wears a short tunic with a belt and ankle boots, and the same high collar as the others, as well as a falconry glove.

Fleki's magic appears to revolve around commanding a number of different bird-like familiars, including a shadowy black bird with a curly tail, three small round white birds, and three larger white crow-like birds.

name: Lycion
description:
__Height__: 170 cm (5'7")

Lycion is a member of Mithrun's squad of Canaries. He is an aloof, laid-back elf. Like many of the other Canaries, he has notches cut into his ears, a mark of being convicted of using black magic.

~!Lycion is able to turn into a canine beast and is comfortable even in partial transformation. He has extreme body dysmorphia and hates how his original elven body looked. Conversely, he loves and praises his beast-man form, and joined in illegal fighting tournaments in order to show it off. He views his monster body purely as a cosmetic change, and doesn't have any real interest in monsters or their natural habits.!~

name: Kensuke
description: A Living Armor mollusk monster who lives in the handle of Laios's sword. The only visible parts of Kensuke appear to be antenna-like eyes, which poke out of the hilt of the sword it inhabits.

name: Kuro
description:
__Height:__ 145 cm

A kobold who joined Kabru's party alongside Mickbell. This loyal kobold never wavers in his dedication to his master.

(Source: Dungeon Meshi World Guide: Boukensha Bible)

name: Pattadol
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm
__Likes:__ Tomato
__Dislikes:__ Liver

Member of the Canaries, an Elf group sent to investigate the dungeon. She is the second child of a noble family, the House of Vari, and was appointed by her parents to join the Canaries.

She appears to have a long-haired faerie as a familiar who acts primarily as a communicator between her and the other elves. She can transform her familiar into a magic staff to cast spells, including one that generates a physical barrier. While she seems to panic fairly easily, she seems to be the most proper of the team, stopping the other elves from laughing at Mithrun's mistake and reminding Sishys to keep her mind on the battle. She is also quite observant, noting Shuro and Namari's response when the chimerized Falin appears on the first floor.

(Source: Delicious in Dungeon Wiki)

name: Maizuru
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm (5'5")

Maizuru is a member of Shuro's party, serving him as one of his retainers. She is a tall-man from the Eastern Archipelago. Her real name is Iyo (イヨ).

Having known him his whole life, Maizuru is a brilliant yet overprotective teacher to Shuro. She is also a powerful mage who is able to perform a wide range of spells. Her magic seems to revolve around paper.

name: Fionil
description:
__Height:__ 150 cm (4'11")

Fionil is a novice adventurer currently exploring the dungeon with Doni. She is a half-elf from the Northern Central Continent.

Fionil was originally hired by the western elves to report any changes that occurred on the island due to the dungeon. However, she was so moved by Doni's story that she decided to leave her job and join him as an adventurer.

name: Leed
description: Younger sister of Chief [Zon](https://anilist.co/character/324941/Zon)

name: Kiki Floke
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm (5'11")

Kiki is of the twins in Tansu's party. She is a tall-man.

Kiki and her twin brother Kaka were born into a nomadic clan, but one day they were left behind at a tavern as children, and were sleeping in a stable when Mr. and Mrs. Tansu found and adopted them. They grew up surrounded by gnomes.

name: Benichidori
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3")

Benichidori is a member of Shuro's party, serving him as one of his retainers, and is a member of the ninja squad who serves the Nakamoto clan. She is a tall-man from the Eastern Archipelago. Her real name is Matsu (マツ).

Benichidori is quiet, observant, cautious, and a skilled fighter. She has facial dysmorphia, meaning she is extremely insecure about the way her face looks, so she always wears heavy makeup.

name: David Martinez
description:
David is a street kid from Arroyo, Santo Domingo in Night City, who is enrolled into Arasaka's educational system at Arasaka Academy. He lives with his mother Gloria in an apartment of Megabuilding H4.

After experiencing a personal tragedy, David has the powerful Sandevistan speedware installed in his body and becomes one of Night City's edgerunners. He also becomes acquainted with [Lucy](https://anilist.co/character/284157/Lucy), who leads him into the city's criminal underworld, and chooses to join the gang of edgerunners she is a part of, led by [Maine](https://anilist.co/character/284159/Maine).

name: Maine
description: Maine used to be a military soldier before he became a mercenary. Now a veteran edgerunner in Night City, Maine dreams of "making it big", although he values his friendships with his crew more than his own glory.

name: Talia Yang
description:
Raised in corpo towers but hardened in Maelstrom’s grip, Talia is fiercely independent and steeped in the gang’s hyper-violent, chrome-obsessed culture.

(Source: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Official Site)

name: D
description:
A Snake Nation netrunner with sharp technical skills and a sharper hunger for revenge, D hunts the killer who wiped out his clan.

(Source: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Official Site)

name: Weak Kingsley
description:
Once known as “King,” a veteran edgerunner at the top of his game, Weak now lives in the shadow of his former glory.

(Source: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Official Site)

name: Roman Carax
description:
Roman Carax is a young cinephile chasing real stories in a city that’s abandoned film for braindance. Obsessed with documenting truth, he shadows the lives of others — only to learn that unlike his favorite reels, Night City’s stories are messy, brutal, and rarely tied up with a clean ending.

(Source: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Official Site)

name: Capri
description:
Project Capricorn, also known as simply Capricorn or Capri, is a personality construct created by [Kyoko](https://anilist.co/character/411116/%E3%82%AD%E3%83%A7%E3%82%A6%E3%82%B3) and the Arasaka Corporation, and is composed out of multiple, if not dozens, of digitized human psyches combined into one single psyche.

Capri was put onto an Arasaka biochip, that later would be stolen from the Arasaka Industrial Park by King's Crew. After Kingsley went cyberpsycho, and the rest of the crew went AWOL, the case containing the biochip was intercepted by Kyoko.

name: Jessie
description:
Jessie is a braindance engineer working at Sal Bigelow’s Braindance Paradise, tuning experiences for those looking to leave Night City behind, at least for a little while.

(Source: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners Twitter)

name: Hideyoshi Ooshima
description: Hideyoshi is a Japanese braindance director.

name: Yupi
description:
A resident of Night City who seeks to destroy the Arasaka Corporation, which was responsible for her father's death. 

She is pragmatic enough to recognize D's potential and utilize it to achieve her goal.

name: Kate Miller
description:
__Birthplace:__ Westbrook, Night City
__Occupation:__ Associate Physical Security Specialist
__Employer:__ Arasaka Corporation

name: Avida Yang
description:
Once a jazz singer, corpo insider, and King’s old flame, Avida Yang left her old life behind. Now, her world revolves around one person: Talia.

(Source: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners Twitter)

name: Sal Bigelow
description: Owner of Braindance Paradise.

name: Kitano
description:
An Arasaka corpo, Kitano has built a life inside one of Night City’s most powerful corporations, where knowing who to trust can matter just as much as knowing who not to.

(Source: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners Twitter)

name: Kiril Yang
description:
Avida’s husband and Talia’s father, Kiril is a composed Kang Tao executive whose smooth corporate calm masks a cold authority.

(Source: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners Twitter)

name: Richard
description:
A Kang Tao corpo, Richard is working for the weapons manufacturer that turned big moves into a place among some of the biggest corporate players.

(Source: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners Twitter)

name: Watashi
description: An unnamed (his name translates to "me" or "I") college student in Kyoto who is recollecting his past two years of college life. He entered college dreaming of the "rosy campus life" that must surely be his. He wants to meet the raven-haired girl of his dreams, which is why he joins a new social circle in each episode. He is quite shy, and easily manipulated by the other characters. Even though he is the central character, he seems to be the most powerless and normal person in the roster.

name: Akashi
description:
Akashi has a very icy personality and is hard to approach. She appears to be slightly less harsh to the main character.

A freshman student who is commonly (but not always) the center of the protagonist's affections. She acts rationally and even coldly towards most people, but often shows hints of affection (or helpfulness) to the protagonist. Her fear of moths also contrasts with her normally calm demeanor.
~!She often appears in the same club that the protagonist joins, she is a student of the engineering department and a member of Birdman circle.!~

name: Ozu
description: The main character's mischievous friend, tied to him by "the black thread of fate." Ozu also appears as a child in The Night is Short, Walk on Girl. His ghastly appearance is due to his refusal to eat vegetables or anything of that nature, rather, he subsists off of instant foods and ramen.

name: Seitarou Higuchi
description: Originally introduced as a deity of matrimony in the first episode, Higuchi Seitarou (his full name given in episode four, though he is more commonly referred to simply as Master) appears to be an eighth year student at the university living in the same dorm as the protagonist. He always wears a yukata and has a wise, distant, nonchalant air about him. He often aids the protagonist most directly, though the protagonist may not see it that way.

name: Johnny
description: The personification of "Watashi's" sex drive.

name: Ryouko Hanuki
description: A student at the university studying dentistry. She likes getting inebriated, at which point she drastically loses her sense of judgement and flirts with whoever is around. Aware of this, she is cautious about choosing who she goes drinking with. She is very good at speaking in English.   ~!She serves as a formal love interest for the protagonist in episodes 6-8.!~

name: Masaki Jougasaki
description: An eighth year student at the University who leads the Film Circle Misogi. He harbors a secret fetish for breasts, and keeps a love-doll (Kaori). He often takes an antagonistic role of sorts relative to the protagonist, and Ozu often assists Jougasaki in some way, usually a way detrimental to the protagonist's progress, in spite of the fact that Ozu is helping the protagonist at the same time.

name: Kaori
description: A love doll secretly owned by Jougasaki. She becomes one of the protagonist's love interests in episodes 6-8.

name: Uranai-baba
description: She is a stingy fortune teller.

name: Neko Ramen Tenshu
description:
The owner of the Neko Ramen shop the protagonist favors. He is mostly silent, occasionally putting in a short, new insight into the protagonist's current conversations or problems. He occasionally takes on a more active role in the protagonist's adventures, always on a helpful note. The rumor is that he uses actual cats to make the broth, but whether that's true or not cannot be ascertained. However, the taste is unmatched.

~!In the 11th episode he was revealed to be a former student who used to be in the same year as Higuchi, Jougasaki, and Ryoko.!~

name: Aijima
description: Jougasaki-senpai's right hand man.

name: Hanako
description:
__Age of Death:__ 13

Hanako is a ghost haunting the old building of Kamome Academy. He resides on the third floor female bathroom, in the toilet of the third stall. He governs over the Seven Mysteries as School Mystery Number 7.

~!Hanako's real name is Yugi Amane. He attended Kamome Academy as a student and his goal was to become an astronaut and go to the moon someday. He was to become a science teacher at Kamome Academy as an adult, but his future changed for unknown reasons. He ended up with the fate of killing his own twin brother, of dying as a kid, and of then becoming one of the Seven Mysteries to protect the students and to fulfill their wishes in order to atone for his sins.!~ 

~!It is hinted multiple times that Hanako has romantic feelings for [Yashiro](https://anilist.co/character/128652/Yashiro-Nene), and that he is madly in love with her.!~

~!He confesses his love to Nene Yashiro and gives her a kiss.!~

name: Nene Yashiro
description: Yashiro Nene is a normal student, and one day she listens to a rumor about ''Hanako-san'' who makes wishes for anyone, but the wishes come with a price. She visits him in the hope of getting her crush to fall in love with her. She becomes friends with Hanako-san soon after meeting him then. She is in the gardening club.

name: Kou Minamoto
description: Minamoto Kou is a student at Kamome Academy's Middle School Division, and a member of a renowned family of exorcists, the Minamoto Clan.

name: Sousuke Mitsuba
description:
Mitsuba, real name Sousuke Mitsuba is a ghost haunting Kamome Academy Middle School's lockers. He was a student at Kamome Academy's Middle School division and a member of the photography club before his death.

~!After being recreated by [Tsukasa](https://anilist.co/character/137221/Yugi-Tsukasa), he consumed the at-the-time School Mystery No.3's heart and is now the current representative of the 3rd School Mystery!~

name: Tsuchigomori
description: Age: ~!70+!~ Height: 6' 0"+ Occupation: Teacher (disguise), 5th Mystery Representative Status: ~!Disconnected (as a supernatural)!~ Tsuchigomori is a science teacher at Kamome Academy. He is secretly a supernatural, representing and curating the academy's 5th School Wonder, the 4PM Bookstacks. He is also Kou's current homeroom teacher. While Tsuchigomori seems like a normal, caring and somewhat meek teacher in his human disguise, he is actually sarcastic, mischievous and quite short-tempered. He's also shown to be quite sadistic, having fun with threatening and scaring Nene and Kou ― although he quickly stops after a light warning from Hanako. Although he is a teacher, he is shown to dislike children because of their noisy attitudes. Tsuchigomori also has an odd sense of humor and likes to joke around, such as saying that he likes to eat human children, only to be met with terrified looks in response. Despite him claiming that he only pretends to care about his students, he has been shown to actually genuinely care about them on various occasions. When asked why he makes his teacher persona so different than his actual personality as a supernatural, he answers that it's simply because he feels like it. ~!As the curator of the 4PM Bookstacks, he has access to the entire body of knowledge surrounding the school, along with the present, past, and future. He seems to know everything about every student that has ever attended the school. Even after his yorishiro and boundary were broken, his powers still allow him ways to retrieve the books in the library. He mentions that because of his position, it's possible for him to alter the future, but he does not plan to do so because any curator who does will be erased from existence.!~

name: Tsukasa Yugi
description:
Yugi Tsukasa is a ghost haunting Kamome Academy. He currently resides at the school's broadcasting club room, with its members Sakura and Natsuhiko.
~!He is the younger twin brother of Amane Yugi. He is said to be the polar opposite of Hanako. Where Hanako grants the wish of a living person, Tsukasa grants the wish of a dead person's lingering spirit!~

name: Aoi Akane
description: Akane Aoi is a first year student at Kamome Academy's High School Division and Nene's friend.

name: Teru Minamoto
description:
Minamoto Teru is a 2nd year student at Kamome Academy's High School Division and the school's Student Council President. He is also a member of a renowned family of exorcists, the Minamoto Clan.

Teru is Kou's older brother.

name: Sakura Nanamine
description: Nanamine Sakura is a 3rd-year student at Kamome Academy's High School division. She made a contract with [Tsukasa](https://anilist.co/character/137221/Yugi-Tsukasa) and is now bound to him. She is a member of the school's broadcasting club.

name: Akane Aoi
description:
Akane Aoi is a first year student at Kamome Academy's High School division as one of Nene's classmates, and the student council's vice president.
~!He is secretly a supernatural who controls the present, as one of the three Clock Keepers along with Kako and Mirai.!~

name: Mei Shijima
description: Shijima Mei is a former student at Kamome Academy and the current School Mystery Number 4.

name: Yako
description:
The fox statue spirit that holds the title of Number Two of The Seven Wonders (二番目の七不思議. Romaji: _Ni-ban me no Nanafushigi_) as the Misaki's Stair ghost. She took on the form of a beautiful lady inside her territory while outside, she took the form of a kitsune spirit.

~!She spirited humans into her realm in hopes of them making an appropriate vessel for her deceased human teacher, Misaki.!~

name: Natsuhiko Hyuuga
description: Natsuhiko Hyuuga is a 2nd year student at Kamome Academy's High School division. He is a member of the school's broadcasting club.

name: Lemon Yamabuki
description: Yamabuki Lemon is a first year student at Kamome Academy's High School divison and Nene, Aoi and Akane's classmate.

name: Sumire Akane
description:
Sumire is a character in Jibaku Shounen Hanako-kun. She made her debut in Chapter 66 of the manga.

She is part of the Akane family, to which No. 6 stated that they are that kind of family with children who are offered to God (specifically because of their coveted bloodline). Nene suspects that her full name must be Akane Sumire, and her family name has been confirmed by Teru in Chapter 70.

It has not been confirmed whether or not Sumire is Aoi's ancestor yet.

name: Shinigami-sama
description: School Mystery No.6 is a supernatural haunting Kamome Gakuen on awaiting the moon, a day where several come together to weave baskets without succumbing to sleep. He is currently known as The Reaper from the rumors and guards the boundary closest to the Far Shore. However, he can only appear once each year for this event.

name: Yokoo
description: Yokoo is a 3rd year student at Kamome Gakuen's middle school. He is Minamoto Kou's friend and is usually seen together with Satou.

name: Tiara Minamoto
description:
Tiara is the younger sister of Kou and Teru Minamoto, and the eldest daughter of the Minamoto clan. She is shown to be a cheerful girl both in off the bonus illustrations and spin-off manga. She calls the Mokkes cute and doesn't even hesitate to rescue a Mokke from a huge, insect-like monster, hence showing that she isn't scared of the supernatural. 

~!Apparently, her spiritual powers far surpass that of Teru's even in her young age, making her the most powerful member of the siblings.!~

name: Satou
description: Satou is a 3rd year student at Kamome Gakuen's middle school. He is Minamoto Kou's friend and is usually seen together with Yokoo.

name: Mirai
description: Mirai is a supernatural who controls the future as one of the three Clock Keepers. ~!Kako and Akane are her partners that also work as Clock Keepers.!~

name: Misaki
description:
The namesake of the Second Wonders of The Seven Wonders, Misaki's Stair and supposed teacher of Yako. He is capable of interacting with spirits and ghosts. He died after falling from the stair of a certain shrine.

~!His demise prompts Yako to attempt to recreate a vessel to hold his souls, forcefully enlisting spirited humans she abducted to gather body parts inside her realms and turning them into dolls in the case where they failed to do so.!~

name: Katakuri
description: Katakuri was once a human that was sacrificed in a village. He first appeared after saving Nene.

name: Fuji Suzuto
description: Fuji Suzuto is a first-year high school student at Kamome Gakuen that is briefly shown to be in Nene's class and is also depicted to be affiliated with the student council.

name: Kako
description: Kako is a supernatural who controls the past as one of the three Clock Keepers. ~!He works with Mirai and Akane.!~

name: Makima
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm (5'6")
__Affiliation:__ Public Safety Devil Hunters

Makima is a Public Safety Devil Hunter, who took [Denji](https://anilist.co/character/130102/Denji) as her human pet. She is one of the leading figures of Public Safety in Japan and has a considerable reputation among experienced Devil Hunters.

name: Denji
description:
__Height:__ 173 cm (5'8"), Devil Form - 180 cm (5'11")

Denji is Chainsaw Man's Human Form. He became Chainsaw Man after his dead body was resurrected by his pet dog, [Pochita](https://anilist.co/character/170266/Pochita).

He is a Public Safety Devil Hunter who works under [Makima](https://anilist.co/character/137080/Makima) as a member of an experimental squad in Special Tokyo Division 4. He works alongside his partner [Power](https://anilist.co/character/137079/Power) and under the supervision of [Aki Hayakawa](https://anilist.co/character/137081/Aki-Hayakawa).

Denji's personality is both brash and naive as a result of being unable to have a formal education and socialize due to living in severe poverty. He comes off as rude and harsh, yet in an almost childish way. He doesn't know how to be clever or wise but he knows how to lighten the mood. As the Chainsaw Devil, he has the ability to grow chainsaws out of his body.

name: Power
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7")

Power is a fiend, a dead body possessed by a devil.

She is a Public Safety Devil Hunter who works (against her will) under [Makima](https://anilist.co/character/137080/Makima) as a member of an experimental squad in Tokyo Special Division 4. She works alongside her partner [Denji](https://anilist.co/character/130102/Denji), and under supervision by [Aki Hayakawa](https://anilist.co/character/137081/Aki-Hayakawa).

Power is childish, greedy, and almost entirely self-motivated. She tends to fights if she has something to gain and is certain of her victory and has no problems in running away from a fight where she is outmatched. She also feels the need to boast her superiority over her fellow Devil Hunters due to her status as a fiend. She has no loyalty to humanity, openly admitting that she will join the winning side. Power is often rude, unkempt, and feels as though those around her should clean up after her. She self-admittedly rarely bathes or flushes the toilet and sees humans as being sensitive for caring about their hygiene so much. As the Blood Fiend, she has the power to freely manipulate the blood within her own body.

name: Aki Hayakawa
description:
__Height:__ 182 cm (6'0")
__Devil Contracts:__ [Fox Devil](https://anilist.co/character/290671/Kitsune-no-Akuma), [Curse Devil](https://anilist.co/character/174265/Noroi-no-Akuma), ~![Future Devil](https://anilist.co/character/172887/Mirai-no-Akuma)!~
__Relatives:__ [Hahaoya Hayakawa](https://anilist.co/character/291241/Hayakawa-Hahaoya) (Mother), [Chichioya Hayakawa](https://anilist.co/character/291240/Hayakawa-Chichioya) (Father), [Taiyou Hayakawa](https://anilist.co/character/174261/Taiyou) (Younger Brother).

A Public Safety Devil Hunter working under [Makima](https://anilist.co/character/137080/Makima) as a member of Tokyo Special Division 4. He is partnered with [Himeno](https://anilist.co/character/144596/Himeno) and tasked with supervising both [Power](https://anilist.co/character/137079/Power) and [Denji](https://anilist.co/character/130102/Denji).

Aki Hayakawa generally appears to be a very stoic person. He acts mature and dependable when he's with his fellow Devil hunters but is actually very soft when he is alone. He has a tendency to get attached to others easily, and hates to see people get hurt, especially his close friends. Aki's primary goal and reasoning for becoming a Devil Hunter is to kill the [Gun Devil](https://anilist.co/character/208942/Juu-no-Akuma) to get revenge for his family.

~!He later loses his contract with the Fox Devil and gains a new contract with the Future Devil!~

name: Reze
description:
Reze is a young girl who met [Denji](https://anilist.co/character/130102/Denji) in a phone cabin. She works at a local café and is a kind and gentle girl who seems to have a crush on Denji soon after meeting him. She laughs at his jokes and isn't afraid to get close to and intimate with him.

~!‌‌‌‌‌‌‌‌She is secretly the Bomb Devil hybrid, owned by the Soviet Union and allied to the Gun Devil. Her true personality is manipulative and brutal, as she is shown killing many Devil Hunters without care or mercy. She does, however, not enjoy killing and prefers to avoid it, unless necessary for her mission. Her objective is to retrieve the Chainsaw Heart from Denji, but the feelings she developed for him quickly made things more complicated.!~

name: Asa Mitaka
description:
Asa Mitaka is an antisocial student. She isn't seen having interest in making friends nor talking to many people during school hours. She struggles to do the right thing, constantly weighing the circumstances and her own morals to decide the “right” choice, often figuratively and literally tripping over herself in situations. She wishes to live more selfishly. 

She has a hate for the infamous [Chainsaw Man](https://anilist.co/character/130102/Denji) and [Kokepii (Bucky, Chicken Devil)](https://anilist.co/character/282388/Kokepii) that is loved by mostly everyone around her, which had put her at odds with her peers. 

~!After being attacked by the [Class President](https://anilist.co/character/282391/Gakkyuu-Iinchou)'s Justice Devil Form, Asa Mitaka encounters the [War Devil](https://anilist.co/character/282872/Sensou-no-Akuma). She resurrects Asa in exchange for inhabiting her body, leaving half her brain intact to keep her alive. Asa will do anything to get her body back, leading her to promise the War Devil she will help her kill Chainsaw Man.!~

name: Pochita
description: Pochita appears to be a small red canine with a chainsaw like appendage protruding from the center of his head. Handles emerge from his body allowing him to be wielded like a chainsaw and his short tail is in the shape of a chainsaw's pull cord. Unlike most devils, Pochita communicated solely through barks and whines like an actual dog.

name: Kobeni Higashiyama
description:
__Height:__ 155 cm

A Public Safety Devil Hunter, she is a new recruit working under [Makima](https://anilist.co/character/137080/Makima) as a member of Tokyo Special Division 4. She is partnered with [Hirokazu Arai](https://anilist.co/character/174263).

She is not very courageous and gets scared easily by devils. Kobeni is shown to easily crack under pressure and break into tears during serious moments. Even though Kobeni is timid, she is pretty talented as a devil hunter. When Kobeni gets into action, she has proven to be cool-headed and efficient in battle, only breaking down in a panic once the fighting is over. Kobeni chooses to keep her devil contract a secret.

name: Tenshi no Akuma
description:
__Height:__ 155 cm

Angel Devil is a devil who embodies the fear of angels, and a Public Safety Devil Hunter from Special Division 4.

The Angel Devil is a unique case among devils having virtually no hostility towards humans. He dislikes being ordered around and doesn't seem inclined towards combat. His extreme laziness holds him back from being a strong fighter and he often refuses to work, even claiming to prefer dying to working.

name: Himeno
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5'9")
__Devil Contract:__ [Ghost Devil](https://anilist.co/character/174262/Yuurei-no-Akuma)
__Relatives:__ [Unnamed Younger Sister](https://anilist.co/character/174283/Himeno-no-Imouto)

A Public Safety Devil Hunter, working under [Makima](https://anilist.co/character/137080/Makima) as a member of Tokyo Special Division 4. She is partnered with [Aki Hayakawa](https://anilist.co/character/137081/Aki-Hayakawa), whom she shares a close personal bond with.

Himeno is shown to be a mature and experienced superior to the new recruits working under her. She generally carries herself with an upbeat body language and is capable of staying calm under extremely stressful situations. Himeno is very efficient and blunt in her duty as a Devil Hunter. Himeno is also shown to be a rather caring and empathetic person, however she does have a sterner side and little tolerance for behavior from new recruits that would endanger or harm her subordinates. 

Himeno holds an extremely pessimistic worldview as a result of having witnessed multiple partners die suddenly in her line of work. Her knowledge that Devil Hunters typically die as a result of their career combined with the teachings of her [master](https://anilist.co/character/144593/Kishibe) eventually lead to her developing a nicotine addiction as a coping mechanism. She also tends to acts extremely aloof and sexual, enjoying a hedonistic lifestyle. However, similarly to her smoking addiction, her hedonistic ways are not used as pleasure, but rather as another defense mechanism.

name: Kishibe
description:
__Height:__ 194 cm
__Devil Contracts:__ ~!Claw Devil, Knife Devil, Needle Devil!~

A Public Safety Devil Hunter from Special Division 1. ~!After the assault on the Special Divisions, he became captain of the Special Division 4.!~

Kishibe is a grizzled man with scraggly facial hair and a stitched scar running across his left cheek from his mouth. He normally wears the standard Public Safety devil hunter uniform with a large overcoat. He has two piercings on his left ear, and one on his right ear. He is often seen with a hip flask which he frequently drinks from. Kishibe is a stoic, straightforward individual. Due to his immense strength and skill, he often undertakes his work with a calm formality, displaying little emotion as he does so. Though he tends to speak in a relaxed, polite manner, his actions often showcase an immense brutality garnered through many years of Devil Hunting. Though he sometimes expresses emotions such as surprise and sadness at certain events, his face and voice remain entirely neutral. Kishibe has been hunting devils for a long time, making him somewhat insane. He espouses a belief that the most fearsome devil hunters to devils isn't the brave or the strong, but the craziest as they are the ones without fear. He admits that he enjoys booze, women and killing devils.

~!He is the former partner of [Quanxi](https://anilist.co/character/162123/Quanxi).!~

name: Beam
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm (With fin: 176 cm)

He is a Shark Fiend and a Public Safety Devil Hunter from Special Division 4.

Beam is very eccentric. He often goes along with [Denji](https://anilist.co/character/130102/Denji)'s plans no matter how crazy they are due to having a lot of respect for the [Chainsaw Devil](https://anilist.co/character/170266/Pochita).

name: Quanxi
description: Quanxi is a devil hunter from China. She has a harem composed of four female fiends.  ~!She is the former partner of [Kishibe](https://anilist.co/character/144593/Kishibe.).!~ ~!Just like [Denji](https://anilist.co/character/130102/Denji), Quanxi is also hybrid. She is fused with the Crossbow Devil.!~

name: Yoru
description:
Yoru is the War Devil and a member of the Four Horsemen, who now occupies [Asa Mitaka](https://anilist.co/character/282389/Asa-Mitaka). Before inhabiting Asa's body, her appearance was that of a bird, largely resembling a potoo.

Yoru is first seen on top of a traffic light a few seconds prior to Asa Mitaka's death by the [Class President](https://anilist.co/character/282391/Gakkyuu-Iinchou)'s Justice Devil Form. She resurrects Asa in exchange for inhabiting her body, leaving half her brain intact to keep her alive.

~!War Devil calls themselves "Yoru" so that it's easier for Asa Mitaka to call her. It is also revealed that there is a condition in which Yoru (War Devil) cannot take over Asa Mitaka's body when she is stricken with fear.!~

name: Hirofumi Yoshida
description:
Hirofumi Yoshida is a Private Devil Hunter.

Considered a high-class bodyguard specialist by [Makima](https://anilist.co/character/137080/Makima). Yoshida always has a smile on his face, he is seen to be quite playful and mischievous but can also be ruthless. He also loves to have small talk with his opponents during battle.

~!He has a contract with the [Octopus Devil](https://anilist.co/character/394350/Tako-no-Akuma).!~ ~!During a conversation with [Kishibe](https://anilist.co/character/144593/Kishibe) it is revealed that he is still attending high school.!~

name: Nayuta
description: ~!She is the reincarnation of the Control Devil following [Makima](https://anilist.co/character/137080/Makima)'s death.!~ ~![Denji](https://anilist.co/character/130102/Denji) is her adoptive brother.!~

name: Bouryoku no Majin
description:
He is a Fiend and Public Safety Devil Hunter from Special Division 4.

Despite his moniker as the Violence Fiend, he is extremely polite and straightforward. He apologized to [Beam](https://anilist.co/character/157232/Beam) after hitting him in self-defense and told the [Spider Devil](https://anilist.co/character/157277/Prinz) to evacuate the area when he mistook her for a human lady.

~!He is later partnered with [Kobeni Higashiyama](https://anilist.co/character/144594/Higashiyama-Kobeni) following the events of the Katana Man Arc!~

name: Kiga no Akuma
description:
The Famine Devil is one of the four horseman devils. 

She is a member of the Devil Hunter Club at Fourth East High School, although she hides her identity. She tells [Asa](https://anilist.co/character/282389/Asa-Mitaka) to call her Kiga, and refers to herself as "[War Devil](https://anilist.co/character/282872/Sensou-no-Akuma)'s big sister". Her earrings resemble scales.

~!In Chapter 198 her true identity is revealed as the Death Devil, having adopted the [Famine Devil](https://anilist.co/character/366135/Kiga-no-Akuma)'s name while in the human world.!~

name: Nyaako
description: [Power](https://anilist.co/character/137079/Power)'s cat. ~!Now currently owned by [Denji](https://anilist.co/character/130102/Denji).!~

name: Cosmo
description: A member of [Quanxi](https://anilist.co/character/162123/Quanxi)'s harem, Cosmo is seen only saying "Halloween."

name: Samurai Sword
description: Samurai Sword is a human-devil hybrid who merged with the Katana Devil. His [grandfather](https://anilist.co/character/289198/Yakuza) was killed by [Denji](https://anilist.co/character/130102/Denji) when they initially fused with [Pochita](https://anilist.co/character/170266/Pochita), and because of that, he affiliated with the [Gun Devil](https://anilist.co/character/208942/Juu-no-Akuma) to get revenge on Denji. He works alongside [Akane Sawatari](https://anilist.co/character/174264/Akane-Sawatari) and other fellow members of the Yakuza.

name: Michiko Tendou
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5'9")
__Devil Contracts:__ ~![Punishment Devil](https://anilist.co/character/306237/Batsu-no-Akuma)!~

A Public Safety Devil Hunter from Kyoto. She is partnered with [Yuutarou Kurose](https://anilist.co/character/144592/Yuutarou-Kurose).

name: Mirai no Akuma
description: The Future Devil is a devil that embodies the fear of the future. ~!After seeing [Aki Hayakawa](https://anilist.co/character/137081/Aki-Hayakawa)'s future, it made a contract with him, so he can see that future himself.!~

name: Yuutarou Kurose
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm (5'5")
__Devil Contract:__ ~![Punishment Devil](https://anilist.co/character/306237/Batsu-no-Akuma)!~

A Public Safety Devil Hunter from Kyoto. He is partnered with [Michiko Tendou](https://anilist.co/character/144595/Michiko-Tendou).

name: Fumiko Mifune
description:
__Devil Contract:__ ~!STD Devil!~

Fumiko Mifune is a member of Public Safety Special Division 7. She's 22 years old but protects [Denji](https://anilist.co/character/130102/Denji) as a high school student.

name: Shisa
description: Inspired by the guardians of the Ryukyu islands, the lion-esque looking Shisa is a hard worker to the core. After passing the extremely difficult "super part - time worker qualification," exam, Shisa works as an assistant to the chef Ramen Yoroi-san at Rou. Shisa regards the boss as a ramen master and holds them in the highest esteem.

name: Midori
description: The green pajama buddy of Pajama Parties.

name: Pink
description: The pink pajama buddy of Pajama Parties.

name: Murasaki
description: The purple pajama buddy of Pajama Parties.

name: Shiro
description: The white pajama buddy of Pajama Parties.

name: Xin Li
description: The hero of the story. A war orphan who aims to become the "World's Greatest General". He later meets Zheng Ying, the future first king that would rule all of China.

name: Lei Qiang
description: A member of a legendary assassin clan called "Chi You" that is exceptional in combat and uses the notorious Dance of Death. She fights with a sword named "Lu Seui".

name: Yi Huan
description:
Yi Huan is a Vice General who serves in Great General Ao Meng's army. In the past, he was a bandit leader with the moniker Yi Huan the Beheader.

His personality is said to be extremely brutal as he has no qualms in killing surrendered soldiers and personally beheaded every person in any city or village he conquered. This is shown in how he sends Wei soldiers, who have been severely tortured, along with bags of eyeballs back to their camp to decrease morale and incite fear.

He always has an arrogant smirk on his face and talks in a crude manner at times. He shows no respect for his foes as he calls Feng Xuan "an old fart" and "trash" before killing him. He is exhibits a sense of humor and sarcasm as in the case when a fellow crew member asked him why he made an unskilled man named Ogiko as 1000-man commander of The Yi Huan army, he replied "Gyahaha cause it's funny obviously."

He also has a cool demeanor and almost never displays any shock no matter how bad the situation is. Yi Huan also shows a very dark side as he toys with Xi Bai Gui by dangling the idea of escape from death if he begged for his life then stabbed him several times after he refused to grovel.

He does exhibits a sense of loyalty exclusive to Ao Meng by holding the rank of Vice General in his army and coming when summoned as demonstrated when Tang Zhang used Ao Meng's name, as he knew that Yi Huan would simply ignore an request for a conversation with him.

name: Zheng Ying
description: The young king of Qin who bears a striking resemblance to Piao. Later becomes Qin Shi Huang.

name: Duanhe Yang
description: Yang Duanhe is the mysterious King of Qin’s Mountain Tribes, is the leader and spokesperson for the Confederation of different tribes that reside in Qin's mountain area. She is known in the mountain realms as the Lord of Death. After the Coalition War, she was also rewarded with the title of Da Shang Zhao of Qin.

name: Mu Li
description:
One of the 3 great heavens generals of Zhao.

~!He marries [Yin Hai](https://anilist.co/character/132035/Hai-Yin) later on in the series.!~

name: Liao Diao He
description: He Liao Diao is the last known descendent of the Kyuumei Mountain Tribe, which was destroyed in the war with Yang Duanhe, king of the Qin mountains. As a result of this, she moved to Kokuhi village, a place of outlaws in which she eventually encounters and befriends Ying Zheng and Li Xin. She becomes an expert in blowing poisonous needles using a hollow bamboo stem acquired following the defeat of the assassin Muta by Xin. It is initially assumed by Xin, Zheng and Bi that Diao is a boy, however it is revealed early on that she is a girl after she is wounded in a skirmish with their pursuers. She remains with Xin after they part ways with Zheng and she cares for their home during some of Xin's early campaigns before heading to strategy academy, where she is taught by Shou Hei Kun. Her expertise result in her eventual appointment as lead strategist of the Hi Shin Unit ~!and later the Hi Shin Army!~. One of the most notable displays of her strategic prowess was during the battle of Koku You Hill.

name: Jian Wang
description: General of Qin and the leader of Wang Jian Army. He is also the current head of the Wang Family

name: Tian Meng
description: The son of Meng Wu and a Qin General leading the Gaku Ka army.

name: Ben Wang
description: Ou Hon is a General of Qin and the leader of the Gyoku Hou Army. The heir to the Ou Family's main branch, he is the son of Great General Ou Sen and a relative to the late Great General Ou Ki.

name: Hui Ji
description:
__Status__ : Alive
__Age__ : 36 
__Relatives__ : 
Ki Shou (father)
Ba Tei (adopted brother)
Ryuu Tou (adopted brother) 
__State__ : Zhao
__Residence__ : City of Rigan


Ki Sui is a General of the Zhao Military forces and the Lord of the City of Rigan.

__Appearance__ : 
Ki Sui possesses a wore thinly mustache and beard. He has long brown hair slicked back and sports a white cape.

Ki Sui's overwhelming love for his hometown, Rigan inspires his soldiers to fight until the end.

name: Kaguya Shinomiya
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm

The vice president of the student council of Shuchiin Academy, member of the wealthy Shinomiya family, she is a multi-talented genius who can do anything if she sets her mind to it. Due to the way she was raised, she instinctively looks down on others and thinks of ways to use them for her own benefit. Kaguya rarely interacted with other people before she joined the student council, but that has begun to change. She is an incredibly sheltered girl, resulting in her lacking in several pieces of what might be considered common sense. She still doesn’t understand love very well, and her main objective is to make [Miyuki Shirogane](https://anilist.co/character/121101) fall in love and confess to her.

Later in the series: ~!She confesses her love to Miyuki Shirogane and they start dating.!~

~!In a [Oshi no Ko special chapter](https://anilist.co/manga/153520), it was revealed that she married Miyuki and changed her surname to Kaguya Shirogane!~

name: Chika Fujiwara
description:
The secretary of the Shuchiin Academy student council. She could not be predicted, her thoughts could not be read. A natural disaster who unconsciously threw everything into chaos simply by being present, also known as __Subject F__.

~!In chapter 222 of the manga, Chika reveals that she played piano because she wanted to be perfect, and she becomes a prodigy at the piano. The expectations of her family and her fans rose, forcing her to practice more. She quit piano after [Kaguya](https://anilist.co/character/120649/Shinomiya-Kaguya) told her to just quit if she didn't like the piano. Soon after Chika challenged Kaguya to a game battle and if she won, she would get to become Kaguya's friend. In the end, she becomes Kaguya's first friend.!~

name: Miko Iino
description:
__Height:__ 147 cm (4'7")

She is a freshman at Shuchiin Private Academy and the Auditor of the Student Council. Miko has a strong sense of justice and will correct others on what's right and wrong. Unfortunately, this led to her being bullied, though she still continues to uphold her idea of "right". She idolizes [Chika Fujiwara](https://anilist.co/character/121103), listening to anything she says, even if it's for Chika's enjoyment.

name: Yuu Ishigami
description:
The treasurer of the student council of the Shuchiin Academy. He's extremely valued by [Miyuki](https://anilist.co/character/121101), given that he single-handedly manages all the school's funds. He's also terrified of [Kaguya](https://anilist.co/character/120649), though no one else is sure why that is. Yuu keeps to himself and rarely speaks up, often getting into trouble when he does. He has a depressed outlook on life while having an inferiority complex. In contrast to his attitude, he is willing to help those in need and will sacrifice his pride if need be. Unlike his high school self, he had a much different outlook and demeanor during middle school.

Later in the series: 
~!Ishigami develops a crush on Tsubame that he inadvertently confesses his feelings for her at the school's cultural festival. Ishigami does not realize that his actions were perceived as a confession by the rest of the student body and is therefore oblivious to the implications of having given Tsubame a heart-shaped gift (considered akin to a confession in Shuchiin tradition). After some convincing by Kaguya, Tsubame decides to seriously consider Ishigami's confession, with her original intention being to let him down as gently as possible. It isn't until Ishigami watches Tsubame's performance of the traditional play that gave rise to the aforementioned tradition that he realizes his actions had unintended meaning. Even then, Ishigami's thickheaded nature prevented him from recognizing the full meaning of his actions: a straight confession!~

~!On the day of the third years' graduation ceremony, Tsubame finally has an answer for Ishigami's proposal. Despite Ishigami doing his best to convince Tsubame to accept him, Tsubame ultimately rejects Ishigami. Tsubame promises Ishigami that the two of them will remain friends and Ishigami sees her off with a smile and a gift of flowers. Afterwards, Ishigami breaks into tears, finally learning what heartbreak is like.!~

name: Ai Hayasaka
description:
Ai Hayasaka is a second-year student at Shuchiin Academy and a valet of the Shinomiya family. She is a member of the Hayasaka family, who have served the Shinomiya family for generations, gaining their trust.

Having been personally assigned to enter Shuchiin Academy with her, Ai supports [Kaguya Shinomiya](https://anilist.co/character/120649) in her high school life and has been a part of Kaguya's life for ten years. Because of their close relationship, Ai is one of the few people around to which Kaguya's amiability is not an act.

Even if she demonstrates maturity as a valet, Ai still has the concerns of a young girl, such as caring to be in fashion and going out with friends, even if she does not have much time for herself due to work.

Ai helps Kaguya with the struggles about her feelings for [Shirogane](https://anilist.co/character/121101).

~!She later leaves her job as a maid to Kaguya but still continues her friendship.!~

~!In the Doujin-ban universe, she starts dating and later gets engaged to Shirogane!~

name: Miyuki Shirogane
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm

He is a second year student at Shuchi'in Academy and the president of the student council.

Miyuki is a handsome young man with blond hair and blue eyes. Due to his constant sleep deprivation and nearsightedness, his eyes appear to glare. He usually wears the regular Shuchi'in Academy black male uniform adorned with the Aiguilette, the golden chain-like accessory around his neck. The Aiguilette symbolizes his authority as student council president.

Shirogane is a diligent student who, despite his underprivileged background, climbed his way to the top of his class through hard work and determination. Shirogane holds himself in high regard, consistently working to maintain his perfect image. He is textbook workaholic, enjoying his part-time job and often putting his own health at risk for the sake of his work. Due to his poor background, Shirogane values money greatly and goes to great lengths to not be wasteful, and generally dislikes expensive gifts.

~!Miyuki's mother left his family when he was a child. Miyuki's father's factory was shut down and currently has no stable employment. They live in an apartment that costs ￥50,000 (Approx $450) a month. Due to this grisly past, he has been led to a lifestyle of part time jobs and hard work. He passed the Level 2 Kanji Kentei exam and has passed Grade Pre 1 on Eiken. He has also got second place on the National mock exam.!~

~!Miyuki transferred into Shuchi'in Academy during his first year of high school on a scholarship. His first week was a disappointment in that a great majority of his peers were condescending to him because of transferring in. Miyuki was being recruited to serve as the new student council general affairs officer by the Previous Student Council President and helped clean up a swamp. There, he saw Kaguya Shinomiya saving a girl from drowning. It was at that moment where he was truly charmed by Kaguya. At the advice of fellow student council member [Momo Ryuuju](https://anilist.co/character/212390/Ryuuju-Momo), he adopted the confident genius personality he is shown to have at the story's beginning in order to attract her.!~

Even though he is obviously in love with [Kaguya Shinomiya](https://anilist.co/character/120649/Shinomiya-Kaguya), her wealth and talents greatly intimidates him, leaving him utterly terrified at the idea of confessing to her. He fears that all of his actions will lead Kaguya to look down him, causing him to overthink in many situations. Shirogane has never had a girlfriend and thus is actually quite clueless when it comes to romance, though his dignified demeanor leaves most of the students to think otherwise. Although he excels at studying, Shirogane has proven to be painfully talentless in a variety of other activities, such as sports, singing, dancing and more.

Despite this, Shirogane is unwaveringly kind and virtuous, never putting any of his goals above the well-being of others. He is extremely supportive and generous, willing to help any students with their problems, and will put aside his quest to get Kaguya to confess if it even has a chance of hurting someone else.

name: Narrator
description:
This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. 

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

name: Kei Shirogane
description:
Kei Shirogane is [Miyuki Shirogane's](https://anilist.co/character/121101) little sister. She attends Shuchiin middle school and is the treasurer for the middle school student council.

She is a hard worker just like her brother and can be very prideful at times. She also inherited his sense of righteousness and hates it when someone doesn't do the right thing in a given situation. Like her brother, she likes helping out those who are in trouble even if it means going out of her way to do it. Since she grew up in a family that places emphasis on saving money, she normally carries coupons and works hard for the things she wants to buy. 

She developed a prickly attitude towards her brother due to his over protectiveness. She's also entered a rebellious phase and due to her pride and she cannot get herself to have a lighthearted conversation with Miyuki, leading into the similar mind games that Miyuki and [Kaguya](https://anilist.co/character/120649) play against each other, but her objective is to talk to Miyuki without making it look like she has a brother complex. She rarely speaks and most of the time it is only when she exchanges formalities at school or when she hurls abuses at her brother.

name: Maki Shijo
description: Maki is a classmate and friend of [Nagisa](https://anilist.co/character/134330). She has short hair styled in short pigtails. She is friends with Nagisa and is secretly jealous of Nagisa's relationship with her boyfriend, as she too liked Kashiwagi's Boyfriend, but could not confess before. As a branch member of the Shinomiya clan, she is [Kaguya](https://anilist.co/character/120649)'s second cousin twice removed so she sometimes refers to Kaguya as "Auntie". [Miyuki](https://anilist.co/character/121101) and [Yuu](https://anilist.co/character/121102/Yuu-Ishigami) observe she acts very tsundere (cold on the outside but wanting to be affectionate), and similar to Kaguya in personality. She declares Yuu and Miyuki as her friends, due to their support in helping her process her failed romance, much to Kaguya's horror

name: Shirogane no Chichi
description:
Father of [Miyuki](https://anilist.co/character/121101) and [Kei Shirogane](https://anilist.co/character/126144).

~!His wife left him and their factory shut down leaving him to not have any stable employment.!~

~!He later becomes a youtuber.!~

name: Nagisa Kashiwagi
description: Nagisa is a classmate who occasionally asks [Kaguya](https://anilist.co/character/120649) about what to do in her relationships. [Tsubasa](https://anilist.co/character/134327)'s girlfriend.

name: Tsubasa Tanuma
description: He is a student in Shuchi'in highschool and always asks [Miyuki Shirogane](https://anilist.co/character/121101) for advice about love. [Kashiwagi](https://anilist.co/character/134330)'s boyfriend.

name: Kozue Makihara
description: Makkii-senhai is a first-year high school student at Shuchi'in Academy and the president of the Tabletop Gaming Club, As the president of the Tabletop Gaming Club, Kozue loves games. She also has a somewhat sadistic sense of humor, as shown by her cheerfully torturing Miko while gathering audio for their class' event during the culture festival. She is shown to be very intelligent, regularly ranking among the top ten students in the freshman class during the end of semester exams.

name: Mikado Shijo
description:
Mikado is the twin brother of [Maki](https://anilist.co/character/134328). He is among the story's smartest characters, as he placed first in the national mock exam during freshman year, to [Miyuki](https://anilist.co/character/121101)'s second place. As such, Miyuki has had an obsession with beating him in a rematch. However, Mikado chose to attend a nearby public school in order to play soccer with his friends.

~!After leading his team to the national championship, Mikado transfers to Shuchiin, where he becomes a member of Class 3-A, along with all of the story's notable third years, including Kaguya, Miyuki, Maki, [Chika](https://anilist.co/character/121103/) and [Ai](https://anilist.co/character/121104/).!~

~!Mikado is revealed to be very much a normal teenager, albeit a genius, as he has normal worries like being able to make friends at a new school. He also readily defers to his sister, despite finding her crazy and incomprehensible. Interestingly, Mikado is very similar to Miyuki, and the two quickly go from misunderstood rivals to close friends.!~

name: Shuuji Taira
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm (5'11")

A boy in [Suzuki](https://anilist.co/character/281250/Miyu-Suzuki) and [Tani's](https://anilist.co/character/281251/Yusuke-Tani) class with a cynical attitude. Lacking confidence, he often compares himself to others and ends up feeling insecure or down.

name: Miyu Suzuki
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm (5'2")

An energetic but self-conscious girl. She admires [Tani](https://anilist.co/character/281251/Yusuke-Tani) for being the complete opposite of herself, but she can't interact with him normally and always ends up bothering him with pointless conversation.

name: Shino Azuma
description:
__Height:__ 163 cm (5'4")

A mature-minded girl in [Suzuki](https://anilist.co/character/281250/Miyu-Suzuki) and [Tani's](https://anilist.co/character/281251/Yusuke-Tani) class. Though she comes off as jaded, she's never experienced a proper romantic relationship.

name: Natsumi Nishi
description:
__Height:__ 147 cm (4'10")

A quiet and reserved girl from the class next to [Suzuki](https://anilist.co/character/281250/Miyu-Suzuki) and [Tani](https://anilist.co/character/281251/Yusuke-Tani) who actually laughs at just about everything. She's extremely shy and bad at talking to classmates other than [Honda](https://anilist.co/character/378435/Rikako-Honda). One of her main worries is always being a beat behind in conversations.

name: Kentarou Yamada
description:
__Height:__ 173 cm (5'8")

A cheerful, easygoing boy and classmate of [Suzuki](https://anilist.co/character/281250/Miyu-Suzuki) and [Tani](https://anilist.co/character/281251/Yusuke-Tani). He's the life of the party, open, honest, and quick to befriend anyone. He expresses his thoughts without holding back.

name: Yuusuke Tani
description:
__Height:__ 171 cm (5'7")

A quiet boy who clearly states his opinions. [Suzuki](https://anilist.co/character/281250/Miyu-Suzuki) always approaches him with a lighthearted vibe, but he always seems to reply curtly.

name: Rikako Honda
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm (5'2")

A girl from the same class as Nishi, with a dry, no-nonsense personality. She's logical and values efficiency in everything. She's close friends with [Nishi](https://anilist.co/character/302624/Nishi-Natsumi) and the only person Nishi communicates with normally.

name: Manami Watanabe
description:
__Height:__ 155 cm (5'1")

A cheerful, upbeat classmate of [Suzuki](https://anilist.co/character/281250/Miyu-Suzuki) and [Tani.](https://anilist.co/character/281251/Yusuke-Tani) She's free-spirited and says exactly what's on her mind without hesitation.

name: Aoi Satou
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3")

A quiet and cool-headed girl, also a classmate of [Suzuki](https://anilist.co/character/281250/Miyu-Suzuki) and [Tani.](https://anilist.co/character/281251/Yusuke-Tani) Calm and reliable, she tends to observe her friends' love lives with a rational, objective perspective.

name: Tempura
description: [Yuusuke's](https://anilist.co/character/281251) pet cat.

name: Gomapon
description: Miyu's social studies teacher.

name: Eikichi Onizuka
description: A hormonal, blonde-haired biker and virgin, Onizuka Eikichi graduated from a bottom-rung university by cheating and, as such, cannot get a decent job. His main way of spending time is peering up girls' skirts in a local mall. He is very athletic, as he can bench press 150 kg (331 lbs), has a second dan black belt in karate, and even claims to perform 500 push-ups, 1000 pull ups and 2000 squats daily.

name: Urumi Kanzaki
description:
The antithesis to the "dumb blonde" stereotype, Urumi Kanzaki is a prodigy with an IQ over 200. She is also a heterochromatic, possessing different colored eyes: one brown and one blue. 

However, she is psychologically disturbed, having her fair share of hate toward teachers. Her genius is displayed repeatedly by such abstract actions as the detonation of time bombs (i.e. firecrackers in disposable boxes) and making a harmless snake look like a cobra using paper cutouts. 

Her intellect is also shown through actions, such as shouting curse words in French and being able to speak fluent Mandarin. On the trip in Okinawa, Toshito Kikuchi noted that she can speak 5 languages.

name: Yoshito Kikuchi
description:
