Yukako is a student in love with Koichi Hirose. At first she was very aggressive in her affections towards him, jealously attacking what she believed were potential rivals in love and even going so far as to kidnap him and threaten his life should he not return her feelings and not appreciate her efforts to "change him into a better person" – she had picked up false rumors that he was insufferable, false rumors that were spread by Josuke and Okuyasu in order to help Koichi in turning her away from him; unfortunately for them, their measures had the opposite effect.   Later in the story, Yukako, still lovestruck, seemed to have learned from her mistake in trying to force Koichi. Unhappy about her unrequited love she made use of the services offered by Aya Tsuji's beauty enhancing Cinderella stand, which rendered her into a bewitchingly attractive woman in the eyes of Koichi - for a price and a certain time limit, during which she was to use a special lipstick in order to uphold the "magic" i.e. the stand's power.    ~!The stand allowed her to grow closer to Koichi, who, after some trials and tribulations, warmed up to her and willingly became her boyfriend. !~

name: Mikitaka Hasekura
description: Mikitaka first appears in chapter 378 (I Am An Alien! 1). He claims he's a 216 year old alien from the Mclon system looking for a planet for his people to live in. His job is piloting a space shuttle and his hobby is raising small pets. He possesses the ability to assume any physical form he desires. Although he can take a form vastly smaller than his normal mass, and can separate himself into several components in the process, it is not known if he can take on a much larger form. On the negative side, if exposed to a siren or similar sound, he suffers a painful rash until the sound stops. It was never revealed in the manga whether Mikitaka is a delusional stand user activated by the Arrow or truly an extraterrestrial life-form (he gives his full name as Nu Mikitakazo Nshi). According to JOJO!A-GO-GO artbook, his stand's name is Earth, Wind And Fire.

name: Tonio Trussardi
description:
Tonio is a man of average to above-average height and medium build. He keeps short, light, neat hair; and he often wears a genial expression.
Tonio is only shown in his chef's uniform, comprising a light or white double-breasted jacket, a loose tie, an apron, and a tall, cylindrical hat. He wears the small, metallic emblem of a "T" at the upper corners of the chest his jacket and apron, and at the frontal fold of his hat.
(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

name: Shigekiyo Yanguu
description:
A side character in Diamond is Unbreakable. Shigechi is a short and stocky teenage boy. Apparently bald, his crown is textured by short spikes, and he has thick, drooping earlobes. He has small, high eyebrows, and youthful features. His teeth are misaligned, and he is missing his left maxillary central incisor.

Introduced as a kid using his Stand, Harvest, to collect money throughout the town, Shigechi befriends Josuke Higashikata and Okuyasu Nijimura.
~!He is soon killed by Yoshikage Kira, prompting Josuke Higashikata and his friend's search for the murderer.!~

name: Hayato Kawajiri
description: Hayato is the son of Kosaku Kawajiri and [Shinobu Kawajiri](https://anilist.co/character/130141/Kawajiri-Shinobu). He does not like to interact with his family and spends most of his time inside his bedroom.

name: Tomoko Higashikata
description:
She is the single mother of [Josuke Higashikata](https://anilist.co/character/13085/Jousuke-Higashikata).

A single mother and teacher, Tomoko is known to show a strong temperament, disliking it when guys try to hit on her (as she still loves Joseph) and she gets annoyed quite easily. She also seems to be mildly perceptive, noticing that the seal on her milk that Angelo had given her was broken. Despite her sharp temperament, she is mostly a kind person, particularly to her family and friends.

name: Yuuya Fungami
description:
Yuuya Fungami is a minor character in Diamond is Unbreakable. He is featured as an antagonist in Highway Star, and as an ally in Enigma Boy.

Yuuya is a motorcycle gang member who was made into a Stand User by [Yoshihiro Kira](https://anilist.co/character/130129/Kira-Yoshihiro) and prompted into attacking the Joestar Group. Selfishly attacking [Rohan](https://anilist.co/character/12659/Kishibe-Rohan) and [Jousuke](https://anilist.co/character/13085/Higashikata-Jousuke) in a high-speed road chase with his Highway Star, Yuuya later assists Jousuke in the fight against Terunosuke.

name: Akira Otoishi
description:
Akira was one of the many people Keicho Nijimura shot with the Bow and Arrow while trying to find a stand user capable of killing his mutated father. Akira was one the many lucky ones to develop a stand after which point he became interested in them and how to create them. To further his goal on studying them he needed the Bow and Arrow which he forcefully took from Keicho leading to Keicho's death. From there on he tormented several people, among them Josuke while trying to improve in the use of his guitar skills.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Wiki)

name: Shinobu Kawajiri
description: Shinobu has reddish-pink hair (brown hair in manga) that is parted to the right and tied back in low ponytail. Sometimes, like in her first appearance, she will tie back several locks of hair that are part of her bangs.

name: Tama
description: Tama was once a normal cat that was hit with an Arrow while peacefully lazing about by a tree.

name: Terunosuke Miyamoto
description:
Terunosuke is a man of average height and slim build. He has skin of a medium tone, light eyes, and light hair that is styled in a criss-cross pattern, framing his face and curling upwards at its ends.

He wears a long, light coat closed to the end of his chest. Underneath is a dark top wrapped in three ornate belts and fitted dark pants. The inside of his coat has the word "ENIGMA" printed at its bottom.

name: Beatrice
description:
The Golden Witch and Endless Witch. She is affectionately referred to as "Beato" (ベアト). A witch who has lived for over a thousand years, she is said to appear as a cloud of golden butterflies, and has the power to summon higher demons among the seventy-two pillars to serve her. It is said that humans can summon her to have their wishes granted in exchange for compensation, though she often acts whimsically. She is the one rumored to have given [Kinzo](https://anilist.co/character/14041/Ushiromiya-Kinzou) ten tons of gold and served under him as the alchemic advisor to the Ushiromiya family.

~!She is one of the personalites of Yasu and was made as the ideal girl for Battler to fall in love with after [Shannon](https://anilist.co/character/15435/Shannon)'s feelings were made to be directed at [George](https://anilist.co/character/14042/Ushiromiya-George) instead of Battler!~

name: Battler Ushiromiya
description:
Battler is the son of [Rudolf](https://anilist.co/character/14043/Ushiromiya-Rudolf) and his first wife [Asumu](https://anilist.co/character/259608/Ushiromiya-Asumu), and is generally considered to be the main protagonist of the series. 

He is extremely stubborn, and is afraid of "shaky" transportation, fearing he might fall off a boat.  At first glance, he appears to be hotheaded, cocky, and even a little perverted. However, he has a heart of gold he isn't afraid to show when the situation calls for it.

name: Frederica Bernkastel
description:
A mysterious witch who appears to [Battler](https://anilist.co/character/14040/Ushiromiya-Battler) following the first game, providing advice and telling him she will support him in his endeavors to solve the mystery of the witch [Beatrice](https://anilist.co/character/10285/Beatrice). Although an ally to Battler, Bernkastel has a twisted personality and refers to herself as the "cruelest witch in the world", and is only interested in Beatrice's game as a chance to escape her own boredom. She is known as the Witch of Miracles, and she has the power to reset any situation and realize a goal, eventually securing victory even with a 0.0000000000001% probability, so long as it is not zero. Initially stoic, cold, and calm, she slowly reveals herself to be just as impish and cruel as her rival, [Lambdadelta](https://anilist.co/character/10196/Lambdadelta).

~!Bernkastel's true identity is strongly implied to be that of Rika Furude's witch self, formed from the suffering she underwent as she died again and again within the loops of Higurashi. She appears briefly in Higurashi, first to provide advice to the reader during Minagoroshi-hen, and then travelling to the past to create a 'perfect' world where Miyoko's parents never died, preventing all the sins that lead to the gameboard of Higurashi. The relationship between her and Rika is examined more thoroughly during Saikoroshi-hen, where a drunken Rika questions her own humanity and christens herself "Frederica Bernkastel", a slurring of her name with the brand of her wine tacked on. After suffering and giving into her aloof personality as Bernkastel, Rika decides to let go and stop being the witch Bernkastel, though she wonders if perhaps this aspect of herself remains on a higher plane, toying with the fate of lower beings.!~

name: Erika Furudo
description:
The main antagonist and self-proclaimed intellectual rapist of End of the Golden Witch and Dawn of the Golden Witch. She is a young detective introduced in End of the Golden Witch. A blue-haired girl estimated by [Genji](https://anilist.co/character/21086/Ronoue-Genji) to be about [Jessica](https://anilist.co/character/14044/Ushiromiya-Jessica)'s age, 18, she's highly intelligent and possesses a photographic memory.  She's quite polite in public and shows a deep interest in mysteries. In reality, she's quite ruthless and cunning and only solves mysteries, so she can sneer at those who pose them. She does, however, possess a serious inferiority complex, since she emotionally breaks down whenever things aren't in her favor. 

~!After the events of The Great Court of Illusions, Bernkastel grants Erika the title of The Witch of Truth as a reward for completely destroying the witch illusion of the 5th game.!~

name: Lambdadelta
description:
She is also known as the Most Powerful Witch in the Universe before losing to [Bernkastel](https://anilist.co/character/11840/Bernkastel-Frederica) and is feared by most other witches, including [Beatrice](https://anilist.co/character/10285/Beatrice). She is quite childish and holds a grudge against Bernkastel for finally beating her in their last game, although she actually cares for her.

Her "Magic of Certainty" allows her to kill anyone without fail as an absolute result, which bends the basic rule of Umineko magic requiring a risk. Like Bernkastel, she is a Voyager. She wishes for [Battler](https://anilist.co/character/14040/Ushiromiya-Battler) and Beatrice to fight against each other for eternity as a part of a larger plot to have Bernkastel lose against her.

She has lived for a thousand years. As a witch, she embodies the concept that 'hard-workers are rewarded', and is very respected even by human beings. She doesn't flee from the human concept of witch. Hence, the power of hers, who is a being respected by human beings, is immeasurable. However, she is whimsical about whose efforts she will reward and, in many situations, the person who can please her more will be able to receive her smile.

Her tremendous and swiftly fierce power makes any kind of witch surrender in a moment. However, she seems to be reckless and it was thoroughly read by Bernkastel.

~!Her name and appearance hint at her being connected to [Miyo Takano](https://anilist.co/character/4934/Takano-Miyo) from Higurashi leading to the possibility that the "game" she played with Bernkastel was the world of Higurashi with the battle between [Rika](https://anilist.co/character/1534/Furude-Rika) and Takano being the purpose of the game.   "Lambdadelta" (λδ) represents thirty-four when using Greek numerals and "Miyo" (三四)  can be translated as "three, four" in Japanese, strengthening their connection.!~

name: Maria Ushiromiya
description:
Maria is Rosa's daughter, and is the youngest of the cousins. She has a habit of uttering 'uu-uu' at times, which frustrates Rosa greatly. Maria is also rather stubborn, and believes things easily, which isn't uncommon for someone her age. She has an interest in the occult, like her grandfather. She carries around a bag which is filled with occult items, such as a scorpion charm which wards off evil. She idolizes witches, and believes that they are there to bring people joy and happiness. In Maria's notebooks there are sketches of witches, and the witches are beautiful, fantastical creatures. It upsets Maria greatly when someone denies the existence of witches, especially Beatrice's existence. At certain times, Maria undergoes a personality change, and begins to laugh in an unnerving fashion. When she is in this mode, she acts rather condescendingly with regards to things about the occult, and will often call people like Battler 'stupid' for having little to no knowledge of such things.     ~!She is the subject of bullying in her class, and the boys in her class often took her books and rubbed them off each other, saying that they got her 'germs'. However, Maria is content with being bullied. Maria came up with quite an imaginative story, where a horrid witch is terrorizing the school, causing students to get into accidents and the like. However, an angel offers one student as a sacrifice so that all the other students shall be safe. With that story, Maria doesn't mind being the subject of bullying, as she feels like everyone else can remain safe while she shoulders the burden.    Although she has no real friends, with Maria's vivid imagination, she breathes life into her stuffed animals. Namely, Sakutaro. Sakutaro was originally a stuffed lion cub, created by Rosa as a birthday present to give to Maria. Maria cherished it, and even though she was often alone, with Sakutaro she didn't feel as alone. However, Sakutaro met a tragic end when Rosa ripped him apart.    Maria is a rather innocent child, and fully believes that her mother needs to work such long hours and weekends. Rosa often forgets Maria's promises, but Maria says that her mother's work is more important. Rosa has told Maria never to call her work office unless it's an emergency. But, once when Maria called, the office told her that her mother wasn't at work. Even when Rosa takes impromptu holidays with her various boyfriends, Maria fully believes in her mother. Rosa often gives in to guilt, and ends up buying Maria presents, such as 'the rabbit band', or various Western sweets.!~

~! __Maria as a witch:__  In the Umineko series it is heavily debated whether magic exists or not, but Maria has her own personal grimoire, in which she conjures up her own spells. Such as, 'have [x] for dinner', or 'make mama come home early'. One particular spell is for her mother's love, where all that is required is a simple 'uu-uu'. Maria came up with this spell after a rather touching day spent with Rosa on a picnic. Rosa taught Maria a song, and Rosa was so pleased that Maria knew the words. However, when Maria forgot the words, she started singing 'uu-uu' instead, but Rosa remained in her happy state. While Rosa thought that her saying 'uu-uu' was charming for a while, she eventually grew frustrated with it, and often resorted to hitting her. Whenever Rosa hits Maria, Maria says that she has been taken over by 'the black witch'.    Maria is a member of the Mariage Sorcière, an alliance of witches in which she and her idol, Beatrice, are exclusive members of. Despite having the same wand as Eva-Beatrice, she is not an Endless Witch successor. By succeeding to give a soul to Sakutaro, she is a potential Creator: a witch with an even higher rank than Bernkastel and Lambdadelta, who (when she will learn how to use her power) may be able to create even a galaxy from nothing. She is also the witch teacher of Ange, despite the fact that they did not see each other as she was banished from Mariage Sorcière.!~

name: Eva Ushiromiya
description: Kinzo's second child. Under normal circumstances, she would have lost her place in the Ushiromiya family when she married, though she managed to retain her name on the family register when she had her husband Hideyoshi adopted into the family and gave birth to Kinzo's first grandchild, George.  Eva is cheerful and mischievous, but also sinister and greedy. She is hostile towards her older brother Krauss, and rallies the other siblings against him in their fight for the family inheritance. She also looks down on Krauss's wife Natsuhi for not being related to the Ushiromiya family by blood. Because she believes George to be the rightful head of the Ushiromiya family, she is cruel towards the servant Shannon, as she suspects her of being his lover.   Despite her insidious personality, however, she treasures her husband and son more than anything, but fears that she is too domineering towards them. She is skilled in various martial arts, and said to be excellent at cooking.     ~!In Banquet of the Golden Witch, Eva solves the riddle of Beatrice's epitaph and returns from Rokkenjima as the head of the Ushiromiya family and sole survivor of the murder incident, but is unable to overcome the grief over losing her husband and son. As depicted in the story and TIPS of Alliance of the Golden Witch, Eva lives miserably for the next twelve years as the guardian of Ange, the only other surviving member of the Ushiromiya family, resenting her for "stealing" the role of the family heir from George until she dies of acute heart failure in the year 1998.!~

name: Natsuhi Ushiromiya
description: Krauss' wife. Born into a family of Shinto priests, Natsuhi discarded her old life when she married into the Ushiromiya family. She is a very proud woman who holds her new family's name in high regard, and is in charge of managing the family head house and family conferences. Unfortunately for her, all of her efforts are often undervalued by her husband, and she is often afflicted by headaches. She holds a bitter rivalry with Eva, who mocks her for not being related to the Ushiromiya family by blood. As a mother, Natsuhi is incredibly strict towards her daughter Jessica, but only out of concern that she becomes an ideal heiress to the Ushiromiya family.

name: Shannon
description:
__Race:__ Furniture

Shannon (Her real name is Sayo- 紗代) is a maidservant working on Rokkenjima. She has a habit of making mistakes and blunders when she is nervous, despite being an extremely talented and hardworking servant. She thinks of [Kanon](https://anilist.co/character/14045/Kanon) as her younger brother, and like him, she feels she is inferior to humans, as she is only furniture. Despite this, she has fallen in love with [George](https://anilist.co/character/14042/Ushiromiya-George). 

In the second game, "Turn of the Golden Witch" ~!Shannon is shown to having the power to use a luminous sort of scythe on her arm, as can Kanon, and a large, pink, protective shield with arrows rotating around it. She, along with Kanon, are portrayed to have been taught this by [Genji](https://anilist.co/character/21086/Ronoue-Genji), as at the end of a battle, he can put them to rest, before being thanked by the pair. In Turn of the Golden Witch she breaks a mirror sealing some of [Beatrice](https://anilist.co/character/10285/Beatrice)'s power in return for a spell to bring her and George together, and in Legend of the Golden Witch, it is shown that she accepts his proposal, as she is wearing the ring on her ring finger when she is killed.!~


~!Shannon is actually one of the personalities of [Yasu](https://anilist.co/character/39949/Yasuda), who is the child of [Kinzo](https://anilist.co/character/14041/Ushiromiya-Kinzou) and Beatrice Ushiromiya. "Shannon" is the embodiment of the ideal servant whom Yasu admired the most as a child, and also the embodiment of femininity.!~

name: Rosa Ushiromiya
description:
[Kinzo](https://anilist.co/character/14041/Ushiromiya-Kinzou)'s fourth child. As the youngest of her siblings, she has the least influence at the family conference. Her husband abandoned her shortly before the birth of her daughter and only child, [Maria](https://anilist.co/character/8555/Ushiromiya-Maria).

Rosa is the president of a small design company, "Anti-Rosa", which has recently begun to flounder, and she thus seeks out Kinzo's inheritance to pay off her co-endorsers.

On the surface, Rosa appears to be the most sensible and soothing of all the siblings. However, as a result of being downtrodden by her older siblings in her childhood and forced to endure the pressures of a single mother, she frequently loses control of her emotions and responds violently to her daughter's childish behavior and overenthusiastic approach to the occult. While Rosa thought that Maria saying 'uu-uu' was charming for a while, she eventually grew frustrated with it, and often resorted to hitting her. Whenever Rosa hits Maria, Maria says that she has been taken over by "the black witch".

name: Dlanor A. Knox
description:
Dlanor is Chief Inquisitor of Eiserne Jungfrau and a first-class archbishop, popularly known as "Dlanor of the Ten Wedges" and "Death Sentence Dlanor". She is named after Ronald Knox, and even upholds Knox's Decalogue  during her debates. She has the appearance of a young girl with lavender hair and yellow eyes, and wears a uniform similar to that of a cleric. The ends of her sentences are written in katakana as a form of honorific. She is cold towards witches and takes her duties very seriously. Despite her duties as a witch-hunter, however, she is old friends with [Virgilia](https://anilist.co/character/19046/Virgilia) (she classifies Virgilia as one of the "good witches").

Her main weapons are her Red Key and Blue Key, which take the forms of a longsword and shortsword, respectively. She is only dispatched by the Great Court as a last resort after a case is vigorously inspected; in other words, to have Dlanor sent is the equivalent of receiving a death sentence, hence the nickname "Death Sentence Dlanor".

~!Her father was a legendary Inquisitor of Heresy, but he broke the rules and was executed. She was the one who performed his interrogation and execution. Since that time, she has stopped growing, and both her body and mind remain eternally those of a young maiden. It is whispered that her heart also died at that moment, but she does not see it that way.!~

name: Kanon
description: A young servant of [Kinzo](https://anilist.co/character/14041/Ushiromiya-Kinzou)'s mansion. He is a serious and fervent servant, carrying out his master's orders thoroughly. He is a bit frail and antisocial. He considers [Shannon](https://anilist.co/character/15435/Shannon) as an older sister and highly disapproves of her feelings for [George](https://anilist.co/character/14042/Ushiromiya-George), as he believes she should not feel love as she is only furniture.

name: Jessica Ushiromiya
description:
Krauss and Natsuhi's eighteen-year-old daughter. She is an energetic young girl, serving as the student body president at her school, and even leading a rock band. If her father inherits the family fortune, she will become the heiress to the Ushiromiya family, although the family's patriarchal hierarchy denotes her future husband will become the next head. Jessica is tomboyish, feisty, and rebellious, much to the dismay of her mother, who insists she act more refined and ladylike. She dislikes her parents at times for the pressures they place on her regarding the family inheritance, which she has no interest in. However, she still shows concern for them deep down. She was born with weak bronchi, and occasionally suffers from asthma attacks. 

~!She is in love with Kanon, who tries to hide his own feelings from her, though she manages to reach out to him in Dawn of the Golden Witch, and they become a couple. She is willing to go to great lengths to gain Kanon's respect, and tries to avoid doing anything that could jeopardize that. Jessica is shown to be skilled with brass knuckles in Alliance of the Golden Witch. !~

name: Kinzou Ushiromiya
description:
The elderly head of the Ushiromiya family, and the owner of Rokkenjima. He is a rabid practitioner of black magic and the occult, his shelves lined with volumes upon volumes of grimoires. One of his most prominent obsessions is [Beatrice](https://anilist.co/character/10285/Beatrice), a witch he is said to have summoned and contracted for ten tons worth of gold. He rarely leaves his exceedingly vast study, which contains various commodities such as a bed, lavatory, and bath. 

Throughout the first four games, ~!Kinzo's body frequently turns up burnt in the incinerator of the mansion's underground boiler room, and is identified due to his polydactyly, distinguished by having six toes on each foot. In life, Kinzo held his children in contempt, viewing them as vultures ready to feast on his inheritance as soon as he died (or at least when word of his death spread out).!~

At the end of the 4th game, Alliance of the Golden Witch ~!it is revealed that he has been deceased as of two years before the events on October 4th 1986, having succumbed to his long-time drinking habit. However, his oldest son [Krauss](https://anilist.co/character/21083/Ushiromiya-Krauss), Krauss's wife [Natsuhi](https://anilist.co/character/16719/Ushiromiya-Natsuhi), his personal physician [Nanjou](https://anilist.co/character/21082/Nanjou-Terumasa), and all the mansion's servants (except for [Gouda](https://anilist.co/character/21084/Gouda-Toshiro)) maintain the illusion at the family conference that he is still alive, albeit with a three-month life expectancy; any interactions between Kinzo and any other characters are meant to sell the deception to the reader regarding the true events.!~

name: Kyrie Ushiromiya
description: Rudolf's second wife. She is also one of Rudolf's business partners, always assisting him in shady dealings and keeping him in line when he gets out of hand. Kyrie and Battler have bonded more as close friends with a sibling-like relationship rather than mother and son, with Battler going as far as always calling her "Kyrie-san." She is well versed in game theory and is known for her "flip the chessboard" mentality, influencing Battler in this regard. She had actually dated Rudolf long before his first wife Asumu, who she envies for marrying Rudolf while she was still going out with him.

name: Virgilia
description:
She was the previous Endless Witch before Beatrice, and was also her teacher.     

Her new name (having passed her old one to her student) comes from the Divine Comedy character Virgil, who guides Dante through Hell and Purgatory to Beatrice, who is his guide through Heaven. She is a silver-haired witch with great powers, despite surrendering most of them to Beatrice with the title of the "Endless Witch". Unlike Beatrice, Virgilia thinks that the powers of a witch should be used for good and not for selfish means.     

She taught Beatrice the Endless Magic, and retired, believing that Beatrice would also devote herself for the people. At the same time that she was Beatrice's teacher, she also served as the magician of Beatrice's home. Because of that, Virgilia had come in contact with her with the position of a servant. It is said that this became her downfall, and invited Beatrice's arrogance and recklessness     

~!She assists Battler during Banquet of the Golden Witch, helping him to come up with theories to counter the claims that Beatrice sets forth, though it is revealed in the end that her allegiances lie entirely with Beatrice, having worked with and secretly assisted her throughout the game in an effort to make Battler accept the existence of witches.    

However, she ends up becoming Battler's ally once again in End of the Golden Witch when Battler becomes the Endless Sorcerer. She is a dangerous opponent, as she can beat Beatrice in combat if not for a surprise attack. She is also somewhat bumbling as well.!~    She may be linked to Chiyo Kumasawa.

name: Ronove
description:
The 27th highest ranking earl of hell named after the demon of the same name. Ronove serves as [Beatrice](https://anilist.co/character/10285/Beatrice)'s (and later, [Battler](https://anilist.co/character/14040/Ushiromiya-Battler)'s) butler and head furniture. He often serves black tea and cookies to Beatrice and her guests. Nonchalant, he often bears a mysterious smile that is hard to interpret, even for his master. Even though he is bound by contract with Beatrice, he does not hesitate to state facts to tease her. He shares a link with [Genji Ronoue](https://anilist.co/character/21086/Ronoue-Genji), similar to the one held by [Virgilia](https://anilist.co/character/19046/Virgilia) and [Chiyo Kumasawa](https://anilist.co/character/21085/Kumasawa-Chiyo).

In Alliance of the Golden Witch, he engages [Jessica](https://anilist.co/character/14044/Ushiromiya-Jessica) in combat, where he utilizes barriers for both offense and defense, generating strong ones to both deflect attacks and launch enemies backwards. He can also use a special barrier that returns damage back to the attacker.

~!He is the fantasy version of the servant Genji, created by [Yasu](https://anilist.co/character/39949/Yasuda).!~

name: George Ushiromiya
description:
Eva and Hideyoshi's twenty-three-year-old son. He is the oldest of Kinzo's grandchildren, and an exceptional and diligent young adult. He was brought up by Eva specifically with the family headship in mind, and is also a skilled martial artist like his mother. He worked at his father's company as an apprentice throughout college, and respects his parents greatly, though he admittedly finds his mother overbearing. George is admired by everyone in his family, especially his cousins, who view him as their older brother and peacemaker. In his youth, however, he had been jealous of their more independent and impulsive lifestyles, particularly Battler, as unlike him, his mother made him do various things in his youth in order to shape him into the next head. As a result, he put up a more condescending mask towards his cousins, but has since outgrown this inferiority complex to a certain degree. He is in love with the maid Shannon and proposes to her (or at least intends to) in every game. Believing that his romance with a servant would be frowned upon by his family, however, he is fully willing and prepared to face the consequences.    
~!Having been personally trained since childhood by his mother, George is an absolute master in various forms of martial arts and, just like Eva, he demonstrates a preference in fighting exclusively with kicks. In the Meta-World he proves to be such a fast, agile and powerful adversary that he not only could easily eliminate goats and confront higher level demons like Gaap, but he even manages to overcome and kill EVA-Beatrice.

His axe kick is also powerful enough to smash a human skull (as shown in Alliance of the Golden Witch).!~

name: Gaap
description:
The 33rd highest ranking earl of hell named after the demon of the same name. She is a curly-haired woman who wears a red dress and a hat with a pink bow. Quite flamboyant, Gaap loves to tease people and give people random nicknames by shortening their names ("Riiche" for Beatrice, "Lia" for Virgilia, etc.). She is one of Beatrice's friends, though she is greatly disliked by Virgilia. She draws power from the Abyss to summon holes that can lead anywhere, although there are limits. In battle, particularly against George in Alliance of the Golden Witch, she uses a combination of these portals and various kicks that stab with her sharp heels, overwhelming her opponent and keeping them from moving as they emerge from the portal in mid-air.
~!From an anti-fantasy perspective, Gaap was created as an imaginary friend by Yasu as a personification of their habit to lose things. Instead of being called Gaap, at this point in time she was called Beatrice. Yasu envisioned Beatrice as the reason why their keys would always disappear and earned her help in playing pranks on servants. At some point, Yasu created a new design for Beatrice and made the original appearance the demon Gaap.!~

name: Rudolf Ushiromiya
description:
Kinzo's third child, and Battler's father. After his wife Asumu's death, he immediately remarried with Kyrie, leading to a falling out with his son, who ran away from home for six years. Rudolf is still known to chat up young women from time to time, though this does not seem to disturb Kyrie. He is an avid lover of Western films and an impressive marksman. He seeks Kinzo's fortune to settle a court case in America.

~! He was known as a philanderer in his youth and had impregnated his business partner and old girlfriend Kyrie with their son Battler before he married his first wife Asumu. He then deceived Kyrie and the other members of the Ushiromiya family into believing that Battler was actually Asumu's child, and that Kyrie's child was stillborn. !~

name: Krauss Ushiromiya
description:
Kinzo's first child. He is the next in line to inherit the family headship, and takes the initiative to lead the family conferences.  Due to his arrogant nature, he has made himself something of an enemy to the siblings, who see him as trying to monopolize Kinzo's fortune, and unanimously attempt to upstage him, though with little success. His daughter, Jessica, also has little respect for him, particularly due to the pressure he places on her to become (or at least marry) a suitable successor to the Ushiromiya family after him. He is a real estate investor, and is currently supplying his funds to a resort. However, he has been unable to carry out his plans, and thus his investments end in failure. Despite always swaggering about, Krauss holds genuine remorse for all the troubles he put his family through. He is known to have taken up boxing in his youth, and still possesses quite a bit of skill in that area. Unlike his siblings, he lives on Rokkenjima with his father, wife, and daughter.

~!He is one of the few people on Rokkenjima who is aware that Kinzo is already dead, and also knows of the existence of Kinzo's hidden gold, which the other family members doubt.!~

name: Chiester 410
description:
She is named after the .410 Winchester shotgun. Chiester 410 wears a blue uniform and has short teal hair. Unlike Chiester 45, 410 has a childish, silly smile on her face most of the time. Her duty is the main sniper using the information from Chiester 45.
~!She is the fantasy version of one of the ceramic bunnies that Maria used to play with.!~

name: Chiester 45
description:
The Siestas are bunny-girl servants summoned by Beatrice. It is said that there is no escape from the Siestas attacks, and they can even locate and bring back a corpse. They have red eyes, bunny ears, and elaborate military-styled outfits.
She is named after the .45 Winchester shotgun. Siesta 45 wears a red uniform and has long pink hair tied in two ponytails. She has a serious look most of the time. Her duty is battle control, information gathering and data mining, trajectory calculating and sending it to Siesta 410.
~!She is the fantasy version of one of the ceramic bunnies that Maria used to play with.!~

name: Beelzebub
description:
Representing the demon Beelzebub and the corresponding the sin of Gluttony. Beelzebub's appearance is a girl with short curly blond hair in two pony tails. She is a gourmet, and is willing to use even her own flesh if it is used to make a delicious meal. She is the second youngest of the 'Stakes of Purgatory'.

~!She is the fantasy version of one of the servants that used to bully [Sayo Yasuda](https://anilist.co/character/39949/Yasuda) as a child.!~

name: Hideyoshi Ushiromiya
description: Hideyoshi is Eva's husband. He is the successful president of a chain of fast food restaurants. He's a very jovial man and manages to tone down the tension between the siblings during their various meetings. He seeks Kinzo's fortune due to people trying to buy all his shares.He speaks with a fake Kansai accent, which he is said to be too embarrassed to use against actual Kansai people.

name: Maria Otonashi
description:
An antisocial beauty with a resolute personality. She transfers into [Kazuki Hoshino](https://anilist.co/character/87513/Hoshino-Kazuki)'s class on March 2nd—right before the end of the school year. Immediately upon her arrival, she announces her intent to “break” Kazuki.

~!Her life first intertwines with Kazuki when she sneaks into Mogi's box that created the recurring classroom. Being a box herself, she is able to keep her memories each recurrence. She spends years searching for the one who has the box and created the recurring classroom. During this time she also spent lots of time obtaining new skills, such as martial arts and how to ride a motorcycle.!~

~!In the final volume Maria and Kazuki get married.!~

name: Kazuki Hoshino
description: A completely ordinary high school student who loves idle chatter with his friends and Umaibōs, a Japanese snack. One day, he somehow suddenly antagonizes Aya Otonashi — even though he has never met her before. She threatens to “break” him.

name: Daiya Oomine
description:
A self-centered and arrogant student who dyes his hair silver and wears three piercings in his right ear. He is also the class president and a shrewd friend of Kazuki’s.

~!Daiya used Kamiuchi and his box in order to learn how to master his own. He tricked Hoshino into believing that he was the real owner. He kills Kamiuchi which terminates the box.!~
(Source: Baka-Tsuki)

name: Kasumi Mogi
description: The girl who has won Kazuki’s heart. She is docile, silent and expressionless. ~!She was actually the owner of the box that created the Rejecting Classroom. She used to be a bright and cheerful girl before but that was an act she put on for herself. Kazuki saw through her and that's why she fell in love with him. When she was hit by the truck she regretted not being able to tell Kazuki how she feels. This allowed her to create the Rejecting Classroom. Inside the classroom due to all the loops and other experiences, her personality changed to silent and expressionless.!~ ~!After the Rejecting Classroom was destroyed she was hit by that truck for the last time. She managed to survive but was severely injured and was confined to a wheelchair.!~

name: Kokone Kirino
description:
A bright and beautiful girl who cares a lot for her friends, but can sometimes be meddlesome. She and Daiya have known each other since childhood, and their mutual verbal abuse has become legendary among their classmates ever since. She loves showing off her bust size.

(Source: Baka-Tsuki)

name: O
description: A mysterious being introduced in the series as the one who distributes boxes. Always refered as they. They love playing with the protagonist Kazuki Hoshino.

name: Yuuri Yanagi
description:
A timid and shy girl who is a close friend of Iroha Shindou.

~!She was the second player to face the Game of Indolence. She managed to clear her round by fulfilling the victory conditions but in order to do so she had to manipulate the other players and used Koudai Kamiuchi to eventually kill them. !~

name: Koudai Kamiuchi
description:
A frivolous and jolly freshman who appears to be very fond of girls.

~!He is one of the 6 who got chosen as a participant for the Game of Indolence.!~ ~!It was later revealed that he was actually the owner of The Game of Indolence.!~ ~!He was later killed by Daiya Oomine as the latter asserted that it was the only way to destroy the box. !~

name: Iroha Shindou
description:
The student council president. She is frequently described as superhuman due to her outstanding ability to concentrate and achieve whatever she wants. She is also a close friend of Yuuri Yanagi.

~!She was the third player in the Game of Indolence and won her round by killing everyone with a knife on the very first day. !~

name: Haruaki Usui
description:
A cheerful but frivolous baseball ace. He often hangs out with Kazuki and Daiya.

(Source: Baka-Tsuki)

name: Riko Asami
description:
A timid girl who is a big fan of Maria.
Volume 2 spoiler:
~!She is actually [Ryuu Miyazaki's](https://anilist.co/character/87527/Ryuu-Miyazaki) younger sister and the owner of the box 'Week in the mud'.

When their parents got divorced and her mother got in a relationship, their new father, Yuhei Ishihara, started beating Riko up because of her nature. At some point she snapped and she and Ryuu murdered their parents. 

During the opening ceremony at high school she was enchanted by [Maria Otonashi](https://anilist.co/character/87519/Maria-Otonashi) and wanted to be closest to her which led her to take hold of [Kazuki Hoshino's](https://anilist.co/character/87513/Kazuki-Hoshino) body as he was the closest to Maria.

At the end of volume 2 Riko Asami drops out of high school and there is a rumor that she is living in Hokkaido and working in a farm.!~

name: A
description: An artificial personality that belongs to the 'Wish-Crushing Cinema', ~! the 'box' intended to destroy Daiya's 'box'. !~ She acts as a guide as the movies are being screened.

name: Ryuu Miyazaki
description:
The president of Kazuki's class. He is considered to be a reliable and exemplary student.

Volume 2 spoiler:
~!He is actually Riko Asami's older brother.

When their parents got divorced and her mother remarried a man named Yuhei Ishihara, his sister, Riko, was being constantly tortured and beaten. When Riko asked for his help, Ryuu snaps and murdered both his mother and  Yuhei Ishihara. He also helped to successfully implement Riko's box 'The Week in the mud'.

After he turned himself in to the police he was sentenced to prison.!~

name: Ruka Hoshino
description: Kazuki's elder sister.

name: Mother Kamiuchi
description: Kamiuchi Koudai's mother. Raised him on her own after his father abandoned, upon finding out that she was not going to abort him. While raising him, she tried to teach him that "Violence can't solve anything!" and that he should "Never use violence".

name: Miyuki Karino
description: She is Daiya and Kokone's childhood friend and a year younger than them. She used to date Kamiuchi Koudai.

name: Touji Kijima
description: Hoshino Kazuki's best friend in middle school.

name: Nana Yanagi
description: She used to go to the same middle school as Kazuki.

name: Yi Jian
description:
__Height:__ 182 cm

Jian Yi is a loud, boisterous individual who is constantly adding light and humour to situations, despite his not-so-happy background. Yi has been friends with [Zhan Zheng Xi](https://anilist.co/character/121621/Zhengxi-Zhan) since childhood and continues to be close with him.

~!Jian Yi grew up in a terrible childhood; his father had abandoned him and his mother when he was just a baby for reasons that are still unknown. As a result, his mother had to try and take care of him by herself; however, she did not provide him with the attention a typical child would need from a parent. For most of his childhood, he was actually taken care of by a nanny since his mother was never around.!~

name: Cheng He
description: He Cheng is  Tian's older brother and he works under Jian Yi's father.

name: Qiu
description: Brother Qiu is very tall, muscular, and has a tattoo on his right arm. His hair is an off white/light grey.

name: She Li
description: She Li is one of the main antagonists in 19 Days and is an enemy to Mo Guan Shan as well as He Tian.

name: Ja-Hyeon Jo
description:
__Place of Birth:__ Incheon, South Korea
__Affiliation:__ Humming Bird Crew 
__Height:__ 178cm 

[Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/ja_hyuni/)

Ja-Hyeon is a member and ace of the Hummingbird Crew and a junior at Sunny High School.

He usually assumes a serious and emotionless expression. He appears cold hearted, but very much so cares about the friends he has and his little brother. His minimal expression of emotion doesn't allow him to articulate his feelings very well, but sometimes his few words mean a lot.

Ja-Hyeon is a well rounded cyclist. Throughout the competition, he is acknowledged as the ace of the crew. He is able to play as a defensive rider, supporting his crew during their races, as well as a offensive rider. Vinny noted that he enjoyed the "hunt" of attacking from the back.

His debut in the League of Street preliminaries helped him gain popularity in the biking scene in Korea and at his school.

name: Yu-Bin Hong
description:
~!Vinny Hong is a student at Gunn High and the current leader of the Sabbath Crew. He was previously a member of the Zephyrus Crew along with [Minu](https://anilist.co/character/140298/Yun-Min-U) and [June](https://anilist.co/character/233793/Lee-Jun-Su), the Hummingbird Crew, and the Ghost Crew..!~

He cares deeply about his mom and does not tolerate anyone who disrespects his mother, not even her self-deprecation. His childhood sweetness does make an appearance once in a while. He displays a great deal of empathy, even while displaying it through hardened words.

Yu-Bin has a condition called Waardenburg syndrome which caused the color of his left eye and hair.

One of the few things Vinny is proficient at in cooking is Ramen. He often cooks a pot for his friends voluntarily and involuntarily.

name: Shelly
description:
__Height:__ 163 cm
__Place of birth:__ Manchester, England
__Affiliation:__ Humming Bird Crew

[Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/shelly_______x/)

Shelly has a crush on [Jay](https://anilist.co/character/137282/Jo-JaHyeon). She is the only female member of the Humming Bird Crew.

Because she stayed at England before coming to Korea her personality is perceived as very headstrong. She does not like it when people talk badly about her friends, especially Jay. Described as someone who can confidently express her thoughts and feelings. Although her words are harsh, it is because she never sugar coated her words with her friends. And with Jay, Shelly is very clingy and flirtatious.

name: Han-Nam Kang
description:
__Height:__ 188 cm
__Affiliation:__ Humming Bird Crew

[Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/hannam_x_jordan/)

Dom is a Junior at Sunny High School. He is the son of a gang leader. He is interested in making music in the future and works part-time as a DJ at his father's club, WD Club. He is quite the sneakerhead and spends his money on his collection.
Dom is caring towards his friends and others and does his best to get involved.

Dom is very good at sprinting and riding on straight distances. He is also good at hand-to-hand combat and wrestling

name: Min-U Yun
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm
__Affiliation:__ Humming Bird Crew

Minu is quite a simple and good guy. He is loyal to his words and his friends and seems to be a rather pure guy. When people provoke him he most likely falls for it since he is very emotional and impulsive. Furthermore he is really tough and can endure some pain. He is quick to anger when someone he cherishes is threatened.

~!He gets run over by a car from a member of Team Scorpion while trying to protect [Jay](https://anilist.co/character/137282/Jo-JaHyeon). He remains crippled in a wheelchair from this accident.!~

name: Yu-Mi Lee
description: Leader of Team Tarantula.

name: Noah
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm 
__Affiliation:__ Light Cavalry Crew

Noah is seen as arrogant, and dislikes losing as seen when she lost a race against [Jay Jo](https://anilist.co/character/137282/Jo-Ja-Hyeon) which led her to stalk him to his home and school, wanting to have a rematch with him using her personal bike and equipment.

name: Kaneshiro Takeda
description:
__Affiliation:__ Kazuma Crew

Kaneshiro Takeda is 3-time international Grand Prix champion and leader of the Kazuma Crew.

She has a strong character, she does not show expressions other than a deep coldness in her eyes, she can look upset even with a face of disgust at things she does not like, but it is rare to see her smile or show compassion, she lets herself be guided by her instincts, both with known and unknown people, his personality does not change much, her way of treating people is very discreet.

name: Joker
description:
__Height:__ 201 cm
__Affiliation__: Sabbath Crew 

He's the undefeated champion in the underground cage fights scene. He seems to be doing it for the money to take care of his family. It is unknown how many siblings he has or if their parents are around but we know he has at least one younger brother, who went behind Joker's back to work at a construction site. He is protective over them, not wanting them to work, assumably in order for them to focus on getting their education.

He's mostly shown working closely with Wooin and are often seen together. It is assumed that they are good friends.

name: Owen Knight
description:
__Height:__ 193 cm
__Place of birth:__ Manchester, England
__Affiliation:__ Light Cavalry Crew

Owen Knight is the creator and member of Light Cavalry cyclist team. He joined Sunny High to stay closer with his childhood friend [Shelly](https://anilist.co/character/140299/Shelly) and fend off her feelings for [Jay](https://anilist.co/character/137282/JaHyeon-Jo).

Owen Knight is said to be close to the crews who spread street riding culture In New York. He was said to have followed them around and became friends with their members and cycled together. Then, in his freshman year of high school, he went back to England and formed a world-famous crew with his athlete friends called Light Cavalry.

name: Jun-Su Lee
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm
__Affiliation:__ Humming Bird Crew

June is one of the more level-headed members of the Humming Bird Crew. He is generally polite and kind, and does not fight as much as the others. However, he will always support his friends.
He sometimes feels as if he is useless, especially when he couldn't lead the team. He feels like a deadweight to the crew, not able to contribute to the success of the team, but he works just as hard as everyone else during training to be more useful to the team.

name: Seung-Chun Nam
description:
Works at Sunny High as a gym teacher.

~!Later on it is revealed that he is Ricardo Rossi, former pro cyclist.!~

name: U-In Yu
description:
__Place of Birth__: Dong-gu, South Korea
__Affiliation__: Sabbath Crew 

U-In is a member of the Sabbath Crew and is currently under the employment of Sang-Ho. He, along with the rest of his crew, aim to sabotage Team Hummingbird's chances of progressing through the League of Street Competition.

name: Monster13
description:
__Height:__ 205 cm
__Place of birth:__ Jung-gu-, Seoul
__Affiliation:__ Monster Crew

Monster, is one of the favourites in the "League of Street" competition. He is the leader of Monster Crew. His team is expected to win the competition due to their raw power and speed.

He is an honest and fair cyclist who is dedicated to the sport. It is seen and mentioned that he works out all the time apart from sleeping and eating, he is addicted to working out and becoming a better version of himself. And he's seen sleeping in classes and only bringing workout tools in his backpack, he uses every opportunity to work out even when his teacher calls him out to the back he would use the chance to do squats while the classes continue.

name: Hyuk Kwon
description:
__Height:__ 183 cm
__Affiliation:__ Sabbath Crew

He is a quiet individual who seems to be quite inquisitive but also very mysterious. He has a part time job outside of his crew and although he seems to have a good friendship with Joker and Wooin, he doesn't like to spend too much time with them . He always leaves immediately after each race, this is known after Wooin mentions it.

In races, he is pretty brutal and ruthless. He is known as the Grim Reaper and is known to take down anyone who rides too close to him.

name: A-Ran Choi
description:
Currently a junior at Sunny High.

~!She is in love with Jay and has even thought of marrying him.!~

name: Yun-Ha Yun
description:
__Place of Birth:__ Dasan-dong, Seoul, South Korea
__Height:__ 162 cm

 She is a student at Sunny High and is s the headstrong twin sister of [Minu](https://anilist.co/character/140298/MinU-Yoon).
Between the siblings, Yuna gets along more with their father and step-mother. An incident from the past has yet to be revealed has caused great strain on their family. Yuna cares a lot for her brother though she is clearly tired from the constant arguments

Yuna is bored with her current life, having expected more romance and drama instead of the humdrum life of a high school student and she complains about it in the beginning. To her friends, she is a very dependable person.

name: Sangho Choi
description:
__Height:__ 187 cm

He is one of the organizers of League of Street, previously a cyclist and Mahon's teammate.

Sangho is cunning and only thinks of money and work, he also seems to hold a good grudge with Mahon. He wants Jay Jo to feel the humilation of being runner up like he did to Mahon.

name: Nanachi
description:
**Species**: Narehate

Nanachi is a Narehate — a person who’s survived the 6th layer’s Curse of the  Abyss and has been left deformed as a result. Unlike other Narehates, Nanachi has retained a sound mind, possessing vast knowledge of the Abyss — its ecosystem, vegetation and even the use of the medicines. Their gender is ambiguous, often using the gender-neutral pronoun "oira." when referring to themself.

Most of the time, Nanachi is cool and reserved, keeping their distance emotionally and physically. Their attitude often borders on being sarcastic and even cynical. However, behind this mask, Nanachi hides a kind and gentle soul, capable of deep compassion and selfless devotion. They are also quite bashful when complimented, seen in their reaction to being called "fluffy". They also express discomfort at being petted, especially by  [Reg](https://anilist.co/character/122444/Reg).

name: Bondrewd
description:
Bondrewd is a legendary white whistle delver who has made many great discoveries about the secrets of the Abyss. A researcher fascinated by the Abyss, he has often resorted to illegal and morally questionable means to get funds for and conduct his research, including selling artifacts illicitly, developing dangerous drugs, and even experimenting on living humans. Though how cruel, he still cared for the kids and people he brutally experimented on.

His methods went against all the ethical principles of delvers, but he was allowed to continue due to his outstanding results. Ten years ago, he did the unthinkable by establishing a large base named the Idofront in the deepest area within the 5th Layer of the Abyss, as well as securing a route to the then-inviolable 6th layer.

~!During one of his experiments researching the Curse of the Abyss, Bondrewd offered children who wanted to unravel the secrets of the Abyss to come with him to the Ido Front. However, he never told them openly that they were going to be used as test subjects. Among the children were Nanachi and Mitty. As Bondrewd continued testing, more and more children were used up in his experiments until only Nanachi and Mitty were left. On his final test, he used both of them, resulting in Mitty being hit with the Curse of the Abyss, while Nanachi received the Blessing.!~

name: Reg
description:
Reg is a robotic being who appears to be a little boy. His actual age, origins, and even name are unknown because he cannot recall anything about his life before his encounter with [Riko](https://anilist.co/character/122443/Riko). He is named after a dog Riko used to have. Having a seemingly artificial body, Reg might be the only being completely immune to the Curse of the Abyss. Because of this, he is sometimes referred to as "The Treasure of the Deep."

Reg’s body is extremely durable, even to the point that [Ozen the Immovable](https://anilist.co/character/122464/Ouzen) couldn’t break him even when slamming him into the floor with all her strength. Despite his high durability, Reg is agile and weighs little. His wounds heal at a faster rate than a human’s, and has a very high pain tolerance. His senses of smell and hearing are strong, one comparable to a dog. His arms can extend up to 40 meters each and can shoot them to the top of cliffs or grab things very far away. The cords attached are very durable. He is also equipped with an incinerator, which is a powerful incendiary cannon built into his hands and feet, emitting a beam of light, indicating the area to eliminate, penetrating through objects. Objects within the range of the light break apart and are absorbed into the spinning axes. The incinerator is connected to the Abyss in an unknown way, having the power to rewrite the rules of the Abyss. Reg passes out for 2 hours upon use, but it can be fired multiple times in the 10-minute deadline, and can also be set to not affect living beings.

Despite being a formidable fighter, Reg is rather shy, naive, and unassertive. He blushes easily and often cries when in distress. However, when forced into danger or an unpleasant situation, he is shown to be hot-tempered and sharp, compared to Riko's analytic, noncombatant role. Regardless of his skittishness, Reg has made it his sworn duty to protect Riko and doesn't hesitate to put up a fight when she is in harm's way. According to Ozen, the way he speaks and handles his body is similar to [Lyza](https://anilist.co/character/122465/Lyza). One of his favorite words to say is "irredeemable," which was a word that Lyza often said.

name: Ouzen
description:
Ouzen the Immovable is an elite White Whistle who lives at the Observation Base on the second level of the Abyss where she commands a small team of cave raiders known as "The Layabouts." Ouzen was a mentor and a close friend of [Riko](https://anilist.co/character/122443/Riko)'s mother [Lyza](https://anilist.co/character/122465/Lyza).

Ouzen is a peerless fighter—her unique relic "Thousand Pins" grants her superhuman strength, speed and longevity (even though Ouzen appears to be young, she's attained the rank of a white whistle more than 50 years back). She's over 2 meters tall and has a peculiar hairstyle which conceals the scalp deformations caused by the extended exposure to the Curse of the Abyss.

Ouzen has absolute control over her facial expressions and her actual feelings (or lack thereof) cannot be guessed with any certainty. The reasons behind her actions are unknowable as well—Ouzen rarely bothers to explain herself and even when she does it's impossible to know whether she's telling the truth or just toying with the audience.

name: Narrator
description:
This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. 

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

name: Riko
description:
**Occupation**: Delver
**Relatives**: [Lyza](https://anilist.co/character/122465/Lyza) (mother), [Torka](https://anilist.co/character/161856/Torka) (father)

Riko is the only child of the legendary White Whistle [Lyza](https://anilist.co/character/122465/Lyza), the Annihilator. When she was two, her mother began her last dive to the bottom of the abyss. She was left under the care of the Belchero Orphanage. Her dream is to become a White Whistle, a legendary type of  Delver, and explore the depths of the abyss to learn its many secrets and find her mother.

Riko is a good-natured, joyful, and energetic child. She has a quick and inquisitive mind, gathering and properly organizing all the information available on subjects that interest her. Growing up, she diligently studied to become a Delver like her mother was, enchanted by its mysteries and secrets. By the age of twelve, she had become an Apprentice Delver with the right to explore the shallowest level of the abyss on her own. Compared to [Reg](https://anilist.co/character/122444/Reg), she is fragile and lacking in physical prowess. However, her ability to keep a cool head under pressure to make rational decisions allows her to tackle the abyss.

name: Mitty
description:
**Species**: Narehate

Mitty is an amorphous Narehate who lived with Nanachi on the 4th layer of the Abyss. Mitty had been a regular human girl in the past and her appearance changed due to the result of the ascension from the 6th layer.

~!In Ilblu, it is revealed that Belaf paid compensation to have an exact replica of Mitty born into the village from the time a "masked man" brought her along to the village. This reproduction even has an exact copy of Mitty's soul from that moment in time.!~

name: Marulk
description: Ozen's assistant and a Blue Whistle Diver.

name: Lyza
description: Lyza the Annihilator is a legendary White Whistle who accomplished many great discoveries about the secrets of the Abyss. She is [Ozen's](https://anilist.co/character/122464/Ouzen) apprentice and [Riko's](https://anilist.co/character/122443/Riko) mother.

name: Jiruo
description:
**Gender**: Male
**Species**: Human
**Occupation**: Delver, Delving Instructor
**Class**: Moon Whistle

Jiruo is a Moon Whistle Delver who serves as a teacher for Apprentice Delvers from the Belchero Orphanage in the town of Orth. While he works as an instructor for the children, he is also largely responsible for their upbringing and well-being.

Jiruo is serious and stern and tends to come off as cold at times but takes his job as a teacher and instructor seriously and prioritizes the childrens' safety. At times he is very insightful and gives good advice, and does his best to support Riko after her mother's whistle was brought back to the surface.

Jiruo was the apprentice of the legendary White Whistle Delver Lyza. Though he was only a red whistle at the time, before she made her last dive, Lyza entrusted him with watching over Riko and protecting her identity as a child of a White Whistle Delver.

(Source: Made in Abyss Wiki, edited)

name: Srajo
description:
Srajo "The Obscure", is a legendary White Whistle Delver of the Abyss. Since she is a White Whistle, she is presumed to have made amazing discoveries within the pit and retrieved Artifacts that have changed the world. Like most White Whistle Delvers, she settled on the 5th layer and lived there for some time, since it is the last point of the Abyss where it is possible to return alive.

~!At some point and for unknown reasons, Srajo decided to take her "Last Dive" and descended to the 6th layer of the Abyss without even mentioning it to anyone else. [Bondrewd](https://anilist.co/character/122463/Bondrewd) was the only one that was made aware of her decision.!~

name: Hablog
description:
Hablog (called Habo-san by Riko and the other children) is a well-known Black Whistle Delver and was the person who delivered Lyza's White Whistle and final notes to the surface.

Hablog is a very bright and kind person with a rather high level of curiosity, as is seen when he first meets Reg.

name: Nat
description:
**Gender**: Male
**Species**: Human
**Occupation**: Delver
**Class**: Red Whistle
**Relatives**: Unnamed sister

Nat is an orphan from the Belchero Orphanage in the town at the edge of the Abyss, Orth. Like all the children of the orphanage, he's studied to become a Delver since a young age and attained the rank of Red Whistle Delver after his first descent. He wants to become a Moon Whistle Delver like [Jiruo](https://anilist.co/character/123188/Jiruo) and someday build an orphanage somewhere in Orth.

Nat has short brown hair with bright blue eyes and wears, like his peers, a red whistle around his neck. He is often seen in his plain white sailor collar shirt, green pants, and track shoes.

Nat cares about the people around him, especially [Riko](https://anilist.co/character/122443/Riko). He was against Riko descending into the Abyss with [Reg](https://anilist.co/character/122444/Reg); he spoke of the difficulties of dealing with the Abyss alone and that she wouldn't be able to see anyone in Orth again. Although he was helping Riko and Reg descend into the Abyss, before the departure, he struggled to express he would miss Riko.

Nat used to live in the Wharf, where he lived in the slums. He didn't have any family besides his older sister. When his sister died, he was alone in the streets, but the orphanage took him in and he becoming a Delver.

name: Shiggy
description:
**Gender**: Male
**Species**: Human
**Occupation**: Delver
**Class**: Red Whistle

Shiggy is an orphan from the Belchero Orphanage in the town at the edge of the Abyss, Orth. Like all the children of the orphanage, he has studied to become a Delver since a young age and attained the rank of Red Whistle Delver after his first descent.

Shiggy has short ashy black hair and bright-red eyes, wears rounded glasses, and bears a red whistle around his neck. He is often seen in his plain white sailor collar shirt and khaki green or black pants and track shoes.

Shiggy has a great inquisitiveness, especially when it comes to the maps of the Abyss. He gives [Riko](https://anilist.co/character/122443/Riko) plenty of advice.

When Riko tells her friends that she will delve into the Abyss to find [Lyza](https://anilist.co/character/122465/Lyza), Shiggy is skeptical and explains each layer via a depth chart. He decides to aid [Reg](https://anilist.co/character/122444/Reg) and Riko anyways and the three meet up the next morning in the South District. Shiggy advises them to enter the Abyss through the entry point at the wharf slums, which are not monitored as closely.

(Source: Made in Abyss Wiki, edited)

name: Mio
description:
Mio is a nurse that visits Orth on a merchant caravan.
~!She helps Kiwi get better from the Birthday-Death Disease.!~

name: Wakuna
description: Wakuna "The Chosen", also known as the "Lord of Guidance", is one of the legendary White Whistle Delvers in the Abyss, and is therefore presumed to have made outstanding discoveries down in the deep. He made his "Last Dive" to the 6th layer some time before Riko's journey.

name: Yelme
description: Moon Whistle and a member of Ozen's expedition team. He is currently stationed at the Seeker Camp in the 2nd layer.

name: Simred
description: Black Whistle and a member of Ozen's expedition team. He is currently stationed at the Seeker Camp in the 2nd layer.

name: Ilim
description: Ilim is one of the children brought down in the depths of the abyss by white whistle Bondrewd, together with Mitty and Nanachi. Later on, it's highly likely that she is one of the Narehate seen in the sixth layer of the abyss.

name: Torka
description: Torka is Lyza's husband and Riko's father. He was one of the members of a survey team ordered from the government, with a special mission to retrieve the Greater Artifact Unheard Bell from the 4th layer of the Abyss. Lyza married Torka when she was a White Whistle Delver, while Torka was a Black Whistle Delver.

name: Laffi
description: Laffi is Hablog's wife and owner of a shop in Orth. She is well-liked by Riko and the other orphans, who frequent her shop. Riko often using her telescope to observe Abyssal wildlife.

name: Beruchero
description:
**Gender**: Female
**Race**: Human

Belchero is the director of the Belchero Orphanage. She imposed strict rules within the Academy and the orphanage.

Belchero has black hair with white strains in it, which ends in a topknot, and two long curls down each ear. She has a gaunt face and sharp eyes with a monocle on her right eye. She wears a black robe with black clothes beneath and black gloves.

Belchero is very strict and enforces her rules strongly, but also only has the best interest of the orphans in mind.

Belchero was once an active Delver but retired due to knee injuries. Belchero, together with Jiruo, teaches the orphans about the Abyss and other academic subjects.

(Source: Made in Abyss Wiki, edited)

name: Zapo-jii
description: Blue Whistle and a member of Ozen's expedition team. He is currently stationed at the Seeker Camp in the 2nd layer.

name: Tankutsuka
description:
A Black Whistle who had a chance encounter with Reg in the 4th layer.
~!Reg and Nanachi save his life by fighting a deadly Abyss monster that was about to kill him. After this, Reg tells him to send a message up to Jiruo!~

name: Yuuna Yuuki
description:
A second-year in middle school and member of the Hero Club. She prides herself on being a hero, helping out others in needs and always remaining optimistic.

She fights the Vertex with her armored gauntlets and greaves. Her fairy familiar, Gyuuki, allows her to condense energy in her fist for her signature move "Hero Punch".

name: Mimori Tougou
description:
[Yuuna](https://anilist.co/character/88636/Yuuna-Yuuki)'s best friend and fellow classmate and club member who lives next door to her and often prefers to be called by her family name. Mimori takes pride in her national heritage and is always ready to defend her country and protect its people. She has lost the use of her legs, along with some of her memories, allegedly due to a car accident.

~! Two years before the main story, Mimori was adopted by the Washio family because of her high aptitude as a Hero Candidate. She went by the name Sumi Washio for the entirety of her time adopted by the Washio family. After her Mankai caused her memory loss, she was promptly returned to the Tougou family and was conveniently relocated by the Taisha as a neighbor to Yuuna. !~

name: Sonoko Nogi
description:
__Height:__ 156 cm

Sonoko Nogi is one of the three main characters of the light novel Washio Sumi is a Hero. At the time of the story taking place, she's an elementary school 6th-year student chosen by Taisha to fight Vertexes as a Hero, along with Gin Minowa and Sumi Washio. She is a very easygoing girl who has a habit of spacing out. However, her cloud cuckoo lander personality masks a truly staggering intellect, and she can formulate plans in mere seconds. Sonoko is also a successful novelist who specializes in romance novels, and she enjoys imagining her female friends in romantic situations with each other.

name: Karin Miyoshi
description:
A second year in middle school, and member of the Hero Club. She is an experienced hero who transferred into [Yuuna](https://anilist.co/character/88636/Yuuki-Yuuna) and [Mimori](https://anilist.co/character/88637/Tougou-Mimori)'s class, joining the Hero Club to supervise the other heroes. Karin is depicted as a headstrong individual: stubborn, obstinate, and single-minded. She is very abrasive and finds it difficult when expressing her feelings towards others. However, she can't resist helping whenever someone is having trouble. She is rather self-confident and positive, initially believing her skills are far greater than the other members of the Hero Club. One could describe her as a "tsundere".

As a Hero, Karin dual-wields twin katana. She is also able to throw her katana to strike at range while being able to generate new ones. Karin also has powerful physical abilities and can sense things without being able to see them.

name: Wakaba Nogi
description:
__Height:__ 163 cm
__Grade:__ 2nd Year of Middle School

A second-year middle school student and one of the Heroes of the first Hero Team and the ancestor of [Sonoko](https://anilist.co/character/88641/Sonoko-Nogi). Wakaba is a serious, strong-willed girl that believes in rewarding favors. She seeks revenge on the Vertexes and is willing to take risks to get it. She is a natural, charismatic leader who is wildly popular with the general public. However, she is also a kindhearted girl who is dismayed that her serious exterior sometimes scares people off, and she has a hidden soft side which enjoys being spoiled by [Hinata](https://anilist.co/character/126245/Uesato-Hinata).

As a Hero, Wakaba fights using a sword named Ikutachi. It can cut through Vertexes with ease, even if the user is not transformed. Ikutachi is one-handed, meaning she has no need to hold onto it with both hands.

name: Chikage Koori
description:
__Height:__ 159 cm
__Grade:__ 3rd Year of Middle School

A Hero of the first Hero team. Chikage is a shy, quiet and lonely girl who is not good at interacting with other people. She enjoys playing video games, like most introverts. Despite how mistrustful and silent towards others she seems, she is a good person at heart who only wishes for acceptance. She is seen bonding with [Yuuna Takashima](https://anilist.co/character/126201/Yuuna-Takashima) the most, but does care about other members of the team.

~!She was killed in action during a battle with the Vertexes, protecting Wakaba. Following her death, her record was erased by the Taisha.!~

name: Fuu Inubouzaki
description:
A third-year in middle school, president of the Hero Club, and older sister of [Itsuki](https://anilist.co/character/88639). She doesn’t bother with trivial issues, but she sees the big picture and inspires the others to follow her like a big sister. She loves her younger sister and friends very much. She is good at cooking and housekeeping, and loves eating.

As a Hero, Fuu wields a large greatsword. The size of her blade allows her to use it as a shield just as often as a sword. She can also use the power of her fairy, Inugami, to increase her sword's size and attack a wide area.

name: Itsuki Inubouzaki
description:
A first-year in middle school and member of the Hero Club. She is Fuu's younger sister and respects her dearly. Unlike her older sister, Itsuki is very shy and timid. However, she is very kindhearted and enjoys helping people. She also becomes less shy around people she knows, and can even be snarky at times.

As a Hero, Itsuki fights with a tambourine-like ring lined with white flowers from which she can fire magical vines. These vines can ensnare and slice through enemies.

name: Yuuna Takashima
description:
__Height:__ 154cm
__Grade:__ 2nd Year of Middle School

One of the Heroes of the first Hero team. Yuuna is a bright and energetic girl and can be thought of as the "mood maker of the team". She thinks friends and family are two of the most important things, and she is sensitive to other's feelings. Yuuna is also selfless and will throw herself into battle for her friends, even to her own detriment. However, she has a habit of hiding her own emotions.

When Yuuna is in Hero form, her weapon is the tekko. Hers, in particular, are imbued with a divine power called Ama-no-Sakate, a cursed from a land god with rage-filled hatred to destroy.

name: Hinata Uesato
description:
__Height:__ 150cm
__Grade:__ 2nd Year of Middle School

Uesato Hinata is one of the main characters of the light novel Nogi Wakaba Is a Hero. She, while not a hero, is a part of the first Hero Team.

name: Tamako Doi
description:
__Height:__ 147 cm

One of the Heroes of the first Hero team. Tamako is an energetic, emotionally-driven girl that is very fond of the outdoors. She tends to laugh a lot and gets angry easily. She is also fond of making puns with her own name, and refers to herself in third person. She is protective of her friends and tries to prevent them from being hurt.

As a Hero, Tamako uses a retractable six-bladed shield named Kamuyatatehime to battle. It can be used as a weapon similar to a yo-yo because it can be thrown and returned, but it can also be used as a blade when swinging around.

name: Anzu Iyojima
description:
__Height:__ 156 cm

One of the Heroes of the first Hero team and the youngest of quintet. Anzu is a bookworm that is especially fond of romance novels. While she isn't the physically strongest fighter out of her team, she is very intelligent and is more knowledgeable than most of the team. She is very close with [Tamako](https://anilist.co/character/126241/Tamako-Doi), thinking of her as her senpai and being her best friend. Anzu is sometimes afraid to fight, which is a disadvantage when she needs to fight as a Hero. However, she is very protective and would fight for her friends until her death.

As a Hero, Anzu wields a repeating crossbow in battle, named Kinkyusen. She is also very intelligent, which can help her think during battles.

name: Utano Shiratori
description:
__Grade:__ 6th
__Height:__ 158 cm

Utano Shiratori is a the main character of [Nogi Wakaba is a Hero](https://anilist.co/manga/99559/Nogi-Wakaba-wa-Yuusha-de-Aru/)'s Bonus Chapter, Shiratori Utano is a Hero. Utano is the world's first Hero to do battle against the Vertex invasion, as well as the sole protector of the Nagano region of Japan. Her Hero weapon, Fujidzuru, is a whip fashioned after a Wisteria vine, granted to her by a local god who maintains the protective barrier around Nagano. 

Utano finds great joy in farming, and is known by all to have an unshakeable positive attitude, often being credited with getting the people of Suwa back on their feet after the dread of the Vertex' invasion first set in over the populace, with the help of her mantra: "No matter what hardships may come our way, humanity will always get back on its feet!" This attitude, and the fact that she successfully brings the region together, has made her greatly beloved in the eyes of the people.

Her small holdout of land is in daily radio contact with [Wakaba Nogi](https://anilist.co/character/126200/Wakaba-Nogi)'s Hero team in Kagawa, over which she formed a close friendship with Wakaba. Utano is known to care very deeply for her Miko, [Mito Fujimori](https://anilist.co/character/136195/Mito-Fujimori), who is her only companion from the back lines in her fight to defend her home from the Vertex. Also known to be quite fond of English, Utano will often insert random phrases of it into her speech, to the dismay of some, and the amusement of others. She strives to one day become the 'Farm King', who will have everyone worldwide eat the vegetables that she proudly grows herself.

name: Mito Fujimori
description:
__Grade:__ 2nd Year of Middle School (Presumed)
__Height:__ 152cm
__Favourite Food:__ Soba

Fujimori Mito is a character in [Nogi Wakaba is a Hero](https://anilist.co/manga/99559/Nogi-Wakaba-wa-Yuusha-de-Aru/)'s Bonus Chapter, Shiratori Utano is a Hero. Mito is the Miko of [Utano Shiratori](https://anilist.co/character/136164/Utano-Shiratori). As a Miko, Mito is able to receive prophecies from their local deity in the form of environmental hints and symbols, or ideas. These oracles aid her Hero in predicting where danger will next appear in Nagano, the region that the two defend together. Although minor, her role is indispensable to Utano. Regardless of this, Mito laments not being able to do more for her Hero. 

Mito had a rocky relationship with her family due to her analytical and often gloomy personality, which resulted in her becoming a quiet, reserved, and timid girl, however, she cares greatly for the safety and happiness of Utano, who she believes to be her complete opposite. She often gets jealous of [Wakaba](https://anilist.co/character/126200/Wakaba-Nogi) when she hears Utano getting along with her over their daily radio check-up calls to the Kagawa region, however Utano is usually able to quickly remedy her mood.

name: Masuzu Aki
description:
Aki Masuzu is from Ehime Prefecture, like prefecture as Iyojima Anzu and Doi Tamako. During the initial Vertex Invasion, she guided them with her Miko abilities in using their Hero powers to protect the evacuating citizens. They took refuge in a school building among other people, where the three got to know one another better.
