She is in constant contact with the Shinju but often complains about her duties (such as bathing in the waterfall to purify herself).

name: Chito
description: She travels with [Yuuri](https://anilist.co/character/120890) on their Kettenkrad. She can read and write in the current language, but not in kanji or Latin alphabets, because they became old languages in this world. She loves reading and collecting books she finds during traveling.

name: Yuuri
description: Yuuri is a care-free, fun-loving girl. She is the direct foil and companion of [Chito](https://anilist.co/character/120889). She carries an Arisaka type 38 rifle and loves food more than anything else in the world.

name: Shijima Tsukishima
description: Was a shut-in for two years before entering high-school, during which two stalks of Shimeji mushrooms grew on her head. Can't be bothered to do anything and is a pessimist.

name: Majime Yamashita
description: [Shijima](https://anilist.co/character/136264/Tsukishima-Shijima)'s classmate. Cheerful and not diligent at all, contrary to her name. Was apparently born with a sunny-side egg on her head.

name: Shijima no Ane
description: Lives together with Shijima as something of a parent figure. She quit university and is currently focusing on some sort of incomprehensible research.

name: Mogawa Sensei
description: Teaches art at Shijima and Majime's school, and is the advisor for the hole-digging club. Often sinks into a depressive spiral of thoughts, and loves drinking.

name: Yomikawa Senpai
description: Likes to read. Can't carry anything heavier than a book even though she is on a hole-digging club.

name: Sumida Senpai
description: A second-year student and a member of the Hole Digging Club. She does not like to talk, and communicates by writing in her sketchbook most of the time.

name: Ayaka
description: Classmate of Shijima and Majime. Vocalist and Pianist of the light music club

name: Yoshiko
description: Classmate of Shijima and Majime. Bassist in the light music club

name: Cheong-Myeong
description: Cheong-Myeong usually has a carefree nature and enjoys fooling around. However, when he has a goal, he sets his mind to it. Cheong-Myeong is intelligent, but often uses that to his advantage (but sometimes end up offending others). He enjoys drinking and indulges himself with food. Cheong-Myeong is sadistic and likes playing around with his seniors. He has confidence and doesn't waver in every situation and knows when he should retreat or run away.

name: Yoo Iseol
description:
__Height:__ 5'7

Yoo Iseol, also known as the Ice Sword Plum Blossom, is a 2nd class disciple of the Mount Hua Sect.

name: Jo Gul
description:
__Height:__ 5'9

Jo Gul is a 3rd class disciple of the Mount Hua Sect. He's the second son of a merchant family.

name: Baek Cheon
description:
__Height:__ 6'2

Baek Cheon is the leader of the 2nd ranked disciples of the Mount Hua Sect and was known as the genius that would revitalize the sect.

name: Jong Yoon
description:
__Height:__ 182 cm

Jong Yoon is the eldest 3rd class disciple of the Mount Hua Sect and is one of the first people who encountered and befriends [Cheongmyeong](https://anilist.co/character/270715/CheongMyeong).

name: Hyun Young
description: Hyun Young is the youngest of the three sages, and an elder of the Mount Hua Sect. He is the general manager of the Finance Office, and is involved in all matters of finance and economy.

name: Hyun Jong
description: Hyun Jong is the current sect leader of the Mount Hua Sect.

name: Lee Songbaek
description:
__Height:__ 6'2

Lee Songbaek is a 2nd-class disciple of the Zhongnan Sect. He was the first disciple from an opposing sect to recognize the true strength of Cheongmyeong.

name: Jin Geum-Ryong
description: Jin Geumryong is a second class disciple of the Zhongnan Sect and Baek Cheon's brother. He is the strongest and most prospective talent within the Zhongnan Sect.

name: Chun Ma
description: Chun Ma, also known as the Heavenly Demon, is the leader of the Demonic Cult.

name: Cheongmun
description: Cheongmun, the Daxian Sword, is the 21st sect leader of the Mount Hua Sect.

name: Yu Iseol's father
description: Yu Iseol's father was formerly a member of the Mount Hua Sect and a disciple who tried to recreate the lost 24-Movement Plum Blossom Sword Technique.

name: Jong Seohan
description: Jong Seohan is a 2nd-class disciple of the Zhongnan Sect. He is deemed the second strongest out of the 2nd-class disciples of the sect.

name: Hyun Sang
description: Hyun Sang is the second sage and an elder of the Mount Hua Sect. He is in charge of managing the sect's martial arts curriculum.

name: Jin Hyeon
description: Jin Hyeon, also known as the Indestructible Sword of the Wudang Sect, or the Sword Dragon. He is a likely candidate to become the First Sword of Wudang.

name: Jongsan Yu
description: Jongsan Yu is the owner of the Huayin Linen Shop, a business that originally was owned by the Mount Hua Sect.

name: Unam
description: Unam is a 1st ranked disciple of the Mount Hua Sect.

name: Jin Mu
description: Jin Mu, also known as the Sword Dragon of Wudang, is a disciple of the Wudang Sect.

name: Un Gum
description: Un Gum is a 1st ranked disciple of the Mount Hua Sect. He is the monitor of the White Plum Blossom Hall and trainer of the third class disciples.

name: Taegeuggeomje
description: Taiji Sword Emperor was a member of Wudang Sect 100 years ago and lost against Cheongmyeong.

name: Hwang Jongui
description: Hwang Jongui is the vice president of Eunha Trading Company.

name: Hong Dae-Kwang
description: Hong Dae-Kwang is the head of the Beggars' Union branch in Luoyang.

name: Sama Seung
description: Sama Seung is an elder of the Zhongnan Sect.

name: Munyeon Gong
description: Munyeon Gong is the proprietor of the Taehwa Pavilion, the largest tavern in Huayin, and is a powerful merchant who runs many businesses from the tavern.

name: Heo Jinin
description: Heo Do Jinin is the current sect leader of the Wudang Sect.

name: Ii
description:
The Nonsense User, a boy that drastically plays down his abilities, yet inevitably solves any mystery he encounters. Ii is an abnormal person. A "defective product." Unable to express much emotion, he is often seen with a neutral expression; however, Ii is able to express some emotion in some circumstances. At the beginning of his second year in junior high, he joined the ER3 System and went to Houston in America for 5 years and later returns to Japan at the age of 19. Upon return, he begins to attend Rokumeikan University in Kyoto. Ii is "friends" with [Tomo Kunagisa](https://anilist.co/character/29594/Kunagisa-Tomo), though he refuses to admit he has any and instead calls them acquaintances. Also known as the "mirror image" of [Hitoshiki Zerozaki](https://anilist.co/character/34293/Zerozaki-Hitoshiki), he is believed to be what Ii would be like if he didn't hold back. 

Tomo is helped out by Ii at times, having a friendly relationship overall. The two are similar, being unable to fully express emotions, though Tomo can only truly express happiness. Despite this, she and Ii had an incident a few years back that she never wishes to happen again. The incident is believed to be Ii leaving Tomo for 5 years. ~!After the beheadings occurred on Wet Crow's Feather Island, the culprit pointed a gun at Tomo, forcing Ii to admit his love for her, causing the culprit to give up as they were able to get Ii to say something he wouldn't.!~

As the mirror image of Hitoshiki Zerozaki, the two are unable to harm each other as they can both predict the other's moves. Their relationship is a strange one, as both of them are vastly different yet so similar to one another.

Many people call Ii some cutesy nickname like, "Ii-chan," and the like, though very few people know his actual name. 
~!In a conversation with Shiogi, Ii is asked questions to hint towards his name. After figuring it out, he requests that she not use his name, as anyone else has died. The people that have died being Tomo (emotionally), Magokoro Omokage (in a fire), and his forgotten younger sister Harukana Ii (in a plane crash)!~

name: Jun Aikawa
description:
The fierce Desert Eagle coated in scarlet. The unstoppable Laughing Red Tigress. Humanity's Strongest: Jun Aikawa. Renowned for her prowess in anything and everything, Jun is the most powerful person in the world. Her occupation is that of a contractor and will take any job, no matter how trivial or illegal it may be, so long as money is involved. Those that call her by her last name are considered her enemies, thus she insists friends to refer to her as Jun. Her abilities are practically limitless as a Multidisciplinary Master. [Ii](https://anilist.co/character/29593/Ii) and Jun initially meet by pure chance and their fates become intertwined.

With a strong sense of justice and a wild personality, Jun can be a lot to handle for the average person and especially Ii. He is particularly bothered by Jun's hatred for leaving things half-assed. On top of that, Jun is a rather arrogant individual. Despite this, she does value her friends and trusts them greatly. A majority of the people that hear her name fear it, as many over-the-top stories exist about her feats. Though some of the said feats may be completely wrong, Jun is a very intelligent woman and is considered to be a genius among geniuses. 

As Jun is known both for her abilities and her mind that is like no other, she is said to be Humanity's Strongest. Being the Multidisciplinary Master,  she is a master of disguise, sound imitating, lock picking and mind-reading. Not only that, but Jun also has amazing fighting capabilities, which are nearly impossible to overcome.

~!When [Hitoshiki Zerozaki](https://anilist.co/character/34293/Zerozaki-Hitoshiki) and Jun fought, she admitted that he was a bit tough even for her and that his skill with knives was second to none. Hitoshiki managed to get away without a scratch, though it wasn't easy.!~

~!The origin of Jun isn't pretty, as she is the product of incest. Initially, [Takashi Saitou](https://anilist.co/character/173351/Saitou-Takashi), her biological father, wished to create the strongest human. He, along with Akira Kajou and Junya Aikawa, created Jun, with one of Jun Saitou twins as her mother. Jun was later abandoned as she was deemed a failure by Takashi. Of her three fathers, Junya Aikawa was the only one she could consider as a father.!~

name: Tomo Kunagisa
description:
The technological genius Blue Savant and heiress of the Kunagisa household. Tomo is a young girl who is well versed in computer engineering, capable of crafting computers that are much more powerful that anything on the market. Most known for being the leader of Team, a collection of genius hackers. Due to Tomo's renowned computer genius, she is invited to Wet Crow's Feather Island by Iria Akagami. Tomo brings Ii with her, to help her get around. 

Tomo stands out like no other, having blue hair and eyes due to recessive genes. Her hair may get even darker if she refuses to wash it, becoming ultramarine, which can happen often as she hates taking baths. Due to this, Ii usually just throws her into a bathtub. Ii also tied up her hair in many ways, from braids to quadtails. Tomo herself enjoys fun, though she is not the best at being sociable, as she rarely listens to others besides the task at hand. Unlike most people, Tomo thinks somewhat backwards. Ii describes her thinking as instead of building a sand castle with what's needed, Tomo simply has a whole pile of sand and removes what isn't needed. Additionally, she is nearly incapable of expressing anything other than happiness, besides a tad of minor annoyance.

As the leader of Team, Tomo bears the title of "Walking Wrath." She manages all of Team, and will get assistance from the other members for whichever goal she has in mind. Team itself is a cyber-terrorist organization that preforms many illegal actions to either get information or money. They rarely get caught, though there is one close call and they end up disbanding, all of which happens while Ii is in Houston. ~!It's later revealed that Tomo is worshipped as a god among the cyber-terrorist team. Tomo appears to treat them equally, but there are questionable times where she may think of them as slaves.!~
~!At the end of the series, Tomo's hair becomes nearly black and she begins to grow again. Prior to this, she had the same appearance ever since Ii left for Houston.!~

name: Hitoshiki Zerozaki
description:
The No Longer Human serial killer of Kyoto and member of the Zerozaki clan: Hitoshiki Zerozaki. Notoriously known as the Prowler during the Kyoto serial murder case. Hitoshiki is a man with a small stature that kills for the sake of killing. Soushiki Zerozaki and Hitoshiki have a somewhat brotherly relationship, though they've grown distant. In general, he doesn't have many friends as a serial killer, though Iori Mutou could be considered one, as well as Ii. Another killer, Izumu Niounomiya, is a friend and rival of Hitoshiki. 

Hitoshiki himself is eccentric, though he generally has a casual personality and way of speaking. He considers himself a brat and believes everyone else was once a brat. When he and Ii meet, he calls Ii a doppelganger as they are essentially identical, yet so different. Hitoshiki is later described as the mirror image of Ii, and what Ii would be like if he didn't hold back. As a Zerozaki, Hitoshiki has a desire to kill anyone he meets without remorse, though he is capable of holding himself back. Like Ii, Hitoshiki has a catchphrase where he often says, "What a riot," which contrasts against Ii's "Nonsense."

As both a Zerozaki and a serial killer, Hitoshiki has a couple abilities and tools at his disposal. In the vest he wears, there are many knives placed all throughout it, which complements his mastery at using knives. To go along with his knife expertise, Hitoshiki is also able to utilize string, making a nearly undetectable trap. Unfortunately, with all his prowess in killing, he cannot do much against Ii, as they can counter each other and will just end up in a stalemate. ~!Hitoshiki's knife finesse has made him able to hold his own against Jun Aikawa. Despite this, he cannot defeat her, thus he escapes. The two later come to an agreement where Hitoshiki vows to stop killing to continue living and tells Jun Ii's solution to his own problem during the time.!~ ~!When Hitoshiki was born, his parents both died. His parents were Hataori Zerozaki as his mother and Zeroshiki Zerozaki as the father. As they died after Hitoshiki's birth, Soushiki began to raise him.!~

name: Takashi Saitou
description:
A peculiar man in a traditional Japanese garb and a fox mask who felt a "karmic connection" to Ii.

Catchphrase: *"We'll meet again, if we have a connection."*

~!His main philosophy is that no matter what humans may try, they can't escape fate, and that every decision that's available to them are ultimately meaningless with every divergence being corrected according to destiny. Two concepts form the core of his philosophy:

Back Nozzle: The belief that events important to the "story" would happen in some form or another since the "story" can't be changed. He states that Ii, Rizumu and himself would have a similar conversation even if the time and place are different.

Jail Alternative: The concept that events that were intended to happen will happen anyway, regardless of the people involved. He explains that the meaning and result would remain the same, but the people involved can easily be substituted, even himself and Rizumu.!~

~!During his first conversation with Ii, he states that he's standing outside the story; he's been exiled from karma; he's been expelled from causality. He also calls himself "half-assed and vague" as a result of past events and his current place outside of the story. Because of this, he has to use other people (mainly the Thirteen Stairs) to act in his place.!~

~!On his second conversation with Ii, he remarks that the "soul" within Ii is reminiscent of his own as *Humanity's Worst*, and his goal is to witness the Dying Epilogue, which is the idea that all events that has occurred will eventually lead to one point regardless of how related or unrelated the events, coincidences and meetings are when leading up to that point.!~

~!Before leaving the clinic, he claims Ii as his enemy and states that Jun Aikawa is his daughter!~

Prior to his first appearance,

~!Ii makes a remark when speaking with his old teacher, Miyoshi Kokoromi, about how he heard through the grapevine that a Japanese person with a strange name was a candidate for the Seven Fools. Tomo Kunagisa also remarks about a "genius machinist who brought electronic darkness onto the entire world with a mere 16 byte program." He is "One that far surpasses Cluster that once existed, the existence called Desert Fox-"!~

name: Izumu Niounomiya
description:
The strongest hitman of the Niounomiya Troupe. He is the split personality and older brother of Rizumu Niounomiya. Though he identifies as a male, his actual body is that of a female due to him being a split personality.

~!In reality, Izumu is his very own person, rather than a split personality. He is typically near his younger sister, Rizumu Niounomiya, though he stays out of sight, only coming out when necessary. Like other Niounomiya, he is the product of a lab experiment to make the strongest killer. Izumu is pure strength without weakness, contrasting Rizumu's pure weakness without strength.!~

name: Akane Sonoyama
description:
A genius scholar, known as one of the Seven Fools in the ER3 System: Akane Sonoyama. Proud of her abilities in mathematics and English, Akane strives with her intellect; however, she doesn't do well in yojijukugo. In her younger years, she became a champion in a Karate tournament, making her capable of defending herself with ease. 

Akane is relatively friendly towards others, regardless of their intellectual ability, though this doesn't stand if they're painters such as Kanami Ibuki. Unfortunately for Kanami, she faces the brunt of Akane's hatred for them, as she considers them to be, "worse than thieves." Though this can concern others, such as Ii, Akane does have a good sense of humour. Additionally, she smokes and is quite anti-feminist. ~!When Akane is accused of the first decapitation, she says she is innocent as she considers painters not being worth killing.!~

As a member of the Seven Fools, Akane has higher intellect than a majority of other geniuses. Despite this, she considers Fraulein Love and Assistant Professor Hewlett to be the second and first smartest people in the ER3 System, respectively. The depths of her ability aren't entirely known, though she is capable of playing Shogi against herself in her head. ~!At the end of Kubikiri Cycle, it's revealed that Akane and Kanami had switched identities before attending Wet Crow's Feather Island for fun and that the real Akane was decapitated. Thus, the "real" Kanami lived and now lives as Akane. It is heavily implied by Jun Aikawa that the real Kanami Ibuki was killed by someone else before their swap. With this, the "real" Kanami, the one that lives as Akane, is a completely unknown individual. Upon being caught for her murders and being sent back to land, she drops out of the Seven Fools and lives her days somewhere else, likely with Shinya Sakaki.!~

name: Miiko Asano
description:
The close friend of Neon and resident of the Antique Apartment, Miiko is a freeter and master of Kendo and Kenjutsu. She rarely expresses her feelings, though is known for showing off her temper while fighting. In order to show what she's feeling, Miiko wears a jinbei with kanji representing her emotions on the back. She has a habit of helping the weak all she can, one being in a relationship with 4 different people because of it.

Ii gets helped out by Miiko often, such as borrowing her Fiat 500. The two shop together for antiques, with Miiko buying things she will never use, and later reselling them. Due to her need to help others, she is quite concerned about Ii's personality and nature.

name: Maki Himena
description:
One of the geniuses invited to Wet Crow's Feather Island for her ability as an esper and fortune-teller: Maki Himena. As a fortune-teller, she often provides her abilities for politicians and corporate clients. Generally, Maki is seen as cynical towards others at times, primarily Ii. When it comes to Ii, she cannot help but dig into him, as she despises people who push responsibility onto others.

Though she will pick on some for their personalities, Maki isn't inherently bad. She has no trouble with having an enjoyable time with others, such as Shinya Sakaki when the two drink together. When waking up, Maki is not too energetic in the morning due to low blood pressure.

As a fortune-teller and esper genius, Maki is capable of knowing almost everything about nearly any person, whether she wants to or not. Gifted with retrocognition, precognition, and telepathy, it's nearly impossible to keep secrets around Maki, unless being one of the few who she cannot read and disrupts everything. Even if she wanted to, she cannot stop her ability of knowing everything about almost everyone. She describes her ability as being in a room full of televisions that she cannot turn off or change channels. ~!After the culprits on Wet Crow's Feather Island are revealed, Ii assumes that Maki knew all along who they were and chose not to say a thing, causing Ii to be somewhat disgusted by her.!~ ~!Near the end of Kubikiri Cycle, Maki states that she can only see her own future for two more years, with it just cutting off afterwards to Ii. She assumes it's her death, and requests that Ii finds out who did it after she passes.!~

name: Magokoro Omokage
description: One of the members of the Thirteen Stairs. She is the grand-daughter of Takashi Saitou. ~!As Jun Aikawa was a failed project to make the strongest human, Magokoro was created as her successor. During her time at the ER3 System, her body was set on fire. After Jun defeats her, they form a rivalry between each other.!~

name: Teruko Chiga
description:
Teruko, known as the "Masked Maid," is said to be invincible at short range combat and an expert at martial arts. Her prowess enables her to act as Iria Akagami's bodyguard. The youngest of the Chiga triplets, she is vastly different from her older kin. Though her sisters preform standard maid activities, Teruko rarely follows them in their duties. Whether she actually needs her glasses is ambiguous, though she does say she wears them to differentiate herself from her sisters, the truth of that statement is unknown, however. 

Out of all the triplets, Teruko has a silent demeanour, almost never letting a word come out of her mouth. When she does say something, anyone that hears about it is shocked to know that she spoke. ~!While Teruko escorts Ii to Kunagisa's room, she tells him that he, "should just die."  During their conversation, Ii asks Teruko if she's lying, with her saying she is several times. When they stop conversing, Ii learns that Teruko is a chronic liar and rarely states the truth, which may be the reason for her lack of speaking.!~

As Teruko has incredible martial arts abilities, she is practically impossible to defeat in close quarters. Suited with a bulletproof maid outfit and a metal mask, inflicting damage upon her is a tough feat. ~!Teruko's prowess in fighting is shown when she fights Akane, where she mercilessly breaks her arm and several ribs among other injuries. Teruko also acts as a shield for Ii after Akane pulls out a gun, ensuring to protect a guest from harm, even when the bullet missed altogether.!~ ~!After defeating Kishishiki Zerozaki, she is dubbed the, "Masked Maid," as she was wearing an iron mask while fighting him.!~

name: Kouta Ishimaru
description: A great thief and rival of Jun Aikawa.

name: Houko Yamiguchi
description:
Houko Yamiguchi is a runaway kid living in the Antique Apartments, and the half-sister of Moeta Ishinagi.

~!She is a former assassin of the Yamiguchi family, the second most powerful Killing Name.!~

name: Neon Suzunashi
description: A part-timer at Enryaky Temple and close friend of Miiko, Neon is a calm and relatively casual woman. She has a great amount of life experience despite not having an education. Ii is uncomfortable around Neon, as she lectures him whenever they meet. Neon is also known to be a powerful fighter, and generally strong.

name: Gaisuke Utsurigi
description:
One of the the former members of *Team* that was lead by Tomo Kunagisa. He refers to the group as *Cluster* instead of *Team*.

Specialty: Cracking (Destruction)
His nickname *Sacchan* comes from *Saikin* (細菌 = Bacteria)
The scientists in Kyouichirou's Laboratory often call him "A Pervert".

~!He's being kept in this facility due to *Mad Demon* Kyouichirou blackmailing him with information regarding Tomo Kunagisa's birth. To him, this information is something he would give his life to keep unknown from everybody.!~

~!He is later found dead in his room, crucified onto the wall with scissors in his eyes, both of his arms dismembered and his stomach cut open. The wall behind him has a message that reads, "You just watch, DEAD BLUE!!"!~

~!At the end of Psycho Logical, it is revealed that he switched places with Koutari Hinayoshi and managed to escape thanks to the help of Tomo Kunagisa, Jun Aikawa (disguised as Kouta), Koutari Hinayoshi and Ii (unknowingly).!~

name: Hikari Chiga
description:
The second oldest of the Chiga triplets, Hikari is a maid that resides on Wet Crow's Feather Island. Like her sisters and Rei Handa, Hikari has vowed to serve Iria Akagami no matter what may occur.

Out of the triplets, Hikari is much more down to earth and is quite friendly to others. Known to be a haggler and has a bit of mysophobia, the latter assisting her in keeping the mansion extra clean. ~!After the second decapitation, Hikari is considered to be the prime suspect. Ii and Kunagisa disagree, believing she wouldn't have murdered someone. Once the teams are formed, Ii, Kunagisa, and Hikari develop a friendly relationship. During which time, Kunagisa declares them all friends, making Hikari's first friends to be Ii and Kunagisa.!~

name: Moeta Ishinagi
description: Moeta Ishinagi is a runaway kid living in the Antique Apartments, and the half-brother of Houko Yamiguchi.

name: Guts
description: Guts is the protagonist of Berserk. He is a tall, muscular man that swings a huge sword called the Dragon Slayer, he has a prosthetic left forearm that has a magnetic grip that also conceals a cannon. Renowned as the "Black Swordsman", he is a former mercenary and branded wanderer who travels the world in a constant internal struggle between pursuing his own ends and protecting those dear to him.

name: Griffith
description:
Griffith was the founder and leader of the mercenary unit known as the Band of the Hawk, named for his helmet which was forged in the shape of a Hawk's head. 

Extraordinarily charismatic, intelligent, and handsome, his skill with his sabre and tactics gives him and his band the reputation of invincibility, making him the favored choice of the Midland King, who was locked in a century long war with the Empire of Chuder. Believing that he is destined for greater things than the average man, Griffith is willing to sacrifice everything for the dream of his own kingdom and only values others so far as they are useful to him. The one exception seems to be [Guts](https://anilist.co/character/422/Guts) and [Casca](https://anilist.co/character/423/Casca), both of whom he confides to in private moments. The source of his ambition is a Behelit given to him by a fortune teller she claimed was "The Egg of the King," which could lead an average person to becoming King himself. 

~! Griffith eventually used the Behelit during the Eclipse, and sacrificed nearly the entire Band of the Hawk to become Femto, the fifth member of the God Hand !~

name: Casca
description:
Casca was the only female soldier in the original Band of the Hawk and is behind only to [Guts](https://anilist.co/character/422/Guts) and [Griffith](https://anilist.co/character/424/Griffith) in swordsmanship. Her ambivalent relationship to both of them makes her moody and capricious. Casca joins the Band of the Hawk after Griffith saves her from a sexual assault by a nobleman. 

~!After Griffith is imprisoned, she becomes the leader of the Band of the Hawk and, along with Guts, leads the mission to rescue Griffith.!~

~!Upon arriving in Elfheim, [Schierke](https://anilist.co/character/7864/Schierke) and [Farnese](https://anilist.co/character/7857/de-Vandimion-Farnese) take it upon themselves to dive into Casca's mind and restore her mental state. They manage to get the old Casca back but at a price of her still not being able to see Guts, without reliving the Eclipse!~

name: Narrator
description:
This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. 

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

name: Judeau
description: The old Band of the Hawk's friendly mediator. A former circus performer who wielded throwing knives, Judeau was also well-aware of the world around him and was seen as a confidant for many of The Hawks. Throughout his stay with the Band of the Hawk, he was secretly in love with Casca, but never acted on it out of respect for Guts' and Casca's feelings for each other.

name: Zodd
description: Also known as Nosferatu Zodd, or Zodd the Immortal, an apostle who has lived for three centuries fighting countless battles in search of worthy opponents. Zodd has the ability to transform from his human-like form into a more menacing creature, resembling that of a minotaur with the face and tail of a tiger along with a pair of bat-like wings that he can retract and grow at will. Zodd first encountered and defeated Guts and Griffith during a castle raid, ultimately deciding to spare them upon realizing Griffith's crimson behelit and Guts' inevitable fate. Zodd has had a long standing rivalry with Skull Knight, along with Guts as he increasingly became a more capable opponent.   ~!Zodd eventually found the "Ultimate Strong One" in Griffith, instantly being defeated by the Hawk of Light within a dream and costing him his left horn. Afterwards, his search for his ultimate opponent was over, he swore his servitude to Griffith in the new Band of the Hawk. He serves the new Band in many of the same roles that Guts served in the old one, including being Griffith's right hand man, most trusted confidant, and strongest warrior. Zodd's ability to fly made possible both Griffith's rescue of Charlotte and Guts' attack on Ganishka at Vritannis. As both a reminder of his defeat and to make the fact he is a replacement of Guts in this new band of Hawk very clear, his left horn has never regrown like Guts' missing right eye. His reason for joining the band of Hawk is much like Guts' also mainly because he was defeated by Griffith.!~

name: Rickert
description:
Rickert was the youngest in the Band of the Hawk, being merely a child. 

~!Now, he is one of the few surviving members of the original Band of the Hawk. After the Eclipse (which he wasn't present at), he lived with [Godot](https://anilist.co/character/6848/Godot), the smith who created [Guts](https://anilist.co/character/422/Guts)' Dragon Slayer, and became his smith apprentice. After Godo's death he takes care of [Erica](https://anilist.co/character/73441/Erica).!~

name: Pippin
description:
A massive dark-skinned man who wielded an equally massive mace. A former miner, Pippin lent his strength to the old Band of the Hawk. He was often associated with [Rickert](https://anilist.co/character/598/Rickert), who he seemed to share a big-brother relationship with. 

Before joining the band, he seems to have worked in a mine, which is why he was able to divert a sudden fire in a tunnel during Griffith's rescue.

name: Slan
description: Slan is the only member of Godhand that isn't repulsive, but her beauty is the only nice thing about her. As [Guts](https://anilist.co/character/422/Guts) is fighting the monsters off she actually laughs at how hard he's trying and that his fight is the ultimate in futility.  She is the first of the Godhand to appear during the eclipse, and takes the form of a giant with black feathered wings.

name: Void
description: A member of the God Hand with a large, exposed brain, eyes stitched shut and lips peeled back. Void is the one who brands the sacrifices made by tortured souls in order for them to become apostles and achieve their dream.

name: Godot
description: The blacksmith who makes and repairs [Guts](https://anilist.co/character/422/Guts)' sword.

name: Corkus
description:
A loud-mouthed ex-thief. Corkus was fond of delusions of grandeur and constantly at odds with Guts. He was the leader of his own band of thieves before he joined the old Band of the Hawk. 

~!Despite his unappealing nature, he was one of the most loyal members of the Band of the Hawk, staying with them until his death during the Eclipse.!~

name: Charlotte Beatrix Marie Rhody Windam
description:
The princess of Midland, Charlotte fell in love with Griffith almost at first sight. 

~!After Guts defeated Griffith in their duel, Griffith slept with Charlotte and was imprisoned and tortured for a year as a result. During that time, Charlotte continued to pine over Griffith and eventually was the one who provided the route for the Hawks to rescue him from prison.!~ 

~!Two years after the Eclipse, Midland was conquered by the Kushans and she was taken prisoner by Ganishka with the view of becoming his wife. Even in captivity, she spent all of her time making embroidery portraits of Griffith, dreaming of his return. !~

~!Soon after the events at Albion, Griffith did return for her and used Zodd to fly her and Anna out of captivity. She is currently traveling with the new Band of the Hawk alongside Griffith, to whom she is betrothed. She recently declared The Band of the Hawk to be Midland's Regular Army after their resounding victory against the Kushans in Vritannis. Sonia referred to her as the "Queen of the Ducks".!~

name: Erica
description: Adopted daughter of [Godot](https://anilist.co/character/6848/Godot). She was in a wagon being chased by trolls when the Band of the Hawk and [Irvine](https://anilist.co/character/7871/Irvine) saved her.

name: Gaston
description: Gaston is the coolest non-commanding soldier in the hawks, and Guts's drinking buddy. He is basically Guts's right hand when it came to the strike team which he led.  ~!Out of all the soldiers who died during the Eclipse he managed to survive the longest, meeting his end just after one last farewell to Guts.!~

name: Ubik
description: Ubik's design is directly based upon one of the Hellraiser Cenobite characters. He is also one of the Godhand, and thus extremely mysterious. He has the voice of an old man, and together with Conrad he shows Griffith a glimpse into his past so that he can make the choice to sacrifice the Hawks without question.

name: Adon Coborlwitz
description: He is General of the Blue Whale Knights. Adon's resilience and extended speeches are legendary. He also possesses a wide array of ancient techniques passed down through generations of the Coborlwitz family, which helped him surviving several battles with the Band of the Hawk.

name: Gambino
description:
[Guts'](https://anilist.co/character/422/Guts) adoptive father, and leader of a mercenary band. Gambino trained Guts to be a mercenary like himself and even gave Guts his first scar (across his nose) during a practice fight. 

~!Gambino sold Guts one night to [Donovan](https://anilist.co/character/132490/Donovan), a fellow soldier, who raped young Guts and whom Guts later brutally kills afterwards. Gambino was later hit by a cannon blast in battle and lost his leg and the ability to fight. This infuriated his anger at Guts even further, as he also blamed the death of his lover, Shizu, on Guts when she adopted him. Gambino became drunk one night and tried to kill Guts in anger. He admits he sold Guts to Donovan for three silver coins right before Guts killed him in self-defence.!~

name: Bazuso
description:
Bazuso was exaggerated in stature, and stood much taller than other men. Although he was killed before he could be seen without his armor, it can be inferred that his physique was very muscular due to the excessive size of his weapon, as well as the incredible size and weight of his armor.

Bazuso was a violent and brash man. He was greatly arrogant and seemingly viewed himself as superior to his foes, taunting those reluctant to attack him and loudly goading his enemies right in front of him. He bore an insatiable drive for combat and possessed incredible physical strength, which allowed him to easily slay anyone who challenged him. However, after Guts emerged as the victor of their duel and mortally wounded Bazuso, he attempted to yield before Guts finished him off.

Bazuso's strength and fighting ability became infamous throughout the battlefield. It is said that he once successfully took on over thirty men in combat, earning him the moniker of "Thirty-Man Slayer", and that he defeated a bear by himself, both of which were testaments to his incredible physical strength. Bazuso was strong enough to send men flying with a single swing of his battleaxe, even when using just one arm.

Bazuso wielded a large battleaxe during his fight against Guts. Due to his fearsome reputation, one can assume that he was very skilled in wielding it. Furthermore, the size of the battleaxe complimented Bazuso's height, giving him a wide reach in combat.

Placed in charge of a fortress under siege by a band of mercenaries, Bazuso leaves the group frozen in fear on sight, intimidated by the immense reputation of the battleaxe wielding man. As Bazuso taunts his enemies, Guts, a young independent mercenary, puts himself forward to remedy the problem; he tells his employer that he will kill Bazuso in exchange for seven pieces of gold. Though Bazuso intends to humor Guts in accepting his duel, expecting to kill the young swordsman with little effort, the ensuing battle is fought on equal terms. After an exchange of blows, Guts is fortunate enough to be able to damage Bazuso's battleaxe and deliver a powerful slash to his waist, forcing the colossal man to his knees. In his final moments, Bazuso attempts to yield for his life; Guts quickly drives his sword down into the neutralized man's head, splitting it half-way, one of Bazuso's eyes dislodged from the impact. It is Guts' triumph over Bazuso that earns him the attention of the Band of the Falcon, and more specifically, Griffith.

name: Conrad
description: Conrad is the giant worm like member of the Godhand. His first appearence is in the eclipse along with the rest of the Godhand, and he is seen as having eyes that do not open, a mouth that doesn't close and hands that are stuck together.

name: General Boscogne
description: Boscogne is the ultra powerful commanding officer of Tuda's most powerful force, the Purple Rhinos. He is politically bound to take orders from Lord Gennon.

name: Laban
description: Laban was a high-ranking noble in Midland's Court. During the Hundred-Year War, Laban was a general for Midland and put great faith in Griffith's abilities.

name: Midland no Ou
description: The King of Midland is the one most responsible for [Griffith](https://anilist.co/character/424)'s ascension to power. He is the ruler of Midland, and father to [Princess Charlotte](https://anilist.co/character/614). During an almost lost battle, the King of Midland's army is saved by the Band of the Hawk. He took an immediate liking to the powerful and brilliant Griffith, and promoted him through the ranks extremely quickly. From making him a noble, to bestowing upon him the title of "Guardian of Midland," the King was always quick to reward him for a job well done. The King's view quickly changes when Griffith seeks out the Princess in one last act of desperation after losing his most treasured prize.

name: Adonis
description:
Adonis was the son of [Julius](https://anilist.co/character/49607/). He was a slim child with long, blonde hair and brown eyes (blue in the movie). In the anime, he wears a green shirt, but in the movie he wears grey noble clothes.

He was a timid young boy who trained with his father in swordplay, who was excessively brutal and harsh when they sparred.

~! After his assassination of Julius, [Guts](https://anilist.co/character/422/) accidentally stabs the young boy through the chest when he approaches the door to the scene. Adonis grasps Guts' hand before he dies, much to the swordsman's horror. According to the caretaker Hassan, Adonis never once saw his father smile. !~

name: Midland no Ouhi
description: The queen is [Charlotte](https://anilist.co/character/614)'s step mother. She disapproves of Charlotte's interest in Griffith.

name: Shoutarou Kaneda
description: Kaneda is a carefree gang-leader who boasts a custom-modified motorcycle. He and [Tetsuo](https://anilist.co/character/2589/Shima-Tetsuo) have been best friends since early childhood. He is brash and not above teasing Tetsuo despite feeling affection for him as a younger brother. Upon rescuing [Kei](https://anilist.co/character/9875/Kei), Kaneda becomes involved in the activities of her group of anti-government guerillas in hopes of locating Tetsuo.

name: Tetsuo Shima
description: Kaneda's best friend since preschool and the second principal subject of the story's theme. Tetsuo is shown as a black sheep in the gang he and Kaneda are part of, and quietly suffers from a deeply rooted inferiority complex. He admires his friend yet at the same time strongly resents his own reliance upon him. After his psychokinetic abilities manifest, Tetsuo quickly becomes Kaneda's nemesis; he desires Kaneda's motorcycle (a symbol of status and power), and seeks to prove himself supremely powerful, without need of protection.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Kei
description:
A young woman whom Kaneda meets on his quest to find Tetsuo. She is a member of an anti-government organization that Ryu and Nezu are also involved in. 

Kei's role in the Resistance is important because she is completely loyal to its cause and to Ryu. She is strong willed and is the one to discover that Lady Miyako is an Esper too. Miyako helps Kei channel her thoughts and discovers she is a conduit for the Espers' telepathy. Kiyoko does this in the movie and Kei communicates with Kaneda and Tetsuo. She works closely with Chiyoko, a physically strong and resilliant resistance fighter and they look out for each other.

name: Akira
description: Codename #28 in the Japanese government's secret ESP project. An estimately 8 year old boy around whom the story revolves. Akira's power was so immense that he inadvertantly caused the destruction of Tokyo in 1988 and was secretly sealed afterwards in a cryogenic chamber underneath the destruction site.  *Manga Spoilers*    ~!Unlike in the animated feature, Akira makes an actual appearance in the manga. After his awakening by Tetsuo, he loses control of his power again as he witnesses his friend Takashi being murdered, and the destruction of Neo-Tokyo ensues.  Though he is known as the figurehead of the Great Tokyo Empire--which was established after the destruction of Neo-Tokyo--Tetsuo is actually the one in charge and he uses Akira to perform miracles with his power to control their followers. Kaori is then appointed by Tetsuo to keep him company and look after him.  Akira displays autistic behavior and has actually very few lines throughout the second half of the manga. Though in flashbacks he appears quite happy with the younger versions of Takashi, Masaru and Kyoko. At the end, he's shot by Ryu and joins with Takashi and his friends from the institute to absorb Tetsuo who had lost control of his powers.   Though Akira is gone, he still lives in the hearts of Kaneda, Kei and other survivor who begin to build the Great Tokyo Empire. !~

name: Shikishima Taisa
description: A senior military officer who oversees research into psychic abilities. He listens closely to the three Esper children, and seeks to capture Tetsuo to exploit his powers.

name: Kai
description:
Sometimes known as Kaisuke, he is a high-ranking member of Kaneda's gang. He does not play a major role at first​ but becomes more prominent later in the story.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Kaori
description: A timid young girl who ends up becoming Tetsuo's companion and Akira's babysitter.     ~!In the manga, Kaori is introduced after Neo-Tokyo is destroyed by Akira when she tries to get food for her crippled father. After she's discovered that she isn't a member of The Great Tokyo Empire, she's denied food and later on recruited by Tetsuo's aide with three other girls to serve as Tetsuo's playmates.     Tetsuo gives each of the girls the government-issued drug, and mistaking it for a medicine, Kaori instead saves it for her sick father; which ends up saving her from sharing the fate of the others girls whom end up being killed by the strong effect of the drug.    Her caring and innocent nature earns her Tetsuo's trust and genuine affection, and she becomes the person to whom he turns for comfort, especially whenever he suffers the strain of the power evolving within him. After Tetsuo begins to mutate and he no longer able to control his powers, his aides plan to assassinate him; hearing of that Kaori takes off to warn him, but gets shot by them.    When Tetsuo finds her dying body, he enters a battle with the American army, then with Kaneda. Later on he attempts to revive her, but fails. He then carries her dead body to Akira's cryogenic chamber and she was last seen by Kei when she takes cover inside it after Tetsuo's body goes through another mutation.!~

name: Chiyoko
description: Chiyoko is the weapons expert for the Resistance and Kei's close friend and ally.

name: Yamagata
description: One of the most prominent members of Kaneda's gang. He often derides Tetsuo, which leads to harsh feelings between them that will ultimately seal his fate. (Credit to Wikipedia)

name: Miyako
description: Lady Miyako was a former test subject known as "Designated #19" from the Project. She is the high priestess and leader of a temple in Neo-Tokyo and a major ally of Kaneda and Kei as the story progresses, who plays an important role in the final battle with Tetsuo Shima.

name: Ryuusaku
description:
Ryuusaku is a comrade of Kei's in the resistance movement who claims to be Kei's brother, but it is implied that this is not the case.

(Source: Fandom.com)

name: Nezu
description: Nezu was a parliament member who is also the leader of the terrorist resistance movement against the government.

name: Levi
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3")

Squad Captain of the Special Operations Squad (known as Squad Levi) within the Survey Corps. He is known as humanity's strongest soldier. 

Levi is abrasive, blunt, and has a strong respect for structure and discipline. He is a clean-freak, demanding spotless cleanliness of himself, his equipment, and his environment. Rumors say he was involved in underground crime in his life before coming a soldier. Despite his emotionless and unfriendly demeanor, Levi cares deeply for his squad and greatly values human life.

name: Eren Yeager
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7") - 183 cm (6'0")
__Affiliation:__ 104th Trainees Squad, Survey Corps. 

Eren was born to [Carla](https://anilist.co/character/62475/Yeager-Carla) and [Grisha Yeager](https://anilist.co/character/62477/Yeager-Grisha) in Shiganshina District within the southern region of Wall Maria. He grew up in the town with his parents and foster sister [Mikasa](https://anilist.co/character/40881/Ackerman-Mikasa), who moved in with the Yeagers as a child. Eren spent most of his time with Mikasa and their mutual best friend [Armin Arlert](https://anilist.co/character/46494/Arlert-Armin), whom the pair often defended from neighborhood bullies.  

Eren is a passionate, determined, hardheaded, and impulsive young man. When they were children, Armin showed him a book depicting the wonders of the outside world. Eren grew to share Armin's curiosity of the world beyond the Walls and resolved to see it for himself. This dream inspired his admiration of the Survey Corps and his desire to join their ranks as soon as he became eligible for enrollment. 

When the Titans suddenly broke through Wall Maria into Shiganshina, Eren was forced to watch on as his mother became trapped under the rubble of their house and eaten by a titan. Forever changed from this event, Eren vows to kill every last titan.

name: Mikasa Ackerman
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7") - 176 cm (5'9½")
__Position:__ 104th Training Corps, Survey Corps
__Relatives:__ [Birth Mother](https://anilist.co/character/84341/Mikasa-no-Haha) (Deceased), [Birth Father](https://anilist.co/character/84339/Mikasa-no-Chichi) (Deceased), [Grisha Yaeger](https://anilist.co/character/62477/Grisha-Yeager) (Foster Father), [Carla Yaeger](https://anilist.co/character/62475/Carla-Yeager) (Foster Mother, Deceased), [Eren Yeager](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Eren-Yeager) (Foster Brother)

Mikasa is Eren Yaeger's foster sister and mutual childhood friend of [Armin Arlert](https://anilist.co/character/46494), living with the two of them in Shiganshina District within the southern region of Wall Maria. 

When she was young, her parents were killed by human traffickers, and she was kidnapped. Eren discovered this and helped her escape her captors. Later, Eren gave her his scarf, which she constantly wears and shares an emotional attachment to. She was adopted by the Yaeger family soon after. Because of these past events, Mikasa shares an unbreakable bond with Eren and lives to protect him, constantly worrying for Eren's well-being. After the Titans broke through Wall Maria and killed her and Eren's mother, she chose to follow Eren into the military to try and keep him safe from danger. 

Even as a child, Mikasa possessed impressive fighting skill and strength, and that skill was only honed further during her training.  Mikasa is considered a genius among all the army trainees and is incredibly skilled at combat and agility, to the point that she was known as the greatest soldier among the 104th Training Corps and graduated in first place. Though being among the best of the best, she remains humble and refrains from displaying arrogance. Ultimately, Mikasa's loyalty remains with Eren no matter the circumstance, with her only true desire being to live a peaceful life with him.

name: Armin Arlert
description:
__Height:__ 163 cm (5'4")
__Position:__ 104th Trainees Squad, Survey Corps
__Relatives:__ [Grandfather](https://anilist.co/character/84313/Armin-no-Ojiisan)

Armin is a young boy who was born and raised in the Shiganshina District within the walls, being childhood friends with both [Eren Yeager](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Eren-Yeager) and [Mikasa Ackerman](https://anilist.co/character/40881). After Wall Maria was breached, he chose to join Mikasa and Eren in joining the military, both to try to make a good and meaningful impact on the world, and to fulfill his dream of seeing the outside world.

Even when he was young, the naturally curious Armin has always had a deep fascination with the world beyond the Walls. As a child, he found and studied an illegal book about the outside world that was owned by his grandfather. He often shared the book and information contained in it with Eren Yeager, his best friend, and his dreams of seeing the world outside the walls. Armin was branded a heretic by other children for his unusual interest in the outside world and was thus frequently picked on. Too timid to defend himself, Armin would often rely on his friends Eren and Mikasa Ackerman to protect him from local bullies. This, coupled with his frail physique, was a deep shame for Armin, leading him to have poor self-esteem and to believe that he is a burden to others. Because of this, Armin has always been very eager to prove his worth, especially towards his close friends. 

Armin is known to be exceptionally loyal and selfless. He constantly worries for the safety of his friends, and he is always prepared to throw himself into dangerous situations to save them. Alongside his kindhearted nature and emotionally intelligence, Armin is a very analytical person. He likes to think deeply about situations and solve problems using his mind. These personality traits, in conjunction with his intelligence, good judgment, level headedness, ability to plan ahead, come up with creative ideas and to think outside the box, are what make him a great tactician. Although he may appear among the physically weakest of the 104th Training Corps, his incredible intelligence and strategic genius makes him an invaluable asset to any team.

name: Hange Zoe
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7")
__Affiliation:__ Survey Corps; Section Commander, Squad Leader.

Leader of the Survey Corps' Fourth Squad, Hange is also in charge of conducting research on Titans, and pursues this knowledge so passionately that they have become obsessed with Titans as a result. After originally holding a deep hatred for the creatures, Hange decided to take on a new outside-the-box approach to their research by letting go of their resentment towards Titans and approaching the test subjects with compassion. 

Hange is an energetic, freethinking and quirky scientist, with a unique way of conducting both themselves and their work. Hange is a genius outside of just Titan research too, using their brain to create weapons, tactical plans, and inventions for the benefit of humanity. As a leader, Hange is thoughtful of their comrades, and can easily figure out complex problems in order to create plans for their teammates to carry out.

name: Erwin Smith
description:
**Height:** 188 cm
**Position:** 13th Commander, Survey Corps

Discerning, intelligent, and widely respected, Erwin is the unshakable and calculated 13th commander of the Survey Corps. While he cares deeply for his men, he does not hesitate to sacrifice them for the good and prosperity of mankind, and his men have proven more than willing to stake their lives at his order. Erwin developed the Long-Distance Enemy Scouting Formation.

name: Gabi Braun
description:
__Height__: 138 cm

Gabi Braun is an Eldian living in the Liberio internment zone and the cousin of [Reiner Braun](https://anilist.co/character/46484/Reiner-Braun). She is friends with her fellow warrior candidates [Udo](https://anilist.co/character/125663), [Zofia](https://anilist.co/character/125664/Zofia), and [Falco Grice](https://anilist.co/character/125660). 

Gabi is very passionate and head-strong, expressing her emotions and opinions without inhibition. She is also brave, possessing boundless determination, and willing to put her life on the line to complete a goal for a perceived greater good. However, these attributes can also make her somewhat overbearing and domineering. This causes her to be tactless at times, forcing her opinions on others and taking charge regardless of whether it was asked for or not. She mostly shows this side around her fellow Warrior candidates, considering herself their de facto leader to an extent, and even threatening to 'punish' them when they disagree with her. Nonetheless, she is friendly enough that they have no issue with spending their leisure time with her. Aside from her resolve and determination, Gabi is care-free even on the battlefield, making remarks about her cuteness and claiming her commander loves her too much to sacrifice her.

~!She is a Warrior candidate that is likely to inherit the Armored Titan.!~

name: Sasha Blouse
description:
__Initial Height:__ 168cm
__Affiliations__: 104th Cadet Corps, Survey Corps; Soldier
__Relatives__: [Artur Blouse](https://anilist.co/character/131281/Artur-Blouse) (Father), [Lisa Blouse](https://anilist.co/character/134952/Lisa-Blouse) (Mother)

Originally from Dauper, a remote and scarcely populated village of hunters located in a mountain forest in the southern area of Wall Rose, Sasha joined the military as a cadet of the 104th Training Corps, where she ranked 9th upon graduation. After graduating, she'd choose to enlist in the Scouting Regiment. 

Sasha is a friendly and fun-loving girl. She speaks with a local accent from her home village, but initially hid it out of embarrassment by using overly formal and polite speech. She is a constant food hoarder and is known to have an incredible appetite; eating provided her with considerable gratification and relief, especially during times of great stress, and food was often the only thing on her mind when at ease. Raised as an animal hunter, Sasha specializes in archery, horseback riding, and tracking, although her eccentricity and unconventional methods tend to make her a poor fit for group operations.

~!She later saves a child named [Kaya](https://anilist.co/character/132738/Kaya) from a titan attack, who her family ends up adopting.!~

name: Reiner Braun
description:
__Height__: 185 cm (6'1")

Member of the Survey Corps and former cadet of the 104th Training Corps. Reiner is a passionate and strong-willed young man with a strong sense of duty. He ranked 2nd in his training class upon graduation, finishing behind only [Mikasa](https://anilist.co/character/40881). His comrades have great trust in him, and he is stated to be the "big brother" of the 104th cadets.

name: Jean Kirstein
description:
__Height__: 175 cm (5'8")
__Relatives__: [Mother](https://anilist.co/character/131444/Jean-no-Haha)

Jean Kirschtein is a graduate of the 104th Cadet Corps, among whom he ranked 6th for his skills with ODM gear and ability to look at things through a more tactical lense. Jean hails from Wall Rose's Trost District, and joined the military with hopes of living a peaceful life within the walls as part of the Military Police. However, he would later find himself joining the Survey Corps after being convinced both by his close friend [Marco Bott's](https://anilist.co/character/62479/Marco-Bott) words, and after witnessing the death of several of his comrades.

Jean has a blunt personality. He holds no restraint when it comes to speaking his mind, even when he knows it would not be wise to do so or when it could spark conflict. Jean is also pragmatic: he has a strong aversion to exposing himself to dangerous situations. During his time as a cadet, Jean was extremely hot-headed, easily becoming frustrated and quick to resort to violence when pushed. Jean was also very cynical about defeating the Titans, believing that humanity has no chance against them and openly mocking more idealistic individuals like [Eren Yeager](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Eren-Yeager), and saw resisting the Titans as a hopeless cause. However, despite these things, and although he presents himself as self-centered, Jean places high value on the lives of his comrades, and is willing to risk his life to prevent countless more deaths from his comrades. Even with his shortcomings, Jean has shown himself to be a natural leader, being able to understand others and assess situations well because of his flaws, and proves capable of leading his fellow soldiers when they are left confused and without a plan.

name: Annie Leonhart
description:
__Height__: 153 cm (5")  

A member of the 104th Southern Division in the Cadet Corps. After graduating from the 104th, ranked 4th place in the top 10, she ends up joining the Military Police. She is roommates with [Hitch Dreyse](https://anilist.co/character/86017).

A stoic girl, Annie is considered to be an isolated, solitary type, being rarely seen smiling or socializing and often having an emotionless expression. She is apathetic and somnolent, with little desire to put in any effort into meaningless disciplines or activities. Nonetheless, what drives Annie more than anything is her desire for a normal life.

name: Krista Lenz
description:
__Height__: 145 cm (4'8")
__Affiliations__: 104th Trainees Squad, Survey Corps

Ranked tenth in the trainee class, Krista is a very shy and kind, caring person, often being described as a "goddess" or "angel" by her peers. She is good friends with [Ymir](https://anilist.co/character/71479/Ymir).

name: Zeke
description:
__Height__: 183 cm

Zeke is the current inheritor of the Beast Titan, and is considered by [Reiner Braun](https://anilist.co/character/46484/Reiner-Braun) to be the strongest Warrior, contrasting [Levi's](https://anilist.co/character/45627/Levi) title of "humanity's strongest soldier".

name: Pieck Finger
description:
__Height__: 155 cm

Pieck is an Eldian who serves as one of Marley's Warriors. She is shown to be somewhat sweet and kind, consistently shown to care about her fellow Warriors and the Warrior candidates. ~!She is the current inheritor of the Cart Titan.!~

name: Ymir
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm (5'7")
__Affiliations:__ 104th Trainees Squad, Scouting Legion

Member of the Scouting Legion. She seems selfish, cynical, bossy, sly, uncooperative, exploitative, and confrontational, but she can apparently be kind, especially to [Krista](https://anilist.co/character/62481/Krista-Lenz).

name: Connie Springer
description:
__Height__: 158 cm (5'2")  
__Relatives:__ [Mother](https://anilist.co/character/137287/Conny-no-Haha), Martin Springer (Brother), Sunny Springer (Sister)

Connie Springer is a graduate of the 104th Training Corps, having ranked 8th in class. He is known to be one of the quickest soldiers while using ODM gear and is skilled at making very sharp turns. He hails from the rural Ragako Village within Wall Rose, his greatest ambition being to make his family and village proud of him. Upon graduation, he chose to join the Survey Corps. 

Upbeat and naive, Connie is rather unfocused outside of combat, and enjoys goofing around and messing with his friends, but can also be a bit dense at times, as he can have some difficulty comprehending new developments as they appear. Connie always tries to remain optimistic, consistently caring for the well-being of his friends, family and village, and being willing to help in any way he can. However, this soft spot and the struggles he goes through as a member of the Survey Corps takes a toll on him, as he often responds to grief and loss with anger, irritation and hatred, causing him to at times make rash, impulsive decisions. He will do anything to protect his family, whether it be his biological family or his closest friends.

name: Falco Grice
description:
__Height__: 140 cm
__Position__: Warrior Candidate

Falco Grice is an Eldian Warrior candidate working for the Marley government and is the younger brother of [Colt Grice](https://anilist.co/character/125665/Colt-Grice). Falco is close friends with his fellow warrior candidates; [Udo](https://anilist.co/character/125663/Udo), [Zofia](https://anilist.co/character/125664/Zofia), and [Gabi](https://anilist.co/character/125659/Gabi-Braun).

While not as physically strong as his fellow soldiers, he makes up for it with his quick wit and improvisation. He is a very merciful and compassionate person, going out of his way to protect and save other people lives, even enemy soldiers. He is also very polite and respectful towards others, and is an empathetic person, being willing to hear people out and properly understand things from their points of view.

~!He is a candidate to inherit the power of the Armored Titan. He has the desire to become the Armored Titan in order to prevent Gabi Braun from inheriting it, as he has a crush on her and wants them to live a long life.!~

name: Yelena
description:
Yelena is the leader of the Anti-Marleyan Volunteers working under [Zeke Yeager](https://anilist.co/character/125661/Zeke). She was one of the Marleyan soldiers on board the first survey fleet to Paradis Island after Marley's failed attack operation. She is a very tall woman with her blonde hair styled in a short bob with straight bangs. She has large dark eyes and somewhat androgynous features due to her build and style.

Yelena is a fervent follower of Zeke Yeager, holding great admiration and respect for him. She is usually calm and collected, her demeanour remaining unchanged even when [Jean Kirstein](https://anilist.co/character/46498/Kirstein-Jean) yelled at her for failing to see her job through. Nonetheless, she is willing to take responsibility and apologizes should she fail in her task. Yelena appears to maintain a very relaxed demeanour while having dry, humorous undertones to much of her actions.

~!It is later revealed that Yelena was born into an unassuming family in Marley, and eventually became disillusioned with her own country. After meeting Zeke Yeager, Yelena concocted a plan to solidify herself in history by helping Zeke save the world. As part of her narrative, Yelena created a false background for herself, claiming that her homeland was invaded and conquered by Marley. She was forcibly drafted as a soldier to fight in the Marleyan military, where she met similar-minded soldiers and organized them into the Anti-Marleyan Volunteers to fight against Marley.!~

name: Floch Forster
description:
Floch is a new recruit in the Survey Corps. He joined the Survey Corps during the two months between the attack at Orvud District and the return to Shiganshina District.

~!After the rest of the Yeagerists are killed during the port battle, Floch hides on the ship to Marley. After shooting holes in the fuel tank of the flying boat, Floch is ultimately killed by Mikasa.!~

name: Bertolt Hoover
description:
__Height__: 192 cm (6'3")  
__Affiliation__: Survey Corps

Member of the Survey Corps and former cadet of the 104th Training Corps. Bertoldt ranked 3rd in his training class upon graduation, finishing behind only [Mikasa](https://anilist.co/character/40881) and his hometown friend [Reiner](https://anilist.co/character/46484). He is a quiet young man who identifies himself as someone with a weak will that follows popular opinion. Despite ranking 3rd in his class, his training commandant noted him to be a person with great potential, but an utter lack of initiative. Bertoldt originally he enlisted in the military with aspirations of joining the Military Police and living in the safety of the inner wall, but after the Battle of Trost he instead decided to join the Survey Corps.

name: Kenny Ackerman
description:
__Affiliation:__ Military Police; Captain of Anti-Personnel Control Squad.
__Relatives:__ [Kuchel Ackerman](https://anilist.co/character/127940/Kuchel-Ackerman) (Sister), [Unnamed Grandfather](https://anilist.co/character/128589/Kenny-no-Ojiisan), 

Kenny Ackerman is a member of the Military Police Brigade's First Interior Squad and also the Anti-Personnel Control Squad. Decades prior, however, Kenny was known as an infamous serial killer that stalked victims in the capitol. 

Despite his dark field of work, Kenny appears to be rather jovial and takes pleasure in taunting his adversaries during battle. When fighting, he becomes animated and lively, often making a scene or otherwise throwing insults and witticisms. However, he also fought with control and was able to effortlessly sneak up on his targets when they least expected him. His preferred method of killing during his time as a serial killer was to slit the throats of his victims which earned him his infamous handle "Kenny the Ripper", and it was rumored that he murdered over 100 members of the Military Police Brigade. However, decades later his killings ceased and the terror that he once inspired dwindled into an Urban Legend. He eventually was found working under the Royal Government, the reasoning for his sudden shift in behavior being a mystery. Kenny is ultimately, despite his comical personality, very cold and calculated, sparing little emotional attachment or loyalty to anyone, with only a few exceptions.

~!ㅤ
He notably shares the same bloodline as both [Levi](https://anilist.co/character/45627/Levi) and [Mikasa Ackerman](https://anilist.co/character/40881/Mikasa-Ackerman).!~

name: Dot Pixis
description: The highest-ranked Administrator of the Southern Region. Head of the Garrison's Southern Territories, Pixis is a cunning leader with astute insights. However, he is also an alcoholic who is constantly watched over by his aid, [Anka](https://anilist.co/character/84331/Anka-Rheinberger), who constantly scolds him for sleeping and drinking during critical moments.

name: Petra Ral
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm (5'2")
__Affiliation:__ Survey Corps; Soldier, Special Operations Squad.
__Relatives:__ [Father](https://anilist.co/character/131987/Petra-no-Chichi)

Petra Ral is a soldier of the Survey Corps hand-picked by [Captain Levi](https://anilist.co/character/45627/Levi) to join the Special Operations Squad.

Petra is a very kind and caring woman, going out of her way to look after and guiding [Eren Yaeger](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Eren-Yeager) when he was first admitted to the squad. She seemed to have the most attachment to Eren among Levi Squad, as she was often the only one shown to actually worry about him and his wellbeing, at least at first. Although all of Levi's squad wished for Eren's unconditional trust, it was ultimately Petra who convinced him to do so. 

Despite her kind nature, Petra was a conditioned soldier with a quick reaction time against perceived danger. She displays extreme loyalty to her leaders, superiors and their orders, and cares deeply for her team, although she tends to be at odds with [Oluo Bozad](https://anilist.co/character/71687/Oluo-Bozard) due to his irritating tendency to try and imitate Levi. She greatly looks up to Levi as her superior and is deeply devoted to him, willing to completely dedicate her life to his cause. It is implied that she may harbor romantic feelings for her captain.

name: Grisha Yeager
description:
Father of [Eren Yaeger](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Eren-Yeager) and caretaker of [Mikasa Ackerman](https://anilist.co/character/40881/Mikasa-Ackerman). He is a renowned doctor who was well respected in the District of Shiganshina after he saved the village from a mysterious viral epidemic by developing vaccines. He also provides a medical house call service to the people of Shiganshina and to various towns in addition to having a network of contacts within the Corps of the Shiganshina District. He is married to [Carla Yaeger](https://anilist.co/character/62475).

~!In the basement of the Yeager family house, he hides a secret which he refers to as the "truth". Upon finding Eren after the fall of Wall Maria, he injects him with a series of chemicals and amnesiacs and entrusts him with the key to the "truth", before mysteriously disappearing. This strange serum resulted in Eren gaining the ability to transform into a titan.!~

name: Hitch Dreyse
description:
**Height:** 168 cm
__Affiliations:__ 104th Cadet Corps.

Recruit of the Military Police stationed in Stohess District. She was roommates with [Annie Leonhart](https://anilist.co/character/46490/Annie-Leonhart).

Hitch acts immature in certain ways, she has a sarcastic, easygoing personality and seems to mischievously enjoy teasing and needling her fellow officers, especially [Marlo Freudenberg](https://anilist.co/character/71457/Marlo-Freudenberg). She claims she chose to join the Military Police out of laziness, as it is well known that the senior staff are incredibly corrupt and she wanted to benefit from the system herself; however, she did not take into account that, as a new recruit, her superiors would dump all their work on her. Though she may act a bit air-headed at times, Hitch is not selfish and cares about those around her, especially her fellow comrades.

name: Albedo
description: The overseer of the Floor Guardians and one of the most powerful NPC in Nazarick. She takes the form of a beautiful woman with fallen angel wings and horns. Because [Ainz](https://anilist.co/character/89103) modified her settings on a whim, she ends up madly in love with him. Albedo's romantic obsessions are so strong that if Ainz were to even glance at her body, she would immediately become excited. Albedo's obsession with Ainz has led him to greatly regret his actions. While she tries to act calm, as befitting of her role, any perceived insult against Ainz or Nazarick, real or imagined, sends her into a rage. Like most inhabitants of Nazarick, she despises humans which she refers to as "lower life-forms." ~!Though the reason is not yet known, Albedo holds a strong hatred towards all of the 41 Supreme Beings except for Ainz. It is hinted that she is scheming to annihilate all the other guild members if they are found.!~

name: Momonga
description:
He is the guild master of Ainz Ooal Gown and regarded as the highest of the Almighty 41 Supreme Beings by the NPCs of the Great Tomb of Nazarick. He is also the creator of [Pandora's Actor](https://anilist.co/character/89154/Pandoras-Actor).

A cautious and stingy person, Momonga always tries to plan and control details, avoiding any haphazard actions. Because he doesn't underestimate his opponents, he will usually overkill them. Since being transferred to a new world and becoming an actual Undead being, Momonga could feel himself becoming very cold and calculating, his emotions repressed.

Loyal to his friends and creations, since becoming Lord ruler of Nazarick in the new world he acts with a certain degree of nobility for his devoted followers. Momonga only does things that will benefit Nazarick or himself, whether its information or prestige. Although he does have a sense of justice and doesn't hate humans as much as his followers, he holds no attachment to them, and he feels nothing toward their deaths.

~!His real name is Satoru Suzuki.!~

name: Shalltear Bloodfallen
description:
The Guardian of the First, Second, and Third floors of Nazarick, she has the form of a beautiful vampire girl. She's also in love with [Momonga](https://anilist.co/character/89103). She and [Albedo](https://anilist.co/character/89122) constantly clash for his attention. While the two don't mind sharing Momonga, they still fight for superiority and who would ultimately appeal to Momonga. Shalltear is one of the most powerful guardians, allegedly capable of going toe-to-toe with Albedo.

~!Due to an incident where she is subjected to mind control by a member of the Black Scripture, she ends up unintentionally rebelling against Nazarick.!~

name: Demiurge
description: The Guardian of the Seventh floor of Nazarick, with the form of a demon wearing glasses. Demiurge is very intelligent, but is also considered the most evil NPC on Nazarick. He greatly enjoys the suffering of others, made clear by his vicious experiments on prisoners. He's in charge of tactics and defenses of Nazarick. Among the Guardians, he gets along the best with [Mare](https://anilist.co/character/89126/Bello-Fiore-Mare), since he understands the more cunning side of the Dark Elf.

name: Sebas Tian
description: The butler of the Tenth floor of Nazarick, who specializes in unarmed combat, with power comparable with the other Floor Guardians. He has the appearance of an elderly gentleman with a neat beard, but is actually of a species known as Dragonoids. He has a strong sense of justice, like his creator. Thus, he dislikes when the other Guardians kill humans needlessly. Because of their opposite personalities, he and [Demiurge](https://anilist.co/character/89125/Demiurge) don't get along.

name: Narberal Gamma
description:
One of the Pleiades, combat maids of the Tenth floor under [Sebas Tian](https://anilist.co/character/89155). She's a Doppelgänger and, because she's one of the most human-looking of the maids, she is [Momonga](https://anilist.co/character/89103)'s companion in his exploration of the new world disguised as adventurers. Narberal takes great pride in this duty, often "wearing" it like a badge of honor. However, like most in Nazarick, she holds great disdain towards humans. This proves troublesome, as she becomes incredibly violent when human males make advances on her. 

While operating as a member of the adventuring guild, "Darkness", Narberal operates under the alias of "Nabe", which becomes "Nabe, the Beautiful Lady" when Darkness becomes famous. Narberal's beauty has been compared to that of the "Golden Princess of Re-Estize" by many of the country's inhabitants.

name: Aura Bella Fiora
description: One of the Guardians of the Sixth floor of Nazarick, alongside her twin brother [Mare](https://anilist.co/character/89126). She's very energetic and extroverted, in contrast with her brother. Aura is a 70-year-old Dark Elf. Despite constantly fighting, she and [Shalltear](https://anilist.co/character/89121/Bloodfallen-Shalltear) are quite close. Aura specializes in beast-taming and fights with a long, bladed whip.

name: Lupusregina Beta
description:
A member of the "Pleiades Six Stars", the battle maid squad of the Great Tomb of Nazarick. She serves as the role of battle cleric and focuses on healing magic. In terms of combat ability, she possesses the highest physical defense and resistances among the Pleiades, and has balanced stats overall. Being a werewolf, she is weak to silver weapons, but is blessed with resistance against other metals.

Her appearance is that of a brown-skinned beauty with amber-colored eyes, and red hair which she ties in two long braids. She wears a maid uniform with short sleeves and long black gloves, white stockings, and a skirt that has a long slit on its left side. She is usually seen carrying her signature weapon slung across her back, a menacing black and silver scepter which looks like and oversized religious symbol, the Crosier.

Lupusregina boasts a very sociable and outgoing personality, and seems very friendly, even towards humans, a race considered unworthy of respect by other beings of Nazarick. For example, she adds "-chan" to the other maid's names, and often likes teasing [Enri](https://anilist.co/character/128405) with lewd jokes. The Homunculus Maids (the ordinary maids of Nazarick) are convinced she's the friendliest of the Pleiades and even believe that being approached by her can be a sign of good fortune. However, her fellow battle-maid [Yuri Alpha](https://anilist.co/character/128288) has commented that Lupusregina's friendliness is merely a facade, and that in reality she can be as brutal and sadistic as [Solution](https://anilist.co/character/89123).

She likes startling people by using her "Complete Invisibility" spell and appearing behind them unnoticed.

name: Mare Bello Fiore
description: One of the Guardians of the Sixth floor of Nazarick alongside his twin sister [Aura](https://anilist.co/character/89129). He's rather shy and calm in comparison to his sister, although he can fight and be ruthless when necessary. Like his sister, Mare is a Dark Elf. Mare specializes in Druid magic, capable of twisting the earth to his whims.

name: Pandora's Actor
description:
__Height:__ 177 cm 
__Race:__ Doppelgänger
__Affiliation:__ Great Tomb of Nazarick
__Occupation:__ Area Guardian of the Treasury
__Creator:__ [Ainz Ooal Gown](https://anilist.co/character/89103/Momonga) (Momonga)
__Hobby:__ Managing Magic Items
