~!Hitagi has told [Hanekawa](https://anilist.co/character/22055/Hanekawa-Tsubasa) that she suffers from an Electra Complex (when a girl has intense sexual attraction towards her father). Whether this was a joke or a sincere admission has remained unrevealed!~

name: Shinobu Oshino
description:
A girl who lives with [Oshino Meme](https://anilist.co/character/22552/Meme-Oshino) in an abandoned building. She loves donuts from the Mister Donut chain. At the beginning of Hitagi Crab, she was renamed "Shinobu" by Meme, who suggested that the name Shinobu (忍), comprised of a heart (心) under a blade (刃), matched her original persona.

~!She appears to be an eight year old girl, but was originally a beautiful vampire who had lived for more than 500 years. After the events of Koyomi Vamp, she was left in a weakened condition with no powers or traces of her original personality, and therefore had to abandon her "Kiss-Shot Acerola-Orion Heart-Under-Blade" name. Prior to being a vampire, she was a princess of unparalleled beauty. She was referred to as "Princess Beauty" or "Acerola" during this time, the latter being her original name. Eventually, she was turned into a vampire by Deathtopia Virtuoso Suicide-Master to save her from the curse of beauty.!~

name: Koyomi Araragi
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm   

A third year high school student who is close to failing every class except math. He is a laid-back person whose only real friend at school is [Tsubasa Hanekawa](https://anilist.co/character/22055/Tsubasa-Hanekawa). Due to events prior to Kizumonogatari and Bakemonogatari, Koyomi avoided having friends and seemed to have lost faith and trust in people and himself.

~!During spring break, he gave [Kiss-Shot](https://anilist.co/character/23602/Shinobu-Oshino) his blood and became a vampire. Although [Meme Oshino](https://anilist.co/character/22552/Meme-Oshino) helped him become human again, there are a few lingering side effects; he can see in the dark and far distances, and he heals faster than the average human. He is still scared of morning sunlight even though it no longer has any effect on him.!~

name: Ougi Oshino
description:
Ougi appears to be a girl with short black hair, black pupils, and pale white skin. She is a junior of [Koyomi Araragi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi) at Naoetsu Private High School. Ougi often talks to Koyomi about oddities, and helping him remember what he knows. Her catchphrase is, "I don't know anything, Araragi-senpai. It's you who knows."

Ougi is mysterious and can come off as spooky/creepy. She also speaks in a condescending tone towards Koyomi and [Hanekawa](https://anilist.co/character/22055/Tsubasa-Hanekawa). Furthermore, Ougi is capable of pulling off many things, despite what she says about what she knows.

~!As of Hanamonogatari and afterwards, chronologically, Ougi refers to himself as a boy. Others will question Ougi's identity when they first meet him as they knew him as a girl before, but they all shrug it off and seem to doubt themselves as to whether he was a girl before. An example being when [Suruga](https://anilist.co/character/22054/Suruga-Kanbaru) asks about it and was told that he has always been a boy since he was born. [Nadeko](https://anilist.co/character/22050/Nadeko-Sengoku) and Koyomi have also have a similar experience. Suruga herself refers to him as 'Ougi-kun', 'he', 'this guy', and 'the boy'. As of Musubi, Ougi seems to be a girl once again, now remaining in the classroom seen in Ougi Formula.!~ ~!The reasons for this seems to be due to Ougi connecting to Suruga after Koyomi graduates, therefore becoming her other side. Thus, Ougi becomes a boy and seems to pretend its the first time he meets everyone afterwards. After Suruga herself graduates, it's likely that Ougi no longer has anyone to connect to and becomes a girl that guides others in the odd classroom.!~

name: Yotsugi Ononoki
description:
**Occupation:** Oddity Specialist

Yotsugi Ononoki is an expressionless human corpse tsukumogami and the shikigami familiar of [Yozuru Kagenui](https://anilist.co/character/57501/).

Despite appearing almost entirely stoic, she still has hinted at feeling genuine emotion. She's mentioned how she considers [Koyomi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/) her friend on multiple occasions, such as when giving him advice "as a friend" as opposed to as an oddity specialist. She's also expressed how she wouldn't want to have to harm him despite needing to follow orders as a shikigami.

She has an ability called Unlimited Rulebook which allows her finger to shape-shift and cause explosions. She also seems to have a type of super strength, being able to to carry Kagenui and others using only one finger.

She also has an appreciation for muscles.

(Source: Monogatari Fandom)

name: Karen Araragi
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm 
 
Karen, the main character of Karen Bee, is one of [Koyomi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi)'s sisters. She is older than [Tsukihi](https://anilist.co/character/24195/Tsukihi-Araragi) and always doing outdoor activities. Despite being younger, Karen is taller than Koyomi, much to Koyomi's dismay.    

~!In Karen Bee, her hot-headed personality and her habit of acting before thinking lead her to be stung by a bee which leads to being poisoned with a terrible fever that lasted for 3 days. Like [Hitagi](https://anilist.co/character/22037/Hitagi-Senjougahara), she refused any help from anyone which eventually leads to her and Koyomi fighting each other. Later it was revealed that it was set up by [Kaiki](https://anilist.co/character/53641/Deishuu-Kaiki). Karen and Tsukihi are nicknamed Tsuga no Ki Nichū no Fire Sisters (栂の木二中のファイヤーシスターズ, lit. Fire Sisters of Tsuga no Ki 2nd Junior High). It was revealed that the reason she and Tsukihi found boyfriends was so that Koyomi would become jealous. They found boyfriends in Koyomi's image with Karen's boyfriend being shorter than her. She and Tsukihi also thought that Koyomi's girlfriend was [Tsubasa](https://anilist.co/character/22055/Tsubasa-Hanekawa). Koyomi, Karen and Tsukihi's parents were revealed to be police officers. !~

name: Tsukihi Araragi
description:
__Height:__ 156 cm   

Tsukihi, the main character of Tsukihi Phoenix, is one of [Koyomi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi)'s sisters. She's the youngest of Araragi family. Unlike her sister, [Karen](https://anilist.co/character/24194/Karen-Araragi), she is always doing indoor activities. Contrary to her personality, she constantly changes her hair style and is short-tempered to the point that Koyomi describes her as having hysteria.    ~!She is actually the reincarnation of a phoenix and has been since before she was even born. The phoenix entered the baby's body when it was still in the womb and by now both beings' minds have become one. She is immortal and the only thing that end her life is a natural death from old age. It was hinted that [Kaiki](https://anilist.co/character/53641/Deishuu-Kaiki) was the one who sent [Kagenui](https://anilist.co/character/57501/Yozuru-Kagenui) and [Ononoki](https://anilist.co/character/57499/Yotsugi-Ononoki) to go after Tsukihi. Tsukihi and Karen are nicknamed Tsuga no Ki Nichū no Fire Sisters (栂の木二中のファイヤーシスターズ). It was revealed that the reason she and Karen found boyfriends was so that Koyomi would become jealous. They found boyfriends in Koyomi's image with Tsukihi's boyfriend being taller than her. She and Karen also thought that Koyomi's girlfriend was [Tsubasa](https://anilist.co/character/22055/Tsubasa-Hanekawa). Koyomi, Karen and Tsukihi's parents were revealed to be police officers. !~

name: Yozuru Kagenui
description: Yozuru was first introduced in Tsukihi Phoenix. She is an onmyouji and one of [Meme](https://anilist.co/character/22552/Meme-Oshino)'s clubmates at the university. As a rule she imposed on herself, she's not allowed to step on the ground. Between the three kouhai during university she was the only one who graduated. She fights by using her fists and is powerful enough to punch through multiple floors at once.

name: Tadatsuru Teori
description:
Tadatsuru Teori was a dollmaster and another Oddity specialist. Similar to Yozuru Kagenui, he specialized in immortal oddities. In particular, he specialized in dead oddities rather than living ones like Kagenui. As a stray specialist, Tadatsuru was obsessed with oddities and viewed them as beautiful creatures and even sometimes captured them for himself.

Tadatsuru was also involved in Izuko Gaen's group in college that included Meme Oshino, Yozuru Kagenui, and Deishuu Kaiki known as the Occult Research Club. Due to their different interests in oddities, Tadatsuru and Kagenui didn't get along well. After the group created Yotsugi Ononoki and she chose Kagenui over him as her master, they've been rivals ever since.

name: Rimuru Tempest
description:
__Species:__  Human (past life) → Slime
__Kind:__  Reincarnated, Otherworlder

Rimuru Tempest, formerly known as Satoru Mikami, is the main protagonist of Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken. They are the founder and King of the monster country Tempest, situated in the Great Jura Forest, and the partner and sworn friend of Storm Dragon, [Veldora Tempest](https://anilist.co/character/128034/Veldora-Tempest).

name: Milim Nava
description:
__Kind:__ Inhabitant

"Destroyer" Milim Nava is one of the oldest and strongest Demon Lords. She is a Dragonoid. Her nickname, Destroyer, is not just for show. She is a demon lord one should never fight against.

name: Shion
description: "War Lord" Shion is Rimuru’s first servant to be in charge of his care as his personal secretary. She is also the leader of the Yomigaeri and also one of Rimuru's strongest fighters and is coveted by many of the Demon Lords who have met her.

name: Diablo
description: Diablo is the Black Primordial and a loyal servant of [Rimuru Tempest](https://anilist.co/character/123962/Tempest-Rimuru). Before he met Rimuru, he went by the nicknames Black or Noir, the latter which he received from his fellow Primordial kin. After receiving the name Diablo from Rimuru, he evolved to a Demon Peer.

name: Veldora Tempest
description:
__Height:__ 210 cm (human form), 100 m (dragon form)
__Species:__ True Dragon
__Blessing / Divine Protection:__ Storm Dragon's Grace, Demon Lord's Ally
__Disaster Rank:__ Catastrophe

Veldora Tempest is the youngest of the four strongest dragons (True Dragons). He is connected with [Rimuru](https://anilist.co/character/123962) by an agreement and was known to rampage here and there. He was the one to name Rimuru and Rimuru gave him his last name, since they share the same last name, Rimuru could technically be classified as Veldora's adoptive brother.

name: Shuna
description:
Shuna is one of the third group of subordinate Monsters to be named by [Rimuru](https://anilist.co/character/123962), evolving her from an Ogre to a Kijin. She was originally the princess of the Ogre tribe and even though she had the talent for using Magic, she was a sheltered girl, but quickly got along with the Goblinas

Shuna is the daughter of the late ogre chieftain and she is also [Benimaru](https://anilist.co/character/128038)'s younger sister, which is why she's nicknamed "Oni Princess" by Rimuru. Very skilled and knowledgeable in domestic matters, she essentially becomes Rimuru's chief economic advisor together with [Rigurd](https://anilist.co/character/129348).

name: Benimaru
description:
Benimaru is one of the third group of subordinate Monsters to be named by [Rimuru Tempest](https://anilist.co/character/123962/Tempest-Rimuru). Originally an Ogre, he was uncertain of his servitude and intended for it to be temporary, but after being named, he evolved into a Kijin, immediately becoming Rimuru's most powerful subordinate for a time, and decided to serve him permanently. He lives in the Capital city of the Jura Tempest Federation: Rimuru City. Soon after, and became Commander-in-Chief, giving him direct command over Tempest's military forces.

Upon Rimuru's ascension to a True Demon Lord, Benimaru evolved into a Fair Oni and reached the strength of a Disaster-Class Monster.

name: Shizu
description:
Shizu was the companion of the previous Hero and a Japanese Summoned One. She is also known as the "Explosive Monarch", an A ranked Adventurer of the Freedom Association's Headquarters, and the formal homeroom teacher of the Freedom Academy's S Class students.

She was also the mentor of several excellent pupils whom became important figures of society.

name: Souei
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm (Kijin), 190 cm (Ogre)

Souei is an Ogre that was among the third group of subordinates to be named by [Rimuru Tempest](https://anilist.co/character/123962/Tempest-Rimuru). He is Rimuru's faithful shadow and the leader of the Shadow Squad of the Jura Tempest Federation.

name: Ranga
description: "Star Lord" Ranga is a Wind Spirit Wolf and a loyal follower of [Rimuru](https://anilist.co/character/123962/Tempest-Rimuru). The leader of the Star Wolf Clan, and the son of the previous boss of the Direwolves. He is also one of Rimuru's Twelve Patrons who has been given the title of a "Lord".

name: Luminous Valentine
description: "Queen of Nightmares" Luminous Valentine is an elite vampire and one of the Eight-Star Demon Lords. She is also the true ruler of the Holy Kingdom Ruberion.

name: Gobta
description: Gobta is a hobgoblin and is one of Rimuru Tempest's followers. Though he seems to be air-headed he tends to be a hard-worker and dependable when the time calls for it.

name: Daikenja
description:
Unique Skill Great Sage is one of the first two Unique Skills (the other being Predator) that [Rimuru Tempest](https://anilist.co/character/123962/Rimuru-Tempest) had upon being born into his new world. It had evolved from Extra Skill Sage during his death, as he thought since he was approaching his forties as a virgin, he must be something much greater than a mere wizard. 

~!During Rimuru's evolution into Demon Lord this Unique Skill evolved into the Ultimate Skill: Wisdom King Raphael.!~

~!Rimuru gave her a name and she evolved into a manas with the name Ciel!~

name: Ramiris
description: Ramiris is a fairy that resides inside of Tempest's Underground Labyrinth. She is also one of the Eight-Star Demon Lords.

name: Hakurou
description: Hakurou is a Fair Oni and is a loyal follower of [Rimuru Tempest](https://anilist.co/character/123962/Tempest-Rimuru). He was one of the survivors of the Orc attack. He was also the teacher of the Dwarven King.

name: Hinata Sakaguchi
description:
Hinata Sakaguchi is an otherworlder and the leader of the Imperial Guards under the Pope's direct command. Along with [Yuuki](https://anilist.co/character/132755/Kagurazaka-Yuuki) and Class S, she's a former student of [Shizue Izawa](https://anilist.co/character/128037/Shizu).

~!At first she thought monsters should all be exterminated. But after her fight with Rimuru, she was convinced that Rimuru is not evil.!~

name: Guy Crimson
description: Guy Crimson is the oldest of the Demon Lords. He has forever ruled over the frozen continent. Being androgynous, he can become a man or woman at will.

name: Testarossa
description:
Testarossa, the White Primordial, was an Arch Demon that was recruited by [Diablo](https://anilist.co/character/131033/Diablo) along with [Carrera](https://anilist.co/character/131032/Carrera) and [Ultima](https://anilist.co/character/131045/Ultima) to serve [Rimuru](https://anilist.co/character/123962/Tempest-Rimuru). After being named, she evolved into a Demon Peer. She now serves as Tempest's Military Attaché, a representative for the Western States Council.

~!Following the battle with the Empire she awakened as a True Demon Lord.!~

name: Chloe Aubert
description: One of the children who were incompletely summoned. Chloe is a quiet child who loves books.

name: Treyni
description: Treyni is a dryad that resides in the Jura Forest.

name: Albis
description:
Albis, known as the Golden Serpent, is one of Carrion's Beastman subordinates. She is the leader of Yuurazania's Three Beastketeers.

~!She becomes one of Benimaru's wives later on along with Momiji!~

name: Gabiru
description: The captain of the Hiryuu of Tempest, and the former lizardmen raid leader. He suffers from a superiority complex. The root of Gabil's pride and confidence​ is the thought that he is the chosen one.

name: Ultima
description:
Ultima, the Purple Primordial, was one of the Demons recruited by [Diablo](https://anilist.co/character/131033/Diablo) to serve [Rimuru](https://anilist.co/character/123962/Tempest-Rimuru). Originally she was an Arch Demon, but being named by Rimuru evolved her into a Demon Peer. 

~!She later evolves into a True Demon Lord.!~

name: Carrera
description: Carera was one of the demons convened by [Diablo](https://anilist.co/character/131033/Diablo) to serve [Rimuru](https://anilist.co/character/123962/Tempest-Rimuru). She was originally an Arch Demon, but after being named by Rimuru she evolved into a Demon Peer.

name: Frey
description: "Sky Queen" Frey is an ex-Demon Lord and currently a subordinate of [Demon Lord Milim Nava](https://anilist.co/character/128036/Nava-Milim). She often scolds Milim for playing around when she is supposed to be working.

name: Mafuyu Satou
description:
__Height:__ 173 cm

One of the protagonists of the manga-anime. He has a quiet, calm and mysterious personality, he can't express his thoughts and emotions very well, despite being a sincere boy. After all he is a strong person who has endured many bad things in his past. He lives with his mother (who works a lot and is never shown in the manga and anime) and his dog named [Kedama](https://anilist.co/character/230878/Kedama), but he usually calls him Tama (cat name). His best friends in the past were [Hiiragi](https://anilist.co/character/167930/Kashima-Hiiragi), [Yuuki](https://anilist.co/character/153048/Yoshida-Yuki) (his ex-boyfriend) and [Shizusumi](https://anilist.co/character/167938/Yagi-Shizusumi) (they were friends since childhood), his current best friends are [Uenoyama](https://anilist.co/character/136843/Uenoyama-Ritsuka) (his current boyfriend), [Kaji](https://anilist.co/character/136842/Kaji-Akihiko) and [Haruki](https://anilist.co/character/136845/Nakayama-Haruki), although he still maintains some contact with Hiiragi.

name: Ritsuka Uenoyama
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5′8")

Ritsuka Uenoyama is one of the main protagonists of the Given Series. He is a high school student and has a guitar prowess despite being just a high schooler. He is a considerate and compassionate guy and is also a genuine younger brother of his sister [Yayoi](https://anilist.co/character/167937/Uenoyama-Yayoi). Uenoyama shows little consideration for small talk and can be quick to be irate. He can be smug when showing his high test scores, and says he can understand theory based subjects. Uenoyama can be very attentive to the feelings of others, particularly [Mafuyu](https://anilist.co/character/136844/Satou-Mafuyu).

name: Haruki Nakayama
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm

Haruki Nakayama is a film major graduate student, and the bassist in the band Given. He is the oldest in the group and the leader of the band. Haruki “prefers lighter music (compared to other guys) and pop. Drawn to Japanese rock and light, slow tempo dance.”  He is “extremely good natured and kind” and is easily flustered. In the manga it is revealed that Haruki’s “stand” is a kind elderly man. He lives on his own in an apartment and is friends with [Ritsuka Uenoyama](https://anilist.co/character/136843/Uenoyama-Ritsuka), [Mafuyu Satou](https://anilist.co/character/136844/Satou-Mafuyu), and [Koji Yatake](https://anilist.co/character/174907/Yatake-Koji). 

~!In season one of the anime it is clear he has romantic feelings towards his band-mate [Akihiko](https://anilist.co/character/136842/Kaji-Akihiko), and as of now in the manga is the boyfriend of Akihiko.!~

name: Akihiko Kaji
description:
__Height:__ 184 cm

Akihiko Kaji is a college student in Given. Also the drummer in Ritsuka's band, he can play not only the drums but also violin, guitar, and bass.

name: Ugetsu Murata
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm

He is a world-renowned violinist. He is [Akihiko](https://anilist.co/character/136842/Kaji-Akihiko)'s room and classmate, and on-again-off-again boyfriend as well as a University student. He has been classmates with Akihiko since their high school days. Though he is Akihiko's roommate, he sometimes goes abroad and sometimes he stays in Japan.

Ugetsu is very intelligent and a prodigy violinist. He is generally a cheerful and friendly person, he is warm and affectionate towards others, such as welcoming Akihiko home. He is very sharp about other people‘s feelings.

Ugetsu is very emotional and capable of overwhelming feelings but he doesn’t know how to express them properly except through his music. When Ugetsu is under pressure he is easily irascible and unstable; in fact he shows to be moody, and violent as well, hitting Akihiko on the face and breaking or throwing things around him.

name: Yuki Yoshida
description:
He is a childhood friend of [Mafuyu](https://anilist.co/character/136844/Satou-Mafuyu).

~!He is Mafuyu's ex-boyfriend, who died one year from an apparent suicide prior to the events of the series. He played guitar in a band with [Hiiragi](https://anilist.co/character/167930/Hiiragi-Kashima) and [Yagi](https://anilist.co/character/167938/Shizusumi-Yagi).!~

name: Hiiragi Kashima
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5'9")

Hiiragi Kashima is a high school student who, along with Mafuyu, seems to know something about Mafuyu’s guitar. He is also Mafuyu's former classmate. He formerly played bass in a band with Yuki and Shizusumi.

name: Shizusumi Yagi
description:
__Age:__ 16 (start to chapter 28)
17 (from chapter 28)
__Height:__ 180cm

Shizusumi Yagi is Mafuyu's former classmate. He formerly played drums in a band with Yuki and Hiiragi who he is childhood friends with.

name: Koji Yatake
description:
He's older than Haruki, but entered university the same time as he did after spending a year retaking his entrance exam.

Does film editing in a small company. He's a bassist and a vocalist, and is close friends with Haruki. Mixing both his interest and the chance to make money, he makes music videos for bands he's chummy with.

name: Shougo Itaya
description:
__Height:__ 176cm

He is one of the best friends of Uenoyama in the school. He is from the soccer club, but he also plays basket with his friends (including Ue), he likes all balls games and loves music.

name: Yayoi Uenoyama
description:
__Height:__ 163cm

Yayoi Uenoyama is Ritsuka's older sister who she lives with. She has an unrequited crush on his bandmate, Akihiko Kaji.

~!She is Take-chan's girlfriend.!~

name: Ryou Ueki
description:
Ryou Ueki is Ritsuka's classmate. Ryou enjoys playing basketball and is close friends with Shogo.
Not as talkative compared to other students, Ryou enjoys playing basketball and is friendly to students from other classes such as Mafuyu.

name: Waka Kurihara
description: She has a very friendly personality towards her fellow classmates and takes part in their discussions on matters including the guys they know. She's friends with Kasai and is in the same class as her and Uenoyama.

name: Ayano Kasai
description: She is very honest and truthful about her feelings towards others, but get's jealous over other people's relationships. She's Uenoyama's classmate.

name: Jin-U Seong
description:
__Class:__ Mage
__Relatives:__ [Park Kyung-Hye](https://anilist.co/character/209396/KyungHye-Park) (Mother), [Seong Jin-Ah](https://anilist.co/character/138791/JinAh-Sung) (Sister), ~![Seong Il-Hwan](https://anilist.co/character/138790/IlHwan-Sung) (Father), [Cha Hae-In](https://anilist.co/character/138789/HaeIn-Cha) (Wife), [Seong Su-Ho](https://anilist.co/character/306654/Suho-Sung) (Son)!~ 
~!__Guild:__ Ahjin Guild (Guild Master)
__Affiliation:__ Korean Hunters Association (helper), White Tiger Guild (helper), Hunters Guild (helper), Knights Guild (helper), Ahjin Guild (Guild Master)!~

Seong Jin-U is known as an infamously weak E-Rank Hunter. He is a humble and benevolent individual who cares deeply for his family and has an ardent desire to become stronger. As a result, he shares a close relationship with his sister and his mother, and rarely wastes an opportunity to refine his skills and gain more power.

~!He becomes an S-Rank hunter after being given a chance to become stronger by the System.!~

name: Hae-In Cha
description:
__Guild:__ Hunters Guild
__Class:__ Sword Fighter
__Affiliations:__ Jeju Island Raid Party, [Song Chi-Yul](https://anilist.co/character/136073/ChiYul--Song)’s Dojo (Disciple)

Cha Hae-In is the Vice-Guild Master of the Hunters Guild. She is an S rank hunter and the 9th ranked hunter in South Korea. She possesses the unique ability of mana smell and hates the smell of hunters except for [Sung Jin-Woo](https://anilist.co/character/129928/JinWoo-Sung).

name: Igris
description:
Igris is one of the first Shadows that [Sung Jin-Woo](https://anilist.co/character/129928/Seong-Jin-U) acquired. He was initially protecting an empty throne in an Instant Dungeon where Jin-Woo was doing his Job Quest in the Job Change Quest Dungeon.

After two failed attempts of Shadow Extraction, Sung Jin-Woo convinced him to protect him instead of protecting an Empty throne, obtaining him as a Knight Grade Shadow.

name: Beru
description:
Born from the Ant Queen on Jeju Island, The Ant King becomes the main threat during the Fourth Jeju Island Raid.

~!Single-handedly responsible for the deaths of over 8 of the 16 S-Rank Hunters during the raid.!~ 

~!After being killed by [Sung Jin-U](https://anilist.co/character/129928/Seong-Jin-U), the Ant King was revived as one of his shadow soldiers, and was given him the new name of Beru.!~

name: Esil Radiru
description: Esil Radiru, or Elisa Radiru, is a daughter of the Radiru chief and an Aristocratic Demon found at the S-Rank Demon's Castle Instant Dungeon.

name: Ju-Hui Lee
description: She is a healer with rank B.

name: Jin-A Seong
description: [Jin-U](https://anilist.co/character/129928)'s younger sister.

name: Geon-Hui Go
description: Go Gun-Hee (고건희) is a South Korean S-Rank Hunter and the Chairman of the Korean Hunters Association.

name: Jin-Ho Yu
description:
__Class:__ Tanker
__Guild:__ ~!Ahjin Guild (Vice-Guild Master)!~

Yoo Jin-Ho is a D rank hunter and is [Jin-U Seong](https://anilist.co/character/129928/JinWoo-Sung)'s faithful assistant and combat partner.

name: Yun-Ho Baek
description: He is a S rank hunter and master of the White Tiger guild.

name: Jin-Cheol U
description: An A rank hunter that works for Hunter's association of Korea.

name: Jong-In Choi
description: Choi Jong-In is one of the 10 S-Rank Hunters of South Korea. He is also the Guild Master of the Hunters Guild.

name: Il-Hwan Seong
description: Il-Hwan is a muscular middle-aged man with black eyes, shaggy black hair, and slight facial hair. When using his powers or agitated, his eyes glows bright yellow.

name: Iron
description: A shadow Sung Jin-Woo gained after entering the Red Gate. ~!Before being reawakened as a Shadow he was Chul Kim (김철), an A-Rank Hunter of the White Tiger Guild.!~

name: Sin Sang
description: Statue of God is the hidden boss of the Double Dungeon. It is first introduced during the D-Rank Dungeon Arc as Jin-Woo and other hunters entered the Cartenon Temple unaware of the dangers that were present inside.

name: Hee-Jin Park
description: Park Hee-Jin (박희진) is a member of White Tiger Guild that Sung Jin-Woo helped when they got stuck inside the Red Gate.

name: Song-I Han
description: Han Song-I is an E-Rank hunter who quit school after gaining money through the Yoo Jin-Ho and Sung Jin-Woo motley group of party. She is friends with Sung Jin-Ah. She first appeared when Jin-Ah visited Jin-Woo in the hospital but she didn't know him then.

name: Thomas Andre
description: Thomas Andre (트마스 아드레) is one of only 5 National Level Hunters that exist and is considered to be the strongest Tank on Earth. He is also the Guild Master of the Scavenger Guild.

name: Tusk
description:
A shadow Sung Jin-Woo gained after entering the Hunters Guild Gate.

~!Tusk is a shadow of Kargalgan, originally a High Orc Shaman defeated by Jinwoo Sung during the Hunters Guild Gate Arc. After being resurrected, Tusk becomes one of Jinwoo's most potent magic users, known for his devastating area-of-effect spells and high intelligence. Even as a Shadow, Tusk kept his powerful abilities and spells, making him just as capable and even stronger than when he was alive.!~

name: Ashborn
description: Ashborn is the former Shadow Monarch. He was extremely powerful, being the Greatest Fragment of Brilliant Light. In other words, the Strongest Ruler and equalling the power of the Monarch of Destruction.

name: Tank
description: Shadow of an ice bear that Jinwoo encountered during the Red Gate Incident.

name: Kaisel
description:
Kaisel is a shadow Sung Jin-Woo obtained in the Demon Castle. Kaisel is the shadow of Kaisellin, a Drake/Wyvern that Demon King Baran used as a mount.

Kaisel used to be a mount that the Demon King Baran rode in battle. After Sung Jin-Woo's fight, he looks around and found that Iron already killed Kaisellin, dragging his corpse towards Sung Jin-Woo. After he was extracted, his grade was Knight, which concludes he was at least an A-Rank.

name: Su-Ho Seong
description:
Sung Suho displays little interest in things that bore him and don't get his blood pumping, especially his education. He also likes to get physical against any bullies who are stupid enough to pick on him and has an intense desire to surpass his father, who always easily defeats him in their sparring matches. 

~!Sung Suho is the son of [Jin-U Seong](https://anilist.co/character/129928/JinWoo-Sung) and [Hae-In Cha](https://anilist.co/character/138789/HaeIn-Cha).!~

name: Bellion
description:
__Rank__: Grand-Marshal Grade
__Abilities__: Immense Physical Prowess, Conversation, Regeneration

Bellion is a servant of Ashborn and the strongest shadow in existence. He is a huge humanoid shadow with two pairs of black wings on his back, jagged black armor, blank white eyes, and glowing light purple skin. He also carries a massive blade that looks like a centipede, which he wields both like a whip and a sword.

name: Chi-Yul Song
description:
__Magic Type:__ Fire

Korean C-Rank Hunter and kumdo teacher. He is also one of Jinwoo's old friends, having known him since he was a E-Rank Hunter.

name: Kiyotaka Ayanokouji
description:
__Height:__ 176 cm (5'9")

Ayanokouji is an inconspicuous and unobtrusive student. He is shown to be extremely intelligent and possesses a profound insight to study the emotions of people around him. Almost everything about his life prior to the entrance exams is unknown. He is shown to be extremely calculating and possessing superhuman intellect, perception, and strength. He's skilled at fighting and is able to easily manipulate the people around him. He is quite fond of his friends and protects those that he can without standing out. He has little regard for others' feelings and will coldly let them suffer to succeed, occasionally even his friends.

name: Suzune Horikita
description:
__Height:__ 156 cm (5'1")

A beautiful girl who sits next to [Ayanokouji](https://anilist.co/character/123212/Ayanokouji-Kiyotaka). She is the opposite of Ayanokouji when it comes to friendship; she disregards it and thinks of making friends unnecessary, thus she does not communicate much with her classmates. She is not convinced that she was placed in the D class, therefore she aims to get promoted to the A class.

name: Kei Karuizawa
description:
__Height:__ 154 cm (5'0")

She is a girl with a bad attitude who is located at the top of the D class hierarchy. She fights with [Kushida](https://anilist.co/character/123214/Kushida-Kikyou) for their class' top 2 places. Even though she gives off the impression of someone who is careless, arrogant, and messy, Kei's true self is very logical and astute with a sharp mind. She has remarkable ability to read the environment and the people around her, and makes the correct decision often.

name: Honami Ichinose
description:
__Height:__ 159 cm (5'2")

If there was one sentence to describe Honami, it would be that she is genuinely kind-hearted, benevolent, and a pacifist to the core who is against using underhanded means and violence. 

One of her main traits is her unselfish and supportive personality, combined with her excellent social skills and her being naturally people-oriented. Honami is also a charismatic and energetic person, and extends her sweet and benign character even to those of the lower classes, unlike many other upper-class students.

name: Arisu Sakayanagi
description:
__Height:__ 150 cm (4'11")

Arisu Sakayanagi is one of the class representatives of class 1-A along with [Kohei Katsuragi](https://anilist.co/character/207026). She suffers from congenital heart disease which limits her physical ability. 

She appears to possess a "go with the flow" attitude as she accepts most situations with no protest though she voices her dislike of boring situations after Katsuragi noted of the class scores. Unlike Kohei Katsuragi, who has a conservative stance, Arisu possesses an innovative attitude. Together, the pair effectively lead class A through the school years.

She enjoys situations she finds interesting as shown when she smiled at [Kakeru Ryuen](https://anilist.co/character/159627)'s declaration to rule the school or when she listened to the speech of [Suzune Horikita](https://anilist.co/character/123213) and found it amusing. In the light novels, Arisu enjoys toying with people as seen when she cryptically hinted to [Kiyotaka Ayanokoji](https://anilist.co/character/123212) of knowing him while he had voiced he never saw her before. Later on, while being together with [Honami Ichinose](https://anilist.co/character/123216), she also had the chance to show her confidence and complacency after [Teruhiko Yukimura](https://anilist.co/character/173450) of Ayanokoji Group boldly claimed that D-Class has the plan to overtake A-Class soon.

Additionally, although she has an easygoing personality, it was shown in the later part of the series that she's easily provoked when being described based on her petite appearance (e.g. "Little Girl") as she believes that it doesn't give her justice due to her domineering quality.

name: Airi Sakura
description:
__Height:__ 153 cm (5'0")

A girl who is into photography. She hates standing out and likes to take modeling pictures.

name: Kakeru Ryuuen
description:
__Height:__ 173 cm (5'8")

Kakeru Ryuuen is the class representative of class 1-C and is known for being an infamous delinquent. He does not lead his class by trust, but rather by fear. He has a group of henchmen who do his dirty work, which contributes to his fearsome reputation.

name: Ichika Amasawa
description:
Ichika Amasawa is one of the first-year students of Advanced Nurturing High School. She is a student of Class 1-A.

~!She is considered to be the second White Room student to have been introduced into the story and enrolled in Advanced Nurturing High School.!~

name: Sae Chabashira
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm

The homeroom teacher of the protagonist's class (D). She is originally indifferent to her class, doing almost nothing to help them in the battle between classes, and remains unmotivated for the most part.

name: Hiyori Shiina
description:
Hiyori Shiina is one of the students of Class 1-C who is a loner.

She's a quiet girl, though sometimes she is seen occasionally smiling. She always carries books with her in her bag in case she meets someone who shares the same interest in literature as her. Since nobody in class 1-C is into literature, she doesn't have anyone to talk to. She always speaks politely. She dislikes how the classes are competing with each other, wanting everyone to be friends.

~! She encounters Kiyotaka in the library, and they find themselves having the same taste in books. As she always wanted a friend who has similar interests as her, their friendship gradually blossoms and she refers to him as her "reading buddy". She slowly starts developing romantic feelings for Kiyotaka.!~

name: Kikyou Kushida
description:
__Height:__ 155 cm

She boasts tremendous popularity among men and women as the D class' idol. She aims to be friends with everyone not just in D class. She wants to get along well with her classmate, [Horikita](https://anilist.co/character/123213/Horikita-Suzune).

name: Rokusuke Kouenji
description:
Rokusuke Kouenji is one of the students of class 1-D. He came from a well-known family of scholars. However, he ended up in D-Class for his egotistical behavior.

~!In Year 1, Volume 11, he watches a scuffle between [Hirata](https://anilist.co/character/123218/Hirata-Yousuke) and [Mii-Chan](https://anilist.co/character/136233/Wang-MeiYu), which ended with Hirata pushing a desperate Mii-Chan, who was trying to help him, on the ground. Kouenji then intervenes and states his annoyance at Hirata "for treating a girl wrong" referring him as "like a fly, very irritating". His friendship with Mii-Chan is then showed to progress in Year 2, Volume 5, when they are seen walking together often, and Mii-chan referring to him as "someone easy to talk to" when asked about their relationship by [Satou](https://anilist.co/character/163519/Satou-Maya) and [Matsushita](https://anilist.co/character/191401/Matsushita-Chiaki).!~

~!During the Second Year Uninhabited Island Special Exam, he strikes an agreement with [Suzune Horikita](https://anilist.co/character/123213/Horikita-Suzune), in which he would try for a first-place finish and Suzune would reward him with complete protection from class vote expulsion until graduation and exempt him from being forced to co-operate with the rest of the class, which he wins.!~

name: Tsubasa Nanase
description:
A second-year student in class D. A bright, positive, and excellent student, she has been given details about [Ayanokoji](https://anilist.co/character/123212/Ayanokouji-Kiyotaka) by [Tsukishiro](https://anilist.co/character/288362/Tsukishiro-Tokinari), and has information about the White Room and other things that only a select few know.

~!At the end of Y2V2, it is revealed that she has been working under Tsukishiro's orders to get Ayanokouji Kiyotaka expelled.!~

name: Fuuka Kiryuuin
description: Kiryuuin Fuuka is a student in Class 3-B. She is the only student in Advanced Nurturing High School to have an A+ in both Academic and Physical Abilities, shown in the OAA app. She was described by Kiriyama as a 'Female Kouenji'.

name: Maya Satou
description:
She is a student of class 1-D. 

~!In Volume 7.5, Maya asks for [Kei Karuizawa](https://anilist.co/character/141122/Karuizawa-Kei)'s help to plan her "date" with [Kiyotaka Ayanokouji](https://anilist.co/character/123212/Ayanokouji-Kiyotaka). Kei was surprised and suggested other boys to her, but she refused, and said that she only liked Kiyotaka. She told her plan to Kei and made some changes according to her suggestions. She then later asked Kei if they could make it a "double-date", by including her and [Yousuke Hirata](https://anilist.co/character/123218/Hirata-Yousuke) in the plan. Eventually, Kei agreed and decided to schedule the double date on December 25.

She confessed to Kiyotaka after the double date during Christmas, but was rejected and ran away crying. They promised each other that they will hang out again in the future and wants to see each other again but Maya couldn’t hold her feelings and excused herself first as she didn’t want him to see her in a pathetic state. She was hinted to have cried an innumerable amount of times behind closed doors after being rejected as the next time we saw her, she was able to frankly tell her friends she was rejected without being choked up. Her friends summarised that this could only had happened if she had come to terms with the rejection showing an immense amount of willpower to move on. That said, she still harbours feelings for Kiyotaka and has admitted that she finds him way cooler and hotter than Hirata not holding against Kei for liking the same person. She still feels conflicted that her best friend was in a relationship with her crush but decided to uphold their secret and support them in whatever way she can.!~

~!Maya has below average academic abilities as was apparent during the Paper Shuffle special exam. Her physical abilities are of the lower echelon as well. However, she is one of more popular girls in her class. Although not to the tier of Kei, many observers were astonished to see someone like her talk to and publicly flirt with the 'uninteresting' Kiyotaka. She is also out-going and not afraid to take risks such as confessing to Kiyotaka on their first date.!~

name: Haruka Hasebe
description:
Haruka is a pretty normal person, but she is not very open to other people as shown when she didn't participate in the class's swimming session where she tends to prefer keeping to herself and not bothering people, simply to avoid trouble. She is considered to have good looks and is often viewed lustfully by boys, thus wanting to seclude herself. She is mostly seen wearing the school's uniform, with the difference that she has the upper button of her shirt undone and her tie relatively loosened. She prefers giving people nicknames the moment she meets them, which is said by Kushida to be a method for her "to appear closer to the people she isn't close to". 

~! In Year 2, Volume 5, Haruka is told off by Kushida when she tries to help the latter. She is then seen aggressively opposing the motion by Ayanokoji to expel Airi Sakura, being her closest friend, to no avail. She is one of the 4 remaining members and the sole remaining girl of the Ayanokoji Group.!~

name: Mio Ibuki
description: Mio Ibuki is a student of class 1-C. Not only does she possess excellent academic qualities, but her physical ability is also not to be underestimated. She is skilled in combat, having the knowledge of several martial skills that can rival those of many martial artists.

name: Yousuke Hirata
description:
__Height:__ 174 cm (5'8")

The social leader of the D class. He has excellent academic and athletic ability, and is considered extremely handsome by his classmates, he is shown to be extremely compassionate and puts others before himself, considering everybody equal. He is considered a perfect male student and his placement in the D-class is originally considered a mystery.

name: Chiaki Matsushita
description:
Matsushita is one of the students of class 2-D. She has a quiet older sister type of personality. She is generally kind to all the boys and girls alike, but she does not actively go out to make friends.

~!Chiaki had believed from early on in the first year that Class D had no hopes of ever reaching Class A and thus resigned herself to a carefree school life, never putting in any real effort into her academics. She considers herself to be a major underachiever, believing that she could easily score in the top 10% of her class if she truly tried to, but believed it to be pointless as long as she was in Class D. Later on in the light novels, she starts seeing improvements in the class and becomes willing to start contributing to the class. She is also known to be skilled at mental arithmetic and can calculate quickly. She even held her own against Kouhei Katsuragi from Class A in the Mental Arithmetic event in the Event Selection Exam.!~

~!Later, in her monologue, she states that she had started to pay close attention to Kiyotaka after the end of year special exam, but she was not romantically interested in him. According to her, she was probably among the top 10% of students in their year, but had not revealed her abilities since she did not want people to be jealous of her. She had thought that even if she tried her best, the chance of Class-D being able to rank up the classes was minimal. However, after closely observing Kiyotaka, she had arrived at the conclusion that Class-D might be able to reach the higher classes if both she and Kiyotaka tried and used their complete abilities. By observing Kei's behavior in class, she was able to deduce that she was attracted to Kiyotaka, and the only logical solution to this change of liking from Hirata to Kiyotaka would be that Kiyotaka was actually very gifted.!~

name: Ken Sudou
description:
__Height:__ 183 cm (6'0")

Ken is apart of Class 1-D and is apart of the Basketball Club. Due to his poor academic ability, he is referred to as one of the 3 Idiots of D-Class. Regardless of this, his athletic ability is without a doubt one of the best among the school. He has a crush on Suzune after receiving help from her. Under the constant supervision of Suzune, he gradually matures and begins to improve academically rising out of the bottom ladder of class and earning her trust.

name: Albert Yamada
description: Albert Yamada is one of the students of Class 1-C.

name: Takuya Yagami
description:
Takuya Yagami (八神拓也, Yagami Takuya) is one of the first-year students of Advanced Nurturing High School. He is a student of Class 1-B.

Volume 4.5
~!He is considered to be the third White Room student to have been introduced into the story and enrolled in Advanced Nurturing High School.!~

name: Ai Morishita
description: She uses polite language, but calls others by their first names and behaves in a quirky way, so she is treated as a unique individual. She is an excellent student with excellent academic and physical abilities, and is good at observation and analysis. She will not take action on her own unless she is interested, but she is intrigued by Ayanokoji's high level of ability.

name: Chie Hoshinomiya
description: Chie Hoshinomiya is the homeroom teacher of class 1-B. She has a cheerful, flirty personality and is referred to as "never having grown from her high school days" by Ayanokoji. She shows glimpses of a more serious side of hers upon matters relating to reaching Class-A. She was a classmate of her colleague Sae Chabashira during their time in the Advanced Nurturing High School.

name: Mei-Yu Wang
description: Mei-Yu is of Chinese descent and is shown to be one of the academically gifted students. She has a visible crush on Hirata Yosuke.

name: Alain Saverio
description:
**Nationality**: American 

A young boy living in a deeply religious and isolated Christian household during the '90s. Often feels betrayed but inevitably chained to God, whom he zealously prays to, and has deep-rooted self-hatred issues. Shy and naive, Alain desires a special connection and new experience, and as he escapes his parents and his sin, he finds them with [Hayden](https://anilist.co/character/261634)—another alike and caring soul.

name: Hayden Stewart
description:
**Nationality**: American 

A free-spirited youth from a troubled family during the '90s. Completely defeated by his inability to protect his abused mother, and desires to be safe harbor for [Alain](https://anilist.co/character/261633), he experiments with drugs and sells sex to fund his travel.  Hayden travels around the country and leaves just as quick in hope of escaping his traumatic past and sin.

name: Maria
description:
**Nationality:** American 

A prostitute who lost her precious children by her own mistake. She grants Alan strength to forgive and absolves him off his sin after an accidental meeting near Hotel Monte Vista.

name: Emilia
description:
**Height:** 164 cm (5'5")

Emilia is a half-elf girl who is one of the candidates to become the next ruler in the royal election. [Subaru](https://anilist.co/character/88573/Natsuki-Subaru) first meets her when her insignia is stolen by [Felt](https://anilist.co/character/88574/Felt) as she needs to possess it to be eligible to participate in the election. She introduces herself as Satella when she and Subaru met during the first timeline before introducing herself by her real name when she got her insignia back.

Emilia is good natured and likes to take care of others, though she herself refuses to admit it, instead thinking of it as her own selfishness. She is indifferent to her own appearance, leaving [Puck](https://anilist.co/character/90187/Puck) to take care of her clothes and hair. Because her appearance is similar to the [Witch of Envy](https://anilist.co/character/127242/Satella), she has received unfair discrimination from others. She sometimes acts like a child and is unacquainted with the world as she used to live in the woods with other Elves, though despite this she still works hard to become a ruler.

name: Rem
description:
__Height:__ 154 cm (5'1")

Rem is one of the twin maids working for [Roswaal L Mathers](https://anilist.co/character/90182/Mathers-L-Roswaal). She has medium length sky blue hair that covers her right eye, large light blue eyes, and young features. She also has hair clips towards left side of her hair, flower-shaped ribbon on the same side of her hair, and a maid hairband. She looks nearly identical to her sister [Ram](https://anilist.co/character/88576) apart from her hair, eyes, and ribbon coloring. She usually wears a maid uniform, and since her chest is slightly larger than her sister's, she secretly changes the measurements to hide it. Rem tends to speak in a superficially polite manner and sometimes acts without thinking. She holds both respect to the point of worship and guilt toward her sister for an incident in the past. Because of her respect and guilt toward her sister, she used to think of herself as inferior.

name: Subaru Natsuki
description:
__Height:__ 173 cm (5'8")

On the way home from the convenience store, he suddenly finds himself transported into another world. He has the ability that he calls "Return by Death" to go back in time when he dies. Despite being a hikikomori and gamer in his real world, Subaru does a bit of workout and seems to know basic hand-to-hand combat, making him not completely weak.

While Subaru tends to not read the situation, he is loyal to those he holds dear, willing to help them, even if that means taking the thorny path. He has his resolve confirmed through the many situations and circumstances he faces in the fantasy world, originally having been one to always take the "easy" route. As a hikikomori, he is hopeful of the possibilities that being sucked into a new realm brings, but later realizes the realities of the predicament he is in. Ultimately, he resolves himself to be faithful and protective of the ones that he cares most about.

name: Echidna
description: Echidna is one of the Witches of Sin, being the Witch of Greed. She has a strong thirst for knowledge along with a curiosity for the unknown, which defines her behavior. Echidna is described as black hearted, being unable to empathize with others and their feelings due to a lack of understanding. She will do anything to gain knowledge, be it deceit or employed sophistry.

name: Beatrice
description:
__Height:__ 140 cm (4'7")
__Age:__ ~!400+ (Actual)!~

The caretaker of the library in [Roswaal](https://anilist.co/character/90182)'s mansion. 

She has a distinct way of speaking, adding "I suppose" and "in fact" at the end of some of her sentences.

~!Around 400 years ago, Beatrice was created by [Echidna](https://anilist.co/character/129330). She helped her with her experiments, such as the Sanctuary Barrier, though she wasn't told everything as she didn't know that [Ryuuzu Meyer](https://anilist.co/character/174072) would be sealed in a crystal. Sometime later, Echidna ordered her to stand guard over the library while she waited for "that person," an order which she diligently followed.!~

~!After numerous and painful attempts to convince her to leave the library [Subaru](https://anilist.co/character/88573) succeeded, and Beatrice became his contract spirit.!~

name: Ram
description:
__Height:__ 154 cm (5’1”)

Ram is one of the twin maids working for [Roswaal L Mathers](https://anilist.co/character/90182). She has medium length light pink hair that covers her left eye, large darkish pink eyes, and young features. She also has hair clips towards right side of her hair, flower-shaped ribbon on the same side of her hair, and a maid hairband. She looks nearly identical to her sister [Rem](https://anilist.co/character/88575/Rem) apart from her hair, eyes, and ribbon coloring. Ram is seemingly self-centered and does things at her own pace, however in actuality she maintains a distance from people to ascertain them. She believes that Roswaal is the greatest and no one else is as precious except for her sister Rem. She is slightly more outgoing in comparison to the generally taciturn Rem, who generally allows Ram to take the lead in their sisterly bond.

name: Otto Suwen
description:
Otto Suwen is a merchant appearing in  Re:Zero. His remarkable misfortune always takes him to dangerous situations, from which he escapes thanks to his wit.
Otto has gray hair that is mentioned to be as long as a gal game protagonist. He is said to be somewhat handsome if he has a serious expression. However, he is usually either retorting, shouting, or panicking, ruining his looks. He has a medium build, but has trained himself since he used to work as a merchant.

name: Reinhard van Astrea
description:
__Height__: 184 cm (6'0")

Reinhard van Astrea is the current Sword Saint and a member of the Royal Guard, currently acting as [Felt's](https://anilist.co/character/88574/Felt) knight. 

As the Sword Saint and the Knight of the Royal Guard, Reinhard embodies chivalry and elegance, treating everyone with exceptional respect. He is fair, brave, and always acts in the name of justice, whether on duty or simply strolling through the Royal Capital.

As a knight, Reinhard only uses his sword when necessary, since, in addition to being a rule, his iron-clad rule is to not inflict pain to others if not absolutely necessary, be it a normal thug or a member of the Witch Cult.

name: Felix Argyle
description: Felix Argyle commonly known as Ferris, is [Crusch Karsten](https://anilist.co/character/90185)'s knight. He is a beast human (demi-human).

name: Garfiel Tinsel
description:
Garfiel Tinsel is the former guardian of the Sanctuary and a member of the Emilia Camp. Introduced during Arc 4, he became one of the main supporting characters of the season. He's a half-beast human and [Frederica Baumann's](https://anilist.co/character/143378/Baumann-Frederica) half-brother. He can transform himself in a giant golden tiger that can deal powerful attacks but with a cost of losing his reason, so he uses this ability when he's pushed to the limit.

~!Garfiel and Frederica lived together until she left when he was around 4 years old and he hadn't seen her since until their reunion 10 years later during the Sanctuary incident. After seeing his mother's "death" during the trial at a young age, he began to fear the outside world, causing him to try and protect the Sanctuary.!~

name: Crusch Karsten
description:
Crusch Karsten is the Matriarch of House Karsten and a candidate to become the 42nd King of Lugnica.

While normally calm and serious, Crusch is honest, sincere, right, being a type of person who is destined to stand above others, though she has talent and has worked hard to reach where she is now. She is already the head of her family, finishing her work better than her father. She prefers to act herself and has the pride of a warrior. Crusch is also gentle, often believing the false knowledge jokingly told to her by [Ferris](https://anilist.co/character/90184), and sometimes displays an airheaded side. Like her mother Helena Karsten, she is shown to be ruthless and reckless.

name: Puck
description:
__Height:__ 7 cm

Puck is an Artificial Spirit that [Emilia](https://anilist.co/character/88572/Emilia) was formerly contracted with. He is the current Great Spirit of Fire.

~!He is currently known as the Beast of The End.!~

~!Around 400 years ago, Puck was created by Echidna, though he had apparently left her by the time she moved into the Sanctuary. Seven years before the start of the election, Puck unfroze Emilia and began to act as her friend and mentor, and later on started to live at Roswaal's mansion where he was reunited with Beatrice.!~

Puck can be described as cute or adorable, thus his skin being pink around his cheeks. His fur is mostly grey with silver in certain spots (i.e. tip of the tail). His eyebrows are pretty small and rhombus-shaped. He also has a gold earring on his left ear. Sometimes, he carries a purple bag.

Puck is generally a nice spirit. He is very happy and stays at Emilia's side to protect her, affectionately calling her "Lia". He occasionally goofs around and gets along especially well with [Beatrice](https://anilist.co/character/90181/Beatrice). 

~!However, Puck's demeanor greatly changes in loops where Emilia dies, showing a complete disregard for anyone except her, and was even willing to destroy the world because of the condition in their contract.!~

name: Wilhelm van Astrea
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm (5'10")

Wilhelm van Astrea né Trias, is a member of the Crusch Camp and was [Theresia van Astrea](https://anilist.co/character/124116/van-Astrea-Theresia)'s husband.

Wilhelm is a refined man with a highly gentle and humble demeanor. However unearth that even temperament belied a fierce warrior who often is the first to help when something happens. However this wasn't always the case as in youth, Wilhelm was very opposite of who he was in his later years. Brash, afoot, short tempered, lonely and often cold with others. He was a troubled individual who devoted himself wholly to the sword and cared for little else. Even so, he knew how to analyze a situation, always finding a way out. Nonetheless, Theresia greatly influenced his personality, becoming increasingly sociable and protective, achieving more results during the Demi-human War. It was through her most of all that he would become the person he is today.

name: Julius Euclius
description:
__Height:__ 179 cm (5'10")

Julius Euclius is [Anastasia Hoshin's](https://anilist.co/character/90177/Hoshin-Anastasi) knight and a member of the Royal Guard. Julius lived with his family at the Euclius House. After his father, Klein Euclius died, he started to live with his uncle Alviero and he started to take care of Julius and became his adoptive father.

As a member of Lugnica's nobility, Julius acts in a proper fashion, always having an air of nobility and conviction. He is also considerate and doesn't forget to show care toward others. He also shows a strict side, giving out accurate assessments of others whether they're good or bad, which is a result of his upbringing as an elite, and in actuality, he believes that he and others can do better than they currently are.

Julius doesn't like those who forget their place, leading him to have bad relations with [Subaru](https://anilist.co/character/88573/Natsuki-Subaru) for a while. While both have apologized to each other after the battle with the Hakugei, Subaru told him he still hated him. Julius said he didn't intend to be friends. They both became very intimate very quickly during the planning and attacking the Witch Cult. In the end, Julius directly considered Subaru as his friend.

name: Roswaal Mathers
description:
~!__Mental age:__ 400+!~
The lord of the Roswaal Mansion and a descendant of the original Roswaal.

He comes across as an eccentric due to his flamboyant appearance and odd speaking style, the latter which he shares with his grandmother. However, he harbors a more calculating and reserved side with a sharp political mind and gaze that reads others quite well.

~!It is later revealed that he is in fact the original Roswaal, Roswaal A. Mathers, who has been possessing his descendants' bodies to meet his teacher Echidna again at any cost, even if that means sacrificing himself or those close to him.!~

name: Satella
description: Satella is one of the Witches of Sin, being the Witch of Envy. ~! Contrary to popular belief, Satella and the Witch of Envy are separate personalities. Both of them love Subaru, though the Witch of Envy is aggressive about it.!~

name: Priscilla Barielle
description: The matriarch of House Barielle and a candidate to become the 42nd King of Lugunica. Her knight is [Al](https://anilist.co/character/90178/Aldebaran).

name: Felt
description:
**Height:** 150 cm (4'11")

A thief that lives in the slums. Felt stole [Emilia's](https://anilist.co/character/88572/Emilia) insignia, hoping for quick, easy cash. Though Felt can usually handle her own, she does consider [Rom](https://anilist.co/character/124117/Rom) to be like family.

~!After being chosen by the insignia, she is forced to participate in the Royal Selection and is currently a candidate to become the 42nd King of Lugunica.!~

name: Frederica Baumann
description:
Frederica Baumann is a maid working for [Roswaal L. Mathers](https://anilist.co/character/90182/Mathers-Roswaal) and a member of the Emilia Camp. She quit her job as a maid a few months before [Subaru's](https://anilist.co/character/88573/Natsuki-Subaru) appearance, but returned after [Ram](https://anilist.co/character/88576/Ram) couldn't manage the mansion ~!after [Rem](https://anilist.co/character/88575/Rem) had her name and memories eaten. !~

~!She is the half-sister of [Garfiel Tinsel](https://anilist.co/character/133847/Tinsel-Garfiel).!~

name: Aldebaran
description:
**Height:** 173 cm (5'8")

Aldebaran, commonly known as Al, is [Priscilla Barielle](https://anilist.co/character/90186/Priscilla-Barielle)'s knight, though he claims to just be a subordinate. He has a frivolous personality and acts aloof, but shows insecurity regarding his disfigured face and wears a helmet to conceal it. Due to that, he is a man of both eccentric appearance and behavior.

~!Like Subaru, he is revealed to be from Japan and was summoned roughly 18 years before Subaru. Shortly after he was summoned, he lost his left arm in an unfortunate incident in the Empire of Vollachia. !~

name: Elsa Granhiert
description:
An assassin-for-hire from the Northernmost nation, the Holy Kingdom of Gusteko, known as "The Bowel Hunter". Elsa wishes to make a trade for an insignia, as her client's wishes.  

~!Elsa Granhiert was an assassin working together with [Meili](https://anilist.co/character/175577) for an individual they refer to as "Mother" until her death.!~

name: Regulus Corneas
description: Regulus is a young man of a medium height. He has gold eyes, white hair and a middle to skinny build. Regulus Is a part of the Sin Archbishops of the Witch Cult and represents greed.  Regulus is known for being very talkative and calls himself unselfish, while in fact he is very prideful and likes to act above others and reference himself as above others.

name: Patrasche
description: [Subaru](https://anilist.co/character/88573/Natsuki-Subaru)'s Earth Dragon that he officially received from [Crusch Karsten](https://anilist.co/character/90185/Karsten-Crusch) for his efforts in the Hakugei battle. Despite being of a species known for being feisty, Patrasche is extremely loyal to Subaru, as she is willing to put her life on the line for him.

name: Anastasia Hoshin
description:
Anastasia Hoshin is the head of the Hoshin Trading Company and a candidate to become the 42nd King of Lugunica. Her knight is [Julius Juukulius](https://anilist.co/character/90183/Euclius-Julius).

Despite her surname being "Hoshin", she's not directly related to Hoshin of the Wilderness. She chose the name because she was inspired by his legacy.

name: Theresia van Astrea
description: Theresia was the former Sword Saint/Master Swordsman, [Wilhelm](https://anilist.co/character/90179/Wilhelm-van-Astrea)'s wife and [Reinhard](https://anilist.co/character/88577/Reinhard-van-Astrea)'s grandmother.

name: Gokuu Son
description:
__Race:__ ~!Saiyan!~
__Height:__ 175 cm (5'9")
__Birth Year:__ 737 Age  

Son Gokuu is a boy we meet in a forest far from any civilization. He lives in this forest alone as his grandpa passed away, he only has this special orb-like object called a Dragon Ball to remember him by, which he will sometimes talk to as if it is his Grandpa Gohan. As the series continues, Gokuu meets [Bulma](https://anilist.co/character/678), a brilliant teenage girl, and they go on a journey to collect these 7 magical dragon balls which actually have wish granting powers once all of them are collected. During this journey they meet and befriend [Yamcha](https://anilist.co/character/4014), [Oolong](https://anilist.co/character/2108), and [Pu'ar](https://anilist.co/character/677). Gokuu also encounters one his closest friends, [Kuririn](https://anilist.co/character/2159), and others during his time training. Participating in several World Martials Arts Tournaments,

name: Vegeta
description:
__Race:__ Saiyan  
__Date of Birth:__ Age 732  
__Height:__ 164 cm (5' 5")
__Hobby:__ Training  
__Favorite Food:__ All types of food  
__Favorite Vehicle:__ Space pod  
__Known Family:__ [King Vegeta III](https://anilist.co/character/9393/Vegeta-Ou) (father), [Tarble](https://anilist.co/character/15919) (brother), ~![Bulma](https://anilist.co/character/678) (wife)!~ ~![Trunks](https://anilist.co/character/2707) (son)!~ ~![Bra](https://anilist.co/character/2733) [Bulla] (daughter)!~ 

Vegeta is haughty, arrogant, and filled with hatred and bitterness as a result of the destruction of his home planet and his race's abusive treatment at the hands of [Freeza](https://anilist.co/character/3694). His royal status seems to have caused him to develop an inflated sense of superiority and he holds himself above most people he encounters.

In _Cross Epoch_ (the _Dragon Ball_ and [_One Piece_](https://anilist.co/manga/30013/ONE-PIECE/) crossover one-shot) Vegeta is the captain of an air ship and is seen wearing an eye patch and a cape with a clasp featuring the Kanji character for "vegetable." [Trunks](https://anilist.co/character/2707/Trunks), [Usopp](https://anilist.co/character/724/Usopp), and [Nico Robin](https://anilist.co/character/61/Nico-Robin) are members of his crew.

name: Trunks
description:
__Race:__ ~!Half-Human, Half-Saiyan!~__Birth Year:__ 766 Age
__Height:__  129 cm (4'2") (Kid), 170 cm (5'6") (Future)

A mysterious person who comes from the future and tells Son Goku of the bleak future to come. He is characterized as well-mannered, serious, and very cautious.

~!Son of Bulma and Vegeta!~

name: Gohan Son
description:
__Race:__ Half-Saiyan, Half-Human  
__Height:__ 175 cm (5'9”)

Gohan is a shy and studious intellectual, and as a child lacks the Saiyan fighting spirit. However, because he is forced to protect the ones he loves, he taps into his vast half-breed Saiyan potential and emotional reserves, becoming one of the most powerful Z Fighters. As an adult, he abandons his superhero duties and uses his mind, as a premier scholar of the Dragon World. Gohan was extremely powerful, surpassing powerhouses like [Goku](https://anilist.co/character/246/Son-Gokuu) and [Vegeta](https://anilist.co/character/913/Vegeta) at times. 

(Source: Dragon Ball Super Exciting Guide, Character Edition)

name: Piccolo
description:
__Race:__ ~!Namekian!~
__Height:__ 223 cm (7'4") 
__Birth Year:__ 753 Age  

Piccolo is a fictional character from the Dragon Ball series. He is introduced in the late stages of Dragon Ball as the main antagonist of the final saga and is a ruthless enemy of the protagonist [Son Goku](https://anilist.co/character/246/Son-Gokuu). He carries a very cold, menacing demeanour and is not afraid to show his evil nature, he is characterized wearing his weighted clothing, cape and turban. 

~!He is considered both the son and reincarnation of [Demon King Piccolo](https://anilist.co/character/9767/Piccolo-Daimaou) and was spawned to save himself from certain death at the hands of Son Goku. Like his father, he appears as a tall green humanoid creature with pointy ears. After his narrow defeat against Goku, Piccolo is soon forced to form an at first uneasy alliance with Goku and his friends against newer, more dangerous threats. Out of necessity he also takes it upon himself to train Goku's child [Son Gohan](https://anilist.co/character/2093/Son-Gohan), forming a powerful bond which ultimately redeems him when he sacrifices himself to save the child's life. After his resurrection he fully joins Goku and the others in their struggles against ever more powerful villains.!~

name: Bulma
description:
__Birth Year:__ 733 Age
__Height:__ 165 cm (5'5")
__Race:__ Earthling 

Bulma is originally a secondary main character, but her role is quickly downplayed as the series continues, even though she does remain an important support character for most of the series. Bulma is a direct parody of the character Xuanzang from the Chinese novel _Journey to the West_. Even though Bulma's character parodies a monk, her Japanese name "Buruma" is the brand of a popular gym short worn by girls in Japan. Her re-adapted name Bulma is a direct take on the word "bloomers", which was a popular brand of women's underwear in the early 20th century.

Bulma is the second character to be introduced in the Dragon Ball series. In the early part of the story, she is the inventor of the Dragon Radar and is searching for the legendary Dragon Balls. Bulma was hoping to use the Dragon Balls to wish for the perfect boyfriend. While searching for a nearby Dragon Ball, she runs into [Son Goku](https://anilist.co/character/246/Son-Gokuu). It is at this time that she finds out Goku inherited one of the balls (the four-star ball) she is searching for from his [Grandpa Gohan](https://anilist.co/character/2104/Son-Gohan). Because of Goku's love for the ball and his belief that his Grandpa's spirit lives in the ball, Goku is not willing to give it up. Bulma then asks him to loan it for her in exchange of taking him in her travels. At that point, they team up to find the remainder of the balls and the adventure begins.

In the later action-oriented episodes of the series, there is little room for a genius but Bulma continues to play a role as a secondary character, helping Goku and his friends with her gadgets, and having a rather rocky relationship with [Yamcha](https://anilist.co/character/4014/Yamcha).

name: Freeza
description: Freeza is a fictional graphic novel supervillain who first appears in the Dragon Ball manga created by Akira Toriyama. Freeza also appears in the television special Bardock: The Father of Goku; a few Dragon Ball Z movies, and in Dragon Ball GT. He is one of the most powerful major supervillains introduced throughout the Dragon Ball universe. In the gag series Neko Majin Z, it is revealed that he has a son, [Kuriza](https://anilist.co/character/9021). Freeza is introduced in the series as the powerful galactic overlord on a mission for immortality and conquest, ruler of an empire said to control seventy-nine or more planets. Freeza creates armies from the planets that he conquers, his most utilized race were the Saiyans. Freeza had heard about the legend of the Super Saiyan, a being with unrivaled power, but dismissed it as simple mythology; however, after several Saiyans emerged with rapidly evolving potential, Freeza began to fear that the legend would indeed come true, so as a result, destroyed the Saiyan race. His actions and lust for power eventually bring him into conflict with the heroes of the series when he tries to take possession of the wish-granting Dragon Balls on Planet Namek. ~!Freeza's fears were realized when he was defeated by [Goku](https://anilist.co/character/246), who in turn had become a Super Saiyan. His character would return shortly thereafter, having survived the encounter with Goku but having been left with multiple metal prosthetics. Though accompanied to Earth by his father, Freeza is unable to avenge his loss, being killed with relative ease by a newcomer to the series, the half-Saiyan time traveler [Trunks](https://anilist.co/character/2707). A blood sample taken before his ultimate fate would later become a catalyst for the next arc's featured villain: [Cell](https://anilist.co/character/3908), a warrior genetically engineered to be perfect. Toei Animation would continue to make use of the character in their anime adaptation, with Freeza making brief cameo appearances during the Boo arc, animated features, and Dragon Ball GT. He is last referenced in the manga as a measure of the strength of the Kaioshin, the supreme lords of the Dragon Ball universe, as "each of whom could have felled Freeza in one blow." In Toriyama's out-of-continuity parody of his earlier work Neko Majin Z, Freeza sends his henchman Vegeta on errand to retrieve his missing son on Earth.!~ (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Jinzouningen 18-gou
description:
Android 18 is a fictional character who first appears in the Dragon Ball manga created by Akira Toriyama, followed by Dragon Ball Z and Dragon Ball GT. No. 18 is a mass murderer in Future Trunks' timeline.  A cybernetic human, #18 modified by [Dr. Gero](https://anilist.co/character/2146). She is often referred to in the original Japanese as a jinzōningen, which literally translates as "artificial human". She is not entirely an android; she refers to both herself and her twin brother as having been "constructed from a human base".

~!After [Cell](https://anilist.co/character/3908) is defeated, [Kuririn](https://anilist.co/character/2159) uses the Dragon Balls to wish for [#17](https://anilist.co/character/2147) and #18 to be turned into humans; [Shenlong](https://anilist.co/character/6127) is unable to perform this task because of the unfathomable differences in power between him and the duo, so he wishes instead for their self destruct devices to be removed. Kuririn pursues #18 and, at some point, they marry and have a daughter named [Marron](https://anilist.co/character/2106).  To clear up the heavily espoused misconception that #18 is a pure android and therefore could not have a child, Kuririn went on to explain to [Son Goku](https://anilist.co/character/246) during the World Tournament Saga that she was originally human but that Dr. Gero just "remodeled her a little bit."!~

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Cell
description: Cell is a fictional graphic novel supervillain who first appears in the Dragon Ball manga created by Akira Toriyama, followed by Dragon Ball Z and Dragon Ball GT. He is the ultimate creation of the scientist Dr. Gero, cloned from the cells of several characters from the series. As a result of the cloning, Cell is labeled the "perfect warrior", possessing genetic and even personality traits and abilities from almost all of the Dragon Ball characters.  These include, but are not limited to,  Piccolo, Freeza, Vegeta, and even Son Goku himself.    (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Kuririn
description:
A short, hairless (for most of the series) warrior monk, loyal Kuririn provides comic relief during tense moments. Like [Chiaotzu](https://anilist.co/character/2151/Chaozu), Kuririn doesn't have a nose. He is a good-natured, outgoing and competitive martial artist.

Once a fierce rival of [Son Goku](https://anilist.co/character/246/Son-Gokuu), he quickly became his best friend while training under [Muten Roshi](https://anilist.co/character/6167/Muten-Roushi). He also is close to Goku's son, [Gohan](https://anilist.co/character/2093/Son-Gohan).

~!He eventually marries [Android 18](https://anilist.co/character/4318/Jinzouningen-18-gou) and settles down, having a daughter named [Marron](https://anilist.co/character/2106/Marron).!~

name: Muten Roushi
description:
The "Turtle Immortal" is an ancient and wise martial arts master and the first Earthling to wield the Kamehameha. Though he seems frail, he is a mighty warrior. Muten-Rôshi trained [Grandpa Son Gohan](https://anilist.co/character/2104/Son-Gohan), [Ox King](https://anilist.co/character/2094/Gyuumaou), [Son Goku](https://anilist.co/character/246/Son-Gokuu), [Kuririn](https://anilist.co/character/2159/Kuririn), and [Yamcha](https://anilist.co/character/4014/Yamcha). His home, Kame House, a shack on a small isolated island, serves as a gathering place for the Z Fighters and friends.

He is a stock character, as he is both the archetypal wise old man and dirty old man, the latter being typical of shōnen anime. Sometimes he gets cranky, which further provides comic relief. He is bald, with a thick goatee and a thick mustache. Muten-Rôshi wears beach clothes or a martial arts suit and a turtle shell on his back. He usually wields a walking stick.

His companions are usually [Oolong](https://anilist.co/character/2108/Oolong), [Umigame](https://anilist.co/character/2112/Umigame) and [Lunch](https://anilist.co/character/2105/Lunch).

name: Bardock
description:
The biological father of Raditz and Son Goku, Burdock is a Saiyan who is given the gift of precognition. In several of his recurring visions, he witnesses the destruction of his home planet Vegeta by the hand of Freeza. After escaping certain death from Dodoria, he tries desperately to change his planet's grim future by attempting to combat Freeza and his legion of men head on. ~!He ultimately fails on ceasing Freeza's attack on the planet and is killed in the process. Moments before his death, he received a vision of his son facing the warlord. According to the anime special, Burdock was estimated a battle power of 10,000 by observant doctors while recovering from his last mission.!~

(Source: Wikipedia)

Bardock is first introduced in the television special, Bardock - The Father of Goku. It was only after the film's airing in Japan that he was later shown in two panels of the manga by Akira Toriyama, who helped design the character for Toei Doga's television production. His name is a pun on "burdock" (バードック), a herb. While the Viz manga and FUNimation's Japanese-language English-subtitled anime both use "Burdock", FUNimation's English anime dubs uses "Bardock", and some Japanese merchandise even use "Barduck".

name: Majin Boo
description:
Boo is introduced in the series as an innocent looking, pudgy, pink genie-like creature. Later in the series, it is revealed that Boo's original form is a more sleek child form ("The Boo of Pure Evil"), however his nature and form had been altered after he'd assimilated the gentle, pudgy god (Dai Kaioshin) into his body. Boo's creator, a wizard named Bibbidi, had used Boo to wage war on the Kaioshin. Boo managed to assimilate two of the four Kaioshin, the second being the one who altered his nature to become innocent. After Bibbidi sealed Boo away, Bibbidi was killed by the fourth Kaioshin, and Boo was transported to Earth where he layed dormant for five million years until he was revived by Bibbidi's son Babbidi during the events of Dragon Ball.

Boo has numerous counterparts in the series. When he first emerges from his shell, he is tall and round, and his personality is naive and innocent. Boo's anger later manifests itself in the form of another Boo ("The Boo of Pure Wrath").  After a battle with the Boo of Pure Wrath, Boo is absorbed and the two combined create Super Boo, who tracks down the protagonists of the series Piccolo and Gotenks. He later reverts to his purest form, the original state called "The Boo of Pure Evil".

name: Videl
description:
__Race:__ Earthling
__Height:__ 4'11"
__Birth Year:__ 757 Age
__Hobby:__ Serving as the Ally of Justice
__Favorite Food:__ Okonomiyaki, Caesar Salad
