~!She is the daughter of [Yoshimura](https://anilist.co/character/136024/Yoshimura), and the half-Ghoul known as the One-Eyed Owl. Her human identity is Sen Takatsuki (高槻 泉), a best-selling horror novelist mentioned throughout the series. Her relation with the One-Eyed King is unclear. However the CCG and [Nico](https://anilist.co/character/88419/Nico) speculate that they are the same person.!~

name: Nishiki Nishio
description:
__Height:__ 177 cm (5'9")

Nishiki Nishio is a ghoul whose original feeding ground was taken from Rize. He is a sophomore in the Pharmaceutical Department of Kamii University and Kimi Nishino's boyfriend.

name: Kuki Urie
description:
__Height:__ 173 cm
__Species:__ Quinx
__Affiliations:__ CCG's Quinx Squad - Former squad leader
__RC type:__ Koukaku
__Quinque:__ Tsunagi (Bikaku)

He is a Rank 2 Ghoul Investigator,a Quinx and the former Squad Leader of the Quinx Squad.

Urie often displays himself as a cool-headed individual, holding a monotonous facial expression the majority of the time. As a Ghoul Investigator, he appears to be very dedicated and stern about his work, to the point where it may seem as though he is ruthlessly slaughtering more ghouls than necessary, which is a habit he often gets berated for. Urie also tends to be quite hasty when investigating the slightest details or signs of a suspect. He has a tendency to execute mission objectives independently, without awaiting the arrival of his fellow team mates, or even requesting their help. This is because he is an ambitious person, and does not wish to share credit with others, as he merely wishes to achieve higher ranks as a Ghoul Investigator. To achieve his personal goals, he is willing to go as far as manipulating his comrades or causing discord within the team. But beneath his ambition and cool-headed demeanor is an insatiable jealousy towards his superiors, particularly Sasaki. Urie believes that ghouls, under any circumstance, must cease to exist. He is a person who is always striving for power and as a result, constantly looks for ways to one-up everyone around him which is shown by asking Professor Shiba to help augments his kagune's power to presumably to get an edge over Sasaki. 

Urie believes that as an investigator, he must never retreat and will fight on even if it means straining himself to the end. This belief stemmed from the fact that his father, a special class investigator in charge of the S3 squad, ordered his team members to retreat while he stayed to fight the One-Eyed Owl to the death. He also holds a grudge against Takeomi Kuroiwa and Iwao, for not fighting by his father's side during the Owl battle; and therefore thinks that they are inconsiderate of his loss. Thus, Urie refuses to forgive them.

An omake in Volume 1, shows that he is a talented painter.

name: Saiko Yonebayashi
description:
**Height:** 143 cm

Saiko Yonebayashi is a Rank 3 Ghoul Investigator, a Quinx, and a member of the Quinx Squad. She dislikes having to work, as she prefers having a peaceful, happy-go-lucky and carefree life by playing video games and eating junk food excessively. Saiko often oversleeps, which earns her the absence from most missions. While not trying to reduce it, she is apparently embarrassed about her weight, humorously covering it during her introduction.

She is excessively lazy to the point of being a hikikomori, unable to remove herself from her room without the intervention and often force of others, even jeopardizing her occupation. Saiko is also depicted as greedy, and heavily involved in her video games to the point of escapism.

name: Akira Mado
description:
__Species:__ Human
__Height:__ 164 cm
__Affiliations:__ CCG
__Quinque:__ Amatsu (Koukaku/Bikaku)
__Likes:__ making quinques, solving puzzles and cats

Akira Mado is a Rank 2 Ghoul Investigator and Kureo's daughter. She is currently partnered with Koutarou Amon.

She is an intelligent woman and seems to be always serious about work and her daily routine in general. Like her father, she has deep insight and intuition that helps her in investigation and determining what is going on around her while on the field. She shares her father's "quinque-mania," but it is not as extreme as his was.

Akira remains professional in most situations, no matter who she is faced with, and she isn't one to admit her own feelings on a subject unless provoked to a certain degree. Seen through her interactions with others, it is most likely that she would prefer to make a quinque rather than to interact with someone else.

name: Renji Yomo
description:
__Height:__ 182 cm (5'11")

Renji Yomo is a worker at Anteiku and the right hand of [Yoshimura](https://anilist.co/character/136024/Yoshimura). He is an old friend of [Uta](https://anilist.co/character/88414/Uta) and [Itori](https://anilist.co/character/88415/Itori). Because of his scavenging habits and long-beaked, avian mask, he has the nickname of "Raven."

name: Seidou Takizawa
description:
__Height:__ 171 cm

Takizawa is a Rank 2 Ghoul Investigator. A classmate of [Akira Mado](https://anilist.co/character/88838/Akira-Mado) at the Academy, he is partnered with Kousuke Houji and assigned to the 20th ward to investigate the Gourmet. He greatly respects [Kishou Arima](https://anilist.co/character/88946/Kishou-Arima) and [Koutarou Amon](https://anilist.co/character/88407/Koutarou-Amon) and admires their achievements.

~!Though he was declared among the casualties of the raid in the 20th Ward, it is revealed that he had actually survived as artificial one-eyed ghoul. He is now a member of Aogiri Tree. As an artificial one-eyed ghoul, he is known as Owl. After betraying Aogiri and killing [Tatara](https://anilist.co/character/88418/Tatara), Takizawa reunited with Akira Mado, and became a member of Ken Kaneki's organization, Goat. !~

name: Tooru Mutsuki
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm (5'4")

Tooru Mutsuki is a Rank 3 Ghoul Investigator, a Quinx and a member of the Quinx Squad. Tooru is kind with a gentle heart and seems to be shy with little self-confidence. Having a constant case of Anemia, ironically, Mutsuki feels repulsive when he comes into contact with blood. Because of this anxiety, he faces discouragement as a ghoul investigator, to the point where he feels as though he isn’t even needed for the job. He expresses frustration with his own weakness, feeling anger at his lack of ability compared to his comrades. When not working, he is shown to enjoy reading books and is the one often left to relate information to Haise Sasaki. As such, he is shown to be a reliable and hard-working individual, following orders in contrast to the more troublesome or lazy members of his team. Though lacking in confidence, he shows a strong desire to help others and does not hesitate to place himself at risk to protect the innocent.

~!A flashback reveals him to have been born female, but unable to reconcile his feelings of discomfort towards his birth sex. As such, he has began living as a man and uses highly-masculine personal pronouns.!~

name: Ginshi Shirazu
description:
__Height:__ 176 cm (5'9")

Ginshi Shirazu is a Rank 3 Ghoul Investigator, a Quinx and the Current Squad Leader of the Quinx Squad. Shirazu, like most of his teammates, is shown to have great respect for his mentor, Haise Sasaki. However, this doesn’t stop him from going out of his way to execute missions without Sasaki’s permission, and so he is constantly seen accompanying Kuki Urie, the former squad leader, on dangerous assignments. Although he is a competent fighter with a ruthless nature, Urie describes Shirazu as a simple-minded person. 

He also seems to be quite exaggerated in his expressions and movements. His primary motive for joining the Quinx Squad is to get fast money for a purpose unknown at this point in time. Shirazu is also a quite carefree individual, and he seems to have an obsession for exterminating ghouls; both of which are traits that submit to the cocky grin he usually displays.

He is stated to be poor at tasks that require thought, such as academics or investigation. However, his consideration for others and attention to his surroundings convince Sasaki he has potential as a Squad Leader. In contrast to his loud and violent mannerisms, he is also someone that cares greatly for his team. While prone to bickering with Urie, he shows a gentler side when interacting with Mutsuki or civilians such as Chie

name: Yoshimura
description:
Yoshimura is a ghoul and the manager of the Anteiku cafe. He tries to help every ghoul, especially those who can't hunt themselves. He takes in Ken Kaneki and tries to help him survive being a ghoul.

~!He is Eto's father.!~

name: Naki
description:
Naki is a ghoul who was imprisoned in Cochlea until Aogiri Tree's invasion on the prison. He was liberated by Aogiri Tree due to being a direct underling and supposedly the right hand man of Yamori. He was almost always accompanied by the Twins Gagi and Guge.

He eventually climbs the ranks within Aogiri, and has become an Executive in his own right. The number of Ghouls following him has grown considerably, forming a gang known as the White Suits for their distinctive dressing style. Naki is left handed.

name: Kurona Yasuhisa
description:
Kurona Yasuhisa is an artificial one-eyed ghoul who impeded Ken Kaneki's pursuit of Madam A alongside her twin sister Nashiro.

~!After being abandoned by Akihiro Kanou, she vanished until her appearance during the Rushima Landing Operation. She merged with her sister and became known to the CCG as Floppy.!~

name: Noro
description:
He is one of the direct subordinates of the King of an Eye and one of the leaders of the Aogiri Tree, next to Tatara.
In the past he was called Noroi and was responsible for raising Eto, when Kuzen surrendered in District 24.

He is a giant who intimidates with an overwhelming silence, seems to communicate only through actions, not words.

name: Anonymous
description: Anonymous is the mysterious founder and owner of the Lounge. They are asexual and, as Kamatani Yuuki has stated, of indeterminate gender identity.

name: Tasuku  Kaname
description: Tasuku Kaname is a high school student at Shimanami High, who is troubled by his sexual orientation and his affection for his schoolmate Touma Tsubaki.

name: Haruko Daichi
description: Haruko is a frequent visitor of the Lounge and a member of the Cat Clowder. After being commissioned by Anonymous, she renovated the Lounge with friends she met through a gay community on Twitter. She's living with her wife, Saki, who she met through that community.

name: Shuuji Misora
description: Misora is in sixth grade and prefers to dress as a girl whenever he's at the lounge. He is unsure about what gender he identifies as. He has multiple older sisters and is called Shuuji at home.

name: Chaiko
description:
Chaiko is an older gentleman who often hangs out around the lounge and enjoys playing classical music.
~!Chaiko is gay, and his partner of 30 years is in the hospital for terminal cancer.!~

name: Natsuyoshi Utsumi
description:
Utsumi is a friend of Haruko, who he met through a gay community on Twitter. He is a member of the Cat Clowder Vacant House Restoration Non-Profit and a frequent visitor of the lounge.
~!In chapter 11, it is revealed that he is a trans man.!~

name: Touma Tsubaki
description: Touma Tsubaki is a character from the manga Shimanami Tasogare, the ace of the Shimanami High volleyball club and Tasuku Kaname's crush. He and Tasuku are on the Health Committee together.

name: Sakura Adachi
description: Adachi Sakura is a high school student. She is found skipping class on the second floor of the gym by [Shimamura Hougetsu](https://anilist.co/character/144718/Hougetsu-Shimamura) one day. The two of them gradually became friends and began to spend a lot of time together. Adachi had an extremely introverted personality. Before meeting Shimamura, she never had someone whom she can call a friend. Adachi was said to be cold toward other people and didn't attempt to make friends with other people in the past. She also gets very jealous when Shimamura is together with her friends, and as a consequence usually ends up running away.

name: Hougetsu Shimamura
description:
Shimamura Hougetsu is a high school student. She met [Adachi](https://anilist.co/character/144717/Sakura-Adachi) while skipping class on the second floor of the gym in her school when Adachi accidentally walks in on her one day. (In both manga adaptations, it was Shimamura who walked in on Adachi in the gym when they first met instead of the reverse.) The two instantly took a liking for each other and began to hang out together all the time. Shimamura has tail-bone length, dyed brown hair, which she keeps out of her face with two clips on the right side. Her eyes are also brown. Despite playing basketball in middle school, Shimamura is on the shorter side. She has a slim figure. Shimamura tends to think of interpersonal relationships as bothersome since she feels that it requires too much effort to maintain a balanced relationship.

~!During a summer break in their second year of high school, Shimamura is confessed to by Adachi at a summer festival, and chooses to accept her feelings, thus becoming her girlfriend.!~

name: Yashiro Chikama
description:
Chikama Yashiro is a friend of [Hino Akira](https://anilist.co/character/167926/Akira-Hino), who met while they were fishing. Like Hino, Chikama makes her own sound effects, the most notably being the "breathing" sound for her space suit. In her introduction, she explains that she has come to Earth to find her brethren.

Chikama wears a full body spacesuit. It has childish design elements, such as hearts and star patches.

name: Taeko Nagafuji
description:
__Date of Birth:__ Unknown

Taeko Nagafuji is a high school student and [Shimamura Hougetsu](https://anilist.co/character/144718/Hougetsu-Shimamura)'s friend. She is introduced in Chapter 2, along with [Hino Akira](https://anilist.co/character/167926/Akira-Hino), in a bookstore with [Shimamura](https://anilist.co/character/144718/Hougetsu-Shimamura).

Nagafuji has straight, shoulder length hair and wears glasses. She has a very mature figure.

Nagafuji is described as having a very laid back personality. Though she sometimes just seems to be out of it.

(Source: Adachi and Shimamura Wiki)

name: Akira Hino
description:
__Date of Birth:__ Unknown

Akira Hino is a high school student and [Shimamura Hougetsu](https://anilist.co/character/144718/Hougetsu-Shimamura)'s friend. She is introduced in Chapter 2, where she is visiting a bookstore with [Shimamura Hougetsu](https://anilist.co/character/144718/Hougetsu-Shimamura) and [Nagafuji](https://anilist.co/character/167928/Taeko-Nagafuji).

Hino has shoulder length hair, tied into low twintails. She is rather short, being shorter than Shimamura and Nagafuji. She also has big eyes.

Hino has a bubbly personality and is known to add in sound effects, whether they're needed or not. She also enjoys fishing, though she often complains about not having any school fishing friends.

(Source: Adachi and Shimamura Wiki)

name: Shuumei Sasaki
description:
__Height:__ 183 cm
__Likes:__ Sweets

Sasaki is [Miyano](https://anilist.co/character/164752/Miyano-Yoshikazu)'s senior in high school. He's a 'bad-boy' who doesn't cause much trouble. He got introduced to BL manga through Miyano.

name: Yoshikazu Miyano
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm

He's really sensitive about his girlish features, and he's a hardcore fudanshi.

name: Taiga Hirano
description: __Height:__ 175 cm - 178 cm

name: Akira Kagiura
description: He's [Hirano](https://anilist.co/character/209018/Hirano-Taiga)'s roommate. He's part of the basketball team and is in love with Hirano.

name: Masato Hanzawa
description: He's president of the student council.

name: Jirou Ogasawara
description: [Sasaki](https://anilist.co/character/164753/Sasaki-Shuumei)'s classmate and friend, he's a bad boy. He shares the same music taste as Sasaki, has a girlfriend, wears an ear cuff, and has blue-dyed streaks in his hair.

name: Tasuku Kuresawa
description: Miyano's friend and classmate. Has a girlfriend from another school, and is a member of the astronomy club.

name: Gonzaburou Tashiro
description: Miyano's friend and classmate. He has bleached hair before he entered school but it not allowed to bleach it again.

name: Kyouji Shirahama
description: Tashiro's friend since middle school. He plays on the same basketball team as Kagiura.

name: Satoko Sasaki
description: Shuumei's older sister.

name: Yoshikazu no Haha
description: Yoshikazu's mother.

name: Nao Makimura
description: A former classmate from Miyano.

name: Eimi Yokota
description: Jirou's girlfriend.

name: Masato no Aniki
description: Masato's older brother.

name: Mitsuru Okouchi
description: The mother of the Okouchi Family.

name: Haru Okouchi
description: She is the eldest daughter of the Okouchi family and a japanese military nurse.

name: Masaomi Naruse
description: Lieutenant of the japanese military air force unit.

name: Osamu Dazai
description:
**Height:** 181 cm (5'11")
**Ability:** No Longer Human

A member of the Armed Detective Agency. He's a suicide enthusiast who searches for a place to die. However, he doesn't like pain, and would prefer a lovers' suicide with a beautiful woman. He's aimless, elusive, nonchalant, and jokes around normally, but, when he is serious, it is clear that he is an insightful and intelligent individual. He loves to annoy his fellow Agency member, [Kunikida](https://anilist.co/character/89200).

~!He was a former Executive of the city's worst underworld organization, the Port Mafia.!~

name: Ranpo Edogawa
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm (5'6")

The great detective of the Armed Detective Agency. He possesses sharp observation skills that are acknowledged by his coworkers, and he settles difficult cases at the request of the police. Because of his self-confidence, his speech is brazen and child-like. His motto is "If you'll have me, everything will be ok!" He likes logical thinking and fantastic tales.

name: Chuuya Nakahara
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3")

Chuuya is a Port Mafia member who detests [Osamu Dazai](https://anilist.co/character/89198) for betraying the mafia and joining the Armed Detective Agency. He's also constantly teased by Dazai what makes him hate Dazai even more. Chuuya is short but he's quick and uses powerful martial arts. 

His ability, "For The Tainted Sorrow," revolves around gravity manipulation, allowing him to manipulate and alter the gravity of anything he touches, keeping it that way until a certain period of time.

name: Atsushi Nakajima
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7")
__Ability:__ Beast Beneath the Moonlight

He came to Yokohama after being driven out of a poor orphanage that was attacked by a man-eating tiger. On the verge of starvation, he meets [Dazai](https://anilist.co/character/89198/Dazai-Osamu) and gets a job helping at the detective agency. Because he's never had friends or family and was labeled as "useless," he lacks self-confidence.

name: Lucy Montgomery
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm (5'5")

A member of Ability User Society "Fellowship of The Guild." 

Her ability is known as "Anne of Abyssal Red".

~!She helped [Atsushi](https://anilist.co/character/89197/Nakajima-Atsushi) escape the Guild because they bonded over their past trauma and loneliness.!~

name: Akiko Yosano
description:
__Height:__ 166 cm (5'5")
__Ability:__ Thou Shalt Not Die

A modern woman with a bob cut who's a member of the Armed Detective Agency. Although she's an excellent doctor who is indispensable to the Agency, all members of the the Agency are scared to be placed into her care. It's recommended that you don't use outdated misogynistic expressions in front of her.

name: Fyodor Dostoyevsky
description:
__Ability:__ Crime and Punishment

Head of the underground organization "Rats in the House of the Dead" and part of the terrorist organization "Decay of Angels". He maintains a calm, confident, and arrogant yet polite personality towards others and has shown to be extremely intelligent, cunning, and sinister. He is highly religious and speaks often of the sin of man, especially ability users. According to him, he is anemic.

name: Sakunosuke Oda
description:
__Height:__ 185 cm (6'1)
__Ability:__ Flawless

Was a member of the Port Mafia. Oda was a man described as kind, despite working for the mafia, by [Dazai](https://anilist.co/character/89198/Dazai-Osamu). He had an incredibly perceptive side to him that allowed him to come the closest to understanding Dazai, whom he referred to as "his dear friend, who had grown tired of the world and is simply waiting to die."

~!It is his understanding of Dazai's loneliness, as well as his regret of not being able to do anything about it, that prompted him to leave behind the last words that became the trigger for Dazai deserting the mafia in favour of carving a brighter path for himself, something that Oda wanted to do.!~

name: Kyouka Izumi
description:
__Height:__ 148cm (4'10")

A docile young lady who dresses in a kimono, but also a member of Port Mafia. As she holds a killing ability, she was found by the organization and raised as an assassin.

~!She later joins the Armed Detective Agency.!~

name: Doppo Kunikida
description:
__Height:__ 189 cm (6'2")
__Ability:__ The Matchless Poet

A member of the Armed Detective Agency. He carries a notepad with the word "Ideal" written on the cover, and what is written inside are guides for life. He has a straight-laced personality and hates nothing more than schedules going awry. As a partner to the free-spirited [Dazai](https://anilist.co/character/89198/Dazai-Osamu), his troubles never end.

name: Edgar Poe
description:
__Height:__ 182 cm (6'0")
__Ability:__ Black Cat in the Rue Morgue

A member of The Guild who is rarely seen without his pet raccoon, Karl. Poe's ability, Black Cat in the Rue Morgue, can transport someone into a story they're reading.
Poe is portrayed as shy but determined. He spent six years on a plot to defeat Ranpo, showing that he will work hard at something he cares about. He often talks too quietly for others to hear. ~!After the Guild War, he forms a rivalrous friendship with Ranpo, and frequently brings him his works to read after Ranpo said he wants to see them.!~

name: Nikolai Gogol
description:
__Height:__ 184 cm (6’0)
__Ability:__ The Overcoat

Nikolai Gogol is a member of the Decay of Angels. He's a sadist who enjoys putting on a show with his words. He is freakish, vigorous, unrepentant, and quite enigmatic. However, Gogol suggests that his quirky image could or might not be real. The side of him that has no remorse for murdering others is just as genuine as the one who has guilt and is well aware of the unjust and cruel nature of his acts. He joined the Decay of Angels in order to experience what he had always desired: freedom against gravity.

The Overcoat, Gogol's ability, allows him to use his coat to manipulate spaces and what emerges from it. It functions essentially as a portal, capable of relocating and moving anything. He may use this to materialize a pillar or to manifest his hand and pistol in a location unrelated to him. The ability is also applicable to living beings.

name: Yukichi Fukuzawa
description:
__Height:__ 186 cm (6'1")
__Ability:__ All Men Are Equal

The president of the Armed Detective Agency, who manages the hooligans. Although he doesn't often come out, at a critical moment, he triumphantly takes command. Because Yukichi is a man of dignity and status, it seems even the frivolous Ranpo will actually work if he orders it.

name: Kenji Miyazawa
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm (5'2")
__Ability:__ Undefeated by the Rain

A member of the Armed Detective Agency. Before he was scouted, he lived in a rural area without electricity. He knows no suspicion, and will be understanding and considerate no matter who he is talking to. He has a lot of friends who call him "Ken-chan." He likes music, tempura soba, and Mitsuya cider.

name: Sigma
description:
Sigma is a member of the terrorist organization, "Decay of Angels", and owner of the Sky Casino.

His ability is unknown, but stated by Fyodor to be the weakest of the Angels. It may be more support-oriented than combat-oriented because of this.

He is shown to be very kind to his customers and to have a sense of pride and ownership over his casino.

name: Gin Akutagawa
description: Ryuunosuke's younger sister and a member of the "Black Lizards" Assault Unit. It seems she is in good terms with Dazai.

name: Junichirou Tanizaki
description:
__Height:__ 174 cm (5'8.5")
__Ability:__ Light Snow

He is a member of the Armed Detective Agency and the older brother of [Naomi](https://anilist.co/character/89209/Tanizaki-Naomi).

name: Ougai Mori
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm
__Ability:__ Vita Sexualis

Ougai Mori is the boss of the Port Mafia. Ougai is analytical and tactical. He often puts on overdramatic acts but rarely breaks his composure internally. 

He has been shown to be somewhat ruthless and unfaltering when it comes to violence. He hasn't, however, shown any particular enjoyment from killing. His ruthlessness comes from his pragmaticism.

Although he can be intimidating at times and emit a scary formal aura, he is often polite to the point of seeming approachable. He is polite to allies and enemies alike.

name: Tecchou Suehiro
description:
__Ability:__ Plum Blossoms in Snow

Tecchou Suehiro is a Hunting Dogs special unit member with the ability Plum Blossoms in Snow. Tecchou has a considerably more serious demeanor than his companions, yet he still qualifies as an oddball for his strange preferences in food. He takes his duty as a Hunting Dog earnestly and has a deep sense of justice. He despises the notion of torture and is a highly compassionate person.

Tecchou's ability, Plum Blossoms in Snow, lets him enhance the size, shape, and reach of his blade. It is unknown whether he can demonstrate his ability on other weapons. He is said to have the strongest ability in the Hunting Dogs.

name: Michizou Tachihara
description:
__Height:__ 176 cm
__Ability:__ Midwinter Memento

A commander of the Black Lizards, the Port Mafia's squad of hitmen. Though he puts up a tough and violent front, he cares deeply for his friends. Very skilled gunner, especially when dual wielding.

name: Francis Fitzgerald
description:
__Height:__ 191 cm (6'3")
__Ability:__ The Great Fitzgerald

Francis poses as the leader for an american secret society, ''The Guild''. Said organization is composed by rich and notorious individuals, who all have some type of powerful influence in the USA. His ability, ''The Great Fitzgerald'', allows him to power up his own atributes and traits, according to the money he spent from his countless fortune. A fierce man, who loves his family, and would do pretty much anything to achieve his goals.

name: Saigiku Jouno
description: Saigiku Jouno is a member of the Hunting Dogs. He possesses the ability "Priceless Tears".

name: Ango Sakaguchi
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm
__Ability:__ Discourse on Decadence 

Port Mafia's former exclusive informant. Works as an assistant counselor at the Special Ability Department at the Ministry of Internal Affairs.

For the most part, Ango is a composed, calm young man, showing more restraint than [Osamu Dazai](https://anilist.co/character/89198/Dazai-Osamu) and more discipline than [Oda Sakunosuke](https://anilist.co/character/120625/Oda-Sakunosuke). Although he values both as genuine friends, he strongly believes that Dazai needs someone to keep him from acting out as much as he does.

name: Karl
description: Edgar Allan Poe's pet raccoon.

name: Mushitarou Oguri
description: A member of the "Rats in the House of the Dead". His ability is "The Perfect Crime."

name: Kana Arima
description:
__Height:__ 150 cm (4'11")

An actress who was called a prodigy child. She has a rather stubborn personality yet an empathic side to her. She easily succumbs to pressure and while she does put up a front to others, she has very self-deprecating thoughts when it comes to her abilities. She's an honest and earnest person, who is very diligent and persistent even in the roughest of times. Also, she tends to place all responsibility on herself when it comes to others as she is the one who has the most experience in the show business world. She also hates bell peppers.
  
~!After the events of the Sweet Today Drama adaptation, she secretly develops a crush for [Aquamarine](https://anilist.co/character/183885/Hoshino-Aquamarine).!~

~!She longs for someone to look at her for who she is now and praise her efforts, someone to say that its okay for her to be here. And after the new B-Komachi's first concert, that person becomes Aquamarine after he waves her respected colored glow stick. Only reinforcing Kana's resolve to make Aquamarine fall for her.!~

name: Ai Hoshino
description:
__Height__: 151 cm (4'11")

She's an idol and lead of B-Komachi, an idol group affiliated with Strawberry Productions. Her life took a turn when through an undetermined amount of time, she became pregnant with twins. Not wanting to squander her reputation, she and her team decide to hide this fact; having to play the role of idol and mother.

name: Akane Kurokawa
description:
__Height:__ 163 cm (5'4")

Akane Kurokawa is a rising star actress from the Lalalie Theatrical Company. Although a shy and quiet person, she is very serious when it comes to creating a good performance. She does a deep examination of each role she is given, allowing her to perfectly portray the character's personality and motivations. Akane is introduced to [Aqua](https://anilist.co/character/183885) as a fellow cast member on the set of the reality dating show *The Beginning of My Love With An Idol*.

name: Aquamarine Hoshino
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm (5'7")

[Ai Hoshino's](https://anilist.co/character/172759/Ai-Hoshino) son. He is the twin big brother of [Ruby Hoshino](https://anilist.co/character/183884/Ruby-Hoshino).

~!He was previously a doctor named Goro, who became a fan of Ai through his patient named Sarina.!~ 

~!After reincarnating as Aquamarine and witnessing Ai's murder, he is intent on plotting revenge to the person who schemed Ai's death.!~

name: Ruby Hoshino
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm (5'2")

[Ai Hoshino's](https://anilist.co/character/172759/Ai-Hoshino) daughter, and the younger twin sister of [Aquamarine Hoshino](https://anilist.co/character/183885). 

~!She was previously a patient named Sarina under Goro's care. Due to her illness, she was wheelchair-bound. After discovering B-Komachi, she had always aspired to be an idol although her condition kept her from achieving her dream. Since being reincarnated as Ruby, she is now working towards her dream of being an idol like Ai. To do so she's currently working with Strawberry Productions to revive B-Komachi along with Arima Kana and Memcho.!~

name: MEM-cho
description:
__Height:__ 155 cm (5'1")

A girl who strived to become an idol at a young age, but due to her family situation, made sacrifices that ultimately ended with her becoming too old to become one. She is a YouTuber. 

~!Mem-cho's real age is 25, and she is later recruited as the third member of the re-formed B-Komachi idol group.!~

name: Miyako Saitou
description:
Miyako is married to [the president](https://anilist.co/character/245521) of Ichigo Productions and is [Ai's](https://anilist.co/character/172759) manager. She is a shallow woman who appears to have only married her husband due to the prospect of working with hot guys. She is also a babysitter to the twins.

~!After Ai's death, she becomes the twin's adoptive parent. As the twins blossom into adolescence, she becomes more mature, both as a caretaker and as a manager. She is also the manager of the new B-Komachi.!~

name: Abiko Samejima
description: Author of "Tokyo Blade".

name: Taishi Gotanda
description: Taishi Gotanda is a movie director, and the "mentor" of [Aquamarine Hoshino](https://anilist.co/character/183885/Aquamarine-Hoshino). He still lives with his [mother](https://anilist.co/character/302910).

name: Pieyon
description: A famous physical training YouTuber affiliated with Strawberry Productions, where he is the agency's top earner. On request from company president Miyako Saitou, he promotes the new B-Komachi by collaborating with Ruby Hoshino and Kana Arima in a physical training video on his channel.

name: Frill Shiranui
description:
Frill Shiranui is a student in Ruby Hoshino's class. She is a multi-talented performer who can sing, dance, and act. At first, Ruby is in awe of her, yet they eventually become friends. 

 ~!She is the younger sister of [Koromo Shiranui](https://anilist.co/character/212391/Koromo-Shiranui) from [Kaguya-sama wa Kokurasetai: Tensaitachi no Renai Zunousen](https://anilist.co/manga/86635/Kaguyasama-wa-Kokurasetai-Tensaitachi-no-Renai-Zunousen/).!~

name: Minami Kotobuki
description: She's a classmate and friend of Ruby Hoshino. Minami is a Gravure model who uses a fake accent.

name: Melt Narushima
description: Model and actor affiliated with Sonic Stage Productions. He appeared while still an untrained, yet arrogant, actor on the TV Drama *I'll Go With Sweet Today*. Melt was then cast in the role of Kizami in the 2.5D Stage Play *Tokyo Blade*.

name: Yuki Sumi
description: Yuki Sumi is a model in 1st year of high school.

name: Taiki Himekawa
description: Award-winning stage actor affiliated with the Lala Lai Theatrical Company.

name: Yoriko Kichijouji
description: A mangaka and author of "Today will be sweet". She used to be [Abiko](https://anilist.co/character/237576/Abiko-Samejima)'s mentor.

name: Sumiaki Raida
description: Sumiaki Raida works for the company "Magic Flow". He is an executive producer on the 2.5D stage play *Tokyo Blade*.

name: Ichigo Saitou
description: Ichigo Saitou is the director of the agency Ichigo Production. He is the one who scouted [Ai](https://anilist.co/character/172759/Ai-Hoshino) and made her a star.

name: GOA
description: GOA is a popular scriptwriter.

name: Lala
description: An idol from a company that wants to scout [Ruby Hoshino](https://anilist.co/character/183884/Ruby-Hoshino) to become its idol.

name: Sakuya Kamoshida
description: Sakuya Kamoshida is an actor specialized in theater adaptations.

name: Kengo Morimoto
description: Third-year high schooler and professional musician signed with a record label. He writes all of the music and lyrics for his band and occasionally for others. He was a cast member of the reality dating show "LoveNow."

name: Masaya Kaburagi
description: Masaya Kaburagi is a TV and Web-TV producer.

name: Taishi no Haha
description: Mother of [Taishi Gotanda](https://anilist.co/character/245519).

name: Mana Suzushiro
description: Mana Suzushiro is an underground idol who decided to stop her show business career after seeing the new idol group B-Komachi on stage.

name: Yslat Han
description: He was a master of the game 'Pick Me Up' who went by the nickname of Loki and was ranked 5th in it. One day, he gets brought into the world of Taoneer as Han Yslat, a 1-star playable character.

name: Yvolka Strashur
description: She is a fire magician from a noble family.

name: Jenna Shirai
description: 1-star hero, who was summoned at the same time as [Han](https://anilist.co/character/298546). She learned archery from her father, who was a hunter.

name: Yurneth Syd
description: The King's Eye. She is from Niflheimr where [Han](https://anilist.co/character/298546) was the Master.

name: Edith Callen
description: A 3-star hero, she was a member of the Maned Wolf Party.

name: Aaron Delkard
description: A 1-star hero, he was summoned up in the 3rd cycle of the draft.

name: Tel
description: She has many names, but the one she gave to [Han](https://anilist.co/character/298546) was Tel.

name: Isel
description: Administrator of Taoneer. She is a fan of Loki.

name: Ridigeon
description: The King's Sword. He is from the Niflheim, where [Han](https://anilist.co/character/298546) was the Master.

name: Syris Agentheim
description: The King's Flame and Niflheim's only 4-star hero. She is from the Niflheim, where [Han](https://anilist.co/character/298546) was the Master.

name: Nihaku Geistfeld
description: The King's Bow. She is from the Niflheim, where [Han](https://anilist.co/character/298546) was the Master.

name: Belkist
description: A 2-star hero who is gifted, belligerent, fearless, and highly talented.

name: Muden Nidelk
description: The King's Spear. He is from the Niflheim, where [Han](https://anilist.co/character/298546) was the Master.

name: Nerissa Iyor
description: A 2-star hero who is cool-headed and composed. She is especially skilled in special actions like stealth, infiltration, and intel collection.

name: Shay Lathasterie
description: A 4-star hero, she was a knight before the draft.

name: Mormonte Carle
description: A 2-star hero, he worked as a mercenary before conscription.

name: Kanna
description:
__Height:__ 157 cm

[Koharu](https://anilist.co/character/342735/Koharu)'s mentor. She's known to be laid-back and often runs away from fights between cupids. However, she will do anything to let Koharu succeed.

name: Koharu
description:
__Height:__ 159 cm

A shy, inexperienced cupid, mentored by [Kanna](https://anilist.co/character/342734). Despite being new to the job, her insight gives her amazing matchmaking abilities.

name: Chiyo
description:
__Height:__ 149 cm

A reckless cupid who loves fighting other cupids more than anything. Her energetic nature seems to land her in trouble a lot.

name: Ena
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm

A cautious, yet strong-willed cupid. Having a fair amount of experience, Ena is determined to make sure the job of matchmaking is done well.

name: Aki Tamaki
description: [Koharu](https://anilist.co/character/342735/Koharu)'s best friend from high school. Aki is bold and brutally honest, unafraid to express her opinion. She confessed to Koharu right before the latter died.

name: Chisa Kotegawa
description:
Chisa Kotegawa is Iori's cousin and a first-year mechanical engineering student at Izu University. Chisa appears to more level-headed and serious compared to other characters. She has a clear dislike for rowdy behavior and can be quite hostile, especially when it is directed towards her (especially with Iori). She rarely takes part in drinking or crazy antics and is usually seen sitting off the side as an observer. She loves diving and looking at diving equipment. Chisa is one of three female students in her class idolized by her male classmates due to her major's lack of females.

~!It is later revealed that she and Iori are not related by blood since Iori's father is adopted by her maternal grandparent.!~

name: Iori Kitahara
description: Iori Kitahara is a first year Mechanical Engineering student at Izu University. Despite no initial interest, Iori comes to love diving and spending time with the members of the club, whom he becomes friends with and cares about despite their rambunctious behavior and endless crazy schemes.

name: Kouhei Imamura
description: A first-year Mechanical Engineering student at Izu University. He is [Iori](https://anilist.co/character/123182/Kitahara-Iori)'s best friend and a diehard otaku, perceived to be a lolicon by his acquaintances. He happens to be particularly obsessed with the little sister character trope (hence his obsession with [Shiori Kitahara](https://anilist.co/character/125928/Kitahara-Shiori)). While many are repulsed by his otaku lifestyle, he is indifferent to how he is perceived by others.

name: Azusa Hamaoka
description: Azusa Hamaoka is a third-year at Oumi University and is a part of the intercollegiate diving club with Izu University. Known for her very outgoing and exhibitionist personality, she displays particular friendship/comradeship to Iori.

name: Aina Yoshiwara
description:
Aina is a first year at Oumi Women's University. She joins Grand Blue Diving Club after getting to know Iori and Kouhei. She is a really shy girl and hates having to expose her skin. She soon becomes good friends with Chisa.

~!She used to wear strong makeups to appear attractive not realizing her very makeup was a turn-off for men. She was part of the Tinkerbell Tennis Club but she was always looked down upon and made fun of by her seniors. Iori and Kouhei came to her rescue when she had it enough during the Miss Izu Contest as she resorted to getting drunk and broke down in tears in front of them.!~

~!Iori's words after saving Aina from the depth of despair during the Miss Izu Contest moved her so much so that suddenly her heart skipped a beat for him. She soon finds herself having feelings for Iori but she has been keeping her feelings to herself and she is yet to tell Iori how she feels about him. Iori is also the reason why she approached Azusa to let her join Grand Blue Diving Club.!~

name: Sakurako Busujima
description:
She is a student at Oumi Women's University and the coworker of Iori Kitahara and Naomi Otoya. She has a crush on Otoya Naomi.
~!She was cheered up by Iori after Naomi rejected her confession. Soon after that, she has developed romantic feelings for Iori, of which he is unaware. She lip-locked him in front of Chisa and Aina during their second trip to Okinawa islands.!~

name: Nanaka Kotegawa
description: Iori's Elder Cousin. When Iori comes to Grand Blue he doesn't recognise her at first since she had become very beautiful and gets attracted to her only to find out later that she has become a siscon who smells her younger sister Chisa's after worn clothes and takes her photo all the time.

name: Shinji Tokita
description: He is a third year Mechanical Engineering student at Izu University.

name: Ryuujirou Kotobuki
description: He is a third year Mechanical Engineering student at Izu University.

name: Shiori Kitahara
description: She is a third year middle school student and the younger sister of Iori Kitahara.

name: Naomi Otoya
description: Otoya Naomi is a high school student who loves diving. He is the captain of the diving club at his school and the coworker of Iori and Sakurako.

name: Ushironomiya
description: He works as an associate professor at Izu University.

name: Shinichirou Yamamoto
description: He is a first year Mechanical Engineering student at Izu University. He is a chubby young man with short hair parted in the middle. He mostly seen wearing a plain t-shirt under a sweatshirt and sweatpants. He is really bent on the idea that he needs a girlfriend and he is a complete virgin

name: Kaya Mizuki
description: Famous voice actor and idol who is worshipped by Kouhei. Her real name is Maya.

name: Yuu Mitarai
description: One of Iori's classmates at Izu University. Unlike most of the others, Yuu is in a relationship with his childhood friend Rie, which his friends immediately attempt to sabotage once they find out.

name: Hajime Nojima
description: He is a first year Mechanical Engineering student at Izu University. Nojima is a tall and self-proclaimed handsome young man.

name: Kenta Fujiwara
description: One of Iori's classmates at Izu University. A muscular man who is jealous of Iori supposedly getting Chisa's affection.

name: Toshio Kotegawa
description: The owner of the diving shop Grand Blue and Iori's uncle. Toshio seems to have a jovial personality and is quite laid back, as he doesn't seem to mind all the havoc that the club members wreck when drinking and partying.

name: Kudou
description: The Captain of the Tennis Club "Tinkerbell" and a beautiful young man who is attracted to Azusa. Kudou is an arrogant womanizer that would do almost anything to achieve his goal. He tends to mistreat those whom he considers lowly.

name: Koharu Fuyutsuki
description: A freshman at a university in Tokyo, living in Tsukishima. She is always cheerful and positive. Her favorite drink is milk tea with a lot of sugar. She is blind.

name: Kakeru Sorano
description: Moved to Tokyo for college. He is shy and does not try to get involved with others. He is a reticent person. Lives in a student dormitory just a minute's walk from the campus.

name: Yuuko Hayase
description: A friend of Fuyutsuki. They often attend lectures together. She is interested in organizing school festivals and volunteering as a student after making her debut at university.

name: Ushio Narumi
description: Ushio Nanami is a roommate with Kakeru in the same dormitory. He is a surprisingly homelike (?) person. He is from the Kansai region and is good at making Monja-yaki.

name: Narrator
description:
This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. 

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

name: Aoteru Misumi
description: Aoteru is a young man from Ehime prefecture, with a deep knowledge of the previous Japanese era and a habit of quibbling. He intends to fulfill his promise to his wife [Saki](https://anilist.co/character/388636/Saki-Higashimachi) to unite Japan.

name: Yoshitsune Asama
description:
Born in August of the 39th year of the Yamato era, hailing from the capital of Wakayama. Held the positions of Assistant Armory Officer for the Frontier General's Unit and later Right Lieutenant General. 

Raised under his mother's rigorous "gifted education," he calls her "Mama" and is fiercely devoted to her—to the point of writing her biography. He is the heir to the main branch of the Asama family, a prestigious clan instrumental in the founding of Yamato. Driven by strong ambition and a desire for validation, he aims to end the Three Kingdoms era through his own efforts and become a figure respected by the entire nation.

While skilled in martial arts, he tends to look down on others and seeks to assert his superiority. When meeting new people or in formal settings, he abandons the Kansai-inflected Yamato dialect in favor of the "Eastern language" (standard Japanese) to project an image of superior intellect.

name: Yasuaki Kaku
description: The strategist of Yamato's Borderland General Corps. He is a master tactician who always stays one step ahead.

name: Saki Higashimachi
description: Saki is [Aoteru's](https://anilist.co/character/388635/Aoteru-Misumi) wife and a strong willed woman who hates dishonesty.

name: Denki Taira
description: The Lord of Home Affairs of Yamato. He poisoned the previous emperor in order to take control of the state, and he shows no mercy to anyone who upsets him.

name: Fuji Sansei
description: The emperor of Yamato, who is a puppet of the court with a cowardly and timid personality.

name: Yui Hirasawa
description:
__Height:__ 156 cm

Yui Hirasawa is one of the 5 main characters in K-ON!. She's also the main protagonist. She is the air-headed lead guitarist and vocalist of the band Ho-kago Tea Time.

Having misunderstood that "light music" equals "easy music" (like whistling), she joined the Light Music Club and picked up guitar with absolutely no prior experience. She plays a Gibson Pre-'08 Les Paul Standard '50s in Heritage Cherry Sunburst. She names it Giita, which quite literally means "guitar".

name: Mio Akiyama
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm

Mio Akiyama is one of the five main characters in K-ON! She is a passionate and technical left-handed musician and writer who serves as the bassist, second vocalist and main lyricist of the band Ho-kago Tea Time. She is a kind and warm girl, albeit very shy and sensitive. Despite her timid streak, she often finds herself as the voice of reason amongst her bandmates, who often rely on her sensibility when in trouble.
 
She plays a left-handed Fender Japan '62 Reissue Jazz Bass in 3-Tone Sunburst.

name: Azusa Nakano
description:
__Height:__ 150 cm

Azusa Nakano, nicknamed "Azu-nyan" by [Yui Hirasawa](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa), is a main character in the K-ON! series. She is a second year student at Sakuragaoka High School. She decided to join the Light Music Club after seeing the band's performance in the school festival, and thus became Ho-kago Tea Time's second guitarist.

Azusa plays a Fender Japan '69 Reissue Mustang in Candy Apple Red.

name: Tsumugi Kotobuki
description:
__Height:__ 157 cm

Tsumugi Kotobuki, otherwise known as Mugi is one of the 5 main characters in K-ON! She is a wealthy, cheery, cute girl with a gentle personality who plays the keyboard and is the main musical composer in the band Ho-kago Tea Time.

Mugi plays a Korg Triton Extreme 76-key keyboard, though she is also seen playing a Korg RK-100 keytar in the closing credits of the first season.

name: Ritsu Tainaka
description:
__Height:__ 154 cm  

Ritsu Tainaka, called Ricchan by [Tsumugi Kotobuki](https://anilist.co/character/19568/Tsumugi-Kotobuki) and [Yui Hirasawa](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa), is one of the 5 main characters in K-ON!.

She is the self-appointed president of the Light Music Club and the drummer of the band Ho-kago Tea Time. She was the one who rebooted the Light Music Club when it was on the verge of being disbanded, and has become the natural leader of the club since then.

Ritsu plays a yellow Rick Marotta Signature Yamaha Hipgig drum kit with an add-on floor tom (in the opening credits only) combined with a cymbal set from Avedis Zildjian, though is shown playing a white Yamaha Absolute Series drumkit in the anime's closing credits.

name: Sawako Yamanaka
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm 

Sawako is the adviser for the wind instrument club at Yui's school. An alumna of the school and a former member of the light music club, she does not want people to know she was formerly a member of a heavy metal band, thus she covers up by being mild and gentle to her co-workers and especially to students. She is forced to be the adviser of the light music club, as Ritsu blackmails her after the girls learn of her past, though it is unknown whether she stopped being the adviser for the wind instrument club as the story progresses. Though she has a mature and gentle demeanor in the school, Sawako, affectionately addressed as "Sawa-chan" by both Ritsu and Yui, displays a totally different, completely authentic character when she is alone with the light music club. In reality, she is a rather wild, lazy and quite an irresponsible teacher who enjoys dressing up the light music club in, sometimes embarrassing, cosplay costumes, much to the dislike of Mio. She names the club band ''After School Tea Time'' after the members take too long deciding on a name themselves, and to maintain the secrecy on her heavy-metal image. She once momentarily pitches in for Yui with her Gibson Flying V electric guitar. Sawako once owned a Gibson SG Standard guitar given by her dad's friend, but she kept it in the music room because she thought it was not in a playing condition anymore.

Her surname is taken from [the pillows](https://anilist.co/staff/100327/the-pillows) vocalist/guitarist [Sawao Yamanaka](https://anilist.co/staff/172230/Sawao-Yamanaka).

name: Ui Hirasawa
description:
**Height:** 154 cm 

Ui is [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa)'s younger sister, who begins the story as a third-year junior high school student, but later enters [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa)'s high school the following year in the same class as [Azusa](https://anilist.co/character/21173/Azusa-Nakano). Unlike her older sister, Ui is mature, responsible and handles household chores well, though she still shares a strong relationship with [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa) and has a great deal of love and respect for her older sister. Despite being a year younger than [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa), she is nearly identical to her with her hair down and is even once able to fool the club. She possesses some of her sister's musical gift, and has a great talent for playing the guitar—she became capable of playing with the rest of the light music club band after only a few days of practice ([Yui](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa) was sick, so Ui dressed up as [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa) to help the band out). She takes particularly good care of [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa) and strives to look after her even at the risk of her own health. Ui is actually considered as the ultimate groupie for her sister's band and supports them with all her heart. She occasionally provides a narrative to the story. She is in the same class as [Azusa](https://anilist.co/character/21173/Azusa-Nakano) and hangs out with her sometimes.

name: Nodoka Manabe
description:
**Height:** 158 cm

Nodoka is [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa)'s childhood friend and confidant who is a member of the school's student council. As a normal, well-mannered and intelligent girl, she is generally taken aback by the light music club's odd behavior, and easily gets annoyed with [Ritsu](https://anilist.co/character/19567/Ritsu-Tainaka) whenever she forgets to fill in the club's application forms. She shares the same class as [Mio](https://anilist.co/character/19566/Mio-Akiyama) in their second year, who appreciates her companionship tremendously, as being the only person [Mio](https://anilist.co/character/19566/Mio-Akiyama) knows in her class. In her third year, she becomes the student council president.

name: Jun Suzuki
description:
**Role:** Bassist
**Instrument:** Bass Guitar

Jun is [Azusa](https://anilist.co/character/21173/Azusa-Nakano)'s and [Ui](https://anilist.co/character/19571/Ui-Hirasawa)'s classmate who often hangs out with the latter. Jun is generally a playful and easygoing girl, but she is sometimes rude without realizing it, compelling [Azusa](https://anilist.co/character/21173/Azusa-Nakano) to reprimand her. [Ui](https://anilist.co/character/19571/Ui-Hirasawa) tries to get her to join the light music club but ultimately fails due to a strange visit to the club room. However, she starts to regret it when she hears about all the activities the club does. She has a pet cat and plays the bass. 

Jun has an older brother, Atsushi Suzuki, nicknamed Acchan by her. He plays the bass at a university and helps Jun on "secret training sessions" because she apparently "still sucks at bass".

name: Ton-chan
description: Ton-chan is a pig-nosed turtle that the Light Music Club keeps in the music room and serves as their ostensible mascot.

name: Ichigo Wakaouji
description: Ichigo Wakaouji is one of Yui Hirasawa's classmates from class 3-2. She has long brown hair, styled in low twintails and eyebrow length bangs, and is a member of the  Baton Club and an expert in it, able to teach the other members. She possesses a strong sense of justice, but because she never flatters, she is often misunderstood. She lives in her own world.

name: Himeko Tachibana
description:
Himeko Tachibana is one of the students from Class 3-2.

Himeko is a member of the school's Softball Club and has a part-time job at a convenience store. Her behaviour is that of any other high school girl, but she has in fact a warm-hearted and polite side. Yui Hirasawa, who sits next to her in class, quickly became attached to her.

name: Yui to Ui no Haha
description: [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa) and [Ui](https://anilist.co/character/19571/Ui-Hirasawa)'s mother. She is usually away with their father so [Ui](https://anilist.co/character/19571/Ui-Hirasawa) is left to do all of the chores and take care of [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa).

name: Jane
description:
Jane (stage name) is Death Devil's drummer and a former member of the Sakuragaoka High School's Light Music Club.

Like her friends, Jane highly cherishes her time within the Light Music Club and later their band Death Devil. She is a highly skilled drummer and dictates the rhythm during her band's performances. As a teenager, she appeared to be a bit timid as she clinged to Norimi Kawaguchi while she and her friends were scolded by their teacher Horigome. She had much shorter hair and usually wore the school outfit of the Sakuragaoka High School

As an adult, she is willing to play at the wedding of her friend Mihoko without concerns, unlike Sawako Yamanaka who is worried that her past might catch up to her.

name: Norimi Kawaguchi
description: She is a friend of [Sawako](https://anilist.co/character/19569/Sawako-Yamanaka)'s from back when they were in high school, and they were both in the light music club together as part of the band Death Devil.  She and [Sawako](https://anilist.co/character/19569/Sawako-Yamanaka) used to try to outdo each other on the guitar.  Her stage name is Christina.

name: Occult Club Member 2
description: The Occult Club Members are two unnamed girls who are members of their school's Occult Club. They both appear to be calm and mysterious and have many interests in bizarre phenomena. They have, however, a helpful side and can also show gratitude by smiling. The movie shows that they have a sense of humour, seen when they asked Yui to take a picture of "Nessie" as a souvenir from England and could barely restrain laughter.

name: Fumie Kimura
description: Fumie Kimura is one of the students from Class 3-2 during the second season of the anime.Fumie has been Yui's classmate in at least their first and third year of high school. She is very kind, as she allowed Yui to leave her duties to have more time to practice for the upcoming concert in season 1.

name: Satoshi Tainaka
description:
Satoshi is [Ritsu](https://anilist.co/character/19567/Ritsu-Tainaka)'s younger brother. He appears when [Ritsu](https://anilist.co/character/19567/Ritsu-Tainaka) is walking home with him from the movies. He then ventures of with a friend from school he saw on the way home. He seems to respect his sister [Ritsu](https://anilist.co/character/19567/Ritsu-Tainaka) but still acts like a normal boy. 
Satoshi seems to be a bit more mature than [Ritsu](https://anilist.co/character/19567/Ritsu-Tainaka), usually saying things like "Geez, be more careful next time" when he has to take care of the problems she caused. Satoshi knows Mio because she and [Ritsu](https://anilist.co/character/19567/Ritsu-Tainaka) have been friends for so long, but becomes shy when [Ritsu](https://anilist.co/character/19567/Ritsu-Tainaka) brings the rest of the Light Music Club home without telling him ([Ritsu](https://anilist.co/character/19567/Ritsu-Tainaka) supposed it as a "rebellious phase"). He is also curious about his sister's doing and eavesdrops sometimes at her door (for example, when Mio and [Ritsu](https://anilist.co/character/19567/Ritsu-Tainaka) were practicing for their class play, [Ritsu](https://anilist.co/character/19567/Ritsu-Tainaka) finds out that Satoshi is laughing outside her room as she practices her dialogue). He also dislikes cold weather. Although he sometimes laughs about his sister or tells her to be quiet when she practices in her room, he still respects her and asks her for permission to hang out with his friends.

name: Occult Club Member 1
description: The Occult Club Members are two unnamed girls who are members of their school's Occult Club. They both appear to be calm and mysterious and have many interests in bizarre phenomena. They have, however, a helpful side and can also show gratitude by smiling. The movie shows that they have a sense of humour, seen when they asked Yui to take a picture of "Nessie" as a souvenir from England and could barely restrain laughter.

name: Youko Sasaki
description:
Youko Sasaki is one of the students from Class 3-2
She has been Yui's classmate since their first year in high school. She is a gentle and quiet girl, but when she becomes fixated on something, the world around her disappears. She is a bona fide member of the Mio Fan Club and also the only one from Class 3-2. Her admiration for Mio knows almost no limits, but Mio's "extremeness", as Ritsu called it, is also too much for Youko to handle.

name: Maki
description: "Love Crisis" drummer.

name: Yui to Ui no Papa
description: [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa) and [Ui](https://anilist.co/character/19571/Ui-Hirasawa)'s father.

name: Nobuyo Nakajima
description: A student in Class 3–2 at Sakuragaoka High School. Nobuyo is a member of her school's Basketball Club and is sports-oriented. She talks loudly and is often the one who stirs up excitement in class. She is sociable and friendly, a close friend of Ushio Oota and Keiko Iida. Her parents own a liquor store, where she often helps out at work. She plans to work at the store permanently after graduating from high school.

name: Della
description:
Della (stage name) is Death Devil's bassist and a former member of the Sakuragaoka High School's Light Music Club.

Like her friends, Della highly cherishes her time within the Light Music Club and later their band Death Devil. She is a highly skilled bassist but does not feel superior to less skilled musicians, seen when she warmly smiled during Yui Hirasawa's apologies for her mistake. As a teenager, she appeared to be unfazed by criticism, seen when she and her friends were scolded by their teacher Horigome.

As an adult, she is willing to play at the wedding of her friend Mihoko without concerns, unlike Sawako Yamanaka who is worried that her past might catch up to her.

name: Akiyo Miyamoto
description: Akiyo Miyamoto is one of the students from Class 3-2 during the second season of the anime. Akiyo is a reserved girl who does not talk much and who likes hanging out at the school's library due to her liking for books. She was deeply touched by the Light Music Club's performances at the school festivals. She has the habit of praising the Light Music Club, although in a very common way, stating its members and activities are "fun".

name: Sakura Matou
description:
__Height:__ 120 cm (Fate/Zero), 156 cm (Fate/stay night)

A student in her first year of high school, Sakura is the sister of [Shinji Mato](https://anilist.co/character/501). After [Shirou](https://anilist.co/character/496)'s father [Kiritsugu](https://anilist.co/character/10010) died, Sakura often visited Shirou's home to help him with his daily chores. She is outwardly shy and timid, but possesses great inner strength. Sakura has a long standing and obvious crush on Shirou Emiya.

name: Rin Toosaka
description:
__Height:__ 124 cm (Fate/Zero), 159 cm (Fate/stay night)

Rin is a model student and idol of [Shirou](https://anilist.co/character/496)'s school. She barely talks to other students in her school and exhibits a desire to be left alone, as exemplified by her tendency to stay on the school's rooftop, away from the rest of the students. She is also secretly a Magus and a Master in the Fifth Holy Grail War. In the beginning of the anime, she summons [Archer](https://anilist.co/character/2087) for her Servant, although she originally wanted to summon Saber.

Rin is reared as the successor to her family's magecraft, instructed by her father, [Tokiomi Tohsaka](https://anilist.co/character/16017), to prioritize sorcery over her own interests. After her father is killed, Rin continues to perfect her sorcery, with some guidance from her guardian, [Kirei Kotomine](https://anilist.co/character/506). She strives to earn the admiration of her peers to avoid drawing attention to her private life, even though she is secretly stingy, tomboyish, and a perfectionist. She is perceptive, resourceful and avidly competitive.

~!Rin is [Sakura](https://anilist.co/character/500/Matou-Sakura)'s older sister, but the two were forced to live apart by their father, Tokiomi. Rin once had a good relationship with Sakura before their separation, evident by a ribbon Sakura always kept. Rin later convinced herself that Sakura was living a happier life with the Matou family than she was living as the Tohsaka family heir, and this delusion blinded her to the knowledge that Sakura was only barely keeping her own sanity in check while constantly suffering. Rin went as far as to try to preserve Shirou's life for what she thought was entirely Sakura's sake. Rin had also decided that she would kill Sakura in the events of the Holy Grail War if it came down to it. However, ultimately, she could not bring herself to do it and took the blow without harming her.!~

name: Artoria Pendragon
description:
__Height:__ 154 cm (5'1)

Artoria Pendragon, better known as Arthur Pendragon and King Arthur, is regarded as a male in history but is actually female. She is the "Once and Future King" and a legendary hero of Britain known as the King of Knights. She used to wield the sword from the stone, Caliburn, but it was eventually destroyed and the Lady of the Lake gifted her with Excalibur and Avalon.

__In Fate/Prototype:__ ~!He is presented as male instead, conserving his original name of Arthur Pendragon. Also called Prototype Saber, he is the Saber-class Servant under the control of [Ayaka Sajyou](https://anilist.co/character/54223).!~

__In Fate/stay night:__ ~!Saber is summoned in the Fifth Holy Grail War as the Servant of [Shirou Emiya](https://anilist.co/character/496). Shirou had been having dreams of Excalibur in the days leading up to the start of the Holy Grail War after receiving his Command Spells and, while stumbling in his shed during his escape from [Lancer](https://anilist.co/character/499), Avalon, hidden inside him, reacts to the traces of a magic circle and summons Artoria as his Servant.!~

__In Fate/stay night: Heaven's Feel:__ ~! Corrupted by [Angra Mainyu](https://anilist.co/character/120855), Artoria is vastly different from her normal self. She is also called Saber Alter/Black Saber. The results of her alteration is not only within Artoria's interior but also extends to her outward appearance. The color of her skin becomes pale, and the pupil of her eyes that were at first concealed behind a black visor during the moment of her summoning becomes golden from her original green eye color as well. Because the armor she wears was dyed jet black and grew in weight due to changing into a heavier armor, its power has increased more than normal.!~

 __In Fate/Zero:__ ~!Saber is summoned by [Kiritsugu Emiya](https://anilist.co/character/10010) to participate in the Fourth Holy Grail War on behalf of [Jubstacheit von Einzbern](https://anilist.co/character/16027) and the Einzbern family. Kiritsugu partners Saber with [Irisviel von Einzbern](https://anilist.co/character/15164), to act as Saber's Master in the open while he acts from behind to win with his own methods.!~ 

__In Fate/Grand Order - First Order:__  ~! She remains the corrupted version, known as Saber Alter.!~

__In Fate/Grand Order Camelot:__ ~!The being called Goddess Rhongomyniad came into existence in the world that [Bedivere](https://anilist.co/character/8941), due to the wish of wanting his King to not perish after the battle of Camlainn, refused to throw Excalibur back into the Lake even after the third time.!~

name: Gilgamesh
description:
__Height:__ 182 cm

Gilgamesh is the King of Uruk, said to have reigned during the Sumer Dynasty in Mesopotamia 5000 years ago. He's the namesake Hero described in the Epic of Gilgamesh, making him the most ancient Hero on which all the others legends were modeled. This grants him the title of King of Heroes and, within his Gates of Babylon, the prototypes of all the Noble Phantasms of the Heroes yet to come. 

Born from the human Lugalbanda, the King of Uruk, and the goddess Rimat-Ninsun, he was a being so perfect and transcendent to the point that he was two-thirds deity and one-third human. He was the chosen one that would guide humanity on the earth that was slowly abandoning the Age of Gods, but instead he grew up to be a selfish and arrogant despot.

His only friend and being he considered his equal was [Enkidu](https://anilist.co/character/60059).

__In Fate/Zero:__
~!
Initially summoned as the Archer-class Servant of [Tokiomi Toosaka](https://anilist.co/character/16017/Tokiomi-Toosaka) in the 4th Holy Grail War, using the fossil of the first skin ever shed by a snake as a catalyst, he soon becomes bored with his Master and takes interest in Kirei Kotomine. Together they plot to kill Tokiomi and forge a new pact, with Gilgamesh pushing Kotomine to accept his true desires. He also takes interest in Iskandar as a worthy opponent to kill, and in Artoria, a tragic figure to take as his bride. 

In the end, invested by the pollution of the Holy Grail, he is gifted a mortal body and is reincarnated in the world. !~

__In Fate/strange Fake:__
~!
Within the World of Fate/strange Fake, Servant Archer Gilgamesh was previously summoned in the Fourth Fuyuki Holy Grail War and participated in the Fifth Fuyuki Holy Grail War. But the Servant summoned in the False Holy Grail War is a new Servant without any memories of the Fuyuki Holy Grail Wars. 

He is the first Servant summoned in the True and False Holy Grail War as the "False" Archer-class Servant of [Thine Chelc](https://anilist.co/character/87307/).
!~

name: Shirou Emiya
description:
__Height:__ 167 cm 

Shirou is the main character of Fate/stay night. He is a serious yet helpful, hardworking, and honest teenager. His hobbies include fixing a variety of broken things, from VCRs to stoves, as well as cooking and cleaning. He is initially confused about the Holy Grail War and attempts to irrationally shield others from danger, including his own Servant, [Saber](https://anilist.co/character/497)

name: Archer
description:
__Height:__ 187 cm (6'1)

__In Fate/stay night UBW:__  
~!He is the Servant of one of the series' main heroines, [Rin Tousaka](https://anilist.co/character/498/Tohsaka-Rin). Due to an incomplete summon, he apparently has no memory of his previous life or identity. Archer is sarcastic and cynical but under his hardened exterior lies a complex and dark personality that unfolds throughout the story. Though skilled with ranged weapons, he can hold his own in melee combat. Archer considers [Shirou Emiya](https://anilist.co/character/496/Emiya-Shirou)'s idealism to be weak and delusional, recognizing the mentality of "wanting to save everyone" as naive and impossible.

Archer is actually a future version of Emiya Shirou, who became a hero through Emiya's wish to save innocent lives. After his death he became a Counter Guardian, a Spirit deployed to maintain balance and prevent humanity's extinction, but without the ability to act on his own he was forced to kill and face the fact that his ideals were not realizable time and time again. 

To escape this cycle the only hope for EMIYA was to be summoned as a Heroic Spirit and kill his past self before he became a Counter Guardian, which would cause a time paradox and release him from the cycle.!~

__In Fate/Grand Order - First Order:__ 
~!EMIYA was Blackened, a process by which a being is tainted by an outside force, causing their personality to be reversed toward the orientation of evil!~

name: Kirei Kotomine
description:
__Height:__ 185 cm (Fate/Zero), 193 cm (Fate/stay night)

~!Through an agreement between the Mages' Association and the Church, the Holy Grail Wars are moderated by a priest. Kirei's father was the mediator for the 4th Holy Grail War, and when he died, Kirei felt obligated to replace him. His selection as mediator is unusual, for Kirei is a member of both the Church and Mages' Association, organizations on hostile terms with one another.

Since the death of [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/498/Tohsaka-Rin)'s father, he has also acted as an indirect caretaker for Rin.!~

name: Illyasviel von Einzbern
description:
**Height:** 133 cm
**Birthday in [Fate/kaleid](https://anilist.co/manga/33526/): **Jul 20

A young Teutonic aristocrat, she traveled to Japan to participate in the Holy Grail War as a Master. Illyasviel has an angelic appearance and an unsurpassed degree of magical power. She lives in a castle on the outskirts of Fuyuki City, accompanied only by her Servant and two maids. Illyasviel asks those she feels comfortable around to simply call her "Illya".

name: Medusa
description:
~!Medusa is a Greek mythological figure described as a winged human female with living venomous snakes in place of hair. Those who gazed upon her face would turn to stone.
 
With her older sisters [Stheno](https://anilist.co/character/191058/Stheno) and [Euryale](https://anilist.co/character/191065/Euryale), they made up the three Gorgon Sisters who inhabited the Shapeless Isle. She came into existence thanks to the thoughts and prayers of humans, who desired a perfect goddess, but she was cursed for her beauty and turned into a monster hated by all. She is thus not a Heroic Spirit but a monster closer to a Divine Spirit. 

Due to her nature, she can manifest through different aspects depending on which disposition is predominant (more or less monstrous)!~
 
__In Fate/stay night:__
~!She is the Rider-class Servant of [Shinji Matou](https://anilist.co/character/501/Matou-Shinji) in the Fifth Holy Grail War of Fate/stay night.!~

__In Fate/stay night: Heaven's Feel:__
~!She only truly acts as [Sakura](https://anilist.co/character/500/Matou-Sakura)'s Servant when their connection is revealed in Heaven's Feel.!~

__In Fate/Grand Order - First Order:__
~!She is a Lancer-class Servant. Medusa is Blackened, a process by which a being is tainted by an outside force, causing their personality to be reversed toward the orientation of evil.!~

__In Fate/Grand Order: Absolute Demonic Front Babylonia:__
~!In this singularity Medusa manifests as two separate beings: 

One is Ana, a Lancer-class Servant without a Master. This incarnation represents the young Medusa, from a time when she wasn't known as the monster inhabiting the Shapless Ile. Though still wary of humans for casting her away, she is much closer to the perfect Goddess she was supposed to be.

The other one is Gorgon, an Avenger-class Servant. This incarnation represents Medusa as a man-eating monster. The burning hatred against the humans that exiled her and her sisters led her to become the very monster they accused her to be. Gorgon wields Tiamat's Authority which grants her the ability to generate Demonic Beasts.!~

name: Taiga Fujimura
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm 

She is an English teacher at [Shirou's](https://anilist.co/character/496/Emiya-Shirou) school, homeroom instructor of Shirou's class and the supervising teacher for the archery dojo. After [Kiritsugu](https://anilist.co/character/10010/Emiya-Kiritsugu) died, Taiga became Shirou's guardian and has been living with him for several years. Taiga and Shirou are very close, and she regards him as a younger brother.

She's initially distrustful of [Saber](https://anilist.co/character/497/Pendragon-Artoria), believing that "some strange woman was trying to take Shirou from her" as she put it. She becomes exasperated whenever a new girl appears at Shirou's house, thinking he stashes girls at his house. Taiga always shows up for breakfast and dinner at Shirou's house to have some of [Sakura's](https://anilist.co/character/500/Matou-Sakura) cooking, and always saves some scraps from breakfast for her lunch.   

~!During Rider's Blood Fort attack on Shirou's school, Taiga was the only person who could still move around somewhat. Begging [Shinji Matou](https://anilist.co/character/501/Matou-Shinji) for help, he quickly kicks her in the head, knocking her unconscious. She recovers quickly though, even pigging-out on hospital food while recovering.!~

name: Heracles
description:
__In Fate/Stay Night:__
~!The Servant of [Illya](https://anilist.co/character/503/von-Einzbern-Illyasviel), he is a swarthy giant with adamantine skin and gross brawn. He wields a colossal stone Axe-Sword, and is capable of causing massive destruction with the mere backlash of his swings. As a Berserker, he was stripped of his sanity and reason, acting feral and animalistic in combat. Berserkers are praised as members of the "Strongest" class, though they are difficult to control. Illya, however, appears to have little trouble managing Berserker.!~

name: Shinji Matou
description:
[Sakura Matou](https://anilist.co/character/500/Matou-Sakura)'s older brother, and a long-time friend of [Shirou](https://anilist.co/character/496/Emiya-Shirou). Shinji is very popular as vice-captain of the archery dojo despite being chauvinistic and a narcissist. Like [Rin Tohsaka](https://anilist.co/character/498/Tohsaka-Rin), he is of a distinguished lineage of sorcerers, though the Matou blood has thinned and no longer produces heirs naturally capable of sorcery.

Shinji feels uncomfortable with his sister's daily visits to Shirou's home.

He has an open crush on Rin, but she does not return his favors.

name: Hassan-i-Sabbah
description:
One of the nineteen leaders of the Hashshashin sect who took the name Hassan-i-Sabbah and the mantle of Old man of the Mountain.

In battle, this individual employs throwing daggers and has modified his body with the hand of an evil spirit which curses humans to death.

name: Zouken Matou
description: A shrewd, powerful, but ancient sorcerer, Zoken is the patriarch of the Matou family and is known to be the grandfather of Shinji and Sakura. He has amassed a large and extensive library of sorcerous knowledge, yet his lessons are strict and harsh. Zoken considers Shinji to be a disgrace of a sorcerer and believes Sakura may have more potential than her brother.

name: Rock Holmes
description:
Rock is a recurrent character in Osamu Tezuka's manga series, and he is an important part of Osamu Tezuka's Star System. Rock is a young boy with shiny dark hair. He first appeared in the manga series Detective Boy Rock Holmes, as a child detective. While most of other Tezuka child characters stayed the same age, Rock grew up throughout the years and his character was reused for more mature "roles" in Tezuka's manga, where he gradually developed a darker personality.

Often cold and brutal, his character tends to be used as an antagonist, who later, in works such as Phoenix, kidnapped and murdered people. In this older form, Rock is often wearing a three-piece suit, a striped tie and dark sunglasses, the last of which became something of a trademark for him.

Best known to American audiences for his dark and violent roles in the Metropolis movie and second volume of Alabaster, Rock is sometimes good, sometimes evil, but always determined, absolute and charismatic.

name: Gaou
description: One-eyed and one-armed young man Gao, an ancestor of Saruta, turns into a murderous bandit when he is rejected by his village.

name: Dr. Saruta
description: Like Dr. Ochanomizu, Saruta is visually identifiable by his large nose, though in his case it is grotesquely spotted. Where Ochanomizu generally appears in light and uplifting roles, Saruta is quite the opposite. His two main roles in Tezuka manga are both in extremely important series: Black Jack and Phoenix. In Phoenix, he is arguably an over-arching protagonist for the series as a whole, alongside its title character. He appears in every story, sometimes in a main role, sometimes in a peripheral one, sometimes with a new name and barely recognizable in his character, but always present and important. He is also distinguishable by the sheer amount of suffering he undergoes over the course of his many lives and deaths, as he demonstrates both the darker sides of human nature and the human capacity for perserverance and transcendence.
