An esteemed painter without any fixed style who was once blind: Kanami Ibuki. After miraculously having her vision restored, she became a painter as a way of portraying the beauty she witnesses. Along with her prior blindness, Kanami has bad legs and is unable to walk around much, if at all, thus she sits in a wheelchair-like apparatus. Since she was blind, she's had a caretaker, Shinya Sakaki. Once her vision returned, Shinya taught Kanami how to paint, though was swiftly surpassed by her.

Kanami is a rather quiet person, keeping herself neat and tidy, though she is more than capable of talking, even arguing, with others. She doesn't get along well with others and can easily hate other people, though she hates Akane Sonoyama the most. Besides that, Kanami can have calm conversations with Ii or apologize if she goes too far.  When conversing with Ii, she often says, "You didn't know?," as a catchphrase.

Kanami is a harsh artist, and will not hesitate to destroy a piece she's made. If the art's audience cannot describe what makes it good, she considers it worthless and simply shrugs it off. 

Akane and Kanami often verbalize how much they hate each other even with the slightest of mention. Kanami, however, respects Akane's position, but hates her as a person. On the contrary, Akane hates painters but doesn't particularly hate Kanami herself. ~!Their hate for each other seems to be a ruse, as the two jokingly switched identities for fun prior to arriving on Wet Crow's Feather Island!~ ~!After Kanami is decapitated, it's revealed that she and Akane swapped identities. In the end, the real Akane is dead and the real Kanami continues to live on as Akane. It's implied that the original Kanami who was blind was replaced by the current Kanami as the blindness magically fixed itself. The true identity of Kanami, and now Akane, is unknown, though it seems Shinya has always been her accomplice.!~

name: Iria Akagami
description:
The heiress to the Akagami Foundation who is exiled on Wet Crow's Feather Island: Iria Akagami. A girl that is absolutely fascinated by geniuses, wishing to be around them for their impressive minds. As such, she invites geniuses from all around the world to live with her for periods of time. On top of letting others live on her estate, Iria also pays them a hefty amount to live there, should they accept. Upon learning about Jun Aikawa, she becomes utterly infatuated by her and believes she is a genius among geniuses.

Iria is emotionally immature and not too sophisticated as her position and wealth may suggest. At times, it's not rare to see Iria pull tricks for her fun. Besides that, she has not too much trouble being social and friendly, though she can give others the cold shoulder at times. When it comes to Rei Handa and the Chiga triplets, she considers them family and loves them very much. ~!Iria is said to suffer from D.L.L.R. Syndrome, where she wishes to harm others. Teruko Chiga states that she killed her twin sister, Odette Akagami, which caused Iria to be exiled. This was later proven to be false, making the actual reason for her exile to be unknown.!~ ~!When Ii and Kunagisa are going back to the mainland, it is revealed that Iria and Rei switched places. She states that the only reason she did it was for the sake of entertainment and that she wanted to see if anyone noticed, much like Ii did by chance.!~

name: Hikari Chiga
description:
The second oldest of the Chiga triplets, Hikari is a maid that resides on Wet Crow's Feather Island. Like her sisters and Rei Handa, Hikari has vowed to serve Iria Akagami no matter what may occur.

Out of the triplets, Hikari is much more down to earth and is quite friendly to others. Known to be a haggler and has a bit of mysophobia, the latter assisting her in keeping the mansion extra clean. ~!After the second decapitation, Hikari is considered to be the prime suspect. Ii and Kunagisa disagree, believing she wouldn't have murdered someone. Once the teams are formed, Ii, Kunagisa, and Hikari develop a friendly relationship. During which time, Kunagisa declares them all friends, making Hikari's first friends to be Ii and Kunagisa.!~

name: Rei Handa
description:
The head maid and Iria Akagami's trusted assistant: Rei Handa. Not much is known about her, though it's assumed she's been with Iria for the longest and shares a strong bond with her. Besides that, like the Chiga triplets, Rei has chosen to stay with Iria no matter what.

Rei herself is a calm individual with the polite attitude of a maid. Ii initially believes she may be cold, though that quickly dissipates after having a friendly conversation with her. ~!While Ii is on his way back to the mainland with Tomo Kunagisa, it's revealed that the Rei attending with him is actually Iria. Iria and Ii reveal that the "Iria" that was around on Wet Crow's Feather Island is actually Rei and that they switched for fun and to see if anyone would notice. Ii guessed this as the actual Rei threw Hikari Chiga under the bus, which wouldn't make sense for Iria to do, along with a few other details.!~

name: Yayoi Sashirono
description:
A genius chef that has been an attendant of Wet Crow's Feather Island for the longest out of anyone else: Yayoi Sashirono. Acting as the island's main chef, she makes exquisite meals that are rumoured to be impossible to recreate even with a recipe. When Yayoi was younger, she opted to become a chef as she has phenomenal tasting and smelling abilities, able to discern much more flavours and scents than the average person. On top of that, she is able to figure out a person's  from tasting their sweat. 

Unlike most of the other island residents and guests,Yayoi herself is down to earth and exuberant. Despite her great abilities as a chef, she is not arrogant whatsoever and just enjoys cooking. ~!As the decapitations occur, Yayoi is greatly affected unlike the others, and becomes extremely paranoid. She, along with Ii and Tomo Kunagisa solve the mystery of the decapitations and throw a ruse to catch the culprits.!~

name: Akari Chiga
description:
The eldest of the Chiga triplets, Akari acts as one of the four maids on Wet Crow's Feather Island. As with the other maids, Akari has vowed to serve Iria Akagami, despite anything that happens.

Contrasting Akari's twin sisters, she has a somewhat unstable personality. Normally, she is alright and acts like a proper woman, though she is known to get violent when things go awry. Despite this, she is quite sharp of a person.  ~!After the second decapitation, Akari busts into Kunagisa's room and punches Ii, blaming him for the death. She later apologizes, stating that her emotions got the better of her because it was happening again. Later, the two have an awkward tension between one another.!~

name: Shinya Sakaki
description: The attendant that came with Kanami Ibuki to Wet Crow's Feather Island as her caretaker: Shinya Sakaki. A friendly man that assists Kanami when needed, though she can be stubborn. He cares for Kanami greatly, yet does speak ill of her personality towards others. He considers himself and Ii to be similar as they both aren't geniuses and are companions of actual geniuses, though the similarities end there. Originally, Shinya was the one that taught Kanami how to paint after her vision was restored. ~!As Akane and Kanami switched places, Shinya knew and was assisting Kanami, now acting as Akane, with her plans. In the end, he helped the real Kanami escape the locked room and didn't care if others died. Jun Aikawa states that Shinya has likely been with Kanami for a long time, and has been with her even before she claimed the original Kanami's identity.!~

name: Odette Akagami
description: The late, younger twin sister of Iria Akagami. Odette died in her teenage years, before Iria resided on Wet Crow's Feather Island. ~!Odette is said to have been killed by her sister Iria, though she firmly denies that she caused her death, despite her saying she killed her with her own two hands. Rather, Iria states her sister died on her own. The event was witnessed by many others, as Iria had killed Odette without warning, while others were watching. After the event, Iria went to Sparrow's Fetched Bamboo Mountain to lay low, until she was eventually led to Wet Crow's Feather Island.!~

name: Gintoki Sakata
description:
__Height:__ 177 cm  

A samurai living in an era where a samurai is no longer needed. To add to his troubles, oppressive aliens have moved in to invade. Gintoki lives with [Kagura](https://anilist.co/character/674) and [Shinpachi](https://anilist.co/character/673), taking on odd jobs to make the world a better place...and to pay their rent. In the Joi war, he was known as the "White Devil" (Shiroyasha) due to his silver hair and white coat he wore in battle, which, combined with his impressive capabilities as a swordsman, made him famous among his comrades and struck fear into Amanto.

Gintoki has naturally permed silver hair, which he blames for his lacking love-life. He has a big crush on the TV's news weather girl, [Ketsuno](https://anilist.co/character/6225). In fact, to date, the only time he is seen to have blushed is when he tries to make use of [Sadaharu](https://anilist.co/character/2651) and Ketsuno's dog to get a chance to talk to her. Though several female characters have shown an interest in Gintoki, he usually does not show any response back and merely puts up with them as annoyances.

Gin has two major obsessions in life. He is obsessed with sweet foods such as parfait, ice cream, and cake. His second obsession is reading the manga anthology magazine Weekly Shōnen Jump. (Which, not coincidentally, is where Gintama is published in). His favorite type of milk is strawberry milk. Gin will go to great lengths to get the latest Jump issue, to the point of reckless behavior. His Jump obsession makes him easily dream of being like other Jump heroes, including wishing that he had a "Bankai" similar to the hero characters of Bleach.

Despite his appearance and initial behavior, Gintoki has a great amount of pride for the old Bushido code. He takes it upon himself to rescue or avenge not only his comrades and friends but also people he barely got acquainted too, be it a pit-fighter who was taking care of abandoned orphans or an Amanto who resembles a kappa.

Despite being a fearsome fighter with nearly unmatched skills, he avoids needless bloodshed after suffering the loss of most of his friends and allies during the Joi war.

name: Kusuo Saiki
description:
**Height:** 167 cm

Kusuo Saiki has an extremely uncaring, neutral personality. As a gifted psychic that can do anything he wants, he has long stopped caring about the world; however, he has shown to be extremely cautious, as he often runs from [Nendou](https://anilist.co/character/90108), the only person he fears and is prone to immediately teleporting to faraway places upon spotting an insect. Saiki has a sweet tooth, so he loves sweets, especially Coffee Jelly.

Fourteen days after his birth, Kusuo uttered his first word without moving his mouth and 1 month after birth he took his first step in midair. At the age of 1 was the first time Kusuo has voluntarily used his abilities, when his mother said they were out of mirin, Kusuo teleported away and returned with several bottles of mirin.

Kusuo Saiki is a gifted psychic. Having obtained his powers since birth, the first signs of Saiki's powers came from when he was able to hear the voices of his parents and he subsequently telepathically spoke back to them. Two months later, he demonstrated the ability to walk in the air. Saiki has stated that in three days, he can wipe out humanity. The full extent of all of his abilities is unknown.

name: Kagura
description:
__Height:__ 155 cm

Although she appears to be a normal, cute, human girl in Chinese-style clothing, she actually belongs to the Yato Clan, one of the strongest and most bloodthirsty of the Amanto races. The Yato is said to have "transparent" skin that is highly sensitive to sunlight, so Kagura carries a purple parasol at all times. The parasol is also the Yato clan's weapon of choice; Kagura's is bulletproof and fires bullets from its tip. Because of her Yato blood, she is super-strong and can stop a speeding motor-scooter with one hand. Although stronger than most humans, she cannot control her strength perfectly. Her super-human strength makes her extremely bad with pets. Most of her pets, with the exception of [Sadaharu](https://anilist.co/character/2651/Sadaharu), have met with an untimely demise at her hands.

She is also extremely flexible and fast; capable of catching multiple speeding bullets between her teeth and fingers. During a battle, she's often seen flipping through the air and performing various acrobatic feats. Due to her Yato blood, she is capable of rapid regeneration. During the Benizakura arc, she is seen healing from a gunshot wound almost overnight.

Kagura also has an unusually strong appetite. She is able to consume large quantities of food within a matter of seconds. Nevertheless, her tastes are endearingly plain. Sukonbu, rice, and eggs are among her favorite foods.

Her immediate family consists of her father, [Umibouzu](https://anilist.co/character/9876/Umibouzu), a widely recognized alien hunter, her mother, who is deceased, and her older brother [Kamui](https://anilist.co/character/12946/Kamui), once presumed missing who is now involved with the space pirates Harusame.

She came to Earth to earn money for her family. She found work fighting for a gang, but when they ordered her to kill her target, she ran away. Not long afterward, she met [Gintoki](https://anilist.co/character/672/Sakata-Gintoki) and [Shinpachi](https://anilist.co/character/673/Shimura-Shinpachi) when Gintoki accidentally ran her down with his scooter. After they helped her to make a clean break from the gang, she intimidated Gintoki into hiring her. She now lives at the Yorozuya and sleeps in Gintoki's closet, like [Doraemon](https://anilist.co/character/4304/Doraemon).

Kagura and Gintoki share an odd father-daughter-like relationship. Together with Shinpachi, the three of them make for a strange, dysfunctional, yet tightly knit family. Kagura is very protective of Gintoki. Although, she herself has gotten into many fights with him, rarely does she let anyone else pick on him. She seems to trust wholeheartedly in Gintoki's ability and strength. Even in sticky situations, she has no doubt that Gin-chan would come to save her. She has a tendency to imitate Gintoki's bad habits, and would often quote the bad advice he gives her. Some of her lines start with "Gin-chan says..." or "Gin-chan told me..."

Kagura is also somewhat of a tomboy. She is often seen partaking in games with various neighborhood boys. Although her candid manner of speech often causes them to shun her, she doesn't seem to mind. In fact, she has no problem at all with forcing her way into their game. In battle, she has proven to be bull-headed and a sore loser. Like Gintoki, and probably because of his influence, she is not above resorting to petty tricks and manipulation to get the better of her adversary. Unlike many conventional manga heroines, she doesn't display the same consciousness toward decorum, table manners, ​and physical appearance. Puking, cussing, picking her nose, spitting, fighting, and scratching herself is common behavior for Kagura.

She regards [Okita](https://anilist.co/character/2282/Okita-Sougo), captain of the Shinsengumi, as a rival. She detests him, and appeared to be disgusted when she previously mentioned (about Okita), that "he definitely likes me", but as that hasn't been brought up since, it is uncertain if it should be considered canon, that he apparently likes her.

According to the OVA, Kagura is the first and only Weekly Shonen Jump girl to vomit on-screen. To date, she has induced herself to vomit on several occasions. She also has an uncanny knack for seeming calm or detached during high-tension situations; in episode 5, she slept through a car-chase. Her appetite knows no bounds, and she is especially fond of sukonbu.

In Japanese, Kagura speaks in a stereotypical dialect that is associated with Chinese immigrants. In the English-translated manga, she punctuates her sentences with yup, uh-huh, nope, and the like.

~!In the Yoshiwara in Flames arc, Kagura meets her older brother, Kamui who abandoned her because she was weak in his eyes.!~ In the last Gintama character popularity poll, she came in 6th place.

name: Shun Kaidou
description: Shun is a young man who considers himself to be the "Jet-Black Wing", a lone hero fighting against the evil organization Dark Reunion. He also believes his powers stem from a dark being living within his arm. To his friends and peers, including [Saiki](https://anilist.co/character/90107/Saiki-Kusuo), he's simply an immature kid playing a game that only he understands.

name: Narrator
description:
This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. 

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

name: Riki Nendou
description:
Nendo has a simple way of thinking, but because of it, [Saiki](https://anilist.co/character/90107/Saiki-Kusuo) is unable to read his mind. Because Saiki is unable to detect Nendo's presence, Nendo is the only person who is able to sneak up on Saiki and making him think he will someday be a dangerous foe.

Nendo believes he is a friend of Saiki, but this is definitely not the case as Saiki despises Nendo. Saiki would often compare Nendo to a bug, as bugs are one of the few animals that Saiki cannot read the minds of.

name: Kokomi Teruhashi
description: Kokomi Teruhashi is a student in [Kusuo's](https://anilist.co/character/90107/Saiki-Kusuo) class, considered very attractive by both women and men, who often stop and stare upon seeing her.

name: Aren Kuboyasu
description: Kuboyasu in his previous school wore the typical delinquent clothes. He sported a pompadour hairstyle, and wore a modified school uniform with his pants looking more like an over-sized skirt. After moving to PK Academy, Kuboyasu changed his looks into more of a normal student like wearing glasses and dyeing his hair dark violet. In school, he wears the standard uniform of male students in PK Academy while in days off, he wears long sleeves; possibly to hide his scars which were first seen by Kaidou.

name: Shinpachi Shimura
description:
__Height:__ 166 cm

Shinpachi Shimura works under [Gintoki](https://anilist.co/character/672/Sakata-Gintoki) to learn the ways of the samurai. He used to stay at his family's dōjo. However, it seems more like he's just trying to help Gintoki pay the rent than to learn. Shinpachi is the captain of the "Otsu's Imperial Guard," a pop singer's fan club.

Shinpachi meets Gintoki after Shinpachi was tripped by the ambassador of Planet Chatoran. Gintoki beats up the ambassador and his guards, not to stand up for Shinpachi, but to get revenge for his spilled parfait. Gintoki frames Shinpachi for the crime, which somehow led to him saving [Tae Shimura](https://anilist.co/character/2944/Shimura-Tae) (Otae), Shinpachi's sister, from becoming part of a brothel.

Despite his meek appearance, Shinpachi is a more than competent swordsman of his family's Kakidō-Ryu, the type of swordsmanship his dojo teaches.

name: Mikoto Aiura
description:
__ Height:__ 166 cm

Aiura is a gyaru soothsayer, or someone who is able to foresee the future. She is another love-interest of [Kusuo](https://anilist.co/character/90107/Saiki-Kusuo)'s and transfers to PK Academy upon reading her own fortune and learning that her "Mr. Right" would be there. After witnessing him save [Yumehara Chiyo](https://anilist.co/character/90115/Yumehara-Chiyo) from a possibly deadly fall, she deduces that Kusuo is the one she's been looking for. Also as a result, she becomes one of the few people outside of his family that knows of his powers.

name: Elizabeth
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm

Elizabeth resembles a giant white duck or a giant penguin and is [Katsura's](https://anilist.co/character/1533/Katsura-Kotarou) companion. Elizabeth was a present from [Tatsuma Sakamoto](https://anilist.co/character/2945/Sakamoto-Tatsuma), who presumably picked it up on his travels around space. Although many people consider Elizabeth to be insane and extraneous, Katsura has named the ambiguous avian "Elizabeth" and dotes on it. Elizabeth is something of a painter, and is surprisingly dexterous. Also, Elizabeth resorts to using signboards to "communicate", as well as an occasional means of attack. Elizabeth is also a skilled fighter, able to use signboards to fight off swordsmen.  

Although the true identity of Elizabeth is uncertain, it appears to be a man wearing a duck costume. In its first appearance, hairy legs are seen underneath her sheet and the body of a humanoid with glowing eyes is revealed as her mouth is opened just as it fell during another battle between [Gintoki](https://anilist.co/character/672/Sakata-Gintoki) and Katsura. Although Katsura seems shocked at what she really is, she has subsequently remained by his side. Episode 50 implies that the person inside Elizabeth is most likely the director (Gintoki was interrupted before he can finish being cut off at "Kanto-" ("Direc-"). Most of the characters seem to ignore this, or at least do not give it much thought, given at the episode was completely filler.

name: Reita Toritsuka
description: Another psychic and one of two people outside of [Saiki](https://anilist.co/character/90107/Saiki-Kusuo)'s family to know of his abilities. He has the ability to see spirits and is haunted by the ghost of [Nendou](https://anilist.co/character/90108/Nendou-Riki)'s late father, but is only interested in using his ability to attract girls.

name: Kineshi Hairo
description: An overly hot-blooded, energetic, passionate student who enjoys sports and is constantly trying to get other people motivated. He is also [Saiki](https://anilist.co/character/90107/Saiki-Kusuo)'s class representative, but due to his nature, he is well-trusted by his classmates.

name: Kurumi Saiki
description: Kurumi Saiki is Saiki's lovely mother.

name: Kusuke Saiki
description:
__Height:__ 179 cm

Kusuke is [Kusuo](https://anilist.co/character/90107/Saiki-Kusuo)'s older brother and a super genius who likes to invent machines/devices. Kusuke is prideful and competitive when it comes to Kusuo. He would have done anything to win against him when they were kids, but he would always lose against his little brother. This led to him being addicted to playing/fighting with Kusuo.

name: Kuniharu Saiki
description: Kuniharu Saiki is the father of Kusuo and Kusuke and the husband of Kurumi.

name: Chiyo Yumehara
description: A romantic and dreamy girl who easily falls in love with boys. She originally has a crush on Kusuo and tried her best to appeal to Kusuo. Kusuo in turn rejected her as hard as he could with his PSI powers. Kusuo even went as far as hooking her up with someone else but the relationship abruptly failed. She later develops a crush on Kaidou after he saved her from the unwanted attention of some guys at the beach.

name: Chisato Mera
description: Chisato Mera is a classmate of Kusuo's. She works part time in Cafe Mami as a waitress.

name: Metori Saiko
description: Metori Saiko is the scion of the top-notch Saiko Conglomerate. He later transfers to PK Academy after falling in love with [Kokomi](https://anilist.co/character/90109/Teruhashi-Kokomi) when he was in the city. His defining traits are being rich and smug.

name: Touma Akechi
description: Touma Akechi, used to be a classmate and one of the very first friends [Kusuo](https://anilist.co/character/90107/Saiki-Kusuo) had in Kindergarten. He is a 3rd student in PK Academy that knows of Kusuo's powers.

name: Anpu
description:
Anpu shows up a couple of times and is also part of the “everyone else loves me so why doesn’t Saiki” brigade. After being saved by Kusuo, he starts to visit his house to make Kusuo pet him. He once got Kusuo (disguised as Sai) to aid him in trying to woo a female cat Pushi. Later on, Kusuo pets him after Anpu saved him from a chasing cockroach.

(Source: Saiki Kusuo no Psi Nan Wikia)

name: Kumagoro Saiki
description: Kumagoro Saiki is the husband of Kumi Saiki, the father of Kurumi, the father-in-law of Kuniharu Saiki and grandfather of Kusuo Saiki and Kusuke Saiki. Kumagoro is a grumpy old man who hates Kusuo's father Kuniharu and loves his daughter Kurumi. He is actually a tsundere who truly wants to dote on his grandchildren.

name: Kouta Nakanishi
description: He's a homeless magician that first appeared playing tricks in the street with his partner Michael. Basically Chouno goes in and out of being a homeless failure and a semi-successful magician. Saiki ends up helping him out every once and a while just on a whim, but doesn’t think very highly of him. Chouno has seen some of Saiki's powers, but thinks it's just stage magic. Because of this, he treats Saiki like a veteran illusionist and even calls him "master". At his most successful, Chouno had a weird comedy magic act going on.

name: Makoto Teruhashi
description:
A top idol and Kokomi's older brother. He has a serious sister complex and hates it when Saiki is near her.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Yuuta Iridatsu
description: A  neighborhood boy. He first met Saiki Kusuo after his balloon got blown up high and the latter caught it for him. He got attached to Kusuo and Kokomi in the later chapters. He is one of the few aware that Saiki has powers, but doesn't know he's a psychic.

name: Iruma Suzuki
description:
__Rank:__ ~!As of now in the Manga, Iruma achieved Rank [5] *He*.!~
__Familiars:__ ~!His very first and only familiar is a demon named [Callego Naberius](https://anilist.co/character/135021/Callego--Naberius), whom he managed to summon in the form of a flying owl in episode 2 of the series.!~

A human boy whose parents sold him to a demon named [Sullivan](https://anilist.co/character/135023), who subsequently transports him to the Demon World and adopts him as his grandson. He starts his new life by being enrolled into Babyls Demon School, where he constantly has to hide the fact that he is a human in order to avoid being eaten. However, after quickly making friends with fellow classmates [Asmodeus](https://anilist.co/character/135022/Alice-Asmodeus) and [Clara](https://anilist.co/character/135019/Clara-Valac), he eventually grows accustomed to his new lifestyle through both his numerous adventures and encounters with other demons.

name: Ameri Azazel
description:
__Height:__ 190cm
__Rank:__ ~!As of now in the Manga, Ameri has achieved rank [6] *Vav*.!~ 
__Relatives:__ [Merize](https://anilist.co/character/326718) (Mother), [Azazel Henri](https://anilist.co/character/155682/Henri-Azazel) (Father)
__Familiars:__ ~!It is yet unknown.!~ 
__Inherited Magic:__ ~!Romanticist: Ameri can pull out her utmost power by trusting in her own strength, making it the Azazel Family's mightiest buff magic as it releases all of their power without limit. Because it is the greatest kind of self-hypnosis, it may be a double-edged sword that can even harm the user if they are afraid of the opponents they confront.!~

Ameri is the president of Babyls' Student Council. She is convinced humans exist, despite them only being myth in the demon world, and believes [Iruma](https://anilist.co/character/135018) to be one. Ameri hides the fact that she enjoys manga, "the forbidden books of the human world", and has Iruma read them to her in secret.

~!During the Student Council Training Arc is revealed that she is in love with Iruma!~

name: Clara Valac
description:
__Height:__ 153 cm
__Rank:__ ~!As of now in the Manga, Clara has achieved rank [4] *Daleth*.!~
__Familiars:__ ~!Falfal: a green-looking creature that is very eccentric, much like its owner.!~
__Inherited Magic:__ ~!Dimensional pockets: Clara can flawlessly duplicate or conjure any thing or object she has previously seen and pluck it out of one of her skirt pockets.!~

Clara is one of the stranger students at the school, acting very much like an excited child. She has abundant energy that most students can't keep up with. Other students find her weird and hard to deal with, but are drawn to her because her inherited power is so convenient. Since she had no friends, she would give students snacks and drinks as "payment" for playing with her. She is the second friend [Iruma](https://anilist.co/character/135018) made at Babyls.

name: Alice Asmodeus
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm
__Rank:__ ~!As of now in the Manga, Asmodeus has achieved Rank [5] *He*.!~
__Familiars:__ ~!Gorgon Snake: a dragon snake that can manipulate fire.!~
__Inherited Magic:__ ~!Fire Magic: Alice has exceptional and effective control of fire magic. Furthermore, he may utilize it both offensively (through fireballs or a sword made of flames) and defensively (by the ability to make fire barriers). He also gained the ability to produce blue flames, which are thought to be more powerful than his usual flames.!~

Alice Asmodeus is the top student of his class at Babyls. His rank and power exceeds those of most other freshman. For a very short time, he was antagonistic, but later became [Iruma's](https://anilist.co/character/135018) first and closest friend.

name: Opera
description:
__Occupation:__~!Security Devil, Babyls Teacher!~

Sullivan's servant who does the chores around the house.

Opera was Kalego's upperclassman when they were both students at Babyls.

Opera has a serious, down to earth personality. They often act as a voice of reason for Lord Sullivan, but are usually ignored. They are mostly reserved with their opinion, but will voice the occasional concern or cynical remark, and will sometimes dispense helpful advice.

Their interactions with Kalego reveal that they have a somewhat more mischievous and sadistic side not normally shown in their professional behavior, which was especially prominent when they were students at Babyls.

name: Kalego Naberius
description:
__Rank:__ Chet (Anime & Manga)
__Height:__182 cm
__Inherited Magic:__ Cerberion
__Relatives:__ [Naberius Narnia](https://anilist.co/character/287564/Naberius-Narnia) (Older Brother)
__Occupation:__ Teacher

[Iruma Suzuki](https://anilist.co/character/135018/Suzuki-Iruma)'s Familiar/Contracted Demon

The homeroom teacher of the Misfit Class, and one of the prestigious professors at Babyls Demon School. Derisive, snappy, and short-tempered, he strongly dislikes demons who are boisterous, brash, and inconsiderate of others, believing them to be troublemakers. As such, he is generally pessimistic when dealing with his students. 

Due to how the familiar summoning spell works with humans, Kalego unwillingly becomes Iruma's familiar for a year. When summoned, Kalego appears as a fluffy white creature resembling a small crow, complete with black bat-like wings, black horns, and his distinctive front hair curl.

name: Sullivan
description: Sullivan is the adoptive grandfather of [Iruma](https://anilist.co/character/135018) and the principal of Babyls. He is one of the Three Heroes, the most powerful and influential demons in society, and is a possible candidate for the new Demon King. He's a Tet (9) Rank.

name: Keroli Crocell
description:
__Height:__ 155 cm
__Rank:__ _Bet_ (Anime), ~!_Daleth_ (Manga, Season 4)!~
__Inherited Magic:__ Ice Surface
__Familiars:__ Blizzard Wolf, Snow King Fox

Keroli is a student at Babyls Demon School. She is in the same class as Iruma, the Misfit Class. Normally under the guise of an ordinary-looking freshman student, she has an Akudol alter-ego named Kuromu. Around school, she wears big, rounded glasses that have the ability to disguise her appearance to other demons. When she is acting as Kuromu, she wears a wig.

name: Lead Shax
description:
__Height:__154 cm
__Rank:__ ~!As of now in the Manga, Lead has achieved rank [4] *Daleth*.!~ 
__Familiars:__ ~!Clever Monkey.!~ 
__Inherited Magic:__ ~!Controller: Lead is capable of stealing one of the target's five senses and adopting it as his own.!~

A cheerful guy who is often seen playing some kind of game. He himself admits that he is addicted to gambling as well as games, and even chooses a battler that allows him to indulge in his hobbies

name: Shichirou Balam
description:
Mythical Zoology teacher at Babyls. He's close friends with [Kalego](https://anilist.co/character/135021/Naberius-Kalego) as they were classmates in the past. He's a Cheth (8) Rank.

~!Iruma mindlessly confesses he is a human while being impressed by Balam's kindness. The teacher chooses to protect his secret.!~

name: Kiriwo Amy
description:
__Species:__ Demon
__Birthday:__ Deviler 13th
__Height:__ 162 cm (5'4")
__Rank:__ _Bet_ (Anime & Manga)
__Inherited Magic:__ Barrier
__Affiliation:__ Babyls Demon School (Formerly)
__Battlers:__ Magical Apparatus Battler (Formerly)

Kiriwo is a physically and magically weak demon. Despite being an upperclassman at Babyls Demon School, he is only a Beth (2) rank. He hopes to develop tools that will help other weak demons like him be treated fairly.

~!Despite his harmless appearance, Kiriwo actually enjoys seeing people in despair and plots to destroy Babyls along with Baal, but his plan ends up failing due to Iruma's interference.!~

name: Bachiko Barbatos
description:
__Rank:__ Tet (presumed)
__Occupation:__ Tutor
__Inherited Magic:__ Full Marks
__Height:__ 120cm

Robin's cousin. She becomes Iruma's mentor and teaches him archery.

name: Sabro Sabnock
description:
__Height:__ 220 cm
__Rank:__ _Bet_ (Anime), ~!_Daleth_ (Manga, Season 4)!~
__Inherited Magic:__ Weapon Creation
__Battlers:__ Demon King Battler

Sabro is the second son of a prestigious family. He dreams of becoming the next Demon King and sees Iruma as a rival after the Rank placement exams. Sabro is a Bet (2) Rank and his familiar is a Kelpie.

name: Jazz Andro
description:
__Inherited Magic:__ Pit (Furtive Glance)
__Familiar:__ Split Wolf
__Height:__174 cm

Jazz is a Gimel Rank and has the pickpocketing ability.

~!He is promoted to rank Daleth after the music festival.!~

name: Soi Purson
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm
__Inherited Magic:__ Detection Warding
__Current Rank:__ ~!Daleth [4] (Anime), Daleth [4] (Manga)!~

He is a classmate of [Iruma Suzuki](https://anilist.co/character/135018/Suzuki-Iruma) and the 13th student in the Misfit Class.

Although he was enrolled from the very beginning, his official introduction did not occur until the final event of the first-year curriculum. ~!This is because his bloodline ability is "Detection Warding," and the Purson family are a clan of covert operatives who have long held the principle of "never standing out" as their highest virtue.!~

~!While usually quiet and expressionless, he is actually an unstoppable chatterbox once he starts talking. He has a playful, spirited personality and—despite his deadpan look—possesses a fun mindset that allows him to handle both the "straight man" and "funny man" roles in comedy. He uses a perception-blocking ability to gather all sorts of dirt on his classmates, yet he remains a gentleman toward the girls. Like any guy his age, he wants to be popular with girls and dreams of having a cute girlfriend. He finds it baffling that his homeroom teacher is popular with the ladies (or so it seems). He harbors resentment toward male students and teachers who have girlfriends or are popular with girls—a sentiment that becomes particularly pronounced when he’s had a drink.

However, having lived a life trying to stay under the radar, he tends to monologue endlessly and struggles with the give-and-take of conversation (a fact he is well aware of). He was given a trumpet by his mother in childhood; whenever he felt an urge to talk but couldn't, he would play the instrument instead. Consequently, he is a highly skilled trumpeter capable of rapid-fire playing that mirrors his talkative nature. It is his daily routine to play on the school rooftop after classes end, a performance that has become a signal for the end of the school day. Because no one knows what he looks like, the students call him "Pixie."!~

name: Alikred
description: __Rank:__ _Gimel_ (Anime), He (Manga) __Height:__ 20 m __Occupation:__ Ring of Gluttony (Avatar) __Affiliation:__ [Iruma Suzuki](https://anilist.co/character/135018) The physical embodiment of the Ring of Gluttony.

name: Elizabetta Ix
description:
__Species:__ Demon
__Rank:__ Aleph (Anime), Daleth (Manga)
__Inherited Magic:__ Favorability
__Familiar:__Floral Papillion
__Height:__ 176 cm

Elizabetta is a demon and student at Babyls. She is a member of the Misfits Class.

Elizabetta can be described as calm and collected. She often likes to take the back seat in the midst of the various shenanigans of the Misfits Class, rarely instigating anything herself. However, she appears to greatly enjoy their antics, participating when her assistance is requested.

name: Picero Agares
description:
__Current Rank:__ _Aleph_ [1] (Anime), _Daleth_ [4] (Manga)
__Inherited Magic:__ My Area

A student at Babyls who is lazy and is always sleeping/napping on a cloud. He wears an eyemask.

Unexpectedly, he's extremely good-looking (ikemen) without his eyemask.

name: Amuryllis Asmodeus
description:
__Height:__ 192 cm
__Rank:__ Tet (9)

Amuryllis is a member of the Thirteen Crowns. She's [Alice](https://anilist.co/character/135022/Asmodeus-Alice)'s mother and [Raim](https://anilist.co/character/154373/Raim)'s mentor. She is a very doting mother, finishing her work and going to the school festival for her son in order to spend some time with him. True to both her name and title, she has a somewhat of a lewd mind, asking [Iruma](https://anilist.co/character/135018/Suzuki-Iruma) if his firework is an erotic tool.

name: Eiko Oni
description:
Eiko is a freshman student attending Babylus Demon School. She constantly tries to have a conversation with Iruma Suzuki ever since he saved her but fails every single effort throughout the series. She's somewhat sociable, as she's usually seen casually talking to multiple unnamed background characters, but mainly hanging with her close group of friends.

She is shy when talking to people she admires, such as when she attempts to thank Iruma for saving her, on multiple occasions. In this way, she appears polite and kind in nature.

name: Robin Balse
description:
__Inherited Magic:__ Bullseye Shot

Robin is a new teacher at Babyls who teaches the students how to bond with their familiars.

name: Shiida
description:
Shiida helped Iruma when he got lost at the Amusement Park.

~!It is later revealed she is a member of the Six Fingers.!~

name: Suzie Stolas
description: Suzie is one of the staff of Babyls Demon School. She works as both Diabotany Teacher and Event Coordinator/ Announcer (together with Dali Dandalion) at the school, as well as manages the Diabotany Division.

name: Romiere Ronove
description:
__Rank:__Hé 
__Inherited Magic:__Charisma

Romiere Ronove is a demon attending Babyls. He is the head of the Discipline Department, a rival to the Student Council. He has aspirations of replacing the current Student Council President Ameri Azazel.

name: Goemon Garp
description:
__Inherited Magic:__ Wind Blade
__Height:__ 173 cm

A student at Babyls Demon School and a member of the Misfit Class who ends his sentences with -de gozaru. He is willing to help others without anything in return and he is very persistent in most situations.

name: Shuumei Sasaki
description:
__Height:__ 183 cm
__Likes:__ Sweets

Sasaki is [Miyano](https://anilist.co/character/164752/Miyano-Yoshikazu)'s senior in high school. He's a 'bad-boy' who doesn't cause much trouble. He got introduced to BL manga through Miyano.

name: Yoshikazu Miyano
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm

He's really sensitive about his girlish features, and he's a hardcore fudanshi.

name: Akira Kagiura
description: He's [Hirano](https://anilist.co/character/209018/Hirano-Taiga)'s roommate. He's part of the basketball team and is in love with Hirano.

name: Masato Hanzawa
description: He's president of the student council.

name: Jirou Ogasawara
description: [Sasaki](https://anilist.co/character/164753/Sasaki-Shuumei)'s classmate and friend, he's a bad boy. He shares the same music taste as Sasaki, has a girlfriend, wears an ear cuff, and has blue-dyed streaks in his hair.

name: Juuya Niibashi
description: He is Kagiura's classmate and friend. A member of the art club.

name: Ao Ichinose
description: He is Hirano's roommate from his first year. He is a year older than Hirano.

name: Violet Evergarden
description:
__Height:__ 161 cm

Violet is described as a very beautiful young woman, being almost doll-like in appearance, with light-blue eyes, a fair complexion, and a slender frame. She is noted for her womanly semblance. She has waist-length golden hair with locks that frame her face. She either has her hair untied, in a low ponytail, or, after becoming a Doll, pulled up into two braided buns with two red ribbons. Due to losing her arms in the war, Violet received maneuverable prosthetic arms made of adamant silver. After the end of the war and on normal occasions, Violet is often seen wearing a white blouse, a green skirt and a pair of heeled brown boots.

~!Growing up as an orphaned child soldier in the army who was treated as a mere tool, Violet was not educated like a regular human being and did not understand human feelings well. She was raised and grew up as a person who had feelings, but couldn't perceive or express them. For this reason, she could be mistaken as emotionless, or apathetic. Even before she was found and taken into the army, she couldn't speak or understand speech, only understanding orders to kill. She did not possess any sense of right or wrong from the start; she didn't understand what could be considered righteous or erroneous. She merely chased after the adults who gave her orders. She followed the idea of "kill or be killed," thus she could kill countless people without feeling guilt or remorse. She did anything that was asked of her and always followed orders, which was a trait from her life as a soldier. Even after the war ended and she was discharged from the military, Violet had a habit of using words back from her life as a soldier; saluting, disliking being defenseless, and doing tasks without taking any breaks. She also continued to think of herself as a "tool" and believed that it would be appropriate to discard her if she can no longer be used as a weapon.!~ 

Violet is also aloof, expressionless and is said to have the attitude and the presence of a doll. Her expressions are mostly deadpan, so it is hard to tell her mood changes. This is why she sometimes has trouble expressing her own feelings and comes off as expressionless, which makes it difficult to get through her, but she will give a smile from time to time. Through her work as a Doll where she helps people write heartfelt letters, she slowly learns about human emotions, leading her to become more skilled at writing letters and conveying her clients' feelings, as well as becoming understanding of others. She is proven to be a good listener and someone who always thinks about other people's happiness.

name: Benedict Blue
description: Benedict Blue (ベネディクト・ブルー, Benedikuto Burū?) is a character in the Violet Evergarden series. He is a postman working at the CH Postal Company. He has known Hodgins since before the company's establishment and has had a brusque attitude towards him since he started working there.

name: Cattleya Baudelaire
description: Cattleya Baudelaire is a character in the Violet Evergarden series. Being a figurehead Auto Memories Doll who works for the CH Postal Company, Cattleya never stops being requested and often takes on clients with love troubles. She works alongside [Violet](https://anilist.co/character/90169/Evergarden-Violet) and has been close with [Hodgins](https://anilist.co/character/124799/Hodgins-Claudia) since before the company was established, joining as one of its initial employees.

name: Claudia Hodgins
description:
A former army commander. He founded the CH postal company and serves as president.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Iris Cannary
description:
Iris Cannary is a character in the Violet Evergarden series. A rookie Auto Memories Doll with an unyielding spirit who works at CH Postal Company, Iris admires young working women and is enthusiastic about quickly making a name for herself in the industry.

~!As a child, she became friends with a boy named Emonn Snow and the two were very close. Iris was in love with him, and she had also supposedly convinced herself that her feelings were reciprocated. Because of that, she confessed to him before they graduated school, but he rejected her confession. The emotional pain caused by Emonn's rejection was what caused her to leave her hometown to become an Auto Memories Doll.!~

name: Luculia Marlborough
description:
Luculia is a graduate of the Auto Memories Doll Training School and a novice Auto Memories Doll. Luculia and Violet became friends as fellow classmates at the training school, and she is the one who helped Violet graduate and earn her licence.

She is shown to be a kind and considerate person who is willing to go out of her way to assist others, such as her offering Violet some of her food the first day they met as well as attempting to help her write a letter to Gilbert. Despite a tragic backstory, she is shown to carry a positive attitude and cheerful demeanor when around other people, but tends to be more quiet and solemn when alone. She is expressive and sociable, but she struggles to communicate her own feelings, particularly regarding her brother.

name: Isabella York
description:
Isabella York is the daughter of the York family that is closely related to the Drossel Royal Family. She had trouble fitting in with the nobility as she can't follow etiquette and mannerism of the nobles in her school, making her some sort of outcast.

~!She is an illegitimate daughter of the York family, she used to live in poverty with her adopted sister, Taylor Bartlett. Before becoming Isabella York, she goes by the name of Amy Bartlett. The condition she proposed to the York family is to take care of Taylor in exchange for her cooperation to become the daughter of York family!~

name: Erica Brown
description:
Erica Brown is a character in the Violet Evergarden series. She is an Auto Memories Doll who has been working at the CH Postal Company for a while. She is not good at communicating and isn't confident in her work.

~!Erica is an anime-original character.!~

name: Taylor Bartlett
description:
Taylor Bartlett is Amy Bartlett's adoptive sister. Her sister, Amy picked her up from the streets despite barely managing to make ends meet for herself.

~!When Amy was taken as the York's daughter, Taylor was sent to an orphanage where she spent years apart from her sister, Amy. It's not until Benedict delivered Amy's letters to her that she start to reminiscence the day she spent with her sister, Amy.!~

name: Tiffany Evergarden
description: An old woman who wants to take in Violet after being contacted by Gilbert. She has lost her son during the war.

name: Yu
description:
Yu is the main character of The Boxer. He becomes a professional boxer under the tutelage of the legendary [K](https://anilist.co/character/208937/K).

Yu has a very dark and melancholic appearance, with unstyled jet-black hair that drapes down loosely on his head, distinctively coal-black eyes with even darker pupils and a wholly disinterested facial expression painted on his face with an equally 'dead' look in his eyes. He has a very skinny body which belies his deceptively athletic abilities.

Yu has a startlingly emotionless and disinterested persona, taking little to no interest in anything other than his pet cat. He is shown to be alarmingly apathetic, simply taking hits because he couldn't be bothered to dodge them and giving zero response when threatened by an obviously vicious person.

name: Yuto Takeda
description: Yuto is known as a positive person, always looking at the bright side. He's very motivated and doesn't give up despite all the obstacles he had faced. He's motivating not only himself but also those around him, helping them at the same time.

name: Jean-Pierre Manuel
description: Jean-Pierre Manuel (쟝 삐에르 마뉘엘, Jyang Ppieleu Manwiel) is a professional boxer and the former boxing lightweight world champion.

name: Carmen
description: She was hired as Yu's bodyguard before his fight with Santorino, she is also K's assistant.

name: K
description: He is a legendary boxing trainer, having raised 5 boxing world champions. He is currently training Yu.

name: Aaron Tide
description: Aaron Tide is the Heavy Weight World Champion. He was trained under Coach K but currently fights under a different gym.

name: Fabrizo Santorino
description: Santorino Fabrizo bears the title of Middle Weight Champion. He is famous for using tricky moves and cheats.

name: Marco Santorino
description: Marco Santorino is [Fabrizio Santorino](https://anilist.co/character/209083/)'s older brother as well as coach. He is known for his dirty fighting tactics.

name: Viktor Grigoryevich
description: Viktor Grigoryevich is the current Cruiser Weight World Champion.

name: Misaki
description: Misaki (미사키, Misaki) is the boxing coach of current light welterweight world champion Takeda Yuto.

name: John Taker
description: John puts on a decidedly confident and somewhat cocky air in public, with a great enjoyment in taking down talented young boxers with promising careers. To this end, he believes that bending the rules is more than okay if it leads to winning in the end.[1] He looks up to the middleweight champion boxer, Santorino Fabrizo, calling the man a true warrior on another level and saying he deserves more respect from people.

name: Gilbert Einstein
description: Previous Cruiserweight World Champion before Viktor Grigorievich.

name: Kasim Al-Hajad
description: Kasim is a swaggering, spoilt, and arrogant man with an extravagant showboating personality in and out of the ring, bringing about controversy and polarization in the Boxing world by merely participating. At any recourse, Kasim's first course of action is to try to throw money at the problem, paying people to spar with him and proposing to simply buy out the Boxing organization he competed in to change the rules to allow for illegal moves he performed out of ignorance.

name: Josh
description: Josh (조시, Josi) was once a member of the Lions Boxing Club with dreams of becoming a professional boxer. However, after being annihilated by Yu, Josh gave up on his dream and currently works as a bartender.

name: Siha Lee
description: Siha Lee is a character in The Boxer universe. He was a boxing prodigy who was able to become one of the best boxers in Korea across all weight classes, being undefeated for 9 matches straight, with many top-ranking boxers unable to do anything against him, all of them suffering a crushing defeat by his hands. He was praised for his ability to memorize attack patterns, rhythms, timing, and everything about his opponents in a single round, using it all against them in the second round.

name: Osamu Dazai
description:
**Height:** 181 cm (5'11")
**Ability:** No Longer Human

A member of the Armed Detective Agency. He's a suicide enthusiast who searches for a place to die. However, he doesn't like pain, and would prefer a lovers' suicide with a beautiful woman. He's aimless, elusive, nonchalant, and jokes around normally, but, when he is serious, it is clear that he is an insightful and intelligent individual. He loves to annoy his fellow Agency member, [Kunikida](https://anilist.co/character/89200).

~!He was a former Executive of the city's worst underworld organization, the Port Mafia.!~

name: Ranpo Edogawa
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm (5'6")

The great detective of the Armed Detective Agency. He possesses sharp observation skills that are acknowledged by his coworkers, and he settles difficult cases at the request of the police. Because of his self-confidence, his speech is brazen and child-like. His motto is "If you'll have me, everything will be ok!" He likes logical thinking and fantastic tales.

name: Ryuunosuke Akutagawa
description:
__Height:__ 172cm (5'8")
__Likes:__ Curios and antiques, tea, figs
__Dislikes:__ Bonsai trees, dogs, baths

"The weak will die. Die, and make way for others."
A member of the notorious "Port Mafia" that operates by the harbor. Akutagawa has a black and white "survival of the fittest" view of the world, claiming that weak people should die and give way to the stronger ones. His ability is called "Rashōmon" (羅生門).

He is not afraid of pain and defeat, if only to hear a word from a "certain person". His ruthless, vicious nature makes him one of the Port Mafia's most dangerous members, feared by both ally and foe. Much of the obedience he receives from subordinates of Black Lizard , and the Mafia in general, largely stems from fear of his short temper and general intolerance of incompetence. 

In chapter 87,
~!it is revealed that Akutagawa doesn't have much time left to live, as he is suffering from a vital lung disease.!~

In chapter 88 of the manga,
~!Akutagawa turns undead, being bitten by Bram Stoker after a fatal blow which results in his death.!~

(Source: Bungou Stray Doys Wiki, Anime News Network)

name: Sakunosuke Oda
description:
__Height:__ 185 cm (6'1)
__Ability:__ Flawless

Was a member of the Port Mafia. Oda was a man described as kind, despite working for the mafia, by [Dazai](https://anilist.co/character/89198/Dazai-Osamu). He had an incredibly perceptive side to him that allowed him to come the closest to understanding Dazai, whom he referred to as "his dear friend, who had grown tired of the world and is simply waiting to die."

~!It is his understanding of Dazai's loneliness, as well as his regret of not being able to do anything about it, that prompted him to leave behind the last words that became the trigger for Dazai deserting the mafia in favour of carving a brighter path for himself, something that Oda wanted to do.!~

name: Ougai Mori
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm
__Ability:__ Vita Sexualis

Ougai Mori is the boss of the Port Mafia. Ougai is analytical and tactical. He often puts on overdramatic acts but rarely breaks his composure internally. 

He has been shown to be somewhat ruthless and unfaltering when it comes to violence. He hasn't, however, shown any particular enjoyment from killing. His ruthlessness comes from his pragmaticism.

Although he can be intimidating at times and emit a scary formal aura, he is often polite to the point of seeming approachable. He is polite to allies and enemies alike.

name: Ango Sakaguchi
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm
__Ability:__ Discourse on Decadence 

Port Mafia's former exclusive informant. Works as an assistant counselor at the Special Ability Department at the Ministry of Internal Affairs.

For the most part, Ango is a composed, calm young man, showing more restraint than [Osamu Dazai](https://anilist.co/character/89198/Dazai-Osamu) and more discipline than [Oda Sakunosuke](https://anilist.co/character/120625/Oda-Sakunosuke). Although he values both as genuine friends, he strongly believes that Dazai needs someone to keep him from acting out as much as he does.

name: Ryuurou Hirotsu
description:
__Height:__ 178cm
__Ability:__ Falling Camellia

Member of Port Mafia, "Black Lizards" Assault Unit Captain. His ability, Falling Camellia, cause things that he touches to fly backward with immense force.

name: Andre Gide
description:
the leader of a criminal organization from Europe known as Mimic.

Due to his actions in Dazai Osamu and the Dark Era, he is considered as one of the main antagonists.

name: Sawako Kuronuma
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm  (5'2")

Sawako is a shy and honest high school girl who in search of friendship, though her resemblance to Sadako from _The Ring_ makes this difficult.

Sawako tends to take things too literally and often over-analyzes situations. Her quiet nature makes it hard for her to socialize, and leads to her classmates spreading rumors and having negative misconceptions about her, to the point where many of them think her name is actually Sadako. Fortunately, Sawako is gradually able to open up to her classmates and talk to different people. With help from [Kazehaya](https://anilist.co/character/13531/Kazehaya-Shouta), [Yano](https://anilist.co/character/13533/Yano-Ayane), and [Yoshida](https://anilist.co/character/13532/Yoshida-Chizuru), she gradually begins to make friends. 

~!When Kazehaya practically confessed right in front of her that he likes her, Sawako believes it was a misunderstanding and that he was just saying he doesn't hate her. However, after having everything cleared up they officially start dating, though this only brings up rumors that she somehow used black magic to get him.!~

~!Currently, she is studying to be a high school Japanese Language teacher at the University of Education with her rival and later best friend, [Ume Kurumizawa](https://anilist.co/character/14117/Kurumizawa-Ume).!~

name: Shouta Kazehaya
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5'9")

Kazehaya is Sawako's outgoing classmate and friend. He is so popular that during middle school, so many girls liked him that they formed a "Kazehaya is Everyone's" Alliance in order to maintain some level of peace among his admirers. Kazehaya has held a long standing interest in Sawako and admits (though not to Sawako) that he likes her, unaware that she feels the same for him.

~!During their second year of high school, he begins to wonder if she actually likes him after she does not give him chocolates on Valentine's Day, not knowing that she had been too nervous to give him any. He seemingly becomes depressed and shows an expressionless face often. However, after being confronted by Ryuu (influenced by Chizuru) and Pin, Kazehaya goes to Sawako as his friends jokingly remark that he likes Sawako; however, Kazehaya takes the remark seriously and agrees, subsequently confessing directly to Sawako. However, after Sawako's misunderstanding of his confession, he believes she rejected him. However, as of chapter 41 was finally able to confess his feelings to Sawako and are officially dating.!~

name: Ayane Yano
description:
__Height:__ 161 cm

Ayane is a close friend of [Sawako](https://anilist.co/character/6977/Kuronuma-Sawako). She is the arguably the most mature of the group and she has a boyfriend in college as well as having her ears pierced multiple times. Initially the mangaka conceived of Yano and [Yoshida](https://anilist.co/character/13532/Yoshida-Chizuru) as a pair, and in the first two chapters the two are difficult to tell apart. She then redrafted the characters, combing Yano's hair and styling it in a fashion that looks like a pony-tail.

In [Kurumi](https://anilist.co/character/14117/Kurumizawa-Ume)'s fake rumors, it is said that Ayane has played more with more than 100 guys in middle school. In their current high school, it is said that Yano and Yoshida pretty much have authority in the year group. Perceptive and intelligent, a trait of Ayane's personality is that she gives just enough information to leave others wondering, thus forcing them to move forward, this as well as being able to figure out that it was Ume who spread the rumors and discovering that Sawako "liked" [Kazehaya](https://anilist.co/character/13531/Kazehaya-Shouta). Although she is usually calm and collected, she is easily infuriated if someone hurts Sawako and does not hesitate to attack the one responsible she believes is responsible (frequently Kazehaya) with kicks and sharp words. She's also fairly intimidating when angry, being called scary by Chizuru a number of times. 

~!As of Chapter 20 she broke up with her boyfriend, who had begun to become too possessive of her: calling her all times of the day, wondering what she has been up to, and the fact if she was with any guys. After she suggested they break up, he slapped her across the face. When he tried to apologize and ask her back, she realizes that the man she liked was not her boyfriend but rather, who he was when they started dating.

Ayane had been a great friend to Sawako and Chizu, but still believes she isn't a kind person. In Chapter 45, when she confessed that she doesn't believe she is a kind person (compared to Sawako and Chizu) because of how cunning she can be in front of Pin, she dreads another full-of-himself lecture from a surprisingly quiet Pin, who instead stares at a candy she gave him because he was whining about not getting one after the festival. Then, Pin pats her on the head and reassures her that she is kind before walking up the stairs, leaving her speechless that he could actually show a serious side. Also, Kento shows attraction to her as well. However, on chapter 54, a guy named Motoki-kun from class B suddenly confessed to her and Ayane accepted it immediately (shown in chapter 55).!~

name: Ryuu Sanada
description:
__Height:__ 179 cm

Sanada Ryuu is also one of Sawako's new group. He is quiet most of the time, but can still communicate well with Sawako (as they both don't talk much anyways). He is a close childhood friend with Chizuru. He is also good baseball mates with Kazehaya since they both played together in middle school.   

~!He has had a crush on Chizuru since they were little.!~

name: Chizuru Yoshida
description:
__Height:__ 167 cm

Yoshida Chizuru is another close friend of [Sawako](https://anilist.co/character/6977/Kuronuma-Sawako). She is the energetic girl of the group.  ~!In Kurumi's fake rumors it was passed around that she was a former Yankee. She is a close childhood friend with Ryuu Sanada, who is also the son of the owner of her favorite ramen shop, they are best friends and they even say brothers, she argues about who is the older. She went to Kazehaya's middle school as well. She has a crush on Ryuu's brother, Tooru. Chizuru is mostly only the slower side of things; she did not realize that Kazehaya liked Sawako (even though she and Ayane planned many events for them) until late in the series, after the 2nd year in their school has started.!~

name: Kazuichi Arai
description:
__Height:__ 193 cm

Arai Kazuichi is the temporary homeroom teacher for the gang's class. He is nicknamed Pin and always is called that way (except [Sawako](https://anilist.co/character/6977/Kuronuma-Sawako) who obeys the formalities and still calls him Arai-sensei). (The previous homeroom teacher had been said to be sick after he made Sawako do his work during the summer holidays.)

He is a great fan of baseball as well as the school baseball team's coach. He used to be part of [Shouta Kazehaya](https://anilist.co/character/13531/Kazehaya-Shouta)'s father's league team, so he has known Shouta since when he was young. He had once said that he likes to 'interrupt' people. He nicknames Kazehaya and Sawako's found-beside-the-river puppy Pedro Martinez.

name: Kento Miura
description: A student in Sawako's class during second year who sits next to her. When Sawako befriends Miura, Kazehaya becomes jealous of him as a potential rival for Sawako. He is interested in girls, particularly Sawako.

name: Tooru Sanada
description: Tōru is Ryu's older brother by eight years and Chizuru's crush since she was young. Although he is Ryu's brother and they resemble one another, their personalities are nearly opposite. Tōru resembles Kazehaya personality-wise and looks extremely refreshing, except much more mature. He lives three hours away from his parents' house and returns home to get married.He cares about Ryu and Chizuru a lot and loves Chizuru like a little sister. He calls her Chi because when she says it, it looks like she's smiling.

name: Souichi Jounouchi
description: One of Sawako's classmates, easily swayed by other people. He generally appears in the background. Jounouchi is very attached to Kazehaya, which usually results in him unwittingly interrupting conversations between Sawako and Kazehaya. At one point, he is rejected after confessing to a girl he liked and is comforted by Kazehaya. After hearing about how Yano broke up with her boyfriend, he sets his attention onto her.

name: Mr. Kuronuma
description: Sawako's father.

name: Youko Kuronuma
description: Sawako's mother.

name: Chigusa Takahashi
description: She sits behind Sawako after winter break in the first year.

name: Eriko Hirano
description: A classmate of Sawako. After Sawako begins to open up, Hirano becomes one of her first friends. Her nickname is "Ekko".   (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Genji Sanada
description: Ryuu's father.

name: Touta Kazehaya
description: Shouta's brother.

name: Mogi Motoki
description: A boy from class B. He asked Yano out just before the school trip and after she accepted, they dated for a short time during the trip.    ~!Yano was never in love with Mogi so when she discovered that he did not honestly love her, she broke up with him. !~

name: Mrs. Sanada
description: Ryuu's mother.

name: Mr. Yoshida
description: Chizuru's father.

name: Sitara
description:
A lonely girl who lost her mother and was torn far from her homeland.
Taken in by a family of scholars, she lives peacefully while gaining wisdom—only to lose everything when the Mongol Empire invades.

name: Töregene
description:
[Ögedei’s](https://anilist.co/character/399632/gedei) sixth wife.

She harbors a deep hatred for the Mongol Empire and sees her husband as an enemy.

After meeting [Sitara](https://anilist.co/character/328089/Sitara), she resolves to stand against the empire alongside her.

name: Boraqchin
description: [Ögedei's](https://anilist.co/character/399632/gedei) first wife and Empress (the Great Khatun). Always calm, composed, and dignified, she is a woman of unfathomable depth. Believing that "in politics, it is crucial to pull strings beneath the surface," she secretly devises strategies, deeply concerned about the empire's future and the imbalance of power.

name: Sorghaghtani Beki
description: [Tolui's](https://anilist.co/character/380761/Tolui) wife. She believes that "the world is wider than the steppe," and is searching for "Elements," a text containing knowledge from the West. She also possesses great insight, recognizing the danger that comes with imbalances in military strength and authority.

name: Tolui
description:
Son of Emperor [Genghis Khan](https://anilist.co/character/403366/) and the fourth prince of the Mongol Empire.
Possessing the greatest share of the empire's military strength, he uses this power to invade other nations.

name: Muhammad
description:
[Fatima](https://anilist.co/character/394598/)'s son and a brilliant young boy in his own right.
He teaches young [Sitara](https://anilist.co/character/328089/) the importance of learning, and sets out on a journey to encounter all kinds of wisdom and to search for the truth.

name: Ögedei
description:
The third son of [Genghis Khan](https://anilist.co/character/403366/), emperor of the Mongol Empire.

Thoughtful and observant, he is known for his calm and generous nature.

With a broad and far-sighted perspective, he strives for the prosperity of the empire.

name: Shira
description:
A young boy captured by the Mongol Empire.
Shrewd by nature, he curries favor with Tolui in hopes of survival and rising in status.

name: Fatima
description:
[Muhammad](https://anilist.co/character/394597/)’s mother and kind-hearted lady of the house.
She takes in the utterly alone Sitara and cherishes her as if she were her own child.

name: Möge
description: [Ögedei's](https://anilist.co/character/399632/gedei) fourth wife, who deeply adores [Boraqchin.](https://anilist.co/character/403710/Boraqchin) While she proclaims that she "isn't very smart," she has an innocent and honest personality.

name: Chagatai
description:
The second son of [Genghis Khan](https://anilist.co/character/403366/), emperor of the Mongol Empire.

Though strict and disciplined, he values law and order because of his kindhearted desire to protect slaves and ordinary people.

name: Khulan
description: Daiyr's daughter. A bright and innocent girl whose proud and strong spirit allows her to protect everyone when her tribe is in danger.

name: Zumurrud
description: A female slave who has long served at the estate in Tus. With a kind personality, she teaches Sitara how to bake bread, among other things.

name: Anis
description: A female slave who serves at the estate in Tus. Gifted at cleaning, she's a kind and dependable older sister figure to Sitara.

name: Kirgistani
description: [Ögedei's](https://anilist.co/character/399632/gedei) third wife. Incredibly emotional, she is very sweet towards Ögedei but makes no effort to hide her feelings of rivalry towards the other wives. Her drastic mood swings often lead her to lose composure and cause a scene when something goes awry.

name: Chinqai
description: A Uyghur and former merchant serving the Mongol Empire.

name: Jochi
description:
The eldest son of Genghis Khan, emperor of the Mongol Empire.

As the eldest of the four brothers, he has a quiet and gentle nature.

name: Dayir
description: A Merkit chief and shaman (Kam) who is capable of communicating with spirits. Despite their large age gap, he warmly welcomes Töregene as his wife for the sake of an alliance against the Mongols. He is a thoughtful and prudent man who consults the spirits and makes a painful decision as a crisis looms over his tribe.

name: Oji
description: Fatima's older brother. A qualified teacher, he instructs Sitara and the other children in reciting the Quran at the estate.

name: Temüge
description: Temüge was the youngest brother of [Genghis Khan](https://anilist.co/character/403366/), fourth son of Yesugei.

name: Gintoki Sakata
description:
__Height:__ 177 cm  

A samurai living in an era where a samurai is no longer needed. To add to his troubles, oppressive aliens have moved in to invade. Gintoki lives with [Kagura](https://anilist.co/character/674) and [Shinpachi](https://anilist.co/character/673), taking on odd jobs to make the world a better place...and to pay their rent. In the Joi war, he was known as the "White Devil" (Shiroyasha) due to his silver hair and white coat he wore in battle, which, combined with his impressive capabilities as a swordsman, made him famous among his comrades and struck fear into Amanto.

Gintoki has naturally permed silver hair, which he blames for his lacking love-life. He has a big crush on the TV's news weather girl, [Ketsuno](https://anilist.co/character/6225). In fact, to date, the only time he is seen to have blushed is when he tries to make use of [Sadaharu](https://anilist.co/character/2651) and Ketsuno's dog to get a chance to talk to her. Though several female characters have shown an interest in Gintoki, he usually does not show any response back and merely puts up with them as annoyances.

Gin has two major obsessions in life. He is obsessed with sweet foods such as parfait, ice cream, and cake. His second obsession is reading the manga anthology magazine Weekly Shōnen Jump. (Which, not coincidentally, is where Gintama is published in). His favorite type of milk is strawberry milk. Gin will go to great lengths to get the latest Jump issue, to the point of reckless behavior. His Jump obsession makes him easily dream of being like other Jump heroes, including wishing that he had a "Bankai" similar to the hero characters of Bleach.

Despite his appearance and initial behavior, Gintoki has a great amount of pride for the old Bushido code. He takes it upon himself to rescue or avenge not only his comrades and friends but also people he barely got acquainted too, be it a pit-fighter who was taking care of abandoned orphans or an Amanto who resembles a kappa.

Despite being a fearsome fighter with nearly unmatched skills, he avoids needless bloodshed after suffering the loss of most of his friends and allies during the Joi war.

name: Kagura
description:
__Height:__ 155 cm

Although she appears to be a normal, cute, human girl in Chinese-style clothing, she actually belongs to the Yato Clan, one of the strongest and most bloodthirsty of the Amanto races. The Yato is said to have "transparent" skin that is highly sensitive to sunlight, so Kagura carries a purple parasol at all times. The parasol is also the Yato clan's weapon of choice; Kagura's is bulletproof and fires bullets from its tip. Because of her Yato blood, she is super-strong and can stop a speeding motor-scooter with one hand. Although stronger than most humans, she cannot control her strength perfectly. Her super-human strength makes her extremely bad with pets. Most of her pets, with the exception of [Sadaharu](https://anilist.co/character/2651/Sadaharu), have met with an untimely demise at her hands.

She is also extremely flexible and fast; capable of catching multiple speeding bullets between her teeth and fingers. During a battle, she's often seen flipping through the air and performing various acrobatic feats. Due to her Yato blood, she is capable of rapid regeneration. During the Benizakura arc, she is seen healing from a gunshot wound almost overnight.

Kagura also has an unusually strong appetite. She is able to consume large quantities of food within a matter of seconds. Nevertheless, her tastes are endearingly plain. Sukonbu, rice, and eggs are among her favorite foods.

Her immediate family consists of her father, [Umibouzu](https://anilist.co/character/9876/Umibouzu), a widely recognized alien hunter, her mother, who is deceased, and her older brother [Kamui](https://anilist.co/character/12946/Kamui), once presumed missing who is now involved with the space pirates Harusame.

She came to Earth to earn money for her family. She found work fighting for a gang, but when they ordered her to kill her target, she ran away. Not long afterward, she met [Gintoki](https://anilist.co/character/672/Sakata-Gintoki) and [Shinpachi](https://anilist.co/character/673/Shimura-Shinpachi) when Gintoki accidentally ran her down with his scooter. After they helped her to make a clean break from the gang, she intimidated Gintoki into hiring her. She now lives at the Yorozuya and sleeps in Gintoki's closet, like [Doraemon](https://anilist.co/character/4304/Doraemon).

Kagura and Gintoki share an odd father-daughter-like relationship. Together with Shinpachi, the three of them make for a strange, dysfunctional, yet tightly knit family. Kagura is very protective of Gintoki. Although, she herself has gotten into many fights with him, rarely does she let anyone else pick on him. She seems to trust wholeheartedly in Gintoki's ability and strength. Even in sticky situations, she has no doubt that Gin-chan would come to save her. She has a tendency to imitate Gintoki's bad habits, and would often quote the bad advice he gives her. Some of her lines start with "Gin-chan says..." or "Gin-chan told me..."

Kagura is also somewhat of a tomboy. She is often seen partaking in games with various neighborhood boys. Although her candid manner of speech often causes them to shun her, she doesn't seem to mind. In fact, she has no problem at all with forcing her way into their game. In battle, she has proven to be bull-headed and a sore loser. Like Gintoki, and probably because of his influence, she is not above resorting to petty tricks and manipulation to get the better of her adversary. Unlike many conventional manga heroines, she doesn't display the same consciousness toward decorum, table manners, ​and physical appearance. Puking, cussing, picking her nose, spitting, fighting, and scratching herself is common behavior for Kagura.

She regards [Okita](https://anilist.co/character/2282/Okita-Sougo), captain of the Shinsengumi, as a rival. She detests him, and appeared to be disgusted when she previously mentioned (about Okita), that "he definitely likes me", but as that hasn't been brought up since, it is uncertain if it should be considered canon, that he apparently likes her.

According to the OVA, Kagura is the first and only Weekly Shonen Jump girl to vomit on-screen. To date, she has induced herself to vomit on several occasions. She also has an uncanny knack for seeming calm or detached during high-tension situations; in episode 5, she slept through a car-chase. Her appetite knows no bounds, and she is especially fond of sukonbu.

In Japanese, Kagura speaks in a stereotypical dialect that is associated with Chinese immigrants. In the English-translated manga, she punctuates her sentences with yup, uh-huh, nope, and the like.

~!In the Yoshiwara in Flames arc, Kagura meets her older brother, Kamui who abandoned her because she was weak in his eyes.!~ In the last Gintama character popularity poll, she came in 6th place.

name: Kotarou Katsura
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5'8")

Katsura is [Gintoki](https://anilist.co/character/672)'s former comrade during the Joi war. Even after the Amanto take-over of Japan, Katsura continues to resist the Amanto, and has amassed a band of followers.

He is a wanted man due to his involvement in terrorist activities against the Bakufu, and is constantly on the run from the Shinsengumi. Although his initial methods were originally more violent in nature (for instance, sending a bomb to an Amanto embassy), Katsura has gradually grown to believe that there are people important to him in Edo, and decides that he no longer wants to destroy the country, but believes there should be a way to change it without causing sacrifices.  Katsura seems to be highly respected by his followers, and has even been called the "Daybreak of the Joui Faction" by some. When people believed that Katsura had died during the Benizakura arc, even other terrorist groups tried to avenge his death. Since he is a wanted man, Katsura is often seen wearing disguises, although his identity is often still easily found out. 

Katsura seems to possess a rather outdated sense of humour, and sometimes refers to things from a past era, such as when he tried to buy a Famicon when people were queuing up to buy the OwEe (a parody of the Wii). He also seems to have a tendency to make up dramatic stories, which moves others to tears when they hear them (except Gintoki). Katsura sometimes works odd jobs to raise money for his terrorist activities. He claims that his heart has started to be moved by [Ikumatsu](https://anilist.co/character/9515) and held his subsequent interview in her ramen restaurant. 

His name is based on the historical Katsura Kogoro.

name: Toushirou Hijikata
description:
__Species:__ Human  
__Height:__ 177 cm 
__Affiliations:__ Shinsengumi

Toshiro Hijikata is the famed chain smoking, vice commander of the Shinsengumi so named by his subordinates, because of his fearsome demeanor. Purportedly the brains behind the force, he takes his work seriously, and is fiercely loyal to his leader, [Isao Kondo](https://anilist.co/character/2943). Hijikata has a reputation as a fearsome leader, earning the nickname of "demonic vice-commander". He is also hot-tempered and often speaks of seppuku. However, despite his cold exterior, he does have a more compassionate side. He also has a tendency to cry after watching movies that are not particularly emotional.

Hijikata is obsessed with mayonnaise and thus has the nickname "Mayora".
