He has been known to smother anything he eats under a mountain of mayonnaise, and he carries a number of objects shaped like jars of mayonnaise, such as his cigarette lighter. He was popular with girls until they discovered this obsession.

He enjoys fighting and sees [Gintoki Sakata](https://anilist.co/character/672) as a rival in practically everything he does from drinking contests to rock, paper, scissors ever since being defeated by him in battle. He is in constant danger of being killed by the attempts on his life by [Sougo Okita](https://anilist.co/character/2282). But, despite all this, he sees Sougo as one of his close friends, and vice versa. Before joining Shinsengumi, he used to be a troublemaker ronin. He enjoys fighting/having a good fight and says he doesn't care how many Amanto buildings get blown up, he only looks forward to having a big battle with the Joui rebels after Shinsengumi has rounded them in 1 fell swoop, in episode 5. He also formulated the Kyokuchuu Hatto, the 45 Regulations that form the disciplinary framework for Shinsengumi members, and implements them firmly.

~! In The Baragaki arc, Toshi's past is fully revealed and we learn that he had a brother named Tamegoro whom had raised Toshi almost on his own during their childhood after their parents had died !~

name: Sougo Okita
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm

Okita is the best swordsman in the Shinsengumi. Personality-wise, he tends to be light-hearted and somewhat childish though his speech is heavily deadpan.

He outwardly displays annoyance and dislike for [Hijikata](https://anilist.co/character/2650/Hijikata-Toushirou), and continuously tries to kill (or at least badly wound) Hijikata whenever he has the chance so that he can become the Vice-Commander. Okita has great affection and fondness for [Kondo](https://anilist.co/character/2943/Kondou-Isao), who took him under his wings when he was little. He still regards Hijikata as one of his three friends (the other two being Kondo and [Gintoki](https://anilist.co/character/672/Sakata-Gintoki)).

He enjoys seeing women fight, finding the ugly looks on their faces as they grab each other being hilarious. He wears a distinctive eye mask when taking a nap during duty, which is a frequent occurrence. At one point, he refers to himself as the best sniper in the Shinsengumi. Although he is a master of kenjutsu, he uses a bazooka more often.  He also regards [Kagura](https://anilist.co/character/674/Kagura) as a rival after an unfinished rock-paper-scissors duel during a sakura-blossom party. He states that he'll "be the only one to defeat her", and usually calls her "China".

name: Shinsuke Takasugi
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm

A former comrade of [Gintoki](https://anilist.co/character/672/Sakata-Gintoki) and [Katsura](https://anilist.co/character/1533/Katsura-Kotarou) and a major antagonist. He is easily recognisable through his bandaged left eye, his colorful  kimono, his eerie smile, and the pipe he is often seen smoking.

~!He now leads a radical Joui faction called the Kiheitai and is known amongst the Shinsengumi as 'the most dangerous man in both the Joui faction and amongst the radicals'.!~

He, Gintoki, and Katsura studied in the same temple elementary school when they were children, and he fought with them against the Amanto invasion during the latter part of the Joui war. After the war ended, he vanished, and has since gained a dangerous reputation due to his assassination of many of the Bakufu's main officers and his planning of a large-scale coup d'etat. Before his first appearance in both the anime and the manga, he was mentioned to have fled Edo and to have been hiding in Kyoto, although it is unclear how long before this was.  He now believes that the only way to save it is to destroy the "rotten" post-Joui war world.

He is shown to like festivals, although this is mainly due to the opportunity they provide for a large-scale terrorist attack: he appears to have an attraction to ruin that is almost nihilistic. He also appears to have considerable insight due to his 'seeing through Itou's heart' and subsequently planting him in the Shinsengumi's ranks.

It can be assumed that he is as skilled a swordsman as both Gintoki and Katsura, having fought alongside them as one of the 'heroes' of the Joui war. That aside, he appears to have at least considerable skill in playing the shamisen, and is shown at one point playing it with [Bansai](https://anilist.co/character/2947/Kawakami-Bansai) as they talk.

name: Taizou Hasegawa
description:
__Height:__ 179 cm 

Hasegawa used to be an official working for the Bakufu, but after an unfortunate incident with Amanto dignitary [Prince Hata](https://anilist.co/character/7929/Hata-Ouji), whom he was assigned to serve and protect, his superior asked him to succumb to his shame and commit seppuku, hearing that he ran away from his quarters.

He initially believed that humans should focus on appeasing the Amanto, but after his encounter with [Gintoki](https://anilist.co/character/672/Sakata-Gintoki), his mindset changed, which led to him punching Hata out, thus getting fired. Since then, he has been living a life of somewhat like a loser, getting fired almost every time he gets a new job, mostly due to the unfavourable look his sunglasses and goatee give him.

No matter what, he refuses to remove his sunglasses because it's the only thing he had left to remind him of his successful past. Although he does exchange the sunglasses for a decent pair of half-moon spectacles at one point, he goes back to wearing them after he decides that he is going to live out his life in the best way he can. He is constantly seen working various part-time jobs. He is often referred to as "Madao," short for "marude damena ossan," which roughly translates into "totally useless middle-aged man."

name: Shinpachi Shimura
description:
__Height:__ 166 cm

Shinpachi Shimura works under [Gintoki](https://anilist.co/character/672/Sakata-Gintoki) to learn the ways of the samurai. He used to stay at his family's dōjo. However, it seems more like he's just trying to help Gintoki pay the rent than to learn. Shinpachi is the captain of the "Otsu's Imperial Guard," a pop singer's fan club.

Shinpachi meets Gintoki after Shinpachi was tripped by the ambassador of Planet Chatoran. Gintoki beats up the ambassador and his guards, not to stand up for Shinpachi, but to get revenge for his spilled parfait. Gintoki frames Shinpachi for the crime, which somehow led to him saving [Tae Shimura](https://anilist.co/character/2944/Shimura-Tae) (Otae), Shinpachi's sister, from becoming part of a brothel.

Despite his meek appearance, Shinpachi is a more than competent swordsman of his family's Kakidō-Ryu, the type of swordsmanship his dojo teaches.

name: Kamui
description:
Kamui is a member of the Yato Tribe, the son of [Umibouzu](https://anilist.co/character/9876/Umibouzu) and older brother of [Kagura](https://anilist.co/character/674/Kagura). His excellent fighting skills helped him become Captain of the 7th Division of Harusame's Thunder Guns, the most powerful combat unit within the Harusame group and Overlord of Yoshiwara. Since defecting from the Harusame, he no longer holds these positions.

Kamui firmly believes that the Yato are to remain on the battlefield and shows his disapproval of [Housen](https://anilist.co/character/25666/Housen) staying locked up in Yoshiwara. Because of this belief, he shows no pity towards family or subordinates as a sign of weakness is unacceptable. He tried to revive the abandoned tradition of Yato clan's men killing their own parent to prove their strength, although failed to successfully execute it and only cut his father's arm off.  Despite this, he pays respect to the opponents he kills by sending them off with a smile. He doesn't kill children, and dislikes killing women because they may give birth to strong children.

~!Kamui lived with his parents and his younger sister on Rakuyou when he was young. As a child, he took over his mother [Kouka](https://anilist.co/character/124308/Kouka)'s responsibilities in doing the house chores and taking care of the then infant Kagura when Kouka fell ill.  He also took up the responsibility to protect his mother and younger sister in the absence of his father Umibouzu, who was seldom around as he was travelling around the universe searching for a cure to Kouka's illness.!~

name: Isao Kondou
description:
__Height:__ 184 cm 

Isao Kondo is the Commander of the Shinsengumi. When not working, he is the stalker of [Tae Shimura](https://anilist.co/character/2944), earning him the nickname Gorilla-stalker. His superior is [Katakuriko Matsudaira](https://anilist.co/character/5972), a high-ranking government officer under direct control of the Bakufu. Even though the Shinsengumi are loyal to Kondo, he often has to use Vice Commander [Toshiro Hijikata](https://anilist.co/character/2650) to settle them down (with harsh words or use of violence) before conducting a speech. Kondo is good friends with Toshiro and [Sougo Okita](https://anilist.co/character/2282), and if one of them ever strayed, then the other two would punch him back to where he belongs, as Kondo once told Sougo. Sougo also often remarks that Kondo's nice-guy attitude is also his weakness as he never notices negative points about other people. In the Mutiny arc, he was described by [Kamotaro Ito](https://anilist.co/character/11458) as honest, pure and unsullied. In the same arc, Toshiro described him as the soul of the Shinsengumi, and the rest of them being the sword that protects him. Toshiro also said that everybody joined the Shinsengumi so that they could be with Kondo, and that as long as he was there, the Shinsengumi would not be finished.

When Kondo once asked Tae Shimura whether she would still love her boyfriend if he had a hairy butt. She became the target of his stalking when she replied that she would love her boyfriend just as much, hairy butt and all. Being a stalker of Tae, Kondo is often seen getting beat up or threatened by her, as she highly disapproves of his stalking and affection towards her. In the Yagyuu arc, Kondo had his mind set on being [Shinpachi Shimura](https://anilist.co/character/673)'s brother-in-law, even going as far as saying Shinpachi was the only one he could entrust the Shinsengumi to, much to Shinpachi's annoyance, answering that he doesn't give a damn about the Shinsengumi.

During his childhood, Kondo was a member of a dojo in Bushuu. There, he would soon meet Sougo and Toshiro, recruiting them both into his dojo. Kondo would later on take all the members with him and move from Bushuu to Edo in search for success, becoming what is now the Shinsengumi. Some characters in the series often call him "gorilla" due to his hirsute nature and although he is angered with this nickname, he sometimes uses the same word to identify himself. Kondo is loosely based on the historical Kondo Isami, famed for his role as commander of the Shinsengumi during the Bakumatsu period.

name: Elizabeth
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm

Elizabeth resembles a giant white duck or a giant penguin and is [Katsura's](https://anilist.co/character/1533/Katsura-Kotarou) companion. Elizabeth was a present from [Tatsuma Sakamoto](https://anilist.co/character/2945/Sakamoto-Tatsuma), who presumably picked it up on his travels around space. Although many people consider Elizabeth to be insane and extraneous, Katsura has named the ambiguous avian "Elizabeth" and dotes on it. Elizabeth is something of a painter, and is surprisingly dexterous. Also, Elizabeth resorts to using signboards to "communicate", as well as an occasional means of attack. Elizabeth is also a skilled fighter, able to use signboards to fight off swordsmen.  

Although the true identity of Elizabeth is uncertain, it appears to be a man wearing a duck costume. In its first appearance, hairy legs are seen underneath her sheet and the body of a humanoid with glowing eyes is revealed as her mouth is opened just as it fell during another battle between [Gintoki](https://anilist.co/character/672/Sakata-Gintoki) and Katsura. Although Katsura seems shocked at what she really is, she has subsequently remained by his side. Episode 50 implies that the person inside Elizabeth is most likely the director (Gintoki was interrupted before he can finish being cut off at "Kanto-" ("Direc-"). Most of the characters seem to ignore this, or at least do not give it much thought, given at the episode was completely filler.

name: Tatsuma Sakamoto
description:
__Height:__ 181 cm

Sakamoto is a former member of the Joi. He is a good-natured man and optimistic to the point of being ridiculous, even in the most dangerous situations. His favorite phrase is "AHAHA! It must be _____". He also has a tendency to misspell names; he calls Gintoki "Kintoki". Gintoki often corrects him, citing that if he were named Kintoki, they would be in some kind of hentai anime (because 'Kin' from 'Kintoki' instead of 'Gin' would make the title 'Kintama', which means 'testicles' instead of 'Gintama', which means 'silver soul').  

Despite his goofy nature, Sakamoto is actually a successful businessman in the galaxy. He believes that business is a way of protecting his country. He has a private, well-equipped defensive business fleet. He believes that sacrifices should be made for the good of the community, which is why he chose to abandon his comrades on Earth to travel into space. Sakamoto is shown to be skilled with a pistol in an anime filler episode.

His name is based on the historical character Sakamoto Ryouma. He speaks in Tosa-ben, much like the inspiration for his character.

name: Sadaharu
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm  

Sadaharu has the outward appearance of a giant dog, but is actually an inugami. When sitting on his haunches, he is taller than most humans. He was left in front of Gintoki's apartment in a box that had "To Mr. Freelancer" written on it. Sadaharu chomps on anything smaller than itself, such as Gintoki's and other people's heads. Kagura seems to be the only one who can control him, for she has immense strength, though he chomps on her occasionally. Though he was dangerous when Gintoki first received him, he has become quite tame in the later episodes, and has helped the main characters in many occasions. He was named by Kagura, after her first pet, a rabbit which she accidentally killed while having a nightmare. He was originally owned by a pair of miko sisters, who initially called him Kamiko.  Recently, Sadaharu has impressed a yakuza's boss and receives permission to date his dog (whom Sadaharu himself has fallen in love for).

name: Kyuubei Yagyuu
description:
The successor to the Yagyuu family name, the daughter of [Koshinori Yagyuu](https://anilist.co/character/15581/) and the granddaughter of [Binbokusai Yagyuu](https://anilist.co/character/15580/).

They were brought up as a male, following the code of the Yagyuu clan, but in later years decided to follow neither femininity or masculinity, but live as only "Yagyuu Kyuubei." During their introduction, they tried to take [Tae Shimura](https://anilist.co/character/2944/) as their fiancee, though [Shinpachi](https://anilist.co/character/673/) and the rest stopped them from doing it. Yagyuu still has feelings for Tae, though they remained in friendly ties.

A genius swordsman; surpassing average swordsmen in skills, and is able to hold themself against veteran swordsmen, like [Toushirou Hijikata](https://anilist.co/character/2650/) and [Gintoki](https://anilist.co/character/672/).

name: Ayame Sarutobi
description:
__Height:__ 169 cm

Sarutobi Ayame is a ninja from the Oniwabanshuu by training, but is currently working as an assassin. She also has a part-time job at the Kunoichi Café.

Since her initial appearance, she has developed a serious obsessive infatuation with [Sakata Gintoki](https://anilist.co/character/672/Sakata-Gintoki), to the point of even stalking him. She is severely myopic, to the point of being almost blind (cannot tell living things from inanimate objects) without her eyeglasses. It was also hinted that she doesn't see well even with her eyeglasses on, as she once mistook [Kagura](https://anilist.co/character/674/Kagura) (dressed up as Gintoki) for Gintoki himself. However, this could solely be due to her infatuation with him. She has frequently clashed with [Otae](https://anilist.co/character/2944/Shimura-Tae) for various reasons.

Ayame has a playful attitude but gets serious when it comes to her work. She also seems to enjoy bondage and S&M. Although Gintoki is indifferent to her affections and even treats her badly most times (e.g throwing things at her whenever he senses her stalker presence), her 'M' or masochistic personality only makes her enjoy the punishment, and his 'cruelty' only serves to encourage her.

name: Shouyou Yoshida
description:
Mentor to the Old Jouishishi members in their youth.  

Trained [Sakata Gintoki](https://anilist.co/character/672/Sakata-Gintoki), [Katsura Kotarou](https://anilist.co/character/1533/Katsura-Kotarou) and [Takasugi Shinsuke](https://anilist.co/character/2948/Takasugi-Shinsuke) in swordskills and the bushido. He died before the Gintama storyline started.

name: Tae Shimura
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm 

Tae Shimura is [Shinpachi](https://anilist.co/character/673)'s older sister. She runs the Kakidokan Dojo—which was her father's failing dojo—with her brother. She is usually addressed as "Otae"; the "O" is an honorific used to refer to women. [Kagura](https://anilist.co/character/674) always addresses her as "big sister" (anego). Despite her sweet face, she is one of the most violent characters in _Gintama_ (and arguably strong too). She mercilessly beats up [Isao Kondo](https://anilist.co/character/2943) and [Gintoki Sakata](https://anilist.co/character/672) whenever they anger her; in episode 19, she mercilessly kicks the men out onto the road (namely her brother, Gintoki and [Taizou Hasegawa](https://anilist.co/character/3760)) so as to stop a car for a hitch ride. She often displays her trademark sweet-looking smile with her eyes closed before engaging in her violent activities. Her killer intent is so strong that on one occasion, a stare from her brings the entire Shinsengumi on their knees begging for mercy. Her weapon of choice seems to be a naginata, a Japanese spear.

Her cooking skills are terrible, seeing as her tamagoyaki (i.e. sweet fried egg) is so inedible that Kondo suffers amnesia after eating it and others are barely able to swallow it down. [Sagaru Yamazaki](https://anilist.co/character/4653) even describes it as "poison" after some of it accidentally gets into his eye. When Kagura tried to hypnotize herself into eating Otae's cooking, Shinpachi objected, saying that Otae's cooking is the reason for his poor eyesight.  She has, so far, been called flat-chested three times in the anime; another in 59 by Gintoki; and the third time by Shinpachi, who thought that [Kyubei Yagyu](https://anilist.co/character/6110) wanted to marry her because Kyubei took her as a male (that her chest is so flat that she looks like a guy). She has strong principles and believes in maintaining what is precious, even if it means throwing away honor and dignity. She once says that if apologies were enough, seppuku would not exist. Her favourite food is Häagen-Dazs ice-cream, but it is called Bargain Dash in the manga and anime.

name: Sagaru Yamazaki
description:
Yamazaki is a spy, whose specialty is naturally gathering intelligence. Yamazaki is often caught by Hijikata playing badminton by himself, and he is subsequently beaten. He is often seen cosplaying as a badminton-playing version of Echizen Ryoma from The Prince of Tennis. In episode 62 he was caught saying "Mada mada dane", which is Ryoma Echizen's catchphrase.  His role as a ninja is roughly based on Yamazaki Susumu, but is never really exercised besides one unsuccessful attempt to spy on Gintoki. Despite having a rivalry with Shinpachi, they most often see eye-to-eye out of their respective groups.  Despite his lack of screen time, he came in 4th in the Gintama character popularity poll. But even with his popularity, Sorachi has clearly stated that he will never be on a cover of a Gintama volume.  Yamazaki's birthday is February 6. He is 169 cm, and he weighs 58 kg. His age has not yet been revealed.  His name is based on the historical Yamazaki Susumu.

 ~!During the Silver Soul arc, he is confronted by Utsuro. In that moment, Yamazaki is frozen in fear, gets his throat slit, and dies. However, he is later remade into a cyborg.!~

name: Otose
description:
__Height:__ 166 cm (5' 5½")

Gintoki's landlady. He swore to protect her when he ate food offerings to her dead husband. Her real name is Ayano Terada, Ms. Otose (お登勢 Otose) being a "genji" alias. She was very pretty when she was young and worked at a restaurant. She secretly fed poor children dumplings for free, and was fired. She is a smoker. Despite constant arguments over Gintoki's general inability to pay his rent, she is confident in his defense of her. But in episode 22, she proves to be quite skilled in martial arts (or at least has above average reflexes) by dodging Ayame's flying kick simply by tilting her head to the left and catching a thrown dagger with two fingers (and then pockets it). She is apparently one of the four "emperors" that rule the Kabuki District.  Otose takes her name from a real person who kept a hotel during the Bakumatsu period, often hiding rebels from the Shinsengumi.

name: Katakuriko Matsudaira
description:
**Height:** 168 cm

A high-ranking government officer under direct control of the Bakufu government, Police Superintendent Matsudaira Katakuriko is in charge of the Shinsengumi and the immediate superior of Commander Kondo Isao.

He has extremely violent tendencies, often seen wielding a pistol, or occasionally heavier weapons. He also believes that people who wear sunglasses are usually assassins, even though he himself wears them. He earned the nickname of 'God of Destruction', as his method of solving problems is to blow everything up using bazooka, tanks etc.

He believes in other abnormal things such as righteousness is what makes up 80% of old men and the police being not more than a group of mafia community.  He is also extremely protective of his daughter, Kuriko, recruiting the Shinsengumi to carry out a hit against his daughter's boyfriend.   He is a party-person who gets lewd when he is drunk, he frequently accompanies the shogun Tokugawa Shigshige on his outings or rather as Gintoki said, he tends to bring the shogun to all sorts of seedy places, under the pre-text of being a 'father figure' to the young shogun.

Womanizer, always frequenting hostess/cabaret clubs, a VIP customer at 'Snack Smile', where Otae works. His name and role are based on the Matsudaira Katamori.

name: Bansai Kawakami
description:
He is an assassin and is one of the strongest swordsmen of the Kiheitai, an extremist Joui faction bent on causing world destruction. He regularly keeps his headphones on, as well as sun glasses even while others are talking to him.  Bansai is shown to have an extremely calm demeanor, which covers up the fact that he has a vicious, almost cruel personality which actively seeks out conflict. 

He carries and is skilled at playing a shamisen, which also doubles as a tool for tying others up or as a weapon similar to a garrote. On top of being famous as a skilled swordsman, Bansai is also a talented songwriter. He works as a music producer under the name "Tsunpo", and Otsu's newer songs are written by him. 

 ~!During a major fight in the Silver Soul War, Bansai sacrificed his life in order to protect his fellow members of the Kiheitai.!~

Bansai's name is roughly based on that of a hitokiri of the Bakumatsu era, Kawakami Gensai, while his stage name is based on the musician Tsunku.

name: Abuto
description:
__Height:__ 186 cm

A veteran member of the Yato clan. He supports and travels with Kamui.    Abuto treasures his own kind, those of Yato blood and dislikes fighting them, though it goes against his blood-thirsty Yato nature. He sees life as a series of questions with right and wrong answers and seems to believe in standing by one's own decisions.     He lost his left arm when he tried to stop Housen from fighting Kamui.

name: Matako Kijima
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm

Matako Kijima is the only female member of the Kiheitai and is skilled in using a pair of pistols. She is fiercely loyal to [Shinsuke Takasugi](https://anilist.co/character/2948), and appears to have a crush on him.

~!She also gets angry and tells off [Nizou Okada](https://anilist.co/character/9534) after he goes on a rampage throughout Edo, trying to kill Takasugi's old comrades. She is quick-tempered and prone to screeching when she's upset. This is evident when she has a "spitting fight" with [Kagura](https://anilist.co/character/674) after she spat at her and when she starts yelling at Kagura after her underwear is said to be stained. She shoots Kagura through the shoulder when Kagura breaks onto the ship. She interacts the most with [Henpeita Takechi](https://anilist.co/character/9535), calling him 'senpai' and also calling him a 'pervert' and a 'lolicon' for sparing Kagura instead of killing her. At the end of the Benizakura arc, she is wounded by Okada after he loses control.!~

Her name is roughly based on a samurai of the Bakumatsu era, Kijima Matabei.

name: Mitsuba Okita
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm

Mitsuba is Sougo's older sister, and took care of him since their parents passed away when they were children. Sougo cares deeply for Mitsuba, and is uncharacteristically polite and docile when around her. She is acquainted with the rest of the Shinsengumi, and regularly brings them extra-spicy senbei, which she herself enjoys. She suffers from tuberculosis, and often requires medical treatment, which Sougo used to send money for. She has romantic feelings for Hijikata. Although it is revealed that Hijikata does in fact love her, he feels that he is unable to give her happiness, that is why he treats her coldly.   ~!She dies in chapter 132 of the manga (Episode 87 for the anime) after a brief conversation with her brother.!~ She is roughly based on Okita Mitsu, sister of Okita Sōji.  Historically though, it was Okita Sōji who suffered from tuberculosis.

name: Catherine
description: An amanto who resembles a cat. At first, she seems to be a diligent worker at Otose's snack shop who is trying to support her family, but soon reveals herself to be a thief. Despite this, Otose hired her again after she was released from prison. She used to work as a thief with three others vaguely resembling Arsène Lupin, Goemon Ishikawa, and Daisuke Jigen. She speaks Japanese with an accent, represented by katakana characters in the place of hiragana; she is the only member of her former crew to speak this way.

name: Ginko
description:
Ginko employs himself as a Mushi master (mushi-shi), traveling from place to place to research Mushi and aid people suffering from problems caused by them. Ginko's unusual white hair and green eye color is the result of an incident involving a mushi that occurred when he was a child.

While designing the character, Mushishi-writer and -artist [Urushibara](https://anilist.co/staff/97394/Urushibara-Yuki) actually planned to have the story take place in a contemporary setting. Ginko's rather modern clothes, which do not seem to match the time period reflected by all other characters, still reflect this.

Ginko is a rare person who attracts mushi. This inspires his peripatetic lifestyle; staying in one place too long will gather a potentially dangerous amount of mushi. He also smokes constantly in order to keep mushi away.  In terms of personality, Ginko is rather laid back, but can be very serious when it comes to protecting people from mushi. He also often stresses that the mushi are not evil, but they merely exist as a part of the nature and try to survive like every other living being.

~!When [Nui](https://anilist.co/character/5167/Nui) found him, he was unconscious in the woods, wounded and abandoned. As he had no place to go, Nui decided to care for him instead of making him leave. He went by the name "Yoki" until Nui was consumed by the Ginko mushi, thus changing his name to "Ginko."!~ ~!He lost his other eye and hair color when he tried to save Nui from the Ginko mushi that lived in the pond near where they lived. Nui protected Ginko by telling him to offer them as a sacrifice so the Ginko would let him be. He never saw Nui again and after nearly being consumed by the mushi he adopted the name Ginko to save himself.!~

name: Narrator
description:
This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. 

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

name: Tanyuu Karibusa
description:
Tanyuu is the fourth and current Scribe of the Karibusa family. A Karibusa Scribe is a person with a special coal-like birthmark. The birthmark contains a type of Mushi called The Forbidden Mushi. The curse is located on her right leg.

Tanyuu is a kind person who, despite the amount of hardship that the Mushi have brought on her life, is extremely attached to them. For this reason, she hates having to hear stories about Mushi being treated as lesser than humans or as vermin that need to be killed. She loves hearing stories about Mushi from [Ginko](https://anilist.co/character/425/Ginko) because unlike most Mushishi, he is attached to Mushi and understands that Mushi are not just evil creatures, but simply living creatures trying to survive. She is efficient and talented at her job, something she initially hated as a child but grew to love, and is proud but compassionate towards those she loves.

A cursed Mushi that once nearly brought the destruction of all of life is sealed in her right leg and she is upset that this Mushi is the reason her current guardian and the Minai family line are suffering. She often worries more about others than herself but does lament the inability to use her leg. Tanyuu's deepest desire is to complete the sealing away of the forbidden Mushi and to be freed to travel with Ginko.

(Source: Mushishi Wiki, edited)

name: Adashino
description:
Adashino is the doctor of a seaside village whom [Ginko](https://anilist.co/character/425/Ginko) occasionally visits to sell Mushi-related items to. His hobby is collecting such items and keeps them in a shed behind his home.

(Source: Mushishi Wiki, edited)

name: Tama Minai
description:
Tama Minai is a Mushishi who is committed to protecting the Scribe of the Karibusa family.

Tama's ancestor sealed The Forbidden Mushi into the Karibusa Family. The Mushi has since then been passed on to each member of the family in the form of a birthmark. The members with the birthmark contain the Forbidden Mushi sealed in them and are called Scribes. The current Scribe of the fourth generation is [Tanyuu Karibusa](https://anilist.co/character/13714).

(Source: Mushishi Wiki)

name: Kino
description:
Kino is the main character of [Kino's Journey](https://anilist.co/anime/486/Kinos-Journey/). They are a composed, stoic, and precocious teenager who travels with their motorrad, [Hermes](https://anilist.co/character/88/Hermes), in search of a country with specific desired characteristics. Their gender is ambiguous.

~!In Land of Adults, Kino's sex is confirmed to be female. They borrow the name "Kino" from [Kino](https://anilist.co/character/3872/Kino) - a traveler they met before his death. Their birth name is left unstated, but there are implications in the anime that their name is "Sakura".!~

Kino was born in the Land of Adults with the name of a flower. They dislike it as it resembles that of an insult, which resulted in them being teased. Their original name is never explicitly stated. Their father describes the flower that their named for as a bright red prairie flower that, while short lived, blooms in abundance in the fields just beyond the borders of their home country during their birthday.

Kino is a 15-year-old traveler. Although they appear apathetic at first, they are a caring and understanding person. They travel through different countries to experience their customs and understand their histories, but never stay longer than three days. They are afraid of settling down, because it would cause them to no longer be a traveler.

Kino is an excellent marksman with amazing speed, agility, and accuracy. They initially traveled with a revolver persuader "Canon" which takes six .44 caliber bullets that they used solely for the execution or maiming of other humans or hunting. They were later gifted with a semi-auto persuader, "Woodsman" which replaced their revolver's purpose of hunting. They use "Woodsman" if they are hunting down other humans without an intent to harm or kill. Kino is rarely known to use a sniper persuader "Flute," but when they do, it is used for hunting and long-distance combat. They make use of many knives hidden in various locations in their clothing for cooking, distraction, and close-combat. They also carry a ballistic knife that doubles as a triple-barrelled gun complete with a laser sight as a final deception tactic when they are cornered. They use all of their weapons with extreme proficiency, if not flawlessly.

While adept at being a survivalist, they have a knack to disappear with impeccable timing to prevent physical and/or emotional harm. They often monologue many times to Hermes that they are no "God" and will only take in their environment and the many countries that they visits as they are. Although they is persuaded many times to sway events into the favour of many people during their travels, they are never tempted to follow up proving their unwavering discipline to their principle; "The world is not beautiful; and that, in a way, lends it a sort of beauty." Their honesty is brutal, and their self-loyalty trumps all of their actions. However, they are known to assist others out of their own inconvenience simply because Kino wants to.

Kino has a sweet tooth; it is used as comic relief against a bleak backdrop of survival and hardships of traveling. Another source of comic relief is their preference for tidiness; they are vexed whenever they cannot maintain a well maintained physical figure/appearance.

In [Gakuen Kino](https://anilist.co/manga/41263/Gakuen-Kino/), Kino is a high school magical girl who defeats evil which appear in their world, known as Mysterious Bishoujo Gun Fighter Rider Kino.

(Sources: Kino's Journey Wiki (edited), Wikipedia)

name: Hermes
description:
**Gender**: Male

Hermes is a talking motorrad who travels with [Kino](https://anilist.co/character/87/Kino) to various countries and lands.

Hermes was found broken in an alley by the original [Kino](https://anilist.co/character/3872/Kino) during his stay in the Land of Adults. The original Kino and the then eleven-year-old child fixed him, although at the time Hermes could not talk to them. The original Kino decided to give him the name Hermes, after their previous motorrad.

~!After the original Kino is killed, [Kino](https://anilist.co/character/87/Kino) uses Hermes to escape the Land of Adults. They keep riding until they collapse into a field filled with flowers. Hermes calls them Kino, believing that to be their name, and they decide to accept the new name to honour their saviour's death.!~

Hermes is often pessimistically realist, unbiased, and usually comes across as the comic relief character. He has a tendency to complain, which sometimes annoys Kino. Despite this, he is a very reliable companion both mentally and physically, as he is the only person who Kino can speak with about their innermost thoughts. He is naive and innocent in many ways, often believing things that are only meant as a joke. He also has a habit of trying to state famous quotes, but usually forgets or changes them, prompting Kino to correct him. Although Hermes can be interpreted as a caring companion towards Kino, Hermes however does not care whoever his rider is. His sole purpose is to provide speed while a rider provides him with a direction and balance. If Kino were to be killed, he would have to wait for an extended period of time before another traveler utilizes him as a mode of transportation. Kino is well aware of Hermes's purpose as a motorrad and fiercely protects him from anybody attempting to steal or damage him, as well as themself in order for Hermes to continue having a rider.

Hermes is also extremely intelligent in literal data. He can assess physical situations to an extremely complex degree but is annoyingly vague in expressing it. In the anime, he uses his knowledge to assess a mythical flying machine that was indeed able to fly provided with sufficient thrust.

In [Gakuen Kino](https://anilist.co/manga/41263/Gakuen-Kino/), Hermes is a cell phone strap. He is described as two canvas strips connected by a brass buckle with a Brough Superior SS100 engraved upon it. His personality has not changed.

(Source: Kino's Journey Wiki, edited)

name: Shizu
description:
Shizu is a young man with a great talent for swordsmanship, weilding a katana. He travels in a buggy alongside his vassal and pet Samoyed, [Riku](https://anilist.co/character/15428/Riku), and eventually [Ti](https://anilist.co/character/150047/Tifana), a girl whom Riku and Shizu eventually take in.

[Kino](https://anilist.co/character/87/Kino)'s first impression of Shizu is of a peaceful martyr, despite participating in a tournament of death.

~!Despite escaping the Land of the Coliseum as a child, he returns seven years later to participate in the tournament as a means to assassinate his father and end the tyranny.!~

Kino and [Hermes](https://anilist.co/character/88/Hermes) occasionally meet up with Shizu and Riku during their travels, but Kino seems to only remember Riku's name.

(Source: Kino's Journey Wiki, edited)

name: Riku
description:
**Hair Color**: White

Riku is the pet dog of [Shizu](https://anilist.co/character/13970/Shizu), and his loyal vassal. Despite being a dog, he is able to speak. He first appears alongside Shizu in the Land of Colosseum. He refers to his master as Master Shizu at all times. He's oftentimes the narrator of some of the chapters in which center around Shizu, [Ti](https://anilist.co/character/150047/Tifana) and himself.

Riku is a white Samoyed, with white busy fur. He states that while he always looks happy and smiling, that is not how he always feels. Being not only Shizu's pet, but also his only vassal, he cares strongly for his master's well being, and tries in vain to have Shizu reconsider his journey back home. Despite his master's insistence on continuing with his plan, his loyally stays alongside him. He's oftentimes designated as the ward of the children that he and Shizu come across and care for on their travels.

Riku, being a sidekick similar to how [Hermes](https://anilist.co/character/88/Hermes) is to [Kino](https://anilist.co/character/87/Kino), appears to have quite a rivalry with the motorrad. In the Anime, he's only spoken to Hermes, as Kino does not believe Riku can speak when told about the discussion Hermes had with him. In the 2003 anime, he also speaks to Shizu, but in the English version, only barks or whimpers to him in these instances. In the novels and the 2017 anime, Riku speaks to both Kino and Hermes

(Source: Kino's Journey Wiki, edited)

name: Kino
description:
**Gender**: Male
**Hair Color**: Brown (2003 anime), blonde (2017 anime & manga)
**Eye Color**: Brown (2003 anime), blue (2017 anime)

The original Kino was a young man who traveled by the same three-day rule that the main character, [Kino](https://anilist.co/character/87/Kino), does. His arrival in Land of Adults sparks the beginning of the story, and is Kino's inspiration to travel after they attempt to discover his past. Kino often make statements similar to the original Kino's and even quotes him on occasion.

Kino is a tall and very thin man when he arrived at Land of Adults. They note that he arrived on foot, and while ridiculed by the guards, he appeared to display immerse dignity. His first appearance shows him disheveled, wearing a black jacket with a long, dusty brown coat, with a tattered backpack. He also wore boots that the young Kino had never seen before. They note that his cheeks were sunken, and that due to the guards' ridicule, white insect powder clung to his hair. They also state that they are unable to understand the language that he sings in, and that he does so quite poorly.

Kino lived with his mother in a country by a large forest. Growing up, he told his mother that he would like to travel. He believed that the traveling related to not only his own growth, but also to the growth of his country. As the years passed, he traveled from his home more and more frequently.

Kino is shown to know how to repair machinery - he salvages and repairs a motorcycle which eventually is named Hermes, after an old motorcycle he had used to travel with before.

~!He is blamed for the younger Kino's refusal for their grown-up operation, and attempts to leave the country before the situation escalates. However, he dies protecting the child when their father attempts to kill young Kino for disobeying their parents and the country's culture.!~

(Source: Kino's Journey Wiki, edited)

name: Tifana
description:
**Age**: 12
**Hair Color**: White
**Eye Color**: Green

Tifana, better known as Ti (ティー), is one of two companions of [Shizu](https://anilist.co/character/13970/Shizu) during his travels. [Riku](https://anilist.co/character/15428/Riku) serves as her guardian.

Ti first introduced to Shizu in the Ship Country by an elder as his guide. She is about twelve years of age, or at least, around the same height of a girl at that age. Her hair is short and white, unlike the remainder of the citizens in the country, who have black and brown hair. She also has an eye color that is not shared with anyone else in the country. Despite her age, she wears a stony expression on her face. She dresses in gray shorts and a long brown shirt, with patches all over. Despite owning other articles of clothing, she chooses to wear this at all times. She oftentimes wears a large messenger bag on her back, as well as elbow and knee guards. Her shoes are made of rubber.

Ti speaks quite little, preferring to answer "yes" or "no" questions with nods or by shaking her head, and refuses to talk about her family. She has an attachment to grenades, so far as attempting to bring them along with her on a stroll. She is eventually gifted a grenade launcher by Shizu, knowing that she has difficulty throwing them. She is also known to own a ballistic knife.

~!Ti is a child abandoned by travelers who stayed on the Ship Country thirteen years ago, with the intention to cross the ocean. They became interested in the country, and decided to stay for a year, until Ti's birth. As the couple wished to travel again, they made the decision to leave their child behind, due to the strain of traveling with a child. The people in black eventually find her abandoned in a storehouse, and decide to raise her themselves, renaming her in the process.

Ti's name, Tifana, comes from the name of the ship that arrived 600 years ago at an abandoned floating city. It was intended as a vessel for pilgrimage or migration, but it contained only children under the age of three, as all the civilians on board older than that age had been wiped out by a plague. She is, in a sense, the princess of the country, as she knows the most of the inner workings of the Ship, as well as the people. However, because of her status, the citizens feared her as she was able to wander as she pleased, treating her as a demon, or an omen of disaster.!~

(Source: Kino's Journey Wiki, edited)

name: Sakura
description:
Sakura is a girl from the country Kino visited in the last episode of the anime series. She shares many similarities to Kino, such as her parents also owning an inn. In the English version of the anime series, her name is changed to Lily in order to preserve the explanation that her name, pronounced slightly differently, becomes an insult. The children call her "Silly Willy" instead of "mekura" (盲, "mekura"? meaning "ignorant") and "dokura" (どくら, "dokura"? meaning "poison") in this version.     

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Nimya Tchuhachkova
description: A girl who dreams of flying wth the birds and builds a flying machine in an attempt to realize that dream.

name: Shishou
description:
**Hair Color**: Black, grey
**Eye Color**: Gray (2003 anime)

Shishou is a former traveler who traveled the world several years ago before settling down in a forest near the Land of Adults. She is considered both scoundrel and savior as she is hailed a hero in some countries and a wanted fugitive in others. She's very adept in military skills comparable to that of a seasoned tactical officer as well as extensible knowledge in situational survival, gun skills, and bartering. She's depicted as a leader and mentor. Her companion, Aibou, defers to her for decisions, and she skillfully mentors [Kino](https://anilist.co/character/87/Kino) in the usage of firearms. It is implied that she is also afraid of ghosts.

Shishou, in her old age, is noted to seem fragile. Despite this, she stands with excellent posture, with her gray hair tied back. At her forest home, she is dressed in a light green cardigan over slim pants and a white shirt. She also wields a persuader. In her youth, she had long black hair and wore elegant looking clothes.

In [Gakuen Kino](https://anilist.co/manga/41263/Gakuen-Kino/), Shishou is Kino's grandmother and secretly a world renown woman of incredible power both hailed and feared by all known only as Granny the Super.

(Source: Kino's Journey Wiki, edited)

name: Hitomi Mishima
description:
[Hina](https://anilist.co/character/89228/Hina)'s friend and classmate. She's a model student and sits next to Hina in class, which caused her to start caring for Hina unintentionally.

When Hina was looking for [Nitta](https://anilist.co/character/89229/Nitta-Yoshifumi), Hitomi was forced to help her. While waiting for Hina at [Utako](https://anilist.co/character/125366/Sakura-Utako)'s Bar "Little Song", a regular customer at the bar started teaching her how to mix cocktails, revealing her talent (in doing actually everything). After that, Utako took a photo of her in bartender uniform and threatening Hitomi to work for her if she doesn't want the photo to be leaked. Now Hitomi jobs part-time at the bar every weekend.

name: Anzu
description: Anzu is an esper sent to kill [Hina](https://anilist.co/character/89228/Hina) whom was banished from their mysterious origins due to her lack of control over her own powers. Failing her mission Anzu attempted to return home only to discover her transportation device was damaged. Stranded, Anzu's homeless life began and continued until she was adopted by a doting couple.

name: Hina
description: A strange girl with supernatural powers that suddenly comes into [Nitta](https://anilist.co/character/89229/Nitta-Yoshifumi)'s house in a strange box. She usually has a problem communicating properly with other people and rarely shows emotion.

name: Yoshifumi Nitta
description: The main character, a yakuza member. His life changes dramatically after he met [Hina](https://anilist.co/character/89228/Hina).

name: Utako Sakura
description: Owner of the bar where [Hitomi](https://anilist.co/character/89230/Mishima-Hitomi) eventually works. Constantly asked out by [Yoshifumi](https://anilist.co/character/89229/Nitta-Yoshifumi), and she constantly denies him. Very close to [Anzu](https://anilist.co/character/125362/Anzu), and found her a new home after the park closed. Sometimes seen smoking.

name: Yassan
description: A kind homeless man whom Anzu gets to know and teaches her about the value of money.

name: Mika Nitta
description: Nitta Yoshifumi's sister.

name: Sayo Aizawa
description: Sayo Aizawa is one of Hina's classmates. The bespectacled girl helped her peers discover Hitomi's secret job as a bartender and enjoys playfully teasing the girl about her profession.

name: Mami Shinjou
description: A classmate of Hina who believes that she has psychic powers.

name: Minako Mishima
description: Hitomi´s mother.

name: Kei Ikaruga
description: The Chief of Security of the esper organization. When Anzu fails to return from her mission to eliminate Hina, Kei is sent to monitor Hina.

name: Tsubasa Matsutani
description: He is a teacher in Hina's school.

name: Kengo Tanaka
description: A classmate of Hina.

name: Yoshihiko Ashikawa
description: The boss of the yakuza that Nitta works for.

name: Atsushi Yamamoto
description: A member of the rock band Rockfusion that Hina joins.

name: Takashi Shimoda
description: A classmate of Hina.

name: Toujirou Yamanaka
description: He's a delinquent and fan of Nitta. He is also one of Hina's highschool classmates.

name: Shiori Honda
description:
A high school English teacher. She was once an aspiring guitarist who was very passionate about starting a band; however, the one that originally sparked her interest, her brother, left her family in debt after taking a 20,000,000 Yen loan. His disappearance caused Shiori Honda to lose interest for the music industry and become a more recluse, timid, and plain individual. After being haunted by the ghost of Jimi Hendrix who noticed her musical talents, she is slowly re-discovering her passion for music.

~!After forming a contract with Jimi Hendrix, if Shiori doesn't become a guitar legend by the time her days of being 27 years old are up, she will die.!~

name: Jimi Hendrix
description: The ghost of the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix.

name: Kurt Cobain
description: The legend guitarist from the group Nirvana who died at 27.

name: Vanitas
description:
__Race:__ Human
__Height:__ 176 cm (5'9")
__Occupation:__ Doctor
__Partner:__ [Noé Archiviste](https://anilist.co/character/89835/Archiviste-No) (now), [Dante](https://anilist.co/character/155328/Dante) (former)

Vanitas is an average human being who inherited his name and the Book of Vanitas from the infamous vampire.

He seems to often take nothing seriously and almost always has a broad grin on his face. He acts more on emotions than thought most of the time since his plans are normally reckless. Also carries a mischievous air around him. 

~!When he was just a child, his parents were killed by a vampire. He was saved by the chasseurs and taken in. They trained him to become a chasseur but somewhere along the line, Vanitas caught Doctor Moreau's eye and became his research subject. According to Moreau, Vanitas went through multiple experiments that nearly killed him, and yet he never cried nor complained. The experiments continued until he and "no. 71" were rescued from Moreau's lab by Vanitas of the Blue Moon. Unlike no. 71, Vanitas hated Vanitas of the Blue Moon. The events that occurred afterwards are unknown, but Vanitas acquired the Book of Vanitas at some point. Since receiving the Book of Vanitas, Vanitas has dedicated his life to curing Curse-Bearing Vampires and considers himself a doctor of sorts as a result; using the power of the Book of Vanitas to restore a Curse-Bearer's true name.!~

name: Noé Archiviste
description:
__Race:__ Vampire
__Height:__ 187 cm (6'1")
__Occupation:__ Student
__Partner:__ [Vanitas](https://anilist.co/character/89590/Vanitas)

Noé is a gentleman vampire.

His story began when he received a letter from [The Teacher](https://anilist.co/character/230438/Sensei), which explained that The Teacher wanted Noé to fly to Paris immediately, as there had been rumors that The Book of Vanitas had been found there. The Teacher then specifically ordered Noé to discern The Book of Vanitas' true nature.

name: Jeanne
description:
__Race:__ Vampire
__Occupation:__ Chevalier (now), Bourreau (previously)

A vampire who acts as the Chevalier to [Luca](https://anilist.co/character/153506/Oriflamme-Lucius).

Jeanne is fiercely protective of Luca and gives off an air of rigidity and power while conducting her duty as his chevalier; however, she is prone to frantic outbursts, especially when in the presence of [Vanitas](https://anilist.co/character/89590/Vanitas), whom she dislikes. Due to her past as a bourreau, she is unused to having kindness directed towards her, and as a result, easily becomes flustered when she receives it.

~!She later falls in love with Vanitas!~

name: Dominique de Sade
description:
__Race:__ Vampire
__Occupation:__ Aristocrat, Royal Guard

Noé's childhood friend and the sister of [Louis](https://anilist.co/character/146017/de-Sade-Louis) and [Veronica](https://anilist.co/character/242848/de-Sade-Veronica). Her father is Count de Sade and her grandfather is [Noé](https://anilist.co/character/89835/Archiviste-No)'s teacher.

She is a flirtatious, playful, energetic, and charming young lady. She strides with style and elegance, even using a machine to spray rose petals when she first appears. However, she isn't afraid to hurt anyone who she suspects of harming those close to her.

~! It is later revealed that Dominique and Louis are actually twins and because of that they were raised seperately since twins mean bad luck to vampires in their culture. Dominique blames herself for the death of Louis and at one point even cuts her hair to resemble him more because she thinks Noé would've preferred to have Louis live instead of her. !~

name: Chloé d'Apchier
description:
__Race:__ Vampire
__Partner:__ [Jean-Jacques](https://anilist.co/character/155330/Chastel-Jean-Jacques)

She is a vampire that resides in the castle of Marquis d'Apchier, where her existence is hidden and is known there as the "Hidden Vampire" of the Marquis' family.

name: Roland Fortis
description:
__Race:__ Human
__Occupation:__ Captain of The Chasseurs

He is a human and known as the Sixth Paladin, and honored with the green gem of Jasper for his service as a Chasseur.

Roland often acts in a manner that emphasizes a fanaticism with his beliefs and seems oblivious to his surroundings and how his actions and words are regarded by others. Despite this, he is actually quite sharp and casually manipulates situations to his will. He is also a serious, capable and deadly opponent, willing to use many means to defeat a threat.

name: Murr
description: Noé's cat. Murr never shows any other emotion apart from irritability but seems to care a great deal for Noé - often times lurking in the shadows and watching Noé.

name: Louis de Sade
description:
He is a Vampire of the Crimson Moon. Louis had been born into the De Sade aristocracy alongside the likes of [Veronica](https://anilist.co/character/242848/de-Sade-Veronica) and [Dominique de Sade](https://anilist.co/character/139553/de-Sade-Dominique), however because of certain circumstances Count de Sade sent him to live with his grandfather permanently. While living with his grandfather, Louis would come to meet [Noé Archiviste](https://anilist.co/character/89835/Archiviste-No) and the two would become close friends.

~!Early in his life Louis was assessed as a potential Curse-Bearer and later thanks to his grandfather would become consciously aware of his condition, which lead him down a path allowing him to resist Charlatan's attempts to control him. Despite this however, when Noé organized a plan to help Mina escape her imminent execution following her diagnosis as a Curse-Bearer - Louis' fear for Noé and Dominique's safety would allow Charlatan the opportunity he'd been waiting for. Louis would proceed to save Noé and Dominique by killing Mina, only to go rogue himself and kill Fanny and Gilles as well. In the end, Louis was killed by his own grandfather when Noé was unable to do so himself by Louis' request.!~

name: Astolfo Granatum
description:
__Race:__ Human
__Occupation:__ Paladin of the Chasseurs

He is a human who at the age of fifteen became the youngest Paladin in the history of the Chasseurs, and having been subject to the bias that all Vampires are inherently evil, has dedicated his life toward their eradication in the name of his faith. 

Astolfo displays psychotic behavior in the face of battle. He relishes the slaughtering of both humans and vampires alike for grievances as petty as being mistaken for a woman. His belief that a Chasseur's duty is not to protect humans but to hunt vampires enables his lust for blood. He has also shown short-temperedness, particularly when called a woman or when his skills are compared to fellow Paladin, [Roland Fortis](https://anilist.co/character/139554/Fortis-Roland).

name: Jean-Jacques Chastel
description:
__Race:__ Vampire
__Partner:__ [Chloe d'Apchier](https://anilist.co/character/146014/dApchier-Chlo)

Jean-Jacques Chastel is a vampire who is shown to be a servant of Chloe d'Apchier in D'Apchier Family Castle at Silver Forest, Gévaudan.

~!Later, Jean Jacques is revealed to be the true Beast of Gevaudan, having made a contract with [Naenia](https://anilist.co/character/155248/Naenia) to undergo a monstrous transformation.!~

name: Olivier
description:
__Race:__ Human 
__Occupation:__ Paladin of the Chasseurs

Olivier is high-strung due to the constant agitation he has from Roland's impropriety as a chasseur. He is quick to anger towards Roland and is constantly frustrated at his inability to temper Roland's wilfulness.

name: Sougetsu no Kyuuketsuki Vanitas
description: Vanitas of the Blue Moon is a vampire. According to legend, they were born under the Blue Moon and were the ostensible creator of the Book of Vanitas and the disease Malnomen. It was their intent to destroy vampires through the corruption of their True Name, hoping to take revenge for a lifetime of prosecution for their birth. This power would be passed onto their kin, prophesied to bring about the end of all vampires.

name: Dante
description:
__Race:__ Dhampir
__Occupation:__ Information Broker
__Partner:__ [Johann](https://anilist.co/character/155329/Johann) (now), [Riche](https://anilist.co/character/155327/Riche) (now), [Vanitas](https://anilist.co/character/89590/Vanitas) (former)

Dante is a Dhampir acting as an insurance broker and jack-of-all-trades, he often partners with Vanitas, selling him information or working alongside him in pursuit of Curse-Bearing Vampires.

Dante tends to be rather carefree when dealing with Vanitas - though he is easily annoyed by his employer and partner - particularly when Vanitas addresses him as "Baldy." The two often take jabs at each other playfully, though in reality they enjoy each other's company. In a lot of instances Dante shows that he is very protective of those closest to him by nature. Dante is scared of dark and creepy places, like the catacombs and the forest.

name: Mikhail
description:
__Race:__ Human
__Age:__ Unknown

Misha has a cheerful smile and seems to be quite friendly and perceptive, but he also appears to be a bit dangerous.

~!Taken by Moreau at a young age, Misha was subject to numerous gruesome human experiments alongside many other children. For reasons unknown, Vanitas of the Blue Moon sought out Misha, destroying Moreau's laboratory and research in the process. During this time, the Blue Moon Vampire also adopted another, Vanitas - at the time referred to as "No. 69", into the Blue Moon Clan. The two would grow up alongside each other, only to be separated by unknown means - though the guilt over what happened to Misha still haunts Vanitas.!~

name: August Ruthven
description:
__Race:__ Vampire
__Partner:__ [Jeanne](https://anilist.co/character/89836/Jeanne) (former)

Lord Ruthven is a Vampire Lord who serves the Queen as a member of the senate. Due to his position, Lord Ruthven has had prominence since the war between humanity and Vampires.

~!Lord Ruthven has also made a point of investigating Curse-Bearers, doing so by partnering with [Moreau](https://anilist.co/character/250994/Moreau) and allowing him to conduct gruesome experiments on those afflicted by various Malnomen. He also has ties with Charlatan, and together they organized an assassination attempt against [Luca](https://anilist.co/character/153506/Oriflamme-Lucius), although his motives for doing so is unknown.!~

name: Johann
description:
__Race:__ Dhampir
__Occupation:__ Informant
__Partner:__ [Dante](https://anilist.co/character/155328/Dante), [Riche](https://anilist.co/character/155327/Riche)

Johann is a Dhampir who acts as an information broker and associate of Dante and Riche's.

Johann typically displays a flamboyant personality, characterized by his often animated facial expressions and a teasing and flirtatious manner of speech. He is physically affectionate and has a tendency of brushing against people or wrapping his arm around them when talking. However, when pushed far enough Johann will do anything to defend his fellow dhampirs, whom he sees as family.

name: Veronica de Sade
description: A Vampire of the Crimson Moon, the second eldest child of Count de Sade and older sister of [Dominique de Sade](https://anilist.co/character/139553/de-Sade-Dominique). She acts as a Beastia - or an enforcer to Queen Faustina - a result of her ability to alter World Formulae to produce ice. During her tenure as Beastia, Veronica entered an intimate relationship with fellow Beastia, [Marquis Machina](https://anilist.co/character/242847/Machina-Marquis).

name: Lucius Oriflamme
description:
__Race:__ Vampire
__Occupation:__ Grand Duke
__Partner:__ [Jeanne](https://anilist.co/character/89836/Jeanne)

He is a Vampire of noble birth born to inherit the title of Grand Duke, Luca is close to The Queen, though he is still too young to accept the role himself, thus allowing his uncle, [Lord Ruthven](https://anilist.co/character/155326/Ruthven-August), to act on his behalf.

name: Sensei
description: The Master belongs to the de Sade aristocracy - being the grandfather of [Dominique de Sade](https://anilist.co/character/139553/de-Sade-Dominique) - and is widely feared by many.

name: Amelia Ruth
description:
Amelia Ruth is a woman [Noé](https://anilist.co/character/89835/Archiviste-No) meets during a trip to Paris aboard La Baleine.

~!Amelia, a vampire, was stricken with a malady that warped her true name, becoming Eglantine, the Prison of Briars, and lashed out at Noé shortly after meeting him. [Vanitas](https://anilist.co/character/89590/Vanitas) managed to cure Amelia's ailment with the Book of Vanitas, revealing her true name to be Florifel, She Who Guides Spring. After being cured by Vanitas, Amelia was left on La Baleine and later taken into custody by Count Parks Orlok. Thanks to the efforts of Vanitas and Noé, Amelia was released from her previously scheduled execution under the condition that she remain under Count Orlok's watch in case she experienced a relapse. She is currently employed as a maid at Hôtel Chouchou.!~

name: Naenia
description:
Naenia is a mysterious ethereal entity from Jun Mochizuki's The Case Study of Vanitas. As a member of Charlatan, Naenia works alongside her colleagues, invading the subconscious of Vampires in order to inflict them with a Malnomen by distorting their true names. It is not presently known who Naenia is or what her motivations for doing so are.

~!Later on, it's revealed Naenia is the malmomen of the first queen of the crimson moon.!~

name: Riche
description:
__Race:__ Dhampir
__Occupation:__ Information Broker
__Partner:__ [Dante](https://anilist.co/character/155328/Dante), [Johann](https://anilist.co/character/155329/Johann)

Riche is a Dhampir who acts as an Information Broker. Often partnered with fellow Dhampirs, Dante and Johann, Riche commonly works on cases in relation to Curse-Bearing Vampires.

Riche is a very scholarly and passionate woman, who often gets carried away talking about what interests her. She is also quick to apologize after sharing her knowledge, as she is self-conscious of her habit to overshare and ramble. She can be very competitive with her fellow information-brokers, but also cares for others deeply.

name: Loki Oriflamme
description: Loki is the elder sibling of Luca Oriflamme and serves the Queen as a powerful Beastia; however, he is also a known Curse-Bearer.

name: Marquis Machina
description: A Vampire of the Crimson Moon with a keen interest in automation, as well as the head of the the Machina Marquisate. As a member of the senate, Machina is often involved in the higher affairs of Vampires.

name: Nox
description: Nox is a vampire who works alongside her brother, [Manet](https://anilist.co/character/242842/Manet), under [Count Parks Orlok](https://anilist.co/character/242839/Orlok-Parks) as his personal security.

name: Mimi Kagari
description:
__Height:__ 143 cm

A mysterious girl who came to [Sheena](https://anilist.co/character/198883/Totsuki-Sheena).

She is said to be the school's immortal secret weapon. She possesses unimaginable power despite her young appearance and innocent words and actions, and she has no reservations about killing her enemies. She has the ability to revive herself even after being injured to the point of losing her original human form.

name: Sheena Totsuki
description: Because of her class number, she is in the same room with [Mimi](https://anilist.co/character/198884/Kagari-Mimi) and is partnered with her. She hates war and anyone getting hurt, and has doubts about her mission as a weapon. Her magical power is low, and she can only use magic to move a book by floating it in the air...

name: Ali Maud
description:
__Height:__ 152 cm

She has a calm personality, always smiling, and is more mature than the other students. She has a bold personality and expresses her thoughts directly, which makes [Seiran](https://anilist.co/character/229290/Lizzy-Seiran) worry about her.

name: Seiran Lizzy
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm

She is a serious person with a strong sense of justice. Whenever one of her classmates behaves in a frivolous manner, she scolds them. But every time she does so, [Ali](https://anilist.co/character/229291/Maud-Ali) calms her down. She shows glimpses of a strong connection with Ali that goes beyond friendship.

name: Fran
description: The school nurse at the school [Sheena](https://anilist.co/character/198883/Totsuki-Sheena) and her friends attend. She is skilled in healing magic and is indispensable to the school. She’s always looking out for [Mimi](https://anilist.co/character/198884/Kagari-Mimi).

name: Esta Nino
description:
__Height:__ 158cm

An upperclassman from class 16.

Esta puts on a cheery demeanor and is kind to both her juniors and classmates. She would often ignore her own health and lets others have priority when it comes to getting treatment, regardless of how bad her own condition might be.

She is roommates with a classmate named [Heather](https://anilist.co/character/402132/Heather).

name: Halfred Anhalt
description:
__Height:__ 148 cm

[Mimi](https://anilist.co/character/198884/Kagari-Mimi) and [Sheena](https://anilist.co/character/198883/Totsuki-Sheena)'s classmate.

When younger, they disliked wearing the hand-me-down skirts from their older sisters, and asked for their brother's shorts instead, leading them to be criticized for not acting "like a girl" and causing problems for their family. At present, they are still figuring out their identity, and about relationships. They are intrigued by Mimi and Sheena's bond. Their favorite food is anything easy they can carry to their room.

name: Omi
description: The homeroom teacher for Class 14, to which [Sheena](https://anilist.co/character/198883/Totsuki-Sheena) and the others belong. Despite her detached demeanor, she truly cares about her students.

name: Heather
description: An upperclassman from class 16. She is roommates with a classmate named [Esta](https://anilist.co/character/380872/Nino-Esta).

name: Wuxian Wei
description:
Wei Wuxian is the founder of the Demonic Cultivation and a former disciple of the Yunmeng Jiang Sect. The son of Cangse-Sanren and Wei Changze.

Also known as the Yiling Patriarch, he died in the first siege of the Burial Mounds thirteen years prior to the start of the story. He was then reincarnated into the body of Mo Xuanyu through a sacrificial ritual.

name: Wangji Lan
description: Lan Wangji is the second young master of the Lan clan. Titled as HanGuang-Jun, Lan Wangji is one of the Two Jades of Lan alongside his older brother, Lan Xichen.

name: Wanyin Jiang
description: Jiang Wanyin is the current leader of the Yunmeng Jiang Sect and the uncle of Jin Ling. He is more commonly known to other cultivators by his courtesy name, Jiang Wanyin, or his title, Sandu Shengshou.

name: Ning Wen
description: Wen Ning, courtesy name Wen Qionglin, was a member of the Qishan Wen Sect. He was a friend of Wei Wuxian's in life, and after death became the first fierce corpse created by Wei Wuxian to retain his sense of self. Known as the Ghost General, he served as Wei Wuxian's righthand man during his time as the Yiling Patriarch.

name: Sizhui Lan
description:
A junior disciple of the Gusu Lan Sect. Born Wen Yuan, he's the last remaining blood descendant of the now-extinct Qishan Wen Sect. He was one of the Wen clan remnants taken in by Wei Wuxian shortly before his death, but he lost his home for a second time in the first siege of the Burial Mounds.

Discovered by an injured Lan Wangji who came searching for Wei Wuxian's remains in the aftermath, the then-three-year-old boy fell into a high fever and lost all memories of his past. He was then re-named to Lan Yuan and later presumably given the courtesy name Sizhui in the same year that Wei Wuxian returned to the living world.

name: Huaisang Nie
description: Nie Huaisang is the current leader of the Qinghe Nie Sect and the younger half-brother of the last sect leader, [Nie Mingjue](https://anilist.co/character/143065/Nie-Mingjue).

name: Yanli Jiang
description:
Jiang Cheng's sister, Wei Wuxian's sworn sister. She's a beautiful girl with a gentle and graceful personality, and really good culinary skills. Since young, she's been betrothed to Jin Zixuan, the young master of Lanling Jin clan. Treats Wei Wuxian like a brother.

~!Yanli was killed when she was stabbed by a sword during a fight that occurred at the Pledge Conference at Nightless Sky!~

name: Ling Jin
description:
Jin Ling, courtesy name Jin Rulan, is a junior disciple of the Lanling Jin Sect. He is the only son of Jiang Yanli and Jin Zixuan and the nephew of both Jin Guangyao and Jiang Cheng. Jin Ling is the only living, legitimate child of the Jin clan, and will therefore inherit the position of sect leader after Jin Guangyao. He is also the owner of Fairy, a spiritual dog given to him by Jin Guangyao.

~!His parents died when he was a baby. His father, Jin Zixuan, died during the Qiongqi Path Ambush and his mother, Jiang Yanli, died during the bloodbath of Nightless City, leaving him an orphan at less than two months old. He hates Wei Wuxian for this reason, thinking that he was responsible for his parents' death.!~

name: Xichen Lan
description: Lan Huan, courtesy name Lan Xichen is the current leader of the Gusu Lan Sect and one of the Two Jades of Lan alongside his younger brother, Lan Wangji. He is also known by the title, Zewu-jun. He is at most three years older than his brother.

name: Qing Wen
description: Wen Qing is the older sister of Wen Ning. As part of the branch families, Wen Qing also shared descent from the Qishan Wen Sect founder Wen Mao, though not to the point of the Wen main clan.

name: Xingchen Xiao
description: The third of Baoshan Sanren's students to leave her mountain for the mortal world.

name: Jingyi Lan
description: Lan Jingyi is a junior disciple of the Gusu Lan Sect. He is usually seen with Lan Sizhui and bickers the most with Jin Ling.

name: Yang Xue
description: A guest disciple of the Lanling Jin Sect. He was recruited to increase their strength in Demonic Cultivation.

name: Guangyao Jin
description: Jin Guangyao is the current leader of the Lanling Jin Sect after the death of Jin Guangshan. He is Jin Zixuan's half-brother and uncle to Jin Ling.

name: Mingjue Nie
description: Nie Mingjue was a former leader of the Qinghe Nie Sect and the older half-brother and predecessor of Nie Huaisang.

name: Fengmian Jiang
description:
Jiang Fengmian was the former leader of the Yunmeng Jiang Sect and the father of Jiang Cheng and Jiang Yanli. He also took Wei Wuxian under his care and considered him as his own child.

~!He was killed during the Massacre at Lotus Cove when his Golden Core was melted by Wen Zhuliu!~

name: Zixuan Jin
description:
Jin Zixuan was Jiang Yanli's husband and the father of Jin Ling. He was Jin Guangshan's only legitimate child.

~!He was killed at Qiongqi Path when his heart was pierced by Wen Ning's hand.!~

name: Qiren Lan
description: Lan Qiren is an elder of the Gusu Lan Sect known for producing outstanding students, even out of the most hopeless ones. He is the uncle of Lan Xichen and Lan Wangji.

name: Zixun Jin
description: Jin Zixun is a member of the Lanling Jin Clan and the cousin of Jin Zixuan.

name: Bojji
description:
The firstborn prince of the Bosse Kingdom.
Bojji was born abnormally small, weak, and deaf. He is a powerless prince who has lived his life under the shadow of his father, the legendary [King Bosse](https://anilist.co/character/244198/). He wants to be the world's greatest king, following his father

Bojji is extremely hard-working and sincere, and these traits draw people towards him even if they can't always understand him.

~!He learns how to wield a sword thanks to [Despa](https://anilist.co/character/244201/). Despa helps him overcome his physical limitations, by making use of his agility and precision
It was later revealed that the reason why he is so weak is because back when his father was still a wandering adventurer, he made a deal with a demon to take the strength from his yet-unborn first son (Bojji) and give it to him. This made Bosse the strongest man in the world, but took away the physical strength of Bojji in turn.!~

name: Narrator
description:
This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. 

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

name: Kage
description: Kage is a literal shadow who becomes [Bojji](https://anilist.co/character/209532/Bojji)’s first friend.

name: Hiling
description: [King Bosse](https://anilist.co/character/244198/)'s second wife, current Queen. She is [Daida](https://anilist.co/character/231128/)'s biological mother and [Bojji](https://anilist.co/character/209532/Bojji)'s step mother. Originally a priestess from a neighboring territory/kingdom.

name: Despa
description: [Desha](https://anilist.co/character/244202/)'s brother and ~![Ouken](https://anilist.co/character/260808/)'s brother.!~

name: Dorshe
description: [Hiling](https://anilist.co/character/231129/)'s bodyguard.

name: Desha
description: The King of the Underworld, ranking #2 in the Ranking of Kings. He is the older brother of both Despa.

name: Daida
description: He is the second prince and second king of the Bosse Kingdom. He is the son of Bosse and Hilling, and the younger brother of Bojji.

name: Bosse
description: The king of Bosse Kingdom and Bojji and Daida's father. He placed seventh in the king's ranking.

name: Sheena
description: The former queen and the biological mother of [Bojji](https://anilist.co/character/209532/).

name: Kage Haha
description: ~!Kage's mother was killed saving Kage from light clan.!~

name: Karyuudo
description:
An unnamed monarch who inhabits the forest that lies between the Bosse Kingdom and the Underworld. Bojji briefly encountered this king while lost in the forest.

(Source: Ousama Ranking Wiki)

name: Oguri Cap
description:
__Height:__ 167 cm

A coolheaded dreamer from the countryside.

Originally hailing from the countryside, she enrolled in Tracen Academy after dominating the racing scene back home. She works to make her hometown proud, but try as she might, her clumsy side always comes out. At the academy, she's known as a fearsome gourmand, able to empty an entire pot of rice in the blink of an eye.

name: Toukai Teiou
description:
__Height:__ 150 cm

Unbeatable and adorable! A happy hoppin' racer.

A bright, bubbly Umamusume with a natural knack for racing. She's long looked up to the student council president, [Symboli Rudolf](https://anilist.co/character/140844/Symboli-Rudolf), and this admiration serves as her ultimate motivation in becoming the number one racer. Fans can't get enough of Teio's boundless confidence, and have lovingly dubbed her upbeat march the "Teio Step."

name: Rice Shower
description:
__Height:__ 145 cm

Bringer of misfortune? This racer pursues her dreams despite her dreary outlook.

A timid Umamusume, she is under the impression that any misfortune befalling those around her is entirely her fault, when really, it's just bad timing. Nevertheless, she is determined to eradicate this supposed jinx of hers. She loves reading picture books in her spare time, especially "The Blue Rose of Good Fortune."

name: Mejiro McQueen
description:
__Height:__ 159 cm

The crown jewel of the prestigious Mejiro clan. A classy and poised young lady.

Born into a family of racing legends, Mejiro McQueen is a long-distance runner who is the envy of her peers. She has class and decorum befitting her prestige, and is determined to take first at the Tenno Sho, like many Mejiro racers before her. On her days off, she enjoys having afternoon tea with the many other residents of the Mejiro estate.

name: Gold Ship
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm

Wild and unpredictable, this golden runner is unlike anybody else!

An unpredictable firebrand born with an extra helping of free spirit. She's prone to some dramatic swings in mood and motivation—one moment she could be setting up an elaborate punchline, and in the next you would be hard-pressed to get her to move. She seems to get along with anyone and everyone, but it is unclear just how she views her bonds with others. Truly, one could call her Tracen's greatest mischief-maker.

name: Silence Suzuka
description:
__Height:__ 161 cm

The silent runner aiming to break the sound barrier.

An Umamusume seen as a prodigy who's always ahead of the pack, both figuratively and literally. She gets so absorbed with running that she comes off as aloof, but most know that she is dedicated. She is roommates with Special Week and many find themselves attracted to her authentic personality.

name: Kitasan Black
description:
__Height:__ 140 cm (Season 2) / 162 cm (Season 3)
__Team:__ Spica

Her smile brightens the room. A festival-loving bucket of sunshine.

Ever bright and cheerful, she loves festivals more than anyone else. Her innate altruism makes her unable to ignore a person in need, and she's always ready to lend an ear. Her bottomless kindness has earned her the admiration of those around her, but when she gets too excited, her words take on a certain festival flair. With a smile as bright as the sun, she continues to run towards the dazzling horizon, hoping that she will discover her true dream along the way.

name: Tamamo Cross
description:
__Height:__ 140 cm
