As the Chainsaw Devil, he has the ability to grow chainsaws out of his body.

name: Power
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7")

Power is a fiend, a dead body possessed by a devil.

She is a Public Safety Devil Hunter who works (against her will) under [Makima](https://anilist.co/character/137080/Makima) as a member of an experimental squad in Tokyo Special Division 4. She works alongside her partner [Denji](https://anilist.co/character/130102/Denji), and under supervision by [Aki Hayakawa](https://anilist.co/character/137081/Aki-Hayakawa).

Power is childish, greedy, and almost entirely self-motivated. She tends to fights if she has something to gain and is certain of her victory and has no problems in running away from a fight where she is outmatched. She also feels the need to boast her superiority over her fellow Devil Hunters due to her status as a fiend. She has no loyalty to humanity, openly admitting that she will join the winning side. Power is often rude, unkempt, and feels as though those around her should clean up after her. She self-admittedly rarely bathes or flushes the toilet and sees humans as being sensitive for caring about their hygiene so much. As the Blood Fiend, she has the power to freely manipulate the blood within her own body.

name: Aki Hayakawa
description:
__Height:__ 182 cm (6'0")
__Devil Contracts:__ [Fox Devil](https://anilist.co/character/290671/Kitsune-no-Akuma), [Curse Devil](https://anilist.co/character/174265/Noroi-no-Akuma), ~![Future Devil](https://anilist.co/character/172887/Mirai-no-Akuma)!~
__Relatives:__ [Hahaoya Hayakawa](https://anilist.co/character/291241/Hayakawa-Hahaoya) (Mother), [Chichioya Hayakawa](https://anilist.co/character/291240/Hayakawa-Chichioya) (Father), [Taiyou Hayakawa](https://anilist.co/character/174261/Taiyou) (Younger Brother).

A Public Safety Devil Hunter working under [Makima](https://anilist.co/character/137080/Makima) as a member of Tokyo Special Division 4. He is partnered with [Himeno](https://anilist.co/character/144596/Himeno) and tasked with supervising both [Power](https://anilist.co/character/137079/Power) and [Denji](https://anilist.co/character/130102/Denji).

Aki Hayakawa generally appears to be a very stoic person. He acts mature and dependable when he's with his fellow Devil hunters but is actually very soft when he is alone. He has a tendency to get attached to others easily, and hates to see people get hurt, especially his close friends. Aki's primary goal and reasoning for becoming a Devil Hunter is to kill the [Gun Devil](https://anilist.co/character/208942/Juu-no-Akuma) to get revenge for his family.

~!He later loses his contract with the Fox Devil and gains a new contract with the Future Devil!~

name: Reze
description:
Reze is a young girl who met [Denji](https://anilist.co/character/130102/Denji) in a phone cabin. She works at a local café and is a kind and gentle girl who seems to have a crush on Denji soon after meeting him. She laughs at his jokes and isn't afraid to get close to and intimate with him.

~!‌‌‌‌‌‌‌‌She is secretly the Bomb Devil hybrid, owned by the Soviet Union and allied to the Gun Devil. Her true personality is manipulative and brutal, as she is shown killing many Devil Hunters without care or mercy. She does, however, not enjoy killing and prefers to avoid it, unless necessary for her mission. Her objective is to retrieve the Chainsaw Heart from Denji, but the feelings she developed for him quickly made things more complicated.!~

name: Pochita
description: Pochita appears to be a small red canine with a chainsaw like appendage protruding from the center of his head. Handles emerge from his body allowing him to be wielded like a chainsaw and his short tail is in the shape of a chainsaw's pull cord. Unlike most devils, Pochita communicated solely through barks and whines like an actual dog.

name: Kobeni Higashiyama
description:
__Height:__ 155 cm

A Public Safety Devil Hunter, she is a new recruit working under [Makima](https://anilist.co/character/137080/Makima) as a member of Tokyo Special Division 4. She is partnered with [Hirokazu Arai](https://anilist.co/character/174263).

She is not very courageous and gets scared easily by devils. Kobeni is shown to easily crack under pressure and break into tears during serious moments. Even though Kobeni is timid, she is pretty talented as a devil hunter. When Kobeni gets into action, she has proven to be cool-headed and efficient in battle, only breaking down in a panic once the fighting is over. Kobeni chooses to keep her devil contract a secret.

name: Tenshi no Akuma
description:
__Height:__ 155 cm

Angel Devil is a devil who embodies the fear of angels, and a Public Safety Devil Hunter from Special Division 4.

The Angel Devil is a unique case among devils having virtually no hostility towards humans. He dislikes being ordered around and doesn't seem inclined towards combat. His extreme laziness holds him back from being a strong fighter and he often refuses to work, even claiming to prefer dying to working.

name: Himeno
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5'9")
__Devil Contract:__ [Ghost Devil](https://anilist.co/character/174262/Yuurei-no-Akuma)
__Relatives:__ [Unnamed Younger Sister](https://anilist.co/character/174283/Himeno-no-Imouto)

A Public Safety Devil Hunter, working under [Makima](https://anilist.co/character/137080/Makima) as a member of Tokyo Special Division 4. She is partnered with [Aki Hayakawa](https://anilist.co/character/137081/Aki-Hayakawa), whom she shares a close personal bond with.

Himeno is shown to be a mature and experienced superior to the new recruits working under her. She generally carries herself with an upbeat body language and is capable of staying calm under extremely stressful situations. Himeno is very efficient and blunt in her duty as a Devil Hunter. Himeno is also shown to be a rather caring and empathetic person, however she does have a sterner side and little tolerance for behavior from new recruits that would endanger or harm her subordinates. 

Himeno holds an extremely pessimistic worldview as a result of having witnessed multiple partners die suddenly in her line of work. Her knowledge that Devil Hunters typically die as a result of their career combined with the teachings of her [master](https://anilist.co/character/144593/Kishibe) eventually lead to her developing a nicotine addiction as a coping mechanism. She also tends to acts extremely aloof and sexual, enjoying a hedonistic lifestyle. However, similarly to her smoking addiction, her hedonistic ways are not used as pleasure, but rather as another defense mechanism.

name: Kishibe
description:
__Height:__ 194 cm
__Devil Contracts:__ ~!Claw Devil, Knife Devil, Needle Devil!~

A Public Safety Devil Hunter from Special Division 1. ~!After the assault on the Special Divisions, he became captain of the Special Division 4.!~

Kishibe is a grizzled man with scraggly facial hair and a stitched scar running across his left cheek from his mouth. He normally wears the standard Public Safety devil hunter uniform with a large overcoat. He has two piercings on his left ear, and one on his right ear. He is often seen with a hip flask which he frequently drinks from. Kishibe is a stoic, straightforward individual. Due to his immense strength and skill, he often undertakes his work with a calm formality, displaying little emotion as he does so. Though he tends to speak in a relaxed, polite manner, his actions often showcase an immense brutality garnered through many years of Devil Hunting. Though he sometimes expresses emotions such as surprise and sadness at certain events, his face and voice remain entirely neutral. Kishibe has been hunting devils for a long time, making him somewhat insane. He espouses a belief that the most fearsome devil hunters to devils isn't the brave or the strong, but the craziest as they are the ones without fear. He admits that he enjoys booze, women and killing devils.

~!He is the former partner of [Quanxi](https://anilist.co/character/162123/Quanxi).!~

name: Beam
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm (With fin: 176 cm)

He is a Shark Fiend and a Public Safety Devil Hunter from Special Division 4.

Beam is very eccentric. He often goes along with [Denji](https://anilist.co/character/130102/Denji)'s plans no matter how crazy they are due to having a lot of respect for the [Chainsaw Devil](https://anilist.co/character/170266/Pochita).

name: Bouryoku no Majin
description:
He is a Fiend and Public Safety Devil Hunter from Special Division 4.

Despite his moniker as the Violence Fiend, he is extremely polite and straightforward. He apologized to [Beam](https://anilist.co/character/157232/Beam) after hitting him in self-defense and told the [Spider Devil](https://anilist.co/character/157277/Prinz) to evacuate the area when he mistook her for a human lady.

~!He is later partnered with [Kobeni Higashiyama](https://anilist.co/character/144594/Higashiyama-Kobeni) following the events of the Katana Man Arc!~

name: Nyaako
description: [Power](https://anilist.co/character/137079/Power)'s cat. ~!Now currently owned by [Denji](https://anilist.co/character/130102/Denji).!~

name: Samurai Sword
description: Samurai Sword is a human-devil hybrid who merged with the Katana Devil. His [grandfather](https://anilist.co/character/289198/Yakuza) was killed by [Denji](https://anilist.co/character/130102/Denji) when they initially fused with [Pochita](https://anilist.co/character/170266/Pochita), and because of that, he affiliated with the [Gun Devil](https://anilist.co/character/208942/Juu-no-Akuma) to get revenge on Denji. He works alongside [Akane Sawatari](https://anilist.co/character/174264/Akane-Sawatari) and other fellow members of the Yakuza.

name: Michiko Tendou
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5'9")
__Devil Contracts:__ ~![Punishment Devil](https://anilist.co/character/306237/Batsu-no-Akuma)!~

A Public Safety Devil Hunter from Kyoto. She is partnered with [Yuutarou Kurose](https://anilist.co/character/144592/Yuutarou-Kurose).

name: Mirai no Akuma
description: The Future Devil is a devil that embodies the fear of the future. ~!After seeing [Aki Hayakawa](https://anilist.co/character/137081/Aki-Hayakawa)'s future, it made a contract with him, so he can see that future himself.!~

name: Yuutarou Kurose
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm (5'5")
__Devil Contract:__ ~![Punishment Devil](https://anilist.co/character/306237/Batsu-no-Akuma)!~

A Public Safety Devil Hunter from Kyoto. He is partnered with [Michiko Tendou](https://anilist.co/character/144595/Michiko-Tendou).

name: Akane Sawatari
description:
__Devil Contract:__ [Snake Devil](https://anilist.co/character/174269/Hebi-no-Akuma)

An enigmatic former Private Detective Hunter, she pledged her allegiance with the [Gun Devil](https://anilist.co/character/208942/Juu-no-Akuma) after making a contract with him and as a result, she seeks to obtain [Denji](https://anilist.co/character/130102/Denji)'s heart for her master. To that end, she conspires with members of the yakuzas, including the likes of [Katana Man](https://anilist.co/character/157241/Samurai-Sword), while acting as a weapons dealer for them in order to obtain Denji's heart easier.

name: Kitsune no Akuma
description:
The Fox Devil is a devil that embodies the fear of foxes. 

It is friendly with humans, allowing numerous Devil Hunters to make contracts with itself. However it only grants attractive people the ability to summon its head, showing a rather superficial side of itself.

**Known Contractors:** 
~! [Aki Hayakawa](https://anilist.co/character/137081/Aki-Hayakawa), [Hirokazu Arai](https://anilist.co/character/174263/Hirokazu-Arai), [Nomo](https://anilist.co/character/174266/Nomo)!~

name: Prinz
description:
She is a devil who embodies the fear of spiders, and is a Public Safety Devil Hunter from Special Division 4.

The Spider Devil usually takes a human shape so she tends to be friendly to humans and works as a devil hunter herself, however she will still kill people for just looking at her the wrong way.

name: Yuurei no Akuma
description:
The Ghost Devil is a devil that embodies the fear of ghosts. 

**Known Contractors:** ~![Himeno](https://anilist.co/character/144596/Himeno)!~

name: Hirokazu Arai
description:
__Devil Contract:__ [Fox Devil](https://anilist.co/character/290671/Kitsune-no-Akuma)

A Public Safety Devil Hunter, he is a new recruit working under [Makima](https://anilist.co/character/137080/Makima) as a member of Tokyo Special Division 4. He is partnered with [Kobeni Higashiyama](https://anilist.co/character/144594/Kobeni-Higashiyama).

Hirokazu is shown to have high moral standards and cares a lot about his teammates and their wellbeing, going out of his way to assist and support others whenever possible, especially towards those who are sick. He was trained by [Himeno](https://anilist.co/character/144596) for half a year. Himeno has stated that what he lacks in ability, he makes up for in drive. He likes writing haikus in his free time as a hobby.

name: Tomato no Akuma
description: The Tomato Devil is a devil that embodies the fear of tomatoes. ~!The Tomato Devil was walking around a house, when [Denji](https://anilist.co/character/130102/Denji) with the help of [Pochita](https://anilist.co/character/170266/Pochita) went and killed him.!~

name: Eien no Akuma
description: The Eien no Akuma is a devil that embodies the fear of eternity. He is the primary antagonist of the titular Eternity Devil arc.

name: Madoka
description: A Public Safety Devil Hunter. ~!After the assault on the Devil Hunters by the [Gun Devil](https://anilist.co/character/208942/Juu-no-Akuma-)'s associates, he was one of the few survivors and decided to leave his job as a Devil Hunter.!~

name: Mio Kofune
description: She is Ushio's younger sister and a first-year high school student. She is good at sports, belongs to the swimming club, and has tanned skin. Despite the death of her older sister, she has a healthy side, such as her cheerful attitude toward Shinpei when he returns home.

name: Shinpei Ajiro
description: Shinpei Ajiro is the main protagonist of the Summer Time Rendering series. He returned to his hometown of Hitogashima for the first time in two years to attend the funeral of his childhood friend, Ushio Kofune. Since he lost his parents at an early age and grew up in the Kofune family, he has been close to Ushio and Mio as if they were his family. ~!Ever wonder why Shinpei is drawn with different colored pupils or irises? it is the eye of Haine, the original shadow. It originally belonged to Haine but after leaving it, this eye was granted as a gift from Ushio to Shinpei. Following the information cited by Shide, this right eye has the power to control time, unlike Haine's left eye which can see time. With this eye, Shinpei receives various types of sub-skills, the most common, and most used is that of observation; By observing various parallel worlds with this eye, he can choose which world he will enter, and according to Shide, there is a likelihood that there are several types of world, such as a world where Shinpei and everyone in the village die for Haine and Shide, or a world where Shinpei conquers the shadows and peace blooms again on Hitogashima Island, or a world where the people he loves so much are slowly dying, and so on. This eye in question also gives a certain level of premonition, not least because it can see parts of the future thanks to its time travel. With this eye he can also travel in time, and even take someone with him, or he can use that eye to regenerate himself from injuries or problems that he started to face in each time loop he lived.!~

name: Hizuru Minakata
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm

Hizuru Minakata is an author who writes using the pseudonym ~!Ryuunosuke Nagumo.!~

~!She has a double personality, the second of which is her dead twin brother, [Ryuunosuke Nagumo](https://anilist.co/character/231699/Nagumo-Ryuunosuke).!~ ~!In actuality, it is [Ryuunosuke](https://anilist.co/character/231699/Nagumo-Ryuunosuke)'s shadow that is within Hizuru. He takes control whenever they must fight, so as not to make Hizuru's hands dirty. They eventually manage to properly meet and talk to each other within their mind, which they were unable to do prior. Afterwards, they take control in tandem, where [Ryuunosuke](https://anilist.co/character/231699/Nagumo-Ryuunosuke) is in control of her body to fight, while Hizuru talks to Haine at the same time!~

name: Ushio Kofune
description: __Height:__ 162 cm She lives in Hitogashima, she lost her life in a maritime accident while trying to save Shiori from drowning in the sea. Her death acts as the starting point of the story, with Shinpei returning home to attend her funeral.

name: Haine
description:
Haine is the main antagonist of the Summertime Rendering series.

~!Hiruko is known as the God of Hitogashima and the mother of all Shadows. She takes the form of Haine, the first person she copied. Prior to her current apperance and based on the history and legends of Hitogashima, she took on the form of a whale's shadow.!~

name: Ryuunosuke Nagumo
description:
The twin brother of Hizuru Minamikata. Ryuunosuke was killed by the shadows in middle school.

~!Though he was killed by Haine, he was also copied and his shadow went into Hizuru, thus forming a bond that let the two switch places in taking control of her body. He often takes control whenever shadows are around, so he dirties his own hands so his sister doesn't have to. The reason for Ryuunosuke seeing two seconds ahead is due to Haine's human-side splitting from her main self with an error of 2 seconds ahead in time, which led to him not just seeing the future but fighting in the future. He often has to hold back when fighting to not damage his sister's body.!~ ~!After Hizuru is killed, Ryuunosuke is transferred into Shinpei's mind. From there, he helps protect Shinpei and fights for him. When they enter the shadow world, he takes full control of Shinpei's body and keeps him safe from dissolving. While he talks to Shinpei, he wishes to be casual and stops hiding his accent. This makes Shinpei casual with him.!~ ~!In the end, Ryuunosuke is alive and an adult with a reincarnated version of Haine as his daughter.!~

name: Tokiko Hishigata
description: __Height:__ 150 cm Tokiko Hishigata is Sou's younger sister, a first-year high school student. She is intelligent and has the top grades in her grade, but she is physically weak and not good at sports. She and Mio have known each other since childhood and are classmates at the same high school.

name: Ginjirou Nezu
description: Ginjiro Nezu is  is an elderly hunter who carries a rifle. He lives on Hitogashima Island and appears to know something about "shadows".

name: Sou Hishigata
description: __Height:__ 178 cm Sou Hishigata is Shinpei's childhood friend and best friend. He is the eldest son of Hishigata Clinic, the only hospital in Hitogashima, and is studying to become a doctor. He has a strong sense of justice and regrets that he was present at the scene of Ushio's maritime accident but was unable to prevent it. He has confessed his feelings to Mio twice in the past and was rejected.

name: Masahito Karikiri
description:
Masahito Karikiri is the chief priest of the Nitto Shrine located in the northern part of Hitogashima.

~!It is revealed later in the series that Masahito Karikiri is Shide and a human/shadow hybrid, allowing him to his armor made of shadows.!~

name: Tetsu Totsumura
description: A lighthearted police officer who works at Hitogashima's only police station. His personality leaves people wondering if he truly is an officer.

name: Shiori Kobayakawa
description: A young girl living in Hitogashima. Her family owns the Koba Mart. She was saved from drowning by [Ushio](https://anilist.co/character/155712/Kofune-Ushio), however, ended up drowning herself in that incident.

name: Chitose Hishigata
description:
The wife of [Seido Hishigata](https://anilist.co/character/155709/Seidou-Hishigata) and mother of [Sou Hishigata](https://anilist.co/character/155708/Sou-Hishigata) and [Tokiko Hishigata](https://anilist.co/character/155705/Tokiko-Hishigata). She is diagnosed with an unknown illness, leaving her unable to move around without a wheelchair.

~!It is revealed later in the series that the current Chitose Hishigata is a copied shadow and the orginal is deceased. This was part of deal that [Seido Hishigata](https://anilist.co/character/155709/Seidou-Hishigata) made with [Haine](https://anilist.co/character/155704/Haine) where he himself would be turned into a shadow so the couple could live on forever. !~

name: Alain Kofune
description: Alain is the father of [Ushio](https://anilist.co/character/155712/Ushio-Kofune) and [Mio](https://anilist.co/character/155706/Mio-Kofune). He is from France and runs a restaurant called "Western Cuisine Kofune" in Hitogashima. For [Shinpei](https://anilist.co/character/155703/Ajiro-Shinpei), he is the adoptive father who welcomed him after he lost his parents in an accident. His wife, Kotoko, died after the birth of [Mio](https://anilist.co/character/155706/Mio-Kofune).

name: Asako Kobayakawa
description: Asako Kobayakawa is the mother of [Shiori](https://anilist.co/character/155707/Shiori-Kobayakawa) and is the owner of the Koba Mart.

name: Seidou Hishigata
description:
Seido Hishigata is the father of [Sou](https://anilist.co/character/155708/Sou-Hishigata) and [Tokiko](https://anilist.co/character/155705/Tokiko-Hishigata). He serves as the director of Hitogashima's only hospital, the Hishigata Clinic.

~!It is revealed later in the series that Seido Hishigata used his clinic as a front to hide his affiliation with [Haine](https://anilist.co/character/155704/Haine) where he would feed the bodies of the deceased to her.!~

name: Tatsuo Kobayakawa
description: The father of [Shiori](https://anilist.co/character/155707/Shiori-Kobayakawa).

name: Mi-Ae Hwang
description:
__Class:__ Baekje Middle School 3-12 No. 40
__Height:__ 150.1 cm

name: Cheol Kim
description:
__Class:__ Baekje Middle School 3-12 NO. 7
__Height:__ 180 cm

name: Seo Jisoo
description:
__Class:__ Baekje Middle School 3-12 
__Height:__ 174 cm

name: Song-I Han
description: __Height:__ 164 cm

name: Takagi
description:
__Height:__ 150 cm (4'11")

A middle schooler​ at an unnamed school. She sits at the back of class 1-2 next to [Nishikata](https://anilist.co/character/120799). Academically talented and physically capable, she claims her only weaknesses are her ticklish armpits and her inability to stop teasing Nishikata.

name: Nishikata
description:
__Height:__ 150 cm (4'11")

Nishikata is a middle school student in class 1-2. He sits in the back of the classroom next to [Takagi](https://anilist.co/character/120800). He can't handle bitter things like black coffee, secretly watches/reads a romance titled "100% Unrequited Love", and gets frightened very easily. He does average academically.

name: Mina Hibino
description: Mina is an energetic, bubbly girl and always cheerful in the group. She is very playful at all times and always noisy. Mina also is bad at running and gets tired easily, such as when she was excited for the school marathon, yet got tired at the start.

name: Chii Nishikata
description: Daughter of Nishikata and (née) Takagi. She hates green peppers, but loves to tickle her father. At the beginning of the story, she goes to kindergarten.

name: Sanae Tsukimoto
description:
Sanae Tsukimoto is one of [Nishikata](https://anilist.co/character/120799/Nishikata)'s and [Takagi](https://anilist.co/character/120800/Takagi)'s classmates and a close friend of [Mina](https://anilist.co/character/128608/Mina-Hibino) and [Yukari](https://anilist.co/character/128614/Yukari-Tenkawa).

Sanae is a very blunt, yet caring and intelligent girl. Known for always having a very stoic expression and demeanor, Sanae likes to keep to herself. She is extremely athletic and is particularly adept at running and swimming. Underneath her typically expressionless exterior, Sanae is shown to care greatly for her two closest friends, Mina and Yukari. The three girls are constantly seen together, both in and out of school. Sanae may have a soft spot for animals. In one instance, Sanae was chasing a cat that had taken Yukari's snack. However, upon realizing that the cat had taken the snack in order to feed its kittens, Sanae decided to let the feline keep the stolen snack.

name: Houjou
description:
Houjou is a student who shares the same class as [Takagi](https://anilist.co/character/120800/Takagi) and [Nishikata](https://anilist.co/character/120799/Nishikata). She has a mature personality which contrasts with her classmates. Every time she sees someone immature, she would say how immature of them.

Despite her maturity, she is often endeared by [Hamaguchi](https://anilist.co/character/163023/Hamaguchi)'s clumsy personality.

name: Kimura
description: Nishikata's friend

name: Mano
description:
Mano is [Nishikata](https://anilist.co/character/120799/Nishikata)'s and [Takagi](https://anilist.co/character/120800/Takagi)'s classmates and has an undisclosed relationship with [Nakai](https://anilist.co/character/128607/Nakai). 

Mano is generally shy, anxious, and sheepish towards other people, especially when she is trying to talk to Nakai. She also has noticeable anger issues, as she quickly becomes impatient when bothered or pestered by others. Regarding her relationship with Nakai, she often second-guesses herself while trying to interact with him. She wishes that Nakai would show more interest in the relationship, but loves him regardless. They are seen happily watching the fireworks together at the summer festival, showing that the two are able to enjoy each other's presence despite their issues with each other.

name: Nakai
description:
One of the classmates of [Nishikata](https://anilist.co/character/120799/Nishikata) and [Takagi](https://anilist.co/character/120800/Takagi) and the boyfriend of [Mano](https://anilist.co/character/128606/Mano). 

Nakai has a very calm, friendly and laid-back demeanor who enjoys hanging out with his male friends more than he does with Mano. He explains that it's hard for him to hang out with Mano, although he still greatly cares for her.

name: Hamaguchi
description: Hamaguchi is one of [Nishikata](https://anilist.co/character/120799/Nishikata)'s friend. He seems to be interested in [Houjou](https://anilist.co/character/163024/Houjou).

name: Sumire Takagawa
description: Sumire Takagawa is one of [Takagi](https://anilist.co/character/120800/Takagi)'s and [Nishikata](https://anilist.co/character/120799/Nishikata)'s classmates. She is a close friend of Takagi.

name: Tanabe-sensei
description:
Mr. Tanabe is the homeroom teacher of class 1-2, in which [Takagi](https://anilist.co/character/120800/Takagi), [Nishikata](https://anilist.co/character/120799/Nishikata), [Mano](https://anilist.co/character/128606/Mano), [Nakai](https://anilist.co/character/128607/Nakai), [Sanae](https://anilist.co/character/128611/Sanae-Tsukimoto), [Mina](https://anilist.co/character/128608/Mina-Hibino) and [Yukari](https://anilist.co/character/128614/Yukari-Tenkawa) are a part of.

~!He later proposes to Tsukimoto-sensei.!~

name: Katsuo
description: A parakeet at the pet shop of Ōta, that Nishikata and Takagi visited.

name: Tsukimoto-sensei
description:
Sanae Tsukimoto's older sister.

~!She is later proposed by Tanabe-sensei.!~

name: Oota
description: A clerk at a pet shop visited by Nishikata and Takagi.

name: Yoshiki Tsujinaka
description:
The best friend of [Hikaru](https://anilist.co/character/281110/Hikaru-Indou), he is a quiet teenage boy. He has a fondness for animals and insects. 

~!The first to realize that "Hikaru" isn't Hikaru. He struggles with accepting the fact that his childhood friend has been replaced by something else, yet continues to go about his daily life with it.!~

name: Hikaru Indou
description:
An easy going teenage boy who went missing in the forbidden mountains for a week about half a year ago.

~!A shapeshifter who took the form of Hikaru after his death. This new "Hikaru" has become greatly attached to Hikaru's best friend, [Yoshiki](https://anilist.co/character/281109/Tsujinaka-Yoshiki). It seems innocent and full of curiosity.!~

name: Tanaka
description:
A man who seems to be investigating something for a certain company. He is always carefree and elusive. He has a hamster as his partner. 

(Source: Official Site)

name: Asako Yamagishi
description:
A classmate of [Yoshiki.](https://anilist.co/character/281109/Yoshiki-Tsujinaka) Since childhood, she has been able to "hear" things that ordinary people cannot. She is tall, lively, and intelligent. 

(Source: Official Site)

name: Yuki Tadokoro
description:
Classmate of [Yoshiki.](https://anilist.co/character/281109/Yoshiki-Tsujinaka) Childhood friend of [Asako Yamagishi.](https://anilist.co/character/359202/Asako-Yamagishi)

(Source: Official Site)

name: Rie Kurebayashi
description:
A housewife who can "see" things that ordinary people cannot. She worries about [Yoshiki,](https://anilist.co/character/281109/Yoshiki-Tsujinaka) who is with a dangerous and terrifying presence, and warns him to stay away. 

(Source: Official Site)

name: Yuuta Maki
description:
Classmate of [Yoshiki](https://anilist.co/character/281109/Yoshiki-Tsujinaka). A class clown with a shaved head.

(Source: Official Site)

name: Kaoru Tsujinaka
description: Kaoru is Yoshiki's younger sister.

name: Toshinori Tsujinaka
description: Toshinori is Yoshiki and Kaoru's father. He has a rocky relationship with his family.

name: Kouhei Indou
description: Hikaru's late father.

name: Satoko Tsujinaka
description: Satoko is Yoshiki and Kaoru's mother. She works as a hairdresser.

name: Satou
description: Satou is a woman who works for the company.

name: Hara-sen
description: Hara is a teacher at Kibogayama High.

name: Tooru Mikasa
description: Tooru is a man living in Kubitachi. He's concerned about the state of the village and the Indou family ritual.

name: Yuki Indou
description: Hikaru's mother.

name: Hajime Takeda
description: Hajime is a man living in Kubitachi. He's concerned about the state of the village and the Indou family ritual.

name: Baaba
description: Asako's grandmother.

name: Inori Yuitsuka
description: A 5th grade elementary student who loves figure skating so much she used to practice it in secret. Though she greatly lacks academic skill, when she's in the rink she's like a different person.

name: Tsukasa Akeuraji
description: He is a former ice dancer and now the coach of [Inori Yuitsuka](https://anilist.co/character/197151/Inori-Yuitsuka).

name: Hikaru Kamisaki
description: An orphan who was picked up by [Jun Yodaka](https://anilist.co/character/197164/Jun-Yodaka) and currently lives with [Rioh Sonidori](https://anilist.co/character/197158/Riou-Sonidori) and his mother. She is [Inori's](https://anilist.co/character/197151/Inori-Yuitsuka) rival who she promised with that they would compete against each other in the All-Japans.

name: Iruka Okazaki
description:
__Height:__ 161 cm

Iruka Okazaki is a figure skating athlete who accompanied [Riina Kojou](https://anilist.co/character/382022/Kojou-Riina) who helped host the opening ceremony of the Chuubu Block Tournament. She is also an A Class Star Skater who goes to Kankyou University High School.

~!Iruka acts coldly towards [Inori](https://anilist.co/character/197151/Yuitsuka-Inori), but secretly has quite a soft spot for her.!~

name: Jun Yodaka
description: The coach of [Hikaru Kamisaki](https://anilist.co/character/197152/Kamisaki-Hikaru). He took Hikaru in as his skating disciple from a far away snowy land, but left the task of caring for her other needs to the Sonidori family.

name: Ryouka Miketa
description: One of [Inori's](https://anilist.co/character/197151/Inori-Yuitsuka) rivals. She is a 3rd grade girl in the Preliminary skating category with Inori. She looks up to "girlish" things and believes cats are the cutest things in the universe.

name: Riou Sonidori
description: Riou is a 5th grade elementary school student and member of Meikou Wind FSC. Son of Olympic silver medalist [Shinichirou Sonidori.](https://anilist.co/character/197159/Shinichirou-Sonidori)

name: Ema Yamato
description: Ema is a 4th grade elementary school student affiliated with Rengecha FSC. She was born in Kyoto and is long time friends with [Suzu.](https://anilist.co/character/209212/Suzu-Kamoto) Her cheeks are always red, and she is well behaved but not afraid to say what's on her mind. She is a hard worker who believes in actions over words. She is an only child and her tall height for her age makes her a motherly figure among her classmates. She doesn't dislike it, but she also likes Suzu treating her like a little sister.

name: Suzu Kamoto
description: Suzu is an elementary school student affiliated with Rengecha FSC. She won the silver medal in the All-Japan Novice B competition. She is the youngest of 4 sisters who have doted on her like a doll since a young age, causing her obsession with cuteness. She has an anti-aging plan for remaining cute, and constantly thinks about the philosophy of cuteness. If someone doesn't call her cute she will massage their face into a "Suzu face" and talk about the philosophy of cuteness for hours on end. She's hard on people who are hard on themselves and has cast-iron mental strength.

name: You Kago
description: You is the daughter of the Kago family who supported [Tsukasa's](https://anilist.co/character/197163/Tsukasa-Akeuraji) skating career.

name: Mamoru Sekoma
description: Receptionist at a local skating rink.

name: Hitomi Takamine
description: [Tsukasa's](https://anilist.co/character/197163/Tsukasa-Akeuraji) former Ice dance partner and a current skating coach at Lux Toyama FSC.

name: Yuuna Yagi
description: Yuuna is the 3rd best skater at Meikoh Wind FSC and is [Shinichirou Sonidori's](https://anilist.co/character/197159/Shinichirou-Sonidori) primary student. She joined the club after seeing his Olympic performance and has a secret crush on him. Before events, she mentally builds herself up while sitting alone with a puppet.

name: Shinichirou Sonidori
description: Head coach at Meikou Wind FSC and father of [Riou Sonidori](https://anilist.co/character/197158/Riou-Sonidori).

name: Mika Yuitsuka
description: [Inori's](https://anilist.co/character/197151/Inori-Yuitsuka) older sister. She used to be a figure skater but quit due to an injury.

name: Kakeru Uobuchi
description: Kakeru is a jump obsessed maniac since his days as a professional athlete, he taught himself a quadruple lutz with no outside instruction. He is like a "cheat code" as a coach, helping skaters pull off any jump they request, but he goes around to all the clubs so will also power up skaters' rivals. He loves helping skaters pull off jumps for him in person and is a great fan of [Shinichirou Sonidori's](https://anilist.co/character/197159/Shinichirou-Sonidori) jumping.

name: Riley Fox
description:
__Height:__ 163 cm

A former Team USA skater and Olympic gold medalist, she is now the head coach of her own club Starfox FSC.

name: Nozomi Yuitsuka
description: [Inori's](https://anilist.co/character/197151/Inori-Yuitsuka) mother.

name: Meiko Kago
description: Meiko was the wife of [Kouichi Kago](https://anilist.co/character/197162/Kouichi-Kago) and sponsored [Tsukasa's](https://anilist.co/character/197163/Tsukasa-Akeuraji) skating career

name: Reze
description:
Reze is a young girl who met [Denji](https://anilist.co/character/130102/Denji) in a phone cabin. She works at a local café and is a kind and gentle girl who seems to have a crush on Denji soon after meeting him. She laughs at his jokes and isn't afraid to get close to and intimate with him.

~!‌‌‌‌‌‌‌‌She is secretly the Bomb Devil hybrid, owned by the Soviet Union and allied to the Gun Devil. Her true personality is manipulative and brutal, as she is shown killing many Devil Hunters without care or mercy. She does, however, not enjoy killing and prefers to avoid it, unless necessary for her mission. Her objective is to retrieve the Chainsaw Heart from Denji, but the feelings she developed for him quickly made things more complicated.!~

name: Asuka Langley Souryuu
description:
__Height:__ 155 cm (5'1")

Asuka is the Second Child ('Second Children' in the Japanese versions of NGE), who pilots Evangelion Unit 02. She is from Germany, but her nationality is American. She has an American father and a half-German, half-Japanese mother. In the Rebuild of Evangelion series of movies, her name is changed to Asuka Langley Shikinami. 

~!Her mother, Kyoko Zeppelin Souryuu, went insane after an Eva-related experiment and began to believe that a doll that resembled Asuka was, in fact, her daughter, to the point that she refused to acknowledge the real Asuka. Kyoko Zeppelin Souryuu committed suicide on the very day that Asuka was chosen to become an Eva pilot. On that day, Asuka promised herself that she would never cry again. This event gives her an innate hatred of dolls and all things that she perceives to be doll-like, especially Rei. Despite those feelings, Asuka shows no hesitation when required to cooperate with Rei when necessary, proving her to be committed and professional regarding her duties as an Eva pilot.!~

~!Asuka's father later remarried a woman for whom Asuka feels no affection. Asuka feels the need to verbally and sometimes physically lash out at everyone around her, except to her unrequited crush, Kaji, who is Misato's ex-boyfriend and more than twice Asuka's age. On her better days, however, she can be quite cheerful and friendly.!~

~!Like Shinji, Asuka also has difficulty being close to people, except unlike Shinji, who shells himself, Asuka's coping mechanism is over-aggressiveness and so she unintentionally hurts people she likes, pushing them away and thus sinking further into loneliness and self resentment. This issue is referred to as the "hedgehog's dilemma" and is a recurring motif in the story.!~

name: Rei Ayanami
description:
**Height:** 149 cm (4'11")
~!Source of genetic material: Yui Ikari and Lilith, the Second Angel.!~  

Ayanami is the First Child and the pilot of Evangelion Unit 00. She is shown to be socially withdrawn and hardly interacts with anyone. Rei's cool, silent and emotionally-stunted personality has garnered the scorn of her schoolmates; [Asuka](https://anilist.co/character/94/Souryuu-Asuka-Langley) calls her a "doll" or "puppet".

Although she once only associated with [Gendou](https://anilist.co/character/1257/Ikari-Gendou), she and [Shinji](https://anilist.co/character/89/Ikari-Shinji) break the ice after the battle against Ramiel and grow progressively closer for a while. In the manga version, Rei grows a lot closer to Shinji than in the anime.  

~!Clones of her, which lack souls, are kept hidden under the NERV building to be the supposed "cores" of the Dummy Plugs. !~ 

~!It is hinted that Rei died twice; in the series, this stems from the fact that Rei herself says "I think I'm the third one," shortly after her death when Unit 00 self-destructed, an event that she could not remember. The first Rei is shown to have died as a small girl at the hands of Dr. Naoko Akagi for revealing carelessly (or perhaps in an intentional set-up by Gendo Ikari) to Naoko that Gendo called her a "useless old hag." The explanation is that her soul and most of her memories are transferred to one of the clones every time she dies, which then takes the preceding Rei's place as if she had not died at all. !~

name: Shinji Ikari
description:
__Height:__ 155 cm (5'1")

Shinji Ikari is the Third Child ('Third Children' in Japanese), who pilots Unit 01. He is the son of [Gendo](https://anilist.co/character/1257) and the late [Yui Ikari](https://anilist.co/character/1258). Abandoned by his father, Gendo, when he was a toddler, Shinji often ran away from difficult situations. As a pilot, he panics easily and reacts very poorly to unexpected events. 

~!Over time and with encouragement from Misato, he learns to be less cowardly, more outspoken, and more confident, but his progress is all undone when he is forced to kill the only person who ever openly expressed love toward him. His only friends are Toji and Kensuke, but he apparently cares about Rei more than even he realizes.!~

name: Misato Katsuragi
description:
__Height:__ 163 cm (5'4)

Misato Katsuragi is the chief operations officer at NERV, initially holding the rank of Captain (with a later promotion to Major). She is the field commander for the Eva pilots, issuing orders and giving battle strategies. She also acts as [Shinji](https://anilist.co/character/89) and [Asuka's](https://anilist.co/character/94) guardian, letting them live in her apartment rather than have them living alone. While she is professional and diligent in her duties, she is a slob and a drunkard while off-duty. 

~!She is the only survivor of the Katsuragi Expedition, the scientific study led by her father which triggered the Second Impact; the cross pendant she wears was given to her by her father just before his death.  She and [Ryouji Kaji](https://anilist.co/character/1260) were lovers during college, and slowly rekindle their romance over the course of the series. She was also friends with [Ritsuko Akagi](https://anilist.co/character/1251) in college, but their relationship unravels as she learns more about the ultimate goals of NERV and SEELE.!~

name: Kaworu Nagisa
description: ~!Kaworu Nagisa is both the 17th Angel and the Fifth Child. Although classified as an Angel, Kaworu is similar to Rei Ayanami in being a Seed of Life that inhabits a human body. Despite his human form, Kaworu does not consider himself to be human, since he refers to humans as "the Lilin".!~

name: Narrator
description:
This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. 

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

name: Pen Pen
description: Pen Pen is a hot-spring penguin who lives with [Misato Katsuragi](https://anilist.co/character/1259/Katsuragi-Misato) as her pet. He lives in a refrigerator and is a source of company and comfort to Misato, who has problems of her own.

name: Ryouji Kaji
description:
Kaji, while only being a special inspector, secretly works for SEELE investigating NERV's true intentions. During college, he had a serious relationship with [Misato](https://anilist.co/character/1259/Katsuragi-Misato), but after having long broken up, they see each other again on the UN fleet ferrying Unit 02 and its pilot, [Asuka Langley Soryu](https://anilist.co/character/94/Souryuu-Asuka-Langley), to Japan. 

~!After he returns to NERV headquarters, Kaji and Misato rekindle their romance following a period of teasing and insults, when Misato confesses that she broke up with him because she realized that Kaji reminded her of her father. He is eventually shot by an unnamed assailant, described as "a third party working either for SEELE or for NERV's Intelligence Division" in the episode Film-book. In the manga, it is Commander Ikari who personally kills Kaji.!~

name: Ritsuko Akagi
description:
Ritsuko Akagi is NERV's head scientist and is heavily involved in the repairs and maintenance of Tokyo-3's defenses against the Angels, particularly the Evas.  She is the daughter of [Naoko Akagi](https://anilist.co/character/19207/Akagi-Naoko), the developer of the MAGI supercomputer system which controls Nerv. In many ways, Ritsuko is living in the shadow of her mother, whom she both admires and despises. Naoko was the head scientist working on the Evangelion project before her death, and Ritsuko is continuing the work her mother began with the Evas, as well as continuing the development of the Magi supercomputer system. Flashbacks to a teenaged Ritsuko reveal that she is a natural brunette, just like her mother.

Ritsuko is extremely intelligent, with a strong dedication to her work and a stoic, detached attitude which is frequently contrasted against [Misato Katsuragi](https://anilist.co/character/1259/Katsuragi-Misato)'s hot-headness, especially during Eva combat. Her occasional jibes at Misato are a source of comic relief in the series. She has a great affinity for cats, and Misato chides her at one point for substituting her cats for human affection. She also is a heavy smoker, as evidenced by an ashtray on her desk filled with cigarette butts stained by her lipstick.

name: Gendou Ikari
description:
Gendou Ikari is the commander of NERV. He is responsible for the research done on the Evas, [Rei Ayanami](https://anilist.co/character/86), and the Human Instrumentality Project. He is the father of the Third Children, [Shinji Ikari](https://anilist.co/character/89), and the guardian of Rei. His original surname was Rokubungi, but he changed it to Ikari following his marriage to [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/1258). At the start of the series, he is the only person having an effective connection to Rei. As the series progresses, his unscrupulous past is revealed, as is the intensity with which he loved Yui.

~!In the original series, his maiden name is Rokubungi.!~

name: Kensuke Aida
description:
Kensuke Aida is an otaku, a military buff, Toji's best friend, and one of the "Other Children," Eva pilot candidates in the same class as Shinji, Toji, Rei, Asuka, and Hikari. His hobbies include camping in the mountains surrounding Tokyo-3 and playing at simulated war reenacting - by himself. Kensuke solidifies his friendship with Shinji after Shinji saves him and Toji during the fight against the fourth Angel, Shamshel. Kensuke dreams of becoming an Eva pilot and ceaselessly begs Shinji to pull strings in NERV so he can be selected as a pilot, despite Shinji telling him that he has no say in the matter. He also seems oblivious to the intense physical and psychological duress endured by Eva pilots. Nevertheless, Kensuke enjoys the privileges of being the friend of an Eva pilot; he and Toji accompany Shinji on the excursion to the UN combined naval fleet during the transportation of Unit 02. Like presumably every one of Shinji's classmates, Kensuke's mother is deceased. Like Toji, Kensuke has a crush on Misato Katsuragi. He is rarely seen without his camcorder at hand.

_Kensuke is named after a main character in the novel The Fascism of Love and Fantasies (Ai to Gensou no Fascism) by Ryu Murakami. He is also similar in appearance to the character Jean, from Hideaki Anno's earlier anime Nadia: The Secret of Blue Water._

name: Touji Suzuhara
description:
Toji is a tough boy, the stereotypical "jock," and is in constant conflict with Asuka. His younger sister was injured in the battle between the third Angel, Sachiel, and Unit 01, and he beats Shinji up soon after for being indirectly responsible. However, after witnessing firsthand the suffering Shinji experiences piloting Unit 01 in the battle against Shamshel, Toji comes to respect Shinji and the two eventually become friends.

~!Toji Suzuhara is the Fourth Child.!~

~!Toji's Eva, Unit 03, is taken over by the thirteenth Angel, Bardiel, and is eventually destroyed by Unit 01, which was under the control of the Dummy Plug system. He is severely injured when his Entry Plug is crushed; in the manga, he is killed.!~

In 3.0+1.0 of the rebuild series, ~!he is a doctor residing in Village 3 and is married to [Hikari Horaki](https://anilist.co/character/1254/), with a daughter.!~

_Toji is named after one of the main characters in the novel The Fascism of Love and Fantasy (Ai to Gensou no Fascism) by Ryu Murakami._

name: Maya Ibuki
description:
Maya Ibuki is a First Lieutenant at NERV and a computer technician who works primarily with [Ritsuko Akagi](https://anilist.co/character/1251/Akagi-Ritsuko). Her main role during the fights with the Angels is to constantly monitor the Eva pilots’ synchronization ratios and send various emergency commands to the Evangelions as ordered by [Misato](https://anilist.co/character/1259/Katsuragi-Misato) or [Gendo](https://anilist.co/character/1257/Ikari-Gendou).

In spite of her profession, Maya despises violence of any sort, and is frequently shown becoming nauseous and averting her eyes during battles with the Angels. Notably, in The End of Evangelion, Maya is the only NERV officer who is shown refusing to fight back against the JSSDF invaders. She rejects the gun Shigeru hands her to defend herself saying "I can't shoot this thing", not because she is unskilled, but because she has never shot it at a human being.

name: Yui Ikari
description:
Ikari Shinji's mother and wife of Gendou Ikari.

~!In the rebuild series, her maiden name is Yui Ayanami.!~ ~!While testing an early version of the Eva control system, she was absorbed into the unit. Her data is the basis of the Rei "replicas."!~

name: Kohzou Fuyutsuki
description: Kozo Fuyutsuki is second-in-command of NERV HQ and Gendo Ikari's right hand man. As Deputy Commander of NERV, Fuyutsuki frequently takes command of situations at the base whenever Gendo is away on business. Gendo also tends to unload the more mundane work, such as town council meetings, paperwork, and the like, onto Fuyutsuki.

name: Hikari Horaki
description:
Hikari Horaki is the class representative of the class that Shinji and the other Eva pilots attend. Like all of her classmates, she is an unknowing Eva pilot candidate. She has a by-the-book demeanor and takes her responsibilities as "class rep" seriously. Although she frequently bickers with Toji, she reveals to Asuka that she has an enormous crush on Toji but is unable to openly express her feelings to him. She also appears to be Asuka's only friend. After the battle with Arael, Asuka seeks out Hikari and stays with her for an unspecified time. During a late evening she reveals her inner insecurities to Hikari, a testament to their friendship; however, Hikari appears saddened by the hateful words Asuka uses.

Hikari is an accomplished cook who appears to take care of her two sisters, [Nozomi](https://anilist.co/character/244735/) and [Kodama](https://anilist.co/character/244734/). Like presumably every one of Shinji's classmates, Hikari's mother is deceased.

In 3.0+1.0 of the rebuild series, ~!she resides in Village 3 and is married to [Touji Suzuhara](https://anilist.co/character/1262), with [a baby daughter](https://anilist.co/character/245144/). [Her father](https://anilist.co/character/245145/) lives with them.!~

_Hikari is named after a character in the novel The Fascism of Love and Fantasies (Ai to Gensou no Fascism) by Ryu Murakami. Her name, and that of her unseen younger sister, Nozomi, and elder sister, Kodama, is also in reference to the names of the trains of the Tokaido Shinkansen line._

name: Shigeru Aoba
description: Shigeru Aoba is First Lieutenant at NERV and a computer technician. At times a stereotypical metal head, he is a nihilist and plays guitar (he can also sometimes be seen strumming an air guitar).  ~!In his implementation sequence, Lilith forces her way through his AT Field by bombarding him with a wall of Reis in which he screams in fear. She supposedly takes this tactic with his implementation because there is no one he loves or trusts enough to let his guard down, suggesting a possible layer of solitude and bitterness behind his cynical persona.!~ Again, his character is not explored in depth within the series.  (Source: afufu.net)

name: Makoto Hyuuga
description: Makoto Hyuga is First Lieutenant at NERV and a computer technician. He is something of a nerd, reading manga while on his break time, but is a hard worker, nonetheless. He also appears to harbor a deep crush for Misato, as Lilith approaches him during his implementation in the form of Misato.

name: Naoko Akagi
description:
Naoko Akagi was Ritsuko's mother. She was the creator of the MAGI system and the former Gehirn head technician. 

~!Naoko was involved in a romantic relationship with the recently-widowed Gendo Ikari while working at Gehirn.!~

name: Kyouko Zeppelin Souryuu
description: Mother of Asuka Langley Soryu. She was a scientist working for NERV before an accident during the testing phases of Evangelion Unit 02 left her hospitalized and mentally unstable.     ~! After this she began to treat a doll as if it were her daughter, and eventually committed suicide by hanging herself in her hospital room.!~

name: Keel Lorentz
description: Chairman of SEELE, it is the ambition of Keel Lorentz that drives mankind towards instrumentality. Part cyborg, Keel's eyes and spinal-cord are aided by advanced machinery.

name: Kusuo Saiki
description:
**Height:** 167 cm

Kusuo Saiki has an extremely uncaring, neutral personality. As a gifted psychic that can do anything he wants, he has long stopped caring about the world; however, he has shown to be extremely cautious, as he often runs from [Nendou](https://anilist.co/character/90108), the only person he fears and is prone to immediately teleporting to faraway places upon spotting an insect. Saiki has a sweet tooth, so he loves sweets, especially Coffee Jelly.

Fourteen days after his birth, Kusuo uttered his first word without moving his mouth and 1 month after birth he took his first step in midair. At the age of 1 was the first time Kusuo has voluntarily used his abilities, when his mother said they were out of mirin, Kusuo teleported away and returned with several bottles of mirin.

Kusuo Saiki is a gifted psychic. Having obtained his powers since birth, the first signs of Saiki's powers came from when he was able to hear the voices of his parents and he subsequently telepathically spoke back to them. Two months later, he demonstrated the ability to walk in the air. Saiki has stated that in three days, he can wipe out humanity. The full extent of all of his abilities is unknown.

name: Karma Akabane
description:
**Height:** 175 cm

A student in [Koro-sensei](https://anilist.co/character/65643)'s class 3-E of Kunugigaoka Junior High School who had been suspended from school due to his violent behavior.  He excels at using weaponry and foul play and is the only student thus far to have successfully injured Korosensei. Despite this, he is actually rather smart and manages a perfect score on one of Korosensei's tests. He and [Nagisa](https://anilist.co/character/65645) were in the same class during their 1st and 2nd years at Kunugigaoka.

name: Koro-sensei
description:
__Height:__ ~300cm (~9'10")

He is a teacher for class 3-E of Kunugigaoka Junior High School and the main antihero of Ansatsu Kyoushitsu. He claims responsibility for blowing up the moon into a permanent crescent shape and plans to destroy the Earth in a year after teaching the students of class 3-E the art of assassination. His name comes from korosenai (殺せない), meaning "cannot be killed", and sensei (先生), meaning teacher. In this way, he is literally called the unkillable teacher.

~!Later in the story he is revealed to have been original reaper named Ryushi Korogane.!~

name: Nagisa Shiota
description:
__Height:__ 159 cm (5'2.5")
__Class:__ Class 3-E 

He is one of the students in Class 3-E. 

Nagisa is seen as one of the weakest students in the class due to his small stature and mediocre physical abilities that are comparable to a girl. However, he is actually the most talented to become an assassin out of all the students, something acknowledged by [Korosensei](https://anilist.co/character/65643) and [Karasuma](https://anilist.co/character/73881). He is able to draw closer while hiding his bloodlust to make a surprise attack and able to make his opponents falter through his bloodlust alone.  

Nagisa usually writes down Korosensei's weaknesses that at first seen minor (since it doesn't look like major weaknesses), but eventually revealed to be useful since once they're able to almost kill Korosensei because of one of his weaknesses that is the same as the one that Nagisa has written down in his note.  

Outwardly friendly and polite to his friends and everyone, he hides a somewhat darker side of him as an assassin that won't be able to be found out during daily classes and will only be shown during training and assassination time. According to Karasuma, whenever Nagisa unleashes his killing intent, he isn't training and truly goes for a kill.

~!In the end, he kills [Koro-Sensei](https://anilist.co/character/65643/Korosensei).!~

~!In the epilogue, 7 years later, Nagisa becomes a teacher of Paradise High School's Class 3-5, Deciding to follow in Koro-sensei's steps.!~

name: Tetsuya Kuroko
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm (5'6")
__School:__ Seirin High 
__Number:__ #11  
__Speciality:__ Simple sleight of hand tricks  

The phantom sixth member of the "Generation of Miracles." He has a very weak presence and often seemingly appears out of nowhere as a result. 

At the first glance all of his abilities seem to be below average, but despite being bad at dribbling and shooting he can be a dangerous opponent. He specializes in circulating passes without being seen. Because of his largely complementary skill set, Kuroko considers himself a "shadow" whose goal is to help his "light" achieve greatness.

name: Tadaomi Karasuma
description: He is a government worker associated with the Ministry of Defense. He first appeared announcing Korosensei's deal with the government and their mission to assassinate him before the end of the year. He later became the assistant teacher and P.E. instructor of class 3-E, using his lessons to train the students in assassination techniques. He is well known among militaries for his outstanding reputation and is a powerful individual, which he has proven when he easily overpowered Irina's master, who is a retired professional hitman, and even Korosensei himself is afraid upon seeing his capability for the first time. He is strict, but kind man, though he keeps a distance between himself and the students due to his status as an agent and his own professionalism. He is one of a few who is very perceptive enough to see Nagisa's talent as an assassin. He seems to know Korosensei's past, though he has no intention to indulge into it further.

name: Irina Jelavic
description:
__Occupation:__ Professional Hitman, Part-time Foreign Language Teacher 

She is a professional hitwoman who is hired to kill [Korosensei](https://anilist.co/character/65643/Koro-sensei) by becoming a part-time foreign language teacher in class 3-E. She uses her charms to seduce Korosensei, making him at first obeys to whatever she asks. However, her first assassination attempt was foiled when Korosensei able to suppressed her 3-men's attacks, ending in her humiliation and swore revenge. She teaches the students how to seduce people from other countries, so that with this method, they can learn foreign languages, and usually would punish male students who failed answering her questions during her lesson by kissing them.    

Irina is a deceitful, wily and beguiling individual; she frequently uses her charm to influence and manipulate her targets. She can easily befriend people, if she so chooses, and entice them to let down their defenses and become vulnerable to her. Seduction is primarily the technique she employs, and it is her area of expertise. Irina is a professional assassin who excels at handling infiltration and approaching targets. She possesses strong conversational skills in ten languages, and a proven track record of eleven jobs in countries all over the world.

name: Kaede Kayano
description:
She is one of [Nagisa](https://anilist.co/character/65645/Shiota-Nagisa)'s classmates and close friends, being the one who is mostly seen with him. She hasn't shown any capabilities during her training to become an assassin, and so far has only been shown to discuss [Koro-sensei](https://anilist.co/character/65643/Korosensei)'s weaknesses along with Nagisa. She experiences a slight inferiority complex when it comes to sex appeal, resulting her to get angry whenever there's a woman with big breasts and readily protest.

~!it's revealed later in the story that she's [Aguri Yukimura's](https://anilist.co/character/207936/Aguri-Yukimura) younger sister, Akari Yukimura and her real birthday is on November 9.!~

name: Rio Nakamura
description:
She is a student in Korosensei's Class 3-E of Kunugigaoka Junior High School. She was a former elementary school genius but felt lonely and longed to be normal. When she got to middle school, she began shirking off her studies which landed her in Class 3-E.
She loves teasing the other students in her class (sometimes together with Karma Akabane)

name: Itona Horibe
description: Transfer student who aims to kill [Koro-sensei](https://anilist.co/character/65643). He is the second assassin transfer student to arrive at Class 3-E, following the previous assassin, [Ritsu](https://anilist.co/character/74832). He initially served as the secondary antagonist, before ultimately joining Class E for good. After being abandoned by [Shiro](https://anilist.co/character/176246) and befriending [Terasaka](https://anilist.co/character/85809) and his gang, Itona has since become more mellow and humble, and is now able to admit people are stronger than him, while still retaining his brutal honesty. He has also shown to be a very observant and creative individual.

name: Ritsu
description:
An artificial intelligence developed in Norway and sent to Class 3-E as a transfer student to dispose of [Korosensei](https://anilist.co/character/65643/Korosensei), able to learn his movement patterns and perfect her shooting skills in order to eventually kill him. After receiving a few modifications from Korosensei, she develops a conscience and becomes friends with the rest of class 3-E, who give her her shortened nickname. Thanks to her processing power, she frequently helps with Intel gathering and communications and usually interacts with others via a smartphone application developed by her classmates.

She is portrayed by Kanna Hashimoto in the live action movie.

name: Yuma Isogai
description: He is a student and class rep in class 3-E of Kunugigaoka Junior High School, taught by Korosensei.

name: Gakushuu Asano
description: A student in class 3-A in Kunugigaoka Junior High School. He is the student council president and the son of the Board Chairman, Gakuhou Asano. He is a genius student who, like many main building students, look down upon class 3-E.

name: Hiroto Maehara
description: He is a student in Korosensei's Class 3-E. Maehara is a nice guy and in every sense of the word, a playboy. He has a "live the moment" attitude about life in general. He is one of the few that is popular in the whole school despite being in the E Class. Despite that attitude, he is a caring person and isn't the type to pick on someone weaker than him. He also falls into the type of being honest, and often reacts strongly to things.

name: Bobobo-bo Bo-bobo
description: This is the cool and incomprehensible hero, swarthy and musclebound, sporting sunglasses and a large golden afro. His hair is 24-karat gold but is usually said to be yellow or blonde; some viewers even argue about its true color. He is called Bo-bobo for short. He refuses to let people call him Bo. He fights with his nose hair using the Hanage Shinken (sometimes "Super Fist of the Nose Hair", other times "Snot Fou-You"), as well as simply confusing his enemies. His only weakness, which he discovered while visiting the world of Blabsalot, is the fact that he doesn't have as many deadly attacks. He believes that the Fist of the Nose Hair is sacred and that he shouldn't overuse it. He has three brothers and one sister. Bo-BoBo directs small "micromovies" in his own movie theatre "Bo-BoBo Gekijou" (Bo-BoBo Theater, but also called other names in the dub). He apparently has some control over an army of stuffed teddy bears which are seen in many episodes. There is an apparently large colony of tiny humans and humanoid boogers living in his nose. They sometimes aid him in battle.

name: Tomohito Sugino
description: He is one of the students and Nagisa's close friends. He used to be a basketball player in their school's basketball club until he was assigned into class 3-E, making him kicked out from the club. He dreams to become a professional baseball player like his idol, Arita, and emulates his techniques to improve his own performance in baseball and is shown to very dedicated to it. He also sometimes used his baseball techniques in his attempts to kill Korosensei. He has a crush on Yukiko.

name: Yukiko Kanzaki
description: She is a student of Kunugigaoka Junior High School. She is assigned to Class 3-E, where she trains to become a professional assassin, with her teacher as the target.   Yukiko is diligent, ladylike, and cordial; although she does not particularly stand out, she is popular with her classmates. A very considerate individual, she had, on one occasion, volunteered to buy drinks for everyone in her class. Yukiko is deliberative and an excellent organizer. She was responsible for structuring the schedule for Class 3-E's trip to Kyoto, and her work had impressed Korosensei. Furthermore, she is adept in considering all factors before making a decision, which is why she had chosen the virtually unoccupied Gion District as the ideal setting for the assassination to take place.

name: Ryuunosuke Chiba
description:
__Height::__ 172 cm (5’8”)
__School:__ Kunugigaoka Junior High School
__Class:__ 3-E
__Seat Number:__ 15

He is a student in Korosensei's Class 3-E of Kunugigaoka Junior High School. Chiba is a serious and stoic boy. He's very calm and doesn't talk a lot. He is the best marksman among all of Class 3-E. He excels in spatial calculation and, as such, is unmatched in long distance shooting. His abilities have even earned him the praises of [Lovro](https://anilist.co/character/265570/Brovski-Lovro), a hitman dealer and a retired assassin.

name: Manami Okuda
description: She is a student in class 3-E of Kunugigaoka Junior High School, taught by Korosensei.   Okuda is shy and rather introverted. She admits that she isn't really good with surprise attacks and expressing things in language. She excels in chemistry and capable of making poisons for assassinations.

name: Rinka Hayami
description:
She is a student in Korosensei's Class 3-E. 

Rinka is a very stoic, businesslike and professional girl who has been compared to a working adult along with Chiba. As a result of her serious demeanor, she can be quite straightforward and direct.

name: Ryouma Terasaka
description:
He is a student of Kunugigaoka Junior High School. He is assigned to Class 3-E, where he trains to become a professional assassin, with his teacher as the target. His partners are [Takuya Muramatsu](https://anilist.co/character/85805/Muramatsu-Takuya) and [Taisei Yoshida](https://anilist.co/character/85811/Yoshida-Taisei).   

Terasaka is a rash, selfish and impatient individual. Desperate to escape from the miserable circumstances of being part of the dropout class, he is willing to resort to any means, even if the methods may be immoral. He holds no regards for the injuries of his comrades who provide assistance.  

However, Terasaka possesses relative leadership skills, as he is usually accompanied by his peers, Takuya and Taisei. He persuades others to do his bidding by being direct and intrusively forward, as indicated when he pressures [Nagisa Shiota](https://anilist.co/character/65645/Shiota-Nagisa) to carry out an assassination of [Koro-sensei](https://anilist.co/character/65643/Koro-sensei) by reminding him of the harsh conditions they live in.

name: Gakuhou Asano
description: He is the board chairman and administrative head of Kunugigaoka Junior High School. He has made the academy into the foremost in Japan in the ten years since its founding.  Gakuhō is a reasonable, prudent, and shrewd individual; he is primarily known for his cool-headed rationalism. He is a proponent of logic and efficiency, and handles matters accordingly. An able and competent administrator, he is resolved in removing factors that may upset the intended balance.

name: Hinano Kurahashi
description: She is a student in Korosensei's Class 3-E. Hinano's personality is an energetic and positive girl and is always seen with a smile on her face regardless of whether she's trying to assassinate Korosensei, or whatever else. Hinano is also a passionate animal and nature lover.

name: Kirara Hazama
description: She is a student in Korosensei's Class 3-E. Hazama is a quiet girl who loves reading, preferring to sit in the shade with a book rather than swim during summer gym classes and wants to become a librarian. She even recommended to Itona the novel, The Count of Monte Cristo, though accidentally spoiled the ending. She prefers dark stories and horror novels, and because of this also has an interest in the occult which she displayed when she attempted to use a curse on Korosensei.

name: Touka Yada
description:
She is a student in Korosensei's Class 3-E. She is the big sister of Class 3-E and one of the most enthusiastic students about learning the art of infiltration from [Irina](https://anilist.co/character/73883/Jelavic-Irina). She's been described as being adult-like and cool to the point that [Kayano](https://anilist.co/character/85291/Kayano-Kaede) admits that she's attracted to her despite her large bust.

Yada does not like violence, which is why she commits herself to negotiation in order avoid fighting.

name: Tomoe
description:
__Height:__ 190 cm (6’3”)

Tomoe is a familiar to the last land god, [Mikage](https://anilist.co/character/37871/Mikage). Currently he is the familiar of [Nanami](https://anilist.co/character/18343/Momozono-Nanami) and sealed their contract with a kiss. He shows a wonderful talent for cooking and is shown to be highly dedicated to the shrine. Tomoe worries a great deal about Nanami and is very aware of how delicate she is as a human, threatening anyone who harms her or speaks ill of her. It is often implied that he loves Nanami, such as doing random acts of kindness for her and refusing to kill in front of her. Plus, it is also indicated that he sometimes gets very jealous of other guys who hang around her. He is also very loyal to Nanami, as shown by him kissing her to seal their contract again after it had been broken.

~!In the most recent chapters it's revealed that he is in fact in love with Nanami, but Nanami is unaware of this. However, this triggered a 'switch' that causes Tomoe to return to his dying curse and remember his love for [Yukiji](https://anilist.co/character/50685/Yukiji), the girl he previously loved. It is shown that when she died, Tomoe, cursed and alone, lost his will to live and searched for a place to die until Mikage found him and sealed his memories. By doing that, the curse fell asleep and Tomoe was able to live a new life.!~

name: Nanami Momozono
description:
__Species:__ Human / God
__Height:__ 162 cm (5'4")

A teenage girl whose father ran out on her because of his gambling debts, she was often mocked for her poverty by her classmates.

She becomes the local land god after former god [Mikage](https://anilist.co/character/37871/Mikage) transfers his position as master of the shrine over to Nanami. She begins with very little spiritual power, but works hard at balancing her godly duties with her schoolwork. Nanami is often upset when [Tomoe](https://anilist.co/character/18344/Tomoe) flirts with other women. Tomoe always puts Shiitake mushrooms in Nanami's food even though he knows she hates them.

~!Nanami falls in love with Tomoe, but is rejected by him since it is taboo for a human and a demon to be lovers. Later though, Tomoe realizes he's in love with her and that awakens his curse and his memories. In recent chapters it is hinted that she might be the descendant of Tomoe's former lover, [Yukiji](https://anilist.co/character/50685/Yukiji).!~

name: Narrator
description:
This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. 

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

name: Mizuki
description:
A snake familiar at the Yonomori shrine.

[Nanami](https://anilist.co/character/18343/Momozono-Nanami) saved his life from her cruel classmates by releasing him out a window, he fell in love with her, so he left an engagement mark on her wrist. After a day, he arrives at her school and whisks her away to the shrine, which she is unable to escape from.

Unlike other snakes, he was apparently raised in a greenhouse and has little knowledge of how most snakes behave. Mizuki is also very lonely because his god has vanished; she once existed when people visited the shrine and believed in her, but now no one lives in the valley and she has dwindled away to nothing. However, he still believes that she exists and will return. As a result, he wants Nanami to live with him forever at his shrine, but when she refuses he tries to rape her and is interrupted by [Tomoe](https://anilist.co/character/18344/Tomoe).

It is revealed that the shrine is an illusion meant to hide his god's favorite plum tree, which Mizuki treasured. Nanami promised to come look at the blossoms with him whenever he felt lonely. Like [Kurama](https://anilist.co/character/24252/Kurama-Shinjirou) he seems to still be harboring a crush on Nanami, and even comes to cook for her when she's ill.

~!In chapter 23 Mizuki decided to become Nanami familiar making a contract by kissing her while she slept.!~

name: Shinjirou Kurama
description:
__Species:__ Tengu Yokai
__Height:__ 183 cm (6'0")
__Occupation:__ Idol

A wildly popular idol with the gimmick of being a "fallen angel", with goth makeup and a bad boy attitude.

He is a crow tengu who wished to become the land god instead of [Nanami](https://anilist.co/character/18343/Momozono-Nanami) by eating her heart. After being thwarted by [Tomoe](https://anilist.co/character/18344/Tomoe), he becomes friendly with Nanami and even allows her to stay at his apartment when she temporarily loses her godhood. He has a lingering dislike for Tomoe.

He left Kurama mountain 16 years ago and has been living in human world since then. He also shown to have more normal human's attitude than the others (Tomoe, [Mizuki](https://anilist.co/character/37872/Mizuki), etc.).

name: Akuraou
description: Akura-ou is a powerful demon with an immortal body, only considering Tomoe to be his equal. However when Tomoe left him, he succumbed to the gods powers and lost his body. After being locked up, he was given a chance to live in a boy's body and took it, returning to the world and is constantly seeking a way to retrieve his lost body.

name: Mikage
description:
__Species:__ God
__Height:__ 185 cm (6'0")

A mysterious man who was once the land god of the shrine, and who left twenty years ago for unspecified reasons. He met a newly-homeless [Nanami](https://anilist.co/character/18343/Momozono-Nanami) and bestowed the land-god mark on her, saying that she was better suited to be the god than him. He has light hair and glasses, and wears a trenchcoat and hat.

name: Numa no Himemiko
description: A catfish who became a swamp deity, and lives in a palace underneath her swamp with her many fish attendants. Ten years ago she fell in love with a young boy, and she asks Nanami to help her reconnect with the boy once again. As repayment, when Nanami visits her palace she allows her to wear one of her luxurious kimonos so she will look her best in front of Tomoe.   Despite rarely speaking, Himemiko is very perceptive and seems to be one of the few characters who has figured out that Nanami is in love with Tomoe. Initially she appears very "fishy," with bulging eyes and a fishlike noseless face. However after getting a makeover from Nanami, she maintains a more casual "human" appearance so she can meet the boy again.

name: Kotetsu
description: One of the two attendants at [Nanami's](https://anilist.co/character/18343/Momozono-Nanami) shrine. Appears to be a bald childlike yokai wearing masks, but like [Tomoe](https://anilist.co/character/18344/Tomoe) is able to shapeshift. Is extremely fond of Nanami and Tomoe both.

name: Onikiri
description: One of the two attendants at [Nanami's](https://anilist.co/character/18343/Momozono-Nanami) shrine. Appears to be a bald childlike yokai wearing masks, but like [Tomoe](https://anilist.co/character/18344/Tomoe) is able to shapeshift. Is  extremely fond of Nanami and Tomoe both.

name: Ryuuou Sukuna
description:
__Species:__ Yokai
__Height:__ 183 cm (6'0")
__Occupation:__ King

His real name is Sukuna, a Dragon Lord of the sea. He has been waiting to seek revenge against Tomoe for 526 years and 28 days ago, at 2 o'clock 18 minutes and 4 seconds in the morning for ripping out his right eye and attacking the north gate of Ryuuguu Castle. He found Tomoe after he saved a girl from drowning in the sea. The Dragon Lord's eyes are known as the Longevity Elixir and are said to give great power to whoever drank them.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Kotarou Urashima
description:
__Occupation:__ Student

Kotarou is technically a shy type of boy who doesn't blend well with other people, claiming his only good point was probably his skill in solving rubix cubes. He has low self-esteem, making him doubt that Himemiko actually loves him and that it might just be a cruel prank of some kind. 

~!However, after undergoing some obstacles in their love, he realizes Himemiko's love for him is true, and so is his love for her.!~

name: Yukiji
description: ~! A very beautiful and elegant girl, Yukiji was Tomoe's former lover that died young. He wanted to be human to be able to grow old at her side or to find a way to make her immortal.  Yukiji was usually very composed, apparently very cold and sometimes even cruel but in reality she was very kind, brave and willing to help those in need. She hated youkai because they burned down her village and killed her family. Her biggest wish was to make a family of her own, so she didn't have to be alone anymore.   It is hinted that she might be Nanami´s ancestor.!~

name: Kamehime
description: Sukuna's wife.

name: Kirakaburi
description: Kirakaburi is a yokai who serves under Akura-ou. He has a love for killing and decapitating and then placing the heads he had cut off on flowers.

name: Yuuko Aioi
description: An energetic high school girl with short brown hair. One of her negative sides is that she is often too lazy to do her own homework and always copies from either [Mio](https://anilist.co/character/40081) or [Mai](https://anilist.co/character/10421).

name: Sakamoto
description:
A black cat who wears a scarf created by the [Professor](https://anilist.co/character/41055), which allows him to speak. Being technically older than both [Nano](https://anilist.co/character/10422) and the Professor, he speaks in a condescending tone towards them, though he occasionally succumbs to his catlike habits.

~!In the last episode, it is revealed that Sakamoto used to be [Nakamura](https://anilist.co/character/44126)'s cat and was called "Taisho". Sakamoto does not want to return to Nakamura because she did not take good care of him, even though she had good intentions.!~

name: Mio Naganohara
description:
