A bright and cheerful girl sporting light blue hair and pigtails held by two small wooden cubes. She has a crush on [Koujirou](https://anilist.co/character/41616). She's usually a calm and collected person who can support her friends whenever they're in a pinch. But she's a lot more sensitive than she lets on, and more often than not needs that support back in return.   

~!She is a fujoshi mangaka, going under the name Daisuke Naganohara.!~

name: Nano Shinonome
description:
A robotic schoolgirl that was built by a [Professor](https://anilist.co/character/41055/Shinonome-Hakase). She often worries about keeping her identity as a robot from others, despite the fact that everyone already knows about it due to the noticeable wind-up key exposed on her back. Luckily most don't make a big fuss about it. Her limbs will sometimes fall apart, revealing dubious items that Professor has installed without her noticing, ranging from bean-firing-weapons to Swiss rolls. She is also the Professor's caretaker.

She wishes to live life as a normal girl and therefore really wants the wind-up key on her back removed.     ~!In the last episode, after her school friends come over for a surprise birthday party, Nano decides that although the key has been annoying, she prefers things the way they are. The Professor installs a new key on her back that looks the same but spins when Nano is happy.!~

name: Mai Minakami
description: A rather quiet girl who is very intelligent and often is seen with a book. She is seen to be multi-talented, excelling at using projectiles, arm wrestling, and especially pulling pranks, usually at the expense of [Yuuko](https://anilist.co/character/10418/Aioi-Yuuko). She also frequently enjoys carving Buddha and Drawing in her spare time.

name: Hakase Shinonome
description:
She is a young scientist, who despite her outstanding intelligence, still reflects her age.

She loves sharks and snacks, and constantly modifies [Nano Shinonome](https://anilist.co/character/10422/Shinonome-Nano), whom she created, to add strange and unusual functions such as a machine gun right hand and a swiss roll dispensing arm. Nano, most of the time, is unaware of these modifications until they are first used. However, Hakase always refuses to remove the obvious wind-up key from Nano's back cause she thinks that it’s cute, despite Nano's requests to do so.

name: Izumi Sakurai
description: A young, shy, and easily frightened teacher. She tries to enforce the school rules to the students albeit unsuccessfully.

name: Misato Tachibana
description: A peach haired high school girl who generally acts as a tsukkomi towards Koujirou. Whenever he does anything to annoy her, she uses various guns and heavy weaponry that come out of nowhere on him, which he miraculously survives despite being injured.

name: Koujirou Sasahara
description: A rich flamboyant high school boy who likes to think he is an aristocrat when in reality his family are just farmers. He likes to ride his goat to school and is often seen with his butler.

name: Haruna Annaka
description: Yuuko and Mio's classmate. She always wears a big red ribbon. Her common reaction to something that surprises/shocks her consists in expressing herself by making the sound "ehhhhh"

name: Manabu Takasaki
description: Yukko, Mai, and Mio's teacher. Has a crush on Sakurai-sensei but always fails trying to make a move on her.

name: Kana Nakamura
description: A science teacher. She is interested in finding out more information about Nano and Hakase.     ~!In the last episode it is revealed that she was Sakamoto's previous owner and called him "Taisho". She was apparently very clumsy and air-headed and because of it Sakamoto suffered under her care.!~

name: Yoshino Naganohara
description: Mio's older sister who likes to wear costumes and play pranks on her.

name: Yuria Sekiguchi
description: A quiet first-year girl who is a member of the go-soccer club and is often seen reading a book called "Helvetica Standard".

name: Shika
description:
In episode 6, part 24, the Deer is seen standing outside of the window that Yukko is looking out from while standing in the hallway.

The Principal then tries to take it down in a fight that almost kills him. It is later shown in part 116 of volume 7 that he has not killed the deer, but has put it on his wall instead.

name: Tsuyoshi Nakanojou
description: A student who doesn't seem to have much luck. He tends to get hurt a lot even though he is not the target. He does not believe in anything supernatural.    ~!The hair on the sides of his head does not grow, i.e. his mohawk is natural. !~

name: Fecchan
description: Friend of Misato and Weboshi.

name: Kenzaburou Daiku
description: A second-year and President of the go-soccer club. At first, he wanted to make a club that combined go and soccer, but in reality he and the two other members don't really do anything at all.    His family is very rich.

name: Weboshi
description: Misato's friend.

name: Makoto Sakurai
description: A first-year and Sakurai-sensei's little brother. He joins Daiku's go-soccer club after being the MVP at his middle school's go-soccer club.

name: Kousuke Oura
description: He is a Vice Principal of Tokisadame HIgh School.

name: Tanaka
description: An eccentric student with an afro.

name: Ogi
description: One of the three members of the go-soccer club. He doesn't normally show up to meetings.

name: Tamamura
description: She works at a coffee shop.

name: Fuuta Okeya
description:
14-year-old boy with the ability to see ghosts.
Falls in love at first sight with Kouko Ishigami, who doesn't necessarily share the same feelings.

name: Kouko Ishigami
description: The 7th reincarnation of Koko and Fortuna's mortal enemy. She regained her memory after a car accident left her with the scar on the top of her face.

name: Lafalle
description: One of Fuuta's previous reincarnations.

name: Fortuna
description: Fortuna is Fuuta's first reincarnation. He is a genius who mastered soul conversion at a very young age. The thing that he desires most is knowledge. He does not fear taboos, because of that he created artificial spirits Rune and East which is why his master denounced him

name: Vann Flantyr
description: One of Fuuta's previous reincarnations.

name: Kouko
description: One of Kouko's previous reincarnations.

name: East
description: Fortunas' former apprentice. He is currently bound to Kouko's spirit circle and therefore he is always with her.

name: Houtarou Kajima
description: Houtarou is the fourth reincarnation of Fuuta that is introduced. A samurai, he was born in the time of feudal japan.

name: Stona
description: Kouko's reincarnation in Fone's life.

name: Flors
description:
Flors is the third reincarnation of Fuuta's that is introduced. Born in the time of Ancient Egypt and Ancient Greece, he spends his life building a sphynx statue in the Egyptian deserts.

(Source: Spirit Circle Wiki)

name: Roca
description: Kouko's reincarnation in Flors' life.

name: Fuuko Okeya
description:
The sixth reincarnation of Fuuta that is introduced. Fuuko is his only female reincarnation, and one of the few that gets along well with the Kouko incarnation of her time.

(Source: Spirit Circle Wiki)

name: Iwana
description: Kouko's reincarnation in Houtarou's life.

name: Lapis
description: Kouko's reincarnation in Lafalle's life.

name: Fone
description:
Fone is the first of Okeya Fuuta's reincarnations that is introduced. He was born in the Yucatan peninsula during a primitive era, in a Mayan tribe that commits blood sacrifices.

(Source: Spirit Circle Wiki)

name: Rei
description: Rei's reincarnation in Vann's life.

name: Kurokami no Majo
description: Kouko's reincarnation in Vann's life. Her real name is unknown.

name: Kousuke Shakujii
description: Kouko's reincarnation in Fuuko's life. His real name is unknown but his friends call him Kousuke.

name: Rei
description: Rei's reincarnation in Fone's life.

name: Rei
description: Rei's reincarnation in Fortuna's life.

name: Osamu Dazai
description:
**Height:** 181 cm (5'11")
**Ability:** No Longer Human

A member of the Armed Detective Agency. He's a suicide enthusiast who searches for a place to die. However, he doesn't like pain, and would prefer a lovers' suicide with a beautiful woman. He's aimless, elusive, nonchalant, and jokes around normally, but, when he is serious, it is clear that he is an insightful and intelligent individual. He loves to annoy his fellow Agency member, [Kunikida](https://anilist.co/character/89200).

~!He was a former Executive of the city's worst underworld organization, the Port Mafia.!~

name: Ranpo Edogawa
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm (5'6")

The great detective of the Armed Detective Agency. He possesses sharp observation skills that are acknowledged by his coworkers, and he settles difficult cases at the request of the police. Because of his self-confidence, his speech is brazen and child-like. His motto is "If you'll have me, everything will be ok!" He likes logical thinking and fantastic tales.

name: Chuuya Nakahara
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3")

Chuuya is a Port Mafia member who detests [Osamu Dazai](https://anilist.co/character/89198) for betraying the mafia and joining the Armed Detective Agency. He's also constantly teased by Dazai what makes him hate Dazai even more. Chuuya is short but he's quick and uses powerful martial arts. 

His ability, "For The Tainted Sorrow," revolves around gravity manipulation, allowing him to manipulate and alter the gravity of anything he touches, keeping it that way until a certain period of time.

name: Ryuunosuke Akutagawa
description:
__Height:__ 172cm (5'8")
__Likes:__ Curios and antiques, tea, figs
__Dislikes:__ Bonsai trees, dogs, baths

"The weak will die. Die, and make way for others."
A member of the notorious "Port Mafia" that operates by the harbor. Akutagawa has a black and white "survival of the fittest" view of the world, claiming that weak people should die and give way to the stronger ones. His ability is called "Rashōmon" (羅生門).

He is not afraid of pain and defeat, if only to hear a word from a "certain person". His ruthless, vicious nature makes him one of the Port Mafia's most dangerous members, feared by both ally and foe. Much of the obedience he receives from subordinates of Black Lizard , and the Mafia in general, largely stems from fear of his short temper and general intolerance of incompetence. 

In chapter 87,
~!it is revealed that Akutagawa doesn't have much time left to live, as he is suffering from a vital lung disease.!~

In chapter 88 of the manga,
~!Akutagawa turns undead, being bitten by Bram Stoker after a fatal blow which results in his death.!~

(Source: Bungou Stray Doys Wiki, Anime News Network)

name: Atsushi Nakajima
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7")
__Ability:__ Beast Beneath the Moonlight

He came to Yokohama after being driven out of a poor orphanage that was attacked by a man-eating tiger. On the verge of starvation, he meets [Dazai](https://anilist.co/character/89198/Dazai-Osamu) and gets a job helping at the detective agency. Because he's never had friends or family and was labeled as "useless," he lacks self-confidence.

name: Lucy Montgomery
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm (5'5")

A member of Ability User Society "Fellowship of The Guild." 

Her ability is known as "Anne of Abyssal Red".

~!She helped [Atsushi](https://anilist.co/character/89197/Nakajima-Atsushi) escape the Guild because they bonded over their past trauma and loneliness.!~

name: Akiko Yosano
description:
__Height:__ 166 cm (5'5")
__Ability:__ Thou Shalt Not Die

A modern woman with a bob cut who's a member of the Armed Detective Agency. Although she's an excellent doctor who is indispensable to the Agency, all members of the the Agency are scared to be placed into her care. It's recommended that you don't use outdated misogynistic expressions in front of her.

name: Fyodor Dostoyevsky
description:
__Ability:__ Crime and Punishment

Head of the underground organization "Rats in the House of the Dead" and part of the terrorist organization "Decay of Angels". He maintains a calm, confident, and arrogant yet polite personality towards others and has shown to be extremely intelligent, cunning, and sinister. He is highly religious and speaks often of the sin of man, especially ability users. According to him, he is anemic.

name: Sakunosuke Oda
description:
__Height:__ 185 cm (6'1)
__Ability:__ Flawless

Was a member of the Port Mafia. Oda was a man described as kind, despite working for the mafia, by [Dazai](https://anilist.co/character/89198/Dazai-Osamu). He had an incredibly perceptive side to him that allowed him to come the closest to understanding Dazai, whom he referred to as "his dear friend, who had grown tired of the world and is simply waiting to die."

~!It is his understanding of Dazai's loneliness, as well as his regret of not being able to do anything about it, that prompted him to leave behind the last words that became the trigger for Dazai deserting the mafia in favour of carving a brighter path for himself, something that Oda wanted to do.!~

name: Kyouka Izumi
description:
__Height:__ 148cm (4'10")

A docile young lady who dresses in a kimono, but also a member of Port Mafia. As she holds a killing ability, she was found by the organization and raised as an assassin.

~!She later joins the Armed Detective Agency.!~

name: Doppo Kunikida
description:
__Height:__ 189 cm (6'2")
__Ability:__ The Matchless Poet

A member of the Armed Detective Agency. He carries a notepad with the word "Ideal" written on the cover, and what is written inside are guides for life. He has a straight-laced personality and hates nothing more than schedules going awry. As a partner to the free-spirited [Dazai](https://anilist.co/character/89198/Dazai-Osamu), his troubles never end.

name: Edgar Poe
description:
__Height:__ 182 cm (6'0")
__Ability:__ Black Cat in the Rue Morgue

A member of The Guild who is rarely seen without his pet raccoon, Karl. Poe's ability, Black Cat in the Rue Morgue, can transport someone into a story they're reading.
Poe is portrayed as shy but determined. He spent six years on a plot to defeat Ranpo, showing that he will work hard at something he cares about. He often talks too quietly for others to hear. ~!After the Guild War, he forms a rivalrous friendship with Ranpo, and frequently brings him his works to read after Ranpo said he wants to see them.!~

name: Nikolai Gogol
description:
__Height:__ 184 cm (6’0)
__Ability:__ The Overcoat

Nikolai Gogol is a member of the Decay of Angels. He's a sadist who enjoys putting on a show with his words. He is freakish, vigorous, unrepentant, and quite enigmatic. However, Gogol suggests that his quirky image could or might not be real. The side of him that has no remorse for murdering others is just as genuine as the one who has guilt and is well aware of the unjust and cruel nature of his acts. He joined the Decay of Angels in order to experience what he had always desired: freedom against gravity.

The Overcoat, Gogol's ability, allows him to use his coat to manipulate spaces and what emerges from it. It functions essentially as a portal, capable of relocating and moving anything. He may use this to materialize a pillar or to manifest his hand and pistol in a location unrelated to him. The ability is also applicable to living beings.

name: Yukichi Fukuzawa
description:
__Height:__ 186 cm (6'1")
__Ability:__ All Men Are Equal

The president of the Armed Detective Agency, who manages the hooligans. Although he doesn't often come out, at a critical moment, he triumphantly takes command. Because Yukichi is a man of dignity and status, it seems even the frivolous Ranpo will actually work if he orders it.

name: Kenji Miyazawa
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm (5'2")
__Ability:__ Undefeated by the Rain

A member of the Armed Detective Agency. Before he was scouted, he lived in a rural area without electricity. He knows no suspicion, and will be understanding and considerate no matter who he is talking to. He has a lot of friends who call him "Ken-chan." He likes music, tempura soba, and Mitsuya cider.

name: Sigma
description:
Sigma is a member of the terrorist organization, "Decay of Angels", and owner of the Sky Casino.

His ability is unknown, but stated by Fyodor to be the weakest of the Angels. It may be more support-oriented than combat-oriented because of this.

He is shown to be very kind to his customers and to have a sense of pride and ownership over his casino.

name: Gin Akutagawa
description: Ryuunosuke's younger sister and a member of the "Black Lizards" Assault Unit. It seems she is in good terms with Dazai.

name: Junichirou Tanizaki
description:
__Height:__ 174 cm (5'8.5")
__Ability:__ Light Snow

He is a member of the Armed Detective Agency and the older brother of [Naomi](https://anilist.co/character/89209/Tanizaki-Naomi).

name: Ougai Mori
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm
__Ability:__ Vita Sexualis

Ougai Mori is the boss of the Port Mafia. Ougai is analytical and tactical. He often puts on overdramatic acts but rarely breaks his composure internally. 

He has been shown to be somewhat ruthless and unfaltering when it comes to violence. He hasn't, however, shown any particular enjoyment from killing. His ruthlessness comes from his pragmaticism.

Although he can be intimidating at times and emit a scary formal aura, he is often polite to the point of seeming approachable. He is polite to allies and enemies alike.

name: Tecchou Suehiro
description:
__Ability:__ Plum Blossoms in Snow

Tecchou Suehiro is a Hunting Dogs special unit member with the ability Plum Blossoms in Snow. Tecchou has a considerably more serious demeanor than his companions, yet he still qualifies as an oddball for his strange preferences in food. He takes his duty as a Hunting Dog earnestly and has a deep sense of justice. He despises the notion of torture and is a highly compassionate person.

Tecchou's ability, Plum Blossoms in Snow, lets him enhance the size, shape, and reach of his blade. It is unknown whether he can demonstrate his ability on other weapons. He is said to have the strongest ability in the Hunting Dogs.

name: Michizou Tachihara
description:
__Height:__ 176 cm
__Ability:__ Midwinter Memento

A commander of the Black Lizards, the Port Mafia's squad of hitmen. Though he puts up a tough and violent front, he cares deeply for his friends. Very skilled gunner, especially when dual wielding.

name: Francis Fitzgerald
description:
__Height:__ 191 cm (6'3")
__Ability:__ The Great Fitzgerald

Francis poses as the leader for an american secret society, ''The Guild''. Said organization is composed by rich and notorious individuals, who all have some type of powerful influence in the USA. His ability, ''The Great Fitzgerald'', allows him to power up his own atributes and traits, according to the money he spent from his countless fortune. A fierce man, who loves his family, and would do pretty much anything to achieve his goals.

name: Saigiku Jouno
description: Saigiku Jouno is a member of the Hunting Dogs. He possesses the ability "Priceless Tears".

name: Ango Sakaguchi
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm
__Ability:__ Discourse on Decadence 

Port Mafia's former exclusive informant. Works as an assistant counselor at the Special Ability Department at the Ministry of Internal Affairs.

For the most part, Ango is a composed, calm young man, showing more restraint than [Osamu Dazai](https://anilist.co/character/89198/Dazai-Osamu) and more discipline than [Oda Sakunosuke](https://anilist.co/character/120625/Oda-Sakunosuke). Although he values both as genuine friends, he strongly believes that Dazai needs someone to keep him from acting out as much as he does.

name: Ichiyou Higuchi
description: A beautiful and intelligent woman who wears pants. She belongs to a commando unit that answers to the leader of Port Mafia, and has authority over the military group "Black Lizard." She adores Akutagawa and calls him "senpai."

name: Violet Evergarden
description:
__Height:__ 161 cm

Violet is described as a very beautiful young woman, being almost doll-like in appearance, with light-blue eyes, a fair complexion, and a slender frame. She is noted for her womanly semblance. She has waist-length golden hair with locks that frame her face. She either has her hair untied, in a low ponytail, or, after becoming a Doll, pulled up into two braided buns with two red ribbons. Due to losing her arms in the war, Violet received maneuverable prosthetic arms made of adamant silver. After the end of the war and on normal occasions, Violet is often seen wearing a white blouse, a green skirt and a pair of heeled brown boots.

~!Growing up as an orphaned child soldier in the army who was treated as a mere tool, Violet was not educated like a regular human being and did not understand human feelings well. She was raised and grew up as a person who had feelings, but couldn't perceive or express them. For this reason, she could be mistaken as emotionless, or apathetic. Even before she was found and taken into the army, she couldn't speak or understand speech, only understanding orders to kill. She did not possess any sense of right or wrong from the start; she didn't understand what could be considered righteous or erroneous. She merely chased after the adults who gave her orders. She followed the idea of "kill or be killed," thus she could kill countless people without feeling guilt or remorse. She did anything that was asked of her and always followed orders, which was a trait from her life as a soldier. Even after the war ended and she was discharged from the military, Violet had a habit of using words back from her life as a soldier; saluting, disliking being defenseless, and doing tasks without taking any breaks. She also continued to think of herself as a "tool" and believed that it would be appropriate to discard her if she can no longer be used as a weapon.!~ 

Violet is also aloof, expressionless and is said to have the attitude and the presence of a doll. Her expressions are mostly deadpan, so it is hard to tell her mood changes. This is why she sometimes has trouble expressing her own feelings and comes off as expressionless, which makes it difficult to get through her, but she will give a smile from time to time. Through her work as a Doll where she helps people write heartfelt letters, she slowly learns about human emotions, leading her to become more skilled at writing letters and conveying her clients' feelings, as well as becoming understanding of others. She is proven to be a good listener and someone who always thinks about other people's happiness.

name: Gilbert Bougainvillea
description:
Gilbert Bougainvillea is a character in the Violet Evergarden series. He is a major in the Leidenschaftlich army who values Violet more than anything, seeing her as a human being rather than a tool.

~!Violet was "given" to Gilbert as a gift to commemorate his promotion, having being promoted to a major in light of his wartime achievements and expectations from his bloodline. Dietfried, not wanting to take care of Violet, pushed this task to his younger brother. Gilbert then decided to enlist her on a militant unit that he had been appointed to take overall command of in his promotion to major. He later received permission to conduct private experiments at the training grounds as to whether Violet could be officially classified as a "weapon."!~

name: Benedict Blue
description: Benedict Blue (ベネディクト・ブルー, Benedikuto Burū?) is a character in the Violet Evergarden series. He is a postman working at the CH Postal Company. He has known Hodgins since before the company's establishment and has had a brusque attitude towards him since he started working there.

name: Cattleya Baudelaire
description: Cattleya Baudelaire is a character in the Violet Evergarden series. Being a figurehead Auto Memories Doll who works for the CH Postal Company, Cattleya never stops being requested and often takes on clients with love troubles. She works alongside [Violet](https://anilist.co/character/90169/Evergarden-Violet) and has been close with [Hodgins](https://anilist.co/character/124799/Hodgins-Claudia) since before the company was established, joining as one of its initial employees.

name: Claudia Hodgins
description:
A former army commander. He founded the CH postal company and serves as president.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Dietfried Bougainvillea
description:
Dietfried Bougainvillea is a naval captain in the navy and [Gilbert](https://anilist.co/character/124790/)'s older brother. He was the one who found [Violet](https://anilist.co/character/90169/) and made her into Gilbert's "weapon" on his promotion to a major in the army.

(Source: Violet Evergarden wiki)

name: Ann Magnolia
description: Ann Magnolia is a character in the Violet Evergarden series and the protagonist of the second chapter of the first volume of the light novel. She is a young girl who lives with her terminally ill [mother](https://anilist.co/character/223026/Clara-Magnolia).

name: Oscar Webster
description: A playwright who used to seclude himself due to the deaths of his wife and daughter. However, after deciding to write his very first children's play to dedicate it to his daughter's memory, he entrusts Violet with the task of putting his ideas on paper.

name: Clara Magnolia
description: She is the mother of [Ann](https://anilist.co/character/213148/Ann-Magnolia), who had a terminal illness and predicted that her fate was close.

name: Lux Sibyl
description: A young girl who was worshipped as a demigod at a "utopia" on the island of Chevalier.

name: William Moriarty
description:
__Height:__ 185 cm (6'1")
__Hometown:__ East End

A noble, a mathematics professor and the antiheroic protagonist of the manga. He is a genius who attempts to overthrow evil nobles and destroy the class system that has caused misery and pain to the poor everywhere.

~!He and his brother were orphans who were adopted by [Albert Moriarty](https://anilist.co/character/151489/Moriarty-James-Albert) after noticing his capabilities and his ideals of overthrowing the evil nobility. At Albert's request, he concocts a plan to kill the remaining members of the family and make it look like an accident. After burning the entire manor down, he adopts the name of the one he killed, William James Moriarty. He assumes the position of the second son of the Moriarty household, and lives under the guise of a noble.

He adopts the title of crime consultant as he, along with his gang, go around destroying the corrupt caste system from the shadows.!~

name: Sherlock Holmes
description:
__Height:__ 185 cm (6'1")
__Hometown:__ North Riding, Yorkshire

He is the antagonist to Moriarty and also the figure around which Moriarty's plan revolves. He enjoys puzzles, is a violin player, has a prodigious observational skill, well-versed in hand-to-hand combat and has a machiavellian attitude when it comes to something he wants. He is a detective consultant and can be considered an intellectual match and rival to Moriarty himself.

name: Albert Moriarty
description:
__Height:__ 188 cm (6'2")
__Hometown:__ London

The eldest son of the Moriarty family.

name: Louis Moriarty
description:
__Height:__ 183 cm (6')
__Hometown:__ East End

William's younger brother. When young, he was often very ill, but was later treated after moving in with the Moriarty family. Louis often serves as the family butler, despite being a nobleman.

name: Sebastian Moran
description: An ex-soldier in the army who was declared KIA (Killed In Action) during the war of Afghanistan but now works with the Moriarty brothers. He is a outstanding sniper who often acts on his own. Although on the outside he holds a cocky and charming exterior he secretly suffers from a lot of psychological trauma following his military service .

name: Irene Adler
description:
Irene Adler is a former theatre actress and prima donna who would later retire.
~!After Irene Adler is pronounced dead, they take on the identity of James Bond and works alongside the Moriarty brothers.!~

name: Fred Porlock
description:
A quiet yet skilled martial artist affiliated with the Moriarty brothers
Although he rarely ever speaks unless prompted he is a gentle person at heart as well as being skilled at both spying and disguise

name: John Watson
description: John H. Watson is a doctor and also the new roommate of Sherlock Holmes. He's an ex-soldier back from Afghan.

name: Mycroft Holmes
description: Mycroft is the Director of the London Military Department and is the Brother of Sherlock Holmes.

name: Von Herder
description: He is a weapon expert.

name: Hudson
description: The landlady of 221B, where Holmes and Watson live.

name: Jack Renfield
description: Formally known as Jack the Ripper from the amount of lives he took while fighting in the Afghan War. He then trained The Moriarty boys as well as Sebastian and Fred with his expert combat skills after they asked him.

name: Charles Milverton
description:
Charles Augustus Milverton is a media mogul who seeks to stir up conflict in London, making himself an enemy of both William James Moriarty and Sherlock Holmes. He is known for blackmailing people.

(Source: Moriarty the Patriot Wikia)

name: Moneypenny
description: Part of MI6 she is transferred from MI5

name: Gregory Lestrade
description: Gregory Lestrade is an inspector with the Shinjuku Police and he often assists Sherlock in his investigations. Despite often getting annoyed by Sherlock Homes reckless actions he puts a great deal of faith in him often trusting him even when things look bad. Although his police co-workers tend to be disregard human life he has a much greater set of morals caring about the safety of others above all

name: Wiggins
description: Wiggins is a crafty kid who acts as a leader to the street children. He's often a helpful ally to Sherlock Holmes.

name: Adam Whiteley
description: He's a member of the parliament, belonging to the House of Commons. Has a strong sense of justice and believes in equality.

name: Henry Antrim
description: A member of the United States Departament of Justice.

name: Dudley Bale
description: An administrative assistant at the university William works at.

name: Sam Whiteley
description: Adam's younger brother

name: Sakura Yamauchi
description:
A high school student who suffers a pancreatic disease, having her lifespan cut in half. She has a diary called "Living with Dying" where she writes about her daily experiences, since her illness was first diagnosed. 

Despite her situation, she keeps her smile and even makes jokes about it.

~!She was later stabbed after being discharged from the hospital and sadly passed away.!~

name: Haruki Shiga
description:
A guy who incidentally found a book in the hospital titled "Disease Coexistence Journal" which is owned by his classmate [Sakura Yamauchi](https://anilist.co/character/127118/Yamauchi-Sakura).

~!It is revealed in the last chapter of the novel that his name is Haruki Shiga (志賀春樹).!~

name: Issei Miyata
description: A classmate who started talking to Haruki, since meeting Haruki and Sakura. For some reason, he offers a piece of gum to Haruki whenever they talk.

name: Kyouko Takimoto
description: Sakura’s best friend since they were little. She is protective of Sakura and will not let anyone who may be harmful near her. Very assertive.

name: Haruki no Haha
description: As his mother, she quietly and protectively watches over Haruki. Though she rarely intervenes, she has very good instincts.

name: Sakura no Haha
description: A very kind hearted woman, who strives to grant all of Sakura’s wishes since her daughter’s diagnosis.

name: Takahiro
description: Class representative who is in love with Sakura. He is very obstinate and gets jealous easily yet hides it to keep face with his classmates.

name: Haruki no Chichi
description: A humble and genuinely nice father, whose relationship with Haruki is neither good nor bad. Has a good relationship with his wife.

name: Ray
description:
__Height:__ 150 cm
__Farm Identifier:__ 81194

As one of the three perfect students at the orphanage, Ray is very logical, smart, cunning, extremely patient and is usually shown to read books by himself. Although he is extremely book smart he says that he never liked to study. According to data obtained by sister [Krone](https://anilist.co/character/121702/Krone), his weakness is that he gives up easily.

name: Norman
description:
__Height:__ 145 cm
__Farm Identifier:__ 22194

Norman seems to be logical, well-meaning, and devoted, with a slightly naive side. He can easily plan his actions in advance and he anticipates on other's actions. He is one of the top 3 ranking orphans, along with [Emma](https://anilist.co/character/121725/Emma) and [Ray](https://anilist.co/character/121724/Ray). Norman loves Emma and he is helpful and loyal towards her.

name: Emma
description:
__Height:__ 145 cm
__Farm Identifier:__ 63194

Emma acts as an older sister to the other children and loves her family very intensely. She is sweet, heroic, caring, and has a big heart. She can also be naive and reckless, and doesn't hesitate to put herself at risk to ensure the safety of the group. The other kids describe her as having monster reflexes and an astounding ability to learn, which enables her to think fast in difficult situations and makes her a very good strategist. She could be considered a beacon of hope for the rest of the children.

name: Phil
description:
__Height:__ 100 cm
__Farm Identifier:__ 34394 (Grace Field House)
__D.O.B:__ 2041

Phil is very active and can always be seen running around.

~!He is also shown to be very mature and intelligent for his age, even suspecting something was wrong when [Emma](https://anilist.co/character/121725/Emma) and the other older orphans were trying to find out ways to escape.!~

name: Isabella
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm
__Farm Identifier:__ 73584

Isabella worked as a Mama at Grace Field House, taking care of the orphans that reside within.

name: Krone
description: Sister Krone runs the Grace Field House orphanage with [Madam Isabella](https://anilist.co/character/121701/Isabella). She has the desire to usurp the position of "Mama" from Isabella.

name: Gilda
description:
__Farm Identifier:__ 65194
__Height (2045-2049):__ 138 - 155 cm

Gilda has short olive drab hair kept in a Chinese bob hairstyle and wears circular-lensed glasses. Gilda is an intuitive young girl. She also has a caring personality. She seems to be an introvert, however she also has her moments of bravery. She can also be quite threatening.

name: Don
description:
__Age (2045):__ 10 yo

Don has dark skin and a tall and slender appearance. He has short, messy black hair with an undercut and brown eyes. He wears the standard white uniform. Like [Emma](https://anilist.co/character/121725/Emma), Don cares deeply about his siblings. Don is portrayed as a cheerful and slightly careless boy, however, he too is fairly intelligent, coming around 5th place in the everyday test, after [Gilda](https://anilist.co/character/126455/Gilda). He also has talents in pick pocketing. His physical ability is also fairly strong.

name: Conny
description:
__Height:__ 115cm
__Farm Identifier:__ 48294

Conny is nice and lovely towards Emma, Don and the other orphans. She always carried her stuffed rabbit Little Bernie around with her. Her intellect level seemed to be average for her age.

name: Anna
description:

Just like every other orphans of Grace Field, she wears the standard Grace Field Orphanage uniform. Anna grows to be a surprisingly big boned, tall girl. She has blonde hair tied into twin braids. 
~!Later, she cuts her hair in order to help with the escape.!~~!During her time at the B06-32 shelter, she spends a lot of time studying medicine in order to help her family.!~

name: Thoma
description:
__Height:__ 123 cm
__Farm Identifier:__ 55294 (Grace Field House)

Thoma is a resourceful and mischievous boy, who enjoys pulling pranks alongside his best friend [Lani](https://anilist.co/character/129783). He is blunt, but can also be quite cowardly.

Lani is a mischievous and resourceful boy, who enjoys pulling pranks with his best friend, [Thoma](https://anilist.co/character/129784/Thoma). He is a bit cowardly, but also blunt and straightforward.

name: Leslie
description:
__Farm Identifier:__ 71584

Leslie was Isabella's childhood friend and is shown to be very kind and loves music.

name: Jemima
description:

__Height (2045-2049):__ 107 - 134 cm 

Jemima is cheerful and well-behaved. Though, she can display acts of mischievousness. She is seen to have a strong bond with [Alicia](https://anilist.co/character/199115).

name: Nat
description:
__Age (2045):__ 9 yo

Nat is a rather frail boy, with brown eyes and a tall nose line (which he takes great pride in).  He wears the standard orphanage uniform. Even though he can be easily intimidated, he does have his moments of bravery.

name: Sobo
description:
Grandmother is a high-ranking human and once worked as [Isabella's](https://anilist.co/character/121701/Isabella) Mama although she treated her more as a pawn than a human. 

~!On January 27, 2046, it was revealed that all of Isabella's mistakes and responsibilities, as in letting the children escape, were placed on Grandma Sarah. Although Isabella wasn't able to manage her products, Sarah wasn't able to manage Isabella. As a result, Sarah was shipped out to be served at the upcoming Tifari in order to make up for the escapees. Isabella took the role of Grandmother after that.!~

name: Chika Kudou
description:
**Height:** 178 cm (5'10")

The first member to join Kurata in the club. Kudou brings with him a reputation for fighting and delinquency, which initially makes others distrustful of him. However, underneath his rough exterior is a kind heart who wants to honor his deceased grandfather by playing the koto.

~!Prior to the start of the series, Chika was neglected by his father and was caused to live with his grandfather, [Gen Kudo](https://anilist.co/character/134571/Kudou-Gen), instead. During these days, Chika would always get into fights and is infamous because of this. Despite this, [Tetsuki Takaoka](https://anilist.co/character/134572/Takaoka-Tetsuki) was close to him and would often come to Gen's house to check up on Chika. Through his grandfather's attempts, and also Tetsuki's reaching outs, Kudo starts to become mellow. Unfortunately, the bad crowd he was hanging out with disliked this and set Chika up by ransacking his grandfather's house where he crafts kotos that he is blamed for this by the neighbors and the police. Not long after this incident, Gen passed away due to a heart disease and it is revealed that Chika now lives with his paternal aunt, [Isaki Kudo](https://anilist.co/character/134563/Kudou-Isaki), after Gen's passing.!~

name: Satowa Houzuki
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm (5'2")

Satowa is a first year student and the daughter of a famous koto family, Houzuki. She has been learning to play koto since she was little and has won many contests. Although she is a koto prodigy, Satowa was debarred from Houzukikai. She claims that she joined the koto music club because she wants to become known as "young virtuoso koto player that led a no-name school club to become number 1 in nation" when she makes professional debut. She loves koto.

name: Hiro Kurusu
description: She is Takezou's classmate and joins the koto music club after hearing their first performance. She has knowledge of koto due to the influence of her grandmother. She becomes the koto music club's vice-president.

name: Takezou Kurata
description: President of koto music club. He's shy and weak in difficult situations. After his failure at the exam, depressed, Takezou saw his senpai's performance, where she was giving her all even though no one listened and koto's string had been broken. He was deeply moved by her performance, so he joined the club. After senpai's graduation, he became an only member of koto music club and had to find strength to protect it.

name: Suzuka Takinami
description:
A math teacher at Tokise High and the Koto Club's advisor.

~!Initially he feigned ignorance of his musical background, though it's later revealed that his parents are world renowned musicians. As a child, he had no interest in playing music whatsoever other than listening to it. When he was seven, his father discovered his talent for writing musical scores and quickly took upon him to brand his son as a child prodigy. Because of this, Suzuka began to disdain music but his interest is later revitalized after becoming the advisor for the Koto club. He often writes pieces for the club as well as gives practice advice, while leaving the actual koto teaching to [Akira](https://anilist.co/character/134569/Doujima-Akira).!~

name: Tetsuki Takaoka
description: Tetsuki has been classmates with Chika since middle school. He's worried about his friend, because he knows Chika's circumstances. He seems to be a quiet person, but in reality he shows his true colors when fighting. He comes from wealthy family, his father is the director of a large hospital.

name: Akira Doujima
description: One of Chiharu Houtsuki's apprentice. She becomes the koto club's instructor.

name: Kouta Mizuhara
description: Kota Mizuhara is a second year student at Tokise High School and a member of the Tokise High School Koto Club.

name: Saneyasu Adachi
description: Saneyasu is a second-year student at Tokise High School and a member of the Tokise High School Koto Club.

description:
__Height:__ 164 cm
__Relatives:__ [Gen Kudou](https://anilist.co/character/134571/) (Father, Deceased), [Chika Kudou](https://anilist.co/character/126137/) (Nephew)

Is the aunt of Chika Kudo who provides a place for him to live after his grandfather passes away.

name: Michitaka Sakai
description: Michitaka Sakai is a second year student at Tokise High School and a member of the Tokise High School Koto Club.

name: Mio Kanzaki
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm
__Affiliation:__ Hakuto High School
__Occupation:__ Student

Mio Kanzaki is a 2nd year student at Hakuto High School and a member of its koto club.

name: Kiriyuu Ousuke
description:
Ousuke Kiryu is a 2nd year student at Meiryo High School.
Due to neglect by his peers at an early age because of his heart condition, Ousuke grew up to be better than average at reading people in order to compensate for his lack of physical ability.

name: Gen Kudou
description:
__Affiliation:__ Tokise High School (Formerly)
__Occupation:__ Koto maker
__Relatives:__ [Isaki Kudo](https://anilist.co/character/134563/Isaki-Kudou) (Daughter), [Chika Kudou](https://anilist.co/character/126137/Chika-Kudou) (Grandson)

Was a koto maker, the father of Isaki Kudo and the grandfather of Chika Kudo who died a year before the events of the story.

name: Takeru Kurata
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm

__Occupation:__ Student

The younger brother of Takezo Kurata and a student at Meiryou High School.

name: Chiharu Houzuki
description: Satowa's mother.

name: Yuki Itose
description: A deaf college student who seeks to learn about the outside world through [Itsuomi](https://anilist.co/character/179810/Nagi-Itsuomi).

name: Itsuomi Nagi
description:
Yuki's university senior and a member of the International Club/Circle. 
He knows 3 languages: German, English and Japanese. He also likes journeys around the world and communicating with children.
In the future he wants to be a teacher that teaches about countries and cultures.

name: Oushi Ashioki
description:
Yuki's childhood friend who learned sign language for her and is very good at it. 
He has known Yuki since their childhood and he is concerned about her relationship with Itsuomi since he's in love with her.

name: Shin Iryuu
description: Shin is [Itsuomi's](https://anilist.co/character/179810/) high school classmate and currently works as a hairdresser. He is usually cool, but his personality suddenly changes to a cheerful one when he drinks alcohol. He often hangs out with [Emma](https://anilist.co/character/282662/) and serves as her love advisor.

name: Rin Fujishiro
description:
Rin is a friend of Yuki from the university. She is very supportive of Yuki's relationship with Itsuomi.

She likes Kyoya, Itsuomi's cousin.

name: Kyouya Nagi
description: Kyouya Nagi is a cousin of [Itsuomi](https://anilist.co/character/179810/Nagi-Itsuomi). He is a barista in a small bar.

name: Motoki Ichishima
description: He is one of Oushi's friends.

name: Yuki no Haha
description: Yuki's mother.

name: Yasuhiro Sandanbata
description: He is one of Oushi's friends.

name: Itaru Itose
description: Yuki's brother.

name: Cheng Hua
description:
__Height:__ 190 cm - 185 cm (San Lang)

Hua Cheng is the deuteragonist and main love interest in Heaven Official's Blessing.

One of the Four Great Calamities, Hua Cheng is the most famed of the three Devastation-class Demons in the Ghost World, thus he is entitled the Ghost King. When he first emerged, he challenged 33 gods and won, making his name as the scourge of the Heavenly Officials overnight.

~!His most famous moniker, Crimson Rain Sought Flower, was attained during his early days as a supreme. After he annihilated [Qi Rong](https://anilist.co/character/261438/Qi-Rong)'s lair and causing blood rain to fall, he found a lone white flower struggling under the heavy rainfall. Until the downpour ceased, Hua Cheng stood by this flower and shielded it from the rain with his red umbrella.!~

~!Just like any other ghost, Hua Cheng's only weakness is his ashes. Hua Cheng's ashes were modelled into a diamond ring that he entrusted to [Xie Lian](https://anilist.co/character/149589/Xie-Lian). When asked if his ashes were sufficiently protected, he stated that if the hiding place of his ashes were to be destroyed, then he would no longer have any reason to exist and might as well disappear.!~

name: Lian Xie
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm
__Weapons:__ Ruoye, Fang Xin

Xie Lian is the main protagonist of the Chinese web novel _Heaven Official's Blessing_.

He was widely known throughout the Xian Le nation as the beloved yet strange prince. Never showing interest in what was considered normal for a prince, he simply declared, "I want to save the common people!" Through practice, hard work, and insight beyond his years, he perfected his cultivation and ascended to the Heavens at the age of 17. He owns a special silk band called Ruoye.

After multiple unfortunate events, he was twice banished from the Heavens. 800 years later, he returns for the third time with an immense crash.

name: Qingxuan Shi
description:
He is one of the Five Elemental Masters in the Heavenly Court. Since he is often worshiped as a female version of himself and often transforms into a woman, he was given the nickname.

He is the younger brother of the Shi Wudu and one of the Four Famous Tales - "The Young Lord Who Pours Wine" (少君倾酒).

name: Qing Mu
description:
Mu Qing is a supporting character in Heaven Official's Blessing.

Mu Qing is a Martial God who oversees the southwest. Eight hundred years ago, he was the personal attendant of Xie Lian. He abandoned the Prince to take care of his mother when Xie Lian descended from Heaven for the first time.

name: Xin Feng
description:
Feng Xin is a supporting character in Heaven Official's Blessing. 

Feng Xin is a Martial God who oversees the southeast. Eight hundred years ago, he was the imperial bodyguard of Xie Lian and later, the first general of the Crown Prince's Palace Hall.

name: Wen Ling
description: Lingwen is the foremost Civil Goddess in the Heavenly Court and one of the notorious Three Tumors.

name: Xuan He
description:
__Height:__ 189 cm

He Xuan is a ghost of Supreme rank and one of the Four Great Calamities. He bears the title Black Water Submerging Boats and his domain is the Black Water Demon Lair.

name: Yi Ming
description: Yi Ming is one of the Five Elemental Masters in the Heavenly Court.

name: Rong Qi
description:
Qi Rong is a Savage level ghost who is close to becoming a Supreme. Despite not being a ghost of the highest rank, he is still regarded as one of the Four Great Calamities, known as the Night-Touring Green Lantern.

He is the maternal cousin of Xie Lian and bore the title Prince Xiao Jing during his years as Xianle royalty.

(Source: Fandom Wiki)

name: Ming Pei
description: Pei Ming, titled as General Ming Guang, is the Martial God of the North with nine thousand temples dedicated to his palace. He is one of the Four Famous Tales: "The General Who Broke His Sword", as well as a member of The Three Tumors.

name: Banyue
description:
She was the Imperial Preceptor of the fallen Banyue kingdom. She was claimed a traitor by its people after allowing the invading army into the city.
~!She had first met Xie Lian over 200 years ago. He took care of her as she was an orphan as a child!~

name: Yao Fu
description: A Heavenly Official of the Middle Court and subordinate of Mu Qing. He often accompanied Xie Lian on his missions in the mortal realm alongside Nan Feng.

name: Feng Nan
description: A Heavenly Official of the Middle Court and subordinate of Feng Xin. He often accompanied Xie Lian on his missions in the mortal realm alongside Fu Yao.

name: Xiu Pei
description:
Xiu Pei is a Heavenly Official of the Middle Court and subordinate of Ming Pei. He appears in the first arc of the story.
He is a proud and composed young man. He takes his tasks as a Martial God seriously and isn't shown to be very emotional.
He holds deep respect and admiration for Ming Pei and is friendly toward Banyue and Lian Xie.
~!For 150 years before the start of the novel, he lured people into the Banyue Kingdom to be fed to the ghosts of the soldiers as a way to calm their resentment. As a Heavenly Official, with his every move watched, he could not directly kill the remaining ghosts of the soldiers in the Sinner's Pit. Instead, he descended as a traveling guide called A-Zhao and worked to cover up the massacre!~

name: Ji Xuan
description: A powerful female ghost of Savage rank and a former lover of Pei Ming.

name: Bai Wu Xiang
description: White No-Face, titled as the White-Clothed Calamity, is the eldest and most powerful of the Four Great Calamities. Centuries ago, he had great influence in the fall of the Xianle kingdom.

name: Na-Ri Yu
description: Na-Ri Yoo is the little sister of [Da-Hee Yoo](https://anilist.co/character/246583/DaHui-Yu).

name: Si-Rin Cha
description:
__Affiliation:__ Team DO (Former)

She has had a talent for games since childhood, and because of that talent, she doesn't get along well with others.

From her days as a promising player before her pro debut, perfect self-management, schedule and training, and high performance to match, she has done everything. Even so, it is said that she could not find a smile on her face. However, thanks to Song Eun-Sa, whom she met while preparing to become a pro gamer, she realizes that her talent is a gift. As soon as she debuted, she won the championship, so she is a top-tier player called the Empress. As she is a rare female player in her industry, her popularity is at an all-time high both at home and abroad.

name: Beatrice
description:
The Golden Witch and Endless Witch. She is affectionately referred to as "Beato" (ベアト). A witch who has lived for over a thousand years, she is said to appear as a cloud of golden butterflies, and has the power to summon higher demons among the seventy-two pillars to serve her. It is said that humans can summon her to have their wishes granted in exchange for compensation, though she often acts whimsically. She is the one rumored to have given [Kinzo](https://anilist.co/character/14041/Ushiromiya-Kinzou) ten tons of gold and served under him as the alchemic advisor to the Ushiromiya family.

~!She is one of the personalites of Yasu and was made as the ideal girl for Battler to fall in love with after [Shannon](https://anilist.co/character/15435/Shannon)'s feelings were made to be directed at [George](https://anilist.co/character/14042/Ushiromiya-George) instead of Battler!~

name: Battler Ushiromiya
description:
Battler is the son of [Rudolf](https://anilist.co/character/14043/Ushiromiya-Rudolf) and his first wife [Asumu](https://anilist.co/character/259608/Ushiromiya-Asumu), and is generally considered to be the main protagonist of the series. 

He is extremely stubborn, and is afraid of "shaky" transportation, fearing he might fall off a boat.  At first glance, he appears to be hotheaded, cocky, and even a little perverted. However, he has a heart of gold he isn't afraid to show when the situation calls for it.

name: Ange Ushiromiya
description:
[Rudolf](https://anilist.co/character/14043/Ushiromiya-Rudolf) and [Kyrie](https://anilist.co/character/18673/Ushiromiya-Kyrie)'s daughter, and [Battler](https://anilist.co/character/14040/Ushiromiya-Battler)'s sister. 

~!She could not come to the island in 1986 (at the age of six) due to a sickness. After the events of Banquet of the Golden Witch, she is raised by [Eva](https://anilist.co/character/14049/Ushiromiya-Eva) after she returns alive from Rokkenjima, and studies to become the next family head. However, she is put through many hardships particularly due to Eva's belief that her son [George](https://anilist.co/character/14042/Ushiromiya-George) should have been the next head, particularly after Eva's genuine desire to raise Ange as though she were her own daughter is poisoned when [Bernkastel](https://anilist.co/character/11840/Bernkastel-Frederica) manipulates a young Ange into rejecting Eva as a surrogate mother. Before her death in 1998, Eva passes down the gold and the title of the Ushiromiya family head down to Ange. Ange decides to try her luck and see if she was really supposed to be alive when her entire family is dead by jumping off a skyscraper, knowing that there is construction going on several floors down and that she might land on a safety net. She survives and decides to figure out the truth of Rokkenjima in the year 1986. Like her brother, she has a habit of saying, "It's useless, it's all useless" during difficult situations. At the end of Alliance of the Golden Witch, the witch version of Ange is violently torn apart when she reveals her true identity to Battler; however, her human self survives and continues to investigate the true circumstances involving Rokkenjima.!~

name: Frederica Bernkastel
description:
A mysterious witch who appears to [Battler](https://anilist.co/character/14040/Ushiromiya-Battler) following the first game, providing advice and telling him she will support him in his endeavors to solve the mystery of the witch [Beatrice](https://anilist.co/character/10285/Beatrice). Although an ally to Battler, Bernkastel has a twisted personality and refers to herself as the "cruelest witch in the world", and is only interested in Beatrice's game as a chance to escape her own boredom. She is known as the Witch of Miracles, and she has the power to reset any situation and realize a goal, eventually securing victory even with a 0.0000000000001% probability, so long as it is not zero. Initially stoic, cold, and calm, she slowly reveals herself to be just as impish and cruel as her rival, [Lambdadelta](https://anilist.co/character/10196/Lambdadelta).

~!Bernkastel's true identity is strongly implied to be that of Rika Furude's witch self, formed from the suffering she underwent as she died again and again within the loops of Higurashi. She appears briefly in Higurashi, first to provide advice to the reader during Minagoroshi-hen, and then travelling to the past to create a 'perfect' world where Miyoko's parents never died, preventing all the sins that lead to the gameboard of Higurashi. The relationship between her and Rika is examined more thoroughly during Saikoroshi-hen, where a drunken Rika questions her own humanity and christens herself "Frederica Bernkastel", a slurring of her name with the brand of her wine tacked on. After suffering and giving into her aloof personality as Bernkastel, Rika decides to let go and stop being the witch Bernkastel, though she wonders if perhaps this aspect of herself remains on a higher plane, toying with the fate of lower beings.!~

name: Maria Ushiromiya
description:
Maria is Rosa's daughter, and is the youngest of the cousins. She has a habit of uttering 'uu-uu' at times, which frustrates Rosa greatly. Maria is also rather stubborn, and believes things easily, which isn't uncommon for someone her age. She has an interest in the occult, like her grandfather. She carries around a bag which is filled with occult items, such as a scorpion charm which wards off evil. She idolizes witches, and believes that they are there to bring people joy and happiness. In Maria's notebooks there are sketches of witches, and the witches are beautiful, fantastical creatures. It upsets Maria greatly when someone denies the existence of witches, especially Beatrice's existence. At certain times, Maria undergoes a personality change, and begins to laugh in an unnerving fashion. When she is in this mode, she acts rather condescendingly with regards to things about the occult, and will often call people like Battler 'stupid' for having little to no knowledge of such things.     ~!She is the subject of bullying in her class, and the boys in her class often took her books and rubbed them off each other, saying that they got her 'germs'. However, Maria is content with being bullied. Maria came up with quite an imaginative story, where a horrid witch is terrorizing the school, causing students to get into accidents and the like. However, an angel offers one student as a sacrifice so that all the other students shall be safe. With that story, Maria doesn't mind being the subject of bullying, as she feels like everyone else can remain safe while she shoulders the burden.    Although she has no real friends, with Maria's vivid imagination, she breathes life into her stuffed animals. Namely, Sakutaro. Sakutaro was originally a stuffed lion cub, created by Rosa as a birthday present to give to Maria. Maria cherished it, and even though she was often alone, with Sakutaro she didn't feel as alone. However, Sakutaro met a tragic end when Rosa ripped him apart.    Maria is a rather innocent child, and fully believes that her mother needs to work such long hours and weekends. Rosa often forgets Maria's promises, but Maria says that her mother's work is more important. Rosa has told Maria never to call her work office unless it's an emergency. But, once when Maria called, the office told her that her mother wasn't at work. Even when Rosa takes impromptu holidays with her various boyfriends, Maria fully believes in her mother. Rosa often gives in to guilt, and ends up buying Maria presents, such as 'the rabbit band', or various Western sweets.!~

~! __Maria as a witch:__  In the Umineko series it is heavily debated whether magic exists or not, but Maria has her own personal grimoire, in which she conjures up her own spells. Such as, 'have [x] for dinner', or 'make mama come home early'. One particular spell is for her mother's love, where all that is required is a simple 'uu-uu'. Maria came up with this spell after a rather touching day spent with Rosa on a picnic. Rosa taught Maria a song, and Rosa was so pleased that Maria knew the words. However, when Maria forgot the words, she started singing 'uu-uu' instead, but Rosa remained in her happy state. While Rosa thought that her saying 'uu-uu' was charming for a while, she eventually grew frustrated with it, and often resorted to hitting her. Whenever Rosa hits Maria, Maria says that she has been taken over by 'the black witch'.    Maria is a member of the Mariage Sorcière, an alliance of witches in which she and her idol, Beatrice, are exclusive members of. Despite having the same wand as Eva-Beatrice, she is not an Endless Witch successor. By succeeding to give a soul to Sakutaro, she is a potential Creator: a witch with an even higher rank than Bernkastel and Lambdadelta, who (when she will learn how to use her power) may be able to create even a galaxy from nothing. She is also the witch teacher of Ange, despite the fact that they did not see each other as she was banished from Mariage Sorcière.!~

name: Eva Ushiromiya
description: Kinzo's second child. Under normal circumstances, she would have lost her place in the Ushiromiya family when she married, though she managed to retain her name on the family register when she had her husband Hideyoshi adopted into the family and gave birth to Kinzo's first grandchild, George.  Eva is cheerful and mischievous, but also sinister and greedy. She is hostile towards her older brother Krauss, and rallies the other siblings against him in their fight for the family inheritance. She also looks down on Krauss's wife Natsuhi for not being related to the Ushiromiya family by blood. Because she believes George to be the rightful head of the Ushiromiya family, she is cruel towards the servant Shannon, as she suspects her of being his lover.   Despite her insidious personality, however, she treasures her husband and son more than anything, but fears that she is too domineering towards them. She is skilled in various martial arts, and said to be excellent at cooking.     ~!In Banquet of the Golden Witch, Eva solves the riddle of Beatrice's epitaph and returns from Rokkenjima as the head of the Ushiromiya family and sole survivor of the murder incident, but is unable to overcome the grief over losing her husband and son. As depicted in the story and TIPS of Alliance of the Golden Witch, Eva lives miserably for the next twelve years as the guardian of Ange, the only other surviving member of the Ushiromiya family, resenting her for "stealing" the role of the family heir from George until she dies of acute heart failure in the year 1998.!~

name: Willard Wright
description:
Willard H. Wright, is a former first-class archbishop and Chief Inquisitor of SSVD, the 8th District Repentance Enforcement Agency of the Great Court of Heaven. He is named after Willard Wright and enforces Van Dine's Commandments. A young ace inquisitor once feared by witches for his cold and ruthless tactics, he gained the nicknames "Wright of the Twenty Wedges" and "Wizard-Hunting Wright". Over time, however, he grew malcontent with SSVD's brutal standards and resigned from his position.

Will is the detective of the seventh game, taking on the role held by [Battler Ushiromiya](https://anilist.co/character/14040/Ushiromiya-Battler) and [Erika Furudo](https://anilist.co/character/36045/Furudo-Erika) in the previous games, in a world where Battler does not make it to the conference. Previously, he was briefly alluded to in TIPS for episode 5 as the leader of the SSVD and rumored to be more powerful than the Eiserne Jungfrau's current leader, [Dlanor A. Knox](https://anilist.co/character/36046/Knox-Dlanor-A). Unlike other characters, who attack arguments using a red blade or a blue blade, or a golden longsword in the case of Battler Ushiromiya, Will utilizes a black sword against his opponents.

Although he appears gruff and quick to anger, he is genuinely good-hearted and opts to be as lenient as possible during his investigations.

name: Natsuhi Ushiromiya
description: Krauss' wife. Born into a family of Shinto priests, Natsuhi discarded her old life when she married into the Ushiromiya family. She is a very proud woman who holds her new family's name in high regard, and is in charge of managing the family head house and family conferences. Unfortunately for her, all of her efforts are often undervalued by her husband, and she is often afflicted by headaches. She holds a bitter rivalry with Eva, who mocks her for not being related to the Ushiromiya family by blood. As a mother, Natsuhi is incredibly strict towards her daughter Jessica, but only out of concern that she becomes an ideal heiress to the Ushiromiya family.

name: Shannon
description:
__Race:__ Furniture

Shannon (Her real name is Sayo- 紗代) is a maidservant working on Rokkenjima. She has a habit of making mistakes and blunders when she is nervous, despite being an extremely talented and hardworking servant. She thinks of [Kanon](https://anilist.co/character/14045/Kanon) as her younger brother, and like him, she feels she is inferior to humans, as she is only furniture. Despite this, she has fallen in love with [George](https://anilist.co/character/14042/Ushiromiya-George). 

In the second game, "Turn of the Golden Witch" ~!Shannon is shown to having the power to use a luminous sort of scythe on her arm, as can Kanon, and a large, pink, protective shield with arrows rotating around it. She, along with Kanon, are portrayed to have been taught this by [Genji](https://anilist.co/character/21086/Ronoue-Genji), as at the end of a battle, he can put them to rest, before being thanked by the pair. In Turn of the Golden Witch she breaks a mirror sealing some of [Beatrice](https://anilist.co/character/10285/Beatrice)'s power in return for a spell to bring her and George together, and in Legend of the Golden Witch, it is shown that she accepts his proposal, as she is wearing the ring on her ring finger when she is killed.!~


~!Shannon is actually one of the personalities of [Yasu](https://anilist.co/character/39949/Yasuda), who is the child of [Kinzo](https://anilist.co/character/14041/Ushiromiya-Kinzou) and Beatrice Ushiromiya. "Shannon" is the embodiment of the ideal servant whom Yasu admired the most as a child, and also the embodiment of femininity.!~

name: Featherine Augustus Aurora
description:
~!Featherine is the true form of Touya Hachijo.!~

Featherine is the Witch of the Theater. She is said to have been the Game Master for countless other games in the past, though she has long-forgotten them. She possesses a crescent-shaped device which floats around her head, serving as a memory aid which maintains traits such as her name, appearance and personality. She has [Ange](https://anilist.co/character/19407/Ushiromiya-Ange) read the story of Dawn of the Golden Witch and challenges her to find the truth about it. She is familiar with [Bernkastel](https://anilist.co/character/11840/Bernkastel-Frederica), and appoints her the new Game Master after the end of Dawn of the Golden Witch.

Certain aspects of her appearance, particularly her dress and memory aid, vaguely resemble the clothes and horns possessed by [Hanyuu](https://anilist.co/character/3128/Furude-Hanyuu) from Higurashi no Naku Koro ni. Parts of her name also allude to Hanyuu—when roughly translated, the two kanji that make up Hanyuu's name translate to "feather" and "in" which, when put together, more or less make up her first name "Featherine"; in addition, the first two katakana shared by her middle and last names, "Au", are also used by Hanyū as a catchphrase, "auau". Bernkastel sometimes refers to her simply as "Auau".

She also tends to call human characters 'child of man' rather than their actual names; Hanyū also refers to humans in this way.

name: Rosa Ushiromiya
description:
[Kinzo](https://anilist.co/character/14041/Ushiromiya-Kinzou)'s fourth child. As the youngest of her siblings, she has the least influence at the family conference. Her husband abandoned her shortly before the birth of her daughter and only child, [Maria](https://anilist.co/character/8555/Ushiromiya-Maria).

Rosa is the president of a small design company, "Anti-Rosa", which has recently begun to flounder, and she thus seeks out Kinzo's inheritance to pay off her co-endorsers.

On the surface, Rosa appears to be the most sensible and soothing of all the siblings. However, as a result of being downtrodden by her older siblings in her childhood and forced to endure the pressures of a single mother, she frequently loses control of her emotions and responds violently to her daughter's childish behavior and overenthusiastic approach to the occult. While Rosa thought that Maria saying 'uu-uu' was charming for a while, she eventually grew frustrated with it, and often resorted to hitting her. Whenever Rosa hits Maria, Maria says that she has been taken over by "the black witch".

name: Lion Ushiromiya
description:
Lion is a member of the Ushiromiya family who exists only within the alternate world shown in Requiem of the Golden Witch as a result of Natsuhi deciding to keep the baby Kinzo offered her. As the first child of Krauss and Natsuhi in this world, Lion is the heir to the Ushiromiya family and well-liked by the rest of the family, including Kinzo, in part because of Lion's soft-spoken nature and good-mannered upbringing.   Lion becomes Willard H. Wright's partner during his investigation of Beatrice's death, becoming close with him and even leading to a running gag in which Lion would pinch Will's buttocks whenever Will acts in an disrespectful manner.   Lion is given an androgynous appearance to hide their true gender.   
~! Lion is in fact Kinzo's biological child together with his daughter Beatrice, and is also Yasu in another world.!~

name: Kanon
description: A young servant of [Kinzo](https://anilist.co/character/14041/Ushiromiya-Kinzou)'s mansion. He is a serious and fervent servant, carrying out his master's orders thoroughly. He is a bit frail and antisocial. He considers [Shannon](https://anilist.co/character/15435/Shannon) as an older sister and highly disapproves of her feelings for [George](https://anilist.co/character/14042/Ushiromiya-George), as he believes she should not feel love as she is only furniture.

name: Yasuda
description:
~!Yasu is Kinzo and Kuwadorian Beatrice's child and was born due to the result of incest. Yasu is at the same time Kinzo's child and grandchild. It is implied that she was DMAB, but reassigned and raised as female upon the cliff incident.

Yasu is the same person as Lion Ushiromiya, but only in the worlds where Natsushi rejected the infant given by Kinzo. Yasu plays the role of Shannon, Kanon, and Beatrice and is the true antagonist of the entire Umineko series. She is the true form of Beatrice and the true writer of the message bottles. Due to her belief that she is furniture, amongst other things, Sayo plans out the Rokkenjima Massacre.

Yasu loves Battler, George and Jessica—that's Kanon's love, Shannon's love and real Yasu's love (Beatrice's feelings for Battler). It's expected that Battler's sin is forgetting Yasu and breaking a promise after six years.  Yasu was the child that fell off the cliff along with another servant 19 years ago, but had survived the incident. The child received an injury which made Yasu's body unable to make love (after Yasu learned the truth it became the source of the furniture complex and the duel between Shannon and Kanon). Genji and Dr. Nanjo saved the child, but kept this a secret from others to prevent another incestuous advance by Kinzo. At the age of nine, (age was lowered to ensure that the child wouldn't be found out easily) Yasu came back to Rokkenjima as a servant. Genji personally arranged Yasu's hiring, hoping to reveal the truth if a good opportunity presented itself.!~

name: Jessica Ushiromiya
description:
Krauss and Natsuhi's eighteen-year-old daughter. She is an energetic young girl, serving as the student body president at her school, and even leading a rock band. If her father inherits the family fortune, she will become the heiress to the Ushiromiya family, although the family's patriarchal hierarchy denotes her future husband will become the next head. Jessica is tomboyish, feisty, and rebellious, much to the dismay of her mother, who insists she act more refined and ladylike. She dislikes her parents at times for the pressures they place on her regarding the family inheritance, which she has no interest in. However, she still shows concern for them deep down. She was born with weak bronchi, and occasionally suffers from asthma attacks. 

~!She is in love with Kanon, who tries to hide his own feelings from her, though she manages to reach out to him in Dawn of the Golden Witch, and they become a couple. She is willing to go to great lengths to gain Kanon's respect, and tries to avoid doing anything that could jeopardize that. Jessica is shown to be skilled with brass knuckles in Alliance of the Golden Witch. !~

name: Kinzou Ushiromiya
description:
The elderly head of the Ushiromiya family, and the owner of Rokkenjima. He is a rabid practitioner of black magic and the occult, his shelves lined with volumes upon volumes of grimoires. One of his most prominent obsessions is [Beatrice](https://anilist.co/character/10285/Beatrice), a witch he is said to have summoned and contracted for ten tons worth of gold. He rarely leaves his exceedingly vast study, which contains various commodities such as a bed, lavatory, and bath. 

Throughout the first four games, ~!Kinzo's body frequently turns up burnt in the incinerator of the mansion's underground boiler room, and is identified due to his polydactyly, distinguished by having six toes on each foot. In life, Kinzo held his children in contempt, viewing them as vultures ready to feast on his inheritance as soon as he died (or at least when word of his death spread out).!~

At the end of the 4th game, Alliance of the Golden Witch ~!it is revealed that he has been deceased as of two years before the events on October 4th 1986, having succumbed to his long-time drinking habit. However, his oldest son [Krauss](https://anilist.co/character/21083/Ushiromiya-Krauss), Krauss's wife [Natsuhi](https://anilist.co/character/16719/Ushiromiya-Natsuhi), his personal physician [Nanjou](https://anilist.co/character/21082/Nanjou-Terumasa), and all the mansion's servants (except for [Gouda](https://anilist.co/character/21084/Gouda-Toshiro)) maintain the illusion at the family conference that he is still alive, albeit with a three-month life expectancy; any interactions between Kinzo and any other characters are meant to sell the deception to the reader regarding the true events.!~

name: Kyrie Ushiromiya
description: Rudolf's second wife. She is also one of Rudolf's business partners, always assisting him in shady dealings and keeping him in line when he gets out of hand. Kyrie and Battler have bonded more as close friends with a sibling-like relationship rather than mother and son, with Battler going as far as always calling her "Kyrie-san." She is well versed in game theory and is known for her "flip the chessboard" mentality, influencing Battler in this regard. She had actually dated Rudolf long before his first wife Asumu, who she envies for marrying Rudolf while she was still going out with him.

name: Clair Vaux Bernardus
description: She is a "substitute actor" without a personality that acts as a vessel to personify both Beatrice and the rules of her game, she was created by Bernkastel to be the "reader" of the seventh game, Requiem of the Golden Witch, similar to the role that Ange held during Dawn of the Golden Witch. Her name signifies that she is the final guide of Beatrice's game.   ~!  Clair can be considered a tool rather than a person, allowing Yasu to confess to Willard H. Wright, Lion Ushiromiya, and Bernkastel without revealing Yasu's own "pitiful form." She exists only in the meta-world and doesn't appear within the game board. Also she is the original form of Yasu's Beatrice, who is made to match the image of a ghost that haunts Rokkenjima with a pure white dress and contrasting personality. !~

name: Rudolf Ushiromiya
description:
Kinzo's third child, and Battler's father. After his wife Asumu's death, he immediately remarried with Kyrie, leading to a falling out with his son, who ran away from home for six years. Rudolf is still known to chat up young women from time to time, though this does not seem to disturb Kyrie. He is an avid lover of Western films and an impressive marksman. He seeks Kinzo's fortune to settle a court case in America.

~! He was known as a philanderer in his youth and had impregnated his business partner and old girlfriend Kyrie with their son Battler before he married his first wife Asumu. He then deceived Kyrie and the other members of the Ushiromiya family into believing that Battler was actually Asumu's child, and that Kyrie's child was stillborn. !~

name: Krauss Ushiromiya
description:
Kinzo's first child. He is the next in line to inherit the family headship, and takes the initiative to lead the family conferences.  Due to his arrogant nature, he has made himself something of an enemy to the siblings, who see him as trying to monopolize Kinzo's fortune, and unanimously attempt to upstage him, though with little success. His daughter, Jessica, also has little respect for him, particularly due to the pressure he places on her to become (or at least marry) a suitable successor to the Ushiromiya family after him. He is a real estate investor, and is currently supplying his funds to a resort. However, he has been unable to carry out his plans, and thus his investments end in failure. Despite always swaggering about, Krauss holds genuine remorse for all the troubles he put his family through. He is known to have taken up boxing in his youth, and still possesses quite a bit of skill in that area. Unlike his siblings, he lives on Rokkenjima with his father, wife, and daughter.

~!He is one of the few people on Rokkenjima who is aware that Kinzo is already dead, and also knows of the existence of Kinzo's hidden gold, which the other family members doubt.!~

name: Genji Ronoue
description:
The head butler of Kinzo's mansion, and the person Kinzo trusts the most. Very loyal and reliable, he also has a penchant for throwing knives. 
~!He is said by Beatrice to be the first furniture Kinzo ever created, It is suggested that the demon Ronove assisted Kinzo in Genji's creation, and thus many hints are given about his connection to Ronove, one being his similar-sounding surname.!~

name: Hideyoshi Ushiromiya
description: Hideyoshi is Eva's husband. He is the successful president of a chain of fast food restaurants. He's a very jovial man and manages to tone down the tension between the siblings during their various meetings. He seeks Kinzo's fortune due to people trying to buy all his shares.He speaks with a fake Kansai accent, which he is said to be too embarrassed to use against actual Kansai people.

name: Terumasa Nanjou
description:
Nanjo is Kinzo's personal physician and close friend. He is also Kinzo's opponent in chess.

~!He met Kinzo a long time ago and would come to be friends with him for decades. Requiem of the Golden Witch reveals that their first meeting was during World War II. A young Nanjo first met Kinzo when he brought Beatrice Castiglioni to his clinic in secret after they escaped the Japanese military base on Rokkenjima. Nanjo was given a gold bar in exchange for secrecy and would become one of Kinzo's oldest friends. He also tended to the baby Yasuda and helped them survive their fall from the cliff incident. The Twilight of the Golden Witch manga expands on this scene, showing that Nanjo had additionally performed surgery on Yasu to remove their extra toes from their polydactyly to conceal their relation to Kinzo and was directly responsible for them becoming "furniture", wanting Yasu to live a happy life even if they couldn't have children.!~

name: Chiyo Kumasawa
description: Kumasawa is a part-time worker who assists with domestic chores in Kinzo's mansion. She often shirks her responsibilites and likes to tell stories and jokes, especially outrageous ones involving mackerel.
