(from wikipedia)     ~!She is actually the former Lady Beatrice, Virgilia (in episode 13). Virgilia is the one who taught Beatrice, her student, and she gave her name to her student.!~

name: Beatrice Castiglioni
description: An Italian. Her father was a high official in the RSI. A lighthearted woman who did not lose that personality even after living a long time in a submarine.  Since she was the only one of the Italians who could speak English, she began to form a close relationship with Kinzo, who was the only Japanese person who could speak that language. Kinzo recalls that he learned what love was for the first time when he met her. This meeting had a great effect on his fate and that of Rokkenjima.    ~!Beatrice Castiglioni is the true Beatrice who was Kinzo's mistress, hidden away in Kuwadorian. She gave birth to Kinzo's daughter, Beatrice Ushiromiya, and died soon after. Kinzo treated the new Beatrice as her reincarnation, and thus she bore yet another child who is Kinzo's daughter and granddaughter at the same time, Yasuda, who is the current Beatrice who loves Battler. !~

name: Rimuru Tempest
description:
__Species:__  Human (past life) → Slime
__Kind:__  Reincarnated, Otherworlder

Rimuru Tempest, formerly known as Satoru Mikami, is the main protagonist of Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken. They are the founder and King of the monster country Tempest, situated in the Great Jura Forest, and the partner and sworn friend of Storm Dragon, [Veldora Tempest](https://anilist.co/character/128034/Veldora-Tempest).

name: Milim Nava
description:
__Kind:__ Inhabitant

"Destroyer" Milim Nava is one of the oldest and strongest Demon Lords. She is a Dragonoid. Her nickname, Destroyer, is not just for show. She is a demon lord one should never fight against.

name: Shion
description: "War Lord" Shion is Rimuru’s first servant to be in charge of his care as his personal secretary. She is also the leader of the Yomigaeri and also one of Rimuru's strongest fighters and is coveted by many of the Demon Lords who have met her.

name: Diablo
description: Diablo is the Black Primordial and a loyal servant of [Rimuru Tempest](https://anilist.co/character/123962/Tempest-Rimuru). Before he met Rimuru, he went by the nicknames Black or Noir, the latter which he received from his fellow Primordial kin. After receiving the name Diablo from Rimuru, he evolved to a Demon Peer.

name: Veldora Tempest
description:
__Height:__ 210 cm (human form), 100 m (dragon form)
__Species:__ True Dragon
__Blessing / Divine Protection:__ Storm Dragon's Grace, Demon Lord's Ally
__Disaster Rank:__ Catastrophe

Veldora Tempest is the youngest of the four strongest dragons (True Dragons). He is connected with [Rimuru](https://anilist.co/character/123962) by an agreement and was known to rampage here and there. He was the one to name Rimuru and Rimuru gave him his last name, since they share the same last name, Rimuru could technically be classified as Veldora's adoptive brother.

name: Shuna
description:
Shuna is one of the third group of subordinate Monsters to be named by [Rimuru](https://anilist.co/character/123962), evolving her from an Ogre to a Kijin. She was originally the princess of the Ogre tribe and even though she had the talent for using Magic, she was a sheltered girl, but quickly got along with the Goblinas

Shuna is the daughter of the late ogre chieftain and she is also [Benimaru](https://anilist.co/character/128038)'s younger sister, which is why she's nicknamed "Oni Princess" by Rimuru. Very skilled and knowledgeable in domestic matters, she essentially becomes Rimuru's chief economic advisor together with [Rigurd](https://anilist.co/character/129348).

name: Benimaru
description:
Benimaru is one of the third group of subordinate Monsters to be named by [Rimuru Tempest](https://anilist.co/character/123962/Tempest-Rimuru). Originally an Ogre, he was uncertain of his servitude and intended for it to be temporary, but after being named, he evolved into a Kijin, immediately becoming Rimuru's most powerful subordinate for a time, and decided to serve him permanently. He lives in the Capital city of the Jura Tempest Federation: Rimuru City. Soon after, and became Commander-in-Chief, giving him direct command over Tempest's military forces.

Upon Rimuru's ascension to a True Demon Lord, Benimaru evolved into a Fair Oni and reached the strength of a Disaster-Class Monster.

name: Souei
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm (Kijin), 190 cm (Ogre)

Souei is an Ogre that was among the third group of subordinates to be named by [Rimuru Tempest](https://anilist.co/character/123962/Tempest-Rimuru). He is Rimuru's faithful shadow and the leader of the Shadow Squad of the Jura Tempest Federation.

name: Ranga
description: "Star Lord" Ranga is a Wind Spirit Wolf and a loyal follower of [Rimuru](https://anilist.co/character/123962/Tempest-Rimuru). The leader of the Star Wolf Clan, and the son of the previous boss of the Direwolves. He is also one of Rimuru's Twelve Patrons who has been given the title of a "Lord".

name: Luminous Valentine
description: "Queen of Nightmares" Luminous Valentine is an elite vampire and one of the Eight-Star Demon Lords. She is also the true ruler of the Holy Kingdom Ruberion.

name: Gobta
description: Gobta is a hobgoblin and is one of Rimuru Tempest's followers. Though he seems to be air-headed he tends to be a hard-worker and dependable when the time calls for it.

name: Daikenja
description:
Unique Skill Great Sage is one of the first two Unique Skills (the other being Predator) that [Rimuru Tempest](https://anilist.co/character/123962/Rimuru-Tempest) had upon being born into his new world. It had evolved from Extra Skill Sage during his death, as he thought since he was approaching his forties as a virgin, he must be something much greater than a mere wizard. 

~!During Rimuru's evolution into Demon Lord this Unique Skill evolved into the Ultimate Skill: Wisdom King Raphael.!~

~!Rimuru gave her a name and she evolved into a manas with the name Ciel!~

name: Ramiris
description: Ramiris is a fairy that resides inside of Tempest's Underground Labyrinth. She is also one of the Eight-Star Demon Lords.

name: Hakurou
description: Hakurou is a Fair Oni and is a loyal follower of [Rimuru Tempest](https://anilist.co/character/123962/Tempest-Rimuru). He was one of the survivors of the Orc attack. He was also the teacher of the Dwarven King.

name: Hinata Sakaguchi
description:
Hinata Sakaguchi is an otherworlder and the leader of the Imperial Guards under the Pope's direct command. Along with [Yuuki](https://anilist.co/character/132755/Kagurazaka-Yuuki) and Class S, she's a former student of [Shizue Izawa](https://anilist.co/character/128037/Shizu).

~!At first she thought monsters should all be exterminated. But after her fight with Rimuru, she was convinced that Rimuru is not evil.!~

name: Guy Crimson
description: Guy Crimson is the oldest of the Demon Lords. He has forever ruled over the frozen continent. Being androgynous, he can become a man or woman at will.

name: Testarossa
description:
Testarossa, the White Primordial, was an Arch Demon that was recruited by [Diablo](https://anilist.co/character/131033/Diablo) along with [Carrera](https://anilist.co/character/131032/Carrera) and [Ultima](https://anilist.co/character/131045/Ultima) to serve [Rimuru](https://anilist.co/character/123962/Tempest-Rimuru). After being named, she evolved into a Demon Peer. She now serves as Tempest's Military Attaché, a representative for the Western States Council.

~!Following the battle with the Empire she awakened as a True Demon Lord.!~

name: Chloe Aubert
description: One of the children who were incompletely summoned. Chloe is a quiet child who loves books.

name: Treyni
description: Treyni is a dryad that resides in the Jura Forest.

name: Gabiru
description: The captain of the Hiryuu of Tempest, and the former lizardmen raid leader. He suffers from a superiority complex. The root of Gabil's pride and confidence​ is the thought that he is the chosen one.

name: Ultima
description:
Ultima, the Purple Primordial, was one of the Demons recruited by [Diablo](https://anilist.co/character/131033/Diablo) to serve [Rimuru](https://anilist.co/character/123962/Tempest-Rimuru). Originally she was an Arch Demon, but being named by Rimuru evolved her into a Demon Peer. 

~!She later evolves into a True Demon Lord.!~

name: Carrera
description: Carera was one of the demons convened by [Diablo](https://anilist.co/character/131033/Diablo) to serve [Rimuru](https://anilist.co/character/123962/Tempest-Rimuru). She was originally an Arch Demon, but after being named by Rimuru she evolved into a Demon Peer.

name: Frey
description: "Sky Queen" Frey is an ex-Demon Lord and currently a subordinate of [Demon Lord Milim Nava](https://anilist.co/character/128036/Nava-Milim). She often scolds Milim for playing around when she is supposed to be working.

name: Rigurd
description: Formerly the chief of the goblin village [Rimuru](https://anilist.co/character/123962/Tempest-Rimuru) comes across. He's now the acting prime minister of the Jura Tempest Federation. He evolved into a hobgoblin when Rimuru named him.

name: Souka
description: Gabil's younger sister, and the daughter of Abil. After the Orc Lord incident, she swears her allegeiance to Rimuru. She attends to Souei as a spy.

name: Homura Akemi
description:
__Height:__ 155 - 158 cm

Homura is a magical girl who first appears in an apocalyptic nightmare of [Madoka's](https://anilist.co/character/37832). She transfers into her school the day after the dream. She is a beautiful, mysterious individual that performs exceptionally well in academics and athletics. This makes her instantly popular even though she is cold to others. She seems to know Madoka well and wishes to prevent her from becoming a magical girl. She attacks [Kyuubey](https://anilist.co/character/38566) in the first episode, only to be stopped by [Mami](https://anilist.co/character/38194).

name: Madoka Kaname
description:
__Height:__ 152 cm (5'0")

A 14-year-old girl whose life changes when she encounters the [Puella Magi Homura](https://anilist.co/character/38005/Akemi-Homura) and the familiar [Kyuubey](https://anilist.co/character/38566/Kyuubey), who offers to transform her into a Puella Magi herself. She sees herself as a person without special qualities or talents, and after seeing [Mami](https://anilist.co/character/38194/Tomoe-Mami) fighting against witches, wants to be a wonderful and cool Puella Magi like her. She is a rather selfless girl who wishes to be a magical girl simply so that she can help others. She allegedly has a large amount of magical potential within her.

name: Sayaka Miki
description:
__Height:__ 158-160 cm
__Weapon:__ Cutlass

[Madoka's](https://anilist.co/character/37832/Kaname-Madoka) classmate who, after helping Madoka rescue [Kyuubey](https://anilist.co/character/38566/Kyuubey), ends up getting an offer to become a Puella Magi herself. She cares deeply for her friends, and wants to help an ill boy named [Kyousuke Kamijou](https://anilist.co/character/39835/Kamijou-Kyousuke), whom she has a crush on. Before becoming a Puella Magi, Sayaka wields a baseball bat that [Mami](https://anilist.co/character/38194/Tomoe-Mami) can enhance with magic to defend herself with while on witch hunts.

name: Kyouko Sakura
description:
__Height:__ 156-158 cm
__Weapon:__ Spear

Kyouko is a veteran magical girl who comes to the city later in the story. Amusingly, she is always seen eating something, even while she is battling. 
 
Having grown up in a poor family, she often has to steal food and hates people who waste it, a logic she also applies to Grief Seeds, as she only goes after fully grown witches. Kyouko has been a Puella Magi much longer than the others, and thus is more skillful; she wields a spear which can extend itself, split into multiple sections, and produce a ball at the end of a chain, which can constrict and hit others at the same time. She also has the ability to put up barriers to protect others or keep them from interfering. She initially clashes with Sayaka, but after learning the truth about Soul Gems, she sympathizes with her and tries to help her.

name: Mami Tomoe
description:
__Height:__ 156-159 cm 

Mami Tomoe is a veteran magical girl and a third-year student at Madoka's school. She lives alone in a penthouse after her parents were killed in a car crash, which Mami survived after contracting with Kyuubey. Mami is particularly focused on saving, guiding, and protecting those around her, which is a traditionally selfless perspective on the role of magical girl. She is much like a maternal figure to Madoka and Sayaka, being the eldest among them. Her name could be considered a play on the word 'mommy', further supported in the third film, where she has a companion named "Bebe". Though Mami's outward disposition is cheery and confident, Mami feels deeply alone as she has no friends to confide in as she fights.

name: Kyuubey
description: Kyuubey is a familiar who can grant any wish to a certain girl, on the condition that she becomes a Puella Magi and fights against witches.

name: Junko Kaname
description: Junko is Madoka's mother. She's a successful business woman. She often goes out drinking with friends and co-workers, and comes home from a long day of work drunk. She's also friends with Madoka's homeroom teacher.  She and Madoka are close, and she cares for her daughter very much, but ultimately lets her go when she tells her there's something she has to do on Walpurgis Nacht.

name: Hitomi Shizuki
description: Madoka and Sayaka's classmate and friend, who is quite popular with the boys. She attends after-school classes in Piano, Japanese dance and Tea ceremony, feeling obliged to make time for them even when she might reasonably be expected to focus on her studies.

name: Walpurgis Night
description: The witch of stage settings; her nature is helplessness. She symbolizes the fool who continuously spins in circles. The witch's mysteries have been handed down through the course of history; her appellation is "Walpurgis Night." She will continue to rotate aimlessly throughout the world until she completely changes the whole of this age into a drama. When the doll's usual upside-down position reaches the top part of the witch, she completely roils the civilization on the ground in a flash through her gale-like flight.  Her true name is unknown.

name: Tatsuya Kaname
description: Madoka's little brother. He's 3 years old and goes to kindergarten.

name: Kazuko Saotome
description:
__Height:__ 155-157 cm  

Kazuko is Madoka's class teacher. Her relationships with guys don't last very long, and so she's extremely frustrated in these regards. Many of her classes involve her complaining about men. She also seems to be a friend of Junko Kaname, Madoka's mother.

name: Tomohisa Kaname
description:
__Height:__ 175-180 cm  

Madoka's father. A stay-at-home dad. He does housekeeping, cooking, laundry and cleaning.

name: Kyousuke Kamijou
description:
__Height:__ 170-175 cm   

A terminally ill boy whom Sayaka constantly visits. He used to play violin when he was younger and enjoys listening to classical musical CDs that Sayaka brings him.

name: Nakazawa
description: Nakazawa is rare among Madoka's classmates in that his family name is known. However, his given name is unknown. He answered Ms. Saotome's question about whether he prefers hard-boiled or soft-boiled eggs.

name: Chihaya Ayase
description:
__Height:__ 167 cm (5'6")

A determined schoolgirl who "possesses a remarkable hearing ability". She believes that by persevering in karuta, she will meet [Arata](https://anilist.co/character/47165/Wataya-Arata) again, and begins a karuta club at her high school with [Mashima](https://anilist.co/character/47167/Mashima-Taichi). While she is beautiful, she is considered too weird; her classmates refer to her as a "waste of a beauty". She has been described as a "tomboy trapped in a supermodel's body".

name: Taichi Mashima
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm (5'7") 

Taichi is from a wealthy family (His father & Grandfather are both doctors). [Chihaya's](https://anilist.co/character/47163/Ayase-Chihaya) childhood friend is quite the golden boy. Smart, good looking, and mature, he excells at nearly everything he does which makes him the voice of reason in the Misusawa Karuta Club. While he sees himself as keeper of Chihaya and the less experienced members, he demands a lot of himself both in games and as a leader and can overthink even the most simple situations. Taichi's karuta leverages his incredible memory to give him a sense of which cards might be called next and the ability to out-think opponents. He also has a crush on Chihaya but is hesitant to do anything as he thinks that she only has eyes for [Arata](https://anilist.co/character/47165/Wataya-Arata).

name: Shinobu Wakamiya
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm
__Favourite Song:__ Poem #40 Though I would hide it, In my face it still appears-- My fond, secret love. And now he questions me: "Is something bothering you?"

Shinobu Wakamiya is the current Queen of Karuta, she is also the youngest Queen in history. She is left-handed. Shinobu has been described as someone who is cute, but having the fashion sense of a rock. She often feels as if her opponents are vigorous and active at the beginning of match, but when on verge of losing, it feels as if she was back to playing karuta alone again. Arata and Shinobu know each other very well, she has never beat him in a karuta match. Shinobu started playing karuta when she and her divorced mother moved to her Grandma's house and found the box of karuta cards, which she fell in love with. Shinobu became a Class A karuta player when she was in fourth grade.

name: Arata Wataya
description:
__Height:__ 173cm (5'8") 
__School:__ Fukui Prefecture East Hitsufujioka High School 
__Karuta Society:__ Fukui Nagumo Society - A Class

Arata Wataya was a transfer student from Fukui that went to Chihaya's elementary school. The grandchild of a master karuta player, Arata inspires Chihaya to take up karuta by telling her that he thinks she has a talent for it. He had difficulty fitting in at Chihaya's elementary school because of his Fukui dialect and his family's poverty. His passion for karuta is inspired by his grandfather, a Meijin (master). After their first game at Arata's house, Chihaya befriends him. His dream is to become a Karuta Meijin. After graduating from elementary school, he returned to Fukui to care for his sick grandfather. He stops playing karuta because his grandfather died while Arata was competing in a karuta tournament to rise to A-rank. However, after Chihaya and Taichi visit him in Fukui, he regains his resolve to play competitive karuta again.

name: Kanade Ooe
description:
__Height:__ 150 cm
__School:__ Municipal Mizusawa High School - Year 2 Class 5 - Karuta Club accountant
__Karuta Society:__ Shirohoku Society - C Class

A girl with a taste for the classics, Kanade is a quiet girl who works in a kimono store and loves all kinds of traditional clothing. She is quite knowledgeable about the true meanings behind the One Hundred Poems and joins the karuta club on the condition that they start wearing hakama. 

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Hisashi Suou
description:
__School:__ 8th Year University student 
__Karuta Society:__ No society - Super A Class 
__Height:__ 180 cm 
__Hobby:__ Karuta 
__Favourite Song:__ Poem #2 The spring has passed And the summer come again

The reigning Master. He possesses the most intuition out of all the current karuta players, and has 28 one-syllable cards.  [Wikipedia] ; For the silk-white robes, So they say, are spread to dry On the "Mount of Heaven's Perfume."  Suoh started Karuta during university, and became Meijin within 3 years, and has held the title for 4 consecutive years. Everyone acknowledges his god-like abilities, but he is on constant lookout for someone stronger than himself. He is a solitary genius who always suffers from hunger, and is hard to become excited. It is his 4th time repeating a year at university.  Personality: The current Meijin is a weirdo? At first glance he may look like a typical university student, but in reality he is tall, has a questionable beard, an extremely quiet voice, and loves Japanese confectionery. His personal favourite idol is “Kyokotan” (Yamashiro Kyouko) who is a professional Karuta reader. He once asked her for a recording of her reading the poems, after offering her a gift of confectionaries. He is a man who wants to only fight strong people, and so he rarely makes an appearance at tournaments. In an interview, he has started that he wants to quickly be Meijin 5 years in a row, become an eternal-Meijin, then retire.

name: Hideo Harada
description:
__Level:__ Class A, 6. Dan
__Group:__ Shiranami Karuta Society

Hideo Harada is the head of the Shiranami Society for karuta that Chihaya and Taichi are part of. He used to teach Arata as well, while Arata was in primary school with Chihaya and Taichi. He taught Chihaya throughout Junior High School and is currently mentor to both Chihaya and Taichi. He is also a medical doctor and married.

Harada Hideo is portrayed as a kind man with a deep and insightful knowledge of the game of karuta. He states that he teaches his students offensive karuta, which aims to take cards from the opponent's side. He is extremely competitive, whether on behalf of his students or as a competitor himself, or even as a figurehead, representing his karuta society, and is his students' staunchest supporter.

name: Tsutomu Komano
description:
__Height:__ 157 cm
__School:__ Municipal Mizusawa High School - Year 2 Class 1 - Karuta Club secretary and recorder of matches
__Karuta Society:__ Shirohoku Society - B Class

An intelligent boy in Chihaya's class who is second only to Taichi in test scores. Often tied to his desk and anti-social, he feels that nothing is worth doing unless it makes you smarter. However, Chihaya and Taichi help to convince him that karuta involves a lot of strategies and he joins the club. He is also left-handed.

name: Akito Sudou
description: Akito Sudo is another Class A karuta player. Together with his teammates from Hokuō Academy Karuta Club he was playing against the Mizusawa Karuta Club. After his team loses to them, he gains respect for them and supports Chihaya. It has been noted that Sudo has incredible potential that is stifled by his tendency towards sadism.

name: Sumire Hanano
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm 
__Karuta Society:__ Shiranami Society - No Class
__Favourite Song:__ Poem #9 Colour of the flower Has already faded away, While in idle thoughts My life passes vainly by, As I watch the long rains fall.

A first-year who's just been dumped by her boyfriend. She’s part of the twenty-strong recruiting class of prospective members the Karuta Club manages to attract, but she's not remotely interested in the Hundred Poets. She has a love interest in [Taichi Mashima](https://anilist.co/character/47167/Mashima-Taichi).

name: Midori Sakurazawa
description: Coach of the Fujisaki High School Karuta team.  She maintains an intense stamina program for all the members.

name: Yuusei Nishida
description:
__Height:__ 176 cm
__School:__ Municipal Mizusawa High School - Year 2 Class 9 - Karuta Club member
__Karuta Society:__ Suihoku Society - A Class

A rather tubby boy who is reluctantly often called 'Porky' by Chihaya. Once a top karuta player who had previously played against Chihaya, Arata and Taichi in an elementary school tournament, Yusei quit karuta after suffering a defeat against Arata and took up tennis as a refuge. However, Chihaya manages to remind him how he used to play for fun and he ends up joining the karuta club.

name: Rion Yamashiro
description: Member of the Fujisaki High School karuta team. She is also the granddaughter of Kyoko Yamashiro.

name: Hiro Kinashi
description: An eccentric member of the Hokuou Academy Karuta Club. His rank is Class B.

name: Akihiro Tsukuba
description:
__Height:__ 167 cm

A boy who joins the Karuta Club at the start of Chihaya's second year. He is originally from Hokkaido and is a master at playing second verse karuta using two hands. He joins the club to learn how to play first verse karuta.
Tsukuba played the Hokkaido-style Karuta until his last year in middle school, therefore he came to the Karuta club very confident. Even though the rules are different than what he’s used to, he has a drive to become strong and becomes a Karuta club member.

name: Taeko Miyauchi
description: The adviser for the tennis club, badminton club, chemistry department, and karuta club. Although against karuta at first, she eventually warms up to the game after witnessing Chihaya and the others play. From then on she started actively cooperating with the team.

name: Chitose Ayase
description:
__Height__: 159cm  

Chihaya's older sister. She's a model and the complete opposite of Chihaya's tomboyish personality.

name: Hajime Wataya
description: Arata's grandfather, a karuta master.

name: Chieko Ayase
description: Chihaya's mother.

name: Rieko Ooe
description: Kanade's mother. She runs a kimono store, which provides hakama for the Mizusawa Karuta Club.

name: Kyouko Yamashiro
description: She's a professional karuta reader, often reading for championships or higher level events. She has a granddaughter, Rion Yamashiro.

name: Mari Wataya
description: Arata's mother.

name: Reiko Mashima
description: Taichi's mother.

name: Sarasa
description: The protagonist of this series. She takes the name of her murdered twin bother Tatara, who was known as the child of fate. As Tatara, she wields the sword of Byakko and leads the survivors of Byakko Village. Even among her allies few people know she is a girl.  Sarasa hopes to create a land that is fertile, full of flora, and free of strife. Though she is quick to cry and psychologically weak in some respects, over the course of the story she develops undeniable skills in leadership and swordplay, and becomes the central figure of the Tatara Army.  Because of visiting hot springs she has met a curious young man named Shuri, who has become her only outlet for being completly herself as Sarasa. But at the moment she does not know that Shuri is her hated enemy The Red King.

name: Ageha
description: A former slave and survivor of the Blue Nobles, a nomadic people all but wiped out by the government. Ageha saved Sarasa from the Red King when she was younger, but he lost his left eye in the bargain. He has friends all across Japan and is capable of calling in tremendous favors from them.  Ageha usually tours with Madam Butterfly's troupe of traveling performers under the name Kicho, the star dancer. He keeps an owl, Kagero, who is a parent of Sarasa's owl, Shinbashi.

name: Shuri
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm

The youngest son of the Emperor, he rules over Saikoku (western Japan) which includes Chugoku, Shikoku and Kyuushuu. In the early parts of the story Shuri stands out as brutally cruel to those who do not obey him, because he is responsible for the destruction of Byakko Village and the murder of [Tatara](https://anilist.co/character/17180/Tatara). Later he meets [Sarasa](https://anilist.co/character/4330/Sarasa), unaware that they are enemies, and falls in love with her.

Though he is merciless to his enemies, Shuri is a capable ruler and very proud of his realm. He has a big-hearted, free-spirited personality and is generally quite personable, though he tends to be overly competitive. Shuri is an expert swordsman.

name: Asagi
description: The captain of the Blue King's special guards, 'Gunjou', which is made up of handsome boys. Asagi infiltrates Tatara's army on the orders of the White King, plotting to play Tatara and the Red King against each other.  Asagi has a contrary and self-centered personality, and he hates physical labor. Though he is very skilled with a sword he is physically weak.

name: Shinbashi
description: Sarasa's pet owl, the runt of his hatch. Sarasa is unwilling to let the other chicks crowd him out, and decides to take care of him.

name: Kikune
description: The last and only female member of the four virtues, a group of four elite agents, who answer to both the white king and the blue king. Kikune specializes in inventions and has shown her ingeniousness on a number of occasions. It is also hinted upon that she and Ichimatsu are attracted to each other.   ~!  Kikune was given a mission up north, where she was sent to spy on the black king and report what she observed back to the white and blue kings. When up north, she had her memory sealed, and took on the identity of Kasane. It was also then that she met Sarasa, who fled up north due to the shock of learning the red king's identity. They quickly became friends, and even after Kikune realized who she was, she remained Sarasa's friend, aiding her on a number of occasions. Eventually when she learns about the relationship between shuri and sarasa, she does whatever she can to help the two of them.  !~

name: Chacha
description: The fierce and beautiful leader of a group of pirates who capture Sarasa and Hayato, intending to sell them to foreigners. However, Sarasa's daring impresses Cha Cha, and she decides to become Sarasa's ally instead. Cha Cha has a sisterly nature and likes to have others depend on her. Her lover is her right-hand man, Zaki.

name: Nachi
description: The son and heir of the head priest of the Kumano Shinto shrine. Nachi runs across Sarasa while hunting the largest whale in the seas in his region. Nachi is a merchant with a bold, optimistic personality, and he speaks with a strong regional accent.  Nachi is a member of the Tengu youth organization with his friend Hijiri, and serves as second in command. He is knowledgeable about survival skills, and comes to Sarasa's aid numerous times.

name: Tamon
description: One of the four generals of Kazuno, he is an eccentric who speaks with a disinctive northern accent. Unselfish and aloof from the world, he loves fishing and travels the land in search of good fishing spots. Sarasa finds him in the most inhospitable part of the Abashiri prison, where he is the only survivor. He holds the sword of Genbu.      Tamon is named after another of the Four Heavenly Kings, Vaisravana, whose Japanese name means all-hearing.  (source: Wikipedia)

name: Nagi
description: The blind prophet who foretold the coming of the child of fate, Nagi was also the physician and schoolteacher of Byakko Village. He serves as a mentor to Sarasa, who trusts him completely. Nagi learned medicine from the great doctor Basho.

name: Hayato
description: A boy from the city of Daizaifu in Kyūshū, Hayato becomes one of Tatara's first allies. He is the successor to the sword of Suzaku, but specializes in the use of bow and arrows. Hayato is scatterbrained, but because he gets the others out of many dangerous situations, he becomes a sort of mascot figure for the Tatara Army.

name: Shidou
description: The governor of Dazaifu and commander of the Kyūshū division of the Red Army, Shidou is the Red King's cousin and closest confidant. While generally warm and genial, Shidou does not flinch from the grizzlier duties of leadership - he is a calculating and ruthless general who is said to leave mountains of corpses behind him on the battlefield.  Shidou is the first character to realize the full implications of Sarasa and Shuri's relationship, but he is killed before he can speak of it.

name: Hijiri
description: The leader of the Tengu youth organization in Kumano; like Nachi, he is the son of a local Kumano leader. Hijiri's personality is opposite to Nachi's - he is calm and quick-thinking, and a master of Iaidō. He is strict with Sarasa, but well-meaning.  Hijiri has been the closest of friends with Nachi since they both were young, and is often worried by Nachi's recklessness.

name: Nakijin
description: A karate master who is kind, serious and reliable. He nurses Sarasa for a time while she is recovering from eye injuries. Despite his initial dislike of Shuri, they reach and understanding as they defend Okinawa's independence and eventually develop an unbreakable friendship.      Nakijin's name is derived from Nakijin gusuku and the likewise-named region of Okinawa.  (source:Wikipedia)

name: Yuna
description: Bashō-sensei's assistant whom Shuri meets in Okinawa. She is bold and tomboyish but likes to be relied upon, and treats Shuri like a younger brother. She is a childhood friend of Nakijin, and also capable in karate. Yūna is engaged to the President of Okinawa, Asato, who is also her surrogate father.      Yūna's name comes from the Okinawan name of Hibiscus tiliaceus, a tropical plant.   (source:Wikipedia)

name: Yuzan
description: Professor and former slave. Revolutionary

name: Zaki
description: Chacha's first mate and lover; a man of few words. While even more deadly in battle that she, Zaki admires Chacha's indomitable spirit and supports her in any way he can. His loyalty is to Chacha above all, and he would trade even Tatara's life for Chacha's.

name: Kakujii
description: A Byakko villager; he instructs Tatara, and later Sarasa, in swordplay. He plays a surrogate father role for Sarasa, and she places a great deal of trust in him. Kakujii originally came from a fishing village in the Tohoku region, but was thrown into Abashiri Prison after rebelling against the Black King, who rules there. He later escaped, and eventually ended up in Byakko Village.

name: Senju
description: Shidou's fiancee, a young noblewoman. Senju is made of sterner stuff than her delicate looks would suggest. She truly loves Shidou even though their marriage was arranged, and they have a rush wedding before Shidou goes into battle with Tatara at her urging.

name: Ginko
description: Ginko holds the title of the "white king" but is in fact a woman. She is also the one who put together the elite spy group, "The Four Virtues". Not much is known about her until the later volumes of the manga. In the anime, the white king is only briefly mentioned as the king who resides in Kyoto with the emperor.

name: Hiiragi
description:
Hiiragi is the best assassin in all of Japan. He serves under the white king and at one point was sent to kill "Tatara". He also taught Shuri, Asagi and Shido how to fight. Hiiragi is said to mean holly, and his victims are often sent holly as a warning that they are about to meet their end at Hiiragi's hands.     

~! Hiiragi was put in charge of the invasion of Awaji Island by the emperor. He was tasked with killing the current leader and bringing Ginko back to Kyoto. Although he accomplished both, he has never been able to forgive himself for hurting the white king so deeply and as penance, he now serves her unquestionably. Hiiragi is also the only person who understands how Ginko, the white king, really feels. In fact before her arranged marriage, it is hinted that he loved and continues to love her. Eventually Shuri and Nakijin are able to defeat him in battle, a battle that costs him his arm. He is finally defeated by Asagi and dies along with Ginko when the palace falls in upon itself.!~

name: Tatara
description: The twin of Sasara, whose death was ordered by the Red King.

name: Makoto
description: One of the children living in the same village as Tatara and Sarasa. He sacrificed himself in order to save Tatara the first time the Red King came to kill him.

name: Ichimatsu
description: He is one of the Black King's top three generals. However unlike the other two, Ichimatsu is loyal only to the Purple Lady (wife of the Black King).   ~! After Sarasa helps Lady Purple gain control of the northern region and form a pact with Kazuno to stop the fighting between the Black Army and Kazuno, Lady Purple sends Ichimatsu to help Sarasa in Kyoto. Ichimatsu has shown affection for Kikune, and during one of the side stories asks her to marry him (albeit half jokingly). Nevertheless, the two of them are seen to be living together like a married couple.!~

name: Kazan
description: Kazan is the red king's general and his most faithful servant. He was also the one who beheaded the real Tatara.   ~!Kazan was with Shuri since Shuri was a young boy and could not come to terms with hiding Tatara's mother from his king even though Shuri was willing to forgive him. He fell in love with Chigusa (Tatara's mother) and asked her to be his second in Harakiri (a ritual suicide to regain one's honor as a warrior).    sources: midori & soaring_wings!~

name: Holo
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'2)

Holo is a wolf harvest deity originally from a land in the north known as Yoitsu. She made a promise with men from a town called Pasloe where she would ensure the town would have good wheat harvests year after year. However, as time went on, the townspeople slowly started to forsake Holo and did not rely on her as they once did. As such, Holo escapes from town in [Lawrence's](https://anilist.co/character/7374/) wagon and started traveling with him to see how much the world has changed since she has been in Pasloe. Holo has chosen the form of a girl younger than Lawrence, though she still retains her large wolf tail and ears. Her true form is that of a very large wolf which many people revered and feared.  

She refers to herself as the "Wise Wolf of Yoitsu" (ヨイツの賢狼). She is typically very haughty and self-sufficient, though due to her isolation for hundreds of years in Pasloe, she gradually feels very lonely, and sometimes shows a more fragile side of herself towards Lawrence, whom she relies on for company. Holo fears this loneliness, along with the difference in lifespans that she and Lawrence have, but hides it the best she can with jokes. She has a peculiar way of speaking, modeled after that of the oiran high-class courtesans. She is fond of delicious food and alcohol, but especially loves apples. She takes pride in her tail and takes special care of it, constantly combing and maintaining it.

name: Kraft Lawrence
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm (5'10'') 

Kraft Lawrence is a twenty-five-year-old traveling peddler who goes from town to town buying and selling various things in order to make a living. When he was twelve, he became an apprentice to a merchant relative, and set out on his own at eighteen. His goal in life is to gather enough money to start his own shop, and he has already been traveling for seven years while gaining experience in the trade. He meets Holo one night and eventually agrees to her traveling with him. She helps him by providing her wisdom which helps to increase his profits and get him out of jams. Lawrence usually goes by his surname, only some who have known him for a long time, like Jakob Tarantino, the master of his guild, call him by his first name Kraft in the novel.

name: Elsa Schtingheim
description: The church deaconess of the the village of Tereo, successor of the late father Franz.

name: Nora Arendt
description: She is a skilled shepherdess from a church-town named Lubinheigen. Her companion in this profession is a well-trained sheep dog named Enekk.

name: Dian Rubens
description:
Dian is an alchemist who is in the process of chronicling pagan tales and beliefs so as to print them in books.

 ~!She is actually an immortal bird deity, similar to how Holo is a wolf deity.!~

name: Fleur Boland
description: A merchant staying at the same inn in Renos as Lawrence and Holo.

name: Col Tote
description: A boy saved by Lawrence at the river checkpoint. A naive but clever lad. He strives to become a priest to save his village.

name: Evan Gyoam
description: A young miller who's romantically involved with Elsa.

name: Fermi Amarty
description:
He is a young man who works as a fish broker. 

~!Amarty is in love with Holo. He wants Lawrence to sign a contract in order to buy Holo.!~

name: Zheren
description: A mysterious merchant that Lawrence and Holo meet on their journey when they visit a monastery. He suggests a "get rich quick" scheme to Lawrence involving reminted coins.

name: Marhait Liechten
description: The manager of the large Pattio branch of the Milone Company. He is a calm, cool, and collected man who speaks very politely.

name: Ted Reynolds
description: The master of the Jean Company on the north bank of Kerube.

name: Lud Kiemann
description: The chief of the Kerube branch of the Rowen Trade Guild.

name: Louis Schtinghilt
description: Louis Lana Schtinghilt, better known as Father Franz, was the abbot of Diendran Abbey in Tereo and, secretly, a mythologist and collector of pagan tales.

name: Jin Seon
description: Jin is the main protagonist and the son of the murderous CEO Dongsoo Seon. Jin is a scrawny teenager with pale skin, brown hair, and a blue right eye. Because of the "accident" during his childhood, Jin's left eye was substituted with a reddish-brown glass eye, which he hides with his irregular bangs. Due to his brutal nature, while dealing with bullies and other opponents, Jin will occasionally appear bruised and cut from his fights. Even though Jin wants to be righteous and well-meaning, he has a sociopathic side that emerges in times of intense stress or anger. When this trait shows itself, he shows no fear, uses rather a foul language, and his face turns dark and menacing. When provoked into an extreme rage, Jin shows no remorse or hesitation for any violent actions he may commit in this state. He is also prone to outbursts, breakdowns, or temporary lapses of fear when he is questioned about his father, hears mention of his father, or he notices his father in action.

name: Dong-Soo Seon
description: Dongsoo Seon is the father of Jin Seon and the executive CEO of G Corporation.

name: Kyun Yoon
description: Kyun is known to be a sociable butterfly and friendly, she has a lot of morality as well as common sense. However there are times where she can be quite cold when the time calls for it.

name: Jae-Hyeok Kim
description: Manny Kim is the 'alpha' of his school, being quite popular with everyone. ~!That changed when an accident took his legs.!~ He comes from a rich family, gets good grades, and is quite good at fighting. He and Jin Seon have a very complicated relationship.

name: Souta Aoki
description: Aoki is a high school student with a pure heart. He possesses an extremely kind personality and a naive nature. He is secretly in love with Hashimoto at first. However, due to certain misunderstandings he begins to get closer to Ida, his new friend.

name: Kousuke Ida
description: Ida is a high school student who belongs to the volleyball club. He has an orderly and direct personality, often saying what he thinks. He is unfamiliar with love and doesn't understand the "feeling of falling in love with someone". However, for reasons unknown to himself, he begins to arouse feelings for Aoki.

name: Mio Hashimoto
description: Hashimoto is a high school student and Aoki's classmate. She possesses a gentle personality and charming smile, but is also shy and withdrawn. Hashimoto accidentally lent Aoki an eraser that had "Ida-kun ♡" written on it, creating a romantic mix-up between Aoki and Ida.

name: Hayato Aida
description: Aida is Aoki's best friend. He possesses a flirtatious and kind nature, as well as being very self-assured. He doesn't have a very close relationship with Ida, but after exchanging a few words, he discovers that he is a good person. He initially tries to romantically set Ida up with Hashimoto. However, Aida subsequently begins to develop a great friendship with Hashimoto.

name: Narrator
description:
This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. 

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

name: Liuqi Wu
description:
He's a 21-year-old barber who suffers from amnesia. Alongside his boss _(and best friend)_ [Dai Bo](https://anilist.co/character/147089/Dabao-Ji) and [Xiao Fei,](https://anilist.co/character/147099/Xiaofei-Ji) works as an assassin for hire to gain a lot of yuan to retrieve his lost memory. He was found by Dai Bo and Xiao Fei on a beach in Chicken Island when he was 19 and has been living with them for 2 years and runs a barbershop business. 

His assassin rank is 17, 369. Before his memory loss, his assassin rank was 1. 

Seven is goofy, a little absent-minded at times, and is a bit of a pushover. He decided to become a killer supposedly because he lacks any morals and is only interested in becoming rich, but he never manages to kill his targets. This is partly because of his incompetence, but also because he actually doesn't want to actually kill others. As the series progresses, his sense of justice slowly comes more and more into the spotlight. 

He's a hopeless romantic and constantly hits on [Thirteen](https://anilist.co/character/147092/Shisan-Meihua) despite her clear disinterest in him.

name: Shisan Meihua
description:
Thirteen is a mysterious masked assassin, anti-hero, and the thirteenth daughter of the Plum Blossom swordsman. 

Having been trained as a cold-blooded assassin, Thirteen is first seen as a detached and cool headed person but also prideful of her skills. When her mask is broken, it shows an easily flustered young woman who seems to have some troubles to completely disregard her feelings of rights and wrongs. [Seven](https://anilist.co/character/147093/Liuqi-Wu) happens to develop a crush on her after their second encounter, and tends to hit on her. When Seven hits on her _(which is during most of their interactions)_, she tends to act like a tsundere towards him.

~!She also developed feelings for Seven as shown at the end of season 2 when she was seen waiting by the ocean with a dress she bought herself and the bag with the swimsuit he bought her.!~

name: Dabao Ji
description:
He found [Seven](https://anilist.co/character/147093/Liuqi-Wu) on a beach 2 years ago and saved his life, but because of this, he's now covered in medical bills that he has to pay off. To pay for them all, he attempts to put Seven into all kinds of odd jobs, but eventually pushes him into an assassinating job. 

Dai Bo gives his invention, the GaiBa Egg, to Seven and instructs him on how to become a killer. He also introduces him to [Xiao Fei](https://anilist.co/character/147099/Xiaofei-Ji) and tells him to use him to flee the scene when he needs it. He soon realizes that Seven is useless as a killer as he always loses, can't bring himself to kill most of his targets, and even saves them.

name: Xiaofei Ji
description:
Xiao Fei is the son of Da Fei and adoptive son of [Dai Bo.](https://anilist.co/character/147089/Dabao-Ji) He's a flying chicken and always follows [Seven](https://anilist.co/character/147093/Liuqi-Wu) around. 

Dai Bo introduces Xiao Fei to Seven as a means to fly away from tough situations. Since then they are always together and Xiao Fei becomes more and more attached to Seven as he keeps helping people. 

Happy and innocent of the time, he can also get angry if someone he knows is hurt or in trouble. Xiao Fei is also very brave as he is willing to fight to protect Seven even against opponents that are stronger than him.

name: Chiya
description: Chiya is the main antagonist of Scissor Seven (刺客伍六七) in Season 2. He’s one of the seven Shadow Assassins of Xuanwu. He is possessed by the Blood Demon that gives him his powers. He had a history with Chairman Jiang.

An ordinary girl who is a little shy. She attended school, but kept a low profile and had average grades. She didn't have any big dreams and lived her life going with the flow.

A girl who attends an entertainment school. She's appeared in commercials and has a promising future ahead of her. She is a beautiful girl who could become a model, and is good at socialising and is very graceful.  But, inside she is actually strong-willed and competitive.

description:
__Height:__ 164 cm

A young street musician. She is easy-going and firm. She does not like to dress typically feminine and chooses to keep her hair down, and keep her clothes plain. She is bright and caring and has the feeling of an reliable senior at an athletic club.

name: Tomo Ebizuka
description:
__Height:__ 148 cm

Originally, she was a young lady from a wealthy family that was famous in their local area. However, she currently lives in a shared apartment. Her view on the world is cold and oblique. Like a hedgehog, she is very cautious and does not open up much.

name: Rupa
description:
__Height:__ 169 cm

A slightly tanned girl who has a South Asian father and a Japanese mother. She has an artistic sense, and a clear-headed mind. She is a so-called genius that everyone respects for her gentle and modest demeanor. Her only flaws is that she is a heavy drinker, and gets tunnel vision when she has a goal in mind.

name: Momo Ayase
description: After making friends with [Ken Takakura](https://anilist.co/character/222593), who she calls "Okarun" (due to refusing to call him by the same name as the actor she idolizes), Momo wishes to help restore his body back to normal after being cursed by a yokai and must overcome other paranormal activities that are involved.

name: Aira Shiratori
description:
__Relatives:__ [Father](https://anilist.co/character/349655/Aira-no-Chichi)

After becoming aware of the existence of the supernatural after collecting a mysterious golden ball, Aira proclaims herself as the "chosen one" that is on a mission to protect the world from evil and directs her attention towards [Momo Ayase](https://anilist.co/character/222594/Momo-Ayase), believing that she is a demon that has to be stopped after seeing her use her psychic powers. Aira revels in her social status as the popular girl at Kami High and strives to maintain her reputation. Outwardly, she appears sweet, innocent, and somewhat air headed. However, internally, she is far more vain and prideful, a side she only shows to people she becomes close with. Whilst antagonistic towards Momo, she harbors feelings towards her close friend [Okarun](https://anilist.co/character/222593/Ken-Takakura).

~!She later gains the powers of a powerful spirit named [Acrobatic Silky](https://anilist.co/character/245467/Acrobatic-Sarasara) and becomes allies / friends with Momo and Okarun, learning to be more mindful of her actions and being more open with her true self.!~

name: Ken Takakura
description: He is a young male student with a firm belief that UFOs and aliens exist. Upon meeting [Momo Ayase](https://anilist.co/character/222594/Ayase-Momo) and taking up on her challenge to see if ghosts were real, Okarun became cursed by a yokai known as the [Turbo-Granny](https://anilist.co/character/239956/Turbo-Babaa) and seeks to return to normal.

name: Seiko Ayase
description: [Momo Ayase](https://anilist.co/character/222594/Ayase-Momo)'s grandmother. Despite being a grandmother, Seiko possesses a youthful appearance that does not match her age and is recognized as being quite beautiful.

name: Jin Enjouji
description:
Jin Enjouji is [Momo Ayase](https://anilist.co/character/222594/Momo-Ayase)'s childhood friend and first crush. After his parents were hospitalized as a result of his house being haunted, Enjouji moved in with Momo and [Seiko](https://anilist.co/character/234824/Seiko-Ayase) and transferred over to Momo's school. 

Jiji comes off as being a very hyper-active young man who likes to express himself with dramatic mannerisms and expressions. He also has a habit of usually ending his sentences with strange verbal tics and is known to be very athletic and enjoy sports, primarily soccer. Past his initial over-the-top presentation, Jiji is a good-natured guy who deeply values his friendships and is committed to protecting those close to him, striving to improve himself and act as a reliable ally in moments of danger. Despite his immaturity, Jiji demonstrates a strong sense of accountability and empathy. 

~!He later gets possessed by a mountain yokai called [the Evil Eye](https://anilist.co/character/309809/Jashi). Thus, whenever he touches cold water, Evil Eye comes out, and when he touches hot water, he is himself.!~

name: Turbo Babaa

The yokai took on the form of a very elderly woman with long white shaggy hair and eyes that were stuck looking to the sides. When possessing her targets, she has her victims transform into a mirror image of herself, albeit with a large mouth with teeth that is capable of biting off body parts.

~!After having her consciousness extracted from [Okarun](https://anilist.co/character/222593/Takakura-Ken), the Turbo-Granny is forced to inhabit a maneki-neko doll.!~

description: Jashi is a yokai who has spent years bound to the [Tsuchinoko](https://anilist.co/character/309811/Tsuchinoko) sacrificial house and is known for cursing humans to commit suicide with his gaze.

name: Hanamichi Sakuragi
description:
__Height:__ 189.2 cm
__Jersey Number:__ #10
__Position:__ Power Forward

At the beginning, Sakuragi was a slacker, always trying to ask girls out but getting constantly rejected (the 50th rejection occurring at the start of the series). He then met Akagi Haruko, with whom he fell in love immediately. This passion led to him joining the Shohoku basketball team. However, as a complete beginner, he was not able to keep up with the rest of the team at first despite his physical attributes (great height, athleticism, stamina, speed and leaping ability). He regards himself as a genius though, with self-confidence that borders on arrogance. His most recognizable trait is his red hair, though he shaves his head as reparation for an error that led to the loss against Kainan.  At first, Sakuragi was known for his poor basketball skills as a beginner; in his first few official matches, he fouled out every game. However, his basketball skills advanced throughout the series. First he developed his basic skills, such as dribbling and layups. Then, trained by Akagi, he became a formidable rebounder; his rebounding became his claim to fame throughout the latter half of the series. He also is seen more than once defining the match for Shohoku in the last seconds, for instance, by dunking a ball that Akagi would have missed in the league round match with Ryonan. His jump shooting was then developed by Coach Anzai, who had him make 20,000 shots in a week. He hit a buzzer-beating jump shot to win the match against Sannoh. However, he also injured his back during the match against Sannoh, and underwent rehabilitation after Shohoku's subsequent loss to Aiwa Academy.  In spite of the setbacks he has had to face, Sakuragi displays a great deal of tenacity and determination that carry him through and help reciprocate for his other failings, both on and off the court. Although his love for Haruko and rivalry with Rukawa are the main driving forces motivating him to succeed in basketball, his injury during the Sannoh match makes him realize that he has actually come to love the game, leading him to give his all for his team and bring them victory.

description:
