Antarc is a perfectionist who acts like a soldier, marching and speaking with extreme formality. They are used to working alone, as all the other gems hibernate during the winter. Despite their usual cold attitude, Antarc has a soft side, and they love [Kongou](https://anilist.co/character/123394/Kongou) more than anything, often breaking their usual icy demeanor around him. They do not like to openly show this softer side though, becoming extremely embarrassed when [Phos](https://anilist.co/character/123385/Phosphophyllite) sees them like that.

name: Padparadscha
description:
__Hardness:__ 9

One of the elder gems who mainly does patrol duty, but is currently inactive. Padparadscha was born with an incomplete torso, which affects their consciousness. They're partners with [Rutile](https://anilist.co/character/123399/Rutile), who also maintains their health.

Padpa is easygoing, but knows a lot more than what they let on. They want the other gems to stop worrying about them, and would like to sleep in order not to burden anyone.

name: Bort
description:
__Hardness:__ 10

One of the gems who mainly does patrol duty. They're partners with [Diamond](https://anilist.co/character/123390/Diamond). Bort is a diamond-class gem whose hardness and toughness are top level. They are a calm yet ruthless warrior who excel at battles and are obsessed with combat. The other gems call them a "battle maniac".

Bort is an efficient and analytic fighter, often pointing out the flaws in the other gems' tactics in a blunt and straightforward manner. This causes them to be seen as cold and scary to the others, but also to be respected, looked up to, and seen as reliable. Despite their harsh personality, they do have a softer side.

name: Kongou
description:
**Hardness:** Unknown

Kongou is the teacher of the lustrous. He has a vast amount of knowledge and has the power to drive away the Lunarians with a single attack.

Normally, Kongou is quiet and stoic. When he speaks, he is straightforward and concise. He only rarely displays emotions, but this is rumored to be because he is deliberately hiding them and that his face would be very easy to read otherwise. On the rare occasions where he shows humor, he is still as deadpan as ever. Kongou cares for the Gems considerably and blames himself when they are injured or taken away by the Lunarians.

~!He is actually a prayer machine built by [Dr. Ayumu](https://anilist.co/character/285150/Ayumu), who Kongou sees as his mother.!~

name: Rutile
description:
**Hardness**: 6

A gem who works as a doctor. They repair cracked or broken gems and handle the management of herbs, pastes, powders, and other medical remedies. They are partners with the unstable [Padparadscha](https://anilist.co/character/124485/Padparadscha), whose body is actively being maintained. Besides repairs, Rutile is responsible for carrying out regular physical checkups and applying powder and saltwater resin to the gems' bodies.

Rutile is a workaholic takes their job very seriously. They are known to stay up all night if needed to put a gem back together. As a result, they are often tired and will take naps during the day. They are also a bit eccentric and sarcastic, and to take great pride in their job and research. They don't take well to having their medical authority questioned. Even so, they become easily embarrassed when pestered about things like love.

They are very close to Padparadscha. Hundreds of thousands of failed operations to fix them have not made them lose hope. They believe they cannot be called a doctor if they cannot solve Padparadscha's condition. They are extremely dedicated, bordering on obsessed with this task.

~!Rutile's mental state is broken after [Phos](https://anilist.co/character/123385/Phosphophyllite) takes Padparadscha to the moon without telling anyone. They have become more impulsive and feral in nature, and have abandoned their job as a doctor.!~

name: Yellow Diamond
description:
__Hardness:__ 10

The oldest gem, who mostly does patrol duty. They're partners with [Zircon](https://anilist.co/character/123401/Zircon). Yellow Diamond is cheerful yet mature, and feels responsible for all of their siblings.

Throughout their life, Yellow has had several partners—[Green Diamond](https://anilist.co/character/393651/Green-Diamond), [Ruby](https://anilist.co/character/393652/Ruby), [Sapphire](https://anilist.co/character/393650/Sapphire), and [Pink Topaz](https://anilist.co/character/393648/Pink-Topaz)—but they were all taken to the moon. Yellow struggles with low self-esteem and possible self-loathing for constantly letting their partners be taken by the Lunarians, and also questions why they bother fighting anymore.

~!They are one of the gems who accompanies [Phos](https://anilist.co/character/123385/Phosphophyllite) to the moon.!~

~!During their time on the moon, Yellow gradually becomes more and more mentally unstable, and eventually even begins to suffer from delusions, thinking of themselves as a Lunarian and becoming distressed whenever they realize they're really a gem.!~

name: Ghost Quartz
description:
__Hardness:__ 7

A gem in charge of the library and convalescent center, though they sometimes do patrol duty as well. Ghost Quartz has a body made of more than one crystal, meaning they have a second gem inside of them: a dark-colored crystal later named [Cairngorm](https://anilist.co/character/124600/Cairngorm), who has their own personality and is capable of communicating with Ghost. Their weapon of choice is a sickle.

Ghost Quartz is quiet, calm, and insecure about themselves. They seem to be rather isolated from the other gems. They used to be partnered with [Lapis Lazuli](https://anilist.co/character/130062/Lapis-Lazuli), who was the one in charge of the library until they were taken to the moon by the Lunarians, leaving only their head behind; Ghost was placed in charge of the library afterwards. They speak of Lapis in high regards. Although Ghost describes their inner crystal, Cairngorm, as "violent and brash", they both equally respected and followed Lapis.

~!Ghost temporarily teamed up with [Phos](https://anilist.co/character/123385/Phosphophyllite), but during their first battle, the outer Ghost Quartz was chipped off of the underlying Cairngorm by the Lunarians and was taken to the moon, leaving only Cairngorm behind. In Ghost's final moments, it's given a clearer picture of Ghost's attitude towards Cairngorm, calling them rude, violent, selfish, and annoying. However, Ghost then entrusts Cairngorm to protect Phos after they're gone.!~

name: Alexandrite
description:
__Hardness:__ 8.5

A gem who works as an expert on the Lunarians. They are studious and passionate about this work, being referred to as a "Lunarian research maniac" by the other gems. They even draw original Lunarian designs sometimes. However, despite being a Lunarian researcher, Alexandrite is forbidden from looking at or engaging with them. This is because they have a condition where, when they look at Lunarians, they have a chance of turning into "Red Alex". In this mode, their color changes from blue to red, and they go berserk, becoming obsessed with just cutting down anything in their way until they eventually pass out.

Alex originally started researching Lunarians for two reasons: one, to overcome their condition, and two, in order to retain the "fresh feeling of hatred" they have for the Lunarians as a result of their former partner, [Chrysoberyl](https://anilist.co/character/393647/Chrysoberyl), being taken by them.

When referred to with honorifics, Alexandrite hates being called Alex-san, preferring the cuter Alex-chan. This is changed to Alexi and Lexi in the official English translation.

~!They are one of the gems who accompanies [Phos](https://anilist.co/character/123385/Phosphophyllite) to the moon.!~

name: Euclase
description:
__Hardness:__ 7.5

A kindly and knowledgeable elder gem who does patrol duty, secretary work, strategy planning, and other odd jobs. They seem to be partners with [Jade](https://anilist.co/character/123393/Jade). Euclase is kind, intellectual, and extremely perceptive. They're also good at math, and can recite any gem's age to the day on command. They have a strong sense of responsibility and often worry over the others.

name: Jade
description:
__Hardness:__ 7

A very serious gem who mainly works as [Sensei](https://anilist.co/character/123394/Kongou)'s spokesperson. They seem to be partners with [Euclase](https://anilist.co/character/123391/Euclase). Jade is responsible, hardworking, and takes things too seriously.

name: Amethyst 84
description:
__Hardness:__ 7

A gem who mainly does patrol duty. They are partners with their identical twin, [Amethyst 33](https://anilist.co/character/209228).

The twins work in tandem for most things, often talking at the same time or finishing each other's sentences. No one really cares which is which anymore, including themselves. Because twin gems won't break by touching each other, the Amethysts have a habit of clanging their heads together, much to the chagrin of the other gems.

~!Later, Eighty-Four switches their hairstyle to deceive [Phos](https://anilist.co/character/123385/Phosphophyllite) in order to go to the moon in Thirty-Three's place. On the moon, Eighty-Four has become their own individual and serves as an assistant scientist there. They seem to be highly interested in more of the psychological aspects in the science field.!~

name: Ventricosus
description: Ruler of the Admirabilis.

name: Obsidian
description:
__Hardness:__ 5

A gem in charge of weapon production. Energetic and bubbly, Obsidian is very dedicated to their job and will make others weapons without hesitation if requested to.

name: Red Beryl
description:
__Hardness:__ 7.5

A passionate and dedicated gem in charge of clothing. Red Beryl a workaholic who lives for their job as the fashion stylist and tailor for the other gems. Their style is very frilly, cute, and feminine, and they have a different hairstyle every day.

Red Beryl used to be partnered with Aquamarine, who was taken to the moon before the beginning of the story.

name: Aculeatus
description: Brother to [Ventricosus](https://anilist.co/character/124216/Ventricosus), ruler of the Admirabilis.

name: Benitoite
description:
__Hardness:__ 6.5

A gem who mainly does patrol duty. They're partners with [Neptunite](https://anilist.co/character/123396/Neptunite). Benitoite is a sensible, earnest, and somewhat timid gem who has a hard time saying "no." They're insecure about their lack of individuality.

~!Benito is one of the gems who accompanies [Phos](https://anilist.co/character/123385/Phosphophyllite) to the moon. They reveal that the reason they wanted to go is to become special, as they see themselves as too ordinary and plain.!~

name: Zircon
description:
__Hardness:__ 7.5

One of the gems who mainly does patrol duty. They're partners with [Yellow Diamond](https://anilist.co/character/123400/Yellow-Diamond), and they're the second youngest after [Phos](https://anilist.co/character/123385/Phosphophyllite).

Zircon is very hardworking, diligent, and responsible, but is also anxious, always worrying over something.

name: Morganite
description:
__Hardness:__ 7.5

A gem who mainly does patrol duty. They're partners with [Goshenite](https://anilist.co/character/123392). Morganite is overconfident, reckless, and loves to tease [Phos](https://anilist.co/character/123385/Phosphophyllite).

~!Both Morganite and Goshenite are taken to the moon shortly after Phos loses their head and begins their 102-year rest.!~

name: Goshenite
description:
__Hardness:__ 7.5

A gem who mainly does patrol duty. They're partners with [Morganite](https://anilist.co/character/123395/Morganite). Goshenite is gentle, kind to everyone, and always has a worried expression.

~!Both Goshenite and Morganite are taken to the moon shortly after [Phos](https://anilist.co/character/123385/Phosphophyllite) loses their head and begins their 102-year rest.!~

name: Watermelon Tourmaline
description:
__Hardness:__ 7.5

A gem who mainly does patrol duty. They're partners with [Hemimorphite](https://anilist.co/character/123994). Watermelon is energetic, bubbly, and always has their head in the clouds.

Watermelon is also able to produce an electrical charge, which they are capable of using as an attack. It appears effective against Lunarians, and doesn't seem to effect nearby Gems.

name: Amethyst 33
description:
__Hardness:__ 7

A gem who mainly does patrol duty. They are partners with their identical twin, [Amethyst 84](https://anilist.co/character/123387/Amethyst-84).

The twins work in tandem for most things, often talking at the same time or finishing each other's sentences. No one really cares which is which anymore, including themselves. Because twin gems won't break by touching each other, the Amethysts have a habit of clanging their heads together, much to the chagrin of the other gems.

~!Later, Thirty-Three expresses to [Phos](https://anilist.co/character/123385/Phosphophyllite) that they want to go to the moon with them to practice independence from their twin. Unknown to them, however, Eighty-Four overheard and later switched their hairstyle to deceive Phos, and went to the moon in Thirty-Three's place.

Amethyst 33 has recently learned to cope with their twin leaving, and believes after 200 years that they are alright. They think 84 is doing alright as well, and still feels connected to them.!~

name: Neptunite
description:
__Hardness:__ 5.5

A reserved, quiet gem who mainly does patrol duty. They're partners with [Benitoite](https://anilist.co/character/123388/Benitoite).

Neptunite has a sharp tongue and believes that people should face the truth head-on, regardless of how it makes them feel. Other gems comment that Nepti is very difficult to read in terms of both their mood and combat movements. [New Morganite](https://anilist.co/character/209245/Morganite) remarks that "not knowing what Nepti is saying is part of their charm".

name: Vladilena Milizé
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm

Vladilena Milizé, more commonly known as Lena by her friends and as Handler One to her subordinates, is an elite Republic commissioned officer who rose to the rank of Major at the young age of 16. She is the commander of [Shinei Nouzen](https://anilist.co/character/141060/Nouzen-Shinei) and the Spearhead Squadron, whom she communicates with via the long-distance communication device known as the Para-RAID. 

~!After the Spearhead Squadron's departure, she becomes known for demanding orders and highly competent leadership, earning the nickname of Bloody Regina among the Processors.!~

name: Kurena Kukumila
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm

Kurena Kukumila is a platoon leader of Eighty-Sixth Strike Package's Spearhead Squadron. She is the squadron's long-range specialist. Her Personal Name is Gunslinger. Having survived four years on the Eastern Front and the Special Reconnaissance Mission, she is considered one of the most elite Processors alive.

name: Shinei Nouzen
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm

Shinei Nouzen is the field commander of Spearhead Squadron. His Personal Name is Undertaker.
Having survived five years on the Eastern Front and the Special Reconnaissance Mission, he is considered one of the most elite Processors alive. Among the Eighty-Six, he is known as the Reaper of the Eastern Front. His ability to hear the voices of the Legion allows him to locate the Legion without the use of detection systems like radar.

Born on May 19th in Republic Year 351, Shin lived with his family in the First Sector of the Republic before the war with the Giadian Empire began. It is implied he lived a sheltered life, surrounded by "only kindness and affection". He also appeared to have developed his extrasensory ability early on, hearing "voices that spoke without words" from his family.

~!He would often play with the daughter of his father's colleague, [Henrietta von Penrose](https://anilist.co/character/210923/von-Penrose-Henrietta), whom Shin called Rita.!~

name: Anju Emma
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm

Anju Emma is a platoon member and later platoon leader of the Eighty-Sixth Strike Package's Spearhead Squadron. She serves as their support fire and artillery provider. Her Personal Name is Snow Witch. Having survived four years on the Eastern Front and the Special Reconnaissance Mission, she is considered one of the most elite Processors alive.

name: Raiden Shuga
description:
__Height:__ 185 cm

Raiden Shuga is the vice captain of Spearhead Squadron. As a First Lieutenant, he holds the position of operations commander of the Eighty-Sixth Strike Package and its 1st Armored Division should [Shin](https://anilist.co/character/141060/Nouzen-Shinei) be deemed unfit to command. His Personal Name is Wehrwolf. Having survived four years on the Eastern Front and the Special Reconnaissance Mission, he is considered one of the most elite Processors alive. As he spent three years with Shin prior to joining Spearhead Squadron, Raiden is the closest person to him in the squadron.

name: Frederica Rosenfort
description:
__Height:__ 130cm

A girl Shin and his team met at Ernst's residence after being provided shelter by the Federacy. She is assigned as the Mascot to the Spearhead Squadron. She has an intelligence and a manner of speech well beyond her young age of ten.

~!She is the last empress of the Federal Empire of Giad, having been secretly rescued by Ernst during the coup against the nobility. Her royal bloodline imparts her the gift of seeing the past and present of people she has known.

She was protected by Kiriya Nouzen, a distant relative of Shin from the Nouzen clan and is on the lookout for him after he was assimilated by the Legion as a Black Sheep, having failed to protect his princess. Shin's personality constantly reminds her of Kiri and she treats him as a surrogate big brother.!~

name: Theoto Rikka
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm 

Theoto Rikka is a platoon leader of the Eighty-Sixth Strike Package's Spearhead Squadron and the artist of the squadron member's Personal Marks. His Personal Name is Laughing Fox. Having survived four years on the Eastern Front and the Special Reconnaissance Mission, he is considered one of the most elite Processors alive.

name: Fido
description: Fido is an M101 Barrett Scavenger Drone of the Spearhead Squadron. As a Scavenger, Fido provides aid to the squadron by resupplying ammunition and recharging energy packs, as well as finding and extracting materials from abandoned or destroyed units. He has accompanied Shinei Nouzen in his battles across the Eastern Front and beyond, making him Shin's oldest surviving companion.

name: Kaie Taniya
description:
A good-humoured girl with no filter. Part of The Republic of San Magnolia's Spearhead Squadron.

~! Is killed by a Löwe during a sortie. Has her neural network assimilated with a Legion after being taken. !~

name: Henrietta von Penrose
description: A member of the Republic military and later the Eighty-Sixth Strike Package. She serves in the Research Division and specializes on working on the Para-RAID system her father helped develop.

name: Daiya Irma
description:
Daiya is the leader of the fifth platoon. As an elite four-year veteran of the Eastern Battlefront, he has earned the personal name Black Dog. He and Anju have been in the same squadron since they were conscripted and are close friends. 

~! When his Juggernaut is surrounded by Self-Propelled Mines, moments before they detonate Daiya whispers Anju's name. He is mortally wounded in the explosion and is later euthanised by Shin, so that he won't be assimilated into the Legion. !~

name: Haruto Keats
description: Haruto is the morale booster of the squadron, often times cheerful and joking.

name: Shourei Nouzen
description:
Shinei's older brother. Rei was a generally friendly and reliable older brother, but he was not without his faults.

~!One night when he was on patrol, he came across a young Vladilena Milizé, who was taken by her father to see the injustices brought upon the Eighty-Six. Their helicopter had been shot by a Stachelschwein and was forced to land, leaving them vulnerable to an attack from a nearby Ameise. He took the only survivor, Lena, to his base and sent her back to inside the Gran Mur.!~

name: Kiriya Nouzen
description: He was the personal knight and caretaker of Augusta Frederica Adel-Adler. ~!After the Federacy's forces managed to breach the defensive line at his posting of Rosenfort and the apparent death of his liege, he was assimilated by a Tausendfüßler and became a Legion Shepherd.!~

name: Lev Aldrecht
description: The chief mechanic of the Spearhead Squadron. ~!He was an Alba married to a Heliodor wife, whom he had a daughter with. Due to them being taken away to the Eighty-Sixth Sector, he dyed his hair to go after them. By then, it was already too late, both of them had passed. In order to follow his family to the other side, he works as the chief mechanic of the First Ward's First Defensive Squadron of the Eastern Front.!~

name: Kujo Niko
description: A member of the Spearhead Squadron's Fourth Platoon. ~!Fatally wounded against the Legion, he was put to rest by Shin and had his unit's personal mark passed on.!~

name: Jerome Karlsthal
description: He was Lena's superior in the Republic Armed Forces. Due to his close relationship with Lena's father, she thought of him as her uncle.

name: Václav Milizé
description: Vaclav Milizé was Vladilena Milizé's father and friend of Jerome Karlsthal. He was a member of the Republic Armed Forces

name: Gong-Ja Kim
description:
Gong-Ja Kim is an aspiring hunter who is jealous of the #1 ranker: the [Flame Emperor](https://anilist.co/character/211825/Yu-SoHa). 

Before entering the tower, Gong-Ja lived his life as an orphan. Even after entering, he was a below-average hunter who adored and worshipped higher rankers. This admiration later turned into envy though, and Soo-Ha Yoo became the main subject of Gong-Ja's jealousy. This below-average hunter's life changed when he received an S-Rank Skill Card for the toxic envy he developed. His gifted S-Rank Skill Card allowed him to receive the power of those who killed him.

name: Raviel Ivansia
description: She is the villainess of the story named "The Tale of Sormwyn Academy".

name: Anastasia Zelenska
description: Anastasia is the Guild Leader of Black Dragon.

name: Baek-Hyang Seo
description: The leader of the Demonic Faction from the story chosen for Floor 22.

name: Bambollina
description: Bambollina is the Guild Leader of Pantheon.

name: Nisha
description: Nisha is the Guild Leader of the United Merchants.

name: Liaofan
description: Liaofan is the Guild Leader of the Heavenly Order.

name: Marcus Calenbury
description:
~! 
Marcus is a Sword Saint 
!~

name: Hamustra
description: Hamustra is the constellation who manages from tower's 21st floor until 30th floor.

name: Preta
description: Preta also known as The Demon King of Fall Rain was the enemy boss of Tower's 20th floor.

name: Patricia
description: Patricia is the Guild Leader of City Security.

name: Hellfire Maiden
description: Hellfire Maiden is the boss monster on the 10th floor.

name: Sarbast Aegim
description: Sarbast Aegim is a NPC of SSS-geup Jugeoya Saneun Hunter.

name: Inori Yuitsuka
description: A 5th grade elementary student who loves figure skating so much she used to practice it in secret. Though she greatly lacks academic skill, when she's in the rink she's like a different person.

name: Tsukasa Akeuraji
description: He is a former ice dancer and now the coach of [Inori Yuitsuka](https://anilist.co/character/197151/Inori-Yuitsuka).

name: Hikaru Kamisaki
description: An orphan who was picked up by [Jun Yodaka](https://anilist.co/character/197164/Jun-Yodaka) and currently lives with [Rioh Sonidori](https://anilist.co/character/197158/Riou-Sonidori) and his mother. She is [Inori's](https://anilist.co/character/197151/Inori-Yuitsuka) rival who she promised with that they would compete against each other in the All-Japans.

name: Jun Yodaka
description: The coach of [Hikaru Kamisaki](https://anilist.co/character/197152/Kamisaki-Hikaru). He took Hikaru in as his skating disciple from a far away snowy land, but left the task of caring for her other needs to the Sonidori family.

name: Ryouka Miketa
description: One of [Inori's](https://anilist.co/character/197151/Inori-Yuitsuka) rivals. She is a 3rd grade girl in the Preliminary skating category with Inori. She looks up to "girlish" things and believes cats are the cutest things in the universe.

name: Riou Sonidori
description: Riou is a 5th grade elementary school student and member of Meikou Wind FSC. Son of Olympic silver medalist [Shinichirou Sonidori.](https://anilist.co/character/197159/Shinichirou-Sonidori)

name: Ema Yamato
description: Ema is a 4th grade elementary school student affiliated with Rengecha FSC. She was born in Kyoto and is long time friends with [Suzu.](https://anilist.co/character/209212/Suzu-Kamoto) Her cheeks are always red, and she is well behaved but not afraid to say what's on her mind. She is a hard worker who believes in actions over words. She is an only child and her tall height for her age makes her a motherly figure among her classmates. She doesn't dislike it, but she also likes Suzu treating her like a little sister.

name: Suzu Kamoto
description: Suzu is an elementary school student affiliated with Rengecha FSC. She won the silver medal in the All-Japan Novice B competition. She is the youngest of 4 sisters who have doted on her like a doll since a young age, causing her obsession with cuteness. She has an anti-aging plan for remaining cute, and constantly thinks about the philosophy of cuteness. If someone doesn't call her cute she will massage their face into a "Suzu face" and talk about the philosophy of cuteness for hours on end. She's hard on people who are hard on themselves and has cast-iron mental strength.

name: You Kago
description: You is the daughter of the Kago family who supported [Tsukasa's](https://anilist.co/character/197163/Tsukasa-Akeuraji) skating career.

name: Yuudai Jakuzure
description: [Ema Yamato](https://anilist.co/character/209214/Ema-Yamato)'s coach. He is a former mens' singles who was strong enough to participate in the free skate in several national events before his retirement. He was born in Osaka and in his junior years, he won several tournaments in the Kansai block. He is a free-wheeling man, when he encounters a problem, he prefers to take it slow and formulate a plan instead of using guts and attitude to tackle it. As a coach, he attempts to dress as close to an elementary school teacher as possible around his students.

name: Mamoru Sekoma
description: Receptionist at a local skating rink.

name: Hitomi Takamine
description: [Tsukasa's](https://anilist.co/character/197163/Tsukasa-Akeuraji) former Ice dance partner and a current skating coach at Lux Toyama FSC.

name: Mario Nachi
description: [Ryouka Miketa](https://anilist.co/character/197157/Ryouka-Miketa)'s coach. She's lively with lots of piercings, with her bold personality fading into bashfulness around people she doesn't know. She was formerly ranked in Japan's top 12 skaters for her high jumps, but she currently only has one student as a coach.

name: Shinichirou Sonidori
description: Head coach at Meikou Wind FSC and father of [Riou Sonidori](https://anilist.co/character/197158/Riou-Sonidori).

name: Mika Yuitsuka
description: [Inori's](https://anilist.co/character/197151/Inori-Yuitsuka) older sister. She used to be a figure skater but quit due to an injury.

name: Ritsuki Koguma
description: Ritsuka is a skater from Okayama who competed in a Level 1 meet against [Inori.](https://anilist.co/character/197151/Inori-Yuitsuka)

name: Nozomi Yuitsuka
description: [Inori's](https://anilist.co/character/197151/Inori-Yuitsuka) mother.

name: Meiko Kago
description: Meiko was the wife of [Kouichi Kago](https://anilist.co/character/197162/Kouichi-Kago) and sponsored [Tsukasa's](https://anilist.co/character/197163/Tsukasa-Akeuraji) skating career

name: Hitori Gotou
description: Gotou Hitori is a shy, gloomy high-schooler who started learning guitar after seeing rock bands on TV, in the hope that she too could become as popular as them. However, after 2 years she has yet to make a single friend or join a band. She instead sits in her closet at home, recording guitar covers and posting them to her YouTube channel, "guitarhero", on which she has amassed a reasonable following.

name: Nijika Ijichi
description: An energetic and cheerful second-year high school student. She is the drummer of Kessoku Band and the organizer who takes care of [Hitori](https://anilist.co/character/257562). She has an older sister, [Seika](https://anilist.co/character/289054), who is the manager of the live house "STARRY" and has a special feeling for the live house.

name: Ryou Yamada
description: A cool and solitary second year of high school. She is in charge of the bass of Kessoku Band. She's the best friend of [Nijika](https://anilist.co/character/261674). Her hobbies are out of the ordinary, and she rejoices when called a weirdo. She lives with a wealthy family, but she spends much of her money on instruments and always runs out of money. She occasionally eats weeds to get rid of her hunger.

name: Ikuyo Kita
description: A bright and popular first year of high school. She is in charge of the guitar and vocals of Kessoku Band. She is a cheerful character who likes to interact with people and can talk to her with a smile without hesitation, even when she meets her for the first time. She longs for [Ryo](https://anilist.co/character/264529), and her feelings can go too far. She often takes photos and uploads to Isosta.

name: Kikuri Hiroi
description:
Bassist and vocalist of the band "SICK HACK".

Always drunk to forget about life's downsides.

name: Seika Ijichi
description: Nijika's older sister and manager of the live house "STARRY".

name: PA-san
description:
__Height:__ 162cm

Mysterious looking female PA engineer with a mouth piercing. In her private life, she is active as a virtual Youtuber under the name "Otogi Alto" producing gameplay videos.

name: Jimihen
description: The Gotou family dog.

name: Futari Gotou
description: Hitori's younger sister.

name: Michiyo Gotou
description: Hitori and Futari's mother.

name: Naoki Gotou
description: Hitori and Futari's father.

name: Oscar François de Jarjayes
description:
Born the last of five daughters to the Commander of the Royal Guards, [General François Augustin Regnier de Jarjayes](https://anilist.co/character/8150/de-Jarjeyes-Regnier), she is raised by her father as if she were a boy in order to take his place and command the Royal Guards serving at Court after he retires. At the age of fourteen, as soon as her training in the basic military skills is complete, Oscar is given the task to protect the [Dauphine Marie Antoinette](https://anilist.co/character/1701/Antoinette-Marie) when she arrives at the French Court.

Despite being raised as if she were a boy and dressing in males' clothes, Oscar is open about being female. Even as she embraces her femininity, she uses her male position to gain freedoms that she could never have as a lady of the court.

~!She is the love interest of both [André Grandier](https://anilist.co/character/1699/Grandier-Andr), her servant at the Jarjayes mansion and afterwards a soldier in her regiment, and Marie Antoinette, who she acts as a bodyguard to. She also earns the admiration and love of [Rosalie Lamorlière](https://anilist.co/character/2924/Lamorliere-Rosalie), and in turn calls Rosalie her "spring breeze". Other women are infatuated with Oscar, even after she tells them she is female. She dislikes the court intrigues, but remains there out of loyalty to her father and her friend, Marie Antoinette. At one point, Oscar falls in love with [Fersen](https://anilist.co/character/2923/Fersen-Hans-Axel-von), who has a forbidden love for Marie Antoinette.!~

name: André Grandier
description: The friend of Oscar and the grandson of her nanny, André and Oscar learned the arts of fencing and horsemanship together when they were children. As they grew up, Oscar became the Dauphine's guard and the class gap between them widened.   He has been described as a "true working-class hero" by Helen McCarthy.   ~!André is secretly in love with Oscar, but he never tells her until both of them decide to help the insurgents when the French Revolution begins. Oscar initially refuses him and asks him to leave her but he stubbornly remains by her side until later on she admits to loving him back.  Later in the series, André loses sight in his left eye in order to save Oscar who had been captured by the Black Knight; his condition slowly worsens until he is completely blind.  André is a very sensitive and passionate man, suffering for his unrequited love for Oscar but being unable to quench his desire for her and vocally siding with the commoners in their plight.  Sadly André dies from a stray bullet the day after Oscar's declaration of love, able to share only one night of passion with the woman he lived for.!~

name: Marie Antoinette
description:
Marie Antoinette married the Dauphin to seal the alliance between his grandfather Louis XV and her mother, Empress Maria Theresa of Austria, when she was 14. After her marriage, she realizes that Madame du Barry, King Louis XV's mistress, is against her. The princess, horrified by what she had heard about du Barry, decides to never speak to her. Meanwhile, she meets Count von Fersen, who becomes her lover.    

Madame du Barry, always plotting against Marie Antoinette and Oscar, fulfils her desire to be greeted by her. After the death of Louis XV, Madame du Barry is condemned to die. Marie Antoinette, after several conflicts with her husband, starts feeling lonely. Fersen, who had left France on Oscar's advice, returns. Rumors swirl about the Queen and the Count, and Fersen leaves again. A depressed Marie Antoinette befriends the Duchess de Polignac. Polignac leads Marie Antoinette to her downfall.    

Marie Antoinette is described as a "lively, silly girl of shoujo manga".

name: Rosalie Lamorliere
description: Rosalie is the adoptive daughter of a commoner named Nicole Lamorlière. She is described as "a stereotypical good girl, sweet, obedient and timid". Her biological mother is the Duchess de Polignac, referred to as Martine Gabrielle. Nicole tells Rosalie the truth when she is dying after being hit by a carriage. Rosalie swears that she will kill the person in the carriage that killed her mother. She tries to kill Oscar's mother, Lady Jarjayes, because she thought Lady Jarjayes was in the carriage, but Oscar stops Rosalie. Oscar decides to help her, and she teaches Rosalie the art of fencing, manners, history, and other courtly skills. Rosalie comes to admire and love Oscar greatly.

name: Jeanne de la Motte
description:
Jeanne Valois de la Motte, descendent of Valois family, daughter of Nicole Lamorlière and adoptive sister of Rosalie Lamorliere. While she grew up in poor conditions, Jeanne is aware that she is of noble birth. She eventually grew tired of living in horrible conditions and was able to work her way into the home of a wealthy woman who was aware of Jeanne's noble family.

While she gained pity from Marie Antoinette, the money she gave Jeanne, according to her, was not enough for her lifestyle. Finally at her breaking point, Jeanne decides that she actually wants to become queen of France and plotted to frame Marie Antoinette, when she finds out about the diamond necklace that the late king was making for Madame du Barry was finally finished, that's when she devised a plot that would become the most famous crime in French history, the Affair of the Diamond Necklace.

name: Alain de Soisson
description: Alain was the sergeant of the Company B, the troops assigned to Lady Oscar's service in the National Guard. He accepted Oscar at first, and even befriended André and smuggled him in the troops, but after learning the truth about her he violently rejected her leadership. Oscar had to fight him to win Alain and the group's respect back, since they refused to be ordered around by a noble. After losing to Oscar and begging her to save the life of a companion who was about to be executed, which she did, Alain forgave Oscar and became fiercely devoted to her, even falling in love with her in the manga; still, he knew he couldn't fight against her feelings for André.    (Source: wikipedia)

name: Hans Axel von Fersen
description: A handsome Swedish aristocrat who comes to the court of Versailles and becomes involved in a forbidden romance with queen Marie Antoinette.  He was Oscar's best friend. It is revealed in the series that Oscar also has strong feelings for Fersen.

name: Jeanne Becu du Barry
description: Lover of King Louis XV. She became enemy of Princess Marie Antoinette.

name: Victor Clement de Girodelle
description: Second in charge of the Royal Guard after [Lady Oscar](https://anilist.co/character/1700/Oscar-Franois-de-Jarjayes).

name: Marron Grasset Montblanc
description: Oscar's nanny and Andre's grandmother.

name: Louis 16-sei
description: Prince of France and heir to the French throne. He married the Austrian princess Marie Antoinette to confirm the pact agreed between Louis XV and Maria Theresa. He became King of France after his grandfather's death.    He was a gentle, mild. He likes sumo wrestling very much in Berubara kids.     (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Charlotte de Polignac
description: Daughter of the Lady Polignac.      ~!She committed suicide after knowing that she would marry the Duke of Guiche.!~    (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Bernard Chatelet
description: Newspaper reporter from Paris. Followed Robespierre like a shadow. (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Maria Theresa
description: Mother of Marie Antoinette.

name: Nicolas de la Motte Taii
description: Jeanne's husband.  He's also apart of the Royal Guards; Oscar is his commander.

name: Orleans Kou Philippe
description: Cousin of Louis XVI who secretly tried to usurp the throne. Second in row to the throne of France. Mastermind in the plot to kidnap Marie Antoinette before she could marry prince Louis XVI, but after it failed thanks to Lady Oscar's intervention, he tried to kill the Prince and make it seem like an accident by switching the rifle Prince Louis XVI used for hunting with a tampered one that would explode once triggered. Later in the story, Duke de Orleans, because of his liberal ideas, lets anti-monarchists like the Black Knight (a masked French Robin Hood) and his followers secretly gather in his Palais Royale.    (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Louis 15-sei
description: King of France and grandfather of Louis XVI. He died at the Palace of Versailles of smallpox.

name: Jarjeyes-fujin
description: Oscar's mother.

name: Aoba Tsukishima
description: The third daughter of the Tsukishima family, one year younger than Kou and Wakaba. Aoba is jealous of how much time Wakaba spends with Kou, and frequently tells Kou how much she hates him. She is an excellent pitcher, Kou modeling after her. She has a poster of Ryota Igarashi, a famous fastball pitcher, hanging on her bedroom wall, and says she is only interested in a guy who can pitch a fastball at 160 km/h (about 100 mph). She loves to pitch in practice games, even though as a girl she cannot play in official baseball. However, she rarely shows her real speed, as most catchers can't handle it. Her name means "blue leaf". Upon entering high school, she has joined the baseball team, despite saying previously she would not.

name: Kou Kitamura
description:
In 5th grade in Part One, enters Seishuu High School at the start of Part Two. Kou lives down the street from the Tsukishima family and is treated like one of the family when he visits their house, batting cage, or coffee shop. He has been practically inseparable from [Wakaba](https://anilist.co/character/13285/Tsukishima-Wakaba) since their birth on the same day in the same hospital. While he shows little interest in baseball to outsiders, he has practiced daily at the Tsukishima Batting Center since he was old enough to swing a bat, enough so he is an excellent batter, especially against fastballs.

~! After Wakaba's death, Kou is inspired by [Aoba](https://anilist.co/character/13286/Tsukishima-Aoba)'s excellent pitching form to become a great pitcher himself, and secretly adopts Aoba's daily training regimen. Although he doesn't play baseball in junior high, his friends convince him to join the high school baseball club. Because Kou and his friends don't take the placement test, they are put on the second string team (called the "prefab" team). With his changeup fastball, he becomes a well-known ace pitcher in the eastern conference. !~

name: Yuuhei Azuma
description: Position: First baseman   Younger brother of Junpei Azuma, in the same year as Kō. Yūhei was brought over to Seishū High School by Coach Daimon to play in his first-string team. He is an excellent batter, so he is the current cleanup hitter at Seishū. He has trouble recalling other people's names and faces, stating that he only remembers people that are worth caring for, but he apparently remembers Kō Kitamura. He has lost some of his confidence in Coach Daimon and the baseball team at the end of his first year, but seeing Kō's abilities during the practice game convinces him to stay in Seishū after Daimon is sacked.   Yūhei's obsession to reach Kōshien is due to his guilt towards Junpei Azuma, his older brother. Junpei injured his leg, ending his rising baseball career, while saving Yūhei from falling down a staircase. The guilt of ending his brother's career turns his desire to reach Kōshien into obsession. Also, since then, Yūhei has been very sensitive towards children who are playing around stairs and matters of when a person's recklessness effects more then themselves. Because of that, he is shown initially to be very cold and uncaring towards people around him, as he is only concerned with reaching Kōshien. He gradually begins to enjoy the game more, becoming less stern on outcome and more on performance, and make friends as Junpei's happiness becomes more sincere throughout the series; turning Kōshien more and more to a personal dream or goal rather then a amends to his brother. He has stated that he has romantic interests in Aoba.   (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Wakaba Tsukishima
description: Second daughter of the Tsukishima family, in 5th grade in Part One. Through their childhood, Wakaba is constantly with Kou. She constantly talks about their future together, even giving him a schedule of suggested future birthday gifts that includes an engagement ring for her 20th birthday. She frequently kisses Kou, which annoys their mutual friend Akaishi, who has a secret crush on her. For several birthdays in a row, Wakaba gives Kou alarm clocks because he has a hard time waking up in the morning.

name: Mitsuru Adachi
description: Mitsuru Adachi is in fact the mangaka of Touch, Miyuki and several other famous manga.  He makes casual appearances throughout a lot of his own manga as comedic relief.  He is often seen being disciplined by his editor and uses a lot of jokes, most of them dealing with manga deadlines.

name: Osamu Akaishi
description: Position: Catcher   Akaishi is a childhood friend of Kō and Wakaba, the same age as them. In Part One, he has a crush on Wakaba and is jealous of the time Kō spends with her. In elementary school, he was kept from pitching on his Little League team because he got into fights with opposing teams. He was able to throw a 100 km/h fastball while in elementary school, but Kō could hit a home run off one of his pitches. However, since Wakaba's death, he plays as a catcher to fulfill Wakaba's last dream in which he and Kō reach Kōshien with him being the catcher and Kō the pitcher. He is currently have feelings for Akane who look a lot like Wakaba. Because he did not take the placement test for the baseball club, he is on the prefab team with Kō. His father owns a liquor/sake store.   (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Momiji Tsukishima
description: Fourth and youngest daughter of the Tsukishima family. She is in kindergarten during Part One, and in 5th grade at the start of Part Two. Although she lost her mother at a very young age, she has a happy, energetic, and outgoing personality. Despite their difference in ages, Momiji and Kō have a friendly, sibling-like relationship. She catches for him when he practices pitching. Once, while playing catch, Aoba apologizes for throwing the ball so hard and Momiji says she is used to it as Kō's pitches are harder—to Aoba's surprise. Momiji grows up to resemble her older sister Wakaba, which surprises Akaishi the first time he meets her. Her name means "maple leaf."

name: Akane Takigawa
description:
Akane bears an uncanny resemblance to [Wakaba Tsukishima](https://anilist.co/character/13285/Tsukishima-Wakaba). Her parents opened a soba restaurant next to Kitamura Sporting Goods shortly after Seishū's loss to Ryuō. She is an excellent artist, and won the grand prize of the Kōshien Poster Art Competition, using [Aoba](https://anilist.co/character/13286/Tsukishima-Aoba) as the model.

She is currently enrolled in Seisen Private Girl's Academy and is employed at Coffee Clover. She has suffered from an unknown disease since childhood and is often admitted into the hospital for various tests. She has stated that she is dating [Kō Kitamura](https://anilist.co/character/13230/Kitamura-Kou), but she seems to be very caring towards [Akaishi](https://anilist.co/character/21681/Akaishi-Osamu) as well.

name: Junpei Azuma
description: Position: Batting Coach   Older brother to Yūhei Azuma, he was once a star pitcher and cleanup batter for Takao Jitsugyo High School. He was on the verge of winning the regional finals to reach Kōshien, as well as being observed by pro team scouts, but was forced to quit baseball after sustaining a career-stopping leg injury while saving Yūhei from falling down a staircase. He runs a produce delivery service, and is currently acting as the batting coach for Seishū's baseball team. This is because Ichiyō, whom he is romantically involved with, has promised to marry him if Seishū makes it to Kōshien.   (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Nomo
description: The Tsukishima's black-and-white cat. He is named after Hideo Nomo, a former right-handed pitcher in Nippon Professional Baseball and Major League Baseball from Japan.

name: Tatsumasa Miki
description: Position: Center Fielder, Pitcher   One of the ringers that Coach Daimon brings in. He is an excellent batter and plays in center field. However, he was demoted to bench-warmer after defying Daimon's orders to make the correct play. After the subsequent fallout with Coach Daimon, he transferred to Sena Municipal High School, becoming their ace pitcher and cleanup batter. He was also acting as a player-coach in his new school, since its baseball club did not have a proper coach. He eventually led his school to victory against his former coach's new school, Kurokoma Jitsugyō.   (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Ichiyou Tsukishima
description: First daughter of the Tsukishima family. At the start of Part Two, she is in her third year of college. After her mother's death, she has run the Tsukishima household, acting as a surrogate mother for her sisters. She treats Kō like a younger brother. Her cooking is generally good, though she sometimes makes something wrong. She likes Junpei Azuma, but has trouble expressing her feelings to him directly. Her name means "first leaf".

name: Daiki Nakanishi
description: Position: First baseman, Third baseman   A member of the Seishū High School baseball club, in the same year as Kō and Akaishi. He likes Kō, but has a rocky relationship with him ever since elementary school, when Kō convinced he and his friends to buy a lot of brand new baseball equipment from the Kitamura store. In compensation, Nakanishi forces Kō to learn the basics of baseball (outside of hitting). He joins the baseball club in junior high, but quits after three months, getting into a bloody fight with the slacking seniors. However, he keeps training after leaving the club. He joins the baseball club in high school, but like Kō and Akaishi he does not take the placement test and is placed on prefab team. While he plays catcher in elementary school, in high school he originally plays first baseman before switching to third baseman as Azuma joins as first baseman.

name: Keiichirou Senda
description: Position: Shortstop   A member of the Seishū baseball club, in the same year as Kō. He is the only first-year student to pass the baseball club placement test, and therefore on the first-string team. Because of this, he frequently brags about how good he must be. Coach Maeda comments that Senda is too much of a showoff to be a good pitcher, but that he would likely make a great shortstop. He constantly pursues Aoba, trying to get her to date him. After making too many errors as pitcher, he is demoted to the prefab team, where he plays shortstop. After the sacking of coach Daimon, he becomes the starting player in Seishū baseball team. His appearance and personality are similar to Ryūtaro Kine from H2.   (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Sentarou Maeno
description: The current head coach of the Seishū baseball team. Because he has coached Seishū for so long, he is well-known and has a lot of influence with other coaches in the region. He is known to be a very lenient and 'weak' coach. He tends to prioritize the enjoyment of the game over victories, hence he always prioritizes the third-years in competitions.

name: Seiji Tsukishima
description: Owner of Tsukishima Batting Center and the Clover coffee shop, and father of Ichiyo, Wakaba, Aoba, and Momiji. Both his wife and second daughter have died, but he is very nice and a worldly man. During high school, he played catcher on a team that went to Kōshien.

name: Hiroko Oukubo
description: Manager of the prefab team, one year ahead of Kō. Despite being called "chubby" by some of the players, she has a kind heart and is a very hard worker. Just like Risa Shido, she is also a former foreign exchange student. However, as opposed to the arrogant Risa Shido, she is humble and down-to-earth. She is the granddaughter of the Seishu board chairman, but she never takes advantage of that fact.   (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Makihara
description: Position: Third baseman   A member of the prefab team of the Seishū baseball club, two years ahead of Kō. He is always late. He did not get along with Nakanishi in junior high, and frequently pushed him around. He is jealous of Kō's abilities and lets it affect how he plays. He retires after the first practice game against the first-string team.   (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Risa Shidou
description:
Position: Manager   Manager of the first string team under Coach Daimon, one year ahead of Kō, and daughter of the stand-in principal. She is a former foreign exchange student who recently returned to Japan. As she considers herself to be above the baseball players, she does not do any work and treats the team (especially the prefab members) as her personal servants. Despite being the manager of the first-string team, she has very little interest in or knowledge of baseball. During the rematch practice game between the first-string and prefab teams, she is on a vacation in Europe. When the regular principal returns, she is fired from the team and she begins working at her mother's boutique. Even after her parents divorce, she still tries to use their influence to get ahead. After she successfully passes an audition for a role in a TV drama, she quits the baseball team altogether and sets up her own fans club in school. However, she is shown to have a little bit of guilty conscience for never doing anything useful for the team as a manager.  

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Toshio Miya
description: Position: Left fielder   A member of the prefab team of the Seishū baseball club, in the year ahead of Kō. Toshio is an excellent bunter and very good at squeeze plays as well fielding. His playing helps keep the first-string team from allowing too many runs during their practice games. He was promoted into captain in his third year after Coach Daimon is sacked.   (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Kyoko Nakagawa
description: Nakanishi's girlfriend. She often asks Aoba for personal baseball matches, so she can improve.

name: Youko Tsukishima
description: Seiji's wife and mother of the four Tsukishima sisters. She died when Momiji was very young.

name: Kensaku Kitamura
description: Kou's father, owner of Kitamura Sporting Goods. He is a fan of the Tokyo Yakult Swallows baseball team.

name: Kimie Kitamura
description: Kou's mother. Aoba loves her korokke, and frequently visits the Kitamuras to obtain them.

name: Nanachi
description:
**Species**: Narehate

Nanachi is a Narehate — a person who’s survived the 6th layer’s Curse of the  Abyss and has been left deformed as a result. Unlike other Narehates, Nanachi has retained a sound mind, possessing vast knowledge of the Abyss — its ecosystem, vegetation and even the use of the medicines. Their gender is ambiguous, often using the gender-neutral pronoun "oira." when referring to themself.

Most of the time, Nanachi is cool and reserved, keeping their distance emotionally and physically. Their attitude often borders on being sarcastic and even cynical. However, behind this mask, Nanachi hides a kind and gentle soul, capable of deep compassion and selfless devotion. They are also quite bashful when complimented, seen in their reaction to being called "fluffy". They also express discomfort at being petted, especially by  [Reg](https://anilist.co/character/122444/Reg).

name: Bondrewd
description:
Bondrewd is a legendary white whistle delver who has made many great discoveries about the secrets of the Abyss. A researcher fascinated by the Abyss, he has often resorted to illegal and morally questionable means to get funds for and conduct his research, including selling artifacts illicitly, developing dangerous drugs, and even experimenting on living humans. Though how cruel, he still cared for the kids and people he brutally experimented on.

His methods went against all the ethical principles of delvers, but he was allowed to continue due to his outstanding results. Ten years ago, he did the unthinkable by establishing a large base named the Idofront in the deepest area within the 5th Layer of the Abyss, as well as securing a route to the then-inviolable 6th layer.

~!During one of his experiments researching the Curse of the Abyss, Bondrewd offered children who wanted to unravel the secrets of the Abyss to come with him to the Ido Front. However, he never told them openly that they were going to be used as test subjects. Among the children were Nanachi and Mitty. As Bondrewd continued testing, more and more children were used up in his experiments until only Nanachi and Mitty were left. On his final test, he used both of them, resulting in Mitty being hit with the Curse of the Abyss, while Nanachi received the Blessing.!~

name: Reg
description:
Reg is a robotic being who appears to be a little boy. His actual age, origins, and even name are unknown because he cannot recall anything about his life before his encounter with [Riko](https://anilist.co/character/122443/Riko). He is named after a dog Riko used to have. Having a seemingly artificial body, Reg might be the only being completely immune to the Curse of the Abyss. Because of this, he is sometimes referred to as "The Treasure of the Deep."

Reg’s body is extremely durable, even to the point that [Ozen the Immovable](https://anilist.co/character/122464/Ouzen) couldn’t break him even when slamming him into the floor with all her strength. Despite his high durability, Reg is agile and weighs little. His wounds heal at a faster rate than a human’s, and has a very high pain tolerance. His senses of smell and hearing are strong, one comparable to a dog. His arms can extend up to 40 meters each and can shoot them to the top of cliffs or grab things very far away. The cords attached are very durable. He is also equipped with an incinerator, which is a powerful incendiary cannon built into his hands and feet, emitting a beam of light, indicating the area to eliminate, penetrating through objects. Objects within the range of the light break apart and are absorbed into the spinning axes. The incinerator is connected to the Abyss in an unknown way, having the power to rewrite the rules of the Abyss. Reg passes out for 2 hours upon use, but it can be fired multiple times in the 10-minute deadline, and can also be set to not affect living beings.

Despite being a formidable fighter, Reg is rather shy, naive, and unassertive. He blushes easily and often cries when in distress. However, when forced into danger or an unpleasant situation, he is shown to be hot-tempered and sharp, compared to Riko's analytic, noncombatant role. Regardless of his skittishness, Reg has made it his sworn duty to protect Riko and doesn't hesitate to put up a fight when she is in harm's way. According to Ozen, the way he speaks and handles his body is similar to [Lyza](https://anilist.co/character/122465/Lyza). One of his favorite words to say is "irredeemable," which was a word that Lyza often said.

name: Ouzen
description:
Ouzen the Immovable is an elite White Whistle who lives at the Observation Base on the second level of the Abyss where she commands a small team of cave raiders known as "The Layabouts." Ouzen was a mentor and a close friend of [Riko](https://anilist.co/character/122443/Riko)'s mother [Lyza](https://anilist.co/character/122465/Lyza).

Ouzen is a peerless fighter—her unique relic "Thousand Pins" grants her superhuman strength, speed and longevity (even though Ouzen appears to be young, she's attained the rank of a white whistle more than 50 years back). She's over 2 meters tall and has a peculiar hairstyle which conceals the scalp deformations caused by the extended exposure to the Curse of the Abyss.

Ouzen has absolute control over her facial expressions and her actual feelings (or lack thereof) cannot be guessed with any certainty. The reasons behind her actions are unknowable as well—Ouzen rarely bothers to explain herself and even when she does it's impossible to know whether she's telling the truth or just toying with the audience.

name: Riko
description:
**Occupation**: Delver
**Relatives**: [Lyza](https://anilist.co/character/122465/Lyza) (mother), [Torka](https://anilist.co/character/161856/Torka) (father)

Riko is the only child of the legendary White Whistle [Lyza](https://anilist.co/character/122465/Lyza), the Annihilator. When she was two, her mother began her last dive to the bottom of the abyss. She was left under the care of the Belchero Orphanage. Her dream is to become a White Whistle, a legendary type of  Delver, and explore the depths of the abyss to learn its many secrets and find her mother.

Riko is a good-natured, joyful, and energetic child. She has a quick and inquisitive mind, gathering and properly organizing all the information available on subjects that interest her. Growing up, she diligently studied to become a Delver like her mother was, enchanted by its mysteries and secrets. By the age of twelve, she had become an Apprentice Delver with the right to explore the shallowest level of the abyss on her own. Compared to [Reg](https://anilist.co/character/122444/Reg), she is fragile and lacking in physical prowess. However, her ability to keep a cool head under pressure to make rational decisions allows her to tackle the abyss.

name: Prushka
description:
__Species__: Human

Prushka is the adoptive daughter of the White Whistle Delver [Bondrewd](https://anilist.co/character/122463/Bondrewd). She lives with him at the Forward Operation Base.

Prushka is a cheerful and amiable girl who loves her adoptive father very much. She is incredibly devoted to him and would do anything to help him, holding him in higher regard than anyone else. Having lived the majority of her life in the 5th layer, she developed a strong curiosity for exploring and was fascinated by tales of others' travels through the Abyss. She is adventurous and quite brave, going on her own adventures through the 5th layer behind her father's back.

Due to her horrible past and the influence of her father, she developed an amazing mental fortitude, and became very obstinate, to the point of being willing to challenge the curse of the 5th layer multiple times just to learn more about it.

name: Mitty
description:
**Species**: Narehate

Mitty is an amorphous Narehate who lived with Nanachi on the 4th layer of the Abyss. Mitty had been a regular human girl in the past and her appearance changed due to the result of the ascension from the 6th layer.

~!In Ilblu, it is revealed that Belaf paid compensation to have an exact replica of Mitty born into the village from the time a "masked man" brought her along to the village. This reproduction even has an exact copy of Mitty's soul from that moment in time.!~

name: Marulk
description: Ozen's assistant and a Blue Whistle Diver.

name: Lyza
description: Lyza the Annihilator is a legendary White Whistle who accomplished many great discoveries about the secrets of the Abyss. She is [Ozen's](https://anilist.co/character/122464/Ouzen) apprentice and [Riko's](https://anilist.co/character/122443/Riko) mother.

name: Yelme
description: Moon Whistle and a member of Ozen's expedition team. He is currently stationed at the Seeker Camp in the 2nd layer.

name: Simred
description: Black Whistle and a member of Ozen's expedition team. He is currently stationed at the Seeker Camp in the 2nd layer.

name: Ilim
description: Ilim is one of the children brought down in the depths of the abyss by white whistle Bondrewd, together with Mitty and Nanachi. Later on, it's highly likely that she is one of the Narehate seen in the sixth layer of the abyss.

name: Zapo-jii
description: Blue Whistle and a member of Ozen's expedition team. He is currently stationed at the Seeker Camp in the 2nd layer.

name: Tankutsuka
description:
A Black Whistle who had a chance encounter with Reg in the 4th layer.
~!Reg and Nanachi save his life by fighting a deadly Abyss monster that was about to kill him. After this, Reg tells him to send a message up to Jiruo!~

name: Rin Shima
description: A solo camper who started camping due to her grandfather’s influence. She experiences camping with another person for the first time when she meets [Nadeshiko](https://anilist.co/character/124576/Kagamihara-Nadeshiko). She’s not a member of the outdoor crew, but she worries about Nadeshiko a bit.

name: Nadeshiko Kagamihara
description: A member of the outdoor crew at high school, she’s drawn into camping when she meets [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/124586/Shima-Rin) at a lake shore. She’s always cheerful and positive and loves anything fun.

name: Narrator
description:
This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. 

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

name: Aoi Inuyama
description:
A gentle girl who speaks with a Kansai accent. Of the reckless outdoor crew members, Aoi is like the secret leader who looks out for everyone during important times. She’s called 'Inuko' by [Chiaki](https://anilist.co/character/124578).

(Source: Honey's Anime)

name: Chiaki Oogaki
description:
A bright and active person, in charge of choosing the camping spots and gear. She’s lively and cheerful, but is also full of emotion and easily brought to tears. Wanting to camp, she forms the outdoor crew with [Aoi](https://anilist.co/character/124577).

(Source: Honey's Anime)

name: Ena Saitou
description: Rin’s friend, a free spirited person who goes at her own pace. She’s not a member of the outdoor crew, but she occasionally shows interest in their activities. She also gives casual advice to Rin, who is bad at dealing with people. She has a dog called 'Chikuwa.'

name: Sakura Kagamihara
description: Sakura Kagamihara is the older sister of [Nadeshiko Kagamihara](https://anilist.co/character/124576). She often drives Nadeshiko to and from campsite destinations.

name: Ayano Toki
description: Ayano Toki is [Nadeshiko's](https://anilist.co/character/124576/Nadeshiko-Kagamihara) childhood friend.

name: Minami Toba
description:
A substitute teacher, soon become the advisor for Outdoor Activities Club.

It is later revealed that she has already met Nadeshiko and Rin. ~!She was seen drinking incredible amounts of booze while camping with her little sister.!~

name: Chikuwa
description: Chikuwa is Ena's pet dog.

name: Hajime Shinshiro
description: Rin's grandfather, who passed his passion for camping on to his granddaughter.

name: Saki Shima
description: [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/124586/Rin-Shima)'s mother.

name: Akari Inuyama
description: Younger sister of [Aoi Inuyama](https://anilist.co/character/124577/).

name: Shizuka Kagamihara
description: The mother of Nadeshiko and Sakura Kagamihara.

name: Wataru Shima
description: Rin's father.

name: Shuuichirou Kagamihara
description: The father of [Nadeshiko](https://anilist.co/character/124576/Nadeshiko-Kagamihara) and [Sakura](https://anilist.co/character/125023/Sakura-Kagamihara) Kagamihara.

name: Sim-Cheong
description: Sim-Cheong is a beggar girl. She lost her mother when she was only 7 days old, and lives with her blind father, who she provides food for through her begging.

name: Manim
description:
Madam is the new wife of the village minister. She is initially seen as a beautiful bride, but then is suspected to be a fox when her husband falls sick and the Indangsu river  does not allow pass of ships. She is found and saved by Cheong in the river when she falls off a boat that her brother uses to catch 'the golden turtle' which they gift to the minister instead of a dowry. She invites Cheong to the mansion to help care for the minister, and the two begin to share a deep bond, becoming romantic over time. 

~!The minister's son and his subordinates blamed her for bringing 'the golden turtle' out of the river which was fed to the minister who fell sick and eventually died. They claimed that it angered the Dragoon King which was why the Indangsu river would not allow for passage. She was to be sacrificed as a virgin bride for the Dragon King, but her nanny lied and said her marriage with the minister was already consummated thus she was not the appropriate sacrifice. Instead she invited Cheong with the intention of making her into a maiden fit to be the sacrifice for the Dragon King. However she soon began to fall for Cheong, only feeling happy and truly free from the burdens that society had forced upon her for being a woman when she was with her. She realised that she only cared to be with Cheong and was willing to abandon her life in the mansion and go against what she had been taught from a young age- to be always be submissive, devoted and stripped away of her own personality and will in order to be loved. She used to believe that it was being loved that gave her the power she needed to survive, before meeting Cheong who inspired her and gave her the strength to be truly strong. She ended up killing the minister's son in self defence, and valiantly risking her life as she attempted to save Cheong from being thrown into the river.!~

name: Ppaengdeong Eomi
description: A single mother whose son was severely burned in a fire that broke out while she was working. She looks after [Shim Cheong](https://anilist.co/character/147644/Shim-Cheong) and is a fortune teller.

name: Yor Forger
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm
__Occupation:__ City Hall Clerk, Assassin (Covertly)
__Affiliation:__ Berlint City Hall, Garden (Covertly)
__Relatives:__ [Loid Forger](https://anilist.co/character/138101/Loid-Forger) (Husband), [Anya Forger](https://anilist.co/character/138100/Anya-Forger) (Adoptive Daughter), [Yuuri Briar](https://anilist.co/character/150425/Yuuri-Briar) (Younger Brother)

Yor Forger is the tritagonist of the SPY x FAMILY series. She is a clerical employee at the Berlint City Hall. She is soft-spoken and mild-mannered, but has a strong sense of humor. She has a bad drinking habit and falls into a coma when she drinks. At home, she struggles to be a good wife and a kind mother. Although her cooking skills are not very good, she likes to keep clean and is good at cleaning.
While she works in the capital of Ostania's city hall... or at least that's her civilian cover. In truth, she is an infamous Professional Killer known as "Thorn Princess". After becoming overly fixated on the idea her cover might be blown after a coworker ribs her about not being married or even having a boyfriend, Yor suggests to Loid a Marriage of Convenience, which he accepts, as he needs a mother for Anya for his own mission.

~!As of Mission (Chapter) 44, it is revealed that Yor is part of Garden, a powerful paramilitary assassin organization operating within Ostania.!~

name: Anya Forger
description: __Height:__ 99.5 cm (3'2") __Occupation:__ First-Grade Student, Test Subject (Formerly) __Affiliation:__ Eden Academy, Unknown Organization (Formerly) __Relatives:__ Loid Forger (Adoptive Father), Yor Forger (Adoptive Mother) Anya Forger is the deuteragonist of the SPY x FAMILY series. She is a young girl who Twilight finds at an orphanage. Believing her to be a smart child, he decides to adopt her for his mission. What he doesn't know is that Anya is an esper who escaped from the Lab that gave her the power to read minds. Starving for excitement in her life after spending most of it so far in a lab, Anya actively sought to be the one adopted by Loid and then make sure Loid and Yor got together, so she could have a spy and assassin for parents. Anya is the only Forger aware of just about everyone's Secret Identities, but keeps it to herself out of fear that if her psychic powers are exposed she'll be put in a lab again.

name: Loid Forger
description: __Height:__ 187 cm __Occupation:__ Psychiatrist, Spy (Covertly) __Affiliation:__ Berlint General Hospital, WISE (Covertly) __Relatives:__ Yor Forger (Wife), Anya Forger (Adoptive Daughter) Loid Forger is the main protagonist of the SPY x FAMILY series. He is the top spy of the Westalian Intelligence Bureau, who is only known by his code name Twilight. In order to investigate the activities of a highly ranked politician, Donovan Desmond, Twilight has assumed the identity of a psychiatrist named Loid Forger. Further, to appear like a normal family man and get close to his target, Loid then adopted a young orphan girl, Anya, and entered a Marriage of Convenience with an Ostanian woman named Yor Briar... who unknown to Twilight are themselves a Telepath and Professional Killer respectively.

name: Bond
description: Bond is the recently adopted pet of the Forger Family. Formally known as Subject 8, Bond has been used for experiments that resulted in the dog gaining precognition abilities.

name: Damian Desmond
description:
__Height:__ 110 cm (3′7″)
__Affiliation:__ Desmond Family, Eden Academy, Cecile Hall
__Occupation:__ Student

The second son of [Donovan Desmond](https://anilist.co/character/180192/Desmond-Donovan) and attends Eden Academy as part of Cecile House, Group 3.  

A young child with an arrogant and rude personality, caused by him being the second son of Donovan Desmond, the leader of the National Unity Party, a group important and powerful enough to threaten the peace between the East and the West. This has caused Damian to gain a highly respected status among his peers and making him incredibly arrogant, assuming [Anya](https://anilist.co/character/138100/Forger-Anya) gained a crush on him when she stared at him. He is shown to prefer being called Lord Damian when spoken to. He gets angry when he is looked down upon by Anya's smile, quickly resorting to insulting her with his limited vocabulary and harassing Anya.

name: Fiona Frost
description:
__Height:__ 172 cm
__Occupation:__ Hospital Assistant (secretly a spy)

A spy who works undercover as an assistant to [Loid Forger](https://anilist.co/character/138101/Loid-Forger) at Berlint General Hospital to provide him with mission details. Fiona is deeply in love with Loid, even telling Loid to replace [Yor](https://anilist.co/character/138102/Forger-Yor) and let her take over the role of the Forger wife.

name: Yuuri Briar
description:
__Height:__ 179 cm (5′10")
__Affiliation:__ Ostania, Ministry for Foreign Affairs (Cover), State Security Service
__Occupation:__ Diplomat (Formerly, Cover), Counterintelligence Agent

Yor Briar's younger brother who works in the State Security Service (SSS). He keeps his job at the SSS a secret from Yor, while pretending to be a normal civil servant at the foreign ministry.

Yuri has a sister-complex, and even at an early age, he would be doing everything he could to get Yor to praise him with affection. Though this could be due to his mother dying at a very early stage in his life causing him to get very attached to Yor as a mother figure.

name: Becky Blackbell
description:
__Affiliation:__ Blackbell Family, Blackbell Heavy Industries, Eden Academy, Cecile Hall
__Occupation:__ Student

The daughter of the CEO of Blackbell, a major military manufacturer. Attends Eden Academy as part of Cecil House, Group 3. Best friends with [Anya Forger](https://anilist.co/character/138100/Forger-Anya).

Becky is a very kind child but with her being the daughter of a major military manufacturer, she is shown to be somewhat prideful and tries to be mature, attempting to take Anya under her wing as an act of benevolence when she views Anya as a brat. She does not attempt to get close to [Damian Desmond](https://anilist.co/character/150424/Desmond-Damian) despite his social position, even looking down on their classmates who try to befriend Damian and Anya who is initially bullied by Damian's group. Anya's confident smile later wins over Becky's admiration.

name: Franky Franklin
description:
__Height:__ 166 cm (5′5")
__Affiliation:__ Ostania
__Occupation:__ Tobacco Store Clerk (False Front), Informant, Soldier (formerly)

Franky is an informant who seemingly works at a tobacco store and presumably works for Loid Forger's agency. He gets information regarding Eden Academy's exam and Anya Forger's past records for Loid Forger.

Franky is a kind person willing to help Loid out when he's in a pinch even though the danger is high. He frequently warns Loid Forger not to get too close to other people in their line of work.

He frequently falls in love with other women but his love life typically fails due to lack of mutual interest or they are already with someone else.

name: Sylvia Sherwood
description:
__Height:__ 173 cm

She is [Twilight](https://anilist.co/character/138101/Forger-Loid)'s main contact at WISE.

name: Henry Henderson
description:
__Affiliation:__ Eden Academy
__Occupation:__ History Teacher, Housemaster of Cecile Hall

Henry is a mature and noble person, who places a high importance on "elegance". To him, elegance seems to be the way a person conducts themselves, and is not afraid to correct inelegant behavior in others.

name: Martha Marriott
description: Butler of the Blackbell family and typically acts as [Becky's](https://anilist.co/character/150423) caretaker.

name: Melinda Desmond
description: Mother to [Damian](https://anilist.co/character/150424/) and wife to [Donovan](https://anilist.co/character/180192/)

name: Camilla
description: One of Yor Forger's three co-workers at Berlint City Hall.

name: Bill Watkins
description: The 6-year-old son of a major in the National Army who attends Eden Academy as part of Wald Hall. He was given the nickname "Bazooka Bill" by his peers for his mental and physical domination in sports since nursery school.

name: Bondman
description: The protagonist of Spy Wars and the number one spy in the show. He frequently has to take down enemies from the League of Evil in order to save Princess Honey.

name: Emile Elman
description: Best Friend of Damian and Student at Eden Academy.

name: Ewen Egeburg
description: Best Friend of Damian and Student at Eden Academy. He is a loyal person, devotedly following Damian, almost always holding his bag when they walk to class. He also genuinely cares for Damian as a friend, getting concerned for Damian when he is hurt or pushing himself too hard.

name: Shinonome
description: An Ostanian spy who thinks of himself as a rival to [Twilight](https://anilist.co/character/138101/Loid-Forger). He is shown to be a highly untalented, yet lucky, spy.

name: George Glooman
description: A student at Eden Academy and a member of Cecile Hall. He is the son of the CEO of Glooman Pharmaceuticals, a company later bought by the Desmond Group.

name: Donovan Desmond
description: Donovan Desmond is the President of the Nation Unity Party and Twilight's current target.

name: Keith Kepler
description: The leader of a terrorist group consisting of isolationist college students from Berlint University, intending on assassinating Foreign Minister Brantz to start a war between Westalis and Ostania.

name: Isaki Magari
description:
A cheerful high school girl who also suffers from insomnia like Ganta. She first discovered the abandoned observatory and made it her sleeping haven, until Ganta came along. 

~!As she and Ganta became closer, she shared to him that she has congenital heart disease which requires monthly examinations, frequent hospitalization, and even surgeries. She was the only other member of the Astronomy Club in her first year, and became the vice-president later in the winter of the same year.!~

~!She started dating Ganta after his confession at the end of their club trip. Initially, she aimed for a university within Ishikawa Prefecture, until she managed to convince her mother to allow her to try for a university in Osaka.!~

name: Ganta Nakami
description:
A high school student of Kuyo High School who suffers from insomnia. He comes off as grumpy and unfriendly due to his condition. Ganta is determined to protect the observatory and the revived Astronomy Club, of which he becomes the president.

~!After meeting Isaki, he opens up to the people around him and reveals to Isaki that the cause of his insomnia is due to separation anxiety caused by his mother leaving him and his father.!~

~!He becomes Isaki's boyfriend at the end of the club trip during the summer holiday of their first year. He aims to get into a university with a nursing program in Kanazawa, Ishikawa, inspired by his desire to always be at Isaki's side.!~

name: Yui Shiromaru
description: Former member of the Astronomy Club, where she won the grand prize in the National High School Astrophotography Contest.

name: Usako Kurashiki
description: School nurse and advisor of the Astronomy Club.

name: Dai Miyamoto
description: Main character. Wants to be the best sax player in the world.

name: Yukinori Sawabe
description:
A great pianist who appeared in front of Dai when he came to Tokyo. 
He started playing the piano at the age of four and is always thinking about jazz. 
He forms a trio with Dai and Tamada.

name: Shunji Tamada
description:
Dai's old schoolmate. 
Dai's crashing at his place during his time in Tokyo.
