She describes herself as "responsible and mature." Chtholly is a Leprechaun Fairy Soldier who lives at the Fairy Warehouse on Sky Island 68. She is the oldest fairy of her generation and she is also the wielder of the strongest sword of the Emnetwiht race, Seniorious. As the oldest fairy of the warehouse, she tries to be a good example for the little ones, she even avoids eating sweets in front of the little ones because she thought it was childish to do so.

She's not very honest with herself.

name: Willem Kmetsch
description:
Originally an orphan, he started training with a weapon at 11 in order to become a Brave. A jack of all trades, he exceeded in a myriad of techniques - earning him the title of  "strongest" Quasi Brave. After an hard fight, several curses caused by his techniques hit back, resulting in his 16 year old body being petrified in a frozen lake for 525 years.

When the events take place, he has been freed from the ice for two years with a deeply broken body caused by the petrification.

By the help of his boggard friend [Grick](https://anilist.co/character/163065/Graycrack-Grick), he becomes the caretaker over a military base run jointly by the Guarding Wings Military and the Orlandry Merchant Guild, where they keep special weapons - the Leprechauns.

name: Nephren Ruq Insania
description:
Nephren is a quiet Leprechaun, who almost never shows her emotions. Despite this, she cares a lot about her friends, and tries to support them as best as she can, especially Willem. Nephren cares a lot for Willem because she thinks he is the same as her. While she was having a conversation with Nygglatho, she described her feeling for Willem as: "I don’t want him to break down. So I’ll try my best to stay by his side and support him."

(Source: SukaSuka Wiki)

name: Ithea Myse Valgulious
description:
Ithea is a Leprechaun that has her hair styled like cat ears. She has a happy-go-lucky personalty, and often jokes that Willem only likes girls of her age. She is one of the main characters in Suka Suka and is a supporting character in Suka Moka. 

(Source: SukaSuka Wiki)

name: Nygglatho
description:
Race: Troll
Position: Fairy Warehouse Caretaker from Orlandri

Trolls, close in relation to Ogres, prey on the other races, especially the Emnetwiht (human). She met Willem during a scavenger mission while he was in his petrified state. Nygglatho often jokingly asks Willem if she can eat him.


Despite her young age, she has already accomplished much. She is the mother figure in the facility, and treats all the fairies in the facility as her own. She shows her weak side from time to time, and usually goes to the forest to hunt bears when depressed.

~!She holds a high opinion about Willem and asks Willem to consider her to be his partner.!~

~!After Chtholly's death, she cut her hair short, a Troll custom.!~

~!Her father is on the 11th Island and runs an inn. Willem and Elq stayed there for awhile.!~

name: Tiat Siba Ignareo
description:
Tiat Siba Ignareo is a young fairy who lives at the Fairy Warehouse. She is a supporting character in Suka Suka and becomes a main character in Suka Moka.

__In Suka Suka__
~!Tiat is cheerful young Leprechaun who loves and idolizes her big sister, Chtholly Nota Seniorious and who aims to become a splendid Fairy Soldier like her. She is delighted by the arrival of Willem Kmetsch and supported his romance with Chtholly. But later on, she becomes broken by Chtholly's death. After a little while, Tiat achieves her aim of becoming a Fairy Soldier when she becomes turned with the Dug Weapon, 'Ignareo.' However, she then becomes heartbroken when she is forced to fight and help kill Willem Kmetsch whom she considers to be a father figure and who has turned into a Beast.!~

__In Suka Moka__
~!Tiat is 5 years older and is still Fairy Soldier, however, has developed a much more depressing outlook on life. Still admiring Chtholly, she aims to become a tragic figure like her, however, is disheartened when she realizes that her skills are average and that she will never be like her. At the start of Suka Moka, she has resigned herself to death that is until she meets a young 4th Grade Officer named Feodor Jessman. From there, her story begins.!~

(Source: SukaSuka Wiki)

name: Rhantolk   Ytri Historia
description:
__Age__: 14

She is one of five full-grown fairy weapons stationed in the Fairy Warehouse. Alongside Ctholly, Nephren, and Ithea, she is classified as Grade A Fairy Weapon. She wields the Dug Weapon Historia. 

~!She later returned the ownership of Historia when she left the military!~

name: Pannibal Nox Katena
description:
Pannibal Nox Katena is young fairy who lives at the Fairy Warehouse. She is a supporting character in Suka Suka and becomes a main character in Suka Moka.

In her youth, Pannibal was a young fairy weapon who lived happily at the Fairy Warehouse along with the other Leprechauns.

(Source: SukaSuka Wiki)

name: Lillia Asplay
description:
Lillia Asplay was a female Emnetwiht who existed over 500 years ago. 

Known as the mightiest Brave, Lillia was the leader of her own team which consisted of Willem Kmetsch, Souwong Kandel, Navrutri Teigozak, Emissa Hodvin, Hilgram Moto and Kaya Cultrun.

~!She was once a princess who was born into the royal family of a small country. Since birth, Lillia was constantly taught to be pure, meaning that she had to be kind, selfless and constantly place others before herself. Despite this, she was happy and loved by everyone around her. When she was 10 years old, her kingdom was attacked by Gloom Elves and her family was killed.

Before Lillia could be killed, she was rescued by one of the people who were loyal to her family and managed to escape through a secret passageway. She was then taken to the Imperial Capital, and after that, she was taken in by Nils Didek Foreigner, who trained her to become a Regal Brave, alongside Willem Kmetsch and Souwong Kandel.

Despite surviving this tragic event, this experience also forced her into a darker fate, as those around and those that heard her tale started to treat her as a tragic heroine. Eventually, her fate was cemented when upon completion of her training, she was chosen by the Holy Sword, Seniorious, a sword that chooses only those who can never meet happiness in their lives. 

During the final battle with the Visitors, Lillia chose to take down the Visitor Elq herself while Willem was busy fighting Ebon Candle. This was because she knew if Willem found out what she was planning, he would've come and do it himself, which would've resulted in his dying. Fighting her way into Elq's sanctuary, Lillia's body and mind took a beating trying to find the Visitor.

Eventually, Lillia did find her, and after great pains, she managed to force her way through the barrier with Seniorious and land in Elq's sanctuary. Seeing the strange battered girl and her sword, Elq naturally inquired as to who she was and why she was there. But each time she spoke, Elq was inadvertently causing damage to Lillia. Eventually, the girl answered that her name was Lillia Aspray and that she was the Brave who was going to kill her and save the world. Elq replied that it seemed like a pain to do that, and in pain, Lillia replied that it is. 

In response, Elq then asked why she would even want to save the world, and as Lillia spurted blood from her mouth, she replied that she was doing it for the sake of her love. Surprised by that concept, Elq was stunned and asked why out of love, inadvertently sending out a telepathic shockwave that ripped through Lillia's mind. Barely conscious, Lillia replied that it was out of love that she came here to slay a god. Elq became awestruck by Lillia in that moment. Seeing Elq's reaction, Lillia continued explaining that she knows it's a fool's errand, but she doesn't have a choice because the one she loves is an idiot and that she had to act on these idiotic feelings before he could act on them himself. Lillia then states the man's name as Willem and she describes him as a "complete and utter moron."

Picking up Seniorious, Lillia tells Elq to rest in peace right before stabbing Elq straight through the chest. After that, she activated Seniorious' curse and turned Elq into a corpse, before dying herself unaware that Willem had already had been petrified. As a result, Lillia fulfilled the prophecy of Seniorious: she died not knowing that Willem loved her and was unable to achieve her happiness in her life.

After the final battle was over, Lillia's body was retrieved by Navrutri Teigozak and taken by to the Imperial Capital to recover. However, her mind had already been torn apart by Elq Hrqstn and she was left brain dead. Ironically, despite sacrificing so much of herself, Lillia's desperate attempt to save the world ended in failure as one year later the entirety of humanity turned back into Beasts in the course of a night. What happened to her body after the fight is left unknown.!~

name: Collon Rin Purgatrio
description:
Collon Rin Purgatorio is young fairy who lives at the Fairy Warehouse. She is a supporting character in Suka Suka and becomes a main character in Suka Moka.

In her youth, Collon was a young fairy weapon who lived happily at the Fairy Warehouse along with the other Leprechauns.

(Source: SukaSuka Wiki)

name: Elq Hrqstn
description: A young girl with a mysterious mental connection to Chtholly.

name: Lakhesh Nyx Seniorious
description:
Lakhesh is one of the many young fairies who live in the Fairy Warehouse.

Lakhesh is a shy, quiet girl. She is rather conscientious of others and is rather careful and timid, often apologizing to others for her "wrongful" actions. She loves cooking and looking at the latest kitchen appliances, often wishing that she had those devices back at the Fairy Warehouse.

She is the most mature of the younger fairies and is very perceptive of others as she is aware that Chtholly and Nygglatho both have feelings for Willem.

She sees Willem as a loving father figure and Chtholly as a big sister.

name: Nopht Keh Desperatio
description:
Nopht Keh Desperatio is one of the fairies who live at the Fairy Warehouse. She is one of the main characters in Suka Suka and is a supporting character in Suka Moka.~! After losing Desperatio, she gets a new name along with a new weapon and is now called "Nopht Caro Oracion" in Suka Moka. !~

She was 14 during the events of Suka Suka and was originally assigned to the Surface Artifacts Recovery Team along with Rhantolk Ytri Historia.This lasted until the Battle of Gomag, where she lost her Dug Weapon, 'Desperatio,' after Chtholly Nota Seniorious took it for her final stand-off against the Timere.

(Source: SukaSuka Wiki)

name: Almaria Duffner
description: She's a member of the orphanage Willem grows up in. She often calls Willem father.

name: Grick Graycrack
description:
A scavenger that shelters Willem for a while before he landed a job as "Military Weapon Caretaker". A borgle, sentient, intellegent, goblin-like race.

~!He is also part of the scavenger team that accidentally discovered and unearthed Willem's frozen body from his final battle location with a Beast!~

name: Almita
description: Almita is a Leprechaun who lives in the Fairy Warehouse.

name: Ryehl
description: Ryehl is a young blue-haired fairy who was originally born on Sky Island 38 and now currently lives in the Fairy Warehouse on Sky Island 68.

name: Limeskin
description: An Officer at the Guardian Wings Military, he has a strong warrior's pride in him and talk in a warrior manner. A reptrace, a reptilian-like humanoid race.

name: Souwong Kandel
description:
The creator to Sky Islands and the advisor to Guardian Wings Military. He is a "Barrowwiht", a race of immortal undead. He had lived for 539 years. He has the appearance of a 83 years old man

~!He is originally an Emnetwiht, a human. During his last battle with The Visitor 500 years prior to the series, he didn't manage to drive off the Visitor and was killed. Before his death, he cast a curse on himself that strips him off his humanity, making him an immortal undead called "Barrowwiht"

He is also Willem's friend and a comrade as a Quasi-Brave!~

His young self is voiced by [Mutsumi Tamura](https://anilist.co/staff/105013/Mutsumi-Tamura)

name: Margomedari Brompton
description:
Dr. Margomedari Brompton is the official doctor of the Leprechauns at the Fairy Warehouse. He is the one who assigns and tunes the Leprechauns to be compatible with their Dug Weapons. He is a minor character in both Suka Suka and Suka Moka.

(Source: SukaSuka Wiki)

name: Haiji Kiyose
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7")

Haiji Kiyose is a 4th year literature student in Kansei University Student and a long time resident of Chikuseisou. He is the resident of room 101 of Chikuseisou. He has a friendly and outgoing personality, but underneath has a bit of a manipulative side. He's never willing to compromise on his dreams, even if it means reasonably threatening his housemates in the process. Despite this, he is very caring towards his teammates. He has shown concern towards them throughout the show. 

 He is the cook of the Chikuseisou.

name: Kakeru Kurahara
description:
Height: 172 cm (5'8)

Kakeru has short, straight black hair and slate-colored eyes. When he runs, the wind pushes his hair to the back. He has a lean and athletic build that was developed over the years of competitive running. He often maintains a serious expression and he is usually seen wearing his sky blue sports jacket and gray sweatpants.

Kakeru is a first-year sociology student at Kansei University and the current resident of Room 103 of Chikuseisou. A prodigious athlete since high school who became disillusioned due to an incident in his old Track and Field team. He first joined the Chikuseisou after Haiji met him stealing from a convenience store. Personality-wise Kakeru is rather cold towards his fellow runners and takes running very seriously. He also doesn't like when he has to slow down to match the pace of others. However after joining Kansei Track and Field time he slowly learns what it really means to run.

name: Akane Kashiwazaki
description:
Height: 167 cm (5'6")

Nicknamed "Prince" because of his good looks, Prince is a 2nd year literature student at Kansei University. He is most notably known for having copious amounts of manga in his room and being the slowest runner in the group with the most unique running style. Prince currently stays in room 204 in Chikuseisou. Prince is rather inactive and occasionally speaks in dramatized speech. It is noted by Musa that he speaks in a more proper Japanese than the rest of the team. He began as one of the most reluctant and slowest members due to his lack of physical stamina and indoor tendencies. Akane picked up his training after Takashi had his family send over a treadmill for him to remain indoors to read manga. After finding true inspiration from his friends at Chikuseisou and Kakeru's presence, he pushes himself beyond his limitations.

name: Yukihiko Iwakura
description:
Height: 170 cm (5'7)

Yukihiko Iwakura is one of the Aotake runners. He is a 4th-year law student at Kansei University and the resident of room 102 at Chikuseisou. Yuki is a rather slim yet lean young man. His skin is a pale peach color. He has side-swept black hair and an undercut. He also wears glasses and piercings on his ears. He is often seen wearing a blue sweatshirt and black pants. He is short-tempered and gets easily annoyed by his teammate's actions. However, he does care about his teammates and often jokes with them. He is very detail-oriented as seen when he points out Shindo's lower center of gravity. He is an avid clubber and often boasts the fact that he passed the lawyer's bar exam in one go to any girl he meets. Yuki was initially reluctant to run and was bent on defying Haiji's enthusiasm, but eventually got drawn into it as the others members did. He hates the smell of tobacco coming from Akihiro's smoking until he quit for running.

name: Takashi Sugiyama
description:
Height: 167 cm (5'6)

Takashi Sugiyama is a third-year business student at Kansei University. He is the resident of room 205 at Chikuseisou. Generally considered an honor student by the other residents of Chikuseisou, Takashi is an earnest student from the Yamagata Prefecture- a mountainy region. He used to walk ten kilometers through the mountains to get to school and back every day. He was the first convinced by Haiji to give running a chance and has been a significant driving force behind the others. His dedication towards training originally stemmed from wanting to inspire and impress his family, but eventually became something entirely his own.Shindou has light brown hair and curved eyes. He has a mole under one of his eyes. He has a pretty small stature compared to his teammates. He is often seen wearing sweatshirts and pants. Shindou is shown to be very determined and dedicated to running, despite just starting out. He is very pure and wants to help his friends.

name: Akihiro Hirata
description:
Height: 178 cm (5'10)

Akihiro Hirata is a 3rd-year science and engineering student at Kansei University. Hirata is resident of room 104 at Chikuseiso. Nico is the tallest among the Aotake runners with a muscular statue. He also has a light beard and chin-length brown hair, which he wears in a low ponytail. He is often seen in sweats. His nickname, Nico-chan-senpai, comes from the abbreviation of the word nicotine due to his past cigarette addiction. It is also seen that the residents of Aotake will just draw a cigarette doodle in place of his name on the chore chart. In an effort to stop smoking, he took up wire sculpting, quickly accumulating dozens of little metal figurines. Yuki later capitalizes on this and sells them to help fund the track team. Prior to entering Kansei University, he ran Track during high school but quit due to his coach. As Akihiro picked up running again under Haiji's influence, he stopped smoking and began to make small metallic figures as a substitute.

name: Nira
description: Nira lives in Aotake house with ten male college students and one elderly man. He often joins his housemates for their daily running practice. He's also the eye catch in the middle of Run With The Wind, which means that he's a welcome diversion when things get too intense.

name: Musa Kamala
description:
Height: 176 cm (5'9)

Musa is a native to Tanzania. He moved to Japan to study Space and Engineering as a sponsored international student at Kansei University. His Japanese still has flaws leading to some misunderstandings and written mistakes. Kind and earnest, Musa is always supportive of his other team members and is well known by the residents of the local shopping district. He is the resident of room 203 at Chikuseisou. Musa is a young man with tall build. He has a dark-toned skin and has black colored shaved hair. He enjoys meditating in the dark in the Aotake bathtub from time to time.

name: Tarou Jou
description:
Height: 172 cm (5'8)

Tarō Jō is a 1st-year economics student at Kansei Univeristy. He is the older twin brother of Jirō Jō. He is a resident of room 201 at Chikuseisou. He and his brother played soccer for three years in high school. He goes by Jota and is nearly indistinguishable from his younger brother. The two think and act in tandem. Though he was originally driven by the intention to attract girls through running, Jota came to appreciate the sport. He wears green and purple accent running shoes.

name: Jirou Jou
description: Jirō Jō is a 1st-year economics student at Kansei University. He is the younger twin brother of Tarō Jō. He is a resident of room 201 at Chikuseisou. Joji has a yellow spiky hair. He is often seen wearing a necklace and a long sleeve shirt underneath a yellow shirt and shorts. He and his brother played soccer for three years in high school. The only two things he knows how to cook is pasta and a simple ochazuke. Originally intending to run for the sake of becoming popular with girls, he realize that running was something enjoyable in itself.

name: Youhei Sakaguchi
description:
Height: 165 cm (5'5)

Yōhei Sakaguchi is one of the Aotake runners. Known as 'King' due to his love of trivia, Yohei is a 4th year Sociology student at Kansei University. He is the resident of room 205 at Chikuseisou. He has a buzz cut, a large nose, and black eyes. Yohei can usually be seen wearing a yellow tracksuit or an orange sweatshirt with grey sweats. He is a joker and is very desperate to get a job, even going as far as joining in Haiji's dream because of the idea of the experience in the Hakone Ekiden could help him land a job. He seems to be shy around people and has trouble opening up to them. Besides his nightly trivia marathons, he's generally preoccupied by job hunting to no avail. Yohei eventually relented and joined in the team's efforts due to the earnest words of Takashi.

name: Hanako Katsuta
description: Known as Hana-chan to the members of Chikuseisou, she is a 3rd year high school student and daughter of one of the shop owners in the local shopping district. At Haiji's request, Hanako rode her bike alongside the team and also times their runs. She's become well known for her terrible cooking.

name: Kazuma Fujioka
description: Kazuma Fujioka is a 4th-year student at Rikudo Univesity. He is a running prodigy and famous among intercollegiate Track meets and races. He is the captain of Rikudo University Track and Field team. He knew Haiji prior to his knee injury and becomes a target for Kakeru to defeat.

name: Kousuke Sakaki
description: Sakaki was a member of Kakeru's high school Track and Field team. He developed an eternal grudge towards Kakeru after causing an incident that affected their entire team. He is a first-year student at Tokyo Sports University.

name: Genichirou Tazaki
description: Genichirō Tazaki is the landlord of Chikuseisou and the official coach of the team. He is an old man with thick eyebrows and a beard. He always wears a red hat. He was once known as the treasure of the Japan Association of Athletics.

name: Emilia
description:
**Height:** 164 cm (5'5")

Emilia is a half-elf girl who is one of the candidates to become the next ruler in the royal election. [Subaru](https://anilist.co/character/88573/Natsuki-Subaru) first meets her when her insignia is stolen by [Felt](https://anilist.co/character/88574/Felt) as she needs to possess it to be eligible to participate in the election. She introduces herself as Satella when she and Subaru met during the first timeline before introducing herself by her real name when she got her insignia back.

Emilia is good natured and likes to take care of others, though she herself refuses to admit it, instead thinking of it as her own selfishness. She is indifferent to her own appearance, leaving [Puck](https://anilist.co/character/90187/Puck) to take care of her clothes and hair. Because her appearance is similar to the [Witch of Envy](https://anilist.co/character/127242/Satella), she has received unfair discrimination from others. She sometimes acts like a child and is unacquainted with the world as she used to live in the woods with other Elves, though despite this she still works hard to become a ruler.

name: Rem
description:
__Height:__ 154 cm (5'1")

Rem is one of the twin maids working for [Roswaal L Mathers](https://anilist.co/character/90182/Mathers-L-Roswaal). She has medium length sky blue hair that covers her right eye, large light blue eyes, and young features. She also has hair clips towards left side of her hair, flower-shaped ribbon on the same side of her hair, and a maid hairband. She looks nearly identical to her sister [Ram](https://anilist.co/character/88576) apart from her hair, eyes, and ribbon coloring. She usually wears a maid uniform, and since her chest is slightly larger than her sister's, she secretly changes the measurements to hide it. Rem tends to speak in a superficially polite manner and sometimes acts without thinking. She holds both respect to the point of worship and guilt toward her sister for an incident in the past. Because of her respect and guilt toward her sister, she used to think of herself as inferior.

name: Subaru Natsuki
description:
__Height:__ 173 cm (5'8")

On the way home from the convenience store, he suddenly finds himself transported into another world. He has the ability that he calls "Return by Death" to go back in time when he dies. Despite being a hikikomori and gamer in his real world, Subaru does a bit of workout and seems to know basic hand-to-hand combat, making him not completely weak.

While Subaru tends to not read the situation, he is loyal to those he holds dear, willing to help them, even if that means taking the thorny path. He has his resolve confirmed through the many situations and circumstances he faces in the fantasy world, originally having been one to always take the "easy" route. As a hikikomori, he is hopeful of the possibilities that being sucked into a new realm brings, but later realizes the realities of the predicament he is in. Ultimately, he resolves himself to be faithful and protective of the ones that he cares most about.

name: Echidna
description: Echidna is one of the Witches of Sin, being the Witch of Greed. She has a strong thirst for knowledge along with a curiosity for the unknown, which defines her behavior. Echidna is described as black hearted, being unable to empathize with others and their feelings due to a lack of understanding. She will do anything to gain knowledge, be it deceit or employed sophistry.

name: Beatrice
description:
__Height:__ 140 cm (4'7")
__Age:__ ~!400+ (Actual)!~

The caretaker of the library in [Roswaal](https://anilist.co/character/90182)'s mansion. 

She has a distinct way of speaking, adding "I suppose" and "in fact" at the end of some of her sentences.

~!Around 400 years ago, Beatrice was created by [Echidna](https://anilist.co/character/129330). She helped her with her experiments, such as the Sanctuary Barrier, though she wasn't told everything as she didn't know that [Ryuuzu Meyer](https://anilist.co/character/174072) would be sealed in a crystal. Sometime later, Echidna ordered her to stand guard over the library while she waited for "that person," an order which she diligently followed.!~

~!After numerous and painful attempts to convince her to leave the library [Subaru](https://anilist.co/character/88573) succeeded, and Beatrice became his contract spirit.!~

name: Ram
description:
__Height:__ 154 cm (5’1”)

Ram is one of the twin maids working for [Roswaal L Mathers](https://anilist.co/character/90182). She has medium length light pink hair that covers her left eye, large darkish pink eyes, and young features. She also has hair clips towards right side of her hair, flower-shaped ribbon on the same side of her hair, and a maid hairband. She looks nearly identical to her sister [Rem](https://anilist.co/character/88575/Rem) apart from her hair, eyes, and ribbon coloring. Ram is seemingly self-centered and does things at her own pace, however in actuality she maintains a distance from people to ascertain them. She believes that Roswaal is the greatest and no one else is as precious except for her sister Rem. She is slightly more outgoing in comparison to the generally taciturn Rem, who generally allows Ram to take the lead in their sisterly bond.

name: Otto Suwen
description:
Otto Suwen is a merchant appearing in  Re:Zero. His remarkable misfortune always takes him to dangerous situations, from which he escapes thanks to his wit.
Otto has gray hair that is mentioned to be as long as a gal game protagonist. He is said to be somewhat handsome if he has a serious expression. However, he is usually either retorting, shouting, or panicking, ruining his looks. He has a medium build, but has trained himself since he used to work as a merchant.

name: Reinhard van Astrea
description:
__Height__: 184 cm (6'0")

Reinhard van Astrea is the current Sword Saint and a member of the Royal Guard, currently acting as [Felt's](https://anilist.co/character/88574/Felt) knight. 

As the Sword Saint and the Knight of the Royal Guard, Reinhard embodies chivalry and elegance, treating everyone with exceptional respect. He is fair, brave, and always acts in the name of justice, whether on duty or simply strolling through the Royal Capital.

As a knight, Reinhard only uses his sword when necessary, since, in addition to being a rule, his iron-clad rule is to not inflict pain to others if not absolutely necessary, be it a normal thug or a member of the Witch Cult.

name: Felix Argyle
description: Felix Argyle commonly known as Ferris, is [Crusch Karsten](https://anilist.co/character/90185)'s knight. He is a beast human (demi-human).

name: Garfiel Tinsel
description:
Garfiel Tinsel is the former guardian of the Sanctuary and a member of the Emilia Camp. Introduced during Arc 4, he became one of the main supporting characters of the season. He's a half-beast human and [Frederica Baumann's](https://anilist.co/character/143378/Baumann-Frederica) half-brother. He can transform himself in a giant golden tiger that can deal powerful attacks but with a cost of losing his reason, so he uses this ability when he's pushed to the limit.

~!Garfiel and Frederica lived together until she left when he was around 4 years old and he hadn't seen her since until their reunion 10 years later during the Sanctuary incident. After seeing his mother's "death" during the trial at a young age, he began to fear the outside world, causing him to try and protect the Sanctuary.!~

name: Crusch Karsten
description:
Crusch Karsten is the Matriarch of House Karsten and a candidate to become the 42nd King of Lugnica.

While normally calm and serious, Crusch is honest, sincere, right, being a type of person who is destined to stand above others, though she has talent and has worked hard to reach where she is now. She is already the head of her family, finishing her work better than her father. She prefers to act herself and has the pride of a warrior. Crusch is also gentle, often believing the false knowledge jokingly told to her by [Ferris](https://anilist.co/character/90184), and sometimes displays an airheaded side. Like her mother Helena Karsten, she is shown to be ruthless and reckless.

name: Puck
description:
__Height:__ 7 cm

Puck is an Artificial Spirit that [Emilia](https://anilist.co/character/88572/Emilia) was formerly contracted with. He is the current Great Spirit of Fire.

~!He is currently known as the Beast of The End.!~

~!Around 400 years ago, Puck was created by Echidna, though he had apparently left her by the time she moved into the Sanctuary. Seven years before the start of the election, Puck unfroze Emilia and began to act as her friend and mentor, and later on started to live at Roswaal's mansion where he was reunited with Beatrice.!~

Puck can be described as cute or adorable, thus his skin being pink around his cheeks. His fur is mostly grey with silver in certain spots (i.e. tip of the tail). His eyebrows are pretty small and rhombus-shaped. He also has a gold earring on his left ear. Sometimes, he carries a purple bag.

Puck is generally a nice spirit. He is very happy and stays at Emilia's side to protect her, affectionately calling her "Lia". He occasionally goofs around and gets along especially well with [Beatrice](https://anilist.co/character/90181/Beatrice). 

~!However, Puck's demeanor greatly changes in loops where Emilia dies, showing a complete disregard for anyone except her, and was even willing to destroy the world because of the condition in their contract.!~

name: Wilhelm van Astrea
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm (5'10")

Wilhelm van Astrea né Trias, is a member of the Crusch Camp and was [Theresia van Astrea](https://anilist.co/character/124116/van-Astrea-Theresia)'s husband.

Wilhelm is a refined man with a highly gentle and humble demeanor. However unearth that even temperament belied a fierce warrior who often is the first to help when something happens. However this wasn't always the case as in youth, Wilhelm was very opposite of who he was in his later years. Brash, afoot, short tempered, lonely and often cold with others. He was a troubled individual who devoted himself wholly to the sword and cared for little else. Even so, he knew how to analyze a situation, always finding a way out. Nonetheless, Theresia greatly influenced his personality, becoming increasingly sociable and protective, achieving more results during the Demi-human War. It was through her most of all that he would become the person he is today.

name: Julius Euclius
description:
__Height:__ 179 cm (5'10")

Julius Euclius is [Anastasia Hoshin's](https://anilist.co/character/90177/Hoshin-Anastasi) knight and a member of the Royal Guard. Julius lived with his family at the Euclius House. After his father, Klein Euclius died, he started to live with his uncle Alviero and he started to take care of Julius and became his adoptive father.

As a member of Lugnica's nobility, Julius acts in a proper fashion, always having an air of nobility and conviction. He is also considerate and doesn't forget to show care toward others. He also shows a strict side, giving out accurate assessments of others whether they're good or bad, which is a result of his upbringing as an elite, and in actuality, he believes that he and others can do better than they currently are.

Julius doesn't like those who forget their place, leading him to have bad relations with [Subaru](https://anilist.co/character/88573/Natsuki-Subaru) for a while. While both have apologized to each other after the battle with the Hakugei, Subaru told him he still hated him. Julius said he didn't intend to be friends. They both became very intimate very quickly during the planning and attacking the Witch Cult. In the end, Julius directly considered Subaru as his friend.

name: Roswaal Mathers
description:
~!__Mental age:__ 400+!~
The lord of the Roswaal Mansion and a descendant of the original Roswaal.

He comes across as an eccentric due to his flamboyant appearance and odd speaking style, the latter which he shares with his grandmother. However, he harbors a more calculating and reserved side with a sharp political mind and gaze that reads others quite well.

~!It is later revealed that he is in fact the original Roswaal, Roswaal A. Mathers, who has been possessing his descendants' bodies to meet his teacher Echidna again at any cost, even if that means sacrificing himself or those close to him.!~

name: Satella
description: Satella is one of the Witches of Sin, being the Witch of Envy. ~! Contrary to popular belief, Satella and the Witch of Envy are separate personalities. Both of them love Subaru, though the Witch of Envy is aggressive about it.!~

name: Felt
description:
**Height:** 150 cm (4'11")

A thief that lives in the slums. Felt stole [Emilia's](https://anilist.co/character/88572/Emilia) insignia, hoping for quick, easy cash. Though Felt can usually handle her own, she does consider [Rom](https://anilist.co/character/124117/Rom) to be like family.

~!After being chosen by the insignia, she is forced to participate in the Royal Selection and is currently a candidate to become the 42nd King of Lugunica.!~

name: Frederica Baumann
description:
Frederica Baumann is a maid working for [Roswaal L. Mathers](https://anilist.co/character/90182/Mathers-Roswaal) and a member of the Emilia Camp. She quit her job as a maid a few months before [Subaru's](https://anilist.co/character/88573/Natsuki-Subaru) appearance, but returned after [Ram](https://anilist.co/character/88576/Ram) couldn't manage the mansion ~!after [Rem](https://anilist.co/character/88575/Rem) had her name and memories eaten. !~

~!She is the half-sister of [Garfiel Tinsel](https://anilist.co/character/133847/Tinsel-Garfiel).!~

name: Elsa Granhiert
description:
An assassin-for-hire from the Northernmost nation, the Holy Kingdom of Gusteko, known as "The Bowel Hunter". Elsa wishes to make a trade for an insignia, as her client's wishes.  

~!Elsa Granhiert was an assassin working together with [Meili](https://anilist.co/character/175577) for an individual they refer to as "Mother" until her death.!~

name: Regulus Corneas
description: Regulus is a young man of a medium height. He has gold eyes, white hair and a middle to skinny build. Regulus Is a part of the Sin Archbishops of the Witch Cult and represents greed.  Regulus is known for being very talkative and calls himself unselfish, while in fact he is very prideful and likes to act above others and reference himself as above others.

name: Patrasche
description: [Subaru](https://anilist.co/character/88573/Natsuki-Subaru)'s Earth Dragon that he officially received from [Crusch Karsten](https://anilist.co/character/90185/Karsten-Crusch) for his efforts in the Hakugei battle. Despite being of a species known for being feisty, Patrasche is extremely loyal to Subaru, as she is willing to put her life on the line for him.

name: Anastasia Hoshin
description:
Anastasia Hoshin is the head of the Hoshin Trading Company and a candidate to become the 42nd King of Lugunica. Her knight is [Julius Juukulius](https://anilist.co/character/90183/Euclius-Julius).

Despite her surname being "Hoshin", she's not directly related to Hoshin of the Wilderness. She chose the name because she was inspired by his legacy.

name: Petra Leyte
description:
Petra is a bright and kind girl from Irlam Village. She likes [Subaru](https://anilist.co/character/88573/Natsuki-Subaru) very much after he saved her from the Wolgarm incident.

~!She became a maid at the Roswaal Mansion after Subaru came back from the witchcult incident. !~

name: Minerva
description:
Minerva is one of the Witches of Sin, being the Witch of Wrath. Minerva dislikes conflict and wishes for all to be well. She also only cares about what's directly in front of her, not worrying about things she cannot see. 

Minerva has some history with the elves as she cares deeply for Emilia, along with the other elves.

~!Minerva's main ability is "Authority of Wrath". Unlike other authorities this ability is only a support skill. Minerva is able to heal others by attacking any part of their body with her own. The authority also gives her increased speed and strength. The drawback is that every time the authority is used it causes a calamity to happen in another part of the world. The calamity can range from many things such as an earthquake.!~

name: Meili Portroute
description:
One of the children that lives in the village within [Roswaal](https://anilist.co/character/90182)'s region. She's timid, though is friendly, such as when she introduces a small dog to [Subaru](https://anilist.co/character/88573). 
~!Meili Portroute is a Demon Beast User.!~

name: Renge Miyauchi
description: A first-grade​ elementary school student. Renge is always attached to her recorder and likes to make up nicknames for all the characters in the show. She is quite attached to [Kaede](https://anilist.co/character/87829/Kaede-Kagayama), to whom she likes to call "Candy store" and is very fond of her since she was a baby.

name: Komari Koshigaya
description:
__Height:__ <140cm (4'7'')

A second-year middle school student and Natsumi's older sister. She is quite short, which she has a complex about.

name: Kaede Kagayama
description: Owns the local candy shop and is Kazuho's underclassman. She used to babysit Renge when Renge was still a baby.

name: Hotaru Ichijou
description: A fifth grade elementary school student who transfers into Asahigaoka Branch School from Tokyo. She is quite tall and mature for her age, but she is also shy and has a crush on [Komari](https://anilist.co/character/54149/Koshigaya-Komari).

name: Natsumi Koshigaya
description: A first-year middle school student and Komari's little sister. An airheaded tomboy who has bad grades.

name: Hikage Miyauchi
description: The middle of the three sisters in the Miyauchi family, Hikage goes to a high school in Tokyo, which she frequently tries to boast about to Renge.

name: Suguru Koshigaya
description:
__Height:__ 171cm (5'7")

A third year middle school student and Natsumi and Komari's older brother. He doesn't say much and has very little presence.

name: Konomi Fujimiya
description: Konomi Fujimiya is a character of the Non Non Biyori series. She's a graduate of Asahigaoka Branch School who lives next door to the Koshigayas. Konomi is a very mature teenager. She acts as a role model for Komari and Natsumi as well as Renge. She is very caring and fun but she can also be serious sometimes as well.

name: Kazuho Miyauchi
description:
Kazuho Miyauchi works as the only school teacher at the Asahioka branch school. Her eyes are drawn as closed and she mostly wear plain cloths or a lab coat when she's teaching. She is a laidback person and is shown to be rather lazy. The Asahioka branch school only has five students attending, ranging from elementary to junior high school, are together in the same class. Since the class is mixed, the students mostly study on their own while Kazuho sleeps at her desk most of the time. She's not the most inspiring teacher and it's not unusual that she's late for class, even coming in as late as noon because she over slept. When she isn't sleeping she grades test, write hand-outs or assign class duties that she's too lazy to do herself.

Kazuho is the eldest sister in the Miyauchi family and lives with her parents and two younger sisters Hikage and Renge. Hikage, the middle sister is attending high school in Tokyo and Renge the youngest sister, who is part of the main cast, is a student at Asahikoka. Kazuho used to attend Asahioka herself when she was younger and later she studied in Tokyo when Renge was born.  At home she is also seen taking frequent naps during the day, but compensates by staying up late to complete her teacher assignment. Renge is sometimes annoyed over Kazuho's lazy manners and wants her to be more of an inspiring teacher who can motivate her students to do better. Instead the students use her as a bad example and studies hard to not turn out like her. Though she can seem erratic most of the time she is shown to be responsible when needed for example when they're on the trip to Okinawa and she does help out on her parents rice fields when she isn't teaching.

name: Honoka Ishikawa
description: A first grade elementary school student who becomes friends with Renge during summer vacation.

name: Akane Shinoda
description: Akane Shinoda is a junior classmate of Konomi Fujimiya. Both Akane and Konomi are flute players in the wind ensemble club at their school.

name: Shiori
description: Shiori is a minor character in Non Non Biyori. Her father is a local policeman. She is younger than Renge Miyauchi and calls her "onee-chan" (elder sister). She is a shy girl, but she is also enthusiastic in playing with Renge whom she adores and sees as her as a big sister.

name: Hotaru no Hahaoya
description: Mother Ichijou is a character in Non Non Biyori. She is the mother of Hotaru Ichijou.

name: Pechi
description: Pechi is a male dog that belongs to Hotaru.

name: Yukiko Koshigaya
description: Natsumi, Komari and Suguru's mother. She is also a graduate of Asahigaoka branch school.

name: Honoka no Haha
description: [Honoka's](https://anilist.co/character/87827) mother.

name: Yor Forger
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm
__Occupation:__ City Hall Clerk, Assassin (Covertly)
__Affiliation:__ Berlint City Hall, Garden (Covertly)
__Relatives:__ [Loid Forger](https://anilist.co/character/138101/Loid-Forger) (Husband), [Anya Forger](https://anilist.co/character/138100/Anya-Forger) (Adoptive Daughter), [Yuuri Briar](https://anilist.co/character/150425/Yuuri-Briar) (Younger Brother)

Yor Forger is the tritagonist of the SPY x FAMILY series. She is a clerical employee at the Berlint City Hall. She is soft-spoken and mild-mannered, but has a strong sense of humor. She has a bad drinking habit and falls into a coma when she drinks. At home, she struggles to be a good wife and a kind mother. Although her cooking skills are not very good, she likes to keep clean and is good at cleaning.
While she works in the capital of Ostania's city hall... or at least that's her civilian cover. In truth, she is an infamous Professional Killer known as "Thorn Princess". After becoming overly fixated on the idea her cover might be blown after a coworker ribs her about not being married or even having a boyfriend, Yor suggests to Loid a Marriage of Convenience, which he accepts, as he needs a mother for Anya for his own mission.

~!As of Mission (Chapter) 44, it is revealed that Yor is part of Garden, a powerful paramilitary assassin organization operating within Ostania.!~

name: Anya Forger
description: __Height:__ 99.5 cm (3'2") __Occupation:__ First-Grade Student, Test Subject (Formerly) __Affiliation:__ Eden Academy, Unknown Organization (Formerly) __Relatives:__ Loid Forger (Adoptive Father), Yor Forger (Adoptive Mother) Anya Forger is the deuteragonist of the SPY x FAMILY series. She is a young girl who Twilight finds at an orphanage. Believing her to be a smart child, he decides to adopt her for his mission. What he doesn't know is that Anya is an esper who escaped from the Lab that gave her the power to read minds. Starving for excitement in her life after spending most of it so far in a lab, Anya actively sought to be the one adopted by Loid and then make sure Loid and Yor got together, so she could have a spy and assassin for parents. Anya is the only Forger aware of just about everyone's Secret Identities, but keeps it to herself out of fear that if her psychic powers are exposed she'll be put in a lab again.

name: Loid Forger
description: __Height:__ 187 cm __Occupation:__ Psychiatrist, Spy (Covertly) __Affiliation:__ Berlint General Hospital, WISE (Covertly) __Relatives:__ Yor Forger (Wife), Anya Forger (Adoptive Daughter) Loid Forger is the main protagonist of the SPY x FAMILY series. He is the top spy of the Westalian Intelligence Bureau, who is only known by his code name Twilight. In order to investigate the activities of a highly ranked politician, Donovan Desmond, Twilight has assumed the identity of a psychiatrist named Loid Forger. Further, to appear like a normal family man and get close to his target, Loid then adopted a young orphan girl, Anya, and entered a Marriage of Convenience with an Ostanian woman named Yor Briar... who unknown to Twilight are themselves a Telepath and Professional Killer respectively.

name: Narrator
description:
This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. 

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

name: Bond
description: Bond is the recently adopted pet of the Forger Family. Formally known as Subject 8, Bond has been used for experiments that resulted in the dog gaining precognition abilities.

name: Damian Desmond
description:
__Height:__ 110 cm (3′7″)
__Affiliation:__ Desmond Family, Eden Academy, Cecile Hall
__Occupation:__ Student

The second son of [Donovan Desmond](https://anilist.co/character/180192/Desmond-Donovan) and attends Eden Academy as part of Cecile House, Group 3.  

A young child with an arrogant and rude personality, caused by him being the second son of Donovan Desmond, the leader of the National Unity Party, a group important and powerful enough to threaten the peace between the East and the West. This has caused Damian to gain a highly respected status among his peers and making him incredibly arrogant, assuming [Anya](https://anilist.co/character/138100/Forger-Anya) gained a crush on him when she stared at him. He is shown to prefer being called Lord Damian when spoken to. He gets angry when he is looked down upon by Anya's smile, quickly resorting to insulting her with his limited vocabulary and harassing Anya.

name: Yuuri Briar
description:
__Height:__ 179 cm (5′10")
__Affiliation:__ Ostania, Ministry for Foreign Affairs (Cover), State Security Service
__Occupation:__ Diplomat (Formerly, Cover), Counterintelligence Agent

Yor Briar's younger brother who works in the State Security Service (SSS). He keeps his job at the SSS a secret from Yor, while pretending to be a normal civil servant at the foreign ministry.

Yuri has a sister-complex, and even at an early age, he would be doing everything he could to get Yor to praise him with affection. Though this could be due to his mother dying at a very early stage in his life causing him to get very attached to Yor as a mother figure.

name: Becky Blackbell
description:
__Affiliation:__ Blackbell Family, Blackbell Heavy Industries, Eden Academy, Cecile Hall
__Occupation:__ Student

The daughter of the CEO of Blackbell, a major military manufacturer. Attends Eden Academy as part of Cecil House, Group 3. Best friends with [Anya Forger](https://anilist.co/character/138100/Forger-Anya).

Becky is a very kind child but with her being the daughter of a major military manufacturer, she is shown to be somewhat prideful and tries to be mature, attempting to take Anya under her wing as an act of benevolence when she views Anya as a brat. She does not attempt to get close to [Damian Desmond](https://anilist.co/character/150424/Desmond-Damian) despite his social position, even looking down on their classmates who try to befriend Damian and Anya who is initially bullied by Damian's group. Anya's confident smile later wins over Becky's admiration.

name: Franky Franklin
description:
__Height:__ 166 cm (5′5")
__Affiliation:__ Ostania
__Occupation:__ Tobacco Store Clerk (False Front), Informant, Soldier (formerly)

Franky is an informant who seemingly works at a tobacco store and presumably works for Loid Forger's agency. He gets information regarding Eden Academy's exam and Anya Forger's past records for Loid Forger.

Franky is a kind person willing to help Loid out when he's in a pinch even though the danger is high. He frequently warns Loid Forger not to get too close to other people in their line of work.

He frequently falls in love with other women but his love life typically fails due to lack of mutual interest or they are already with someone else.

name: Sylvia Sherwood
description:
__Height:__ 173 cm

She is [Twilight](https://anilist.co/character/138101/Forger-Loid)'s main contact at WISE.

name: Henry Henderson
description:
__Affiliation:__ Eden Academy
__Occupation:__ History Teacher, Housemaster of Cecile Hall

Henry is a mature and noble person, who places a high importance on "elegance". To him, elegance seems to be the way a person conducts themselves, and is not afraid to correct inelegant behavior in others.

name: Camilla
description: One of Yor Forger's three co-workers at Berlint City Hall.

name: Bill Watkins
description: The 6-year-old son of a major in the National Army who attends Eden Academy as part of Wald Hall. He was given the nickname "Bazooka Bill" by his peers for his mental and physical domination in sports since nursery school.

name: Bondman
description: The protagonist of Spy Wars and the number one spy in the show. He frequently has to take down enemies from the League of Evil in order to save Princess Honey.

name: Emile Elman
description: Best Friend of Damian and Student at Eden Academy.

name: Ewen Egeburg
description: Best Friend of Damian and Student at Eden Academy. He is a loyal person, devotedly following Damian, almost always holding his bag when they walk to class. He also genuinely cares for Damian as a friend, getting concerned for Damian when he is hurt or pushing himself too hard.

name: Donovan Desmond
description: Donovan Desmond is the President of the Nation Unity Party and Twilight's current target.

name: Honey-hime
description: Princess of the kingdom where Spy Wars takes place. She is frequently saved by Bondman which has caused her to develop feelings for him.

name: Chadwick Curtis
description: A scarred man who is a lieutenant and a higher position than [Yuuri Briar](https://anilist.co/character/150425/Yuuri-Briar) in the SSS. He seems to be fairly close to Yuuri and is aware of his drinking habits and sister complex, advising Yuri to get over his sister and focus on his work.

name: Karen
description: The daughter of Edgar. Twilight formerly dated her as "Robert" with the intention of investigating her father. Karen is known to have participated in a fair amount of criminal activity, enough to get her in trouble if Loid so wishes.

name: Walter Evans
description: The English Teacher and the Housemaster of Dormitory 5, Malcom Hall at Eden Academy. He is regarded as gentle, reliable, conservative and well-liked by his students.

name: Mai Sakurajima
description:
__Height:__ 162 cm (5'4")

A 3rd-year student at Minegahara High School. She is serious and polite, but has a strong will.

Well known, famous actress, who is currently on hiatus. Because her life had always revolved around her work in entertainment, she remains isolated at school.

(Source: Aniplex USA)

name: Sakuta Azusagawa
description:
__Height:__  172 cm (5'7")

A strange 2nd year student in high school, who doesn't have a cellphone in this day and age. He is currently an outcast at school due to rumors of a violent past... but doesn't seem to care.
~!Sakuta eventually starts dating [Mai Sakurajima](https://anilist.co/character/127222)!~
(Source: Aniplex USA)

name: Rio Futaba
description:
__Height:__ 155 cm (5'1")
__Talent:__ Explaining any strange phenomenon with science

She is [Sakuta](https://anilist.co/character/127221/Azusagawa-Sakuta)'s classmate, who is always cool and calm, always willing to give various advice on puberty syndrome. She is also the sole member of the Science Club, and known as an eccentric person at the school. 

(Source: Aniplex USA)

name: Kaede Azusagawa
description:
__Height:__ 5'4" (162 cm)

She is the younger sister of Sakuta Azusagawa. 

~!Suffered amnesia and gained a different personality after her ordeal with Adolescence Syndrome stemming from online bullying. Since then, she has lived with Sakuta and has not attended school.!~

name: Tomoe Koga
description:
__Height:__ 150 cm (4'11")

A typical 1st year high-school student at Minegahara High School who can take hints, but is slightly scatterbrained. Being overly concerned about how people look at her, she hides her Hakata accent, which comes out when she panics or is relaxed.

(Source: Aniplex USA, edited)

name: Shouko Makinohara
description:
__Height:__ 150 cm (4'11")
__Talent:__ Early to bed, early to rise

A girl who has the same first and last name as [Sakuta](https://anilist.co/character/127221/Azusagawa-Sakuta)'s first crush. She is a shy middle school girl, but reliable and kind.

She bumps into Sakuta, while holding an umbrella over an abandoned cat in the rain.

~!It is later revealed that the older Shouko that Sakuta encounters is from the future, and is able to return to the past due to her puberty syndrome.!~

name: Nodoka Toyohama
description:
__Height:__ 158cm (5'2")
__Talent:__ Changing clothes quickly

Mai's half-sister, related through her father. A member of the idol group "Sweet Bullet" and designated as the most fashionable within the group. Despite her flashy looks, she attends an elite all girls' high school. She is confident and can be competitive.

(Source: Aniplex USA)

name: Yuuma Kunimi
description: A good friend of [Sakuta Azusagawa](https://anilist.co/character/127221/Sakuta-Azusagawa) and [Rio Futaba](https://anilist.co/character/127633/Rio-Futaba), as well as the boyfriend of [Saki Kamisato](https://anilist.co/character/130304). He is a member of Minegahara High's basketball team, being quite athletic and popular within the school.

name: Saki Kamisato
description:
[Yuuma](https://anilist.co/character/130307/Yuuma-Kunimi)'s girlfriend. Popular within the school and can be a standoffish person, but she shows great affection towards Yuuma. She is quite protective of him and often clashes with [Sakuta](https://anilist.co/character/127221/Sakuta-Azusagawa) as a result.

~!It is revealed that Saki has an older sister whom her parents often compare her to, causing her to develop low self-esteem. Sakuta believes this to be the reason why she is so protective of Yuuma's image and her own, as in her eyes she already has a fragile self-image.!~


~!After graduating she attends the same college as Sakuta and goes into health studies, in the hopes of becoming a nurse in order to help Yuuma whenever she can due to his decision to partake in firefighter training.!~

name: Yousuke Maesawa
description: A member of the school basketball team. He has an attractive and charming demeanor, but he is ultimately not above slandering other students. Maezawa has bad-mouthed all of his past girlfriends.

name: Ikumi Akagi
description: Sakuta's classmate from middle school who seems to share a troubled past with him. She currently attends the same college as [Sakuta](https://anilist.co/character/127221/Azusagawa-Sakuta). She's highly intelligent, and appears to have a number of secrets.

name: Mai no Haha
description: She is the mother of Mai Sakurajima.

name: Shinobu Uzuki
description: Shinobu is a member of Fuurin high school's broadcasting club. She dreams of becoming an announcer

name: Rikka Inohana
description: Rikka is the president of Fuurin high school's broadcasting club. She dreams of becoming a singer.

name: Arisu Yamabuki
description: Arisu is a transfer student at Fuurin high school. He enters the broadcasting club because he's looking for the host of a radio show he used to listen to years ago, who he believes to be one of the club members.

name: Nene Himekawa
description: Nene is a member of Fuurin high school's broadcasting club. She dreams of becoming a voice actress.

name: Iko Kirino
description: Iko is a member of Fuurin high school's broadcasting club. She dreams of becoming a Vtuber.

name: Lemon Andou
description: Advisor to the broadcasting club who yearns to be called "Lemon-chan." She tries not to rock the boat or stand out but still helps the club.

name: Ao Momotose
description:
Momotose Ao is a famous VTuber and side character in Tune In to the Midnight Heart. As part of the VTuber group Blue Box, she has over 3 million subscribers and does streaming as well as live shows.

(Source: Tune in to the Midnight Heart Wiki)

name: Aiko
description: She is a student at Furin High School, and Rikka's former band member.

name: Xiaoshi Cheng
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm
__Skills:__ Basketball, Photography

Manager of Time Photography Studio. Rough around the edges, but good at heart. Often acts impulsively. In order to save his studio from going out of business, he works together with [Lu Guang](https://anilist.co/character/218267/Lu-Guang), using their powers to enter photos and fulfill client requests.

He can enter the world inside a photo and possess the photographer's body, temporarily controlling their words and actions.

name: Guang Lu
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm
__Skills:__ Intelligence, Strategizing 
__Dislikes:__ Things being messed up after he's tidied them up, Plans being messed up
__Likes:__ Gourmet Food, Basketball, Reading, Sleeping, Sunbathing

Partner at Time Photography Studio. Calm and rational. Works together with [Cheng Xiaoshi](https://anilist.co/character/218266/Cheng-Xiaoshi) to fulfill client requests by acting as his guide and directing his actions.

He can foresee everything that happens inside a photo within 12 hours of it being taken; can share the consciousness of the person going into the photo through a high five and use this to direct their actions.

name: Ling Qiao
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm

Current landlord of Time Photography Studio. Grew up with Cheng Xiaoshi. Acts as the middleman and picks up commissions for Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang.

name: Fei Xia
description:
__Height:__ 185 cm

A college student studying Applied Physics in Bridon who became a part-time model and quickly became famous.

name: Vein
description:
__Height:__ 187 cm

The head of the Yingdu Chinese Chamber of Commerce. He oversees countless businesses and a talent agency, holding extensive connections and intelligence. Beneath his unrestrained exterior lies a sense of strong principle.

name: Xiao Liu
description:
__Height:__ 183 cm

Liu Xiao is the younger brother of Liu Min and the second son in the Liu family.

He met Li Tianchen by chance when they were both children. Later on, he left to study abroad and finished his studies, returning to China a few months after the events of Liu Min's passing and the Li Tianchen incident. Soon after, he met with Li Tianchen again and stated his plan to "bring more parallel lines together"

name: Qing Wang
description: **Height:** 173 cm

name: Momo Ayase
description: After making friends with [Ken Takakura](https://anilist.co/character/222593), who she calls "Okarun" (due to refusing to call him by the same name as the actor she idolizes), Momo wishes to help restore his body back to normal after being cursed by a yokai and must overcome other paranormal activities that are involved.

name: Aira Shiratori
description:
__Relatives:__ [Father](https://anilist.co/character/349655/Aira-no-Chichi)

After becoming aware of the existence of the supernatural after collecting a mysterious golden ball, Aira proclaims herself as the "chosen one" that is on a mission to protect the world from evil and directs her attention towards [Momo Ayase](https://anilist.co/character/222594/Momo-Ayase), believing that she is a demon that has to be stopped after seeing her use her psychic powers. Aira revels in her social status as the popular girl at Kami High and strives to maintain her reputation. Outwardly, she appears sweet, innocent, and somewhat air headed. However, internally, she is far more vain and prideful, a side she only shows to people she becomes close with. Whilst antagonistic towards Momo, she harbors feelings towards her close friend [Okarun](https://anilist.co/character/222593/Ken-Takakura).

~!She later gains the powers of a powerful spirit named [Acrobatic Silky](https://anilist.co/character/245467/Acrobatic-Sarasara) and becomes allies / friends with Momo and Okarun, learning to be more mindful of her actions and being more open with her true self.!~

name: Ken Takakura
description: He is a young male student with a firm belief that UFOs and aliens exist. Upon meeting [Momo Ayase](https://anilist.co/character/222594/Ayase-Momo) and taking up on her challenge to see if ghosts were real, Okarun became cursed by a yokai known as the [Turbo-Granny](https://anilist.co/character/239956/Turbo-Babaa) and seeks to return to normal.

name: Seiko Ayase
description: [Momo Ayase](https://anilist.co/character/222594/Ayase-Momo)'s grandmother. Despite being a grandmother, Seiko possesses a youthful appearance that does not match her age and is recognized as being quite beautiful.

name: Jin Enjouji
description:
Jin Enjouji is [Momo Ayase](https://anilist.co/character/222594/Momo-Ayase)'s childhood friend and first crush. After his parents were hospitalized as a result of his house being haunted, Enjouji moved in with Momo and [Seiko](https://anilist.co/character/234824/Seiko-Ayase) and transferred over to Momo's school. 

Jiji comes off as being a very hyper-active young man who likes to express himself with dramatic mannerisms and expressions. He also has a habit of usually ending his sentences with strange verbal tics and is known to be very athletic and enjoy sports, primarily soccer. Past his initial over-the-top presentation, Jiji is a good-natured guy who deeply values his friendships and is committed to protecting those close to him, striving to improve himself and act as a reliable ally in moments of danger. Despite his immaturity, Jiji demonstrates a strong sense of accountability and empathy. 

~!He later gets possessed by a mountain yokai called [the Evil Eye](https://anilist.co/character/309809/Jashi). Thus, whenever he touches cold water, Evil Eye comes out, and when he touches hot water, he is himself.!~

name: Turbo Babaa
description:
The yokai took on the form of a very elderly woman with long white shaggy hair and eyes that were stuck looking to the sides. When possessing her targets, she has her victims transform into a mirror image of herself, albeit with a large mouth with teeth that is capable of biting off body parts.

~!After having her consciousness extracted from [Okarun](https://anilist.co/character/222593/Takakura-Ken), the Turbo-Granny is forced to inhabit a maneki-neko doll.!~

name: Jashi
description: Jashi is a yokai who has spent years bound to the [Tsuchinoko](https://anilist.co/character/309811/Tsuchinoko) sacrificial house and is known for cursing humans to commit suicide with his gaze.

name: Penny Chinkosu
description: Peeny-Weeny, also known as the Dover Demon, is a Dover Demon's Race, he works for the Serpo in order to earn money for [his son's](https://anilist.co/character/270706/) blood transfusion.

name: Tarou
description: Taro is an anthropomorphized anatomical model that resides at Ayase's and Takakura's school.

name: Muuko
description: Best friend and classmate of Momo Ayase and Miko in high school.

name: Acrobatic Sarasara
description: Acrobatic Silky took on the form of a tall woman with long silky black hair. She had a narrow face with hollowed eyes, wrinkles on the upper half of her face, and a permanent lipstick smile that exposes her teeth. She walked around barefooted while wearing a red wide brimmed hat and a red dress.

name: Chiquitita
description: The son of the [Dover Demon](https://anilist.co/character/270705/Penny-Chinkosu), also known as the Mantisian. He needed to ingest new blood every day, but his life was saved thanks to [Seiko](https://anilist.co/character/234824/Seiko-Ayase) and crew giving them a cow. Currently lives on Earth with his father.

name: Miiko
description: Miiko is the best friend and classmate of Momo Ayase and Kei in high school.

name: Joou Sensei
description: Joou is the school nurse of Momo Ayase and Okarun's high school.

name: Serpo Seijin
description: Serupo Seijin are an entirely male alien race who come from Planet Serpo.

name: Hana
description: Hana is an anthropomorphized anatomical model that resides with Ayase and Seiko.

name: Tsubame
description: Aira's former closest friend at high school.

name: Naki Kitou
description:
Naki Kitou, the ringleader of the Kitou Family who for generations have been sacrificing people to the "tsuchinoko".
~!She is a subterranean.!~

name: Nessie
description: Nessie, also called Kamissie by Okarun since the creature had previously arrived in Kamikoshi City, was a cryptid and a disgruntled subordinate of the Serpod.

name: Anzu
description: Aira's former closest friend at high school.

name: Jibakurei Kani
description: Jibakurei Kani is an earthbound spirit that was previously bound to a tunnel in Shono City.

name: Serpod Dover Demon Nessie
description: Serupo Doubaadeemon Nesshii was the result of a Serupo fusing with the Dover Demon and Nessie as a last resort to eliminate Momo, Okarun and Aira.

name: Flatwoods Monster
description: Furattouzzu Monsutaa was an alien that was first sighted in the American town of Flatwoods.

name: Shouma
description: Shouma is a young man who valued having a good reputation as an idol.

name: Senkuu Ishigami
description:
__Height:__ 171 cm (5'7")

Senkuu is a genius with a vast amount of scientific knowledge. He is able to invent various kinds of tools and gadgets in a short amount of time with ease. As a child, he designed and built a functioning miniature rocket ship. Senkuu also possesses an analytical mind, being able to correctly discern the situation he is in. Even in his pre-teens, he was intelligent and sharp-minded enough to create advanced machines.

Senkuu's physical abilities are very low and he would lose against someone like [Kohaku](https://anilist.co/character/124143) in a brawl, something he himself admits.

~!In "Village Games Arc" Senku unintentionally won and married [Ruri](https://anilist.co/character/143272), but divorced immediately afterwards.!~

name: Gen Asagiri
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5'9")

Gen Asagiri is an enemy turned ally of [Senku](https://anilist.co/character/124142/Ishigami-Senkuu). Originally de-petrified by [Tsukasa Shishio](https://anilist.co/character/124144/Shishiou-Tsukasa), he was sent to find Senku, only to defect to the Kingdom of Science. Gen later becomes one of the Five Wise Generals.

He is somewhat full of himself and his abilities, taking pride in his status as a magician and a mentalist, along with his knowledge of the human psyche. Gen is rather quirky and can often be seen speaking in Pig Latin. He tends to be lazy, self absorbed, and perverted, and he is also perfectly capable of lying without a hint of stress or change in expression. While he frequently portrays an aura of selfishness, hard self-interest, manipulation and deviousness, Gen is intrinsically a good person who can't bring himself to harm others. His outward appearance is masked by his mastery in psychology, but his actions tell of loyalty, determination, kindness and even sacrifice at times.

While not nearly as intelligent in terms of science compared to Senku, he proves to be his equal and one of his most vital allies due to his ability to understand the human psyche and manipulate people through lies in contrast to Senku's more honest nature. He uses his abilities to promote cooperation and enthusiasm, motivate allies, conduct negotiations, and outsmart enemies. He tends to shift between acting as a ditzy airhead when it suits him (such as to avoid work or going into battle) and an intelligent manipulator. He is confident and is shown to have nerves of steel, even in the face of death.

He has frequently stated that his favourite drink is cola, and that he cannot handle alcohol.

name: Kohaku
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3")

Kohaku is a young woman who is a descendant of modern humans. She is Ruri's younger sister and the daughter of Kokuyo. She appears to be well known in her village due to her combative abilities, as both Kinro and Ginro were afraid of her. Kohaku excels at fighting, hunting, and general survival skills. She is a tomboy by nature, having little interest in more typical feminine activities and has little knowledge about them, although she does seem to enjoy some lavish clothing that was provided to her. She possesses a sharp instinct and intellect.

Kohaku is a kind young woman, caring deeply for her sickly older sister, willing to participate in the tournament for her hand in marriage just to protect her. This care extends to her comrades, and anyone she's loyal to. In addition to this, she has a reckless and hotheaded personality, often reacting in anger to being called a gorilla or lioness due to her strength and physicality. She also acts on her emotions at times, going against rational thought. She also has a bit of a teasing side, asking Chrome if he could fall for her to her resemblance to her sister.

name: Chrome
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7")

Chrome is the alleged sorcerer - eventually turned scientist - of Ishigami Village. As part of the Kingdom of Science, Chrome serves as the unofficial right hand of [Senku](https://anilist.co/character/124142/Ishigami-Senkuu); this trust is what makes him one of the Five Wise Generals.

Chrome is a highly energetic person with a lot of passion and curiosity. He is genuinely interested in science, although at first, he only knows it as sorcery. He is confident in his intellect, enough so to go toe to toe with Senku despite getting destroyed in a battle of wits. He also has a tendency to refer to something as "bad" when he thinks it is cool or amazing. Chrome has a deep love of science, though he admits his expertise and knowledge lies mainly in exploration, particularly pertaining to rocks and minerals and gathering them.

He is loyal and selfless to his friends and, while lacking in physical abilities, he is still able to think of clever solutions out of dangerous situations. He is also exceedingly brave, and in addition, while he is usually a loudmouth, he knows when to keep his mouth shut. He loves science and, in many ways, is an accomplished scientist in his own right, managing to create chemical reactions from the rocks he collected through frequent trial and error (reactions which were only made known in the seventeenth century), despite never knowing this knowledge before Senku's arrival.

name: Ryuusui Nanami
description:
__Height:__ 187 cm (6'1½")

Ryuusui Nanami is the son of the owner of Nanami Conglomorate. He was revived by [Senku](https://anilist.co/character/124142/Ishigami-Senkuu) for his expertise in sailing. His wisdom about adventuring at sea or air makes him indispensable as one of the Five Wise Generals of the Kingdom of Science.

He was the Heir to the Nanami Conglomerate, and an accomplished sailor. As such, he lived a wealthy and lavish lifestyle. Pre-Stone World, He has been seen as a greedy playboy, rarely seen without the company of beautiful women, exotic sports cars, and excessive partying. While he is arrogant and greedy, it was his greed that fuelled his ambition, which was the cause of his great success pre-Stone World. He spent a great deal of time studying, and was active in ship making, from making small models, to building huge ships. The money he earned, he put toward bettering himself and the company. Senku deduced that his presence would be beneficial to the Kingdom of Science, as his greed does not only apply to himself, but to those around him. He pushes and motivates everyone.

name: Suika
description:
__Height:__ 119 cm (3'10")

Suika is a young girl who lives in the village with the other stone age humans. Her most notable feature is the large watermelon on her head, which she can climb inside to disguise herself as the fruit. [Senku](https://anilist.co/character/124142/Ishigami-Senkuu) first meets Suika when he, [Chrome](https://anilist.co/character/124145/Chrome), and [Kohaku](https://anilist.co/character/124143/Kohaku) were searching for iron sand in a nearby river.

Suika is eager to help Senku build his kingdom of science because she's never been useful to anyone before. She comes to work as an information gatherer for the kingdom of science, occasionally being referred to as 'Ace Detective Suika.'

name: Tsukasa Shishiou
description:
__Height:__ 195 cm (6'4")

According to [Taiju](https://anilist.co/character/124146/Ooki-Taiju), Tsukasa has the reputation as "The Strongest High School Primate" due to his tremendous fighting abilities.

Tsukasa is essentially violent, but extremely careful and aware of his actions. He is a very kind, thoughtful, and polite man outside of his pessimistic ideals towards humanity. He offers help in the beginning to [Senku](https://anilist.co/character/124142/Ishigami-Senkuu) and Taiju after they revive him and becomes their hunter for food, using his skills as a prominent athlete to aid them. It’s revealed later that Tsukasa plans to purge humanity of adults who hurt the young and weak, then thinks Senku will go along with him, but instead Senku rejects him. After this point, Tsukasa becomes fairly determined in carrying out his plans even to the point of leaving their group.

name: Ukyou Saionji
description:
__Height:__ 173 cm (5'8")

Ukyou is a survivor that was revived by [Tsukasa Shishiou](https://anilist.co/character/124144/Tsukasa-Shishiou). He is pacifistic and dislikes needless bloodshed.

name: Kaseki
description:
__Height:__ 155 cm (5'1")

Kaseki is an elderly craftsman from the Ishigami Village. When Senku arrives at Ishigami village, Kaseki is introduced as an artisan, and through Senku, his dedication to his craft is reignited tenfold.

name: Taiju Ooki
description:
__Height:__ 189 cm (6'2½")

Taiju is an outgoing, friendly, and kind person. He's enthusiastic about performing even small tasks and a diligent worker. He is very determined when something is important to him. He tends to yell loudly and is enthusiastic regardless of the task so long as he proves useful. He is persistent and determined. Despite being emotional and expressive, he has great control of his temper, never losing his cool or acting impulsively.

Taiju possesses an extremely sturdy body, something his friend [Senku](https://anilist.co/character/124142) vouches him for. He is the first human to be able to withstand a kick from [Tsukasa](https://anilist.co/character/124144) without losing consciousness. He also possesses immense stamina, able to cross 80 kilometers in 5 hours.

name: Yuzuriha Ogawa
description:
Yuzuriha is the love interest of [Taiju](https://anilist.co/character/124146) and a friend of [Senkuu](https://anilist.co/character/124142).

Yuzuriha is a young woman with brown hair, brown eyes, and a slim build. She has two noticeable petrification scars, both in the shape of spirals, located on her shoulder and neck. Before her petrification, Yuzuriha wears a standard High School Uniform. After her depetrification, she wears a white cloth dress that's spit at her sides and matching cloth shoes. Noticeably, Yuzuriha wears a white hairband that's vaguely shaped like wrap-around headphones, both before and after her petrification.

name: Hyouga
description:
__Height:__ 189cm (6'2")

Hyoga is a survivor who was revived by Tsukasa Shishio. Initially, he was an elite member of the Tsukasa Empire since he was depetrified by Tsukasa.

~!He ultimately betrays Tsukasa by attempting to take over his leadership and threatens Senku into joining, only to be defeated by the duo in the decisive battle for the Kingdom of Science. When the situation calls for it, he is depetrified once again and summoned to battle - now as a begrudging ally of the Kingdom of Science with a similar but slightly mellowed goal in mind. Since his third depetrification, Hyoga's goals are unknown.!~

Hyoga has an easy going attitude towards everything. Even in situation that do not work in his favour, he still remains calm. While he claims to share the same values as Tsukasa when it comes to only reviving the young and creating a community where no one takes from others, Hyoga himself is an elitist who believes in social darwinism. He categorizes humans as either enlightened (or strong) and unenlightened (or weak). He believes that the "brainless incompetent masses" should not be allowed to live and that only those who excel should be allowed to live. While he does follow a form of social darwinism, he does not believe it is only the physically strong who should survive, as he wanted Senku to join him in his endeavors and become the strongest duo, indicating he respected Senku's intelligence and understood his capabilities. He is very manipulative and cunning, seems to be observant, and can often be cruel, merciless, and uncaring. He tends to refer to things as being done "properly" or not.

name: Kinrou
description:
Kinrou is the elder brother of [Ginrou](https://anilist.co/character/143270/Ginrou) and the son of Tetsuken and Shirogane. Originally having served as one of the guards of Ishigami Village alongside Ginrou, he quickly joined [Senku](https://anilist.co/character/124142/Ishigami-Senkuu) as a member of the Kingdom of Science. 

Kinrou is a muscular young man of average height, with a scar on the right side of his face and a cluster of hair hanging in between his eyes.
