He wears a sleeveless karate gi-like uniform with a belt and a buckler with a star pattern on his back. After the Grand Bout, Kinrou begins wearing a pair of glasses to correct his nearsightedness.

name: Ginrou
description:
Ginrou is [Kinrou](https://anilist.co/character/143271/Kinrou)'s younger brother and one of the village guards. He is shorter and scrawnier than his brother, with short blonde hair and green eyes. He usually wears a karate gi-like uniform and belt and carries his spear wherever he goes. He and his brother were two of the first villagers to join the Kingdom of Science.

~!During the adventure on Treasure Island, Ginrou manages to convince [Matsukaze](https://anilist.co/character/188816/Matsukaze) to serve him due to the resemblance Ginrou bears to his late master.!~

name: Dr. Xeno
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm (5'11")

Scientist and leader of the American Colony. Similar to [Senku](https://anilist.co/character/124142/Ishigami-Senkuu), Xeno is brilliant when it comes to science. He is very observant, somewhat eccentric, and has a penchant for stating the word "Elegant."

name: Stanley Snyder
description: Stanley is a tall, well-built man with very feminine facial features.

name: Francois
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3")

Francois is [Ryuusui](https://anilist.co/character/145097/Ryuusui-Nanami)'s faithful and extremely talented butler whose services were well sought out and coveted before the Petrification. Their gender remains unknown. They are demonstrated to be a supreme chef.

name: Homura Momiji
description:
__Height:__ 145 cm (4'9")

Homura acts as the right-hand man of [Hyouga](https://anilist.co/character/145062/Hyouga) in [Tsukasa](https://anilist.co/character/124144/Tsukasa-Shishiou)'s army. She was a competitive gymnast before the petrification.

name: Nikki Hanada
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm (5'11")

Nikki is a survivor that was revived by [Tsukasa](https://anilist.co/character/124144/Tsukasa-Shishiou), who assigned her to keep watch over [Taiju](https://anilist.co/character/124146/Taiju-Ooki) and [Yuzuriha](https://anilist.co/character/124147/Yuzuriha-Ogawa). She later defected from the Tsukasa Empire and joined the Kingdom of Science, where her unofficial role is that of disciplinarian. She has great physical strength, constantly being shown keeping people like [Magma](https://anilist.co/character/145095/Magma) and [You](https://anilist.co/character/145061/You-Uei) in line.

Nikki is a massive fan of [Lillian Weinberg](https://anilist.co/character/149274/Lillian-Weinberg). In the modern world she was having a rough time at school and listening to Lillian's songs saved her.

name: Luna Wright
description:
__Height:__ 165 cm (5'5")

Luna is a slender young woman of average height who has somewhat wild, short blonde hair with a few locks long enough to cover her left eye, similar to [Ginro](https://anilist.co/character/143270). She has a small bust but extremely wide hips and is considered to be very attractive by [Carlos](https://anilist.co/character/187009), [Max](https://anilist.co/character/187010), [Mozu](https://anilist.co/character/157298), and several others. For clothing, she wears a striped, form-fitting short backless dress and a choker with a star on it. She also has a pouch wrapped around her left thigh and a pair of thigh-high boots with heels. Her petrification scar takes the form of a star shape on her lower back.

~!Luna is one of the residents of the American colony.!~

name: SAI Nanami
description:
__Height:__ 181 cm

Sai Nanami is the son of the owner of Nanami Conglomerate and the older brother of [Ryusui Nanami](https://anilist.co/character/145097/Nanami-Ryuusui). While he is a prodigy in mathematics and is said to be "a million times" better than the average person (according to Ryusui), Sai's passion lies in coding, and he claims himself to be a programmer rather than a mathematician.

name: Chelsea Childe
description:
__Height:__ 148cm (4'10")

Chelsea is a happy girl who seems friendly and excited, especially after seeing people for the first time after petrification. Her straightforward and carefree attitude when talking earns her a nickname of "Chelsea the Blunt" by Gen, practically when she ask Luna directly about her weight.

name: Minami Hokutouzai
description:
__Height:__ 166 cm (5'4")

Minami is a Pre-Petrification human and former reporter before the Petrification occurred. ~!Originally a member of [Tsukasa](https://anilist.co/character/124144/Shishiou-Tsukasa)'s army before Tsukasa's downfall at the hands of [Hyoga](https://anilist.co/character/145062/Hyouga)'s betrayal, she later joins and helps the Kingdom of Science.!~

name: You Uei
description:
__Height:__ 177 cm (5'10")

You is a pre-petrification human and former policeman who is revived by [Tsukasa](https://anilist.co/character/124144/Tsukasa-Shishiou). He faked his death after [Chrome](https://anilist.co/character/124145/Chrome)'s escape to avoid the blame, then eventually joins the Kingdom of Science after the stone wars are over. As penance, he worked with [Yuzuriha](https://anilist.co/character/124147/Yuzuriha-Ogawa) to rebuild the statues that were destroyed by Tsukasa. He is constantly butting heads with [Magma](https://anilist.co/character/145095/Magma) due to each other's naivety of their respective worlds.

name: Chalk
description: Dog from Ishigami Village. He is Suika's friend.

name: Yuusuke Urameshi
description:
The main protagonist of the manga and anime series YuYu Hakusho.

He is a Spirit Detective who is tasked with protecting the Human World from various supernatural threats over the course of the series and his closest friends, as well as greatest allies, include [Kuwabara](https://anilist.co/character/730/Kuwabara-Kazuma), [Kurama](https://anilist.co/character/731/Kurama), [Hiei](https://anilist.co/character/732/Hiei), [Keiko](https://anilist.co/character/733/Yukimura-Keiko), [Genkai](https://anilist.co/character/735/Genkai), [Koenma](https://anilist.co/character/2305/Koenma) and [Botan](https://anilist.co/character/734/Botan). He is also the de facto leader of Team Urameshi and the general person to look to when the going gets tough.

At the start of the series, Yusuke is an uncontrollable teenage delinquent/street fighter with little to no positive qualities to his character. Over the course of the series, he starts becoming a better person, changing into an almost altruistic defender of the Human World while he himself continues to become a powerful martial artist.

(Source: Yu Yu Hakusho Wiki)

name: Hiei
description:
Hiei is a main character in Yu Yu Hakusho, a demon who prefers to keep his distance from others. Because of this he often comes across as aloof and elusive. He has a rather cynical and even misanthropic view of the world around him, often belittling and mocking humans and their emotions and the significance they place on friendship and life.

Hiei is the shortest of the four main characters at only 147 cm (4'10) during the Dark Tournament as stated by [Juri](https://anilist.co/character/8717/). Despite his short size, he has a lean, muscular build to him. He wears a white headband that conceals his Jagan Eye, which is placed on his forehead and has a purple iris. His eyes are crimson, with an angular and slightly slanted shape, giving him a very sinister look in the beginning of the series. He has spiky black hair with blue outlining and white streaks. His skin complexion is regular peach-tan. Living up to his classic villainous persona, Hiei usually dresses entirely in black.

__Trivia:__
- Hiei was based on the character Skunky from [Patalliro!](https://anilist.co/anime/2835/)

(Source: Yu Yu Hakusho Wiki)

name: Kurama
description:
Kurama is first encountered in the series at the same time as Hiei. His ability is in manipulating plants, and he generally wields a whip created from a rose vine, complete with thorns. He is one of the wiser characters in the series and the smartest and calmest of the four main characters.

Kurama is generally regarded as the most calm and level-headed member of the group. His analytical nature is present in battle where he prefers to study the strengths and weaknesses of his opponents before devising a strategy of his own.  He is protective of those he cares about and is often merciless to anyone that poses them a threat, a shift in his usually friendly manner. In many instances, Kurama has shown to be very self-sacrificing in the interests of the safety of his friends and family.  

Fox Demon Kurama/Youko Kurama was a cold hearted and ruthless thief and the most feared bandit in Makai. He was considered to be an A-class demon (though he eventually surpasses that), and is said to be more than a thousand years old. After being wounded by a bounty hunter while in his spirit fox form, Kurama sent his spirit into the Ningenkai (human world) where his spirit took refuge within an unborn child that had not yet gained a soul. It was from this point that Kurama made the transfer to a human body with the intention to recover his strength as the child developed. Kurama planned to leave Ningenkai to return to Makai after regaining his strength after an estimated ten years. However, sometime during or before the tenth year, an act of selflessness by his mother, Minamino Shiori, opened Kurama's eyes to pain he had caused his mother while growing up. Thus, he decides to continue living his human life as Shiori's son.

Kurama's special ability is that he can turn plants into deadly weapons by manipulating his youki into that plant. Kurama has complete control over any Human Realm plant and has some control over Demon Realm plants. However Demon Fox Kurama has complete control over Demon Realm Plants and has more power than regular Kurama. The strength of Kurama's moves depends on how much aura Kurama uses. He has an incredible sense of smell and he can read lips. Though Kurama is considered the second weakest of the four main fighters, topping out at low S-class power by the end of the series, he is easily the smartest fighter of the four. He relies on cunning and tactics and not necessarily power to win battles. 

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Narrator
description:
This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. 

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

name: Kazuma Kuwabara
description:
Kuwabara, as most people call him, is the second-toughest kid in Sarayashiki Junior High School and is always trying to usurp [Yusuke Urameshi](https://anilist.co/character/729/Urameshi-Yuusuke)'s position as the toughest. In the manga(chp.1) he says he never lost a fight until he met Yusuke. He leads a gang consisting of himself, [Kirishima](https://anilist.co/character/9591/Kirishima), [Okubo](https://anilist.co/character/8641/Okubo), and [Sawamura](https://anilist.co/character/8640/Sawamura) (In the English dub, Komada). He has a soft spot for kittens (including his own, Eikichi) and an iron code of honor. He develops a minor crush on [Botan](https://anilist.co/character/734/Botan) when he first meets her, but later harbors intense feelings on the ice apparition [Yukina](https://anilist.co/character/736/Yukina), but is unaware that she is [Hiei](https://anilist.co/character/732/Hiei)'s sister.

Kuwabara has a tough older sister named [Shizuru Kuwabara](https://anilist.co/character/8595/Kuwabara-Shizuru). She and Yukina are the only characters known to call him by his given name. In the anime, Kazuma and Shizuru's parents never appear and are rarely, if ever, even acknowledged. His father does makes a brief appearance in the final volume of the manga to reveal that Yukina is going to be living with them and appears to be aware of the Reikai, etc. As the show progress, Kuwabara's and Yusuke's relationship evolves from rivals to best friends, although the two still disagree constantly. Kuwabara and [Kurama](https://anilist.co/character/731/Kurama) are quite cordial with each other, but Kuwabara shares no love for Hiei, and both will readily mention their hatred of the other, although in truth deep down they are friends.

Kuwabara's most unusual ability is his sensitivity to Reiki, or Spirit Awareness. He and his band of friends call this "the Tickle." Kuwabara has the ability to sense when ghosts and the paranormal are around, can see spirits and other demons, and can predict motives of others. Kuwabara can also create a blade out of his own spirit energy (known as the Rei Ken, or Spirit Sword). Although he first needed a piece of wood as a physical entity to create it, Kuwabara was able to practice and be able to create his own after one month (six months in the English anime). During his training, Kuwabara's sword is able to extend and shrink to his whim, and he can even create two, one in each hand.

Kuwabara is not as strong as the rest of his teammates, but can be quite crafty in battle when he needs to be, and he is widely considered as the nicest of the four.

name: Botan
description: Botan is the guide for the dead across the Sanzu River (the River Styx), Botan is hardly typical of what one would expect from the shinigami, or death god; clad in a bright pink kimono, with her blue hair in a ponytail. Botan is cheerful, sometimes sarcastic, and a completely atypical version of Death (something the main character Yusuke Urameshi points out almost immediately after meeting her). Although her initial purpose is to help Yusuke cross over to the Spirit World, or Reikai, Botan eventually becomes a sort of guardian angel to Yusuke, helping him in his efforts to return to his body, and when Yusuke becomes a Spirit Detective, being the liaison between Yusuke and friends, and Koenma in Reikai. Botan works hard, cares deeply for others, and tries not to let her friends know when she's down.  Botan is not a fighter like those around her, but she has fought several times, often to help Keiko Yukimura to get her out of trouble. She has no spirit powers like Yusuke's Rei Gun or Kuwabara's Spirit Sword, but she possesses heightened spirit awareness and spiritual energy (as can be determined by her ability to use the detective tools, which require spirit energy in order to work.) Typically, when Botan fights, she tends to favor blunt instruments like her oar, a metal bat, or, if all else fails, her fists. In her human form, Botan can use any of Yusuke's detective items. In one scene during the episode "Setting the Trap", Botan was planning to use the Concentration Ring to blow up walls, which suggests she might have spirit powers like Yusuke, but they are undisclosed. Botan tends to use human weapons, or something heavy around, to fight while in the human world. Botan also possesses healing powers, to the extent that she could stop or pause demonic transformations.  In the old FUNimation dub, she is given a slight British accent.

name: Toguro Otouto
description: Younger Toguro is the younger of the two Toguro brothers, as well as the most powerful member of Team Toguro. He is the main antagonist of the Dark Tournament Saga, aside from Sakyo. He is always calm and collected, as is expressed by the fact that he never removes his trademark sunglasses. He has no plans in life and spends most of the series serving under Sakyo, one of his most important clients. He's tall and extremely muscular with a slick black hairstyle.

name: Shinobu Sensui
description: Shinobu Sensui was Earth's Spirit Detective before Yusuke Urameshi. According to Koenma, he was the natural choice; he was gifted with amazing spirit awareness, strength, and a strong moral sense of right and wrong.  Sensui was very clear-cut and adamant about his moral codes. Humans were victims, so he had to protect them. Demons were evil; he had to kill them. In time he met Itsuki, who asks Sensui give him another day to live first so he can watch the finale of his favourite TV show. Hearing something so human coming from a demon, Sensui laughs and spares Itsuki. By hanging around Itsuki, Sensui realized that not all demons were evil. However, his attitude towards humanity didn't change until one fateful night.   ~!Koenma had ordered Sensui to seal a tunnel connecting Demon World and Human World. This portal was being maintained by the Black Book Club (Sakyo amongst them), for use in luring demons through; kidnapping them, and then selling them as bodyguards. Sensui was able to catch the club by surprise, but in doing so witnessed a horrifying sight. He saw something known as the Feast of Human Vices, where the demons were cruelly tortured by humans, who then bathed in their blood for no purpose other than a sense of power and twisted enjoyment. Sensui’s black-and-white beliefs about humans and demons, that one was wholly good and the other wholly evil, suddenly became very grey. Unable to handle this discovery and the knowledge of his own acts, he was driven insane. In a rage, Sensui slaughtered everyone there, and began to question the sanctity of the human race.  He became obsessed with the Chapter Black video tape, which documented the worst cruelties of the human race against demons and each other. The tape and Sensui eventually disappeared. Sensui decided to punish humanity for their sins by opening a stable tunnel to Demon World, in turn keeping Team Toguro owner and (ironically) Black Black Club member Sakyo's plan alive.  He waited ten years for Koenma to recruit a new Spirit Detective so that humanity could have an ‘attorney’ to defend itself in the upcoming ‘trial’. With his partner Itsuki, and recruiting other psychically gifted humans to their side, using the Chapter Black tape to turn them against their own kind, he claimed he wanted to purge the living world of the human scourge.  These humans, seven in number, were thought by Yusuke and his companions to be Sensui's seven. However it was revealed that Sensui's seven did not refer to the seven humans, but his seven personalities. One of Sensui's personalities proclaimed that the seven of them would be the ones to wipe out the human race.!~

name: Genkai
description: She trains Yusuke in the Spirit Light Wave Fist (Reikō Hadō Ken) aka the Spirit Wave in the English dub and coaches him to the extreme. Though she may appears nasty towards Yusuke and the others, she truly cares about all of them, and tries to lead them down the right road.  Genkai is an elderly martial arts expert who lives alone in a very large temple. She first appears during Yusuke's second case as he infiltrates a tournament she is holding to find a successor to her techniques in search of the demon Rando. Genkai is a legendary reiki master, known both in the human and demon realms. Yusuke ends up winning the tournament, defeating Rando in the process, and is taken on as a student by Genkai.  ~!When she was 50 years younger, Genkai and the younger Toguro brother were lovers and teammates in an earlier Dark Tournament. After winning, Toguro decides to become a demon, while Genkai returns to the human world, creating a split in their relationship. She enters the next Dark Tournament with Yusuke, disguising herself as the "Masked Fighter" in order to once again face Toguro. Her signature technique is the Spirit Wave, an outpouring of spirit energy from the whole body which can be directed through several different variations. This makes her technique effective in healing and purification, in addition to combat. A side effect of using this power is a shifting of the body's cells which leads to a temporary reversion to the form in which the wielder was at their most powerful in life. In Genkai's case, it allowed her to briefly regain her youth.!~  Although Genkai is of advanced age and her physical and spiritual strength had gone down, she is still a fighter to be respected and feared. Even after she gave up most of her power to Yusuke, she still is capable of using some Reiki notably during the Chapter Black saga.

name: Keiko Yukimura
description:
Keiko Yukimura is a straight-A student whose personality is opposite that of [Yusuke's](https://anilist.co/character/729/Yuusuke-Urameshi). Her hobbies include cooking and cleaning. Keiko's parents run a ramen restaurant called the Yukimura Diner. 

 After Yusuke is hit and killed by a car, he is allowed to come back to life on the condition that someone kisses him, and this ends up being Keiko. Yusuke tries to not get her involved with his spirit detective escapades, but circumstances prevent her from staying uninvolved. After being dragged into multiple supernatural incidents, Keiko asks [Botan](https://anilist.co/character/734/Botan) to explain Yusuke's situation and is initially told a cover story which excludes any supernatural element. Eventually the full truth is revealed and Keiko does her best to support from the sidelines.

~!Yusuke and Keiko, who are childhood friends, are closer to each other than they would like to admit. Towards the end of the series, Yusuke stops by her parents ramen restaurant and proposes to Keiko. It is initially brushed off as being like multiple proposals when they were kids whenever Keiko got mad at Yusuke, but he promises to return in three years and marry her. After Yusuke returns to the human world at the end of the series it is implied that he keeps this promise!~

name: Koenma
description: King Enma Jr., usually addressed as Koenma, is the son of [Enma](https://anilist.co/character/34456/Enma-Daiou), the ruler of the spirit realm, and the one responsible for appointing [Yusuke Urameshi](https://anilist.co/character/729/Yuusuke-Urameshi) as spirit detective. Koenma first appears as a toddler, which he is often teased about, though he is at least 700 years old and has extensive knowledge of the universe. Koenma is a basic comic relief character and is often shown as cowardly. However, if Yusuke or any of the others are in immediate danger, he will help all he can. He comes off as a good leader and a nice guy for the most part. His job in Spirit World is to decide who goes to Heaven, and who goes to Hell. Some think this should be his father's job, but King Enma is too busy on business trips most of the time.  Also, he has a Jr. sign on his forehead, and still has his pacifier, which has been carried in his mouth for most of his existence, storing up his spirit energy. When the power is unleashed, it creates the Mafukkan, Spirit World's most powerful defensive spell.

name: Jin
description: Jin is one of the members of the Shadow Channelers team during the Dark Tournament. The team's true name, however, was the Shinobi of the Spirit World. He is assumed friends with Touya, another member, since one is almost never seen independent of the other, except when fighting, and they stick together after the Dark Tournament. Jin has a cheerful and up-beat personality. Jin speaks with a strong Irish accent (in the English dub) and has a serious disdain for his team-mate, the brutish Bakken. He tells Yusuke that a fighter shouldn't bring outside hostilities and anger into a match, and that they should enjoy themselves - especially when they are battling for their lives. Despite his sunny disposition - or perhaps because of it - Jin is an incredibly talented fighter who throws himself whole-heartedly into a match. Jin's special ability is wind manipulation, being able to float in the air, create miniature cyclones around his fists, or create full-blown tornadoes.    Jin first appeared, along with the other members of the Shadow Channlers, in the Dark Tournament against Team Urameshi. Jin, just as he wanted, ended up fighting Yusuke Urameshi. After a long battle where each of them sent one powerful attack after another to their opponent, Jin finally got knocked out of the arena and lost. Unfortunately for Yusuke, due to a trick made by the team's owner, the battle was counted as a tie. Following the Dark Tournament, Jin later appears in the Makai Tournament. He was recruited by Kurama to work for one of the three Demon Lords, Yomi in the Demon Plane, or Makai. Jin trains under Genkai before entering the Makai Tournament, and goes from an upper C Class to an upper A Class. During the tournament itself, Jin ends up fighting Souketsu, who was a former friend and rival of Yusuke's ancestral father, the thunder god Raizen. A flashback is shown where Soketsu is defeated by the deceased king (Raizen).

name: Shizuru Kuwabara
description: Kazuma Kuwabara's tough older sister. Like her younger brother she also has a high level of Reiki sensitivity and is extremely strong; Shizuru, in the beginning of the manga, has more of a sixth sense than her brother. Shizuru, 17 at the start of the manga, wants Kazuma to grow up and get an education so he can make something of himself. Shizuru, an aspiring beautician, gives Keiko her new haircut after Keiko rescues Yusuke from the burning house in Chapter 13: Qualifications for a Girlfriend. Shizuru is also a chain smoker and the biggest part she plays in the anime series is during the Dark Tournament (Ankoku Būtsukai) where she falls in love with Sakyo, the owner of Team Urameshi's rival team, Team Toguro. He saves her life twice, but she is unaware of his true identity until the end. She also knows Yukina's connection to Hiei because she saw a videotape that provided the details for the mission that Yusuke and Kuwabara had to rescue Yukina from Gonzo Tarukane (only she, Botan, and Yusuke saw the details that Yukina is Hiei's sister). Like Keiko, she is a woman who is unafraid to speak her mind or deliver a beat-down where needed. She even yells out to Toguro during the Dark Tournament when he goes up to face Yusuke. Shizuru also appears in the Chapter Black and Three Kings saga. During the Three Kings saga, Shizuru who was tired of seeing her brother recklessly endanger his life began to harshly discipline Kazuma to force him to keep up in his school studies and warned him that he would only bring ruin to his life if he kept fighting. In the anime, Shizuru is introduced later (during the Yukina arc rather than right after Keiko's fiery haircut), but ends up having a larger role, mostly due to the addition of her romance with Sakyo and her taking on Atsuko's role.

name: Raizen
description: The strongest of the Three Kings, the God of War, and the strongest character in the series. Raizen, however, was injured in battle and nursed back to life by a human who he fell in love with and impregnated with his baby. Raizen vowed to never eat another human again until he saw her again, though she died before he could, and, keeping his promise, went on starving himself for hundreds of years, and his power decreased as his hunger grew. The family line of the witch doctor continued into Yusuke Urameshi. Just minutes before starving to death, Raizen still had enough strength to fight evenly with S-Class warriors. Raizen possessed Yusuke during his battle with Sensui, and with Raizen's help Yusuke defeated Sensui. Raizen then tells Yusuke to train relentlessly for months so he will surpass Raizen and gain his kingdom before he dies, but Raizen dies before Yusuke surpasses him, Yusuke still gains Raizen's kingdom.

name: Koto
description: Koto is the referee in the Dark Tournament. She is a fox demon like Kurama, but seems to have no special abilities. She is later replaced by Juri and switches to commentary. She was also the referee in the Makai Tournament. She is an idol in both the human and demon planes. She seems to have a crush on Kurama's demon form, Yoko.    Koto often seemed overly amused by the suffering of the fighters in the Dark Tournament, leading to her looking like a mean character. However, she later reveals that she can only enjoy brutality when both contestants can fight back. During the tournament, she begins a ten-count in an attempt to stop Bakken from beating up Kurama- showing that she is not totally sadistic. She also has the entire tournament rule book memorized.    Koto is briefy the object of affection for Chu, whom she doesn't share feelings for. She sometimes puts on a cute act, but is very shrewd and manages to get in jabs at Juri being a former 'cocktail waitress'.

name: Chuu
description: The true captain of the Jolly Devil Six a.k.a. Team Rokuyukai. One of his types of fighting styles is the Drunken Fist. When preforming Drunken Fist he moves with an erratic stumbling motion which, in addition to making him difficult to attack, allows him to move very quickly. He fuses his demon energy with the alcohol to form his Sui Ken, which is a ball of energy he throws at his opponent. The other form of fighting he uses is his favorite type- a Knife Edge Death Match, in which he put his knives into the floor of the arena, and he and his opponent put their feet to the knife. The first one to slip his foot off the knife loses, and the winner has the right to kill the loser. He later falls in love with a demon girl named Natsume, in the Makai Tournament and surrenders to her automatically when fighting in the preliminaries. In the English dub he is given an Australian accent.

name: Mukuro
description: Mukuro is one of the Three Kings of Makai. She's been a sex slave since birth and on her 7th birthday she decided to pour acid on her body to have her master abandon her. Once free, she replaced the burned right side of her body with mechanical parts and masked herself to hide her womanly status. In the following centuries, she became more and more strong, feeding her powers with the hate derived from her traumatic childhood, and slowly built a kingdom until she became strong enough to face the Makai Lord Raizen and started a war against him. She was saved to be consumed by hatred by finding Hiei's lost Hirui stone, that had the power to calm her soul, and later she summoned Hiei to be her ally in the Three Kings war, and she developed a deep bond with him due to them having both experienced deep hate and traumatic childhood. During the Makai tournament in the anime, she fought Hiei and she won, but he managed to break the hard chains that she had on her wrists since the time of her slavery, a symbolic way to free her from her past. In the manga, Hiei does the same thing by capturing her abusive master and removing a mental conditioning that prevented her from trying to kill him.

name: Puu
description: Yusuke's spirit beast who hatched from an egg that fed off his actions. Puu is considered to be a reflection of Yusuke's soul, likewise Puu's physical condition reflects Yusuke's, even bieng able to find Yusuke no matter where he is. This connection has caused Yusuke to think of him as his other half.   ~!During Yusuke's second revival Puu evolved into a phoenix and protected his body from an assault from the spirit world until Yusuke's revival was complete.!~

name: Yukina
description:
__Height:__ 152 cm (4'10")

Yukina is the kind, thoughtful, and somewhat naïve twin sister of Hiei. Her name literally means 'Ice Sprout'. Yukina was born as an ice apparition (Kourime, literally ‘Ice Woman’), the same as her clan. Ice apparitions have special abilities relating to snow and ice, and have light healing abilities. In addition, when they cry, their tears become gems, which are highly valuable in the human world. But she was also born with a twin brother Hiei. Her twin brother was the forbidden child who was never supposed to exist, and was "killed" by being thrown off a cliff, despite his mother's desperate pleas.    At the beginning of the series, Yukina had no knowledge that both Hiei existed and that she had a brother. Hiei also, for reasons that remain largely unknown to Yukina, always shows up at various times to protect her when others aren't around or are unable to do so. In the manga, Yukina does eventually figure out that Hiei is, in fact, her brother. (In the English Dub Hiei often tells her that her brother is most likely dead) Yukina is also the love interest of Kazuma Kuwabara, although she remains unaware of this. The very first time Kuwabara saw Yukina via video tape, Kuwabara replied that he was in love and left quickly to rescue her, although he didn't stay long enough to find out that Yukina was Hiei's sister. At any time he can, Kuwabara will try to protect Yukina at any cost to him. At the very first sight of Yukina, Kuwabara's strength rapidly increases past its normal limits, as seen during his battle with Risho. After seeing how Tarukane treated Yukina, Kuwabara told her he wanted her to not hate humans, to which she replied that she didn't dislike humans and liked Kuwabara.

name: Yomi
description: Is the newest of the Three Kings. He is the former second in command to Kurama's brigand prior to Kurama placing his soul into a mortal. Yomi, however, was reckless, losing countless men in unauthorized raids and direct confrontation, thinking it more exciting that way. Kurama, angered, sent an assassin to kill him, who failed but blinded Yomi. Yomi then grew extra ears and tuned his senses so acutely he could eventually hear all within his kingdom. He plans to take over both the demon and human planes, calling on Kurama to his side. He fights Yusuke in the tournament, barely winning after hearing Shura's shout, and loses the next round due to his injuries. Yomi then leaves to properly raise and train Shura, thanking Yusuke for helping him achieve a sense of peace he could not have attained on his own.

name: George Saotome
description: George Saotome is an oni working with Koenma as his personal assistant whenever Botan is on Earth. Koenma sometimes clashes with him and primarily vents his anger on him if he is anxious over a situation. In the second to last episode of the anime, it is revealed that he is also the narrator of the series, a joke on how they have the same voice actor. In the English version he is referred as Ogre or Blue Ogre and not by name.

name: Juri
description: Juri is the referee of the Dark Tournament after Koto was forced to switch to commentary. She is apparently a sea-creature demon. She is an idol in the human and demon planes. Towards the end of the Dark Tournament, she complains that she will die a virgin, but in the Makai Tournament, Koto implies that she got "what she wanted", and there is an extra scene showing Juri watching the tournament with a demon with a mustache, presumably her husband.

name: Karasu
description: A member of the Togoru team in the dark tournament. Karasu is a lower B Class demon. Karasu's personality is largely unknown, with Karasu always remaining calm and serious, never showing his true self. Karasu always wears a mask over his lower face. His goal in the tournament was to have Kurama's severed head. In the second Character Popularity Polls in Japan, Karasu was at 8th place with 698 votes, making him the most popular member of Team Toguro.    Sometime ago, Karasu and Bui faced off against the Toguro brothers, where the brothers won. Promising them a rematch if they joined their force, the two followed the Toguro Brothers.    Karasu is a demon bomber, and as such can not only explode things without physical contact, he can also create bombs himself, including winged bombs and giant cases of dynamite. Karasu's most dangerous ability comes after he removes his mask, and his hair turns from black to blond, a full-body explosion strong enough to kill large numbers of humans.    Before the Final Rounds, Karasu met Kurama in an alley where the two had a confrontation, which ended in Karasu victorious.    During the Final Rounds, Karasu fought against Kurama, where he almost killed Kurama off rather quickly, and it was only thanks to a potion Suzuka gave to Kurama that helped him live, transforming him into Youko. Kurama then gained the advantage, having a giant plant eat Karasu. Karasu simply exploded the plant and used his full-body explosion on Kurama, reverting him back to human. Karasu then had the complete advantage, almost killing Kurama, but Kurama used a Vampire Plant to stab Karasu's heart, killing him. However, Kurama still failed to win the match since he attacked from his knees and timed out.

name: Sakyo
description: Sakyo is the owner and leader of Team Toguro in the Dark Tournament. He is a very rich man, having gained his wealth from gambling all his life. He is usually a very calm, collected, and intelligent person while keeping his evil side influencing his outside self. For both the Rescue Yukina arcs and Dark Tournament Saga, Sakyo made few appearances, but in truth was the real villain of both arcs, merely using Team Toguro as his own personal puppets, although it appears none of the characters realized this.    Sakyo was once one of five siblings, but unlike his siblings, he "veered from the norm". While his siblings became civil servants, he began to gain mental insanity and coveted blood. Over a three year period, he slowly moved from dissecting frogs and fish, to cats and dogs, and finally real humans. Soon he entered the gambling business, using a key strategy to help him win by threatening to wager his life. Most of the time the others quit when they saw he was serious, but this was suspected five times. He states one time was up against the Black Book Club, or BBC, which he was a former member of, and the last this was suggested, coincidentally the last time he wagered his life, was during the final rounds of the Dark Tournament. It is sometime in his gambling life he became a member of the BBC.    Sometime during his membership, former Spirit Detective Shinobu Sensui had witnessed an experiment the BBC were doing, Sakyo included. They had made several humans slaughter demons taken from a portal between the human and demon planes, and the humans then bathed in their blood. Angry, Sensui killed all of the humans, and began to question humanity.

name: Atsuko Urameshi
description: Atsuko Urameshi is Yusuke's alcoholic mother, who first gave birth to him when she was only 15 years old. She tries to raise him into a respectable citizen despite her questionable private life. She wants nothing more than her son to turn out better than her, but she has a hard time with that, and doesn't really succeed. However, she shows that she really does care about Yusuke when she cries at his funeral. In the Filipino dub she is known as "Victoria". Atsuko has a larger role in the manga, accompanying the girls to the Dark Tournament. In the beginning of the manga, Atsuko is 29 years old.

name: Joseph Joestar
description:
__Height__: 195 cm (6'5")

Joseph Joestar begins as a young Englishman in New York, with his grandmother [Erina](https://anilist.co/character/21937). However, an attack by [Straits](https://anilist.co/character/21961) and the disappearance of [Robert Edward O Speedwagon](https://anilist.co/character/21938) soon involve him in the greater chain of events.

name: Joutarou Kuujou
description:
__Height:__ 195 cm (6'5")
__Occupation:__ Student, Marine Explorer, Oceanographer
__Nationality:__ Japanese 

Joutarou is Holly Kujo's son and [Joseph Joestar](https://anilist.co/character/6356)'s grandson. In Part 3, he has a recognizable attire of a blue trenchcoat-length school uniform jacket with yellow chains on the collar. He also wears a trademark hat which, while torn in the back, often seems to blend with his hair. When Joutarou first appears, he turned himself in to the police because he believes his Stand is an evil spirit possessing him. After he is released from jail, and learns what his Stand is, Joutarou gets used to Star Platinum -- a fierce, muscular, vaguely Aztec-looking spirit with "the precision of a machine" and the ability to destroy virtually anything with a sledgehammer barrage of fists. He has a very tough exterior, and is even rather rough and delinquent, but he also is very dedicated, intense, and loyal. He is very intelligent, but usually lets his (or Star Platinum's) fists do the talking with the enemy, even though he often has to rely on his wits to deal with stand users' attacks. He is also known for a quick and short temper. His catchphrase is "Yare yare daze." It generally relates of being bored or exasperation. In Part 3, he is the main target of [Dio](https://anilist.co/character/4004), who realizes that Joutarou is his greatest threat.

One of the strongest stands in the JoJo universe; Star Platinum possesses super human senses, strength, stamina, accuracy and speed. It can see for great distances and at great magnifications. The Star tarot card that Star Platinum is named after symbolizes hope. Like other physically powerful stands, Star Platinum suffers from a narrow range of activity. It can only be active within a 2-3 meter radius from Joutarou. ~!It is similar to Dio's The World stand, and, it turns out, can likewise be used to stop time, but that ability is only revealed in Joutarou's epic battle with Dio Brando when Dio was about to drop a steamroller on him.!~

In the sixth story arc Stone Ocean, Joutarou becomes an oceanologist, moves to the United States, eventually marries, and his daughter, [Jolyne](https://anilist.co/character/11222) inherits the potential to wield Stand powers.

name: Dio Brando
description:
__Height:__ 195 cm (6'5")
__Race:__ Human (formerly), Vampire (onwards)
__Nationality:__ British

Dio is an immortal vampire and the arch rival of the Joestar clan.
 
__Series 1: Phantom Blood__ 
~!Dio is the son of [Dario Brando](https://anilist.co/character/74099/Brando-Dario), an alcoholic and abusive father. Back when Dio was just a boy, he was brought into the household of [George Joestar](https://anilist.co/character/21956/Joestar-I-George) after the mysterious death of his father, so as to repay the debt he owed Dio's father for saving his life. But soon Dio's personality caused trouble for George's young son, [Jonathan Joestar](https://anilist.co/character/8087/Joestar-Jonathan). Even more of a sociopath than his father, Dio was resolute to shatter Jonathan's spirit and take his place as the favored son, even going so far as to arrange for Jonathan's dog [Danny](https://anilist.co/character/222601/Danny) to be burned to death. Initially, Dio is able earn the trust of the patriarch of the Joestar family through deceit (and at Jonathan's expense). However, his plans of taking over the Joestar household were discovered by Jonathan when he discovered that not only had Dio poisoned his biological father to death, he was doing the same to his adoptive father, all to take the Joestar estate for his own.

Determined not to be stopped, and understanding the potential to enjoy power over all things instead of just the Joestar estate, Dio wears and activates the Stone Mask, becoming a nearly unstoppable vampire. His gains supernatural abilities such as being able to walk on walls, and regenerating his body faster than fire can consume it. He is able to create two fluid jets from his eyes powerful enough to slice stone and kill living things. He is also able to vaporize his body fluid rapidly enough to freeze anything he touches. However, this is at the expense of having his body be sustained by sheer willpower alone, rather than vital energy. A sufficiently powerful vital force--specifically, sunlight or the Hamon force--will negate the sustaining force's presence and disintegrate the long-unliving body. Like all Jojo vampires, Dio sucks blood through tentacles in his fingers and has been seen at least once drinking blood from an unnamed girl.!~

name: Noriaki Kakyouin
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm (5'10")
__Stand:__ Hierophant Green

Kakyoin is a high school student and user of the stand Hierophant Green. Unlike most stand users, Kakyoin was born with his stand, though it caused him to feel like an outsider for most of his life due to not knowing any other stand users. Until meeting the rest of the main characters, Hierophant was Kakyoin’s only real friend.

Hierophant is not physically strong, but is elastic and can able to unravel into tentacles which can capture opponents. It can also enter an enemy’s body to possess them, though Kakyoin rarely uses this ability. Hierophant’s signature power is emerald splash, which hurls emeralds that slice opponents.

Kakyoin remains calm and collected even in dangerous situations, and is good at seeing through opponents’ strategies. 

During a trip to Egypt with his family, he encountered [Dio](https://anilist.co/character/4004/Brando-Dio), who controlled him using a flesh bud. It was later removed by [Jotaro](https://anilist.co/character/4003/Kuujou-Joutarou) and Kakyoin joined the Joestar group.

name: Jean-Pierre Polnareff
description:
__Height:__ 185 cm (6'1")

Jean-Pierre Polnareff is a Frenchman who joins the Joestar group on their journey to Egypt after being freed from Dio's control by the group. He aims to avenge the murder of his sister. His brash nature and overconfidence combined with his general tomfoolery is often the source of trouble throughout the journey, and other members of the group often remark on his tendency to endanger himself and others.

~!Polnareff reappears in 2001 (Part 5), now 36 years old and wheelchair-bound, to assist [Giorno](https://anilist.co/character/10529/Giovanna-Giorno) and the rest of Passione in their fight against the boss.!~

He also serves as the inspiration for many characters in other franchises such as [Guile](https://anilist.co/character/9312/Guile) (Street Fighter), [Paul](https://anilist.co/character/285435/Phoenix-Paul) (Tekken), [Benimaru Nikaido](https://anilist.co/character/61203/Nikaido-Benimaru) (King of Fighters).

name: Jonathan Joestar
description:
__Height:__ 195 cm 
__Nationality:__ British 
__Occupation:__ Archaeologist 

Born the unique son of the wealthy businessman [George Joestar I](https://anilist.co/character/21956), Jonathan is an honest, kind, and positive man whose life is fraught with tragedy after meeting his adopted older brother - and series antagonist - [Dio Brando](https://anilist.co/character/4004). In his battle against Dio, Jonathan becomes a Ripple user under the tutelage of the master [Will Anthonio Zeppeli](https://anilist.co/character/18062).

**Part 5:**~!Jonathan is the biological father of [Giorno Giovanna](https://anilist.co/character/10529), the protagonist of Vento Aureo, as well as a handful of other illegitimate offspring.!~

name: Narrator
description:
This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. 

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

name: Mohammed Avdol
description:
__Height:__ 188 cm (6'2")
__Stand:__ Magician's Red

Avdol is a fortune teller and friend of [Joseph Joestar](https://anilist.co/character/6356/Joestar-Joseph). They met three years before the events of the story. He was born with a stand, Magician’s Red, which controls fire. This stand’s abilities include Crossfire Hurricane, which shoots fire in the shape of an Ankh, and Crossfire Hurricane Special, which splits into multiple Ankh-shaped flames. He can also create flame tracker that detects a person’s energy.

Avdol presents himself as a serious person but can sometimes let his emotions get the best of him. He often acts as the voice of reason among the Joestar group and exhibits strong loyalty by frequently placing himself in danger to protect his friends. He is knowledgeable about geography and stands, enjoys India’s chaotic atmosphere, and respects [Polnareff](https://anilist.co/character/4368/Polnareff-JeanPierre)'s chivalrous attitude that he displayed when they first met. Avdol gives [Jotaro](https://anilist.co/character/4003/Kuujou-Joutarou)'s stand its name. 

~!Avdol encountered [DIO](https://anilist.co/character/4004/Brando-Dio) in Egypt before the main events of the story, but was able to escape unscathed.!~

~!At one point he is shot by [Hol Horse](https://anilist.co/character/16557/Horse-Hol) and presumed dead, but he was actually in hiding and rejoins the Joestar group later. He is killed protecting Polnareff and [Iggy](https://anilist.co/character/21089/Iggy) from [Vanilla Ice](https://anilist.co/character/76658/Ice-Vanilla).!~

He is named after Paula Abdul.

name: Iggy
description:
__Height:__ 33.3 cm
__Nationality:__ American

Iggy is a boston terrier who wields a stand known as The Fool, which is able to manipulate sand. Since The Fool is made of sand, damaging it will not hurt Iggy. He creates various objects out of sand including the wings of a glider and a statue of DIO. Iggy is depicted as rude and disobedient, as shown by his tendency to chew on people’s hair while farting on them. He loves coffee-flavored gum.

Iggy was previously owned by a rich man, but he ran away and became a stray in New York. Avdol caught him and brought him to Egypt to help the Joestar group defeat DIO. He frequently chews Polnareff’s hair and once put chewed gum inside Jotaro’s hat.

~!At first, Iggy seems indifferent towards the Joestar’s quest to defeat DIO. Then he accidentally finds DIO’s mansion and is attacked and injured by Pet Shop, causing his hatred for DIO to grow. He is killed after saving Polnareff from Vanilla Ice.!~

He was initially drawn as realistic dog, but as the story progressed, his face gradually became more similar to a human’s. He is named after Iggy Pop.

name: Hol Horse
description:
**Height**: 188cm *(anime)*

Hol Horse is a minor antagonist in JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Stardust Crusaders (first seen in Chapter 141 and Episode 10), as well as one of the main characters of Crazy Diamond's Demonic Heartbreak. He is a tall, blonde-haired cowboy-themed mercenary, serving under Dio and his army of other Stand Users. He considers himself "The #2", preferring to work as support with a partner due to his cowardice and caution. He also respects women, no matter how pretty, or how ugly, as seen with his ex, Nena. 

His Stand is Emperor, named after the Tarot Card of the same name. It manifests itself as a retro-futuristic pistol, which functions as a normal firearm, although the bullets are able to change their trajectory to Hol Horse's command.

~!He is seemingly fatally injured by his own Stand's bullets in Chapter 221 (and episode 37 of the anime), but manages to survive and go into hiding, fearing Dio's punishment for failing his mission of killing the Joestar group.!~

name: Suzie Q
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm 

The female assistant to Lisa Lisa. Suzie Q is a slightly ditzy girl who worries for her friends. Evidently this carefree personality has not diminished even in the events of Stardust Crusaders, when she is shown enthusiastically recording her sightings in Japan on a camcorder when on a trip to see her daughter.   ~!She is introduced as the female assistant to Lisa Lisa. When she first appears, she is taken over by the remains of Esidisi and attacks her friends. Thanks to a combination attack by Caesar and Joseph, she is saved with only minor injury. She marries Joseph in 1939.!~

name: Daniel D'Arby
description:
__Occupation:__ Gambler
__Stand:__ Osiris
__Manga Debut:__ Chapter 211
__Anime Debut:__ Episode 34

D'Arby is an expert and inveterate gambler and his Stand, Osiris, can steal souls. He is a member of the Egypt 9 Glory Gods and meets the Joestar Group in Cairo. Here, he tricks them into wagering their souls in various gambles. D'Arby is also Telence T. D'Arby's older brother.

Daniel J. D'Arby exhibits an affable but sly, knowing character. D'Arby first and foremost character trait is his love of gambling. He states that he lives for the thrill of gambling (which he recognizes as worthless). This love of gambling is complemented by his enjoyment for cheating, and he proudly admits that cheating is one of his greatest skills shamelessly rigging every game he's seen participating to while justifying himself by claiming that if the cheat isn't exposed, it is "fair" game.

name: Mariah
description: Mariah is one of the Egypt 9 Glory Gods. She separates the group in Luxor and attempts to take out Joseph and Avdol using her Stand, Bastet, while Alessi confronts the rest of the heroes.

name: Boingo
description:
Boingo is a young Stand User whose Stand is Tohth. As part of the Egypt 9 Glory Gods, he attempts to assassinate the Joestar Group in Egypt alongside his older brother Oingo and later Hol Horse. Boingo is a young child of ordinary build, but his characteristics include an unusually large mouth and a large afro held together by a topless cap, leaving a few stray hair locks. His attire consists of a bright shirt and trousers over which he wears shorts and a jacket, plus a coat and simple shoes.

Tohth is an Artificial Non-Humanoid Stand that takes the form of a manga. The book, titled, Oingo Boingo Brothers Adventure, will show predictions of the future. When an image appears, the prediction(s) then become fate and are destined to come to fruition. However, nobody, not even Boingo, can control the Image projected onto Tohth.

name: Holly Kuujou
description: Holly Kuujou née Joestar is the daughter of [Joseph Joestar](https://anilist.co/character/6356/) and mother of [Joutarou Kuujou](https://anilist.co/character/4003/).

name: Vanilla Ice
description:
Vanilla Ice is the last Vampire created by DIO and one of the penultimate Stand Users the Joestar Group faces upon infiltrating DIO's Mansion. After the group is split up, he is sent to take out the team consisting of Avdol, Polnareff, and Iggy. Vanilla Ice is a Stand User controlling his void-based Stand ability, Cream, to battle.

His name is based off the famous ''rapper'', Vanilla Ice. His stand is named after the band, Cream.

name: N'Doul
description:
N'Doul is a man of athletic build and medium height, keeping unkempt dark hair and whose blank eyes are always near shut due to his blindness. He wears a simple T-shirt over which he keeps a stripped overshirt and a drape to protect himself from the sun. N'Doul also wears armbands and simple trousers and shoes. He wears a headband and two earrings which look like bracelets.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

name: Terence D'Arby
description:
__Nationality:__ American
__Occupation:__ Butler
__Stand:__ Atum

D'Arby is one of the Egypt 9 Glory Gods and resides in DIO's mansion in Cairo acting as his butler. He isolates and challenges Jotaro, Joseph and Kakyoin when the Joestar Group enters the mansion and forces them into waging their souls against him in various video game challenges. He is also Daniel J. D'arby's younger brother.

As a butler, Terence is a mannerly individual. However, his demeanor is a facade for his twisted and arrogant personality. Due to his occupation, Terence is rather polite and affable, keeping his calm even in the face of provocations and comes to greet and confront the Joestar Group when they enter DIO's Mansion. Terence is a very intelligent man and is especially proficient at video games: He defeated the likes of Tatsuhiko, a child genius with an IQ of 190, albeit without the use of his Stand's ability to read minds.

name: Oingo
description:
Oingo is a minor antagonist appearing in Stardust Crusaders.

As a part of the Egypt 9 Glory Gods, he attempts to assassinate the Joestar Group alongside his little brother Boingo. His Stand is Khnum, which allows him to disguise himself as anyone.

name: Pet Shop
description: Pet Shop serves as the guard of Dio Brando's mansion in Egypt. It ruthlessly kills any who may trespass or it deems as suspicious. When it first appeared, Pet Shop decapitates two large dogs with ease and smashes a beggar (employed by Abdul to find Dio's mansion) and his car with his stand. Pet Shop possesses incredible aerial agility and the ability to swim.   ~!Ultimately, Pet Shop is defeated by Iggy, but is able to severely injure him by severing his leg in the process.!~  (Source: JJBA wiki)

name: Anubis
description: Anubis is a minor antagonist featured in Stardust Crusaders. It's unique in being a userless Stand who can possess anyone who wields it, and repeatedly tries to kill the Joestar Group's members in Egypt.

name: Enya Geil
description: Enya Geil is one of Dio's most loyal supporters, and the one who originally gave him the Stand Arrow, which she obtained from Diavolo. She is the mother of J. Geil. Her stand is Justice, which is able to control people through their wounds, whether alive or dead.  For legal reasons, her name is changed in the American version of both the game and the manga, to N-Yah Gail and Enyaba Geil respectively.  In the OVA:  ~!She is able to change her appearance from that of a young woman to an old lady at will. No explanation as to why is ever given.!~

name: Malèna
description: A kind young woman, she nurtures a de-aged Jean Pierre Polnareff after he's injured from his fight against Alessi.

name: Roses
description: Roses is the butler of Joseph Joestar and Suzi Q, also acting as the latter's personal chauffeur and bodyguard.

name: Alessi
description: Alessi is one of the Egypt 9 Glory Gods and attempts to assassinate Polnareff in Luxor as Mariah battles Joseph and Avdol. His Stand is Sethan, a rejuvenating shadow.

name: Levi
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3")

Squad Captain of the Special Operations Squad (known as Squad Levi) within the Survey Corps. He is known as humanity's strongest soldier. 

Levi is abrasive, blunt, and has a strong respect for structure and discipline. He is a clean-freak, demanding spotless cleanliness of himself, his equipment, and his environment. Rumors say he was involved in underground crime in his life before coming a soldier. Despite his emotionless and unfriendly demeanor, Levi cares deeply for his squad and greatly values human life.

name: Hange Zoe
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7")
__Affiliation:__ Survey Corps; Section Commander, Squad Leader.

Leader of the Survey Corps' Fourth Squad, Hange is also in charge of conducting research on Titans, and pursues this knowledge so passionately that they have become obsessed with Titans as a result. After originally holding a deep hatred for the creatures, Hange decided to take on a new outside-the-box approach to their research by letting go of their resentment towards Titans and approaching the test subjects with compassion. 

Hange is an energetic, freethinking and quirky scientist, with a unique way of conducting both themselves and their work. Hange is a genius outside of just Titan research too, using their brain to create weapons, tactical plans, and inventions for the benefit of humanity. As a leader, Hange is thoughtful of their comrades, and can easily figure out complex problems in order to create plans for their teammates to carry out.

name: Erwin Smith
description:
**Height:** 188 cm
**Position:** 13th Commander, Survey Corps

Discerning, intelligent, and widely respected, Erwin is the unshakable and calculated 13th commander of the Survey Corps. While he cares deeply for his men, he does not hesitate to sacrifice them for the good and prosperity of mankind, and his men have proven more than willing to stake their lives at his order. Erwin developed the Long-Distance Enemy Scouting Formation.

name: Narrator
description:
This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. 

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

name: Keith Shadis
description: Keith Shadis was the head instructor of the 104th Trainees Squad. He seemed to be a friend or have some sort of relationship with [Dr. Grisha](https://anilist.co/character/62477/Yeager-Grisha), as he knew [Eren](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Yeager-Eren) is the son of the doctor and praised Eren for his effort.

name: Mike Zacharias
description:
Squad Captain of his own squad, Squad Mike, a major division within the Survey Corps. He has been described by others as "humanity's second strongest soldier", being only behind [Levi](https://anilist.co/character/45627/Levi).

Mike is an extremely strong and durable soldier and an acknowledged leader with a brave heart and a tactical mind. He also has a remarkably good sense of smell, which allows him to detect Titans from great distances. During times of ease, Mike is shown to be a quiet and reserved man, rarely speaking unless it concerned a more serious matter. He also has a bizarre habit of "sniffing" people when he meets them.

name: Isabel Magnolia
description:
Isabel Magnolia is one of [Levi's](https://anilist.co/character/45627/Levi) two old companions from his time in the capitol's Underground District, the other being [Furlan Church](https://anilist.co/character/87928/Furlan-Church). She met the two of them after she was discovered trying to sneak past a checkpoint to the surface without paying and was forced to flee until she arrived at their doorstep and was saved by them. Impressed by her saviors, she asked to join their gang, and they agreed on the condition that she be trained to use ODM gear 

Isabel is an energetic, outspoken young woman who is rarely afraid to speak her mind and confident in her abilities. She is able to use ODM gear quite well and calmly, and is also quite prideful of her skill. She values Levi as a brother figure and often becomes emotional if he berates her. She takes his opinions very seriously, as shown when she cried when he said she was an idiot for not knowing how to do math and continued to cry until he ruffled her hair. She is known to have a soft spot for animals, claiming to get along with them better than other humans and going out of her way to save any animals she discovers.

name: Moblit Berner
description:
__Height:__ 176 cm (5'9")
__Affiliation:__ Survey Corps; Executive Officer, Fourth Squad.

A veteran member of the Survey Corps and [Hange Zoe](https://anilist.co/character/71121/Hange-Zoe)'s second-in-command within the Survey Corps' Fourth Squad. He also serves as Hanji's assistant and messenger.

He comes across as an intelligent and responsible person, which may be the reason he was tasked to keep his overzealous and eccentric superior out of trouble. Much of the time, this leaves him in a state of near-panic, having to constantly remind Hange to be more careful or yanking them to safety. That he remains at Hange's side constantly suggests he is a loyal person, and that he cares deeply for his superior's safety, regardless of the stress involved with being under their command. He is also able to show signs of a serious nature when it comes to missions, going out of his way to investigate problems and put himself in danger before others.

name: Furlan Church
description:
Furlan Church is a delinquent who roamed the capital's Underground District and one of [Levi's](https://anilist.co/character/45627/Levi) two old companions from his time living in the underground, the other being [Isabel Magnolia](https://anilist.co/character/87929/Isabel-Magnolia). He's a very talented ODM user, having learned to use it and teach his fellow delinquents how to use it. The way he managed to acquire and learn how to use ODM gear is unknown.

Furlan, in contrast to Isabel, is very focused and able to make the distinction between when to have fun and when to be serious. He is usually depicted as level-headed and calm, but he dislikes when things spiral out of control. He has a clear understanding of when he's been bested, and when to give up if he knew that he had lost, though he can also be defiant. Furlan places a great deal of trust in Levi and followed his decisions and leadership without question. After one of many heists pulled with Levi's gang, Furlan was placed in charge of dividing the profits from the job among his comrades. He is shown to be sympathetic towards others, such as when he knew that one of his accomplices, [Yan](https://anilist.co/character/137155/Yan), was suffering from a leg injury and would need extra money to afford medicine, so he gave them a larger cut compared to everyone else.

name: Darius Zackly
description:
The head of all three divisions of the army.   

__ _Note:___ Darius Zackly is the official English translation by Kodansha.

name: Flagon
description:
__Affiliation:__ Survey Corps; Squad Captain

A member of the Survey Corps and a Squad Captain at the time [Levi](https://anilist.co/character/45627/Levi), [Furlan Church](https://anilist.co/character/87928), and [Isabel Magnolia](https://anilist.co/character/87929/Isabel-Magnolia) had joined the Scouts. He disliked the idea of allowing the trio of former thugs to join the Survey Corps, especially when they were assigned to his squad and were from the Underground District. However, he acknowledged Levi's skills after seeing his abilities in action.

name: Yan
description: He is an Underground companion of [Levi](https://anilist.co/character/45627/Levi), [Furlan Church](https://anilist.co/character/87928/Furlan-Church), and [Isabel Magnolia](https://anilist.co/character/87929/Isabel-Magnolia). He is known to be a calm and considerate person to other people living in the Underground city. Yan is one of the underground companions who gets paid by Furlan Church. Since Furlan knows well that Yan needs more money for his leg treatments, he gives Yan more money than usual.

name: Nicholas Lovof
description:
__Occupation:__ Councilor

An anti-scouting mission faction leader and close associate of the Lang Company. 

Lovof is a selfish and greedy noble, who is prepared to go to brutal lengths to get what he wants. Lovof has proven to be manipulative, often blackmailing people in order to make them do his bidding. He is cautious to an extent and also tends to leave no loose ends.

name: Misaki Nakahara
description:
__Height:__ 154 cm

Misaki is a mysterious girl who decides to help [Tatsuhiro Satou](https://anilist.co/character/1839/Tatsuhiro-Satou) escape his hikikomori lifestyle. She convinces him to sign a contract, involving him in her "big project", with the goal of making him an average person. Though seeing right through his actions, she tries reading him (beginner's) psychology books in an attempt to click with his feelings and "save" him.

~!Her backstory varies depending on the media. In the anime, it is revealed later on that the only reason she is helping Satou is to save herself from being worthless. Due to traumatic childhood experiences such as living with her abusive stepfather and seeing her mother committing suicide, she believes that she isn't worth anything and her existence is a reason for people's misfortune. She feels useless and the only way she can live with it is to have someone to rely on her.

However, in the manga and light novel, it is revealed she made those details up in an effort to manipulate and try to help Satou through unconventional means. Her story in the media mentioned above actually involves both her parents being happy, healthy, kind, and wealthy.

Her biological father gave her the name "Misaki" (岬) which means "promontory" in Japanese after the Ishihama Promontory.!~

name: Tatsuhiro Satou
description:
__Height:__ 176 cm (5'9") 

The story's protagonist is a 22-year-old hikikomori and NEET of nearly four years. He is highly unstable, easily manipulated, obsessive, and often blames the N.H.K. conspiracy, a fabrication of his mind, for his shortcomings. He lives in a rented apartment, but depends on his parents' allowance to live.   ~!At the end of the novel, Satou and Misaki promised each other to get married once they finish school.!~

name: Kaoru Yamazaki
description:
__Height:__ 169 cm (5'6")

Tatsuhiro's former kouhai (Junior) in high school, who is an otaku. Tatsuhiro once stood up for him when he was still in middle school being beat up by some bullies, since then, he respected him greatly and decided to join the literature club with him when he went into high school. He is currently Tatsuhiro's neighbor and a college student aspiring to be a game creator.

name: Hitomi Kashiwa
description:
[Satou](https://anilist.co/character/1839/Satou-Tatsuhiro)'s senpai in high school, now a public servant. Due to stress, Hitomi develops a dependence on drugs. Hitomi met Tatsuhiro Satou when she persuaded him to join the Literature Club, though most of the time they only ever played card games. She has always been fascinated by the concept of conspiracy theories and introduced Satou to the idea.

~!Satou's longtime crush/love-interest, seemingly the only friend and the only woman in his past, or perhaps the only noteworthy or memorable one. Apparently had an immense influence on his life.  Acted as the catalyst for the actions that made [Yamazaki](https://anilist.co/character/2866/Yamazaki-Kaoru) idolize Satou in school and befriend him in the present, as Satou was just trying to show off and look cool in front of Hitomi-Senpai. Took Satou's virginity in high school, giving him goodbye sex when she graduated ahead of him and left him alone.  It is revealed later that Hitomi is part of an online cult at present, and plans to attend an offline meet on a private island where the group will commit suicide together.!~

name: Takashi Mitsuhashi
description:
Height: 181 cm  

He gave up his ordinary school life and decided to "become a delinquent from today on" (thus the title of this manga), after moving to his new home in Chiba. To make his appearance more noticeable, he dyed his hair blond (he often use this appearance to pretend to be a foreigner). Being a very athletic person, he used his talent for the sole purpose of brawling and actually becomes a real delinquent. His fighting style is based around his speed, as he often dodges most attacks, becoming enraged whenever he is forced to block. Despite being the most self-centered person in the series and may seem stupid or shallow at first, he actually cares about his friends.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Shinji Itou
description:
__Height:__ 180 cm

Just like Mitsuhashi, Itou got transferred to Nanyou High's first year.
Being a complete reversal of Mitsuhashi, Itou's the kind of righteous person fighting for justice. Like his personality, his fighting style is also the opposite of Mitsuhashi's: he's incredibly tough, and often stands up from any beating, even in the most bleak of situations. While he may be as strong as Mitsuhashi, Itou is beat up much more often than Mitsuhashi due to often sacrificing himself to protect others as well as fighting fair in unfair situations or against numerable opponents. He dates Kyoko.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Katsutoshi Imai
description:
__Height:__ 192cm

Beni high's idiotic Banchou, the eldest son of four brothers. His basic traits are his enormous physical strength, lack of intelligence, and bad luck with women, although he appears to be handsome at first glance. He considers Mitsuhashi who never misses a chance to ridicule him as his sworn rival and as the story progresses he tries to steer away from him and the misfortunes he always suffers from their meetings. Despite his naive nature and simple-minded personality, he is honest and manly, who in the end earns the respect of the people around him.  He is one of the characters in this Manga with the most character development.

name: Riko Akasaka
description:
The only daughter of the Akasaka dojo. Originally she visited another senior high school than [Mitsuhashi](https://anilist.co/character/18367/Mitsuhashi-Takashi) and [Itou](https://anilist.co/character/18366/Itou-Shinji), but ultimately decided to transfer to Nanyou High instead to repay Mitsuhashi's favor. Being pretty skilled in Aikido, she can handle most delinquents on her own despite her small body size and harmless appearance.

While she used to be very popular at her old school, in Nanyou High she is considered somewhat weird because of her constantly hanging out with Mitsuhashi. As the manga goes on, her originally quiet personality gradually changes, due to Mitsuhashi's influence, to a brighter version of herself. She has a crush on Mitsuhashi and is the only person who refers to him as "San-chan".

name: Kyouko Hayakawa
description: The second heroine beside Riko. She attends the Seiran Girl School. A former Yankee girl and leader of a girls' gang, but because of her beauty, she's subject to many punks' attempt of hitting on.   She may look delicate, feminine, and naive, but she actually has a tough attitude. She's Itou's girlfriend and loves him very much: in fact, she often worries about him and doesn't want him to get into fights.   (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Naoya Sagawa
description: A slacky delinquent from Nan high, who quickly became Mitsuhashi's and Itou's lackey and informant due to his nature "always succumbing to the circumstances". Even though he is no strong fighter, people respect him for the sole sake of him being able to call for Itou and Mitsuhashi's help at any given time.

name: Toua Tokuchi
description:
__Height:__ 183 cm (5’11")

Toua is a successful gambler, and a pitcher in the game One Outs. After losing a game of One Outs for the first time , he joins the Lycaons with an odd contract, the One Outs contract, that decides Toua's pay based on his performance. As the Lycaons' famed star pitcher, he can pitch entire games without giving up a single hit.

name: Satoshi Ideguchi
description: He is the catcher of the Saikyou Saitama Lycaons and he also notices Toua talents as he catches Toua's pitches.

name: Hiromichi Kojima
description: Kojima is the cleanup batter in the professional baseball team, Saikyou Saitama Lycaons. He is defeated by Toua during his time at the training camp as he challenged Toua to avenge his relief pitcher, Nakane. After his defeat, he goes into the forest to train himself mentally against Toua but as he is training he injures his wrist. Even with the injury he challenges Toua to a rematch with the bet that if he wins, he takes Toua's hand. He wins the match as he gets hit by the pitch making it a deadball, Toua admits defeat and Kojima makes Toua join the Lycaons. (source: wikipedia & manga)

name: Itsuki Takami
description: One of the cleanup batters in the team "Chiba Mariners", he is known to be a prodigy in baseball and his eyes have the best in motion vision in the baseball world. He is the best player in the team and is able to think of counters against Tokuchi's fastballs, until he is outwitted and his team loses.

name: Mitsuo Oikawa
description: Oikawa is the head of Saikyou Saitama Lycaons public relations. Unlike the rest of the Lycaons management, he seems to truly wish for Tokuchi's success.

name: Dennis Johnson
description: Johnson, a foreigner who joined the Bugaboos, is called the World's Fastest Man by stealing home from third base as the pitcher pitched to home.

name: Tsuneo Saikawa
description:
The owner of the Saikyou Saitama Lycaons team. He is more interested in gaining money than getting the Lycaons to win. He forms the One Outs contract with Toua Tokuchi but later on as he realises he is still losing money to Toua he adds more conditions to the contract. He has a few members of the team under his control as pawns that will do his bidding, few of them are the secretary, sales, scouts, scorekeepers and even the manager of the team.

(Source: Wikipedia)

name: Yuuzaburou Mihara
description: The manager of the Saikyou Saitama Lycaons. Obediently obeys every order given to him by the owner, and is often likened to a dog for doing so.

name: Shin Fujita
description: Member of the Lycaons. Number 7. Third base and competent outfielder.

name: Kumoko
description:
A high school girl of self-professed low standing who has reincarnated as a spider. 

In her former life, she lived as a shut-in and immersed herself in video games, but now she uses her remarkable mental strength to fight for survival. She uses battle tactics that make up for her low stats with her mastery of agility, spider thread, and poison fangs.

~!Kumoko later takes on the name of Shiraori after deification, becomes the Tenth Demon Army commander and the transcended protagonist of the series. After the events of the battle with the G-Fleet, Kumoko was forced to transcend the limits of the System and become a god, losing access to the System, but in return gaining an incredible amount of energy at her disposal as well as the ability to create unique magic.!~

~!Shiraori came into being when Kumoko eats a GMA Bomb in a panic because it was going to explode, thinking maybe she could digest and absorb it in a similar fashion to [Ariel](https://anilist.co/character/130477/Ariel)'s skill Gluttony. The GMA Bomb was being used as a generator to power a large pre-system flying machine and its army of fighters and robots. Devices that utilized MA Energy as a power source is the technology that led to the destruction of the world and the necessity of the System. After absorbing the MA Energy from the GMA Bomb, Kumoko reaches Divinity Expansion Level 10 and undergoes Apotheosis, transcending the system, and is reborn as Shiraori after 47 days.!~

name: Ariel
description: The current Demon Lord. ~!She is the Origin Taratect, Ancient Divine Beast, and Ruler of Gluttony. She is the origin of all Taratects in the System, and thus all spiders can be considered her kin. The Queen Taratects and Puppet Taratects are her closest kin, having wills and personalities of their own, and are not dominated by Kin Control, even though she has this skill.!~

name: Feirune
description:
[Shun](https://anilist.co/character/130487/Schlain-Zagan-Analeit)'s pet Earth Wyrm.

In her previous life, she was a girl named Shinohara Mirei, but she reincarnated as a monster instead of a human. As a monster, her stats grow at a very fast rate, and she has excellent situational judgment. She has a cheerful, open personality, but she was a bully in her former life, and this shows in her behavior.

name: Sophia Keren
description:
Sophia Keren, formerly known as Negishi Shouko in her previous life, is one of the reincarnated students. She was reincarnated as a True Vampire in a noble human family, the Kerens. Her relatives are normal humans, so she hides the fact that she is a Vampire.

~!Sophia works for the demons as a soldier of the 10th Demon Army under direct orders of [Shiro](https://anilist.co/character/122124/Kumoko) to hunt the various clones of [Potimas](https://anilist.co/character/130480/Harrifenas-Potimas).!~

name: Filimøs Harrifenas
description: In her previous life, she was Okazaki Kanami, homeroom teacher to the kids who were reincarnated, and they affectionately call her "Oka-chan." After reincarnating, she began attending school with [Shun](https://anilist.co/character/130487/Schlain-Zagan-Analeit) and the others as their classmate. Since she reincarnated as an elf, she looks younger than she actually is. She's a caring teacher who continues to follow her students after their reincarnation, but she has many secrets.

name: Karnatia Seri Anabald
description:
The daughter of Duke Anabald.

In her previous life, she was a boy named Ooshima Kanata, but she reincarnated as a beautiful girl. She's a prodigy on par with [Shun](https://anilist.co/character/130487/Schlain-Zagan-Analeit), and has been his best friend since their former life. Her speech is normally elegant and refined, but when talking with others who have reincarnated, she talks like a boy.

name: Wrath
description:
Wrath, formerly known as Sasajima Kyouya, is one of the students that reincarnated. After reincarnation, he found himself reborn as a Goblin in a Goblin Village with the special skill to create weapons.
