~!He is the commander of the Demon Lord's eighth army.!~

name: D
description:
D is a god.

~! D is responsible for the reincarnation of the class that was killed at​ the beginning of the story.!~

~!The name of their temporary human form is Wakaba Hiiro (若 葉 姫 色)!~

name: Güliedistodiez
description:
Güliedistodiez, also known as Gyurie, Kuro, or Black, is one of the Administrators of the System.

He is described by [Kumoko](https://anilist.co/character/122124/Kumoko) as "a very dark man."

name: Schlain Zagan Analeit
description:
The fourth prince of the Kingdom of Analeit.

His name in his previous life was Yamada Shunsuke. He was a textbook example of the average high school student and retains that quality after reincarnating. However, he has a deep admiration for his older brother [Julius](https://anilist.co/character/196477/Julius-Zagan-Analeit), the hero, and spends every day working hard to catch up to him.

name: Merazophis
description:
Merazophis is a human turned Vampire by [Sophia](https://anilist.co/character/130482/Keren-Sophia). He is also her butler and was her caretaker when she was a toddler.

At present, he is the Commander of the Fourth Demon Army, but continues to be Sophia's butler and one remaining family member from their hometown.

name: Suresia Analeit
description:
The second princess of the Kingdom of Analeit.

As [Shun](https://anilist.co/character/130487/Schlain-Zagan-Analeit)'s half-sister, born to a different mother not long after his birth, her talents rival his. Her obsession with her brother Shun is extreme enough to put others off, and she's noticeably hostile toward all girls who get friendly with him.

name: Julius Zagan Analeit
description:
The second prince of the Kingdom of Analeit. 

Julius is [Shun](https://anilist.co/character/130487)'s older brother and the strongest hero among all humankind. Despite his mastery of both swordsmanship and magic and his achievements in combat, he remains virtuous and not at all proud. He is a true hero, devoting himself to fighting for world peace.

name: Ronandt Orozoi
description: Ronandt is the chief of the imperial court wizards. He is the most prominent magic-user in the world and considered an amazing person who has even mastered Space Magic. He’s probably the strongest genuine human around. As Julius’s master, he was somewhat concerned about him.

name: Sanatoria Pilevy
description: Sanatoria is one of Ariel's commanders. She is the leader of the Second Demon Army.

name: Potimas Harrifenas
description:
Potimas Harrifenas is the elf patriarch and ambassador of the Elf Village.

~!Potimas is known for being extremely cunning and a brilliant inventor, due to his selfish pursuit and actions that constantly push the world into destruction, he is considered one of the main antagonist of the series. Using his extensive networks of spies, connections, magical gadgets and a league of followers makes him a troublesome foe to deal with.!~

name: Hyrince Quarto
description:
Hyrince Quarto is [Julius](https://anilist.co/character/196477/Julius-Zagan-Analeit)'s childhood friend as well as the tank of the Hero party. As the second son of Duke Quarto of the Analeit Kingdom, he is a proud noble who has dedicated himself to protecting his friends and home. He is an uncle-like figure in [Shun](https://anilist.co/character/130487)'s life.

__Volume 13 Spoilers__
~!It is later revealed that Hyrince is a clone of Güliedistodiez created to watch over the current holder of the Hero Title. The human infant Hyrince was stillborn, therefore, the Dragon God implanted his soul to begin his first experience as a human through the long influence of Sariel.!~

name: Sael
description: Sael acts as the "youngest" of the Puppet Taratect sisters. She is also the most robotic, typically doing nothing until she is ordered to do so. Despite this, aspects of her personality do show her to be bold and dutiful.

name: Yurin Ullen
description:
A Saint candidate in the Holy Kingdom of Alleius.

Her name in her previous life was Hasebe Yuika. She's very serious and well-mannered, but often loses sight of what's going on around her. After reincarnating, she inherited the life of a girl who was abandoned by her parents and raised by the church, and she is now a fanatical believer in the Word of God religion, which follows the creed of "We improve our skills so that we may hear the voice of God."

name: Ael
description: Ael is one of the Puppet Taratect sisters that join [Kumoko](https://anilist.co/character/122124/Kumoko), [Ariel](https://anilist.co/character/130477/Ariel), [Sophia](https://anilist.co/character/130482/Keren-Sophia), and [Merazophis](https://anilist.co/character/130492/Merazophis) on their journey to the Demon Realm.

name: Fiel
description: Fiel is the playful and rowdy one of the taratect sisters. She tends to get carried away but is often stopped by [Ael](https://anilist.co/character/217295/Ael) before she does anything she'll regret.

name: Riel
description: Riel plays the role of the "cool-beauty" of her sisters, often holding back from doing any activities other than observing them from a place nearby. She is just as strong and capable as her sisters, though, so one shouldn't let her ladylike appearance fool them.

name: Yaana
description:
Yaana is the previous Saint from the Word of God religion, dispatched to assist [Julius](https://anilist.co/character/196477/Analeit-Julius-Zagan) in his responsibilities as the Hero.

~!She dies crushed by a queen taratect during the Great Human-Demon war.!~

name: Leston Analeit
description: The third prince of Analeit, born to a different concubine than [Julius](https://anilist.co/character/196477/Analeit-Julius-Zagan) and [Shun](https://anilist.co/character/130487/Analeit-Schlain-Zagan).

name: Bloe Phthalo
description:
Bloe Phthalo is the brother of [Balto](https://anilist.co/character/211284/Phthalo-Balto) and the Seventh Demon Army commander. He is a warrior who wields a greatsword; he is also a bit rough around the edges personality and looks-wise.

~!He was going to be spared but ultimately gets killed by [Julius](https://anilist.co/character/196477/Analeit-Julius-Zagan) during the Great Human-Demon War!~

name: Megumi Katou
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3")
__Occupation:__ Student / Assistant Director / Main Heroine

Megumi Kato is the classmate of [Tomoya Aki](https://anilist.co/character/88747/Tomoya-Aki), who is hardly noticed by others. After Tomoya had met her during the fate summons, she inspired him to make a dating sim game, featuring her as his Main Heroine. However, he is disappointed by her real personality. She is one of the main characters of the [Saenai Heroine no Sodatekata](https://anilist.co/anime/20657/Saenai-Heroine-no-Sodatekata/) series and is essentially the inspiration for the series title.

name: Utaha Kasumigaoka
description:
__Height:__ 169 cm (5’6”)
__Occupation:__ Student / Author / Scenario Writer

Utaha Kasumigaoka is an up-and-coming young novelist and a student in class 3C who has a secret identity as a writer.

She is a hardworking girl who easily finishes writing their game's plot in the span of a night. Her usual disinterested expression gives off the impression that she is an unapproachable person. When she is with the people in [Tomoya Aki](https://anilist.co/character/88747/Tomoya-Aki)'s circle, she reverts to her disdainful self who enjoys making sarcastic remarks. She seems to be calm and quiet, but she actually has a sharp tongue. Utaha can be a little aggressive. Utaha is also very intelligent and is the smartest student in the school. She even writes plays for the drama club as a hobby. She is also a little bit self-centered, but she never talks back to her parents, making her well-mannered. However, when [Tomoya](https://anilist.co/character/88747/Tomoya-Aki) complimented her one time, she acted like a shy, embarrassed girl instead of her usual cold self and called [Tomoya](https://anilist.co/character/88747/Tomoya-Aki) by his first name instead of Rinri-kun.

name: Eriri Sawamura
description:
__Height:__ 158 cm (5’2”)
__Occupation:__ Student / Illustrator / Painter

Eriri Spencer Sawamura is [Tomoya](https://anilist.co/character/88747/Tomoya-Aki)'s childhood friend. She is a student of class 2G art club. She wears two hats as a student and a doujinshi artist. Eriri is one of the most beautiful girls to attend to Toyogasaki High School. Her family is very affluent. Her father is an English diplomat and she lives in a mansion. She is the secret illustrator for a famous doujinshi circle called ''Egoistic Lily'' under the alias Eri Kashiwagi when she participates in doujin activities. She was greatly influenced by her fujoshi mother and otaku father. She was the illustrator for Blessing Software.

name: Michiru Hyoudou
description:
__Height:__ 174cm (5'8")

Michiru Hyodo is [Tomoya Aki](https://anilist.co/character/88747/Tomoya-Aki)'s cousin/childhood friend (and by far his longest standing friend). She is a student in class 3, in the second year of Tsubaki Girls' Senior High School.

Michiru would have been a well-rounded student if not for her poor academic performance. She is fickle and naturally good at anything she does. [Tomoya Aki](https://anilist.co/character/88747/Tomoya-Aki) once noted that Michiru had a lot of useless talents. She is not interested in anything but her band and music, and enjoys playing the guitar. Michiru had a prejudice against otaku culture and wasn't happy about [Tomoya](https://anilist.co/character/88747/Tomoya-Aki) being an otaku and tried to get him out of his 'nerd phase' until Tokino Himekawa, Echika Mizuhara and Ranko Morioka (band members) told her they were all otaku. Michiru is a kind and caring girl, but she can also be childish sometimes and she also seems to be naturally cheerful as she is usually seen with a smile on her face. However, she also has shown to be serious and mature. It is hinted that she has feelings for [Tomoya](https://anilist.co/character/88747/Tomoya-Aki), though its not completely clear due to her slightly impassive personality.

name: Tomoya Aki
description:
__Occupation:__ Student / Executive producer / Director / Scenario writer / Manager

Tomoya is described as a 'hardcore geek'. However, he is one of the three most notable students at Toyogasaki Academy, along with [Utaha Kasumigaoka](https://anilist.co/character/88750/Utaha-Kasumigaoka) and [Eriri Spencer Sawamura](https://anilist.co/character/88749/Eriri-Spencer-Sawamura), due to his strong advocating of otaku culture at the school.

Tomoya is an otaku and prefers reading comics and light novels, watching anime, and playing visual novels above anything else. He is an enthusiastic fan of [Utaha](https://anilist.co/character/88750/Utaha-Kasumigaoka)'s novel Koisuru Metronome. He is the founder and representative member of Blessing Software, serving as the producer, director and programmer. He is also the manager of [Michiru](https://anilist.co/character/88752/Michiru-Hyoudou)'s cover band "Icy Tail". When motivated, especially by otaku-related factors, he can be shown to be very hardworking. After his encounter with [Megumi Kato](https://anilist.co/character/88748/Megumi-Katou), his strong desire to make his dream game drives him to take up several jobs for funding. He is extremely tenacious and would do anything to get what he wants, but is easily distracted. He was a typical consumer otaku who would spend the money at his part-time job on anime and games, but his money and time are later devoted to his own games. He is very friendly despite his eccentric personality, and he has a strong sense of morals and conviction when dealing with others.

name: Izumi Hashima
description:
__Height:__ 157 cm (5'2")
__Occupation:__ Student / Illustrator


Izumi Hashima is a student in class 3A of Honoda Junior High School and a supporting-main character in the [Saenai Heroine no Sodatekata](https://anilist.co/anime/20657/Saenai-Heroine-no-Sodatekata/) series. She later attends the same high school as [Tomoya Aki](https://anilist.co/character/88747/Tomoya-Aki), the Toyogasaki High School.

When she was younger, Izumi used to be very outgoing and active and played with the boys. But after being introduced to the world of otaku by [Tomoya Aki](https://anilist.co/character/88747/Tomoya-Aki), she has become immersed in the fandom. Over all, Izumi has shown to very cheerful and glad, as she usually is seen with a smile on her lips. She usually is seen playing around, especially with [Tomoya](https://anilist.co/character/88747/Tomoya-Aki). Izumi is also very air-headed and childish and she rarely gives up on something that she really wants or likes. She has also shown to be quite matured.

name: Akane Kousaka
description: The leader of doujin circle Rouge en rouge.

name: Iori Hashima
description:
Iori Hashima is the older brother of Izumi Hashima, Tomoya Aki's former best friend and the previous representative of Rouge en rouge.

Iori is friendly at first, and despite being soft-spoken, he can be a little cold, and he dislikes being ignored. He can be kind as well as shown when he helped Tomoya Aki when he was in a tight spot.

name: Echika Mizuhara
description:
Echika Mizuhara is another oboist of the Icy tail band who is a vocaloid addict.

She has shoulder-length purple hair that has a light purple colored hair band attached to her head and violet eyes.

name: Sonoko Machida
description:
Sonoko Machida works at Fujikawa Shoten and is Utaha Kasumigaoka's editor.

She is a calm, collected and hardworking young woman who is also very mature but she acts childish at times.

name: Tokino Himekawa
description:
Tokino Himekawa is another oboist of the Icy tail band who is a voice actor fanatic.

She is a petite girl that has purple shoulder-length hair that curls at the tip. She has purple eyes. Tokino is usually seen with normal Tsubaki Girls Senior school uniform.

name: Ranko Morioka
description:
Ranko Morioka is the oboist of the Icy tail band who is a is a casual otaku fan.

She is a quiet and calm girl who also seems to be experienced in Data Processing.

name: Cid Kagenou
description:
__Race:__ Human

Cid Kagenou, under the moniker of "Shadow," is the founder and leader of the secret organization "Shadow Garden." He founded the organization to help realize his fantasy of becoming an “Eminence in Shadow". However, unbeknownst to him, his fabrications are often revealed to be quite genuine in reality. Cid is the reincarnation of Minoru Kagenou.

name: Delta
description:
__Race:__ Beastkin

Delta is a member of Shadow Garden, being fourth of the original Shadow Seven to join the organization after her Demonic Possession was healed by her master [Shadow](https://anilist.co/character/136837/Cid-Kagenou). As the most physically gifted of the Seven, Delta is also often the most destructive and brutal of the group due to her lack of sense and self-control.

name: Alpha
description:
__Race:__ Elf

Alpha is the second-in-command of Shadow Garden. After being cured of Demon Possession by [Cid Kagenou](https://anilist.co/character/136837/Cid-Kagenou), she would devote her life to his cause, becoming the first member to be recruited into his organization, Shadow Garden. 

~!She is the descendant of the elf [Hero Olivier](https://anilist.co/character/204203/Olivier).!~

name: Beta
description:
__Race:__ Elf

Beta is the second member of Shadow Garden, supporting her master [Shadow](https://anilist.co/character/136837/Cid-Kagenou) against the Order of Diabolos. 

~!Outside of her Shadow Garden activities, she adopts the identity of Natsume Kafka, an up-and-coming author of numerous original pieces of literature.!~

name: Epsilon
description:
__Race:__ Elf

Epsilon is the fifth member of Shadow Garden. Due to her insecurities with having a flat-chest, she manipulated her slime bodysuit every year to slowly increase the mass on her chest, eventually developing a fake large breast. As a consequence of this, she developed extreme magic control earning her the title, "The Precision."

name: Alexia Midgar
description:
__Race:__ Human

Alexia Midgar is the second princess of the Kingdom of Midgar and younger sister of [Iris Midgar](https://anilist.co/character/204204/Iris--Midgar). She is also a student of Midgar Royal Spellsword Academy.

name: Gamma
description:
__Race:__ Elf

Gamma is a member of Shadow Garden, being third of the original Seven Shadows as well as the director of the Mitsugoshi Company. Despite her lack of coordination, Gamma's knowledge has allowed her to recreate many of the items described by her master [Shadow](https://anilist.co/character/136837/Cid-Kagenou) to sell as Mitsugoshi's exclusive products.

name: Aurora
description:
__Race:__ Human

A woman known as the Calamity Witch who once brought chaos and destruction to the world. In the Goddess' Trial in the Sacred Land, she is summoned in reaction to Cid's presence and does battle with him in the form of Shadow. Her body is sealed in the sanctuary, and after helping Cid to escape she disappears together with its destruction. 

~!Aurora's true identity is the great demon Diabolos but it is unknown if she founded the Order of Diabolos or cursed the three heroes with possession. !~

name: Claire Kagenou
description:
__Race:__ Human

Claire is the older sister of [Cid Kagenou](https://anilist.co/character/136837/Cid-Kagenou) and heir to the Kagenou Family.

name: Rose Oriana
description:
__Race:__ Human

Rosa Oriana is a noble Princess from the Oriana kingdom. She is known for being a genius in art in her kingdom. However, she came to Midgar Royal Spellsword Academy in order to learn swordsmanship.

~!Later [Alpha](https://anilist.co/character/162246/Alpha) discovered Rose, who became a fugitive for assassinating her father and was then offered membership into Shadow Garden.!~

name: Zeta
description:
__Race:__ Beastkin

Zeta is the sixth member of Shadow Garden, being one of the original Seven Shadows. She usually travels around the world alone gathering intelligence.

name: Beatrix
description:
__Race:__ Elf

Beatrix is the champion of the God of War Tournament.

~!She is presumed to be the long lost aunt of [Alpha](https://anilist.co/character/162246/Alpha).!~

name: Eta
description:
__Race:__ Elf

Eta is the seventh member of Shadow Garden, being one of the original Seven Shadows. She specializes and is in charge of the research faction of Shadow Garden and as a result has her own laboratory. She is known as Eta Lloyd Wright, the genius architect, whose work won unanimous first place in an Architecture of the Year.

name: Yukime
description:
__Race:__ Therianthrope (Fox)

She is the ruler of the White Tower, a therianthrope known as a "Spirit Fox". Even Among the Spirit Fox clan she possesses exceptional talents and combat abilities, using an iron fan as her weapon to dance gracefully in battle. While she manages the red-light district in the Lawless City, she is also a savvy entrepreneur who runs a trading company called the Snow Fox Corporation

~!Later on, Yukime chooses to form an alliance between her faction and [Shadow's](https://anilist.co/character/136837/Cid-Kagenou), both organizations desiring to end the nuisance of the cult.!~

name: Nu
description:
__Race:__ Human

Nu is the thirteenth member of Shadow Garden and an employee of Mitsugoshi Company.

name: Iris  Midgar
description:
__Race:__ Human

Iris Midgar is the first princess of the Kingdom of Midgar and older sister of [Alexia Midgar](https://anilist.co/character/168799/Alexia-Midgar). She is also leader of the Crimson Order.

name: Akane Nishino
description:
__Race:__ Human

Akane Nishino is the daughter of the CEO of Nishino Conglomerate and the former classmate of [Minoru Kagenou](https://anilist.co/character/136837/Kagenou-Cid), Cid's pre-reincarnated self.

name: Sherry Barnett
description:
__Race:__ Human

Sherry Barnett is a student of Midgar Royal Spellsword Academy. She is also the adopted daughter of [Lutheran Barnett](https://anilist.co/character/291390/Barnett-Lutheran).

name: Elisabeth
description:
__Race:__ Vampire

Elisabeth is one of the three monarchs of the Lawless City and the Queen of Vampires.

name: Mary
description:
__Race:__ Vampire

Mary is a Vampire Hunter, dedicated in putting an end to [Elizabeth](https://anilist.co/character/217044/), the Vampire Queen.

name: Annerose Nichtsehen
description:
__Race:__ Human

She is a Dark Knight of the Velgalta Empire. Originally a member of "Velgalta's Seven Blades," she abandoned her position to embark on a journey of self-improvement.

While participating in the Bushin Festival to test her strength, she was left impressed by [Mundane Mann](https://anilist.co/character/136837/Kagenou-Cid)'s ability and is now training to reach his level.
While she possesses skills and brains, she can sometimes be a little klutzy.

name: Lambda
description: Member of Shadow Garden, and one of The Numbers (No. 11). She is in charge of training new recruits.

name: Victoria
description: Member of Shadow Garden, serving as one of The Numbers under the codename Number 559. Her abilities are said to rival those of the Seven Shadows. She is one of only two people, except the Seven Shadows, to receive their powers directly from Shadow himself. Victoria does not care about consequences of her actions or collateral damage as long as she can accomplish her mission.

name: Omega
description: Member of Shadow Garden, and one of the Numbers (No. 24). She is a subordinate of [Epsilon](https://anilist.co/character/162249). Omega is usually calm and collected but is troubled by her tendency to laugh at silly jokes.

name: No.665
description:
__Race:__ Elf

665 is a member of Shadow Garden's Numbers and is in a squad with [664](https://anilist.co/character/229662/No664) and 666. She has a calm personality and is good at providing support.

name: Mafuyu Satou
description:
__Height:__ 173 cm

One of the protagonists of the manga-anime. He has a quiet, calm and mysterious personality, he can't express his thoughts and emotions very well, despite being a sincere boy. After all he is a strong person who has endured many bad things in his past. He lives with his mother (who works a lot and is never shown in the manga and anime) and his dog named [Kedama](https://anilist.co/character/230878/Kedama), but he usually calls him Tama (cat name). His best friends in the past were [Hiiragi](https://anilist.co/character/167930/Kashima-Hiiragi), [Yuuki](https://anilist.co/character/153048/Yoshida-Yuki) (his ex-boyfriend) and [Shizusumi](https://anilist.co/character/167938/Yagi-Shizusumi) (they were friends since childhood), his current best friends are [Uenoyama](https://anilist.co/character/136843/Uenoyama-Ritsuka) (his current boyfriend), [Kaji](https://anilist.co/character/136842/Kaji-Akihiko) and [Haruki](https://anilist.co/character/136845/Nakayama-Haruki), although he still maintains some contact with Hiiragi.

name: Ritsuka Uenoyama
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5′8")

Ritsuka Uenoyama is one of the main protagonists of the Given Series. He is a high school student and has a guitar prowess despite being just a high schooler. He is a considerate and compassionate guy and is also a genuine younger brother of his sister [Yayoi](https://anilist.co/character/167937/Uenoyama-Yayoi). Uenoyama shows little consideration for small talk and can be quick to be irate. He can be smug when showing his high test scores, and says he can understand theory based subjects. Uenoyama can be very attentive to the feelings of others, particularly [Mafuyu](https://anilist.co/character/136844/Satou-Mafuyu).

name: Haruki Nakayama
description:
__Height:__ 178 cm

Haruki Nakayama is a film major graduate student, and the bassist in the band Given. He is the oldest in the group and the leader of the band. Haruki “prefers lighter music (compared to other guys) and pop. Drawn to Japanese rock and light, slow tempo dance.”  He is “extremely good natured and kind” and is easily flustered. In the manga it is revealed that Haruki’s “stand” is a kind elderly man. He lives on his own in an apartment and is friends with [Ritsuka Uenoyama](https://anilist.co/character/136843/Uenoyama-Ritsuka), [Mafuyu Satou](https://anilist.co/character/136844/Satou-Mafuyu), and [Koji Yatake](https://anilist.co/character/174907/Yatake-Koji). 

~!In season one of the anime it is clear he has romantic feelings towards his band-mate [Akihiko](https://anilist.co/character/136842/Kaji-Akihiko), and as of now in the manga is the boyfriend of Akihiko.!~

name: Akihiko Kaji
description:
__Height:__ 184 cm

Akihiko Kaji is a college student in Given. Also the drummer in Ritsuka's band, he can play not only the drums but also violin, guitar, and bass.

name: Narrator
description:
This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. 

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

name: Ugetsu Murata
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm

He is a world-renowned violinist. He is [Akihiko](https://anilist.co/character/136842/Kaji-Akihiko)'s room and classmate, and on-again-off-again boyfriend as well as a University student. He has been classmates with Akihiko since their high school days. Though he is Akihiko's roommate, he sometimes goes abroad and sometimes he stays in Japan.

Ugetsu is very intelligent and a prodigy violinist. He is generally a cheerful and friendly person, he is warm and affectionate towards others, such as welcoming Akihiko home. He is very sharp about other people‘s feelings.

Ugetsu is very emotional and capable of overwhelming feelings but he doesn’t know how to express them properly except through his music. When Ugetsu is under pressure he is easily irascible and unstable; in fact he shows to be moody, and violent as well, hitting Akihiko on the face and breaking or throwing things around him.

name: Yuki Yoshida
description:
He is a childhood friend of [Mafuyu](https://anilist.co/character/136844/Satou-Mafuyu).

~!He is Mafuyu's ex-boyfriend, who died one year from an apparent suicide prior to the events of the series. He played guitar in a band with [Hiiragi](https://anilist.co/character/167930/Hiiragi-Kashima) and [Yagi](https://anilist.co/character/167938/Shizusumi-Yagi).!~

name: Hiiragi Kashima
description:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5'9")

Hiiragi Kashima is a high school student who, along with Mafuyu, seems to know something about Mafuyu’s guitar. He is also Mafuyu's former classmate. He formerly played bass in a band with Yuki and Shizusumi.

name: Shizusumi Yagi
description:
__Age:__ 16 (start to chapter 28)
17 (from chapter 28)
__Height:__ 180cm

Shizusumi Yagi is Mafuyu's former classmate. He formerly played drums in a band with Yuki and Hiiragi who he is childhood friends with.

name: Kedama
description: [Mafuyu Satou](https://anilist.co/character/136844/)'s nine-month-old Pomeranian dog.

name: Koji Yatake
description:
He's older than Haruki, but entered university the same time as he did after spending a year retaking his entrance exam.

Does film editing in a small company. He's a bassist and a vocalist, and is close friends with Haruki. Mixing both his interest and the chance to make money, he makes music videos for bands he's chummy with.

name: Shougo Itaya
description:
__Height:__ 176cm

He is one of the best friends of Uenoyama in the school. He is from the soccer club, but he also plays basket with his friends (including Ue), he likes all balls games and loves music.

name: Yayoi Uenoyama
description:
__Height:__ 163cm

Yayoi Uenoyama is Ritsuka's older sister who she lives with. She has an unrequited crush on his bandmate, Akihiko Kaji.

~!She is Take-chan's girlfriend.!~

name: Ryou Ueki
description:
Ryou Ueki is Ritsuka's classmate. Ryou enjoys playing basketball and is close friends with Shogo.
Not as talkative compared to other students, Ryou enjoys playing basketball and is friendly to students from other classes such as Mafuyu.

name: Waka Kurihara
description: She has a very friendly personality towards her fellow classmates and takes part in their discussions on matters including the guys they know. She's friends with Kasai and is in the same class as her and Uenoyama.

name: Ayano Kasai
description: She is very honest and truthful about her feelings towards others, but get's jealous over other people's relationships. She's Uenoyama's classmate.

name: Mikoto Misaka
description: __Height:__ 161 cm (5'3") __Classification:__ Esper __School:__ Tokiwadai Middle School __Esper Power:__ Electromaster __Power Level:__ 5 One of the main heroines in the Toaru Majutsu no Index series and the protagonist of her side story, Toaru Kagaku no Railgun. An Esper of Academy City, her powers are ranked Level 5, the highest rank for the most powerful Espers. She ranks as third-strongest out of the seven people who hold this rank in Academy City.

name: Accelerator
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm 
__Classification:__ Esper 
__Esper Power:__ Accelerator
__Power Level:__ 5

Accelerator is the most powerful Esper in Academy City. Their real name is unknown, though Accelerator recalls their surname was composed of two characters and their given name consisted of three characters. 

A sadistic person about the same age as [Touma](https://anilist.co/character/13700/Kamijou-Touma), Accelerator has the esper power "Accelerator", an ability unique to them. The ability includes "Vector Change", a form of telekinesis that allows Accelerator to change the vector values of anything they touch, due in part to having a thin coat of AIM fields surrounding their body.

name: Touma Kamijou
description: __Height:__ 168 cm __Classification:__ Esper (technically) __Esper Power:__ Imagine Breaker __Power Level:__ 0 (technically) The main protagonist of Toaru Majutsu no Index and a supporting character in Toaru Kagaku no Railgun. He has the lowest psychic rank possible at Level 0—largely because the people testing psychic abilities cannot detect or classify his abilities. His power is Imagine Breaker, a power which negates all magic, psychic, or divine powers but also his own good luck. Due to the nature of his power, the founder of Academy City considers him neither a Psychic nor a Magician but rather a normal person with a unique ability. He tends to stay away from trouble but possesses a strong sense of justice, albeit somewhat shallow and dogmatic. He is a smart student and knowledgeable about certain subjects yet is a failure in his esper studies. While he is an idealist for the hopes of other people, ironically he is cynical about himself possibly because of his powers.

name: Kuroko Shirai
description:
__Height:__ 152 cm (5'0")
__Classification:__ Esper
__School:__ Tokiwadai Middle School
__Affiliation:__ Judgment
__Esper Power:__ Teleport
__Power Level:__ 4

Kuroko is [Mikoto](/character/13701/)'s kouhai in Tokiwadai Middle School and a protagonist in <cite>Toaru Kagaku no Railgun</cite>, as well as a supporting character in <cite>Toaru Majutsu no Index</cite>. A Level 4 Esper, she is a member of Judgment, a special public committee group whose duty is to maintain peace and order in Academy City. She has an unhealthy obsession with Mikoto, whom she calls "Onee-sama" (big sister), and is on the constant lookout for a chance to get physically intimate with her (and getting called a pervert in the process). 

Her power is instant teleportation, which allows her to teleport herself and anything she touches as long it weighs under around 130-137 kilograms to anywhere in a radius of around 81-85 meters.

name: Misaki Shokuhou
description:
__Height:__ 169 cm 
__Classification:__ Esper 
__Esper Power:__ Mental Out
__Power Level:__ 5

Misaki is a Level 5 student who attends Tokiwadai Middle School. She goes under the alias "The Queen" which refers to her having the largest faction within Tokiwadai Middle School. She appears as an elegant beauty of Tokiwadai Middle School, sporting long straight hair of golden color. She wears a pair of white gloves and stockings, both adorned with lace. She is also seen holding a shoulder bag with a star adorned on the middle.

As one of the two Level 5s of Tokiwadai, she and her followers have a rivalry with [Mikoto Misaka](https://anilist.co/character/13701/Misaka-Mikoto) and her fans. She never shows herself in public, instead using her followers or mind-controlling people to act as her representatives when talking with individuals. It is hinted that she has a strong dislike for public appearances, and this is why whenever the school needs a "face" to promote certain public events, she and her faction will simply stand aside and let Mikoto hog all of the attention and responsibilities.

name: Kaori Kanzaki
description:
__Height:__ 175cm 
__Classification:__ Magician
__Affiliation:__ Necessarius, Amakusa-Style Remix of Church (Priestess)  

A  sorceress from Necessarius. Unlike her partner Stiyl, she uses magic to magically strengthen her body. Her sorcery name is Salvere000. She uses a 2 meter long katana (which actually is a Nodachi) called "Seven Heavens Seven Swords" as her weapon. She has a special attack called Nanasen (七閃, Nanasen? "Seven Flash") that uses her katana and some wires. She used to be a kind woman who treated Index like a sister, but when Index's memories were deleted by Necessarius, Kaori changed into a cold and silent woman as Index no longer remembered her and consequentially did not trust her. 

After Touma saves Index's life and her current memories, she decides to stay in Academy City to be with Index and protect her.  Later in the novels, more of her past is revealed. Not only is Kaori a skilled swordswoman, but she is a Catholic Saint possessing the "Stigma" — the ability to call upon God's power — and the former leader of the Amakusa Catholics. However, Kaori left the group as she resented that she had been fated since birth to become its leader, which led her to despise the concept of luck and fortune. Though she is Catholic, she joined Necessarius in hopes of changing her fate and befriended Index, developing a sisterly relationship with her. The repeated failed attempts to make Index remember her after each memory erasure resulted in her cold personality as Kaori began to accept that no matter how much a person tries, no one can change their destiny. She begins to show a kinder side to herself after Touma saves Index (thus giving her hope that anyone can defy their destiny) and gradually falls in love with him after he helps her face her past with the Amakusa Catholics, becoming more prone to showing emotion and sometimes showing a little embarrassment if she is with him. She is the protagonist of her own spin-off mini light novel bundled with the Toaru Kagaku no Railgun DVDs.

name: Index Librorum Prohibitorum
description:
__Height:__ 148 cm (4'10")
__Classification:__ Magician
__Affiliation:__ Anglican Church
__Ability:__ Spell Intercept

Index, also known by her full name Index Librorum Prohibitorum, is one of the main heroines and the titular character of the series. She is a young nun from Necessarius, a branch of the Church of England. 

Index is small in stature and has a petite build. About 14 or 15 years old, she has thigh-length, silvery-blue hair with very white skin and large green eyes. She also wears a white robe with golden embroidery sewed onto every edge of it, the Walking Church.

name: Last Order
description:
Misaka clone No. 20001, she is the administrator of the Misaka Network and the fail-safe mechanism in case the Sisters got out of control. She is not designed to function independently and survive for long outside a culture container, and appears to be only about ten years old.

Unlike her previous clone sisters, she is capable of showing emotions and has a close relationship with [Mikoto](https://anilist.co/character/13701/Misaka-Mikoto), [Misaka Imouto](https://anilist.co/character/17729/MISAKA-10032) and [Accelerator](https://anilist.co/character/13917/Accelerator).

name: MISAKA 10032
description: Misaka is the 10032nd clone of Misaka Mikoto, a Sister, that was first introduced in Toaru Majutsu no Index and plays a relatively small role in Toaru Kagaku no Railgun. Originally supposed to be killed in the 10032 experiment against Accelerator as part of the Level 6 Shift Project, she is one of the few Sisters that remained in Academy City for readjustments. She becomes the most prominent clone in the series after being rescued by Kamijou Touma, and is referred to as Misaka Imouto (御坂妹 Misaka Imōto?, lit. "Misaka's little sister") whenever they meet.

name: Kazari Uiharu
description:
__Height:__ 153 cm
__Classification:__ Esper
__School:__ Sakugawa Middle School
__Affiliation:__ Judgment
__Esper Power:__ Thermal Hand
__Power Level:__ 1

Shirai's friend and colleague in Judgment and another protagonist in Toaru Kagaku no Railgun. Shy and humble, she goes to Sakugawa Junior High, different from Shirai's, and is known for wearing a headband made of flowers on her head, and sometimes a surgical mask as she constantly suffers the flu. She has a sweet tooth but is often called for Judgment duties before she can enjoy her sweets. She displays various skills with the use of the computer, such as repelling hackers and information gathering.   She makes a cameo appearance in the opening of the Index anime and appears as a supporting character in the second season. She has small parts in the novels, larger ones in the Railgun SS novels.   ~!Her power is the ability to maintain the temperature of objects although she can really only maintain them at temperatures she herself tolerates.!~

name: Othinus
description: She is referred to as One-Eyed Othinus and, similarly to the Othinus of legend, she wears an eyepatch over her right eye which she has presumably lost in order for her to drink from the Well of Wisdom, though this may just be a ritualistic and aesthetic choice, as Othinus is maybe invoking Idol Theory to match that of Odin of Norse mythology. Her remaining eye is glittery green and with slit-like iris. She's seen dressed in a fur coat and a black leather outfit. She also wears a wide brimmed hat with a pointed tip, one which would have been worn by a witch.

name: Shiage Hamazura
description: Level 0 and former Skill-Out with his best friends [Komaba Ritoku](/character/40145) and [Hattori Hanzou](/character/39988). A former lackey, grunt, chauffeur, and informant of ITEM, he delved into Academy City's darkness and turned into an anomaly that disrupts Aleister Crowley's plans and calculations time and time again.

name: Stiyl Magnus
description:
__Height:__ 200cm (6.56 ft)
__Classification:__ Magician, Priest
__Affiliation:__ Anglican Church (Necessarius)

A sorcerer from Necessarius. His sorcery name is Fortis931. He is an extremely heavy smoker; he claims a world without nicotine would be hell. He specializes in using flames and is able to use a flame sword or summon a 3000 degree Celsius fire called Innocentius ("King of Witch Hunters") to battle his enemies. Despite his looks, he is actually fourteen-years-old and ironically is physically weak. He mostly has a bad temper but is actually kind, as he cares about Index very much and his failure to save her life without losing her memories was his greatest regret. When he learns the Church lied to him and Kaori about Index's condition, he decides to disobey orders to capture Index and let her live her life.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Aleister Crowley
description:
Based on the late Aleister Crowley. He was once the greatest magician in modern magic history, where more than half of all modern magicians are affected by this man's established theories, and two-fifths of them are direct followers of his ways. Aleister stretched the boundaries of sorcery farther than the advances made in the last few millennia alone and wrote many top-class spell books like The Book of the Law.

 His death in 1947 shocked many but it was not the last the world had heard of him. In reality, he faked his death to stop the obsessing fanatics following him and secretly went to Japan where he meet a doctor who he would later call Heaven Canceler. Years later, Aleister, Heaven Canceler, and several powerful individuals combined their resources and influences to create one of the most technologically advanced cities on Earth in western Tokyo, Academy City. By this time, rumors of Aleister still being alive led some mages to discover the truth. At first, they were happy to see that he was alive but were immediately shocked as that not only Aleister abandoned using magic but was more interested in the study and development of espers. 

To this day, only a few magicians know Aleister is still alive who are mostly the leaders of powerful magical organizations and their trusted followers, and those that do know him to view him with skepticism, curiosity on what he's doing, or outraged for abandoning magic and supporting science especially esper studies. Not making things any better is the fact Aleister was responsible for the creation of the truce between Science and Magic where neither side is allowed to interfere in each other affairs which have irked both sides. As the 13th Board of Director and General Director of Academy City, Aleister has the final say of the city affairs but usually leaves the city's welfare to the other members of the board. He resides within a tall, gray building called The Windowless building, known for not having any exterior windows where access to the building is a secret to a few. In there, Aleister's body which has now become younger lies inside a giant glass tube, supported by machines made by Heaven Canceler that extended his lifespan where he plots his mysterious plans.

name: Aisa Himegami
description:
__Height:__ 160 cm
__Classification:__ Esper (Gemstone) 

 A quiet young girl with a rather blunt personality who wears Miko attire.   ~!While she may seem normal, she is also known as "Deep Blood" and has the ability to kill vampires when they approach her, as her blood's smell attracts them. However, it made her miserable because it killed her family and friends that were turned into vampires. This prompts her to go to Academy City, hoping to find a way to get rid of her powers, until she meets the alchemist Aureolus Izzard. She cooperates with him because he told her that her blood can be used to save the life of a person he cared for (Index) in return for helping her get rid of her powers.!~  ~!When Aureolus learns Index's life was already saved by Tōma and tries to kill him, Aisa attempts to defend Tōma, which prompts Aureolus to use his alchemy to try to kill her as she was now useless to him. Her life was saved by Tōma who dispelled the spell on her with his right hand. When she asks Tōma about why he saved her, he told her that he did not have a reason to rescue her. After the incident, she lives with Tōma and Index but later moves to Komoe's apartment and wears a magical power-blocking cross, which enables her to live what she had always wanted: a normal life. She was formerly a student at Kirigaoka Academy for Girls, one of the five elite schools of Academy City, but was transfer to Tōma's school when her sponsor, Aureolus Izzard mysteriously disappear thus ending her enrollment at Kirigaoka Academy. Ever since Tōma saved her life, Aisa started to have feelings for him, which is ironic as she once joked that Tōma's life was like a dating sim. !~

name: Komoe Tsukuyomi
description:
__Height:__ 135 cm

Despite her childish and very short appearance, she is actually an adult and one of [Touma Kamijou](https://anilist.co/character/13700/Kamijou-Touma)'s teachers. This is proven by her apartment being littered with beer cans and cigarettes. She also contradicts her age by acting childish to her students, having a child-like crush on Touma, and ending her sentences with desu, something a child usually does. This irony means that she is often regarded as one of the seven great mysteries of Academy City.

She has major interest in studying pyrokinesis and performs magic once, when [Index](https://anilist.co/character/13699/Librorum-Prohibitorum-Index) requires her to participate in a magical ritual to heal her wounds. The fact that she is able to do so indicates she has no esper abilities of her own.

name: Shizuri Mugino
description:
__Height:__ 163 cm
__Classification:__ Esper 
__Esper Power:__ Meltdowner
__Power Level:__ 5

Mugino is one of Academy City's Level 5 espers. She is ranked #4th and has the ability "Meltdowner". She can retain "pure" form of electrons (fix them in an ambiguous state which is neither a particle or a wave), and manipulate them into a beam which can melt down pretty much anything. She is also the leader of ITEM, the underground peace-making organization.

Mugino's appearance may suggest she's gentle and kind, but in reality she's a sadistic, battle-hungry fighter who looks down on all she deems weaker. She shows a compassionate face towards her teammates, although she would dispose of them if they got in her way.

~!She encounters [Teitoku Kakine](https://anilist.co/character/39953/Kakine-Teitoku), leader of SCHOOL in the war of Acadmey City's underground organizations, but was defeated. Shortly after she kills her subordinate in ITEM, [Frenda](https://anilist.co/character/30040/Seivelun-Frenda) for betraying the organisation. And around the end of the war, she makes a decision regarding [Rikou Takitsubo](https://anilist.co/character/30042/Takitsubo-Rikou), which led to her fighting against [Shiage Hamazura](https://anilist.co/character/39705/Hamazura-Shiage), a level 0 who was an underling of ITEM. Surprisingly Hamazura wins the fight with a combination of luck and brains. Mugino was severly damaged in the fight, losing an eye and an arm, which led Hamazura into believing her to be dead.

But later she reappears in Russia, having acquires a replacement arm and a monocle that snugly fits in her right eye socket. After losing her arm every encounter that she had with Hamazura left Mugino more and more imbalanced, she developed a huge obsession with getting rid of Hamazura. She becomes obesessed to the point of abusing Body Crystal to defeat Shiage.

By the end of volume 22 she finally decides to make peace with herself and with Shiage, finally returned to being the "old Mugino" who trusted her teammates and friends.!~

__In To Aru Majutsu no Index: New Testament:__ ~!Mugino has had her eye replaced with a mechanical one and covers up the rest of her injuries with makeup and has gotten a prosthetic arm that she is able to use as well as a real one. These replacement body parts make it look almost exactly the same as how she used to look before she fought Hamazura. She has also rekindled relations with the rest of ITEM and is shown to regret having killed Frenda. Also Mugino's personality is shown to have changed greatly in New Testament. She is far kinder than she was in the first series and shows far less bloodlust and obsession than the times during the conflicts between underground organizations. She is also shown to think more of lower level espers and no longer look down on them as much as she used to.!~

name: Saiai Kinuhata
description:
She is a member of ITEM, led by [Shizuri Mugino](https://anilist.co/character/30041/Mugino-Shizuri). ~!She later becomes its leader in Volume 19, after Shizuri's defeat in Volume 15 at the hands of Shiage Hamazura.!~

Despite being a powerful Psychic, Saiai is one of the most mellowed-out characters in the group; she isn't a screw-up like [Frenda](https://anilist.co/character/30040/Seivelun-Frenda), nor is she as frightful as her leader, Mugino. She enjoys bad movies and likes to tease others, [Shiage](https://anilist.co/character/39705/Hamazura-Shiage) in particular because of his reaction to anything sexually suggestive. She also likes to add "super" (chou) to her remarks.

Her ability is the Level 4 Offense Armor (Chisso Soukou, "Nitrogen Armor"), which she uses to control the nitrogen in the atmosphere to create a few centimeters of solidified nitrogen to act as a barrier. She can use this to attack and defend. Like Accelerator's AIM vector shield, the primary function of her ability is to create an armor of super-compressed nitrogen around her, she fights a sniper in volume 15 and Academy city's special sniper rifle is shown to have no effect on her other than to knock her backwards a little. Because of her ability, she carries around a small amount of nitrogen for use at all times.

~!According to [Teitoku Kakine](https://anilist.co/character/39953/Kakine-Teitoku), Saiai is a leftover from 'Project Mayday of Darkness' (usually referred to as the "Dark May Project") whose aim was to create a personal version of Accelerator's ability by using a similar pattern of ability operation. This was done by referencing the cognitive patterns of Accelerator himself in order to optimize the personal realities of certain espers taking part in the experiment. Though the details are not mentioned, Saiai only succeeded in creating an automatic self-defense capability that activates if she is attacked.!~

name: Lessar
description: She is a member of New Light and was introduced in Volume 17. Lessar is a member of New Light with black hair and a dragon-like tail accessory which allows her to keep her balance when jumping because she can jump very high, but is also afraid of heights, as shown when she had no problems jumping to the top of a building but then hesitated to jump back down. She is the kind of girl who doesn't know how to keep a low profile. Lessar has so far made the most aggressive attempts at seducing Touma out of all the girls interested in him, and doesn't try to hide it. She once made a move on Touma while in a enclosed space in Russia but it is not shown what happened. After her clothes got wet from the snow and her bra could be seen through her top, instead of being embarrassed, Lessar is more annoyed that her secret weapon to seduce Touma has been wasted after all of her preparation.

name: Aiho Yomikawa
description: Yomikawa Aiho is teacher at Touma's school and a friend of Komoe. She is beautiful, has glamorous proportions, and is always seen with a green jersey and often ends her sentences with "-jan". Despite having a glamorous figure, she acts in a tomboyish matter and regularly joins colleague Tsukuyomi Komoe in drinking sessions after their work. She also always tease Komoe, her senior & friend.  She is a member of Anti-Skill and cares deeply for her students (in spite of having a "spartan" approach in teaching according to Komoe), and is an active peacekeeper within Academy City. Due to her habit of ramming delinquents with protective items like shield or helmets to resolve incidents, saying it's alright to do so since those are protective items, she's known as 'the woman who uses comedy-like methods to solve problems that could end up as a tragedy'.  As a favor to her old friend, Yomikawa is asked by Yoshikawa Kikyou to take care of Accelerator and Last Order after they are released from the hospital.   ~!Yomikawa suspects that Accelerator is involved in Academy City's dark side, which he does not deny, but instead calls Yomikawa naive for thinking the things that barely scratch the surface are the worst that things can get. Later she brought Accelerator back out of the dark side briefly, before he got dragged back by Kakine and got herself stabbed by Dark Matter.  In New Testament, when Accelerator came back, it was said that she punched him and then hugged him.!~

name: Junko Hokaze
description:
Hokaze Junko is a third-year student of Tokiwadai Middle School and the most prominent and arguably loyal member of Shokuhou Misaki's clique. She can be described as kind but naive, believing that she can make Misaki and Mikoto get along, as well as being unable to comprehend the lewd nature of Aogami Pierce's conversation regarding his dreams with Misaki and Mikoto. She is also a fan of Gekota.

(Source: Toaru Majutsu no Index Wiki, edited)

name: Seiri Fukiyose
description: Touma's classmate, Aisa's best friend, often takes up roles of the class representative even though it's Aogami who is the class representative. She dislikes people (namely Touma) who give up on their life and blame it on bad luck like Touma, yet she secretly has a crush on him. It's debatable if she is tsundere towards Touma or only dislikes him because of his attitude towards life and school in general but for sure she does have a sort of friendly relationship with him, even sometimes playing a role of tsukkomi for Touma who acts as the bokke. She is mentioned as the girl who is "pretty but lacks sex appeal". She is a health-product freak and is frequently ordering different health products from the television shopping channels. Her abilities have yet to be revealed.

name: Teitoku Kakine
description:
He is one of the seven Level 5 espers, ranking second after Accelerator and is the leader of SCHOOL, one of the many underground factions. His power is production of the Dark Matter, the substance which isn't supposed to exist in this world, which makes him the opposite of Accelerator who specializes in destruction.  He shares a rivalry with Mugino Shizuri, team leader of ITEM and the number #4 Level 5 esper 'Meltdowner'. He strives to become the strongest, even if it means to kill off Accelerator. He's also a ruthless, cocky, and coldhearted individual who shows no mercy or compassion towards his enemies or bystanders, and won't hesitate to look down on anyone whom he deems inferior.   

~!In the war between the underground factions of Academy City, Kakine fights Accelerator but loses. Yomikawa stopped Accelerator from killing Kakine but Kakine stabs her from behind, causing Accelerator to go berserk and kill Kakine in a gruesome way- going as far as tearing him into countless pieces. But later Kakine reappears in New Testament and features prominently in the sixth volume. It was revealed that he wasnt actually dead but his body was preserved by the Kiharas. He learns to copy human cells thanks to Kihara Byouri using his power in Baggage City, resulting in him becoming able to create even his own body. !~

name: Rikou Takitsubo
description:
She is the member of underground organization ITEM. Her power is the LV4 AIM Stalker. She can detect and memorize the AIM of any esper on earth. She usually use it to locate the target person for her team. Rikou has a potential to become Level 5. ~!At one point, she suffers brain damage from the battle that prevents the use of her esper powers for a while. However, later she is cured and the path to become lv5 has opened for her again.!~ ~!According to Academin City's calculation, Rikou's full potential at Lv5 are following:
• Able to lower/rise the level of other espers
• Give any ability at any level to any person
• Remove the ability from any person
• Switch/change other esper abilities!~

name: Heaven Canceler
description: Often mentioned as "the Frog-Faced Doctor" by Touma, he is an exceptionally gifted and benevolent physician who can cure any illness and heal any injury, even if it is terminal. He is only unable to heal specific brain-related injuries, such as the "Imagine-Breaker Boy's" damaged memories and Accelerator's computation ability. However, in the latter case he was able to configure Accelerator to control his powers with support from the Misaka Network. This medical genius also manages the life extension devices for the ruler of the Academy City, Aleister Crowley, while also supporting the foundation of the city itself.

name: Gintoki Sakata
description:
__Height:__ 177 cm  

A samurai living in an era where a samurai is no longer needed. To add to his troubles, oppressive aliens have moved in to invade. Gintoki lives with [Kagura](https://anilist.co/character/674) and [Shinpachi](https://anilist.co/character/673), taking on odd jobs to make the world a better place...and to pay their rent. In the Joi war, he was known as the "White Devil" (Shiroyasha) due to his silver hair and white coat he wore in battle, which, combined with his impressive capabilities as a swordsman, made him famous among his comrades and struck fear into Amanto.

Gintoki has naturally permed silver hair, which he blames for his lacking love-life. He has a big crush on the TV's news weather girl, [Ketsuno](https://anilist.co/character/6225). In fact, to date, the only time he is seen to have blushed is when he tries to make use of [Sadaharu](https://anilist.co/character/2651) and Ketsuno's dog to get a chance to talk to her. Though several female characters have shown an interest in Gintoki, he usually does not show any response back and merely puts up with them as annoyances.

Gin has two major obsessions in life. He is obsessed with sweet foods such as parfait, ice cream, and cake. His second obsession is reading the manga anthology magazine Weekly Shōnen Jump. (Which, not coincidentally, is where Gintama is published in). His favorite type of milk is strawberry milk. Gin will go to great lengths to get the latest Jump issue, to the point of reckless behavior. His Jump obsession makes him easily dream of being like other Jump heroes, including wishing that he had a "Bankai" similar to the hero characters of Bleach.

Despite his appearance and initial behavior, Gintoki has a great amount of pride for the old Bushido code. He takes it upon himself to rescue or avenge not only his comrades and friends but also people he barely got acquainted too, be it a pit-fighter who was taking care of abandoned orphans or an Amanto who resembles a kappa.

Despite being a fearsome fighter with nearly unmatched skills, he avoids needless bloodshed after suffering the loss of most of his friends and allies during the Joi war.

name: Kagura
description:
__Height:__ 155 cm

Although she appears to be a normal, cute, human girl in Chinese-style clothing, she actually belongs to the Yato Clan, one of the strongest and most bloodthirsty of the Amanto races. The Yato is said to have "transparent" skin that is highly sensitive to sunlight, so Kagura carries a purple parasol at all times. The parasol is also the Yato clan's weapon of choice; Kagura's is bulletproof and fires bullets from its tip. Because of her Yato blood, she is super-strong and can stop a speeding motor-scooter with one hand. Although stronger than most humans, she cannot control her strength perfectly. Her super-human strength makes her extremely bad with pets. Most of her pets, with the exception of [Sadaharu](https://anilist.co/character/2651/Sadaharu), have met with an untimely demise at her hands.

She is also extremely flexible and fast; capable of catching multiple speeding bullets between her teeth and fingers. During a battle, she's often seen flipping through the air and performing various acrobatic feats. Due to her Yato blood, she is capable of rapid regeneration. During the Benizakura arc, she is seen healing from a gunshot wound almost overnight.

Kagura also has an unusually strong appetite. She is able to consume large quantities of food within a matter of seconds. Nevertheless, her tastes are endearingly plain. Sukonbu, rice, and eggs are among her favorite foods.

Her immediate family consists of her father, [Umibouzu](https://anilist.co/character/9876/Umibouzu), a widely recognized alien hunter, her mother, who is deceased, and her older brother [Kamui](https://anilist.co/character/12946/Kamui), once presumed missing who is now involved with the space pirates Harusame.

She came to Earth to earn money for her family. She found work fighting for a gang, but when they ordered her to kill her target, she ran away. Not long afterward, she met [Gintoki](https://anilist.co/character/672/Sakata-Gintoki) and [Shinpachi](https://anilist.co/character/673/Shimura-Shinpachi) when Gintoki accidentally ran her down with his scooter. After they helped her to make a clean break from the gang, she intimidated Gintoki into hiring her. She now lives at the Yorozuya and sleeps in Gintoki's closet, like [Doraemon](https://anilist.co/character/4304/Doraemon).

Kagura and Gintoki share an odd father-daughter-like relationship. Together with Shinpachi, the three of them make for a strange, dysfunctional, yet tightly knit family. Kagura is very protective of Gintoki. Although, she herself has gotten into many fights with him, rarely does she let anyone else pick on him. She seems to trust wholeheartedly in Gintoki's ability and strength. Even in sticky situations, she has no doubt that Gin-chan would come to save her. She has a tendency to imitate Gintoki's bad habits, and would often quote the bad advice he gives her. Some of her lines start with "Gin-chan says..." or "Gin-chan told me..."

Kagura is also somewhat of a tomboy. She is often seen partaking in games with various neighborhood boys. Although her candid manner of speech often causes them to shun her, she doesn't seem to mind. In fact, she has no problem at all with forcing her way into their game. In battle, she has proven to be bull-headed and a sore loser. Like Gintoki, and probably because of his influence, she is not above resorting to petty tricks and manipulation to get the better of her adversary. Unlike many conventional manga heroines, she doesn't display the same consciousness toward decorum, table manners, ​and physical appearance. Puking, cussing, picking her nose, spitting, fighting, and scratching herself is common behavior for Kagura.

She regards [Okita](https://anilist.co/character/2282/Okita-Sougo), captain of the Shinsengumi, as a rival. She detests him, and appeared to be disgusted when she previously mentioned (about Okita), that "he definitely likes me", but as that hasn't been brought up since, it is uncertain if it should be considered canon, that he apparently likes her.

According to the OVA, Kagura is the first and only Weekly Shonen Jump girl to vomit on-screen. To date, she has induced herself to vomit on several occasions. She also has an uncanny knack for seeming calm or detached during high-tension situations; in episode 5, she slept through a car-chase. Her appetite knows no bounds, and she is especially fond of sukonbu.

In Japanese, Kagura speaks in a stereotypical dialect that is associated with Chinese immigrants. In the English-translated manga, she punctuates her sentences with yup, uh-huh, nope, and the like.

~!In the Yoshiwara in Flames arc, Kagura meets her older brother, Kamui who abandoned her because she was weak in his eyes.!~ In the last Gintama character popularity poll, she came in 6th place.

name: Toushirou Hijikata
description:
__Species:__ Human  
__Height:__ 177 cm 
__Affiliations:__ Shinsengumi

Toshiro Hijikata is the famed chain smoking, vice commander of the Shinsengumi so named by his subordinates, because of his fearsome demeanor. Purportedly the brains behind the force, he takes his work seriously, and is fiercely loyal to his leader, [Isao Kondo](https://anilist.co/character/2943). Hijikata has a reputation as a fearsome leader, earning the nickname of "demonic vice-commander". He is also hot-tempered and often speaks of seppuku. However, despite his cold exterior, he does have a more compassionate side. He also has a tendency to cry after watching movies that are not particularly emotional.

Hijikata is obsessed with mayonnaise and thus has the nickname "Mayora". He has been known to smother anything he eats under a mountain of mayonnaise, and he carries a number of objects shaped like jars of mayonnaise, such as his cigarette lighter. He was popular with girls until they discovered this obsession.

He enjoys fighting and sees [Gintoki Sakata](https://anilist.co/character/672) as a rival in practically everything he does from drinking contests to rock, paper, scissors ever since being defeated by him in battle. He is in constant danger of being killed by the attempts on his life by [Sougo Okita](https://anilist.co/character/2282). But, despite all this, he sees Sougo as one of his close friends, and vice versa. Before joining Shinsengumi, he used to be a troublemaker ronin. He enjoys fighting/having a good fight and says he doesn't care how many Amanto buildings get blown up, he only looks forward to having a big battle with the Joui rebels after Shinsengumi has rounded them in 1 fell swoop, in episode 5. He also formulated the Kyokuchuu Hatto, the 45 Regulations that form the disciplinary framework for Shinsengumi members, and implements them firmly.

~! In The Baragaki arc, Toshi's past is fully revealed and we learn that he had a brother named Tamegoro whom had raised Toshi almost on his own during their childhood after their parents had died !~

name: Sougo Okita
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm

Okita is the best swordsman in the Shinsengumi. Personality-wise, he tends to be light-hearted and somewhat childish though his speech is heavily deadpan.

He outwardly displays annoyance and dislike for [Hijikata](https://anilist.co/character/2650/Hijikata-Toushirou), and continuously tries to kill (or at least badly wound) Hijikata whenever he has the chance so that he can become the Vice-Commander. Okita has great affection and fondness for [Kondo](https://anilist.co/character/2943/Kondou-Isao), who took him under his wings when he was little. He still regards Hijikata as one of his three friends (the other two being Kondo and [Gintoki](https://anilist.co/character/672/Sakata-Gintoki)).

He enjoys seeing women fight, finding the ugly looks on their faces as they grab each other being hilarious. He wears a distinctive eye mask when taking a nap during duty, which is a frequent occurrence. At one point, he refers to himself as the best sniper in the Shinsengumi. Although he is a master of kenjutsu, he uses a bazooka more often.  He also regards [Kagura](https://anilist.co/character/674/Kagura) as a rival after an unfinished rock-paper-scissors duel during a sakura-blossom party. He states that he'll "be the only one to defeat her", and usually calls her "China".

name: Tsukuyo
description: Tsukuyo is a blonde-haired woman with a scar over her forehead and left cheek. One of the better known Hundred Blooms of Yoshiwara, a law enforcement squad of Yoshiwara that consists of all females, deployed by the Night King Hosen. Despite appearing to be a heartless person when approached by Odd Jobs when he arrives to Yoshiwara, throwing a fake kunai to their foreheads, she later becomes friends with them. She has a difficult past being orphaned as a child, only to be picked up and raised by a ruthless and deadly assassin, Jiraia. While the original motive for Jiraia was to instill every bit of despair and tragedy of his own life into Tsukuyo, of who he refers to as his art or perfect creation, Tsukuyo ended up growing attached to what he did not manage to do. That is "Friends, A Home, and Precious Things To Protect" as told by Jiraia. Her loyalty and home lies with Hinowa in the underground city of Yoshiwara. She has ties with Hinowa, who also helped raise her like an older sister/mother through her childhood.   ~!It is hinted by Jiraia (in Chapter 255/Episode 178) Hinowa and Seita (in Chapter 294) that she has romantic feelings for Gintoki. This is further supported by her scribbling out statements from Hinowa's and Seita's New Year's cards commenting how lonely she was when they heard Gintoki has gotten married and her inability to give him chocolates for Valentine's Day (in Episode 204). Tsukyo herself has confirmed that, while she doesn't quite know what they are or what to do with them, she has some feelings towards Gintoki. This was in episode 177 when she said to him, "When I am with you, my resolve weakens. Don't shake up my feelings any further."!~

name: Taizou Hasegawa
description:
__Height:__ 179 cm 

Hasegawa used to be an official working for the Bakufu, but after an unfortunate incident with Amanto dignitary [Prince Hata](https://anilist.co/character/7929/Hata-Ouji), whom he was assigned to serve and protect, his superior asked him to succumb to his shame and commit seppuku, hearing that he ran away from his quarters.

He initially believed that humans should focus on appeasing the Amanto, but after his encounter with [Gintoki](https://anilist.co/character/672/Sakata-Gintoki), his mindset changed, which led to him punching Hata out, thus getting fired. Since then, he has been living a life of somewhat like a loser, getting fired almost every time he gets a new job, mostly due to the unfavourable look his sunglasses and goatee give him.

No matter what, he refuses to remove his sunglasses because it's the only thing he had left to remind him of his successful past. Although he does exchange the sunglasses for a decent pair of half-moon spectacles at one point, he goes back to wearing them after he decides that he is going to live out his life in the best way he can. He is constantly seen working various part-time jobs. He is often referred to as "Madao," short for "marude damena ossan," which roughly translates into "totally useless middle-aged man."

name: Shinpachi Shimura
description:
__Height:__ 166 cm

Shinpachi Shimura works under [Gintoki](https://anilist.co/character/672/Sakata-Gintoki) to learn the ways of the samurai. He used to stay at his family's dōjo. However, it seems more like he's just trying to help Gintoki pay the rent than to learn. Shinpachi is the captain of the "Otsu's Imperial Guard," a pop singer's fan club.

Shinpachi meets Gintoki after Shinpachi was tripped by the ambassador of Planet Chatoran. Gintoki beats up the ambassador and his guards, not to stand up for Shinpachi, but to get revenge for his spilled parfait. Gintoki frames Shinpachi for the crime, which somehow led to him saving [Tae Shimura](https://anilist.co/character/2944/Shimura-Tae) (Otae), Shinpachi's sister, from becoming part of a brothel.

Despite his meek appearance, Shinpachi is a more than competent swordsman of his family's Kakidō-Ryu, the type of swordsmanship his dojo teaches.

name: Isao Kondou
description:
__Height:__ 184 cm 

Isao Kondo is the Commander of the Shinsengumi. When not working, he is the stalker of [Tae Shimura](https://anilist.co/character/2944), earning him the nickname Gorilla-stalker. His superior is [Katakuriko Matsudaira](https://anilist.co/character/5972), a high-ranking government officer under direct control of the Bakufu. Even though the Shinsengumi are loyal to Kondo, he often has to use Vice Commander [Toshiro Hijikata](https://anilist.co/character/2650) to settle them down (with harsh words or use of violence) before conducting a speech. Kondo is good friends with Toshiro and [Sougo Okita](https://anilist.co/character/2282), and if one of them ever strayed, then the other two would punch him back to where he belongs, as Kondo once told Sougo. Sougo also often remarks that Kondo's nice-guy attitude is also his weakness as he never notices negative points about other people. In the Mutiny arc, he was described by [Kamotaro Ito](https://anilist.co/character/11458) as honest, pure and unsullied. In the same arc, Toshiro described him as the soul of the Shinsengumi, and the rest of them being the sword that protects him. Toshiro also said that everybody joined the Shinsengumi so that they could be with Kondo, and that as long as he was there, the Shinsengumi would not be finished.

When Kondo once asked Tae Shimura whether she would still love her boyfriend if he had a hairy butt. She became the target of his stalking when she replied that she would love her boyfriend just as much, hairy butt and all. Being a stalker of Tae, Kondo is often seen getting beat up or threatened by her, as she highly disapproves of his stalking and affection towards her. In the Yagyuu arc, Kondo had his mind set on being [Shinpachi Shimura](https://anilist.co/character/673)'s brother-in-law, even going as far as saying Shinpachi was the only one he could entrust the Shinsengumi to, much to Shinpachi's annoyance, answering that he doesn't give a damn about the Shinsengumi.

During his childhood, Kondo was a member of a dojo in Bushuu. There, he would soon meet Sougo and Toshiro, recruiting them both into his dojo. Kondo would later on take all the members with him and move from Bushuu to Edo in search for success, becoming what is now the Shinsengumi. Some characters in the series often call him "gorilla" due to his hirsute nature and although he is angered with this nickname, he sometimes uses the same word to identify himself. Kondo is loosely based on the historical Kondo Isami, famed for his role as commander of the Shinsengumi during the Bakumatsu period.

name: Nobume Imai
description:
Imai Nobume is a vice captain and part of the assassination unit of Mimawarigumi.

She is emotionless in her facial expression and speech. She is sadistic and likes to cut people down. According to [Isaburo](https://anilist.co/character/55579/Sasaki-Isaburo) when she switches into her assassin mode, she doesn't stop until she kills everyone in the vicinity. Her favorite food are donuts. She can becomes so obsessive about them, to the point where she uses violence to get them.

Nobume alongside [Kagura](https://anilist.co/character/674/Kagura) and [Princess Soyo](https://anilist.co/character/32214/Tokugawa-Soyo) are known as the "Sisterhood Sadist Three".

name: Tatsuma Sakamoto
description:
__Height:__ 181 cm

Sakamoto is a former member of the Joi. He is a good-natured man and optimistic to the point of being ridiculous, even in the most dangerous situations. His favorite phrase is "AHAHA! It must be _____". He also has a tendency to misspell names; he calls Gintoki "Kintoki". Gintoki often corrects him, citing that if he were named Kintoki, they would be in some kind of hentai anime (because 'Kin' from 'Kintoki' instead of 'Gin' would make the title 'Kintama', which means 'testicles' instead of 'Gintama', which means 'silver soul').  

Despite his goofy nature, Sakamoto is actually a successful businessman in the galaxy. He believes that business is a way of protecting his country. He has a private, well-equipped defensive business fleet. He believes that sacrifices should be made for the good of the community, which is why he chose to abandon his comrades on Earth to travel into space. Sakamoto is shown to be skilled with a pistol in an anime filler episode.

His name is based on the historical character Sakamoto Ryouma. He speaks in Tosa-ben, much like the inspiration for his character.

name: Sadaharu
description:
__Height:__ 170 cm  

Sadaharu has the outward appearance of a giant dog, but is actually an inugami. When sitting on his haunches, he is taller than most humans. He was left in front of Gintoki's apartment in a box that had "To Mr. Freelancer" written on it. Sadaharu chomps on anything smaller than itself, such as Gintoki's and other people's heads. Kagura seems to be the only one who can control him, for she has immense strength, though he chomps on her occasionally. Though he was dangerous when Gintoki first received him, he has become quite tame in the later episodes, and has helped the main characters in many occasions. He was named by Kagura, after her first pet, a rabbit which she accidentally killed while having a nightmare. He was originally owned by a pair of miko sisters, who initially called him Kamiko.  Recently, Sadaharu has impressed a yakuza's boss and receives permission to date his dog (whom Sadaharu himself has fallen in love for).

name: Tama
description:
__Height:__ 166 cm 

Tama is an android that was found by Gintoki. At the time she was only a disembodied head. She was given her name by Kagura, who was obsessed with eating egg on rice at the time. She is an android maid currently working at Otose's Snack House. When she isn't cleaning or serving Otose's customers, she often visits the Yorozuya Gin-Chan to collect rent.  Tama was originally an android created by Professor Hayashi to provide his sickly daughter with a companion. But when the professor tried to implant the personality of his daughter into Tama, the experiment killed his daughter in the process. Tama however, possesses the element known as the "Seed", allowing her to retain some of Fuyou's personality and making her capable of human emotions.  Even though Tama is an android, she is capable of human emotions. Her interactions with living human beings, however, often seem to be severely limited by her lack of knowledge of the outside world. This is due to a memory loss she already suffered before her initial introduction. As the series progresses, however, it seems that Tama learns more and more just from being around the Yorozuya Gin-Chan. She also seems to have some rather strange main functions, such as imitating the Dragon Quest RPG.

name: Kyuubei Yagyuu
description:
The successor to the Yagyuu family name, the daughter of [Koshinori Yagyuu](https://anilist.co/character/15581/) and the granddaughter of [Binbokusai Yagyuu](https://anilist.co/character/15580/).

They were brought up as a male, following the code of the Yagyuu clan, but in later years decided to follow neither femininity or masculinity, but live as only "Yagyuu Kyuubei." During their introduction, they tried to take [Tae Shimura](https://anilist.co/character/2944/) as their fiancee, though [Shinpachi](https://anilist.co/character/673/) and the rest stopped them from doing it. Yagyuu still has feelings for Tae, though they remained in friendly ties.

A genius swordsman; surpassing average swordsmen in skills, and is able to hold themself against veteran swordsmen, like [Toushirou Hijikata](https://anilist.co/character/2650/) and [Gintoki](https://anilist.co/character/672/).

name: Ayame Sarutobi
description:
__Height:__ 169 cm

Sarutobi Ayame is a ninja from the Oniwabanshuu by training, but is currently working as an assassin. She also has a part-time job at the Kunoichi Café.

Since her initial appearance, she has developed a serious obsessive infatuation with [Sakata Gintoki](https://anilist.co/character/672/Sakata-Gintoki), to the point of even stalking him. She is severely myopic, to the point of being almost blind (cannot tell living things from inanimate objects) without her eyeglasses. It was also hinted that she doesn't see well even with her eyeglasses on, as she once mistook [Kagura](https://anilist.co/character/674/Kagura) (dressed up as Gintoki) for Gintoki himself. However, this could solely be due to her infatuation with him. She has frequently clashed with [Otae](https://anilist.co/character/2944/Shimura-Tae) for various reasons.

Ayame has a playful attitude but gets serious when it comes to her work. She also seems to enjoy bondage and S&M. Although Gintoki is indifferent to her affections and even treats her badly most times (e.g throwing things at her whenever he senses her stalker presence), her 'M' or masochistic personality only makes her enjoy the punishment, and his 'cruelty' only serves to encourage her.

name: Tae Shimura
description:
__Height:__ 168 cm 

Tae Shimura is [Shinpachi](https://anilist.co/character/673)'s older sister. She runs the Kakidokan Dojo—which was her father's failing dojo—with her brother. She is usually addressed as "Otae"; the "O" is an honorific used to refer to women. [Kagura](https://anilist.co/character/674) always addresses her as "big sister" (anego). Despite her sweet face, she is one of the most violent characters in _Gintama_ (and arguably strong too).
